reviews.author: Danny M
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Melia Paradisus Palma Real - April 11-18 2025

Booked through Costco Travel with Air Transat Vacations

Flights: Air Transat was amazing and I (6'5") got the emergency exit for both legs (My wife as well). :)

Transfer: Costco includes private transfer and what a treat. To pass a line of 150 people and go directly to a comfortable minivan that whisked us to the resort in 20 minutes. Wow!

Garden view suite Reserved section

Check in: super fast efficient and easy. We never touched our bags and they were delivered to our rooms immediately.

Room service: Called at 11 pm and ordered a burger and Chicken nuggets. The burger was amazing and the nuggets were pure white meat but a bit doughy. Fries were warm. Food arrived in about 20 minutes.

This resort is the closest I have come to a 5 star. Everything seemed classier and we felt like royalty.

I contacted Alvaro Manuel at Reserved Guest Services before arriving and he ensured we had rooms on the second floor, that we were close to our friend who was travelling with us and that our first dinner reservation was made at Santé. He also made sure to come and see us during our stay and make sure we were happy.

Our butler, Harry was superb. He was so refined and personable. He noticed every detail and ensured all our reservations were made, delivered a bucket of ice every evening (usually with a bottle of quite good Chilean Merlot). He was constantly in communication  with us and sent us the reservation confirmation and the activity schedule every day. Such a pleasure. We will request him next time we stay at this resort.

Every single staff member at this resort was amazing. So professional and helpful and there was NEVER and expectation for a tip (although we tried to tip for every meal and service). You get what you give.

The resort is not too big and very walkable. Also very quiet and peaceful and well groomed.

Beach: groomed twice a day with a giant net in the ocean keeping the seaweed out. Plenty of super comfortable beach beds with 8 inch mattresses. Servers will usually follow you to the bed you want and clean it off, than place towels down and ask you for your first drink order. No silly towel rules, just go up to the hut and take what you need. NEVER had a trouble finding a nice comfortable beach bed, even after 10am.

Drinks: Bars are everywhere and getting service is never an issue. Ginger bar in the lobby does amazing coffees and specialty drinks. In the evening at the plaza there is a Mojito cart which does hand crafted specialty mojitos. The resorts frozen Pina Coladas are made with real pineapple and coconut.

Snack and drinks in room: the guys who replenish the room are great. Beer choice is Presidenté, Coors lite, Heiniken and Corona. Pop is Coke, Diet Coke or Sprite. Jus is orange or apple. Lots of still water and Perrier too. Nespresso coffee maker in room. Beach bags are very plush and include flip flops (not big enough for my size 16 feet).

Food: loved every restaurant but our favorite was Flora. Such a chill vibe and the food was amazing. Japanese was fun but the food is nothing special. Since we were Reserve, we went to Santé many times for breakfast and lunch. Both were excellent (omelettes, cappuccinos, fruit smoothies and much more). Lunch seemed to feature seafood like lobster, scallops, shrimp, etc and frequently and amazing beef tenderloin. Taco bar day was my favourite. The buffet was always great food but too noisy and chaotic for me. My tip is to sit outside at Kanna (great tacos and pulled pork) and get whatever food you like from the buffet. Ice cream at the buffet was really good. Friday is Dominican Day and the entire plaza is buzzing with vendors and food and drink.

We attempted to take the free/included catamaran trip but it was cancelled due to crappy weather. They provide towels and a snack BTW.

Workshops: 2 or more every day. We did several and they were free and fun. Go early since they fill up.

Nightly entertainment: Some sort of show every night. Nothing spectacular but always entertaining. Several nights had staff in costume taking pics with guest. Dance party outside the sports bar every night from 9 to 11pm.

Got some bug bites at night. My fault since I brought spray but didn't use it. If you don't bring enough sunscreen, you may have to sell a kidney to buy some at the resort store.

Shopping tip: We went to the downtown mall (Jumbo is amazing) and shopped at the 2 malls there. Uber to the mall was about $15 with tip. It was a fun rainy day activity.

Weather: rain forecasted everyday but really only rained one day. Umbrella in the room. 

Thanks again Harry for making our stay so relaxing. Reserved Section is the way to go, so deluxe.

reviews.author: Zarenna P
reviews.title: The good, the bad & the raw fish
reviews.text:
My partner and I, a couple from London, England, stayed at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa for 8 nights. The first thing to note if it is your first time visiting the Dominican Republic (DR) is that the entire Melia group hotels are together in one perfectly curated compound. On arrival we were stunned at the beauty and as far as hotels go in terms of aesthetic and amenities this does try to encapsulate it all.

We had originally booked the adults-only section with a king size bed, however, when we arrived, despite the front desk staff being polite, our first room was two double beds. We were told that we would have to remain in that room for the first night and would need to attend the front desk in the morning to see if our desired room was available. Fortunately, this was the case and we were moved that morning. In general, the resort is a pleasant all inclusive hotel which can cater for couples, families and friend groups. 

Dining: the hotel has one main buffet and 6 a la carte restaurants for regular guests which you can book in advance, whilst 'Reserve' guests have one extra buffet restaurant and 'Melia Circle' members have an exclusive a la carte restaurant. There is also a beach club with buffet/al a carte options. 

In general, the food varied between each restaurant. Notably, the best were Mina and Tokimeku. We would also like to thank Jean from Mina who was amazing in terms of service and who was one of the only members of staff who provided us with second drinks without being asked. The food at Mina was arguably the best with the most options and best ambience. We are not steak eaters so we were hesitant to eat here but after our experience at The Winery (see below) we enjoyed our second visit. We also ate twice at Tokimeku and loved their menu. There is the option for Hibachi dining which seemed like a lot of fun (something which we did not book). We would also like to deeply thank Romeris who is the head of Tokimeku and the breakfast service at the buffet. She is warm, friendly and attentive. She continually ensured we were well looked after and it was a pleasure to see her in the mornings. She is a credit to the team. 

The restaurants which were most disappointing were Flora, Blue Agave and Mascalzone:
Flora - this is said to be the Dominican restaurant, having not had Dominican food before, we were excited by the menu, however, when the meals came the "slider" was a piece of meat in some bread; the goat main was even worse - whilst in a tasty sauce, the quality of the goat meat was very poor and we were effectively served a bowl of fat and bones...a real mess of a dish. We also experienced the world's worst passionfruit "mojito", which was actually recommended. I can only describe it as a medicinal flavour with gone off mint leaves which was also made wrongly, so bad technique coupled with rubbish ingredients.  

Blue Agave - again, we love Mexican food so were excited to try here. We ordered the el pastor and fish tacos. The fish tacos were raw - the batter was not cooked which was fortunate as it fell off and revealed the raw fish beneath. My partner and I were not openly bothered but were surprised by the lack of interest in the fact that we had just been served raw fish and that it was not sushi. However, the el pastor taco was brilliant. Excellent flavour and well cooked so we ordered another plate of this. The churros were not freshly fried and tasted a little stale which was another disappointment, though not as life threatening as the fish. (1/10 for the food safety, great al pastor taco though).

Mascalzone - we were hesitant to try the Italian given our travels to Italy, and we were correct. This is an americanised italian restaurant. The meal started off positively with two very good appetisers, however, whilst we were still eating our appetisers, the mains arrived and were aggressively put on top of our starter plates. The mains consisted of an overly cheesed pizza which was supposed to be a diavola pizza but could have easily been an oven pepperoni as it lacked any sort of spice. However, the true horror was the pasta dish, which instead of being a tomato based sauce was more of a cheese sludge. The colour of the sauce was orange and it had so much cheese in it, it was gloopy. My partner refused to try it after I had struggled through two bites before admitting defeat. We opted for tiramisu for dessert and whilst it was an ok dessert it simply was not a tiramisu. The rushed service ruined dinner even further and is not necessary as there are plenty of tables. 2/10 unless you are a mouse or despise actual Italian food, when this would be for you!

The Buffet - we ate here every breakfast and most lunches, there were some occasions where food had not been cooked properly so, we started opting for vegetarian meals to be safe. This, of course, is not enjoyable and you do not go on holiday hoping that fish and meat is handled and cooked properly. There were, however, lots of great rotiserrie options, fresh fruit, ham and cheese stations, an american fried food area etc., though the true standouts were the morning egg/omelette stations in the morning with our favourite manned by Leudy, who made fantastic omelettes and was very cheerful. 

The Winery: this is a great concept, and was our favourite dining option. Our server was Jonathan who was excellent. You were required to purchase a bottle of wine or champagne (over a certain value) and then your default dinner was from Mina but you could opt to order from any other a la carte restaurant. The wine options were extensive with options from all over the world. The dinner service is calm and considered and the ambience is an excellent date night spot. As we wanted to try other restaurants, we sadly only came here once but if we were staying longer, this would have been our go to as it was, good wine, good food and great service - this was a 9/10 experience at the resort, especially compared to the other restaurants.

Service: The poolside service by Dilania in the adults only part of the main pool was phenomenal. She genuinely brightened up my day, she was always smiling, singing and happy. She was efficient, polite and a great joy to be around. We would also like to shout out the bar men at Celsius who were always singing, cheerful and made wonderful drinks. There was also one lady on breakfast and lunch in the buffet who was amazing as she was attentive and provided good service, however, we did not get her name as she wasn't as pushy as some of the others in obtaining reviews. The Rum Republic bar served the best evening drinks. 

The service by other members of staff varied, whilst staff were polite, we think the overall system at the buffet needs re-working. There was often a wait for cutlery or for tables to be cleaned. I think there needs to be more of a core group per section whereby you have a manager who greets guests and finds a suitable table, you then have the staff member who takes their drinks order and deals with this. You then have additional staff members who deal with clearing and cleaning in a quicker more efficient way. I also am not sure if there was a staff incentive to gain reviews as it suddenly became a little intense as the week went on. 

Spa: my partner treated me to a massage, given the hotel is a Spa resort. What was good is that if our hotel did not have availability you could use the other Melia hotel Spas. However, the cost of what is effectively a standard body massage is quite extorniate and unfortunately, once my massage had finished and I was led into the spa there was a group of very loud individuals despite signs saying "we honour silence" leading to me leaving promptly as this was not relaxing. Although the golf pricing is good value, the spa pricing was unnaturally high for what is marketed as a Spa and Golf resort, with no apparent reduction or subsidy for the services: Being from London it was premium pricing but not for much added value. Although we did get 30$ off a treatment over 50 minutes, the massage still came in at a whopping £105 (£125 without the discount) which is double London pricing. Whilst Ana Spa at Zel was lovely and my masseuse was lovely it was not worth the cost. 

Housekeeping: In general, it was ok, I would rate this a 5/10. Having stayed in a lot of 5* hotels, differing between B&B, half board & all inclusive, this was the worst and not for a lack of cleanliness, although they did not clean our mirror one day despite it clearly needing a proper wipe. It just seemed slightly lazy. Yes the towels were replaced but we do not think our bedding was. As I mentioned, the mirror wasn't cleaned. When we moved into the second room we had to request a second robe and a pair of slippers. Our items were cleaned around and not moved, cleaned and put back. That being said, it wasn't to say the room was dirty, it just didn't have that extra touch that one would expect in a 5* resort.

Other: there is one very expensive shop in the hotel which does sell most things you may have forgotten, but as mentioned previously, given the hotels are on one compound we are not sure how long or how much it would cost to go outside of this. When reviewing our expenditure, we had actually spent a significant amount on incidentals $47 than in The Winery $53. There is an ATM which charged us a 4.5% transaction fee. Tipping is pretty commonplace and we opted for between 1$ to 5$ depending on the service provided. 

Overall, we enjoyed our holiday and the good weather and people of the DR. I think this hotel is teetering in and out of providing 5* services and requires some changes to really elevate peoples' experiences. If it is the case that only Circle Members receive 5* service then the hotel overall should be downgraded to a 4*.

The Buffet offers a very nice variety of dishes that are different and the à la carte restaurants also offer different flavors of world cuisines. Just outside the Buffet restaurant, you can enjoy a barbecue every day with different options such as burger, chicken, steak. etc

The beach is incredibly beautiful, clean and pleasant to walk around or just stroll on the various umbrella chairs available to guests.

The adult section in particular offers a huge swimming pool with a bar where gatherings are pleasant.

The rooms are spacious, very clean, with all the accessories for comfort and pleasure (mini-bar refilled daily, bathrobe, clean towels, everything is spotless) Each room has its very functional temperature control for air conditioning.

Without any hesitation, I highly recommend this resort and would gladly return.

reviews.author: Jade Huguet
reviews.title: Not a 5-star experience - extremely disappointing stay
reviews.text:
We chose this resort expecting a true 5-star experience, especially because it had been renovated in the last 2 years. Unfortunately, it has been one of the most disappointing hotel stays we’ve had. From the moment we arrived, things started off disappointingly. We checked in at 3:00 PM and quickly realized that the sofa bed mattress in our room was completely unacceptable, you could feel every spring, making it impossible to sleep on. 
They knew we were 3 mothers. We reported this issue to the front desk around 5:00 PM before dinner and were assured it would be resolved. When we returned at 9:30 PM, exhausted from traveling, nothing had been done. 
Cockroach: The situation got worse when we discovered a large cockroach on the wall of our room. While we understand that insects can occasionally happen in tropical destinations, this is absolutely not acceptable in a hotel that claims to be 5-star. Even more concerning was the lack of urgency or proper response from staff when we reported it. We have photos documenting these issues, its not an exaggeration. We were told that “a” manager would contact us the following day at 10:00 AM. No such contact was made. We were instead obliged to follow up again, and only received a response at 3:22 PM the next day. This delay further demonstrates a lack of prompt and appropriate handling of the situation. The proposed alternative only included a room change within the same building.
The Melia will probably answer in this chat that they responded rapidly and with a nice offer. This is not true and I have WhatsApp chat to prove it. After2 days of discussion with them, meaning we had to fight for a proper upgrade, an additional “compensation” was offered, including access to a Bali bed, a 30-minute massage (only 2, and we were 3). These compensation are wholly inadequate given the circumstances. It does not compensate for the distress experienced, including the discomfort and concern associated with the presence of the insect, the repeated delays, the effort required to obtain responses, and the attitude displayed by your staff.
Lying to customer: At check-in, we requested to pay the USD 450 upgrade fee for access to “The Reserve” section. The front desk employee informed us that no availability remained. However, in parallel, I contacted the representative by email, who advised that rooms were indeed available and that we should present ourselves accordingly. This inconsistency raises concerns regarding the accuracy of the information provided and the overall standard of customer service.
Additional hidden fees: To make matters worse, the next morning we were told that if we wanted beach chairs with an ocean view, we would need to pay an additional fee. Charging extra for basic beach access in an all-inclusive resort, especially at this price point, is simply unacceptable.
Overall, the service, responsiveness, and quality of the experience do not match the level this hotel advertises. At this price, guests should not have to deal with uncomfortable sleeping arrangements, hygiene concerns, and constant upselling. We strongly recommend future travelers to reconsider before booking here, as this property does not deliver on its promises.
We believe that transparency is important, and as such, we intend to accurately report our experience. Note that I have not uploaded all WhatsApp conv. But did upload the insect photo.  

Overall, the resort offers excellent food, the buffet is varied and high quality, and the steakhouse is outstanding. However, the wine selection is disappointing, and the à la carte options are priced at an excessive markup.
More importantly, the overall management approach at the Melia property feels lacking. There is a clear absence of follow-up and accountability, which gives the impression that issues are left unresolved in the hope that guests will simply move on. For example, a meaningful room upgrade could likely have mitigated the impact of the first night and improved the rest of the stay, rather than having to deal with ongoing discomfort.
The so-called “upgrades” offered (such as a short massage or access to a Bali bed with additional hidden fees) feel superficial and do not reflect the level of service expected from a resort of this category. In higher-quality resorts such as Club Med, more substantial gestures are typically made to address guest concerns and make them come back. This contrast gives the impression that Melia prioritizes revenue without delivering a comparable level of service in return.

reviews.author: benjaminfarkas2026

reviews.author: Paradise89522
reviews.title: Inmejorable
reviews.text:
Nuestra estancia en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort fue, sencillamente, inolvidable. El entorno es espectacular, con unas instalaciones cuidadas al mínimo detalle que invitan al descanso y al disfrute desde el primer momento. Todo está pensado para ofrecer una experiencia de auténtico lujo en el Caribe.
Sin embargo, lo más destacable vuelve a ser, sin duda, el equipo humano. En el restaurante Blue Agave, Virtudes nos hizo sentir especialmente bienvenidos, con un trato cercano, atento y siempre pendiente de que todo estuviera perfecto. En Olio, Gabriel destacó por su profesionalidad y su excelente atención, haciendo que cada visita fuera un auténtico placer. Y en Flora, Starling nos sorprendió con su dedicación y amabilidad, cuidando cada detalle para que la experiencia fuera redonda.
Queremos hacer también una mención muy especial a Marc, cuya atención y compromiso con los huéspedes marcan realmente la diferencia. Gracias a él, nuestra estancia fue aún más cómoda y memorable.
En resumen, un hotel que lo tiene todo: instalaciones de primer nivel, gastronomía excelente y, sobre todo, un equipo humano que hace que quieras volver.

reviews.author: yoli
reviews.title: 100% recomendable, paraíso puro!
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort ha sido simplemente espectacular. Desde el primer momento, el hotel impresiona por sus instalaciones impecables, su entorno paradisíaco y la calidad de todos sus servicios. Es el lugar perfecto para relajarse y disfrutar de unas vacaciones inolvidables.
Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es el trato excepcional de su personal. En el restaurante Blue Agave, queremos destacar especialmente a Virtudes, quien nos atendió con una amabilidad y profesionalidad increíbles, siempre pendiente de cada detalle. En Olio, Gabriel nos brindó un servicio impecable, combinando cercanía y eficiencia de una forma extraordinaria. Y en Flora, Starling hizo que cada momento fuera perfecto gracias a su atención y dedicación.
Por supuesto, no podemos dejar de agradecer a Marc por todo. Su implicación y atención constante hicieron que nuestra estancia fuera aún más especial.
Sin duda, recomendamos este hotel al 100%. Una experiencia de lujo donde, además de las instalaciones, el trato humano es simplemente inmejorable. ¡Volveremos seguro!

reviews.author: Rose A
reviews.title: Friends getaway
reviews.text:
My friend and I had an amazing week. We stayed in the reserve section. I emailed ahead to ask for two beds and that was accommodated. I also was able to have them book the next nights dinner as we arrived very late and I didn't want to look after that next morning. Our butler Basilio was good, He did what was asked of him. No issues, we made contact daily as needed via WhatsApp. Our favorite bartenders was Marcus and Junior, We met at their bar daily around 4:00pm for our start of day drink. No ask was too much. Always a smile. Thank you guys... We loved our pool view room and the rocking chairs on the balcony was a big hit. We loved it in the evening while we laughed and had a couple of drinks before getting ready for dinner. All ala cart restaurants was great, we enjoyed the steak as our best. But all very good. We accidentally left our safe open and there was a polite note stuck in the locked safe that they found it open and locked it and we needed to call to have it open. NOTHING was missing. As for someone writing a review to say someone stole 100.00 out of your safe I find that very hard to believe. I tested this resort with a friend as I am somewhat picky and I loved it. In fact my hubby and I, along with another couple are going to go for 2 weeks in Sept because of the great week I had. 
The beds on the beach is awesome, so comfy. I loved the lounge chairs too so you could go from full sun to shade when required. A couple bars ran out of grey goose vodka a few times which was annoying because I book specialty or reserve for that reason. I don't drink a lot but do expect what I pay for, That would be my only thing to mention, please keep your bars stocked to accommodate what your guests pay for. I look forward to coming back in Sept. I will email prior to coming to let you know when. Thank you Paradisus and thank you also to Odeht to responding to my emails and booking my first dinner reservation. It was appreciated..... See you soon...Rose and Sheri.....

reviews.author: Ash C
reviews.title: Reported Missing Money, No Resolution Provided
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort from April 15–19 2026 and unfortunately had a concerning experience. On April 17, $100 was taken from our in-room safe. We immediately reported it to the front desk, and a team was sent to investigate. However, we were later told that, according to their records, the safe had remained locked and therefore no theft had occurred.

What was frustrating is that our claim was essentially dismissed, leaving us without any resolution. After this incident, I looked through other guest reviews and noticed several similar reports about missing money from safes, which raised additional concerns.

I recommend that future guests be extra cautious with valuables and not rely solely on the in-room safe. Based on our experience, issues like this may not be acknowledged or resolved.

This is a picture of "Angel" processing our report which got us no where :(

reviews.title: Nice hotel but don't reserve the Kanna Beach Club or Bali Bed Experience!
reviews.text:
The hotel is lovely, the beach was great. Food was good but make sure to make reservations as far ahead of time as possible for availability. There were fun daytime activities (yoga, pilates, dancing, hat making, Dominican doll painting, etc). Nighttime entertainment was mediocre (mostly music and dance shows- one night had a circus-like performance)- seating is not great for watching the shows and quality of the performances were just ok.
The biggest negative I had is that I paid for the Kana Beach Club Experience, that was supposed to include reserved Bali Beds and food and beverage service. However, no one at the hotel was ever able to help me use this service I paid for. There was never anyone at the kiosk where they told me to check in for the service and find out what day I could use the service (apparently I wouldn't get to choose for myself). I spoke with the concierge and the front desk a few times during my stay and was not able to make any progress in using this service. Everyone was very kind and seemed like they wanted to help, but never did actually help.
In the end, it was not a big deal and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. But I would like a refund of the money I spent on a service I did not receive. I was told by the concierge and again at check-out that I would be refunded but have not heard back. 
Pro-tip: Bring an insulated water bottle!!! You can get it filled with ice once or twice a day and keep cold water on hand all day.

reviews.author: Guilherme M
reviews.title: Be carefull before booking this place
reviews.text:
Hotel is overrated. The price charged is completely unrealistic for what it offers. Upon arrival, the guy who took our luggage to the room left angry and slammed the door because he didn’t receive a tip. The room was supposed to be for a honeymoon from the start, but they gave us a room with two single beds and did not allow us to change it—unless we paid an extra $800.
There’s no coconut water, no freezers around the resort to grab drinks freely. There’s no ice cream. There’s no heated pool. It was hard to even find a bar that had food. You have to order food and wait for it to be prepared, sometimes taking more than 20 minutes.
I tried to book a restaurant for dinner, but there was no availability—not even for the next day. And the restaurants don’t allow reservations more than two days in advance. I went to get a beer at the beach kiosk, and they said my reservation didn’t cover beach beer. I went to another bar to get wine, but the wines are extremely expensive (yes, they charge for wine at an “all-inclusive” resort).
The room amenities are low quality. Liquid soap. There’s no music, no parties, no shows. It claims to be adults-only, but there are lots of children. Food service is only available at certain hours at the buffet (the only place with food for those who couldn’t get restaurant reservations). I asked for a Corona at a bar, and they said I wasn’t entitled to it. For a coconut or a Redbull you must pay U$$5 extra for each one. The beer is warm and far to get one. ALL inclusive total fake news.
This is the worst all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to.

reviews.author: Shaun B
reviews.title: Overall, a good week
reviews.text:
The positive: The hotel is very large, with immaculate grounds and excellent presentation.  Overall, the staff are very friendly and ready to help.  We stayed in the adults-only section, The Reserve, which has several pristine pools.  It was generally much quieter than the rest of the resort and was always clean. 

One of the advantages of being in that location is the assignment of a personal concierge.  We were fortunate enough to work with Christopher Rivera, a shining star!  He took care of our room issues (see below), booked our restaurant meals, and generally filled in a few gaps.  He was unfailingly cheery, communicative, and very professional.  I cannot say enough about what he added to our holiday. 

The beach is walkable white sand, and there seem to be plenty of loungers for everyone. I’m sure the swimming is fine, but it was very windy during our stay and the water was rough.  The food is good and varies from restaurant to restaurant. Of the ones we tried, Mina (the steakhouse) was our favourite. There is a large three-meals-per-day buffet available to all guests, offering more options than you could possibly desire.  And in The Reserve, there is a private breakfast and lunch buffet area around the pool which offered a smaller, quieter, but delicious option. 

There is no evening “show” at this resort, but there is usually some form of musical entertainment.  Unfortunately, bad weather can cancel those events as they take place in an open-air location.  A shout-out to Luis and his crew at the sports bar, too.  They always managed to find the Blue Jays games for us on at least one of the tv’s.

The negative: It’s possible that our room was unique, but the door lock, safe, refrigerator, and hot water in our room all required some maintenance/attention when we arrived.  The rooms are large and clean, with all the amenities you might expect.  One of the beds in our room appeared to be quite new and firm, the other less so.  These inconsistencies lead me to suggest this is a solid 4-star resort rather than a 5.  

Also, a word of warning – the bathrooms have no walls.  The bathroom area is separated from the main room by a gauzy curtain.  The sinks and tub sit in the open, with a glass-doored shower and a toilet with a door alongside.  If you are travelling with a friend, colleague, or family member with whom you do not wish to share so openly, this hotel is not for you.  There are also sound and light issues if one person gets up through the night.  

There is also no place to easily change money on site (although many guests ask).  One has to take a cart over to the nearby casino in order to exchange money in its secure area.

Finally – and this is regarding Air Canada Vacations rather than the resort – the ACV rep was entirely absent throughout our stay.  He didn’t show up for the arrival briefing, and he didn’t respond to texts.  I ended up having to contact head office for basic departure information.  We were told by some of the other travel reps that this was not the first time this had happened.  ACV needs to do better by its customers in that regard.

reviews.text:

Special shoutout to Yuderi in the beach area who has made each of my 3 stays incredible. Remembers his guests each time and is a very special human being - look forward to seeing you next time bro.

reviews.author: Nina S
reviews.title: Awful oceanfront room and terrible service
reviews.text: Went with my husband & 1 child for spring break. We are Circle Melia members. While the hotel is very pretty from the outside and right on the beach, which is gorgeous, unfortunately our room and concierge service was awful. The room (Junior Suite oceanfront) was very old and in desperate need of refurbishing. Room was clean but super old and parts were really gross and absolutely need replacing (see pics). I did report that to management. Apparently, they told us that most of the rooms in the hotel have been refurbished but not our building! The concierge was the worst I've experienced with Melia. The job is make sure we have all our reservations for dinner and to ask us what we need and to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. It was the complete opposite of that. I had to go into the Circle office to confirm the remainder of our dinner reservations and a birthday cake for my husband as our concierge did nothing as far as I can tell. We were not informed of the Circle activities (that are included in our cost) until 2 days into the trip and only after I asked.  We only got to do one activity, and the concierge did not tell us where to go at the sister hotel where it was so we had to ask upon arrival and we were late. I had to go back and forth on What's App texting needlessly (Melia's preferred system of communication for the concierge) to get confirmations done for dinners when I'm supposed to be relaxing by the pool. The room didn't have the bed we asked for (king) and it didn't have the welcome package in the room. Nothing special for our child. Nothing special at all for the price! We got the economy service and a terrible room for a first class price. We will likely not be returning to this hotel.

reviews.author: VTHarv
reviews.title: Very clean, well maintained resort with Pleasant Staff
reviews.text: This was our second trip here in the past year. We really enjoy this resort and the staff is outstanding.  The resort is clean and spacious.  The beach staff was excellent and kept us hydrated everyday and made sure we got a umbrella on the front row every morning.  We became almost like friends by the end of the trip.  The breakfast buffet is unreal with an option for everyone.  The breakfast staff was awesome Yanira and Rosanna were or waitresses last trip and and again this trip.  They remembered us from our previous trip and picked up where we left off.  My only gripe is that the resort needs either more restaurants or they need to enlarge what they have.  If it weren't for our concierge (we stayed on the Reserve side) working his butt off to get us reservations, i don't know that we would have been able to get in to any of the restaurants.  There were only 3 of us in our group and we were told all of the restaurants (with the exception of Sante' on Reserve side) were fully booked every night of our stay and that reservations were full.  Luckily our concierge worked to get us into 3 of the restaurants.  This is a great resort and we will be back.  Just hope they fix the restaurant issues.

reviews.title: Great vacation spot, highly recommended
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa resort for 10 days and had a great time. Our concierge Christopher was great. He checked in with us several times a day and made sure we had reservations for dinner each night. He always made sure we had everything we needed. If we had any issues, the staff dealt with it immediately to make sure we were happy.

Junior at the bar next to the pool in the adult only reserve section close to the beach was the best bartender and makes the best banana mammas I ever had.

The staff was nice and friendly, the room was so nice and new and the beach in front of the resort was beautiful.

Most of the food was great. When it wasn't great, it was just not what I expected being from another country, for example tiger shrimp is quite large in Canada, but here, was much smaller and very salty.

We golfed 5 rounds which broke up the trip nicely and we never got bored. Even after being there for 10 days, we didn't want to leave when it was time to go. Usually at the end of 10 days, we're ready to go home but would have been happy to stay a few more days.

reviews.title: Disappointed is an understatement
reviews.text:
We are here now for my husband’s 50th birthday trip and the experience so far has been pretty awful, I honestly wish we could just switch hotels. Firstly, the building they put us in had no elevators and my mom is handicap. They gave us rooms on the 3rd floor. We ended up needing to upgrade to swim up suites for an extra $1200 just to get floor level rooms. We were also charged a $30 early check in fee, which made no sense to me, and the guy at the desk made us pay in cash saying the credit card machine was down and then I’m pretty sure I saw him just pocket the cash. Lastly, it’s impossible to make a dinner reservation for our first night here, and nearly impossible to make reservations for the rest of our nights here. We had to settle for 8:30pm reservations at whatever restaurants were available the remaining nights (not necessarily the restaurants we actually want to eat at). 

If the experience doesn’t change soon, I will never come to a melia resort again and I definitely won’t recommend to anyone. It’s such a shame because the resort itself is very beautiful, and some of the staff we have met (Emmanuel specifically) have been very helpful to us.

reviews.author: NewYorkPresa
reviews.title: Very disappointed once again
reviews.text:
We have been coming to Palma Real since it opened. We visit a few times each year with our family and our employees, and during the first year after opening the hotel was truly special. The service was kind and attentive, the staff felt genuine, the food was fresh and high quality, and the rooms were always clean and ready—everything felt like a real top hotel.
But honestly, it’s not like that anymore. And it’s been really disappointing to see how much things have changed.
Room check-in delays and missing items
We also had issues with our room and check-in. On our second stay this year, the room was not prepared for our arrival, and the check-in process had constant delays.
We requested an extra bed for our child, and it took many hours and requests to five different people. We finally received the bed at 9:00 PM, but it came without pillows and without a cover. The room was also missing basic things like robes, slippers, an iron, and lotions.
Lack of entertainment
Another big change we noticed is the lack of entertainment and weekly repetitive of the same entrainment. In the past, there was more to do and more atmosphere. This time, it felt quite limited and not what we expected from the hotel.
Evening dinner reservations are very difficult
We also found it extremely difficult to reserve evening diners. Availability to book restaurants for dinner was very limited, and it was hard to get reservations—even when we tried ahead of time.
Food concerns
One of the problem for us recently has been the food as well. Several times it didn’t seem fresh, and we noticed it with items that had a bad smell (especially fish). We mentioned this to the chef, and we were really concerned about guests getting sick.
We also noticed that some food (like chicken and beef) seemed old and dry, and then it was mixed back into sauce to make it look and taste “okay” again.
The situation that made us most uncomfortable was what we saw in front of us. The chef took shrimp that didn’t look the same, quickly toasted them in sauce, and mixed them with other shrimp, then seemed to look around to make sure no one noticed. When he saw me, he quickly disappeared.
I’m sharing this because food should not be handled in a way that could affect guests’ health.
I’m writing because I genuinely want Palma Real to return to the level it used to be. It’s hard to explain how disappointing this experience has become, especially since we used to really love staying here.

reviews.author: elianasaranibar
reviews.title: No era lo que esperaba
reviews.text:
Este hotel pertenece a la misma cadena que el anterior donde me hospedé, pero dentro del mismo complejo. Primero estuve en el otro hotel y luego me trasladé a este, que supuestamente ofrecía una categoría superior, específicamente en el sector solo para adultos.
La expectativa era tener un mejor nivel de servicio, incluyendo beneficios como playa exclusiva y atención más personalizada, pero lamentablemente esto no se cumplió. El servicio de playa exclusivo nunca estuvo disponible.
Además, este tipo de categoría incluye servicio de concierge, cuya función es acompañar al huésped para hacer su estadía más placentera (reservas, recomendaciones, seguimiento, etc.). En mi caso, la experiencia fue muy mala. El concierge asignado tuvo una atención prácticamente nula: no hubo seguimiento, ni interés, ni propuestas. Solo se limitó a realizar reservas de restaurantes. Incluso, noté una gran diferencia con otros concierges que sí estaban muy atentos a sus huéspedes. El último día, envió un mensaje de despedida al cual respondí y nunca obtuve respuesta.
En cuanto al hotel, se trata de una estructura antigua, parcialmente remodelada, pero aún se percibe como un edificio viejo. La habitación tenía un fuerte olor a humedad, lo cual resulta bastante incómodo.
Como punto positivo, destaco la gastronomía, que fue excelente en todos los restaurantes. En especial, el restaurante italiano, que realmente se destaca.
Por este motivo, mi calificación es intermedia: la comida eleva la experiencia, pero el servicio y las condiciones del hotel están lejos de lo esperado para esta categoría.

reviews.author: Tork0818
reviews.title: Service & Food
reviews.text:
I contacted the resort ahead of time after hearing concerns about service and difficulty getting restaurant reservations. I was seriously considering canceling and booking elsewhere, but I was assured that everything would be taken care of for both our group and our in-laws.

Unfortunately, that was not the case. Reservations were made for us but not for our in-laws, and by the time we realized this, nothing else was available. As a result, we weren’t able to use the reservations at all, which was extremely frustrating and disappointing.

We also had a concierge assigned to us, but despite multiple requests, not a single one was followed through on. This added to the overall lack of service we experienced throughout our stay.

We even booked a spa service at check-in, but when we arrived for our appointment, there was no record of our reservation. That was another frustrating example of the lack of organization and communication.

For the amount we spent, the experience was nowhere near worth it. In addition to the reservation issues, the service overall was very poor, and the food at the buffet was especially disappointing.

The only highlight of our trip was the beach experience, which was excellent. If it weren’t for that, the trip would have been a complete disappointment.

reviews.author: Giorgia A
reviews.title: Paradise in paradise!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. From the very moment we set foot on the property we were well attended to and so impressed by the grounds and hotel aesthetic. We booked on the Reserve side which meant we had a separate reception where we were welcomed with a glass of bubbly, as well as a small buffet for if you’re feeling peckish. We were able to access all the hotel facilities whilst we waited for our room, including the restaurants etc.
I would definitely recommend booking the Reserve side if you are an Adults Only party. The pools and beach area was fabulous, as well as access to Santé (adults only restaurant). However, in general the hotel did not feel overcrowded or too “childish” though there were families. And though it felt exclusive, it did not feel exclusionary which I personally liked. The on the beach location was incredible, I would not want to go without it, the beach itself is gorgeous and well maintained, with plenty of sun loungers and beds.

The food at the hotel in general was of a decent standard, I particularly liked the buffet and à la carte at Santé, as well as Flora. Overall nothing to scream home about but decent enough with decent quality. We also took full advantage of the Nespresso spot and the cafeteria upstairs. Another nice touch was a bbq by the Reserve pools during the day, with freshly grilled meat and even lobster! They would also have live musical entertainment. I was in love with their piña colada slushies and had plenty of those by the hand of Gilberto at the beach bar. In general they are quick with the beverage service which is great. One small note is the bars could be open a little later on the beach/by the pools.  

The entertainment options at the hotel were very varied and unique! Our favourites were the Aerial yoga and the bike ride around the Melia grounds, genuinely loved both! I wish the aerial class could be a bit longer. We also enjoyed the Pole class. Sadly we didn’t get a chance to try the coconut oil making or the coffee making but I know those would be so fun, particularly due to the staff facilitating. We also missed the catamaran tour - they need to do it more often! The nightly entertainment was also cute and fun, it got everyone engaged and dancing. In general there’s a lot of dancing a good vibes throughout the day/evening which we loved. There are so many to name but the staff do an amazing job at keeping good vibes and friendliness throughout the resort, big gracias to Fernando, Johan, Carlos and the rest of the entertainment team, including the boys in blue!

In general the rooms were a very good size and very clean from the start, they have all the amenities you would need. They do a turndown service which was a nice touch. The beds are relatively comfortable and other than hearing the occasional other guest, we felt like it was quiet at night. We did find that the daily cleaning could be more thorough however, it seemed they would dispose of the bins and then do a quick sweep of the place. We understand the cleaning staff work very hard and have a lot of rooms to clean, but a slightly more thorough clean would’ve been appreciated where possible. The general resort however is spotless and smells lovely as soon as you arrive (this includes the pools/beach/restaurants). You can tell they work very hard to maintain it.

We were introduced to our Concierge Eriol at check in, he was very friendly from the start, gave us a tour of the hotel and Reserve area. He gave us his number so we could WhatsApp him with any questions, and quickly asked us to tell him which restaurants we would like to book for the evenings we were there. He also sent us a list of the daily activities going on in the hotel which was very helpful and was always on hand to answer any doubts. Additionally he surprised us with a bottle of wine during our stay to our room. The hotel provide a courtesy room for guests who are leaving on the final day post check out but this was fully booked when we needed it. However, Eriol was able to book us individual courtesy rooms in the spa instead which was extremely helpful. He’s a great concierge, thank you Eriol!

As said, our overall stay was amazing, we did not want to leave! It is a very well set up resort, with great attention to detail, very clean, stunning location with very friendly and helpful staff. Considering the price compared to others, it was definitely worth it. Our own paradise in the paradise that is DR. Thank you again!

P.s. for those complaining about staff not speaking English, you’re in a Spanish speaking country and I guarantee they are trying their best - get over yourselves!

reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Nos hemos alojado una semana por segundo año consecutivo en la zona The Reserve del Paradisus Palma Real. La zona exclusiva del hotel es más tranquila que el resto, elegante y con una atención buenísima. Las habitaciones muy cómodas y grandes, con colchón dream maker de gran tamaño y cuidada decoración. Nuestro concierge, Kelvin, nos hizo la estadía si cabe más agradable por su esmerada atención. De los restaurantes destacaría el de comida dominicana, Flora, que nos sorprendió gratamente. reviews.author: Julie D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort Dominican Republic – March 22 to 29, 2026
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort
Dominican Republic – March 22 to 29, 2026

We stayed at this 4.4-star rated resort and had a very enjoyable overall experience. The property is beautiful, very well maintained, and the service is excellent. The quality of the food is exceptional—probably the best we have had while traveling, both at the buffet and in the à la carte restaurants.

Upon our late arrival on Sunday evening, we were initially given a room with two double beds instead of queen beds, which was uncomfortable for two adults. However, we were able to move to a room with a king bed the next day. It is worth noting that the bed was very firm.

We had access to three à la carte restaurants. We highly recommend booking as early as the morning after your arrival, as reservations are in high demand. We chose the Italian, the steakhouse, and the Japanese restaurant, and the food was excellent. Special mention for the Japanese restaurant: although it is marketed as a “show,” the experience is more of a U-shaped table with a chef in the center. There is no menu choice, but the dish (stir-fry with shrimp, chicken, and steak) is delicious.

A downside concerns the “hospitality room” service at departure. It was poorly organized, with only one room available, to be reserved the same morning. We recommend reserving immediately upon waking. Our time slot was from 5:00 to 5:30 a.m., but we were interrupted several times (by staff and other guests who thought they had the same reservation). Additionally, our luggage was left unattended, which is concerning—especially with the presence of a CPAP device. This situation was frustrating and marred the end of an otherwise very successful stay. We reported the issue to reception.

The facilities (shops, café, restaurants) are grouped in the same covered area, which is very convenient in case of rain—no umbrella needed. Shows take place in the same open-air area, with an indoor option available in case of rain, including bar service. Organization is excellent, and the decoration is tasteful.

The beach is well supervised by hotel security, but less so by local authorities. Vendors are numerous and sometimes persistent, which can reduce comfort. However, it is easy to find a spot without having to reserve early in the morning, and all chairs have umbrellas. The area is also well suited for children.

The main pool is calmer but the water is quite cold. The adults-only pool is heated (around 90°F), clean, and not crowded. However, service there is slower and less attentive.

In summary: an excellent choice for couples and families with young children. Less recommended for families with teenagers. We leave with wonderful memories. Considering the pros and cons, we preferred this resort over Dreams Onyx, which we visited last year.

reviews.author: Lenin G
reviews.title: A stay in paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus is an amazing experience. Staff is friendly and accommodating. The hospitality is superb. Blue Agave restaurant is top notch and Delvin was the best waiter. Ariel was the best butler, making sure our stay was as comfortable as possible.

reviews.author: zebrah_c
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Spent one week at the Reserve Adults only section.  Food was great.  Staff were very friendly and helpful in all areas.  Easy to get sun and shade on the beach at any time of day and the staff were quick to assist getting towels to cover the sunbeds and coming around often to get drink orders.  Food was great.  We did not try any of the buffets in other restaurants.  Sante, the reserve restaurant was so good we ate there every day for breakfast and lunch.  Flora had melt in your mouth ribs.  Blue agave and the pizza/pasta place were good.  The steakhouse was a bit hit and miss but that could happen anywhere.  Drinks were fabulous.  Margaritas, martinis and mimosas.  We had a swim up suite so no issues with getting chairs by the pool but there were empty chairs available (perhaps we went on a quiet week?).  Our concierge, Emmanuel was always quick to respond to us and made sure we were satisfied with our stay.  Overall an amazing week.  We will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: TishB81
reviews.title: Disappointed......
reviews.text:
I would say that the ONLY positive experience we had was a gentleman by the name of Martin who worked at the reserve section pool and private beach.  He made us feel heard and looked after us every single day.  This was the highlight of our trip.  This man deserves to be management as his customer service and attention to detail was amazing not to mention he never stopped, he was always working and always with a kind gesture or smile on his face.

All else was terrible including the concierge in the reserve section that did absolutely nothing to help us with anything that pertained to our trip.  

Even after we advised him that my mother in law was allergic to the feather pillows he still did NOTHING to help us.  I don't normally write reviews but considering we paid ALOT for this trip we were very disappointed.

This was my husbands first time in DR and he really doesn't want to go back and its too bad because I have been to many other resorts in the DR far less expensive that had much better service.

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: PROBABLY WON'T RETURN
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, there was total chaos at the front desk. There were 4 in my group, and 2 arrived approx 2 hours before the rest of us  and still had not gotten their room key. 3 of us reserved swim up King rooms and there were only 2 available. The mini bar was not stocked and the snacks  were stale.

The grounds are an 8 out of 10 but the service was not what you would expect from a 4 Diamond rated resort.

Initially when we tried to make dinner reservations we were told all the  restaurants were booked  thru Sunday..mind you we arrived on Wednesday.  We had to reach out to a gentleman named Antonio who went out of his way to get us reservations. Baffles me how a person could say the restaurants were all booked for dinner but you are checking guests in. THANK GOODNESS FOR HIM.  Also, Jose Rameriaz was also very helpful during our stay. THANKS JOSE! 
The food was nothing to brag about and was average. All guest have to eat  breakfast at one location unless you are club members..I  assume they have other options.
Additionally,  I  would suggest arranging your own transportation to and from the airport as the resort has no dedicated transportation service.
I don't know if this review will elicit a response and I really don't want to hear back from the resort. I WILL JUST SAY THAT THE CUSTOMER SERVICE NEEDS TO DRASTICALLY IMPROVE ESPECIALLY AT THE FRONT DESK. ONCE AGAIN, THANKS TO JOSE AND ANTONIO FOR THEIR EFFORTS

reviews.author: Arturo S
reviews.title: Una Experiencia Maravillosa
reviews.text: Nuestra visita al Paradisus Palma Real en Punta cana ha sido fantástica una experiencia cinco estrellas de principio a fin nos quedamos en el área exclusiva sólo para adultos (The Reserve) al llegar te reciben en un Lobby privado donde te hacen tu checking al Hotel, te asigna a un mayordomo (en nuestro caso fue Basilio) que te va a acompañar durante toda la estadía y te va a apoyar con reservas preguntas dudas en todo momento Luego te designan a una área exclusiva del Resort con piscina exclusiva para los miembros de la zona adultos y también en la playa tenemos nuestras propias camas y servicio directo al las camas donde estamos en la playa sin necesidad de levantarte para pedir un trago la atención 10 de 10 Todo ha sido espectacular. los restaurantes a la carta todos fueron fantásticos la atención del personal también la limpieza ha sido maravillosa la habitación que nos has tocado nos hospedamos en una suite Junior con vista directa o acceso directo a la piscina el cual fue increíble un mini bar que era rellenado cada día con todo lo que necesitábamos servicio a la habitación 24 horas Estamos complacidos con lo maravilloso que ha sido este Hotel y volveríamos sin ninguna duda lo recomiendo a toda persona que esté buscando un Resort en Punta cana.

reviews.author: Shawn K
reviews.title: Not a four diamond resort as advertised
reviews.text:
The resort itself is so beautiful and breathtaking - beach, pools and open spaces. However the food doesn’t match the level of the resort.  It’s just plain bad and not edible. There are a lot of options but nothing is good.  The beef doesn’t taste like beef, salad leaves are wilted, and the seafood is so overcooked & fishy.    We expected the buffet to be not good but the restaurants aren’t even better.  And this resort is supposed to be 4 diamonds.  

Some notable cons:
There are too many commissioned locals going around trying to sell you excursions and DR souvenirs. The same people go around throughout the day and asking you over and over again despite having said we are not interested.  

People take your sunscreen so don’t leave them lying around. I should expected this since they charge $34 for a 6oz spray at the gift shop.

Unless you staying at the Reserve section or paying for concierge service, getting reservation at the restaurants is nearly impossible. We had to tip our ‘unofficial’ concierge $50 to get reservations for the entire week. Since the buffet food is so not edible, this was worth it. But this should not have been the norm, especially since the restaurant was half empty around 6pm. The resort may be doing this purposely to get more people to eat at the buffet. Again the restaurants wasn’t that much better than the buffet but at least the restaurant food was edible.

Lastly, housekeeping took our housekeeping tips without actually cleaning the room and restocking the items. We had to bring this up with someone each day to get water, towels and toilet paper restocked.

We will not be coming back to this resort but what a shame, the resort is so nice and had great resort activities.

reviews.author: JorgeC
reviews.title: No está a la altura de lo esperado en Meliá
reviews.text:
Soy cliente Platinum Meliá y hago más de 50 noches de hotel al año solo en Meliá. 

Segunda vez en este hotel y misma mala experiencia. La primera vez le di otra oportunidad por ser post pandemia, pero esta vez será la última que vengo a este hotel que no está a la altura de otros Melia.

A pesar de ser abogado en The Reserve muy mal servicio desde el check in, al que se llega a través de pasillos estrechos de habitaciones para hacerlo en “privado”, la atención del personal, la comida y restaurantes como siempre un lío para reservar y pésimo servicio. 

Todo a base de propinas para tener un mejor servicio. 

Pido late check out hasta las 14:00 con la tarjeta platinum pues que no. (El hotel no está completo
Esta noche ni mucho menos, aunque no depende de eso al ser platinum) pues que no, que por ser Reserve a la una pero a las 14:00 que no. A un compañero de viaje siendo plata si le dejan y sin estar en Reserve. 

Nos dicen el primer día que no consta el pago de la agencia que lo iban a comprobar, al día siguiente nos dicen que está todo ok, y al hacer el check out que no, que no está pagado y que hay que pagar y nos cobran mucho más que lo que teníamos con la agencia. Eso sí, avisan el domingo cuando la agencia está cerrada. 

La verdad es que muy bajo el nivel comparado con otros hoteles de la zona. Sobre todo a nivel atención y servicio. 

Lo dicho, si vienes con familia y niños pues ni tan mal, pero si buscas la más mínima atención y exclusividad no la tendrás y pagarás como si lo tuvieses que es lo peor 

Espero que esto ayude a otros viajeros a tomar mejores decisiones sobre sus viajes.

reviews.author: Miguel Clase
reviews.title: Muy buena experiencia, con un evento negativo

reviews.author: Sonia F
reviews.title: Paraíso dominicano
reviews.text: Magnífico hotel situado sobre una espectacular playa. Nos alojamos en una Master suite, habitación muy amplia, con salón independiente y vistas al mar. Los restaurantes de calidad, tanto el buffet como los restaurantes a la carta. La zona The Reserve (solo adultos) un oasis de paz, con varias piscinas, zona exclusiva en la playa con camas balinesas y experiencias incluidas como excursión en catamarán a una isla virgen para realizar yoga, muy top! El personal siempre atento y con una sonrisa. Destacar el servicio de nuestro concierge Christopher que hizo que nuestra experiencia fuese inmejorable, estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento, realizando las reservas de los restaurantes y ayudándonos con todas nuestras peticiones. reviews.author: Abel J
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el paraíso

Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es el personal: profesionales impecables que te reciben con una sonrisa y te hacen sentir como en casa. Para una experiencia aún más exclusiva, recomiendo la opción Destination Inclusive con The Reserve. Disfrutarás de acceso a zonas premium y experiencias únicas, como una clase privada de yoga en una plataforma virgen con vistas espectaculares. Además, contarás con un servicio de mayordomo personalizado. Queremos destacar especialmente a Christopher, quien hizo de nuestra estancia algo mágico. Su atención al detalle, su amabilidad y su disposición para anticiparse a nuestras necesidades fueron excepcionales. ¡Gracias, Christopher!
