reviews.text: The staff at the Kidsdom made the trip much better. While the Kidsdom space itself is pretty sparse, the staff were kind and cheerful and my kids loved hanging out there and participating in all their activities. The resort is nice overall. Wish they had a kids’ pool but my kids enjoyed it anyway. Room was comfortable and modern. Overall a good experience. I’d return again.

reviews.author: ISABELLE L
reviews.title: Un autre magnifique séjour au Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Wow! Quel beau Resort dans un cadre idyllique et en bordure d'une magnifique plage de la mer turquoise des Caraîbe! La beauté, la propreté, la tranquillité et la bonté du personnel font la marque de commerce de cet hôtel qui assume bien ces 5 étoiles!

Pour ce séjour dans la Réserve (section adulte), nous avons été merveilleusement  accompagné par Basilio qui a été bien à l'écoute pour satisfaire tous nos besoins. 

La Réserve offre un bel oasis de paix  et l'exclusivité du Resto Santé avec la cuisine gastronomique du chef Rafaël! Tant à ce restaurant,  qu'au buffet Canna, nous avons trouvé de quoi satisfaire nos papilles gustatives à chaque jour: de beaux poissons, fruits de mer en abondance, bon choix de viande et de légumes locaux bien appréciés...

Le personnel y est dès plus sympathique et accueillant! Merci particulièrement aux hôtesses pour leur chaleureux accueil, à Henry, Juan, Edouardo et Gustavo du Resto Santé, ainsi qu' à Santo, Cyrillo, Rosanna et Yanira du buffet Canna qui se sont assuré de répondre avec entrain à tous nos besoins! 

Merci aussi à Carlos de l'équipe d'animation pour son enthousiame et à Pedro sur la plage qui accourt à la sueur de son front et avec tout son coeur pour vous servir!!

Les seuls désagréments de ce séjour ont été la musique très bruyante de certains spectacles le soir et  la monopolisation de la Place Coloniale un soir par un groupe privé qui a envahi l'hôtel quelques jours. 

Nous trouvons que l'hôtel devrait offrir une salle privée pour permettre à ces regroupements de tenir leurs activités et animation bruyante qui ne devraient pas avoir lieu dans les aires communes ...

Isabelle et Alain

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Luis is the man.
reviews.text: Luis was the best. He gave the best recommendations for dinner and things to do. My dude is like family now. I would recommend this trip. Give it 3 thumbs  up! Find Luis for anything you need. Friendly people, good food and great drinks. Pools are great and the beach is very nice. All the staff is great.

reviews.author: Collin C
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text: Best all inclusive I’ve been to so far! The pools were great. Luis did an excellent job, took care of us the whole time! The shows at night were a highlight. The food was a 9 out of 10. The only thing that was missing was a hot tub and maybe more servers walking around for drink service.

reviews.author: tristansofficial
reviews.title: Paradisus vacation
reviews.text: Staff is extremely accommodating. Special shout-out to Johnathan at the Celsius swim up bar. He is genuinely sweet and happy to not only help serve but interact with the guests to make sure they feel safe and have fun. He, as well of the rest of the staff, are always checking in to make sure you are having a nice experience. When you leave your room, you can leave for what feels like 5-10 minutes and return to a room with a bed made, snacks and refreshments restocked, with everything organized. This resort employee very enthusiastic, hard workers

reviews.author: Autry1978
reviews.title: Beware of Upgrading to the Reserve with Concierge Service
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and our first (and last) stay at a Melia Resort.
First off, the property and beach were beautiful, however that beauty was overshadowed by issue after issue. 
Good experiences...Gustavo in Sante is wonderful. Wanda at the Fahrenheit pool bar is fabulous! The 80-minute couples massage that we paid for was excellent. Out therapists Alba and Maria gave us great deep tissue massages. 
Issues that occurred during our stay:
•	We had no concierge on Day 1 and part of Day 2. We were told upon check-in that Adriel would be our concierge, and that our luggage would be delivered within the hour.  I had to call the front desk after 2 hours to have them find our luggage. This caused us to miss dinner on Day 1 . The room service food was terrible. How do you mess up a cheeseburger? Melia can do it! Adriel finally contacted us at 9:30pm via WhatsApp on Day 1. We found out he had left at 5:00pm, so there was no way we would have gotten our luggage without me calling and complaining. 
•	On Day 1, The shower was not draining.  I messaged Adrial and also called the front desk. This issue was fixed on Day 4. The water flowed out of the shower into our room and into the water closet.  We had to make a dam out of towels when we used the shower.
•	Called the front desk and messaged Adrial about air conditioning on Day 1 not cooling enough. This issue was fixed late on Day 2.
•	Our Minibar was not stocked upon arrival.
•	Had to visit the Reserve lounge on Day 2 to ask for an on-site concierge, because our concierge, Adrial, was not going to be onsite again on Day 2. We got Alam, our 2nd concierge, that gave us a tour that we should have received on Day 1. He said he would make our dinner reservations. My wife had to send Alam a WhatsApp message to remind him about dinner reservations EVERYDAY or else we would have not gotten dinner reservations. We requested dinner reservations be between 6pm-8pm. Only 1 dinner was scheduled between 6pm-8pm. The rest was after 8pm. 
•	We received one message about activities the entire stay from our concierges. This was on Day 1 and we did not receive any more. We were supposed to receive a message every morning about the day's activities.
•	On Day 5, Alum told us he was off for the rest of our stay. We were then assigned to Gustavo our 3rd concierge. I didn't think things could have been worse well Gustavo proved that they could.
•	On Day 5 We were told by Gustavo to wait in our room because the manager was coming by to talk to us. We waited over 2 hours and had to get to our 8:30pm dinner reservation. The manager never showed up.
•	On Day 5 the room was not serviced. Green ('Make up room') light was on since breakfast. Had to complain to Gustavo after coming back from our 8:30pm (turned into 9pm) dinner. The room was finally serviced late. The Minibar was not serviced.
•	On Day 6 the concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez, met with me and my wife on our room's patio. I told them everything. They both agreed that we did not receive the Reserve service that we had paid for and they agreed to talk to upper management about refunding us the Reserve rate minus the regular resort room rate (wo/ concierge service). We thought everything was going to be settled after that, but NO!
•	Day 7: We were checking out and I had not heard from Alvaro. I messaged him on WhatsApp (see attachment). Since we booked through Costco Travel they are basically not honoring the agreement from Day 6. Melia owns the resort, not Costco!
After we returned, we contacted Costco Travel. They reached out to the resort and the resort is now saying that they are not honoring anything talked about with concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez on Day 6.
My suggestion…if you go to this resort do not upgrade to the concierge or reserve service. I wish we had had concierges like the other guests had. If you get Adriel, Alam, or (God forbid) Gustavo, you need to request someone else.

reviews.author: Nasti58
reviews.title: Decepción total
reviews.text:
El personal es muy amable (sonrisa Disney) pero ineficaz. Tuvimos un problema y pese estar en la zona reservada para adultos y en teoría disponer de un "concierge" para nosotros, hasta que no hablamos con la dirección el problema no se solventó. Estuvimos más de cuatro días perdiendo tiempo de vacaciones buscando quién podía solucionar el problema. No nos funcionaba el teléfono y mi marido no se encontraba bien. Por la noche era angustioso ya que si se ponía peor hasta que llegaba a la recepción para avisar, se quedaba solo. El teléfono de emergèncias del baño tampoco funcionaba.
Las cenas en los restaurantes temáticos son desagradables por los grupos, sobre todo americanos, que hablan tan fuerte y hacen tanto ruido que no oyes ni al camarero e imposible mantener una conversación, pero nadie les llama la atención.
Mucho mejor estar con niños que con estos grupos.
Los parterres de las habitaciones en la zona que estábamos estaban muy descuidados y casi cada día había un pintor que iba dando brochazos pintando los desperfectos de la pared pero no lo indicaban y si te apoyabas te manchabas la ropa.
Las instalaciones en la playa están en mal estado. Hay como unas camas que están rotas y no aplanan la arena, o sea que quedan torcidas y estás muy incómodo.
Pesaban muchísimo para moverlas y en general, aunque vean que estás intentando acomodarte, el personal de la playa se queda en la zona del bar hablando entre ellos.
Mención especial por su interés y amabilidad a Pedro, personal que nos atendía en la playa que se desvivió por hacer nuestra estancia agradable. Zenobia también se tomó mucho interés.
No aconsejo este hotel. Hemos estado varias veces en República Dominicana y hay otras cadenas mucho mejores.

reviews.author: Vicky
reviews.title: En el Paraíso 🏝️❤️
reviews.text:
Destaco la cena de enamorados , excelente y cordial atención de Arismendis Neguéis jean, que a pesar de la lluvia salvo una noche inolvidable ❤️ 
Ubicado en una de las mejores playas de Bávaro, su extensión un 10! 
Las instalaciones impecables , superó nuestras expectativas! 
Los restaurantes temáticos muy bien sugiero ponerle un poco más de fuerza a la experiencia japonesa.
Gracias a cada una de las personas que hicieron de nuestra experiencia momentos inolvidables🏝️🤍

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Must do experience!
reviews.text: Arismendis Negueis Jean arranged a private romantic dinner on the beach for us to celebrate our honeymoon. From beginning to end it was perfect. Surf and turf, wine, apps, and dessert. It was amazing! Make sure you do this if you go! 10/10 service!

reviews.author: Coleen J
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in The Reserve section and it was fabulous! Eriol was our concierge. He took care of every need.  He really pampered us and made it a memorable experience. We had a junior suite. It was perfect size and always well stocked. Flora and Mascalzones were our favorite cuisine. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alejandro Q
reviews.title: Meliá Paradisus 10/10
reviews.text:
La atención de los meseros de la playa, Rafael, Yudery, Pedro , Martín, Arisleida, Teófilo, Joel 10/10 así mismo Luis Garcés jefe de zona es un caballero, amable y muy dispuesto para esta familia.

Gracias q todos por atendernos y estar disponibles siempre paga atendernos. 10/10 todos.

reviews.author: Yegzeru A
reviews.title: Relaxing experience at the beach
reviews.text: Our experience at the beach was great, thanks to Vanessa, who took care of us serving us drinks and anything we asked for. Vanessa checked in on us and was very attentive. Vanessa was a good server and we remembered her from our last trip here to DR.

reviews.author: Andrea D
reviews.title: Tropical paradise for adults only
reviews.text: Beautiful  clean and updated property. We stayed in the reserve section. The reserve is for adults only.  We had our own concierge,  Adriel, who was fantastic! He took care of all our reservations and anything else we needed. The food was top qualify. I'm definitely planning to return.

reviews.author: Amani M
reviews.title: Rum Republic is a must!!!
reviews.text: Jensy and Miguel we’re amazing and kept us coming back every night!!! If you come here, Rum Republic is a must!! They took great care of us and were extremely knowledgeable! Take my advice and try the Smoked Rum Fashioned, you will not be disappointed!!!

reviews.author: Alice K.
reviews.title: Thank You Melia!
reviews.text: Beautfiul hotel with picturesque rooms and very friendly staff. In particular, our concierge Basilio made sure our stay was enjoyable and that everything went smoothly. We stayed at the Reserve portion of the hotel and really enjoyed the quiet pools and beach this section offered.

reviews.author: guylainegervais
reviews.title: Nous étions au paradis
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une excellente semaine au Paradisus.Le site enchanteur, d’une propreté impeccable, le personnel gentil et courtois.
Il y a de la disponibilité pour s'asseoir à la mer et à la piscine au soleil ou à l’ombre.La nourriture digne d’un 5 étoiles avec collation dans la chambre.
Le seul bémol est la réservation des restaurants, L’idéal serait premier arrivé premier servi avec aucune réservation et après on prend une roulette et on attend qu’une table se libère ou sinon garder les réservations mais qu’on puisse tous les réserver à l’arrivée.
Il y a beaucoup d’animation autant le jour que le soir bon spectacle avec de la danse en fin de soirée.
Je recommande cette hôtel nous y retournerons sûrement.

reviews.author: Sherri R
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Christopher was attentive and eager to make sure everything was in order including reservations. He did what he was supposed to do, but if there is any feedback, I would say response time should be shortened. Christopher did ensure we were good when we saw him, I feel that he was stretched thin. All in all, good job.

reviews.author: Stay628400
reviews.title: Flora
reviews.text: If you’re in Punta, Cana, highly recommend. DCS Pomeroy, and the restaurant Flora or some Dominican food.Cocofongo is amazing at Flora. Ask for Andrea Santana. If you want to have DELICIOUS Dominican food She will set you up. Franklin too!

reviews.author: jkmac672025
reviews.title: Palma real
reviews.text: Outstanding experience. Staff very accommodating and friendly. Special mention to Jose Acosta and Pedro who remembered our favorite spot on the beach and was always out early to make sure we were set up with towels and beverages. We were present for the members gathering which was very nice and great opportunity to meet other members for dinner.

reviews.author: Patty G
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 1 week and had Christopher as a concierge in the Reserve section of the resort.  Christopher was very friendly, attentive and really went out of his way to ensure our stay was the best experience.  We stayed with a group of 15 family and friends and even though he was our concierge, he made sure everyone from our party was feeling just as welcomed. I would highly recommend this resort and Christopher as your concierge.  Can’t wait to go back next year.

reviews.author: sgillette2016
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort Experience
reviews.text: All inclusive, overall friendly, clean, helpful staff, and beautiful beach.  A few staff were grumpy, like the dessert staff in the Lunch Box but the wait staff at every place we ate were great!

reviews.author: Kiara R
reviews.title: Our Wedding
reviews.text:
El pasado 28 de marzo de 2025, mi esposo y yo celebramos nuestra boda en el hermoso Paradisus Palma Real, y no podríamos estar más felices con la experiencia vivida. Cuando decidimos tener una boda destino, nos arriesgamos sin conocer personalmente a las personas que harían realidad nuestro sueño… pero hoy, podemos decir con certeza que fue la mejor decisión que tomamos.

Estamos profundamente agradecidos con cada persona que puso su corazón, esfuerzo y profesionalismo en hacer de este día algo mágico.

Un agradecimiento muy especial a Stephanie Borja, nuestra coordinadora de bodas, por su calidez, atención a cada detalle y por acompañarnos con tanto cariño durante todo el proceso. A Alki Fiesta, gracias por la magia de su decoración — superaron nuestras expectativas y transformaron cada espacio en algo sacado de un cuento. A los talentosos fotógrafos de Novia Mía, gracias por capturar cada emoción con tanto arte y sensibilidad; ahora tenemos recuerdos eternos para revivir nuestro día. A Wasabi Música, infinitas gracias por llenar el ambiente de alegría y energía con sus voces — ¡hicieron vibrar a todos los invitados!

Y por supuesto, al hotel Paradisus Palma Real, gracias por abrir las puertas a nuestros seres queridos y hacer que cada uno de ellos se sintiera especial. Su atención, hospitalidad y servicio fueron simplemente excepcionales.

Gracias a todos por hacer realidad nuestra boda soñada. ¡Fue un día perfecto e inolvidable!

On March 28th, 2025, my husband and I celebrated our wedding at the beautiful Paradisus Palma Real, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. When we decided to have a destination wedding, we took a leap of faith without knowing the people who would help bring our dream to life… but now, we can say with certainty that it was the best decision we ever made.

We are deeply grateful to every person who put their heart, effort, and professionalism into making this day truly magical.

A very special thank you to Stephanie Borja, our wedding coordinator, for her warmth, attention to detail, and for being so caring and supportive throughout the entire process. To Alki Fiesta, thank you for the magic of your decoration — you exceeded our expectations and turned every space into something straight out of a fairytale. To the talented photographers of Novia Mía, thank you for capturing every emotion with such artistry and sensitivity; we now have eternal memories to relive our day. To Wasabi Música, infinite thanks for filling the atmosphere with joy and energy through your voices — you made every guest feel the celebration in their hearts!

And of course, to the Paradisus Palma Real hotel, thank you for opening your doors to our loved ones and making each of them feel truly special. Your attention, hospitality, and service were simply exceptional.

Thank you all for making our dream wedding come true. It was a perfect and unforgettable day!

reviews.author: ali m
reviews.title: Great place with worse food.
reviews.text:
This is the first day in resort. 
1. Nice resort, beach and rooms.
2. Nice  people who trying to make your stay  relaxing and great.
3. Food is  not good at all. You can not call it 5 star resort food at all.There is no tase to food. We were in Blue agva for dinner. Simple and blend food. From starter to appetizer. I can easily say worse food ever I ate in a Mexican restaurant.  As some one who has been traveling to all carribian  islands and Mexico. By far this is the most tasteless food I ever had. I  invite  Melia resort manager  to randomly  go and taste the food. .
I should say the people who work there are all welcoming .

reviews.author: lou112358
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: This was the best vacation I ever had! The accommodations were wonderful and every staff member was helpful and very pleasant. Our concierge, Emmanuel, was unbelievable. Emmanuel kept us informed of events, made our reservations at restaurants for us, and checked on us and our comfort multiple times during the day. He also surprised me a birthday celebration . We are making this an annual trip and requesting Emmanuel as our concierge next year.

reviews.author: rolvero1717
reviews.title: 70th birthday
reviews.text: Resort was amazing and topping on the cake was celebrating with my family and friends. Would definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Donna B
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation in Paradise!
reviews.text: First trip to Punta Cana, and it was an absolutely amazing experience. The accommodations and amenities at The Reserve were exceptional, as were the services provided by our concierge Emmanuel. He checked in with us regularly, was so very attentive to our needs and very responsive to all of our requests. The resort had so much to offer, from the pristine beaches with comfy cabanas, to a multitude of pools (with swim-up bars!), great food and a diverse offering of activities and fun entertainment.  All staff members were extremely friendly and provided exceptional service. In particular Freilyn (AyeYaYa!), Carlos & Joefry were engaging, fun and made us feel extra special. This was a most memorable trip and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: dawn f
reviews.title: Fabulous experience!
reviews.text: Resort is gorgeous, room was so beautiful & very clean. Housekeeping was timely and did a great job. Staff everywhere were so friendly and accommodating. We had Emmanuel as our Concierge & he was amazing. Shared great info, gave us a lovely tour, secured reservations for dinners and a really fun excursion. Right from check in he made us feel comfortable, welcomed and at home.  Always smiling and eager to help us.

reviews.author: Ester P
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: La estancia en The reserve fue genial. Basilio y todo el equipo se encargaron de que no nos faltara de nada para pasar unos días de relax en família. Las excursiones a Isla Saona y Los Haitises son largas per recomendables. Ojalá volver pronto! :)

reviews.author: Camarin M
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this resort! We leave tomorrow. I wanted to write this review to give special shout outs to a few people that made our trip magical while we were here. 

The best service we had of at any of the restaurants was surprisingly the buffet. We always sat in Yanira’s and Rosanna’s section. They were two of the kindest people you will ever meet. They always welcomed us in and seemed happy to see us every day for breakfast and lunch. By the end of our trip i could honestly say they felt like family to us. Such amazing women. I will miss them both.

The other person i would like to highlight was Gladys from the Spa. She was walking around the pool showing people the spa menu. When she got to our chairs, she sat down with me and i could immediately feel her loving energy. My husband and i immediately booked services with her. My facial I received was incredible and my husband said the same of her massage. She truly had such good energy. Book with Gladys!

This resort was so clean!!! The pools were pristine!!! The plants were always being manicured and cared for. Such a beautiful resort. 

We got a master suite swim out pool and it was worth every penny. We could swim right out of our room into an impeccably clean huge lap pool. We also had our own cabana and lounge chairs. It was heavenly. Our room was always cleaned so nice daily. They stocked snacks, drinks and had a nice coffee bar with a nespresso machine. 

We are so very thankful to have been able to stay at this resort for everyone that made our stay so wonderful. 

Thank you for having us!

reviews.author: Heather M
reviews.title: Perfect Paradise
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing.   Came on a girls trip with family.   We were not disappointed.  Everything was on point.   From the time we arrived to the time we left we wanted for nothing.  Staying at the Reserve is definitely worth the extra cost.  Shout out to our concierge, Emmanuel, who made sure we had reservations for dinner & excursions.  Freilyn, Carlos & Joefry with activities made this a trip to remember.   We'll certainly be back.

reviews.author: emetz19
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful trip to Paradisus Palma Real! 
The Accommodations: We stayed in the Reserve Adults Only section.  We requested 2 separate beds but both of our rooms had king beds.  It ended up working out fine though. Emmanuel was our concierge and was so friendly and on top of everything!  We casually mentioned we were celebrating my mom’s 70th birthday on this trip.  One of the days we got back to the room, it had been decorated with balloons.  They also had a charcuterie board, cake, and bottle of champagne.  The adults only pool and beach areas were great and there were plenty of day beds and loungers.  

The food: Was pretty average at the buffet.  Was slightly disappointed in the selection in Sante for lunch but the fact that it was peaceful more than made up for it.  Our favorite meals were at Flora and Blue Agave.  Service was great at all of the restaurants.  

The entertainment: All I can say is WOW!  The activities staff have amazing talent!  Special shoutout to Freilyn (Mr. Wonderful Aye ya ya 😁), Jholfry, and Carlos for all of the amazing classes and activities.  They genuinely seem to enjoy their job and it was evident in the entertainment they provided.  

We absolutely will come back again and can’t wait to spend another week in this paradise!

reviews.author: Elissa V
reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: Me encantó el trato en todo el hotel y todos los departamentos. En especial Yesica del departamento de Kidsom. Super servicial y mis hijos amaron hacer castillos de arena con ella. 100% recomendado, si vienes a Punta Cana, necesitas venir a Paradisus y conocerla.

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.text: This place was paradise. We went with a group of friends and had the most amazing time. The service was top notch, the resort is beautiful, and so many fun things to do. Jendry was so helpful assisting us with anything and everything. They all know how to take care of their guests and are so accommodating to make sure you have the best experience.

reviews.author: Darcie C
reviews.title: My favorite place
reviews.text:
Our concierge Eriol was waiting for us and guided us through out the week. He was so helpful with the dinner plans and activities for the week. He was so kind.  Thank you Eriol ! 
 
Top notch service. 
We loved it so much we’re going back next year! We highly recommend this resort! Very clean, excellent food. There were no pesty bugs. 5 stars for us 

Blaine & Darcie

reviews.author: Paloma L
reviews.title: El hotel es Precioso. La situación , en la misma Playa Bávaro. La playa muy limpia.
reviews.text:
La playa con muy buen mantenimiento de limpieza. 
El hotel muy bonito y las piscinas ideales. 
El personal que te atiende en bares y restaurantes encantador y muy servicial. 
En especial Jeison en el buffet de desayuno. Y en el pool bar
90 Degrees, Olga, Raisa, y Leticia. Muy buenas como profesionales y serviciales al máximo. Nos solucionaron un gran problema por encontrar un producto en una farmacia, que no habían encontrado los concierges, ni los de recepción. 
La gastronomía bastante deficiente. Las bebidas muy buenas.

reviews.author: Renata Fonseca
reviews.title: Com certeza indico
reviews.text: Fiquei neste resort ha 10 anos e voltei em 2025 pois ele é sensacional e acima da média em Punta Cana, sei disso pois já me hospedei em outros resorts lá. Caso você tenha possibilidades de ser um "Reserve" a experiência fica melhor ainda mas não há necessidade pois o resort inteiro é maravilhoso. A Cada manhã vc fala com seu concierge e realiza as reservas nos vários restaurantes maravilhosos de lá. Aconselho levar uns casaquinhos leves pois o ar condicionado é forte tanto nos restaurantes quanto na musculação. Todos os dis tem atividades e shows. A Partir do momento que você entra não existem taxas para nada, as toalhas de praia são ilimitadas, a comida é ótima, as bebidas de qualidade e além disso tudo tem serviço de uqarto 24hs . Os funcionários são ótimos, em especial a Wanda do Bar da ala premium que decora até o que e como você bébe, te atendendo com muito carinho, também o Martin. Gostaria de elogiar o atendimento da equipe do Restaurante principal o Yensen, o Cirillo, a Maira, toda a nimação do Jeyson que acorda cantando e todo staff de forma geral. A Equipe de fitness e recreação o Fernando e seus amigos são bem atenciosos e animados. O Antonio que é tipo um supervisor geral. A equipe do café ao lado do Loby que serve drinks com café e sempre tem um docinho um bolinho...especial o expresso é fantástico. Toda a equipe dos carrinhos de golf que te leva para os outros resorts da rede Paradisus e para o cassino também e os carregadores de malas em especial o Hector. Devo elogiar meu concierge Samuel que conseguiu as reservas que eu queria em todos os restaurantes e também a minha agência de viagens a PHD travel em SP e minha agente Daniela Della Manna quem sempre me indica os melhores resorts e hotéis . Obrigada! Em fim, se você gosta do belo, de luxo e serviços,  vale a pena se hospedar ai e desfrutar de uma experiência bem melhor que em outros Resorts.

reviews.author: Luisa Fernanda Hernandez M
reviews.title: Un cumpleaños perfecto en el paraíso, gracias al increíble servicio de Ynes!
reviews.text:
Tuve el privilegio de celebrar mi cumpleaños en el Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort en Punta Cana, y fue una experiencia que jamás olvidaré. Desde el primer momento, la calidez y hospitalidad de su personal hicieron que me sintiera en casa, y quiero resaltar especialmente la increíble atención de Ynes, quien no solo nos dio una bienvenida excepcional, sino que nos mostró todos los secretos y servicios del hotel, incluyendo aquellos que no conocíamos. Gracias a ella, pudimos disfrutar a fondo de todo lo que el resort tiene para ofrecer.

Entre las actividades, tuve la oportunidad de probar aqua cycling, yoga aéreo y pintura, todas ellas con instructores maravillosos que hicieron que la experiencia fuera aún más enriquecedora. Cada actividad fue única y sumó un toque especial a nuestra estadía.

Quiero recordarles a los futuros huéspedes que es importante hacer las reservaciones para los restaurantes a las 2:45 p.m. del día anterior para asegurarse de disfrutar de la variedad gastronómica que el hotel ofrece.

Sin embargo, me gustaría hacer una pequeña sugerencia para el hotel: sería ideal trabajar más en la capacitación del personal de recepción. Si no fuera por Ynes, quien nos orientó en todo momento, no habríamos conocido todos los servicios disponibles ni el manejo de las diferentes categorías de miembros del hotel.

A pesar de este pequeño detalle, la experiencia fue inmejorable y, sin duda, volveré. ¡Gracias, Paradisus Palma Real, por hacer de mi cumpleaños una ocasión tan especial!

reviews.author: Roving54178999672
reviews.title: Another great stay at the Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort never disappoints. We have been coming here for 20 years and it still a great place to visit- we had a great meal at Flora- and the service is always great- everyone at the resort is always pleasant and accommodating. The rooms are great and the food is always good.

reviews.author: Angela H
reviews.title: Blew my mind! Can't wait to come back!
reviews.text:
This hotel blew my mind and is definitely worthy of its five star rating. Everything from this hotel was gorgeous: the room, the landscaping, and especially the pristine pools. I am a clean freak and this hotel exceeded my hopes on that score. Also having walked 10 miles of coastline in total while I was there I can say honestly the beach at this hotel was the best setup.

I loved the multitude of dining options all different types of cuisine and all excellent! 

And finally I can't say enough about the service! Everyone was so kind an polite, especially our concierge Basilio, guest services Antonio, waitress Rosanna, and room Taura.

reviews.author: Anne-Marie T
reviews.title: Vacances au paradis
reviews.text: Resort absolument magnifique!  Tout était parfait.  Chambre très propre, tout ce dont nous avions besoin était là, très facile de se retrouver sur le site,  que dire de la plage, superbe.  Beaucoup de choix au buffet, restaurant mexicain, tout simplement délicieux.  C'était ma 6e fois en République, ma premiere fois au Paradisius Palma Real et nous y retournerons c'est certain.  C'est vraiment le paradis.  Mention spéciale à George qui donne un service exceptionnel.  Toutes les personnes rencontrées ont été courtoises et aidantes.

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.text: Caesar is the best!!! Food was good, service was better. Will be back. I do not recommend the gnocchi. It was good, but only two shrimp in the entire dish. Steaks were not cooked as ordered, but Caesar made it much better. Excellent service, nice atmosphere, ok food!

reviews.author: carlos A
reviews.title: The lunch box
reviews.text: La comida fue magnífica, la variedad me pareció muy interesante, el sabor, el ambiente y el personal, en especial Laura la hostess de The Lunch Box, fue muy agradable, servicial, dinámica, muy atenta hizo que la experiencia fuese mucho más placentera.

reviews.author: alfred u
reviews.title: Review Laura
reviews.text:
Laura, hostess del lunch Box necesito que me le den un aumento, o cargo superior, iré el próximo año y espero esa noticia 

Excelente atención y disposición con los visitantes, tiene vocación de servicio, así que cuando regrese iré directamente allá

reviews.author: Martin1202
reviews.title: Great helpers
reviews.text: Carlitos and Soranyi were super helpful at the pool and I felt like a celebrity with all their attentiveness they gave us. I would recommend coming to this resort because of the great service here!!! I love Punta Cana.💕☺️😍👙🩱🩳👑☀️☀️🌴🌴

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Incredible Resort!
reviews.text:
Everything was absolutely wonderful. Service was excellent, the entire staff was amazing. The resort is beautiful, the food is really good. The Reserve (adults only) is the perfect choice when looking to relax, and you have a personal concierge. Ours was Basilio and he was simply the best. He was so sweet; took care of everything for us from dinner reservations, spa appointments, setting up excursions and sending us daily activities. He checked in on us every single day. We couldn’t have asked for more.
I highly recommend this hotel, I was so sad to leave and cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: timothyjohnsondvm
reviews.title: Business trip with a little personal time
reviews.text: I traveled with my fiancé for a work meeting. The location, services and people were excellent. Special shout out to Wellington. He went out of his way to walk us to our room when we were way out of the way. The food is the only downside. The meat was of poor quality and the food was always cold when it should have been hot or warm when it should have been cold.

reviews.author: Rosemary M
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Resort and beach has been beautiful! All the staff was amazing!!! Five stars! Basilio was our concierge and was so friendly and helpful… my girl Aresleida, beach server, was the BEST!!!!!! 💖😎🏝️. Food was nice, plenty of choices. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Carole Clare
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text: We have been here at the hotel Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort Punta Cana for nearly 3 weeks and apart from the beautiful surroundings it's the people who have been looking after us so well that have made it so special, our shout out today goes to the guys around the adults only swimming pool by block 8, the bar person Wanda is lovely, so friendly (a beautiful soul) and does the best cocktails! Martin the server is so attentive and always asking if we want a drink and Pedro who's lust for life is infectious he "works in paradise" We want to thank them all for helping to make our stay so enjoyable. They are credit to your business highly recommend ❤️

reviews.author: mautello
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: El lugar es excelente, se disfruta mucho de los servicios que presta. La comida es muy buena, tanto en los restaurantes a la carta como en el buffet. Tiene una gran playa además de muy buenas piscinas. La habitación es muy confortable. Todo el lugar mostraba buen mantenimiento, limpieza y cuidado.

reviews.author: Sharad N
reviews.title: A stay that will define you trip to Punta Cana for LifeTime ...Wonderful!!!
reviews.text:
They say your accommodations/stays  are  a crucial part of your travel - and after being here , we have to say it was the most crucial, lovely and memorable part of our vacation to Punta Cana. A True 5 star in every aspect.  We(A couple and an 11 year Old)  can write a book on the kind of comfort, care and fun we had at this Resort , but let me start with the one which was kind of there in back of our minds, based on certain reviews , while booking this Resort . The Food - especially the Buffet - Its incredibly clean, healthy (you choose) , flavorful and most importantly available. We had  been to to 5 Star and 5 Star Deluxe  properties all across the world and I wouldn't rate this hotel below any of those -in fact above to most of those. 
We stayed at the Family side of this Resort (not the Reserve but the next door property) and we opted for the OCEAN VIEW SUITE - and IT WAS MAGNIFICENT. Just too good - and every penny worth of  a Splurge. When we go back we go back to this exact same suite.
The Section of Bavarro beach is glistening . The Beach chairs , lounges and cabanas are in plenty Tand he Property is just spic and span, super clean, safe and the best - the People. They Make you feel special, respected , helped at every corner. Variety of  activities for adults and children , in a perfectly safe and clean environment. 
This was a trip of a lifetime for us - and now I know why they say - Once you go to the  Caribbean, you return back to it,  and with Paradidus Palma Real - Its going to be even more convincing, We will be going back very soon and going back to this exact one. Another good thing - we literally saw, met people(mostly families with children)  from around the world - with the languages, cultures and just respect to each other - An aspect that your travels lets you experience.
Note : Its a paradise for those who are vegetarian and like the varieties and freshness of the Fruits and Vegetables.    And the Coffee is so flavorful.

reviews.author: Cale C
reviews.title: SO BAD, CAN WE PLEASE LEAVE ALREADY!
reviews.text: Do not come here, unless you love to over pay for unbelievably poor food and service.  Been waiting a the concierge desk for 30 minutes this time.  See Photo below.  Had the worst meal of my life if you consider three bites a meal.  Cannot get anyone to listen to how bad this place is as no one is in charge, of anything.  Lots of people trying to check in behind me, but they are not having much luck.  We tried to just roll with this place all wee.  I mean, what are you going to do.  Where are you going to go.  (Still waiting to speak to some).  I really don’t write reviews, but this place sucks so bad.  We leave tomorrow and will never come back.  P.S.  At least 10 people waiting to check in at 11:20 PM

reviews.author: HC
reviews.title: Vacaciones TOP
reviews.text:
Todo superó las expectativas, especialmente el servicio.
Mención especial para nuestro Concierge Christopher, siempre atento y disponible para hacernos la estancia más dinámica.
Pedro en el servicio de hamacas, un espectáculo. 
Igualmente Yeison, un maestro coctelero.

reviews.author: Moncho07
reviews.title: Serv de Reynaldo
reviews.text: El servicio de Reynaldo Martinez en el Lunch Box fue excelente. Muy atento y servicial. Siempre estuvo atento a nuestro grupo.    M!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Michael N
reviews.title: Paradisus April 2025
reviews.text:
From check in to check out - absolutely superb experience at Paradisus Palma Real.
Ginger bar in the main lobby has the best drinks and the best service - shout out to Carolina - drinks kept coming with a special twist each time. 

Our flight was delayed 12 hours until 2:30am and we had to check out at noon.  Front desk booked us into a complimentary ocean view suite for the rest of the day until our transfer arrived to take us to the airport.

reviews.author: Bryan R
reviews.title: Great experience at paradisus
reviews.text: Everything is excelente the personal was great, the food at the Italian restaurant was very good the chef Juan has grand hands for making those delicious meals and our waiter Juleni was very attentive for everything we ordered we had a great time here

reviews.author: Alexis B
reviews.title: Recomendable!
reviews.text:
Muy recomendable el hotel, para ir con familia o amigos. 
Nos faltó una discoteque para bailar. 
El concierge Harry no tan recomendable. 

Arisleida la mejor del servicio de la playa en The Reserve. Agradecida!

Los restaurantes muy buena calidad, disminuyó un poco la calidad de los postres.

reviews.author: Curiosity41029358430
reviews.title: Resort 4 étoiles.  Nourriture et restaurations 3 étoiles...
reviews.text:
C'est la première fois en 20 ans que la qualité des restaurants et de la nourriture a tellement baissé. de 50%
Sûrement dû aux spéciaux 46% 49%... pas la même clientèle. c'était notre deuxième maison... Pour un couple agé. 280US$ pour nourriture est ridicule. Les restos sont bruyants.

reviews.author: ignacia F
reviews.title: Lo mejor de Paradisus su personal del kidsdom
reviews.text: Lo mejor que tiene Paradisus palma real es el personal del Kidsdom, realmente increíble! Sobre todo Alexandra, con muy buena disposición, cariñosa, preocupada y por sobre todo el cariño que le dio al cuidar a mi hija Blanca! La recomiendo a ojos cerrados a la hora de venir con niños

reviews.author: Paulo Q
reviews.title: Experiência memorável
reviews.text:
Hotel excelente ! Gostei de tudo! Tudo lindo, limpo e perfeito! Bons restaurantes, praias lindas, atendimento excelente e ótimo consierge, além de atenderem nossos pedidos sem queixas e prontamente. Voltaria sem dúvida.
Comida e bebida de ótima qualidade.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Birthday destination/celebration
reviews.text: My wife and I love this resort. The fact that we are Circle members also makes many options that much more available. I was disappointed that getting in touch with the “pre-arrival team”was disappointing to say the least. I needed to send multiple emails and call the resort to eventually get answers to many of my questions. But nevertheless, it all worked out. My room and two additional rooms that I booked for family and friends were all ready to go once we arrived. There isn’t enough words I can say to express how horrible our concierge treated us. Talking over me, did not show interest in explaining the amenities and activities. Appeared to be rushing the check in process to get out of work in time rather then showing us the room and making us feel welcomed. However, staff at the resort made my experience amazing. Every preference that the concierge said was definitely not possible, specific staff member made it happen. Special shout outs to Edito and Delvin. Edito made a dinner for 11 work out amazingly. All requests were appeased and he was on top of the whole meal from beginning to end. Two of our other dinners were made possible by Delvin. He gave top notch service and my whole family were delighted. Where the concierge dismissed the requests Delvin made my request a realization. The buffet food was always great and I always had something new to try out. We all loved it. Checkout went smooth without a glitch. Will be returning to this resort.

reviews.author: Helma T
reviews.title: Maravillosa experiencia
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, todos súper hospitalarios, el servicio al 100, súper atento todo el personal

Sobre todo en Ginger bar excelente trato, las bebidas súper ricas los cafés, los mojitos con fresa uff, gracias a Luis, Luis Alejandro, Andreina y Walquiria por sus atenciones me voy muy feliz de este viaje, encantada de regresar

reviews.author: Natalie K
reviews.title: My new favorite vacation spot!!!
reviews.text: This resort is unbelievable!! The most beautiful views, welcoming staff, and great vibes. Jendry was our personal butler for our stay at Paradisus and he was beyond amazing! So personable and catered to all of our needs. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Aubrey K
reviews.title: Spring break trip
reviews.text: The staff is amazing! Property is great. We had a difficult time making dinner reservations so we ended up being limited on where we could eat. Food was decent but now great. Best meals were the steak and steak tacos. I was hoping for better sea food. Make sure to check out the daily activities. They aren't advertised much but they are fun. There was only one place to go after dinner which is a sports bar that turns into a DJ party. I'd love to see them add another night club at the resort so you can get a little bit of variety.

reviews.author: LSC
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text:
El hotel está fenomenal las habitaciones las instalaciones y todo el personal .
La calidad de la comida no es muy buena para ser un hotel de cinco estrellas pero lo peor para nosotros fueron las bebidas la oferta de cervezas es muy escasa y solo son cervezas muy suaves sin apenas sabor y el vino es de una calidad muy mala para una hotel de estas características
Todo lo demás fenomenal el sitio es una maravilla y lo pasamos genial .

reviews.author: Trevor N
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Resort was great, food was all very good and location was perfect. Jendry was the best! He took great care of us and made everything very easy. He helped us to make reservations and book excursions. Will definitely go back and request to use him again!

reviews.author: Dylan H
reviews.text:
Beautiful location and resort! Thoroughly enjoyed staying with The Reserve! 

We enjoyed having a personal concierge and service on the beach. 

The quietness of the Reserve was a nice escape and would definitely book again. The drinks were great and we especially enjoyed the Rum bar.

reviews.author: William D
reviews.title: 10/10 experience! We are already planning our trip back.
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful with a ton to offer! The food was incredible and the customer service was off the charts. Our butler Jendry was very welcoming and attentive. He made sure we were set up with activities and reservations to ensure we had an amazing time.

reviews.author: Kelly R
reviews.title: Great staff, great food
reviews.text: Would highly recommend paradisus Palma resort for anyone staying in punta Cana! We went as a group of 8 and stayed in the reserve adults only side and can’t thank our butler Jendry enough. He went above and beyond for us and made our time there spectacular. The food was fantastic, rooms were stocked and the resort was clean and calm. We will be back!

reviews.author: Yegzeru A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Good day,
I am writing to give feedback on my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. I am a member for about 8 years. There are times I stay using my options, and there are times I go to Punta Cana just because my family and I love it there. We have always have good experiences and this was the first time we didn’t. 
We checked in and our room was not ready. Understandable, because we arrived to the hotel at 1.  After checking in, the person at the front desk told us to come back at 3 to see if the room was ready. We went to the beach and grabbed a bite to eat before heading back to the front desk. I found it weird how I wasn’t given a concierge right away so that the concierge would let me know when the room was ready, but I figured I would get one soon enough. 
The following day, I decided to make a reservation for a restaurant. Upon trying to make a reservation, a concierge came to me and said that he wasn’t notified of my arrival and he was waiting for us, meanwhile this was the following day. He went ahead and made a reservation for us that Saturday night at the Italian place. He told us the reservation would be under another room because I guess that person cancelled. The reservation was at 8. We usually never eat that late, but we took it. When we got to the restaurant, we gave the person the room number that the concierge had given us. They asked our name and told us there was no reservation. We showed them the text message from the concierge but they said there was nothing they can do. We left the restaurant disappointed because we could not eat there and because now we were forced to eat late at the buffet. 
The next day, the concierge let us know there was another reservation made for us at the Mexican place. When we get there, we give our room number and name and they tell us that the reservation was made for one person. They told us that luckily they had room so they were able to squeeze us in. Another disappointment for us having to be told the reservation was made incorrectly by the concierge. 
The day I met the concierge, he knew I wanted to eat at either the steak house or hibachi for our final dinner which was Monday. He let me know that reservations can only be made 2 days in advance. So when we asked him on Monday morning, he said everything was booked. So for our last night there, we ordered room service. 
This whole trip was disappointing. My family and I have never experienced this and I ask myself, is good service given to members only? If that’s the case, very sad. Melia is a huge company and has to remember they have members that don’t always come using options and regardless great service service always be provided. 
There were 2 employees that were nothing but nice to us and that was Eric that was our waiter at the buffet for lunch and  Vanessa who took take of us while at the beach.

reviews.author: gIB4Gib
reviews.title: Over booked! Bad Service
reviews.text:
Booked the Reserve for a couples vacation in mid April.
On arrival was told they were OVERBOOKED !! and would need to spend first night at another resort. After a healthy  debate, miraculously a room was available with a promised upgrade for the remainder of our trip.  This event caused a disappointing two day loss in our vacation while we shuffled around rooms.
The resort, pool and rooms were well maintained, grounds were in good condition.
The service on the other hand was very poor and disorganized despite high employee numbers. Constant trying to up-sale wine at dinner. Tipping  had no value in service motivation, that seemed very odd! The only drive for good customer service was an online review, which a few servers stated it was important for their boss to see the review. 
Butler Service was none existent the first night until we asked and the only value was restaurant bookings. Beaches had a lot of sea weed and many beach peddlers. If the staff service was as good as the peddling , this would be a 5 star !! 
Restaurants food was ok .
Despite the beauty, this place had a bad vibe.
Will not return, do not recommend.

reviews.author: Pam W
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our vacation at Paradisus in Punta Cana.  The rooms, pools, and grounds were beautiful and well maintained.  The ocean and beach were great!  We enjoyed all the restaurants and thought the food was awesome!  We had upgraded to The Reserve and found that beneficial in that our concierge was able to make all our reservations at the restaurants at the day and time we wanted!  We had read reviews that were not favorable…after spending a week there, I have no idea why there were be any negatives!!  Just don’t forget to do a ticket- coming and going!!!

reviews.author: Mario D
reviews.title: Un autre séjour mémorable!
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné au Palma Real du 20 au 28 avril 2024.  Il s'agissait de notre sixième séjour en tant que membres du Club Melia.  Encore une fois, nous avons été très satisfaits.
Tout d'abord, nous tenons à souligner le travail exceptionnel de notre concierge Lewis De La Cruz.  Il était rapidement disponible et au moindre problème, il était en mode solution. Certainement le meilleur que nous avons eu en six visites.  Il mérite un 10/10!
Nous voulons également souligner l'excellent service de Yafreisy qui nous a accueilli avec le sourire et amabilité au petit-déjeuner et au lunch pour la majorité de notre séjour.  Nous étions d'ailleurs surpris de sa mémoire pour nos demandes des journées précédentes.  De loin la meilleure parmi toutes les personnes qui nous ont servi lors des 22 repas pris sur ce site. Merci Yafreisy!
Pour ce qui est de notre chambre, le ménage était impeccable.  Notre seul bémol: le mini-bar n'était pas rempli à tous les jours.  Mais considérant notre faible consommation, c'est mineur.
En général, les repas dans les restos étaient excellents (sauf les desserts qui étaient bien moyens) et le buffet plus que respectable.  Et il a été d'une qualité irréprochable pendant les deux jours du congrès de l'industrie touristique DATE 2024.  J'imagine qu'on voulait impressionner cette visite VIP!
Quant à l'a plage, elle était propre et le peu de sargasses était ramassé quotidiennement. À l'occasion un peu bruyant selon le degré de supervision de certains parents (...) ou encore ceux qui oublient qu'aime pas nécessairement la même musique qu'eux et au même volume.  Il nous a fallu d'ailleurs demander à une reprise au personnel d'intervenir auprès de clientes qui se croyaient dans une disco afin qu'elles baissent le volume de leur haut parleur.  Ce qui a été fait rapidement et avec efficacité.
Bref, nous avons apprécié notre séjour et nous espérons que Lewis et Yafreisy y seront pour nous accueillir à nouveau dans deux ans lors de notre prochain séjour au Paradisus Palma Real!

Danielle et Mario

reviews.author: cmwass23
reviews.title: Probably wouldn't go back again
reviews.text: The whole stay was very inconsistent regarding service and food quality. Some days it was amazing, other times not so much.

reviews.author: Nubar K
reviews.title: Deception, disgusting and disappointing
reviews.text:
I would give this hotel a 0 if i could. Recently got back from our 1st family vacation in years and was run through the typical mill of ripping off tourists.  
We booked connecting rooms as we have 3 small children, all was confirmed over the phone.  A week prior we are told rooms are not connected and there is no availability.  Of course when i arrive at the front desk what am i told  by front desk "if you can pay $700 cash we can give you connecting rooms"  What do i do? I traveled 1k miles with my kids, I was left with my pants down and had to pay.  Insane extortion.
The facility itself is beautiful, I cant knock it.  The majority of the staff is disinterested in your happiness and comfort.  There were a few absolutely selfless and dedicated employees on site, good luck finding them as it wont be hard since most are so rude and make fun of you when you try and speak spanish.
Room keys always malfunction so you need to go to front desk all the time.
The pinnacle was after the 1st room cleaning, we came back at night and found a stain on the sheets - you decide, blood or feces that was not cleaned.  Although they immediately changed it the customer service after claimed it was RUST.  How does a cloth sheet rust???? absurd.  
Think twice before you book.  Truly gives the Paradisus name a bad look.  My post stay complaints with the hotel were absolutely worthless and you can see from every comment on these reviews.  They apologize and hope they can improve next time.  

So much for a paradise.......

reviews.author: ISABELLE L
reviews.title: Séjour mémorable
reviews.text: Nous avons eu un séjour de 2 semaines mémorables à cet hôtel qui réunit toutes les conditions pour permettre des vacances de rêves... La beauté et le raffinement sont partout ainsi que la bonté des gens.Le personnel est dès plus accueillant, souriant et attentionné. Le site est grandiose et très bien entretenu. C'est un vrai Palace qui offre une vue exceptionnelle sur la mer turquoise des Caraïbes. La  plage est magnifique et les algues sont ramassées à chaque jour. Un véritable oasis où se côtoient la tranquilité et des activités et animations variées et créatives. Les buffet est en général très bon, mais moins variés certains jours. Pour la restauration, nous avons eu un coup de coeur pour le restaurant SANTÉ qui offre une cuisine gastronomique. Ce restaurant est toutefois accessible seulement à la clientèle de la RÉSERVE (section adulte) . Si vous avez des besoins alimentaires particuliers, le personnel  vous accompagne avec une gentillesse remarquable pour y répondre. A cet égard, nous tenons à remercier du fond du coeur, Stéfanie, Jordania, Katherine, Rafaël, Gorge, Juan, Éduardo, Santo et tous les autres qui ont contribués à rendre notre séjour si agrable! Nous retournerons à cet hôtel sans hésiter!!

reviews.author: Eric C
reviews.title: I don’t recommend you can find better place
reviews.text: Food is terrible, people preparing breakfast don’t know what they doing. They cannot make even simple eggs over easy. Half of the restaurants you not allowed to go too unless you are a member you cannot use full facility because you’re not a member and bars are restricted to a member or adults only section, Communication with the guests are terrible. They had a big event and they did not notify anybody that you cannot use buffet for a dinner. They made me eat in Mexican restaurant which I don’t like. None of the bars can make a piña colada. They told me they don’t have piña colada in this hotel. I can have anything else, but piña colada the simplest drink to make and specially in Caribbean. Waiters and maids working great rooms are very clean. Waiters are polite, but everything else in this place bad

reviews.author: Sonia R
reviews.title: Jonathan sommelier at the Winery
reviews.text: Excellent service - excellent food and EXCELLENT sommelier JONATHAN!  Thank you and we look forward to see you at the Winery !

reviews.author: soledadadrover
reviews.title: Todo excelente es muy completo y todo de lujo
reviews.text: Gastronomía limpieza atención muy bien los alimentos y bebidas espectaculares todo lo q pedíamos lo teníamos limpieza excelente en todos los sectores muy bueno el mantenimiento y pintura también excelente vajilla impecable y de buena calidad la atención del personal muy amables y predispuestos, respetuosos todo espectacular el show y bailarines la música genial

reviews.author: jgp187527
reviews.title: Una semana inolvidable
reviews.text: Una estancia de una semana para celebrar algo en pareja. Todo excepcional, los miembros del staff del resort una maravilla, amables, siempre atentos y dispuestos a ayudar. Gracias por una semana inolvidable

reviews.author: Isabelle N
reviews.title: Un séjour extraordinaire !!!
reviews.text: Nous avons passé un excellent séjour au Paradisius Palma Real. Tout était parfait sans exception. Le site, la plage, les chambres, la nourriture, le service de tout les employés. Une mention toute spéciale à Thomas notre concierge. Il a été avec nous extraordinaire. À l’écoute de nos besoins du début à la fin. Toujours souriant et présent il est le meilleur. Merci encore Thomas  pour ton dévouement 😊

reviews.author: Emmy A
reviews.title: Can’t wait to return
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing stay with family (Couple and 2 kids) can NOT wait to go back. Staff is attentive, beach is gorgeous- no seaweed when we went. We did not feel like we had to rush for a spot on the beach. With the littles we rented the beach beds- very reasonably priced.  We did stay in the swim up suit and it’s so worth it especially with the kids. The grounds are not huge but big enough that you feel spread out. Food was good. I mean it’s an all inclusive resort it’s not going to be the highlight. Our butler was ok. Room- modern, clean, staff came by 2x a day to tidy up. My husband set up a beautiful dinner by the beach I’ll never forget. Overall book it if you are considering it. NOW this is not a party hotel. There is entertainment but not like in the huge resorts. So if you are looking for that- this isn’t it.

reviews.author: Mara C
reviews.title: Picture Perfect Relaxing Experience
reviews.text:
Picture perfect.
The Reserve is beautifully situated close to all amenities.( pools, bars,beach,private restaurant , spa…)
The grounds are pristine and are constantly manicured and cleaned .
A very quiet stress free location and facility.
Food  was excellent at the reserve and the Restaurants ( the main buffet lacked fresh salads and was not the best I have experienced but certainly adequate)
Our room was lovely , well stocked and 
spotless. 
Our concierge , Tomas , was attentive,available and helpful.
The welcome wine and charcuterie he delivered upon arrival and on our last evening was a very nice touch .
The friendly staff made this a 
Wonderful Experience !
We will most definitely return.
P.S. Don’t pay attention to the forecast,
Rain clouds appear and disappear quickly . A quick shower and the sun pops out !

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Relaxing and memorable stay
reviews.text: Our trip was amazing. The resort makes every effort to make your stay comfortable and positive. Our concierge Tomas went above and beyond for us and was very attentive. He answered all of our questions in a timely manner and helped us book restaurants. Overall it was a lovely week in paradise!

reviews.author: crygonz616
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.  Eat and drink with caution.
reviews.text:
First. Let me start by saying this is a beautiful resort and you can tell a lot of care was taken in the remodel. The beach did have quite a bit of debris and seaweed on it, but there were storms in the area that may have caused that.  The pools and grounds were lovely. The rooms were gorgeously done with modern decor.  

We were there on an incentive trip, so there were a lot of people there.  And getting reservations in the nicer restaurants was a challenge. Which, unfortunately, left you with the buffet as an option.  Food was undercooked, and sat out all day.  With the open atmosphere to the outside, there were birds flying around and landing inside. 

We had A LOT of people get sick!  I understand that Montezuma’s revenge is a possibility when traveling.  However, we were assured that the water at the hotel was safe and not a concern with brushing our teeth. Apparently not the case.  We used a lot of ice on the trip because our refrigerator did not work and we gave up after 4 attempts to get it repaired or replaced. We are concerned now the ice was tainted. I know more people who got sick on this trip than didn’t, and the illness is lasting for days.  In fact, it will be two weeks tomorrow since my initial onset of symptoms which was vomiting and diarrhea the 3rd day I was there.  In fact, based on what I’ve read about Travelers Diarrhea, I fear I contracted something else.  Diarrhea and stomach pain is still an issue after 3 days of an antibiotic.  

I really wanted to love this trip because I worked hard to earn it.  Definitely not the case… and after this being my second bad experience in the Dominican Republic, I won’t be back.

reviews.author: Teresa B
reviews.title: NO SERVING UTENSILS at BUFFET
reviews.text: If you like to use your hands to get food vs serving utensils at the Buffet then this is your place. 🤮. Not every item on the buffet had serving utensils and people were using their hands. GROSS & NO THANK YOU

reviews.author: marysaip47
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, rooms, easy access to several pools and beach. Love the room service, mini bar and all inclusive....EVERYTHING! Getting dinner reservations was our biggest complaint. I would go back again.

reviews.author: No rain trip
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text: Don’t listen to the negative reviews.   We are here now and it’s amazing.   Nothing to complain about at all.  Great property and great staff.

reviews.author: tristansofficial
reviews.title: Most amazing vacation
reviews.text: First and foremost, Paradisus has an exceptional staff. No request is taken as a burden or with an attitude. The team constantly was working hard, and somehow you’d familiarize yourself with most of the ginormous numbered staff. Through all hours of the night or day, they were there to accommodate any need we had. The room was unreal. Super clean, beautiful, and constantly stocked with fresh water, snacks, and beer with each cleaning service. You could not imagine a more friendly staff!

reviews.author: Givanni A
reviews.title: Paradise at it's finest!!
reviews.text: This trip was a yearly excursion for my company. About 80 employees attended and we had a phenomenal time. The resort is beautiful to say the least. Very clean, comfortable and accommodating. All our needs were met thanks to our amazing, responsive and attentive concierge Adriel. Adriel's customer service was top tier. We will definitely be revisiting.

reviews.author: liketotvl
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Paradisus Real Palma! The staff and service were exceptional, the food was great and the swim-out pool room in The Reserve was perfect. Our personal concierge, Irvin, made sure that everything ran smoothly and was always available to book dinner reservations and activities. The rooms were clean, the restaurant/bars were welcoming, and the lobby and layout were perfect for relaxing. The beach and pools were also clean and well-maintained. The staff and service were outstanding from arrival to departure. I highly recommend Paradisus Real Palma and can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Jimmy W
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Felix at the japanese restaurant was very entertaining. He made my 2 year old very happy. Avoiided the meltdown!

Thanks team

reviews.author: leanne s
reviews.title: Disappointed for a 5 star
reviews.text:
My mother and I travelled a few days ago and although the grounds and views are stunning, they have a lot of work to do for it to be an actual 5 star and for the price they are charging. We spent 2500$ CAD each and it did not match the services and food. 

Food is not the best and we’ve travelled many times to punta Cana and never had  1 complain about the food but this time it was not good. The buffet was terrible, tasteless, cold, some of the meats were raw or overcooked to the point where you couldn’t even cut through. One of the staff member serving the fish gave people attitude when they asked for their salmon to be well done because he was serving it half rare, another lady asked for her bacon to be more crispy and he just picked up the bacon from her plate with his fingers- she was livid. Some staff members were amazing and super nice and some seemed to be there out of being forced. 

Entertainment- barely any entertainment which I haven’t seen at an all-inclusive hotel. The vibe was very boring, no beach activities. 

Beach- stunning! Never had issues getting chairs. Only negative to it is that the vendors can be very disturbing and hover around constantly asking you if you’re interested. 

I would rate this hotel a 4 star and wouldn’t pay more than 1500$. Unfortunately I would not come back or recommend to anyone. I hope management takes these into consideration as the reviews are very accurate.

reviews.author: lynepaquin
reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: We have been coming to this resort for years and have always stayed in the adults only section because of the tranquility. We have tried the oceanfront and the swim up rooms and both are amazing. The resort is the cleanest we have seen anywhere and staff are constantly updating and maintaining the grounds and structures.

Le plus extraordinaire fut l’accompagnement de notre concierge TOMAS. Un vrai professionnel. Attentif. Avenant, cultivé et extrêmement efficace. Il a contribué à rendre notre séjour relaxant. Une personne humaine et bienveillante. Un employé de haut niveau.
On reviendra.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Diego R
reviews.title: Resumen
reviews.text: Reservé mes y medio antes y llegué el 14/04/24 día de mi cumpleaños. Pasé un pésimo momento en recepción en general creo que por eso les pongo un 3 sobre 5 la recepción y todas las personas que atienden ahí desganados, sin ninguna amabilidad ni empatía. Pedí hablar con un administrador pues simplemente me dijeron que no tenían habitaciones disponibles… el administrador solucionó pero el mal rato y en mi fecha de cumpleaños lo tuve que pasar. Es un hotel bello pero no es la atención que yo esperaba. La comida del buffet normal ( repetida todos los días) las habitaciones limpias y bonitas, el servicio a la habitación bueno tb. No regresaría por el precio que pagué iría a otra cadena.

reviews.author: bertorellijoseph72
reviews.title: Beautifull resorts
reviews.text: I Will recomeded, very nice place, restaurant and food very good, night activities was very interesting

reviews.author: Daniel L
reviews.title: Luna de miel perfecta.
reviews.text: Hace un par de meses decidimos casarnos y uno de los momentos más felices de nuestra boda era pensar en nuestra luna de miel. Somos de Monterrey N.L , tuvimos muchas recomendaciones como Cancún, puerto vallarta, etc, pero decidimos probar algo diferente y optamos por Punta Cana. Nuestra experiencia en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real fue increíble, desde el comienzo hasta el final, estamos muy agradecidos especialmente con el chef ejecutivo Cristian Díaz, quien ayudó a convertir nuestra luna de miel en algo extraordinario, agradecemos a Cristian y a todo su equipo de colaboradores y esperamos poder visitar en conjunto con nuestros padres próximamente para compartir con ellos nuestra experiencia magnifica que tuvimos, esperamos volver a ver al chef cristian para que nuestros familiares vivan la experiencia tan maravillosa de la cual fuimos parte.

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.title: Hard Pass.
reviews.text:
We had the most disappointing stay here. We upgraded to a Nikke room so we would have upgraded services and a butler to help us with our stay. Our room was old and dated. Our butler did NOTHING for us. Not one reservation. Didn’t answer our texts. We did not get the promised amenities or services or experiences. We called, talked to front desk, emailed Melia. No one cared. I’m furious and beyond disappointed. 

Nothing in the resort is amazing. Food is meh. Activities are very few and far between. Go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Daniela V
reviews.title: Run Republic em Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Estou bar com José Hernandes e Demi… excelente bartenders … servem drinks e dão um show no preparo… bar Run Republic… adoramos o pré jantar… a cada drink eles servem a simpatia junto… cada drink um capricho……………………………………………………..show……..

reviews.author: Dustin & Emily H
reviews.title: Mostly poor service but nice amenities
reviews.text:
The highlight of our trip was the spa. Wow! My wife and I did a couples massage and facials, and both of us agreed it was the best message we have ever had!

We rate this place average because of its service. Here's why:

1) We spent over $4,000 here and have yet to receive Melia points for our stay. The reason? Apparently the resort 'forgot' to link our stay with our Melia account. I've contacted Melia HQ, a Circle salesmen (Carlos, who promised to resolve it for us), the resort (twice), and our concierge and this still hasn't been resolved.

2) We agreed to meet with their pushy Circle salesmen in exchange for a free massage. One of the salesmen, Santos, stood up and left our conversation, slamming his notebook on the table and exclaiming, "Dear God" when we refused to upgrade our Circle membership. We continue to be disappointed by Circle.

3) We called housekeeping 3-4 times requesting items they had forgotten to restock during our stay, such as towels and water, and our request was only resolved once.

4) Most days we had to contact our concierge to ask when and where our dinner reservations would be. One night she arranged reservations at a place we told her not to, and she failed to inform us that a new restaurant had opened, which we went to on our own.

We spent every day on the beach soaking up paradise, although the beach was noisy with hawkers and loud party boats passing by with bass vibrations we could feel.

Our favorite places to eat were Sante (especially for breakfast and lunch; see photos below) and the buffet. We were spoiled by the men working The Reserve beach, too. They were always willing to lend a helping hand, made us special drinks, and even purchased me a mamajuana kit after I discovered I liked it. I'm terrible with names so I should have written them down, but they alone earned this review an extra star/circle!

We stayed at The Reserve. However, we will not be returning to this place as part of our Circle experience, especially after having visited Playa del Carmen last year.

reviews.title: Nice resort but food is lacking.

reviews.author: Danielle R

reviews.author: Johnathan H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, lots of pools, must try the hot chocolate! The beach was beautiful and the little huts are great when sitting at the beach

reviews.author: CCW
reviews.title: Wonderful Escape!
reviews.text: The facility is beautiful and kept very clean.  The atmosphere is wonderful & very entertaining.  Our favorite part was A.eriol! He was amazing & was diligent to check in on us daily!  He treated us like royalty!!  It was an exciting escape from reality!

reviews.author: Caitlin S
reviews.title: Very Kind to Families with Young Kids
reviews.text: Wonderfully kind staff across the resort. Very helpful and kind with families of young children. My kids loved Susu at the kid zone. We went back many times to play games or do the special activity. Luciana was so kind to my family at the lunchbox buffet. Eriole was our concierge and he always jumped in to help us with bookings and information - including our airport transfers.

reviews.author: Nick_Sussex_WI
reviews.title: Worst all inclusive we've visited over 16 years
reviews.text:
We traveled early to mid April as a couple and chose to extend a trip my wife earned through work. Not sure if this place is just really hit or miss but the positive reviews shock us and the negative reviews seem spot on.

First off I want to highlight that our butler/concierge Tomas was very good at getting us reservations and responsive to text messages throughout the trip. I'd recommend him since I've heard many horror stories of others not even hearing from their butler/concierge. Derny who worked at the 90 degree swim up bar was always on top of it and poured some good drinks.

The good:
We had a reserve room so check in/out was in a nice private and quiet area. The ocean view room had a really nice view. The resort itself is beautiful and seems newly remodeled. The beach was large and lots of places to sit. Breakfast was the best food item we probably ate daily, recommend Sante for breakfast they offer some menu items and a mini buffet with egg/omelette station. Swimup bar was good at serving drinks and keeping up with demand.

Mascalzone:
The appetizers were good. The chicken alfredo and shrimp linguini were also good. Potentially the best restaurant on the property.

Mina:
They know steak at this restaurant, the new york steak was good and so were the appetizers and bread.

Tokimeku:
So this place is walk in if not doing the hibachi, wish we would have known so we could of avoided the buffet. They surprised us with a special roll not on the menu, unfortunate since it was better than the roll we ordered. But overall tried some rolls and ordered everything under the wok section and enjoyed.

The bad:
Let's start with the room. The mini fridge is placed inside of cabinet, took us 2-3 days to realize you need to leave the door open because there wasn't adequate air flow and the fridge would not cool. Secondly the bathroom light switches were placed in an odd location between top and second from top shelves that were next to vanity. Lastly, the tub would be better suited with a handle near by since the edge was terrible to push on.

The property overall while beautiful, every morning there would be plates and or glasses left at pool chairs or at random places and many times those items would stay for hours after breakfast. This is something I've never experiences before, probably from a lack of waiters which lead to the next point.

The pool service, or should I say lack of service as in waiters. Never noticed one waiter come and take an order from anyone seated around the pool. The adult swimming pool also lacked significant amount of chairs to accommodate the crowd that wanted to be there. Also lack of enforcement by adult pool bar staff to turn away kids.

Reservation system for sit down restaurants, not sure why reservations are needed since most places weren't even at capacity unless its a staffing issue. The restaurants didn't even match times as mentioned on the app. 

The Lunch Box:
Had to eat there the first night since we couldn't get reservations. With went to seafood station and got lobster, its precooked frozen and reheated, the lobster was so overcooked that the meat came off in little tough strings. I went around station to station to try a few things, got onion rings (ice cold), potatos (ice cold), rice and some sort of pork stew for on top.

Kanna Beach Club:
Went for lunch 3 days, first three days ordered the nachos, everyday they came different and not one single day did they come with all listed items per the menu. Wife ordered tacos or nachos and experienced the same issues. 4th day there they had a grill and buffet of sides. Sides were fine but we both ordered the chicken from the grill, both pieces of chicken were undercooked and raw in the middle.

Kicks Sports & Fun Bar:
Went the first night after the huge disappoint at the buffet. Ordered nachos thinking it would be quick and simple. They brought out a plate of chips and a bowl of watery cheese sauce and a bowl of pico, which is not nachos.

Sante:
Figuring this was part of the reserve room upgrade we were excited to try the more exclusive dinner, first off the menu they presented was wrong so it took 10 minutes to straighten that out. Secondly the lobster ravioli and ribeye were both disappointing.

Mina:
I know it was listed as a good but its also a bad. My wife ordered the chicken which looked amazing until you cut to the center and again it was raw.

Blue Agave:
Love mexican food and although the tortilla soup was good. We both ordered different tacos (shrimp and pastor) and were really disappointed by the dryness which made them hard to eat. The margaritas were also a major miss, something in the mix was off.

Flora:
We had high hope after visiting other resorts. Premium steak ordered and was by far one of the worst steaks I've ever eaten, overcooked and full of gristle. Wife ordered gnocchi and a rice item, both were ok. High light here was probably their avocado bread appetizer. 

Summary:
Not sure how this place is considered a 5-star luxury resort. The price point is aligned with 5-star luxury but the resort is not. I've been to other brands such as Excellence and Secrets both which I highly recommend. The Paradisus Palma Real is not worthy of the price and I do not recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Pj C
reviews.title: Exceptional Experience

From start to finish, our stay at this exquisite hotel surpassed expectations thanks in large part due its exceptional team - especially Mr. Omar Hasbun.

reviews.author: jagvivi c
reviews.title: Best experience ever ..

Great food, excellent customer services, rooms are great. Nothing negative about this resort. If you have the chance to visit this hotel in DominicanRepublic please ask for Omar Hasbun, he is the best. He will help you from day one until your last day..

reviews.author: Peggy P
reviews.title: Golf and Sun
