Attached are pics.

reviews.author: rtjornhom
reviews.title: Great beach service
reviews.text: Francis is a fantastic server on the beach. He checked on us frequently and met our every need! We especially liked the Miami Vices ( thank you for no alcohol!)! Even the sandstorm we experienced didn’t keep Francis away from us. Francis is great!

reviews.author: Evan G
reviews.title: Spring Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in a Nikte swim up along with 4 other rooms and one in the reserve. The resort is beautiful and a 20 min ride from the airport. We arrived early and received our rooms right after 3pm which is check in time.  Check in was easy with  Wvladimir who was very helpful and assisted us as much as he could. There was an issue with 2 rooms assigned with only one bed. Stephanie who is a manager found us after one of our dinner reservations to make sure everything was corrected and everyone is happy. My big complaint is the lunch buffet. The food is not good and not hot.  Breakfast buffet is much better with a decent selection. Luciana was one of a few in the lunchbox who were very attentive.  My recommendation would be to upgrade to Nikte or reserve with a concierge to assist with the dinner reservations. Our concierge was Ariel who we communicated with for our dinner reservations, daily schedules and he did get us cake for 3 birthdays that we were celebrating. Just be a little pushy if for any reason they give you a hard time getting reservations. All of the specialty restaurants were good. The concierge will ask you to go to circle members office for a meeting but you can just decline. If you are not happy with anything just speak up.  Drinks in the resort were really good as well. Maria and the Male bartender in Rum bar were awesome. Smoked Leyenda for me and the guys and Leyenda with cinnamon and passion fruit for the wives!   Julia Solana on the nikte side worked the bar and pool area like she owned it. She is a real hustler and gives 100% in her service. Plenty of beach and pool chairs available. There is nightly entertainment in the hotel but no shows which I can do without. Late night the sports bar is the place for those who want a later party.  I would recommend this resort as long as your in Nikte or Reserve. Just know if you want excellent service keep tipping. While some may disagree with it the hard workers do deserve it.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Clean, great staff, beautiful, good food
reviews.text:
We booked through Costco Travel, along with two other families. I highly recommend this method. 

We had two concierge’s serving our group of 4 rooms. They were Ariel and Willy. Both were absolutely amazing!  Ariel would message me every morning with the event schedule of the day, so we always knew what we could participate in. The guys also made our dinner and excursion reservations for our group, which made this a hassle free vacation. They even arranged bag pick-up when it was time to leave. 

The resort itself is beautiful. We had the Nikte Swim Up Master Suite. It was worth the upgrade price. Our teen son slept on the pull-out in the living room and we had a king bed in the master.  

The entire staff was very friendly and there was constant upkeep being done. It was not distracting, just an observation. The entire property and buildings were spotless at all times. 

The buffet food was typical for breakfast. They cater to many cultures, so the variety is excellent. We only had one evening dinner there, but it was excellent and included fresh lobster tail. 

The other restaurants were excellent!  We were there. Week, so we tried everything. Great service at all. My favorite was the steak house and Jesus, our server. 

The resort is quite large, yet did not feel crowded. It was a mix of young families up to older couples. There were quite a few young children, but there are adult only areas if you do not want to day-drink around the pool with kids around. Note that the drinking age is 18 there, so you might see young adults with a drink. We did not witness any out of control partying though. 

We had 4 teenage (hs seniors) in our group and 3 dads who golfed multiple times. It was a very easy shuttle on the property to get to the clubhouse. Friendly staff at the course. The course itself is beautiful, but the greens are not great. If you are a very serious golfer, go with an open mind and be prepared for a few terrible greens.  Also, the course has a mix of family homes and mini vacation complexes on it. There are people constantly walking the cart path (more so on the weekends). 

Bring lots of tip money!  $1, $2, $5 get used a lot!!  If we were sitting poolside for a long period, we just tipped the servers big  ($20-$50) to start and then didn’t worry the rest of the day. 

Overall, we had a great time with friends and the resort was wonderful. Would definitely recommend and we plan to visit again.

reviews.author: Juan130790
reviews.title: Excelente todo para ir con familia
reviews.text: Excelentes instalaciones, comida, el ambiente pero en especial la atención de los que trabajan allí. Siempre preocupados porque uno estuviera conforme y contento. reviews.author: Lissette Nunez
reviews.title: Experiencia Memorable en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Excelentes atenciones de parte del equipo del restaurante Winnery y Blue Agave. Especial reconocimiento a Jonathan por todo lo bien que nos hizo sentir durante el cumpleaños de uno de Nuestros amigos en el restaurante Blue Agave.

Muchas opciones de comida y excelentes bebidas, las habitaciones impecables.

Una experiencia memorable. 100% recomendado.

reviews.author: Janet S
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Amazing hotel,staff, beach, activities/workshops, pools and food.  This is a high-end hotel, which we’ve never experience before in the DR.  I would like to especially thank a person who made our stay even  more enjoyable.  Miguel, the manager at the main buffet restaurant.  Miguel was extremely helpful and attentive . He went out of his way to help us book certain things as we have young kids….  You can always spot him working hard at keeping the buffet, full and clean. I’ve never seen a hotel with amazing Wi-Fi everywhere on the beach, Nespresso machines in the room, snack galore in the room, every day fresh, tuna or salmon at the buffet, towels always available at the pool/beach, etc.  Finally, the staff was in general Amazing… NOT true that if you don’t tip they are rude.  we like to particularly mention Marta the waitress.  So smiley and gave us great service at the kana restaurant.  Jesus also… Very nice waiter.  Finally, thank you to Dioni the manager of the steakhouse.  He also went out of his way to make our experience an amazing one every time we dined.  One last comment, thank you to the spa experience technician who did the facial workshop on Friday. Very relaxing workshop.  So many other workshops that were also very funny like you got the stretching and yoga at the beach, Marine, classes, workshop, painting, classes, etc. etc.

reviews.author: nick h
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Pigs at bar Celsius is absolutely amazing! The trip was at best a 3 star! Meeting this local was a blessing. She gave great local advice and made you feel at home! I highly recommend this!!! 5 stars!!  The resort is beautiful the workers make the trip!!!!

reviews.author: Excursion54226325620
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text: El  hotel estupendo, la habitaciones grande y cómoda, la bienvenida que nos dieron fue muy bonita , muy majestuosa la habitación , las comidas nos encantó muchísimos, la playa es muy bonita y el personal es muy servicial,  lo recomendaría sin lugar a dudas, volvería a

reviews.author: Dena M
reviews.title: Great experience at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Thank you to Rosanna, Edito, Yoygelis at The Lunch Box! They are so welcoming and friendly! Made for a wonderful trip! They are great! Gracias! Please visit here - it's a gorgeous and wonderful place!! 
This trip was for work to celebrate our winners!

reviews.author: Jessica G
reviews.title: Aperfect backdrop for relaxation and unwinding
reviews.text: I was blown away by the level of attention and care provided by the staff. The views from the main pool were absolutely stunning! However, it was the pristine beach that stole my heart. The Yhi Spa provided a revitalizing experience, it truly exceeded all my expectations. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable and rejuvenating getaway.

reviews.author: charles-O s
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT !
reviews.text:
Great resort and so easy access Vs other resort in the Bavaro Area. 
We stayed at THE Reserve. rooms are nice and well furnished. We had 2 rooms side by side.  
No running in the morning to grad a chair or a palapa. Beach butler Pedro is just fantastic. Gave him our needs on day # 1 and every following day we had our palapa, towels. He would recognize us and call us by our names. Perfect set-up. Makes a big differences being in the Reserve - Adults only section Vs Normal section. I strongly recommend The Reserve area. 
 
My only constructive comment is in ref to the Food: the signage on the buffets ie. Santé or The lunch Box (main buffet) lacked of what the food items are. We have 2 allergic people (peanuts and fish) in the family so it was a challenge at these locations to find out the name of the food item. Many of the buffet stations  where missing service spoons for each food item to serve yourself properly. Ex: The Grazzie Station /Charcuterie board: people would take the folk from the salmon plater to get some ham and or other charcuterie, cheeses etc. I asked several times during the week to get additional cutlery to not contaminate.  All the hotels of this level have proper food signage and each item it's own food tong.  
Easily corrected if the F&B supervisor would just go around and check the buffet before the doors open.

reviews.author: Harley M
reviews.title: Ginger Bar!
reviews.text: Ginger Bar is great and clean! The bar staff Ismael, Dominga, Michael, Olga, & Nervida are so amazing! The bartenders have come up with different drinks everyday for us to try and we could not be happier with what they have made! Must go see them when coming to Paradisus!

reviews.author: ginalbilot
reviews.title: Excellent Service at Buffet
reviews.text: Rosanna and Yuderquil and Edito provided excellent service at the buffet every day. They were the only highlights of this trip. They were there with whatever we needed before we even asked for it. If only the rest of the resort service was nearly that good.

reviews.author: Jaccell A
reviews.title: Great People
reviews.text: Rosanna , Edito y Yuderkis gave us good service in the buffet restaurant .  Constantly refilling coffee cups and anything else we need it.  They were very friendly and welcoming. They came to our table several times to make sure we were happy! They are very hard workers !

reviews.author: Francisco A
reviews.title: Es un hotel maravilloso , lugar  privilegiada , su personal empezando por José Ramos Rivera , gracias
reviews.text: Maravilloso hotel , Jose Ramos Rivera y su equipo son maravillosos , las mejores vacaciones que se puedan tener en Republica Dominicana , gracias de corazón a todo el equipo por hacernos sentir tan agusto , volveré y lo recomendaré, son las vacaciones soñadas .

reviews.author: Lidia H
reviews.title: Experiencia espectacular pero mejorable
reviews.text: Venir a Paradisus ha sido una experiencia maravillosa, aunque también se puede decir que mejorable. La comida muy rica, especialmente en los restaurantes Mina y Sante. Sin embargo el italiano Mascalzone y el mexicano Blue Agave dejan algo que desear… Por último, el restaurante Malva directamente no puedo opinar porque fuimos a cenar y no nos quisieron atender porque no tenían gente y no estaban por la labor. La chica que nos limpia la habitación es un encanto y nos la deja siempre perfecta. Luego hay una chica que trabaja en el chiringuito llamado 90 grados que se llama Rosanna Aquino y es la mejor de todos, te atiende que es una delicia y siempre tiene conversación para darte. De hecho vengo expresamente para pasarme un rato con ella😊  Y para finalizar, los que te atienden en la playa son muy simpáticos pero demasiado listos. Te ocupan las camas de la primera fila para “guardártelas” pero realmente te quitan la posibilidad de que lo hagas tú y así se llevan su propina de manera sucia, para mi gusto. Las instalaciones están muy bien, para que negarlo, y el personal en general muy agradable pero si tienes un problema te vas igual que viniste. Te ponen buena cara, te tratan bien, te hacen reír y parece que te van a solucionar el problema pero nada de eso. Llamémoslo ritmo dominicano… La conclusión es que volvería, pero con todo este aprendizaje en mente😂 Me lo he pasado divinamente y desde luego que he desconectado🥰

reviews.author: Treysmom616
reviews.title: Luciana server at the buffet
reviews.text: Luciana was amazing at the buffet she had everything ready for us every time we ate at the paradisis  Palma real. She always had a smile on her face.  And spoke great English.  She was so sweet to me and my small children.  They could not wait to see her every day.

reviews.author: Kirbi B

reviews.title: Luciana, attentive at breakfast! She provided great service for Melia, paradisus palma real! She is an asset to this hot
reviews.text: Luciana was great at the breakfast buffet! 💯! She was very attentive every morning, and she already knew what we wanted to drink. Always happy and smiling!!😃 made sure coffee was filled, mimosa's were poured and we were comfortable with our seating!

reviews.author: Nicolás S

reviews.text: Buen resort. Tiene de todo y todo el mundo es muy atento. Buenos servicios en general, lo recomiendo. Mucho lujo y la piscina bar muy divertida. Fui al gym y sorprendido con la cantidad de maquinas que tiene. Destacar el trato de Ricki en el buffet del hotel.

reviews.author: Alba H

reviews.text: Genial servicio de ricki en em desayuno. El día que nos vamos a santo domingo. Nos atendió muy bien. Muy agradable, servicial y simpático.  Nos explicó varios lugares para visitar en santo domingo ya que el es oriundo de allí y nos sirvió de gran ayuda.

reviews.author: Dixan M
reviews.title: Hotel precioso en una primera línea de playa único en Punta Cana.
reviews.text: Una vez más visitamos nuestra casa y como siempre la pasamos fenomenal, calidad de alimentos y bebidas excelente, las áreas super cuidadas, las habitaciones preciosas con una vista al mar inigualable, un servicio de calidad y un carisma del personal único en el Caribe.

reviews.author: Bryan W
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent experience. And top quality resort. Service was top notch. Specific call out to Luciana - She took the best care of us each morning and lunch. Always paid so much attention to our needs and was very helpful. Thank you for the service.

reviews.author: kreynoso54
reviews.title: Good stay!
reviews.text: The service is excellent! Luciana, Wladimir, Ariel, were excellent! We had a group of 16 and although it was hard, to accommodate, it worked out in the end. Food at the buffet could be better, but overall it was good. The beach and facilities were clean, and it wasn’t crowded at all.

reviews.author: scott a
reviews.title: poor customer service and cold showers
reviews.text:
I am really not one to write reviews but I had no choice after our recent visit.  My wife and I organized a trip for our daughters spring break and convinced 15 other families to join us.  
Let me start with a couple positives:  this location has great weather, the swim out pool was amazing and the beach was walkable and really nice.
Here we go:  the customer service was flat out pathetic!   I was fully expecting somone to understand english but the majority of the resort knew little to zero english.  This really makes communicating or asking any questions nearly impossible.   The food was maybe a 2 out of 10 and our entire group was sick the majority of the time.  (3) of our days/nights were without hot water in both of our rooms.  When I asked to have this addressed, nothing was done.  When we went to check out and I asked to speak to our "butler", he walked the other way.  When I asked to speak to a manager to discuss our frustrations, no one had any authority to do anything.  I was not looking for a huge portion off the bill, but wanted someone (anyone) to take accountability for no hot water.  I would never, ever recommend staying at this resort!

reviews.title: Awesome resort
reviews.text: Me and my wife went on our 10 year anniversary here at Paradisus, we had an amazing time, the beach is amazing, we have been here to Dominican republic 3 times and we loved this resort, the food was good and service amazing, a must stay, we also had a butler for the reserve area he’s name is Juan Carlos, he is so awesome he would think of everything for us before we even know we needed it lol he awesome

reviews.author: YENNI A
reviews.title: Experiencias
reviews.text:
Se necesita más Personal y/o un poco más de experiencia de parte de los mismo y mejor respuesta frente al cliente.

El restaurante tiene mucha variedad, pero deben mejorar la variedad de postres según vayan cambiando los días.

El tiempo de espera del servicio al cliente es demasiado largo.

El Ginger Bar es un bar excelente, personas atentas y pendientes al usuario.

reviews.author: Dorothy B
reviews.title: AN OASIS OF PAMPERING & RELAXATION
reviews.text: We had 10 days at the beautiful Reserve Nitka Room swim up.  This was our first time here and it is gorgeous!  The beach is breathtaking; the facility is immaculate; and we were thrilled with the restaurants, activities, ocean and pool swims as well as night shows which more than met our expectations.  We were blessed with the best concierge ever - Wily Mercado who took care of our every need and whim - making all reservations for us and answering our questions in such a timely manner.  Wily went ABOVE & BEYOND all you could possibly expect.  Huge thank yous to the lovely Loyda Tejeda who was our fun and super attentive  pool bar server extraordinaire!  She made our trip extra fun for sure!  Gladys Dominguez provided an amazing massage and even helped cure my sore shoulder!  Elizabeth Joaquin worked hard to keep the buffet area so clean and neat and always had a beautiful smile on her face (every single day!)  and was so welcoming and warm.  We enjoyed many lunches at the Kanna Restaurant and received great service and laughs with Elvin and Francisco who were also so welcoming and helpful and spoiled us every day.  The food at Sante Restaurant was exceptionally delicious but truly, all the meals we had were fantastic and so many choices at the buffet as well.   We did have a slight issue with a long wait at one of the restaurants but once we voiced our concerns, it was all made good and we felt that management really cared about their guests and wanted to make our stay excellent in every way and they followed up with us repeatedly to make sure we were happy.  The whole experience was so relaxing and everywhere you looked there was beauty in the surroundings and especially, in the people who served us.   We would definitely go back again and I highly recommend this beautiful oasis of total pampering!

reviews.author: Tatiana M
reviews.title: Very good !
reviews.text:
Very good experience! The food was excellent !! The service was lovely also. Thank you very much 
Lovely service from José Rosario; Asmanda Envriquez; Marian Rabsatt and Milton Perez!
Gracias por todo😌

Grande for a large beer is a bonus.

reviews.author: Iris H
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: We had a great experience.  Highly recommended.  The people are great, very accommodating.  The difference restaurants were very tasty and the drinks were so good.  The activities and shows were very entertaining.

reviews.author: Suiden D
reviews.title: Muy buen servicio!
reviews.text: Excelente servicio en el bar Gunger, Aperol spritz en su punto. Criceida es muy amable y atenta!! Las instalaciones limpias, amplio espacio con distintos ambientes agradables…. Muy recomendable para venir con amigos y grupos!

reviews.author: Sune P
reviews.title: Wonderful time in paradise, except for the initial welcome
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing time at the Palma Real, from amazing food, tasty beverages and the most courteous and amazingly friendly staff. Special shout out to Yuderi Reyes for making us feel like royalty on the beach, and always being ready with a drink, water or towel and even teaching us some Spanish. Another special shout-out to Franky Feliz, for his upbeat spirit and good service, and Miguel Peña for his assistance with booking of activities. 

The staff is what makes this resort so special. The only exception was when we initially arrived at the resort…because I exchanged this holiday using timeshare elsewhere with RCI, we checked in at the circle lounge, not the usual check in desk. The person working there, whose name I can’t remember, was extremely rude to the couple ahead of us and we received a similar unfriendly welcome. He refused to answer any questions we had about restaurant reservations, etc, instead told us that a concierge would be reaching out to us and handed us a piece of paper with a QR code. No one reached out and when we stopped by the next day to ask about this he was again very rude. Thankfully his colleague was much more helpful and put us in touch with Claritzel Otañez who was extremely helpful in answering our questions throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Kimberly M
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
We just got back home from this beautiful resort and we had an amazing time. Yanira S, Maria and another wonderful woman whose name I unfortunately do not remember were so incredibly kind and so amazing to my kids. They treated us just like family and went above and beyond. We already miss them. Damian and Olivia say hi! 
The rooms were very spacious, the bathtub was AMAZING and the ocean front view was spectacular. 
We would totally come back to this resort!

reviews.author: Doon070401
reviews.title: Great service and beach!
reviews.text: Osvaldo made our welcome genuine and warm. He explained how the resort works and made sure we took full advantage of the resort’s amenities.  Maxima gave us excellent pool side service which made us come to his area every afternoon! The only thing we would improve on is access to all restaurants and there were major up charges at the steakhouse restaurant for instance. Only one cut available for the regular traveller. We had a Nitke Oceanfront room which was beautiful 😊

reviews.author: fcontador
reviews.title: Restaurant zona adultos fui atendido por José del rosario y su equipo Eduardo Saudys y Amanda excelente atención
reviews.text: Fuimos muy bien atendidos por este equipo estábamos decepcionados ya que fuimos agua marina y fue horrible tuvimos que avisarle al personal que los baños estaban asquerosos una muy mala experiencia en este restaurant de adultos que vinimos hoy con este Equipo que nos atendió nos hizo olvidar en parte la mala experiencia .

reviews.author: DDB T
reviews.title: Paradisus es el Paraiso en Dominicana, Punta Cana
reviews.text: La atención en el lugar es de la mejor de Punta Cana, realmente todo el personal hace un esfuerzo constante por brindarte la mejor calidad de servicio y atención. Volvería solo por la atención! Milton y Fausto, en “mascalzonne”(rest italiano) se enfocan en que tengas una experiencia espectacular. La comida no es muy variada pero esta a la altura de un all inclusive de primer nivel.

reviews.author: Marcela M
reviews.title: Dias increibles
reviews.text: El hotel es increible. El personal es muy amable eriel hizo de la estancia muy agradable. Los chicos del kids zone fueron muy amables durante la estadia, mi nino jugo siempre.el restaurante sante que es solo para adultos es muy recomendable, la comida super rica y esta cerca de la piscina muy romantico.

reviews.author: Danny G
reviews.title: Great family resort and service.
reviews.text: One of the best vacations I had recently. Thanks to the concierge Francisoc Vilorio. Hands down the man on making sure nothing goes wrongs or goes out of his way to get you what you need for your family.

reviews.author: jack o
reviews.title: Palma Real
reviews.text: Excellent vacation at palma real, the grounds are beautiful maintained, the staff at the pool and restaurants are helpful and friendly.  Want to acknowledge our concierge Francisco V, who went above and beyond. His hard work is much appreciated.

reviews.author: Romy C
reviews.title: Happy vacations
reviews.text: En nuestra estancia la pasamos muy bien, atención del personal A1,  las instalaciones muy cautivante y relajantes, la comida muy deliciosa. Disfrutamos de las actividades Destination Included. Felicito a Francisco Santos y su equipo por su profesionalismo y empatia pues hicieron de nuestra estancia muy gratificante. Las actividades que brinda el resort son muy divertidas y el personal muy amable, agradecer a Jorge Rafael por su alegría y motivación a que disfrutemos de las actividades.

reviews.author: Mauricio Gonzal... B
reviews.title: Best Holidays in paradise
reviews.text: Estuve 6 días y fue una experiencia increíble, los restaurantes son variados y de muy buena calidad, las habitaciones son hermosas, amplias y muy limpias se tienen todas las comodidades, la atención es 24*7 y todo el personal es muy amable, la ubicación del hotel es excelente y está a un paso del mar. Felicito a Francisco Santos por su excelente atención y a Juan sierra por su excelente apoyo y recomendaciones. Se pueden hacer actividades extremas, las piscinas son grandes, hay muchas y con bellas vistas. Se puede solicitar cualquier bebida y alimento en casi cualquier lugar del hotel, las instalaciones son de primera. Volvería sin dudarlo!.

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.title: Beautiful paradise!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful! We went with a networking business event where we had some planned dinners and some days/evenings to ourselves and the resort was perfect for that. The Japanese hibachi restaurant was the best food we had and the buffets were plentiful. 
We had a Consierge named Dalmis Rodriguez and he was very helpful! He sent us the daily activities, made our reservations, and even helped us get more M&Ms (lol). Very nice staff.

reviews.author: Jose Maria P
reviews.title: Estancia maravillosa en Paradisus Palma Real !!
reviews.text: Hemos pasado una estadía maravillosa en el hotel.  Hemos viajado mucho y por muchas cadenas de hoteles y en Paradisus sin duda ha cumplido todas nuestras expectativas, tanto de tranquilidad como de disfrute en familia.  Sin duda volveremos

reviews.author: anapS3663OO
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel muy bueno, personal muy amable, servicio excelente de restaurantes y comida muy buena. Lo recomiendo 100%. Ubicación inmejorable frente al mar, se puede ver desde cualquier punto del hotel. Increíble!

reviews.author: Christian Chena
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia, hermoso lugar y el mejor equipo humano.
reviews.text: No sabría cómo empezar para explicar lo bien que pasamos con mi familia en este hermoso resort que es Paradisus Palma Real. El servicio impecable, las actividades del día siempre cargadas de belleza del lugar y un acompañamiento más que excelente del equipo humano de este resort. Atribuyo el 100% de la experiencia maravillosa a la gestión del Sr. Wily Mercado, quien siempre hace que la estadía en el lugar no sea solo un viaje, sino un recuerdo de esos que brillan siempre en la memoria. También destaco al mejor soporte que es el amigo Franklin, que siempre estuvo ante cualquier consulta de asistencia técnica. Cada vez que visitamos Punta Cana, no dudamos que Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort es el lugar para ir, y consideramos a Wily Mercado, definitivamente, familia.

reviews.author: Beatriz J
reviews.title: Restaurant Sante
reviews.text: We loved the restaurant Sante for adults only from the food to all the service and in particular the Sante staff like Zuleica, Fausto, the two Franklins, Luz, Gustavo, Jose, Juan, Pamela, Zunilda and everybody else, as well as the chefs  Juan Tavera y Rafael. They were always very warm, kind and cheerful. And I had a very special birthday celebration!!❤️

reviews.author: Melwin M
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text:
The hotel was amazing! They gave us the most incredible Concierge who went out of his way to make sure our stay was incredible. Shout out to Felix Garcia! 

The restaurants at the hotel were a bit slow, but maybe that's just because I'm used to faster service in Europe. They often forgot orders but that might've been a language barrier. Though, it felt like there was a disconnect between the kitchen and staff.

Make sure you reserve either through one of the awesome Concierges or by yourself, even if the restaurant isn't full, they will tell you it's full. We went up to one of the restaurants and we got the message that it was full and they couldn't serve us, even though we clearly saw that there were 4 people sitting in the restaurant. But because they had a reservation at 9PM (It was 6:30 at the time) they couldn't serve us because it would be too busy.

reviews.author: brookmill
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
We just returned from an amazing 7 night stay in the Reserve. The resort is absolutely beautiful! Team of people out every morning cleaning and refreshing everything from cushions on chairs, to the beach, to the pool, to the walkways. Always greeted with smiles and every person we met was ready to help with anything we might need.

Our concierge, Starlin, was AMAZING! He arranged all of our dinners, even one night making a last minute switch when our excursion returned late. He was there to help with anything we might need.

Loved the variety of activities--from unique exercise (spin class in pool!) to pizza making/Aperol Spritz workshop--fun and low key and no need to sign up in advance

Food and Drink--first time I have been at all inclusive that had true craft cocktails. Each bar had signature drinks and each had a slightly different vibe. Food was very good--some hits/misses but overall very good. We only ate at Sante one night and wish we had gone more often--if you like steak--go there instead of Mina. We mostly at Sante for breakfast and lunch, but unlike many buffets, there's is WONDERFUL--great selection and the lovely seating area with attentive staff to bring drinks and clear tables. Definitely check out the grilling stations on the beach next to the Taco Truck and next to the snack restaurant on the beach.

Some of the people who made our stay amazing;
Starlin--WONDERFUL concierge
Eduardo and Gustavo--Sante
Lucia Diaz--Ginger Bar
Wanda--ReservePool Bar
Martin--Beach Attendant

We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Freddy B
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Ismael in the ginger bar was so helpful making us terrific tropical cocktails as we're all the waitresses they made us feel at home....my concierge Aeriol was absolutely terrific and over the top 5 star service all the way can't thank you enough your my reason for wanting to come back and we will come back for sure sooner than later.truly my best stay here in Punta Cana Ever and I've been Here six times I'm al.ost Dominican Now lol.

reviews.author: Michele B
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant service
reviews.text: Amazing service at the resort and especially Nikte restaurant, Jose del Rosario, Feliz, Andino,   Laicho, Saudys, and Alex Marthur were all attentive, professional, and helpful. And, very delicious food!

reviews.author: dleone123
reviews.title: April 2023
reviews.text: The resort was only reopened for 4/5 months before our arrival after a huge renovation.  The rooms were beautiful and everything was very clean.  We had the Nitke Master 2 bedroom swim up.  The swim up room was the best decision we made- definitely worth the extra money.  The concierge service was great.  Fernando was the best- scheduled all of our dinner reservations and excursions.  He was always available and overall a terrific guide and he made sure we had a great experience.  The only downside was the food.  It wasn’t bad, but not the greatest either.  Our teens loved the buffet as they are picky eaters and could always find something good to eat. The restaurants were ok- the Italian was our favorite.  Overall, we loved our vacation and would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Fetiye T

reviews.author: Danilo L

reviews.author: Penelope D

A really nice place to relax.. The grounds are beautiful,  Staff AWESOME.   Our concierge Irvin.  AMAZING!!  He was attentive,  caring, and set up the most amazing anniversary celebration for my husband and I.

reviews.author: Gabriel D
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia

reviews.author: Esteban A

Comprometidos todos con que uno se sintiera cómodo y descansando.

reviews.author: mickweeks

This was our third trip to this resort and it did not disappoint.  The property has grown since our last visit in 2018 and dare I say the customer service has grown as well.   Everyone we encountered from our assigned concierge Diana to the Manager Cesar was professional, friendly and helpful.  We had terrific weather and excellent meals, the Buffet, to taco truck on the beach, the steak house, MINA check out my tomahawk post, the Mexican restaurant. reviews.text: This place is so beautifully  done the decore the pools the food the service all over the top 5 star plus plus is all I can say absolutely amazing experience first class all the way and a Butler to Boot  what  can I say it's a must do thing to put on your bucket list  and Marielisa was such a dear friend  to us helping  us out at every availability she's an asset for paradises Palma real your lucky to have her as we were to meet her.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Family Vacation Success at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
If I could rate this 4.5, I would. Not quite a 5, but nearly perfect. 

The good/great: 
- The room. We stayed in a swim up Nikte master bedroom suite. We were traveling with our toddler (2.5) and she stayed in a hotel provided crib in an alcove in the master bedroom where the tub/extra sink was. BUT there was a curtain divider and a separate door to the bathroom, so we could stay in the living room during bedtime/naps and she couldn't see us at night/in the morning. 
- The pool outside our room was great - sun bed, chaise lounges. The hotel staff would swing by to offer a drink (or you could grab a beer from your stocked minibar.) 
- The beach. We were about a 5 minute walk to the beach. Yes, there is a bit of seaweed, but nothing crazy and it is the ocean after all. The waves were manageable and my toddler enjoyed playing in the wake and going into the water. 
- The restaurants. The restaurants for dinner - especially Mina and Blue Agave - were great. The buffet was good and had lots of options. The fruit, tostadas and French toast were all especially good at breakfast. Some things were a miss at the buffet but they're catering to many different tastes. 
- The staff. This should be #1. Everyone from front desk, to our concierge (Edgar!), to the servers at the buffet and restaurants and the staff at the kids club was lovely and trying to make our stay enjoyable. 
-The hotel/design. This place is beautiful. The beach is beautiful. 

We didn't use the kids club b/c the kids seemed to skew older than toddler, so we didn't think our daughter would enjoy it. But we saw kids participating in the activities - which are numerous - around the resort. Susu - a staffer in the kid club - was very welcoming when we went to check it out. 

This hotel seemed to cater to conferences, which could go either way, but seemed to make the place quite while being busy. You always got a beach chair, always got a seat at the buffet and just generally had peace and quiet. 

Overall, we had a wonderful, chill beach vacation where we didn't have to worry about anything in a beautiful place with wonderful, welcoming people. What's better than that?

reviews.author: Simon D
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text:
Great bar with great staff - very friendly and helpful. We he gin and tonics are really good as is the beer.

There are also many free snack to have with the very good coffee they provide. The bar is also open 24x7

reviews.author: NLG
reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.text: We went on free business trip for four days.  For free it was great.  I wouldn’t pay for it though.  Service was very poor.  You’d have people come over to take your order and then never bring whatever it was.  I’m vegan and was informed ahead of time that I’d be able to eat here.  It was very very hard.  The restaurant on the premises that’s advertised as vegan - Flora - changed its menu and it’s now fully meat. Both the website and hotel brochures still say it’s vegan though. The restaurants told us they could accommodate me but when we’d get there, it was clear they had no idea what vegan was and couldn’t handle anything off menu other than a green salad - which since the water is bad here, isn’t safe to eat.   If you wanted to eat at a red you needed to make reservations at  a particular desk that closed at 4.  After that they wouldn’t let you in even if the restaurant was empty.  Several times we were told no for something that when our Butler asked magically appeared.  Beach was gross with sea weed.  Overall just not worth it and don’t bother if you eat anything other than meat.

reviews.author: Brock R
reviews.title: All inclusive fun
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, excellent staff, friendly and helpful.  Room was first rate, clean, and close to beach and pools.  Lunch box restaurant was great for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Also had a personal concierge “Mac” who was a delight and made the stay even better.

reviews.author: Julian P
reviews.title: Excelente en el Meliá
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, totalmente real, muy entregados serviciales y muy queridos todos en el hotel. La comida es un 10, pero los postres si se queda un poco cortos ;). Los servicios que ofrecen son perfectamente realizados.

reviews.author: Jason F
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had a great trip. They could adjust some things to make the resort spectacular. There could be way more communication when you arrive. We didn’t have a list of restaurants or menus. We didn’t get any list of included activities We had a Nitke Master Swim Up Suite. It was a great room. There was waiter service right to our room. The food was good. It wasn’t excellent. Overall we had a great time.     Our concierge Ariel was great. After he took care of some things for our room and understood what we were looking for he took care of us nicely.

reviews.author: Lorrainbow
reviews.title: Luxurious hotel, great food, great service, too pushy on the sales
reviews.text:
We (family of 2 adults, 2 kids aged 10 and 8) booked Melia hotel with Loveholiday. Less than a week before they emailed and said there were no rooms available and had changed the reservation to paradisus. Paradisus is a much more luxurious hotel but less child friendly. It's not anti child just melia has a water park and is more lively. 

We got caught in a sales pitch. Our concierge said we should try breakfast in the other hotel and he had a $100 voucher for us which we thought was for the hotel change inconvenience. It wasn't, it was for sitting through an aggressive sales pitch. The sales person sat with us at breakfast, she was very friendly but the whole thing was very pushy, writing down numbers. I tried to be polite and said enough after an hour but they didn't listen and started again. My husband was very blunt and said no and stood up. 

That was only 1 of 2 negative parts of the holiday. 

The two bedroom hotel room was amazing. The rooms were interconnecting, ground floor with an outdoor shower and hot tub outside each room. Seating area, kitchen, it was like a mini hotel. 

The pools were great. Bars were great, high quality drinks. The buffet was great. Different food every meal, every day.  Lots to choose from and lots cooked fresh in front of you. 

As many people have mentioned there is so much staff around. If you need anything they're right there to help. 

The second bad thing was the restaurants. The pizza place was not good, the pizza at the buffet was better. It was soggy and didn't taste great. The steak restaurant is amazing, we went there twice. The Mexican restaurant, we arrived at our reservation time at say 7.30pm. At 8pm we asked when we'd be seated, they said the next table was ours. We watched them give it to another family 15 minutes later. So 45 minutes of waiting we left. That was disappointing. 

We booked a catamaran trip, skape park and Katmandu. All excellent. Skape park is very simple and you can't quite fill the full day. The bus drops you off in the morning and collects you at 5pm but 3pm would have been better. It's a lot of walking but everything is great, zip wire, cave swim. The monkey "island" is a patch of grass in the entrance! But it was a great day out.

Katmandu is setup like Disneyland, lots of staff, lots of places for people to queue but when we went it was empty and felt a bit soulless. The rides weren't amazing, very tame. But still a fun day out. 

Altogether it was an excellent holiday, very luxurious, very hot. We don't tend to visit the same hotel again and again so we wouldn't go here precisely but maybe a different hotel, like the Melia!

reviews.author: jose luis v
reviews.title: Lindas vacaciones

reviews.author: jent1005
reviews.title: Nikte - PPR Adult Trip Swim Up (Circle Black)
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a 5 night stay at The Palma Real - Black Circle Members, staying in a Nikte swim up room. This trip was seamless for us! We were met deplaning at the airport, taken to the lounge, no immigration, baggage in the car and at the resort for check-in just 50 minutes of time! Outstanding. The only blip was that we arrived earlier in the morning and no one seemed ready to receive us. But once we had our concierge, Kenneth, everything was PERFECTION. To the Management:  Kenneth deserves a promotion.  We have been members for 10 years now, first Club Melia now Circle.  Kenneth stands out.  He has a bright future with you and should be noticed/rewarded appropriately.
In the room with our welcome chocolates/berries/Cava was a note explaining all of the amenities included in our stay. It was clear, and appreciated. And met with my expectations of what was included. This was a couple/adult stay for us and we had no need to be at Falcon or visit Katmandu. Service across the resort was on point and no one let us want for anything - ever. We were offered lobster or steak or lobster AND steak in one form or another at each of our dinners. The presentation and quality of the Tomahawk steak at Mina is over THE top! We laughed and had fun with the staff. Shout out to Jorge at the Black Circle Lounge (tending bar)...to Rosanny at breakfast.  We shared our Easter meal with the staff at Brisas - great meal, great staff (Yonely, Denice, Stomin).  More thanks to the staff at Mascalzone, everyone at Mina (Kelvin, Esekiel, Blue Agave too!  We did our best to appreciate everyone. We would not be more pleased with the improvements and are very happy to have the Members only Beach Club at the Palma Real. IMHO it was lacking with The Reserve (now Garden Suites) and Level Guests being mixed with members. At every turn our member level upgrades were offered and received. Oh.....and our room was made up each day and turn down service each night. 
 Just remember to put the light on requesting it when you leave the room.  Already looking to come back!  Well done.

reviews.author: SAI
reviews.title: Best place to be!!!
reviews.text: The best of the best!! Don’t understand any negative reviews! Meet Jose Ramirez and Melvin Mercedes  at the front and he’s gonna take care of you! One of the nicest people you meet around.  Don’t double think your stay and come to Palma real!!!

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.title: Great time in Santo Domingo
reviews.text:
Jhon Carvana land Ralphy were amazing. Had a wonderful time. The beach was great.  Manageable small waves for children.  There were activities everyday and a wide variety of food and drink options.  At this point I’m liking this much better than my normal
Cancun trips.

Ariel nuestro concierge muy atento siempre y dando el mejor trato, una gran persona. Volveremos!!

reviews.author: Juan Manuel P

reviews.author: D Garcia
reviews.title: Excelente estadía gracias a José Arismendy!
reviews.text: La mejor experiencia de todas, fui con unos amigos y todos disfrutamos al máximo, el hotel ha hecho muchos cambios para mejor, las habitaciones están hermosas, la comida de buena calidad. Mención especial a JOSE ARISMENDY maletero, que siempre estuvo pendiente a nosotros desde la llegada, asegurándose de que no nos falte nada y a José capitan del restaurante Santé por su excelente servicio.

reviews.author: Ana R
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
El hotel es lindisimo, muy bien ambientados todos los espacios. La habitación es espectacular. Todo muy limpio.
La comida del buffet es riquísima, de enorme variedad y buena calidad. El hecho de que esté abierto todo el día es comodisimo. Genial el food truck en la playa con cebiches y parrilla. Probamos el restaurante de sushi y el de pastas y no valieron la pena. El personal en el desayuno varía en su nivel de atención, hay que encontrar con insistencia quien te sirva el café. 
La atención de Eriol Alix fue muy amable y atenta, siempre pendiente de lo que necesitáramos y preocupado porque estemos bien, haciendo más agradable nuestra estadía. Se esforzó por todos los días ocuparse de todo.
Destaco que además fue excelente la atención médica de la Dra. Grullón ante una emergencia que tuvimos. Sorprende contar con una profesional de ese nivel de manera permanente en un hotel. Pedimos una ambulancia que llegó en el acto. Son cosas que uno no piensa de antemano que va a necesitar y fue gratificante que todo funcionara tan bien. 
El kids club regenteado por Yesmeily Tejeda Abreu, Martha y sus compañeras fue inolvidable y uno de los motivos por los que nuestra estadía fue excelente. Amorosas, divertidas, confiables. Todos los dias una actividad mejor que otra, superó cualquier cosa que hubiéramos imaginado. ¡¡Increibles las actividades y el manejo de los chicos!! De lo mejor.
Las canchas de tenis muy buenas, nos dieron raquetas y pelotas. Sugeriría más actividades para los adultos, el nivel no se compara con las de los chicos.

reviews.author: Carlos A
reviews.title: Everyone made us feel like family
reviews.text:
Stuff is excellent everyone is friendly Fernando at the main bar, Leandro at the pool made us feel like home
Food was excellent all the workers by the beach all friendly,pools very clean it's one of the best resorts I been

reviews.author: vanessam714
reviews.title: Amazing Family Trip
reviews.text:
I was nervous because of all the challenged reviews. It was an unbelievable vacation. Absolutely recommend for families!  Don’t hesitate!

We had a 2 bedroom Nikite Suite.  Super comfortable beds and beautiful rooms that are just intuitive in their layout and BIG. My only critique was the one of the bedrooms didn’t get cold enough but when we called our concierge it was fixed immediately which I believe just meant they lowered the set floor for the thermostat allowing it to cool more. 

The pool waitstaff and bartenders are outrageously attentive and so friendly – you don’t go more than 3 minutes without a drink if you want one. It’s remarkable how hard everyone is working to make sure you have a good time.  All of us said it was the best service we have had at any hotel ever. 

There are pools that surround the rooms which all have drink service. A really nice touch if you don’t feel like dealing with the chaos of the larger pool or just need a break. 

The fact that your room key is on your wrist at all times (and works all the time) is brilliant. All of us commented how we wish it was like that all hotels. 

Our concierge was Nicolas and he was super responsive and helpful. He got us great dinner reservations each night, made massage and other spa appointments and made our kids laugh. He sent us the daily activities each morning too along with the room service and spa menus. We never had to chase – always proactively texting to provide info.

We did the buffet for breakfast and sometimes lunch.  It was good with offerings changing just enough to make it interesting.  Highly recommend the omelet stations and the fresh fish cooking station was a bit hit.   Kanna is next to the buffet and has really great offerings for snacks / lunch. There were also grill stations on the beach each day with meats and vegetables. Our favorite restaurants for dinner were Agave Blue (Mexican) and Mina (steak) but also liked the Italian restaurant. Special shout-out to Manuel and Eduardo at Blue Agave – unbelievably welcoming and responsive hospitality staff.  Truthfully, all of the restaurants were good.  The only restaurant I would skip next time is Malva which had great service but the steaks were chewy. Highly recommend the Ginger bar – they had the best drinks + they have games (chess etc) in the cabinets. 

The hotel goes out of the way to provide unique offerings day and night – it’s just a great touch that a lot of places don’t take on and the staff has such great energy so it feels fun. We have 6 and 9 year old boys so we gravitated toward the kids-oriented activities.  During the day, this included pool activities like inflatables, body boards, obstacle courses, and then on the beach there was face painting, basketball inflatables, soccer games, dancing, etc.  It’s amazing how much they organize each day to make it unique.   There were also events each night including a circus night with performers, astronomy with telescopes, dancing transformers, and a local market among others. These were all on the plaza with bars throughout. It was a great way to spend time with kids and adults after dinner.  

The Xi spa and the fitness center could use a refresh but honestly not a big deal for us.  Skip the gift shop if you can – it’s crazy expensive and it’s likely worth asking if there are nearby alternatives if needed. I know there is a pharmacy nearby that delivers.  

I got a massage at the eco spa and I highly recommend Katherine – she was fantastic – I went 2x.  

We did go to Katmandu one to the afternoons.  It is a theme park on the hotel property.  The hotel will give you bracelets which allow you to enter one of the attractions at the park for free - the quadragon. It is a dimensional climbing gym. Our kids probably spent 30 minutes playing. I’d recommend it if you’re there and need something new / active to do as it’s a golf cart ride from the hotel. Accessing the rest of the park costs $120 for 1 adult + 1 child. CRAZY!! So we skipped it. Honestly they are going to struggle unless they lower the price by 60-75%. 

One piece of advice - do yourself a favor and bring $100-200 in small bills to tip. We never carry cash and the ATMs weren’t working.  It doesn’t feel like there is any expectation to tip but we wanted to and having the small bills would have been nice.

reviews.author: Big Mike
reviews.title: Concierge Top!!!
reviews.text: Great Service in the Concierge Melvin!!!! beutifull  hotel , beaches, great room service at 1am... Full Aperol Spritz, white sand everywhere,  every day different activities to do! children will love all of the activities!

Las actividades para niños se destacaron realmente el personal se esmeró para q los niños la pasen batanaron con actividades ingeniosas y divertidas. reviews.author: Lem151areg
reviews.title: Experience culinary Utopia at Flora!

We enjoy the scrumptious tuna tartare and a fried shrimp app. We shared a unique apple salad. Our main courses enlivened our senses with the delicious flavors of salmon and octopus.

reviews.author: Mallory M
reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.text: Excellent service and food!! Our waiter Ulise P. was great and so attentive. Super fantastic! The guacamole was delicious!! Eduardo was very friendly and helpful. Our son loves the rice and beans and wanted to come back immediately

reviews.author: Marissa H
reviews.title: Great week!!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week at the Paradisus Palma Real. The grounds are gorgeous and the staff so friendly and helpful. We don’t bill ourselves as “all inclusive” people - mostly because we are pretty picky about having good food and had a bad experience at a different all inclusive resort many years ago. Lucky for us, the food all week was fantastic! We ate at most of the restaurants and did the buffet for breakfast and lunch. There were also grills going everyday at lunch outside where you could get different meats freshly grilled. Room service was also available. Our two favorite restaurants were Blue Agave (Mexican) and Mina (steakhouse). Franklin from Malva was a great server. Wilmer went above and beyond to take care of us at the pool/beach bars. And the best for last, Kelvin was our concierge and was amazing. He secured our dinner reservations and helped us with misc requests all week long. Would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: J Nigos
reviews.title: Spring break
reviews.text: Hotel is very clean, airy and layout is awesome. We really liked the kids club. They had a variety of activities for the kids and the staff were very nice and engaged. Specialty restaurants had great food. Although certain things on the menu were not part of all inclusive and would have to pay extra. Not much choices in alcohol/cocktails but we were mostly in the family area so not sure if the experience would be the same in the adults only part of the hotel. We were disappointed with the service in the buffet restaurant. When it gets really busy, its hard to ask for drinks or silverwares. Also very limited restaurant choices for breakfast and lunch. But we really liked Kanaa and Santo is the best. Very friendly and attentive and my kids loved his “San Francisco juice”. Night entertainment was awesome.

The shrimp & wild rice does need some seasoning & sauce.  The salmon was amazing and would get that again for sure

reviews.author: joannecasey
reviews.title: Time of our lives !!
reviews.text:
My hubby and I visited the Paradisus Palma Real from March 20-27/2023.  We initially booked a swim up room at the Reserve, however when we got there we were asked if we wanted to be upgraded to the newly renovated Palma Real. We were very skeptical as to why we received the upgrade, perhaps they overbooked, however we really lucked out.

Our swim up room was stunning and spotlessly clean. Our concierge Yaleidi Sims was a beautifully sweet lady who took care of whatever we needed. She dropped by 3 separate times during the week with wine, dipped fruit trays, and meat and cheese trays. She connected with us daily through WhatsApp, no problems getting reservations. The staff at the bar by the swim up rooms was fantastic as well. Whenever they noticed us outside they came right over to see what they could get us.

The staff everywhere were so happy and personable. And I mean everyone. From the restaurants, to the beach, to the pool, to the maintenance staff. They really did make us feel like family.

While I see a lot of complaints about the food we were very pleasantly surprised. The flavors and spices they used were absolutely delicious. My husband has been a chef here in Canada for 30 years and he gained 8lbs while away lol  He was so impressed by a t-bone we had at the steak house that he asked to speak with the chef. 

The servers at the buffet, the Italian and steak restaurant are now like our best friends. They greeted us every day with a huge smile, never let a glass go empty and just could not have been more happy to help us. Be on the look out for the following names, I believe they rotate through the restaurants :
Arito, Virtudes Mercedes, Melvin de la Cruz, Yonely Cancu, Andrea Santana. They will give you excellent service <3

The pool ... oh I miss that pool.  Never felt crowded, great swim up bar and lots of loungers. We were able to get a covered hut next to the pool every day we spent there and it was heaven. They made the huts up with towels and pillows and constant drink service. We had many an outdoor nap in those huts ! Jose our pool guy was the best !!

The beach was stunning, both the sand and the water. The only thing that we found a little hard was the vendors. I have never seen as many as that before, but they were all friendly .. there was just a lot of them :)  But we realize they are trying to support their families so we just politely declined and they would move on happily. The water was really warn and did have a little bit of seaweed but they constantly are removing it from the beach. Plus we are East Coasters so we aren't afraid of a little seaweed !

The entire resort is so beautifully decorated and very very clean. As much as some seems not to, we really enjoyed the entertainment they provided.  Great bands, and opening for those bands one night was a super talented electric guitar player, she was beautiful to listen to. Another night was a violin player and a mermaid by the fountain. And on Earth Day they shut all the lights off in that area and had a really stunning ceremony with candles. 

Honestly we cannot say enough about the service and amenities here. We were very fortunate to get a crazy good deal here last August through Costco. Unfortunately I see now that the price has really gone up. But I would pay it to be here. When we left, we felt like we were leaving home. Cannot wait to go back !!

reviews.author: wandering_spirit_nj
reviews.title: Good resort. Good Service. Good Experience. But ...
reviews.text:
This is an excellent resort in terms of location, service and experience. Then why 3-stars?

After 4-nights of a wonderful stay at the resort, we went to the checkout with a bagful of pleasant memories. We were informed that we had some extra-charges from the spa and the bar. We were aware of the spa and the premium drinks and were okay with the charges. We asked if they had adjusted the $15 that was given as the complimentary drink/beverage at the time of booking. Minor thing really and the expected answer was either "yes" or "let us see what we have here". Instead, we were asked "Did you use your coupon at the time of the drink?". We informed the manager Carlos that our booking only said "2x Food & Beverage Coupon - 15 $ - Included". There were no coupons. He pointed us to the fine-print that said "Coupons must be redeemed via Melia APP". It was under the section "Resort Coupon Conditions". We explained to the manager that it was not usual for people to read the fine-prints nor would a guest be trying to pull up some app while ordering a drink. Carlos told us that he was the manager and that he can't do anything and we have to pay those 15 dollars as well. It was somewhat amusing as well as shocking. Most resorts and hotels where we have spent far less are quick to accommodate such things where there is confusion over coupons. At least reasonable accommodations. We were only asking to honor what was included in our booking. 

A manager can't adjust what was included as complimentary in our booking? And 15 dollars where a customer has spent ~3500? It is like a hotel saying "Complimentary breakfast included" and then charging you for breakfast at the checkout under the garb of fine-prints. We suddenly felt we were dealing with a cheap management who are penny-pinchers. This was a moment of perception change. This was the moment that the wonderful and pleasant experience of our stay was blanked out by a sense of anger and helplessness.

reviews.author: isamouve
reviews.title: paradisus palma real mars 2023
reviews.text:
Trés bel hôtel, belles infrasturctures 
les chambres refaitent à neuf sont superbes , très spacieuses et propres
la plage est nettoyée chaque jour, elle est très belle également et la piscine superbe
