Merci également à Maria Luz au buffet qui s'est très bien occupée de nous.
ce voyage était ma 17ème fois en République Dominicaine, mais la première fois dans cet hôtel, je mettrait un 7 sur 10 pour l'hôtel en lui même mais un 2 sur 10 pour le service;
moi qui vantais à mes amis la gentillesse, la serviabilité, la joie de vivre des dominicains, ce ne fut pas de cas dans cet hôtel.

reviews.author: soapbox73
reviews.title: 7 Days of Paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa
reviews.text: Sitting here on our last night and reflecting about what a good time we’ve had and have so much to say. The property is beautiful and so clean! You can smell the cleanliness in the air as you arrive and walk around. The entire staff is so professional, hard working and willing to do most of whatever you ask. As Americans, we felt like a minority which is fine. The resort seemed to have guests from many different countries, especially Europeans, so Spanish is the main language spoken but many staff did know English also. We were happy to be immersed in the local culture and not have that drowned out a bunch of American culture or influences. The food, pools and beach are all very good! We had a 2 bdrm master suite for four of us including myself, husband and 2 boys ages 14 and 15. The room was perfect once you get the hang of all the light fixtures and what they operate, etc. Room service was prompt and always available just as advertised. We were here for spring break and there were always chairs available at both the pool or on the beach. We had a concierge named Nicholas and he was so helpful because we always had dinner reservations for exactly where we wanted each night. Not sure how our stay would have been without him? The only downsides as far as we could see was that traveling w teens we wished there would be more for them? A teen oriented club or hang out would be great. We saw a lot of other “bored” teens either walking around aimlessly looking at their phones and/or hanging with their parents which I don’t think they necessarily wanted to do but being at an awkward age not really knowing how to facilitate meeting other teens, especially from other countries, on their own. Also, there are no hot tubs on the property at all, which I thought was strange for a resort of this size. Hot tubs are always a great place to unwind after a long day and they also facilitate conversation for adults and teens alike. There are none. The resort is brand new and seems to have a lot of large spaces dedicated towards the “Circle Members” of Melia that never had anyone in them! Dedicated restaurants and private hang out areas that could possibly used for something else? A teen lounge with some pool & ping pong tables, foosball, video games, board games, air hockey, Uno and playing cards, etc. would be really cool. My husband and I would have had a better time if our kids were having a better time. They did have a beautiful child care center for younger children, I’d say for maybe 7 or 8 years old and younger. All in all we had a wonderful stay and would probably stay here again in the future. The staff and grounds are what really make the resort special.

reviews.author: snake11
reviews.title: Pure relaxation.
reviews.text:
Lots of things to recommend this hotel: great staff, stunning location, dining choices, cleanliness and amazing beach with lots of loungers and shades. A few things stopping a 5/5 review. Our room was a little tired: gap in the patio doors, cupboards not fitting, leaking shower, broken patio table; plus it wasn't as described (no kitchenette; there was a hot tub, but too unclean to use) - we were offered an upgrade, but too steep at £2000. Daily topping up of minibar and snacks was good, but not perfect.
Another issue, as others have mentioned, you do feel a bit second class if you are not members of the Melia Club - most notably with regards to dining. You cannot book restaurants except on the day at a booth by the buffet but, by the time this booth has opened, a lot of the best slots have been taken up by members through their concierges (we were able to make a direct comparison as we were initially there with other family who were members - we were also able to compare the room quality as the member area rooms had been refurbished recently)
Thought the food choices were pretty good. Buffet was a you would expect - tended to avoid it for dinner with the other restaurants available. When our other family were with us we had an opportunity to dine at the Reserve restaurant, which was excellent - had one of the best steaks I've ever had (unfortunately made my steakhouse experience later a little underwhelming). There aren't many hand sanitisers, and my wife did get a stomach upset (we of course avoided using tap water).
Gym was well equipped and quiet when I used it in the afternoons - think it was busier in the mornings.
Other than the location, the best thing about the hotel is the staff - universally helpful and pleasant. Special mention to Juan in concierge services, Luciana serving in the buffet, Elizabeth in the domestic staff and Ernesto the Melia representative. Tipping was variable and it wasn't obvious whether this affected service. We did tip and I would recommend securing a good supply of US dollar bills before travelling as it was not easy to change larger bills (we had ordered dollars from Travelex before travelling, but they didn't have any single bills!). If you're stuck Reception, bell boys or bar staff may be able to help exchange. Ernesto was a great help with booking restaurants, but his main role was to arrange a meeting with the Melia Sales staff. The expected 20 minutes with them became two hours and I felt the sales pitch quite confusing and pushy. We declined membership in the end. I'm not saying it's a bad deal, just didn't suit us. If it's something you may be interested in, I would suggest looking into it before you travel and, if you like the look of it, try to meet with the sales team early on as they may offer incentives that could make your holiday even more enjoyable. Ernest arranged a meal at the Winery for our time, which was excellent - another superlative steak and lovely bottle of wine.
Be warned, there are mosquitoes present, especially at the Lobby Bar (which is a pity as this is one of the best places to enjoy a drink) - so take protection.
Overall, this is a fantastic hotel and I would rate 5/5 for Melia Club members.

reviews.author: Inspire320199
reviews.title: Disappointing Resort - but the weather was great!
reviews.text:
Very few members spoke English -- which made it difficult to commuincate.  We were upgraded to this resort but felt like maybe we it wasnt an upgrade - No concierge services and the other resort we were to be assigned a personal concierge. 
The Dinner Reservation system is very poor - If you want to reserve dinner times - You MUST PLAN your morning schedule so you can get a reservation.

reviews.author: 681nikiv
reviews.title: 2 weeks in the sunshine
reviews.text: 2 weeks in paradise, relaxing. A lot has changed sine my last visit in 2017 but still fab. We enjoyed pre and after dinner drinks  in the Kicks sports bar, Andreína was always on hand , always had a smile and remembered our drinks order, really looked like she really enjoys her job. Jorge was also brilliant playing with pool with all and chatting with us around the pool making feel welcome and relaxed. Jose and Luis at the pool bar were super friendly and and always up for a laugh.  Frank always ensured that the day started well with coffee and mimosas.  Nothing was too much trouble for these guys. They ensure you get the most out of your holiday.

reviews.author: nicolas o
reviews.title: Muy buena atención en el bar kicks en el melia
reviews.text: La experiencia muy muy buena, las personas son muy atentas, todos los chicos del bar en especial Andreina  fue muy atenta con todas las necesidades y te atienden con mucho cariño, en el bar kicks, la comida es genial y las comodidades en la playa se prestan mucho para venir con toda la familia

reviews.author: chrisD4595WA
reviews.title: Food is not good
reviews.text: Nice location and facility but the resort lost me with the food quality.  Restaurants were either closed or had limited hours…always trying to steer you to the buffet. Room service was awful and took one hour and forty mins.

reviews.author: anthony1252023
reviews.title: Lied to and wasted money
reviews.text:
- Misleading in-take form asking if I needed transportation, turns out they don't offer transportation at all so I wasted my time finding the hotel transportation, called and the receptionist was just mumbling so I decided to take a taxi
- Mina Steakhouse kept serving a well-done steak when I asked for rare, I felt bad after sending it back once and just ate it. 
- Probably the worst part: I had an emergency back in Canada and I asked the receptionist if it was possible to cancel and get a refund for tomorrow. He said yes sure of course, I asked twice to confirm. So I went ahead and proceeded to make my flight change, the next morning the same guy said no they can't and handed me a release form. Explain?? 
- Also the bed was not super clean I kept getting bit at night and didn't sleep.

reviews.author: Glewis1
reviews.title: Great staff wonderful beach!
reviews.text:
We had a great week at the resort.  The beach is wide ant not crowded.  There was not too much seaweed during our week. 

The beach staff led by Pedro were great our hut was ready each day and the group at the beach bar were all fantastic. 

Rosanna at the breakfast and lunch buffet was amazing, and welcomed us each day. George and Jean were also very helpful and accommodating.
The food was great at all the restaurants!

Our only complaint was that management wants guest to attend the Club sales session.  They apply quite a bit of pressure and we had to be quite firm to make them stop.  This is a bad policy and guests should not feel  pressured to attend this type of sales pressure. Management should revisit this policy. 

In spite of that we had s great week.

reviews.author: Melissa C
reviews.title: Alex at Kanna.
reviews.text: Alex at Kana is amazing.  So very friendly, top notch service.  With a beautiful smile. We will be back for sure. View of the beach from this spot is amazing.  Food was perfect snack spot just before a late dinner reservation.

reviews.author: esthela i
reviews.title: The bed
reviews.text:
Lennson Montero fue espetacular una attention 
Nos hiso sent it en casa este Luger es hermoso 
Vuelvo a venir y lo voy a recommend a toda mi family this was my first time here and will definitely come back again soon

reviews.author: Navigator17227528384
reviews.title: 4th time here - it’s changed.  Price no longer in line with experience.  Poor value
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real has increased prices and decreased service.  This is my fourth trip to the hotel, my first was in 2002.  Other repeat guests are saying the same.  

Let me give you can example: I am staying in the Nikte Double Master swim-up suite. A suite.  Today I went to the beach to reserve some chairs for me and my family.  there were not many folks out there and I was told my room didn’t entitle me to a front row.  Not a second.  Not a third row. (All rows had available chairs).  4th row was for me.   

I’m still here, 4 days left. I’ve spoken with management and I get acknowledgment of the decline in value.  No solutions are presented. Will be pursuing either a discount to align the experience value with the cost or an increase in access and experience. Either is fine with me. 

Doug

reviews.author: Y7407XXdianeh
reviews.title: LOVE!!!
reviews.text: Loved the Resort! So Gorgeous and Beautiful! Huge hotel rooms that look like an apartment! Staff are Wonderful! Especially Leo at the Grille bar area!! He is Amazing! Love, Love! So Worth it! I'd Def go back! ! Heavenly!! :)

reviews.author: Curiosity799190
reviews.title: Great resort at Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Gorgeous Resort, lots of beach activities. Good food and great staff. Nathaniel our concierge was very helpful in organizing daily activities in a very hassle free manner. 

Our room was junior oceanfront suited and so daily sunrise over ocean was memorable for us.

Love to revisit!

reviews.author: Payal K
reviews.title: Best Experience
reviews.text:
We had amazing time at the Paradisus Palma real and our butler/concierge Nathanael Montilla was amazing! He helped us book a beach night to celebrate my daughters 4th birthday and arranged the cake for us the way my daughter wanted! He had to get stuff from outside of the resort for the cake and he went an extra mile

Highly recommend Nathanael and this resort

reviews.author: Jess J
reviews.title: 5 Star Services
reviews.text:
The Lunch Box buffet was awesome, food great & Alexander Santos & Myra Vil provided excellent service! 
Thank you for a great time, I will return again in the near future
Very enjoyable experience!!!

reviews.author: LJ A
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text:
Where to begin.... 
Check in-- the checkin took over 3 hours and was extremely chaotic. We  finally got to our room which was a lovely ocean view. 
Room--Later in the evening  we started to hear some type of scurrying within the ceiling and walls of the unit. When we shut off the lights to go to bed the noises turned into screeching sounds. We called the front desk and maintenance arrived and was unable to do anything for us as the animal type, noises were coming from inside the walls. The following day the hotel was unable to move us due to being completely oversold. So we had another night with loud screeching noises. Ultimately we moved to another room but was offered no apology.
Food: very inconsistent and bland
Service: making reservations was a long and tedious process.
Overall-- for the all inclusive price, it was not worth the experience my husband and I encountered.

reviews.author: Jessica H
reviews.title: Corporate Trip
reviews.text: We hosted an event at Paradisus and our guests loved it! Lenison Montero was especially helpful and handled our nightly room drops for all of our guests and was a huge help! He was on time and followed instructions exactly. We also received pictures of all of the room drops so we knew they were done properly! If you are hosting an event at Paradisus, be sure to request help for your group from Lenison!

reviews.author: Big Mike
reviews.title: Paradisus Melia
reviews.text:
BLUE AGAVE .... best Bar by far Ana Carolina and Clara best Bar Tender ever... Tequila + Tequila + and... Spicy Margarita!!!! best service best drinks... great hotel!! 

Also ask for Aperol Spritz!!! incredible!!

reviews.author: Helena W
reviews.title: Good food for our needs
reviews.text: Steak and mushrooms wear very tasty- the fish was a little dry though. Crème brûlée was superb but the cheesecake wasn’t very flavorful. Staff was awesome!!!  We had Milton and Wander as our waiters/staff and they wear amazing!!

reviews.author: Traveler201877345
reviews.title: Poor Experience
reviews.text:
As a family of five that has enjoyed luxurious stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and other Caribbean destinations, our expectations were high for our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We booked two NIKTE class master bedroom swim outs, expecting the same level of excellence we've experienced elsewhere.
While the concierge staff and individual servers have been exceptionally kind and helpful, the hotel management has failed to deliver the 5-star experience we anticipated. The website promised premium quality drinks as part of our all-inclusive package, but we were served “well” drinks regardless of where we went, with the option to purchase premium drinks separately - a bait-and-switch tactic unbefitting a 5-star establishment. NIKTE definitely isn’t worth the upcharge.
Our grievance lies with the hotel's deceptive practices (website language of “premium” drinks), not the dedicated staff who've tried their best to make our stay enjoyable. It's disheartening to see their efforts marred by the resort's management.
If you are considering a five star family experience, seriously consider other options before booking at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. The Caribbean has numerous other luxurious and honest resorts that will provide the true 5-star experience you deserve, reminiscent of our stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and beyond.

reviews.author: Judy P
reviews.title: Service and amenities and beauty are beyond ones hopes and dreams!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have traveled extensively in our 55 yrs of marriage. Living in Europe for 10 years in the 1980’s, we traveled extensively and stayed at hotels throughout. This was our first time in the Dominican Republc and at an all inclusive hotel. Our experience was outstanding!!! I arrive at the resort with a most unexpected injury that occurred on our fight to the DR. We were instantly welcomed by Marielisa Nunez and Karina Santana. They were our very first impression of this glorious resort and such a positive one. They were so compassionate and eager to assist me and my husband in any way! A phenomenal on site/in-house doctor, Dr. Batista, saw me immediately. In the interim,  my room was most unexpectedly  upgraded from a junior suite with a garden view to one with a pool AND ocean view! Lovely array of sweet delectables and a chilled bottle of wine awaited us upon our return from the hospital emergency room. Diagnosed with a lacerated LCL, I was told minimal walking, wheel chair, no swimming in the multitude of glorious pools, and no beach! 24 hour room service was magical as I could keep my leg elevated while eating breakfast and enjoy the breathtaking view of the ocean, the lush gardens and a beautiful pool. Our concierge Ernesto would call each morning to check on me and he and Rosemary de la Cruz would take me by wheelchair to a chaise lounge and almost lift me up so that my feet didn’t touch the soft white sand. Drinks were offered to me as I relaxed and enjoyed the beautiful colors of the sea! Marielisa Nunez, truly an asset to this glorious resort, would consistently surprise me with her thoughtfulness. One of many examples, she’d walk to the beach in her free time, to be sure I was most comfortable. Thanks to the many on-site restaurants, the buffets and evening entertainment, my husband and I truly did not feel “handicapped”  in spite of my inability to walk and, instead, be in a wheelchair. Aside from the stunning resort, ( I could not stop taking photographs of it) , our beautiful room, the overall immaculate cleanliness, there was such attention to details, AND the entire staff were the most warm and gracious and genuine people we’d ever experienced.  There was not one member of the staff that was anything less than wonderful! As my husband loves to golf, I insisted that he go in spite of my injury. He was so taken by surprise when he returned to our room from his first day onthe course, to discover that my wheelchair AND I were not there!  That was only possible because of the unbelievable staff assuming the task of taking me by wheelchair to wherever I wanted to GO! Had this not been true, I would have no alternative but to remain in our hotel room until my husband returned from a game of golf.  I felt as though I had my own personal staff.Ernesto, our concierge and Rosemary de la Cruz  accompanied him and even wheeled me into a store on the premises where they assisted as I chose a beach hat and purchased my sunscreen!   Talk about “ ALL inclusive!”  Hearts of gold is what they have! The mini bar was replenished each day, our room was attended to whenever it was best for us and a large bag of ice was brought to me each evening so that I could follow the doctor’s orders and ice my swollen knee. 
Regretfully, I only have the names of a few others that were so very dear to me. Might I suggest you take photos of their name tags. 
Eduardo Aquino has the sweetest smile and a twinkle in his eyes, Miguel De La Rosa, John Carvajal, and again, I must repeat Marie Nunez, not enough positive adjectives to describe her!  Our personal concierge, Ernesto and Rosemary de la Cruz were the best chariot drivers and so very kind to me. We highly recommend this incredibly wonderful resort and spa. The Melia hotels will be those we chose wherever they may be in our future travels!

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Relentless high pressure time share sales people
reviews.text:
Unfortunately we will not likely return to this resort.  The beach is one of the best we’ve seen in the Dominican (have vacationed in the DR eight different years). The wait staff was fantastic and the food was on par with most all inclusive resorts. Pedro and Rosanna deserve special mention as they were fantastic. 
Unfortunately our concierge Hector was relentless at tracking us down daily to try to get us to attend a timeshare type sales pitch even after being told “no, we are not interested”.  After five days of this we had to get angry with him to get him to stop. As a result we won’t return to this resort. Other resorts have always respected our answer of no to time shares and left us alone to enjoy our vacation, unfortunately this doesn’t seem to be the case at Malia resorts. 
If you want a relaxing vacation, free from high pressure sales people, then do not go to the Paradisus Real Malia.

reviews.author: Mary C
reviews.title: My first time in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful concierge named Ariel Benzo who took great care of us. He was extremely helpful and polite!
There were two restaurants that we did not like the food at and they were Flora and Mina. They were not good at all. Our favorite restaurant was Sante. The workers there were so wonderful and we had great conversations with them.

reviews.author: 260annmariec
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Very nice resort and beaches as well as food. I feel the staff little pushy at times to purchase into their timeshare.Also bring tips..I felt everyone expected tips..which I am not opposed too..just annoying when they look right in my wallet

reviews.author: eastcoastgirl
reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE WHEN LOOKING AT ALL OF THE 5 STAR REVIEWS
reviews.text:
Just returned from a lovely visit to the Paradisus Palma Real in the DR and wanted to outline some pros and cons. If you don't want to read it all, here are the Coles Notes. Resort is gorgeous, service is generally good, food is hit and miss, beach has seaweed but is warm and gorgeous, and don't trust all the starred reviews you read here. We were manipulated by a staff member into giving a 5-star review (I can explain how later in the review). 

Check in was a bit confusing due to some language barriers, but we were eventually placed in a lovely room in the adult section just steps from the adult pool. 

Tip#1: Upgrading your room is expensive and not worth it in my opinion. We upgraded, due to the above language barrier, only to discover we were charged $2400 usd MORE rather than $2400 total. When we were moved back to our original room, we discovered they were exactly the same. The only thing different was that instead of a swim-out, we had to walk a few feet to the adult pool. 

Housekeeping was exceptional. Service, in general was served with a smile. Staff were eager to please, but many had very limited English. Using a translation APP or learning a few phrases in Spanish is helpful and appreciated. 

Tip#2: Bring lots of $1s and $5s for tipping. The adult pool was quiet and when they did crank up the music, they were agreeable to turning it down when asked. The bigger family pool was FULL of teenagers on a high school grad trip. 800 of them at one point. Pretty sure they weren't all 18, but all of them had a drink in their hand. Whatever. They were actually cute to watch. 

Tip#3 - Book the adult section if you are adults who don't want to listen to happy, but loud young people.  

Food was what you would expect at an all inclusive. Hit and miss. The Steakhouse provided the best food and service, IMO. Judi was an excellent server. The buffet was quite good and Francisco seemed to always be there to get us whatever we wanted or needed. The folks on the reservation desk for the restaurants were hit and miss. Some were friendly but one woman was exceptionally rude. If you didn't book a higher priced room, you had to book your dinner reservations every day. Those who did have upgraded status had their reservations made by their "concierge". Ohhhlala. 

Tip#4: The starred reviews on here often mention particular servers. Please be aware that these reviews are often inaccurate. Case in point: we were asked by our server at the Ginger Bar (best place on the resort, IMO) to review her service adding that she had to get 12 good reviews to get extra shifts. She was great so I said sure. She had me scan a QR code which took me to a Google review page. Then she leaned over my shoulder and tapped 5 stars for all services on to my phone and asked me to enter her name and say something nice. I was in shock and stupidly did as she asked. Later I saw that my Google review had given the ENTIRE resort 5 stars. This is a lovely spot but it is not  a 5 star resort. This is also very manipulative on the behalf of the resort. 

Finally, the beach is lovely but there is seaweed (helloooo, it's an ocean) and it is divided into many different sections depending on what type of room you have. Very confusing and often made us feel like second class citizens. 

All that said, we had a great time. We won't return due to the issues noted above but if you just want some sunshine, drinks, and beautiful setting, by all means, this place fits the bill.

reviews.author: Dwyane M
reviews.title: Best Service in the DR.
reviews.text: This is the trip i’ve ever taken. Alejandro Gomez was the best. He took care of us the entire time. Best service ever. Bartender Ruby was also amazing. The both of them provided the best customer service I’ve ever had.

reviews.author: Maur Barroso
reviews.title: Excelencia en atención
reviews.text:
Seguramente lo más destacado es la gente. Un excelente servicio por parte de todos los colaboradores del hotel, especialmente los del restaurante Santé, con un GRAN EQUIPO (Franklin Bautista, José del Rosario, Amanda, Ycauri, Pamela y Chef Rafael), del chiringuito de la playa del The Reserve, Rafael, Gilberto, Pedro, Yuderi y, por supuesto, Manuel, nuestro concierge.
La habitación reformada, bonita y muy moderna. Wifi perfectamente funcional en todo el hotel.

reviews.author: Betsy T
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text: Excellent service, beautiful resort setting. Our family thoroughly loved this week spent together. The restaurant selection was awesome. The steak house especially did not disappoint. I’d definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Chloe W
reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: mina restaurant and staff are fabulous.  we love the exclusivity of the resort.  we will come back. The  blue agave was an excellent restaurant as well. the staff is fabulous and extremely friendly and accommodating.  The freshness of the food is unforgettable.  love the private pools by the family area.  love that resort never feels busy. we felt like we were important.

reviews.author: Bruce R
reviews.title: Great annual trip to Melia Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Just got back from a great vacation at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real.
We stayed in the Reserve Adults only for the second time. They remodeled the rooms and put two new pools in which was extremely nice.
The bar was remodeled and is very nice.
Fortunately Wanda is still the bartender. she does a great job, the drinks are the best and always greets you with a smile and hi poppy.
The restaurant were very good as usual.
Our concierge Ariel Benzo was exceptional as in the past and took care of all of needs.
looking forward to our next trip.

reviews.author: JT
reviews.title: Spring Break Get-Away
reviews.text: Overall, the resort grounds, buildings and amenities are first class. We found the service to be excellent. With the buffet, there was always plenty of food. We were lucky enough to have concierge service which made it easier to navigate the resort. Our concierge was Raul who was great. He was extremely responsive to our needs.

reviews.author: Brendan T
reviews.title: Phenomenal Relaxing Luxurious Vacation Paradise
reviews.text:
Phenomenal stay! A perfect relaxing trip with family. 

This is the fourth time we have stayed at this resort and the improvements and renovations were definitely felt. The new restaurants and areas are luxurious and perfect. The hospitality, service, and attention to detail is incredible. 

A few shout-outs are deserved here. Wanda and Luis at the Reserve Pool bar are incredible. You have got to try the Wanda special. She would always be happy to help you and always with a smile on her face. Just lovely. Gilberto at the Reserve beach bar and the rest of the crew are also fantastic, always helping us with setup of the bali beds and with drinks. Luis our personal concierge included with the Reserve always checked up on us and got us our restaurant reservations without issues. Countless others like the waiters at the Sante restaurant and the Lunch Box / Kanna Cafe were always so fantastic and got us all we needed.

The beach was beautiful as it used to be, just minor seaweed which is unfortunately getting worse in the whole Caribbean region every year. Totally swim-able ocean waters. This season seems to be much better than in late summer months when we used to go. There was effort made every day to clean the beach of the seaweed which was greatly appreciated. 

The food was definitely improved on since our last stay. The new Reserve exclusive Sante restaurant was incredible, the best spot by far. We went twice. The buffet (Lunch Box) options were all good for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Mexican restaurant had great food but was a little too loud. The steakhouse was as bit disappointing, only the skirt steak was tasty, and better cuts were locked behind paid fees. 

Lots of pools and bars around and very lively even at night with the new sports bar club and nightly entertainment in the palazzo area.

The new renovated rooms were very nice, but not as large as the previous Reserve section. I believe that is now a separate hotel called Garden Suites. Unsure if they have access to the Paradisus. That would be the only complaint. And no jacuzzi on the terrace / balcony as previously had.

The membership / timeshare pitch is a bit absurd and one presenter was very arrogant during discussion. 

Overall an amazing stay, looking forward to visit again!

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
This resort was our 3rd vacation this winter and also our best. We were greeted upon arrival with a nice cocktail and was looked after very well the whole week by our concierge Miguelito Cuevas. Every thing from doing Sunwings job, to making our dinner reservations,  to making sure we had extra water in our room every day.
Our room was large and clean. We did have a couple problems like the 1 sink very slow to drain and the tub leaking which was fixed immediately.

The food in the buffet was great, plentiful and varied.  We tried 3 of the 4 ala carts and decided to stick with the buffet.  We didnt have to worry about a time and we could eat whatever we felt like that day.

We did not go on any excursions. We go for the beach and it did not disappoint. It was huge with soft white sand and it seemed to be cleaned daily of seaweed.  There was never a problem finding a palapa. There were lots. 

The resort seemed huge but was never crowded. It was well kept and very clean.

We would certainly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Myron A
reviews.title: 25th Anniversary in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real resort. The facilities, scenery, and atmosphere was beautiful. Our concierge (Ralphy) delivered exceptional service! Ralphy was extremely friendly, attentive to our needs, and professional. Ralphy took excellent care of us and went over and above. He made our experience even better. I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Dara A
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This was the most beautiful vacation that my husband and I have taken. The Paradisus Palma Real was an amazing place to celebrate our 25th anniversary. Our concierge, Ralphy, was phenomenal! He took our experience to another level. He was attentive to all of our needs and ensured that we were well taken care of. He even went into town to bring us the best cheese cake the Domican has to offer. Ralphy was absolutely amazing!!!!!

reviews.author: Natalie L
reviews.title: Alexander Santos @ the Lunch Box
reviews.text:
Alexander Santos and Yessica Carlos . 
Alexander gave us great service! He has such a great personality & always has a smile for everyone! He made our experience here even better! Food and drinks were excellent!

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort is my second HOME.. The service and care I receive each time we come is excellent— let me tell you about Darleni Alvarado was our concierge. She gave us the best customer service . She was always available to assist us with all of our vacation needs. If I could give Ms. Alvarado 10 STARS I would. She loves what she does and it shows by her how we were serviced..

reviews.author: Jeanette B
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation
reviews.text: We had such an amazing experience staying at the reserve! The people were so kind, the food was exceptional and the landscaping was nothing short of immaculate. However, the best part of the whole trip was the Kidsdom. We have a two year old, and not only is it hard to find a resort that has the facility and staff to care for that age but to find one that my son LOVED was such a blessing. They remembered his name from day one, fed him meals (super hard since he is a picky eater) and had a ton of one on one play time with him. The facility was super clean and child safe, I never hesitated leaving him. Thank you to everyone for a great vacation and some much needed peace!

reviews.author: Donnapcdr
reviews.title: Horrendous...Scam Alert !
reviews.text: If you are thinking about this hotel and have any interest in getting what you have paid for you'd better run not walk away from this one !  This hotel is running the biggest scam I have ever seen in 21 yrs of traveling to the DR after having stayed in most of the 4 and 5 star hotels on Bavaro beach and Cap Cana.  If you stay in the higher priced rooms and are in Royal Service,  according to the booking and the website you are entitled to have a butler.  You will not get one because they will tell you that they don't have them because they have concierge service.  I clearly witnessed them walking throughout the resort in white suits with a bright blue sash.  We were not the only people being denied a butler who were entitled to who we spoke too. We were tipped off that the butlers are paid a salary,  and the concierge are paid commission only based on whether they can get you to attend the hotel club membership talk.  Be prepared for your concierge to beg and bug you to go and don't do it because you will not get out there in under 90 minutes!     This hotel is just not bothering to offer any shows or decent entertainment under the excuse of covid when all the neighboring hotels I researched were back to normal offering shows and beach events. Also, no Caribbean night of vendors happened.  The food was honestly so bad that we had to request to go to another hotel to try to get a decent meal. The quality of the food was so low it was unbelievable and I should have heeded previous bad food reviews, yet the hotel charge is as high as ever.  Understand that these hotels are operating on 30% to 50% occupancy and they are cutting back at your expense even though they will tell you they are at 85%. The buffet was fine and we had no issue with many of the workers who work very hard. Terrible maid service, had to chase them down daily for things taken out of the room and to get pillowcases for stripped pillows left in the middle of the room, had to restock our own mini bar after many requests.  It did not help that was a very big birthday trip that they did not acknowledge till I said something.  Do yourself a favor and stay away from Melia completely because their corporate management  could not care less whether you are happy or if they have fulfilled their hotel responsibilities.  They have just showed me this in their response.  Go with Excellence or Secrets and you will get what you pay for and will rarely be disappointed !

reviews.author: Gonzalo F
reviews.title: Descanso medio pelo
reviews.text:
Lo bueno, las instalaciones, la cercanía a la playa, servicio de playa, la limpieza, las piletas, los restaurantes, la comida en general.

Lo malo... el servicio THE RESERVE NO VALE LA PENA. Pagamos este servicio, que se supone exclusivo con mejoras en bebidas y atención personalizada y no lo fue. Solo 1 barra en todo el hotel ofrece bebidas mejores y solo abre de 8am a 18hs. A la noche, el upgrade de bebidas ya no cuenta.
El personal del hotel, no hola ni chau, salvo algunas excepciones. Creo que es algo cultural...

Si vas a ir a este hotel, no pagues de más. No vale la pena pagar mas, para la calidad de servicio que vas a recibir.

reviews.author: thai h
reviews.title: Cielo restaurant
reviews.text: Jose Batista has the BEST staff. The food is amazing. Francis Javier has amazing food and the food waiter Bryan Alexander, Hostess Jafreisy Lopez are the best. So happy with the Paradisus Palma Real Reserve!

reviews.author: Jan Steehler
reviews.title: Sal. Steak Cave
reviews.text: Fantastic meal! If you visit Punta Cana  you must  see Abraham  and enjoy your memorable meal from start ro finish! The steak, salad, mashed potatoes and roasted mushrooms  are amazing. Dessert is delicious also!

reviews.author: Laura J
reviews.title: Cielo
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Palma real was amazing. Quiet and great place for a honeymoon! The swim up suites are private and quaint. 

Many restaurants included to chose from in the all inclusive. Cielo: best restaurant at Paridisus Palma Real! Frances Javier made the best Chimichuri sauce I’ve had. Fresh Ingredients. Jose Batista greeted us right as we came in the restaurant. His staff including Bryan Alexander, Jafreisy Lopez made our experience a 10/10

reviews.author: Ct P
reviews.title: Excellent all inclusive resort. We will definitely visit again soon.
reviews.text: Excellent stay. All inclusive food and drinks. Staff are all very nice and provide great customer service. Rooms are cleaned every day. Snacks and drinks are supplied in the rooms. The swim up bar was the best. Bartenders Victor Felis and Luis are very polite and provide great drinks. They made us feel very comfortable and it was nice to be able to swim up to the bar and enjoy our drinks. Overall it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: Dinner Disaster
reviews.text:
We just checked in today. The hotel claims you can call a number or use the Meliá app to make dinner reservations. We are traveling with a party of 8 for a big wedding at the resort and after sending multiple emails, calling the reservations number and attempting to use the app (which is useless) we still have no dinner reservations. 

This is so inconvenient and unprofessional. For an all-inclusive experience, this is not very inclusive. Not a great way to start our vacation.

reviews.author: Kammy M
reviews.title: Perfect Spring Break Getaway
reviews.text: We booked 5 days at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa and had a fabulous and relaxing mini-vacation!  The property was incredibly beautiful, the staff was VERY accommodating and friendly,  and our incredible concierge was an amazing bonus to our trip! From the time we arrived to our departure, Jose Simeon took great care of every aspect of our trip that we could possibly imagine and provided all of the information and recommendations we requested. Did I mention he was literally available 24/7 via the WhatsApp on my phone?  How's that for service!!!   We took advantage of the spa, golfing, and even off-shore fishing which we thoroughly enjoyed.  Our ocean-view room was perfect for us and our teenager who had his own space :) and was simply breathtaking! The  tasty buffet was easily accessible between dinner reservations and the beach Snack Shack was a great alternative as well (they have fabulous burgers!).  Honestly, the only drawback we encountered was not enough sunblock and/or Aloe for a sunburn offered in the gift store :)  We will be sure to pack accordingly next time! We really enjoyed our time at the resort and are already planning a return trip!

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience at this resort our Butler Nicolas was exceptional.  He set everything up for us, visited and texted us regularly to make sure we were enjoying our time and that we had everything we needed.  He even served us guacamole on the beach!  Definitely request him as your Butler!  Great bar service by my girls Wanda and Ruby loved them both!  Hansel serving our drinks A+ such a sweet cute guy!  If you are thinking of a trip to Punta Cana this was a great place to stay!

reviews.author: Beth Romano
reviews.title: Ismael that works at the lobby bar is AMAZING!
reviews.text: Ismael that works at the lobby bar is AMAZING! I visited this hotel back in Nov 2021 and again in April 2022 and he remembered me. I was blown away that he remembered that I was there. He knew everyone's name and remembered our coffee order. He is so personable and so friendly, he truly made my experience there. I would go back to see him.

reviews.author: jmf528
reviews.title: Overall it was fantastic!
reviews.text:
We have stayed at this resort many times and have always enjoyed it.  The rooms were always clean and comfy.  The staff is fantastic, especially Ruby and the crew at the Gabi Bar and Luis from the Lobby Bar.  Gerson Ortiz at the front desk was fantastic!

More of a specific breakdown, the rooms were clean and housekeeping was fantastic whenever we needed anything.  The mini fridge was kept full.  We had a standard junior suite overlooking the spa area and it was nice and quiet in the evenings.

There was no evening entertainment that we could find during the day for adults, there was a few things at night but not much.

The food at the buffet was the same typical resort buffet food.  We did get to eat at the steakhouse one day for lunch and we ate at Mizu one night.  We tried to get reservations at the other restaurants but they were always full....even though they were empty when we walked by.  We even stopped in to see if they would take us but they said they were full....but no one was in there.  THIS issue needs to be fixed.  The hamburger and hot dog trucks out by the pool was a good idea.

Overall the hotel was fantastic.  I have stayed at many resorts in Punta Cana but this has always been one of my favorites and I will be back.  Masks were not required and the hotel did not charge for the return COVID test.

We traveled with another couple and my mother and I took advantage of the spa services.  We both got the aromatherapy massage, 50 minutes.  It was fantastic!  Gladys was my masseuse and I highly recommend requesting her when you go.

My husband and I travel a lot and have stayed at many hotels.  As a travel professional, I am always looking out for my clients and I would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text: Where do I begin? My husband and I came for a friend’s wedding and let me just say that I’m glad they chose this resort! We selected the upgraded package and stayed at the reserve; which is a part of the resort but includes premium treatment. Our concierge, Edward was phenomenal! He was attentive to our needs and every little detail in between. Edward kept us on our schedule each day, had all of our reservations and activities planned with no hiccups. The food was amazing! All staff members that we came in contact with were excellent and always smiled. Our spa experience was top tier! You cannot help but be relaxed during your stay. Be warned, you will not want to leave and will go through though withdrawals. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Andrea P
reviews.title: Vacaciones y Mi Boda
reviews.text:
Nos vinimos a casar con nuestros amigos y familia y fue DE LO MEJOR. El servicio perfecto. La playa, la piscina hermosisima. La boda quedo HERMOSA. No Tuvimos ni un problema y todos mis invitados (70) estuvieron muy contentos con las habitaciones.

La wedding planner Mariangel Sanchez me ayudo muchisimo y todo salio perfecto. Super amigable y cuando llegamos, ella lo tenia todo preparado y sabia todos los detalles. Nos ayudo muchisimo, gracis Mariangel!

Y nuestra server favorita ALTAGRACIA, de parte de todos mis 70 invitados, muchas gracias por tu servicio tan perfecto! Super recommendada, siempre estaba alli con nosotros y super atenta. Nos hizo reir tanto!!! Con mucho amor, gracias Altagracia.

reviews.author: Luis B
reviews.title: Vacations and weeding attending
reviews.text: Our review is base on experience, the hotel and staff is really good, Resort is nice and clean, with a lot of atractive activities, restaurants, pools, beach front, but my reason for only 3 stars is base on the Restaurants work, at your arrival and check in, the staff advice you call a number to make reservations for any other restaurant than the buffet, good luck with that!!!!!, you call and must of the times the line is busy and when you finally get som one on the line, all reservations are gone, but when you walk by the restaurants you see many empty tables like 90% of the time and times, so paying for a all inclusive Resort, and have to eat a Golden Corral food at buffet! Is no fear!, I guess is a way for the corporation to save money. Just for this reasons I can’t give this hotel a five stars!

reviews.author: Isamary G
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Altagracia Cruz was absolutely amazing taking care of us at Gabi Beach & different parts of the resort. Her energy and happiness would always bring us joy & she always made sure we were well taken care of. GRACIAS ALTAGRACIA !!

reviews.author: Jefe
reviews.title: Raul Jiminez
reviews.text: Awesome time in punta Cana. Raul Jiminez by far the best waiter. He took care of us all day long. Tiempo increíble en punta cana.  Raul Jiminez por mucho el mejor mesero.  Nos cuidó todo el día. The best there is

reviews.author: ceetzel
reviews.title: Paradisus 2022
reviews.text:
Raul is the best! He tended to our group of friends with our diverse orders every day of our stay with a smile on his face. 

The views were incredible and Paradisus was very accommodating. We loved our stay here and would recommend it for families and friends alike.

reviews.author: Silvina L
reviews.title: vacaciones
reviews.text:
Excekente la atención del Concerge Edgard Ridriguez.Excelente atención responsabilidad seguridad y predisposición increible.preguntar porél

El lugar es increíble 4 diamantes los restaurantes excelentes y las personas muy amables

reviews.title: Cielo excelente comida en Palma Real ! Deli !
reviews.text:
Chicos muy rico todo ! Se pasó el chef! Francis Javier chef , la atención de Ariel Perez y la dedicación de José Batista manager. De todos ! Y de la alegre Lili que nos solucionó una reseva peddida 😂. 
Ahora a divertirnos un rato y descansar, nos tocó una súper habitación , 6 amigas en 2 habitaciones contiguas  en The Reserve ! Se los recomiendo .

reviews.author: Giselle K
reviews.title: Restaurant Naos

Excelente servicio de Roandel Acosta y de José Batista . Estuvimos disfrutando de la playa . Nuestro servicio de habitación , excelente y merecen un reconocimiento por alta atención .

Atte. Giselle KOPP, habitación 3018

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: Amazing service at Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Altagracia Cruz, Victor, Ruby, Ulisse at Gabi beach we’re incredible!!! Amazing drinks and incredible service!!! Loved it!! They provided the best service and some of the best services at a all inclusive and I’ve been to many in my life. a+++++

reviews.author: Severine M
reviews.title: Excelente ubicación del Hotel en Punta Caña con vistas espectaculares y sobre todo un personal muy atento en todo moment
reviews.text:
Excelente ubicación y servicio.  El hotel es espectacular. 
Muchísimas gracias a Lucia Díaz, Luis Desa, Ana Person, Walquiria Brito y Olga Martínez por el excelente servicio que nos brindaron durante toda nuestra estancia.
Nos vemos pronto otra vez aquí!!!

reviews.author: Kenneth M
reviews.title: Another wonderful trip to paradise
reviews.text:
We just returned from another wonderful trip to the Paradisus Palma Real property in Punta Cana. We have been to the Melia properties there (the Beach Club and the Paradisus Palma Real) five times over the past several years, including a trip this past December, and we always know that we are going to have a quality experience. 

We booked the adult 16+ Reserve Jr Suite which gave us access to the adult only area of the property (e.g., pool & beach area) as well as our personal butler (concierge) to assist us with our stay. 

Zanovia was our butler (as we requested her again after our December trip) and she is amazing! Not only is she great at her job in keeping us informed, ensuring dinner reservations are what we wanted, checking in on us every day to see if we needed anything, and delivering a few added surprise snacks and drinks, she is just a warm, sincere, and happy human being that makes everyone smile.  Thank you Zanovia!

The adult only areas are a valuable premium, especially if you are a couple going there to get away and have time just to yourselves. The adult only pool area is quiet and very private with a bar located adjacent where Wanda and other wonderful staff take great care of you. The adult only beach area is the best we have found in any resort. Whether you like to be in the sun, have chairs under a palapa, or have a private palapa with a bed in the shade and chairs to use in the sun as needed, you will find what you need. Pedro (he is awesome!) and the beach staff are attentive and make sure you always have a water or your beverage of choice.

For those of you that frequent all-inclusive resorts, you know what to expect in terms of dining. The Paradisus Real is definitely all-inclusive type of dining, in terms of expectations, but we believe they are a cut above others. The buffet (breakfast and lunch) has plenty of choices of fresh or made to order items, and there is a larger than normal list of dinner restaurants to choose from here. We love the Winery (thank you Johnston!) where you can enjoy a lovely four course dinner (included) with a wine bottle purchase. The other restaurants that are fully included are also better than the average resort food. We enjoyed them all. 

For those wanting a peaceful trip to paradise, this is a great value and we can highly recommend.

reviews.author: Deena R
reviews.title: Plan on eating at buffet for every meal! No chance of getting reservations for dinner
reviews.text: Let me start by saying, the hotel and the property are beautiful. However, if you book this property, plan on eating at the buffet every meal.  The very first day, I tried to make reservations for dinner, and was told nothing was available. I called everyday, and was told the same thing. The only reservation I could get was for lunch for 2 days at the steakhouse. I made sure to order "house wine". When I went to check out, I had a $307 bill for wine. I find that very impossible, since It was just me (with 3 kids) and only ate at restaurant 2 days. I asked to talk to manager but I was told that no one was available. I feel that I was taken advantage of. PLEASE BEWARE!

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.title: Terrible restaurant reservation system
reviews.text:
I am writing this review while staying in the hotel - room 3039.

Don’t get me wrong - food in the buffet is quite good, but it is the same every evening, even on Easter Sunday.

We are traveling with two other families - 11 ppl in total. Not Reserve, not Circle - just “regular “ Palma Real - which is actually quite expensive compare to other similar hotels in Bavaro area.

For that kind of money you would expect an ability to make the reservation at the a la carte restaurants without any hassle.

Surprise! There is no restaurant reservation desk at the hotel. You have to call certain number to make the reservation. But the line is either constantly busy or no one is answering the phone. And you have to call from the hotel phone - either from your room or lobby. Who has time to spend 5 hours in the room trying to get through?

Even if you get a chance to speak to operator, you get ZERO availability for “regular” hotel guests. All spots are pre-booked for Reserve and other “VIP” guests by their concierges.
The interesting thing is that restaurants are half-empty - management is saving the money and not allowing full capacity (even though there are zero COVID-related measures at the resort - no mandatory temperature checks or hand washing or mask wearing).

Front desk gave a hint - upgrade to VIP service and we will help you.
This is completely unacceptable for such luxury resort to treat the guests by how much they had paid and what type of room they are staying at.

reviews.author: Nuria M
reviews.title: Semana Santa en Paradisus Palma Real Reserve +18
reviews.text:
Semana Santa fantástica en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real. Estuvimos muy bien atendidos, sobre todo dar las gracias a Darleni Alvarado que estuvo pendiente de todos nosotros , nos ayudó con todas las reservas en los hoteles y gracias a ella la estancia estuvo perfectamente organizada .  Muy eficiente y dispuesta a ayudar en todo momento . También mencionar a Pedro, que se ocupa de las hamacas, que te alegra el día desde por la mañana.
En cuanto a las habitaciones les hace falta una renovación porque están un poco anticuadas sobre todo los baños.
De los restaurantes que hay en el hotel , el mejor,  sin duda La Sal.

reviews.author: JoseBVirginie
reviews.title: Le paradis sur terre
reviews.text:
L'hôtel nous a vraiment beaucoup plu!!!  Très bel emplacement avec la plage à proximité. Un jardin très bien entretenu, verdoyant.  Très bon accueil et chaleureux de la part de tout le personnel, principalement de notre concierge Raul Mota, qui était très disponible et nous a offert un service exemplaire et personnalisé !!! 

Seul bémol: le buffet qui n'était pas trop à notre goût, mais  il y avait suffisamment de restaurants, qui offraient une grande variété de plats

reviews.author: Matias Shaw
reviews.title: Dicen tener 7 restaurants.. no los pude conocer
reviews.text:
Vinimos dos días solamente ya que extendimos la estadía de nuestras vacaciones y queríamos probar otro hotel. Veníamos de Melia Beach Resort The Level.
Llegamos un sábado y nos vamos un lunes
El lugar? Impresionante. Todo muy bueno. Espectacular digamos. Los shows entretenidos. Mis hijas muy contentas con las actividades nocturnas también
Las habitaciones, al menos la que nos tocó, es un poco venida en años (el beach resort estaban mucho más actualizadas) pero cómodas y funcionales. Nos tocó una habitación con vista al mar, increíble.
Las cosas que no me gustaron. Para conseguír sombra en la playa o pagas una propina al muchacho o tenés que ir a las 730 am... Terrible. Sino, a quemarse al sol. Uno está de vacaciones y tiene que pensar en esas cosas. Hay muy poca sombra para la cantidad de gente que va (pensar que se juntan 3 hoteles de la misma cadena en la misma costa (Grand cana, Paradisus punta cana y Paradisus palma real).
Al ir solo dos días no nos dieron concierge (después nos enteramos porque)... Y para reservar restaurant nos dieron un número de teléfono. Acá empezaron los problemas. 
El Paradisus palma real tiene 7 restaurants... En dos días no pudimos conocer ninguno.. porque? Porque como llegamos un sábado ya estaban todos reservados por los pasajeros que llegan los lunes, reservan todos sus restaurants para la semana, y sin importar ni reconfirmar si van o no, cierran las reservas y nadie más puede entrar al restaurant.
Para que ponernos concierge si no nos iban a dejar ir a ningún restaurant? Ahí entendimos

Entonces habían 6 restaurants vacíos (Sal siempre estaba lleno) y no nos dejaban entrar a ninguno. Estaba claro que no les importaba total está todo pago al ser all inclusive, para que llenarlo, no?
Ante nuestra queja, nadie sabía que decir ni que hacer. solo te dicen que ASI Es el sistema, en vez de buscar una solución. Demás está decir que la gerente de reserva se va a las 18... A esa hora uno está en la playa!!

Mi humilde consejo es que dejen mesas en el restaurant para el mismo día para gente como nosotros, que no llegamos el día que había que llegar. De esta manera al menos tenés la posibilidad.. sino, quedas afuera desde el inicio pero la tarifa es la misma eh. No piensen que les van a cobrar menos. También deberían reconfirmar las reservas.
Entonces mi consejo para los que vengan a este súper hotel es no lleguen despues de un lunes, sino van a comer en un buffet dónde la comida se repite y una cerveza tiene el mismo gusto que una papafrita.. en ese caso les recomiendo que vayan a otro hotel, xq acá son inflexibles y no vas a poder sentarte en ningún otro lado que el buffet.

Nos vamos con un sabor amargo de este lugar que fue muy recomendado... No creo que vuelva. 

Del 16 al 18 de abril de 2022
Adjunto tres fotos de restaurants que estaban llenos según ellos pero en realidad están vacíos y no pudimos comer
Pero también fotos de lo lindo que es el lugar

reviews.author: Aline N
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This hotel is perfect for honeymoon, was there in a part of the hotel called the reserve, totally vip, with cabanas close to the beach, private bar and pool and a concierge just to ourselves to provide us the best experience ever, she was so helpful with restaurants reservations and scheduling the excursions! (Thank you Darleni 🧡) and also Martín at the beach was always ready to find a good cabana at the beach and bringing us good drinks! (Thank you Martín 🧡)

reviews.author: Happiness375652
reviews.title: Páscoa no Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Aspectos positivos: localização, arquitetura e praia.
Qualidade da Alimentação boa em todos os restaurantes excepto o italiano ( Olio…) top o restaurante japonês e a picanha no restaurante Sal.
No restaurante central variado nas 3 refeições.
Áreas dos quartos otimas.
Profissionais de restauração: muitos terão de ter oportunidade de melhorar e não pensar só na propina.
Aula de pilates com a instrutora Argentina e alongamentos  e zumba  e dança com o Pedro excelentes.
Ginásio top

Aspectos a melhorar: reformar quartos alguns estão muito danificados e cheiram a mofo.
Controlo de mosquitos no lobby Bar ( um dos espaços de convívio mais interessantes mas onde os mosquitos são mais que muitos.
Actividades: a equipa de actividades de adultos não estimula a participação se as pessoas aparecem muito bem se não têm conhecimento, ficam sem participar em nada porque os animadores nada dizem.
Aula de Yoga pelo menos ter alguém com mais conhecimento na área.

Se dás gorjeta (propina) és bem tratado se pensas que vais com tudo incluído e nada dás, podes em alguns sectores como na praia, ficar a esperar sentado. 
Tem tudo para se desfrutar umas excelentes férias .

reviews.author: Bahar F
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay very much! Very family friendly, lots of food, kids club made things very easy! Activities every night and all through the day. Our third time here. Now a water park which made the kids very happy!

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus!! Real paradise
reviews.text: We had an incredible time in Paradisus Palma Real. This is a real paradise and the service is amazing. I have to mention Fausto from Vento restaurant, Giovanni from Tokimeku and Victor from the pool bar. We just had an incredible time. The concierge Jairo helped us with all reservations at the restaurants. We have been at Paradisus 12 times and will continue to come every year. It has been a dream vacation and can’t wait to come back next year!!

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: Buena atención de todo el personal, variedad en el bufete en el desayuno, almuerzo y cena, siempre encuentras bar disponible y la amabilidad del personal es excelente. Hotel impecable, servicio de aseo permanente.

reviews.author: Cathy M
reviews.title: Great dinner at Aqua restaurant
reviews.text:
Great service / great food. We had a great night !
The place is really nice for Punta Cana, the chef has great Mediterranean influences and the result is pretty good.
The parpadelles and the Greek moussaka are good choices

reviews.author: Justin W
reviews.title: Cielo must do
reviews.text: My wife and I had reservations as the first guests. We were promptly greeted and “wow”is all I can say from there. Fresh guacamole, fresh pico de gallo, fresh warm tortilla chips… Just the start. I had the best red snapper I have ever eaten in my entire life, my wife, the vegetarian, had some of the best vegan meatballs she’s ever had. Kudos to the manager, Batiste and his crew. Five stars. Wish we were hungrier, I would have eaten the napkins everything was so good!

reviews.author: alandriver99
reviews.title: Melos (DR) Paradisus Palma Real Resort Lobby Bar
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Resort Lobby Bar with Luis Desa, Lucia Diaz and Walquiria Brito was the best spot for drinks in the entire resort! The conversation, attention to detail and yummy drinks are what made this spot our first stop every night! If you visit, you must go see them!

reviews.author: Pelaez F
reviews.title: Brisas
reviews.text: Great food and service from Jennifer Munoz , not to mention the view from the seating area. Amazing different types of ceviches, the service is top notch and ended up with a capuchino and a tres leches dessert .

reviews.author: Daniela F
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text:
Os quartos são muito bonitos, assim como a piscina e a praia. Este hotel é memorável! 
Fomos jantar ao restaurante mexicano e a comida estava maravilhosa, especialmente a carne. O funcionário Alexander Santos merece os parabéns, muito simpático e prestável. Assim como Juan Vicente fez as nossas bebidas, Francis Javier cozinhou estes pratos deliciosa os, e José Batista, o chefe de sala, foi muito prestável também.

reviews.author: Beatriz Azevedo
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text:
Comida muito boa, o melhor era a carne como prato principal. Muito bom atendimento do Alexander Santos, sempre preocupado em nos servir é muito atencioso. Sobremesa três leites boa. 
Comida é boa não é picante

reviews.author: Sandra L
reviews.title: Beautiful Location - Wonderful People
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from 7 fabulous days at Paradisus Palma Real (The Reserve).  Stunningly beautiful property with FANTASTIC staff.
Many thanks to the team at The Reserve beach area, always helpful and accommodating...making for a very relaxing vacation!  Pedro on the beach, Wanda at the bar (ask for the "Wanda Special", you'll LOVE IT) and  the gentleman who greeted me at the beach every morning with a warm "excelente" smile (I'm sorry I did not get his name).  
A big thank you to our butler Lewis who was always there to make our vacation carefree, organising dinner reservations and tending to any request we had.
I have included a picture of the view from our Panoramic Beach Front Junior Suite (room 6109)...breathtaking!  Having the view of the ocean was such a bonus, we enjoyed drinks and snacks on the balcony and even room service for breakfast.
I strongly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: wattersj165
reviews.title: Fantastic resort
reviews.text: Just finished a week long vacation with the family. The resort is beautiful and the food was wonderful. Our concierge, sairen Rebinson, was fantastic. He  helped with all reservations, handled all requests and made sure we enjoyed every moment. Definitely coming back.

reviews.author: Francheskca B
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text: Un paraiso es como describo este maravilloso lugar con un servizio unico y un personal muy atento sobre todo en los restauraantes Sal, Tokimeku y el buffet ademas la playa es muy linda y limpia al igual que las hab

reviews.author: Deby Ricci
reviews.title: Inesquecível
reviews.text:
Hotel maravilhoso, comida deliciosa mas o destaque vai para o concierge Starling que fez nossa estadia se tornar ainda mais especial pois nos ajudou a celebrar nossos casamento com muito carinho!! Recomendo de olhos fechados
Obrigada a todos!!

reviews.author: Esther D
reviews.title: Cancelled my reservation and switched me to a different resort
reviews.text: We have our vacation set for next week, and received notice that they are closing for renovations and we are getting moved to another resort! We planned our vacation with another family, and now we are going to be at different hotels! We did a lot of research before booking and specifically chose this resort for its rave reviews and closeness to the beach. If we wanted to stay at the hotels we are being moved to, we would've chose it ourselves. I don't understand how this happens, especially since we booked less than 3 months ago. Beware!

reviews.author: george k
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Everything in this resort is first class from the   service and the quality of food and presentation to the serenity of the beach and accommodations. Highly recommend Palma Real Reserve for everyone looking for the best. Check out Cielo for authentic Mexican Michelin ⭐️ ❤️🙏❤️

reviews.author: JORGE EDUARDO M
reviews.title: Una cena fenomenal
reviews.text: Restaurante Sal del Paradisus Palma Real.  Atendidos por Ulise Pacheco que nos hizo vivir una velada fantástica, ademas comida de primer nivel y el resto del personal excelente. Una noche que no olvidaremos.

reviews.author: Luisa V
reviews.title: Aqua restaurant ( Mediterranean)
reviews.text: The best service in Paradisus ( Melia) , wonderful time, delicious food, and Abraham service was excellent with the best option in the menu. Was the best option por the dinner, don't hesitate in visit it.

reviews.author: julian v
reviews.title: Aqua restaurant
reviews.text:
Lo mejor de aqua el servido de ABRAHAM 

Recomendados todos los platos, en especial el cordero 

Todo es el especial, el servicio, la cena. Recomendado la musaka, el salmón y para finalizar postre de chocolate, mama Juana y amaretto

reviews.author: ammie_11
reviews.title: Beach bar on adult side
reviews.text: Wanda and martin are the best! Martin Had our beach spot set up everyday and Wanda always had great drinks! Ruby at the Gabi Beach bar was super every night! Simeon was great getting our dinners set up! Enjoy a great trip business and personal!

reviews.author: James Phelan
reviews.title: Give Raul a Raise!!!
reviews.text: Raul Jiminez was the best. He kept is from all but guaranteed dehydration with his excellent drink service. Look for Raul on at the pool bar or beach on your next trip to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Enrique A.
reviews.title: Playa del hotel Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: El trato del personal en la playa es inmejorable, en especial mencionar a Wilmer Sabino e Iván Pérez por su simpatía y profesionalidad. Seguro que volveremos, sea en pareja o en familia. Muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Carrie B
reviews.title: Service Manager Town & Country Services
reviews.text:
Very excellent service. Friendly staff. Glenny was an excellent waitress and Jose the service manager was always pleasant and accommodating.  Fresh food and quick service. Portions are perfect. 5 stars
.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Improvements urgently needed
reviews.text:
We have been on the property before and multiple times at the Paradisus PuntaCana. We can say that the hotel in PalmaReal needs an overhaul. The stuff is as friendly and professional as always but rooms are old, food is everything but what it says on the menu and the barkeeper decides if he will give you the drink you want…they tell you that this and that bottle is just for decoration….

But the food is the worst aspect. Filet steaks are skirt stakes, salmon is some colored Idontknowwhat,
Chicken or whatever else you order is just disappointing.

The Pistachio ice cream was good… but that was about it!

I will not give advise to management professionals,
they know best what could be improved to get good recommendations…

But they will not see me there again to find out where else can be cut…!

reviews.author: nhart0513
reviews.title: Beautiful weather and service
reviews.text: Jessica, our concierge was wonderful in making our dinner reservations, helping us with whatever we needed, absolutely great  I liked some restaurants better than others but was a great experience. My husband and I had a massage, which was awesome. I also had a facial that was great!  Everyone was so nice, bell boys awesome, ready to take you to where you needed to go on the premises.

reviews.author: Beth7816
reviews.title: Great evening
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time dining here. Great food and wonderful service! Above and beyond especially with the drink service. Very relaxing, especially loved the chips and salsa, the margaritas and the tres leches! José and a Carlos took great care of us.

reviews.author: Iratxe
reviews.title: Vacaciones de ensueño
reviews.text:
Realizamos nuestro viaje a finales de noviembre, invierno boreal en R.D. Por un invierno así, firmamos de por vida (25C° día y 18 - 20C° durante la noche). Nuestra estancia en un alojamiento de belleza incomparable,cumplió nuestras expectativas incluso por encima de lo contratado desde la agencia. Una estructura del hotel monumental manteniendo su esencia acogedora, cómoda y muy tropical. Comodidades continuas en cada zona del resort, con diferentes ambientes para cada momento del día.
Especial mención al trato siempre amable, atento  y servicial de todos sus empleados comenzando desde el excelente servicio de limpieza siempre pendiente de todas las necesidades de acomodo.
Trabajadores que hicieron que nuestra estancia allí fuera inolvidable:
Nuestra organizadora Leonela Calderón que se esforzó mucho en satisfacer nuestro disfrute y entretenimiento allí. Cariñosa, cercana al tiempo que sutil en su presencia. Nuestro barman de piscina don Víctor Feliz excelente profesional dedicado en cuerpo y alma a su trabajo y a sus clientes. Nos atendió como miembros de su familia, preocupado siempre por nuestro mejor bienestar. Para disfrutar de una cena show inolvidable, nuestra recomendación es el chef Henrry, del restaurante asiático Tokimeku, y para una cena espectacular y suculenta, el restaurante Sal Steak Cave.
Para disfrutar de los mejores cócteles nuestro barman Jonathan Rodríguez y nuestra camarera por excelencia Ivelisse Abad, dos personas cariñosas y entrañables pendientes siempre de ofrecer el mejor servicio en el pub Gabi.
Agradecer también el trato amable y la diligencia a Yicel de la Cruz y a Jesús Peguero.
Única recomendación a mejorar, la habitación de cortesía del último día, que fue un auténtico desastre, la habitación es inexistente, solo te procuran un pequeño vestuario donde ducharte y cambiarte. Mal acondicionado, sucio y sin atención. Una forma extrema de terminar con el paraíso y volver a la realidad. Algo que no se resuelve con la mala gestión, actitud y falta de respeto de la encargada del Dpto. del cliente Dña. Grace hacia los empleados. No es un fallo de los empleados sino de la cadena del hotel.

reviews.author: Julie B
reviews.title: Plage superbe, hall et piscine centraux magnifiques!
reviews.text:
Plage de sable blanc superbe et très bien entretenue à l’encontre des algues.  Eau turquoise, lits baldaquins et chaises à profusion.  Multiples vendedors  sur la plage mais pas trop insistants en général.
L’hôtel est très jolie avec son magnifique hall central, son bar central décoré avec goût et ses multiples livres nous plongeant dans la nature Dominicaine. :)
Les restaurants à la carte sont en général très bons;  cependant, dans l’ensemble le style cafétéria fait en sorte que le coté élégant et chic est vite décevant par son manque d’ambiance feutré et de musique.  D’ailleurs souvent, les bruits sont incroyablement cacophoniques et intolérables, particulièrement lorsqu’il y a des groupes.  De ce côté, très décevant.  Cependant, le cote de ne pas obliger les hommes à porter le pantalon long mais de tolérer le bermuda élégant est fort apprécié de tous.
Notre chambre était superbe avec vue sur la mer.  
La signalisation sur le site et le manque d’informations générales est à retravailler avec que les touristes puissent mieux apprécier l’hôtel.
Le concierge est disponible via l’applation What’s app, ce qui est pratique pour les réservations de restaurants et informations diverses.
Services spa très joli mais 2.5 fois trop cher pour les services rendus.
Dans l’ensemble, la sécurité et le contrôle ne sont vraiment pas assez sévères pour délimiter les zones adultes via familiales et d’en optimiser leurs particularités.
Sinon, très bel hôtel à découvrir.

reviews.author: Nicole R
reviews.title: Great Dinner
reviews.text: We are stayed at the Reserve and had dinner at Cielo. The chef Francis Javier, manager Jose Batista and server Isaura Urena were amazing. The service was wonderful and the food was delicious. We highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: steven j
reviews.title: A beautiful property with a terrific staff helped make our vacation a great success. Oh and the weather is also fantastic here.
reviews.text: We had a terrific time at Paradisus Palma Real. They met and exceeded our expectations. Pablo Perez, our host, was great and helped us throughout the week with reservations and other details. He was very attentive and took care of every detail in timely fashion. The resort is beautiful with plenty of happy and attentive staff. Beautifully landscaped, with plenty of pools and private nooks. Although the resort was full we never felt like it was crowded, and never had to wait in line. We are coming back again next year and bringing the family.

reviews.author: Doug A
reviews.title: Doug
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the Palma Real resort. We spent 11 days there and it met or exceeded our expectations every day. Our Concierge/Butler Samuel did a wonderful job. He arranged every dinner, spa treatment, golf game and anything else we needed. The fun time around the pool was extremely enjoyable as well. Raul (the pool side server) both entertained us and provided top notch service. 

We would definitely recommend this resort to anyone thinking about a trip to the Dominican. The food was very good and the complimentary golf was a real bonus. To be able to play 5 rounds when there is still snow on the ground back home was awesome. 

We will return

reviews.author: Rodney N
reviews.title: Poolside Service
reviews.text:
When vacationing, customer service is priority #1.  Raul is provided exceptional service for our group everyday.  He locked down the cabanas, had the buckets of beer on ice (and kept them full), as well as made sure our entire team felt like VIPs.

Thank you Raul!

reviews.author: Scodea
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but restaurant reservations were a real hassle
reviews.text:
We've been to the DR more than a dozen times... at different AI resorts.  We just returned on April 8 with a group of 12 friends.  

Generally resorts in Punta Cana ( and La Romana, Puerta Plata, etc.) are beautiful and well- maintained.  The Paradisus Palma Real is no exception.  It was beautiful and the staff was very friendly and accommodating.  The food is good and on par with other AI resorts.  Our issue was with the utter frustration involved in getting reservations at the restaurants.  

On Sunday (that's when restaurant reservations open), we spent more than an hour in line; only to be told that they couldn't make reservations for parties of twelve.  We were told that we had a concierge (would've been nice to know ahead of time) who was responsible for reservations.  In fairness, he tried but for an eight-night stay he only got us three reservations.  We would find out late in the day that we had an "8:30" reservation.  We'd be seated at 9:30, then finally eat after 10:00.  The frustrating part is that we passed restaurants with many empty tables!

We tried to help them prepare for our group ahead of time- even sending multiple emails so they would be in a better position to plan for the group.  Not one response, though.  We said that we would be willing to split the group to accommodate them and even then couldn't get restaurant reservations.  With all the positives the resort had to offer, this put a real damper on the vacation.  

We spent many frustrating hours trying to work out the three reservations we were ultimately able to get.  We actually lucked out and got into a restaurant on the first night.  I believe the problem is that they are short-staffed; which is understandable given the events of the past two years.  They should have been up-front about this from the start.  We were not the only ones with this complaint.  In fact, if you want a conversation starter, just ask somebody how it's going with reservations.

Our overall impressions:  beautiful resort, friendly staff, decent food, great golf, wonderful time with friends, terrible management of reservations.

We'll give it some time before considering a return.

reviews.author: Kimberly P
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! The whole experience, from room to concierge service, it was just amazing! The location, right on the beach and the grounds with pools was the best. Our personal concierge was named Simeon and he was AWESOME! He was very attentive to our every need. He made sure he was available to us for whatever we needed. He told us what places were available for dinner each evening and made reservations for us each night. I had an issue with accessing my COVID test that was required before leaving and he took care of everything! I had a slight issue with my room initially, and he made sure I was accommodated with what I needed. I will definitely visit Palma Real again and again!

reviews.author: Deacon22
reviews.title: Good for the Price.  Average at best
reviews.text:
Went there with 4 other couples. Had a room in the reserve. Rest booked the main hotel closer to the beach.  When they arrived, 3 of their rooms were under construction and they were moved to the Reserve. They were unhappy. Staff kept telling them that the room they are moving them to is more expensive, but the staff and management didn't realize it was more about convenience. I will say they were right to want to be on the beach.  The reserve is more for a private setting.  We were looking to engage with people.  The walk to the beach is ten minutes not the end of the world and kept my weight gain to a minimum.
