Food-  The buffet was terrible, Steak House was good but salty.  Hibachi was good but salty.  Italian was ok and salty. (See a theme here)
The pools were filthy.  They need to invest in a skimmer.
Barely used the concierge but one couple asked theirs 
to fill their mini bar in their room the first day, and it was never filled.
The beach was beautiful. The wait staff on the beach was tremendous.  They did a really good job!  
Liquor is anything but premium.  If you like tequila be prepared to pay extra.  They had junk tequila.  Had to pay 100$ for a Don Julio Blanco bottle (40$ in a store)  Only Jim Beam bourbon.  No idea what rum they give you.  couldn't pronounce it.  Funny had Coors light in my mini fridge but could only get Presidente and Corona at the pool which was fine for me.  

All in all for the price it was worth it.  If you are expecting a high end all inclusive, this isn't it.

reviews.author: Carmen p
reviews.title: No está a la altura de un Meliá 5*
reviews.text:
Me gustaría destacar el trato exquísito de Franklin y Gustavo, camareros del restaurante Palazzo, y el hamaquero Martín.

A pesar de haber contratado el paquete “the reserve” que da acceso a todos los servicios destaco como Cosas a mejorar: la limpieza y en especial la comida pues al ser un todo incluído la calidad no se corresponde con un restaurante “de pago” en un hotel de 4 o 5 estrellas. Tampoco había espectáculos o shows como suelen haber en este tipo de hoteles en el Caribe, que si bien no es imprescindible, es algo que uno espera por el precio de este hotel.

reviews.author: Benedick Cruzado
reviews.title: The home away from home. The family we found in Punta Cana.
reviews.text: From the moment we made the arrangements to stay in the all inclusive resort, it has been nothing but amazing and with ease. They were more than accommodating and tended to me and my love ones needs. They made our first family Vacation something to remember with. From the pick up form the airport, to our stay in our ocean front rooms, everything was impeccable. They even went out of their way and gave us a welcome surprise. The accessibility to the pools, restaurant, entertainment was definitely something memorable. Altagracia, Luis, Margia, Boris, Kiris, Antonio, Julia at Bar Avenue was so I tune with our needs that at times we don’t even have to ask and we have drinks on our hand or at times coffee or tea. Adonis came over an do really again to make sure we were taken care of. Yonier was so helpful . From errands, to reservations to arranging our amazing photo shoot with Edwin! They all went above and beyond. They were very engaging and the food was amazing. There are different selections of the type of food and the chef at times even came out and ask if we would want something more local or what we felt like having. Unforgettable. I will definitely remember our stay here and will definitely come back. Thank you thank you thank you once again.

reviews.author: Damaris
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text: Great service loved the attention from each individual! Will return 100% recommend to family and friends. Great experience no complaints. Experience was full of laughter and enjoyment. Made to feel very special

reviews.author: Mariela Nieva
reviews.title: Bufete Nao
reviews.text: Estuvimos de vacaciones 12 días en el hotel! Realmente pasamos unos días espectaculares, no solo el lugar es hermoso, la calidad de la comida y la atención cálida que recibimos nos hicieron terminar nuestra estadía con una sonrisa. En varias ocaciones tuvimos la suerte de coincidir con José Batista, quien nos atendió con mucha amabilidad, predisposición y alegria. Un gusto cruzarse con gente así. Extrañaremos no solo la comodidad y confort del hotel sino también la calidez de su gente y servicio! Volveremos!

reviews.author: Agustin Bernasconi
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Estuvimos 2 semanas en paradisus y la pasamos muy bien. 
Jose Batista nos atendió muy bien tanto en el buffet Nao como en Cielo.
También destacar la atención de Alexander en Mama y Juana y de marilin sanchez en el buffet de paradisus gran cana.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Fabuloso almuerzo en buffet Nao
reviews.text: Nos atendió muy amablemente José Emilio Batista!. Excelente variedad de comida y un gran servicio. Nos hospedamos en Grand Cana pero disfrutamos varios días de esta gran opción para almorzar al visitar la playa.

reviews.author: Maricel T
reviews.title: Lindos espacios y genial atención en Buffet Nao
reviews.text: Los espacios al aire libre del hotel son hermosos, linda música con sillones cómodos. Se disfruta mucho la comida en el Buffet Nao donde el servicio es excelente. Allí, José Emilio Batista nos ha asistido en todo lo que necesitábamos, fue muy cordial y atento en el servicio. Sin dudas volveremos!

reviews.author: Brandon L
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Punta Real - Gabi Beach Bar and Sunset Bar
reviews.text:
Gabi Beach Bar. Arisleida Perez and Joel Valdez were the waitress and bar tender. GREAT people...very friendly....taught me some Spanish. Made us feel like family. :-)

Sunset Bar - Wanda Correa make some great monos sucios (Dirty Monkeyes.) Need to have that potassium while drinking.

reviews.author: swktenafly
reviews.title: NOT QUITE PERFECT!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week. On the plus side this resort has magnificent beach front  with wonderful huts that provide shade,many gorgeous pools along with 2 great water parks for toddlers to teens. The Kidzone has quality staff that tries really hard to engage children.

The hotel, which is an all inclusive (and the first all inclusive we’ve ever been at) boasts a great buffet and appears to offer restaurant dining as well. And here’s the problem.  We were there ….two grandparents, and parents with two toddlers, during spring break along with a huge corporate gathering.  In terms of making restaurant reservations we were treated  as non entities. The concierges yesed us to death but never were able to get us any reservation we requested. Only when, on day 3, I insisted on seeing a manager was I helped by Grace Arellani who listened to my frustrations and handily secured 2 nights of reservations for us. Really, who wants to spend time on their vacation trying to get what seemed to be included?
Clearly, the restaurant reservation system is awful and we were part of a large group that felt frustrated and angry with being utterly disrespected by concierges.

The rooms also could use a huge overall. Although we had a sitting area, the couch seemed to be missing an innerspring (in our room and in our daughter's as well) so there was no place comfortable to sit. The lack of comfortable furnishings might be a result of Covid related financial strains.  The rooms themselves were large and cleaned well. We had a balcony, the room was made up everyday and well stocked snacks, beer, soda and water.

We never golfed but the people we met who did golf enjoyed it.

Would we go there again? YES, because we now know what to expect, the employees are 5 star (not the the restaurant reservation people) and the outdoor space is wonderful.

reviews.author: Tor E
reviews.title: The Reserve is incredible!
reviews.text: Everything we could have wished for when booking online. We had an amazing Concierge in Jose Salvador and on point housekeeping from Nairobi! The rest of the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. Jhonleiri, Domingo, Gustavo led the way, but we loved everyone!

reviews.author: Allison S
reviews.title: Painting tote bag activity
reviews.text: Very good, and a great souvenir. Leonardo and Darlin and Axel are the best entertainers. super outgoing and energetic. always around when you need to see them or have a good time. Wilton and axel are great also with Xrasis service

reviews.author: Michele B
reviews.title: 50th B day celebration
reviews.text: We had a great time the staff was excellent. Yoiner was our personal concierge. He was very responsive. He along with Julio in the Circle office made my stay easy and enjoyable. Arisleida and Reyna greeted us with a smile every day. This is why I joined as a member this weekend.

reviews.author: Brandon L
reviews.title: Another great time!
reviews.text:
Very kind staff and always willing to help. Arisleida Valdez and Joel Perez who work at the Gabi Beach Bar, for example, treated us like friends and family....even taught me some Spanish too. My wife and I have been here 5 times now. The resort changed some over the past two years....partially because of COVID maybe...The adults area and the family locations of the Reserve flipped. So, this time we were much closer to the beach. But, we still liked visiting both areas.

 I did not use it, but I hear that the Melia app is very helpful in sorting out the somewhat confusing details. It requires your booking confirmation but gave us an error...and I didnt feel like messing with tech problems while laying on a beach. 

We did discover that Pallazo for lunch is very nice (baked salmon, chimmichurri (sp) steak, Tuna steak....) if you want to get away from the Naos restaurant (which is also good) where a lot of people go for lunch. The Hydro Grill at the Reserve family section is also a good option.

They do push a little bit on time shares....but not too bad. Our concierge talked to us once about it, insisted and offered a free massage at the Spa, but then accepted that we didn't want to sit through a free breakfast (at an all inclusive resort...haha) for 45 minutes (which is never just 45 minutes based on a previous experience.) He was doing his job and was respectful of our decision and not pushy....which was nice. 

We plan to come back! :)

reviews.author: Amanda P
reviews.title: Great !
reviews.text:
Antonio at lobby bar was amazing ! Also great crew of Olga, Criceida, Soranyi and Rosanna !!  
Highly recommend starting the day with a mommawanna mimosa his specialty it’s delicious and gets the day going
Beaches are nice 
Food is delicious 
Good times

reviews.author: Nathalie B
reviews.title: Vacances inoubliables
reviews.text:
Très bonnes prestations avec un personnel toujours aux petits soins qui vous accueillent avec le sourire et leur bienveillance. Un coup de coeur tout particulier au Bar Gaby Beach et son personnel : Notre ami Victor qui fait de superbes cocktails🍹, notre très gentille Ruby toujours souriante sans oublier Miguel, Solen et Ysauri. On vous adore🥰💜
Nous reviendrons très bientôt. Un conseil allez-y les yeux fermés. Au top👍🏝
Nathalie et Benoit

reviews.author: Frederik D
reviews.title: Being sick at Paradisus Palma Real because of their food
reviews.text: As guests with a little baby we certainly did not experience that the wellbeing and health of your customers was of greatest importance to the staff at Melia. We left 1 week early because we were sick from eating the Food at Melia resort restaurant. We were not supported by the guest service and the reception except from one time in the very beginning.  We did not get better. Hence, we walked up to the guest service desk and requested medical help and the day after I called the reception for medical assistance from the room. Reception promised me to get back to me but nothing happened. I expected to get a full refund for the full stay because we were not being prioritised and taken care off. We always had to walk all the way down to the reception while sick, the reception kept calling our room walking up our baby and a service agent from the concierge desk in the lobby got angry at us when I asked him to order immodium and not to call our room anymore.   We would strongly advice against staying at this hotel chain. They seem to big to care.

reviews.author: Andres G
reviews.title: Restaurante Sal
reviews.text:
Muy rica la comida y buena atención

Estuvimos visitando el hotel y en el restaurante fuimos muy bien recibidos por todo el personal y la comida fue muy buena

Recomendado el restaurante para almuerzo y cenA

reviews.author: Tomás K
reviews.title: Lobby Bar - Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Gran atención y simpatía de Lucia Diaz y Walquiria, felicitaciones!!
Un agrado pasar todas las tardes por el lobby bar y conversar un rato disfrutando de un buen cóctel.
Nunca olviden disfrutar lo que hacen, sigan asi!!

reviews.author: Lionel L
reviews.title: Vento is a great spot
reviews.text:
We had dinner at Vento, the decor is very cozy and modern
The menu is quite interesting with excellent quality and a special attention to details and presentation 
The server Juderski Javier is excellent making sure we are well taking care of
The supervisor Eduardo is doing a good job with the team

reviews.author: Vsaumell
reviews.title: Worst experience ever! DO NOT STAY IN THIS HOTEL. I GOT FOOD POISONING and the hotel didn’t take responsability!
reviews.text: Tuvimos muchos problemas En este hotel desde el momento que llegamos. Nuestro cuarto no estaba listo hasta después de las 5. El aire acondicionado del cuarto nunca enfrió y hacía un ruido muy feo en el ducto del bano que no me dejo dormir la primera noche,  lo reportamos bastantes veces. Fueron dos veces a arreglarlo pero al rato volvía a sonar. Y el aire nunca llegó a bajar de 25 aunque nosotros tratábamos de ponerlo en 23. Cuando hicimos check in el minibar estaba casi vacío y había una lata de cerveza vacía tirada.  Y lo peor de toda la estadía por que si hay más!!!! Es que me intoxique al segundo día de estar en el hotel, después de estar vomitando y con diarrea por la comida del hotel llamamos al médico del hotel a las 6 de la mañana Del miércoles y el nos derivó a un hospital porque me encontraba totalmente deshidratada y con una infección gastrointestinal. El hotel no se hizo cargo de la cuenta del hospital ( fueron 900 dólares, ni en Estados Unidos sale una cuenta así por lo que me hicieron) ni de la consulta del doctor en el hotel  que me vio 10 minutos y nos cobro 180 dolares. Cuando hice mi queja de todo lo que me había pasado, lo que me ofrecieron fue un Gatorade a las 12 del mediodía que llegue del hospital después de estar 6 horas ahí que nunca llego a la habitación. Lo único que pudieron hacer por mi después de todo lo sucedido fue darme un late check out hasta las 5 cuando lo pedí hasta las 7 porque me encontraba en muy mal estado. Cuando salimos del cuarto pedimos hablar con la manager para ver si habían podido ver el tema de los gastos médicos. La manager nos hizo esperar dos horas para despues mandar a un supervisor a decirnos que el hotel no podía hacer nada, como no estaba contenta pedí hablar con la manager, que apareció después y nos ofreció un upgrade para futura estadía lo cual no arregla nada de lo que paso en esta estadía. Estamos muy descontentos con la estadía y con cómo se comportaron a cerca de todo lo ocurrido.

reviews.author: MaryB
reviews.title: Do not book this resort - The Beachfront section is still closed
reviews.text:
We booked a dream vacation last fall to celebrate my husbands retirement. We are due to arrive next Tuesday, expecting to stay at the in the Presidential Suite, beach front royal service. We have been dreaming about this extravagant vacation for many months. 
I went on Tripadvisor this morning to see if there was any information about limited restaurant services due to Covid. Imagine my surprise when another reviewer noted that they had been "upgraded" last minute to another part of the resort away from the beach because that section is closed.

I can understand that Covid has impacted so many businesses, especially in the travel industry. If the resort had contacted us a month ago - because clearly they would have known that they would not be open... 

But we have not received a single communication alerting us to any changes!! 

Imagine if we had just showed up expecting to stay at the Presidential Suite on the beach and we wind up in the back of the resort far away from the beach! 

What terrible customer service!! I have been trying to reach the hotel, not only did they not answer my call when I called Melia main reservation number they were not able to reach the hotel.  

This is a beautiful resort - but beware, what you book and what you get may be completely different. As I said, I understand that we are in a difficult time with the pandemic, but that is no excuse for this complete lack of communication!!

reviews.author: Mishy0714
reviews.title: Covid-19 Experience
reviews.text:
Our group stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a March break family reunion.   We were some of the last guest at the hotel durning the Covid-19 Pandemic.   The hotel did such an amazing job durning a stressful time.  Everyone was cleaning all the time.   The services were excellent , the staff did an outstanding job taking care of us.  We only got to enjoy one a la carte  ( the Japanese ) as they had to close to enforce social distancing.  The rest of the stay we ate at the buffet and it was so good !     As every day passed more tourists left but the buffet was still an excellent choice with so many options considering how many guests were at the resort.   All the staff were so good and although we were aware that they  would all be out of work once the hotel shut down you could not tell.  They were all professional and kept smiling through it all and did not give a hint of what they must have been going through.  I regret not taking their name as they all deserve recognition.  Maicol from buffet was our main waiter most days.  Always pleasant and willing to help.  All the bartenders were fantastic.  The ladies that cleaned our rooms were sweet and did such a great job.  Juanily helped when we arrived and also on our departure.  He always had a great smile and always there to assist.  The grounds are well maintained, the resort is very clean.  Perfect beach !   The rooms are nice and the beds are super comfortable.  We  would love to return here!   
Thank you Paradisus Palma Real !!

reviews.author: Sean H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Edison Abaulauo - Lobby bar - not sure if that’s how you spell his name. It’s in the picture I took. Best bartender ever, makes great drinks, and great jokes he seemed popular with the other vacationers also. One of the best weeks in my life.

reviews.author: valen
reviews.title: Muy agradable el ambiente, la decoración, amplitud de las instalaciones, amabilidad y buen funcionamiento.
reviews.text: Habitacion super espaciosa, tomamos una suite. La ubicacion del hotel es excelente, sobre todo por las playas que son super amplias y cuidadas en ese sector. El servicio fue muy bueno, la comida es buena, superior al nivel de los all inclusive en general. No nos gusto que nos quisieran ofrecer un tiempo compartido en THE GRAND RESERVE. Tiene zona de entretenimiento nocturno y no te atozigan de la mañana a la noche con musica caribeña. Muy relajado.

reviews.author: jokerji
reviews.title: IMHO, the best option in the Melia options in DR
reviews.text:
This review is long due for a trip made a while back. We are a vegetarian family and have stayed at Paradisus in Mexico - Cancun and PDC.  Had great past experiences with Paradisus.

DR resorts are not like Cancun - we kinda expected that before going.  The grounds and the property is nice, the overall experience, not so much.
The dollar goes much further in Mexico than in DR. If you are unsure of the different Melia resorts in DR, Palma Real is the overall best.

Pros 
1. Beautifully landscaped - Gabi beach is your own slice of Paradise  
2. Chef Rajinder Singh would cook up special Indian vegetarian food - not on the buffet
3. Vladimir was friendly and courteous
4. Francisco and a few waiters at Naos were nice, the rest - not so much
5. Visited all of the Melia resorts, Palma Real was probably the best - including food
6. The Otium Tour onsite are the BEST customer service experience
7. Decent night activities & beach activities

Cons
1. BIGGEST CON - Rooms which have 2 double beds are extremely uncomfortable - not designed for a family. No possibility of an upgrade. Even Holiday Inn at Queens, NYC had a big room with 2 plush queen beds & nice pillows. All rooms have musty odor (like several other reviewers say) and need the vent fan running to remove it.  Bathrooms have no privacy with glass doors - really awkward for a family.
2. Not once did anyone ask for drinks near the pool or beach - no royal treatment like Mexico.
3. Booking restaurants is painful - they need to get their act straight. There is a long line and not worth the time waiting on vacation. Vento was not worth it.  Aqua @ The Reserve was the only winner - hands down.
4. Watered down cocktails, stick to scotch.
5. Paid extra to book through Melia for $1000 in resort credits.  The credits are JUNK, and can't be used - unlike Paradisus in Mexico
6. The Indian Chef is working without authentic ingredients, please get him Indian chilli and other basic ingredients to make some real food. Sriracha is not Indian.  The Indian station has the longest lines, with folks fighting over naan's -- it should give the management some clues.
7. Nothing much to see in town

Overall, I wouldn't have high expectations of a 5 star resort with luxury treatment.

reviews.author: Adam R
reviews.title: Terrible Experience with coronavirus
reviews.text: Came here for my 5th reunion of our honeymoon.  The resort shut down and we did not receive the service we paid for.  Restaurants weren't open most nights, they stopped serving alcohol, and guests were not allowed to lay by the pool.  I understand the precautions and the Dominican Republic shutting their borders.  My review is based upon the fact that they refused to offer us a refund for the days we paid for.  They offered a voucher for one year from when we booked.  Well we booked three months ago and are planning to have children.  Can't travel with an infant.  They have refused to be understanding and offer us a refund.  Never again will I travel to this family of resorts for their behavior.  Sad because I've had a great time at this resort for my honeymoon and love the staff.  I will be proceeding in small claims court against this resort.  I would strongly encourage that no one prepay for their booking as the hotel will outright steal your money if their is an extenuating circumstance.

reviews.author: Rachael Trotta
reviews.title: Company Presidents club trip
reviews.text:
I just spent the last 4 days at the Paradisus Palm Real Hotel in Punta Cana D.R. I was with a large group ( my husbands presidents club- 45 people) and everyone had the same complaints.  
Let me also preface that we had the basic package. I know that there were upgraded royal service etc.  so I’m sure not everyone who stays there has the same service and experience. Although the president of the company we were with stayed at the royal service and had many complaints as well. 
So... First off the drinks (even the wine) were watered down.  They refused to give us straws. The royal service got the paper straws. It was weird.  
The food was terrible. And the restaurants were just about impossible to get a reservation in at a decent time. They were very small and couldn’t accommodate the amount of people that stay at the resort. I guess they want people to go to the buffet. There is no food at the pool... only at the buffet. 
The service was terrible as well.  The wait staff at the buffet & in the restaurants were slow, rude ... just horrible. 
However I will say the service on the beach was great!   The beach was the best part... there were many lounge chairs with the hut umbrellas which was great. We would go down early to reserve a spot large enough for part of our group otherwise we would never get to be together because they fill up fast. 

Everything closes at 11:00 except for at the casino so that was a bummer. 
The rooms... they were fine.  We had a bad view of the road but there only seems to be a handful of rooms that actually have sea views.  It seems that most of the rooms have a garden view (better than ours).  There is a huge tub and a shower. The shower most complained  that they were too short (I’m short so I had no problem lol.) and very difficult to get the temperature right.
The toilet room and shower both had half doors and they were glass with boxes of frosted glass. It was very strange. Not much privacy. 
The resort is very large and pretty. The spa I couldn’t get a massage so I don’t know how that was. 
We’ve been on this trip with the large group to many different islands and I have to say that this was by far the worst hotel / resort we’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: CLS1220
reviews.title: Rather Good.. not excellent
reviews.text:
Let me preface by saying we were married at the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen Mexico and had the most incredible vacation.  So I made the mistake of expecting that all Paradisus resorts would be the same.. so while we are halfway through our vacation in Punta Cana I want to lay out my thoughts.

Checkin - easy and pleasant.  Yet our rep switched our bracelets three times.. maybe it was his first day.. not a big deal.

Rooms - dated.  Tiles chipped with mediocre patch jobs, sofa bed has a hard bar that goes through the middle making it impossible to sleep.  But the regular bed is fabulous. Shower door doesn’t close properly (swings inward) so constantly holding it closed with a foot so water doesn’t get everywhere.  There are a million switches, half I’m not sure what controls and half the lamps have the switches on the wire so it gets confusing.

Family Concierge - maybe we didn’t introduce ourselves properly but so far haven’t seen any special gifts for the kids or bubble baths or balloons that everyone else is talking about.  However, they are very kind and east made us a week of dinner reservations for 10 people 

Pools - wonderful.  The reserve has a great main pool and a smaller kids pool and it’s practically empty.  The regular Punta Cana pool is great as well but I enjoy the quiet reserve pool.  We were grabbing breakfast and immediately Ramon got us a Bali bed for the day and made sure we were all set.  (FYI - Ramon is amazing.. nicest guy!!)

Staff - extremely wonderful.  They truly love kids and everyone wants to talk to and play with our boys (1 and 3).  

Food/drink - the buffet is good but gets old.  The restaurants are great.  Bana was terrific as was fuego and vento so far.  However, what’s up with paying for bottles of wine.  At the other resort for room service, they would just bring you a bottle.  Here, they charge.  We have kids, we can’t hit the bar, our excitement is a bottle of wine after they fall asleep.  BUT my biggest complaint about Mexico was the lack of a Cocktail menu and here is an amazing cocktail menu.  Try the Bees Knees or Meet the Greek!!!  In Mexico the beach bats had better and fresher food selection.. even if some came at a premium it was worth out.  Here is just pizza, burgers, salad.

 Beach - beautiful.  And no lack of Bali beds.  No complaints at all.

The distance - it’s not bad between the 2 sides.. the trolley makes it seem longer because if the circuitous route but honestly 
once you gather your surroundings, you can walk to the beach from the reserve in approx 5-10 easy minutes.  You can make the walk before the tram shows up.  

Kids club - great.  They truly enjoy the children and it’s extremely safe.  (You must be buzzed in to enter or leave the club)

Overall, it’s nice but based on previous paradisus experiences, it could be a lot better.  I’ll update as necessary the rest of the trip.

reviews.author: Franciso
reviews.title: Best vacation Ever
reviews.text: Juan and Pedro were súper attentive and profesional. I could not ask for a better experience. They Went above and beyond to make sure that our experience das a true paradise. Royal service was everything and more, exclusivity was beyond what we expected

reviews.author: Connector760154
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Love this resort. Stayed in the royal service where they provide you a butler. Our butler, Faustino, was excellente!! Very attentive and helpful with anything we needed.  Rooms were clean.  Bartenders and people working the beach and pool couldn’t have been more friendly and helpful. Made us feel like family! Can’t wait to go back! Loved it!

reviews.author: Alisa S
reviews.title: Spring break fun with friends
reviews.text:
We visited the reserve with our friends, two couples and three kids ages 6, 9 and 13. Everyone had a good time, and we didn’t have enough time to enjoy it all, the shows, the dinners, the beach, pool, spa and kids club. 
What stands out about the Paradisus chain is the service, I find it extraordinary. I felt almost submersed in smiles and positivity from everyone. I wish I spoke the language and then I could converse with ease but unfortunately I only know a few words, and so I end up speaking English. This might sound ridiculous and I usually keep my reviews to positives and negatives only, so forgive me for straying. 
The positives:
Reserve section of the resort is very nice, if you are wondering which is better the reserve here or at Palma Real, both are good, with the design slightly better at Palma Real. Just to clarify, as I’ve seen some mistakes, there are no swim up suites at the reserve in Paradisus Punta Cana. In fact the rooms are divided into two categories, those that face the pool, and those that face the road. Hence, ask for pool view. There are three floors and unless you have mobility issues or a stroller, ask for the higher floor. It will give you more privacy, better view and less noise. The rooms that face the road are a bad choice because of the trolleys and other vehicles which pass by constantly.  
The reserve section has one large pool, one kids pool and a baby pool. Very convenient for everyone. The seating is spread out with multiple Bali beds and soft loungers, set up in a way so that no one is right next to you, unless it’s your own family and friends. My friend and I disagreed about the beds, she didn’t think they were clean enough. I suppose she may have been right, and they should be cleaned more often. You put a towel down first, so it’s not a huge deal. Unfortunately guests were messy, and the staff had to really keep on top of it. The worst was a dirty diaper someone left next to a bed we were using, who does that? It was removed of course, but come on guys, use a garbage can! The grounds are cared for daily, and the flowers were beautiful. Gardners were collecting coconuts and all you had to do was ask, and there you are with a great drink. Please tip them, they work hard. I also noticed that no one was waiting for a handout, meaning that if you didn’t have cash and asked for something extra, special drink, scuba lesson in the pool, they were not going to chase you down. 
Another note about the rooms, they are not so much in bad shape as some have mentioned, but more prone to neglect by management. Little things make a difference especially when everything else is pretty great. We had a broken shelf in the bathroom, markings on the granite, and a crooked dresser drawer. All this could be fixed within an hour, but somehow it wasn’t. My friends said, are you buying the place? And I decided to let it go, I didn’t really want handymen in my room fixing anything. 
The food and drinks. The buffet at the reserve is a great place for breakfast and lunch. We all liked the small pre made portions which looked and tasted delicious. Small coconuts with fruit, salads cut in different varieties, fresh made egg omelettes in the mornings, and plantains prepared differently. Everything was replenished and fresh. Desserts also good. Drinks are best at the beach bar, a great bartender will be happy to customize your beverage made with fresh fruits, this gentleman is Lous, and if he’s there, consider yourself lucky, he is awesome! If you need assistance and don’t know whom to ask, he is the person, his English is perfect. As others have mentioned the beach area for the reserve guests is very nice. Even without a personal concierge and in a busy season we were always able to find a spot in the shade, with very comfy beds and lounge chairs. We were closer to the back, if you want the front row I suppose you need a concierge. Spots are reserved and guarded, so we stuck to the back. 
The beach. Some have noted that they could not swim, because of high waves. Please note that this changes daily, we indeed had more days when the water was a bit rough, this did not mean we didn’t swim, just meant we had to be careful walking in. If you are uncomfortable with this consider booking somewhere else, so as not to ruin your vacation. The water is clean and on the calmer days, it’s very clear. The sand is beautiful and kids had a blast playing in it. We went sailing on one of the days when the surf was rough, it was difficult to get out to the open water and even worse getting back in, as it seemed that a high wave was going to tip the boat over. It didn’t, but we got yelled at for not jumping off quickly enough. I thought this was a bit rude, and also created panic, rather than actual help. The kids ended up staying on land, this was too dangerous. As the saying of an old commercial goes, we did have some good weather on the day we left. The ocean was calm, but we didn’t get a chance to sail with our daughter, hopefully next year!

reviews.author: Shirin
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
A big shout out to Richard Oritz our Butler, who was care about his customer happiness and their satisfaction very much. 
He was checking on us from the early morning every single day and making sure we are happy with almost everything.
First day on our check in, We had concerns about our room and he took care of it right away, beside his Manager was a very nice lady and with her help of changing our room so quick, vacation starts the way we loved it.
And also than you to nice chef from Palazzo Rest. Mr.Rafael, who surprised us with his yummy dishes 2nights in a row.
We need to mention another great waiter, Steban from palazzo, who was always welcoming and care.
Thanks to all nice ppl in Palazzo Restaurant.

reviews.author: mali13723
reviews.title: Paradisius Palma Real, Punta Cana
reviews.text:
J'ai fait un voyage à cet hôtel à l'été passé (juillet 2018). Nous avons réservé notre forfait sur le site de l'hôtel et avons réservé notre vol et notre transport vers l'hôtel nous-mêmes (navette: suntransfers.com). Tout a bien fonctionné et nous avons économisé 350$ par personne par rapport au prix offert pour un tout inclus sur le Web. L'hôtel est très bien, la nourriture est impeccable et la chambre est belle. La plage est quand même décevante. Heureusement, on peut y marcher des deux côtés. Il y a des bateaux un peu partout et ça sent l'huile. L'hôtel est situé juste à côté du centre commercial Palma Real.

Service de majordome ++++ :)

Je recommande cet hôtel. Nous avons passé un beau voyage.

reviews.author: Pattyaresco
reviews.title: Awesome family vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve 4/6-4/13 and had an amazing time!! Domingo Espinal was the best, always had a smile on his face and such a genuine person, truly made us feel like family. Jhonaton Reyes was awesome as well! Made our vacation that much better!!

reviews.author: Marie B
reviews.title: Beautiful property, clean most employees were extremely pleasant.
reviews.text:
I haven't been out of the country or to an all-inclusive in over 25 years. Not much to grade on, but here goes.  The lobby is gorgeous, and check in was fast and friendly. Please keep in mind when reserving, there are no elevators. If you are not 1st floors, you gotta take the stairs.  That being said, we had a garden side room on 1st floor. Short walk to beach from Villa 5.  It was fairly quiet but there are lots of work trucks that go by. The workers on them are not so quiet in the morning, but did not wake me up. I really enjoyed sitting on the  patio early.  One worker came by with a fresh coconut, cut off the top and offered me  the water. It was good, and then he cut off the husk and I got to enjoy fresh coconut. 
     We had (I think, company trip) a deluxe garden suite. 2 doubles which were comfortable and the room was very spacious. It was spotlessly clean, not at all musty. The fridge really could have been colder but was bearable. It contained 2 lite beers, 2 regular beers, a few waters and a few sodas. We checked in on Wednesday and housekeeeping did not come back until Friday. When she did (wish I got her name) I thanked her for everything and gave her a nice tip ($5) She was sweet. Appeared every day with extra beers, bottles of tonic (because I had my own vodka), glasses, extra waters and sodas. Never lacked for anything in the housekeeping dept. our room was perfect.  I saw some people have complaints about showers, but we did not. However, we did have issues controlling the lights. Take a few minutes and practice. There is an iron and board in the room, which was handy. 
     Food was ok.  Breakfast at the buffet was nice the 1st 2 days, then ordered the fruit, toast, juice and coffee from room service. Keep in mind, the food is free, but there is a $5 delivery fee. No problem with that and pay at check out. They poured fresh OJ, poured the coffee and unwrapped everything. The toast was not so good. (No mamn, just dry white toast.)We went to the teppanyaki place, which was extremely entertaining, but my meal was meh. The rice was crispy, one of the appetizers was edemame, which I like but a few beans on a plate was just odd. I got the sushi appetizer, of which I ate one and gave the others away. Someone said the pistachio ice cream was good. 
     I don't like the fact that people throw their old  nasty towels under the palapas at night to reserve, then either show up at 2 to sit on the beach or don't show up at all. Maybe they could have a beach attendant to deal with that in the morning. However, we managed to get one daily, although had to walk on our knees to get under it and one was several rows from the water. The vendors were polite. Never annoying. Just remember to haggle. Be firm. Not interested, no thanks works. 
     The beach was lovely, perfect weather.  The seaweed pickerupper machine was quiet. I didn't understand how it woke people up. It's not perfect but it helped. For our 1st 2 days, there was seaweed in the water. That's where it come from. Yes, not reually pleasant but we got over it. Just go out a bit. On the 3rd day, there was less. Servers on the beach were hard working, came back quickly and never got an order wrong. Small tip for each one. 
    Last tips, try to make dinner reservations early. There is a separate area to make these, employees were  polite but uninspired.  The lower lobby area is fairly loud, at least on the weekend.  It would be nice if the lobby could post daily activities, like shows, dance parties,etc. They do have them, so if interested find someone and ask. 
     I would go back, if only because the grounds were so lovely, most of the employees were pleasant and helpful ( it helps if you know a bit of Spanish) and I'm easy to get along with.

reviews.author: maximiliano r
reviews.title: Genial
reviews.text:
Brillante atención. Solo mejoraría el menú del buffet un poco. Pero nada más. Brillante la atención en general. Destaco a Ramón en el bar de la playa. Un genio. 
Es nuestra segunda vez allí y volveremos por la atención recibida. Ahí marcan la diferencia. Muy recomendable

reviews.author: Rafa H
reviews.title: Hotel precioso donde ha bajado la comida
reviews.text:
Es mi segunda vez en el hotel, la primera fue en 2014 así que puedo comparar su evolución desde entonces. El hotel sigue siendo precioso y está bien mantenido. Dispone de algún espacio nuevo que me ha gustado como es el nuevo gym y el winery. Sus jardines lo diferencian de los otros Meliá de la zona de igual categoría (Palma Real/Circle) donde no hay tanto jardín y se ve más asfalto. En esta ocasión sí note que había bajado la calidad de la comida en los buffets (Gabi Beach, Gabi Club y Naos) se han quedado con comida poco variada y poco sugerente. El perosnal es amable en general y dispuesto a facilitarte tu estancia. La animación es más discreta que en otros hoteles vecinos (menos ruidosa) pero tiene un programa amplio tanto para pequeños como para mayores, lo que se agradece. 
Los restaurantes temáticos; Bana (asiático), Vento (mediterraneo), Mole (mejicano) y el Grill (más de carnes) no ofrecen propuestas especialmente atractivas. Como sugerencia; bajen el aire acondicionado del restaurante Fuego (sigue estando demasiado fuerte). 
Lo que hace especial al Paradisus son sus instalaciones caribeñas, la sensación de estar en un país tropical lleno de palmeras y jardines cuidados en los que puedes pasear y correr con buenas sensaciones.
Como punto positivo nuevo es el cuarto de lavadoras y secadoras nuevas que hay en la reserva y que hace que puedas adelgazar la maleta.
Es un hotel que recomendaría pero que debe mejorar su cocina para volver a brillar.

reviews.author: Kristina Ibra
reviews.title: Расположение и территория
reviews.text:
Хорошая просторная территория, отличное расположение. Множество занятий на день. Отлившей выбор экскурсий. Приятный персонал. Большой выбор ресторанов.
Водоросли на пляже. Дорогой спа салон. 
Хороший сервис в целом.

reviews.author: Kristina Ibra
reviews.title: Хорошая гостиница
reviews.text:
Все понравилось. Гостиница,большие светлые комнаты , еда и множество ресторанов,  большая территория, приятный персонал.
Минусы: водоросли на пляже из-за рифов, закрытие бассейна в 6 вечера, дорогие и необоснованные услуги в спа салонах.

reviews.author: Stephanie-STCA
reviews.title: Tres bel endroit et super personnel
reviews.text:
Nous avons pris une suite one bedroom dans cet etablissement.la chambre est spacieuse et agreable bien que l'ensemble meriterait un peu de renovation ( il ne faut pas regarder les joints de la douche, la poubelle de la salle de bain ou bien les retouches de peinture vite fait, mal fait). Apres avoir fait abstraction de cela, le complexe benificie d'une belle vegetation, de belles piscines et d'une belle infrastucture ou on ne sent pas le monde. Petit bemol quand meme: la reservation des restaurants qui reste compliquee malgre l'aide du concierge.. nous n'avons pas pu tester le restaurant asiatique de la semaine. Le fuego est a eviter, le grill steack house est de bonne facture ( malgre le supplement pour les bons morceaux de viande), l'italien beneficie d'un cadre tres agreable surtout quand on est situe sur les petits ilots, le vento tres bien et enfin le buffet sur la plage rien que pour le bonheur des yeux.
La plage est agreable avec des matelas confortables et les clients de la reserve ont un espace privilegie. Reste le probleme des algues qui representent un veritable fleau sur toute la republique dominicaine.
Enfin, une mesaventure a signaler: a notre arrivee, on nous a propose de visiter un hotel tout neuf du groupe Melia, nous y sommes alles pensant y trouver notre prochain lieu de vacances.. en fait nous n'avons pas vu grand chose du complexe hormis une chambre. Le but de cette visite etait en fait de nous faire acheter un programme de fidelite a 150 000 dollars pour devenir black circle member. Meme le personel du paradisius n'avait pas l'air tres au courant de la manoeuvre. Si vous avez du temps a perdre et une carte de credit sans plafond, cela peut passer, sinon declinez la visite.
Un grand merci a jean , responsable marketing, toujours aidant et disponible et qui parle parfaitement francais. Notre concierge Brian etait aussi tres prodessionnel et a tout fait pour rendre notre sejour agreable. Dans l'ensemble, le personnel est vraiment agreable et a l'ecoute de ses clients. En resume, la qualite est plutot au rendez-vous pour une formule All inclusive et nous reviendrons avec plaisir.

reviews.author: Paige
reviews.title: Soooo relaxing!
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at the resort! The resort grounds are absolutely stunning, and the weather was so perfect (as you can see in the pictures). We enjoyed both the beach and pool on a daily basis. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the resort, and it was such a perk! Our butler Ariel met us when we arrived and kept in touch with us during our entire trip. He’d meet up with us daily to make sure we had everything we needed and confirm our reservations for dinner (reservations are required for most of the restaurants). He even left us a daily treat like chocolate covered strawberries or a cheese plate! We also want to shout out Rafael, who would reserve us a good spot on the beach every morning. They both took all the work out of our vacation so all we had to do was relax! Thank you Ariel and Rafael!!

reviews.author: Mike K
reviews.title: Good value, horrendous service
reviews.text:
This is a nice resort with friendly people and a nice clientele.  Lots of things to do.  Food is good, not great.  Drinks are good, not great.  If you come, eat at The Winery every nite.  There is good service here.  Wines are very very good and well priced.  They will serve you customized meals.  Really good!!   

The biggest thing is the overall service.  Lots of people work here but nobody really wants to help you.  Lots of handoffs and excuses.  Everything is slow and lots of errors.  For my money, Cancún all inclusive are SO much better.

reviews.author: Carl and Patty
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation at this lovely resort.
reviews.text: We stayed 4/6-4/13/19 and had a wonderful time!!  Kids loved it and so did we.  Room was spacious and very comfy.  Staff was very friendly and genuine which made us feel right at home.  In particular Jhonaton Reyes, Domingo Espinal and Fidel Rosario went above and beyond to make our whole family feel welcome!!  We can't say enough about their tremendous personalities and friendliness.  They truly treated us like family!!

reviews.author: Mark J
reviews.title: Went to a wedding here
reviews.text: Was a very nice and beautiful all inclusive. 99% of the wait staff were very friendly. The only real complaint was that we felt we were not informed of the amenities, restaurants and shows like we should have been. We had to ask a lot of questions and figure out ourselves. I wish there was a list of events and times and locations. Plus more info on how reservations work for the restaurants. But we liked the buffet better than the restaurant experience anyways.

reviews.author: aito16
reviews.title: Férias no paraíso
reviews.text: Estivemos no hotel Paradisus Palma Real e optamos pelo Royal Service. Por optarmos pelo Royal Service tivemos 1 restaurante exclusivo, além de área reservada na piscina e na praia. Todo o serviço e atenção dos funcionários foi excelente, um agradecimento especial para nosso mordomo Yohelvi. Ele foi muito prestativo reservando todos nossos restaurantes e deixando mimos todos os dias no nosso quarto! Com ctz fez a nossa estadia muito mais especial!!!

reviews.author: jounianni
reviews.title: Could be a lot better if they would train staff for service...
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our 10 days vacation at Paradisus but were left with quite mixed feelings from this hotel, which has potential for much more

Positives
+Juan Carlos & Tennis teacher is superstar. We ended taking both private lessons and participating on free of charge lessons (morning for beginners and late afternoon for advanced). He is great teacher with great service attitude - best in resort
+ beach and surroundings well taken care of
+ Cocotal golf club with free of charge green fees is 15 minutes walking distance (or free bus once ever hour). Pleasant - not toughest course - we enjoyed 3 rounds
+ wide choice of restaurants and bars

Negatives:
- service is really hit and miss - you get positive suprises but for majority they are just working there. It is clear that management was nowhere visible asking and meeting customers
- Reception zero welcoming (we are melia gold rewards members) but just wanting us away fast - asking to sign credit card reserve without even explaining how much and why 
- Very noisy. Neighbour hotel played very loud music each evening - worst night until 2 am. Sleeping without ear plugs impossible. Loud music at pool and beach all day long 
- We ended up at front desk 7 times for changing keys which always stopped working (no - we did not keep them next to phones). No apology given
-Safety box in our suite didnt work and shower very low pressure and extremely hot water - mentioned on this issue a few times with no action
- Even if they have many ala carte restaurants there are really only 2 good ones (Aqua - great quality and ok Italian). Rest of them adequate at best. Book reservation in advance to avoid long waiting lines
- Huge resort and at easter time running at limit - plenty of colf carts transporting people back and forth but none of drivers stopping and asking to take you anywhere even if tehy were empty / employees only on board
-Fix the tennis court !!

If youre looking for party vacation at Caribbean beautiful beach this is a great place - if youre looking for high quality and service with quiet surroundings please go elsewhere... Comparing with Melia Zanzibar this was at best 3 star experience

reviews.author: frank L
reviews.title: Bien
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné dans cet hôtel 10 jours mais il n’a pas réussi à nous faire oublier le royal service paradisus Punta Cana de la même chaîne l année dernière.
Dans cet hôtel, Le calme à la plage et au restaurant réservés au royal service est bien là, la chambre est propre et grande.
Ariel benzo notre majordome est très gentil et toujours à vouloir vous faire plaisir avec le sourire. Il devance vos attentes ! Luis, notre second majordome prend plaisir à parler français avec nous et garde le sourire toute la journée. Il s’occupera très bien de vous aussi. Côte plage royal service c’est grand et calme. esteban côté palazzo est très gentil et toujours de bonne humeur et c’est un réel plaisir de le voir tous les jours.
Mais le rapport qualité prix du paradisus Punta Cana est bien au dessus avec des services en plus et une ambiance générale bien au dessus également. Notre coup de cœur reste donc le paradisus Punta Cana: L’Acceuil au Check in royal service, le choix du petit déjeuné, le beach bar, le lunch sur la plage.

reviews.author: KHoff
reviews.title: Exceeded our expectations.
reviews.text:
We booked a trip for our 30th wedding anniversary. Upon our arrival we were upgraded to the Royal Service and a room in an adult's only area. This gave us access to a private beach and pool which was very nice. Royal service included a butler, Darleni Alvarado. Darleni really made our stay special, from showing us around and introducing members of the staff to us, setting reservations at the different restaurants and being more of a friend than staff. Darleni was available to answer any and all questions and made sure we were never left wanting. She was always accessible and would stop by to see how thing were going and what might we want to do next.  One great surprise was when coming back from dinner one night, Darleni had a bubble bath with flower petals and candles setup in the oversized tub for us.
The resort grounds are kept immaculate. From the pools to the beaches, everything is well kept. Our room was a bit dated, but always clean and comfortable. We had breakfast delivered to our room and eaten on the veranda. Listening to the surf and birds is the best way to start your day. All of the staff is friendly and more than helpful. A special thanks to Omar and Wanda (and many more, sorry that I do not remember your names) at the adult pool bar will keep you satisfied with drinks and humor.
Make sure you get up early to see at least one sunrise from the beach.

reviews.author: Buttinsand19
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing and beautiful! Saddens me to leave my Paradisus familia. They were all exceptionally friendly and helpful in making my stay one to remember and anxious to return. Edison Ylilian and his crew at the lobby bar were exceptional in personality, creativity and service. Edwin Padilla, server at the alacarte restaurant, treated me like a princess,and was always ahead if my every need.I look forward to return visit!

reviews.author: snobnative
reviews.title: Management
reviews.text: Prior to our arrival we had a few special request. When we arrived  we were greeted by Ladizon Reyes who is the Front desk manager. Ladzion was extreamly accomadating and made our stay much more pleasurable than expected. He is another reason we will return to The Reserve. As well as Lazion and Gabriel, Johanna De Los Santos another conciere assinged to us could not have been more helpful. She as well as Gabby follwed up on all dinner reservations and called daily to be sure everything was ok. Just a wonderful personality. Took the time to make you feel like family. She would stop by to chat and make us feel at home. We are Looking  forward to seeing her and all again soon.

reviews.author: 903travel
reviews.title: Unfortunately it is not the best experience
reviews.text: I was so exited to go in Paradisus Palma Real and could not wait to stay there. Unfortunately this hotel did not meet my exspectation. Hotel is huge and have a different level of service. The biggest problem is nobody explain you what you can and can not use according to your room accomodation, nither give you a tour around the property when you checking in. Absolutely poor managment. We had a huge problem with restorant reservation. Even spend more then 40 minutes to make a reservation for the reatorants for 7 nights, we got very unprofessional person by name Nicalis, who gave us a paper with a list of restorant reservation, but did not put it in the computer. We came to the Aqua restorant very nicely dressed up and nobody could found the place for us. The hole vacation was completely ruined after that night. Thank you very much Tata, Yohendy and Milly who help us to make another reservation for the rest of our stay. Unfortunately we did not  have an experience with Aqua restoraunt, but Vladimir made a reservation for us in Pallazio. I want to say thank you for the manager in the reception(sorry, forgot her name) and hard working personal in this hotel. Everybody in the buffet, restoraunts, bars, lanscaping are working just excellent. The room are clean. The beach is gorgeous, but beach beds are very bed and need to be replace. The entertaiment is good. This hotel has great potential to be one of the best in Punta Cana, but right now has a poor management. If you can pay top dollars for the Royal Service, you will enjoy it. Otherwise you will feel like a poor guest on the expensive ball.

reviews.author: Christopher B
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Hotel was fantastic.   Very clean, modern, and up to date.  Lots of restaurants on site for dinner.   Was in an adult's only area and had access to a private beach and pool which was nice.   Our room butler (Nicolas) took care of us our entire stay.   He was easily accessible via text and took care of everything we need for arranging dinner reservations, to providing us with the daily schedule, getting things to our room, and taking care of everything else.   Overall I recommend this hotel to anyone thinking of going to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Craig S
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: We decided to go to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for our 5yr anniversary. We went with the Royal Service and had Darleni as our butler. She was amazing and made our trip very special. Our favorite show was King of Pop Michael Jackson. Excellent impersonator. Room service was quick, complimentary shuttle to the Reserve for their Spa was timely. The Hydrotherapy (included with Royal Service) at Yhi Spa was amazing, we went a few times. The beach sand is like powder and there’s workers every morning combing the beach to keep it beautiful.

reviews.author: BFrankly
reviews.title: Short but sweet
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I only spent 3 nights here but it was incredible. We paid for the Royal Service, and it was worth it. Having a private pool, bar and beach area was great, and the ability to simply text someone to have a cabana reserved made the experience so stress-free. The pool and beach were beautiful. Staff were so attentive, and friendly. I have dietary restrictions but there was such variety at each meal that I had no problems finding something to eat. Drinks were great. My only complaint was that we didn't book a longer trip - but that's my fault. Hoping to get back next year!

reviews.author: Kristin L
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: So fun great staf Luis Cordero is  the best!!!!!!! Drinks t great food amazing beautiful resort and beach and sexy staff Luis baustisra Michael Jackson show was so amazing and the staff goes above and beyond

reviews.author: Jeff J
reviews.title: Emill David - Bartender
reviews.text: Once again the people that work at this resort make it such a pleasure to stay here. Emill is full of energy and always takes time to make everyone feel welcome each and every night. Emill’s special drinks are amazing and keep you coming back for more!

reviews.author: machuloureiro
reviews.title: Vacations at paradise
reviews.text: Really great vacations, went with the family. The arquitecture and gardens of the hotel are spectacular, they have free daily activities such as yoga, spinning or painting by the pool which are very fun to do.The quality and the variety of the food is very good. You can enjoy the day by the beach under the palapas shadow with the great service of jendry and junior whom will be always sure you have a drink in your hand or you can enjoy the activities and music at the pool with really friendly and entertainment staff like Nixon boo who manage to steel a smile of my baby girl every time we cross by. We’ll definitely come back soon.

reviews.author: Fearless06419337249
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text: Se pasa agradable , tienen calidad en las comidas y bbebidas y las instalaciones limpias. Deben mejorar el Room Service ya que en ningun hotel de la zona se carga nada adicional por su uso si esta incluido y trabajar el trma de las moscas en el buffet.

reviews.author: Ciusni
reviews.title: Needs to improve
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, family proposal but the furniture is too old. They don`t have tropical gardens as they claim to have. Very noisy, noisy rooms. Very small buffets, when the hotel is full is hard to go inside the buffets.
The beach is not children family, bavaro beach is for sure much better than the one where this hotel is located. When we leave the hotel to the airport, they told us it costs USD 35, but for my surprise, the driver told me it is USD 40. 
Really needs to improve.

reviews.author: BR10016
reviews.title: Family trip that left a bad taste in our mouths
reviews.text:
This was my family's second time at the Reserve at Paradisus. When I booked, I requested the same room as last year or something similar. We were first floor and pool facing. I'm not sure if other reviews warn about the rooms not facing the pool, but be aware, they are awful. They face the road and you will hear carts (shuttle buses the hotel takes guests on), scooters (used by staff), and other loud noises late into the night and early morning. We were on the side facing the edge of the hotel's property and could hear thumping music from the adjacent hotel all night long. They made no effort to honor our request. Clearly they don't value return customers. 

What left the worst taste in my mouth - literally and figuratively - was that at the time of booking (black Friday), we were told “as a special thanks” we would be given dinner for two at Pasion, their "premier" restaurant (which carries a charge, is adults only, etc). We figured "why not," arranged for my mother to babysit the kids, and scheduled for our dinner. Pasion is a tasting menu--of the ten courses, about three were edible. I am a seafood lover, but this was the most fishy, inedible seafood I had ever tasted. At the end of an unnecessarily long (3 hour) dinner, I was presented with a bill for $160 ($80 per person). I mentioned to the waiter that we had been offered dinner for free, and he looked at me and said to speak to the management. I was upset and angry and immediately conveyed what had happened to our Family Concierge. She said she would look into it. After asking her day after day about this, I spoke with the Concierge manager.  What they failed to mention, was that what we were offered was a three course "sampling" of Pasion. I explained that I felt completely tricked into eating at this horrible restaurant. After going around and around, they wound up charging us half. I made it clear that I didn’t think was a satisfactory resolution - they did not seem to care what I think. While this was my personal story, it reflects on the overall experience at Paradisus—they will try to “sell” every minute of the day. Quietly sitting by the pool, you'll be hounded by salespeople trying to book family photo sessions (many of who didn't politely take no for an answer). Waiters wanting to bring you "drinky drinky" so that they'll earn a tip. The whole place just feels like everyone is hustling. Overall, I found that tiresome and, in the case of Pasion restaurant, downright shady.

reviews.author: Rosa T
reviews.title: Vacaciones excelente
reviews.text: Me he sentido muy bien. Excelentes atenciones. Comidas y todos los bares excelentes Los show muy bueno Los bailarines Luis cordero Oscar Leo carida eh yefry Benjamin manta champu eh guachy bares fautino Mejia  yancarlodj

reviews.author: jane smith
reviews.title: Best Trip Ever
reviews.text: This trip we went on with 10 of my friends along with parents. Incredibly nice hotel, great service, definitely a place I would love to come back to!! 10/10 Best servers - Nixon & Luis & Joanna! They went out of their way to suit all of our needs!

reviews.author: Arianna
reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Loved this trip, came with all of my friends and had a blast! Nixon was definitely the best part, so much fun, I definitely recommend meeting him if you come here! DJ Janky also played amazing music, very fun music

reviews.author: Laura K
reviews.title: Mojito
reviews.text: My trip was amazing. I had so much fun with my friends. The food was amazing and the beach was so beautiful. My personal favorite person working was Nixon bao! He’s the best and will make your visit awesome.

reviews.author: Sydnie K
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Loved it was a great time. Perfect weather. Great service. Nixón Bao was a great part of the hotel. He made everything so great. I loved the beach and pool here. Everything was so nice and special here because of the members at the hotel.

reviews.author: sydneyvanhorn
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: amazing staff, ZUMBA is very fun - adult and kid friendly. very clean rooms and staff is very attentive. lots of different things to do, Jendry & Nixon are my favorite staff members. Jendry was very fast with our drinks and very nice.

reviews.author: Lauren B
reviews.title: Spring break
reviews.text: Amazing staff!!! Very welcoming and entertaining! The first day was my 18th birthday and I had a blast. We took Zumba classes with Nixon and jendry was the best beach server ever! 10/10 recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Dany00
reviews.title: Necesita una Renovación
reviews.text: Por el precio, esperaba más de las instalaciones, que sí bien se nota que en sus días de esplendor fue lujoso, se ha quedado atrás respecto a la gran competencia, por la falta de renovación. Un hotel de esa categoría no puede permitirse tumbonas y muebles rotos, habitaciones desactualizadas, pero menos la piscina rota al punto de causarle una herida de puntos a mi niño. El hotel se hizo cargo de todos los gastos, como debe ser en un caso así. Debo destacar el excelente servicio de todos los empleados y tienen un muy buen Miniclub para los niños. Visitamos el restaurante Aqua donde lo mejor fue el postre de chocolate y el Japonés donde fue muy entretenido el show de cocina.

reviews.author: janetgp1014
reviews.title: Very Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: This was our first time at Paradisus Palma Real.  We opted to upgrade to the Royal Service and are so happy we did.  Our butler, Richard, took such wonderful care of us the entire stay.  Dinner reservations, poolside bali beds, drinks...you name it he was there for us and checked on us several times a day and responded to our What's Ap texts immediately - no matter what time of day.  We went to Dominican Republic for the beach and were not let down.  Raphael took great care of us every morning setting up our lounges under the same palapa every day.  When he was busy caring for other guests, Pedro jumped in and took great care.  Wanda, our bartender at the Sunset Bar in Royal Service, was amazing. I can't say enough amazing things about the staff - everyone that we encountered was pleasant and really wanted our stay to be outstanding.  We were a little disappointed with some of the food options.  Our steak dinner at Rare was just that - rare, even though I ordered a well done steak, sent it back and it came back microwaved.  While the buffet was plentiful, it was chaotic.  So glad that we had Plazzao at our disposal - it did not disappoint for breakfast and lunch.  We took the opportunity to have dinner at Aqua and it was delish! However, the food highlight of our trip was our dinner at Passion.  We highly recommend spending the extra and enjoying a world class meal. We would most likely return to this resort the next time we come to Punta Cana - and will request our "Guy", Richard!

reviews.author: Jose Manuel Tamayo
reviews.title: Un hotel con una infraestructura excelente pero con un personal que no representa una excelencia en servicio
reviews.text:
Nuestro viaje fue familiar, 10 personas en total, la recepción es lenta por lo que hay que tener paciencia desde la entrada si vas en un grupo, te piden nuevamente las tarjetas de crédito que usaste para pagar la estadía, en nuestro caso ya teníamos pagado el 100% de la estadía pero de todas formas nos pidieron las tarjetas de crédito para un cobro de seguridad.
Todos teníamos la categoría Family Concierge, supuestamente esto seria un upgrade de nuestras vacaciones pero realmente no vale la pena contratar este servicio, en mi caso personal nuestro concierge no se preocupo por nosotros y teniendo en cuenta que viajábamos con un bebe de 5 meses acompañados de nuestros suegros que cumplían años de casados... En servicio en general no es tan bueno como lo pensábamos, yo personalmente venia con expectativas altas, ya que nuestra ultima estadía fue en el Hard Rock, en general en los restaurantes y barras si no andas con dolares en la mano  los chicos no te atienden de la mejor manera y se les nota en la actitud... al parecer el típico norteamericano que anda dejando dolares en todos lados tiene al equipo de Paradisus muy mal acostumbrado ya que sin dolares en la mano no vas a tener la misma atención que con una buena propina. 
(Esto es lo que diferencia a un equipo realmente fidelizado, la atención es siempre buena y esto genera en el cliente las ganas de dejar una buena propina y este no fue el caso)
La comida en general es buena y las instalaciones de primer nivel.
Reposeras en la piscina ni se molesten en buscar, nunca hay disponibles, de alguna forma el hotel permite que los huéspedes dejen reservada las reposeras todo el día!! Vas a las 7 AM y ya están todas las reposeras con toallas y cosas.

En general si algún día recomiendo el hotel les diría que hay que ir con muchos dolares para propina y que la suerte los acompañe con un buen concierge.

reviews.author: theaveragemoco
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text:
Resort, staff and experience was a 5. Our butler, yes butler!, Ariel was great. My only complaint was the food. Most of what we had was sub par. 

We attended a wedding there and it was perfect. Staff and ceremony was handled great. And the carnival dancers for the reception were amazing!

reviews.author: Caroline U
reviews.title: Wonderful family vacation
reviews.text:
We visited for a week in June of 2018 and went through Costco travel for booking. I highly recommend doing it this way. We had booked for just the regular Paradisus resort and were so lucky to get a free upgrade to the Reserve side. Being skeptical, I asked why the upgrade. I was told they were trying to keep the families with kids on the reserve side. It turned out to be the best thing that could’ve happened for us. The pool and facilities on the Paradisus side were always super crowded and not as clean as where we were. We had a Concierge in our building to answer questions all hours of the day and evening. Everyone was pretty helpful. We did have a few issues while there. Water in room was shut off for a day. Lost power briefly a couple of times. Room service that was to be delivered for an early morning trip didn’t show the evening before, however they went above and beyond the next morning to pack our family bagged lunches and delivered them earlier than normal. 
My kid and I got sick for a day with stomach stuff, but took a trip to a pharmacy and got Meds from there. Also, think my daughter came down with Strep when we first arrived and we were able to go to the pharmacy and get Amoxicillin. She was feeling much better the next day. 
The beach had tons of seaweed, which was messy, but the resort really couldn’t control that. They made every effort to continuously clean it.
Employees were friendly and smiling. 
We ate at all the restaurants and none really stand out. Our least favorite was the Hibachi place. The food just didn’t taste good to us.
The kids club was really for younger kids, but my 10 and 12 year old took one for the team and hung out there one evening. I think they ended up entertaining the toddlers and helping to keep them busy. The probably need a few more things for the older kids to do so mom and dad can be alone for a while.
They had a Michael Jackson impersonator on the stage one night and I was very impressed!
The pool bar at the Reserve was great as was the bartender, Jesus. He was there everyday working hard. We would love to go back and visit sometime and would definitely stay at The Reserve again.

reviews.author: dnacmll
reviews.title: Spa Massage
reviews.text: While we didn't stay at this location (we were at a different property) we decided to schedule some time at the Spa. I had a wonderful spa massage with Ysabel at The Reserve @ Paradisus and it was fantastic! I personally do not like 'hard' massages and her touch was consistent and perfect, as requested. I would highly recommend Ysabel.

reviews.author: Jatin.S
reviews.title: Anniversary Celebration
reviews.text:
Had a pleasant stay, Staff is highly cooperative, amazing restaurant, amazing beach, Our butler Mr.Danny sounds bit lazy though, but overall I would rate it 9/10,
We got free upgrade to the royal service " the best part", free premium drinks all day long. Last but not the least our Chef Mr.Dayal Singh made deliciously home made style cuisine for South Asian people, very humble personality. Keep up the good work guys,

reviews.author: Josh K
reviews.title: No BS Review
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Palma Real for our honeymoon.
I think the rating depends on what you are travelling for. If you are going with a group of friends or a big family trip I would give it 5 stars. But not necessarily designed for a honeymoon. The resort is legitimately right on the beach. The beach is prime nice white sand, the main beach gets packed and need to get there around 6am if you want seats in the first or second row. Jendry was our man getting us drinks on the beach, seems like he was the only one that we could actually rely on to actually get us the drinks. 
The pool is really nice and well maintained but not really designed for honeymoon, swim up bar is also packed during the day. The buffet food was fantastic, I'd rather have that than most of the restaurants personally. The bars are good, drinks can be pretty inconsistent but nothing to crazy. The night life seemed really good but again this is where I start to say it is better for a group trip because we didn't really wanna go party with a bunch of people on our honeymoon. 
The rooms themselves were nice, the issue I had was the WiFi sucked and the TV didn't work the whole time I was there. Not a big deal because I really wasn't going to use it much and you're there to chill on the beach but at the same time you're paying enough money that the TV and internet should at least work. 
Overall I thought it was a solid resort ideal for a group trip, would not necessarily recommend for a honeymoon unless you upgrade to the royal service or one of the other options, which will cost you a good amount more money. But still earns 4 stars in my book because I know that if I went on a trip with a bunch of friends it would be everything that I hoped for.

reviews.author: Pierre D
reviews.title: punt une deuxième année de fil
reviews.text: Excellent site, la plage est superbe, une des plus belles que nous avons vues dans tous nos voyages. De magnifiques restaurants et des employés souriants et serviables. Une mention spéciales à Miguelina Palmara qui a ensoleillé notre semaine encore plus...

reviews.author: joecast1974
reviews.title: Perfect Family Vacation and Great Resort
reviews.text:
This was our first time staying at the Paradisus Palma real, as we usually stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana. 

I must say we like this resort a little better because of the setup of the pool and the beach, as they are in close proximity to each other.

There also seems to be more nightlife and activities going on at this Resort compared to the paradisus Punta Cana.

What made our stay even better was a service of Abraham Torres oh, we had the pleasure of being our server at just about every meal, every single day. He went above and beyond to make sure that our meal was perfect and our service what's top-notch.

I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Effie B
reviews.title: Very nice place -ditch the white glove service
reviews.text:
Very nice facilities and staff. Food is ok and plenty of variety to pick from. Overall great service. It’s wonderful for children and overall a great place to vacation at. 
Special shout out to Alejandro from the entertainment team who was amazing!!
That said, all the so called “white glove” services need to be dropped in favor of modern ,straightforward online reservations. It was impossible and frustrating to book a dinner at a restaurant without your ‘concierge’ or taking a cart to the restaurant reservation place where you wait in line and put your name down.  if you were on the waitlist you also needed to go back to see if you got off the waitlist  (waste of time -as they don’t really follow up on reservations). The so called concierge is a waste and frankly nothing but a marketing thing - they couldn’t do more than what I did when I physically tried to book a restaurant. The only thing they did was text the daily activity schedule that we already had in the booklet we got when we came. 
The check-in/our took forever (a staff of 10 but only one person can actually check you in/out).  Same for the boutique - staff of 6 but one cashier. 
Finally, we deliberately picked a place to avoid any sales pitches and yet staff tried  selling us on a lunch to see the new resort -grand reserve. If nothing else that would be the reason we won’t be coming back -time share or whatever you are trying to sell ain’t our thing .

reviews.author: Justin D
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Met Reynaldo monegro on my first day on the resort. He took care of all our needs and was amazing. Really enthusiastic and full of energy. Great staff with great service which is hard to find. 10/10 would recommend to anyone. We came as a family of 4 and had a blast.

reviews.author: Dana H
reviews.title: Perfect Get away!
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with perfect entertainment every night.  I wish the buffet had changed up the selection a bit more.  We relaxed on the beautiful beach each day with our favorite server Santo Marrero, he was polite and attentive and always had a smile on his face.  I think the restaurant service was good.  A little room for improvement but no real complaint.  The entertainment personal worked hard to keep you entertained.  Overall a great vacation.  Was our second visit and would not hesitate to go again!!

reviews.author: Lesli C
reviews.title: Best choice for a vacation!
reviews.text: I came here to celebrate my 30th birthday with my boyfriend and friends and our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was a dream come true. Our concierge Yolando made us feel at home and was so attentive on making sure we were comfortable and happy our entire stay. I was extremely satisfied with our stay and I want to thank Yolando and the entire staff at Paradisus for making this vacation in Punta Cana my favorite so far. The resort itself is not only ultimately beautiful and well maintained but the entire staff and the people are so kind and friendly I am definitely considering planning another vacation to this resort. Yolando made my birthday extra special as he and my boyfriend planned a surprise for me. I walked up to our room after lunch and Yolando came out of the room sweating and had decorated the room extra nice for my birthday. He also went out of his way and picked up my 30 balloons outside of the resort and had them in the room ready the morning of my birthday. I couldn’t have pictured my birthday celebration any more perfect. Thank you Paradisus Palma Real. Your resort and people are beautiful!

reviews.author: Vikas
reviews.title: Very nice hotel and staff
reviews.text: The resort is nice, clean, well planned and staffs at the hotel are awesome; enjoyed the stay. The rooms were clean. Restaurants offer great selections. The butler assigned was also very helpful. The management should consider enhancing butler program to be more engaging and providing more information. Nonetheless, I will go back to this resort again.

reviews.author: Brutus
reviews.title: Good time and food
reviews.text: Had a great time thanks to our butler Armando (Supermando!) Excellent service and beautiful oceanfront views in Royal service. The food was good and we were treated like kings/queens! The room was awesome. No complaints!

reviews.author: Departure26717815172
reviews.title: Very Expensive Golf Never Again!!
reviews.text:
This review is solely about our experience playing Golf.  We played one round of 9 holes.  we had our children with us.  8yrs and 10 yrs  They know how to play.  When we booked the round with our Concierge we were never told that the cost of a golf cart would be $75 per person!!!!!  We knew we had to rent clubs which was reasonable for being on a resort.  So our round of 9 holes was just under $450, and $300 of it was FOR CARTS!!!  I am disgusted, and appalled that they had the audacity to charge $75 per person for an 8 and a 10 yr old child.  It was a 25-30 minute drive to the course and would have been an hour wait to just leave to get back to our resort.  Be very aware if you plan to golf here.  Some might say "what do you expect its a resort"?  What I expect to to have the "resort" be up front about the costs we were never told.  

That being said everything else was awesome!!

reviews.author: viajeravenezolana
