reviews.title: Vacaciones perfectas
reviews.text: Esta Semana Santa en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service han sido mis vacaciones perfectas, el sitio es espectacularmente hermoso, la habitación es enorme con una cama King size comodisima, el jacuzzi también es muy grande y todas las tardes te lo preparan primorosamente con flores y velas y una botella de vino, desde el balcón se ve y se oye el mar y se siente la brisa marina que mueve las palmeras. La comida es exquisita en todos los restaurantes y cafetines todo incluidos y el Restaurante Passion de Martin Berasategui aunque no está incluido, es una experiencia que no se debe perder; no todos los días se tiene la oportunidad de comer en un sitio con 3 estrellas Michelin. En la playa te ubican en una choza con unas camas tamaño matrimonial donde se pueden disfrutar de maravillosos cócteles servidos por un personal muy atento. Y allí debo recalcar que el sitio no solo es muy hermoso, sino que lo más resaltante es la atención. El servicio Royal cuenta con un concierge que te consiente en todo momento, está pendiente de todos tus caprichos y necesidades, te hace las reservaciones de los restaurantes, te prepara el jacuzzi, coloca almohadas perfumadas en tu cama, llama a tu taxi para los traslados, etc, en lo particular tuvimos mucha suerte de contar con nuestro concierge Juan Carlos Sierra quien nos brindó una atención esmerada para que estas vacaciones fuesen inolvidables. Estoy deseando regresar ya que una semana se me hizo muy corta.

reviews.author: Alexandre M
reviews.title: Estrutura impecável.
reviews.text:
O Hotel é extremamente bem cuidado, lindíssimo nos jardins, lobby e quartos.

Ótimas piscinas e estrutura de praia

A praia tem muitas ondas e acaba não proporcionando o banho de mar tranquilo, principalmente com criancas. A praia dos outros hotéis da rede Meliá em Bávaro é melhor. 

Os restaurantes as La Carte são ótimos,  desde que você consiga reserva-los. Missão difícil. Dica : Na chegada busque reservar com o Concierge para a estadia toda. Ainda assim é difícil. 

Pontos negativos : Restaurante buffet não tem boa variedade e falta reposição no horário de pico.

Atividades noturnas fracas. 

Coisa para se aborrecer é o room service. Ligue quantas vezes quiser e o telefone simplesmente não atende. Me pediram desculpas depois, informando que a linha estava com defeito...

Por fim, apesar da simpatia dos funcionários, pedir uma bebida nos restaurantes é missão complicada também. Termina a refeição e fica sem a bebida. Eu simplesmente levantava e ia aos bares ao lado do restaurante para pegar bebidas. Aliás os bares são excelentes.

O Hotel é dedicado a famílias. Muitas crianças mesmo, com tudo de bom e ruim que isso pode trazer a estadia.

No geral, tem poucos hotéis em Punta Cana com a estrutura deste. Gostei e voltaria novamente.

reviews.author: Steven T
reviews.title: Wow

reviews.author: TEXASMIKE78641
reviews.title: Royal Service with Royal Treatment
reviews.text:
A much needed vacation after 4 years of non stop work. Now we know how bad We needed this vacation. 

I was a bit mixed on the reviews between Hard Rock Hotel and Paradisus Palma Real Spa & Golf Resort. I know Hard Rock is more of a party kinda property, my wife and I quite, relaxation and catered too. We came across Paradisus and read about the Butler Royal services, and having a ocean view room sounded like our perfect dream vacation. 

Not knowing what to expect and booking our Resort stay from April 10-April 17, 2019 being our first visit to Punta Cana. We arrived being greeted by Hotel staff when we arrived to the front drive. We where escorted without our bags to the Royal Service Check-in. You know your vacation starts at that time because all the staff started signing to us as soon as we walked in, and the alcohol started flowing, fresh fruit and snacks. Extremely friendly, explaining everything about the resort. Shortly after check-in we where delighted to meet our butler Jose Vargas (can’t get a better butler), he escorted us to our beachfront room, and showed us around the resort and explained everything to us. We arrived to our Hotel room to find champagne on Ice and fresh fruit tray (wow delicious), and booked us dinner for that evening. Wow what a unforgettable first day, and I’m thinking that it’s only the first day! 

Of course we headed down to the beach the first day to meet “Pedro Cedano” our poolside waiter. Wow what a great server, very funny, extremely accommodating, always had a cabana ready for us with towels set up, fruit trays on the beach for us, and non stop Pintá Colada’s kept coming. Make sure you add to his #tag we created for him if you get to meet him #PuntacacaPedro. Great person and lots of fun!

Each day that went by we received special surprises, so I posted one since I don’t want to spoil the other surprises. The food was absolutely first class, entertainment was very enjoyable (even Michael Jackson was there). The staff cut down fresh coconuts to enjoy and the overall property was exceptionally clean. We received two massages at different locations on the resort and was absolutely amazing!

This vacation was absolutely first class, and would share more, however you would be reading for another 20 minutes, so to shorten it up, Jose Vargas is the one that truly took all my stresses that I arrived with away, even when I got sick for 24 hours, he came to check on me, and if I needed a Dr. Because I was sick we missed our Monkey and zip-line tour, they didn’t have to accommodate us, however our butler contacted the tour and got us booked the following day! Everyday he made sure we had restaurant reservations and explained the good options for us. Amazing Amazing Amazing! I hope he takes my employment offer when he gets his Visa. 

Great experience and definitely without doubt recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Vincent V
reviews.title: Nice Resort But Not On My List For A Second Visit
reviews.text:
Out of all the resorts I have stayed at I found this resort extremely well designed and beautiful.  At the “Reserve” the pool wraps around the three story buildings and the foliage creates these very nice secluded spots.  In addition the main lobby and pool have an amazing design coupled with a sight line right down to the beech.

We had a wonderful eight days – the resort as well as our room was beautiful – the weather is always amazing - but this resort is not on my list for a second visit.

Service at this hotel is not always with a smile (of course the staff at Guest Services are always willing to help and are second to none – I want to thank Karen Morel for making our stay as special as possible) – however when it comes to bartenders and waiters it is a hit and miss.  I read a review before I left which I paid no attention to - the “Reviewer” said “The staff makes you feel like they are doing you a favor”.  In hindsight I found this to be true at least 40% of the time – but not all the time.  Please note if you have not been to the Hard Rock in Punta Cana or Secrets in Punta Cana or Paradisus in Playa de Carmen Mexico – you will most likely not notice the 40%.

But I want to take this opportunity to give a special thanks to a waiter named Juan who waited on us at the Vento Restaurant – his behavior was rude, abrupt and boarded on disrespectful – thanks for the memory – and not in a good way.

Since I retired four years ago – I been to about ten of these resorts – and I have to say the food is comparable to a Jersey Diner – not bad but not made with love.

Oh - did I tell you our room did not have hot water for three days.

reviews.author: N.O.
reviews.title: Royal Service Ocean Front Suite for an incredible romantic getaway.
reviews.text:
The architecture, layout, maintenance and cleanliness of this resort are exceptional. The tile, stonework, buildings and pools are incredible. We have stayed at a number of resorts in the past including a few luxurious Red Sea resorts but architecturally this place outclasses them all. This place would be worth the stay even without a beach.

We had a butler - Francis - assigned to us which we were not expecting and this made all the difference.  Francis made all our dinner reservations, arranged transportation, brought us food and drinks to our room daily and was extremely knowledgeable of the resort, DR and the world.  Without him, our trip would have been just OK; with him it was exceptional. I highly recommend going for Royal Service if you are going on a romantic getaway and asking for Francis if possible. It is my opinion that Francis one day will manage an entire resort.

The beach was above average but not spectacular. The shoreline is beautiful especially in front of the Paradisus were the beach sand was regularly groomed. The water is clean but not clear to snorkel. Perhaps arrange an excursion instead if you wish to snorkel or scuba.  There was also quite a bit of boating traffic near the shoreline but the areas where swimming was allowed was cordoned off from the boating channel.  

The food for us unfortunately was subpar. The service was great but the quality of food and preparation were lacking. The food combination and sauces plated were very odd to me. Deserts were good. I did not care for Brisas at all. Not sure it is worth having so many full service restaurants and numerous food stations in all inclusive. Perhaps the resort should focus more on having fewer higher quality food and less effort on full service restaurants and numerous varieties of food. Chef should prepare stations and also be involved in serving the food. Drinks at the resort were well prepared and the wine was acceptable for all inclusive.  

Overall, we would return to Paradisus for another stay in the future. I really enjoyed resort architecture, layout, beach and service - especially our butler. Our room was spotless and very well cleaned.  View was incredible. All this more than made up for OK food but hopefully that will improve in the future when we book a future return trip.

reviews.author: António Neves
reviews.title: Muito, muito bom !!!
reviews.text: O Resort está muito bem pensado. A zona da praia é excecional. Nota-se em todos os empregados e em toda a organização que o cliente está, sempre, acima de tudo. Não é necessário deixar "gorgeta" para as coisas funcionarem como deve ser !! A zona dos restaurantes é de muito bom nível. Os quartos (apesar de já não serem novos) são muito tranquilos. Estive no Paradisus Palma Real mas o Grand Reserve é um "must". Não posso deixar de falar, também, no serviço ao cliente junto à receção, sobretudo no empregado Vladimir Rodriguez (cinco estrelas no atendimento) e também no Domingo Beltre.

reviews.author: Haley B
reviews.title: AMAZING TRIP!
reviews.text: My mom and I came on this trip for a mother daughter trip and it exceeded our expectations greatly. We had the royal service which was amazing and our butlers name was Faustino (he was amazing!!!!). We got our palapa on the beach every morning by Martin right in the front row of the beach. The weather was amazing every single day and everyone is so nice who works here. The whole resort is super clean and people are always working to clean it. Faustino made our reservations every night and every single place we went to was amazing (bana teppayanki was our favorite). Highly recommend for any age or family! We are very sad to leave.

reviews.author: Alejandra P
reviews.title: PLAYA, RELAX, TRANQUILIDAD, MÁS RELAX, PURO DISFRUTE
reviews.text: Estuvimos en marzo 2019. Somos una familia de socios Black de Circle, los beneficios que tenemos son muchos, pero canjeamos opciones para hospedarnos, no pagamos en dinero. La atención de todo el staff del hotel es excelente. Todos ellos, no importa el lugar en el que estén, se brindan a los huéspedes como sólo los dominicanos saben hacerlo. La calidad y la calidez están en todas partes. Es muy nuevo, se inauguró en diciembre pasado y, si bien hay varios ajustes por hacer aún -nosotros dejamos nuestras humildes sugerencias al partir, a través de Reynaldo, el mayordomo asignado-, la calidad en todos los servicios está presente. Quiero dejarle una gran felicitación a Odeybi Pérez, el muchacho que nos asistía en la playa, siempre hizo su trabajo de manera esmerada, bajo el sol y la pesadez de la arena, pero nunca faltaron su cordialidad y su amabilidad, además de una gran sonrisa. Ojalá los directivos del hotel tengan en cuenta esto y lo beneficien de alguna manera. Una sugerencia para los directivos, aunque sea a los socios Black, podrían otorgar como beneficio, inmersiones para bucear, como solían tener en el Paradisus Punta Cana (somos socios Meliá desde hace unos cuantos años y socios Circle desde el año pasado), algo así como una o dos inmersiones por cada 5 días de estadía. Estúdienlo, por favor!!!! Aunque haya mucha gente o muchos norteamericanos, en ningún momento sentimos la diferencia, el hotel brinda servicios de excelencia a todos por igual, no hay preferencias, y la tranquilidad también se puede disfrutar a pesar de la cantidad de gente. Para nosotros fue una estadía estupenda, calidad, calidez, sonrisas, mucha gente con muuuuuy buena onda. Gracias a todos !!!!   Alejandra P

reviews.author: Glenn F
reviews.title: Outstanding experience at Paradisus Reserve Punta Cana
reviews.text: My wife and I just returned from 6 awesome days at the Paradisus Reserve.  The hotel and grounds were immaculate.  Set in beautiful natural surroundings it  was truly a wonderland and exceeded every expectation I had regarding an all-inclusive Caribbean resort.  The staff of the hotel was friendly beyond belief from the groundskeepers to the shuttle drivers to the restaurant staff, bartenders and concierges (our concierge, Angie, was always cheerful, thoughtful and able to help us negotiate every detail of our stay.)  In addition, they use a tractor to clear off the seaweed from the beach each day as well as having a protective boom cordoning off their beach area so we were able to enjoy the beach and swim in the ocean every day with no problems, despite a number of the beaches to the north of us (side away from airport) having some serious seaweed problems.  I think the drinks were a bit weak (which might be a good thing considering they are unlimited) as I never woke up with a hangover which normally happens if I drink.  They also had great entertainment every night and the lobby was gorgeous and a fantastic place to hang out at after dinner.  All in all we just had the most wonderful time and I highly, highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: racheldF674VH
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
This was our third trip to the Paradisus Palma Real, and or first time staying in the Royal Service section.  Overall, we had a wonderful trip, and the Paradisus Palma Real continues to be a tremendous value for a high quality all-inclusive resort.  The property is gorgeous, and the staff is genuine and friendly.  

In particular, Juan Carlos at tennis, Yonathan Astacio at the palazzio bar, Martin at the Royal Service beach, and our butler Alvaro, all deserve special mention.  Prior to this trip I did not play tennis, but on each day of our trip I went to the free beginners morning lesson with Juan Carlos.  On most days I was the only guest to attend.  Juan Carlos provided outstanding instruction, to the point that after just the fifth day I could play at an intermediate level.  Since the vacation I found an adult tennis clinic, and I was placed with a group of men who have been playing for years.  I am loving tennis, so my experience with Juan Carlos may have actually been life changing.  Our experiences with Yonathan Astacio at the palazzio bar, Martin at the Royal Service beach, and our butler Alvaro were not quite as profound as with Juan Carlos, but they all helped make our stay special.  

As far as the comparison between royal service, and the regular reservation, we would do royal service again, but it is not absolutely necessary.  Royal Service certainly makes for a nicer trip.  Our butler, Alvaro, handled all of our dinner reservations, which in years past was a pain.  The pool and beach area is also much quieter and nicer.  With that said, we had wonderful stays without royal service.  So, if you can afford royal service, it is great, but if not, you will still have a wonderful trip.

One disappointment on our trip was the restaurants.  In our estimation, the buffet has improved since our last stay, but the a la carte restaurants have become less consistent.  In the past all of the restaurants were surprisingly good, and now it is a bit more hit-or-miss.  Palazzio, the royal service only restaurant, was awful.  We much preferred the regular buffet for breakfast and lunch, although our favorite place for lunch was Brisas, which was great.  We also enjoyed Aqua, Bana, and Rare (just don't expect Ruth Chris).   Passions was well worth the additional cost, and is in a different category for quality.  Vento used to be great, but was poor on this trip.  Finally, the cocktails are high-end and great.  

Thanks for a wonderful trip.

reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text: Food is Great. Great atmosphere, shows are fun at night and it is perfect for all families and ages. Golf is great as well as tennis. Waiters and workers are extremely friendly and are always here to help. Nixion is the best! He made my trip unbelievable. Jose also made the trip a blast. Both were extremely friendly and fun. I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: elizabethhearle
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: We arrived today and already have been overwhelmed by the friendly, helpful staff!!! Carlos, our concierge, and Domingo helped us check in with ease. Carlos has answered every question we had and escorted the 13 of us to dinner. Nixon has spent the evening getting our teenage daughters dancing and laughing- he has made our first day a blast!!!

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Girls week
reviews.text: Best time ever. Staff is so friendly and welcoming. My room was perfect fresh sheets and towels. good food and drinks. Nixon is so awesome he got our group up to dance and let us have a really great time.

reviews.author: Kandice M
reviews.title: LOVE LOVE LOVE This Resort
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Punta Cana and it was amazing. We arrived to the resort after having several problems with flight, shuttles, and lost luggage and the staff greeted us with a warm smile and an ear to hear us vent. My wife and I do have 2 children but we did not bring them because we wanted to check the place out before bring younger children. The resort was just beautiful the pictures do not do this place justice. To start the room was lovely, there was some chipped paint and some issues getting the TV to work but they did fix the problem. The room was VERY clean we did tip the a few dollars a day for all the great work. The food was very good at "The Reserve" part of paradisus the other buffets in our option were not edible. The Reserve also has a pool side grill that makes burgers, fresh pizza, and has an ice cream machine that is self serve that the kids just loved. Also room service was very good we had room service for breakfast everyday since we like to sleep late. 

My wife and I did not really leave the resort we went just to relax. The staff the this resort were very friendly and helpful. If you are looking for some great bartenders and staff look for Jesus Avelion, Junior, Carmen, and Juan Diego. Jesus Avelino really warmed my heart, as I said my wife and I did not bring the kids.But while we were at the pool bar a group of kids sawm up and ordered all kinds of drinks (playing adult) and he served and interacted with those kids like they were celebrities, it really made their day to be treated like adults (as they giggled ordering Roy Rogers). Carmen was the first staff member we had the joy of interacting with once we arrived and she was helpful and so kind to us after having a bad day traveling. Junior was sweet and had to deal with us really drunk one night. But he made sure we got back to our room and were safe. Juan Diego was very helpful during the whole stay, but went out of his way to find me all different kinds of dominican peso to take home to my son.

This was our frist time in the Dominica Rebulic but we are already planing a trip back next April.

reviews.author: CPereira
reviews.title: Ferias V&C
reviews.text:
Hotel muito bom, apenas um ponto negativo, a humidade sentida no quarto. Aconselhamos sem duvida o serviço Royal. Foi sem duvida uma excelente semana que deixa muita vontade de voltar!
 Pessoal 5 estrelas, muito simpatico, prestável, sempre pronto para nos servir e de sorriso na cara! 
Um grande obrigado ao nosso mordomo Jeury, por toda a organização e cuidado que teve connosco. 
Muito obrigado tambem ao Pedro, Vanda e Albin, que foram os melhores!! Parabens pelo profissionalismo e alegria que nos passaram, foram sem duvida fantasticos! 
Com pessoas assim, vale a pena!

reviews.author: Akram A
reviews.title: Great place to spend vacation
reviews.text:
The place is fantastic. The hotel is aptly named.
The staff is very attentive and we have a special thought for Elena SINE met in the Gabi beach restaurant. She is very kind and every time, we and kids were very happy to see her

reviews.author: Steven W
reviews.title: Loved the Reserve
reviews.text:
This may be the most relaxing holiday you can have. Perfect for parents who need a rest - our kids (8 & 5 years old) played all day every day, sometimes with us and sometimes at the activities. They loved the kids club (special thanks to Carmen). Our favourite restaurant was the Mizu teppanyaki (special thanks to Fidel Rosario) and our concierge took great care of us too (thanks Lugo!).

Would recommend to anyone if you want a resort holiday. The food is great. The staff are all friendly. The weather is perfect. You can do as much or as little as you like. It’s a great place to rest.

reviews.author: zajo10
reviews.title: Perfektna dovolenka
reviews.text: Musim pochvalit vsetko  - od pocasia pocnuc. Ubytovanie - vynikajuce, niet co vytknut. Strava - vyborna, bez chyby, musim pochvalit hlavne mladeho sefkuchara Garyho +1*. Obsluha - v pohode, slusna, ochotna, zvlast Benita. Zaver - nie je co povedat zle. Velka spokojnost!!!!. Dik. Pavel + Dana, Slovakia...

reviews.author: Harry M
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Very fun time, with great weather. Room was excellent. Very friendly staff and good food. Paradisus was one of the best resorts that I have stayed at. Nixon Bao with activities was great!! We can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Roberta H
reviews.title: A little piece of Paradise
reviews.text: For our first time getting away to a tropical place as a couple ...this place was exactly what we needed to rekindle the spark. The service is amazing...entertainment kept us busy and the food was world class. We did the buggy tour with our guide Johnny and it did not disappoint. I loved hearing about the history of the island and learning how they make cigars in the village. Can't wait to come back with the kids for a family vacation. We are checking out the Spa tomorrow and Reef on Monday.

reviews.author: Steph De
reviews.title: More than an all inclusive resort
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning location!  Beautiful white sand with clear turquoise water.  Huge pools! Activities every day and are engaging to guest.  The staff is really what makes this resort exceptional.   Just to name a few - Junior (pool beach), Jendy (pool beach) and Julio (special event and dining). All three went out of their way to provide an exceptional experience and will bring us back!    Thanks to Junior, Jendy and Julio for making our week one of the best ever!!

reviews.author: Jenni L
reviews.title: Great option for families
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent our spring break week the end of March at this resort with our teenage son and 3 other families.  The ocean is spectacular - a little seaweed our first day, but then it cleared up and we really enjoyed the beach,  It has powdery sand and calm turquoise water which is great for swimming.  The beach vendors can get a little obnoxious, but for the most part you get used to waving them away.  

The resort has good options for activities that are included - Kayaks, paddle boards, etc - and the pool is pretty amazing.  Great shade options too, we could always get a palapa - even though we were not staying in either of the concierge levels.  

The only tricky and unpleasant part of this resort was the dining.  The buffet is good - but its nice to eat at their other restaurants for dinner.  Being a group of 11, I had to wait in line for a mad scramble on Sat to book all our dinner reservations for the WEEK - and we were unsuccessful for one evening and had to take a 9:30 reservation for another day.  It worked out fine for us - but was not the best experience - and had we waited until the next day we would have been entirely out of luck.  A few in our party ended up with tummy issues, but again this is not completely unexpected when traveling to the DR.

The service is good, but inconsistent and sometimes slow, and there was quite a language barrier if you do not speak Spanish, although not insurmountable.  Our room was a suite with a pullout out sofa for our son, he didn't complain (teenage boys can sleep anywhere) but it was on an incline and would likely not be comfortable for an adult.  However the room was clean and convenient.  Of course it had the typical musty odor you get in any Caribbean location, and there was an a/c unit fan that sounded horrible when used on anything but the lowest setting.  Overall it was a good trip, we enjoyed the beach and the grounds the most and would consider returning.

reviews.author: mkirzhner
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We spent a week at the reserve as a family of 4.  We had a lovely time.  The resort is beautiful, well groomed and the beach is fantastic.  The rooms were a bit dated and could use screens on the balconies to avoid bugs.  There was lots of space for all the guests to feel relaxed and not crowded.  The food was wonderful, well prepared and fresh.  Especial thank you to Antonio from the entertainment crew for making spin class challenging and fun every day!!!!!

reviews.author: SOC
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Experience...Maybe a 2 or 3 with your own effort...
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that I am only now writing a review after reaching out to different levels of management since the start of our stay on April 1st.  To date, I have received no response, which is indicative of the true disregard for you as a costumer.  

I can confidently say that I have never had such a disappointing vacation, given the stress on myself, my husband, my father, and daughter in managing the variety of issues we encountered during our stay.  First, in calling Meliá to make my reservation, I found a non-working reservation system and was encouraged to book online myself.  I attempted to clarify several times as to how to best identify the beach front family concierge experience I was seeking and was directed to book the Reserve Punta Cana- please don’t do this!  What a mistake!  I spent about 14 emails (48-hr response return) later and phone calls (PS there is no direct number to speak with someone- wrap your head around this). Attempting to make sense of the reviews I read about the different sections of the hotel to discover that I had needed to book the Palm Real reserve...confused yet?  Of course, this is intentional.  When a hotel is only partially renovated, they benefit from this confusion.  Having you pay top rate for a subpar, rundown room.  While I was finally responded to and moved to the Palma Real allegedly, I noted that the online program did not reflect this and was assured via email by Jason Espiritusanto, who suggested this would be corrected upon arrival. Our transportation service dropped us off at the Reserve as I understood that our concierge was here... Upon checking in, we encountered Harol, a very difficult guest service representative.  I attempted to show him my correspondence and asked several times about the correspondence I had had to this end.  He assured me I was in the right place- but we were not!  I even showed him on the Meliá app and said, why is this not reflecting the palma real...he said it would update.  This was duplicitous of course.  The charge for our room was increased to reflect the Palma Real and we proceeded to be guided to our room at the Punta Cana Reserve.  The swim up suite was Run down, broken rooms, swampy pools loaded with bugs and leaves, and room service that makes McDonald’s looks luxurious.  I had spent a considerable amount of time doing this research and was shocked as to how these other reviews did not indicate issues such as these... How could the gross manipulation, deliberate misguidance and overt dismissals not be represented in these reviews... I came to understand how this happens...

While my husband and I have a little facility with the Spanish language, my father who joined us in fluent.  Here’s what I have come to understand, staff are responsible for soliciting their own referrals for their job security and promotions.  We were asked and told several times about the way this works, and pleaded with to do our best to reflect well on them or their jobs could be in jeopardy... yes, rather than formal internal job training and reviews, employees are subjected to public reviews for job security and promotions?  Completely outrageous!  As you spend your vacation attempting to relax, you are met with a hotel that you have spent thousands on whose employees are anxious and working under the threat of TripAdvisor feedback that could directly impact their jobs... I generally choose to spend my money at establishments where I can be sure employees are well treated and respected.  And so, how do your manage this tension, while attempting to salvage your experience of a promised five star experience, you tip constantly.  Some days to the tune of $75-125 USD in order to get the service you would expect at a space like this.  If you do not prepare to have this cash in advance, expect to pay a 20% fee for the exchange at the hotel.  The ATM’s have a $200 USD limit and only hands out equivalent of $20 bills that no one breaks...hmmmm... and so, here’s a quick rundown of expectations and upsets that may help you navigate if you find yourself stuck with a prepaid reservation as we did. 

Rooms: Run Down, room cleaning service does not clean rooms adequately- sheets and bedding with dried blood, hair in drains, broken glass shelf precariously hanging over the tub we bathe our child in, broken lamps with incompatible outlets for the room- cue no lights!   Luckily, I was the only one who ended up stepping on Glass fragments and not my daughter. Fellow patrons may drunkenly throw their trash over their patio, onto yours soiling your jacuzzi and seating area.  This may not ever sufficiently be cleaned, in spite of reporting, and you will not feel comfortable using this area during your stay.  And lastly, During your time here, you will find yourself without sufficient towels and water...be prepared to call regular for these things with tip in hand. 

Spa: skip it!  Not luxurious...masseuses do not seem to have sufficient training, and the spa Does not have A/C!  I also was greeted to my massage with an up-sale and those resort credits don’t exist.  They work nowhere and only allow you the privilege of buying from this place...or offer a faux discount that the spa will tell you, they can beat.  They don’t give you these resort coupons as you need to hand deliver them after searching them out (don’t bother they are useless).  But this runaround is comical.  The spa will up sell you and are unrelenting.  I was escorted out from my massage by a woman who later appeared with a calculator offering me a discounted next massage which is outrageous, and not relaxing.  There is no relaxation room and so I sat adjacent to the landscaping crew with my hot tea served from a dirty dispenser...I left immediately after being disappointed.  

Family Concierge:  I am not sure how folks navigate the resort without these folks. Although let me say, they serve more as counselors and facilitators and have no real power to help You troubleshoot your encounters.  We were initially assigned Jorge Tejada, who was wonderful, and later Willy Wonka, who was also fantastic.  They help you to get dinner reservations that seem in high demand...only the restaurants seem empty usually...and filled with other patrons lamenting the poor quality of the food.

Food:  lower your expectations and bring tums...
Low quality food, over cooked meals that lack fresh ingredients and are over salted.  Fresh fruit and vegetables are scarce... we survived off the breakfast Buffett at the main resort... do not eat breakfast at the Reserve unless you are unworried about warm dairy sitting out, over cooked and aged sides...truly stomach turning.  Omelette station is the thing that allowed us to approximate fresh and recently cooked ingredients... Our collective stomach upset continues to settle a week later.

Pool: reserve pool is usually quiet, minus unannounced foam party during our stay with children in the pool... staffed by wonderful folks including Felipe and Jorge.  They made our experience by helping us poolside, and we needed for nothing as a result. Problem is outside vendors are Constant...selling will preoccupy your stay.

Beach: seaweed collection...beautiful sand and palm trees... constant vendors that are sales pressured and will interrupt you constantly.  Far less relaxing than you would hope.

Customer service: unresponsive and unhelpful.  The worst of these experience was with Harol, guest service representative.  Our fellow patrons who witnessed his behavior and his aggression with us, shared their concerns and outrage about his behavior and the ways in which they too imagined nothing would happen given the poor customer service.

In the end, we will Not be back.  For the record, I have reached out to the following managers via email: Gabriel Bobadilla, Rafael Torres Sanchez, Carlos Silva Junior, and Jose Carlos Sanchez, and have received no response.  We overpaid and we were taken advantage of.  Please do consider traveling elsewhere.  We loved the Ritz Carlton in Aruba and would suggest this as a family-friendly tropical alternative.

reviews.author: Pao V
reviews.title: Best spot
reviews.text:
Lovely hotel, good food, nice and well cared beach, lovely people.
Special mention to our lovely concierge Fernando  who has taken care of us way better than expected. We will definitely come back and look for him.

reviews.author: Geosuzie84
reviews.title: Amazing Views
reviews.text: At first arrival, the vista is amazing! You look down the stairs upon arrival and see clear thru columns, marble staircase, fountains and pools to see the ocean! Breathtaking! You think you’re somewhere between Greece & Italy! But you’re in Paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real, in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic!!! True treasure for the eyes and then the experience continues. And while the Restaurants, amenities and grounds are all done well, they don’t compare with the excellent staff,managers and accommodating people who work there.

reviews.author: jacksontch
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
Resort was beautiful and the staff was wonderful! The beach was clean but a lot of seaweed in the ocean!
Choices of restaurants were good. Some restaurants were really good and a few were just ok! Would go again!

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: Visit to Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip and got the royal service. Bladimir was a fantastic personal Butler and set up a decorated cabana as a surprise for my birthday as well as a bath with rose petals and champagne. Will definitely have to go back!

reviews.author: lovetogo-hh
reviews.title: Fantastic !
reviews.text: We have been to Punta Cana 4 times to different resorts (majestic elegance and mirage & royalton) and the service here by far is the best we have ever received. We got the Royal Service for our daughters 20th birthday & our butler Francis was phenomenal! Sweet, smart, and genuinely took care of everything on this trip! He surprised our daughter with a cake, champagne, and drawn bath one evening, which she loved! He had all our restaurant reservations taken care of on the day we arrived. Enjoyed getting to know him!! A huge shout out to Martin & his kindness as well - always made sure we had seats & drinks on the beach! Beach and resort are beautiful! Loved the Aqua, Palazzo, and Rare restaurants. Enjoyed a nice relaxing vacation at Paradisus! Excellent service with caring people!

reviews.author: Ron.S
reviews.title: An amazing vacation
reviews.text: Went beginning of April.because of overbooking received an upgrade to reserve royal service.at first we were skeptical as it's further from the beach but we couldn't have been more wrong.BEATIFUL section of resort.we had the best concierge Angela who made sure we had anything we wanted anytime of day, from reserving restaurants, booking golf,and Palapas wherever we wanted.showing up wherever we were all through the day.she even arranged a private steak and lobster dinner for the 6 of us by a quiet section of royal reserve pool section!Omar at the royal section of the beach treated us all exceptionally.we would definitely recommend this resort to all

reviews.author: tjw9176
reviews.title: Great hotel. Great food. Great experience
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for a destination wedding and we had a great time. The food was great at the buffet, especially at breakfast (omelettes!) Our room was comfortable and clean with a great shower and a comfortable bed.Wifi in the room was very spotty, but elsewhere at the resort was fine.

reviews.author: Chenai
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: Jose Gonzalez was a great entertainer. He is polite, a great communicator, and takes his job very seriously. Here on a trip with Cox Communications was an amazing experience. Without Jose it would not be the same. Great host friendly entertainer he needs a raise!!! We’ll come back just because of him!!!! Great time

reviews.author: Lashanda
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Awesome experience Jose Gonzalez is amazing great time awesome communicator so glad I. Are with my company cox communications will be back because of him. This was a time I will never forget. He is GREAT ASSETTO your company

reviews.author: laurelaggie
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
Overall, we enjoyed our time at the Paradisus Palma Real.  My husband and I went on an award trip with his company so we had the basic package.

Pros:  The grounds are beautiful and well maintained!  The beach and pool were gorgeous ! Our room was huge and the air conditioner worked great.  (Some nights I was actually cold.) We ate at the Japanese restaurant, Bana, one evening and it was fun and entertaining.  The drinks were good especially at the Avenue Bar.  Get a Dirty Monkey you won’t be disappointed!

Cons:  Aside from Bana, the other food was only OK.  A lot of the food I got at the buffet was cold and did not taste fresh.  The buffet was pretty much the only place to eat breakfast and lunch.  There is another restaurant open for breakfast and lunch (Palazzo) but it’s only for people with the Royal package.  There were quite a few things that were restricted to the upgraded packages and that was disappointing.  There was another restaurant listed on the map and in the brochure/website that was suppose to serve breakfast and lunch (Olio), but it not appear to exist anymore which was confusing.

Overall, it was a relaxing getaway for my husband and I.  We took a snorkeling trip to the Maranarium and it was awesome!  Hopefully, we make it back to the DR some day!

reviews.author: mjf4man
reviews.title: Wonderful stay. Thanks to all of our favorite staff members for making our stay perfect.
reviews.text: Yohelvi was amazing!!! Thank you for the incredible stay.  Wanda, Omar, Douris and Rafael all helped our stay be incredible. The resort was beautiful and we will be back. The restaurant was great and the service was great.

reviews.author: Bridget H
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text:
We recently visited the Paradisus in the DR for a sales incentive trip with my husband’s job.  Our butler was Yohelvi.  He was AMAZING!  He made sure our room was stocked with all our favorite snacks and delivered chocolate covered strawberries to our room.  Because of Yohelvi’s attentiveness and high level of service, we had the best vacation at the Paradisus and will definitely be coming back again soon!

Keith and Bridget

reviews.author: Passport323157
reviews.title: Winner Circle 2019
reviews.text: Our company had the best experience with this hotel. Nixon Boo, Luis, Luis Cordero, and Mr. Jose! was our dancer/DJ and they were the best. They were full of energy and made us feel like family. We appreciate them and their hospitality. Thank you! We can't wait to come back again!

reviews.author: Paradise
reviews.title: Paradise found
reviews.text: We had a great time in Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service during our 9 days stay. The resort is clean and gorgeous. We did not have any issues. Our buttler Alvaro F. made our vacation even more special ( from chocolate covered straberries left in the room to a jacuzzi decorated with fresh flowers). Anything we needed, he would make it happen. Look for Pedro at Sunset bar, he is fun and entertaining. Definitely great vacation

reviews.author: Jamie M
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and service
reviews.text: Fortunate enough to have an opportunity to travel to this beautiful resort.  We had fabulous weather and an overall lovely experience.  A big shoutout to our awesome pool servers Junior and Jendri who took special care to make sure we were always well hydrated and all our needs were met.  #greatservice #poolbar

reviews.author: Antonella
reviews.title: Non vediamo l'ora di tornarci, come ogni anno
reviews.text:
Trascorro le vacanze invernali con mio marito ogni anno in questo hotel da 13 anni, e questo significa che siamo molto soddisfatti sia della struttura, che del paesaggio, che del trattamento.

Viaggiamo sempre per circa un mese e usufruiamo del Servicio Real del Paradisus Palma Real, che garantisce un trattamento piu riservato con servizi dedicati, quali spiaggia, piascina, ristoranti etc, oltre a poter usufruire dei servizi classici dell’hotel, che sono molteplici e tutti di buon livello.

La nostra camera è Ocean Front e si trova sulla ampia e bianchissima spiaggia a circa 40 metri dalla “palapa” riservata che è dotata anche di 2 lettini king size con asciugamani. 
Mr. Pedro, Mr Martin e Mr. Rafael accolgono i clienti in spiaggia con un approccio sempre amichevole e professionale e ti fanno sentire a casa.

I ristoranti sono buoni, anche se con qualche margine di miglioramento.
La predisposizione dello staff in tutte le aree è ottima, sono sempre tutti molto attenti e gentili. E questo grazie anche alla direttrice del Servicio Real, Miss Glenys Martinez, che è veramente speciale.

Una nota di merito per Mr. Juan De Aze, il supervisor del ristorante, che ormai conosciamo da anni e che è sempre gentile e disponibile con noi e con tutti gli ospiti.

Infine un grazie anche a Mr. Kelvin, il nostro gentilissimo “majordomo” degli ultimi due anni.

Normalmente trascorriamo un mese ogni anno in questa struttura e conosciamo bene tutti i ristoranti (molti), le attività e lo staff, e posso dire che anche questa volta, come le altre, non vediamo l’ora di tornarci ancora il prossimo anno.

Consigliatissimo.

reviews.author: Companion58071581031
reviews.title: 2nd visit to Paradise!
reviews.text:
This was our second year in a row staying at Paradisus Palma Real, in the Royal Service. We were able to book our same butler Nicolas M., he did an amazing job. Very attentive to my husband and myself. Any requests we had, he made it happen. We had an issue with the room we had being on the first floor next to the service area. It was very loud at night and early morning. I mentioned it to Nicolas and he got us a new room right away. (I would recommend booking a room on the 2nd or 3rd floor, instead of the 1st, a lesson learned for us.)
We were celebrating our anniversary and he surprised us with decorating our room and door. He set up our jacuzzi beautifully with fresh picked flowers, had champagne chilling and a fruit and chocolate platter waiting for us. He puts his personal touch in everything he does, to make his guests happy. We appreciate the great service we received once again from Nicolas. Also, Pedro and Wanda at the Royal Service sunset bar are awesome! They were super friendly, attentive and very entertaining. Pedro takes pride in making sure his guests are taken of and are enjoying their time in the royal service bar, pool and beach area. Also, he makes awesome drinks! 
Make sure to look for Yanira S. in the buffet, she has a great personality and very attentive. We made sure to sit in her section everytime we had lunch.
We cant wait to book our trip next year!

reviews.author: Andressa V
reviews.title: Serviço deixou muito a desejar
reviews.text:
Os empregados ou não sabiam dar informações ou davam informações erradas de propósito... 

No dia em que chegamos tivemos dificuldade de ligar a hidromassagem da banheira do quarto e a atendente do prédio disse que nossa reserva não dava direito à hidromassagem e por isso não conseguiríamos ligar. Achamos estranho, pois na reserva constava a hidromassagem. No dia seguinte perguntamos a outra atendente como fazia para ligar, ela nos explicou como ligava e funcionou. 

No dia em que chegamos solicitamos um berço para o nosso bebê e disseram que iriam providenciar, mas não providenciaram. Pedimos a vários funcionários e ninguém resolveu. Diziam que era para esperarmos que eles levariam o berço no quarto mas ninguém levou. Nosso bebê não teve berço para dormir na primeira noite.Somente resolveram a situação no dia seguinte. 

Em outra ocasião, perguntei à atendente de drinks do gabi club onde ficava o banheiro e ela disse que só havia na área da piscina (longe), mas depois descobri que no próprio restaurante Gabi Club havia banheiro. 

A limpeza do quarto não foi adequada. A camareira não recolheu o lixo (que estava cheio) em diversos dias e eu tinha que sair procurando local para depositar o lixo. A camareira também não limpava a banheira de hidromassagem e deixava sujeira dentro dela. Nós tínhamos que limpar antes de usar.

Tivemos dificuldade de reservar os restaurantes para o jantar pois a recepcionista dizia que não havia vagas, só consegui as reservas depois de muita insistência e em horários horríveis, com o restaurante quase fechando na maior parte dos dias. Expliquei que tinha bebê pequeno que dormia cedo e que não poderia ir muito tarde, mas não adiantou muito, pois ela dizia que estava tudo muito cheio. Contudo, em diversos dias encontramos os restaurantes com muitas mesas vazias. 

Tenho um bebê e por isso precisei solicitar alimentação para ele, já que ainda não come todos os tipos de alimentos e temperos. Conversei com o empregado Siberian do restaurante Gabi Club, expliquei o tipo de comida que precisava, e era simples (arroz, batata, brócolis, ovo e frango picadinho). Marcamos um horário para que eu fosse ao restaurante buscar a comida do bebê e quando eu chegava lá nunca estava pronto, teve dia em que ele esqueceu de fazer e quando eu cheguei ele mandou dizer que não estava, mas eu o vi na cozinha...

O serviço foi muito aquém do que eu esperava... principalmente considerando o valor pago e o fato de ter adquirido uma estadia no "The Reserve"

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Spring Break with teen boys
reviews.text: I chose this location based on the amenities and the reviews.  Food being of particular importance to me, the reviews on that aspect were appealing also.  Under the all-inclusive packaging, all but two restaurants are available, with most requiring reservations for dinner.  My family had dinner in each of the included restaurants and were very pleased with the quality and presentation of the meals.  Did not feel like we were missing out by not paying extra for the other restaurants, although the steakhouse looked quite nice.

reviews.author: Dream46178591371
reviews.title: Review of our family concierge
reviews.text:
Our family concierge - Sofia Paternina - was the sweetest, most attentive person we've ever encountered at any hotel or resort. She was super responsive to every need and dealt with our ever-changing requests with grace and patience. Sofia was vibrant and engaging and went out of her way to make sure each of us was relaxed, happy, and enjoying our stay (including my two-year old nephew, for whom she planned a bathtub balloon surprise that he loved!). 

We plan to come back to the Reserve every year now and will request Sofia as our concierge each time if she's available!! Thank you, Sofia! 

Separately, the resort was very beautiful and relaxing. This was our first time experiencing an all-inclusive resort and we were pleasantly surprised at the quality of the services, amenities, and restaurants. We loved the trolly service around the resort, going to Gabi Club or Beach for meals, and walking around the stunning resort and encountering the super friendly staff along the way. 

We'd rate our overall experience as a 5/5 and plan on recommending this resort (and Family Concierge and Sofia!) to whoever's planning a trip to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Max B
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: Out 11 year old son had the time of his life, the beach, the pool and all the additional activities were amazing.  Our concierge, Lady Elizabeth was simply put, the best!  Thank you to all the staff for making the vacation memorable (except America Airlines) and we will return in LATAM Airlines.

reviews.author: Maca C
reviews.title: Días de súper descanso y relax !
reviews.text:
Elegimos punta cana como muchas otras veces ! Pero este hotel nos encanto ! La atención de todos es excelente ! Muy bien predispuestos , sobre todo cuando elegis un destino como este en que la playa lo es todo , especialmente destacar la atención de Boni Ramos que nos asistió en la playa y siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros , haciendo nuestros días de playa espectaculares !

reviews.author: Nath3238
reviews.title: un petit paradis au bord de l 'eau.

hotel majestueux avec un personnel au top.
tout est a profusion et a portée de main.
clean et parfaitement adapte aux enfants.

reviews.author: Leka Carvalho
reviews.title: 6 Dias no Paraíso
reviews.text:
Lua de Mel, utilizando o serviço Royal Service. Não poderíamos ter nos sentido melhor, o atendimento fantástico. Destaque para o mordomo Alvaro e ao Elbim C. que cuidava das cadeiras da praia, foram fantástico.

reviews.author: Curiosity05570169806

Ficamos hospedados no Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service
Tudo perfeito !!! Super recomento . Funcionários super atenciosos e solicitos , destaque para o pessoal da praia ( Pedro , Wanda, Erwin, Francisco), No Spa ( Emanuel), as bebidas e comidas são de primeira qualidade , destaque para o restaurante privativo Palazzo ( Exelente). 
Foi uma semana pra ficar na memória !!!

reviews.author: Eblacher
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
Was slightly wary before coming as saw a few negative reviews. However my concerns were completely unfounded- the resort is gorgeous, staff friendly and food good. I am lucky to have been well travelled around the world so feel I have a good bench mark to judge this hotel -No this is not the four seasons in terms of 5 star but nor did I pay four seasons prices. Value for money is excellent - Jhordan our concierge has been great and done everything we have asked. 
The resort is beautifully kept and the grounds are magnificent. Buffet selection is limited (if you are used to Vegas style) however quality is high. 
Always something we can eat at the a la carte restaurants and lots of choice between these to stop boredom of the buffet. We came with our two teenage daughters and parents (party of 7) and the reserve catered for us all. Generally all staff have been friendly and attentive and would definitely return. We noted a reviewer comment about the Reserve not being on the beach- this is true, the Reserve is ‘set back’ from the main hotel (as clearly shown on all the formal hotel literature), but the walk to the beach within the complex is less than 10 mins through stunning grounds, and there are regular golf buggies to and from if you are feeling lazy.

reviews.author: negra30
reviews.title: Sobrevalorado
reviews.text: Vinimos en un viaje de amigas buscando el all inclusive de playas bien cuidadas , tragos y comida. Primeo, hay que contratar el royal service si no el trago es el nacional, el buffete general es promedio, el rest de carnes demasiado lento, muyy muy lento y la carne la mas dura que he comido nunca. Las instalaciones bien, playa de royal service muy bien pero me llama la atencion que algo tan basico como botanas de papas fritas con chili o nachos y guacamole no hayan en este hotel, poca informacion, etc. Por la misma plata he ido a mejores

reviews.author: Molly Nye
reviews.title: Beautiful Punta Cana
reviews.text: The Paradisus was wonderful. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and hope to come back very soon! The hotel was very clean, comfortable and details were paid attention to.  The beaches were gorgeous and an easy walk from the hotel.

reviews.author: marge8700
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: My daughter and I just returned from a visit to this hotel March 30-April 5.  The hotel is absolutely gorgeous.  My daughter loved the pool at the Reserve, where she was able to meet and play with other kids her age (9 yrs old).  The buffet at the Reserve was very good, as were the a la carte restaurants.  We only spent one day at the beach.  We paid for several excursions--swimming with dolphins, feeding monkeys and parasailing.  All were very enjoyable.  The main Paradisus lobby is not to be missed with flamingos and other wildlife in the beautiful pools with lush vegetation surrounding them.  Our suite at the Reserve was luxurious with a living room, jacuzzi, a refrigerator stocked with soda and snacks and many other amenities.  The staff for the most part were friendly and helpful.  I definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: edielloyd
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Fourth Trip to Paradisus Palma Real. Food is Excellent. Highly recommended to dine at Passions. Your Sommalier Domingo will match your wine tastes to a tee. Buffet is wonderful for Everyone. Royal Service worth the extra money. Luis Sanchez our Butler for the fourth year is Wonderful. Also Felix Garcia new Butler is Great. Pool conceriges, Martin, Pedro and Rafael work very hard in the heat to meet your beach needs. Can preorder Room Service the night before. Can enjoy your breakfast on the patio. So Wonderful. Ocean is warm and we enjoyed watching the pelicans dive for fish. The endless acres of gardens, hibiscus hedges, various palm trees etc are really spectacular. Freddie is the coconut slayer with his machete. Franseco is the extrodinary towel collector who works very hard at the end of the day to clean up the mountains of towels and stray cups etc. Jose is our favourite beach vendor. Has various prices on jewelry. Can haggle with the beach cigar vendors as well. Non alcoholic smoothie bar on the beach. More gluten free options on all the menus. Gratius Glynis RS Supervisor and my Amigos at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: A wonderful experience
reviews.text:
We stayed with the royal service during our stay. Our butler, Ariel Benzo was an amazing help throughout our visit. We had no trouble arranging our dinner reservations, spa time, beach and poolside cabanas and every other thing we asked for. We frequently came back to our room to find we have been left wine and cheese, a nice touch we really appreciated. He definitely made the vacation a more pleasurable experience and made all of the logistics much less of a hassle.
Some running comments:
The resort was very clean updated and new. Our room was spectacular with a separate jacuzzi and shower, nespresso machine in the room, and minibar restocked daily. 
The pools were also immaculate, with plenty of seating and cabanas surrounding them. the royal service area was also very nice, including both a private pool and an adults only section of the main pool near the swim up bar. 
The beach was clean, plenty of space between so that you could easily feel it was all to yourself, again the royal service area was adults only. 
The spa is an excellent add-on worth trying, prices was fair and the massage was great. 
The bars, overall pretty good. Wanda ran the royal service bar and was always pleasant and helpful. excellent drink, brand name liquor, great service all around. Wanda certainly took care of us. 
The pool and beach side service was also great, made sure we had a towels and drinks at all times, Pedro and Raphael  really owned that beach. made finding a space in the morning very easy,. 

The food:
Pallazo: probably the best overall for the all inclusive. steak was perfect for dinner, at lunch I really enjoyed the squid ink pasta, breakfast was simple but the space is very convenient and comfortable. 
Vento: Not adults only, the food was not as good as pallazzo, Nothing was bad but it wasnt spectacular
Naos: comprehensive buffet with lots to offer. overall good, fast and convenient. 
Rare: also not our favorite, not adults only, the steaks were cut thin but prepared well, flavor was good, overall worth going to 
The Winery: Wine tasting was more of a lesson in how to taste wine, offered some good spanish wines among others, apparently they have a good food menu, We did not eat there but they do offer cheese plates and it looked like good entrees 
Brisas: exclusive to the reserve and royal service. Tapas style sushi and small fish plates, everything we had here was excellent. At night the bar was fantastic, Miguel took care of us, had a great time. 
Passion: excellent ala cart, consistent with his other menus such as at Tempo in Cancun. tasting menu with wine pairing was over the top amazing. the wine selections were perfect for the plates and each dish was more amazing than the previous. We left fully satisfied. With the royal service there is a significant discount on the price. 

The only negatives I could think of: 
the resort is not entirely adults only and so you will have to make compromises at some restaurants and areas near the pool. 
The house wine included in the all inclusive package is not good at all, basically grape juice. 

Overall it was a fantastic trip. Our severs, staff, Ariel our butler, Pedro and Wanda, made sure we had an excellent vacation. It was really their efforts that made the trip a great one, and I would absolutely consider returning again.

reviews.author: cbattsolutions
reviews.title: Beautiful resort--staff and rooms could be improved though
reviews.text:
Having stayed at the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen La Perla and having a tremendous experience there, I decided to stick with the Paradisus brand and book the Palma Real in Punta Cana. While both resorts were stunning, this resort needs a lot of improvement, and I'm torn between giving it three stars and four. 

Pros:
- The resort itself was beautiful--the aesthetics here are incredible, and everything seemed photo-worthy. 
- One of the largest pools I've ever seen and a beautiful beach with plenty of lounge chairs in the shade under palapas. 
- For the most part, the food at the restaurants was very good.

Cons:
- The resort has several price points, which can be annoying, as all sections are not included in all price points (e.g., the "premium" beach is reserved for higher package guests, as well as premium alcohol [the only beer included at the "base" level was Presidente]). If you are not staying at one of several high price points here, you are made to feel that way, with restricted pools, etc. Also, if you want adults-only here, that is a higher price point.

- It would have been nice if they explained the resort to us when we checked in or made dinner reservations. We discovered on accident our last night here, the "Grand Reserve," which is a newer section of the resort with wonderful restaurants. Similarly, when we made dinner reservations, no one told us the restaurant we booked was at the Grand Reserve and we would need to take a golf cart to get there.

- The resort staff was not as hospitable as in other resorts I've stayed. They were slow to approach for drinks, and many acted annoyed when you asked a simple question of how to find a place on the resort. The girl making dinner reservations looked like she couldn't be bothered, and gave us one word answers to questions we had such as, "what do you recommend?" "what type of food is this restaurant?" Similarly, another experience we had was when it was raining, we saw many people carrying umbrellas around. We asked the front desk if they had an umbrella we could borrow and they responded, "no." So we said, "we see people with them, where can we get them?" And their response was "I don't know." This is not 4 or 5 star service.

- They also had many people trying to upsell you on excursions and activities roaming the resort, which got quite bothersome. While the caribbean is notorious for having people approach you on the beach, at this resort, they had people all over when you were at the pool or walking around that tried to get you to book things, and when you would say "no thank you," they would come back in a few hours and say "how about now?" It was really annoying. 

- We stayed in a junior suite, which was definitely not the highlight of the trip. The room was musty, and had chips and cracks all over the bathroom, wires hanging out from the TV, and a semi-broken patio door. When we arrived, there were dirty cleaning towels in the shower, and we had to call for a maid to remove. 

While this review may seem negative, overall, the resort is truly beautiful and it was a nice getaway. However, the rooms need to be updated (I have heard they are spending all the money in the new sections of the hotel) and the staff could be more accommodating. This is definitely not the four-diamond hotel it once was--unless, of course, you upgrade to the Grand Reserve, which is very far from the beach.

reviews.author: Charles W
reviews.title: Great time in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
The Paradisius Palma Real Royal Service is the Way to go.  

Our butler, Ariel Benzo, made our vacation even better. He was thoughtful and attentive in booking our reservations for dinner, travel, and golf. No request was to small or unfulfilled. 

The wait and bar staff are super fun and friendly, especially Wanda and Rudy.

We will definitely go there again.

reviews.author: Coco211
reviews.title: A Great Resort and Beautiful People
reviews.text: Writing another review as I am not sure if my previous review has gone through. We went to the resort to rest and restore and the resort presents many opportunities to relax - the facilities are efficiently laid out within a short walking distance from one another; nice to explore the entire resort without a golf cart! We stayed in the Royal Service section very close to the beach and the pool.It was extremely convenient to enjoy both and also to be able to change attire before going to restaurants without too much time required to walk back and forth to our room.Our stay was greatly enhanced by a cordial, personable and professional help of the Resorts staff; we want to offer special thanks to our butler Richard Orlitz who was very prompt and efficient in answering all of our questions and requests. In addition to being well prepared and organized, he is also very polite, friendly, charming and very likeable. Richard has a rare gift of knowing when we might need help - as he happened to contact us just after we thought of something we needed help with! There were many details he was looking after -reservations of restaurants, bali beds ,tv programming , plumbing repairs, entertainment schedules, weather reports, replacing our umbrella and treating us with a beautiful fruit and cheese platters in the afternoon! We appreciated Richard's efforts and highly recommend paying a little extra for the Royal Service.  "Thank You" to Raphael and Pedro as well as Joachina and Melisa !

reviews.author: Jim Chambers
reviews.title: Week’s rest
reviews.text: The resort accomplished our goals to take a meaningful break from work and the winter.  Our objective to relax was helped along greatly by our Butler, Richard Orlitz, who took the worry out of all arrangements, scheduling etc.  Richard had the ability to make us feel « at home » with a manner of trust, and friendship.  Clearly the highlight of our visit.

reviews.author: Pray4rfc
reviews.title: Great friendly staff especially Zumba!!!
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and the staff was very friendly and helpful. Jose capuchino was  The resort was beautiful and the staff was very friendly and helpful. Jose capuchino was very vibrant and engaging. His Zumba class was fun and his personality made it an amazing experience. Jose was lively at the bar by the pool at night by the beach he Makes every one have a great time. The restaurant food wasn’t the best for all the trouble it took to get a reservation. We went to Bana and the chef didn’t speak English and left food on the grill instead of dividing it up and serving it ... that was weird ... The steakhouse The Grill The cuts of the meat wasn’t good at all I had the Rib Eye that was more like a chuck steak. The food was more presentation than flavor and quality however the atmosphere and the staff were always amazing. The buffet is the best bet for meals but the options are few and the meat isn’t that great there either. I had the lamb chops and they were tough as leather I would think they would marinade the cheap cuts at least so they’d cook better on the grill top. Overall I enjoyed by stay and loved the room and I want to thank Jose capuchino for a great time! vibrant and engaging. His Zumba class was fun and his personality made it an amazing experience. Jose was lively at  the pool in the day and at night by the beach he Makes sure  every one has a great time. I enjoyed the avena at breakfast buffet the most... Overall I enjoyed my stay it was relaxing and fun. I loved the room and I want to thank Jose capuchino for a great time! I will definitely recommend this resort and return with my family again. This resort is beautiful and very well kept.

reviews.author: Jamie K
reviews.title: Spring break 2019
reviews.text:
We loved our experience at the Reserve Paradisus. This resort is truly paradise ☀️🏝🌊but more importantly the staff made our experience the most memorable. I have to thank a few personally for going above and beyond our expectations. First I want to thank Sandra Villanueva our concierge for everything she did to make our experience perfect and special. She made our cabana and dinner reservations every day, coordinated pickups for excursions and so many more things and always with a smile and “ of course” I must also mention Christoffer Walters who befriended us and entertained our daughter - teaching her how to dance and always checking on us. A very genuine person who we call our friend now just as we do Sandra. Ramon’ at the beach  bar H2O was also extremely helpful and always smiling and accommodating. Always stopping by asking if we needed a “ drinky”. Betanya at the spa was a sweetheart and helped me one day when I got lost. She actually walked with me and also gave me a personal tour of the spa. 
Our favorite restaurants were Vento and the breakfast and lunch buffet. The drinks were great . Also I should mention Ramon’ at the pool was helpful also and Samuel when we arrived. We felt that Paradisus was our second home the week we were there and hope to go back next year

reviews.author: md0ttawa
reviews.title: An excellent Winter Paradise is what to expect at Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text:
Hola from the Dominican.

My wife and I just returned from our 3rd winter get away to Punta Cana and we had an amazing time.  We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service which we found to be a tremendous Caribbean vacation.

Jeuri our butler as well as the many amazing employees at the Palma Real Royal Service made our stay wonderful and we will be sure to return.  Notable mention and tremendous thanks to Jose Rivera , Michael, Julio Cesar at the Royal Service Palazzo Restaurant.  Their attention to detail and your preferences make you feel at home and as a result leaving will be very difficult when the time does arrive.  At the Royal Service beach bar Wanda will also be there with the same level of service and how she remembers every guest's favourites is remarkable.

As for accommodations you can expect luxury and the housekeeping services are impeccable.  It's all down to the staff who provide a level of excellence you won't find everywhere.  

After a day of enjoying the sun and water you will be able to relax with amazing meals at the many restaurants on the property followed by nightly entertainment.

Finally, Bavaro beach is absolutely breathtaking. So many activities available but just walking the beach and swimming will bring you back to the Palma Real very soon.

Don't hesitate to visit this wonderful Caribbean Gem.

Enjoy!

reviews.author: Julie V
reviews.title: Truly Paradise!
reviews.text: The resort was more than we could have hoped for on this 8 day vacation.  There are many pools for families, children and adults only.  Due to the many options the resort felt exclusive and never busy.  There are over ten restaurants and we visited 8 of them and we were satisfied with the food, service and amazing atmosphere.  Make sure to make dinner reservations when you arrive.  The staff goes out of their way to engage you, show you a fabulous time and create a positive environment.

reviews.title: Vacation

reviews.author: Emmie W
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana never ceases to excel
reviews.text:
This is our third time here in a year with our 2 kids (ages 6 and 3 1/2). The staff is a huge reason we keep coming back. Extremely friendly, personal, loads of fun and genuine. It feels like a second home. 

The food is excellent (our favs are the nuggets, Fuego and Passion is an extraordinary culinary experience). The services offered are excepcional- from the Yhi Spa (great massages from Mercedes and Trudys), to the unique exercise activities (a cycling class taught in the water, poolside Zumba.....).

My kids ran to kids’ camp every day- excited to do yoga, hunt for animals, work on the garden, dance the bachata, learn new songs and much more. 

A big shout out to the kids’ camp staff- Kati, Jack, Joanna, Baker, Benya, Kiamyi, etc. My kids were really sad to say goodbye to them today. 

A big thanks to Sandra- our concierge who made everything smooth for us and the special touches for our kids.

Thanks to Emília and her special balloons for my kids and a sweet smile and hug every day. 
Raul on the bungee jump, Cristoffer of the activity hut and so many more. 

Mil gracias a todos. Los echamos de menos ya!

reviews.author: Blake Seven
reviews.title: Proceed with caution
reviews.text:
All in all we had an ok time but read all reviews carefully. If you think you are coming to 5 star luxury and like good food be very careful. Your not getting luxury and the food is average at best and shocking at worst. 

Without family concierge everything is difficult. We managed to get restaurant reservations but we had to be flexible on days and times. If you are in a group with  children and want to be specific. Forget it without family concierge. 

Pros. 

- Amazing kids club, the staff are brilliant and facilities great. 
- great beach, shame about the constant sellers. 
- Grounds are stunning. 
- Evening shows are quite good and the kids liked them. 
- Generally a good buzz around the place in the evening. 

Cons. 

- Rooms are tired, dated and literally falling to bits. Frayed mats, lampshades torn and a broken fridge but to name a few. 
- Food, the buffets are just ok at best and sometimes VERY poor. Cheap cuts of meat (knuckle, thigh etc) plus limited options and a lot of repetition. 
- The other restaurants are ok, but service very up and down and the food tries hard but is mostly all show and no taste with very small portions. 
 - Watch your drinks. They served our KIDS ALCOHOLIC punch in Mole restaurant. 
- Wine markups can be VAST. Sometimes 500%. We know that as we paid an checked. 
- ADVICE - if you are going to buy wine then look at the menu and use a wine app. You see the rating and also check the value. Many wines were 500+% mark up but some wines were less so and well rated. 

Passion restaurant - was a good evening, food was great but note that when we took the 80 US wine pairing that all bottles used were 6 - 12 USD per bottle. After the buffet food you’ll feel like your in heaven. Worth the investment, not perfect for a chef with 10 stars to his name. We sent back one Hake fish dish where the ‘fish was from spain’ it was so tough (and I mean tough) I can only assume it swam it’s self to DR. 

We won’t return to this resort as it’s just not what we hoped for. We’re pretty relaxed as a family but i can see how a lot about this resort could really irritate people. Especially if you booked the holiday after looking at the official website. 
That place on the website existed 10 years ago. It doesn’t now! 

If you get a cheap deal on this place and like your food quantity over quality then you’ll be fine.

reviews.author: LSullivan
reviews.title: Family Concierge is worth it
reviews.text:
We arrived at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana March 30.  

We had a few disappointments during our trip. Check in was a long process and we were not thrilled with the food. It wasn’t that the food quality was poor just that the selection was so limited. The ground level room we originally checked into was very musty to the point we could hardly breathe in the room. There was black mould in the shower. However our concierge, Yarol was phenomenal. He managed to switch our room to the third floor for us and walking up and down a couple flights of stairs with the baby was well worth it. He also planned a special surprise cake for my daughter’s birthday. He was very thoughtful and helped us work out every issue. We may have cut our trip short without him. In my opinion the family concierge is worth every penny and Yarol made the trip for us. If we return we will definitely request him. 

We found the staff, in general, to be very helpful and friendly, as well as hard working. We were travelling with small children and spent most of our time around the pools and never had to wait for service. Ery at the pool grill was very accommodating with our children's orders and always fast and efficient. We genuinely felt like staff went out of their way to make sure guests were enjoying themselves which was very nice to see.

reviews.author: AFoodieAndTraveler
reviews.title: Great staff.  Lovely Property.  Royal service.
reviews.text:
Just returned from a great week at Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service and would like to share some highlights.

Staff – I was amazed that almost every single employee was pleasant, smiling, happy to do what they can to make our vacation pleasant.  Special kudos to awesome Yonathan at the Royal Service bar for experimenting with custom scotch for hubbie and coffee drinks and margaritas for me; to Miguel at the Royal Restaurant for his wonderful smile and welcoming personality as he welcomed us to the bar and restaurant each day even while running 100mph to service all the other guests.  

Activities – I was thrilled to have a large selection of class options every hour from 8am through noon, and a few more in the afternoon.  My week included ‘Master Class’ instructor Linda who gave a great variety of yoga/pilates/barre/etc.  Paradisus management: I do however, strongly suggest that you post the activities.  I appreciate your effort to eliminate unneeded paper printed each day, AND I realize it should not take a rocket scientist to figure out that the schedule is a basically the same every day – 8 Reserve Spin, 9 Beach yoga, 10 Reserve Yoga, 11 Poolside pilates, 12 water aerobics, 3:30 craft, etc.  That said, we are paying for activities so it would be nice to know for sure.  I suggest that each evening you post the activities for the following day at a half dozen spots around the resort – Buffet restaurant, Lobby Bar, Restaurant courtyard, Royal Bar, Reserve lobby, etc.  It would be so easy to place a standing plastic frame with a copy of the schedule at these spots each evening.  Simple.  Inexpensive. Problem solved.  

Rooms – I was a bit worried reading reviews that rooms were old and run down.  Pleasantly, ours was newly appointed and very clean. And, from reviews, I was also prepared for a deck view that would feel like I was in the middle of a rain forest (‘garden view’), and was pleased to find that my deck, which faced into the pool area, did look at mostly the gardens, but it also had a glimpse of the pool, a decent view of the ocean, and was not chlostrophobic or shaded as I feared.

Food – better than other Punta Cana resorts (this is our 4th).  Passion was expensive, but spectacular.  We wish we had gone early in the week so we could go again!  Other than Passion, I’d have to say the buffet had the best food, but the Steakhouse and Japanese were also very good and enjoyable.  Other restaurants were ok, although most were so noisy we could not really enjoy. Maybe it was just a bad week of noisy groups.
 
Pools – Very well maintained.  Tons of chairs, even at the main pool throughout the day.  Very large, giving lots of room for the water activities while with plenty of room for others to play.  Also has many stairs for entry and exit.
  
Beach – Awesome.  Very wide.  Great soft sand.  Walk about a half mile in either direction and still feel safe.  Plenty of beach chairs and umbrellas available in both the Royal and the regular side.  Kudos to the very young gentleman who catered to the Royal Guests at the beach.  

Property and Grounds – Lovely.  Period.  Many say it is too big, too far to walk.  Not so.  We were as far away from lobby bar as (a non-Reserve) room can be yet we have 10 minutes to get to dinner with plenty of time to spare.  And, I want to give a special shout out to the older gentleman who maintained the grounds who worked diligently to keep the property lovely while also extending the loveliest smile and greeting in Spanish to make guests feel welcome.  Each day he’d offer a lovely smile and greeting in Spanish and I’d (thinking I knew what he said!) reply with hopefully a cryptic but hopefully appropriate response!  I hope a special acknowledgement can be extended to him.

All in all a relaxing week with a lovely property; lovely staff.
