reviews.author: Kik54
reviews.title: Tracasseries administratives grotesques
reviews.text:
C’est la sixième année consécutive que nous réservons à cet endroit, c’est dire s’il nous plait ! Par contre cette année le début du séjour a commencé de façon plus que décevante, grotesque même !
En effet nous sommes arrivés en début d’après-midi à l’hôtel, et nous pensions pouvoir déjà profiter de notre première 1/2 journée sur place, c’était sans compter les tracasseries administratives qui nous attendaient : je dois vous préciser que depuis le temps, nous sommes pour Meliá des clients « Gold » , j’effectue mon check-in en ligne depuis chez moi avant d’arriver, et j’effectue ma réservation plusieurs mois à l’avance en appelant la centrale téléphonique Meliá située en Espagne après avoir consulté le site Internet Melià, et comme à la fin de la conversation téléphonique je dois faire une réservation ferme et définitive en réglant l’intégralité du séjour de suite, j’utilise, pour des raisons de sécurité bancaire, une payweb card.
Je vais ici préciser ce qu’est une payweb card puisque c’est ce qui m’a valu toutes les difficultés qui ont suivies et que je pensais que ce système était connu dans le monde entier, je m’excuse donc auprès de ceux qui connaissent le principe, car mes explications vont leur paraître superflues.
Pour effectuer un paiement sécurisé sur Internet ou, comme dans mon cas, par téléphone, je fais une demande auprès de ma banque qui me donne un numéro virtuel unique à 16 chiffres attaché à ma carte bancaire, lequel numéro ne peut être utilisé qu’une seule fois et pour un montant bien précis.
Notre séjour en All Inclusive était donc réservé et intégralement payé au mois de novembre 2018 alors que notre séjour commençait en mars 2019.
À notre arrivée à la réception de l’hôtel, on nous a demandé de produire la carte bleue avec le numéro qui m’avait servi au règlement, ce qui forcément était impossible pour nous puisque ce numéro n’était que virtuel et que je ne pouvais produire que ma véritable carte bleue, celle à laquelle avait été attaché le numéro virtuel.
Nous leur avons expliqué en long, en large et en travers et finalement en vain, la procédure utilisée et proposé de prendre l’empreinte de la carte que j’avais en ma possession pour le cas où on ferait des extras pendant notre séjour : rien n’y faisait, ils s’obstinaient à vouloir qu’on leur produise une carte bleue qui n’existait pas et ne voulaient absolument pas nous donner nos clés de chambre, ce qui pour nous était une aberration car nous avions réglé d’avance notre séjour en All Inclusive, et nous avions droit à nos clés de chambre, car à ce moment-là c’était plutôt l’hôtel qui était redevable envers nous d’une prestation réglée d’avance que nous envers lui d’une somme d’argent !
Nous avons eu plusieurs interlocuteurs face à nous car toutes ces palabres ont duré plus de 3 heures ! Finalement nous nous sommes engagés à entrer en contact avec notre banque, pour que celle-ci fasse un mail à l’hôtel assurant que la carte bleue en notre possession n’était pas volée et était bien provisionnée. Avec le décalage horaire, ce n’est que le lendemain dans le courant de l’après-midi que notre banque a pu faire l’envoi du fameux mail, qui finalement a dû satisfaire la direction de mélia, car nous n’avons plus eu de nouvelles pendant tout le séjour ! Finalement pour nous les vacances n’ont commencé qu’au bout d’une journée et demie, ce qui est relativement dommage, qui plus est que l’on ne nous a rien proposé,à titre de geste purement commercial, pour nous faire oublier toutes ces tracasseries inutiles !!!
J'ai voulu partager cette expérience car je pense qu'elle pourrait arriver à d'autres. A noter que si ça ne change pas, même les personnes qui auraient réservé avec une carte bleue arrivée à échéance entre le moment de la réservation et du séjour connaîtrait les mêmes déboires que nous !

reviews.author: Journey60814927962
reviews.title: When You've Had Enough of Winter
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is a wonderful, care-free place to escape the surly bonds of winter.  It was our family's second visit and, both times, this resort has provided relaxing and memorable holidays.  Our first visit three years ago, our kids were quite young and the Family Concierge service arranged everything for us daily -- restaurant reservations, cabana placement, tennis lessons, off-resort activities, etc.  This year, the kids were both familiar with the resort and more independent, so they took much more initiative in their daily planning. As parents, it's very comfortable because, while discrete, the Paradisus is clearly very secure and you always feel the kids are safe, even when out of sight.

If you choose the Family Concierge, be sure to check in regularly with her and ask for what you want. These people aren't mind readers, but they are very powerful within the hotel and they will bend over backwards to make you happy.  They seem to like using WhatsApp for quick communications every day. Our concierge both times, Sofia, was a joy and made our holiday so easy. 

The hotel is all-inclusive and you don't NEED to tip, but a little goes a long way, especially with the waiters and bar runners around the pool.  I would suggest you bring a small roll of $1s and $5s with you as getting change at the reception is always a hit-and-miss proposition.  Keep it in the safe and have about $10 in walk-around money. Again, tipping is not expected, but a little gets you a lot of attention and it's obvious that the hard-working staff really appreciate it.

We have been to many resorts in the Caribbean. For families, it is hard to imagine a more restful and enjoyable place.

Es waren sehr schöööne erholsame Tage in einer schönen gepflegten Anlage. Der Strand ist wunderschön. Wir waren bereits mehrmals in der Dominikanischen Republik ( 22x ) und können daher beurteilen, dass wir sehr gut rundum versorgt worden sind. Besonderen Dank unseren Betreuer dem Faustino und am Strand der Petro. Beide haben uns jeden Wunsch erfüllen können.
Nicht vergessen möchten wir auch die Netten Damen vom Housekieping.
Wir können mit Sicherheit den Royalservice und Mitarbeiter weiterempfehlen. 
Schon beim Check in war es eine sehr freundliche Begrüßung und unser Zimmerwunsch wurde zu 100% erfüllt. 
Vielen Dank für all eure Hilfe und wir empfehlen euch im Freundeskreis weiter. 
Bis bald 🙋‍♀️🙋‍♂️

reviews.author: pepperminty00
reviews.title: Full Details of our stay
reviews.text:
So this was our 3rd trip to DR and 2nd with a Paradisus brand, the first being in Playa del Carmen Mexico. We chose the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana because our experience in Mexico was amazing. We are a couple in our late 30’s who chose a last minute 4 night getaway without the kids. So we were also scoping this out as a place for the next time we come with kids. 
Upon check in- this was a pleasant process. Room was ready. We had requested a king bed and walked into a room with double beds. We actually were fine with our own beds…(married 15 years- I like my own blanket). Next morning they pushed the beds together and I asked them to return it and they laughed at my reason why haha. 
First night we ate at the buffet. Reservations for the restaurants can only be made at the desk from 9-4pm. Buffet was typical…variety of different foods. We were hungry and tired so it didn’t matter. 
Next day we made reservations for Rare (steakhouse), Vento and Aqua (at reserve). Our favorite was Rare. Vento had a pasta dish with mushrooms which sounded delicious on the menu but it was a bowl of pasta with finely chopped mushrooms and a ladle of butter….JUST BUTTER. 
Each morning and lunch we only ate at the buffet because that is the only option. Though we didn’t have the kids with us, I always kept an eye on things like what would they eat? There was fresh grilled steaks and chicken as well as kid friendlier items such as pizza, pasta and fries. BUT- they never had plain pizza? Not sure how many American children will eat pizza with corn or green olives. (But I loved the green olive). There wasn’t a grill section near pool like Mexico where you can grab a burger. Just buffet. Also Mexico changed it up with themed food too. 

This resort was great because the pool overlooked the ocean. The Paradisus in Mexico was secluded from beach due to the mangroves and we didn’t get to enjoy that as much. There is a more family oriented section on the reserve but I would find it annoying to go back and forth. 

Entertainment- wow did this resort lack on all aspects. For Pool- every once in a while they did aerobics or yoga. Pool didn’t have music and guests had their own portable speakers both around pool and beach which didn’t give it a resort vibe. Felt like I was on a public beach. No inflatable pool slides or obstacle courses in water for kids. (Mexico had this). For night- amphitheater was empty most nights. One night there was a woman dressed up on what seemed like 15 ft stilts with creepy music. So thinking if we had kids, after dinner there wasn’t anything to do with them. 

Rooms- were clean. Toilet and shower area were a little tight. but overall the room was great. Cleaning service came 2x once for cleaning in am and turn down in pm. 

I would expect that as a brand- some things would remain consistent. I would probably come back but on the fence.

reviews.author: Nomad27314945030
reviews.title: An enjoyable time!
reviews.text: Royal service was exceptional. Jueri, our Butler was friendly, professional and very attentive. Other than Rare, food was very good. Martin did a good job setting up beds on the beach. Raphael was very attentive as out waiter. Wanda was amazing at beach bar and Franily made wonderful smoothies everyday. They need to be clear on the $1000 resort credit (coupons) as it is misleading. We were only able to use about $100 of the coupons. I and my party had a great time and highly recommend the Royal Service and the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Katiuska2013
reviews.title: What a shame!
reviews.text:
I visited this resort a few years ago and I had such a good time that I decided to return. It has completely changed and I don't mean when it comes to the additional buildings like the Reserve or the level but as far as the service and entertainment is concerned.

Pros: Building and rooms are beautiful and clean. Employees at the Bar Gabi Beach and Avenue are great when it comes to preparing drinks.

Cons: The buffet is terrible. Food is either cold like it has been sitting there for a long time or warmed up from the day before. It's pretty much the same thing every day but arranged differently! The only thing that seems fresh is the eggs that are made to order in the morning or the chicken or steak from the grilling station.  Staff does not help you find a table. Depending on how busy they are, they don't bring you water or drinks to your table unless you call them. No mimosas offered when you check in or at breakfast which was something they used to do the first time I came. The music that is played either at the bar or the restaurant is to put you to sleep. There is no back up plan for entertainment on rainy days. There is only one bar that plays Salsa, Merengue, Bachata (Avenue Bar) and the music is lowered or in some cases stops after 11:00pm. The shows offered at night are boring or there isn't any offered at all. The disco closes at 1:00am. The girls at the reception desk are rude, the people at the guest service practically ignore you even after standing there for at least 10 minutes. The app they tell you to use to find out the activities for the day or make restaurant reservations doesn't work and I went to the reception desk to let them know and instead they just said here is a printout of the week activities which led me to believe they already knew it wasn't working then why didn't they give me the list at check in?
In summary, if you want to go to sleep early or just sit, eat and drink all day this is your place to be. If not, stay away. I know for sure I won't be coming back.

reviews.author: Stay35329274233
reviews.title: Punta Cana March 2019
reviews.text: Great resort. Food was above average but not amazing. Overall a wonderful time and a great value.  I would recommend to family and friends and would return. Cocktails were consistent and servers went out of their way to make the stay enjoyable. Family conciegere was a must for us.

reviews.author: Nadia N
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We selected Palma Real for an all inclusive 7 day vacation with kids (6 and 7 years old) and grand parents. We are really pleased with our week here and will definitely return. Our experience was enhanced by the great staff and the hands-on approach to all requests. Domingo the manager was essential in this experience and the support staff such as Carlos and the kids club staff were just beyond excellent. We as a family had an amazing time and would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Brendan W
reviews.title: Party
reviews.text: I like the people that here everyone it’s very fun especially jose gonzalez the weather it’s perfect the food it’s great I love the beach and sand good drinks I have no words because its amazing thanks

reviews.author: Santi0924
reviews.title: Spring Break 19
reviews.text:
This was our first time to Punta Cana and our second time staying at a Paradisus property. I got married at the Playa Del Carmen resort so I was excited to stay at this one. We chose the family concierge and our concierge was Yarol...he was EXCELLENT! Yarol always greeted us with a smile, made our reservations for the cabanas and dinner for us, and even changed reservation locations and times when asked. Yarol also did kid surprises for my daughter that were really nice. If you stay at this property and do the family concierge, I hope you get Yarol!

There are a few things that I think need to be improved... First, they need to upgrade the linens and towels. The towels were dingy and the sheets didn't have that crisp feel to them like at other hotels. They also need to upgrade the rooms. We stayed in 3413 and it needs to be revamped. The doors were dirty, the shower had cracks in it, the tub was stained, the faucet on the left would get you soaked when you turned it on (I do have to say, we did tell Yarol this and maintenance came right away to fix it).

The pool and beach area are great! My top picks for restaurants are Mole and Bana. The Gabi Beach bar made great drinks and Jhonny, was great. Overall, we had a great trip!

reviews.author: Alan S
reviews.title: Hospedagem

reviews.author: patricia foschi... r
reviews.title: Hospedagem
reviews.text: O hotel é perfeito, comida boa, atendimento ótimo nada a reclamar. Adoramos o atendimento da equipe em especial dos meninos da praia e o Nixon que fez jogos com nós. Foi um sossego e um lugar maravilhoso.

reviews.author: Brad G
reviews.title: Paradises Punta Cana
reviews.text: My wife and I just stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana, using the Royal Service, and had an amazing week!  We travelled with two other fun loving couples!  The romantic dinner on the beach, served by Eduardo, was perfect for our 30th Anniversary dinner!! Matiel, our butler, became our friend and provided awesome service, answering all our requests with a smile and a nod!  The beach service, with Maximo, was also great, and the cabanas were very well maintained and the towels and drinks were always on hand!  This is a great resort!!

reviews.author: Mauricio G
reviews.title: Cumpleaños
reviews.text:
Esta vez nos vamos en deuda el hotel cambio se nota en su gente ,agradecidos por la atención de Abraham camarero luchito en el bar Sandy como conserge pero ya no es lo mismo , algo pasa una buena atención y estadía lo hace un equipo de personas ese equipo ya  no esta en Palma Real ,deseo de todo corazon vuelva a ser el hotel que visite en viajes anteriores .

Señores Garcia.

reviews.author: serena n
reviews.title: Reserve Pool Staff
reviews.text: The whole resort was amazing and the staff is so friendly but what really made the trip was the Reserve pool. The chairs are great for lounging by the pool for hours and the the pool is big enough that it never feels overcrowded. But by far the best part of the experience was the staff-- they are so incredibly friendly and accommodating! On my first day at the resort I met Wander Rao and he remembered name through the last day. He always asked how I was doing and made sure I always had a drink in my hand. On my second day there I lost my favorite ring. I didn't realize until hours later and by then I was so sure it was gone. When I went back to find it I met Jonathan, who had already found it and placed it in a safe place. Every time he saw me he would make sure I had everything I needed, including my rings. These men were always on their feet getting drinks and still always found a couple of seconds to personally come over and check in on me and my family. It's the little things like this that will keep us coming back.

reviews.author: Ramon R
reviews.title: Service beyond expectations!!
reviews.text: It started with a lot of turbulence, people trying to sell you a vacation membership and wouldn’t take no for an answer. But Edwin Padilla, Maria Ortiz and Gregorin Ortiz were just amazing. Because of you we will make this our home in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: JTO_10
reviews.title: Beautiful spot and great pools
reviews.text:
We stayed as a family of 8 in 3 rooms: (two parents + 2 kids, one set of grandparents, and one other adult couple,) during March break.  It was easy and quiet despite the popular period.  We stayed in buildings 35 and 36 as part of our club melia membership.  We received a nice welcome and attentive service. We were pleasantly surprised to find that all our dinner reservations were made for us in advance, and we were able to modify them when we needed to.  The ground were well maintained although the rooms themselves were dated and not consistently in good repair and numerous small problems could not be fixed.  One room did not have air conditioning, and while we were offered to move to the Reserve, it would have been too much for 8 of us to move.  Some furniture had minor problems such as drawers that were were broken, missing handles ... things that should have been easily fixed.  It looked as if the problems were just ignored or overlooked.  None of the washers worked until we asked to have them hooked up, and even then, they only had hot water connected to them.  
While the restaurants were good, the buffet was just mediocre.  Service was, however, very attentive.
The pools were perfect for us and the beach was very nice.  The kids zone at the Reserve was also very welcoming and easy to use.
The tennis courts were generally free and available all day long and the gym/fitness rooms were very well equipped and maintained.
The staff was consistently friendly.
Overall, I would still say it was very good, but the food was not as good as the two Paradisus resorts in Mexico.  
With a little attention paid to the rooms (such as updating or simply taking better care of the furniture), and fresher food, the resort could be Excellent.
The buildings at the Reserve looked to be better maintained and were better appointed.

reviews.author: jsan023
reviews.title: She Said Yes !
reviews.text:
Well consider this a Dominican timed review…… Our stay was absolutely fantastic and we wanted to share our experience with everyone. My now fiancé and I stayed through the dates of February 12- 19th. What a great experience. 

We have dated for 8 years and I decided to propose at Paradisus Palma Real. Prior to our stay I coordinated with Mariangel Sanchez from the romance department to ensure everything was perfect and she delivered. Mariangel was easily accessible prior to visiting the DR and once we were at the resort. 

The romance department offers different proposal packages, which included an amazing dinner on the beach, couple massages, breakfast in bed and a romantic décor of you room with roses champagne and chocolate truffles. 

I proposed on Feb.14th Valentines day. We had a scheduled dinner on the beach. Prior to our dinner the weather forecast called for wind and possible rain. As you can imagine after flying to the DR with an expensive piece of jewelry and hiding the ring for 2 days there was no possible way I can wait any longer to pop the question. While my finance was getting ready I met with Mariangel in the lobby of the hotel. She explained that they did not recommend dinner on the beach due to the weather and proceeded to show me alterative location for dinner. I was unhappy with the locations and to accommodate Mariangel and her staff set up dinner in a private cabana at the reserve section of the hotel. She made it happen and made our night and vacation extra special. I cannot thank Mariangel and the romance staff enough for making this vacation extra special. 

Additionally I hired the grounds photographer to capture this special moment and he was fantastic. I believe his name was Pepe and he took some candid moments. 

Now for the review of the hotel….

From the moment you enter the resort grounds everything is kept beautiful. They are in the process of building the new circle hotel so there is some construction going on in the front of the hotel.  When we were checking in our concierge Johan greeted us. We were his first clients ever and he did a great job. He was able to make reservations for each restaurants which was a relief given we read how hard reservation may be. Johan was also very accessible throughout our trip consistently checking in with us to make sure we didn’t need anything. 

Our room was perfect for our stay, as we didn’t spend too much time there however our room was cleaned evry day/night. Our day typically started with breakfast followed by a trip to the pool/beach. The service by the pool was also fantastic. My Fiancé and I did not have to worry about making trips to the bar as our waiters constantly brought us cocktails and water!  
Big shout out to my man Ravel at the pool. Ravel was one of our waiters from day one. From the remainder of the vacation no matter where he was working he came up to us everyday to chat and make sure we were good. We actually still keep in touch with Ravel. 

Also Pam at the pool that was in charge of the towels, she was great. She was always friendly and made some great recommendation about the resort.

The food was better then most all-inclusive we have stayed at. Our personal favorite restaurants were Fuego Hibachi and Greek. The buffet food was also great and a lot better then other resorts we stayed in the past. We also had a few late nights with room service which was great after a night out!

Our nights we ended up at Gaby’s beach bar were the live entertainment was great. Also Joshua (I think was his name) made great drinks at Gaby’s. The bartender in the hotel lobby also made some of the best cocktails including the best bloody Mary and was super friendly. I forgot his name I believe it started with an E but he was great. 

As for the only negative I have is the persistency that the staff has to have you sit in for one of their circle presentation or book an activity. We were recently engaged and just wanted to relax as their persistency become irritating to the point were I just told everyone I did it already to have them leave us alone.
Also the change in diet had our stomachs upset for 1 day so bring medicine. 

All and all I would recommend this resort for anyone. If you are looking for a family relaxing vacation this would be ideal. Additionally if you wanted no children there is an adults only section however it is away from all the action if that’s what you are looking for.

Thanks to all for making this vacation extra special see you soon ☺

reviews.author: flacobuenosaires1
reviews.title: LUJO EN PLAYA BAVARO
reviews.text:
Pase una semana con mi nieto, mis hijos con sus esposas y la mia en el Paradisus.
no soy un gran usuario de hoteles all inclusive, no me gustan las aglomeraciones ni las repetidas comidas de los bufetes de este tipo de instalaciones.
en el paradisus nos encontramos con la grata sorpresa de los grandes espacios, nos alojamos un dia en la reserva y otros seis dias en el paradisus palma real, y siempre estuvimos muy comodos
no había que preocuparse por obtener unas buenas reposeras, a la sombra o al sol a cualquier hora del dia, siempre había espacio en los bares, las piletas son inmensas, la sala de juegos para niños es mas grande que un super jardín de infantes y esta llena de juguetes, la comida en el buffet principal, Naos es muy buena y de gran calidad y variedad. festejamos varias noches con colas de langostas y blinis con caviar.
la playa es muy buena y en la época que fuimos, abril, la temperatura fue ideal, unos 28 grados de dia y unos 24 grados en la noche
pero lo mas destacado del hotel es la amabilidad y la profesionalidad de todos sus empleados, siempre una sonrisa, siempre una gran disposición para ayudar, en las buenas mientras disfrutamos y tambien la noche que nos preocupamos porque mi nieto tuvo un sarpullido y fiebre y nos asistieron con mucho cariño
no puedo nombrar a todos, pero destaco a Michael en el restaurante Naos que nos atendio con todo cariño, a Ravell en la zona de playa de la Reserva, a Yedi que nos transporto con alegría y tambien con preocupación en la noche al sanatorio con mi nieto y que nos facilito todo el movimiento de valijas de los siete, y a Dani que siempre venia con una sonrisa para ver si nos podía convidar con un trago en la playa.

reviews.author: Simone S
reviews.title: Férias maravilhosas.
reviews.text: Ótima estadia. Lugar lindo. Comida deliciosa. Destaque para para o excelente atendimento e cordialidade dos amigos jhonatan Medina, Benita, Jose Reinoso, Luis, Wally ( Excelente ) e Cristian Rivera, Frankelelly Morrobel. Pessoas fantásticas que faz o diferencial do paradisus. Parabéns amigos e até a próxima.

reviews.author: Beth Q
reviews.title: Wonderful service
reviews.text: We stayed in the Royal Service suites, which I would recommend, and had a wonderful time!  Our butler, Alvaro Fernandez, was awesome!  He reserved the pool cabana or the beach chairs with an umbrella for us to hang out during the day.  He brought beer and wine to our room and kept them cold in ice buckets!  We even had his cell phone number if we had any questions or problems.  He handled everything!  The rooms were very clean and nicely updated.  The rest of the staff was great as well.  Basically, everyone wanted to make sure you had a great time!   Our teenage kids stayed in a different section and had a blast too.  They had fun with their friends, made their own dinner reservations, and enjoyed the beach and late night entertainment by the pool and the disco.  Since we only stayed on the property, we didn't have to worry about their safety.  There was plenty of security and staff around at all times.  Wifi was good in places, but cell service was great so we could keep in contact.  Great family resort!

reviews.author: PEDROOSSAN
reviews.title: Trabajo en equipo
reviews.text:
Admirable nuestra visita de 8 días.
Frente a cualquier consulta una Sonrisa y muchas soluciones.
Nuestra coordinadora de la estadía Sandra Cedeño. se esmero a que nuestra visita fuese algo placentero.
En Hidrogrill Narciso y Frankeli. Una delicia en la preparación de platillos al lado de la Piscina.
Los encargados de tener contenta a la Gente a la orilla de Piscina Jose y Jonathan. siempre ofreciendo bebidas y Toallas.
El equipo de Actividades, Germanía y muchos otros preocupados de tener a la gente entretenida. en las noches con un equipo  de bailes y espectáculos. Sobresaliendo el de Michael Jackson,
Es largo de enumerar pero fue unas vacaciones fantasticas

reviews.author: anth0ny4
reviews.title: awesome
reviews.text: we had a awesome time there. first rate service and amenities .beach great, food and beverage great and service was top notch!!!large facility . my wife and I attended a business trip there and we had a great experience!!!

reviews.author: ReRanieriWanderley
reviews.title: Beleza natural nota 1000 porém atendimento nota 0
reviews.text:
Estivemos hospedados por 7 dias e o motivo da viagem foi para um casamento no hotel que estava divino. A paisagem e paradisíaca, lugar lindo e praia ótima. 
O atendimento do hotel deixou muito a desejar desde o check-in. Chegamos em voo noturna as 23:00 no hotel e demoramos mais de uma hora para chegarmos ao quarto. Não houve nenhuma apresentação do hotel pelo recepcionista. A ideia de all inclusive é um pouco enganosa pois havia somente um restaurante com um buffet “quebra galho” nesse horário. As bebidas alcoólicas não são porcionadas dentro do padrão de doses, dando a impressão de estarem sempre “ sem paladar e fracas “ . Os restaurantes servem apenas até 22:30 e seguem esse horário de forma bem rígida. 
Estranhamente dentro de um grupo de quase 70 pessoas em 3 apartamentos do grupo sumiram dólares e relógio de dentro do cofre. Um absurdo. 
Em todos os locais , como bares , restaurantes os funcionários não possuem cortesia e alegria em servir. 
Outro ponto negativo é que um hotel com varias qualificações de hierarquia de hóspedes pelo tipo de pacote adquirido. Se o hóspede não for do royal service  fica limitado a poucas áreas de uso na piscina e praia , ou seja poderá usar os locais na maioria das vezes sem sombra. 

Não voltaria para esse destino senão fosse por um ótimo motivo como foi para o casamento que estava maravilhoso!!!

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: VERY GREAT!!!!
reviews.text: Wally,Luis Hidro grill the chef in the pool area and jhonatan Medina were great with everything helped me with any and everything I needed. I plan on coming back just because of their hospitality!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Karen M
reviews.title: Amazing Experience Best Kids club
reviews.text: We stayed at the reserve and had an amazing time. Millie was our personal concierge and she was amazing!! We loved everyone at the kids club, they took such good care of your children and really enjoyed and loved them. The chef and staff were all amazing and accommodated us in every which way we need. This was our second time here and we will def be back!!

reviews.author: Nate M
reviews.title: Amazing time!
reviews.text: So beautiful here and all of the staff was friendly. Deivi Silverstre was exceptional at recommending the best scuba trip I’ve ever been on! had a great time at the beaches and the water was perfect as well!

reviews.author: Mallory s
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I stayed  at the Reserve April 19- April24 and was quite disappointed,,,I stayed at Paradisus about 11 yrs ago and loved it,,,so I thought I would take my niece for her bday and stay at the Reserve,,,checked in and told I was upgraded on my room ,,the view was the back of a kitchen,,,,the couch was broken,,,the wall between the bath and bedroom was filthy soap scum,,,the hall had a huge puddle which was not lit so we fell 2x ,,,we requested the light be fixed not once was it on ,,very dangerous,,,room so cold could not lower thermostat,,,got sick 
the best thing the help ,,need a little better English,
oh and the casino was a joke ripped carpet looked so tacky
will not be back

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation with my fiancé
reviews.text: I have nothing but great things to say about Paradisus Punta Cana. My fiancé and I went on our first vacation together 9 years ago. We absolutely loved it so we came back again. Didn’t think it would be possible but we loved it even more the second time. So much that we’re planning our wedding there in 2019. The resort and staff are top notch. There are honestly too many positives to list. Everything is very clean and everyone is very professional. There’s plenty to do and plenty to eat. The food for an all inclusive is delicious, and I’m a picky eater. The only negative for us is that other guests have a habit of slamming the doors to their rooms at all hours. Maybe the resort can do something to prevent the doors from slamming so hard. It’s the not the end of the world though. I’d like to mention of few people that make the stay at Paradisus Punta Cana memorable. First and foremost Antoni our reserve concierge was amazing. There was nothing he couldn’t take care of. He constantly checked on us throughout the stay. Jose Cappuccino at the reserve pool has a natural quality for making people laugh and have a great time. You can hear his laugh all around the pool. Santos at the reserve beach was an amazing waiter. He makes wonderful recommendations from the perfect spot to sunbathe for the time of day, wonderful fruit drinks and great conversation. Frankely,Julio and Miguelina were always around to greet us with a smile when we passed through the reserve restaurant and lobby area. I have the utmost respect for their work ethics. Daniela and Willy in the reserve concierge office are also extremely helpful and informative about any questions anyone may have. By the end of the week we felt like these were our friends and not employees of the resort. In a nutshell, do not hesitate staying at Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Elizabeth P
reviews.title: Lua de mel 2018
reviews.text: Nixon um dos melhores dos tantos funcionários queridos e prestativos desse maravilhoso resort que é o Paradisus Palma Real, lembraremos de todos no Brasil com muito carinho e recomendaremos o Resorttt

reviews.author: mbl0mberg
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort!  Amazing service
reviews.text: This resort is amazing. The beach is beautiful.  The food has been excellent - with amazing variety. The service is 2nd to none. My husband and I played tennis - they drove us down in a golf cart and offered us water and towels as soon as we got there. It's hot here so we needed it!  They happily drove us back the short distance across the hotel property. The pool is enormous here - you can either find a tranquil corner or fun at the pool bar. We bunked up at a pool cabana and one of the resort employees, Nixon, came by and played Connect four with us. He beat me twice and won my husband's employee a day off by beating my husband 4 out of 6 games!  (Connect four can be a betting game). I highly recommend all aspects of this resort and would gladly come back!

reviews.author: Nicole M
reviews.title: Nixon is awesome!
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing and beautiful. The food was decent and as good as any inclusive resort but what made this hotel great was the staff! Anytime you were without a drink within minutes there was someone there asking if they can get you a refill and I promise you will not pass a single employee that does not say hello to you! If you visit make sure to look for Nixon who works around the pool, he literally came up to our group with a connect four board and challened us to a game! He was a blast!

reviews.author: MIKEY in the C
reviews.title: Great resort , even greater people
reviews.text: Me and my wife came to this resort in January for our honey moon , the resort , the food , the pools , beach , rooms , and amenities were just great . This place is truly paradise. But what made our trip even better was the truly awesome beautiful people we met while on this trip. There were three employees specifically that made this trip more then what we could have ever hoped for. Our excursion guy Alex , and two servers Bony and Freddy made this trip feel like home away from home . These guys are the best of the best that the resort has to offer . They made us comfortable, gave us a bunch of great information about the area and local activities , culture and food . They have become friends for life and because of the great people I met while on this vacation I will Only go back to this resort when in Dominican Republic, love this land, love the people even more . Alex is your go to guy for any activity you can imagine! The most friendly, humble guy you could meet . Servers Bony and Freddy were great , energetic, super friendly, fast service and just all around good guys ! Christian is the guy to see for your photos ! All in all , great resort , even better people

reviews.author: Sibarita61
reviews.title: Semana maravillosa !!!
reviews.text:
El hotel es un paraíso , hemos quedado encantados !!!!!!
Nos vamos llorando !!!!!!!
El personal ha sido en todo momento encantadores y muy atentos .... Empezando por los chicos q nos atendían en la playa ( Ramón ) como los de piscina y comedores .
Queremos hacer especial mención a sra Sandra , su atención ha sido muy especial , ha estado muy pendiente de nuestro bienestar durante los días que hemos estado en el hotel ..... Gracias a todos por hacernos unas vacaciones fantásticas ...
Lo recomiendo, al 100% x 100 !!! Quedarán encantados ( GIRONA )

reviews.author: Francisca L
reviews.title: Vacaciones royal service
reviews.text:
Fuimos de vacaciones con mi pareja en el mes de abril bajo sistema royal service.... sobre dicho servicio, se encuentra bajo el nivel ofrecido, poca o casi nada ayuda y orientacion del mayordomo, parece que solo hacen reservas a restaurantes, lo que parece insuficiente, si nosotros no lo buscamos probablemente ni lo habriamos conocido, el ultimo dia de hecho, tuvimos que cargar nosotros las maletas hasta el check out preferencial,
Lugar en el que nos preguntaron porque lo habiamos hecho nosotros. probablemente el valor del servicio se compensa por la vista de la habitación, por otro lado la atencion en la playa royal tambien regular, los acomodadores parecian mas interesados en la propina que en el cliente, eran solo 2, muy poco para todos los huespedes de area, tal vez el servicio deberia ser reforzado alli.
En lo general, muy buena comida, los bares bien, discoteque con buena musica, los restorant tematicos con muy buenas preparaciones.
Pero por sobre todo quisieramos felicitar a los somelier Vicente de passion, Jonathan y Milquiades de winery, son geniales, amables, un lujo tener la cata gratis y privada con ellos, son por lejos lo mejor del hotel, gran aprendizaje y el mejor trato recibido
Por ultimo, y algo que nos parecio algo preocupante, es 3ra vez que visitamos la isla, y observamos que varios trabajadores sobre todo los del bar y buffet estan muy interesados en las propinas, aveces de hecho, limitan la atencion a quienes les dan y a quiene no, negando una mesa o bien desatendiendo completamente a algunos huéspedes....  en nuesto caso al ser royal, deberia haber un trato mas preferente, sobre todo en este punto.
En general buen hotel, pero para ls estrellas, en terminos de detalles deja que desear.

reviews.author: Melissa J
reviews.title: Royal Service by Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This trip was for our 10yr anniversary. It was great. Argenis Romaro, our personal butler, was amazing and catered to us very well. I highly recommend! Olga at the royal service only swim bar was excellent and. Pleasure to visit with. Bring plenty of 1s and 5s for tipping as it is highly encouraged. Gorgeous beach and weather, very clean!

reviews.author: Nereragain
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Do not visit this resort. We went out to dinner and left the do not disturb sign on the door. When we came back someone had left chocolates on the bed. We were wondering why they had came in. The next morning we were packing to return home. The safe would not open.  We called the front desk and a few minutes someone came to tell us that security was called because we left the safe unopen. This was not true. Money was missing but how do you prove it. We went to the front desk and the manager would not come to speak with us. So my question is: If you came into a room with the do not disturb sign on the door why would you go into the closet? Never again!

reviews.author: Marcos Sarres
reviews.title: Com a família
reviews.text: O serviço é maravilhoso. Os funcionários  nos fazem sentir em casa. Recomendo a todos. Jhonatam Medina, Bebida Mercedes e Luis Peña foram muito atenciosos, sempre nos atendendo com profissionalismo e cuidado. Restaurante Gabi Club tinha um serviço especial. Sr. Silvio Lantegua trabalhou muito bem na gestão de todos. Ficamos muito felizes com a estada nesse hotel.

reviews.author: Claudeea
reviews.title: Excellent time
reviews.text: Visited this beautiful resort with my daughter & husband. Every one was so kind and accommodating. The food was fantastic! I can’t say enough on how wonderfully and amazing the service was here. The Boys at the beach were incredible!! Everyone made us feel very at home here... can’t say enough!!  5 stars all around for everyone! This was our second time here and we look forward to coming back. We left our daughter at the Kids Zone and she loved it!! When i was nervous about her the when at the beach Ramon who runs things at the beach would call and check for me to easy my mind. Santo was amazing and very friendly and made us feel very at home, Jairo &  the boss Silvio lantigua were very accommodating and so nice while we stayed there. Looking forward to going back!

reviews.author: Stevie B
reviews.title: Incredible service
reviews.text:
We spent an incredible vacation the people that work at the beach took very good care of us and we're wonderful with my 3 year old daughter

The room was clean early so we were able to go back to them room for my daughters nap and weren't disturbed

The food was excellent the executive chef at Gabi Club made us paella one night as a special treat,  thank you Miguel

We spent allot of time at the beach
The service was excellent they kept the ice cold for us was very impressed

Thanks to Ramon Ramirez,  Santos Fries and Jiro Michael

reviews.author: Russ M
reviews.title: Give all 5 senses a great vacation!
reviews.text:
Our company has an annual trip for the top sales performers across the country, this year we chose the Paradissus Palma Real as our destination this year and what a great choice!

The entire experience begins with the breath taking views you take in as soon as you get out of your cab ( see attached photos). These are the same type of views and amazing scenery shots we often see on computer screen savers or post cards!  No photo shop or touched up pictures- the sky really is the perfect blue and the ocean actually has those multiple shades of green and blue that you have dreamt of!

The Facility is well very clean, well kept, and has a large and expertly trained staff that appears to be predicting your every need and delivering it just when you need it.  No matter who or where you are.

The cuisine is also Outstanding!  With a great variety of tastes and choices and the freshest ingredients for every tastebud- from sushi, to seafood, steak, to pasta and everthing else you could want- all the way up to the 3 Star Michelin rated Passions restaurant where you will be treated to a 7 course experience that will be like nothing else you have ever experienced!  Only an artist can creat such masterful flavors that awaken every taste bud you have and often doing so all in the same course!

Many of our employees commented that this was our best destination EVER ( I have been to 24 different trips and this place ranks in the top three ( all three owned by this same family of properties too!) no doubt I will be returning with my family over the winter so that my kids can enjoy the total experience themselves!  Just the smell of the soaps and shampoos they supply offer me a sense of calm and relaxation the elludes me in my normal daily life!!

My experience was additionally enhanced after accidentally leaving my room safe open when it was holding my travel cash, credit cards and some of my wife’s jewelry.  The hotel had procedures to safeguard the contents and with the help of Katery and Vladimir, we were able to thank the housekeeping staff who took the steps to make sure the contents were safeguarded and save me from a miserable lesson in hotel security protocols.  What peace of mind!!

Overall, whether you are looking for a relaxing and romantic trip away with your spouse, an amazing all inclusive and exotic vacation for your group trip or a family spot to enjoy the most picturesque location you have ever seen- this property is a sure thing for a successful time away!!!

You will have nothing but praise from your family or  group for booking this place!!!

reviews.author: Claire I
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful resort, plenty of options as far as food and drinks go. I stayed at the Reserve, but spent most of my time at the main area. Service is good, some much better then others (Nixon from activities and Abraham from the restaurants were my favorite). Totally recommend this spot for a nice, inexpensive get away. Wish I stayed an extra few days.

reviews.author: Vesna K
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text: Stayed in the royal service section.  Nice adults only part of the resort.  Much quieter, would highly recommend it.  Our butler Carlos was amazing.  So sweet and genuine, he really does go out of his way to ensure your stay is perfect.  Rafael at the beach is the best.  After the first day, he knew to reserve our beach beds and even have them turned facing the sun just the way we liked it.  Drink service on the beach is great, someone is always making sure you’re taken care of.  Olga at the smoothie bar is pure joy.  She’s just so pleasant, always smiling.  Not to mention that she can whip up some tasty smoothies.  I’d come back to this resort just because of the wonderful employees.  They are the ones who really make your vacation a memorable one.

reviews.author: Alex K
reviews.title: Great resort! Amazing Service
reviews.text: Pictures don’t this resort justice! Beautiful resort but we really enjoyed the staff. Nixon in activities was a blast. Had to let him win a couple games of connect four! Thanks Nixon you are the man and thanks for making us laugh!! 😀

reviews.author: Tiffany M
reviews.title: Staff is amazing!
reviews.text: Nixon was very helpful! He came over talked to us, he made us feel welcomed! He came over to us while we were by the pool & made us laugh and played games! Kids were here and he was so great with them!

reviews.author: Nicholas A
reviews.title: Staff very friendly
reviews.text:
Nixon from activities and Nicolas from avenue bar provided excellent service!!!!

Boni was our waiter on the beach and he provided great service as well. 

Resort is beautiful and would recommend to anyone 10/10

reviews.author: Ryan F
reviews.title: My trip to punta cana
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice the food is very good i made friends with nixon and reynaldo they are my Dominican brothers they kept me intertaind  the beach is pretty good the show. Ill have to come back soon

reviews.author: kimveis
reviews.title: Nixon is the best!
reviews.text: Had a great time at this resort. Staff was fantastic... especially Nixon.  Challenge him to a game of connect 4 if you’re feeling lucky.  Food was great, grounds were beautiful. We had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: CMTPetro
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana. I would especially like to thank our Family Concierge Sandra for being an amazing host. She went the extra mile each day to help us feel right at home. She was amazing to our kids and we cant thank her enough!!

reviews.author: Ladyfish76
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
We come every years for 21 years this is like our second home
Everyone treats us like family it will meet all your needs and wants from check in to check out the rooms are clean and spacious, the food is great quality all the restaurants. Anything you need all your have to do is ask and they will make you happy. The beach is beautiful and we spend most of our day there Ramon Ramirez is always there to serve and a smile, Santos Frias, Jairo Minier are very good they will set you up with towels, water,drinks all your needs are taken care of.
Luis Santana will also meet all your request in the reserve friendly & there to serve you with a smile.
Silvio lantigua supervisor, Socraste Tejada are very friendly and also will do for you anything they can to make you stay a pleasant one Fernando who also has been here for all the time we have been coming here I would give them all five stars for all there service

reviews.author: tmgoforth
reviews.title: Royal Service is the best!!!
reviews.text:
I read a lot of reviews and I have to say that I disagree with most of them. The ones that say the place is dirty, not true! The ones that say the service was horrible, not true! The Royal Service is a must for sure, that is so true. 

We had a great time and the food was amazing!! You have to tip well for sure ( $15 is like a $100 to them) but if you do you get wonderful, wonderful service and they so deserve it. 

We had Richard Ortiz as our butler, he was great and really deserves some recognition. Luis was our beach concierge and took wonderful care of as at the beach. He always had our place saved in the front with a full view of the ocean, so wonderful. Wanda at the Royal service pool bar is the best, make sure to ask for her!! She makes them good and strong 😉 Then make sure to ask where Abraham is waiting tables because he is so great and always smiling!! 

The restaurants are wonderful, but don’t expect to have large portions. We as Americans have come accustomed to that and it’s just to much! The food is 5 star good! We ate at Fuego x2, Vento and Rare x2. The buffet is good for what it is and the bread there is soooo good. Just remember they are a slower culture and that’s not being rude or anything they just don’t have your stuff to you in 10 minutes, so relax and enjoy and by all means slow down, it’s vacation!! 

The only issues I have seen are from other guests being rude, which is a shame because it makes us as a country look bad. I saw two couple both from the states complaining and being loud and it’s just not necessary. If you come here and understand that things are different and accept the culture you will have a wonderful time. 

We are already planning our next trip and we don’t leave until tomorrow. We will be back many, many times!!

reviews.author: Masstraveler11
reviews.title: Hotel service
reviews.text:
Beach crew was excellent, Santos Frias, Ramone, Juaro and the rest of the crew serving the guests on the beach thank you. Very friendly, attentive and accommodating. All the people at the restaurants, pools, room service, etc.
Thank you for the great service, will return.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Beautiful at First View
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days at this all-inclusive resort.  The trip was for a business meeting but we arrived a few days early to get in some 'relaxing' time. As the title says, the resort is beautiful, perfect beach location but there were many little things that took down my ratings to Average.

Our first SURPRISE was that the 3 story villa that our room was in had no elevator. It wasn't that we had to carry our bags up, that is done by the staff, but 3 flights up and down several times a day is a bit much. They were able to move us to a 1st-floor room. The only building that did have an elevator in the main building and it was not in operation.  If you have bad knees this is NOT the place to stay.

Food: We only went to a few of them as we had 2 nights of company functions. 

The buffet, NAOS, excellent. Good selection except they did not have any bagels for the cream cheese and smoked salmon. For breakfast, they have many stations where they can prepare eggs, fresh fruit juice station too.  Lunch, well the burgers are NOT of the same quality of meat I am used to and have a funny flavor. they have a good selection of other items. We stuck to salads and the fish chef was very kind to grill up some shrimp for us.  We did not go to the buffet for dinner but did stop by for dessert.  Hint, you can ask a latte, they do not tell you they are available.  The coffee is probably the best 'over the counter' I have had. It is not brown water.  The only real complaint is that they do not serve food all day long. 

OLIO is where you can get food when the Buffet is closed. Lunch selection was not great, burgers, hot dogs, Pizza, and salad. Probably great for kids.

Dinner, the first night we went to the - we thought it was a sushi restaurant but it was really a teppanyaki restaurant that served some sushi. NOT a place to have a quiet meal and we were told that it would be hours waiting if we wanted a table by ourselves as we did not make a reservation!  Food was typical teppanyaki, so-so flavor. The 'show' of throwing knives was too long and NOISEY! 

Our best meal was at BRI SAS .... we finally found Sushi and it was unique and delicious.  Even though it is listed as limited to RESERVE guests we were able to make a reservation there.

Last night we ate at RARE, a steakhouse, Again the quality of beef is not the same as in the USA. We both ordered a Rib Eye and it was very fatty. And the flavor wasn't what I am used to.

Pool Bar, not enough bartenders! Beach towel station, only 1 and it was not central to the pool. 

Spa, my wife went there 3 times and it was average. We had a couples massage and it was nothing to rave about. I did hear from one from our group that there is a blind masseuse, one male and one female that are incredible. We did have to take a golf cart to the RESERVE for these services.

Beach, it was populated by a good number of covered lounge chairs and there is a separate area with much nicer lounges for the upgraded guests. Local vendors do patrol the open sand area before the water but did not appear to be pushy.  There is a sign that says they are rebuilding the beach area and that is why the sea grass is not cleaned up. 

Some areas that need correction.  Floor outlets in the meeting rooms when not in use have no covers.  My wife fell when her heel caught the recess.  She was not hurt but could have been.  There were several other areas in the resort that have uneven transitions from cement to wooden walkways.  

One thing that upset many in the group was the 'vendors' that walked around the pool areas trying to get you to sign up for a trip or parasailing or some other activity. That was a nuisance. Also, there is a Vendor night and those people are very pushy, the jewelry seller ... well, let me just say his prices were stupidly high as were the cigar seller.  The onsite store was selling an insulated cup that water leaked into the 'sealed' area.  I went to return it and get a refund for a defective item and they would only give me store credit. The clerk took the cups and handed me back the receipt without indicating I returned the items and had a credit... I made her correct that... BUT when I went back a day later I had to wait while several clerks looked at the receipt and then she had to make a call. I ended up leaving a 'credit balance' with them as my purchases did not equal my credit and there was no indication they would give me cash or credit to my CC. 

Service by waiters, bellmen etc was very good. That was probably the best thing about the resort.

Overal the resort was nice, if I go back to Punta Cana I would select a different place to get a different feel.

reviews.author: Kyle C
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The staff really treats you like loyalty, from Boni bringing you drinks to Nixon playing you  in connect four on the beach. Very nice and personal staff. I would reccomend this resort! Its absolutely beautiful here.

reviews.author: cheryl k
reviews.title: Ravel!!!!!
reviews.text: We just returned from a wonderful trip to the Reserve and my family cannot stop talking about Ravel, who works at the beach.  He was a standout - friendly, funny, personable, genuine and helpful!  If we were to return to this property, he would be a big reason why.

reviews.author: Jojo Dee
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with great food and service
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort is located only about 20 minutes from PUJ airport and is right on the shore. The rooms were tastefully decorated but since I roomed with my dad this time, the partial planation shutters and the frosted glass doors to the shower and toilet made things a little more difficult as far as privacy is concerned. If you want an ocean view, you probably have to book the private suites that have a butler service for an extra charge. The newly weds were pampered by their butler who helped w/everything from room service, reservations, even ensuring the pool bar toned the music down during the wedding in the garden. All rooms have decent access to the resort via the garden.This resort provides expansive pools, beach access, great food and service.  I went with family to attend a wedding and we had a great time. The resort is not like the "all inclusive cruise boat" as I was expecting. It was a lot classier and not full of college students trying to get as blitzed as possible. There were some families and a lot of 30-somethings in addition to your expected elderly couples trying to relax. I saw a number of business groups attending seminars there and numerous weddings on this immaculate resort. I feel there is a nice balance of fun and relaxation here. The nightly entertainment at their bar Gabi Beach was a nice way to end the day. Go to the Red Lounge at night if you want to dance. They have an adults only pool and also plenty of places for families to hang out together. There are poolside cabanas (you have to reserve these ahead of time, or show up early in the morning) and there are plenty of places to relax in the pool including tiled lounge "chairs" and cabanas that let you enjoy the water and sit in the shade. There is not so much as far as infant areas as I did not see any playgrounds/splash areas, but they did have a small, toddler pool near the main pool. The beach had powdery sand and the water was a gorgeous turquoise color. There was a nice gym (never went tho) and a full service spa (also didn't visit but a friend in my group really enjoyed her massage.) The food was excellent. The presentation and quality of the food options was surprising for an all-inclusive and the bars didn't give you tiny plastic cups (with the exception of the swim up pool bar for obvious safety reasons so pack an insulated cup for that!) and they didn't water down the drinks. The liquors available were average and were provided with a smile. I'd recommend passing by the bar in the hibachi restaurant and ask for the Big Papi: a light vodka drink served with freshly muddled pineapple with a spash of grenadine, juice and sparkling water.....very refreshing.  On Fridays, their on-resort winery has a free wine tasting event where you taste a white and a red wine along with cheese and crackers to compliment the taste. Be sure to make a reservation to try Fuego their Peruvian Fusion restaurant (very popular so you need to reserve early!) and try all the ceviche dishes (hey, it's all inclusive!) and the grilled octopus (so good) and follow it with the salted lomo (steak) with a finale of the Suspiro Limeno (a caramel and liquor meringue). Yummmm!  I would definitely go again!

reviews.author: drjoek
reviews.title: Great visit GET THE ROYAL SERVICE if you can
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 4 day trip to Paradisus Palma Real. We have stayed in Melia resorts before and knew what to expect. They are always very beautiful and well designed. We got the Royal service which if you can afford the added expense it truely worht it, You get a personal butler who does all the extra things for you. Dinner reservations cabana acquisition and a bunch of little things with out being overbearing. The added amenities in royal service are well worth it.
The suites are very attractive and well appointed  comfortable and  in good repair for the most part. The dining choices are quite  diverse, The buffet changed things day to day so there is some variety there . We enjoyed a very nice meal at Fuego the Latin food restaurant and our favorite dining was at Rare the steak place.Special mention to Greechy the hostess at Rare who took VIP care of us on a return for dinner there.
Bartenders and staff at Royal service are very good everyone if attentive and pleasant .

My only complaint would be that many times they seemed to be a little understaffed in  places and some of the staff could be a little better trained in servicing an English speaking clientele. With more experience the staff will be better. 

Overall a great vacation and highly recommend the resort

reviews.author: CrayZee127
reviews.title: Service Makes Up For Most Shortcomings
reviews.text:
We arrived on an early Saturday afternoon to begin our one week stay at this lovely resort. Our room wasn't ready yet, but Marcos at the desk was very helpful finding us an area to change clothes and store our luggage. He was very good about giving us updates and eventually changing our preassigned room when they found a maintenance issue in the first room during cleaning. He continued to be helpful throughout our stay.

The room itself is a little dated, but very clean and comfortable. Housekeeping consistently did a fantastic job throughout our week there. There were a couple of times when we had minimal water pressure or no running water at all, but it didn't affect us too much and was usually fixed quickly. Same with a few power outages we experienced during our stay. These issues were resort-wide, so it may be an infrastructure issue.

The dining options are varied and mostly good. Our favorites were Bana and Rare. We made our whole week's worth of dinner reservations right after we checked in and it all worked out well. 

The pool and beach were both lovely. We didn't have Royal Service but were permitted to use that part of the pool for most of our stay as the hotel was nearly empty. Once a group of 1,000 people checked in that was off the table, but it was nice while it lasted. 

The service by all members of the staff was great. I can't remember all of the names, but Louis and Bonni were awesome servers. Raphael at the towel check area was so nice. He speaks Spanish, English, French, and Russian so everyone can stop by and have a conversation! 

One thing to note- there are almost no elevators on this three-floor property. If you have issues with stairs, the best place for you is the ground floor. My husband and I joked that the roughest part of our very relaxing vacation was climbing the three flights of stairs to our room. 

The grounds are beautiful and smell amazing. You can tell (and watch!) that they work hard every day to maintain and update this property. Their hard work really shows. The beach has the normal wandering vendors, but they aren't aggressive and take "No gracias" and quickly go away if you don't want to see their items. I have a feeling that this has a lot to do with the hotel security on the beach. I walked down the beach one day to the south and the vendors became more and more aggressive the farther we got away from "our" beach. 

All in all, this was a wonderful resort that we felt was worth the price we paid. If we return to the Dominican it will likely be to this location.

reviews.author: dsemraurn
reviews.title: We love Nixon and Antonio!
reviews.text:
We just returned yesterday from 5 wonderful days at your resort. My husband was there for business with some colleagues who also brought along their wives. We were blessed with lots of free time to enjoy your restaurants (Rare was our favorite), the YHI spa for a wonderful couples massage, the adorable little wine bar, and your delightful pools. 

But I must say that Nixon and Antonio from your entertainment staff were the most memorable part of our stay. We met them down at the Gabi beach bar one night and they danced with our group, made us laugh and smile, and were so fun to be around. They both always had the biggest genuine smiles on their faces whenever we would see them throughout our stay and would greet us with a fist-bump or high five. Nixon even played connect four with our friend for quite a while. You truly have an engaging and hardworking group of guys there and we are so thankful to have met them!

reviews.author: Ruthanne H
reviews.title: We loved this place!!
reviews.text:
We couldn’t have been happier with our choice to stay at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana. Our week there was truly one of the best vacations we’ve ever had. This was our daughter’s (8 years old) first tropical vacation and she absolutely fell in love with this place! There were fun activities by the Reserve pool every day for families, including zoomba, yoga, painting class, and even an expert violinist playing on a platform one afternoon, in the middle of the pool, while guests all floated around her in giant inflatable swans!! It was unreal!! Our daughter attended several of the various workshops at the Kids Zone, including kite-building, puppet-making, foam party, and more, which allowed for some adult time for us too!! The nightly entertainment was top notch as well, from dance and music performances to circus and acrobatic acts, there was a fantastic show or party for guests each and every night! 

The food and service was excellent at every one of the restaurants we visited, but especially the multi-course tasting meal we had at Passion, where we were taken such great care of by the waitstaff, Martin and Bilis, who were professional, competent, and pleasant. What an extraordinary meal and experience! 

The week before our trip we made the last minute decision to upgrade to the Family Concierge option and we were soooo glad we did! Upon check-in we were introduced to Sandra, our concierge for the week. She was absolutely delightful and made sure she took the greatest care in assuring an amazing and relaxing stay for us, from booking all of our restaurant reservations, to leaving special surprises in the room for our daughter, to reserving palapas at the beach and/or pool for us. We looked forward to seeing her each morning and she always greeted us with a friendly smile and eagerness to make our vacation be everything we hoped for. I could go on and on, as honestly, I cannot say enough great things about our stay and we’re already talking about another trip back! We loved this place!!

reviews.author: melissa r
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great staff, very quiet
reviews.text:
Firstly, this resort looks exactly like the pictures online. The grounds and beach are absolutely breath taking, it is truly like paradise. The staff are extremely helpful and attentive. In particular a young gentleman named RAYNOLD TAMAYO stood out, he provided amazing customer service and truly made our stay that much more enjoyable. If you have the chance to encounter him during your stay here you are lucky and sure to be amazed! 

The food is above average for resort food, both the buffets and a la carte restaurants. But you have to make reservations for the a la cartes as soon as you get there, or you will have a hard time eating anywhere else but the buffet for the week. Best restaurants are Aqua, Mole and the Grill. 

Resort is very close to shops, restaurants, nightclubs and casinos (2-10 mins walk!). Felt very safe leaving the resort to go eat during the day, as well as taking taxis at night to go to the nightclubs! 

Cons: 
- Room service very slow or doesn’t come at all 
- the reserve is quite far from the beach and main areas 
- There need to be more carts going around to pick people up and bring them around the resort, particularly past 11 pm (sometimes you would be stuck at the beach for like 20 mins waiting for someone to pick you up and bring you back to your room)
- The resort is VERY quiet. It is an older crowd, fewer young people, many families. There is currently no disco (they are building one), but there is a nightly DJ by the beach bar which is nice (but usually pretty dead). It can also get pretty cold by the beach that late due to the wind and the mosquitos get pretty bad. Still fun, but If you are looking for a more upbeat resort with music, dancing, day/beach parties or a nightclub I wouldn’t recommend this resort. Or if you are okay with leaving the resort past 11 for nightlife then you will be okay.
- Not that many things to do during the day, wish there were more organized events (I feel like there was never anything going on). Like I walked to other resorts where the music was blasting, pool parties, volleyball, dance competitions, shows etc.. where as I said this place is very quiet and relaxing. 

Overall beautiful resort, great staff, good food, needs a little more excitement :) would definitely return!

reviews.author: paulacO8400ME
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed for 7 nights in the Royal Service are of Paradisus Palma Real. We had a beautiful Oceanfront room. A special thank you to our butler Francis Newton. He made all our dinner reservations at the times we requested. He sent the menus to my phone so we were able to decide in advance where we wanted to dine. I told him that I liked Chardonnay wine and my husband was Coors lite and these were always left cold in our room. Not to mention the fresh fruit and chocolate strawberries. We mentioned to him that it was our anniversary and he left a special cake with our names on in our room while we were at dinner. He was always smiling friendly and available for us. The property is beautiful and clean. We were is awe as we stepped off the airport transportation and saw the breathtaking view from the lobby. The beach is clean and quiet...perfect for relaxing. Pedro and the the beach staff kept us laughing and always had a spot ready for us. Wanda at the beach bar made the best drinks for us and suggested many new drinks we enjoyed too! The food at all the restaurants and the buffet were much better than the all inclusive property we visited in Mexico. We had a wonderful vacation and can't wait to return. We traveled 2 weeks after Easter so the hotel was very quiet as the Spring Break crowds were gone. PERFECT!!

reviews.author: trodager
reviews.title: Great family vacation!
reviews.text:
Our family had an amazing week at The Reserve @ Paradisus Punta Cana.  We stayed in the family concierge 1-bedroom suite.  Our concierge, Estephanie Ruiz, was fantastic!  She remembered our kids names immediately and was so sweet with them.  She was very helpful with dinner reservations, beach/pool cabana reservations and even filled our bathtub with bubbles and balloons for the girls!  We also had a delicious dessert as surprise every night in the room when we returned...it was a highlight for the kids:)

The restaurants were very good.  We had a delicious meal at Fuego, which was our favorite.  We also enjoyed Vento, Mole and The Grill.  We enjoyed the food at Aqua, but unfortunately the bugs were really awful the night we were there.  It was beautiful dining on our own private deck, but the bugs were defininitely an issue.  We enjoyed poolside lunch from Hydro Grill - good pizzas, burgers, hotdogs.  They also have an ice cream machine that is self-serve:)  If you want to enjoy cocktails at the pool, Jose "Drinkie Drinkie" is your guy!

I won a massage in a raffle at one of the shows and had a WONDERFUL massge by Gloria.  She was great!

Speaking of the shows...definitely see all of them!  We saw a Michael Jackson show, a Domincan show, the Lion King and an acrobat show on the beach.  Our whole family enjoyed all of them.

Overall, it is a great place for a relaxing beach vacation!

reviews.author: Ellery T
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Rooms needed some updating, but the level of attentiveness def made up for it.  The food was great with many different options.  We ate at Bana, Naos, Mole, and Gabi.  The food was great at all locations.   Def upgrade to the Family Concierge package.  It was seamless and well worth the money.  They gave us recommendations for where to go, what to do, which restaurants to eat at and booked everything for us.  They would book cabanas by the beach/pool.  We just relaxed the entire time.  They even did nice things for the kids like bring them snacks during turn down service  set up a bubble bath midday while we were out, and even put aromatherapy pillows on their beds.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Sometimes the universe changes your plans!
reviews.text: Our original vacation was to be to Cancun for 2018 but we decided to change our destination after the US Government changed their travel warning.  We booked the Paradisus Punta Cana.  We arrived there to find out that we were booked in the Reserve which is not close to the beach which is what we wanted.  We ended up moving to Palma Real on Sunday to have our 'close to the beach' rooms.  A special thank you to Aris from Club Melia for helping to make that happen.  She was a God send to us!  We LOVE this resort but felt like a change.  The universe called us back.  It was exactly what we needed.  So nice to see our friends Daniel; Luis at the pool bar; and George at the beach!  Always the best service.  Another special thank you to Felipe Morla at Club Melia beach for superb service.  Our butler, William Calderon, was amazing!  Best butler ever!  Finally, Abraham in Naos buffet and Rare--breakfast is typically uneventful--just breakfast.  Abraham made breakfast memorable.  He was so in tune to what we needed almost before we knew.  Food at this resort is always good.  Rooms we had were beautiful and clean.  Housekeeping did an amazing job as did turn out at night.  I have no complaints about this resort.  Looking forward to another visit.

reviews.author: Tom J
reviews.title: Four days in paradise
reviews.text:
Was lucky enough to win a company trip to the Dominican republic and we stayed at the Paradisus,  part of the experience was the Royal service and we had the BEST Butler Sigfredo, he was outstanding!! 

Top class service from a real standup guy,  he took care of all of our needs from  the simple like a welcome bottle of Dominican republic run to restaurant reservations to the he most difficult restaurant to get into to  cutting through all the price negotiations for parasailing .    He even added special touches for me and my wife like rose petals on the bed and a bottle champagne… What more could you want???

 I would ask for them by name

reviews.author: Nacho T
reviews.title: Almost perfect holidays
reviews.text:
5 of us stayed in 2 rooms suites at the reserve. Rooms were nice although a bit aged. Fernando Morla at the beach was great during our whole stay. Yesica Reyes, our concierge took good care of us with restaurants reservations and other issues. Only the food is to be improved in most restaurants. Fuego and Rare were good and we still have to try Passion tonight. All the staff was super attentive with special mention to Victor from Gabi, Aqua and Mizo. 

Would recommend the hotel to everyone, just avoid the timeshare/vacation program presentation. They do comp you just for listening, but their sell tactics are way too aggressive, plus the product is just not worth it.

reviews.author: Roberta S
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
I went with my family of 6 adults and two grandchildren to celebrate a birthday milestone. We all had a fun time with each other. Augustin Nunez helped take care of our needs. He was very attentive and was wonderful in arranging dining reservations and other things that needed to be taken care of. However there were many negatives about this place. The rooms were not well maintained. I had booked 2 suites and a   2 room suite. My room had  2 TVs  one of which  never worked although someone had attempted to fix it. I had a leak under my sink which also never got fixed. The lighting was so poor in the bathroom it was ridiculous. One room had to replace a safe that was broken from the start.basically I think it was very poor quality control overseeing rooms that were being utilized. Getting towels was even more difficult than it should have been. The first morning the electricity went out for a few hours throughout. That affected toilets and WiFi. We stayed in the reserve section so there was only a pool. My family went to the regular section where they would spend the day at the beach and pool. On 2 of those days the water was not working  for approximately 3-4 hours. Toilets couldn’t flush. It was gross. In general the service at the buffets  especially on the reserve side and at the beach was difficult. 

I felt this was supposed to be a more upscale all inclusive and it  was really lacking.

reviews.author: Leonardo G
reviews.title: BUEN ALL INCLUSIVE PERO REGULAR ATENCION
reviews.text: este all inclusive tiene confortables habitaciones y la comida es buena. el problema radica en que si tenes un inconveniente, por ejemplo, que no te funciona la tarjeta magnetica tardan mucho tiempo en solucionarlo , se debe concurrir a la conserjeria y hacer escandalo recien ahi aparece alguien mas responsable , los que atienden se lavan las manos, tambien hay que elegir quien te sirve las bebidas, algunos son de terror te la traen cuando terminaste de comer y de mala gana. ni con propina logras cambios.

reviews.author: Ayelet K
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort, well maintained,  staff was very nice and helpful. 
We loved the crew at the pool (Rafael, Antonio, Reynaldo, Angel) for the day activities : they danced with us, played beach volleyball and were sweet and hospitable.

The Spa in the reserve is most recommended. A 30 min head and shoulders felt like 50 min Swedish massage!

This is our second time at a Meliá Punta Cana resort. Previous time was more relaxing since there weren’t any sports activity agents at the pool and at the beach trying to persuade buying something. Same for the ‘Circle’ agents - sometimes disguised as service people (hotel personal concierge).

Our first stay was at the Paradisus Punta Cana. I remember the Restaurants there were better.
At Palma real I enjoyed a few (Aqua, Fuego, Rare)
The Mediterranean one (Vento) was pretty bad.
All in all it was a pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Cathy M
reviews.title: Business trip and vacation in one
reviews.text:
Just finished our stay at this resort!! My husband was her for a work trip. Beautiful resort with great staff!! I spent most mornings poolside while my husband was in meetings. The rooms were spacious and well maintained. Fridge and drinks stocked everyday, thanks to Johnny!
The activities guys were amazing!! Very social and friendly! I did aqua aerobics, paddle board Yoga and even paddle board fitness! Wilman, Joel and Antonio made it a lot of fun!! Can’t wait to come bck with my family!!

reviews.author: Bob G
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: We just spent 5 days at Paradisus and had Alex as our personal butler. He was perfect in every way! The resort was beautiful and very well maintained. Our room was taken care of 2x a day. The royal service was very helpful. Our friends has steve as a butler and he was also super friendly. Thanks again Alex and Steve!!!

reviews.author: Valerie V
reviews.title: Hg grill
reviews.text: We loved our stay at this hotel, what made it better was Wally. Wally is the best men you could ever meet to make your stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana hotel better. Every time we step foot near the pool he would come see us to see if we needed anything, weightier it was food, drinks, chairs, etc. Thank you Paradisus workers put a big thank you to Wally!

reviews.author: Bailey S
reviews.title: Lovely Visit
