reviews.text: Visited the Paradisus Palma Real for a wedding and had a lovely experience! The property was well maintained and clean, and the view was stunning. We really enjoyed the food, especially the hibachi and Passion! We had a blast with our #1 bartender, Emmanuel, at the bar outside of Rare. His signature drink, the Big Papi, was beunisimo! The staff was really friendly and helpful, and we would definitely return!

reviews.author: Josh H
reviews.title: Upscale, Clean, Great Food and Friendly
reviews.text:
We've been to several all-inclusive Carribean resorts, and the Reserve with a Family Concierge tops our list. 

Our experience was immediately first-class with the private Reserve check-in and dinner reservations already made for us. A poolside cabana was also reserved for the next day, and all made possible by our concierge Sofia. 

The food exceeded our expectations, and even the buffets had very nice meal options. We took a peek into the kitchens which were clean and professional. Each day you can see their care and attention to cleanliness at the pool, restaurants, landscaping, and our room. 

Of course, Sofia had several surprises for the kids, and she made their stay remarkable. Both of our kids said they will miss her most!

All the staff were very friendly and always looking for fun ways to incteract with the kids, giving high fives, joking, etc. Also, the surrounding environment while being inside the reserve made for beautiful views. 

The Reserve beach is also nice, and we split time here and the pool. The beach is very clean, and not too many merchants. You are on the Atlantic side, so you will get the waves that come with it. 

Mole was our favorite restaurant, and try the passion fruit margarita. Be sure to get a mojito at the beach lobby in front of The Grill. 

Also, Mario the Outdoor Photo rep took some great pictures, and we sprung for a couple. 

FYI -They told us the Reserve will be closing for renovations, but not sure when.

Overall, a great experience!

reviews.author: OMC
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text:
Wow, what a truly wonderful vacation!  I’ll have to admit, an All-Inclusive vacation has never been high on my list of things to do.  Boy, did The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana change my mind!

This was our family’s first trip.  We joined our friends who travelled to The Reserve last year.  In total, we were a party of 9 and we spent 5 glorious days at the resort.  We’re already talking about next year’s visit.

The facility was lovely – pictures do not do it justice!  The Reserve rooms were spacious & spotless and had a balcony in each.  We loved hanging around the pool area just outside our door.  Awesome swim up bar and sunny seating in the pool.  The pool deck chaise seating was comfortable with enough sun and shade options.  The staff changed the chair cushion covers each evening ensuring a fresh & clean seat each day.  The staff working at the pool were excellent.  Thanks to Jose (aka Cappuccino) who entertained us with dance lessons, water aerobics and paddleboard lessons and the Cabana guys (Jose, Jonatan & Wander) who kept the area clean with fresh towels at the ready.

I would highly recommend making dinner reservations upon your arrival.  Especially for larger parties as the restaurants are fairly small and generally do not take walk-ins.  The concierge in each building can help. We ate at Mole (Mexican), Vento (Mediterranean), The Grill (Steak House), Aqua (Italian) and Gabi Beach (Buffet).  Vento and The Grill were by far our favorites.

The daily breakfast buffet at The Reserve’s Gabi Pool Restaurant was delicious.  So many fresh fruit and vegetable options plus your normal breakfast fare (eggs, bacon, sausage, toast, yogurt, waffles, pancakes etc).  They also have a buffet lunch and dinner with a variety of tasty options.  Our thanks to the Gabi Pool Restaurant staff, Silo, Jose Duran, Yaritza, and Urvania who were friendly and always there for any need you may have.  A special shout out to bartender Juan Diego who kept us fueled with cappuccinos in the am and drinks at the pool the rest of the day and into the evening. Wally Reyes floated from the restaurant to the pool area and was always there to offer a drink, a smile and great conversation.  All the staff we encountered were hard working and kind.  

The kids loved the pool snack bar as they could grab a burger, pizza or ice cream anytime.

The breathtakingly beautiful beach was a 10 minute walk on a mostly shady path through the beautifully manicured grounds – think Disney-esque.  A tram is also available if you prefer.  The Reserve has it’s own seating area with shade and sun options.  The sand was soft & white, the water a tranquil blue & aqua with enough waves to make it fun.  The beach bar offers yummy tropical drinks and Presidente Beer on tap to keep you hydrated.

A highlight of the vacation were a couple of visits to the YHI Spa on property.  Though the treatments were not covered in the “all-inclusive” package, they were well worth indulging.  We scheduled a few massages with Mercedes.  She offered an amazing experience, with the right touch for deep tissue and relaxation all in one.

A reminder to all you future visitors, don’t forget to tip the staff!  Make sure to bring cash (1s, 5s, 10s & 20’s) to tip the hardworking servers, bartenders, concierge and cleaning staff – they deserve it!

reviews.author: Thex1xManBetter
reviews.title: This place is Mindblowing!
reviews.text: This place literally has it all! I have been to many Caribbean islands and Dominican is definitely one of my favorites. The people that work here are super helpful and very friendly. You barely have to lift a finger to get anything. There are trolleys that take you wherever you need to go at anytime of the day. Jhonathan, Wally, Pamela Arias & Benita Mercedes around the pool will make you feel like royalty. The rooms are always clean and fresh and the grounds are very well taken care of. We ate at Fuego's which is one of the many many restaurants that you can go to on the resort and the food was amazing. There is always a bar open and there is always a place to get food even late night! I am trying to find a reason to return home but I currently can't find one! I recommend this Paradisus highly!!!!

reviews.author: Sassy081417
reviews.title: Bad Rooms & Worse Food
reviews.text: I am currently at this hotel and we are hold up in our room, counting the hours (40) until this experience ends. We are on a rewards trip. Typically we stay at 4 and 5 star hotels, so I'm a bit spoiled. This trip is FREE, so you would think it would be fine. Nope... I wish I had stayed home. The property is tired. The rooms are shabby and feel dirty. It's like they stuck a bunch of doors in where they don't belong. Example our closet doors are old sliding glass doors. The power goes off periodically. The sinks don't drain. Light bulbs are burned out... etc. this is our second room. The first room had too many issues to count but a non-working safe was the final straw. The free food is terrible. It's all very bland and unappealing. The salt and pepper shakers are all clogged so you can't even season it. Nothing tastes like it should... it taste like fake chicken and fake burgers. All the breads are stale. The omelet guy can't make an omelet.... just BAD! The best thing I've eaten is mac and cheese which taste like kraft. I like kraft so that is good. Ordering that for dinner tonight. The beach is pretty but no security from the locals trying to sell JUNK. Sat at the pool today to avoid them but there is no breeze so came back to the room. Our group consists of nice Americans who are well dressed. The other guests here are mostly disgusting and covered in tattoos. There are tons of children and our group is all adult. They had three weddings yesterday which were all competing with their music. Kind of sad for the brides. The one nice thing I can say is that the staff is amazing and could not be nicer. I feel bad trashing the place because the people are so wonderful. That being said... I would feel bad if I did not warn people to avoid this resort. That is, unless you are looking for a cheap cruise like, spring break experience. I'm clicking my heels... "There's no place like home!"

reviews.author: DgJedi
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
The reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is your best option!  Excellent attention, best staff ever! Drinks and music at the beach bar were much fun, make our stay best ever, Pedro, Jairo, Ramon, Santos do there best to make your stay the best!
Kids had so much fun they didn’t want to go back. 

Excelente people! Best staff !

Way to go Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Grolche
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation
reviews.text: What a beautiful stay with my family and my friends. I have been here for a few times already and the people are really great! The day activities are amazing, I love to do zumba, paddle board and painting. I love the entertainment staff especially Luis, Angel, Nixon, Antonio, Reynaldo, Looky Looky, Francisco, Pamela, Raphyel, Benjamin and yubi. Those people made my stay incredible!

reviews.author: Ali G
reviews.title: Beautiful place but has some issues
reviews.text:
Pros: it’s beautiful. Rooms are nice. You can walk everywhere you need to go. It’s nice when workers (Nixon) will just sit and talk with you! 
Cons: power went off twice a day. On two separate occasions out of the 3 1/2 days I was there we did not have cold water. Safe was broken and after six different workers and a few hours of our time lost, it still was not fixed. Heard complaints about room service. THERE ARE NO WAITERS AT POOL AREA! 
I only got to experience the buffet and the Japanese restaurant which were good. But food during our convention was not—- steak was grey/over cooked and lobster tail was so over cooked I had a hard time cutting it with a knife! 
I stayed at the resort next door for the first part of the week which was much better in my opinion at half the price.

reviews.author: Downunderman
reviews.title: Family vacation - lovely trip
reviews.text:
Stayed here with my wife and 3 kids (6,4,1) in April for a week.  The Reserve is a more exclusive part of a larger resort, Paradisus.  You have access to everything the Paradisus Punta Cana resort has + a few more bolt on (eg nicer private pool + additional restaurant + better bigger rooms).

All in all - we had a great time.  We had been staying at the Iberostar Bavaro Suites for 4 nights before staying here.  We were so happy to switch over.

PROS: 1. Rooms are good size (we had a family master suite and it was plenty large enough).  Rooms were clean.  Some of the furniture could probably use an update.   2.  Property/Gardens:  Lovely.   3.  Transit to the beach from The Reserve - worked fine.   4.  Staff - for the most part, all very friendly   5.  Beach - nice + good service eg drinks.

FOOD -  all in all it was good.  We tried a different restaurant each night, some were better than others.  The breakfast is fairly repetitive but still nice.  I personally think they could do a bit more variety on the lunch menus.

We didn't opt for the Family concierge service - didn't see any point.  We didn't have any problem getting a sun bed.  Maybe if the resort is packed, it would be worth it but the week we were there this was clearly not needed.  Saved ourselves $100 a day.

All in all, we got what we paid for.  Thanks

reviews.author: SKK710
reviews.title: Amazing trip with my husband!
reviews.text: We had a great time time! Everything was excellent from service to food. Antoni was awesome and treated us very well. Grounds were very clean and kept up. The staff was very polite and made sure we were always okay and had everything and anything we needed.

reviews.author: GMAKFAR
reviews.title: all-inclusive paradise
reviews.text:
This was a last-minute booking via Costco Travel and we had a great time! Trip was very smooth. Followed instructions in the travel confirmation and transfer was ready and very good both ways (I did make sure to confirm our departure transfer at the Blue Travel Services desk in the main lobby).  Check in was easy (we had booked Reserve) and we were by the pool in almost no time.  The room was spacious, clean and very comfortable.  We had a suite in Building 36 which had a wet bar, dining area, sitting area with 3 sofas, a credenza and large screen TV.  Balcony had 2 chairs and faced out to a path with trees, flowers, shrubs, etc.  We had a king size bed in the bedroom, a huge jacuzzi bathtub with dual vanity and then a separate bathroom with toilet, nice shower and vanity.

PROS
pool area
food at buffet
friendly people
special callouts to Kiki (Antoni Santana) and JJ (Jose Jones)
beach!!
all inclusive quality (Johnny Walker Black scotch standard)
weather
landscaping

CONS
theme restaurants not worth the reservations (Passion service was very good, food was OK but not up to hype)
lots of families/kids - we didn't mind but if you want adults only, this isn't it

reviews.author: btjk35
reviews.title: excellent vacation
reviews.text: This was my first trip to DR and it was the best vacation.  The room was great, the staff was excellent.  The food was very good.  The staff was so friendly and eager to serve They were there for every question and need we had.  The beach was beautiful - a paradise.  The beach bar staff was so nice and quick with a towel and drink. The pool swim up bars were fun.  We went the beach in the AM and used the pools in the afternoon.  It was such a great time.  The beach was about a 10 minute walk which we loved to walk thru the beautiful gardens.

reviews.author: StuSarni
reviews.title: Spring Break 2018
reviews.text: Shout out to GEORGE ALRICHE at the Reserve beach for taking such excellent care of out group during our stay last week.  He was very attentive and had water and drinks ready for us without us even asking.  George made out stay at Paradisus Palma one that won't be forgotten.

reviews.author: Karina Dutra Franzese
reviews.title: Viagem em Família
reviews.text:
Passamos uma semana no Hotel e voltei de fato encantada .
Nossa estada foi excelente ! Desde a recepção com Sr. Miguel que foi extremamente receptivo e atencioso . 
Comida excelente e com muita opção , se ficar no Reserve ainda tem uma seleção de restaurantes excelentes que podemos reservar pra o jantar ! Todos muito bons , mas recomendo que não faça reserva próximo ao horário de encerramento porque nota-se uma movimentação para que o jantar corra mais rápido . 
Importante ter desde o primeiro dia contato com sua Conciege que cuidará de todas suas reservas e sua programação , pegamos uma excelente que além de marcar nossos jantares , ainda foi extremamente gentil enfeitando todo restaurante e meu quarto  , já que estava comemorando meu aniversário , de uma gentileza ímpar , super recomendo Keren Morel .
Possui um kidszone super bacana e bem equipado . 
Povo extremamente receptivo , mas funcionam sempre melhor com uma “propina” , mesmo dentro do hotel , sendo all inclusive , vc dando uma gratificação tudo flui mais rápido .
Dica é pedir para ficar nos quartos térreos , estão melhor conservados e possuem vista para jardim ou piscina , na medida ! 
Lugar para descansar e comer bem , muito bem , paraíso !!! 
Todas as noites tem shows bacanas , música boa e uma equipe composta dentre outros pelo Alejandro que dão o toque todo especial . 
Certamente voltaremos !!

reviews.author: Paradise768290
reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text:
First trip, joined family on their second visit. Delightful space. Honored to know Paula J, Melissa R, Wally, Jose, Vander and Melanie whose gracious hospitality are a credit to the resort.

Virtually every staff member went out of their way to be welcoming, helpful and thoroughly professional.

A nice variety of dining venues and entertainment. Loved the beach party,  saxophone, violin and vocal soloists.

Fresh Market is tops for lunch.

Will be back

reviews.author: Cristina S
reviews.title: servicio
reviews.text: El hotel está muy bien. falta de información de las actividades y espectáculos. los restaurantes excelentes de muy buena calidad. El personal del hotel muy atento, en especial Jesus Avelino el camarero de la piscina muy bien profesional

reviews.author: Kentrosi
reviews.title: Good First All Inc Experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Real with the Royal Service upgrade. This was our first all inclusive experience so I made sure to review Trip Advisor and the tipping advice q/a thread. 

The room was excellent! I travel for a living and I am very picky about hotel rooms. I was not disappointed. 

The check in process could use some serious modification. If you have Royal service, you have to go to a different check in and it takes about a half hour. 

With Royal Service, you are assigned a butler. This butler is supposed to wait on you, book reservations, and be there for you. Our butler, Angel, was basically useless. He texted us in the morning saying we would get together after breakfast...we never heard from him for the rest of the day. This happened every day. He never called to ask if we needed anything or check in on us. Some of my colleagues got way better butler service. And this was not for lack of tipping...I would have provided a tip when I met him, if we ever met him. 

Tipping: so I realize this is an all inclusive resort and tipping is not required. I read a Trip Advisor review that stated, if you want to be treated like a rock star, leave $2 a day for the maid, $2 for the mini fridge restocker, and have a dollar bill in your hand at the bars. This was excellent advice. I look at it as $10 per day for extraordinary service opposed to ordinary island-type service (slow). 

Booze: I would have enjoyed, and payed extra, for upgraded alcohol. The cheap wine and mixed drinks give me a hangover. We did buy a bottle at the well-stocked wine store, but the free wine and free drinks were very bottom shelf. Also it would be great to have more of a beer selection than just Presidente.  

The beaches are beautiful. We had no issue finding an available grass hut thingy to hang out under with the assistance of a beach attendant (and yes, I gave him $2). When he brought us a round of pina coladas, I tipped him another dollar. Never had to worry about getting up to get drinks on the beach. 

All of the food was decent. Nothing that great. The buffet had a fabulous selection of everything you can think of. The food was nothing special. We ate at Rare one night. The NY steak was excellent! Probably the best meal I had while there. We had room service for breakfast every morning. Again...decent. 

I would recommend Paradisus Real for the price. It seems the butler service is hit or miss so it may not be worth upgrading to Royal Service. I may look at other places that may have a more top shelf alcohol for my next all inclusive experience.

reviews.author: dolly152015
reviews.title: Royal Service and wonderful staff
reviews.text:
We stayed here with family and friends for a wedding. I would highly recommend the Royal Service! Our butler was Faustino and he was always so kind and helpful. On our first night he had gone ahead and made dinner reservations for us, which was amazing after a 10 hour flight! 
 It was also relaxing to have a bit of a sleep in and have a lazy breakfast knowing we already had our lovely Bali bed reserved. Faustino also helped us sort out our return to the airport by contacting our travel company ( they had not come to the hotel as scheduled) and with possible strikes at home it was great to have someone help us get the answers and take away the stress we were starting to feel. 

Faustino also arranged our morning of kayaking, all we had to do was show up. It was the same for dinner reservations, everything was always taken care of as per our request. We’ve stayed at some resorts where half our morning has been spent on the phone trying to make dinner reservations.
I have to also give a big thank you to Martin! What a nice man, full of smiles every morning and was always checking that we were ok throughout the day! 

The hotel is very nice, was not too crazy on the buffet, but loved the Palazzo restaurant that’s exclusive to the royal service. The other restaurants were fine, but found them to be very busy and loud. The only exception was Passion, service was impeccable and ambiance was very nice. 

The beach is gorgeous and the water is so warm. One thing that really stood out to us was the vendors along the beach, always so polite and never pushy!! 
In speaking with one of the bartenders (Lee, who was also such a nice man), he was explaining that is how the Dominican people are, always happy, kind and full of smiles. I really can’t say enough about the people as I feel they are the ones that made the vacation so enjoyable! 
If you are looking for more of a tranquil vacation then the Royal service is a must.

reviews.author: klipp810
reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text:
We have vacationed in Punta Cana many times. The Reserve at Paradisus is the best hotel we have experienced here. We will certainly use it exclusively in the future. There are a great many resorts here. I have never had a bad experience in DR, but there is a “sameness” among the resorts that I have noticed. Paradisus and The Reserve are clearly better than most. 
But first: The shout outs to the people who made our vacation extra special: The staff of The Reserve:
Paula Jiminez and Melissa Rodriguez were EXCELLENT concierges in Building 39. Very helpful, professional, efficient, always there to help, never in the way.
Alexandra was our day housekeeper and she was so wonderful-we 
loved her.
Wander Roja and Jose Reinosa and Jonathan were so great at the pool. And Naomi was at the pool too and she is always so friendly and cheerful. They made our vacation special. 
The grounds are more beautiful than other Punta Cana resorts. By a big margin. The food is a little better than elsewhere. The pools are prettier and more relaxing. 
The Reserve is an add-on area sheltered from the main resort. It’s a little more expensive, and totally worth it if you can swing it. 
The concierges are delightful and efficient. Paula and Melissa made our dinner reservations, coordinated the excursions, filled us in on little tricks about making our vacation even more fun.The rooms at Reserve are bigger. The Reserve Pools are even more beautiful then the main resorts pools-which is quite saying something. 
The service here is great-as it always is in DR. Friendly, unobtrusive,  not snooty at all. The people in this country are warm and helpful, and they are very proud of the resorts-deservedly so. 
The beach and the weather are really nice- as always in Punta Cana.
If I have to find some items for Melia to work on it would be these:
The nightly “Animation” or entertainment show at Paradisus Punta Cana is a little weaker than some of the other resorts.
The performers (like all the resort performance staff in Punta Cana) are game and earnest and delightful. The room Melia set aside is inadequate. This resort deserves a real theater, with better seating, better lighting. The Cast members deserve better costumes, and a bigger budget. The nightly “animation” is an important part of the DR vacation experience (There is ALWAYS a Michael Jackson night). This beautiful resort needs to bring its animation budget and resources into line with the rest of the property.

On this trip, for the first time, a staffer approached me for an off site Melia club membership/time share pitch. I declined-not my thing. The pitch came very early in our stay, and of course the fellow who they sent was perfectly nice. But I just paid them a bunch, I am here on a few precious vacation days and the absolute last thing I want is to be trapped in a time share pitch that I am too polite to get out of. I managed to get the young fellow to sort of leave us alone and we DID NOT go to the “presentation”. I strongly advise you to follow my lead. I thought it was tacky to set me up for a hard pitch after I already paid a good amount to get some peace and quiet. The whole thing was totally manageable, but a surprise. And I hope it doesn’t represent a trend. 
But overall my experience was really quite positive. And now, after many years of coming to Punta Cana, I finally have a resort that I am looking forward to coming back too. 
If you book here, I think you will have a super fun time!

reviews.author: tremblaytd
reviews.title: Amazing beaches, nice resort and friendly staff
reviews.text: This was a great resort.  Very clean and lots of things to do.  The beach was beautiful.  The staff were incredibly nice.  Nixon was a great resort ambassador.  I would highly recommend a stay here anytime and will hopefully be returning soon!

reviews.author: Kelly N
reviews.title: It's ok, would rather stay at the Paradisus (same property) instead of the Reserve
reviews.text:
We just came back from Punta Cana (April 2018). This is our 3rd times in Punta Cana and we always booked 2 different resorts per trip. This time, we stayed at the Secret Royal resort for 3 nights and the Reserve at Paradisus for 3 nights. This is our second time at the Secret Royal resort and it's still a 5-star. We enjoyed our experience at the Reserve, but here are the reasons to why I give it only 3-star. 
   1. When staying at the Reserve, you also have access to the Paradisus pools and restaurants, but not the other way around because it costs more to stay at the Reserve. Both properties have beautiful pools and lazy rivers, but sadly they are too deep...roughly 4.75 ft deep. My boyfriend is 5'-7" and the water comes to his chin. For anyone who is less than 5'-7", you would not be able to enjoy the pool unless you can really swim. I can swim a little bit, but I need to be able to stand in the pool. They are both kid friendly resorts, but their pools are not ideal. They do have 2 kid pools, but they are tiny. Short adults with no kids would not want to hang out in the kid pools.
   2. Food and drinks are not allowed around the pool. I've been to many different resorts and this is the first resort that doesn't allow food and drinks around the pool. 
   3. We booked the Reserve because of the high rating, but we spent more time at the Paradisus because the Reserve is a 10 mins walk from the beach (or take the shuttle), food selection is limited at the Reserve since less people stay there in comparing to the Paradisus, and they have the same food. We thought since the Reserve costs more, they may have better food, but the Paradisus has lobster, steak, etc. just like the Reserve. The food is really good. The point is we would rather stay at the Paradisus and pay less.
   4. The Reserve is a newer property, but walking around the building at night is gloomy/low light level. Not many people around makes it feel a little creepy. 
   5. May not apply to every room, but the shower in the room that we stayed did not drain very well due to the improper slope of the floor to drain the water.

reviews.author: Anna V
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus was exceptionally good. The beach, restaurant, animation, entertainment and people there kept us in warm and friendly atmosphere. Especially, I want to note Jose Capuchino. This guy is amazing, speaks Russian (what helped us a lot) and made our vacation the dream vocation. Thanks!

reviews.author: Pee P
reviews.title: Great Dominican Activity
reviews.text:
I participated in most of the activities by the pool and they were amazing. What made these activities amazing was due to Jose Cappuccino. He’s kind, welcoming, funny, energetic, amazing with kids, and in general fun to be with! I love his story and his hard work! He truly is amazing! 

great time at the party with Jose!

reviews.author: Catherine G
reviews.title: the best painting class ever!
reviews.text: Jose cappuccino led the best painting class i’ve ever been too, he is the most entertaining person i’ve ever met! He awesome! If anyone decides to stay at this resort, Jose is one of the nicest guys you will meet here. The food is very good and the service at Paradisus is the best. This is my second time here and i would definitely come again.

reviews.author: Lauren V
reviews.title: Wedding/family vacation
reviews.text: This resort is amazing. The grounds are immaculate, the staff is beyond accomidating and friendly. Jonathan and Jose at the reserve pool are wonderful and made sure no one had an empty drink.  Sofia our family concierge made sure our kids had a blast. Overall this resort is by far the best we've been to and would definitely come back in the future. Would highly highly recommend for a destination wedding. They did everything and it was gorgeous.

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Rest and Relaxation
reviews.text: We arrived to a very beautiful scenery - the landscaping was so manicured.  The rooms were so clean and comfortable.  The staff was very helpful in directing us on where we needed to go. We had housekeeping twice a day.  Our drink replenisher John Juan made special efforts to make sure we had special drinks for my husband - at the end of our trip their supervisor came to our door at 830pm to do a survey and check how our stay was - which is impressive - face to face service

reviews.author: littleginny
reviews.title: Pool Entertainment, Nixon -great guy and entertainer.
reviews.text:
I am reviewing the pool entertainment which Nixon and other staff members worked very hard to make sure it was a fun trip. The resort review will be on another post since there were a few things that need improvement. But as for Nixon, Angel, and Rafael -I give them 5 stars. 
Had a dance class with Nixon and Angel-lots of fun. Also the Class on Dominican culture and history given by Nixon and Rafael was also very interesting. These entertainers do a good job keeping you busy if you want to be. Also did a paddle board yoga in the pool with Franklin, Kevin and one other staff member. Very good and loved the set up of all the boards being tied up for stability. Genius!!

reviews.author: G3PO
reviews.title: The Reserve vs Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I was confused by the two Paradisus properties in Punta Cana, so make sure you book the right one! There are two...Paradisus Punta Cana and Paradisus Palma Real. Both have a Reserve section which shows up like a separate hotel here on TripAdvisor but they are just a separate section of the main property. We stayed at the Reserve at Palma Real because it has the golf course, but it was not free! Cart fees range from 40 to 75 US and were mandatory. We did spend most of the day at the main property. It has the beach, big pool, more entertainment. Beautiful like the pictures. Paddle board class was a must!

reviews.author: Stephanie S
reviews.title: Banker's Life Convention
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying at the Paradisus Hotel in Dominican Republic! The rooms were beautiful and service was wonderful! I want to recognize Dalvin Feliz who showed so much compassion and concern for out experience at the resort.  He was very personable , genuine, and eager to ensure we were happy with our stay.  We will definitely be returning to this resort on our next visit!

reviews.author: 988pedrod
reviews.title: Reencuentro amigos
reviews.text:
si buscas un all inclusive un poco más tranquilo y exclusivo este es el lugar.  Nosotros éramos 10 y nos asignaron a una persona de Guest Service, Carlos Sulca que nos atendió de maravilla.  Es importante que alguien te ayude con los datos del hotel de acuerdo a lo que quieran hacer para sacarle provecho.
La comida es bastante buena y hay varias opciones de restaurantes.
El hotel es grande y tienes carritos que te llevan a tosas partes.  Para que no se demoren es bueno avisar al concierge o cualquier persona del hotel que pueda notificar que esperas el servicio.  Así no esperas casi nada.
En el gym, David Contreras da la mejor clase de spinning.  Además  tienen algunas trotadoras y otras máquinas para ejercitarse.
En la playa Ramón Ramírez y Santos te atienden con un buen humor envidiable.
Las habitaciones son cómodas y están bien mantenidas.  En general bastante recomendable.

reviews.author: corinne c
reviews.title: Vacances à la réserve de l’hôtel Melia paradisus Punta Cana du 6 au 16 avril 2018
reviews.text:
Bonjour 
C’est la 10ème année consécutive que je passe des vacances dans cet hôtel puisque je suis membre et de puis l année dernière membre Circle 
Les années achetées ne sont pas revendables contrairement à ce que l’on m’avait annoncé 
Même si cette formule a des avantages elle me semble complexe et mal expliquée surtout aux francophones 
Cependant l’hôtel et les prestations sont très bonnes 
Il n’y a pas beaucoup de personnel francophone ce qui est parfois compliqué 
Le souci le plus penible ce sont les clés (cartes magnétiques) qui ne fonctionnent qu’une fois sur 10
Il faut donc aller à la conciergerie faire remagnétiser sa carte plusieurs fois par jour et ça peut rendre dingo 
Le personnel est très agréable et aux petits soins
Surtout Georges sur la plage qui est particulièrement adorable et attentionné ainsi que Wilson au bar de la Réserve 
Ce sont de magnifiques vacances à chaque fois, de belles prestations de jolis spectacles et un jardin paradisiaque

reviews.author: Sossa71
reviews.title: 7 days at The Reserve at paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
It was an amazing trip we felt so comfortable and relaxed from day one as soon as we arrived we were treated like royalty ...everything is so perfect about paradisus , I will never go to another resort . we were so happy and impressed by the super friendly staffing , room services , the foods are amazing and the entertainment super nice . You feel like you wanna live here for ever . 

The beach so nice and clean the staffing there super friendly and entertaining , Ramon Ramirez really humble and friendly guy , I mean this guy make you feel like family and also santos frias super nice guy and always looking after us for what ever we need , at paradisus their staff are amazing and always acting professionally and making you feel like at home , any where at this resort you feel comfortable and satisfied.
Will be back soon guys :)) I would rate them at six stars ! definitely they deserve it

reviews.author: Phoebe C
reviews.title: Happy memories with my baby
reviews.text:
Overall, we were happy because my 10.5 months old baby was all happy and healthy in the resort.  It was his very first trip I did a lot of research before I booked this place, his health is my priority, then facilities for fun and rest, I think they delivered!  We upgrade to stay at the reserve with family concierge, it's very convenience because we can whatsapp him with anything we need, including booking the restaurants and cabana.

Highlight: 
-We had a family photo session beside the beach, the photos are spectacular! They are beautiful under the sun with the turquoise color water.  Mario is a talented guy, he captured the very first fun time my baby had on the beach.  Elvis, who booked and assisted us during the session, was so friendly and helpful, I couldn't thank her enough!  I highly recommend doing this to keep the memory of whatever age your child is.  They have a booth right beside Naos.  It won’t be missed because you will come across someone promoting it around the resort for sure. 

Pros:
-This is a very beautiful resort, day and night.  With all the lighting decorations around the cabanas, it's very cool to chill beside the beach at night.  Beautiful and clean beside the pool at all time as we have seen in photos. 
-It's full of entertainment every night.  The live music beside the beach was romantic, we enjoyed it on the beach cabana at night, baby got to sleep with the warm sea breeze, we got a moment to drink and relax.  The beach party was fun and energetic, with people dressed up that wowed me, we enjoyed watching it at Gabi beach while having buffet. There are shows at night, I only made it to The King of Pop.  Tip with baby is you can watch it outside, the glass is clear enough for you to see it, music is not that loud and you got comfy chairs outside too.  
-Food are clean and choices are plenty.  We all enjoyed the food, including my baby.  My baby ate some fruits, boiled eggs, pancakes etc. I’m glad he was fine with the food the whole time.  I saw other babies eating all sorts of food too, no food hygiene issue is a big check mark.  The Gabi beach has a view beside the sea, it’s amazing to have breakfast there.  The Gabi club is in the reserve beside the pool, it’s very relaxing.  Only thing is there were a lot of flies in Gabi club, I’ve to drive them away all the time when I had breakfast there, it’s annoying.
-A few outstanding restaurants.  We enjoyed The Grill, which offered good steak and chilled lobsters as buffet appetizer!  I love the corn soup there.  I am giving Passion solid 6 stars!  It’s no kidding a taste of Michelin stars earned dishes, from welcome champagne, bread and butter, to dessert with a rose, every detail and service are top notch, I was aroused by the delicious food there.  It’s rare that a resort includes such an option for dining, I appreciate they have it.  Vento also have good food, but not all of them are.  The rack of lamb was juicy and off the bone soft, the beef was tough and dried.  I also love the potato soup and lobster bisque there. 
-Special care for family.  We did not regret an upgrade to family concierge.  Our family concierge Yarol was very nice and patient.  He followed up with everything, easy to get ahold of, no matter what time he replied to our messages.  He provided a bottle sterilizer just like the one we have at home.  He gave me the bottle warmer and microwave as well.  Anything we need for the baby they have it for us.  When we decided to book a cabana (pool or beach side) we just text him at night, he got it done for us the next morning.  No time concern for booking the restaurant either, anytime we decide, just let him know.  He visited us in person everyday to make sure things are all fine with us, somehow, he was able to locate us no matter in pool or on beach. 
-Lots of day time activities. One day I joined the paddle board yoga, fitness, and surfing in the reserve pool.  It’s so much fun! I like Fraddy who lead the classes, he made us laugh and healthy!  That’s the most relaxing yoga I’ve ever had: in the natural hot environment instead of a dark room, floating on the board with access to cool pool water anytime, gazing at the blue sky with palm trees as decorations.  His assistant beside working as team to ensure safety.  Baby joined us for the Dominican culture, they put in effort to do a dancing show for us, a small group beside the reserve pool.  They offered cultural fruits and mamajuana, they tasted good.  I got a chance to try rolling cigar too.  With a baby, I got to do all these because of a pool side cabana and a husband, it was a no stress fun day.  Ask the concierge sitting in villa lobby to print you a weekly schedule, it’s easier on paper to track the time and location as there are painting class, beach yoga etc etc, so many activities at either the reserve pool or the gabi beach or pool.  
-Plenty of cabana beside the beach and pool.  This is essential to us because we have a baby, he’s in a sleep, eat, play cycle.  And he has to be under the shade, even he has sun screen on he can’t be exposed for hours.  We managed to let him sleep for hours with the warm sea breeze gently blowing into the cabana.  These cabanas for reserved are all covered with palapas, the whole big beds are under the shade for sure.  There are staff bringing us drinks from time to time.  It also very close to the buffet so we can eat anytime: cabana beside the reserve pool was close to the gabi club buffet, the kids pool area is the other end so it’s further from the gabi club, it just takes one more min walk.  The reserve cabana area on beach was beside the Royal Service area, then the Palapa and Galbi beach buffet, a bit of a walk on sand, but still not far to get food. 
-Unlimited clean towels.  We can get as many towels as we need at the hut, the towel lady beside reserve pool is very nice to kids.  The towels are thick, warm, and clean. 

Cons:
-The cabana reservation system sucks!  On first day I was there before 10am. After breakfast with baby we went back and the cabana was stolen!  My baby needed a shade, it’s stressful for me to run around to get the right person to told me a different rule than my family concierge that I couldn’t leave for 1 hour.  It was upsetting because we needed a cabana to keep my baby under shade.  Other sun beds won’t provide full shades. Then I learnt that I have to leave personal properties there, even it could be stolen, so I have to find invaluable personal properties, which was a bit hard while I’m on a trip, I only have essential stuff with me.  Another day we booked the beach cabana, we had to wake at 8am to feed and change baby and put sun screen all over him before we step out.  For sure we need to wait for the shuttle cart while we are in rush, and for sure the shuttle had to go around and stop at all other places before it arrived the Gabi beach and asked us to walk over because it won’t go to our reserve beach.  When we were there we were told that it was 7 minutes late so we don’t have a cabana!  Somehow, they found a collapsing crappy one at the back corner for us and there you go. It was a lot of stress to get a cabana in most mornings.  We are coming to relax, everyday should be imitating Sundays, I deserve brunch, and then pool or beach time, relax.  But no, I was damn stressed in most mornings, especially trying to get to the beach on time.  I think the reservation should last till 11:30am.  It’s been reserve, me being there at 10 or 11:30am is the same it’ll be occupied anyways, so way make me stress!? Especially we have to travel to the beach.  The reserve pool I can still make it happen before 10am.  The beach, no, I can’t get everything packed and tend to baby and have breakfast and be there before 10am sharp!  This rule sucks, I hated it so much!
-Again, hotels’ problem. How come there were no crib mattress?  There are plenty of babies there, I wonder how other babies sleep if they don’t have proper mattress.  I was told they don’t, so the first day was lots of back and forth for them to try make a bed out of bed sheets in crib. But they are against safety standards, all bumpy and loose. At the end Ana, don’t know how, found a proper mattress for us so our baby can sleep properly.  I couldn’t thank her enough.  So, the hotel should stock up on crib mattresses, I don’t want to spend the first whole day to deal with it without able to rest.
-The room was small, I can hardly walk with a crib inside. I bumped around and bruised myself.  The room was old, lots of problems to be fixed.  It’s clean though. Just breaking down.  The sound insulation wasn’t good, I heard the baby cried next door every day. 

Special thanks to:
Yarol Rijo, my family concierge, he’s a gentle and polite person as described above.
Wally, our first amigo there at Gabi club, he has the most sincere warm smile and he worked very hard serving!
Johnathan at reserve pool, he helped me while my hands were full with baby and stroller, he is a happy helpful person.
Fraddy who taught paddle board fitness, yoga, and surfing. I liked his classes! He’s cool.
Freddy who brought food to room service.
Ana the room service supervisor lady, she worked so hard in making my crib mattress happen, without her baby had nothing to sleep on.
Santos Frias at the reserve beach, he’s a funny guy, I like his big smile during the day.
Francesco Ramerec at the reserve reception, he was very polite and patient when I told him all the problems with my room the first day.
I can’t remember all the names with everyone who served, helped, worked there because most are them are great, those who worked at the bar, the buffet, the towel collector at beach who worked very hard under the sun, the cleaning team in green uniforms (the beach is very clean thanks to their hard work), even they are not named here they deserve gratitude from Paradisus.

reviews.author: SCOB
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise
reviews.text:
My recent stay at Paradisus was amazing. I highly recommend anyone looking for a relaxing, upscale (yet affordable) getaway to consider this resort. The service is absolutely REMARKABLE - I’ve been to several resorts in the area & in the Caribbean & by far this was one of the best experiences. Standout personnel: Reynold in activities, Eliezer Rodriguez the pool bartender, Felix de Jesus at the Gabi club, and ESPECIALLY our concierge at the Reserve, Brian Aracena - what an amazing soul!! These individuals went above and beyond and exceeded our expectations to always accommodate us during our stay. We were ALWAYS greeted with a smile & felt very welcome by all. Customer service is of upmost importance to me while staying far from home & I couldn’t have been more pleased.

One thing, if you’re single & looking to party/mingle, I don’t recommend this resort as it is more of a relaxing, calm place where you & your family can take in the sun & waves & enjoy good food/drinks. 

The gastronomy was spectacular with lots of variety to choose from. The drinks were delicious! The suite was always clean, very nice & modern! Overall, it was a great experience. Only reason I don’t give it the 5 rating is because they lacked in the entertainment department as far as the shows & club at night, but overall...I HIGHLY recommend Paradisus to anyone looking to visit the DR!

reviews.author: Lynn N
reviews.title: Pure paradise
reviews.text: We just returned from our stay at the Reserve. The oceanfront room exceeded our expectations. The view was breathtaking. The property is impeccably maintained. The beach is so clean and organized. The staff is so welcoming and friendly all the time. Special thanks to some very special people who made our stay memorable - Jose Ramos (restaurants) and Fermin our concierge. Thanks to the management who keep it going!

reviews.author: mnh_mi
reviews.title: Consistently exceeded our expectations!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just returned from a 7 night stay at The Reserve. When we booked, we did not realize there are 3 resorts on the Paradisus property: Paradisus, The Reserve at Paradisus (more for families) and Royal Service (adults only). While just the two of us were traveling, we were glad that we ended up at The Reserve as we enjoyed all that it had to offer and had access to everything else on property except the areas exclusive to Royal Service. Our room was large and more than 2 people needed but fantastic nonetheless -- jacuzzi tub and patio included. During our stay, there was no problem finding space on The Reserve beach no matter what time of day. The Paradisus beach also had more than ample space, if we'd chosen to relax there. We had massages on the beach which were incredible and the view of the turquoise water never disappoints! The beach front was also very well kept -- little seaweed (no smell!!), no shells, trash or any washed up critters. Probably one of the most noteworthy points: THE PINA COLADAS ARE MADE FROM SCRATCH WITH FRESH PINEAPPLE AND PINEAPPLE JUICE THAT THEY MAKE THEMSELVES. I thought I'd died and gone to heaven -- how could this be?! None of the drinks were made in batch ahead of time -- even the daiquiris are made with fresh fruit. 

The grounds of the entire resort are pristine. You will never see a leaf on the grass or a piece of rogue trash; the staff work tirelessly throughout the day to keep up with all of it. If it rained, the staff was out there the second it stopped to get things cleaned up as quickly as possible.The Paradisus lobby is INCREDIBLE as it includes a beautiful pond with greenery and flamingos. That's right -- real, live flamingos. 

Food can be a crapshoot at some all-inclusive resorts but we were thoroughly pleased with all of the options and every meal we ate at every restaurant. All restaurants are included except La Palapa (Royal Service only) and Passion. Breakfast was great at either Gabi Club or Gabi Beach with made-to-order eggs/omelettes and smoothies. Gabi Beach has a bigger selection but we noticed the service was slower there as it became more crowded. Naos also offers a great selection. The staff at Bana (hibachi) were very accommodating to our dietary restrictions and asked up front if we had any allergies. Chef Alejandro was most entertaining! Aqua provides beautiful scenery at night if you can sit outside -- though you may be subject to a plethora of mosquitos. And the Hydro Grill at the Reserve pool was really excellent for lunch or pool side snacking. 

Nightly events were more fun and entertaining than expected. The Gabi Beach Party was actually really well done and so easy for anyone to have fun from age 5 to 75! 

The Reserve also provided us with our own Concierge (Frankily Castillo!!) who checked in with us daily to accommodate our every need - that was so helpful and appreciated. He made all of our dinner reservations (this is highly recommended) and answered all of our questions, big or small.  Thank you, Frankily! 

The staff in general is very friendly and helpful. We enjoyed workouts with Rey and Naomi...the rock climbing wall with Miguel...and naturally, drinks and conversation at the Reserve swim-up bar and inside Gabi Club with Jesus and Jose! 

One bit of advice: be sure to pack more than enough sunscreen...we ran out and had to pay $29 USD for one can of Banana Boat 50 SPF. Regular size that would cost $7 at Target. Point being: the gift shop is VERY expensive. 

And lastly, it was suggested to download the Melia app so we could check the restaurant menus and exercise schedules, but they were never right or consistent with the information we received if we asked the staff. This became a point of frustration so I finally gave up on trying to attend exercise classes and just went to the gym (which is lovely). 

We walked the beach daily a good 30 minutes in either direction and I have to say, we didn't see one other resort or beach front that appealed to us more than Paradisus. Really looking forward to next time!!!

reviews.author: Elvis H
reviews.title: Great service.
reviews.text: A big Thank you to all the staff at this resort. Special thanks to Raul Jimenez because He took care of us by the pool. He always had cold beverages for us at all times. Another big thanks to Felipe Mayi for cooking us a special dinner for my wife’s birthday. See you guys soon.

reviews.author: Joselyn T
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: Thank you to all the staff that treaded us like celebrities. Special thanks to Raul Jimenez, our pool guy, who took extra care to make sure our two children were having fun and, always had cold drinks for us at the pool. Also, special thanks to the staff at the Olio Restaurant. Specifically to Felipe Mayi, who came in early to cook us a traditional Dominican lunch. Thank you from the Hernandez family.

reviews.author: Maria H
reviews.title: Pool service: Raul Jimenez
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Paradisus for 7 days and we were treated like royalty by Mr Raul Jimenez (our pool guy). Also, Mr Fernando from the beach area was very helpful. Moreover, the guys at the restaurant Olio, Felipe Mayi, Felix de la Cruz, and the kitchen staff made us a special dinner for us.Thank you for your service. We give this staff 20 Stars. We will see you next year.

reviews.author: seh501
reviews.title: Carlos Hinostroza was an AWESOME butler!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort on a beautiful beach! Loved the first class attention Carlos gave us! We asked for a bottle of chardonnay in the am and when we got back to our room at the end of the beach day it was there! We also enjoyed the cheese plate he sent and I truly enjoyed the warm bath that he drew for us with the beautiful fruit tray to go along with it!

reviews.author: suriel892018
reviews.title: peor resort
reviews.text: No vale lo que pagamos. El servicio estuvo pesimo y punto. Jamas recomendaria este hotel a nadie. Unoo asiste esos lugares para pasarla bien no para hacer mala sangre. Mi mama que sufre de asthma estaba en una habitacion donde apestaba a humedad y ella lo habia reportado varias veces y no se resolvio el problema

reviews.author: fmrswimr
reviews.title: George Alriche
reviews.text:
George made our trip!  He arranged our chairs, towels, and water at the beach so there were no concerns.  He greeted us every day with a huge smile and a new towel.
Find him in the reserve section of the beach and your trip will be even better!

George is fabulous!

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: EXCELLENT! Wonderful Relaxing hotel and probably the best in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We've just returned from 10day Easter Break and have to say that this hotel exceeded our expectations by lots and in some areas LOADS!

We stayed "Family Concierge" which is upgrade level and worth it, everything at The Reserve is higher class but Concierge takes that up another level. Special mention and thanks to Elaine - she was so helpful and willing to do anything to make our stay better even going to a local Pharamcy on our behalf. Many Many thanks for making our stay so relaxing. I'll add another thanks to Omar as well - the smiliest person you can meet who not only never seemed to go home but also again always willing to help with assistance or advice.

Its not all perfect - check in is a complete pain and very irritating when after 12hours travel and providing evidence from their own email of confirmation of booking (Id printed out the email to show them) being forced to produce the credit card actually used for booking is just nuts! Unpacking luggage in reception was the result.... I get that they need to prove it .. but its their own email .. how about just ask for passport like every other hotel in the world?

That saying once we'd had a nights sleep in the large comfortable room - beds EXCEPTIONALLY COMFY .. decor a little tired but far far better than most holiday hotels. Everything works as it should and the minibar refilled for free daily. The bed sheets also changed daily which was unexpected and very nice touch of class and quality.

Its an all inclusive resort and often that means the food on the running buffet is average at very best - not so here! 

(I'll do separate reviews for the on site restaurants we usedbut heres the general stuff)

Gabi Club (the buffet restaurant for the Reserve) very very VERY good breakfasts - lots of fresh food - all of it tasty - fresh omelettes excellent and perfectly made (you would think thats a given in a hotel - trust me it isnt!). The fresh fruit plentiful and as youd expect from a Carribbean hotel - tasted like it was picked yesterday! Coffee not great but tip... go to reception on the way to breakfast and use the Nespresso machine if you need a shot of good stuff with your breakfast!

Lunch and dinner here both good - a little repetative by the end of the holiday but thats why the other restaurants are there. I repeat myself though by saying that all the food was good and the location just lovely.

Pool - get a cabana - Elaine arranged ours and we kept it all week .. they are comfy and a great shelter from the sun. Otherwise Im afraid there's a scramble between 6:30am and by 7:30 all beds are gone. ... however theres lots down on the beach it just depends if you want to be close to your room and by the pool.

NOTE for those who havent been here before.... The Reserve is 400yrds from the Beach at the "top" of the complex. To get to the beach and also some of the restaurants you need (if you dont want a long walk) to use the golf carts and little train/bus that runs around constantly on its route. In the day time this isnt a problem as there seems to be lots but after dark the number of these collapses so plan ahead to get to a dinner reservation on time.

The whole complex (this and Paradisus) are spotless clean and the gardens beautifully kept. The beach is clean and tidy, well organised and beds are plentiful.

The bars and free drinks are really good! (aside even though the cocktails and spirits average 6 measures each we saw almost no drunken behaviour. Note on the bars Estefani in Gabi Club bar is an excellent barsteward making anything very quickly and with great skill - her Special Coffee is just mmmmmmmm (Dominican Coffee with lots of crushed ice.. tastes fab!). I drink Chivas Regal and Im not kidding when I say I was getting about 20% of a bottle with a single measure... excellent! makes UK look hilarious when you get home!

Note of caution for travellers - dont use the Scuba place on the beach ... its a sales office for somewhere else - they are unsafe! Have not got a clue about scuba! Possible never done it and just have a price list - no idea whats involved and have crazy idea of how long it takes to get places - Im guessing to try not to scare off punters ....if you want to scuba or go on excursions to Saona or Catalina suggest you contact Dressel Divers - see separate review - they are amazing!

Im trying here to write information for potential travellers to this resort - and the good news is that this is one of the very few all inclusive resorts that without question Id take my family back to without hesitation.

It really is VERY VERY good ... service fabulous - food good to better - pool lovely beach brilliant - drinks excellent  - over all GREAT FAMILY HOLIDAY!

reviews.author: cs5227
reviews.title: THE BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text:
This review is long overdue. We visited The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana in January 2018 and have nothing but great things to say. STRESS FREE - From check in to check out the customer service was amazing. 
Cheila Rodriguez and Yurandi went over and above at check in to accomodate our every request for a room and when we had noisy unruly guests in the next room they made sure to find us a better room, which worked well for us as we were there for 10 days. 
Chefs (Miguel Deano, thank you for the lunch you prepared us for the airport), and chef SIlverio are both numero uno. The food at the buffet was amazing and the made anything we asked for to our liking, can't beat that service. 
Jose Jones the buffet supervisor was always welcoming and very happy. Luis as well.
Silo Tavarez was our #bestwaiteratthebuffet. His service was so amazing the first time he served us, we picked him to be our waiter the rest of our stay as he is very attentive. By day 2 he knew exactly what our drinks were at each meal which impressed us. 

Since we had access to the Punta Cana side we visited the bar daily....reason being the following people just made it the best for us. Amazing service and perfect drinks. Juan Gomez the bar supervisor is by far the best. He is full of positive vibes and so friendly, with the biggest infectious smile at all times and oh yes the best dancer. GO JUAN!!! 
Pamela, Juana, Yeraldin, Miguelina Agustin, Alexis Nunez, you guys all rock and are the most fun and amazing bartenders:)
Raul Domingez made rock climbing a breeze for me (I'm afraid of heights), he was pretty awesome and helped me climb almost to the top. 
Jose Capuchino taught me the Merengue, thanks for you patience lol
Jose Jones, Jose De La Cruz.
Carlos at concierge went above and beyond and provided outstanding customer service from booking restaurants, to proving royal service/dinner at Passion.  
The restaurants are beautiful and the food and service was very good.
The resort (reserve) itself is very clean and comfortable. Room service is very quick and the food is fresh and hot.  We are looking forward to going back for November.

reviews.author: Mrlessley
reviews.title: Fantastic Spring Break
reviews.text:
My husband and I, along with our two teenage kids, vacationed in the Dominican Republic during spring break. We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort.

The trip was spectacular. We loved the resort…it was picture perfect. The beaches were a gorgeous white sand with crystal blue water, and lined with palm trees.  The pool areas were nice and the resort constantly had entertainment activities going on for the guests. The restaurants were great too but we were surprised by the limitation on lunch places. The market is the only thing open, although it does offer many options in a buffet style. 

The grounds on the property were meticulous and workers were constantly doing maintenance. My only complaint were the rooms could use a little updating. We stayed in a Junior Suite and several things did not work and the wear and tear on the room was noticeable. It was comfortable but could use some refreshing.

My family utilized the spa and it is incredible. It is something out of a magazine. The space is very quaint and peaceful. I highly recommend the spa.

The staff was so accommodating. Everyone was so nice and wanted your stay to be a pleasant as possible. We especially would like to thank Vladimir Rodriguez. He was our personal concierge. He made sure our trip was stress free. He handled all of our dinner arrangements for us and his recommendations were on par. He truly made the trip for us. 

Overall I would give this resort an A+. We plan to visit there again soon.

reviews.author: sani
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real( vs Paradisus Punta Cana)
reviews.text:
I was in Punta Cana with my 14 year old twin daughters the week of March 20-27th.  We have been in Punta Cana about 7 times and we always go back to the Paradisus Palma Real.  When I booked this holiday, I reserved  the Paradisus Punta Cana by mistake but I was able to transfer to the Palma Real at the end of our stay.

Paradisus Punta Cana

The Paradisus Punta Cana has a beautiful beach, the hotel grounds are immaculate and the food is average-good although the selection at Bana and Gabi Beach (Buffet) is limited.  The service at the restaurants was "hit and miss".  Unfortunately, the service  at Vento, the Grill and Mole was terrible. The gym facilities are good and Frank, the empoyee at the gym was very welcoming and helpful.  This is a very large resort and you need to take a shuttle to access the services.  Overall I would rate this hotel 3.8/5. 

Paradisus Palma Real

 We live in Canada, flew from Montreal and booked our holiday through Air Transat.  We wanted to transfer from the PPC to the Palma Real.  The rep of Air Transat at The PPC declined to help us.   He was more focused on selling tours.  Finally, I decided to take a taxi and go to the Palma Real to see what could be done about a transfer.
 
At the reception, we were greeted by Mr. Domingo Beltre, the guest service manager of the Palma Real. Mr. Beltre was the consummate professional, in other ways he was extraordinary!   He went out of his way to help us transfer to the Palma Real.  Air Transat needed to approve the transfer to the PPR and  as I didn't get any help from the AT reps, Mr. Beltre spent at least an hour on the phone with Air Transat trying to arrange a transfer.  Although the PPR was booked, Mr. Beltre was able to find us a room for the end of our stay in Punta Cana. While we were at the PPC, Mr. Beltre stayed in contact with me and he went as far as giving me his cell phone number so that I could contact him as needed.

When we moved to the Palma Real, Mr. Beltre was waiting at the reception for us and again, made sure that the room was ready shortly after our 9:00am arrival.  He accompanied us to the restaurant , he helped us with restaurant reservations and he went as far as coming to the beach to get us beach chairs!   Mr. Beltre was in contact with us for the rest of our stay.(I should note that we don't have any connection to the Royal Family)

The Paradisus Palma Real, a wonderful hotel...
 
 We usually stay in a master suite but as everything was booked we were given a regular room.  This room is smaller than the master suite but to my surprise, it was quite large and extremely comfortable. 

 The bar area at Gabi beach  was renovated a few years ago and it is phenomenal; It is decorated with pastel colours and  the view is breathtaking.  The food at Naos (Buffet restaurant) is excellent!  The choice of appetizers, entrees and deserts is endless.  The chefs will grill fresh seafood, red meat, poultry right in front of you.  You will find a large selection of fresh juices, smoothies...and the deserts are outstanding! Don't forget to try the Paella; always excellent although I'm not a big fan of the noodle version!

The restaurants serving dinner are also very good, "Aqua" at the Reserve is  my favourite.  I can also add that the service at all the restaurants we tried was very good.

The beach and pool area are both gorgeous.  A great new addition on the beach is a small grill area where they serve delicious burgers, hot dogs, french fries...The mexican restaurant that used to be by the beach was demolished and was replaced by a restaurant exclusively for the Reserve guests.   In my opinion, given the location of that restaurant, it should be accessible to everyone. Management should keep in mind that the rates at this hotel are high for everyone, especially for Canadians who pay a 30% surcharge!
The resort is much smaller than the PPC and all the facilities are at a very close distance. Everything is easily accessible. The gym has very good facilities.  Alberto, the tennis pro is amazing.  Unfortunately, my daughter Annabelle and I weren't  able to meet him  for private lessons this week as we didn't have enough time.

The employees of this hotel are very welcoming and most provide an excellent service.

 The other improvement I would suggest is to include more complimentary water sports as this is an all inclusive beach resort.

The Paradisus Palma Real is a wonderful resort and I strongly recommend it.

Thank you Mr Beltre for the exceptional service that you provided!
We will be back next year.
S. A and G.

reviews.author: Madison M
reviews.title: Relaxing girls weekend!
reviews.text: Had the most stress-free and incredible time at the Reserve! Went with three girlfriends, and we had no complaints. The food at every restaurant was fantastic, and the beach/pools/cabanas were all amazing. The highlight of our trip was the rockstar service we received from the staff members. Anthony de Paula, in particular, made our trip unforgettable. He was there at our every beck and call for questions, driving us around the (very large) property, and arranging reservations. Additionally, the beach staff of h2o were awesome! Ramon, José, Santos, and Jairo were so fun, friendly, and helpful that we never wanted to leave the beach area! 5 stars for these 5 men and the resort as a whole.

reviews.author: lizzie8888
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text:
Stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus and it was an amazing stay. Great for solo, friends, family, or romantic trip. Specifically, Anthony de Paula was an amazing host/concierge and provided unbelievable service to us. If you can get him as your butler/concierge you are lucky!!! At the beach, ask for Ramon, Santos, José, and Jario - they were so welcoming and helpful throughout our stay with great service!

Thanks Paradisus for an awesome trip!

reviews.author: 5252davis
reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful!
reviews.text: This resort was amazing. Our family loved it and will definitely return on a future vacation. The staff was all accommodating and very helpful. Many different restaurants if you didn’t want buffett. Everything was perfect.

reviews.author: Kelsey Y
reviews.title: Wonderful girls trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve for just under a week in April and had an amazing time. The room was beautiful, we were able to reserve a beachfront cabana every day and the food was incredible - far exceeded my expectations for a resort. We ate at Gabi Beach, Gabi Club, Mole and Fuego and they were all amazing. The buffets have sushi, lobster and endless incredible foods. What really made our trip so special was our wonderful concierge Anthony de Paula. He helped us reserve a cabana each day, drove us around the large resort, helped us with restaurant reservations, airport transportation and anything else we needed - always with a smile on his face. Our trip would not have been be same without Anthony and we are going to miss him very much. In addition to Anthony, Ramon, Santos, José and Jairo were all amazing as well. They made sure we had what we needed on the beach whether it was towels, fresh coconut water, a dirty monkey or just a smiling face. Thank you all for making our trip so amazing! We don’t want to leave.

reviews.author: Mustaf G
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Let me start out by saying. This country is beautiful. The people here are beautiful. The resort is amazing. And the best of all, the staff. They have done an amazing job since I've been here. The bartenders are entertaining. The young entertainer guys are fun and excited. Nixon (young man) was fun to watch dance. I absolutely loved my experience here. I recommend spending the money to see this place. You're investment will reward you 10 fold with an experience. Thank you DR

reviews.author: Christopher M
reviews.title: Bankers life convention.
reviews.text:
Great stay. Spacious “suite style” rooms. Food was actually decent for all inclusive. Fresh Presidente on tap all over!! Wonderful staff. Service was exceptional. Lilian at the main bar is the best. Total sweetheart with huge smile and great service. Elizabeth the front desk manager/ hostess at passion made our trip
And made sure our needs were meet at every corner. She truly went above and beyond and deserves a raise/ promotion!! Starky the bartender at passion is top notch, great service and personality. Yuderqui at fuego is an amazing waitress. Great service and even better personality. Let her recommend what to order, she knows all the best things in the menu!!! Overall great experience and it was definitely because of the exceptional staff!! Thanks again to all that made our trip
So enjoyable!!!!

reviews.author: Eileen L
reviews.title: Family vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text: Great resort with very friendly staff. A lot of good restaurants, pools, beautiful beaches. Great for families or couples. Would recommend and the weather in April was perfect as well. Not too crowded when we were there so this time of year is nice.

reviews.author: nmy04001
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: Nixon Bao was an EXCEPTIONAL activity entertainment specialist at the resort. He was friendly and kind, trying to meet all needs of the visitors. Jesus was a wonderful bartender on the beach, very attentive. Great resort, much fun

reviews.author: Heinz C
reviews.title: Urlaub ..... der beste Urlaub seit Jahren
reviews.text: Tolle Anlage...Die Anlage ist wirklich ein Paradies... besonders gut war das Restaurant Mole . VICTOR ARIAS ein toller freundlicher Mensch. Das Essen hervorragend.  Die Bedinungen auch . Seh r empfehlenswert.

reviews.author: Estur
reviews.title: First Time!
reviews.text:
This was the first time at an all inclusive for my husband and I. We met our kids and grandkids at the Reserve Paradisus Palma Real for a week of fun and relaxing. 
My husband and I arrived ahead of ‘our crew’ and were immediately met by Jose Salvatore which was our Concierge for the week as he introduced us, as first timers to a resort, the ‘all inclusive’ amenities. The resort, spa, beach are GREAT!  Service amazing. 
Thanks!

reviews.author: m1221l
reviews.title: A truely wonderful vacation at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I want to thank a few wonderful people for making our vacation to your resort a very great stay. This was our first stay at your resort and it will not be the last.  All of your employees are wonderful hard working people, but these nice people made our stay a little more comfortable. Their names are Martim Timeo, Kelvin Fernandez, Grey Rijo, Carlos Rosario, Corey Rijo, Yahaira Mega, Manuel Galemia, Rafael Guerrere.. i have one more person to thank but I do not remember his surname so I will add his picture,  thanks for your special drink. A note to the resort management,  please let these wonderful people know that you are great full to them for their great care of your guests.

reviews.author: Ted K
reviews.title: Why We Keep Coming Back
reviews.text:
We just returned from our annual trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  This is the sixth straight year that we have visited the resort.  We never leave disappointed.  The restaurants are good.  We hit our favorites - The Grill, Bana and Agua.  We also hit Passion one time for the food/wine pairing.  It was at Passion that we met up again with Martin our waiter.  His service was fantastic as always.  We hit Mole for lunch.  I am not typically a fan of Mexican cuisine, but I was pleasantly surprised.  I have been missing out all these years.  The Gabi restaurants are passable.  Also, I highly recommend the wine tasting at the Winery.

Our day started after breakfast and a long walk on the pristine beach to the welcoming faces of the guys (and lady) at the beach.  My cabana was always prepared with towels and my wife’s chaise was set up with towels, table and facing the sun each and every day.  I can’t say enough for this team that waited on us on the beach.  They are Jose De Los Santos, Santos Frias, Jairo Meniere and Dorby Santiago on the beach.  Our bartenders at the beach bar, Enerio Pinales and Yeraldin Rodriguez.  I save the best for last.  Ramon Ramirez is more than wait staff for us.  He is a friend and is one of the main reasons we come back each year instead of trying other resorts.   
After the beach, we would head back to the Reserve pool for a snack, a dip and a cocktail, not necessarily in that order.  We were pleased to have Wally take care of us at the pool and Benita at the pool bar.

Last but not least, our butlers and concierge made the week stress-free. Junior had the latter half of the week and made sure he was always there to bring us to our dinners and arrange for our airport transportation.  Anthony was our butler for the first half of the week and made all of our dinner reservations in advance.  He even cheerfully rearranged reservations as we changed our minds a couple of times.  I would be greeted each morning with “Good Morning Sir.  Is there anything you need?”  Angie was our concierge and was always pleasant and helpful.  She is so easy to work with and always helpful.

The last person I want to mention is Luis Santana.  Luis has been a good friend over the years waiting on us at the pool and the last few years, at the beach.  He is now a Family Concierge butler, so we didn’t require his services.  Congratulations Luis on the move.  I know you will be great in your new position, but I missed the daily Red Sox/Yankees debates.

In closing, I want to share an anecdote that I think explains how I feel about a Paradisus Punta Cana vacation.  My wife and I agreed to attend a Sales pitch on the new Melia Circle resort that is under construction.  It looks like it will be beautiful with state-of –the-art technology.  My response to our salesperson, Onesimo was that the Paradisus Punta Cana has one thing that the new resort does not.  People that know us, have waited on us, taken care of us and treated us like family.  Why would I go anywhere else?

reviews.author: stanclarke
reviews.title: Do you want to know what it feels like to be treated like Royalty? We found the spot!
reviews.text:
An excellent all-inclusive resort, a bit above most others that we have frequented in Punta Cana. A big thank you to Martin Tineo, Wanda Correa and Carlos Hinostroza for making this a special vacation experience.
We are an energetic couple in our mid 60’s who enjoy a relaxing adult environment on our holiday.  We traveled to Punta Cana Apr 1-8 2018. This is our 7th visit to the Dominican Republic and our 5th resort. At the Paradisus Palma Real, we opted for the Royal Service (RS), which we would highly recommend, as the resort experience would not be the same without it.  Every little detail is taken care of -- no hassles getting towels or the right sun bed or premium label drinks or food or what ever you want… just ask or simply look like you need something and they make it happen. So refreshing!
What do they offer?
The resort offers several themed restaurants and a large buffet area.  Multiple bars are located throughout the resort.  The resort is located on Bavaro beach - a 50-mile-long, near white sand beach with small waves.  Excellent for walking, tanning and swimming.  Other than the sea weed issues (a problem for all resorts in Punta Cana) the beach is absolutely beautiful.  The resort was updated a few years ago and is very well maintained.  Minor items were out of service (as is the norm at almost all resorts) but they were not important elements that effected your stay in any way.

This resort caters to both families with children and offers an adult only area. (Royal Service). The resort offers a selection of restaurants and a very good buffet.  All of the food was good, but as you expect at a resort it was not fantastic. They do have a Michelin Star restaurant ($ 80 USD extra charge) which we did not frequent -  if you’re a foodie you would probably enjoy the five-course gourmet experience. The restaurants and common areas are shared among the guests so you do see children around.  However, they separate the two areas when it comes to the pools and the beach area (there is designated dedicated private areas for Royal Service guests only - makes it feel very exclusive).  

The name “Royal Service” is appropriate as the staff make you feel like “royalty” -- Martin was our pool person from 6:30 am to 4:30 pm. Everyday Martin made us feel like we were the only ones he had to take care of.  After the 1st day, he knew our favour drink, where we like to suntan, what we liked to do and he was always one-step ahead of us.  Martin was truly amazing and obviously loves his job.   Wanda was our bar tender at the Sunset Bar (exclusive to RS guests) and again she was so attentive. She greeted us every morning with a wide smile and a very happy, up beat attitude …  set the day off just right.   Wanda knew exactly how we liked our drinks and anticipated our snack schedule and was again amazing in that she seemed to know when we wanted a cool drink and would have it ready when I went to the bar.   Finally, a big thank you to Carlos our butler (ah yes RS guests get an assigned butler to take care of any whims you may have).  Carlos was our “go to” person -- helped us sort out a room issue (fast and with no hassle).  He made sure all our needs were met and accommodated all of our requests regarding which restaurants and at what time we wanted to dine. If we changed our minds he made sure the needs were taken care of and sometimes even went beyond --. Chocolate covered fruit snacks, a cheese plate in our room at the end of the sun-tanning day. He even ran us a beautiful bath with flowers and cool drinks to surprise us when we came home from dinner one night. Ensured our fridge was always stocked with our favourites.  Total pampering! No debates!  No stress!
 
The down side: very few and minor in nature
The rooms - we requested a king bed- to accommodate they took 2 double beds and moved them together.  Very uncomfortable and not what we expected.
