They fixed the issue (changed rooms) but I was surprised they tried to accommodate in this manner when they should have known it would not work.  An unnecessary issue they could have avoided.
There are children around (not a problem for us) during the day and early evening so if you want a child free vacation then maybe consider going to an adult only resort. Remember, the RS area is absolutely adults only, peaceful and quiet.
The spa was included in the Royal package, but we found it to be tired and dated. The hot tubs were not working, there were no attendants, and the ladies steam room wasn’t functioning.
To summarize:
Overall, it was a great experience and if you can afford it then I highly recommend the resort.  As always, the difference is the service - again a big shout out to Martin, Wanda and Carlos.
Recommendation:  Take the Royal Service -  dedicated room areas,  private pool and beach areas accompanied by total pampering!

reviews.author: sylviagriffin09
reviews.title: truly paradise, friendly staff, awesome expierience
reviews.text: I was so blown away by the wonderful customer friendly staff, special thank you to Raimin who kept our mini bar stocked and so attentive to our needs, we could not have asked for better service from the housekeeping staff as well. Gracias Amigos! We will be back!!

reviews.author: Lissy J
reviews.title: The word paradise doesn't begin to describe this place and service!
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and the ocean even more perfect. The entertainment was even more divine. Nixon was amazing! His entertainment services were exceptional! He was sweet and funny and outgoing... We just loved him! Any resort that hires such wonderful staff deserves all of my business! Anthony was also fantastic! He knew how to make us feel welcomed. The pool was large and refreshing. Great resort for friends and fun.

reviews.author: Casey B
reviews.title: Wonderful resort & staff!
reviews.text: This is paradise! The resort is gorgeous, well-kept & friendly staff! The entertainment staff are incredible, especially my new friends Nixon & Lois! They make the activities fun with their friendly smiles! We will definitely come back!

reviews.author: rhassija
reviews.title: Super Hospitality & Amazing service!
reviews.text:
Writing this review before leaving today! Had an amazing time at the Reserve! Kids don’t want to leave.. 
A very special thank you to Sandra Cedeno (from Circle by Meliá) for taking care of every little detail that made our visit a memorable one! Sandra took great care of us right from the time we checked in to checkout. The room was very nicely done and had a nice touch to it. Views are super and the food at Gabi club , Mole , Fuego and Vento was extremely delicious!! Also special thank you to Ramon Ramirez at the beach and Santos, Ericka and Janette at the concierge desk, Raul FD at Gabi club, Julio at Vento and Gabi Club, Jose Jones from concierge and Benjamin another great man to make our trip a very special one. 
I would like that the manager take note of the hard work and dedication of these people. Without them this would not be possible! 

All staff is extremely friendly and take pride in their work! Also an excursion worth going for is the seaquraium/ Danny from Otium tours helped us out with this . 

Overall a 5 Star experience and would highly recommend this to anyone age no barrier ! Thank you again and looking forward to visiting again in the future !!

reviews.author: James R
reviews.title: My review of Reserva
reviews.text: The facility at Reserva Paradisus is absolutely gorgeous and it is kept spotless by the constant attention of the friendly staff. The supervisor Sandra Cedeno was attentive to our every need and went out of her way to make sure we had a great experience. Our private concierge Jose Jones (JJ) was professional, courteous, and knowledgeable. All in all a terrific experience that I would recommend for a great family vacation.

reviews.author: Janet B
reviews.title: Things have changed
reviews.text:
Last year I scored my trip a 5, this year only a 4. This is probably my 7th visit to this wonderful hotel but this year there have been changes made that will make me consider going elsewhere next year.  It was great to come back to see some familiar faces, ie Lookey Lookey and Angel from the activities team plus some new faces, in particular Snoopy.  Last year and this I travelled with my sister, we are both in our early 60s but still enjoy a laugh and a dance, last year we spent many a good evening at the Gabi Beach dancing the night away to local and dance music, the place was packed and the atmosphere brilliant BUT this they have decided that 'House Music' is the way to go, so the place is empty, there is no dancing and no atmosphere.  This hotel is a luxury hotel, frequented mainly by adults and families, it's not a young person's or clubbers hotel.  Last night I sat in the Gabi Bar and watched person after person just walk on through, it's such a shame.  Now I'm told that other music is being played in other areas but Gabi is the main bar, by the beach, so move the 'House Music' to one of the smaller bars and bring the dance music back to Gabi PLEASE.  I'm fed up with early nights!
Sent from my iPad

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Amazing Time!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve for 6 days.  My family of 4 (2 boys 9, 18) had an amazing time.  The service at the beach and in the restaurants were outstanding.  I didn't give it 5 stars due to the food being very good and not excellent.  The food was much better than expected with some restaurants better than others.  Our favorite was Bana with Mole a close second.  We had breakfast at both The Reserve and Gabby Beach and both always had plenty to chose from.  We attended the shows at night which were all fun.  This is the perfect place to vacation for relaxation, beautiful beach & pool setting.  Catching a shuttle to the beach was never a problem and walking the short 7 minutes was never an issue.  My 9 yr old loved the Eco Bungy where the assistants were so helpful and kind to the children.  I wish I was still there!

reviews.author: TBL13_13
reviews.title: Great Last Minute Trip to Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
My husband and I booked a last minute trip to the Paradisus Palma Real on the recommendation of a couple of friends.  It was our first time in Punta Cana.  Upon arrival at the hotel, we were whisked away for check-in. We invested in the Royal Service/Adults only package - well worth it.  Our butler, Angel, greeted us with a smile and anything we needed.  He booked our dinner reservations, checked-in with us daily to see what we needed, updated us on the Boston Red Sox as well as surprised us with lots of treats along the way. 

We spent out days at the beach or at the pool.  Martin, one of the support people dedicated to working on the beach and pool, was awesome!  He learned our names and figured out what we liked right away.  Martin greeted me with a smile every early morning!  I like sitting on the beach at the crack of dawn - he was right there with me!  He made sure that I had whatever I needed to make my day perfect...a beach hut, towels, drinks, etc.  Martin went out of his way for us.  He's a star!

The food at the hotel is good.  The restaurants offer lots of options.  Gentlemen - remember to bring pants and closed toe shoes - my husband had trouble at one of the restaurants.  My only feedback is that I wish there was an option for a more casual lunch on the Royal Service side - sometimes you just want a sandwich for lunch...not a more formal hot meal.  Other than that, the food was good.

All in all.. we had a great trip to the Paradisus.  I plan on going back soon!

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.title: Lovely hotel but visitors should be aware of a few things!
reviews.text:
This is my second time to this country; I was here last June at their sister hotel Paradisus Punta Cana which was lovely too! This hotel is beautiful, the pools are nice and relaxing and the service (depending on where you are) is excellent also! We stayed at the royal for two weeks so we could be comfortable and let me say its way better than the reserve. You can only go to certain restaurants and have specific cabanas on the beach or at the pool if you're at the reserve so its best to stay. The royal beach bar is far nicer than the reserve bar! 

Moving on, I'd like to say a big thank you to Jorge the waiter, Juana the spa lady, Angel Medina the waiter at the buffet, Nicolas the butler, Carlos Rosario the barman at the royal, Alvaro Fernandez our butler, Angelo our second butler and Wanda Correa the bar lady at the royal beach bar. These people made my holiday special. 

One thing I'd like to add is that they need to get a lift for the royal rooms as there are four floors and it may not be easier for other disabled people. I'm a quadruple amputee and use prosthetics legs to walk around so in that case I'm lucky but for someone who couldn't walk this is going to be a problem. 

The food at the buffet was always delicious and the only restaurant I would bother going to other than the buffet would be Olio or Passion. 

A big issue in the Dominican Republic is race and colour which not many people over there are comfortable to talk about. There is a certain negative attitude towards darker skinned people. Being mixed and my mum being black there was a clear difference in treatment. 

For example, we would get served water 30 minutes after being seated even if we have asked; we were always seated at the back of the room in Passion whenever we dined there (we did move!), We were treated terribly by a waiter in the restaurant rare and refused to dine there again! We waited an hour just to be served water and then when we ordered we waited 2 HOURS! At around ten we left and went to the buffet, but we did call the waiter out on what he was doing as other people were of other races and were seated, served and left after we were seated! You may also be served less frequently on the beach if you're black or look ethnic. The mentality is 'white is right' so be aware of this when using their services!!!

it was truly ridiculous and for these reasons, my mother has decided not to come back to this country. I, however, will continue to visit as I know what to expect from a country that denies their black heritage and tries to deny their black roots even though their ALL BLACK! 

On the other hand, the accessibility was perfect apart from the steps up to the rooms, my favourite butler has to be Nicolas as he made my family and I laugh with all his craziness!

I would suggest that if you like pepper to bring your own as you can kill a Dominican with a single pepper! This is one of the very few islands that don't use pepper in their foods. 

Knowing Spanish is also EXTREMELY helpful as some of the staff don't understand English, luckily I study Spanish and French in university, so it was easy to converse with the Dominicans and the Haitians. 

Overall, I had a phenomenal time and will be back in June with other family members, and we will be staying perhaps for three weeks or longer as two weeks is never enough. 

Honestly, you won't regret staying here!

reviews.author: sqld2018
reviews.title: Good outweighed the bad
reviews.text:
Overall we had a great stay but there are definitely areas for improvement.  

Facilities are excellent.  The pool and beach are beautiful- but it would be great if the hotel actually enforced their 30 minute no show rule on reserving sun beds.  We flew in from the UK so we were up early and found sun beds 'reserved' as early as 7:30am with no one showing up until lunchtime.  We also realised towards the end of our stay that the security guards put towels on the best sun beds on the beach and look for a tip to clear it for you.  

Activities and shows were fantastic.  Reynaldo and Antonio's dance and fitness classes on the beach and at the pool were great.  Reynaldo went out of his way to make sure we knew what was going on and he was so great with our daughter- she particularly loved Zumba!!

Restaurants on the whole were good.  Buffet was surprisingly good and we loved Vento.  We were disappointed with Bana teppanyaki - food and service were terrible.  

Now to the issues:  When we checked in we were 'upgraded' to a 1 bedroom master suite.  It was awful.  Air conditioning sounded like a freight train, toilet didn't flush properly, it smelled mouldy, only 1 plug socket worked and most of the light switches did not work.  When I spoke to reception about it they promised to send someone to fix it.  They couldn't move us that night as the hotel was full.  The issues weren't fixed so they promised to move us following day which was fine but the process of moving was a nightmare.  I was back and forth with reception a number of times with nothing resolved until I finally spoke to the manager.  We ended up downgrading to the room type we actually booked and on the whole that room was fine but the confusion and time it took sort this out was unacceptable.  Thankfully the rest of the trip was saved by the fun we had as described above.

reviews.author: H A S
reviews.title: Royal Service Rules
reviews.text: After frequently going to Royal Service Paradisus in Cancun we decided to make a switch to DR Paradisus.  Upon arrival we were greeted warmly by staff.  Once situated, we were introduced to Nicolas our butler.  He was amazing and made as feel very safe being it was our 1st time in DR.  Nicolas arranged all our dinner reservations and a fishing trip.  Also, Nicolas made our 30th wedding anniversary a special time to remember.   He is very attentive and takes time to acquire all your requests.  My family enjoyed the quality of the food, too.  The room was clean and the bed was comfortable, but pillows need to be replaced or upgraded.  The liquor selection also needs improvement. Just want to mention that check out was a breeze and hassle free.

reviews.author: Kyle R
reviews.title: Our 3rd year in a row
reviews.text: This is our third time here, favorite place to be in paradise. We feel very fortunate to be here, and definitely will continue coming back. Service is amazing and the entertainment is awesome. Raynold tamayo is the best on the resort and will always make you happy. Naomi Jose is also a great dancer! Strongly recommend.

reviews.author: Asier G
reviews.title: Para repetir
reviews.text:
Nos sentimos en el paraiso durante nuestra estancia  en la Semana de Pascua, en el Paradisus Palma Real del grupo Melia. 
Las habitaciones y zonas comunas, acogedoras e impecables en limpieza.
El buffet de 10, sobre todo la zona de la plancha del pescado, destacar al cocinero mas corpulento de esta plancha, hace las langostas de escándalo (siento no acordarme de su nombre, creo que era algo como Guito)
Animación y animadores, de 10 también, destacar a: Nixon, Luis, Antonio Banderas, Raphael (Scooby doo)
Hicimos una salida nocturna a Coco Bongo, orientados por Vivien que nos vendio la mesa VIP y nos lo pasamos en grande. Gracias Vivien.
Todo el personal del hotel muy amable y servicial.

reviews.author: samann72
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel was so kind.  Our family concierge Sandra did everything she could to make our stay work for us.  Kids zone staff Jairol, Jack, Xavier, Michele, Oni, Kati made my son's trip unforgettable. He couldn't wait to get there and had to be forced to leave!   Wonder, who helped set up chairs and served drinks at the reserve bar, was always attentive and made each guest feel special.   The staff truly did everything they could within their ability to make guests to feel satisfied.

reviews.author: Matthias B
reviews.title: Erholsamer geht kaum
reviews.text:
Traumhafte, bestens gepflegte Hotelanlage, die täglich von einem Heer von Gärtnern gepflegt wird. Ausgezeichnetes Essen, tolle Cocktails, vor allem aber das ausgesprochen freundliche Personal haben uns so überzeugt, dass wir schon zum zweiten mal da waren. Defekte im Zimmer, nach denen man immer wieder gefragt wird, werden sehr schnell repariert (in 15 min. habe ich noch nirgendwo sonst einen Klempner herbeigekriegt). Unsere persönlichen Highlights waren die Restaurants Grill, Vento und Gabi Club. Danke insbesondere an Felix Jesus, Emilia und Maria vom Service sowie Barkeeperin Juana und unseren "persönlichen" Barkeeper Julio Mercedes! 
Verbesserungsvorschläge wären allenfalls eine Prüfung und Erneuerung durchgelegener Strandliegen und Betten sowie etwas mehr Wasserdruck aus der Dusche. Vielleicht ließe sich auch eine andere Reservierungsregelung finden, als morgens um 6 Uhr zum Pool-Liegen belegen aufstehen zu müssen, denn als wir da waren war full house und ansonsten schon früh jede Liege belegt. Aber dennoch ein wunderbar erholsamer Urlaub und wir kommen gerne wieder.

reviews.author: ejm352018
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Sin dudas el mejor resort, definitivamente le hace honor a su nombre, es un Paraiso! Es la segunda vez que lo visitamos y sin duda regresaremos en nuestra proxima escapada a Punta Cana. Desde que entras hasta qye sales te olvidas del mundo exxterior

reviews.author: Jacqueline L
reviews.title: 5-Star for Serivd
reviews.text: We LOVED our stay at the resort; not only did we have an amazing informant (“butler”, but we can’t call him that), but we had AMAZING service at the bar with Lee with the Royal Service. He was fun, informative, and made us feel special as his bar tender. Yohelvis Aracemas was phenomenal as our informant, he helped us make our reservations for dinner each night and ensured that our days were planned to our perfection. Honestly, because of the service, I couldn’t imagine a better Caribbean getaway. We had a great time getting to know Lee & Carlos Rosario. They made sure that we were constantly refreshed & enjoying our stay for the entire 7 days. We love the Palma Real!!!

reviews.author: Kevin M
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text: Had a great vacation with my girlfriend. Make sure to include Royal Service in your vacation and make sure to seek our Lee who was our bartender. Took excellent care is us and became a good friend during our 7 day stay. Our butler took great care of us during our stay as well Yohelvis Aracemas. Look forward to another trip at this resort.

reviews.author: Vacationtwins
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
I have never taken the time to write a review on trip advisor before but after the trip my family had I just had to. We stayed for 8 nights in the reserve section with our amazing concierge Omar. Omar made all our dinner reservations and even when we made a mistake thinking we booked a different restaurant he fixed it for us. There was nothing we needed that he did not help with. He also left little treats in the room for our family. 

Reserve section- This is absolutely worth the money. We loved it. It’s a quick walk to the beach but after eating We really enjoyed this short walk. We looked forward to our morning walks to the beach to look at all the beautiful nature. They also had a cart that would take you over. We didn’t have to wait more than 2 minutes if we wanted to use it at night with the kids.  The reserve section also has a grill so you don’t have to go to the buffet for lunch. This feature really made our life easier with the kids. They could just grab what they wanted including ice cream. The chef at the grill as well as Wally Reyes were so warm and knew exactly what we wanted by the end of the trip without having to say anything. Also the service in the reserve Buffett as well as all the restaurants was fabulous. Wally Reyes was wonderful in the Buffett as well.

Pool- We spent our days at the pool as we have the beach at home and wanted to do something different. The reserve section is just beautiful and having a concierge gives you a shaded palapa everyday. This is totally worth it if you need any shade. My kids get rashes from the sun and this was a lifesaver. We walked away from the trip for the first time with neither one getting a rash. Also the pool is beautifully cleaned everyday. They take such good care of the area. The reserve section is the way to go. We would not do it any other way in the future as well. 

Pool staff- The VERY best pool staff I have ever seen. Mr. Wanderful, Eliezer, Jose Reinoso incredible staff. We have traveled to many 5 star resorts ritz included and these guys are top notch. They are always in an amazing mood, wonderful to the kids and the service is great. They really made our trip!! We loved seeing them each and every morning. We will miss them. 

Bar- All of the bartenders in the reserve section were great especially Juan Diego and Jesus

Spinning- The spinning class was so good we pushed to wake up for a 7am class 5 out of the 8 days. We absolutely loved this class. We also enjoyed the aqua bike, water paddle boarding  as well as Zumba with Jose and water aerobics. 

Naomi from events services was always warm and happy to see us. The Michael Jackson show was great!! That show by far was our favorite. We loved painting by the pool,karaoke and the dance parties at Gabi beach. 

A special thank you to Francy, Silvio Lantigua and Christelle who made sure our trip was the very best it could be. This was an incredible family vacation and we thank everyone for showing us such kindness.

reviews.author: dean k
reviews.title: Hydrogrill
reviews.text: Great salads and burgers this is in the reserve area. Awesome job as always second time here........  #hydrogrill #wally   These guys went out the way to show us a good time the staff is super friendly and just happy to have you. Maybe we are just lucky but the weather does not disappoint in Punta Cana !!!!!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus
reviews.text: We had a wonderful trip to the reserve. Hotel was super clean , staff was very attentive. I would definitely recommend booking the Family Concierge. Sophia was absolutely wonderful.  She booked all our dinner reservations, had a cabana waiting for us each morning and so many other wonderful surprises for the kids daily.  Great Family Vacation!!

reviews.author: Camilo D
reviews.title: Reservation Issues
reviews.text: I called to make a reservation and the person on the phone put me in the wrong hotel. Be very careful and make sure the person on the phone place you in the correct place since there are more than one hotel. Some of the staff were not very friendly.

reviews.author: DIETMAR R
reviews.title: It only take the right concierge for us !!
reviews.text: We are regulars who have visited this resort numerous times - yes we like it that much ! Great food, activities, location, people, ect.  I own a multimiilion dollar business, a medium sized staff, and travel the world on a regular basis.  Please take note - LEANDRA  POLANCO is one of th best concierges that we have ever met.  Her service was one of dedication, professionalism, and concern of our needs - even on her off hours. Paradisus - take heed - she has the qualities needed in todays management.  I hope that you utilize her qualities wisely in the future...... Thanks for a great vacation last week......

reviews.author: Patsy
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Hotel situado en playa Bavaro, con una impecable limpieza y trato del personal.
La comida muy buena también y los animadores muy majos sin resultar cargantes.
Habitaciones amplias e impolutas. Con detalles, todas las tardes pasan para ofrecerte chocolatinas y  reposición en las neveras y ademas tienen servicio de habitaciones también.
Especial mención a Nixon y Antonio animadores del hotel, muy atentos y correctos.
También a Vivian que es la RRPP de Cocobongo nos aconsejo muy bien y el trato muy bueno, lo pasamos genial.
Meliá no defrauda, no le pondría ningúna crítica. Hemos vuelto felices!!!
Gracias!!!

reviews.author: Kate S
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!!
reviews.text: Raynold is such a great dancer 💃 people are very friendly, greet you with a smile food is awesome! The beach is amazing the most important is the service all employees are good and have good vibes and thanks Gaby Joseph for great attention definitely we come back

reviews.author: marie s
reviews.title: Overall great
reviews.text: We love this place.  We’ve been here 3 times.  Biggest complaint this time is the lack of service at the buffet.  In the past, there were plenty of servers.  This time, the same person had to clear tables, wait on WAY too many tables, get drinks from the bar and provide the silverware and water.  The supervisors just watched this happen and did nothing to step in.  Absolutely ridiculous.  I don’t blame the servers, I blame the management for allowing this to happen.  Used to be 2-3 people worked an area.  Not anymore.  Was unappetizing coming in to many unclean tables and sitting for 10 minutes an no one paying attention.  Get on with it management- take care of your people and they will take care of you.

reviews.author: Dawn-Marie B
reviews.title: Fabulous property - Honored Reservation after Medical Emergency
reviews.text: In August 2017 we were scheduled to arrive at the Reserve, but 3 days prior to the start of our vacation, our 10 year had to have emergency hip surgery. We had no trip insurance. But we asked the Reserve and they honored our reservation!! We just returned yesterday and the swim out first floor suite was AMAZING! The room was very comfortable. We arrived late and the young man who showed us to our room, Eddie, took my cell number and essentially acted as our concierge. He booked is dinner reservations for each night and my spa appointment. Couple of nits: the spa treatment itself was wonderful, but the intake was a little unenthusiastic - they basically pointed me to the dressing room. If I wasn’t a regular spa user, I would have been lost. The number of plastic water bottles used was mind boggling - as someone who has had it with plastic pollution - it was difficult to see. But we didn’t have much of a choice. Even though it is all inclusive, we did bring a bunch of $1 and $5 to tip bartenders, waiters, concierge, etc.

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Spring Break ‘18
reviews.text: Paradisus - best all-inclusive food i’ve experienced (2x Mexico, 1x Jamaica).  Friends visiting from the Westin Punta Cana also thought this resort slightly higher end (than Westin) and better food.  Nice beach, large pool.  A 27 hole golf course is part of the complex surrounded by a housing development inland from the beach.  The rooms are suites with a separate bedroom and sitting room/kitchenette with outdoor porch/balcony.  Friendly staff.  Wifi included and pretty reliable which was a pleasant surprise vs Mexico.   Walled/gated resort compound which feels quite safe.  DR beaches are public so expect local “entrepreneurs” to be hawking any and everything on the beach.  There are a couple of hotel style work-out facilities.   One has a separate yoga and spin class (Keiser bikes) in a covered outdoor area and classes were offered most days.   Alcohol Brands included: Tangarie, SaphireBombay, JackDaniels, RoyalCrown, Stolie, Absolute, Baileys, Royal dark rum (and many other varieties of rum).  Beer - El Presidente, El Presidente Light, Corona (are the only brands I saw + coors light and heineken in your fridge).  Wine - recommend BYOB.

reviews.author: edielloyd
reviews.title: Best Ever
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has never disappointed me. Three years in a row I have experienced the BEST Food, BEST Service in a Spotless Resort. I would like a special mention to Luis Sanchez our Royal Service Butler for three years now. Also special mention to Royal Service Butlers: Carlos,Richard,Alberto
Royal Service Staff:Fatima
Smoothie bar staff:Olga/Joel

Also Martin Pool Concerige and his trusty side kick Big Pedro and Crew.They will arrange your purple towels on the beach/pool as you wish. Wanda the Sunset Bartender will create You her special drink.

Special mention to our Very Good Waiter at Plazzo,Felix#2. Golf carts are arranged to take you to YHI Spa on the Reserve a must visit for massage. The grounds are breath taking. 
Freddy the Coconut slayer will keep you safe from coconuts by chopping them off prior to falling off. You can enjoy fresh coconut water from his labour. 
Francesco our special towel collector cleans up after us by lugging heavy bundles of towels to the cart.
Don't forget to buy a premium cigar from Jose who will visit you on the beach lugging a very large very heavy bag of cigars(good cigars as long as you only smoke one)
Cleaning/House Keeping staff visit at least 2-3 times per day and as needed. 
Room Service shout out to Darius and Michael. 
The onsite gym is wonderful. Thank You Noel. 
Pools are Spotless.

Hope to be back next year

reviews.author: lauramunoz271196
reviews.title: Pérdida de control
reviews.text:
Otro año más que pasamos las vacaciones en el Paradisus Palma Real (con este son ya 6 años). Todos los años, nos alojamos 2 semanas con ustedes, por la gran experiencia que vivimos los años anteriores. Pero este año, podría decir que una de las estrellas se está tambaleando. 

Son muchas cosas las que he echado de menos, y por las que voy al Paradisus en Punta Cana y no en Cancún. Hay una clara pérdida de esencia en este hotel. La tranquilidad que ofrece este hotel  ha sido interrumpida esta Semana Santa por un grupo de estudiantes americanos.  

Por las mañanas, he echado de menos, la música que había en el paseo, desde la reserva hasta la playa. La calidad de la comida del  Naos y la reserva ha empeorado mucho. El trato del Royal service impecable como siempre, gracias a Pedro, Olga, Martín, Wanda... La música de la piscina central, me ha dado mucho que pensar. No sabía si estaba en Estados Unidos o en Punta Cana (trajeron hasta un DJ americano). 

En cuanto a la animación, he echado de menos a Shaky Shaky. Con la música que se escuchaba por el hotel, era imposible que estuvieran contentos los animadores. Por las noches, ya no había ese espectáculo dominicano que solía haber otros años. En el Gabi bar solo se escuchaba música inglesa, y veías a un grupo de estudiantes saltar. A las once acababa todo, y solo te quedaba la discoteca del hotel que cerraba a la 1. Entiendo los motivos, pero porque no pensáis en cambiar la ubicación de la discoteca. Para cambiar la música, en la discoteca, tenías que pelearte con los americanos que ofrecían 5 dólares al DJ, para que pusieran su música. Frente a eso ¿qué puedo hacer yo? 

La última semana, estaba cerrada la discoteca, y habilitaron el Avenue, cuando había un sitio al lado mucho mejor que ese. Como ya no sabían que hacer con los grupos de estudiantes, porque a las 12 de la noche ya estaban todos borrachos tirados por el suelo, decidieron dejar de dar alcohol a partir de las 00:30. "Es justo que tengamos que pagar todos los huéspedes por la actitud de un grupo de estudiantes descontrolados. "

Hasta las 5 de la mañana, hay un bar abierto, donde ofrecen comida. Este bar fue cambiando de situación a lo largo de esta Semana Santa por el grupo de estudiantes que no podíais controlar. Unos días dejaban de vender alcohol a partir de las 2, otros a partir de las 00:30. Que paciencia tuvieron que tener Gustavo y Benjamín, con ellos. 2 camareros muy buenos del hotel. 

Fueron varias veces las que nos quejamos por todas estas cosas, y en una de ellas tuvo que venir un responsable de Circle para ver la situación desde cerca. Se quedó atónito y acto seguido hizo que echaran a un grupo de padres (con la pulsera del área general) que estaban en el área del Royal. Estaban ahí, porque no había espacio suficiente en el otro lado, y el supervisor dijo que era necesario habilitar este área para todos los huéspedes del hotel. La diferencia del precio entre una zona y otra es muy elevada.

Con todo esto, el próximo año estaremos ahí de nuevo, y esperamos que este hotel vuelva a ser como antes.

reviews.author: LoveTravel766041
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones
reviews.text: La gente en este hotel es muy amigable y muy sonrientes todo el rato,hacen un monton de actividades en la playa y piscina y muy divertidas pero sobre todo Raynold Tamayo se porto muy bien con nosotros y muy majo.🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎊🎊🎉

reviews.author: shawnbrody
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation
reviews.text:
We just came back from a week vacation at this resort. We traveled with 10 of us ranging from 1 years old to 75 years old. I will start out with the pros: beautiful property, amazing staff everyone so nice (to name a few Claury Carela did an amazing job as our concierge, Rosanda our cleaning lady was so sweet and accommodating, Yesenia by the pool bar was wonderful with our kids, Luis was wonderful at night helping us with the shows and Gusto our amazing chef who even got my kids to eat fish!!!), entertainment was fantastic, grounds were clean and the food was really good.  Now to add the cons and this is why I only gave 4 out of 5 stars:
first to start off it was extremely confusing to understand the different levels of service and when I emailed the hotel they were not very accommodating in explaining and after 12 emails back and forth they told me what I wanted wasn't available (which was extremely frustrating).  I had to get my travel agent involved and she was able to get the upgraded service without staying in the section. Not once did the hotel themselves offer this at all which was very frustrating. I had asked to speak to a supervisor but was refused.  Also when I checked in for this upgrade they tried to charge me $30 more a day then what I was originally quoted. Word of advice - you need to update your website to explain what is and isn't included. In the end it all worked out but the amount of back and forth was very frustrating. Also the check in process was horrible it took over an hour. We were hot, sweaty and tired and were just told to "relax you are on vacation" that doesn't make it better. My father is handicapped and since we got the reserve concierge they made him walk from one check in counter to another one (which was 2 stairwells and a walk away).  Also my parents room had items that needed to be fixed and never were (even after many complaints)

reviews.author: charlotte m
reviews.title: Celebración de cumpleaños Familiar
reviews.text:
El mejor lugar para una celebración especial! Nos fuimos en familia a festejar el cumpleaños de mi madre, simplemente increíble, cada detalle  del equipo de The Reserve hizo de este día aún mas especial! Gracias a Elvis y Luis de Ocean front por cada detalle a diario en nuestra estadía, al chef español y su equipo en Gabi Club, en especial a Rosi en el buffet, y a todo el staff de Brisas! Roberto, Marta, Julio por el mejor desayuno a la carta, cócteles y sushi que prepara el chef en la barra! 

Los vamos a extrañar!!!

reviews.author: Gustavo M
reviews.title: Incredible Spring Break Trip
reviews.text: Our family went to this resort for one week and had the most incredible time. The resort was beautifully set up right on the ocean.  We were so lucky to have great service the entire week;  everyone was incredibly attentive, and always eager to help make our stay enjoyable.  I would like to personally thank Martin Tineo and Wanda Correa for their service during our stay—they were fantastic!  This resort has many activities to participate in throughout the day, and the night life is plentiful.  We had such a great time and truly recommend!

reviews.author: friasbettina
reviews.title: Perfect price quality
reviews.text: Viaje con mis hijas en marzo y la playa Bávaro es estupenda, el hotel nos encantó, los restaurantes todos con excelente calidad de comida, y muy amables todos. Muy buen servicio todos atentos, aunque el hotel estaba con bastante gente dada la distribución todo muy tranquilo e impecable. Gcias.!!! valio la pena

reviews.author: marielmn
reviews.title: Beautiful place--but beware the upsell to the family concierge program.
reviews.text:
There were many things I loved about this resort:  the grounds were beautiful; the ocean breezes and the powdery sand were a welcome respite from a cold, northern winter, the swimming pools were large, warm, and cleverly designed.  The food was better than I expected at an all-inclusive; in fact, our dinner at the upscale Passion restaurant was one of the best meals I've ever eaten.  Why not five stars?  Two reasons:  the interminable check-in and the family concierge program, which failed to live up to its promises.
I traveled with my husband, daughter, son-in-law, and two young grandchildren.  After a long flight, the kids were tired and grumpy.  Even though there were snacks available, there was just no reason for it to take an hour to check in.  The person we talked to insisted that we must have the same credit card we had used to pre-pay for our stay.  (We no longer had the card--it had been lost or stolen and its replacement had a different account number).  There was no logical reason for this rule.  We had paid for the stay--in full--a year earlier, but we had to explain all this numerous times before they finally relented and let us go to the room we had already paid for.  The family concierge program sounds good on paper, and I think that it was good for some people.  Its success depends entirely on your assigned concierge and ours, while perfectly pleasant, didn't do a very good job.  
First, although the hotel charges you by the day, we didn't meet our concierge until the second day, and she didn't reserve a pool-side cabana for us the last day, as we had requested, so we actually only had the service four out of six days.  
As the week went by, we saw that other people were getting tours of the grounds from their concierge; that didn't happen for us.  The confirmation we got from the hotel told us that we would have a special phone so we could always get in touch with our concierge.  When I asked about that, she told us they no longer used the phones, but I should download a special app.  Fine--except that my phone didn't get service in the Dominican Republic and the app required a working phone number to install it.  We had to use the regular concierge in our building to send messages to our family concierge.  In the end, she made four dinner reservations for us; had cookies sent to our room at night (she did not even offer this service; I requested it); reserved a cabana three days out of six; and arranged for a porter to pick up our luggage.  We paid $900 extra for these services.  All this left such a bad taste in my mouth that it was hard to appreciate the many things that the resort did right.
Punta Cana's beaches are just gorgeous.  The weather is perfect, at least in the winter.  We got a direct flight, which makes it a very easy destination to get to.  I hope to return.  But I doubt that I would go back to The Reserve at Paradisus.

reviews.author: suzannegb542
reviews.title: Beautiful All-Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Upside:  
Eye-popping view as you first enter the lobby!!  Very pretty grounds with ample spots to find a little privacy from other guests.  White sand beach.  The resort was spotless and always being scrubbed down by staff. All-inclusive was worth it for our family of four.  Royal Services level for adults included butler service, private restaurant/ pool/ beach/bali beds.  Also additional restaurants not available to non- R.S. guests and access to The Reserve facilities and Yi Spa.  We liked that.  The R.S. staff was pleasant and efficient, especially Martin Tineo, Pedro Cedano, Unnda Correa, Franklin Bautista and Nicolas.  We enjoyed paddleboard yoga and water aerobics in the main pool and spin class at The Reserve.  (Sorry, forgot the instructors' names, but they were fun.)  Also a shout out to Jhonatan at Vento Restaurant.  He was the best waiter we had all week!! 

The Yi Spa at The Reserve was expensive, but great!  I had reflexology with Daury.  My family had deep tissue massages.  I suggest bringing cash for tips, as it was a little convoluted to put them on my room account afterward.  Definitely arrive early to experience the outdoor hydrotherapy under their zen pergola!  They recommend 30 minutes, but I say arrive 45 or 60 min.in advance. It was very comfy! 

Tips were included, but we did leave some extra for the butler, wait staff, room service, bartenders, and pool/bali bed servers.  We brought some small denomination DR $ that we purchased at AAA, but they also accept USD$.

Downside: 
We were annoyed that Passion Restaurant required an additional $80-$120 pp upcharge to eat there.  We felt we had paid enough already, so we passed.  

We sometimes had a language barrier because we don't speak Spanish--but nothing severe.  Most staff spoke English, but some things were lost in translation.
More on-site shopping is needed; there's only one retail shop at the resort besides the cigar store.
There were a couple of mixups on our restaurant reservations when the restaurants had the wrong # of people listed for our party.  It wasn't much of an issue to correct except at Bana, where the restaurant had the wrong count for us and another family.  As a result, there were several extra people stuffed at one hibachi table.  And I had to ask for more veggies after my portion was about 2 tablespoons worth.

Restaurant portions are more European than USA. Our favorite restaurants were Aqua, Vento, and Rare.

Royal Services had its own small gym, which was convenient. It could use upgrading. One of the ellypticals was broken, there were not enough floor mats, and it didn't feel super clean.  The spin bikes at The Reserve definitely need upgrading!!!  

Nightlife was a little underwhelming for our grown sons in their twenties.  And we would have liked more formal shows at night in addition to Michael Jackson and the Lion King.  We weren't interested in hanging out in the Gabi Bar every night and the disco was tiny.

Overall, we had a very nice vacation at Paradisus Palma Real and would recommend it to friends.

reviews.author: abmilw
reviews.title: profit minded hotel or just mis-managed - probably both.
reviews.text:
If you have been fortunate enough to stay at a Four Seasons, you know they are well managed, you get a great room and great service, and of course they are making a profit - you just don't think about it. This place, while not priced like a Four Seasons, so your expectations should change, their are plenty of in your face examples that are puzzling that will leave yourself asking if they really more interested in profits or if they need a new managers.  I'm sure after I post this, the manager will say 'thank you for bringing this to our attention' but I'm certain, I'm not the first person to tell them this stuff.

Front desk - a disaster (no explanations of hotel/layout, no activity book).  They do check ages for wristbands and are strict about it. One check-in person told us go to building 37, the other employee for the other room we had, said go to building V. After getting lost and asking, we ended up in same building - what hotel does that - a poorly run one.

Food - they have stocking/inventory/operation problems and/or they holding back for their profit. Grilled lobsters on buffet - nice touch. We'd often go here at 5pm for a appetizer/snack when leaving the beach and then had dinner later. Here is an example; If on the dinner buffet all you have is rum raisin ice cream left near end of the night for 4 nights and your chocolate ice cream is long-gone - order more chocolate and less rum raisin. You've been doing this for years - have you not noticed? I don't think this week you had a surge in chocolate demand or that their was a sudden supply shortage. Plenty of examples like this made for a frustrating stay at times.

Make your dinner reservations asap. If a large group, as an example try for 2 tables of 8 instead of 16, otherwise you will be  eating at 5 or 9pm, bigger groups don't get prime times.  We tried to alter dinner reservations and were told no availability, this was the afternoon after we arrived. So that isn't good that the whole place was apparently sold out, if you don't book promptly.  The next day we tried making dinner reservations for part of the group using the other room # (we had 2 rooms) - and they had prime time availability for some nights. Why - because they saw that this room # had no dinner reservations.  So we go to the restaurant at 830 for our 930 large group dinner - and they often had room and would take us earlier, by the end of our dinner we only ones in the restaurant. Multiple times, the restaurants were half filled. May be they have an issue getting staff for the high season - or they holding back capacity at the nicer restaurants.    Food quality at Naos Buffet was generally pretty good and huge selection for breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet (Italian, Indian, grilled, fried, fruits, veggies, meats, fish, seafood, salads, dessert and stuff for kids). Other restaurants very hit miss on quality and service.  Don't expect a USA prime steak. One example, we told they out of crepes and nutella for dessert.  Meanwhile, their location/kitchen is attached to the main buffet, guess what they had out at 8am breakfast? So they must have run through their nightly crepe allotment before our 9pm reservation at a half-empty restaurant.  At sushi place - the waiter came back 20 minutes later and said they out of salmon rolls. He never asked if we wanted to order something else - we found similar salmon rolls on the buffet. Waitresses would disappear for long time periods.  One night the waitress took our drink order without writing it down, she came back and said she forgot and wrote it down - and then got it wrong. Multiple nights at various places someone at our table would be forgotten, entree or a glass of wine. Jut too many examples of poor service.  Passion restaurant with the wine pairing was worth the upcharge. Italian and sushi places were bad.  Fuego and Vento better ones. Rare fine. They had a beach grill for lunch and the afternoon.  The worker would make all 100 burgers and hot dogs at once and then leave them out all afternoon. To make it worse, he would not replace the warming burner once it ran out, so you got a cold dog.  They would forget to bring out the ketchup too (more then one day). Why not cook the food throughout the afternoon and keep it hot and fresh? It has to be a bad manager not noticing and lazy employee who gets no tips.   Booze quality - I would call middle shelf. Real high end available for Royals or upcharge.    Gabi bar was nice and fun.  This is where action was a night 8-11pm.  Dress code for these restaurants - if don't wear beach sandals, t-shirt and gym shorts - you will be fine at most. (the top 2-3 nice restaurants you will need a collared shirt and long pants for guys). 

Grounds are beautiful and well maintained. Fountains, night lighting, plantings all look great.  This may be their saving grace. Saw a worker painting in the main walkway one morning, but no wet paint signs. This during spring break. If they had to paint, which I wasn't sure they did, how about at midnight vs. 8am?

The hotel rooms - are tired and worn. We had to have a worker fix safe, a fix the tv and never bothered with toilet (we just jiggled it). Hot water was an issue - the whole complex showers between 430-8pm after the day at the beach/pool.  We had mold and cracked paint on shower ceiling, big cracks in shower wall tile grout, freezer was iced over.  Furniture= sagging cushions, nix and it looks old and worn. Bed, a/c, lighting, balcony good.  I think one time we got snacks delivered, but not at start or again. Sometimes towels were replaced, sometimes not. They would take dirty one on floor, but not replace it.  The last 2 nights we had wash clothes show up, I'm guessing because a new person was servicing the room.  Empty kleenex box took a day. I sporadically left tips.  They just not detailed oriented and don't follow a checklist. Plenty of outlets. Wifi worked good in room and in main lobby area.  Room was generally clean and so were the public places. Use your room safe. We felt safe on grounds.

Bartenders and beach staff - get it, they hustle for the tips and are friendly.

Beach is long and wide, shallow for a while, good for kids, great for walks in both directions, however - sea weed is a big problem, at least this time of year.  They periodically rake it, but in my opinion not enough. They should do it in the afternoon as well. Can see sunrise. Lounge chairs gone very early.  Royal chairs plentiful - I think the Royal customers use the main beach/pool, but the hotel didn't bring over more chairs to main beach when they see it is full and the Royal sides are empty (I know they can't move every lounge chair, but they can adjust some), if they were better managed. They do have varied activities/classes and boats available. Main pool was nice.

25 minutes from airport.  Bring a stack of singles for tips. 

Summary: Very good beach, great grounds, average (maybe above average) food, spotty customer service and tired rooms.

reviews.author: Doug J
reviews.title: Great resort if you have the right expectations
reviews.text:
This was my first time to the DR and this resort.  Overall, I would say that if you go there, you will have a great time.  I would also say that you want to have your expectations appropriately set.

Some highlights...

The good:
** The beach and water- the water is warm though not terribly clear.  You wouldn't be able to snorkel in front of the resort.  The water is a filled with a surprising amount of garbage- plastic bags, plastic bottle lables, etc. 
** The sand was soft, mostly white and pink in some places.  It is very nice to walk on but you will never find the beach to be free of seaweed.  The ocean washes it up all day long and this resort doesn't have the equipment or manpower to keep it clean.
** The staff- most of the people are really good, especially those who have to interact with the tourists (wait staff, guest service desk, front desk staff, etc.).  They are friendly and generally helpful.  You will have a language challenge with some so be prepared to be patient as they try to help you.
** The exercise room is nice and clean but small.
** The restaurants are really good- more on that below which is MUST READ!!
** The all-day buffet has a huge variety and is really good- while I could eat as much as I wanted, pretty much whenever I wanted, I ended up losing 5 pounds in 5 days there.  I have no idea how that happened.  I will say I think it is because the food is very healthy- very fresh, little salt or oils added, most everything is grilled.

The eh....:
** Stuff happens down there when it happens.  Your room will get cleaned at some point.  Be patient and enjoy your vacation.
** The resort is either understaffed or many of the workers have a "that's not my job" view of things.  This becomes most noticeable when you walk the paths to go to the restaurants during the day or in the morning- you will see garbage and wrappers on the ground which someone should have picked up but no one does.
** The rooms are fine- regardless of what fancy title yours might have.  If you've ever stayed at a reasonably nice hotel in the states or anywhere else, that is what you'll get here.
** The beach vendors are everywhere- all day long, about everything.  While they are not terribly pushy, they are a consistent, regular feature of the beach.  
** The beach waitstaff generally does a nice job but they forgot about me on multiple times. Not a big deal again if you set your expectation that the hundreds of other people asking for drinks may make them forget about you.  ** if you want them to remember you, tip.  A couple bucks for wait staff and bartenders gets you remembered and that is a really nice thing.

The bad:
** Weirdly, it is the fellow tourists that are the worst part.  This is the typical one bad apple spoils the bunch and there are plenty of bad apples.  They yell at staff, literally scream about they should get this or that, throw trash everywhere and in general think that just because they paid money for this all-inclusive that it gives them the right to be disrespectful- to the property, to the people and to other guests.  

Things you MUST DO:
** When you show up, after you check-in, you have to immediately book dinner reservations- for every night you are there.  And be prepared to be disappointed.  We booked for all five nights we were there on the first day- there were no open spots the first two nights...which sucked.  We got 9pm and 9:30pm reservations the next two nights and on the last night finally got reasonable time at 7pm.  The restaurants are in high demand so book early.  (You can also put yourself on waiting lists but need to check back the day of in the mid-afternoon (around 3pm) to see if you can do better.)
** On your last day, as you are preparing to leave, you must go down to the front desk and check out.  You can't leave the resort without a check-out card.  Do it in advance so you don't have to run back to the front while your family is waiting in the shuttle van to take you back to the airport (like I did).
** Tip.  I always carried a collection of ones and fives with me for wait staff mostly.  It is a gesture that is very much appreciated by the staff, gets you remembered (because almost no one does it) and gets you served faster.  A small price to pay for more attention.

reviews.author: Paolo B
reviews.title: Very nice resort, great friendly staff, very bad music
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Royal Service.
This is really 3 hotels within one very large property. The Paradisus, the Royal Service (adults only) and the Reserve (their top level). 
When we arrived our rooms were not available because of overbooking, so they upgraded from Royal rooms to Reserve Suites (their best rooms, I suppose) for one night and then they moved us to the rooms we had booked. To compensate for the annoyance of moving around they upgraded us and gave us access to all the daily facilities (separate beach and pool, some restaurants and bars and concierge room) as the guests staying at the Reserve. 
That was a great deal especially because of the separate beach area and separate swimming pool. The pool is essential as the ocean water is full of sand and seaweeds. You can swim in it but it is not a pleasant experience. The main beach and pool are very crowded and very noisy. I asked when we checked out: one can buy the upgrade on arrival. That is you do not have to stay at the Reserve to be able to use the daily facilities. I did not ask the price of the upgrade, but I suggest that you inquire.
The food at the main buffet compares favorably with you find in similar all inclusive resorts. We tried a few restaurants (where as usual you have to book in advance).
Passion was great: they have an exceptional sampling menu and it is $80 per person and it goes with a wine sampling list for $40. We shared the wine list (4 people, 2 wine lists) and it was more than enough. Prices include tax and tips. If you are a foodie, I recommend it.
the other restaurants are included in the "all-inclusive" package.
Brisas: it is very nice, with a Japanese-Peruvian flair (ceviche all around).
Hydrogrill: meh.
Vento: don't bother.
We did not try the scuba shop of the hotel, but used seapro instead. They would pick you up at the lobby and drop you back after your dive, and we loved them.
Here is the main criticism of the place, and I hope that management is reading.
After dinner they have some entertainment at the "theater". We did not really check it out, so I cannot comment on it.
But they also have some "music" at the Gabi bar at the beach, with some staff that try and get people to "dance". I use quotes for "music" and "dance" because they play american club-style stuff (I actually have in mind another 4-letter word that begins with s). 
I mean, we come to the DR and we cannot find any Bachata, Merengue, or Salsa anywhere. The Avenue bar closer to the lobby plays some local music, but there is no space to dance. It would be so simple to play that same music a little louder in front of that bar and clear some space for real dancing. Hopefully management will do something about that.
Ah, yes, one last thing: our daughters went to a club outside of the resort, the "Coco-Bongo". You buy can a package at the resort, and it includes admissions, drinks, transportation. They pick you up at the lobby and then take you back to the hotel. The girls had a great time, the place plays all kind of music (some Beatles too!) and -most importantly- they thought it was very safe.
All in all, if we go back to Punta Cana and if I hear that the music has changed, then I would go back to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: LUV2TRAVEL70
reviews.title: Looking for a glimpse of Paradise at Paradisius
reviews.text:
I just returned from a week at the Paradisius Palma Real. Although the grounds were pretty, the bad outweighed the good for SURE. Check in was a complete disaster. We arrived and paid the extra to stay at the Reserve. Three other families we traveled with paid the difference as well. We were told that although we have Reserve privileges we would be staying at the other building but one family will be at the Reserve building which we were fine with because we understood they were overbooked. We were told to eat lunch and return to main lobby when the room is ready. After two hours waiting for our room we were told they made a mistake and we would stay for one night at the reserve and then switch over to another building. Of course that would mean we would waste another day transferring our luggage  to the other building. After arguing back and forth they were kind enough to waive the Reserve fee and still allow us to use Reserve property. We appreciated their kindness and decided it was fine.
Service_ I have traveled to many all inclusive and around the world and the service at the Paradisius was by far the WORST we have ever experienced. The staff is lazy and acts like they are doing us a favor. There are no smiles , no enthusiasm. During our one week stay MAYBE we came across two or three people who were friendly. It appears if you give them a tip after a meal  they  tend to be nicer. After breakfast one day the waiter from the previous day asked if we were not happy with his service the day before. The funny thing is we looked for him to give him a small tip but could not find him so we left.  How dare they ask for a tip when this is an all inclusive? Tips are optional especially at an all inclusive. 
Food- going to an all inclusive I knew not to expect anything great regarding food and good thing I did otherwise I would be even more disappointed because the food was an absolute disaster. The only restaurant that had decent food was hibachi at the Reserve. We ate at Passione which was fine but not worth the 80.00 per person for the amount they give you. Several times during meals I asked the people serving what something was and 99.9 percent of the time they could not tell me what it was because they did not speak English.
How do they hire people to work at a resort and not speak English? I would say the majority who worked at this resort did not speak English. Ifyou do not know minimal Spanish, good luck to you trying to communicate.
Rooms- rooms were fine except for the fact that hot running water is hard to come by. My children took cold showers at least four times during our stay. How is this acceptable? We found by letting the water run for a while eventually the hot water comes out but only for a few seconds. I did not bother to  complain because at this point where would it get me. So cold showers it was for the rest of the week. The only thing that I kept thinking was how do people with infants bathe their children?
Truly it is a shame that they can't get their act together regarding service. Honestly, I could deal with terrible food but not having good service to me ruins my entire experience.

reviews.author: javier b
reviews.title: Bien, instalaciones nuevas
reviews.text: Playa bien menos oleaje y más plana, mal la vegetación poca sombra y por lo general ocupan los sombrillas con toallas lo que no permite la rotación. Restaurante temáticos muy buenos, comida buffet exelente

reviews.author: Elizabeth F
reviews.title: Vacation 2018
reviews.text: The service, food and the cleanliness of the resort was top notch.  Ery Cordero, Wally, Luis, Hidro, Alexandra Morales, Gladys Jimenez, Pascual, Felix DeJeus and Liz Pena were great.  They all made you feel welcomed and treated us like family.  I would recommend the resort to any looking for a great family resort.  We plan on going back soon.

reviews.author: Jacob C
reviews.title: Great Family Trip
reviews.text: The Bars are awesome. The pool side services was even better. Shout out to my main men Wander and Jhonatan Medina at the pool for helping us out. Even though I could not speak Spanish, they helped by speaking great english and making me feel at home.  Also shout out to Eduardo and Julio at the beach side bar for the excellent service.

reviews.author: Alex G
reviews.title: Second stay - even better than the first time!
reviews.text:
The Reserve is one of our most favorite places in the Dominican Republic. We had a great time when we went there for the first time in 2013, and our expectations were very high when we came here for the second time. We are so happy that The Reserve's quality remained the same! This hotel is a perfect place for a family vacation in our opinion. We stayed in the Master Suite with a swim-up and truly enjoyed this room. Two days out of seven we decided to stay in our backyard and hang out by the pool. The rest of the time we went to the exclusive area of the beach dedicated to The Reserve guests. 

The Reserve offers a lot of excellent services, but what makes this place unique for us is the people that work there. 

Irvin Nolasco and Santo Avila are two superstars that made this trip memorable for our kids and us. Special thanks to both! Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: JLG-letrado
reviews.title: ESTADIA PARA RECORDAR
reviews.text: Un verdadero placer la estadía en el PARADISUS PALMA REAL de Punta Cana.    El alojamiento en las suites Royal Service marcan la diferencia de excelencia en la calidad del servicio.  Un verdadero descanso.

reviews.author: missionguy2018
reviews.title: The employees make it.
reviews.text:
This was our second time here.  We find the resort very nice, clean, and the restaurants great.  The employees are wonderful, all that we met were super friendly and helpful.  Being served on the beach is wonderful and Fernando Gonzalez did a great job helping us keep "hydrated" every day.  Service to our room was within minutes of a call, and Dauris kept us well stocked with whatever we needed, even bringing some incredible fruit displays made by the Pantri Chef Henri Ozoria.  We had lunch at Fuego, on numerous occasions, as it is steps from the beach area we were in, the waiters there were superb, and Yuderyui Javier became like a family member.
The beach is great, waves are minimal, and you can snorkel from a boat right off the beach.

reviews.author: AdventureSeekerWW
reviews.title: Mother Daughter Spring Break
reviews.text:
I am sitting on the beach enjoying the last day of our Spring Break vacation.  I am looking out at the beautiful wide white sand beach and the turquoise blue water.   There is a gentle breeze.   Our trip will be a total of 10 nights.    We were originally supposed to be in The Reserve area but upgraded to Royal Service in main area of resort when we arrived after some discussion at the checkin area.   The Reserve section is beautiful but as we are traveling with our 18 year old daughters, we decided we wanted to be in the main section of the resort to be closer to action.   The Reserve section seemed to be filled with mostly families with small children and as our daughters were 18, we could stay in the adult only Royal Service section.    We did did walk back and forth to Reserve section several times to take some excercise classes at fitness center by YHI spa.   The walk was part of our exercise, but we did see that there were golf carts going back and forth from Reserve section of resort to main area/beach constantly.   Our walks gave us the opportunity to see a lot of the grounds.   Very BEAUTIFUL.   Very clean, well maintained.   All staff very friendly and accommodative throughout resort.   We are happy with our choice to be in Royal Service area and liked being closer to beach and main pool/restaurants/activities.     The Royal Service area is a separate section in main resort area.   We were assigned a butler, Bladamir, who made our vacation extra special.   He made reservations for us at restaurants and answered all of 
our questions.   Communication was very easy via text and if anything came up, he was very responsive.  There was issue with toilet handle and he had someone fix right away.   If we needed more water or coffee in the room, he would let housekeeping know.   He checked in with us regularly to see how things were going.   He arranged for us to speak with someone about excursions when we wanted information (although we did not go on any excursions because we were quite content staying at resort, relaxing and enjoying activities there).   Every afternoon, there was a little treat waiting for us from Bladamir and when he learned that our daughters preferred the cheese and we preferred the chocolate and fruit, he made sure we receive the treat of our choice.   I think if you choose the Royal Service area, you can get as much attention and service as you would like from Butler, and I felt it was just right for us.    Bladamir was excellent and we really got Royal Service.    As part of Royal Service, there is a special separate pool area and beach area.   Everyday, Martin in the beach area arranged an area for us with towels and beach chairs and the beds under the straw umbrella/cabana.  And when we were relaxed and situated he would bring us our favorite green juice drink to enjoy while we soaked in the sun or relaxed with our book in the shade.   Martin also went above and beyond everyday and made us happy and feel special.    Wanda and the bar in the Royal Service pool area also took care of us with refreshments.    We felt overall the food was very good.   We liked some restaurants more than others, which is probably more of a personal preference thing, and the general buffet area had a lot of choices and was high quality.   Our daughters chose the hang around the main pool area most days.  A lot more going on there.  Lots of activities, music, and other people that are their age that they connected with.   They had a lot of fun.    I felt that there was something here to keep everyone happy.   It felt big enough and there were enough restaurant options.   I recommend trying them all.  Our favorites were Vento (Mediterranean) and Bana (hibachi/Japanese/sushi - Fun!)   There are activities at night which vary - beach party, shows, etc. if that is of interest.   We walked up and down the beach both directions.    You could do very long walks both ways.  Palma Real is on a nice wide part of beach.   Sand is very fine and soft.   Seaweed washes up but resort areas clean this up regularly and did not bother us.   Beach is shallow pretty far out.   Nice to wade or swim.   Plenty of beach activities available if you want- parasailing, paddle board, kayak.  There was security around and I don’t think beach accessible at night.   Always felt safe at resort.     Anything that was “wrong” was minor for us and quickly addressed.   The only major complaint was that the building we were staying in was having some work done.  Looks like they may have been redoing some rooms.   Fumes from paint/stain were kind of strong and not fun to breath in.    But we just accessed our room from a different side and didn’t have to go through this area.    Our rooms were very comfortable and spacious and clean.   Housekeeping very good.  We were disappointed that there was no ESPN so we couldn’t watch women’s NCAA final four games, but we were able to see men’s games as they were on an available channel.   We went to both fitness room areas and took a couple of yoga classes and a Pilates class.   Richard was the instructor for all and worked us hard and it was fun!   The fitness center at the YHI spa area had 2 treadmills that weren’t working (forgot to mention to someone so hopefully you are aware and repair) but overall there was enough equipment for cardio or weights and not overly crowded when we went.  Haven’t done a spa service yet but massage scheduled for the afternoon.   The YHI spa in beautiful and tranquil.   Thank very much for a fabulous, relaxing, beautiful vacation. I would highly recommend Punta Cana, the Paradisus Palma Real and the Royal Service area.   If you are lucky, you will have Bladamir and Martin to take care of you!

reviews.author: usk
reviews.title: fun summer trip
reviews.text: Enjoyable place, we had a good time relaxing at our own pace. Very helpful and friendly staff and very nicely furnished accomodations. Large spacious rooms. The beaches are a delight and you can walk out of the resort into the beach.

reviews.author: J6353CYlaurent
reviews.title: Vacances en famille
reviews.text: Une expérience très mitigée, pas de personnel parlant français, la plage est très bruyante avec un balai incessant d'hélicoptères, de bateaux qui vous font bénéficier des odeurs de carburants, beaucoup trop de parasailing et surtout une plage jonchées de déchets divers et variés y compris dans l'océan.

reviews.author: Alejandro D
reviews.title: Magnifico Hotel. Servicio excelente. Kids Zone insuperable
reviews.text:
Es la tercera vez que vamos a este hotel y como siempre todo ha sido excelente. Es un magnifico hotel, con un servicio muy atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar. La habitacion muy bien y las piscinas y playa magnificas. Un hotel ideal para ir con niños. Unas vacaciones estupendas!!!

El Kids Zone es genial y con muchas actividades. Muchas gracias a Katy, Mitchelle, Benyaniris, Joanna, Loreni, Yafreisy, Arisleida, Jack, Jairol, Xavier y Onil por hacer disfrutar tanto a nuestros hijos y cuidar de ellos. La fiesta de superheroes fue increible. Los espectaculos del Rey Leon y la cena de Mohana magnificos, con Katy (Mohana en directo!!!) y Jose Capuchino (genial Maui!!!) haciendonos disfrutar muchisimo. El servicio de la piscina estupendo con Jhonatan, Jose Reinoso y Wandel siempre atentos a traernos una piña colada y ayudarnos con las hamacas. Muchas gracias tambien a nuestra magnifica family concierge (Elisabeth) que nos ayudo y consiguio todo lo que necesitabamos; una gran profesional. 

La comida y restaurantes muy buenos, gracias al magnifico chef Miguel que incluso nos preparo una paella buenisima y a todo su equipo que siempre nos ayudo en todo, especialmente preparando los pures de frutas para la princesa (gracias a Beloni). Los camareros tambien siempre muy atentos y eficientes, entre otros Julio, Celso y Wally. 

En resumen, un gran hotel con un magnifico equipo de trabajadores para pasar unas vacaciones inolvidables.

reviews.author: WillWork4Food
reviews.title: Beautiful resort (amazing grounds)
reviews.text:
Thoroughly enjoyed our family vacation to the Paradisus Punta Cana.  We stayed at the Reserve Family Concierge, great location in the sprawling resort. 

Though the resort seems to be a bit older, the layout is great. We loved the open lobby, great pools, and wonderful landscaping throughout. Gorgeous beaches await, and the resort team works hard to take care of their guests.

Couple of areas could be done better -  

Food is okay (don’t fall for the worlds best burger at The Grill), but Passion is a must do (and well worth the extra price). The buffet restaurants (Naos and Gabi) are great, others like Mole - billed as an authentic Mexican restaurant - disappointed .

Staff is friendly, though service was spotty at times.

The MELIA App was confusing. 

Overall though, our 8 year old son loved it and already is asking to go back .

reviews.author: WorldSkwirl
reviews.title: Nice resort. Tip the women
reviews.text:
This is a nice resort, but other than housekeeping and concierge positions, most of the tipped jobs are held by men. You can help “tip” the balance by provide by gratuity to some of the many women on staff (hostesses, kids zone, water/coffee staff) etc.

Other thoughts... I would love to see the “reserve” section, including kids zone moved to the beach. The melia app should be functional. I don’t want to need a concierge to make a dinner reservation, get a beach chair etc. This is an artificial “perk.” 

Drinks, beach and overall property were beautiful. Kids zone needs more activities (a la club med). Kids don’t need to spend vacation time playing video games. How about a treasure hunt, sand castle competition or soccer game?

reviews.author: Krisztina B
reviews.title: Amazing food and high quality services at Paradisus
reviews.text:
The best quality all inclusive resort I have ever seen. The food, variety, was overwhelming, quality and choice great. Special thanks to the staff at the Rare bar. 
The staff was very friendly overall, the only area of criticism is for the breakfast buffet; would be better to focus on setting the tables instead of focusing on taking away the empty plates.
A word on Yhi Spa: I experienced a terrible mistake on my first visit. After complaints, the extremely friendly and professional spa manager Arabelle made sure to compensate for the mistake and she managed to turn my first negative experience into a positive memory. If we ever come to the island again I’ll be sure to visit Yhi Spa.

reviews.author: SHERRY H
reviews.title: Pampered
reviews.text: The staff at this resort will go above and beyond to make sure you get what you need. My son and friend are Vegan, the staff and management tried their best to provide them varieties to eat (except dessert) especially Mr. Jose Rivera (one of the restaurant managers)  The resort and staff were clean at all times of day and night. Rooms were always clean and efficient.   Everyone is always friendly and very attentive. The food quality was excellent. My family and I felt pampered through out our stay of 5 days.

reviews.author: Rick F
reviews.title: Ideal family trip
reviews.text: Everything about the stay was excellent, especially the family concierge, Elaine, who was very helpful and friendly.  The only situation that was less than perfect were the transfers arranged by the resort to and from the airport.  They were not well organized and were late, especially in taking us back to the airport.

reviews.author: Amy M
reviews.title: Good Value at the Discounted Price
reviews.text: We paid 35% off regular rates, and found this to be a good value. If we had paid full price, we would have been dissatisfied. Food was a flat C in our opinion. Would love more variety at the buffets (all three restaurants are the same). Please add GRILLED CHEESE to the kids' menus! The family concierge at the Reserve is worth every penny. Sandra, our family concierge made our stay wonderful. If we did not have her, we would not have been as satisfied with the property. Overall, the staff was very friendly and wonderful. Rooms are a bit banged up, but good size. The beds are lumpy and the music from the main hotel lobby kept us up in the Reserve. Request a pool side Reserve room for a quieter experience. They do not turn on the pool music until noon and then the music is done by 6 pm. The beach was amazing, but the hotel did not clean up the seaweed as much as other nearby properties did.

reviews.author: sarahfromlondon27
reviews.title: Fantastic family holiday
reviews.text: Great hotel, we had a wonderful family holiday here. Restaurants were great, pool and beach fantastic. Lovely staff. The highlight for us was the AMAZING kids club and the absolutely wonderful staff there. They absolutely made the holiday for our kids (1.5 years and 3.5 years old). So professional, friendly and fun. Great activities and entertainment and a lovely team. Also a special mention to Stephanie our lovely family concierge who looked after us so well, and to the team at the Passion restaurant who produce absolutely top quality food with impeccable service. The hotel is lovely, albeit in some areas it is showing its age a very little bit. But overall it is still a beautiful place.

reviews.author: iss29
reviews.title: Excellent butler Nicolas at Royal Service
reviews.text: My family has been staying at another Paradisus resort for years, but we tried this resort for the first time and we were pleasantly surprised. We stayed in the Royal Service side with our fabulous butler, Nicolas. He blew our expectations away by tending to every single one of our needs. Also, at the Royal Service pool Carlos, Martin, and Pedro were very attentive. Nicolas made us feel very comfortable from the moment we met him until we had to leave for the airport. From always checking in how our meals were to helping us when we needed recommendations, he always went the extra mile. Our experience would not have been the same without him and I could not imagine coming back and not being able to have Nicolas accompany us along the way.

reviews.author: Tim D
reviews.title: Restaurant Fuego
reviews.text: Great hotel and when you get a chance, you must book at the Fuego restaurant. Come a half hour earlier to have a drink at the bar with a great waiter Luis who can advise on cocktails and give some tips on the selection of Rums. Afterward ask for a table with Yuclerqui for a nice evening. One of the best settings of the hotel to dine.

reviews.author: Rolo
reviews.title: EL HOTEL EXCELENTE COMO SIEMPRE - PERO HOSPITEN UNA VERGUENZA
reviews.text:
Estuvimos por 2da vez en el Paradisus Palma Real, todo excelente como siempre.

Delvin es el mejor mozo del Naos, siempre atento a todo! Excelente en todo! De noche estaba en el restaurant Rare. Agradecemos mucho su atencion! 
Tambien la atencion de Gabriel, nuestro mayordomo que nos atendio muy bien. En la playa siempre atento Felipe, muchas gracias!!

Pero tengo que resaltar un punto NEGATIVO, me senti mal a la madrugada y me desmaye, esto fue a las 2 a.m llame a mi seguro y me dijeron que debia asistir de urgencia a un hospital ya que el tiempo que ellos tardan en organizar que venga el medico era de 90 minutos, por lo que recomendaron utilizar un servicio medico pagando yo por los servicios y luego me reembolsarian los gastos.
Llamamos a Guest Service y enseguida estuvo en Manager en nuestra habitacion y me traslado al Dr que tienen en el hotel de al lado, el Melia Caribe Tropical, que es parte del Melia... me atendio un Dr. y me indico que debia trasladarme a una clinica para hacerme analisis. El personal del hotel organizo mi traslado en taxi, me costo USD 20.00. Al llegar al hospital el personal no era muy agradable, de entrada me pidieron un deposito de USD 2.500, luego me hicieron esperar como 20 minutos sola, el hospital parecia desierto no se veia a nadie...
