Finalmente aparecio una enfermera con mala cara, quien me dijo que tenian que ponerme una via para darme suero porque estaba deshidratada (llegue con un cuadro intestinal), la señorita me clavo 2 veces en las venas de la mano izquierda y 5 veces en la mano derecha, ya estaba llorando del dolor y no lograba ingresarme la aguja ni el cateter, me culpaba a mi diciendome que yo ponia mis venas duras! cosa que es imposible de hacer voluntariamente... le dije que por favor era una tortura, varias veces ya estuve internada con suero y en varios paises, y jamas me hicieron eso! FInalmente con cara desagradable y de mala gana, fue a llamar a otra enfermera, quien finalmente logro ponerme la via pero en la parte de arriba del brazo, las dos manos tenia adoloridas. Mas tarde llego la Dra de guardia y me dijo que debia quedarme internada al menos 24 a 48 hrs porque tuve perdida del conocimiento, y que iban a hacerme analisis para ver que tenia. Ok, accedi y me trasladaron a una habitacion. Estuve desde las 2 am y a las 10 am vino el medico, me dijo que estaban esperando los resultados del analisis de sangre, orina y heces. Mas tarde, llame a ver si tenian los resultados, ya me sentia mucho mejor, y me dijeron que el cultivo tardaria 2 a 3 dias para saber que bacteria tenia. Les explique que mi vuelo era al dia siguiente y que queria retirarme para organizar mi retorno, ya estaba mejor y queria seguir con hidratacion y medicacion oral. Luego de esperar hasta las 5 pm, finalmente accedieron a darme de alta, la cuenta alcanzo USD 1.600, que me parece una locura por estar 1 dia con suero... Ya de vuelta en mi pais, escribi para que me envien los resultados del cultivo, queria saber que me habia pasado, pero grande fue mi sorpresa cuando me dicen que no me tomaron la muestra, y yo si entregue la muestra! Es una estafa que te cobren USD 1.600 por estar 1 dia con suero, no me hicieron el analisis por lo que hasta hoy dia no se que me paso, y sigo esperando que me devuelvan la diferencia de USD 900 que pague extra en el deposito. Realmente esta clinica se nota que esta con las intenciones de cobrarte de mas y no darte el servicio que dicen que deben brindar. Ojala el Melia analice esto porque tener un servicio asi estafador para los huespedes es muy malo, uno confia en lo que te recomiendan y realmente una verguenza la atencion que recibi!

Espero les sirva para analizar y mejorar.

reviews.author: WunderKid S
reviews.title: My phone was stolen on a beach
reviews.text: We spent 5 days in this beautiful resort a year ago and I'd like to warn anyone who will stay there during Easter/ Passover time.  THIS PLACE IS NOT THAT SAFE as you can expect. In the first few hours that we arrived my phone was stolen from my pant's pocket on the beach in the club members area. We tried to contact with resort staff and security, but it seems that nobody care and when I asked to call police the staff member convinced me that Police  will not care because of God Friday.  This spoiled all my vacation.

reviews.author: Trknight72
reviews.title: If you have ever been to a five star resort...you will be disappointed 😔
reviews.text:
Well, where to begin....first let me say if you have never been to a five star resort you will probably be very happy with this resort.   Over all it was not awful, but not it is not "as advertised"   My family and I have been to several 5 star resorts/hotels so I will admit our standards are high.  Last Spring Break we went to Atlantis and stayed at The Cove Club Level, although we had a few hiccups they were attentive and were very eager to make things right.  The service was top notch and accommodations were 5 star.  I say all of this for you to understand what we consider 5 star...
Now, to our trip.  We had a 2 bedroom suite w family concierge service...this was stated to be the "top notch" at Paradusis.  Prior to our trip I contacted the resort to see if I needed to pre-reserve a Cabana for our week (we have traveled enough to realize that at some resorts you must pre book these) I was put in touch w the head of the Family Concierges, he was very friendly over email and explained that there was no need to pre book a Cabana.. he did however send me some "preference sheets" this had questions like...your favorite food, drinks, ask the kids their favorite games, cartoon characters, their favorite food and drink.  This of course got the kids very excited that some of their favorite things would be there when we arrived....
Check-in:  we were escorted into the lobby area and give a seat, snacks and water...no beer, specialty drink just water.  We were told our room was not ready and would not be til 3, no big deal we were early...however we are beginning to realize the language barrier may become an issue. We were never told to go relax hang by the pool grab some lunch....nothing.  We figured that out on our own.  We also realized that their were two types of people that worked at this resort....the ones that wanted to be there and enjoyed their job and the others that would prefer to be anywhere but helping you.  We did get checked into our room and on a positive note it was HUGE!!!  We do not like to be all over each other so this was perfect for the 4 of us.  Our Family Concierge Stephanie was very friendly showed us around the room and offered. To make dinner reservations for us.  The room looks decent on the surface however when you begin to look around the quality is not there, the age of the building is showing.  The shower was awful no water pressure and water was always Luke warm never hot. Both toilets stopped working on numerous occasions which my husband fixed on his own.  The food was mediocre at best and service the same.  And those preference sheets that I mentioned earlier never to be heard or spoken of again not sure why they needed them. Nothing great to mention about the food so I will move on.  I do recommend getting a cabana our first cabana was at the beach which was very enjoyable and the other days we had one at the pool which was great also.  Throughout our stay we continued to run into employees that were very accommodating and friendly and those who would not be helpful and allowed the language barrier to be an issue. If they did not understand what you were asking for it they would just move on.  Very disappointing to say the least for a five-star resort.  All and all had our expectations not been so high we may not have been disappointed. However if you were looking for the best of the best this is not it.

reviews.author: AuntJuJu
reviews.title: Packed, did not get room booked
reviews.text:
So....  here now at resort.  Hotel is generally nice but my daughter and I did not get the room we booked.  Booked through Delta Vacations with complimentary room upgrade and access to water ritual at spa.  At checkin, they did not give us a Luxury suite.  I had to ask about the water ritual and they reluctantly changed my bracelet to the one that gives access.  I understand it's not a huge deal but I do not appreciate that I had to argue and fight for it and made to feel like a was trying to get something for free when it's clearly stated in my itinerary.  

The hotel itself is nice enough but PACKED.  People were coming down at 4 AM to reserve pool chairs by the shade.  Beach chairs were gone by 7 also.  I complained and the answer/advice I got was to come down before them.  This is ridiculous. 

And now hat I've complained to the hotel again, they offered to change my room.  I don't feel like packing and reunpacking.  Why didn't they just honor my reservation at checkin?!!!!

reviews.author: spain74
reviews.title: Paraiso para los niños y toda la familia
reviews.text: Acabamos de volver de una semana en The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana y mis hijos ya me estan preguntando cuando volvemos. Esta es la tercera vez que vamos y seguro que repetiremos. Lo hemos pasado genial y el servicio es magnifico. Nuestra family concierge Elizabeth Perez es la eficiencia en persona. Siempre pendiente de nosotros y nuestros hijos para que no nos faltara nada. Viajar con niños y un bebe de pocos meses no es facil pero en the Reserve lo unico que hay que hacer es relajarse. Los niños han disfrutado de lo lindo en el kids zone. Muchas gracias a Katy, Jairol, Mitchelle, Benyanirys, Jack, Xavier, Joanna, Ioreni, Yatneis, Aris leida y a Onil. Simplemente fantasticos. todas las actividades muy entretenidas y muy bien organizadas, la fiesta de superheroes divertidisima para toda la familia y el nuevo espectaculo de Moana muy chulo (ay esa peluca! ;-) Jose Capuchino, Maui, y genial Katy). Los niños se quedaron con ganas de más porque vieron el espectaculo del rey león y se quedaron enganchados. Gracias tambien al personal de la piscina siempre atentos, amables y pendientes de todo Jonathan, jose Reinoso, y Wandel...esas piñas coladas...y como no, el personal del Gabi (Julio, Celso, Waly, el chico que barre - que trabajo te dio mi bebé;-) - Liz, y mas compañeros de los que no recuerdo el nombre,...). Por ultimo Miguel, un magnifico chef y profesional que tuvo el detalle de prepararnos una paella deliciosa. Muchas muchas Gracias y esperamos veros el año que viene.

reviews.author: Oliver1313
reviews.title: A Rare Find!  On scale of 1-10, it’s a 12
reviews.text:
We spent 6 days in paradise at the Reserve. Of the many all-inclusive resorts we have visited, this is one of the top two. Highly recommend Family Concierge if you can. Ours was Jhordan, and he took care of every detail. He was wonderful.  Unlike other resorts, you do not need to make dining reservations before you arrive.  We can’t say enough nice things about the poolside staff at the Reserve. Jhonotan, Wander, Wally, Medina, Jose, Reinoso will take great care of your every need!  Dry towels and cold drinks when you need them. When our kids got hot in the sun, Jhonotan and others made sure to bring them cold water. 

The resort itself is beautiful and no place we went ever felt crowded.  A few simple suggestions: bring a sweatshirt (nights are chilly)and some smaller bills for tipping. While it isn’t necessary, it was VERY much appreciated and everyone works very hard so you can enjoy yourself. 

As far as dining, there is no shortage of fresh fruits and juices.  Many of the restaurants are open air - such a treat!  The breakfast and lunch options got a little repetitive. For people looking for healthier options, there are salad (but too often vinegar is the only dressing option), ceviche, and baked options. Our best meals were at the grill (steakhouse) and Aqua (Italian). We had reservations at Passion but were turned away because my husband wasn’t wearing long pants. We wish we had known in advance because he didn’t think to pack anything other than shorts.  

It’s the first time we’ve ever seriously considered booking our return trip before leaving!

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Good but won’t return...
reviews.text:
Let me preface this review by noting that I try not to visit the same place twice unless it is exceptional. I visited with my wife and daughter and another couple and their daughter, kids 3 & 5. 

I’ve traveled to 47 different countries and have circumnavigated the planes by ship, so I have a pretty extensive travel experience to draw comparisons from. I’m a relatively low maintenance traveler, but when I pay a premium for something, my expectations will be higher. 

I have been to PC three times in the past 5 years and have stayed at Barcelo Bavaro Palace (My PC favorite), Hard Rock (huge property, almost too big, but very nice),  and Paradisus. 

Paradisus is a “smaller” resort than the others I’ve been to, but it is pretty well kept. There was the normal amount of maintenance going on while we were there.

The service was decent, not great, but that seems to be the general quality of service everywhere in the DR. 

The rooms were nice and well kept. We were in 3606, which had a bed room, living room and kitchen, but we only used the fridge for a few drinks. The room steward left me a 6 pack of Coors Light on the first day and a single Heineken can each following day, so the “mini-bar” was disappointing.  I have never been to an all inclusive resort with an upgraded room and didn’t have at least all the regular liquor categories on hand in the room along with mixers and snacks. 

We stayed at the Beach hotel, and were lead to believe that the kids pool was at that location, but it is at their “exclusive” jungle side hotel, which is about 2k inland. We were able to go there and use the pool, but we couldn’t get drinks or food. When we wanted to take the golf cart back to the beach hotel, we waited for quite a while after the person working that stop had radioed several times before we gave up and made the walk back, which wouldn’t have been bad except for the exhausted, thirsty and hungry kids. 

We probably won’t return to the DR simply because it doesn’t have much to offer for the expense of getting there. If we do another all inclusive trip, it will likely be to Mexico, where we have had some great experiences. 

For me, DR does have some beautiful beaches, but it is fairly basic relative to the alternatives. 

Overall, it wasn’t a bad trip, but we had this feeling the whole time that made us feel less than welcome.

reviews.author: wadebrantner
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: My wife and I visited Paradisus for a business trip and we want to go back again.........would consider taking family members or visiting with friends.  When you first arrive in the main lobby the view is incredible.  While walking the beach I didn't see any resorts that where as appealing to the eye, hands down!

reviews.author: Hellen Higuera
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bueno, la comida es excelente y la playa muy linda, las bebidas super buenas.muy buen servicio, en especial la atención de Olga frutas ... con los batidos en la playa , nos sentimos como en casa.

reviews.author: tenowinski
reviews.title: Great all inclusive resort
reviews.text: Family of 4 with 2 children ages 10 and 7. We did not book the family concierge initially, but upon check-in we opted to upgrade to it. We are glad we did. Our concierge Elaine Rodriguez made sure that anything we needed was taken care of. She arranged palapas by the pool or beach, reservations at dinner, and typed up and laminated two cards that outlined my wife's food allergies in spanish so that she could give it to the chefs at the different restaurants. The restaurants were very good. We ate at Mole (mexican), Aqua (italian), Bana (habachi), the buffet twice, and then the "bbq" for family concierge. All of the food was good, but Bana was the best. The property is big, so it does take a 7-10 minute walk to get to the beach, or wait for a shuttle but that usually took longer. There was always entertainment at the pool and the resort. Reynally (Sugar Rey) at the Reserve Pool, Mr. Wonderful, and Jose Reynoso all went out of their way to make sure we had a great time. Chef Rafael at Bana and Chef Miguel at Gabi Club were amazing with my wife's allergies. Jose at the North Bar also made great drinks. The paddle fitness team was also a great way to not feel too guilty for all of the "drinky, drinky" that is offered. Overall, very pleased.

reviews.author: Jimmy B
reviews.title: Our Best Family Vacation So Far!
reviews.text:
On our last day at this resort we all didn’t want to leave! We loved everything about it! The staff, the food, the rooms, the pools, the cleanliness, the beach, the events etc... We stayed for 7 days and each day was filled with different events that made our stay very enjoyable. 

My wife and I were celebrating our renewal of vows after 11 years of marriage. Our Romance Coordinator Noelia Jiménez was the best. She tended to every single one of our needs in such a professional way. We literally didn’t have to do anything, she took complete control. We were impressed by her dedication, and attention to details, always smiling and making sure we were having the best time of our lives. Which we did. Our 28 guests did too. 

We will definitely come back to this resort again, wether for another event like ours or just for vacation. We definitely recommend this to all. You will not be disappointed. 

J&K.

reviews.author: Hiway
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Overall, a very good experience.  This was our second time at Paradisus Palma Real.  The food is the best that I have had with an all inclusive.  Beach is very good and beach service is pretty good.  Staff for the mass majority is very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: ChristophNo
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Food's ok but everything else was great.  Service could have been better but having access to a butler definitely made everything easier.  Most of the servers are laid back but sometimes a little to laid back which sometimes is annoying but there were excellent service all around.

reviews.author: Raffy T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: Best trip we have been on as a family. In particular I really needed to Thank Mario and Jonathan at the Gabi Beach bar for taking such good care of me. I was always greeted with a smile and solicitousness. #bars

reviews.author: chadstutelberg
reviews.title: Great Time...Again
reviews.text: This was our 6th time to this resort in 20 years.  While the resort had changed somewhat, the experience and service had not... The people at the Paradisus are the best anywhere.  This year we had Maximo Perez as our conceirge as part of Royal Service.  Maximo went above and beyond to make sure our vacation was the best experience possible. His dedication and hard work to ensure we had a great vacation is the reason I will keep coming back to this resort.

reviews.author: Maria V
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text:
Pasamos la Semana Santa en Paradisus Palma Real y todo excelente: la comida, el trato del personal, las instalaciones....todo.
Los monitores de baile los mejores y también los camareros de la playa que eran amabilísimos y muy atentos, en especial, Ravel, quién nos atendía siempre con una sonrisa y con el mejor trato. Un hotel 100% recomendable para parejas, familias o grupos de amigos, siempre hay algo que hacer y el personal encantador.

reviews.author: Carlos D-M
reviews.title: Hotel 5 Estrellas? mas bien diria 2 o 3.
reviews.text:
No se por donde empezar,pero lo hare por lo mas evidente. El hotel esta abandonado, las habitaciones estan para tirarlas y los muebles no digamos.
El servicio ha empeorado notablemente, y ya no obtienes nada si no das suculentas propinas. Si es un todo incluido, todos deberiamos ser tratados igual, y no es asi.
Por ejemplo en la playa. Te dicen que hay un turno rotario, pero yo no consegui estar en primera linea en 7 dias, pero otros con propinas si lo consiguen. 
El botones, 20 minutos esperando a llevar las maletas, y al final las tuve que llevar yo. Reserva en restaurantes mal realizadas, teniendo que cenar en mesas diferentes 6 personas (no hablo de 20 pax). La calidad de los vinos, digamos que muy mejorabes, supuestamente franceses pero embotellados en Italia y los tintos estaban siempre calientes.
Y lo de las copas mejor no hablar. Refrescos de botellas de litro, abiertas no se cuando, tonicas inexistentes, etc.
Eso si, todos preocupados por tus quejas, pero nadie hace nada. 
Como soy socio, y ya he pagado los USD 25.000, ya nada les importa, solo intentarnos vendernos otro paquete de USD 90.000 para el Circle, otro engañabobos.
En fin, si Melia trata asi a sus socios, no se que hara con otros clientes.

reviews.author: Staci M
reviews.title: Multi Generational Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We took this trip to celebrate a 50th anniversary with three families (6 adults 5 kids 7-18).  The resort is beautiful.  The beach is great; soft sand, gorgeous water,  awesome umbrellas (i prefer no sun). It was a very windy week for us but sitting in the back of the beach was perfect. When we arrived our room was not in an ideal place for us because I like to see something tropical when waking up on a vacation and we saw a dirt road and parking lot. We spoke to Jean Cedano who was AWESOME and so helpful throughout our entire trip.  He suggested we talk to Wally Pena about the room situation and Wally quickly made an adjustment in the room for us.  We were very happy with his service.  He also greeted us every time we saw him after that during our stay. 
So our accommodations were very nice.  The water pressure in the shower was a bit to be desired but I know this is to be expected on an island. Our room was two connected rooms and the space was great.  Both rooms were big and each had a sitting room, large bathroom and large tub, we had one balcony, a kitchen and gallery kitchen. 
We have been to many all-inclusives and have never had a great food and this resort followed suit.  The food was fine, nothing stands out as great.  often times the food wasn't warm enough.  There are many restaurants to choose from and a BBQ on the beach. 
Every night there were evening activities and fun things to do.  the bar by the beach (Gabi) was always a good place to hang out at night.  Our favorite night activity was the Queen cover band - they were so fun and entertaining!
I gave a 4 on Service because some of the restaurant service was not perfect, sometime slow, food not hot; but the service outside restaurants was very good. Oh - and bring enough cash - 20% charge to get American cash

reviews.author: AMIenMacondo
reviews.title: Un lugar para repetir siempre...
reviews.text:
Somos una familia viajera y siempre estamos buscando un destino diferente para conocer; sin embargo este lugar tiene la cualidad de seducirnos y hacernos repetir la experiencia de visitarlo. 
Hospedarse en este complejo es similar a estar en un gran crucero pero en tierra firme. Cuenta con una muy buena instalación, cómodas habitaciones (Hab. 3605-3606), hermosa playa, muchas actividades y una variada oferta gastronómica. 
Pero su principal encanto radica en su gente, un ejército de personas con una auténtica disposición a atender, a agradar a los huéspedes y a resolver los inconvenientes, (si los hubiese).
Sin embargo, merecen mención especial algunas personas que se empeñaron en hacernos cada día especial con su trabajo y detalles: 
Yeimi, Rodny y Delvin, atendiéndonos en los restaurantes; Emil, con sus deliciosos aperitivos en el bar; Felipe, quien logró que cada día en la playa fuese mágico; Gerardo y Juan, apoyándonos desde la cocina con recetas especiales para mi hija que es intolerante a la lactosa, nuestro “mayordomo fiel” Gabriel y Dionisio y Arabelle, por convertir los problemas en una oportunidad para hacer feliz a las personas. 
Gracias a todos. Nos vemos en la próxima visita!

reviews.author: Jonathan P
reviews.title: Stunning views, great staff but food needs options
reviews.text: Truly relaxing atmosphere from the beachfront views to the grand pool and the kind staff. Dario Gonzalez and Davidson from the buffet deserve recognition from their attentiveness of service. Nathaniel from Rare also deserve recognition. Franklin Hernandez, Edison, Jacinto along with Dominga in the lobby bar make it fun to pay them a visit. Visit the oriental spa which is a small walk from the main resort but completely worth it. However; don’t expect to have meal options because there are only dinner restaurants outside of the buffet. Overall great resort with welcoming and ready to serve staff.

reviews.author: Rachelle W
reviews.title: Activities
reviews.text: Amazing Zumba! Best Zumba ever! Me and my friends had a GREAT time! Really good music!! Highly recommend!!!! Scooby Doo (Raphyel) is amazing. Loved the music! Raphyel is so friendly and very fun! I would recommend his Zumba class to all my friends.

reviews.author: RockStrong2627
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, BUT.....
reviews.text: The food is NOT the greatest. To top it off, the buffet has an open layout and has flies flying all over. Overall, beautiful resort and wonderful staff like Dario Gonzalez & Davidson the buffet, Nathaniel from Rare and Franklin Hernandez, Dominga, Edison & Jacinto from the main lobby bar. They were all very great and attentive. Thank you for making our stay extra special.

reviews.author: Lisa R
reviews.title: Palma Real Paradise
reviews.text: Rooms, pools and beach front lounging - first rate.   We stayed for 5 days in March leaving cold for warm sand and lazy days.   We stayed on resort just resting, sunning and having the wonderful beach waiters take care of us.  Only challenge is reserving your meals at the restaurants once you arrive.  Who know what they want for dinner every night?  Booked every restaurant we wanted without issue.  Enjoy!!

reviews.author: travelmomw2girls
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort..but the service was hot and cold.
reviews.text:
As for the property, the resort is beautiful.  Hence, the 4 stars. 

Upon arriving we got our room number, our pool towels and that's it. We were not offered to do any upgrades. We booked with Delta Vacations, so not sure if it wasn't available to do? I had to ask where and how to book our dinners.  I can handle that, so no problem, but is it too much for the dinner reservation desk to put on a smile? Maybe because I was a mere non-royal peasant...but I digress.
Then on the 2nd day there we realized there was entertainment during the day and night. I went back to the front desk and asked if they had some type of schedule, I was handed a black and white flyer with the weekly events. Thanks, a day late. 

Our room was so-so. We traveled with our two pre-teen kids, so we reserved a one-bedroom suite. Space-wise, it was perfect. However, the view was awful; construction and not so great landscaping. I would say it was a typical, dated room that was a little musty, but that's the Caribbean.  And our kids are awesome because they didn't complain about that pull-out couch bed. I couldn't even sit on it-it was horrible. I called housekeeping and asked for 4 pillows for them upon arrival..they said we have 2. Ohhhkay.  Music at neighboring hotel that was right outside our rooms lasted til about 1am. Good thing we brought a white-noise machine to help drown it out. 

Service was touch and go. You'd either get great service with a smile (and then they'd get a tip), and some experiences were just plain rude. (Waiter at Fuego-that's you.)  And you walk out.  Buffet had a lot to choose from, we ended up canceling our last dinner reservation just to go there because it was easier and you knew what you were getting. Breakfast hours are CRAZY.  It's so chaotic, but you can tell the service did their best to keep up.

Pool service was great! Jesus was so kind and attentive. But try and find a seat after 9am, and good luck. 

Free golf is not free golf. They got the two of us for about $250 (we rented one set, got premium cart, and had to buy drinks-premium cart only includes 3 waters or a beer/gatorade.) Nice enough course, but no ocean views, no waterfalls...palm trees and condo rentals. 

Overall, the place is gorgeous. The beach...eh. Seaweed and rough-ish waters. No clear, see your feet, kind of Caribbean here. I think that was one of my biggest disappointments.  Pool was a highlight. Swim up bar was so fun for the kids and their virgin Pina Colada addictions!  

I would recommend it, but we most likely will not be back to the DR.

reviews.author: Anna Payet
reviews.title: El Paraíso
reviews.text: Unas vacaciones de Semana Santa inmejorables gracias a la experiencia que hemos podido disfrutar en Hotel Paradisus Palma Real. Queremos Felicitar a todo el equipo del hotel por el servicio tan profesional y a la vez cercano. Especialmente queremos destacar la gran variedad de oferta gastronómica que ofrecen a los clientes y los servicios que hemos podido disfrutar. Nos llevamos un gran recuerdo de este paraíso gracias a Ángel Arroyo, Miguel Rodeiro, Juan Manuel Feito, Mónica Serra y a todo el equipo a su cargo.

reviews.author: wineloversMichigan
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text:
My golf group (eight guys) have stayed in various properties in the Punta Cana area over the last dozen years and our sweet spot is the Paradisus Punta Cana. We stay in the Reserve and enjoy the special attention that we receive from the moment that I start making my reservations until the time we check out. Of special note was Jose Adamas, one of the concierge staff that especially stood out. Since I organize everything for my group, it was especially important for me to do as much as possible in the pre-planning phase and to do as little organizing as possible on property so that I could enjoy my vacation maximally once I got down there, Jose took care of golf reservations, dinner reservations, advanced car/bus transportation, etc., very politely and professionally. He returned my calls/emails promptly and delivered on what he said that we would.  
If I had to pick a downside for the trip it would be the kids in the Reserve pool. There is a kiddie pool 100 feet from the reserve pool and that is where the kids should be hanging out--not at the Reserve pool. The reason that we book the Reserve area is to get away from the noise and relax and the children make that impossible. I don't think that the parents realize how disruptive their children are to others around them. 
Overall great property--we plan to return.

reviews.author: Erica H
reviews.title: Paradisus palm real royal service
reviews.text:
Superb vacation, Armando our butler, Wanda at the Royal Service bar and Pedro at the beach made our vacation extra special🐇especially on Easter very special! Excellente! Mocha gustos 👌

Back to reality.🧜🏽‍♀️28 Celsius everyday hard gig!

reviews.author: RODRIGO H
reviews.title: Ótima escolha para famílias
reviews.text:
Excelente estrutura, tanto na praia, quanto nas piscinas. Destaque para a comida. Café da manhã, almoço e jantar (buffet) farto e com ótimas opções. 
Jantamos em alguns dos restaurantes reserváveis. Só não gostamos muito do latino (Fuego). Não sei se não tivemos sorte, mas a comida demorou pra chegar (e os pratos principais também não estavam no nosso gosto).
Mas isso foi só um detalhe, porque todo o resto foi muito bom!
No dia que jantamos no Vento, foi comemoração de aniversário de duas pessoas do grupo. Não só fomos muito bem recepcionados pela Miguelina, como também tivemos um tratamento especial de todos no restaurante (Silo e Benjemin). No final, ainda nos deram um espumante para comemorar e um bolo com o nome das aniversariantes!!!
Não optamos pelo royal service, mas não nos arrependemos. Tivemos um tratamento muito vip das concierges Yanit e Erika. Não só no começo, quando nos explicaram o funcionamento do hotel e fizeram as reservas em todos os restaurantes, como também durante toda a nossa estadia. Elas sabiam os nossos nomes, o nosso apartamento e todas as nossas preferências e particularidades (sabiam quem era da família, onde estavam etc). Isso fez com que a gente se sentisse especial. Um tratamento personalizado e que fez total diferença nessa viagem.

reviews.author: parguy99
reviews.title: First class property..not so much the food and service
reviews.text:
We are a family of 11 (including 5 children ages 2-10). We have been to the Family Concierge section of Paradisus La Esmeralda, Playa del Carmen, Mexico, three times and have used that as a comparison.

The hotel grounds are incredibly beautiful and meticulously maintained in Punta Cana. The colorful flowers and landscaping set off against the natural mangroves, is a sight to behold 
The kids loved the kids club, the zip line and the bungee trampoline. The kids pool was a perfect height for the younger ones as the 3 and 4 year olds were able to stand. If there is any complaint about the hotel property, is that it's just too big. The Reserve is not set on the beach and is a good 10-15 minute walk with kids. The beaches are much nicer than those in Mexico. The sand is white and the water, incredible shades of blue.There are shuttles that run fairly often but it's a bit of an ordeal with kids to pack things up to go to the beach as opposed to just running over for a little while.

The service at the hotel, at almost every level, was disappointing. We were delayed in our arrival by 2 days because of the nor'easter snowstorm. When we arrived, we were not met by our Family Concierge, and nobody explained the amenities to us, nor did they give us any significant information about the hotel. They were mostly interested in making sure that our bill was paid up front. (Ultimately, the hotel was very nice to work with us in dealing with the missed days). We found out 2 days later that we could eat an a la carte breakfast and lunch in one of the restaurants and that there was a section for the Reserve set aside at the beach.

In Mexico, the Family Concierge would find us a few times during each day and make sure that everything was ok.  There were nights when she came to walk with the kids to dinner and gave them small presents (which they treasured) when we left.  She would make sure that our rooms were filled with our favorite beverages and snacks every day. That wasn't the case in Punta Cana. There were days we never saw the concierge and there just wasn't the same level of involvement. She added little to our experience. 

As to the rooms..there were days that the rooms weren't made up until late in the day. Turn down service would often come at 9:00 PM long after the younger kids were asleep. We ran out of towels, We ran out of water. Any beach towel that was taken back to your room would sit there forever.  As another review pointed out, for a 5 star resort, there is no excuse for not meeting and exceeding basic services. 

The restaurants in Mexico and Punta Cana almost all had the same names. The quality of the food and the level of service in Punta Cana was not very good and not close to meeting that at the Mexican resort.  Drinks were often not brought. Water was often not refilled. 

The drink service around the pool was excellent!!

All in all, we had a great time despite the issues. I asked the family, including the kids, whether they would want to come back next year, or go back to Mexico. Almost unanimously they said that they would go back to Paradisus La Esmeralda in Mexico.

reviews.author: santiago09
reviews.title: Insuffisant vu le prix
reviews.text:
Deux jours dans un beau resort pour terminer un séjour d’une semaine, voilà qui était alléchant. 
Bon, alors en vrai. À notre arrivée notre chambre n’est pas prête, alors que l’heure du Check in est passée. La chambre est un peu défraîchie, avec une minuscule télé et plein de câbles apparents, une douche à la limite de la casse. Les cartes qu’on nous donne pour accéder à la chambre ne marchent pas. Impossible de réserver dans les restaurants il ne reste de la place nulle part. Les gens se comportent comme des veaux en réservant des 7h du matin des chaises longues pour la journée ce qui fait qu’en permanence on doit chercher pour se poser alors qu’il n’y a personne qui occupe ces sièges. Faillite du monde civilisé... la plage est moyenne. 
Après, le personnel de l’hôtel est sympa. C’est pratique. On mange bien. On est pas mal. 
Mais pour ce prix, franchement, ce n’est pas à la hauteur.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: The best vacation ever!!!!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I stayed in this hotel for 6 nights in March 2017. We opted for the Royal Service upgrade during our stay. First off, we would like to thank Jose Salvador, our butler, for outstanding service. Also, Hebreo was awesome and made us delicious smoothies on the beach every day. Rafael was great for setting us up with an umbrella and towels on the beach each morning. Huge thanks!!!

Beach
The beach was beautiful and the Royal Service upgrade entitles you to a private, adults-only section on the beach. This section includes better beach chairs (more like beds) and you can reserve a spot for the day (Rafael helped us with this). This private section also has a healthy smoothie bar, which was manned by Hebreo (aka the smoothie god) who made us delicious smoothies several times a day. The beach itself is beautiful and clean, although there was a bit of seaweed washing up on shore each day. The beach also had free kayaks, paddle boards and catamarans that you could take out during the day. 

Pools
The hotel has one big pool and a section of this is Royal Service (adults only). There is also another small pool for Royal Service guests with a private bar and seating area. Staying in Royal Service was totally worth it because you can easily find umbrellas and spots by the pool, whereas the main section has limited umbrellas and they fill up early each day. With Royal Service you can have your butler reserve a spot by the pool just like the beach.

Spas
We spent a ton of time hanging out and lounging in the Spa right on the Palma Real resort. It is directly adjacent to the main pool and has warm and cool hot tubs, jacuzzis, and a stone path to walk on and stimulate your feet. It also has a cold bucket to dump water on yourself and freshen up, as well as beach chairs to relax and hot tea to drink. This was a nice, quiet area to hang out in when the pool was too cold. We also hung out at the Yhi Spa on the Reserve section of the resort and got massages there. The hot stone massage was alright but overpriced, however it was a nice experience.  If you have had a Thai massage before and enjoyed it, you probably won't enjoy this type of massage (very light pressure).

Food
The Palazzo is for Royal Service only and was by far the best lunch and dinner that was included for us. Breakfast is good too, but similar to the main buffet. There is another place you can have lunch right next to the main buffet (it has burgers and hotdogs and fries) which was also pretty good for a quick lunch. The dinner at this place was not that great. The Mediterranean restaurant was also pretty good. Passion was outstanding food, however, it comes at an added cost ($70/person). Worth it to try it at least once during the trip. The Peruvian place was not the greatest. Overall the main buffet place is pretty good, it has a massive selection for all three meals and we always went there for ice cream and snacks after our main dinner.

Butler
Jose Salvador was our butler during our stay (Royal Service) and he was outstanding. He helped us make meal reservations every day, gave us advice on activities throughout the day, helped connect us with the folks at the beach and pools, and overall made sure we had a great stay. 

Activities
The resort has some cool adult activities, like painting, candle making and dance classes. You should totally try them out because they are all fun. Caramelo is great. Aye aye aye.

Entertainment
Every evening there is a show, but coming from NYC where we are spoiled with the best in opera and broadway, it was a bit disappointing. Not why we came to Punta Cana though, so it wasn't a big deal for us.

Wifi
Super slow, use it only when you absolutely need to.

Overall the resort is beautiful, the people are friendly, there are flamingos hanging out, and it was a great week. I've been to many Caribbean resorts and this was by far the best experience I have had.

reviews.author: misty a
reviews.title: 4 days in punta cana
reviews.text:
My review of this property: it seems tired....this was a shorter 4 day Vacation and I have wanted to go home after day 1.

#1. We had a oversized 2 room suite, good in size, but lacked much. The shower didnt work right, minimal warm or hot water, no water pressure. Only day 1 were we provided wash clothes and Diet Coke in the minibar. There was only 1 small beer in the fridge each day. After that it was always a call and a long delay to get them to the room. There was a large empty kitchen, must have been a time share or villa at some point with space for even a washer and dryer. Very dated decor. The television had terrible picture and service. No movie channels. Minimal English. Only 1 working phone. Terrible wifi. And the safe was a disaster! Was hard to get to work and a stress on us to prepare to leave the room every time we had to deal with the safe!

#2 food was a let down overall. Breakfast was the best meal. Lunch offered few restaurants but numerous buffet option. However we prefer to eat al la carte. Alcohol was plentiful, but rarely offered pool side or beach service meaning you had to go to the bar. No food was allowed pool side. Drinks were served in paper cups that crumbled after the first few minute. 
Dinner lacked pizazz even though multiple restaurants. House wines included were terrible. 

#3 there were no hot tubs unless you paid to use the spa. Only 1 large pool for non-reserve guests...made us fee less important.

#4 the beach was pretty, numerous chairs and cabanas at our leisure but were always hassled by locals wanting to sell souvenirs.

#5 the team of 4 that staffed the towel cabana were down right rude and made us feel like we were asking for the moon when we asked for a towel. Every day!!

#6 the hotel ran out of napkins for breakfast and towels for pool during the daytime hours.

we do travel often and have become accustomed to great treatment but I would not return to this property unless it was free and I would want to upgrade to the reserve so I don't feel like I am a bother to the staff. 
I am not excited about punta Cana for sure and would not recommend it!!
Oh by the way, it rained 3 days! No suntan for us and there wasn't much to do with your time when it rained. I am so glad to be going home today!!

reviews.author: hairsnicole
reviews.title: Awesome place!!! Everyone is so friendly
reviews.text: The resort was wonderful, beaches the best and the rooms where fabulous!  We had room service every morning and Sotero Castillo was the most amazing! kind, so gracious.  Sotero really went out of his way to make the day wonderful! Hopefully you get to experience the pleasure of meeting Sir Sotero wonderful person.

reviews.author: Blondie6558
reviews.title: Good hotel with great staff
reviews.text: We recently stayed here on a business trip. The rooms are somewhat dated but the food and location were decent. Francis N. was our butler in the Royal Service. I cannot say enough good things about him! He was incredibly friendly and hospitable our entire  stay. If you plan to stay in Royal Service, request Francis as your butler!

reviews.author: TropicalGem5
reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: Sand here is beautiful!  The water really isn't "crystal clear" and calm like other places in the Caribbean and does have some seaweed. We booked an ocean front suite with hot tub on balcony. The room was a nice size and we loved the ocean front view. The only negative is that these more expensive ocean front suites are directly over the bar below. The loud pounding music (screaming DJ) and parties go on until 11:00 or so. We were traveling with our kids and were hoping for more sleep so that we could function the next day. We called the front desk several times but there was little they could do to help us out. There is basically a wedding here "each" day of the week, so that means a huge party each night. I'm not sure if this room is worth the money since it comes with loud pounding noise each night.  If you are at the party in the bar below this room (each night) then you won't really care... if you'd like some down time and peace and quiet at night then pick a different room. So surprised that they would put the bar below the most expensive rooms there.  ;)  We tried to move rooms but there was nothing else available.  All the fountains were dried up while we were there so we didn't get to experience the beautiful grounds. The grass was pretty fried too so maybe there was a water shortage.  The staff was friendly and hard working and they all do expect tips. We've been to all inclusive resorts where they cannot take tips, but here they do expect to be tipped. All in all it was a nice time, although I don't think we would return.

reviews.author: Maria Helena S
reviews.title: Excelente. Fui mimada pelos funcionarios
reviews.text: Hotel lindo, confortavel. Um oasis dentro de uma ilha de povos sofridos. O hotel tem um serviço de praia como nunca vi. Muitos esportes aquaticos alem de vinho geladinho para seu conforto. Cada familia tem um funcionario especificado para lhe ajudar, o nosso, Elvis, resolveu um problema muito grave com as malas q não haviam chegado conosco no aeroporto.

reviews.author: Dany V
reviews.title: Better For couple
reviews.text: The hotel and amminity are vere similar to the level at melia . The only thing different to me is the customer service is super excellent. The quality of service and drink you can get there the pool area with bed. And they bring you bottles of champagne right where you at in the pool area or most anywhere . I love the customer service the room are nice like i say very similar to level melia room. But if you are looking fir a great quiet time not crazy this one place

reviews.author: Alejandra Collazo
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Estuvimos una semana hospedados aquí. La verdad es un paraíso 😍un lugar dé ensueño, la atención de todo el personal del resort inmejorable, siempre atentos a todo , muy alegres y serviciales. Lo recomiendo 100%.

reviews.author: GermanGonzalez1975
reviews.title: Un paraíso caribeño donde sentirse a gusto y bien atendido
reviews.text:
Es la tercera vez que nos hospedamos en este resort con mi familia y, luego de haber conocido muchos otros resorts, la verdad que siempre volvemos a él, tanto por sus excelentes servicios, la buena atención y amabilidad del personal, la rica y variada comida, entre tantas cosas para valorar, que me gustaría detallar:
- la ubicación: a menos de 30' (reales) en auto del aeropuerto, lo que lo hace muy accesible.
- las instalaciones nuevas y bien mantenidas, con muy buen servicio de limpieza.
- la playa: inmejorable. Ancha, de arenas blancas y mar cálido turquesa. El concierge reserva una o dos sombrillas todos los días para la familia, con lo que no hay que estar peleando lugares ni toallas.
- piletas varias y bien atendidas
- los restaurants: variados y todos buenos. Para todos los gustos.
- vinoteca bien surtida, con vinos destacados de todo el mundo
- spa: excelente tratamiento y buenos precios y promociones.
- espectáculos: muy variado (vimos un tributo a Queen excelente).
- golf: nos quedó pendiente para otra vez, pero hay un lindísimo campo de golf al lado mismo del resort, con buenos precios para hacer 9 o 18 hoyos o tomar clase con un instructor.
- atención médica: mi hijo se contagió otitis al día siguiente que llegamos, y fuimos muy bien atendidos, con un seguimiento casi diario, por la guardia médica (mi reconocimiento al Dr. González)
Por último, al administrador del resort, quisiera destacar la cálida y servicial atención  de Raúl Jimenez, de nuestro concerge Gabriel Dalusma, y de Denny (no me acuerdo el apellido) de Coffe & Gelatto por su excelente predisposición y amabilidad

reviews.author: roadwarrior495
reviews.title: Run down and not maintained
reviews.text:
This place is a dump.  When I checked into my room, TV did not work,  Telephone did not work.  WiFi did not work.  I called the front desk from my mobile phone and all three issues were fixed within an hour.  Day 2:  took a cold shower in the morning and the TV again did not work.

Hotel is very old and tired.  It's a great location but the property is not maintained.  It rained this morning and water was leaking from the ceiling in the hallway - thank god it was not in my room (was on the top floor).

Food is mediocre.  Drinks are served in paper cups - you can taste the wax from the cup in the drink.

Most of the staff claim they don't speak English when you ask for something.

At best, this is a 3 star property - much better options are on the island.

reviews.author: gjb-6
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text:
I was lucky enough to join my wife for a business trip here. I quickly realized that all inclusive is one thing but above and beyond is another. The quality of food, drink and service was beyond high expectations. With that being said, it should be for the price they charge. You won't be disappointed. 

The grounds are immaculate and decent size. Not just the beach front everyone really comes for.  The selection of restaurants is impressive and quality is outstanding.

reviews.author: wgtstudents
reviews.title: lugar de ensueño para unas buenas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Servicio 5 estrellas, todo muy bueno, las comidas, las habitaciones, vale la pena la inversion en comodidad especialmente si quieres unas vacaciones agradables.
buenos shows en la noche, buenos licores y en general ninguna queja.

reviews.author: JORGINHO2009
reviews.title: Wilson Guzmán from Hydro Grill
reviews.text: Excelente atención de Wilson Guzmán from Hydro Grill, pendiente de las necesidades de uno antes y luego de salir de la piscina. Cuando vengan no duden en buscarlo que el estará ahí atento a su disposición y servicio.

reviews.author: Ana Paula P
reviews.title: Impressões de viagem a Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Boas instalações, comida razoável mas os empregados pouco educados, sem qualquer noção sobre como se deve tratar os clientes.
As cadeiras da praia , às 9 horas estão quase todas reservadas, sem ninguém a usá-las e são distribuídas, ao belo prazer de uns empregados sem educação e sempre à espera de gratificação .
Questionei este facto na recepção e a resposta foi q era o serviço famíily concierg e q só as famílias com crianças podiam fazer reserva de cadeiras. 
Não faz qualquer sentido esta explicação pq quando comprei a viagem não me referiram q ia para uma praia  com estes condicionalismos.
Falaram-me então no Royal Service, uns quartos perto da praia,  só para adultos e com serviços especiais.
" SÓ " teria q pagar mais 85 dólares por pessoa/dia ( 170 o casal).
Para isto poderia usar uns créditos promocionais, q vêm mencionados no voucher da viagem mas q só servem para gastar mais dinheiro.
Resumindo, uma aldrabice pegada !
Só num país subdesenvolvido isto é viável.
Fiquei vacinada contra a república dominicana. 
Esperava muito melhor pelo preço que paguei.

reviews.author: Allex A
reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text:
This is the place to choose if you are coming to DR. Let me break it down:

The grounds, beach, and room- BREATHTAKING. It is beautiful and well kept wherever you go. Very relaxing and luxurious. Also (and this was important to me) it was private- they only have 500 something rooms, so while it was social, it was never too crowded. You could always find a spot at the bar, on a cabana, in the buffet, etc. without waiting. You'll also notice, their beach chairs are much nicer than a lot of their other counterparts, and I like being comfortable on the beach.

The service- Good- people are friendly and professional. You might have to send out a reminder every once in a while, but generally, they are on top of it.

Royal Service- This is difficult- Yes, Royal Service was definitely worth the extra splurge, but coming to this hotel would still be amazing without it. We were greeted with scented towels, taken on a tour, had our baggage delivered to our room, and given a personal butler. He reserved cabanas on the beach for us, helped us with our reservations, delivered wine, mamajuana, fruit, and cheese plates to our room, and made a BEAUTIFUL bath the night of the wedding. There were a few difficulties- he wouldn't deliver beer to the room my husband went to to get ready with his groomsmen, saying he didn't know where it was (really?) and he sort of disappeared the last day after saying he would deliver our luggage, leaving us the stress of trying to do that ourselves and making sure the shuttle wouldn't leave us, but overall, he brought a lot of wonderful surprises.

The food- Great, and varied! There is a lot to choose from. Honestly, out of all of the restaurants I tried, the Indian food in the main NAOS buffet was the most amazing. DELISH. Aside from that, in order, I liked Palazzo best (Royal Service only,) followed by Vento, Aqua, Rare, Bana, and lastly Fuego (it's RS only, and the food was fine, but the service lacked a bit.) I didn't have a chance to try Blue Agave, but the people who came with me enjoyed it.

Romance department- I was a bride, and our friends and family came with us here. This department was amazing. I had Noelia helping me, and if you are a planning a wedding, and you are lucky enough to get her, you are in good hands. She was PERFECT. Usually things go wrong on wedding days with big parties like this, but nothing did. She took care of everything, and made it so relaxing for me. It was wonderful. The hair and makeup artist Anny, was fantastic, and the photographers, tropic one studio, were excellent as well. My photographer, JC, figured out the style I like within five minutes, and thought of some poses that really worked out. I was so pleased with the photos. 

This hotel delivers an experience, rather than just room and board. You should absolutely choose it.

reviews.author: Troy A
reviews.title: Our Butler service was spectacular!
reviews.text: The room was immaculate with 24/7 room service and a very dedicated butler. If you have the option to choose I would highly recommend Francis who treated us amazingly and provided countless services throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Xcaliba8
reviews.title: Majestic stay for a beautiful wedding where we were immersed by excellent service in paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for five days and four nights.  two nights were spent at the Reserve section of the resort and two nights at the main resort.  All four nights were amazing and we were pampered by awesome service in paradise.  The minute we arrived we were introduced to Sandy and Gabriel (Gabi).  They took care of us for the duration of our stay, even though they are primarily based out of the Reserve.  They were helpful in helping managing our restaurant our reservations, activities and went above and beyond for a surprise for my wife on her birthday.  The rooms were spacious and clean, with twice a day turn down service.  The Reserve side of the resort is definitely more family oriented and quiet, so we were appreciated we were able to enjoy both the tranquil side and the party side of the resort.  The pools were clean, as was the beach.  Beyond everything, the service was impeccable and this was further illustrated at how well the wedding that we attended was planned, organized and executed.  

We will definitely come back to this resort and we recommend that you ask for either Sandy or Gabriel, especially if you are checking into the Reserve side of the resort.  They will help ensure you have a marvelous stay.

reviews.author: Lupe C
reviews.title: Drinks /service
reviews.text: Andrea smoothie  bar, great service  excellent drinks very nice lady. I really  enjoyed  my trip to Dominican Republic,  Punta Cana  Paradisus Palma Real resorts thanks Andrea for prepared delicious  smoothies.

reviews.author: Jackie A
reviews.title: Some Good....Some Bad
reviews.text:
First of all...this resort is absolutely beautiful.  The pools are great huge, and the grounds and pathways are manicured to perfection.  Room are wonderful.  We had a 2 bedroom suite with a master bedroom w/ sitting large sitting area, a bedroom with twin bed and a large living room in between.  Both rooms had balconies overlooking the pool.  We were on the third floor...there are no elevators.
Maria at Gabi's is wonderful and WIlson at the Gabi Grill is the best !!!
The service is sub-par in many places....they take your drink order at meals, but the drink sometimes never comes!  I fell and ended up in the emergency room.  The doctor at the resort was great, but no one from the staff or management ever came up to me when I fell, nor checked up on me afterward  (and yes, they did see me fall.)
IF you don't stay in the concierge suites you will probably not get reservations for dinner in any of the restaurants.  Palapas at the beach and by the pools are reserved, but if not occupied by 10AM they are up for grabs.
Bottom line is the grounds are beautiful, food is OK, service not great.  We were a large family group of 16 so we had a great time being together, but I don't think we would return.  Make sure you double and triple check your reservations....part of our group ended up at another hotel (Paradisus Palma Real) which was the fault of their central booking department.  They were moved back with us after 2 days, but what a hassle....felt like we lost 2 days of our family reunion.

reviews.author: James L
reviews.title: Great Location, Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Great location, nice resort, horrible customer service. They spent more time trying to sell the next trip vs. making the current trip a great experience. Reservations for dinner were messed up every night. For the rates they charge you should expect more.  Visit Punta Cana but choose from one of the many other fine resorts.

reviews.author: deniseandfrancois
reviews.title: Too many little annoyances
reviews.text: We have been members of the Melia for over 10 years.  I must say this trip was frustrating.  Upon arrival we had one concierge, Junior who was amazing.  Then he was off for 3 days.  That's when all the problems began.  Our first morning we were awoken at 6:45 AM by the ambient music the hotel plays.  REALLY!!!! Dinner reservations were a nightmare!  with two young kids we repeatedly asked for early dinner since they would fall asleep at the table otherwise.  The two people who helped us in our lobby kept reassuring us that it would be taken care of by the next day, but of course it wasn't.  There is a serious lack of communication between employees.  Tammy and Junior were the only ones who were helpful.  Anjelina Rosario in the Gabi was amazing.  She remembered our names, took care of us and was very attentive.  Eventually with all the frustrations I spoke with the manager Silvio. He was quite helpful.  He arranged for us to have early dinners and compensated us with a visit to the spa for all the problems.  But of course the cherry on top is the sales people that don't leave you alone!  We are already members, LEAVE US ALONE!!!! Drinks were ok, could have been better.  One night they accidentally put alcohol in my son's virgin Pina Colada!  Thank God he was honest about it. I wouldn't go back there.

reviews.author: Jose Angelo S
reviews.title: Retorno apos tres anos
reviews.text:
Antes de tudo o local e previlegiado, permanecem os elogios da visita anterior, mas desta vez vou resaltar os pontos que ao meu ver sao cruciais para quem decide ficar recluso por um periodo nao muito curto, no meu caso a permanencia foi de 8 noites.

1 - Restaurantes tematicos de uso noturno nao mais tem a qualidade de 3 anos atraz, destaque para o Aqua que mantem aquela cozinha, aliaz o complexo onde esta o Aqua tem a gerencia de uma brasileira.

2 - A comida japonesa aquem do desejado e a mexicana por favor nao tinha cabimento.

3 - O restaurante diario bem sortido para todos os sabores peca pelo excesso de ofertas em detrimento de controle de um bom chef.

4 - As instalacoes ja demonstram o envelhecimento, o que e lamentavel
correndo o risco de ficar parecido aos velhos hoteis de Miami; As almofadas que decoram os quartos estao com mau cheiro e alguns quartos o odor de mofo e penetrante,talvez proveniente 
dos acondicionadores da ar.

Finalizando o local e excelente no tocante a natureza e Paradisus mas com o devido cuidado caiu em ranking
perdendo para outros complexos que em breve visitatei.

reviews.author: Dikova
reviews.title: Lovely vacation
reviews.text: Everyting was perfect, we spent a wonderful week in The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. The food was good, big and clean rooms, the staff was very polite and helpful. Special thanks to the pool and beach staff: Luis Florian, Melvin Concepcion, Luis Santana, Santo Frias and Ramon Ramirez.

reviews.author: Catiana P
reviews.title: Amazing trip!!
reviews.text: My best friend and I stayed at this resort for 5 days, 4 nights and we wish we never left! It was definitely family-friendly, so I highly recommend this resort for families. Although it wasn't party central, we still had an amazing time. There was always dancing and fun activities to do. We would always go to dinner, hang out at Gabi Bar after and then make our way to the Red Lounge. Everything was so so beautiful. Our room was so comfortable and clean. We had an issue with our television at some point, but we called and it was immediately taken care of. The staff was so nice and caring. Daniel was a server by the pool and beach area. He was amazing. He would make sure that we were never empty-handed when it came to drinks, and he made them so well!! We are so sad that we had to leave. We would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: bdznyc
reviews.title: Beautiful facility, but be warned... they told us they didn't have a room
reviews.text:
Arrived to the the hotel only to be told they didn't have a room for us (not meaning just for the next few hours, but for the entire trip).  After much back and forth, and wasted time and aggravation, we ultimately were provided a room -- but we watched other guests agree to move to another property so this wasn't an issue limited to just our party.

Otherwise, the remainder of the trip was enjoyable.  The room was excellent.  Food was better than expected.  Drinks were good (although the tequila could use some upgrading  -- $6 additional for Patron).  Pool was fantastic with many chairs and never crowded (even when sold out).  Events at night were a real plus.  

The idea of overselling rooms at an international destination, and not having the courtesy of contacting the guest in advance of their departure is inexcusable.

reviews.author: 120erikj
reviews.title: It was a DREAM ;)
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience but disposed about promises and results.  

I would recommend the hotel to friends and colleagues.

Everything was present sun, beach, food and drinks   what do you need more ;)

----------

reviews.author: mickyloghin
reviews.title: Best Resort Ever
reviews.text: This was by far the best resort my husband and I have ever visited. We had the Royal Service and we definitely treated like Royals since our arrival there. Francis was always checking up to make sure we had everything we needed and went above an beyond to surprise us with big and little details that made us feel at home while enjoying a marvellous vacation. I loved that all the staff was genuinely kind and helpful, especially Francis. The rooms are clean, the food is great and the garden is something out of this world. Loved it!

reviews.author: C B
reviews.title: run down, rude front desk personnel, tough to communicate with staff in english, some terrible food
reviews.text: run down hotel, awful seating on beach and around pool, poor quality food. limited choices, rude staff when bringing up an issue, phones don't work, room service fails to bring complete order, requests not followed up on, lot of staff just standing around doing what??,  laundry not picked up, ice buckets don't get filled even when requested ... 2 star amateurism at its best ... over priced, waste of money for what you receive ..... back to cruising and international top hotel chains

reviews.author: marina g
reviews.title: Paradise on earth
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort is breathtaking.  I have never experienced such excellent care in the Royal service.  Our butler, Alberto, was ubiquitous; he made our stay fabulous.  The private beach and pool were the highlight of the trip.  Swimming with sharks and Manta Rays was certainly a unique experience.  That excursion was capped off with a trip to the lagoon where fun and frivolity ensued.  My husband and I loved every minute of it.

reviews.author: 1JWT2014
reviews.title: Great place for relaxation.
reviews.text: We visited as a family recently and found the resort and staff to be wonderful. Raul Jimenez took great care of us by the pool. The daily activities and nighttime entertainment are a plus. The beach is beautiful, the all inclusive restaurants are good. It's a great place for family vacations. We will be back.

reviews.author: Kate M
reviews.title: Excellent service, beautiful surroundings
reviews.text:
I have been to this resort several times and the pool service was wonderful this time. Our pool guy, Raul Jimenez, was an absolute pleasure. He attended to our every need before we knew we needed it. He always kept us well furnished with drinks, and he was such a pleasure to interact with. We really liked seeing Raul Jimenez show up with a cold drink in his hands.

The resort is also wonderful. The pool and beach are great and the food is high quality. I really enjoyed the after-dinner shows.

reviews.author: gardonur
reviews.title: Vacaciones familiares
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado unas vacaciones estupendas estuvimos del 12 de abril al  21 eramos un grupo de 10 personas y estuvimos en el SERVICIO Real agradecer a José Salvador y Francis Newton todos los detalles q tuvieron desde hacernos todas las reservas hasta su postre típico de habichuelas dulces, agradecer al personal de la playa Pedro Cedano y Francisco Cabrera siempre con una sonrisa
La comida muy buena y el bufet variado
Tienen q mejorar la conexion a internet
Esperamos volver pronto

reviews.author: norma m
reviews.title: El paraiso
reviews.text:
Es maravilloso siempre volvemos este año lo hicimos desde el 4/3 al 18/3/17.
El personal de 10 .
Recuerdo especial para Ramón Ramírez y Benita los que atienden el Bar de la playa 
exclusiva para la reserva y family concierge. Son divinos en ningún lugar del mundo te tratan de esa manera.
Todos los empleados son únicos siempre están pendientes de tus necesidades.
Las instalaciones siempre bien cuidadas y limpias en fin es un verdadero paraíso

reviews.author: Jerry S
reviews.title: A for Appearance. C- for Execution
reviews.text:
We opted for a 4 night stay at this facility.
Our initial reaction to Paradisius was "WOW!". The architecture was grandiose and beautiful. The beach was beautiful. The buildings picturesque.The rooms were gorgeous. The atmosphere evoked feelings of peace and relaxation. The Staff was courteous and presented well. The grounds nicely manicured and decorated. I found the Wedding Gazebo area especially relaxing.

While the room looked nice, with a canopied bed and in-room jacuzzi, there were some significant issues. I first discovered the bathroom sink would not drain properly. Then, I realized the television volume could not be adjusted between level 6 loudness and OFF resulting in my inability to quietly watch TV while my wife was sleeping. And finally, when the A/C fan shut off as the room came to temperature, as I was sleeping, I became aware the toilet tank was refiling every 1.5 minutes. (I eventually shut off the water supply at 3am so I could get some sleep.

Long-story-short: The room was adequately repaired the next day... after multiple attempts. So much for day one. (The Hotel DID compensate us for our discomfort with a refund for one night AND a dinner for 4 at one of their "for pay" restaurants.)

The rest of the stay was uneventful, except for the next night, when housekeeping decided to make their rounds for service at 10:30 pm. (Yes. I was sound asleep.)

The food at the included restaurants was average. The buffet, while visually appealing and exceptionally varied choices, could have been better managed as far as temperature control.

One evening, we ate at Palazzo (one of the "for pay" restaurants), and it was FANTASTIC! One of the best meals I've had in a while.

The couple we were traveling with had problems with the latch on the balcony door. It  was broken, and the room had a significant mildew smell with the A/C running.

All in all, if you like the "all-inclusive" type resort, this one was just OK.

reviews.author: 213krista
reviews.title: Pretty resort but beware
reviews.text:
I'll start with the few positives. The grounds are really beautiful and the beach is lovely. The room was nice, nothing overly impressive but nothing to complain about.   
Many people have complained about the distance to the beach and I enjoyed the walking everyday, but could see how it would be difficult with elderly or young kids. There did seem to be a decent amount of shuttles, but we never used them so not sure the time in between rides. We stayed at The Reserve in one of the very first buildings, so farthest from the beach and it was about a 10 minute walk. 

Not to the not so good. The service here is seriously poor. We spent about $150 in tips over 4 days and rarely got so much as a smile.  We had no kids with us, required no special requests in food, and are pretty low maintenance diners and we had to constantly flag down employees to get service. And when we did get someone's attention , the service was often rude.  

The drinks were short poured, which is laughable at an all inclusive and the only bar where an employee was attentive was at the M Bar. 

The food is mediocre at best and making reservations are just a pain.

And in regards to the food. Beware. My husband got food poisoning at some point on this trip. We cannot pinpoint what restaurant but on the last night he started vomiting at midnight and it was quite scary. After being up all night I went to the reception desk to see if we can get some ginger ale when someone got there around 7:30. I explained the situation and she looked annoyed and made 2 calls, where she was laughing and smiling and clearly talking about other things. She hung up and told me no, there is no ginger ale until service stocks the mini bar later that day.  What? You have how many restaurants and bars and no one has access to a ginger ale?!?!?  That is absurd. 

My husband was so ill he had to get IV fluids at the airport before the flight and we almost weren't allowed on , but finally got a doctors clearance. 

So no, we were not at all impressed with this resort. We have stayed at some wonderful all inclusives  with amazing service and had such high hopes for this one and were tremendously disappointed.

reviews.author: Mayra L
reviews.title: Feo, viejo, NO lo recomiendo! Barcelo deluxe mil veces mejor!
reviews.text:
Habitación: piso 3 por escalera (NO HAY ASCENSOR), manchas de humedad, frigobar apagado (bebidas calientes), no funcionaba el inodoro, tampoco la televisión (de tubo). 
Hotel: antiguo. Mal servicio y comida. 
Hay todo el tiempo fiestas privadas, casamientos, etc. Mala organización para los que estamos de vacaciones descansando. 
No hay show nocturno. Las barras cierran temprano. Aburrido.
Los restaurantes ofrecen menú muy limitado. La comida en general es poco variada.
Mala señal de wifi.
Vine por segunda vez a punta cana y en esta oportunidad de luna de miel, lamento haber elegido este hotel, no vale el precio que cobran. Recomiendo una y mil veces el Barceló Bávaro deluxe (donde vine la primera vez) donde todo es moderno, la atención excelente, la comida riquísima y variada, divertido y las habitaciones soñadas. No vengan a este hotel que no es nada de lo que publican.

reviews.author: Beluga1968
reviews.title: Oh la la loin du Paradis!!!
reviews.text:
Arrivé dimanche de Pâques Check in, hors contrôle. mis dans un coin pendant une heure reçois notre chambre au 1 er étage avec vue sur la machine à crème glacée. La place est bondée des très jeunes enfants partout ça cri et ça pleure je suis à THe RESERVE  pour la tranquillité je suis déjà allé à the reserve palm real à 10 minute de la et j avais fait un voyage de rêve. Nous avons voulu Le reproduire avec mon ado de 17 ans.Mais c est pas ca qui s est  passé, On a vécu l équivalent d' une semaine au centre d achat la semaine de Noël pas moyen de se cacher dans un coin tranquille c est trop loader pour l espace disponible. PAS DE PLACE DANS LES SECTIONS POURTANT SUPPOSÉES RÉSERVÉ NI À LA PISCINE, ni à la Plage. ( quand on est obligé de se coucher dans le sable ou sur les abords de la piscine, incapable d avoir des chaises, il y a un mega  problème de gestion !!!!!! J ai essayer de changer de chambre pour un coin moins actif style côté jardin impossible on me propose de Downgrader côté paradisus régulier sans compensation dans une chambre plus que la moitié moins 
Grande et on me fait comprendre que puisque j ai booké  avec un agence ils ne peuvent pas  faire grand chose il me recommande fortement de passer directement par eux la prochaine fois.Donc je vais voir mon représentants sun wing Dans ce  cas ci lui aussi n a pas de solutions, on demande de changer d hôtel il me réfère à une autre personne au-dessus de lui elle nous appelle et elle a l 'air de comprendre la situation nous propose  de choisir 3 hôtels vendus par Sunwing aux  alentours et qu elle va nous rappeler le lendemain entre 11et 14 hrs.PAS DE SON PAS D IMAGE Elle ne NOUS A JAMAIS  RAPPELER et NOUS N AVONS jamais retrouvé le représentant sun wing non plus sur le site.
Alors on S EST  résigné à vivre avec,  Mais ça avait l 'air d un mauvais Cuba !!!!! à un certain moment plus d œufs  au buffet  au déjeuner plus de sprite pendant une demi journée pas de vin rouge à la Réserve pendant souper à la carte ce n est  pas rien !!!! on est au paradisus 5 étoiles étoiles Conseil amenez  vous yde l argent US Le taux de change de l hôtel 55us pour 100 canadiens.Nouveau à punta cana taxe 10.00us à l entrée et 20.00 us à la sortie ou 35.00 canadiens.Prix du vin a la carte exorbitant et 27% de taxe par dessus nous avons fait le Resto payant Passion 7 étoile Michelin 95.00 us chaque avec accord mets vin 55.00 us souper seulement très bon Mais dispendieux pour la qualité du vin servis.Le reste des Resto à la carte évitez  le Grill service pourri et bouffe ordinaire Fuego très bien et une belle gagne de serveurs  attentionnés Aqua ordinaire.  mexicain bon le midi Le buffet du reserve bon Le midi tard et Le soir Le reste du temps c est la jungle les enfant se baigne dans les fontaine aucun contrôle dans la place et le buffet très petit avec les carrosse en plus pas évident.Gros effort des serveurs en général ils ont vécus vraiment l enfer cette dernière semaine et ce n est pas fini ça entrait encore ce matin je me croyais à l entrée d une grosse garderie.Donc très déçu de ma semaine et surtout de Melia et sun wing je voyage depuis 30 ans Mais c est terminé République dominicaine vous m avez écœuré solide et Melia j ai toujours  cru en vous dans plusieurs pays Mais la vous m avez vraiment déçu.

reviews.author: MaryB
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - but beware the Melia Club timeshare!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, friendly staff and great location. The food is good and the beach is beautiful. One word of caution – stay away from the time share deal. It will take at least a half day of your vacation and what you are promised is not what you get. This is our second Melia resort vacation. We are club members, but I think this was a huge mistake. We are paying lots of money with an annual fee. The “all inclusive” is not included with membership and despite what anyone tells you it is not a flexible program. You have a limit on the type of room and any changes will cost you. Certainly not what I expected for the $$$ and unfortunately not what I was told. There are so many rules my head hurts from trying to figure it out (and I read regulatory guidance from the federal government all day!) so bottom line – go this resort is a great vacation as is the Paradisus Punta Cana. But avoid the club membership!!

reviews.author: Antoinette M
reviews.title: Family Vacation Spring Break 2017
reviews.text: Stayed during spring break Easter 2017 with family at Reserve.  Overall very friendly staff, Louise, Raynold, Sophia, Jose at pool most friendly.  Quality of food could be a little better and paying for concierge service I wish the evenings with reservations and requests were a little smoother.

reviews.author: Stacycda
reviews.title: Perfect weather, beach and location
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time.  We had junior suites with garden views.  they were beautiful  The pool was great and the beach was spectacular.  We loved the restaurants - the Italian one and Bana (Japanese) were our favorites.  The buffett had a wonderful breakfast and lunch.  Room service would good. I wished for a few more wine choices in the all inclusive price but overall the wine was ok.  The hotel mall was all high end and not really a marketplace but we visited.  It was a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Russ B
reviews.title: Recent Vacation Family Comcierge
reviews.text: My family and I just returned.  The grounds are beautiful.  The beach and pools were very nice.  We did the family concierge so we had a cabana every day. We had 3 different concierge attendants during our stay.  This was frustrating.  We also were promised restaraunt Bana two nights in a row.  Finally, we were able to eat there the third night.  This was especially disappointing for the kids.  Overall, the food was slightly above average.  My wife and I especially liked Aqua as well as The Grille.  Unfortunately, the overall service was a 3.5 at best.  We vacationed at the Paradisus Cancun and found the service to be much better.  Of course with any resort, there are always a few exceptions.  Wilson at the Hydro Grille was excellent.  He remembered my name as well as what I liked to drink.  Overall, I would give this resort between 3.5 and 4 stars.  Grounds, the beach, and the pools, are a 5.

reviews.author: Book C
reviews.title: Good property, Average Service
reviews.text: Not worth the premium paid.  Service level not comparable to other top Melia properties.  Staff, specifically service staff in restaurants and bars did not provide anywhere close to unforgettable experience that we hoped for (and paid for).

reviews.author: becnanQc
reviews.title: Un gros WOW
reviews.text: Novembre 2014. Super site. Magestueux. Nourriture plus qu'excellente. Beaucoup de choix dans les buffets, qui étaient à mon avis, meilleurs que les restos à la carte. À la piscine le jour, catch of the day disponible et fraîchement cuite devant vous. Service irréprochable. Prise en charge personalisée à l'arrivée. Un 6 étoiles ! Chambre Master très grande et boiseries superbes. Grand bain à remous. Pièces séparées et grand balcon. Service de concierge super et voiturettes disponibles pour les déplacements, car le site est immence. Superbes allées pour marcher vers la plage. Belle plage. Lits de plage. Beaucoup d'ombre. Grandes piscines et animation. Un bel hôtel avec luxe. J'y retournerai un jour !

reviews.author: faltmann
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
Increíble todo! Sobre el la atención de la gente !!! Las instalaciones de lujo y siempre muy limpias! 
Los restos muy buenos todos ! Estamos muy contento con el viaje que realizamos y del hotel que vinimos a vacacionar ... volveremos !!!

reviews.author: jtuchsch2017
reviews.title: Fantastic 2nd Honeymoon
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus left a lasting impression.  Miguel, our butler, made us feel very welcome and customized his interactions with us perfectly.  He was great to talk to and answered lots of questions about the resort, surrounding areas, and culture of DR.
