We loved the fact that he shared his family background and deep rooted traditions and beliefs.  A wonderful man.  Rafael, our beach concierge, wouldn't let me lift a finger at the beach.  Even when he caught me grabbing a drink walking back from the room.  He was personable, friendly, and made us feel like we were the most important people there.  He chatted with us frequently which made the time even more enjoyable.  Last but not least, Juan Suarez, our daily waiter in the buffet is one of the finest customer service individuals I've ever met.  He remembered us from the first day we had breakfast, and we ended up planning our meals around his schedule.  We didn't chat much with him, but he made us feel so comfortable we looked forward to seeing him each day.  A consummate professional.  Overall the resort was great and very relaxing.  The food was phenomenal, especially the royal service Italian restaurant, which we enjoyed twice.  A few minor hiccups could have been handled a little better, but nothing that would make me think twice about staying there again.  If you plan a trip to Paradisus, definitely upgrade to Royal Service.  AND, seek out Miguel, Rafael, and Juan!  You won't regret it.

reviews.author: cyoda21
reviews.title: Trip of a life time
reviews.text: What a great place to vacation. Sergio mateo out guest representative was amazing. We had such a great time. Thank you for the fun and memories.... the resort was amazing the food was great. Everyone was friendly. I have nothing bad to say. Was truly an experience.

reviews.author: ptleon
reviews.title: Gran experiencia
reviews.text: Vinimos por la boda de unos amigos y desde que llegamos todo ha sido maravilloso. Las instalaciones, la comida, los cuartos. Sobre todas las cosas, lo que debe destacarse es la calidez y amabilidad del servicio, Alexis Angomas, quien surtió nuestro bar de servicio, Vladimir Rodríguez, quien se puso a nuestras ordenes desde antes de llegar y Milton, quien nos recibió a nuestra llegada, fueron los componentes esenciales de la experiencia. ¡Muchas gracias, sin duda volveremos!

reviews.author: ChadBaltimore_Md
reviews.title: Nice Resort...have realistic expectations.
reviews.text:
Traveled with w group of 17 people ages from 2-70.
1. Transfer to and from airport, no issues.
2. Upon arrival they did not have one of our Family suites.  They had us booked at the The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real instead of with the rest of our family.  Not the local staffs fault and they did the best to accommodate us. Melia, Paradisus Parent company should have know we all wanted the same resort.  Bottom line make sure you confirm what resort you are supposed to be at and be very specific.  We ended moving to the Punta Cana resort after 2 nights at the Palma Real.  Both are owned by Melia, the Palma Real is more expensive and nicer.  Jurandy at the Reserve Lounge was very helpful with laying out options for us but his hands were tied since they were overbooked.  We found out the Palma Real was overbooked as well when we tried to see if we could bring the rest of our group over there.
3. Buffet at Reserve is ok, Maria at the Reserve Buffet was great. We preferred the main buffet by the beach.
4. Reservations at Restaurants are a joke unless you want to eat late.  Read the other reviews on that.  We didn't really expect to get 16 of us at one time but did try for smaller groups with no luck.
5. The Reserve has a nice private area on the beach. If you aren't Family Concierge you can't reserve a cabana, BUT, go down after 10 and if you can get one if no one has showed up for the reserved ones.
6. Beach is gorgeous.
7. Definitely a language barrier with some of the staff.  They try very hard and one needs to remember that you are in their country and as visitors you need to be patient and try to be very clear on what you are saying.  They may not understand what you are saying but may say 'yes', make sure you confirm.  On the flip side some staff will definitely give you the lip service and tell you want you want to hear. (that's the hospitality business in many parts of the world)
8. Rooms.  We had a 2 bedroom suite which was huge.  Master Bedroom had Bathroom w/shower, Tub, King Bed in one Room, Living room with a sofa bed.  2nd Bedroom had Bathroom w/shower, tub, 2 Full beds,large family room with table, 2 sofa beds. Large Family room was in between the 2 bedrooms.
9. Entertainment- the Michael Jackson show was AMAZING! One of the best resort shows I've seen.
OVERALL- Nice trip, grounds are gorgeous, Casino Slots were very generous, Food Average but lots of options, go for the beach, Rooms very nice and larger. tip$, tip$, tip$. They are VERY AWARE of TripAdvisor Reviews at this resort so if you have an issue you might want to mention that you write reviews. Staff was very friendly and accommodated us as much as they could given our rocky start there.  Not sure if we would go back.  We have done Club Med in Ixtapa (3X and our Favorite) and Cancun (1X) and think we might give Club Med Punta Cana a shot since we love the Club Med Experience.

reviews.author: milliiii
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: Son super maravolloso los consideramos parte de nuestra familia por que nos hacen sentir como en casa sin duda alguna cada año regresamos por estos chicos Raynold Tamayo activities guys Luis Florian,melvin concepcion, Ramon concierge, Luis santana  concierge, jose de los santos concierge, jhordan Rosario 🤗🤗🤗

reviews.author: jayz00m
reviews.title: Loved the Reserve - A fun week in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We are a family of 4 with 2 boys (ages 6 & 10) and we went to the Reserve over their Easter break. It was a fantastic trip.  We went to one of the Barcelo Bavaro beach hotels and it was good, but this was MUCH better.  Now you will pay a little more for the Reserve but it was totally worth it.  The room itself was okay, nice enough although small for a 1 bedroom suite.  What you are really paying for is better food and service.  The room comes with a concierge and ours, Sofia, was great.  Everyday she arranged for a hut at the pool or beach and also took care of all the dinner reservations. Also answered any of our questions and checked in on us during the day.  The kids club was good. My 6 year old LOVED it and couldn't get enough time there. Our 10 year old was okay with it and spent minimum time there.

The food was so much better than other all inclusive I've been to in many places. The a la Carte sit down places are real restaurants, not a huge cafe turned into a smaller restaurant.  The Mexican restaurant was the best, try the grouper.  The others were generally good too.

Also, if you are going snorkeling and have at least 4 of you then consider renting your own boat.  For $100 more you can avoid the large crowds and it was worth it.  We split the time between fishing, snorkeling, and swimming which made the boat time more fun.

reviews.author: ALEJANDRA  S
reviews.title: FABULOSA VACACIONES CON CARAMELO Y SHAKY SHAKY
reviews.text: Muy simpáticos y muy divertidos, unas vacaciones maravillosas, esperamos volver y pasar unas vacaciones igual, todo muy divertido y en un minuto te sientes genial con el personal son súper amables ,simpáticos amigables

reviews.author: Monica H
reviews.title: Great Family Trip
reviews.text:
What a wonderful place to stay for Spring Break with my family of 5: two teenage daughters and one 11 year old son. I wanted to share some of our experience to help you make a decision. *We did not have Royal Service - they said we could not upgrade since we have kids - and didn't feel like we needed it at all*

Rooms
We were SO nervous that the resort would be overbooked (because of Trip Advisor reviews). Our Costco Travel agent said she had never heard of that and that we could call them if it happens, but were pleasantly surprised that our two rooms were available and right next to each other 3032 and 3031. The rooms were very clean and room service was twice a day and great. We had two Paradisus Junior Suites. A few nit picky things - the shower handles were pulled away from the wall, as was the mirror, the door handle to the room was loose, the shower temperature changes a lot so you have to keep adjusting but the shower (but pressure was great), toilet didn't always flush correctly.

Beach and Pool
The sand is super soft and water is warm and GORGEOUS - waves are low. There are lifeguards. The main pool is HUGE with a swim up bar and so much fun. Our 11 year old made some great friends and had a blast swimming for hours in the pool. One day they brought out paddle boards and the kids paddled around for a few hours - GREAT FUN! The girls and I did aqua aerobics and loved it. Very easy to get towels and they were comfy and large (TIP: get a daily activity schedule at the towel place).

Daniel DelCarmen and Nathanael Fernandez were our pool waiters. They were SOOOOO friendly, fun and nice. We laughed so much with them and they treated us like royalty.

Food & Drinks
Dinner:This was our main complaint about the vacation. AC supposedly made us reservations at different restaurants every night but the first two nights we weren't on the list. So we stopped going to the restaurants and ate at the buffet or Blue Agave (the salmon burger was delish). The buffet was nice and always had fresh fish that was cooked perfectly. The fruit and salad bar were good. 
At breakfast the watermelon and green juices were awesome. Our favorite waiters were Rander, Francisco Roman and Junior Martes - they got to know us, were so sweet and took great care of us.

Snacks - the kids loved the Gelato Bar and got gummies, oreos and gelato. We all loved getting french fries at Blue Agave and bringing a plate over to the pool - (you have to ask the cook for fries but well worth it!).

My husband got a special margarita every afternoon at the margarita bar - he loved the unique tequila (soaked in cinnamon & jalapeno). We also really liked the rose wine.

Scuba
My husband and son took the scuba lesson and tried it in the pool but didn't in the ocean because of windy, poor conditions.

Selling
One annoying thing was that we felt like there was someone selling something to us a lot. AC was great when we got to the resort - very helpful but on day 2 or 3 tried to make us feel guilty and go to a pitch for membership to the Melia Circle (not spending precious vacation time and then we didn't see him after that), the Scuba instructor was trying to sell to us every day (even though we had already bought it for two of us), there were tons of people trying to sell us activities on the beach - constantly saying no thank you. 

The Wifi was slow but it was everywhere so we could iMessage each other anywhere on the resort, which was great (and surprisingly included in price!)

All in all - great resort - close to airport, absolutely beautiful, good food & drink.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Health concerns with cleanliness, food, & pest control.
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach clean and can always get a place under a hut. 

Top Resturant in main lobby, I got food poisoning from Seafood.  Pool bar so much foam and scum "urine" at the edges.  Make reservations and confirm them 10 times.  Some how ours were lost and we had to beg to get into one of their restaurants.  When we did I got sick and hardly anybody was in the restaurant.  Multiple empty tables.  Why did they consistently tell us "Sorry we are full?"  They want you to eat at the Buffet " it is a money loss for them to fill up the good restaurants."
Pest control went off sporadically so when walking a mile from Main restaurants/Lobby to room or beach prepare to get Sprayed with chemicals.  Hold breath and run. A family member got bit by something.  She was ill with rash from bite, her joints stiffened and she was down for a month.  Several dead pools of water "swampy" from main area to beach and rooms.  Pretty walk long walk with flamingos etc.., but beware of the bite.  They again spray, but only mid day when walking thru.  They will tell you they only spray at night.  Those pretty huts behind each room the minute you sit prepare to be attacked by bugs.
Lastly, one of the rooms the entire wall to the outside with sliding doors was lined in Mold.  If you have allergies beware.
Rooms only cleaned with 1 chemical "vinegar?" I searched for something since my bowels exploded for 4 days.  Maids cleaning closet scary.
First night, room was not available until 10:00pm.  Manager would not upgrade or compensate all restaurants stopped serving.  Starving we waited from 5:00pm to 10:00pm.  We were meeting up with a group, but wanted to clean up before seeing everyone.
Night life fun DJ and beach dance.  However, they dress in Drag and dance on countertops.  Entertaining, but highly offensive!  Not the Drag, but the Drag in USA red, white, and Blue.  Sexy tiny clothes with the USA flag all over.  Sorry, but I love my country.  I did not disrespect their Country.

I am not a fuzzy person and this is the first review I ever wrote on a resort.  In fact, I went a year ago.  I was searching for a new place and finally decided to write this.

Maybe they got their act together?  However, Manager & Melia Corporate acted as if they did nothing wrong.

Oh, I thought I was spending $1,600 for 5 nights (not including flight) It ended up being over $2,000.   Get the Travel insurance because they do have a busy Doctor at the resort.

reviews.author: cynalo1978
reviews.title: Gran estancia. Como una segunda luna de miel
reviews.text:
Nos alojamos en the reserve paradisus mi marido y yo. Desde la llegada hasta el check out todo el personal estuvo pendiente de que nos nos faltase de nada.

La habitación estaba situada justo enfrente de la piscina. Era espaciosa,bien insonorizada, muy limpia y con cama confortable.Disponíamos de servicio de habitaciones que probamos y resultó rápido al desayuno. 

Especialmente nos gustó la zona reservada para adultos con piscina,barra y zona de la playa privada.

Las zonas verdes son preciosas ( tienen manglares, huerto ecológico y toda la zona de jardines está muy bien cuidada).

La zona de restauración es buena, especialmente el gabi club y gabi beach por estar en la playa y su zona chill out por la noche.

Hubo alguna incidendia de disponibilidad en los restaurantes que la dirección gestionó de forma rápida.

Para nosotros ha sido una segunda luna de miel y nos llevamos una buena experiencia y un recuerdo inolvidable.

reviews.author: iVAMP2017
reviews.title: Como una segunda luna de miel..
reviews.text:
Durante nuestra primera estancia en la República Dominicana, pasamos cuatro jornadas inolvidables en THE RESERVE Paradisus Meliá Punta Cana.

Desde nuestra llegada hasta el check out nos sentimos muy bien acogidos por todo el personal del complejo. Entre otros, Stephanie, Emilia, Celso, Hermes, Danilo, Cinthya nos ofrecieron un trato muy personal y profesional.

Disfrutamos con la variedad de restaurantes que ofrece el complejo. Destacaría ”Bana”, donde disfrutamos de comida asiática preparada por Francisco en una amplia plancha compartida con otros comensales. Fué sin duda, una cena de cumpleaños muy agradable.

La zona de la playa es fabulosa, con una piscina reservada a adultos confortable (existen otras más orientadas a las familias e igual de cómodas) y un restaurante, ”Gabi Beach”, literalmente situado a pie de playa.

Cabe mencionar que el complejo dispone de todo tipo de actividades para peques, además de contar con SPA y un escenario para espectáculos vespertinos como homenajes a Queen, Michael Jackson, El Rey León,etc.

Finalmente, mención aparte y muy positiva al director del complejo, Adrián Alonso, que nos resolvió un pequeño malentendido en una reserva nocturna de forma muy profesional y dejándonos buen sabor de boca por el excelente trato.

En resumen, lo recomiendo totalmente. No dudo que repetiré en el futuro.

reviews.author: xxxx_yyyy_zzzz
reviews.title: Beautiful place, but has problems. Don't recommend
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful, people are nice, good food, however the resort has issues, we won't be returning. I would have given a 1 star, but the staff was very nice, and the property is beautiful, so I am giving 3 star for that.

*** Biggest issue

1) Can't get into the restaurants. Plus, you can't book them for entire stay, it's every morning kind of deal.

You have to go to front desk every morning at 9am to make a reservation for that night. You can't reserve restaurants for all your days at once, it's an every day hussle. Even if you come at 9am you may only get 8pm spot or later, and only to one out of many restaurants. There were several guests complaining about this. You technically paid already for eating at a restaurant every night, so you are technically getting ripped for not being able to go. Another family who we've met said they complained several times and nothing happened.  Luckily there was another very upset customer when I was at the front desk about this issue, so both of us went to talk to the manager at the same time, so thanks to the other guest we were able to get into 4 restaurants. Basically, he said you either give me a refund for every day that I can't eat at the restaurant, or you upgrade me to another more premium resort in your chain that serves better food.

*** Other minor issues

2) It's too far from the beach. 

You can wait for a shuttle but be prepared to wait for a long time. Or you may walk, maybe 10 minutes.

2) Not enough seats by the pool. 

You have to wake up early to put your stuff on the chairs, but if you come after breakfast you may not find anything. Plus, there is little shade due to limited number of umbrellas. Cabanas are reserved for those who have a special membership or package.

4) Room cards sometimes don't work.

This is more minor, but still... The cards that open the door constantly stopped working, we had to go to the front desk on 5 occasions during a 7 day vacation. On one occasion I went to the front desk 3 times, each time they give me a new card, I go to the room, and it doesn't work. We had 4 cards, finally, they realized that when they activate new card, the current cards get de-activated.

5) Birthday cake wasn't ordered. 

We ordered a cake for a 5-year old birthday at the front desk, and they texted someone at the resort. When we came at 2pm for the party to the Kids Zone, there was no cake, apparently the kitchen never received the order. We had to wait until 4pm for the cake to arrive. Lastly, there were no plates and forks, the kids had to eat the cake from the napkin with their hands. 

6) Room wasn't decorated

A really nice lady talked to us at the breakfast about our stay, asked questions, took a lot of notes. We talked about my son having a birthday and she offered that the staff can decorate the room. We were like yeah, do that, this would be really nice. It never happened, no decoration.

7) Fake concierge 

When we arrived we were met with a very nice guy, he said he was our concierge, we talked about booking restaurants, which in the end turned out he didn't do, after the first 2 days we never saw him again. Also, he organized a breakfast for us at a more expensive resort next door, which turned out to be a several hour trap for selling us timeshare. The lady who gave us a tour was very sweet, we liked her a lot and had fun, but had the concierge told us it will take 3-4 hours and where we'll be offered an opportunity to buy a timeshare for $50,000+ (which we don't have), we would have never spend our time and wasted the time of the timeshare personal.

reviews.author: Vovchik
reviews.title: Family vacaction
reviews.text:
My family of 4 stayed here during second week of April 2017.

During our check in (we arrived at noon as oppose to 3pm check in), Jose pretended that our room was not ready so he can lure bribe out of us to expedite the process.  Weird passive aggressive tactic.  After a quick lunch we got our room keys, stayed in 3216, 3rd floor one bedroom.  Room overall was in descent condition, had to call to get them ton fix the toilet and the phone, lucky not to have anything major considering this resort has worn facilities.  By the way, the walls are extremely thin and you can make out your neighbors conversation.  Opt for top floor otherwise can heat people walking or moving furniture.

The beach and water was awesome with plenty of towels and shade on the beach.

We ate only at the buffet and we found the food to be very good even for our 3 and 6 year olds.  Most waiters were attentive and welcomed tips.

Evening entertainment was good as well, half of our stay the had a show and other nights they had a party by the main bar and the beach.

We did not like the pool at all, it's 5ft deep across everywhere and had very limited shade, most lounge chairs we in the open with no umbrellas.

The resort itself is beautiful.

We enjoyed the stay but dealt that it was a bit pricey relative to other places we have been to in DR.

reviews.author: chgmd
reviews.title: Gran hotel
reviews.text: Estuve en el paradisus palma real en las vacaciones de semana santa de 2017. Si pueden contraten el Royal Service, vale la pena, las habitacianes estan al lado de la playa, con palapas reservadas todos los dias en primera linea. Por poner una pega el baño solo tenia una pila y era un poco incomodo. Gracias a nuestros mayordomos Francis y Salvador que fueron realmente utiles y agradables, buscando por todos lados una habichuelas con dulce que queriamos probar. Tambien acordarme de francisco cabrera y pedro cedano que en la zona de royal service estaban muy pendientes de nuestras bebidas. El mar a veces esta muy movida y el wi-fi no va muy bien pero el hotel es de 10 y la comida la mejor que he probado en un todo incluido.

reviews.author: Marisol G
reviews.title: Impresionante Hotel
reviews.text: Hemos pasado 8 días en el Royal Servicie. Perfecto. Nos adjudicaron 2 mayordomos, Francis Newton y José Salvador. Atentos en todo momento, eficaces, estaban siempre pendientes de nuestras necesidades.  Nada que objetar al trato recibido, desde aquí agradecerles la atención recibida. El hotel tiene mucha animación y ambiente, aunque siempre hay áreas reservadas si lo que se quiere es descansar y desconectar. Las instalaciones perfectas, siempre teníamos nuestras palapas y hamacas reservadas. La playa impresionante, aunque nos hizo unos días con viento. La comida de los restaurantes muy buena, y para ser un todo incluido el nivel del buffet muy alto.

reviews.author: 25terri
reviews.title: a dream come true
reviews.text: absolutely recommend this beautiful hotel, there was always something to do and is a very large place to never get bored! the decor is exquisite and the restaurant life makes you excited to eat every night! just know that you have to reserve for dinner every night which is a bit different than other resorts that are all inclusive. My husband and I enjoyed our vacation of 5 days so much it felt like a second honeymoon here. Recommend it!

reviews.author: Jilbxv
reviews.title: Top Five Reasons to stay at Paradisius Palma Real and a 2 needed improvements
reviews.text:
We just got back from a 6 night stay at Paradisius Palma Real.
I was with my husband, mother, and two children (ages 6 and 8) 

Top Five Reasons: 
5) Beach:  The beach was lovely, and the ocean was nice and warm. There was a little seaweed but nothing too bad. From reading the reviews I was worried that it was going to be really bad seaweed but it wasn't even noticeable most of the week. I walked up and down both ways and the beach at this resort was definitely the best.  Also, they had plenty of shaded areas which was very important for me and my family. 
4) The pool was spectacular and refreshing.   Not crowded swimming but hard to get poolside chairs after the morning rush. 
3)  Service: Most of the restaurant and hotel servers went out of their way to accommodate us.   Room was cleaned daily and fridge was stocked everyday.  Room service each morning was wonderful for breakfast.  
2)  Location: quick trip from airport and resort was walk-able compared to some other all inclusive resorts. Resort is beautiful and has a nice set-up.  
1) People- very nice couples and families from all over the world.  People were respectful and extremely nice.  
 
Improvements Needed: 
Dinner reservations:  reservations are hard to get and I knew this in advance. Luckily we had our travel agent set up reservations for us before we arrived.  There are some restaurants with dress codes and we couldn't eat at two of them because we didn't come prepared. (men need pants and closed toe shoes)   Food was good but I wouldn't go to an all inclusive expecting fine dining.  

Room:  We stayed in a two bedroom master suite on the third floor.  Room was spacious but definitely outdated.  This is one of the reasons I don't think it is a 5 star resort.  Things were broken, TV's didn't work, Wires hanging off of TV on the wall, couch and drapes seemed old and dirty.  By the second day I started to smell some type of sewer or musty odor in the bedroom.  The smell never went away and my luggage still smells musty now that I'm home.  Not sure if the hotel can do anything about this unless they do a renovation of the older suites.  Just don't expect a modern room unless you are staying in the new beach reserve rooms or at the Paradisius Palma Real Reserve. Also, if you can bring older luggage or bags that you don't care about because they will smell when you get home.

reviews.author: Gabriel R
reviews.title: Si viajas en pareja contrata Royal Service
reviews.text:
Al contratar royal service tienes acceso al restaurante exclusivo Palazzo, en mi opinión el mejor de todo el hotel, sirve excelente comida a la carta en desayuno, almuerzo y cena con un personal altamente dedicado a agradarte, Miguel, Fatima, Felix y todos los demás siempre te reciben con gran amabilidad, un día llegamos a desayunar tarde y se habían acabado las bananas pues Miguel atravesó medio hotel hasta el buffet principal y nos las trajo hasta nuestra mesa. En royal service también tienes acceso a la piscina, playa y bar exclusivos para adultos que contraten este servicio aquí te recibe Pedro Cedano por las mañanas desde muy temprano con un humor que provoca hablar con el todo el día y quien siempre siempre te conseguirá un buen punto en la playa o piscina que sea de tu agrado. En el bar está Wanda quien sabe preparar todo trago imaginable y en la playa en el bar de smoothies está Andrea. Todos personas muy alegres y serviciales. Royal service también te asigna un mayordomo a quien puedes contactar para cualquier petición, en nuestro caso tuvimos a Armando Minien que nos ayudó con las reservas en otros restaurantes dentro del hotel y quien se encargo de todos los días dejar nuestro jacuzzi de la habitación preparado y siempre dejando algún regalo para nosotros cada día en la habitación.
Las habitaciones son espaciosas y poseen jacuzzi para dos personas, todos los días el room service las deja impecables sin embargo el mini bar no es repuesto todos los días a pesar de que hay un cartel en el mismo que dice explicitamente que si será repuesto a diario pues esto no se cumple y es bastante desagradable.
El resto del hotel es muy bonito con instalaciones muy bien mantenidas, hay diversos bares, restaurantes para cena a la carta y una heladería. Es muy importante saber que el buffet principal es caótico, parece increíble pero en un punto puedes escuchar a las personas quejándose de no haber lugar para sentarse o vasos limpios, para quien no contrate royal service debe saber que aquí deberá desayunar y almorzar todos los días.
No dejen de visitar el YHI spa o el YHI boutique.
Esperamos volver muy pronto.

reviews.author: Raya_Toronto
reviews.title: One of our best vacation!
reviews.text:
We stayed with our friends at Paradisus Palma Real in early April. Overall it was one of our best Punta Cana experience. The things we totally like there are: amazing food/restaurants, beach (including the weather we had, no waves), beach towels are available without limited cards and any time, service, entertainment (Gabi beach, animation team, shows). Things to be improved in our openion: 
a) Rooms (especially plumbing including showers and toilets); bath tabs take extra space (we never use them); not much privacy with their layouts; 
b) Restaurant reservation is somewhat complicated. After going once we chose to go to the buffet that offers great variety of food without any hustle.
c) Coffee/Gelato bar is open till 4pm only. We had ice cream and coffee craving between 5-7pm. Kind of strange schedule.
d) Companies/Private events (evening) sometimes overtake evening resort's entertainment (being too loud, etc.).  For sure it is good for Melia's business ($), but doesn't feel right for resort's customers.
e) It would be nice to have business hours visible for the restaurants and bars

reviews.author: tkhossfeld
reviews.title: Great Spring Break Trip
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus and loved our experience.  We were travelling with a large party (19 people in total) and we were all glad we splurged to upgrade to the Family Concierge section.  Our family concierge, Yarol, was incredible!!  He always had a friendly smile and accommodated whatever requests our group might have.  He even went so far as to track down a contact case for my husband.  Whether booking difficult dinner reservations for such a large party or even helping us reunite with a few of the kids in our group when separated on the beach, Yarol was outstanding!

Additionally, it was so nice to actually be on a beach and at a pool where people weren't fighting for chairs by 7:00am each morning.  Having our own designated cabana areas both on the beach and poolside was really great.

While not a deal breaker on staying at the property, the check in process was a bit rough.  There seemed to be a fair amount of confusion when checking people in and the language barrier proved to be a bit of a challenge.  Once we were in our room the experience was great; however, the actual check in was more difficult than one would have expected.

It was a great property that I would definitely return to.  The beach alone would make it worth it!

reviews.author: Ferran J
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text: El Hotel perfecto no existe, pero éste intenta que te marches sin ninguna queja y lo consigue. Hay una máxima entre TODAS las personas que trabajan en él, que sientas que cualquier inconveniente te lo solucionan con amabilidad y simpatía. Las instalaciones son espectaculares, las habitaciones lujosas y muy cómodas, los restaurantes muy buenos. Lo que esperas de un hotel así, en este caso, se cumple. está claro que lo pagas, pero a gusto.

reviews.author: cjcdngrl
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: The Palma Real experience in Punta Cana was a very good one. People were friendly and helpful. Room was clean, and lots of choices for dining out. The people who worked there were motivational and friendly - always letting you know what was going on and when etc. Service on the beach was exceptional - Daniel (aka "Drinky Drinky") was always there to make sure we had anything we needed. There was no end to food choices at any time of the day or evening - beach BBQ started shortly after breakfast as well as lunch buffet. The set up of this resort is excellent. Beach, pool, drinks & food all close together with strategically placed washrooms. Beautiful views and clean beach. Security kept outside vendors to a minimum. We had "Shaky Shaky" and "Luca Luca" always working to get everyone involved and make sure they were happy. Gabi Beach Bar was where the action was at night - lots of good dance music and dancing and flashing lights in a great atmosphere right by the beach and pool. There were lots of places to sit and watch or get involved. One morning we heard a musician play beautiful music on his violin - current songs done in a classic way - very relaxing while sitting on the beach. I would recommend that you consider taking reservations for dinner into your own hands rather then let the concierge do it for you. There were nothing but problems with that system unfortunately. For example - when you request dinner at a restaurant at a certain time -you most likely will not get that time. You might get a piece of paper telling you that you do - but when you get there its a different story. I hope they fix this as it caused people to get very upset at the hostesses in the restaurants which we witnessed and we too were upset when we thought we had a reservation according to our piece of paper for 7:00 but were told it was actually in their system for 6:00pm so they had to squeeze us in  - or when you ask for 7-7:30pm but were told 9:30 pm - only to get there to find out that they could have taken you earlier. So - lots to fix with the current system. Flip side - if you are not fussy about when and where you eat - there is always food somewhere. Vento was a relaxing atmosphere and great service -but food there was not great - the menu needs fixing. Olio was very nice and the food was good. Rare was very nice also and food was good. Bana was a good show and lots of food. Mizu was on the reserve resort 3 minutes away and was very nice as well. Waiters and staff all very friendly and helpful in every restaurant. It is all inclusive here but any tipping is very appreciated. These people work very hard and are sometimes there for 9 days+ in a row only to go home for 2 days  - sometimes 3 hours away.  Everything felt very clean there, and the atmosphere was friendly and welcoming. I would recommend this resort and would stay there again if our adventures ever take us there.

reviews.author: Michelle C
reviews.title: Hotel very nice, but getting dinner reservations was a nightmare
reviews.text:
The hotel is pretty.  Rooms are nice - we stayed in a 1 BR suite which was spacious.  Hotel property, pools, beaches all very well kept and clean.  The food at Naos, the buffet, was good.  There was a large selection, but it got a little tedious after a few days (we stayed for 1 week).
You have to make dinner reservations through Guest Services.  The app that Melia tells you to download doesn't work.  When we got there, Guest Services made us reservations for 2 nights only, saying that the system resets on Monday.  I was later told this happens on Sunday.  They made us dinner reservations at Blue Agave for 6:30 one night.  We show up, and it doesn't open until 7 and no reservations are required.  The next time we asked Guest Services, and the person told us no reservations are needed and we could just show up tonight.  When we went, it was closed for a private event that the Guest Services person didn't know about.  When we finally went there, I wish we hadn't.  It took 30 minutes to get a waiter to take our order, and this was after having to have the hostess drag him over.  Then the food took another 30 minutes, and it wasn't good.  Go there for lunch if you want to - the burgers are good.
I tried for 3 days to make dinner reservations at Passion for my brother's birthday.  Each time I talked to someone, they took down my room number and told me they'd get back to me.  After talking with 3 different people, I was told that it was all booked.  When I finally got to talk to the supervisor, he apologized for all the confusion and tried to help.  He offered other options instead, which I appreciated, but I was annoyed at the entire process.  
A friend of mine was staying at the Reserve at the same time.  Her concierge made a reservation for our large group at the hibachi place for 6:00.  That afternoon, we were told it was changed to 6:45.  When we got there, there was no room for us and they had to switch us to a different restaurant.
I liked the hotel overall, but was very frustrated with the dining experiences and Guest Services.

reviews.author: Tomas rpo
reviews.title: Tres veces en el mismo hotel
reviews.text:
He estado dos veces en el Paradisus Punta Cana, y tres veces en el Paradisus Palma Real, una de ellas en The Reserve. Volveria 10 veces más.
Estando en el Paradisus Palma Real se puede acceder a todos los servicios de The Reserve con un cargo extra diario de 60 dólares por adulto y 30 por niño (un poco alto) pero viajando  en familia y en temporada alta vale la pena, pues los servicios de The Reserve Beach son un poco más exclusivos, había mayor disponibilidad y las piscinas en The Reserve son super para niños. Como siempre nos fue muy bien, los dos primeros días sentimos que el servicio dejaba mucho que desear con respecto a lo que habíamos experimentado anteriormente, pero fueron super receptivos con nuestras observaciones y corrigieron todos los detalles que mencionamos.  
Nos gusta mucho, y volveríamos siempre ha este hotel.

reviews.author: Doreen F
reviews.title: Zum 3. Mal
reviews.text:
Wir waren jetzt zum 3. Mal in dieser traumhaften Anlage und uns hat es wieder sehr gut gefallen.
Schon der Check in verlief sehr zügig, wir mussten  nicht mal mehr zur Rezeption.
Wie gewohnt würden wir von den Mitarbeitern sehr freundlich begrüßt.
Positiv hervorzuheben ist die neue Toilette am Strand.
Leider läßt die Qualität des Mittagessens am Strand sehr zu wünschen übrig.
Wir haben den Gabi Club im Reserve vorgezogen.
Unsere Concierge Diosmery, Jhoan vom Gabi Club, Katiuska aus der Kidszone und Ramon und Luis vom Strand haben sich wieder bestens um uns gekümmert.
Wir kommen wieder und das schon im Oktober!!!!

reviews.author: bgsbgs10
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Really has a blast at The Reserve. Plenty of room to lay out and for the kids to play. Ray was as a stand out employee; was super nice to my kids and was more than happy to throw a baseball around. The waves were rough but we liked that sort of thing. Drink selection could be bigger but other than that, no issues.

reviews.author: berylbenoit
reviews.title: Lots of positives....a few noteworthy nitpicks
reviews.text:
We did a week at the Reserve with a small group.  Overall a positive experience, but there were some negative items of note.
On the positive side, the property was beautiful, the rooms were big and quite nice and the staff was universally friendly and accommodating.  The beach experience was a big positive as were the pools and we really enjoyed our days.  Also, the restaurants for dinner were varied and a reservation was never an issue. 

 Now the negatives:
1.  As nice as the staff was, the restaurant/buffet service was pretty "blah".  At the buffet, you could go a whole meal without someone taking drink orders and to get a water refill was often quite an event.  We tipped throughout, but that wasn't a guarantee of great service.  
2. In our room, neither of the tvs worked the entire time we were there (one worked in our companion room).  I wasn't on vacation to watch tv, so not a huge deal, but one day it poured all day and for the kids, it would have been nice or at night when we are in bed, etc... not a big deal, but combined with some leak issues, it was unfortunate.
3. Finally, the food was just sort of ok.  There was plenty of it, and there was lots of variety, but there was nothing that jumped out as especially good.

Overall, a positive experience and I would probably go back, although I would be tempted to try a different resort in the DR if I was going back.

reviews.author: isabelarose
reviews.title: Incredible Honeymoon!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is incredible! The moment you enter the property you're amazed with its beauty and serenity. My husband and I celebrated our honeymoon there and are so happy with our choice. We were upgraded from the reserve to royal service which was so amazing! Our butler Kelvin Fernandéz was phenomenal. He was so attentive, kind and so helpful, he truly made our trip such a pleasure! Everyone there is so friendly and warm hearted. We felt like constant royalty always; from our cabana bed always being reserved for us or the simple greetings from the staff who made us feel they truly cared about us by remembering our names or calling out to us if they saw us in passing. Martin who works in the pool/beach area was so friendly and attentive. Miguel who works at the buffet and rare is so nice and is very attentive constantly making sure your glass is always full and that you know he is there if you need something. Wander in the buffet and who who also works at Vento is so kind hearted & attentive! All the food is delicious, Ibana & Rare are a must! We would definitely recommend this resort to anyone looking for a staff who are welcoming, kind, friendly and very attentive. The resort is gorgeous and everything is so clean!

reviews.author: susanaali
reviews.title: Gracias...totales!!
reviews.text:
Nos alojamos ya 5 o 6 veces...cada vez nos venimos con más ganas de quedarnos.Quiero destacar q la atención es exelente en todos los niveles.
Gracias al gerente CARLOS SAN JOSE ,por solucionar cada inconveniente (por viajar tanto los tuvimos ) (aplazos de vuelos , enfermedad,etc)....siempre la solución ahí al alcance,
..muchas gracias
A DIONISIO, siempre atento a nuestro buen pasar.A JENNY de administración TAN buena anfitriona .A FANNY q siempre me atiende el teléfono y me saca fechas ¡DE LA GALERA!.A ESTRELLA en la playa siempre atento a lo que necesitamos
La comida es MÁS QUE BUENA ! y la atención de l@s camareros de lo mejor.Es grato pasar unos dias en estos lugares con shows magníficos,  música que invita a bailar ¡AL MÁS PATA DURA ! ja.
Mi hijo de 12 años la paso de primera también. Im po si ble aburrirse.
Y por sobre todo felicitaciones al Hotel en el que nos alojamos PARADISIUS PALMA REAL! O sea a su gente , les brota el buen atender y se nota q lo hacen desde el corazón!  Las habitaciones de lujo.Los restaurantes de primera.Las playas LAS MEJORES .
TODO!! altamente recomendable! Felicitaciones amigos.Un placer

FAMILIA DAMIANI.BUENOS AIRES

reviews.author: Jeff T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
I am currently on day 5 of a 7 day vacation. This is my third time to Paradisus Palma Real. This is my first time back at this resort in 10 years. Let me start by saying this resort is one of the classiest resorts I have ever been to. I have only been to 4 other all inclusive resorts in Mexico and Cuba and I can honestly say none of them compare to Paradisus Palma Real in terms of the food, pleasant wait staff, the beach, lounging chairs and covered in cabana huts, etc.

We never had a problem getting loungers on the beach. The beach is very large with lots of room and easily accommodates the number of people staying at the Paradisus.

The layout of the resort is easy to navigate and everything you need for food, drinks, washrooms, and pools are all centrally located.  You can  find an area to sleep all day with no noise or you can sit by the pool and watch the festivities during the day. 

When I go away to an all inclusive resort I go to relax and enjoy some great food each and every night.  This resort gets a 10 out of 10 for those two things. I have never eaten better food at an all inclusive than at the Paradisus. Premium liquors are available in some bars, not all, and depending on which level of stay you decide to purchase you could have access to more premium liquors at more locations. 

The lobby bar, Avenue bar, and Gabi beach at night were my favorite places to hang out after eating dinner. They are all modern places with a great music vibe.

The gym is very nice and has everything you need in there for a cardio or weight work out.

The shows at night in the auditorium are great for all ages and provides some pretty cool entertainment. 

Spa is amazing.

Wind surfers, kayaks, etc are all free if charge to take out in to the ocean.

Rooms are modern, clean, and spacious. My only complaint about the room is the fact the bathroom is exposed to the main living/sleeping area and people don't have total privacy when using the washroom. Instead of the open wall to the room itself the resort should frame in a permanent wall and allow people to use the washroom in privacy. Now, it is my understanding that some rooms do have private bathrooms but I stayed in the Royal Service area and the bathroom was exposed. Hair Dryer is not great.

Gold carts are readily available to transport you around. 

Getting dinner reservations can be difficult at times but if you stay on Guest Services about your reservations,  and follow up with them when they tell you to, you will get the restaurant reservation you are looking for and usually at the preferred time you want. It is very important to stay on guest services because it can be difficult to get straight answers or confirmations for dinner times in advance of you going to dinner. They usually required us to call back the afternoon of the reservation to confirm for that night, but like I said I was always able to get the reservation I wanted. One piece of advice is to ask your waiter which items on the menu are really good. No one has led us astray in that department.

Coffee is delicious. The Gelato bar seems to serve the best coffee with the most options. Hint, adding bailey's really helps as well.

I can't even comment on the buffet because I have never eaten there. No need to with the other options available. 

Room service breakfast every morning was excellent. 

Champagne and freshly squeezed orange juice was amazing.

Burgers, onion rings were awesome. 

Rocking out at Gabi Beach mid afternoon while listening to great tunes was always relaxing and a good time.

On the improvement side, to make this resort one of the best resorts in the Carribean, if not the best, I would say they should improve their night life a bit for those of us who may want to go out a few nights while on vacation. It lacks a bit in that department right now. I think having the evenings at Gabi beach with the DJ playing should continue on to at least mid night, if not later. Or, have a nice bar that is close to the beach designed for dancing and socializing.  This would be the icing on the cake for this resort. Is they has these things this resort would be sold out consistently, if it is not already. The bar that is open until 5am is OK but not great for dancing, etc. 

The house brand Cabernet Sauvignon  (Red) is really good. No need to buy bottles of wine when you can have good wine as part of your package.  

Kids feel there should be a large water slide or something similar in the pools to entertain them during the days. Although family concierge has options to keep kids busy during the days.

The people that come to this resort are from all over the world and we met some great people from the US, mainly New Jersey and New York. We had a blast with them.

No flies on the beach but bring bug repellant just in case we lucked out the week we were here.

Ronnie Mercedes at aqua restauramt was the bomb and basically told us what we should eat off the menu. He nailed it, lobster pasta was amazing, and the Chocolate lava cake for desert was amazing. 

Mizou tepanyaki restaurant was great. Each table has their own chef who prepares dinner in front of you. Shrimp, steak, salmon, rice, etc was all very good.

Vento restaurant was very good. We had the shrimp ravioli, steak and tomatoes soup which was all.very good. Desert was OK.

Airport was clean and transport to Paradisus in a private van was a nice touch. 20 minutes drive from airport to resort. It was a beautiful drive from the airport, Dominican REPUBLIC has some beautiful malls and downtown Punta Cana seems like a fun place to be. Lots going on that's for sure. 

Lots of options are Paradisus for excursions.  The people selling the excursions are obviously commission based because they constantly try and sell you trips / day events. But they weren't too bad.

reviews.author: GM-JDsMom
reviews.title: Loved it...Can't wait to go back...thank you Jose and Argenis
reviews.text:
We were originally booked in a jr suite but decided we should try the Royal Service (Adults Only) after reading reviews and told by friends it was well worth it. When trying to do the upgrade with the company we used to book the trip they had one price on their computer for the upgrade and when they called the resort the upgrade number was a lot higher.  We opted to wait until we got their to do the upgrade. They did work with us on the price and we ended up with an ocean front view. 

The Negatives...Skip the buffet at Naos if possible and don't try the Sushi from Bana. 

The Positives...We had butler service, from Tuesday-Thursday Argenis R was our butler.  He made all our dinner reservations and reserved the cabanas for us on the beach. He was great I would recommend him.  Friday-Sunday Argenis had to leave so Jose Salvador replaced him. Jose was very attentive and made sure that we were taken care of in our last few days at the resort. I would also recommend Jose. 

If you opt for the Royal Service do dine at Palazzo.  We did Breakfast and Dinner there but they also serve lunch. The people that work at Palazzo were wonderful...Thank you De Aza Juan, Osualdo Jhoneidy, Miguel Edison, Felix and Fatima Diaz. Our other favorite restaurant was Aqua. 

The staff at the Paradisus was phenomenal. Everyone was helpful and friendly.

Plenty of dining options, beautiful beach and pools, plenty to do at night...Well worth the price for an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: robbies03
reviews.title: Best trip yet!
reviews.text:
This is now the 5th time I've stayed at the reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and by far the best experience yet. The facilities never fail, the room had an amazing view of the pool and the maid service was perfect each and every day!

As per employees at the pool, I think they've found the dream team! Every single employee was an absolute all star, they made our experience one to never forget. Luis Pena at the Hydro Grill along with Wilson Guzman made some of the best food I've ever had and attended to all of our needs with a huge smile and positive attitude. Emilio Valdez and Mr.Reinoso, WOW- these guys are like the energizer bunny - they just don't stop! All day long attending to each and every single guests needs as if they built the resort themselves. Never did we have to wait long for a beverage or as they call it "drinky drinky", each time we were assisted with a smile and genuine hospitality. 

Hilario Vasquez helped us the majority of the time with our experience at the reserve, if he's not part of the management team - I'm sure he will be soon. Besides helping my family out with an extremely important celebration, this man went above and beyond to make sure we felt right at home. Hilario checked in on us everyday and made us feel part of the Paradisus family. Angis as well was extremely helpful. 

We were gifted a day at the royal service on the house and were attended to by Rhanelly Polanco. Not to our surprise he was just as amazing as all of the other staff! 

Thank you team Paradisus for the most amazing trip ever! 

My only complaint -- we need better late night food options. Food during the day is absolutely delicious, all of the restaurants are amazing. Room service late night, two thumbs down. Let's step it up guys and make this even better, see you on my next trip!

reviews.author: 393becca
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY AMAZING, service is impeccable
reviews.text: Nothing but great things to say about Paradisus Palma Real Resort. Visited the resort with my family and family friends and everything was amazing. The service is the best service we have ever received at an all inclusive resort. All the staff are extremely friendly and treat you fantastic. Jose Saro, one of the favorites!!! He provides impeccable service at the buffet restaurant and always makes sure he goes above and beyond. Would highly recommend this resort for an all inclusive, we will be back!!

reviews.author: Clint A
reviews.title: Great place-Alex
reviews.text:
My wife and I had a great time, we arrived late but was immediately checked in and we received an upgrade to Royal Service.  

The room was extremely clean and well latex out, having stayed at all inclusive's before we were a little worried about the food. 

The food was outstanding, we did not eat at the Italian place but ate at every other restaurant.  We enjoyed the Gabi buffet the most, they keep a great arrangement of food and it never felt like cheesy buffet. 

But, besides the gorgeous resort and beautiful beach, one of the best parts was our butler Alex he was very attentive and put us at ease about making sure we stayed on time for our events.  

We will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Natalya S
reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: Luxurious resort with friendly and professional staff. Perfect place for the family vacation. Special thanks to our concierge Elvis Hidalgo. He does everything possible to turn our stay hear into the excellent experience. We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Kim K
reviews.title: The Royal
reviews.text: Such a wonderful adults only resort! I would go back in a heartbeat. Poolside, Yolanda took great care of us, I don't think we ever lacked a drink in our hand. Marco also took great care of us when it came to getting a cabana!!! The food was really good as well!

reviews.author: Gill_Iain
reviews.title: Fantastic family holiday
reviews.text:
Used to luxury resorts before the kids arrived, we choose our holidays carefully now that we have 4 year old twins as we still like to experience some luxury and time out as a couple in addition to ensuring the children have an amazing time - after all, happy kids = happy parents!

After holidaying in Europe (predominantly 5*Sani resort in Halkadiki, Greece) since the children were babies, we decided to try a long haul break this year (8.5 hours from the UK with a 4 hour time difference). 

Kids Club
This was closed for refurbishment the first few days of our holiday and was held in the conference centre - very dark and appeared a little disorganised so we were disappointed we hadn't been notified of this in advance. Once it reopened the kids club facilities were great and the staff very welcoming.  Do note though, it isn't to the OFSTED standards that Sani (Worldwide for Kids group) for example prides itself on so do be aware of this if you are used to kids clubs in Europe that operate to OFSTED standards around ratios

Parents are able to stay with their kids which is nice if your child doesn't like to be left but it's not therefore like a true nursery setting for pre schoolers.  I arrived one afternoon to pick our children up who we'd dropped off for an hour to do some craft activities and found my son playing football with another child's father who I didn't know.  In a nutshell, I'd say it caters more for older children of school age who are that bit more independent.  To be honest we didn't put the twins into the kids club that often as they had so much fun at the beach but more on that later.

So to our highlights......

Family Concierge
One of the big draws for me when booking over and above other resorts was the Family Concierge concept. Dedicated concierge, children's toys and treats in a dedicated reception and accommodation a stones throw from the great kids pool and facilities.  Our concierge Sofia Paterninan was totally amazing.  Caring, professional, attentive and a total natural with children she really made our holiday. Nothing was ever too much trouble and our children loved her.  She made all our dinner reservations at child friendly times, left treats in the room such as bubble bath with balloons and Disney Frozen characters - just fabulous.  She is a real credit to the resort and works incredibly hard.  We miss her 😢.

Reserve Beach
Well - of course the beach was paradise......white sand, crazy waves in gorgeous warm sea (not toddler friendly for paddling but ok accompanied by Mum and Dad wave jumping!). Sofia would reserve a cabana for us every day (be there by 10am though) so there was never a mad rush to grab a sun lounger.

The thing that really made the beach for us though were the staff. Professional, attentive and treated us like family - the twins loved them! Special mention to Benita, Ramon, Luis, Jairo, Santos and my son's idol, the wonderful Jose (who also worked by the pool). These guys worked as a close team and are a true credit to the resort.

Restaurants
All inclusive concept worked well and food was great. Our favourites were Vento, Fuego and Bana. Kids loved the teppanyaki - their first experience of Asian cuisine and chef would adapt the dishes to cater for the children's preferences.  Buffet at Gabi Club for breakfast and dinner was also a great option - special mention to the lovely Liz Pena who looked after us so well and Joaquín Mella and Antony Cid.

Negatives.......
Not too many! Observation about the accommodation is the walls are paper thin so be aware. Our neighbours with older children would come in later (fine - they are on holiday!) but would telephone their adjoining room and have loud conversations waking our kids up. Please be mindful of this.  

That said due to jet lag our children were awake at 5am on our first morning and with the best will in the world we tried to keep them quiet but obviously not quiet enough! The people upstairs complained and a security guard came round to ask us to be quiet! What could we do?? - they were whispering but how a 4 year old whispers!!! Being in a family block the complainants should have been thankful we didn't have a baby waking for night feeds at 1am and 4am!!!! Thankfully by day 3 the children's body clocks had reset to Dominican time but it did make us worried and on edge for the first few days of our holiday.

We would love to return in 2018 but see prices are on the rise especially in school holidays so keeping an eye on the sales!

reviews.author: JAVM
reviews.title: Semana Santa 2017
reviews.text: Lo visito por 4 año consecutivo y no dejo de apreciar sus bellísimas instalaciones, la calidad de la comida, sus magníficos restaurantes. El servicio es extraordinariamente cálido y gentil. Un reconocimiento especial para el valet de la playa de socios Felipe Morla, dedicado, eficiente,, atento, servicial. Muchas gracias.

reviews.author: amoshal93
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.text: What an amazing trip. Eduard Mendez was a god send as a butler. What a phenomenal experience he gave us!!!! Took care of everything and just made the entire trip easy and carefree. Highly recommend and highly recommend Eduard.

reviews.author: sueknutson
reviews.title: Repeat visit
reviews.text: I visited The Reserve last fall and it was an excellent experience with several people who were especially helpful during our trip. I think the real test is a return to a place where you previously had a wonderful time and see if it can measure up again.  The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana did not disappoint!  This time I suggested it as a destination for my sister and I.  The location and property were as beautiful as I had remembered.  The room was again very nice, clean and well serviced daily.  We booked a room with the concierge service and Estefania (Steph) was assigned to us.  She was wonderful at helping us navigate the large resort, find the entertainment that we wanted, arrange beach chairs with a umbrella every day of our stay and dinner reservations.  She also had the room refrigerator re-stocked with the beverages and snacks that we requested!  This service is included with the concierge room and became invaluable when our return flight was cancelled due to storms over our connecting airport (Chicago) and the northeast coast. She helped us get our flight re-booked (there are some tricks to calling an "800" number from the DR) and found availability for us to stay in our room for another night.  I again found Yuri at the front dest and he was as friendly and helpful as on the previous trip.  The beach bartenders were great (Santos, Louis, and Ramon) and we were never without friendly conversation or a drink delivered to our chair.  Emelio, at the Gabs Club Bar, remembered me from the fall and was also a wonderful, friendly representative of the hotel.  We did not encounter anyone who was less than helpful and friendly.  The resort is great, but the people really make it memorable.  Thanks for another great trip.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Kat G
reviews.title: Great customer service, for the most part--Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
My husband was unfortunate and had a slight accident.  The staff promptly attended to his needs and called each night after to make sure he was okay. We are especially grateful to Mariely Amancio and Carolema Frameo from guest services.  She rode with us to the on site urgent care facility where my husband was promptly and professionally treated.  When it was found that his injury required stitches, the on site doctor arranged for his transfer to the local ER where he also received prompt and professional treatment.

The guys at the GABI bar are the absolute best!  Luis, Carlos and Marcos made sure our glasses were always full and our snack bowl never empty.  Luis looked for and found the recipe to make my friends favorite drink, a 57 Chevy.  All the bars have the best alcohol, with many very top shelf varieties.

The service at all the restaurants was wonderful.  The staff are very friendly and genuinely want you to enjoy your stay. 

I had the most relaxing massage at the spa and even though it was a little pricey, I would invest in the experience again.

As the official language of the Dominican Republic is Spanish, everyone speaks Spanish, and some speak English as well.  We did have a little trouble communicating especially over the phone, as we do not speak Spanish. My friend had a frustrating experience in the VIP lounge, once again because we do not speak Spanish and they spoke little English. He asked for help with the spelling of the names for the ladies in guest services and they told him to go to guest services to ask them to rewrite their names in larger letters.  It was especially frustrating as we wanted to ensure we had their names correctly spelled so that we could pay them the compliment that they truly deserve.

reviews.author: Gregory Curtis C
reviews.title: Fun for families
reviews.text: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was a fun place for vacation for our family.  The family concierge service that Yarol provided was outstanding!  We would highly recommend paying a bit more for the family concierge service.

reviews.author: Kwon L
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Overall, I had a great time with my family (wife, 6 & 8 kids) and give this review 4.5 stars. We really enjoyed the beach, drinks and family concierge service (Yarol). Below are a few notable events:

Checking In - We were shuffled to 2 different check in areas upon arrival. First the main Paradisus lobby, The Reserve lobby and then private check-in of the building we planned to stay. Once that was all done, we began our vacation and started to relax!

Yarol made our stay feel like a 5 star with a children's welcome gift, bubble bath balloon bath or chocolates every night! He checked in each day to see if we needed anything.

Beach - we made reservations with Yarol for the Reserve beach area. This was confusing when we got there as sometimes it was available and one time it wasn't for some reason but otherwise, the best part of our vacation. Kids love the beach, parents love the waiter drink service (Thanks Jose!) and taking turns watching the kids while napping.

Food - Its been a long time since I did an all inclusive. The food was mainly buffet and quality was better than average; fruits and vegetables were great! Kids love the variety and my kids commented about how thy can eat whatever they want! One of the best places was Mole (Mexican-non buffet). I didn't expect a lot here so met my expectations.

reviews.author: kleincm7
reviews.title: Armando Minier: Butler of the Year? Answer: Yes.
reviews.text: Unforgettable trip. The resort blew away our expectations. The room, beach, and resort in general were spectacular. The food was above average relative to the many other all-inclusives we've been to. The restaurant that requires that you pay a little more beyond what's covered with the all-inclusive, Passion, was on-par with a great NYC restaurant. Above all, our Royal Service butler, Armando Minier, was incredibly attentive, thoughtful, and kind. He went above and beyond and not only fulfilled every request, but proactively did things for us (such as running the jacuzzi and leaving gourmet snacks and drinks in our room to have when we returned from the beach) that really blew us away. We're planning to return later this year and will be requesting Armando as our butler again!

reviews.author: Packageintheair
reviews.title: Consideration and Excellence
reviews.text: My review of my stay was delayed due a personal set of issues that the resort aided me in progression back home to immediately. There are great PEOPLE there that make The Reserve STAFF great examples of excellence. My experience with the excellence started before arriving. Let's be clear, I am not indicating perfection...I don't believe perfection can be manifested in this realm. What can be achieve is the "pursuit and deliverance of excellence" in actions for providing service, consideration and empathy for others. As I mentioned, my trip started off rocky because wires were crossed in the setting up of reservations between my friends and I. Once we were able to reach the leadership at the resort, extra efforts were done prior to- and while there to enable us to feel extremely important and well taken care of by ALL.  WHO was the daily administrator of that excellence...a Ms. Rudelania (a.k.a. Rudy). Started with a great reservation check-in team that was filled with smiles and LAUGHTER. From Rudy to Santos in the restaurant...to the bar staff by the pool...to the early morning team that aided me when I had a personal emergency that required I immediately return home stateside. They...Them...ALL of the people we met onsite and at the main hotel were extremely generous with time...attention..laughter...music...SURPRISE CHOCOLATE COVERED STRAWBERRIES IN OUR ROOMS...and lots of FUN through relaxation. If you are considering this location, don't think long. The accommodations are beautiful, large and immaculate landscaping. The bartenders will excite you with the fun antics/production of their concoctions. The FOOD will have you gaining all the weight you lost just to get there...but don't worry, the time on the beach will be just as beautiful. The money invested here will be well worth the experience and thoroughly enjoyed!  Thanks again The Reserve Staff for all that you do above and beyond what is called for in your daily duties.

reviews.author: Melanie P
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: Visited this resort with my friend in the first week of April and it was wonderful! Beautiful resort, good food and staff! Highly recommend this resort!  Would like to thank Daniel, Nathan Fernandez and Kung fu panda for your excellent service while we were your guests!

reviews.author: donnygloves
reviews.title: Relaxing family experience
reviews.text:
10 of us joined together for a family vacation.  Our group included grenadparents, and 2 families children ages 3-17.  We have traveled together yearly for many years and found this experience our easiest and most relaxing.  With family food tastes which vary from pescatarian (fish and vegetables) to true carnivores this location offered plenty of options.  As with most all inclusive resorts the food was far from 5 star but certainly was plentiful and decent.

Some food highlights for our group were Fuego and the grill for dinner and mole for lunch or dinner.  The staff at every facility were accommodating, friendly and always helpful. 

The liquor included was name brand and good upgrades available for minimal cost.

For me personally the experience of reserving chairs at the pool or palapas at the beach was stunningly comfortable.  We had the family concierge with Sofia to help us.  She was responsive and caring..  At the beach each morning I was greated by a staff at the reserve beach which was second to none. The group was led by Luis Santana. He could not have done more to be caring to my family the entire week as we are generally beach bums,  this was true though for his entire group which included Santos Frias Ramon Ramirez, Danilo Rosario, Dariro Minier and at the beach bar Benita Mercedes.  The yoga guy Ralynold Tamayo was a great happy face every day too.  This staff interacted comfortably and in a caring way with every member of the family including all ages.  They did this and never did so with an unspoken hand out for special tips.  This is not true at other Punta Cana locations.  Last year at dreams if you were not protecting territory before 5 am you were screwed what a change.  I would honestly say the reserve beach crew were responsible for our happy easy going experience.  

Interesting.initally I was disaapointed that the reserve accommodations seemed so far from the beach but the exclusivity of the pool area was pleasant and the shuttles or 5 minute walk became second nature.

Rooms: spacious, clean and cared for.

Wifi functional everywhere from beach, pool to tennis courts. 

At the tennis courts Domingo was skilled and fun to play with.  

Girls had massages which they enjoyed very much,

reviews.author: MARYROGERS176
reviews.title: No way except for Jose
reviews.text: Leaving here tomorrow, will write a detailed review when I get home.  If you are considering coming here I suggest you pay the extra $$$ and book Royal.  We did not book Royal and we had to almost beg for dinner reservations, a pad for lounger... This said our trip was still great thanks to Jose Rigo, he was wonderful to us and helped in any way he could.  There were also many other terrific staff members whom I will mention in next review .

reviews.author: Cris Z
reviews.title: Aniversário Inesquecível
reviews.text:
O Hotel é incrível a paisagem de tirar o folego e a comida divina. A energia de todos é contagiante. Minha sugestão é no primeiro dia fazer todas as reservas para os jantares assim terá oportunidade de conhecer todos os restaurante ou boa parte deles. 
Os quartos são excelentes conforto e beleza.

reviews.author: Anibal G
reviews.title: Amazing family vacations
reviews.text:
We are having an amazing experience!!! Family trip to Punta Cana from all over the world.
Kunfu Panda was THE BEST!!!! Our concierge Enrique didn't even appear or call, but the rest of the staff was great! Rafael the security guard, the youngest waiter in the buffet at dinner, we call him "the Benjamin" , all sooo friendly and courteous, and fun.
Food is amazing! Same as room service.

reviews.author: blndiegrl
reviews.title: Choose Paradisus for your next trip!
reviews.text:
We went to the Paradisus Palma Real from 2/24 - 3/4/17. This was our fourth time in the DR, previously having stayed at Club Med, Melia Caribe, and Memories. By far, the Paradisus was top notch for the accommodations, the staff, the amenities, and the SERVICE!!!
My husband and I took our two kids ages 8 and 10, and upgraded to the Family Concierge - worth every penny!! We had our own concierge - Leidy - and we were given a Blackberry phone that called her phone. She checked in with us every day, made reservations for us, gave us information about activities, and even arranged for our check out and transport to the airport. Wow!! When you upgrade to Family Concierge, you get access to the Reserve.
The Reserve is by far the most beautiful, luxurious, relaxing, and tranquil place ON EARTH! You get the Gabi Club which is a private buffet restaurant that will cook you literally anything you want. You get a humongous pool with so many twists and turns, nooks and crannies with covered beds, pod loungers, chairs, recliners, and privacy if you want. You get the pool restaurant that serves amazing burgers and salads. You get pool drink service and a swim up bar. It was never crowded and we were there during prime time - always seats, always towels, and the most friendliest staff! Kids didn't even want to go to the kids club because the pool was so amazing! But the resort was not over-run with children - there were many places for adults to escape to (and Royal Service is adult-only) and then there were places where our kids met new friends and played all day.
The Reserve also gives you access to another pool just a few steps away from the beach (on the other side of the resort) and you also get your own beach spot under a hut with waiter service every day - your name is put on it.  The Reserve beach area is private and separate from the main beach area.
The main buffet in the resort is HUGE - super big, open seating, and sometimes loud and crowded. But there is a cool burger joint right there and they had the best lunch!
We had a suite with a private master bedroom and a kitchen and dining area, and our kids slept in the living room - it was the perfect space for us. We had a balcony and we were steps away from the Family Concierge building where Leidy, Daniel, and the others were there waiting to assist.
The a la carte restaurants were also good - the steak house, the mediterranean restaurant, and the hibachi as well as Aqua were all terrific and catered to our kids.
After 9 days in paradise, it was time to go home - our kids actually cried and gave Leidy hugs because they loved her and the trip so much!! 
The spa in the Reserve is amazing, too - beautifully decorated and very relaxing.
We will definitely come back next year as it has been the best trip we ever took.  The service was top notch and we really got the impression that the staff truly cared about us and wanted us to have a great time. There were also carts that were available 24/7 to take us anywhere at the resort that we wanted to go.
It's easy to see why the Reserve is rated #1 in Punta Cana. We cannot wait to go back next year.

reviews.author: lrtocan
reviews.title: Royal Service Amazing
reviews.text: Lying on the beach on one of the amazing beach beds at the end of a great week at the Paradisus Palma Real. We were in the Royal Service area and our butler Carlos Hinostroza was wonderful, reserving our beach bed for us every day, making all our dinner reservations and taking care of all our requests including stepping in at the smoothie bar one day.  He also arranged little treats when we would get back to our room at days end - cheeses, fruits, chocolate covered strawberries and wine. We particularly enjoyed the Palazzo restaurant in the Royal Service area which had great service and food. The resort is beautiful with plenty of activities (paddle board fitness was great) and nighttime entertainment (loved the Queen tribute) and lots of bars depending on your mood.  The resort was very clean and housekeeping did a great job in our room coming in twice a day to clean and ensure our fridge was stocked. We also had great massages at the Oriental Garden Spa - a great kickoff to the week. Another highlight was Passion restaurant, not included in the all-inclusive but definitely worth the extra cost. It's been a great and relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: JJ0703
reviews.title: April Trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text: This is my second trip to Palma Real (first trip was for work) and this time I brought my girlfriend so we can enjoy this amazing location together.  We spend time at Palazzo restaurant, the spa, and one excursion to the Blue Hole (nature hike).  Everything was incredible.  Our butler, Jose Salvadore, along with the staff (Wanda the bartender, the team at Palazzo restaurant, and the guys offering dance lessons by the pool each day at 4 pm were fantastic (including Victor the DJ).  The food was simply outstanding.  I recommend trying each restaurant.  You know its a great vacation when we are already looking at a week to return next April!  Thanks to the guys including Looky Looky, Shaky Shaky, and Caramelo who helped us relax and have fun.

reviews.author: Roberto79
reviews.title: Nice hotel but very loud in Family Concierge Suites
reviews.text:
We liked the experience overall as our kids really enjoyed the holiday but the noise at night was terrible. We arrived on a Saturday night after a long haul flight to be greeted  by music until 4am. My wife and I essentially did not sleep that night at all. Second night being Sunday was better but then Monday onwards we got 2 / 3 nights of more music until 3 or 4 am each night. We stayed at the hotel for second weekend and again Friday and Saturday night we enjoyed the delights of dance music until 4am. Thankfully our 2 children were in an connecting room that was more protected by the noise so they rarely heard anything even though my son on a couple of occasions did mention in the morning that he had heard music overnight but had fallen back to sleep. We mentioned the music to the customer service manager of the hotel on various occasions and yet nothing was done about it. They had a wedding on over first weekend and a beer conference over the following week and hence many events on and the main concern of the hotel must have been the welfare of the big groups as opposed to a families concerns over sleep deprivation.  The management of the hotel are terrible... do not care about the clients concerns as all the customer manager did was apologise (thanks for the apology but what about paying a large sum of money to stay at your hotel and not being able to sleep!!!). Out of 12 nights we stayed at the hotel, we had 5 terrible nights and another 2 with music until about 1am. The other nights we did have decent sleeps. As I said to our family concierge, we don't travel to the Caribbean for a holiday and book what is supposedly a 5* in order to listen to music until the early hours of morning especially when we had booked the Family Concierge section of hotel which one would assume has Families in mind?! I got no adequate apology from the hotel and quite frankly that is not acceptable for the quality of hotel they claim to be.
I will not stay at a Paradisus again (I have stayed previously at the one at playa del carmen and have stayed on business at a few melia hotels) as I would not want to encounter the unprofessional management in any other of their hotels! 
Apart from the complaints, the food was decent (tepanyaki and Francisco the chef was a highlight).. the buffets in general are good. 
The staff apart from managers were friendly and efficient. 
Accommodation in family suites are large but definitely not 5*. I would say this hotel is a 4* superior but don't expect a 5* hotel with all the luxury extras.
Kids club was decent but not exceptional for a resort focused on families. 
My review would be much better if the hotel had done something about the noise and offered to change our room to another location the first couple of nights of our stay.
Our family concierge offered us to look into a change of room 3 days before leaving (i.e. We had been there for 9 nights already!!) of which I declined the offer as we were nearing the end of our holiday. 
Just another thing to add, the hotel are trying to sell their new 'circle' product and it is quite annoying having sales people pestering you on holiday. Going to beach restaurants was like walking the guantlet of sales people!! It was room 3415.
