I would request a room overlooking the pool for people staying in the family concierge then hopefully you won't get the noise.

reviews.author: mdivasta
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation Royal Sevice worth it
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is well worth the trip. Royal Service is the way to go. Seperate pool area. Your own restaraunt Palazzo. Cell phone to call your butler at any time. Butler makes all your reservations and helps with any other needs. Restaraunt, Cabana reservation etc..Our Butler Argenis was great and personable. Definitely worth the upgrade. Be sure to tip The maids we did and our fridge was stocked every night. The property is amazing as well.

reviews.author: Todd T
reviews.title: Beautiful Setting, Good Food, and Events
reviews.text:
Overall, had a great week there. Will start with the drawbacks: I was a bit frustrated with getting dinner reservations that could not be booked in advance. Vladimir (manager at front desk) did a great job helping us get reservations after the concierge attendants were not much help.  Also the pitch to sell us on the "Melia Circle Club" was a bit annoying after we dropped thousands to go to this place.  We were literally tracked down and asked to attend a 30 minute briefing (which we did not attend) after choosing this resort over others. Who wants to blow even 30 minutes on a vacation to be upsold?  Last but not least the resort credits are a joke. $20 off $100+ bottles of wine, one $10 casino credit per day (even though you get $100), and $50 off a spa treatment that starts at $200 for an hour!  Even though we got $1500 of these we used only $10 worth.

The buffet was solid but got old after a few days.  Blue Agave - great burgers for lunch. Fueyo and Vento were amazing for dinner.  Skip Olio - it's hard to get Italian wrong, but they did. Mizu (Hibachi at reserve) and Bana (Sushi) were good options as well.  In room breakfast highly recommended for days with early tours.  The swim up bar was a key in the pool area. Also know that earlier in the evening even when restaurants are supposedly 100% booked people always skip out and there are tons of open tables so go anyway if you want to try the better places in your all inclusive trip.

The shows and on resort activities were a highlight from sushi making to candle making to painting and beach volleyball. Everyday at 3:30 there is something good to do from an activity perspective. A few shout outs to the stag: Reynaldo "Carmelo", Oliver "King Fu Panda", and Oxnard were amazing from an entertainment perspective.  From Zumba to Latin Dancing to art classes and the Lion King show these guys were omnipresent and always fun to be around.  

Overall location is great (less than 30 minutes from the Punta Cana airport and centrally located for day / half day tours), the property is beautiful and I would recommend for families with kids of any age (there is a kids club as well for toddlers to pre teens). My daughter was 13 and was not interested in the club as there was not a big teen presence in the romper room like environment.

reviews.text: This is our second time visiting Paradisus and the shorty made us feel like home!!! Everybody is so helpful and friendly at the hotel, food & drinks on point, but la  shorty always went the extra mile,me, my wife and our  11 months daughter had a wonderful experience overall!! with all sorts of games and activities, indoors and out, and snacks as well as meals for the little ones. We highly recommend that venue!

reviews.text: Nous sommes allés au Paradisus PR , section  Royal service ,en mars 2017, Notre majordome Miguel , tout sourire ,  venait nous visiter à  la plage pour nous demandé  si on avait besoin de quelques choses....toujours efficaces dans nos demandes ..la partie qui fait du Royal service un grd plus,  est qu'il nous assigne une place à  la piscine ou à  la plage pour la semaine...Francisco est à  la plage, nous assigne  une place dispo à  note arrivé  et la prépare  toute la semaine...pas de stress le matin pour ce trouver une place avec parasol....le seul pt négatif est le choix des restaurants, différent mais pas pour tout les goûts  , mais de qualité. .......Christiane

Food, beach activities and spa are off the chart. The beach is like white sugar but is not hot to walk. One of the most relaxing trips I  have taken.

reviews.author: zimpsych
reviews.title: Absolutely perfect
reviews.text:
This was a family holiday, all inclusive, for 8 days in a one bedroom master suite in the Reserve. From the check-in to check-out I was unable to find any fault with the service, rooms, food and amenities and was reduced to trying to find tiny process improvements to suggest, to avoid the risk of gushing too much. We ate almost exclusively at the Gabi restaurant and were so happy that we didn't see the need to try out any of the other restaurants there. Sushi, ceviche, Dominican and international cooking and a brisk and willing bar service allowed us to drift happily into the extensive dessert buffet and excellent coffee. The room was large enough (around 80 sq metres) to comfortable accommodate us and the 2 double beds and a double sofa bed in the lounge worked out just fine.

There is an element of trying to sell membership to the Club Melia but it gained us a great catamaran ride to another Melia resort and a sales pitch that was perfectly civilised. Our equally polite declining of the offers caused no animosity.

Our kids loved the spring temperatures (27 degrees C) and the waves were just big enough to make swimming fun. The beach was excellent and all in all it was quite simply the best beach holiday ever. High praise from someone who grew up on the beaches of South Africa and Mozambique. The walk from the Reserve to the beach was a gentle 15 minutes - we didn't bother with the somewhat erratic golf cart service and just enjoyed the balmy weather. Kids had fun in the Kids Club on 2 of the afternoons but otherwise we just lounged on the beach and drank interesting things out of coconuts. You'll need good sun creams and perhaps a bit of mosquito repellent although not much at all by our experience. Fantastic holiday - many thanks Silvio Lantigua and team.

reviews.title: Dahiana she is the best
reviews.text: Dahiana is the best worker at this place. She is always dancing and partying with us. She always cares about us. She has great vibes. Her and angel are the two best workers at this resort. I'm going to miss her so much when I leave.

reviews.author: Sam K
reviews.title: Would have been 5 star if it was not for the terrible service experience at check in
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort but when it comes to service they are lacking! Very disappointed!!
We booked directly with the resort for party of 5 couples in the Royal Service. Had heard great things about the Royal Service as how well you are treated.

Before our trip, we were contacted by Melia's staff, Edgar Montilla, to make sure everything was planned out right. We requested for King beds and as airport transfers were included, sent him our travel plans. We were told that someone from Royal Service will contact us to arrange for the transportation. We emailed Edgar twice before departing to check on it. Still same answer. Never heard from Royal Service. 

When we arrived in PC, we were informed that the transport had to be arranged 72hrs before arrival. Well we tried, had emails to prove our conversations, no luck:( Not a big deal as it was not too expensive but the fact they are telling us something different upon arrival was not cool. Had also asked for King beds as we were all couples travelling, as part of the welcome email conversation, didn't happen. Got room with 2 beds. Beds were not even Queen size. Could not be comfortable as we found it too small for a couple. 

Got to the resort, were escorted to the regular check in as appose to the Royal Service check in. Told the front desk staff that we were with Royal Service and were told we would have a separate check in. Got ignored! Took our passports and started checking us in. Happen to be that one of the friends travelling with us had arrived earlier. He saw us checking in and came and told us we are at the wrong check in. Well, we told the front desk but he said to stay there and he would check us in. Anyway, we asked him to give us the passports back and followed the friend who was checked in to the Royal Service check in. 

Spoke to the manager about all the issues and that this is "Not Royal" in any manner. Got ignored...sorry you had trouble, but the resort is nice right? Really, that's the best you can do to apologize?? She told us she will speak to someone. Never got back to us. Went back to check on the matter after couple of days. Were offered 50% discount at their paid restaurant. Said no thanks!

Butler service is overrated. All they want to do is sell you add on items as they make commissions. If you don't seem interested, they are are hard to find when you need them. One of the nights had a reservation at Aqua for 9:30pm. Apparently they had us down for 9:00pm. Not a big deal, "can you accommodate us". Were told "No" we are busy. Really, we only see two tables with people on them. Rest of the place is empty. We told them we were walking in anyway and they can figure out their issues. They ended up seating us.  

I could go on and on..but you get the gist. Very, very disappointed with how we were treated by management.

But there are lots of positives as well. The food was better than expected, staff at the restaurants, bars all along the property were awesome. Beautiful property, not very crowded. Great beach. Nightly entertainment was amazing.

Perhaps we expected too much but that is what we were led to believe when we booked. Had a super time with the friends, would go back but Not to Paradisus Palma Real. For how much they charge, there are many other nice properties there.

reviews.author: Mia R
reviews.title: AMAZING!! Dahiana Moreno is my fav!! She's awesome!!
reviews.text: I love my trip! I had the best time at the pool and hanging out with my friends at night!! Dahiana really made me trip so fun!! Love it!!! You all need to vacation here now!!! Angel is also awesome!! Love them!!!!!!

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Above Average Food - Below Average Room
reviews.text:
The resort is located on lush, expansive grounds, right on the ocean with a majestic Romanesque foyer.
Many resorts offer unlimited mediocre buffets. This resort offered unlimited superior food choices: fresh fish in abundance, e.g lobster, ceviche, and dream homemade ice creams.
Our room was large, tastefully appointed but had poor lighting and smelled of...mildew? The climate is humid, so washing did not dry quickly, which may have led to the smell.  Some rooms are located 10+ min walk from the foyer.

reviews.author: Nicolae B
reviews.title: Great rooms,5-8 minutes walk to the beach.
reviews.text: 6 people-2 adults,4 kids-2 teenagers.Excellent food, very nice rooms, great service.Better overall/more upscale then Majestic Elegance from 2 years ago. Room checked/cleaned twice a day.Our concierge, Carlos, did a great job managing restaurants reservations, special in room bar requests and checked with us multiple times a day, bending over backwards to help us in anyway possible. Everyone at the Reserve gets a concierge.The Reserve is 5-10 minutes walk from the beach-not a biggie for us.Never had to wait for a shuttle/cart upfront if didn't feel like walking. After 4 months indoors in MN I was happy I had a reason to walk outside.Beach is wide, clean.

reviews.author: jason s
reviews.title: Shorty shorty
reviews.text: Shorty is the best! She is very fun and very beautiful. I loved spending time and dancing with her. She's got the moves! She's very kind and caring and knows how to have fun. She is very cool and always putting a smile on everyone's face.

reviews.author: Ryan R
reviews.title: Great Vacation with Friends
reviews.text: Dahiana and Angel are fantastic. They made my vacation so much better than it already was. They were extremely fun, caring, and nice. They were very nice to have around and I enjoyed the time I spent with them. Dahiana spent time with my friends and me at the pool, the beach, the bar, and the dance floor. Everywhere she was made for an amazing time. I loved her energy and enthusiasm as well. I will never forget her and the great time I shared with her in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Karinà S
reviews.title: Vacaciones perfectas
reviews.text:
Excelente atención . Espectacular el lugar. Atención personalizada . Lindos espectáculos . Los restoranes están bárbaros . El hotel en si mismo es una belleza . Un lugar ideal de descanso! 
Nada para criticar .

reviews.author: Alex G
reviews.title: grandioso
reviews.text: Mi familia y yo consideramos que este resort es nuestro segundo hogar, es un hermoso lugar y el personal es parte de nosotros incluyendo a Raynold Tamayo muy buen entretenedor melvin concepcion muy una muy buena persona gracias chicos por su atencion como siempre agradecidos de sus servicios en general. 💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻

reviews.author: Alexandra T
reviews.title: Great long weekend Getaway
reviews.text: My husband would definitely go back.  It even rained the majority of the time, we had a great time, enjoyed the food, felt everyone was positive spirited, they had fun music, great drinks (grey goose vodka at all bars - but we also were royal service customers so not sure how it works when you aren't.)  It was awesome!

reviews.author: jaycollins51
reviews.title: 10 days of Quality Relaxation
reviews.text: What a beautiful retreat. We stayed at the Reserve which is adjacent to the main hotel and it was great. It rained for at least 50% of the time but it was warm and easy to relax in the bar or eating areas when outside was out of bounds. This was the best ever all-inclusive with the most amazing selection of really good food. Our area of the beach for Reserve guests was never crowded  and the beach and water were beautiful. I have never come across a service staff that were so helpful and happy. The rooms were spacious - living area, king size master and very large bathroom as well as a kitchen area. We were extremely happy with the experience.

reviews.author: Peter C
reviews.title: Royalty at its best
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort march 18 to 25.from the minute we arrived we were greeted to first class service.our butler Nicolas treated us like royalty.he couldn't do enough for us.it was like he knew our next wish or want ahead of time.there was nothing we had asked him to do or check for us that he never questioned it.he just went ahead and did it .i would highly recommend going to this resort.you will not be disappointed.would recommend royal service for your best  experience at this resort.we were so pleased with the service that we will probably return next year. Peter and jane

reviews.author: 17LF
reviews.title: Parfait !
reviews.text: Nous sommes partis en famille avec nos 2 ados et notre fils de 3 ans. Les enfants se sont éclatés et nous, nous nous sommes reposés. Raynold a été top! Il nous a appris à danser et a été un amour avec les enfants. Le personnel est tres génial et on avait une super concierge! Bref, je recommande sans hésitation pour des vacances en famille.

reviews.author: marcia H
reviews.title: El mejor park disfruta en familia
reviews.text:
Excelentes habitaciones ,atención y atracones park todas las edades
Un hotel e lujo Attendanae sobresaliente
Un gusto volver
Desayuno diferente alternativa y muy variado .
Variedad en almuerzo 
Y cenas en excelentes restaurante   y variados tipos de comida

reviews.author: salma_martiinez
reviews.title: otras hermosas vacaciones
reviews.text: Todos los años vengo aquí, a este mismo hotel y sin duda alguna las personas siguen siendo maravillos, con su atención, servicio y carisma. Gracias Raynold Tamayo como siempre muy respetuoso, alegre y divertido también gracias melvin concepción, jhordan Rosario de FC son muy atentos

reviews.author: karadeniz12345
reviews.title: Great Christmas get away!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for two weeks with our 3 year old and 6 weeks old sons

Spacious resort

Food was quality lot of choices, you have main restaurant where you eat your meals as well as i think it was 5 others where also included in the all inclusive. You had to book via room butler which worked out well
They had bbq by the pool often which was fab. 

Friendly staff, our butler was very attentive and knowledgeable

Kids club was great variety of actives each day and friendly staff   

We mainly stayed by the pool so beach looked lovely but did not sunbathe there so cant comment 

Amazing meet the Santa event! Santa came in a red helicopter landed on a beach staff from kids club were dressed as elf. Santa was friendly despite wearing a suit in the heat. We were very impressed! 

New years eve party we heard was excellent too in the main hotel but we did not attend due to having a little baby

Live music and salsa most nights 

Shopping area inside the resort which was excellent for diapers, wipes. Clothes, toy shops, cinema and night club also around there 

I gave 4 instead of 5 star only because of the mosquitos. We did get bitten by mosquito 🙁our butler fumigated the room couple of times and it seemed to work after awhile but i do advise to take plug in mosquito repellent, wipes, mosquito bite relive cream, net for the strollers and long sleeve tops for the kids at night. 
They only sell the repellent spray at the shop.    

I would consider revisiting.

reviews.author: Paula S
reviews.title: Servicio Real lo peor!
reviews.text: Decidimos pasar 7 días en Paradisus con una pareja de amigos. Elegimos el servicio Real, ya que queríamos una atención de lujo, por lo cual pagamos un gran cargo extra. Este servicio consiste en una serie de instalaciones exclusivas y un mayordomo que se supone te tiene que hacer la estancia más agradable. A nosotros y a nuestros amigos nos tocó uno de nombre Ariel. La verdad es que la atención de dicho mayordomo fue pésima, con una falta de detslles y profesionalismo, que nos echó a perder la semana completa gracias a sus mentiras, errores y excusas. Como ejemplo un día estuvimos varias horas afuera de nuestra habitación, todos mojados y de noche, porque nuestro mayordomo y nadie del servicio Real era capaz de arreglar nuestras llaves, perdimos una serie de descuentos que el nunca nos notificó y cuando se lo dijimos, se excusó con tonterías, a nuestros amigos los tuvo durante un día completo sin su maleta, tenía un trato displicente desde que noto que los latinos no dábamos tanta propina como los norteamericanos . La verdad es que el hotel tiene instalaciones correctas pero la atención del personal es pésimo, nunca más vuelvo a servicio Real de Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: travel2017349
reviews.title: A+ Service
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved staying at this resort. The food and it's presentation was amazing. There were beach activities To enjoy. We played volleyball in the sun, took pictures with a monkey, swam in the warm blue waters, danced bachata... Food at Fuego was amazing!! Staff treated me like a princess. So sweet! Food at Mole wasn't so great. Wasn't even close to authentic Mexican. I'd say skip it and experience the foods they are knowns for. We had a HUGE suite and the housekeepers did a great job. The room was muggy and we had a few cold nights so having no heat or real blankets in the room was uncomfortable. That's my only "complaint." The bar staff was great. Made great drinks. I loved how willing everyone one was to help me with my Spanish :) Such amazing people.  

I'd highly recommend this resort. It's beauty is breathtaking and the staff is supreme.

reviews.author: 901erik
reviews.title: Beautifull resort, but......
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at the resort till the last day.  
We had an all-inclusive with Royal Services.  
One of the exclusive services was to be able to eat in the restaurant “RARE”.  My husband and my went to this restaurant and had an enjoyable evening till the moment we wanted to leave the restaurant because we had to sign a bill.  Whether we told them that this dinner was included or not they would not listen.
We did not find it correct that the let you eat thinking its included and that when finish eating that you receive a bill!
Afterwards we went with our document proving that the restaurant was inclusive to the reception  but they only said “sorry for our mistake but you still have to pay”.

It’s a pity that this issue made us leave the hotel with a bad feeling.

So be careful when you use the exclusive services because it is not always clear if its included in your package.

reviews.author: Bonnie S
reviews.title: Shorty
reviews.text: Ella es la mas bella y encatadora me encantan sus baile amo bailar con ella recomiendo este hotel gracias al equipo de actividades son especial angel la shorty regresare el servicio es lo mejor de lo mejor gracias

reviews.author: Nina M
reviews.title: Lindo lugar
reviews.text: O hotel é lindo, tem uma vista maravilhosa saindo do lobby para a escadaria onde você vê a Praia.... entre os restaurantes o melhor é o Acqua, vale a visita para experimentar a comida mediterrânea. O que deixou a desejar foi o atendimento... não é ágil e falta bastante atenção dos funcionários...

reviews.author: holidayaddy
reviews.title: First visit to Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
It was our first visit to DR. I struggled to select a clear rating for this beautiful hotel resort, with beautiful white sand beaches. The star rating I selected is a maximum of 5 being the highest rating. 
5* For surrounding gardens, beautiful walkways, well maintained gardens. Miles of beautiful beaches with soft white sand. A private beach for guests staying at the Reserve or with Royal Service. Plenty of sunbeds, sundeck chaise chairs, shade. Bar service available at the beach. Washrooms on the beach.

We checked in on a Wednesday. After our flight and transfer to the hotel, we arrived at 1:46pm, and check-in is at 3pm.  The front desk was very friendly. We were offered a welcome beverage. Front desk suggested that we head for lunch and return in an hour. Before we could head to lunch, our concierge intercepted us and we followed the concierge gullibly. Our concierge introduced himself and explained that tomorrow we would not be having breakfast in this hotel, but that he would meet us and bring us by catamaran to the Palma Real for breakfast and we would have a tour of the bay. He brought out a map of the Paradisus hotel layout and explained briefly, hotels along the coast, the restaurants, and that he had a gift for us of three free nights to be used at any of the Paradisus hotel resorts in DR and Mexico. Then he held onto the map and the hotel envelope and brought us to Gabi Beach by shuttle for the lunch buffet. We were seated immediately for the lunch buffet. Service at the lunch buffet was excellent. After the lunch buffet, we decided to walk back to the main lobby and check on our room. 

5* High rating because we were upgraded to The Reserve to a one-bedroom suite. We would be in Block 42 on the third floor, with a partial garden/road path/parking view. Note there are no elevators. If you have a young family and strollers, the main floor may be better for your family. Laundry facilities if needed are on the ground floor. We liked being on the 3rd floor. 

We had requested one bed at check-in. The front desk advised that when we get to the room, if it is not one bed, to let them know and they would push the beds together. We get to the suite and it is two double beds. We call housekeeping but the phone does not work. We have to walk back to the main hotel lobby to make the request. The beds are firm and provide a good comfortable sleep. The suite although facing the road and parking lot is actually quiet.
3.5* I downgraded the accommodations because of the phone did not work for the first 3 days out of 5 days. The TV in the living room did not work. Some days there were no bath mats. It would be taken away and not replaced. Some days there were no hand towels. Turn down service and tidying up was inconsistent. Sometimes they appeared at 9:45pm. We were really surprised that they would appear so late and then offered us chocolates at the door. The mini-bar fridge beverage selection is quite lacking. Soda, diet soda, beer, no other liquor; crushed crackers and crushed cookies. It was nice to see chips in the fridge but these were not replenished daily. 

Our package said there would be a welcome bottle of rum and a welcome basket. Nothing arrived for the first 3 days. At the Reserve, there is a concierge in each building. We spoke with the concierge on the 4th day, and our concierge apologized and said that it is like a champagne (not a bottle of rum.) On that day when we returned to the room, there was a fruit platter with beautifully carved fruit, plates, cloth napkins and a bottle of Merlot. How beautiful to walk into your suite and be greeted by this. 

Recommend staying in The Reserve if you are staying at this hotel resort. 
Plus’s for The Reserve:
Priority check-in and checkout in the Reserve lobby, and offers its own refreshments.
Own pool; swim up bar, buffet (Gabi Club) and a la carte dining (Vento) only for Reserve guests. Live music is performed in Gabi Club in the dinner hour. 

Resort likes-
Beautiful property well maintained;
Beautiful sitting areas in the main lobby; swing chairs for two in the main lobby;
Surrounds of miles of green and flowering vegetation;
Shuttles between lobbies and the beach ran approximately every 10-12 minutes. 
Upgrade to a one-bedroom suite in the Reserve.
Suite had lots of wardrobe space-one closet with hanging space, bathrobes and slippers. An adjacent closet with lots of deep shelf space, plus the chest in the bedroom, and two closets in the entranceway and living room. Digital safe in the closet. Long umbrella provided in the closet. One of the sofa's is a pullout sofabed. 
3 wash basins in the bathroom (double sink vanity in the double Jacuzzi bathroom) and a single sink in the adjoining bathroom, separate toilet and separate standup shower. Two entrances to the bathroom. 
Washrooms avail at The Reserve beach.
Sunbeds, deck chairs, shade areas at The Reserve beach.
We arrived at the beach late one morning and could still find a sunbed in the shade.
Pick up beach towels at the reserved beach area.
Wi-Fi throughout the resort is free.
Firm beds. 
Lots of bath sheets. 
Bar on the beach-we picked up our own beverages from the beach bar.
Preferred the dining service and choices at the buffets. Beverage service at the buffet was also really more enjoyable than at the a la carte's except for Bana where the service was excellent. 

The hotel main lobby is a two-minute walk from The Reserve. 
Recommend Bana, a la carte Japanese fusion dining is a one-minute walk from the main hotel lobby. Entertaining meal, teppanyaki style, dine with others/meet other travelers and food service was quick. 

3* Dinner reservations can be booked by your concierge in The Reserve, however dining reservations close at 5pm. You will be asked for your Wishes which restaurants and preferred dining time of either 6-730pm or 8-930pm. We asked for early dining and were told they can reserve 2 restaurants because we would be staying for 4 nights. Our dinner reservations could be confirmed the next day only between 3pm-4pm. This would mean we could not map out our day because we would only find out about our dining time by 4pm. 
Dress code at buffet or a la carte dining is casual. 

Be aware. We were given 3 dinner confirmations at 3 restaurants. 8pm, 830pm and 6pm. We cancelled the 830pm at The Grill, a steakhouse with our building concierge. The next evening, we received a phone call and were asked why did we not arrive for our 830pm reservation. When we told them we had cancelled with the concierge, they wanted to know why we cancelled, and we said because it was too late. We were then told that we should have just gone to the restaurant directly and asked for an earlier time. Please note, The Grill is at the beach, a good ten-minute walk from your hotel, or a ten-minute wait for a shuttle to the beach. It’s not as simple to see if the restaurant can take you earlier. I had read other reviews, which showed they would be turned away.

3* Daily entertainment shows are at 830pm. We only saw a show on the first night because we had dinner at the buffet. The performers were good, and really danced the full 35-40 minutes, what energy! We missed the show the other nights because we tried the a la carte dinner at Vento, which was at 8pm, but the food arrived after 9pm. We are not accustomed to eating so late, and left immediately after the main entrée. 

There are no dining facilities at the main Paradisus hotel lobby. All 
dining facilities are near the beach. The main pool with activities is also near the beach. Ie. 10-12 minutes walk from the hotel lobbies.

By the end of our vacation, our phone was working and we received several phone calls in the evening asking how our stay was. 

Dining:
There is not a lot of vegetables offered, except for daily salads. Fruit is in abundance. 

Be aware:
Of the timeshare ploys in the hotel. We had friends staying at the Paradisus and they warned us about not going on the catamaran boat tour as it would takes 2 hours away from our mini-vacation. This is being done by the hotel staff in the main lobby and in The Reserve lobby. Hotel staff would politely enquire about our plans for the day, and then suggest that we participate on a catamaran tour of the bay. The word catamaran became a key word on our visit to avoid any of these ploys.

The exchange rate is better at the airport than at the hotel. 
There is a gift store in the hotel. Another hotel guest told us to negotiate the price. 

Be aware of mosquitoes after 530pm. Even with the anti-mosquito spray, those no-seeims will catch up.

reviews.author: fernando p
reviews.title: maravilloso y paradisíaco lugar de república dominicana
reviews.text: El resort es fantástico , con todo lo necesario para pasar unos días de ensueño, basta llegar y ser recibido de la mejor manera . Con cordialidad de Darling en la madrugada , nos dio una habitación confortable y bella para nuestro descanso. y luego a disfrutar de las instalaciones, restaurares, show y amabilidad de todos sus integrantes . fuimos atendidos como reyes en un lugar bellisimo lleno de atractivos y la naturaleza de la reserva y el mar espectacular .

reviews.author: Dennis R
reviews.title: Great Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: Very Clean and beautifull place to vacation. Everyone was very nice and our Butler Francis was the best. We would go back in a heartbeat and will request Francis as our butler again. Lots of excursions to choose from each one has their own local shop to purchase momento's be ready to negotiate pricing. If you know Spanish great plus.

reviews.author: jwB566OY
reviews.title: Fun in the sun family trip
reviews.text: Fun in the sun . . . even when it's raining.  Paradisus made everything enjoyable.  The huts on the beach kept us and our things dry in the rain and shaded in the sun.  The intermittent rain didn't bother our day at all.  We found many activities to do like paddle yoga & aerobics, working out in the gym, sailing, and shows in the evening.  What a fun, fun trip.

reviews.author: Laura R
reviews.title: Spectacular Spring Break Get-Away
reviews.text:
Beautiful compound and fabulous accommodations!   We used the family concierge service (5 stars to Sandra V for making us feel like kings and queens).  The distance to the beach was a bit long but walkable.  Golf carts always available, if you needed.

We travelled with another family to celebrate our daughters' Senior Spring Break.  We had 7 days of perfect weather and spent every day on the beach. The cabanas provided the perfect amount of shelter.  We explored the pools a few times - but most of the action was at the beach.   Nightly entertainment was well produced.

One circle is dim because we had a most unwelcoming arrival.  The hotel did not provide promised transportation for our two families and then when we finally made it to resort we spent an hour arguing with staff that we indeed paid for the accommodations  - a lot of money, btw - even showing them printed receipts could not convince.  Our husbands were so upset they asked for a meeting with management.  That was an even bigger blunder - left us with even worse taste in our mouth.

Thankfully, the remaining staff understood the meaning of customer service.  We tried all the restaurants and were never disappointed.  From starters to desert - we really enjoyed our time dining.  The decor and architecture in each was top notch.  The club at the beach was a favorite evening hangout for us and our teenagers.

Special shoutouts to activity staff Luis who arranged pickup basketball game and Melvin who led Pilates on beach.  Also thanks to Antonio and Marcos who charmed our daughters and impressed them with linen roses.  Restaurant staff were always friendly and professional.

reviews.author: SCC112
reviews.title: *Ignore the negative reviews at your own risk*
reviews.text:
I am on the flight home from our stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. I read the good and the negative reviews on TripAdvisor before I booked this property. I wish I'd paid more attention to those negative reviews before going. I was swayed by how beautiful the place looked online. And it truly is gorgeous.

I brought my teenage daughter and her friend. I travel regularly, but not super frequently. I stay at varying levels of hotels, (usually nicer) to include a few 5-star ones. This is no 5-star experience. At least ours wasn't.

I'll start with the PROS:
- [ ] The grounds are truly spectacular and lavish. Beautifully maintained and one of the highlights of our stay. 
- [ ] The design of the common areas (pools, lounge, restaurants, bars, sitting areas, etc) is gorgeous! Cannot overstate. The aesthetic is sleek and relaxing at the same time.
- [ ] The trolleys (golf carts) that transport you to the different properties (the Reserve & the original Paradisus property) plus the beach, etc. were plentiful and fun to catch.
- [ ] The numerous workers are so sweet and smiling and always trying to be helpful.
- [ ]  The various classes (I took 2 pool fitness classes) were a blast and the instructors at the Reserve pool were awesome! Just the right amount of fun and challenging for me. I took Paddle Fitness & the pool spinning class. Would love to ditch my gym and just do that all the time, ha.
- [ ] The various cabanas around the pool are just the best. What a nice touch!

The CONS: (not a full list)
- [ ] When we arrived, we were given a 2 bed room despite reserving a K bed. 
- [ ] When I'd previously gotten the email asking if I had any special requests for when we arrived, I'd asked if they could have a Welcome note of some sort mentioning my 2 Spring Breakers by name (thought they'd enjoy). There wasn't one. 
- [ ] If you speak Spanish, your experience is going to be much better than mine and easier for sure. So many things I let go by the wayside b/c to try and explain what I wanted would've taken so long. I'm not one of those who think everyone should speak English. But if I'd known how difficult it was going to be to communicate and understand, I *never* would've booked here. And after 5 days, it was draining.
- [ ] The ongoing self- promotion for the Melia brand and time-share properties was so cheesy and unavoidable. You're offered a 'free' catamaran ride, but it only goes to another Melia property (Palma Real) and you get a tour, a talk about the 'opportunities', from what the concierge said. I chose not to take it. 
- [ ] The second sort of self promotion came from some of the workers. My daughter and her friend had a worker chat with them a couple nights ago for a while and then asked for their phones so he could download the TripAdvisor app--and then proceeded to take one of their phones and type in a favorable review!! Beyond inappropriate.
- [ ] I was required to meet with my concierge, and then we met with a person who explained some of the benefits of having a Melia rewards membership, especially the Coupons you could spend on your stay. Again, more time away from anything relaxing. And when I think of '5-star hotel' a book of coupons does not come to mind.
- [ ] My concierge was sweet and helpful at times, and other times just took up more of my vacation time than I would've liked. Personal preference. 
- [ ] The restaurant reservation process was awful. Again, back & forth with concierge. I believe we had choice of 10 restaurants, a few are buffets, no reservation necessary. For the others, you fill out a Wish List with 4 options. We got 2 (out of 7) of the ones we wanted! Does that sound like being relaxed/pampered(?) because it wasn't to me. I texted the concierge and told her we wanted to at least try the highly-touted Passion during our stay, and if we couldn't,  we would just eat off property that night (not a threat, it was just sounding pretty good right about then). We got to eat there (which is not included) and it was nearly empty. The restaurant was beautiful, and the food was gorgeous. It did nothing for me, and my teenagers said they were going to need to go get something to eat when we finished. (I have no problem with small portions of beautiful food as long as it is delicious. It was not.) 
Room service was ridiculously slow. One night after waiting a full hour, I called them back to see what was taking so long and the (polite) man said that they had ONE delivery person for BOTH the Reserve and the Paradisus. 
- [ ] I inadvertently bumped into a manager on a trolley and we got talking about my concierge experience (coupons, catamaran, taking up more time than I liked, etc) and not liking the restaurant experience. He listened(?) & said that's not the experience he wants guests to have. He asked me more specific questions, then (wait for it) said that if I could give him 30 min's of my time, he could tell me about getting in on the Melia Circle experience for a great price. When I declined, he appeared offended. 
- [ ] The last night, we went to the Grille and ordered steak of corse. My daughter ordered a skirt steak M/M rare. It arrived cooked completely through. They gave it another try and this time the inside was raw. Not rare; raw. Inedible. She'd tasted my Ribeye and liked it, so on her 3rd try she ordered a Ribeye. She got another skirt steak. When we left, the server cheerfully asked So did you enjoy your dinner? (What are you supposed to say to that(?) 

I could go on, but will just say it is unfortunate that such a gorgeous place falls short on so many levels. I actually thought it was a red flag to have those 'pop-ups' floating around on a supposedly 5-star hotel website. In my opinion, Trip Advisor should reconsider listing it in this category.

reviews.author: Martin8821
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.text:
We visited March 30th for a week and had a great time here.

Highlights for us were the beach, the food and the entertainment. We never had a problem finding a spot on the beach, and while it was a bit windy which stirred up some weeds, generally the water was clean and warm. The entertainment was better than we've experienced at any other all-inclusives: Queen tribute band should not be missed (Thursday nights at the Gavi beach bar), and the King of Pop (Michael Jackson) show was fun. The Circus performers were also very entertaining.

For food, the buffet here is the best I've seen; it continually changed with high quality offerings. We decided not to go to an A La Carte one night because we had heard food was not so great at the one we reserved, plus the time wasn't ideal for us - went to the Naos buffet and had a great dinner there. They even had a small Indian food area at lunches that was very tasty and changed every day. Breakfasts were very good there too (omelette, poached egg and pancake bars) and a special shoutout to our waiter Gustavo V. who was always ready with our coffee, juice and a smile! We especially enjoyed the Olio, Rare Steakhouse and Bana restaurants in that order.

The only negative I can say is booking the A La Cartes was somehow challenging, not sure why. On arrival we booked our restaurants for the week and were told to come back the next morning for the tickets. Easy. But then we had to go back 4-5 times over the next several days in order to finally get them. Small inconvenience, but not something I want to spend hours doing on my vacation. I think it was just the person we spoke to that caused the problem, since other guests we spoke to didn't have any issues.

Finally, the entertainment gang was fun; enjoyed beach volleyball and chatting with Lukey Luke and Panda.

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Great winter getawaay!
reviews.text: I love going to the Dominican Republic when it's winter in Chicago. This time we traveled with out daughter and it was great.The resort is huge and has everything you can think of. Really wanna thank to all the stuff  and especially those from the kids center. Nica Luis Alexandra Diasarys Yan Yesmerlyn Adrian Samantha Candy Yves. If you're traveling with kids you will know why this is so important.  We will be back for sure. Cheers

reviews.author: Orquidea Q
reviews.title: Super viaje
reviews.text: El mejor viaje para repetir y volver con todod los amigos.Los chichos de animación comenzando por Melvin cobcepción,josé a vicente,luis florian,oscar santana,neibi peréz,rubert Pérez.Los increíbles  chicos del circle con Lola,Víctor Estrada Ya somos socios os quiero chicos!! El mejor personal y la mejor comida en los restaurantes Passión de Martín Berasategui,The grill;Isidro, cheila,Martín Rafael,Gustavo  y del gril; isamar pulinaro.EXCELENTES !!!

reviews.author: Margaret b
reviews.title: Birthday Getaway
reviews.text: Stayed in the Royal Reserve, our Butler Francis was outstanding,  even arranged a special dinner birthday party for my husband by himself. Food is incredible &  staff is efficient.  Bartender Starky served  excellent beverages.  Beautiful beach.  We will definitely return & highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bexs94595
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
Where to start.... My husband, daughter and I just visited Paradisus in Punta Cana and WOW what a great time! First off we went to check in and already decided ahead of time from reading reviews that we wanted to upgrade to the reserve. We originally wanted Royal Service but our daughter is only 14 and you had to have everyone in your party 18 or older so decided to upgrade to reserve for a bigger room and more amenities. 

The upgrade was easy and our check in lady ( I forgot her name) was awesome. We were than taken around for a little tour from Julio who showed us the main area. We were than taken over to our room. We had an amazing pool view and even though we wanted 2 beds we tried the king bed and pull out sofa for the night. We ended up changing rooms the next day since the sofa bed was not as soft as our daughter would've liked but Elaine made it easy. 

Elaine was the concierge in the Reserve in our original building. She was so awesome! When we first got there she made all our dinner reservations and when we asked her to move rooms the second day she accommodated us and didn't ask any questions just wanted to make sure we were taken care of. Throughout our stay she was awesome and always so kind and friendly. 

Honestly everyone in the reserve area that we're working throughout our stay were just amazing. I would like to take a minute to say thank you to Angelina Rosario. She was my absolute favorite person at Paradisus. We made sure to go where she was working different days/nights because of her customer service. She was so kind and taught us Spanish. She remembered our names and was just really a gem! Next would be Maguelina. She was also so kind and remembered our names and was great. Daniel who helped us with our bags and when he saw us took the time to say hello and to see if we needed a ride anywhere or if we needed anything. Like I said everyone was amazing but these few definitely need to be recognized.

We loved eating most breakfasts and lunches at the Gabi Club because we were always at the pool and honestly was the best. The cooks were amazing and service fantastic! We also loved Vento, The Grill and Mole! 

I would highly recommend the Reserve for families. Five star for sure.

I do want to say one thing that I didn't like which I'm sure can be fixed in the future. I understand that Paradisus is owned by Melia and Melia is a big company and have properties all over the world.When we first got to the airport we were told since we booked through Costco travel to make sure the next day at the resort go to the Costco representative to discuss our departure transfers and our excursion  credit we had. When we checked in we were asked to come the next day also to have a tour of property etc. so we thought it was the same thing however it was not. 

We were picked up the next morning to find ourselves at a timeshare presentation. I believe we were mislead and to be honest I was a little disappointed. We didn't want to be woken up the first full day there to be brought to a presentation. If I wanted to buy a timeshare I would and I don't want to feel pressured and I did feel like that. We told the lady that was at the presentation that we were confused because we thought we were going to the Costco rep. They did offer us $550 dollars to use on different things throughout the resort however we didn't use any of the coupons and really felt the approach was wrong. I think In the future explaining to the guests exactly what is being presented up front would be great.

Other than that amazing time and thank you so much for the great vacation !!!

reviews.author: asjohns1986
reviews.title: A Much Needed Vacation
reviews.text: Visited April 1-8 (tomorrow), 2017. This was our first trip to Punta Cana. We will definitely be back after our experience this week at the resort. We were initially concerned about the Zika virus but we didn't see any mosquitoes the entire trip at the resort or even while playing golf at Cocotal. The service we received from the staff was great as well, especially from Francis N. our butler - Rafael, Carlos and Pedro (Grande) at the Royal Service pool - Lee and Wanda at the Sunset bar - Jose H. at the juice bar on the beach - Carlo who arranged our airport shuttle and worked with our work group during our trip. Thank you all very much.  Wish we didn't have to go back home so soon.

reviews.author: Kenia G
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: What a wonderful time. This people are fantastic. We shall return. La shorty us a fantastic girl and the dancer guys were super too. Very glad we came over and I'm looking forward to come back. I'll recomend this hotel to anybody who is looking to spend great vacation. Wonderful experience. It's going to be hard to go back to regular life.

reviews.author: Gwenn C
reviews.title: The Minkoff Experience
reviews.text: The people couldn't have been nicer. Everyone was super friendly and very accommodating. The food was fresh and fantastic. The restaurants were extremely clean and everyone was right there to assist in anything that you wanted.

reviews.author: Karin B
reviews.title: Encantador
reviews.text:
Hotel con toda la magia del Caribe, muy bonitas instalaciones, exquisita comida en todos sus restaurantes, gran preocupación por la limpieza y orden de cada espacio ("gran labor"considerando que vimos como muchos irrespetuosos huéspedes quebraban vasos y botaban basura al suelo en una nefasta actitud que estoy segura no practican ni tolerarían por parte de ningún extranjero en su país) pero lo que más destaco es la amabilidad, cortesía y atención basada en los  detalles. ( jardineros, garzones, barman, limpieza, etc)
Mención especial a la asesoría y cortesía de Sue, José Javier (rooms) y todo el equipo del boofet!
Saludos cordiales,

Karín Bravo Verdugo.
Santiago, Chile.

reviews.author: jerseyshorefood
reviews.title: "Relaxation"
reviews.text: We travel here every February - It's a wonderful resort that offers you everything - The people are extremely friendly/weather beautiful/ food very good and lots of it.The only complaint this year is that the beach itself could have been a bit cleaner - loaded with seaweed which by the middle of the week they cleaned as many people were complaining.  We are also club members which has added amenities. The Spa is great... Looking forward to next year...

reviews.author: joseX2204JY
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Un lindo Hotel muy buena ubicación , su personal es muy atento  y sus instalaciones son muy acogedoras  , muy buena comida en el restaurante de Bufet , no pude comer en los demás  , tiene una piscina muy linda pero la playa es espectacular .

reviews.author: iswimyouswimweswim
reviews.title: Un séjour au top !
reviews.text:
Une belle expérience, l'hôtel est à la hauteur des prestations attendues. Le personnel attentionné, les suites spacieuses et de grand confort. Les restaurants de grande qualité.
Le all inclusive est juste parfait.
Une jolie adresse.

reviews.author: marlapet
reviews.title: Отдых в Доминикане
reviews.text: Второй раз в этом отеле, на этот раз с детьми 3-х лет. Отель вообще очень семейный, у нас был family concierge, очень милая девушка Стефани, бронировала нам рестораны, помогала уладить пару вопросов и даже по собственной инициативе организовала детям сюрприз: набрала ванну с воздушными шарами, дети были в восторге! Все очень вкусно в ресторанах, по-домашнему и для деток и для взрослых. Первый раз были 8 лет назад, номера были совсем новыми, сейчас нуждаются в ремонте, но в целом очень прилично. Пляж с сильными волнами, но если пройти 3-5 минут по пляжу, то поспокойнее и можно купаться. Очень дружелюбный персонал, нас все знали по именам, а мы их)) особенно хочется отметить Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana, Jairo minier, santos friars,Benita Mercedes,Oneida zorrila!

reviews.author: wbckhum
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: Just finishing a most amazing week at Paradisus Punta Cana. This resort is by far the nicest and most well serviced in Bavaria. I want to send a special thanks for the amazing service we received from Ramon Ramirez, Jairo Minier, Luis Santanna and Santos Frias on the Reserve beach! The food is fantastic and the décor from rooms to the grounds are amazing as well. We are already counting the days till our next trip here.

reviews.author: Laura W
reviews.title: Amazing property, TERRIBLE food, picky eaters stay away
reviews.text:
I have visited many resorts - Jamaica, Mexico, Dominican Republic. This resort had an absolutely gorgeous beach, pool and views. However, this was also the worst food I have EVER had at any resort. At such a highly rated resort I was completely shocked when the food tasted quite terrible. It was a beautiful resort, suitable quiet rooms, mediocre wifi (but at the beach which was good), small crowds, yet I cannot get over the food selection. The ONLY good quality food is at the Teppanyaki restaurant where they prepare the food in front of you. The steak and fried rice there is delicious! Service was alright all around - shoutout to Enrique who was excellent. Food at the Reserve section is not much better. Although the room was nice, beds were comfy and cleaning was consistent, this is important - the rooms are not family friendy. The bathroom is not closed off so it is impossible to get privacy when changing, showering, bathing or doing your business. It caused a lot of frustration. The TV, light and AC didnt work in our room but it was fixed. 
Basically I cant say it enough the food was awful. DEFINITELY not a good place for children or anyone who is picky.

Tips: 
Do not bother with the Italian place - it is awful.
The buffet basically takes all the types of food from the specialty restaurants and combines them. The food seems fresh, most of the time prepared in front of you, but the taste of everything is quite awful. 
Slightly far walk from the room with long stairs, especially with older family members.

It was a great resort but we would not return simply because of the quality of the food was so terrible.

reviews.author: Kenny R
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text:
All I can say is that we had such a wonderful stay on this return visit. We are so impressed by the staff; especially the hard-working housekeeping, food service,and outdoor beverage staff. Francisco,Martin,& Raphael kept us very happy while on the beach. The drinks at the Royal Service bar were top notch! The food at every restaurant was Amazing.
Only disappointment was that Butler Gabriel Dalusma,is no longer at the resort. Find him..increase his pay & bring him back...he was top notch and one of the main reasons we returned.
It would be nice to have a limited food offering for delivery to guests at the Royal Beach & Pool.
An outdoor hot tub would be another terrific amenity. 

-Rossi

reviews.author: Nicole Danielle
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
This was my second island trip I took way back in Sept 2015. This was by far the best resort I have been to regarding the Caribbean. This resort is next to its sister resort which golf carts are provided to transport you back and forth. This is a wonderful option as this gives you a change of scenery when desired. The palma real was the more affordable options, the pool side was awesome but the beach side at the main hotel ( I believe paradisus) was breath taking. The cabanas on the white beach were amazing. The bars were great. The whole property of the entire hotel were beautiful and extremely island vibe. I can't recall most of the food. We did a hibachi which was actually really good and lunch at i believe Fire? which was really good too. We did some awesome excursions, including a catermaren which was great and the azul tour with atv. Sorry i don't remember all details as the was almost two years ago, but this place deserves a review.

Also there was a cool "night lounge/club" that was very empty at first but filled up quick. It played good hiphop/spanish music. We enjoyed plenty of mamajuana our whole trip. There was also a cool area downstairs by the bar where everyone was dancing, all age groups but this ended early. ( well were from NY so early to us is about 10 pm) haha. But for an all inclusive it was good. 

I know I was contemplating between here or the hard rock prior to my trip andI was very pleased with our decision. 

Also, our room was fantastic. It was huge with an awesome balcony. We were able to order breakfast to the room every morning and was ready at whichever time was selected. This was a great option. Would defiantly go back.

reviews.author: R Elisa F
reviews.title: Vacaciones melvin y capuchino jose
reviews.text: Estamos súper bien aquí en el paradisus con todo el servicio. Muchísimas atenciones los empleados son muy atente espicialmente melvin conception es un buen animante y muy agradable de hablar con el.la animación es súper con José capuchino y Melvyn Concepcion son súper amable y carismático,

reviews.author: Jade S
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We spent a week there in march of 2017 and it was a great stay. Lugo, our butler made sure everything we asked for was taken care of. Dining was great and private pool area and private beach area was the best.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Vento Restaurant
reviews.text: Richart was our best server and we had the best meal of our trip here. He made recommendations for our entrees and dessert which were impeccable! Kenia seated us even though we didn't have reservations and after a day of two flight cancellations and having to stay an unexpected day, we needed the extra kindness! Thank you for your hospitality!

reviews.author: patriciamM4479XI
reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: We were part of the Royal Seevice.  Arrived late morning and was immediately welcomed despite mid afternoon scheduled checkin. Bladamir, our personal butler, was amazing.  He arranged all reservations, coordinated return transportation to the airport, and left special surprises everyday for us.  He made the trip super special.  The resort itself is beautiful and the room very comfortable. We will look forward to a return visit!

reviews.author: KarenReck
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation with Royal Service!!!
reviews.text: Just returned from a much needed vacation and enjoyed every minute!  The hotel and grounds are kept up very well.  Our Royal Service included butler service and Francis was OUTSTANDING!!  He was knowledgable, caring and what a great personality too.  He ensured our stay was top notch!  I am happy to have made a new friend and will definitely ask for only Francis specifically when we go back!   The only issue we had was with the room safe and that the mechanics failed, but it certainly was not a deal breaker and Francis was on hand to help us work thru the issue with hotel security.  Gorgeous views, lobby and grounds.  Would highly recommend!  Be sure to stop at the RS pool bar and see Lee and Wanda behind the bar too - they make it fun to hang out there.   😀

reviews.author: Passport562228
reviews.title: Reserve at Paradisius Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Quel beau séjour nous avons eu à la réserve.  Le personnel est attentionné et joyeux, en particulier Julio Aponte au resto de la reserve et Yurandy à la réception.

La plage est très belle et bien entretenue.

Suzanne & Benoît

reviews.author: lisafrankr2017
reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text:
This  was our second visit. Our butler Sandy Gill  made our trip spectacular  both times and one of the main reasons we came back here. 
 The beach was a main attraction for us.  The food and service and atmosphere was wonderful.  Sandy took care of everything for us.  It was a wonderful vacation both times.  I like to go a different place each year this was the first place I've come back to twice !

reviews.author: Ninous H
reviews.title: Great for families & kids!
reviews.text:
My family, which includes a 4 year old boy and a 1.5 year old girl, stayed at Palma Real for spring break in March.  We had very high expectations for our trip.  Our resort & our experience were way better than we could have ever imagined.  We were there for 6 days and enjoyed every second of it. 
Let me tell you about some of my personal favorite highlights:

- I have a lot of amazing experiences but my favorite one that sticks with me the most is the incredible staff!!!  Wow, my kids got so much love and attention from the staff that it blew me away. They are incredibly kid-friendly and that meant the most to me. Plus, the staff remembers you! I don’t know how they do it because they see hundreds of tourists every day but they still remember you, where you sat, what you drank, what your wife’s name is, etc!
- They have a 24-hour medical clinic ON-SITE!  Unfortunately, I did have to use them because my son had a fever but they took care of him and we were back in action the next day.  The peace of mind of knowing that they are there, is worth a million.  
- Our one bedroom master suite was so nice and definitely worth the extra charge 
- The food, the food, the FOOD!  Some people have told me that all-inclusive food sucks….but definitely not here!  I could live here. Forever.  
- We had our kids with us so I couldn’t drink enough to pass out by the beach, which is what I wanted to do, but I did see that the booze was everywhere and it looked good & top notch!  
- The resort grounds are absolutely beautiful with so much green and landscape everywhere. The pool and beaches are perfect. 
- Another great story about the staff…I was at the pool and an employee asked me if I wanted a coconut so, of course, I accepted.  The dude CLIMBED the tree next to me and brought me down a fresh coconut and prepared it for me.  Wow.  
- Lots of nightly entertainment for the whole family.  For example, there was a kid’s event every single night at that was followed with another event for adults & the whole family.  Never a dull moment.  

We can’t wait to go back.  We were fortunate enough to meet Vladimir Rodriquez, from guest services, who even made our experience even more special.

reviews.author: Country-Boy007
reviews.title: Mostly great, some bad
reviews.text:
Our family, myself, my spouse and 13 year old daughter, stayed at this resort from March 18th through the 25th, traveling with Air Canada Vacations from Halifax, Canada.

Rooms.
When we checked in we were informed that we had been upgraded to a luxury junior suite having only booked the lowest class junior suite.  This would of been great but it was room 3218, which is located right beside a huge loud generator of some sort and being light sleepers this would not do. Back to the front desk to ask for a room change, being informed that there were no other rooms available.  After much debate and saying just put me in the room class I paid for they were able to accommodate us.  We were led for a viewing, room 1055. Quiet, we'll take it, but it had the musty smell as rooms in the Caribbean get, not to bad but evident.  We discovered the odor was most prevalent in the extra cushions etc., on the sofa and bed, so out on the terrace they went, which pretty much eliminated the smell.  Room otherwise were well appointed,A/C worked very well, kept very clean and fridge kept well stocked(no Presidente, could not believe, room class I guess).

We ate a 3 a la cartes
Bana - very good
Vento  - mediocre
Blue Agave - poor
Naos buffet was very good.
During the day the Blue Agave is a hamburger joint.  We did not find it to be very good as we ate there 2 times and both times asked for our hamburgers to be well done but received some of them almost raw  Coincidentally we found the hamburgers served in the buffet cooked to our liking and with better flavor.

Staff were very good, cheerful, always greeted you with a hola, and I believe truly wanting you to enjoy yourself.  Standouts were Luis and Teurdy(spelling) at the Gabi and Gustavo(wheres your mug) at the pool bar, and the gent at the lobby bar(sorry for not remembering your name) for making my daughters cappuccinos.

Beach was spectacular, although it did get to be an annoyance with the constant people traveling at waters edge yelling picture withe the monkey or bird, and parasailing.  Had no issues getting palapas, although you did have to get there before about 8:30 or they would all be reserved.

Shows 
We found the start time to be early 8:30pm, and because of this, we only got to 2 shows (arriving late) but not to be missed is the Michael Jackson tribute and the Circus show

Grounds.
Immaculate!

Overall a good resort, but because of the room issues and cost($6500) I don't think I would return.

reviews.author: Mike-Lisa M
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana provided a wonderful experience. An upgrade to Royal Service is highly recommended. Private section on beach, butler service, premium drinks, exclusive restaurants, private pool, and so much more. We felt completely pampered. Hello Miguel, (our butler) we did not have many requests for you but you tended to our every need. Always amazed that you located us each day just to ask how we were. Thank you for making our dinner reservations, and showering us with daily goodies I.e. Chocolates, truffles, fresh fruit, champagne. The rose pedals and jacuzzi bubble bath was a lovely gesture. Best wishes in your future. 
     All staff greeted us with professionalism, smiles and enthusiasm. 
  Our room was in the adult section with a view of the ocean from our jacuzzi laden balcony. Spacious, clean, well stocked fridge and all the amenities one would need. Maid service was fantastic. Too many wonderful features of the resort to mention but meaningful to us included the following; beautifully landscaped natural setting, gorgeous beach, plentiful palapas, towel service, wifi everywhere, huge pools, plentiful restaurants, (our favorites) Vento, Fuego, LaPalapa, and Bana. Overall the food was fantastic and beautifully presented. Visit Coco Bongo for a night out that you will never forget. During checkout we met the lovely Jennifer Jhonson, thanks for brightening our day when we were saddened to leave. My wife and I had the most wonderful vacation experience!!!

reviews.author: Stephen P
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Awesome resort highly recommended  food was great people were friendly and helpful pools beach were great restaurant's were good room's were great the pool bar and lobby bar were great this resort didn't have the loud music around the pool that some resorts have witch was nice it's a five star resort

reviews.author: tutili
reviews.title: A dream vacation!
reviews.text: We just returned from an amazingly-wonderful week in paradise at 'this all-inclusive resort in Punta Cana. Everything about this professionally-run, absolutelybeautiful resort was beyond our expectations and we totally enjoyed our stay. Friendly and helpful staff, delicious and varied food at the buffet and great facilities right on the beach all contributed to a memorable vacation. We couldn't have been happier with our choice of resorts in this lovely setting. The genuine warmth of the all the staff members should surely be cited as a real plus!

reviews.author: Claude Helene L
reviews.title: Nature luxuriante, tranquillité et soins attentionnés
reviews.text:
Belle expérience familiale au Réserve Paradisus. Le site est superbe, bien entretenu et verdoyant. Beaucoup d'oiseaux dont 2 flamandS rose! Grande chambre avec salon et cuisinette, idéal pour notre famille de 4. Tranquillité et service très attentionné en tout temps. Le personnel est extrêmement courtois. Buffet Gaby Club offrant toujours des repas de qualité, saumon fumé, Sushi, charcuteries et fromages et une sélections de petites entrées délicieuses. 
Mention pour notre serveur, Junior Suero qui a été extrêmement gentil, disponible, poli et attentionné avec nous et nos enfants!

reviews.author: Julie B
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Feliz muy feliz gracias. a los chicos de actividades la shorty angel son los mejores gracias por hacer mis vaciones las mejores son simpaticos y Siempre bailando sin parar manana tarde noche son los mas exelente chicos recomiendo este hotel gracias shorty besos

reviews.author: Kaitlyn47
reviews.title: Shorty
reviews.text: Lo mejor de lo mejor la shorty con su sonrrisa baile y Siempre Feliz todo trabajan bastante recomiendo este hotel porque la van a pasar de maravilla angel en la clase de pintura siempre participando de cada even to de lo q es el equipo de actividades gracias shorty

reviews.author: Becky C
reviews.title: shorty
reviews.text: It was excellent!! The best experience!! Best family vacation! Fantastic dance class instructors (Shorty, Oliver, angel the kids went every night! We all loved them! They were so entertaining and the kids hugged them every time they saw them at the activities or in the nightly shows!! BEST STAFF!!!!

reviews.author: Aaron M
reviews.title: La Reserva Punta Cana
reviews.text: I had a phenomenal time with all of the activities. The Dominican Cultural activities were the best with Melvin Concepcion and Pastora Medina were so much fun and they were a great time. Making cigars with Vladimir and Alfredo was super fun. The service of Dalila from the Club and the food made by Silverio was phenomenal. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Courtney B
reviews.title: Caribbean luxury and one of our best vacations ever!
reviews.text: The Reserve presents Caribbean luxury in a relaxed setting and manages to pull off all-inclusive in style. I have already recommended the property to several friends planning trips to the Dominican, and I can't wait to go back as well. I found the TripAdvisor reviews very helpful in preparing for our trip and suggest others read several to gather helpful tips regarding accommodations, tipping, restaurant reservations, activities, etc. Our family of 5 stayed in a 2 bedroom family concierge suite at The Reserve. Estafania was our wonderful concierge who was welcoming, friendly, thoughtful and very helpful all week long. We were sad to say goodbye! I recommend the concierge service especially for first time visitors to the resort. Estafania was very helpful in navigating the property, reservations, excursions, beach activities and other details of our stay up until our departure. The pool waiters and attendants are all very friendly and attentive, especially the pool waiter, Emilio, and Luiz, the chef at the pool grill. The Gabi buffet at The Reserve was surprisingly good and was more relaxing and a better atmosphere than the Gabi buffet at the beach. In fact, I found the food quality and presentation at The Reserve Gabi buffet better than the a la carte restaurants in many cases. Our children preferred the buffet as well. Still, we enjoyed the change of atmosphere and variety offered by the a la carte restaurants, but the quality of food was better in some than in others. We have travelled to many upscale resorts in the Caribbean and The Reserve is a notch above when it comes to service, food and variety of choices.  Any minor issues we encountered were handled quickly. However, we did have an issue with housekeeping during the latter part of our stay when the hotel became very, very busy with a large convention group.  In general, I would advise others to request a housekeeping time if possible: late morning, mid-day, early afternoon. Housekeeping seemed to come very late in the day when we needed to be back in our rooms to shower for dinner. This generally was not an issue for the first 4 days of our stay, but during the last 3 days, our rooms were left uncleaned after housekeeping came at a ridiculously late time. We requested they return at different times while we were at dinner, but when they returned they brought new towels and chocolates but they did not clean the rooms, sweep floors, tidy beds or remove dirty, wet towels. Each of those last few days, I thought the room would be cleaned the following day in a reasonable timeframe based on our obvious pattern. I was shocked when it appeared housekeeping didn't bother to clean not 1, but 2 days in a row, then 3. I reported the uncleaned rooms when we checked out and was told I should have reported it at the time (each of the last 3 days). Truly, we thought we were doing our best to communicate with housekeeping and kept hoping for better (normal) service the following day. Perhaps it was a language barrier.  Perhaps it was an overcrowded hotel. To be fair, the first 4 days were all right, the last 3 shocking.  On a final note, we typically tip housekeeping at the end of our vacations. Perhaps we should have tipped daily and then we would have gotten better housekeeping service? Again, unacceptable if this is the case. My tipping preferences shouldn't affect the daily housekeeping standards at an upscale hotel. I still left a tip but it was less than what I would have left under normal circumstances. Regardless, I believe this is something that can be remedied with better communication at the start of one's stay. This issue will not keep me from coming back as soon as I can, and as I mentioned, I have already recommended the property to several others.

reviews.author: T Y
reviews.title: Family Concierge is worth it!
reviews.text:
Such a beautiful location!  The beach on The Reserve side was immaculate and clean with plenty of loungers.  The grounds are spotless.  We went in late March and it was not crowded and there was always a quiet corner to be had.   If you are looking for R&R this is the spot. 

It is well worth it to choose the family concierge.  Our concierge, Jordhan,  took care of all our dinner reservations as well as reserved our cabanas everyday by the pool and the beach.   The cabanas are amazingly cozy and you can spend the day in there napping, reading or people watching.  From what I gather from reading other reviews, dinner reservations and cabanas were a rare commodity.  Having the family concierge we just asked and Jordhan made sure we had a spot reserved the next day.  He responded promptly to our requests for extra water and amenities in our room and always had a smile, even if we making extra demands on him.  He also left little gifts for the kids (beach kit, fresh coconuts to drink and special pillows) which delighted my kids.

The most amazing part of the vacation for the whole family was the Kids Zone.  My children loved it so much they never wanted to leave.   The staff are great and speak English well.  There were also many engaging activities planned everyday.  One staffer stood out with his energy and enthusiasm.  My kids loved Jack,  he was always full of energy and fully engaged with the children.  Because the kids enjoyed the Kid Zone so much and because we felt comfortable that the staff were caring and vested in the kids.  My husband and I were able to find a lot of time to ourselves,  we were able to have a few dinners on our own and were able to read a couple books cover to cover without interruption! That has not happened in years.

The food at the Gabi Club buffet was great for breakfast and lunch, there was enough variety so that is was not too repetitive.  We also went to Bana, Naos, Aqua, Vento, the Mexican place (forgot the name), and The Grill for dinner.  Our favourite by far was Aqua because of the ambiance as well as the food.  The Hydro Grill poolside also made great pizzas, skip the salads and hot dogs though...  The server Winston was excellent.  He goes a step above,  when it started to rain one afternoon while we were having lunch he found an umbrella and walked us from the poolside to the lounge where he continued to serve us our lunch.

I would recommend this resort to any family with kids between the ages of 4 and 9.  Our experience was great and the whole family is looking forward to going back soon.

The only negative is that our room faced the theatre and main lobby and from 8:30 to 11:30 most nights you can hear the music from the festivities.   Our kids are pretty heavy sleepers and were so exhausted from the days activities it did not affect us too much.  Next time tho we may try for a pool facing room in the family concierge building.
