reviews.author: bigdaddycool492
reviews.title: A little good....A little bad, but all Paradise
reviews.text:
The week started off very bad, but improved as the week progressed.  Not enough to make it a 5 star resort, but close.   

During our visit we had three family's with us, all with reservations to stay at the main Paradisus Palma Real.  I attempted on several occasions to reach out to the resort about transportation options on getting too and from the airport.  I sent numerous emails and phone calls, but never received a response.  On the resort there are three resort; the Paradius, the Reserve and Level.   The only resort on the beach is the Pardisus.  You can get to the beach by walking (a few miles, its far!) or taking one of the non existent golf carts (continue reading, it will explain below).  We had made our reservations almost a year in advance to have all three families to stay at the Paradisus.   Of course we got there and they had no rooms because they overbooked.  So they moved my friends to stay one night at the Reserve and we were located at Level.  The Level and the Reserve where very nice, but we had planned on all staying near each other, but it was only one night, so not a big deal.   Because they placed us at the Level (the furthest location from the Ocean) they stated they comped us with VIP bracelets (as I learned later on in the week, it is all smoke and mirrors) we waited for a ride to the main resort.  and waited..and waited...and waited...and waited, sometimes upwards of an hour for a ride.   You would waive down a golf cart and either the driver had to be elsewhere or didn't understand English (which I found out they have 3 months to learn conversational English or they cannot work there)  If you have little to no intention of visiting the Paradisus on a daily basis, not a big deal.   Because we were all separate, we had to.  Here's one of the downfalls.  The lack of golf carts and every time you took one, it cost you money because you felt obligated to tip.   The room that we had at the Level was very nice.   The issue is Saturday morning at 8 AM, the room staff decided to have an unannounced meeting outside of our room for a few hours.  I wanted to invite them in, since i could hear their conversation as if it was occurring in our room.  Saturday, asked about our room, still don't have room.  Our friends got moved over, so we had to wait one more day, even though they strung me along all day about room availability.   I finally had to get firm with them about the room and told them we are moving and to move my luggage and find me a room, per our reservation.  We finally moved and two adjoining rooms (it was my wife and three kids).  The rooms were very nice and stylish.  Needs a little upkeep and simple repairs, but overall nice.  They have a "mini bar' in each room (our room had a full kitchenette, not sure why since it is all inclusive) which consisted of 2 coors light, 2 presidente, 2 cokes, 2 coke lights, 2 sprites, one package of oreos and a couple bags of chips.  Guess I am accustom to having a full mini bar, not just 2 of each (sometimes they were refilled, sometimes they weren't).   The wifi service in the hotel is atrocious.   While it's not bad to disconnect from electronics, I needed it for my work, so huge inconvenience. The grounds at the Pardisus were immaculate.   I was overly impressed with the grounds.  You never saw trash lying around, dead flowers, etc.  I always saw people working on the landscaping.   I have taken a number of cruises, stayed at all inclusives all over and hands down, they have by far THE BEST FOOD I HAVE HAD!   The food was outstanding.   I don't think there was meal that was even ok.  All the food I had was exceptional and this made up for more than the issues.   I had fresh, raw tune shashimi every night.  The folks in the hibatchi grill and sushi bar (young lady and man who prepared the sushi) did a phenomenal job and highly recommend it.  Nathaniel and Angel who are waiters on the beach and pool area are awesome and understand what great customer service is.  Every day, they would save seats on the beach, hustled to get us drinks (including a bunch of non alcoholic mixed drinks for the kids)   Overall a great trip.  Here are my highlights and low lights:

Highlights:
FOOD!!!!!  Cannot say this enough.  The food is enough to make you come here.
Grounds were exceptional 
Rooms were good.  Good A/C
Shows were very good.  Make sure to catch the Michael Jackson show.
Beach was outstanding. Very clean and well maintained

Lowlights:
Communication.   Attempted to contact them (4 emails and 2 voicemails) and no return calls.  Trying to talk to people there, some don't understand 
Transportation:  The golf cart system sucks.   It takes forever to get one to go anywhere
Wifi:   Subpar.  They didn't give us the code when we got there.  Ask several people at the front desk for the code and never received it.  
VIP and Scheduling:  spent two nights in the outlying resort.  Gave us VIP, but didn't give us any other advantages over anyone else.   

Overall, I would return to this resort.  The minor issues were an inconvenience but not a deal breaker.

reviews.author: Scott L
reviews.title: A mixed bag...
reviews.text:
We spent a lot of money to go here, and part of the reason we pushed our budget was to (hopefully) ensure a great experience.

We did what you are probably doing right now — researching and trying to get intel on people’s actual experiences.

There are a lot of good reviews here which helped us feel more comfortable deciding give it a go.

Let me preface this by saying that others clearly had good experiences, and that’s great. But ours was a truly mixed bag.

We travelled with our 2 young daughters.

The first day — a long day of travel, we arrived. Get outside bus. No one there to greet or smile or say welcome. Lots of confusion around the bags. I see that one of our bags is separated and try to confirm that it’s not lost and was spoken to pretty rudely. I thought that was a but weird, but hey, maybe they are having a bad day.

We go to check in. Long wait in line. No one acknowledges us (foreshadowing….).

Finally get checked in. Taken on long walk to a room that is beside a very loud electrical generator and parking lot with view on other side to kind of swampy looking ‘garden view’. No can do, not for $7K. Drag the family back to reception. Wait in line again. Ask them to move us. They say no because the room as promised has a garden view. Eventually they agree and move us to a better location. The bellboy acts irritated moving us and our luggage there. 

Room was pretty good set up, a little long in the tooth. Leaky shower faucet, no biggie. Phone sometimes did not work. TV flaky. Overall wifi very very spotty.

Here’s how I would describe things overall:

We loved the beach and overall resort layout and facility was really nice. But service was overall pretty bad. Which kind of shocked me for the price we paid. For every 2 experiences we had where we were acknowledged and maybe even smiled at, we had 7 where we were completely ignored or had to try and get service from people who seemed to not care at all, and 1 where we’d be treated outwardly rudely. 

It was weird, I was going around trying to smile at the service people to see if I could get them to smile back so I could feel like they actually care. 

The big notable exception is the Kids Club, which was absolutely amazing. Great staff, great facility. And some of the bar staff were friendly.

A few experiences:

—  went to get towels one morning. The person behind the counter was looking at a cell phone and would not acknowledge me. The other employee saw that I was holding water and said they were thirsty, could they have it? I said no problem, gave them my water, easy for me to get more and they were hot. Other person continues ignoring me. The person who I gave the water to says loudly to them “Acknowledge the guest.” The person keeps looking at their phone.  Eventually they look up and ask what I want. I say I need 4 towels. No smile. Response is “Don’t have any, come back later.”

— Marketing presentation. This was pushed on us hard by our hotel rep. Normally I would never agree, but he was insistent. 45 minutes max, nice breakfast, just hear what they have to say, we’ll give your wife a coupon for 1 hour massage. So, yes, I thought why not? Big mistake. They tried to suck us in, would not let me leave with family to beach, insisted we come back to see manager to claim vouchers, followed by more pressure. Super awkward.

— room service. I called one night and ordered a bottle of red wine. It comes up, I say thank you, tip, no problem. Next night, my wife calls for same thing. They refuse, saying they will not send a bottle of red wine for room service. Ok, so we should order 4 glasses of red wine? What’s the difference? The next night, I call to order a bottle of red wine. No problem.

— The wrist tags kept coming loose. Eventually all of them fell off. 2 lost in ocean. I go to front desk. Person in VIP line says I can come to him. He tells me “$250 U.S. per wrist tag.” “But don’t worry. Don’t tell anyone else who works here. Come back and see me. I will give you for free.” So the hook is I will fee so grateful for saving $500 US that I will give a fat tip to my guardian angel. I go to someone else and ask them. They say you can get them replaced free. Which we did, the next day.

— The day before departure, I went to the Sunwing rep at the hotel to confirm our next day departure time and the rep, glowering at me, asked me 3 times if I could read English and essentially acted like I was a stupid person who was annoying him. Later the hotel guy told me that the Sunwing rep was pissed because I did not come the day after we arrived so he was not able to try and sell us excursions, which we did not want anyway. 

— the restaurant booking system is a joke. Good luck getting confirmation on anything. Or maybe you do if you have a more involved personal hotel rep. We went through all this stress trying to get into the steak place for 6:30 and we manage to get in and at that time it was basically empty anyway. And then it’s the regular thing of not particularly friendly service, food so-so.

But the beach and pools were really nice. And the most important thing was spending time as a family and we made the most of that.

For the price, I would not go back. Even for a much lower price, I probably would not.

For anyone reading this who has young children and wants to go, I would suggest staying at The Reserve, where the Kids Club is. We had the Gardenview Suite in the main resort. Every time we went up there to the Kids Club we felt more relaxed. And again, the Kids Club staff are amazing and friendly.

reviews.author: TravelingMom201108
reviews.title: Not our favorite family vacation
reviews.text:
Overall, The Reserve is a nice resort with attractive rooms and grounds, but we will not return and are not likely to recommend it to others.  We have experienced better value, service, and surroundings for the money elsewhere (Mexico, Turks & Caicos, Jamaica, Hawaii).  The service was highly erratic and as a result we had to work hard while on vacation to make things happen, more than other places we’ve been.  No process was particularly seamless or effortless for us as guests. 

Many staff members were not strong with English, which we actually loved for our teens learning Spanish, however, they often hid behind their lack of English to not provide service.  There seemed to be little desire to resolve our issues if they did not understand or could not help us directly.  And despite staff all around, there was little ownership or follow-through for most requests.  I counted 9 staffers behind the desk at check-in, yet it took a long time and no one truly owned the process.  Also, it took 3 visits to our building concierge just to get an umbrella, which was very necessary given the frequent showers during our stay.  For a hotel of this level with apparent staff all around, service should be much better.        

A few individuals were exceptional, however.  Wander aka “Wanderful” at the pool, made sure we were settled in chairs or a cabana every day.  He was always pleasant and made a point to know and use all of our names regularly – truly the most welcoming and personable individual we met at the resort -- he understands good service!  Also at the pool is Head Chef “Speedy Gonzales” (don’t know his real name) at the Hydro Grill.  He always ensured we had the food we ordered in a timely manner and were enjoying our time.  His food at the Hydro Grill was really fresh and good – better than the lunch buffet.  Francis at the CosctoTravel desk was very helpful getting me in touch with individuals who could help with dinner reservations and was eager to make our experience a good one.  Lastly, Wilson Guzman in the main buffet was very pleasant and more helpful than most.

Quick Summary of The Reserve:

Pros:
- Good food quality and variety especially in a la carte restaurants – loved Bana and Mole for lunch 
- Spacious, clean, well-stocked rooms (we were in a two-bedroom master suite)
- Gorgeous beach with convenient facilities (a 10-minute walk from The Reserve)
- Cabanas around pool–comfortable and pleasant, and a must during rain showers and mid-day sun; lounges and chairs very nice too
- Soft-serve ice cream machine at the pool available from 9am-7pm!
- Wonderful porch swings at the main shuttle stop 
- Nice variety of live music and dancing in the evenings

Cons: 
- Highly inconsistent service, most staff did not seem terribly concerned about following through on requests
- Challenging and lengthy process for dinner reservations – we witnessed some families who were unable to get restaurant reservations for days.  If they tell you not to worry about your restaurant reservations and you want to eat at the a la carte restaurants, insist at check-in that the staff record your request (they have a form) and submit those requests that afternoon.  You will need to follow-up as we were never delivered our confirmations as promised.  Confirmations arrive around 4pm, which is late if you are trying to map out how to spend your day.
- Only Family Concierge is able to reserve cabanas at the pool and beach; the rest of us have to circle like vultures in the hope that a family does not show up by 10am so we can claim their cabana (thankfully we were fortunate every day)
- Overall bartending and drink quality was poor.  Training clearly lacking.  When you want a good rum drink, you want a good rum drink...especially if it is listed on the bar's own menu.  
- Resort credit was a disappointment – small credits to offset additional, larger expenditures – we did not feel like spending more as we had already dropped a large chunk for this all-inclusive – it felt a bit like a scam

This was our first trip to PC and we stayed for four nights.

reviews.author: Smicunek
reviews.title: Worst Food in the history of hotels
reviews.text: First the good, rooms were decent and clean, pools were nice.   Now the bad, the food was unedible.  For an all inclusive place, I starved all week because I couldn't find anything good to eat at all.   The meats across the board didn't taste like the USA, bacon, sausage, hamburger, steak, chicken, all tasted artificial and gross.  No creamer for your coffee, only milk.  No snacks to be found anywhere except lays potato chips and plantain chips.   I can honestly say the worst food I have ever, ever, had to eat.

reviews.author: Cindy F
reviews.title: disappointed
reviews.text:
I want to begin by saying that the service, wait staff, appointment scheduling, etc. was easy and the people were awesome. Now the bad news...
After we arrived we were assigned a person to show us our room and make sure everything was perfect. She was terrific until we told her that we were not interested in a time share promotion, then we were dropped like hot rocks. No more turn down service, no more help, barely an "Hola" in passing. So disappointing and a bad reflection on the resort. There was NO representation for the hotel after we were dumped by our representative. No way to reach room service, no way to get to house keeping unless you found someone in the halls. 
The room smelled like mold. It wasn't a deal breaker because we were in the tropics of course. However, every night when we got into bed the sheets were moist feeling. YUCK! Nothing dried and we were uncomfortable.
Food was "meh"  No wine and beer menu unless you want to pay extra- much extra! A $10 U.S. bottle of wine was upward of $50 and average $30 bottle of wine was $200+.
Mixed drinks were weak weak weak! We were not warned. 
The beach was nice until winds brought in trash. We were literally swimming in a trash can. Baggies,  wrappers and plastic bottles hitting us as we swam. Gross! 
I am NOT a complainer but for the price I was disappointed with the trip. 
Good points: Salvador from Olympus was FANTASTIC! He helped us with excursions, guided us to the right places to go. 
Julio with extreme zipline was great great great! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: familyfun32014
reviews.title: Above the Rest
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Palma Real.  Our reservation was for The Reserve (adjacent to Paradisus and same property).  The Reserve is very beautiful and well suited for families with young children.  Upon check in, Christopher the reservations coordinator, offered us an ocean view room at Paradisus.   Our party was 3 adults and this was much better suited for our needs.   The room was close to everything and very convenient.  The lobby and bell staff were excellent.   Each staff member went out of their way to always greet us with a friendly Hola!

Recommendations:  Take the on site classes offered.   We did aqua spinning and cocktail making and a few dance.   All were excellent. Night dance parties at the Gabi bar were very fun!!  Evening shows were average.
The Restaurants were all vey good.  The buffet service was slow however and it was a long wait to get coffee and tea.   We ate at: Rare, Fuego, Blue Agave, Mizu.  The buffets had an enormous variety of foods, something for everyone.   We loved the daily trips to the Gelato bar in the afternoon for a cool refreshing treat.    
The Palapas at the beach were top notch.  They were very comfortable and provided full shade.   There was plenty of room between palapas to move the lounge chairs into the sun without intruding on the neighbors.
The bartend service was excellent at all bars.   The bartenders were friendly and very fun.   The crowd was very classy and there were no issues with annoying or excessive drinkers.  

A few cons:   drinks were very watered down, probably to keep with the family friendly environment.   
Our concierge was not available most times.  We had to search for her daily to inquire about dinner reservations and other questions.
Even though the resort says private beach, the locals are constantly walking along the beach selling things.   I found this very annoying after the second day on the beach.  Apparently there is a small section towards the water that is public by law so expect to be approached.
Last, the staff at the beach was less than attentive.   We were never served drinks on the beach.

reviews.author: Poliana Romanholi
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text: Visitamos o hotel em nossa lua de mel e foi otimo, as bebidas eram muitos boas e havia muitas opções de comidas inclusas. recebemos espumante e frutas no quarto como cortesia. Somente o quarto que era longe e tinha que subir 3 andares de escada.

reviews.author: exchangeplace
reviews.title: First time in DR
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting the Dominican Republic and we booked through JetBlue vacations.  We booked a two bedroom master suite family concierge.  Room was great size since we have two kids ages 6 and 3. It was very dark. Not a ton of sunlight. The reserve was ok. The grounds were beautiful and did go to the main resort quite often. Shuttles not reliable but we managed. Our main reasons for not wanting to go back are the service and the food. Our family concierge was fine but didn't really add value.  We could it believe how bad the food was. Inedible at times.  Bars were ok.  Juan at pool bar at Reserve was great.  A couple decent tips helped with his service but we liked him. The best service we had was Argenis at the main resort poolside.  He really enjoyed his job and went out of his way for our kids.  Find him because he was the one real positive we had and the only time we enjoyed the resort.  Pools are clean and nice.  All in all, the DR is a one time visit for us.

reviews.author: BandD00
reviews.title: A little bit of PARADISE
reviews.text:
My mom and I met at this resort for a few days of vacation and we are still basking in the amazing time we had. We had an ocean front suite with breathtaking views. 

Our butler, Faustino Ramos was in a class of his own. He was INCREDIBLE! His kindness, professionalism, thoughtfulness, and attentiveness helped to make our stay exceptional. It was so sad to say goodbye to you.

We ate most of our meals at Palazzo with Juan Mejia as our server. Juan is also in a class of his own. He always seemed genuinely happy to see us and made us feel so welcomed. My mom has a few special requests which Juan gladly accommodated. His professionalism, warmth, and humor contributed to what will be for my mom and me, memorable and treasured time spent together. 

Wanda, the bartender at the bar in the Royal beach area was amazing. Her smiles and warmth were never ending. Thank you for making my mom feel so very special.

We were saddened to leave because of the wonderful, warm, and kind people we met. The staff is incredible. Faustino, Juan, and Wanda, you are exceptional people and we will remember you always. Thank you for making our time at Paradisus so beautiful. Sending you LOTS OF HUGS! Hope to visit again. =)

reviews.author: Beaudette23
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation!
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I had a great time in the royal service area of this resort. Our butler, Edward, was awesome! He was there to guide us for any questions and help us get cabanas by the beach and pool. The royal service area was nice since there weren't any kids there and service was good. 

The resort is very large and there is lots to do, from being at the beach or pool, to activities during the day and shows at night. 

The regualr buffet was good, although we were a little frustrated that other guests didn't always appear to know line etiquette. The Royal service breakfast buffet didn't have as much to offer but was also more quite and there were no kids. Overall the restaurant were good, though we found the food quality in some to not be as good as a pay per meal restaurant. Drinks were good and they didn't skimp on the amount of liquor. 

We also really enjoyed the YHI spa - amazing!! 

We would definitely recommend the resort as a whole and are planning on going back!

reviews.author: AOrellana2017
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real #Butler
reviews.text: Great vacation. Cleanest beach for a mile each direction. Our personal hotel butler Armando Minier was awesome! He made our visit perfect and was full of local knowledge. I recommend the royal service and the aqua spa!

reviews.author: ray123248
reviews.title: Great resort to stay and relax
reviews.text:
Very beautiful resort and very nice sandy beach.
Room was so clean as well as the resort and amenities.
The family concierge was the best part of it.
Many thanks to our assigned person Mr. Jordan Rosario who made our stay very relaxing and worry free.
The taste of the food was great and fresh but not many choices.
Over all I totally recommend this resort and I will go back again.

reviews.author: zellejuju
reviews.title: au top
reviews.text: un petit paradis sur terre. The reserve paradisus est en petit paradis sur terre. Tout est le confort est mis a la disposition du client pour lui rendre tres confortable son sejour.Par contre je n'ai pas aimé les chambres du rdc je trouve qu'elles sentent trop l'humidité. il y a plusieurs restaurant tous bien

reviews.author: catlady501
reviews.title: Disappointed- OVERBOOKED ROOMS- not our dream vacation- will not be returning
reviews.text:
This was our second time to this property and we were very disappointed right from our arrival. We arrived to find that we had to spend the next two nights at the sister property Paradisus Punta Cana, as the room we had booked (in DECEMBER!) was not available and the property was overbooked. Really? Welcome back.
We spent our first night being transferred over to Paradisus Punta Cana as there really wasn't anything we could say to get our booked room at Palma Real. No amount of " Royal Service" ( which really was lacking) could compensate for our time lost on our vacation. We bumped into quite a number of people who had the very same thing happen to them; they had arrived on the same day we did. 
We lost one day to transferring over, no apology, no room upgrade. Just a safe and keys that didn't work. also waiting for a long time for luggage.
We also stopped having maid service as the cleaning staff left our balcony windows OPEN all day - two days in a row. 
This experience left us with a bad taste for this hotel chain and we will not be returning to what would otherwise be a lovely resort, However, looks can be very deceiving.

reviews.author: TheRoseland
reviews.title: Luxurious, Relaxing Vacation & Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: We just returned from a week at this beautiful resort.  It is without pause that we would recommend the Paradisus Palma Real to anyone.  We reserved the Royal Service after reading many reviews on this site.  It is most definitely worth the extra money considering the extra amenities. We have travelled to many places around the world and this was certainly a step above anywhere we have stayed. Upon arrival, we were escorted to a separate Royal Guest area where we checked in at a private table with our butler.  No waiting in the hellish line at the front desk. He then gave us a short tour & escorted to our room We have never had "Butler" service before. Our butler Luis was extremely attentive, professional and literally took care of everything for us. It is the first time we have taken a vacation and not had to even "Think"!  Luis reserved all of our dinner reservations on our first day. No worrying about where to eat or elbowing in with a load of people to secure a spot for dinner.  He ensured that Francisco & Martin reserved the beach Bali beds we requested everyday.  No rushing down to the beach at 6am with towels, clothes & belongings to claim our spot which in & of itself was worth the extra money.  We had coffee delivered to our room every morning & enjoyed waking up slowly in our robes on our patio. Luxurious!  My husband"s birthday was on our second day which I mentioned to Luis.  That morning we arrived at our "Palapa" decorated with balloons & Happy Birthday signs.  Luis personally delivered a bottle of champagne on ice to the beach around 10am.  At 5pm we went back to our room to find it filled with balloons, our jacuzzi filled & decorated with rose petals & candles.  There was a bottle of wine on ice and chocolate covered strawberries on a plate with Happy Birthday written on it.  We had dinner at Fuego-the Peruvian restaurant & a gourmet cake was sent over with the entire staff singing Happy Birthday in Spanish.  I had not requested any of these special things to Luis-he took care of it all. Extreme Royal Service! The food was very good.  We had dinner at the Royal Service guests only restaurant Palazzo 3 of the nights.  The food was amazing & the chef outstanding. We had quiet breakfast & lunch there everyday with a la carte service. All of the staff at Palazzo were so friendly & provided great service-Felix, Jaun, Peronita, Fatima, Paz (I wish I could remember everyone's name!) This resort has about 11 a la carte restaurants Royal guests can use but we found Palazzo to be so good we kept going back. We had massages at the Oriental Spa and used the Royal guest only "HydroMassage" faciilites beforehand which were fantastic.  We tried out "Paddle Board Yoga" with Eduardo, Miguel & Jenkins which was kind of hilarious but fun.  I feel as if I am gushing about the resort but it is truly an exceptional place and we are looking forward to returning next year.  I should also note that although I have used the Trip Advisor site hundreds of times, I have never posted a review. The Paradisus Palma Real was certainly deserving of an excellent rating & recommendation. Thank you to all of the staff there that helped us have such a relaxing, luxurious vacation.

reviews.author: JCMaryland
reviews.title: Great Bday weekend!
reviews.text: My wife and I had an amazing time! Only our 3rd all inclusive but our favorite so far. We upgraded to Royal Service and well worth it. Francis Newton was our butler and was incredible!! He made the trip that much better. He made sure we did not have to worry about anything but enjoying our vacation. Recommend him if possible. We will!!

reviews.author: TualatinChris
reviews.title: It could be the worst hotel experience...EVER
reviews.text:
I travel more than 100 days per year.  

In spite of tipping well, I can't remember a hotel that had more indifferent service that was darn near hostile at times.

Our experience started at check-in, electronic rooms keys that didn't work - three times.  No bellman at either check-in or check-out, dragging luggage to one of the farthest rooms (3046).  Also there was no apparent way to lock the room door from the inside...housekeeping interrupted us at particularly inconvenient times.

On check-in you are given a color coded bracelet to wear.  If you have the "right" color the staff and servers are high 5ing the guest and are very attentive.  If you have the "wrong" color you are ignored.  In 35 years of traveling throughout the world, I have never experienced class distinction like this!

It felt like the concierge that made our dinner reservations at the property was doing us a favor.  The concierges clearly didn't communicate the dinner reservation to the restaurant's front of the house staff.  

The buffets look much better than food tasted.  The steak at Rare was quite nice but the gentlemen that had sommelier on his apron and zwearing the tastevin (silver cup) was clueless in the art of wine service, including reaching across my wife to serve me the nice Brunello that we had ordered.  With one exception, (Edwin Padilla who was amazing) the restaurant servers were inattentive at best.

The beach is nice but it remained a mystery how to get lounge chairs and towels, in spite of tipping.  

In the evenings there is no way to escape the techno and disco music.  That was the one advantage of having a room far away from the lobby.

The very worst experience was when I went to front desk to get change for tips.  I gave the front desk a US $50 and explained I need to tip hotel staff.  He only gave me US $45 back.  When I asked why only $45 he said "the $5 is my tip," seriously.

In a million years, we will never return to this property!

reviews.author: SMCCutting
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: Excellent property. Gorgeous beach. Delicious venues. Fuego = favorite. Many activities. Golf and Explorer Reef = low-key fun. Consistent, attentive, friendly and professional staff and service. Butler, Francis Newton, is a must!!

reviews.author: caroforest
reviews.title: Spectacular vacation!
reviews.text:
Let us start by saying that this has been the best resort vacation we've had, and they have been plenty. A lot of things contributed to this being an extraordinary experience but a few people stand out and we would like to thank them personally. 

Our butler, Argenis, who took great care that we were completely happy at all times. The chocolate covered strawberries in our room almost daily were just one of his nice attentions. 

Then there's Wanda at the Sunset bar, in the Royal Service area, was the life of our days at the beach, serving my husband his classic drink from the eightys.

Speaking of the beach, Martin, our beach concierge created the perfect setting for our lazy days by preparing our Bali bed daily. We could not have asked for more.

And finally, Lisa at the lobby bar made sure our evenings ended on the best note, with a rum extra anejo no ice and an espresso with milk. 

We had reserved through Transat and had paid the premium for the Royal Service, which we highly recommend. Private lounge, automatic reservations at any of the many and delicious restaurants, your personal butler, reserved beach and pool area... it is meant to be the best and it was.

Food was amazing everywhere, even the buffet was incredible! Service, all of them, are extraordinary: present but not too much, friendly but not too much, professional and attentive - what we were hoping for. 

Thank you to everyone who made this vacation was it was: one we will remember for a long time. For sure, we will be back at a Paradisus resort, here or elsewhere.

Caroline and Francois, room 2103.

reviews.author: Lucas B
reviews.title: Espectacular lugar
reviews.text: Excelente la calidad del hotel, la gastronomia es de primera calidad. Muy lujosas las habitaciones y sobre todo la atención de todo el personal. Me divertí mucho viendo el paso de Michael Jackson de melvin concepción, un genio en la fiesta playera . Reynaldo un genio total en los restaurantes , excelente su atención y cordialidad.  Y los chicos de la playa Ramón , Luis y compañía unos genios totales. Volvería por el personal tan amable.

reviews.author: Dawn M
reviews.title: Perfect getaway!
reviews.text: This vacation was exactly what we needed! Beautiful resort, beautiful weather, so relaxing. Butler service was great, plenty of options for food, drinks, activities. Staff was great. Shout out to our butler, Bladimir, who made our stay memorable. Wanda at the Sunset bar was always ready with our drinks and a smile, and Francisco at the beach who set us up daily, and kept us happy!

reviews.author: pappou13
reviews.title: Service royal with Ariel Benzo
reviews.text:
Une note de 11/10 pour Ariel Benzo.  Service royal professionnel, efficace, respectueux et ce, avec le sourire.  Bonne suggestion de resto, toujours attentif à nos besoins.  Merci à Ariel d'avoir mis du soleil dans notre quotidien.  WOW

Monica et José

reviews.author: Marc J
reviews.title: Overbooked rooms - sent us to another resort without adequate compensation!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort last year and thought it was nice enough to visit again. We booked our trip in December of 2016, which was over 3 months ago. After a long day of travel we finally arrived at the resort and were looking forward to checking in and starting our week long vacation. Things went downhill from there. The front desk said that unfortunately they overbooked the rooms and had nothing available. They would have to send us to the Paradisus Punta Cana resort for a couple of days and then transfer us back to the Paradisus Palma Real on Sunday. We argued with them for 20 minutes, but to no avail. It's that or nothing. They promised to give us Royal Service when we came back. More on that later. 

We went to the Paradisus Punta Cana and spent another hour doing paper work before we finally got to our room. On Sunday we had to check out at noon and wait until 2 pm to catch the ride back to the Paradisus Palma Real. When we arrived at the hotel we thought everything would go smoothly. We went to the front desk and where they told us there was a separate line by the bar for the overbooked people (there were a lot). We went to that lineup and where they told us to come back at 3 pm to get the room key. Why make us line up again! We came back at 3 pm and they gave us the room card keys. When we got to the room the card keys didn't work. The bell boy opened our door and I called the front desk and asked them to send new card keys, but they wouldn't. You have to go to the front desk in person to get them. So I went back to the main lobby again and got new card keys and they worked in the door, but they didn't work in the safe. So I called the front desk again and they sent out someone to help with the safe. By this time, all of Sunday is a write off. We lost a full day of our vacation. But we got "Royal Service", which is supposed to compensate us for a lost day and all the hassles. 

Royal Service is supposed to come with a concierge. We didn't get one. Some other overbooked people got the concierge and some didn't. We went to the Royal Service beach and there were only a couple of chairs available at the very back near the bar. Lots of chairs had towels on them but were empty all day long. I later found out that the beach staff put towels and old books on many of the chairs and you have to tip them for the chair. A couple we met started to give the beach staff money, but we felt that Royal Service should include the beach chairs without having to pay the staff.

The Royal Service didn't get us anything special nor did it compensate us for lost time and stress. The resort grounds are very beautiful and the Naos buffet is pretty good. We weren't that impressed with the a la carte restaurants and ate at the Naos buffet most of the time.  

A lot of the service staff work hard especially the servers, maids, maintenance crew and bell hops. However, the staff at the front desk have a difficult time explaining and resolving issues. 

Some other overbooked couples told us that cruise ships are much better. We have never taken a cruise, but that's what we will do next time we go on a sunny vacation to the Caribbean.

reviews.author: Josie R
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
This is my first review, although we've previously travelled to Cuba, La Romana, and the Mayan Riviera. 

With a few slight bumps that we were able to get beyond, we really enjoyed our stay!  

Bumps:  Upon our Friday, March 24th arrival we were informed the resort was overbooked, and we'd be transferred to Melia The Level until Sunday. We were driven to the neighbouring resort and made the best of being in a resort we knew nothing about and living out of our suitcases for two days. Inconvenient and somewhat more stress than expected, but we were grateful to be sheltered and well fed. When we returned to the Paradisus Palma Real, we were told we were being upgraded to Royal Service for our troubles. It ended up were were given Royal Service "access", not full Royal Service, which we only found out through persistent questioning. The front desk staff were less than forthright with information. We heard grumblings of many more people bumped around due to overbooking. For this reason, we feel we can't honestly give full marks on this visit. 

The areas of the resort we saw were pristine and breathtaking. The staff throughout were friendly and helpful - Wanda, at the Sunset Bar, is a gem; and beach concierge, Pedro, warmly attentive. Most particularly, we have to mention the warm, courteous and professional staff at Palazzo restaurant. Thank you to hostess, Fatima Diaz, who always made us feel welcome!  Palazzo's food was very nicely done - excellent steak and seafood!  The only other a la carte restaurant we tried was Vento. It was only okay, both in food on offer, quality and service. We were quite content to return to Palazzo.  The Naos Market Grill had an amazing variety and the quality was very good for a buffet, with options from pre-prepared to cook to order burgers, meat cuts and seafood. 

Dominican night with entertainment and souvenir market was so much fun. The Gabi Bar was lively and entertaining and Bargarita's offerings were original and so delicious!  The Gray Goose sampling in the lobby bar with martinis and caviar was interesting. 

We enjoyed our daily beach walks, the restful Oriental Gardens, and the complimentary half hour couple's massage provided at the lovely Yhi Spa (also to compensate for the overbooking). One day when were making a purchase from a beach vendor, we noticed that a security guard came and hovered close by, carefully watching the transaction but not interfering, and we appreciated his attention. 

We would definitely return to this resort. While the overall experience at the Palma Real outweighed the bumps at the beginning, we hope that the overbooking is quickly brought under control.

reviews.author: brooklinbc
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but service & food so-so
reviews.text: Family of 4 (2 kids 6 & 9) stayed March 18-25, 2017 at the Reserve.  The grounds are gorgeous, 1 bedroom master suite was great (but be sure to request a pool or garden view or you might end up with a parking lot view as we did for first 2 nights, but our request to move was eventually accomodated).  Reserve pool is very family oriented.  Walk to beach was lovely and carts came regularly if you didn't want to walk.  Beach is amazing, very big waves and strong undertow so probably not ideal for kids under 5, but my kids had a blast.  We were always able to find a spot with shade at pool and beach.  We did not book the family concierge and our biggest disappointment was the very obvious tiered system, despite being a 5 star resort we got 3 star service.  For the most part the staff did the best they could, but the resort needs to modernize their check in system (totally disorganized and slow) and restaurant reservation system, which clearly gives absolute priority to family concierge/butler patrons.  Although we submitted our restaurant  requests on the first day we received random confirmations (after repeated follow ups with our building concierge) that would be slipped under the door between 3 & 5pm, with most reservations for 8pm or later, which is not what we requested and ridiculous for a family with young kids.   Our very first reservation was apparently a mistake, and when we presented the reservation confirmation at the restaurant (Mole) the hostess was very confrontational and made a very big deal about it.  We were eventually seated and most of the staff were very kind but the unneccessary argument with the hostess tainted our evening.   I noticed other families having the same experience/argument at different restaurants over the duration of our stay. Also noteworthy that 3 out of 4 of us were sick with stomach troubles, which was also very disappointing.

reviews.author: Ivan J
reviews.title: Amazing Resort & Staff
reviews.text:
This is truly an amazing resort in every sense (especially if you decide to go with Royal Service which I would recommend):

- food selection 
- drink selection
- beach 
- hotel grounds and many bars/lounges to choose from.
- cleanliness of everything  

Special thanks to Wanda & Pedro on the Sunset Bar, as well as Rafael who reserved our cabanas each morning. They were very helpful each day! 

Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ed P
reviews.title: Great relaxing week
reviews.text:
Good service, Food, Beach and Pool The Guest services of Junior and Angie were fantastic.
We ate at Gabi Club the hostes Yesica De La Cruz very helpful.
The hardest decision is to go to the pool or beach were Louis and Ramon made you at home

reviews.author: fjferaco
reviews.title: Disappointed in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We have stayed in this area several times over the years; this was the first time at Paradisus, Reserve..It came with excellent reviews; even from Trip Advisors.

We travel frequently as a family. We know a 5 star resort when we see one. This one is over rated, clearly. Here is what WE found..
1. For ambiance and flora we rate it 4.5... very beautiful location.
2. For its people and wait staff. 4.0. very friendly and accommodating. We had the Reserve level stay with a Concierge. Frankly, without Jordan, our concierge, we would have left early and cut our stay short. Communication here is very limited; and most employees do not understand English.
5 star resorts never have this issue...That is why they are 5 star.
3.The food: Maybe a 2 out of 5; perhaps more like 1.5 out of 5. The food is horrible and no taste. Reservations must be made well in advance and then you wont eat it.

reviews.author: worldtraveller940
reviews.title: Average food, poor service and damp rooms spoil the whole experience
reviews.text:
Unfortunately not a positive review for this hotel despite of some very nice features like a beautiful beach and nice grounds. That's about it. 

Service - non existent neither at the reception, restaurants or anywhere else. They just don't understand what a customer service actually mean and what the level should be for a 5 star luxury hotel.

Food is very average. Occasionally there are nicely cooked dishes in the buffet but the restaurants are a no go at all as the atmosphere, food and service are just unacceptable. If you are eating healthy food then forget about coming here. The choices for healthy non sugary food are very limited - you can't even find a natural yogurt ( without sugar) for breakfast. 

The restaurants are always overbooked and you can't get there and being forced to eat at the mad buffet for the duration of the stay. 

Rooms - damp, smelly all the time. All my clothes were smelling of damp by the end of the stay because of a very poor air conditioning system. I heard the same problem from other tourists. The beds and the towels are wet. When you turn on the air con the air that is coming from the system smells of toilet. 

Cleaning of the rooms. Yesterday the turndown service was at 10.30 in the evening -  I was already in bed asleep. The cleaning of the rooms are not at the normal time like in the other hotels in the morning or midday but at 3-4 in the afternoon when you are back from the beach. I complained 3 times -  no reaction. 

The beds on the beach and by the pool are very uncomfortable with no padding. 

It cost us GBP 2200 per person for a 7 day stay ( flights separately). We feel absolutely robbed.

reviews.author: Jetnor M
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful place, food is great, beach is great, didn't have issues finding chairs on the beach.  Only down side, there is not much for small kids at the pool outside of the entry point into the pool, the rest of the pool is 5 foot deep.

reviews.author: 963donaldf
reviews.title: Paradise!!!
reviews.text: This resort was amazing.  We were treated like royalty.   Pampered from the time we landed until the time we left.   I have told everyone about this resort.  I will only stay at this resort when I come back.  The party boat for snorkeling was so much fun.  It's a must do!!!

reviews.author: LACVA
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
We had a great trip even though the weather was crappy, lots of rain. Our butler, Alexander Guzman was great he helped with everything we asked and even made sure our bags we're there for pickup at our departure today (although the bellman didn't get them -Alexander carried them himself)

Pros - staff is great, lots of food, and nice drinks. Grounds are beautiful and highly maintained. Royal Service -well worth it. 

Cons - our rooms shower had really crappy repairs done. Also maids varying times to clean room and unpredictable restocking of mini bar.

reviews.author: Monica F
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables!!
reviews.text: Un encanto el hotel! Ha superado todas mis expectativas, las instalaciones , la habitacion impecable. La playa preciosa! La atencion de su gente. Estuve hospedada desde el 18 de abril en the reserve habitacion 2423 , con una vista a la piscina preciosa. Todos los empleados muy atentos siempre! reviews.author: NeilCzarnecki
reviews.title: SOME GOOD POINTS, MANY BAD POINTS
reviews.text:
Stayed 4 days for a friend's wedding.  Pricey, but all-inclusives generally are.  Very pretty - good food - beautiful rooms.
However, what distinguishes a great resort from just an OK resort is the management.  The Palma Real is NOT a great resort.  Some examples:
   # After the wedding, I went to the bridesmaids ready-room to collect up all their bags - called the front desk and asked for a bellhop with a luggage cart.  45 minutes later, I hauled them myself, as neither bellhop nor cart ever showed.
   # Groom's 75-year-old mother fell face down on the stone walk.  We called for the resort doctor, as no one knew how severe her injuries were.  Thank goodness there were medical personnel in the wedding party, as the doctor took 20 minutes to show up.  I watched him strolling slowly down the corridor with a backboard in one hand and his bag in the other, as if he had not a care in the world.
   # I understand the purpose of the neon green wristbands for the guests at an all-inclusive.   However, we could not have been the first wedding party to have been concerned about the looks of these wristbands on the wedding pictures.  We were ordered to keep them on and told if anyone took them off it would cost $50 to get them put back on.   ...btw...we took them off and I MacGyvered them back on for free.
   # Wedding coordinator was the most disorganized lady I have ever met.  At least a dozen guests asked "Is this her first wedding?"
   # Worst WIFI I have ever seen at a hotel - worst cell phone service I have ever seen at a hotel.

All in all, go there to vacation - don't go there for anything important.

reviews.author: sonnenanbeter2016
reviews.title: Wunderschöner Urlaub, mit Wolhfühlgarantie
reviews.text:
Habe 14 Tage im Hotel Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa in Punta Cana verbracht. Als abschließendes Fazit kann ich jedem Urlauber dieses Hotel objektiv empfehlen. In der ganzen Zeit habe ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt und möchte gerne im Detail darauf eingehen. Die Hotelanlage ist zwar extrem groß , jedoch ist eigentlich alles Notwendige auf kurzem Wege zu erreichen. 
Sollte man doch mal Zeit im etwas weiter gelegenen Shopping Center verbringen wollen ( am Eingang der Hotelanlage gelegen) , so wird man dorthin mit einem Shuttle gebracht, welcher von 10 Uhr morgens bis 10 Uhr Abends die Hotelgäste ununterbrochen Hin und auch wieder zurück bringt. Hier ist für all diejenigen Abwechslung geboten die nicht ununterbrochen am Pool oder Strand liegen wollen. 
Ich war doch überrascht am Strand wirklich ständig freie Liegen zu finden , unabhängig der Tageszeit. Am Pool war dies schon etwas schwieriger, doch da ich alleine im Urlaub war, hat sich in meinem Falle immer wieder eine Gelegenheit ergeben. Der Pool ist sehr groß und man schöne große Runden drehen. Vor meinem Urlaub habe ich diesbezüglich immer wieder negatives über zu viel Partystimmung der fast ausschließlich vorhandenen amerikanischen Gästen gelesen. Hierzu sei angemerkt, wenn überhaupt fand man viele feierwütige rund um die Poolbar an den beiden Wochenenden meines Aufenthaltes. Es handelt sich eigentlich um 2 bzw. 4 Tage des Aufenthaltes. In der restlichen Zeit war man auch hier kaum Lärmbelastung ausgesetzt. Selbst an den Wochenenden fand ich es erträglich. Da habe ich in der Vergangenheit unter anderen Umständen schon wesentlich schlimmeres erlebt. Wie gesagt rund um die Poolbar war es an den Wochenenden schon mal etwas voller, aber man muss nicht immer nur einen negativen Punkt suchen , nur um Ihn gefunden zu haben. 
Über die Verpflegug , sprich Qualität der Speisen und Getränke, kann man eigentlich auch wenig bzw. eigentlich garnichts schlechtes erwähnen. Morgens und Mittags ging es immer ans Buffet. Welches nicht zu groß war ,aber immer extrem abwechslungsreich und auch die Frische hielt was man sich versprach. In Glasvitrinen liegt der frische (täglich weschselnd, aber wiederkehrende) Fisch bereit um direkt frisch zubereitet zu werden. Das gleiche gilt für die Fleischabteilung. 
Sushi + zusätzlicher asiatischer Ecke, Pizza +  Pasta u.s.w.
Alle Servicemitarbeiter waren durchweg freundlich, jedoch möchte ich hier Juan hervorheben der seine Aufmerksamkeit immer voll und ganz den Gästen widmet,wirklich jeden Wunsch erfüllt,  ohne dabei störend zu wirken und immer ein freundliches Lächeln parat hat. Ebenso hervorheben würde ich gerne Madame Yessica , die sich nach 1-2 Tagen  meine nicht standardhaften Getränkewünsche verinnerlicht hat. Die Dame scheint noch sehr jung zu sein aber wie die meisten Ihrer Kollegen und  Kolleginen z.B. Eunice über eine sehr sehr gute Auffassungsgabe zu verfügen scheint.Auch Sie begnete einem immer mit einem freundlichen Lächeln. 
In den verschiedenen Themenrestaurants , welche ich immer Abends besucht hatte, fühlte ich mich eigentlich auch immer wohl. Im Rare macht Mr. Willi einen fantastischen Job, in der Lobbybar der Profi Francis, welcher sich auch unübliche Kreationen meinerseits schnell merken und nach meinen Wünschen umsetzen konnte. ( Mein Campari Soda- mit Lemon und etwas Minze spezial) 

Und abschließend , so dass ich eventuell noch auf 1-2 negative Dinge eingehen kann, möchte ich noch den Chef des Gaby Club Restaurant Ernesto erwähnen. 
In einer professionellen , symphatischen Art begleitet er einen durch jedes Frühstück bzw. Lunch und sorgt schon dafür sich als einen besonderen Gast zu fühlen. Danke und Weiter so. I´ll be back. 
Ich muss an dieser Stelle erwähnen, dass die kulinarische Verköstigung bei mir an oberster Stelle stand und bis auf die Ausnahme in 2 Restaurants einen Aufpreis zu zahlen , obwohl das Hotel nicht ganz billig ist , wurde ich in keinster Weise entäuscht. Die beiden Restaurants mit Aufpreis habe ich gemieden, die Speisen in den anderen Restaurants waren aber durchweg frisch und gut zubereitet. Dies möchte ich erwähnen weil ich hierzu ( auch in anderen Portalen) doch negatives gelesen habe. Ich denke hierzu kann man im allgemeinen noch etwas anmerken, was vielleicht meinen vieleicht sogar euphorischen Bericht wieder zu einem objektiven macht. 
Man kann immer etwas aussetzen oder meckern wie z.B. folgendes:
Neben der Rezeption befindet sich die Station welche sich um Reservierungen für die Restaurants oder sonstige Belange der Kunden kümmert. Natürlich entstehen hier auch mal Wartezeiten durch warteschlangen. Ich hatte auch 2-3 Anliegen ( Reservierungen Restaurants/ Sonnebrille verloren/ Erfragung der Abholung im Hotel) Und wenn es eben eine Schlange gibt, dann komm ich halt später wieder. Was solls? ich bin doch im Urlaub und habe keine geschäftlichen Termine. Hier gab es (Ausnahmen) Gäste welche sich über diese Dinge z.B etwas aufgeregt haben. Bei mir fiel die Sicherung des öfteren mal aus im Zimmer. Nach ein paar Tagen kam ich darauf dass einfach die Sicherung immer rausfällt wenn  alle Strombetriebenen Geräte gleichzeitig eingeschaltet sind. Es kam aber eigentlich immer jemand relativ kurzfristig vorbei. Auch hier empfinde ich 15 Minuten wartezeit als nicht schlimm.....
Als es doch nicht aufhörte einigte ich mich darauf mit dem Servicemann , dass er den Kasten einfach nicht mehr zuschraubt, einen sicherungsschalter betätigen schaffe ich gerade so noch und stellt für mich auch keine Einschränkung dar....
So gäbe es noch 2-3 weitere Punkte zu erwähnen. Jedoch ist mein Bericht (mein erster) doch schon recht lang und die Punkte störten mich nicht weiter . ok 1 Beispiel noch ,  zur "Rush- Hour" war das Fitness- Studio voll befüllt, so dass man eventuell etwas warten musste um an eine, und dann noch an die gewünschte Maschine zu kommen. Dann bin ich halt am nächsten Tag um die Mittagszeit gegangen, zum Glück hab ich im Urlaub ja Zeit. Und falls ich mich gerne massieren hätte lassen, hätte ich mich eventuell über die Kosten gewundert. aber beides war nicht der Fall. 
Resumee:  Ich hätte nicht gedacht mit dem Gedanken zu spielen ein Hotel 2 mal zu besuchen, aber unter anderem die Freundlichkeit des Personals, die Sauberkeit (nicht nur) der Restaurants , die Qualität der Speisen u.s.w. haben mir eine sehr schöne Zeit beschert.
Ich denke die Rückkehr ins Paradisus wird für mich ein Novum darstellen.   
P.S. Wer auf Kontakt zu Deutschen Urlaubern steht, sollte sich auch für ein anderes Hotel entscheiden. 
Ich empfand das aber als angenehm. :-)

reviews.author: drkkw
reviews.title: Nice, but average!
reviews.text:
I am not here to bash the Paradisus.  However, I believe that many people review a place, but have not been to many other places.  Having been to many resorts around the world, you can't but help, to compare.  I believe that is where ratings and reviews can really help.
The Paradisus is a very large complex.  That can seem to be amazing when you first drive up, but you also must remember that you will walking a much greater distance to get from one side of the property to another.  (Just something to think about)
I love exercise, but on a vacation, I'm also there to relax and necessarily to break my record on my fitbit.  (ha)
If you have ever been to a good number of all-inclusive resorts, you start to pick up the fact that they all start to look the same.  I have often wondered if the same designer has been hired throughout the world to design every single all-inclusive.
That doesn't make it bad, but then I guess it really doesn't matter which one you pick; it's a bit boring seeing the same 'ole thing.
With all-inclusives, you are subject to the daily buffet.  As far as choice, or options, that seems wonderful.  However, I have yet to be "wowed" with the overall enjoyment of the food at anyone's buffet.  I realize it is hard to prepare all those dishes in big masses and make them all taste wonderful, but isn't that part of the reason you pay extra at all-inclusives?  You are prepaying for the food and drink that they estimate you will consume.
Your other option for dinner, is to get a reservation at one of their Premium restaurants.  Unfortunately for us, we were told on Wednesday when we arrived, that there was no availability for us at any of their premium restaurants for the next 4 nights, and that was all we were going to be there.

I will say, the staff is very friendly, and I found very helpful.

As far as weather goes, can someone tell me if the wind ever stops?  It seems to blow hard 24-7.  Honestly, not a wind fan!  Also, it was super cloudy 3 out of the 4 days.
Again, since comparisons help, the Dominican doesn't hold a candle to the consistency of weather in Ixtapa or Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.  (2 of my faves)

I guess overall, the Paradisus Palma Real is good, just not great.  Also, you can probably tell that I am NOT a fan of all-inclusives.  I only go when the situation or the group I'm with dictate it.
For my money, there are many other wonderful gems to stay at and make memories that will be different from the same 'ole thing.

reviews.author: Zorina J
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text:
Our vacation was from April 21st-28th~ for our anniversary. We booked the reserve because of the reviews. We were thinking of changing hotels, as we found out it was mostly geared to people with families. However, we decided to stick with it~ and thank goodness we did. The grounds were beautiful, with a gorgeous beach, gardens and walk ways. There are many restaurant to choose from. The resort was less lively than the other Paradisus, which suited us just fine, as we can go and see where the action was, yet go back to quiet.
Though it was more for people with children, my husband and I found it was relatively quiet. The children we saw running around were younger~ and were usually asleep by 8:00. Quite frankly, we got a kick out of seeing the children as their concierge kept them busy all the time~ and I mean all the time. We saw them playing games at the beach~ Races against each other running back from the ocean with a small cup scooping up the water and dumping them into a big pail. Or blowing balloons etc...I don't know who had more fun~ the concierge or the kids. 
There was activities in the pool area, or the beach. My husband and I would have breakfast at the reserve, then walk to the beach, and usually have lunch at Gabi beach. 
The people at the reserve was super friendly, and accomadating. Our rooms were always kept clean by the staff ( Olga Lugo, Soranlly Borg) . 
We did things like get a massage~ which I highly recommend by Ana, and my husband went scuba diving which he throughly enjoyed with his master diver Maurice. We did go out to the market (something I was expecting different~ I did not like that to much, it was a strange and unnerving experience). Later I found out that many vendors sell their wares at the hotel during some nights~ better off doing that as you get better selection and prices. 
Though we did not have a concierge, Rosemary and Lix  did everything for us. They booked our meals, made sure we're were set up at the beach, and made sure our shuttle picked us up on time on our way back to the airport.  
They do try to sell the Melia hotel~ though it seems great! we were just not interested. They were not pushy as other places we've been, so I respected that in those people. Overall, I would go back~ this time with the children. I hghly recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Ivan D
reviews.title: Best honeymoon ever!!
reviews.text: Although my wife and I are half Dominican this was our first trip to the Dominican Republic. I surprised her with our honeymoon to DR and after doing tons of research on which resort to stay at I decided to stay at the reserve at paradises punta Cana and it was such a great experience. The staff is all so pleasant to speak to and the resort itself is gorgeous. We had a blast with the staff at the swim up bar Juan Cruz, Argenis, Pedro Amparo, Santo Polanco, and Jensy Rio. They recommended us a unique drink and it was so good! We hung out with them almost our entire time we were there. They definitely added to the experience.  And the food is so delicious!! I can talk about it for days. I've been to other resorts in the past and even though I grew up in a Latino household where the food was always amazing and flavorful, the food here at paradisus has been the best by far compared to other resorts I've been to. I can't really say there was anything at the resort I was unhappy with. Everything was perfect!! Thank you Paradisus!!

reviews.author: Vivian S
reviews.title: Excellent Experience at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Overall, my friends and I had a wonderful experience. The food was outstanding!! The breakfasts and lunches at Naos buffer were spectacular. We also ate at several restaurants including Vento (italian restaurant), Bana (sushi restaurant), Rare (steakhouse), Mizu (teppanyaki japanese food) and Blue Agave (Mexican food). All were super fantastic and exceeded my expectations. The landscaping was absolutely stunning with the majestic pool and beautiful sea views. The whole atmosphere was awesome. Amazing pina coladas as well!! The rooms were super comfortable and very spacious. The staff was super friendly and so welcoming. Shoutout to Gasolina, an entertainer at Gabi Beach, for being funny and friendly.
Some things the hotel should improve on are dinner reservations at the restaurants (a little confusing) and housekeeping at appropriate hours and not late in the afternoon. But beautiful resort overall, I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Madamson66
reviews.title: Love d the Paradisus Experience!
reviews.text: We stayed here with our two college children.  There was something for everyone and although this was a family vacation, our children were able to meet a variety of young adults their same age.  By staying in the Reserve we enjoyed the exclusivity of the beach, pool and restaurant but loved that we could utilize the other busy areas of the resort as well.  Our suite at the Reserve was exceptional.

reviews.author: LisaMonroe
reviews.title: In need of Rest and Relaxation this is the place for you.
reviews.text: All in all everything was nice. Stayed at the Reserve, had a master suite (tons of room) and when we arrived we purchased the ‘Royal Service’ for the beach/pool area.  Its adults only and it was mostly empty until the weekend came. The Reserve Beach area appeared to be pretty empty too.  Beach was beautiful, and the cushioned chairs were great. The weather was beautiful too.  We were on the 1st floor, never again, view was limited as well.  Had bug issues in the room from time to time, smelled a little moldy too, but the room was pretty. I know I would have loved the room if I was on a higher floor.  Cheila the concierge in our building was great, booked all of our restaurants and was always nice. Wando Javier at MOLE was fabulous and deserves a raise.  He wasn’t just a server, he genuinely cared.  I have lots of allergies and he was the first one to acknowledge this and do what he could for me. He was wonderful, he even inquired where I was dining the following day and he alerted another restaurant of my allergies.  We enjoyed Mole and Aqua and Vento the most.  The grounds are nice and well maintained.  We walked a lot from our hotel to beach/dinner most of the time, they have signs telling you how long it will take to get from place to place (figure 5-15 min) depending on where you are.  The premium vodka is Absolute, so be prepared to pay for anything above that.  Not sure why but had a problem getting ginger ale, but after 2 days they started stocking it.  We tipped a lot, brought lots of 5’s and 10’s based on another trip advisor advice.  Bring snacks from home if you can, overly priced at gift shop. Compared to a cruise, food on cruise is much better with a ton of selections and LOTS of it.  Breakfast was too fancy at the Reserve and not great, but the coffee was good. Resort had plenty of places to sit at the pool/beach area, I didn’t have to wake up at 7 a.m. just to get a chair by the pool like you would have too on a cruise.  If you’re looking to relax this is the place to go.
