reviews.author: LLA15
reviews.title: Amazing Family Trip!
reviews.text: Can't wait to book our trip again for next year. Our expectations were met and exceeded ....Wonderful compliments to Alonso Adrian who is the hotel manager at the Reserve....The staff were incredibly kind and sincere, some greeting us by our names by our second day. (Janna, Antony, Juanilin, Paola) We truly enjoyed our family concierge service by Nikel Lendor who had bubble baths waiting for our girls when we returned from the beach. He managed to show up just when we had a request and was incredibly helpful with anything we needed. We were very impressed with the space in our room which allowed us to feel like we weren't on top of each other and had a place for all of our belongings. Food was great, service at the restaurants and by the pool was great as well....There was nothing I would have changed other than having more vacation days to stay longer :)

reviews.author: PatriciaCarbonell
reviews.title: Un lujo de experiencia
reviews.text:
Es el mejor lugar para ir de vacaciones con la familia y sobre todo si tienen niños pequeños. Mi hija de 18 meses lo paso increible y todos en el hotel estaban pendientes de ella. 

Tienen espectaculos todas las noches y se pueden disfrutar perfectamente con los más pequeños

Todos en el hotel son un encanto y siempre disupuestos a atenderte con la mejor de las sonrisas.  Paola y Stefania de Family Concierge se preocuparon al detalle de nuestras necesidades. En la playa Ramon todos los dias nos esperaba con unas piñas coladas y un juguito para mi pequeña.  Maridaria nos limpio la habitacion todos los dias y siempre fue un encanto de persona con una sonrisa todo el tiempo.  En el desayuno Antony Cid, Celso y Paola nos atendieron de lujo.
Se me quedan tantos otros nombres por mencionar lamentablemente.

Felicitatciones al equipo.

reviews.author: Lynne C
reviews.title: Great relaxing vacation destination
reviews.text:
My family just returned from a  10 day stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. What a wonderful vacation. We stayed in the Family Concierge Suites with our children who are 7 & 9 and my parents. The rooms were well appointed and clean. Beds were very comfortable too :-) The kids were in awe when they came in and saw backpacks, tee shirts, hats, coloring books and more all for them! Our personal concierge, Nikel spoiled us rotten. He was so attentive to us and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed in our room and around the resort. The beach was the most amazing beach we've ever been too, and we live on the coast of Maine. The water was warm and free from seaweed...the sand was soft and clean. 

We really enjoyed the pool and activities staff as well, Melvin, Naomi and Emilio were favorites of ours! They took such great care of us and kept us stocked with dry towels, drinks and entertainment all day long. 

Our children enjoyed the kids club - they participated in several of the events like the pajama party and hikes around the property, painting and cooking. They made great new friends that we've connected with on Facebook and hope to see in the future.

There were several choices of restaurants and the food, though not top of the line, was good. I would've liked to see more choices of "kids food" at the lunch and dinner buffets. We really enjoyed the pasta bar during our lunches at Gabi Beach.

This was our first time at a Paradisus resort and we were really impressed. We look forward to visiting their other properties in Mexico.

reviews.author: amgfch
reviews.title: fabulous
reviews.text:
the entire experience was beyond compare butler eduard mendez was great. the staff at the palazzo restaurant went beyond to serve us. felix garcia, petronila,zenovia,miguel,
zenovia,richard,junior,marino,elisa,osvaldo were all outstanding, friendly and right on their game. i would recommend this property to all. had a wonderful, relaxing, great time.
the owners did not miss a thing. spectacular.

reviews.author: T.J. M
reviews.title: Little extra effort can make it 5 star!
reviews.text:
Wife and I traveled to Palma Real for our fifth anniversary.  We are not hard people to please. When we go on vacation, we want to feel like we are at an upscale, safe place, and want to feel like we are getting the value for what we spend - to a reasonable extent. I'll try to be as thorough as possible with this. I feel that we owe that, based on the fact this site is the sole means we use for choosing vacation destinations.

Airport and arrival:

The Punta Cana airport is pretty simple to get through. We purchased the tourist cards ahead of time, and I would say we were about 10-15 minutes from stepping off the plane to sitting in our transport van. We used the free shuttle offered by the resort from Otium. We were joined by 4 other couples and were second in line to be dropped off. I would say about 30-35 minutes from the time we left the airport to arriving at the hotel. Be ready for the speed bumps - they are everywhere except the expressway. Drivers do a good job slowing for them, but the constant speed up/slow down can be a bit annoying.

Check in:

A lot of reviews mention the stunning view when stepping out of your transportation at the hotel entrance. Words can't explain it. Looking down through the open air lobby through the courtyard, over the pool, to the ocean is breathtaking. We reserved a Royal Service room and were taken on a short walk to the RS Lounge. The drinks and cold towel were a nice touch, and check in was easy. However, our room was not ready and were sent to Palazzo for lunch (we arrived at about 12:30). After lunch, we returned to the Lounge and waited about an hour to be taken to our room (around 2:00-2:15). I can't really fault the hotel - they make it clear check in is at 3:00. That said, of all the other all inclusives we've traveled to, we've never had a problem getting a room immediately on arrival, no matter the time. It did not seem the hotel was full, thus we feel that it shouldn't have been a big deal to get us in a room with no wait. Small complaint here.

The room:

Our room was a Royal Service Garden View. It was located on the third floor, in the same building (2 minute walk) to the RS Lounge. I was of the understanding that all the Royal Service rooms were out on the edge of the property by the RS Pool and Beach - obviously not the case. Nonetheless, we were a very quick walk to the RS Lounge and Lobby area, along with the beach, main pool, RS pool, and all restaurants. The room was clean and came as described in the photos on the hotel website. The furnishings were a bit dated, but nothing that made you feel that you were not in a very nice room. Toilet and sliding door could use a bit of work, but again, nothing to really complain about here. Our hot water worked without any issue. The in-room safe was nice and we used it extensively. Housekeeping did a nice job, except for the fact that turn-down service didn't arrive until around 10 pm a couple of nights, when we were already back in the room. We don't really care about this, but figured I would add it in case you are someone who does.

Employees: 

For the most part, the employees were very impressive. Most seemed to be hard workers who seemed to truly enjoy their jobs. We have to point out our Butler Miguel Abreu. Terrific guy who I will review more thoroughly a bit later. The other employee who stood out to us was Mercedes, our server at Fuego. The guys at the RS Beach were very nice, but seemed a bit careless at times, hanging out chatting it up at the juice bar, rather than finding out if people wanted drinks, towels, ect. We tipped a dollar or two for drinks and any other type of service, which was much appreciated but didn't feel necessary at all.

Royal Service Experience:

We were happy with it at times, and underwhelmed at others. I already covered the check in issues. When we arrived, Miguel had all of our dinner reservations made for our four nights (based on the pre-arrival form we filled out and sent in), which was awesome! After discussing restaurants with him, we decided to change one of the restaurants. Miguel promptly took care of it, and we had reservations at all four places we wanted to eat, between 7 and 8 pm, which was great for us. Miguel also took care of arranging our massages, and made a very quick last minute change of the time from off property when we called him on the cell phone and requested it (butlers are available by cell phone at all times, even when they are not "at work"). We didn't need to be waited on hand and foot, and seeing Miguel once or twice each day to check on us was plenty for us. Let me be clear, if we return I would love to have Miguel again, but I do want to point out a couple of things that we were disappointed about, mostly related to check out.

We tipped our butler what we thought was a very good amount the afternoon prior to our departure. We had an early 8:00 am flight. We commented to Miguel how we were not looking forward to the 4:50 am departure from the hotel through the free transfer. We were kind of hoping he would arrange for a private transfer which gave us another hour or so of sleep. It wasn't done. We had had this experience at other all-inclusives and had read reviews on this hotel stating that others had received this courtesy. We were a tad disappointed that it wasn't done for us - but not the end of the world. Second, we noted to Miguel that we wanted to have room service deliver breakfast the next morning at 4:00. He advised that room service would take the order that night and bring it at 4:00. However, room service would not make any of the breakfast dishes until 6:00 am, so we had to settle for a ham and cheese sandwich. We felt that Miguel, or the RS concierge who we checked out with the night before, should have taken care of this for us. Also, when we laid on the beach, we didn't have someone get us drinks one time. Others did - don't know what made the difference in service here, but there was a difference. To us, small issue. We don't mind getting up and walking 50 feet to grab a drink, but the beach concierge should be more on top of this - if you are paying for "royal service" you should probably get drinks served to you on the beach.

Food:

All of the food was good. The buffet had plenty of options at breakfast and lunch. All of the ala carte restaurants had good variety and filled us up well. The food tasted very good. Cooks did a great job with preparation and presentation. Look, if you are going to a Caribbean all-inclusive expecting St. Elmo's steakhouse or some other top of the line restaurant, you are going to be disappointed. If you go expecting good taste, good variety, and good portions, you will be very happy. We were very happy. If I had to critique anything, it would be nice to have some more exotic seafood options, but that is a small, small issue.

Grounds:

The pictures don't do this place justice. The grounds and the hotel are just absolutely stunning. Can't say enough about how nice the place is.

Entertainment:

Cirque de Soliel was fantastic. That was the only one we made it to. Resort didn't seem to do a great job of promoting shows or other activities. Live music in the courtyard was good one of the nights, and we had a great time dancing (well, trying to dance) and drinking at Avenue Bar.

Massage:

Massage was great. Would do it again. However, funny story - both wife and I came out with bruises  from the deep tissue! Nothing that really hurt, just kind of interesting.

Beach: 

Beach was great, except for the day where it rained all day. "Seaweed" that people mention on here is not really seaweed. Almost like tiny little tree branches that get grouped together in spots - thus the multicolored look of the water. Water is clear as can be and the sand is beautiful. Waves were fun to wade in. 

Excursions:

We did the dune buggy tour. It was nice to get out and see the countryside a bit, but we would not recommend. Worst 4 hours of our trip. You have to drive in a line on a small trail - no gassing it and having fun. The stops were boring. The bus was extremely uncomfortable. We would have much preferred to have been on the beach all afternoon. 

Wifi:

Worked great everywhere. No complaints.

Overall:

We were happy with the resort. A few small effort related things would have made this place 5 star without a doubt. The facilities are superb. The employees are fantastic. They just need to pay attention to detail a bit more at times. We would absolutely recommend this place to anyone travelling to the Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: michaeleV9479OQ
reviews.title: Paradisus at Punta Cana
reviews.text: Absolutely Gorgeous resort.  Beautiful Landscaping, pools, beach, décor lighting etc.  Could not get in any of the Restaurants they offered unless you wanted to eat at 9 pm or later.  Had cold water for 2 days in our room.  Buffet food was culinary, good but would have been nice to try one of the resorts restaurants, especially being an Industry professional.  Not a lot to offer as far as entertainment.  Casino very small, entertainment mediocre at best, and if not a clubber, just not a lot to do.  There is a mall that we visited frequently on the resort as something to do after dinner.  Very westernized with the shops offered, and pretty pricey.  We actually ate at the Hard rock their one night because we were tired of buffet and couldn't get in the restaurants.  Grounds are beautiful though and rooms spacious and nice.  There was a lot to like and some things we didn't like so much.  Probably would look at going to another resort if we were to go back.

reviews.author: amyem2000
reviews.title: Great stay in Royal Service
reviews.text:
This review is overdue as we stayed here in December 2014, but we had a lovely time. This was our first visit to the Dominican Republic and Punta Cana.   We have stayed at 3 other all inclusive resorts in the past, but this was by FAR our favorite.  It was what we would consider upscale in terms of food, wine selection and service.  We were only there for 3 days as a couple before we moved on to another resort to meet a large group of friends.  What we really liked about this resort was it was CHILL. It was quiet (we were mostly on the beach of the royal service section).  There was no loud thumping music (which made us happ) Seemed like a bit of an older crowd (we were mid/late thirties and some of the younger folks there).  

We went with the royal service option because of many TA reviews and also it was a good deal in terms of price.  We loved that they did things like put wine/cheese in a our room at night, set up a bubble bath for when we came back from the beach, and made dinner reservations so we didn't have to. If anything they were almost TOO attentive. That's not their fault, we just usually like to do our own thing, but realize they are just trying to serve you here.  If you're not used to it, you just may feel a little strange....but they were really nothing but nice. 

Compared to any all inclusive we have stayed at this had the BEST food.  We at the buffet night one (great selection) and then had reservations the other 2 nights.  I can't remember where...but enjoyed them both.   We also loved the lobby bar with it's fancy cocktails. 

We spent most of our time on the beach in front of royal service and hit the pool bar which was right there.  Everyday they set us up with a nice bed (one in shade for my husband and one in sun for me).  They laid out the towels and everything.   No complaints.

We didn't spend much time in the family section except to have lunch at the Gabbi beach club one day. We also didn't use the main pool. All looked nice, but we were glad to have a smaller area that was close to our room with a beach and more private pool.  I would do Royal Service again.  I honestly can't imagine not doing it if I stayed here again ( which we are thinking of doing). 

This is on a nice beach (filled with seaweed when we were there, but that's not their fault--the Caribbean has been having issues the last few years).  We walked up and down a bit and swam in the water. 

My only complaint was that the rooms were a bit dated.  We booked a garden view room and had no view other than a walkway for the housekeeping golf carts. That didn't bother me as we spend most of our time OUT of the room.  We didn't want to pay for ocean view as the resort orientation doesn't have a ton of what we really consider ocean view (pure unobstructed view) anyway.  I just felt the rooms were a bit old and could use a refresh.  The style was fine...it just could use some updates as things get worn out fast in tropical vacation spots.  The bathroom was also a bit dark...but i don't spend a bunch of time getting ready in the mirror so it wasn't an issue for me.  The rooms are really the only reason I deducted a star.  The bed was comfortable enough and the air worked great (always a plus!)

reviews.author: Holli W
reviews.title: Amazing for families!
reviews.text:
Luis florian .raynold tamayo.naomi made sure we (and our babies) had the best time ever! They were always there to greet us by name and took the best care of us.  They had fun activities all day long and we friendly and kind.🏋🏼. 
We danced, played games, and even rolled cigars!  It was so much fun and the kids were always smiling!

reviews.author: Andrea A
reviews.title: Vacaciones familiares
reviews.text:
Impresionante!!!!!!
El hotel hermoso, la atención impecable! Estamos felices de haber venido! Aún estamos en el hotel y es un relax increíble!
A pesar de los días lluviosos hay muchísimas cosas para hacer y los niños en Kids Zone.
Volvería todos los años a este hotel!

reviews.author: Lyne P
reviews.title: Relaxation to the max!
reviews.text:
My partner and I spent a week in Royal Service in an oceanfront room (2121) during the week of April 8-15, 2016. Although it wasnt necessary, it was nice to see that Melia had updated the rooms since our last stay in 2014. The dark wood had been freshly changed to white which looked amazing and modern. 

Our butler Jose was very attentive to our every need, ensuring that we had reservations for dinner every night and that we had a bed reserved by the pool and on the beach daily. Oh those darn beds - they're too comfortable and you never want to get out! We could NEVER go back to laying in a lawn chair....

Speaking of the pool and the beach, the bartender at the Sunset Bar (darn, I forget his name) did his best to accomodate all of the guests' requests. Several US companies had rewarded their top salesmen with a few days' stay in Royal Service during the time that we were there so needless to say, the bartender was busy! Pedro and Carlos were outstanding around the pool and beach, keeping us refreshed with new drinks and always cracking a joke or two! Pedro's smile is simply infectious!

We also want to thank the staff at our favourite restaurant, Palazzo: Petonila, Richard, Felix, Miguel, Johneidy, Junior, Osualdo and Zenovia. Zenovia greeted us daily at the hostess desk and although she is a tiny little thing, she has a very large personality that we'll never forget. She joked with us, as did a few of the waiters who served us and personalized our stay - we'll never forget Richard, Junior and Jhoneidy. Junior and Jhoneidy did their best to teach us some Spanish and we practiced with them everyday. Jhoneidy even gave me one of his Spanish dictionaries to take home with me - what a lovely gesture! In return, I gave him a booklet that I had which could help him translate common words into six different languages. 

I would definitely recommend the Paradisus Palma Real; it's exactly what the doctor ordered, and then some!

reviews.author: rgmotta
reviews.title: Vale cada centavo!!!!
reviews.text:
Qualidade primorosa!!!
O acolhimento e qualidade diferenciados nos mínimos detalhes vão desde o check in até o check out.
TODOS os funcionários te tratam com carinho, presteza e disponibilidade de ajudar no que for preciso.
O acolhimento começa no transfer (in e out) já no aeroporto.
Pontos positivos - acomodações amplas e confortáveis - restaurantes (all inclusive) de nível internacional para todos os gostos - bebidas premium - serviço de praia impecável - um dos melhores ponto de praia da cidade, kids Zone para as crianças  é uma diversão a parte, etc...
Pontos Negativos - a volta para casa!

Funcionários do Family Concierge nota 10 - Sofia - Lady Elisabeth e Nickel
Gerencia do Resort Nota 10 - Sr. Adrian Alonso and Sr. Silvio Lantigua

reviews.author: Carla F
reviews.title: great place, excellent service!
reviews.text:
El restaurant fuego su comida y sus mesoneros: Jose Mesa, Ricardo Feliciano, Ramon Polanco y Martin hicieron de nuestras vacaciones un momento increible. 
Sin duda alguna tienen una comida exquisita, los ceviches son deliciosos..
Recomendado sin excepcion!

reviews.author: Kris J
reviews.title: Fantastic resort!
reviews.text: Brought my wife to Paradisus Palma Real for our 25th anniversary. We were wowed from the time we stepped out of our shuttle. We splurged for a Royal Service beachfront suite, which was amazing. Our butler, Carlos, had "Happy Anniversary" decorations, sparkling white wine and fresh fruit waiting for us in our room. On our actual anniversary, he had a cake and a flower petal jaccuzzi bath waiting for us after dinner. Highest praises go out to Leonardo and Francisco at the Royal Service pool and bar area. Leonardo, and his ever present smile, always went out his way to make sure you were "well hydrated". Francisco always made sure you didn't have to go to the bar. He made sure you had the beach or pool loungers/palapas you desired, and never let your drinks go dry. The Nao buffet, Rare and Palazzo also earned great reviews. We would most definitely return and recommend this resort to others.

reviews.author: DoubleD1616
reviews.title: Trip of a lifetime
reviews.text: Just came home after spending 6 days in Paradise . Paradisus is amazing and beautiful . But what stands out the most is the service! Our butler Alexander was only a phone call away at all times , he was on top of everything and made sure our stay was one we will never forget . And when it came to the beach life , Francisco Cabrera was awesome ! He took care of us our whole trip and made us feel like we were the only ones on the whole island ! We would recommend this oasis and all of its  amenities to anyone that would ask!

reviews.author: KristinDBuckwalter
reviews.title: KK and KB's getaway!
reviews.text: It was beautiful and romantic, my boyfriend Ken and I had the most amazing time together.  We went ziplining and sat at the pool.  We also spent a lot of time alone in our room.  We are sort of a secret relationship right now so we were trying to stay hidden from some other members of our group.  It was really a work trip but we made it a couples trip and even came a day early so we could be alone!!

reviews.author: Kirwin G
reviews.title: Great place. Great staff.
reviews.text:
Another wonderful stay at The Reserve in Paradisus Punta Cana. For third year in a row we've had a wonderful time. I wrote a review last year and I said The Kids Zone is the best in the world and I am even more convinced of that fact. My daughter has the best time at The Kids Zone and never wants to leave.  Berlis, Katy, Martina, Mitchelle, Virginia and Miguel are wonderful. 
The buffet meals at Gabi Beach, Naos and Gabi Club are wonderful. The pool staff at The Reserve are wonderful. I always have drink before the one I'm drinking is done. The entertainment staff of Melvin, Luis, Jabiela and Naomy were extremely nice and gave us the royal treatment. 
We definitely will be back next year if not sooner.

reviews.author: Kristina W
reviews.title: Perfectly spoiled at an excellent resort!
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently traveled here for our 10 year wedding anniversary. We had an amazing 4 nights. I wish we could have stayed longer!  The Royal Service was totally worth the extra money. We never really wanted for anything!  It was done for us, down to a perfect bubble bath with roses and a bottle of champagne one night. 
Pedro, the beach concierges, was awesome. He was by far the friendliest, most helpful person we worked with. Martin, the pool concierge, was awesome as well. They made sure we had spots everyday to sit and never let us get thirsty!  Finally, Felix at the Palooza restaurant was the best waiter I have ever had. We went back a couple other times just for him!  He was awesome!  
Overall, the resort and all the food was amazing. Loved every minute of it!

reviews.author: rebbbyfreesh
reviews.title: Best place ever!!!
reviews.text:
Luis florian .melvin conception.javiela .naomi.josias inirio 

The staff are all extremely attentive, always keep the energy high. I've been coming here for 3 years now and I love it more every year!! They treat you like family and if they're not treating you like family they're treating you like royalty. It's all inclusive which you really can take advantage of. Some highlights are free 24 hour rom service and a bar every 10 feet you walk. Kids would have a good time here, but it would be better for the parents of the kids didn't come so they can fully utilize the bars and parties haha. 
The names listed above are some of the people that really made me experience special every year. Can't wait to come back next year! Highly recommend 10/10

reviews.author: bridgestant
reviews.title: The best stay, have fun!
reviews.text: Melvin concepcion , Luis florian.javiela. We're all very wonderful and beyond helpful! Very courteous staff with smiles all the time! Easily the best week I have had up to date. Fantastic resort all around. The most beautiful place in the world, absolutely feels like paradise.

reviews.author: malloryhorowitz
reviews.title: Best place in paradises
reviews.text: Luis florian.melvin conception.maria cuello .randy Acosta. Naomi.  The staff listed previously is AMAZING and made our vacation fabulous.  THe chef at Hydro Bar Melvin Brizon was superb.  This is my third time at Paradisus.  The best of the trip was the "Actividades" was the best part.  Finger  painting was great and the staff was extremely helpful.  I loved the painting and it was so much fun.  The happiest place on earth.

reviews.author: gwochabrakCraig
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Pictures don't do it justice. Nicer in person than any review or picture. We were amazed and surprised at the quality and the beauty of this resort. We have stayed in 5 star resorts all over the world - Bali, Florida, Mexico, this was as nice or nicer than any of them.

reviews.author: 431bethw
reviews.title: Overall, Good Vacation!
reviews.text: Overall good experience.  Food was top notch.  Service at restaurants including the buffet was excellent.  There was confusion with our daily maid service.  We enjoyed the shows every night.  I truely enjoyed the pool cycle class with Gasolino.  He had a tremendous amount of energy.

reviews.author: Charles P
reviews.title: A Great Location for Activities and Events
reviews.text: One of my nieces and her husband had a destination wedding at this location, an all-inclusive resort. On the surface, it looks like an expensive venture, but like a cruise ship, most of what you'd want to do was included: meals, beaches, pools, etc. The resort is beautiful and well kept. Many with children were also at this resort which covers an area the size of several football fields. This is a luxury resort with fine dining restaurants as well as casual eateries and drink spots. The beach is full of activities parasailing to body surfing. There are also lots of swimming pools with different sizes and features, Palm trees all around the beach and resort give that tropical island feeling. Even with the activities, the trip was relaxing and yet invigorating. The rooms do vary. We had a suite with a kitchen and a very comfortable king-sized bed. A covered balcony also provided a quiet little retreat, overlooking one of several "lakes". Paradisus Palma Real is a great place to relax or play, to walk in the sand or on one of the sidewalks, to rest in the sun or under one of the many cabanas. It's the sort of resort everyone needs to visit at least once.

reviews.author: CarvalhoCA
reviews.title: Tenis Show !!!
reviews.text: 4 quadras de Tenis de saibro sintetico ( clay) e um professor super gente boa , Amby , com varias dicas para quem quer um upgrade em poucos dias. Servico de Praia legal, com garçons animados, com destaque para o Santos. Os quartos do The Reserve ficam longe da Praia, se for do Royal Service ou os normais, pode ficar perto da praia.

reviews.author: Raysa D
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: This place was amazing! Melvin Concepcion was awesome. He was part of the Animation/Entertainment crew. Super energetic and friendly. Made my husband and I feel real welcome and helped us enjoy every single night here. Luis Florian (also part of the animation/entertainment crew) was great. The entire crew made every night so much fun! Great food, great beach, great customer service. Definitely coming back. I suggest this place to anyone who wants to have a great time, lots of fun with AMAZING employees including these two gentlemen, and for anyone who wants to really enjoy their vacation.

reviews.author: mabrettell
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: We spent 5 days at the resort and loved every moment. The resort and rooms are gorgeous and the staff was wonderful.  Shakey Shakey made the afternoon at the pool a blast. Carlos Pie at the Tequila was a delight and his drinks where delicious. The food was some of the best food I have had anywhere. I hope to go back in the near future to visit again.

reviews.author: Jeri D
reviews.title: What a wonderful trip!
reviews.text: Our experience at the Paradisus in Punta Cana was wonderful.  Mostly due to the amazing staff.  No matter where we went we were taken care of in a genuinely  friendly way.  On the beach our days were taken care of by Juan and Mario, they were fast and friendly even though we had a very large group most days. Most memorably at a catered function we had a waiter named  who never let our drinks go empty. We barely had to stop dancing, and then we were at the Gabi bar where he handed us waters on the dance floor even without us asking!   I can't say enough great things about YoYo in the casino. With her wonderful smile and attitude, she made the evening so enjoyable...BOOM!!!   Our room was great no complaints. There was some construction going on in the garden areas near our rooms. It would have been beautiful to have the lagoons filled and our fountain going in the courtyard, but don't get me wrong this did not make our stay bad at all. Every staff member we encountered was just so friendly!

reviews.author: Angel L
reviews.title: Great resort !!! Unforgetable !!!
reviews.text:
Absolutely nice in every way shape or form. Beautiful grounds, friendly staff, great service, great food, fun entertainment, nice beach and our room was extremely clean.  
As a matter of fact I CAN'T WAIT TO GO BACK TO PARADISE.

reviews.author: mikecA2169GD
