reviews.text: Awesome Resort. Great Value and super friendly staff. We have been to dozens of resort all over Mexico, San Juan, St.Thomas, and Hawaii including the Grand Wailea in Maui.  The Paridsus was was my favorite and most memorable. We shall return soon!

reviews.author: harryn15
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Melvin conception, Jonathan  and Jose de la Cruz were very friendly and helpful with my kids doing the bungi at the acion  adventure.  The hotel was great and the entire staff was friendly.   We loved the food and the pool and the shows at night.  I would recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: johnkyleb
reviews.title: Paradisus Golf & Spa
reviews.text: We had an enjoyable time while a guest at the hotel..  Played golf one day and the course was fun and in good condition.  We felt the hotel and surrounding area was beautiful but the staff and the dining needed some management.

reviews.author: 893joyf
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: This resort was beautiful and had so much to offer!  The pool atmosphere was fabulous and the beach was beautiful.  The hibachi restaurant was the best meal we had and buffet had delicious food and many options to choose from!

reviews.author: Ryan Roberto
reviews.title: Wasn't worth the premium expense
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here from April 22nd- 26th in a Jr suite. Upon arrival we were assigned a room 3062, this was a 3rd floor room and the building had no elevators. The building was also far from all the central activities. After calling the front desk 3 times and getting knowhere I decided to walk back to the main lobby and request a room change. I asked for the hotel manager who was not available instead I had to deal with a front desk employee which took almost an hour of arguing to get him to change my room to one with an elevator. Then I was assigned to room 2018 which was centrally located and very close to the main lobby and restaurants. The problem with this room was the air conditioning wouldn't go below 73 degrees even though I had it set to 65. The other issue was the shower stall had constant water running and when I called the front desk to advise them of these issues I was told they would send someone to investigate. 2 days later and the water is still running in the shower and the shower valve system is loose and swinging all over the place. Now on to day 2, the family and I went for breakfast around 8 and then to the pool and beach. We arrived back to our room around 3pm to find the room cleaned but no towels or face clothes. I called the front desk who advised me they would send someone up immediately, well 90 minutes later the towels arrived. On the 3rd day the same issue occurred so I went and spoke with the front desk and they advised me there was a shortage of towels and that the laundry dept would bring me towels and face clothes ASAP. Around 4:30pm the towels arrived and my family was finally able to take a shower. When you spend $500 a night at a resort this issues are unexceptable and show be non existing however the employees advised me these are a everyday occurence. While the food is mediocre and the pool and beach is great the customer service and guest relation priorities are absent. Next stone I will stay elsewhere for $500 a night.

reviews.author: DavidLD0101
reviews.title: Second time and still amazing
reviews.text:
We just spent 10 wonderful days at the Reserve at Paradisus in Punta Cana 
We had an amazing week last year and opted for ten days this year . 
Again we were not disappointed . The weather was great , the hotel , the restaurants , and the always attentive and helpful staff made our stay so relaxing . Everything is so clean , so beautiful and has such a relaxing atmosphere 
Yessica, our concierge was amazing and so caring and helpful , Angela Mercedes and Antoni  Santana always remembered our preferences at breakfast , lunch or dinner . 
Again we were pampered and this was for all of us a truly relaxing vacation .
We took advantage of a few snorkeling excursions, awesome time and great staff who remembered us from last year . Great job Eddie. Lots of Go pro pictures . The Dolphins experience was nice also , the trainer so great but the staffs setting groups were not so friendly or helpful , separating families and friends . Disappointing . Zahiruby was sadly unhelpful and ignorant 😔

reviews.author: Brad T
reviews.title: Great people, great food, great experience
reviews.text: My wife and I and three other couples stayed here for 7 days and 6 nights.  The property and rooms are beautiful and clean.  The pool and beaches were beautiful.  The maid service and night turn down were timely and consistent.  All service and wait staff were polite and professional.  We especially enjoyed Wandy Castillo in the Naos Buffet every morning for breakfast.  He really took care of our group of eight.  He provided excellent service and greeted us by name every day.  He really made our stay personal.  He was just superb.  We took an excursion to zip line that was really fun and also went to town for a little shopping.  Even when the days were overcast it was still beautiful.  A great resort and experience - would go back in a heartbeat.  We think it would be a great honeymoon gift for our kids.

reviews.author: moaaz10
reviews.title: Simply amazing!!!!!
reviews.text:
Me and my wife visited punta cana early december 2015, weather was fantastic besides one night, pros and cons listed below:

Pros:
1. Really nice Staff!! and i mean it, they seem to be smiling ALL the time and forever ready to help.
2. Room was spotless plus we were upgraded to a suite as it was our honeymoon! the Hot tub was a real treat and the general area was immaculate too.
3. Private beach is the best in my opinion, lots of beach beds and chairs plus hammocks and a bar nearby so thats great. Plus if your a non-alcoholic like us the staff will whip up imaginative drinks. 
4. Lots of activities around like snorkling, kayaking other watersports (were to scared to do them). 
5. FREE COCONUTS (ask one of the green shirt employees with machetes)
6. Loads of restaurants but if you have taken the fully comp options not all the restaurants are included. 
7. Live music in the evenings and the shows are amazing and not to be missed. 
8. House keeping was good just remember to tip em otherwise you might find your fridge empty! I gave my guy a cigar and 10 dollars. 
9. Family concierge in the building are really helpfull... took care of my romantic evening.

Cons: 
1. This wont apply to many people but were a muslim couple and can only eat halal meat, we found it hard to find decent vegetarian food. Although the chefs are happy to take requests. 
2. I paid for a romantic evening meal on the beach, but because of the rain it didnt happen, was not refunded although they tried to give a meal in one of the paid restaurants. I think the hotel could have done a little more to compensate. 
3. Room service is slow and not good at all. 

All in all its an amazing place to visit, we loved every second of it and would go back.

reviews.author: SubGrapHR
reviews.title: A Joke of a "resort"
reviews.text:
Best part about this review is I am actually still here looking for a way to depart early despite paying in full! 

Here is the gist of the matter, we booked through Melia and via the CSR I was speaking with, we were guaranteed the "best rate". After paying, two weeks later they ran a better rate and would not honor the price difference because, get this, we paid in full. Welcome to Melia Rewards! Don't fall for it. 

That should have been the sign to run but naturally we did not want to lose our $. After calling ahead to book dinner reservations after reading some reviews, we booked all 5 nights. Upon arrival, they had no record of our reservations. Shocker. Trying to get this while here was pulling teeth and they still screwed those up. Our dinner reservation for tonight is at the wrong restaurant. The one we wanted to go to is now fully booked this unable for us to try it out. 

There is no sense of urgency in the staff and that is matched only by their ineptitude. I am writing this at 3:15p and our room has yet to be tended to for the day. When brought to their attention, they had no idea what to do. Basically if you have stayed at any all inclusive before, even Sandals, you will find this place to be a Motel 6 with restaurants. By the way, if they put you in building 39, you better enjoy early mornings because you are right next to the employee work area and pool. The employees have no regard for the level of noise they are producing. 

Bottom line, you will likely be roped in by several positive reviews but if your standard for high dollar all inclusives is anywhere mid grade or above, you will curse yourself, like I am doing currently, for paying $2k+ for something not worth half that. Pay the extra and stay at Iberostar or Hard Rock. 

I will never stay at any Melia resort ever again, especially if there is a Motel 6 nearby as at least my value expectations would be met. Book here and regret it - there are far better options in the DR.

reviews.author: Kkzaam
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma is one of the best All - Inclusive out there
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Royal Suites, which was such a nice upgrade. Loved the Royal lounge and Pool/Beach areas.  The butler was a nice touch, but we really didnt need his assistance that much.  We were traveling with a group and most of our plans were already made for us.  It was nice to have him available just in case.  They even gave us a mobile phone to use incase we needed to contact him for anything.
The grounds of the Resort are absolutely stunning!!  The Beach area is one of the best beach experiences we've ever had.  We would love to return to this location for a family trip someday.

reviews.author: ckpradhan57
reviews.title: A great week at The Reserve with the family.
reviews.text: Carefully managed and well behaved staff who left no stone unturned to feel us happy at all the times.  Lots of sun and fun in the beautiful beach and the swimming pools. Yesica Reyes was there to guide us to variety of dining places and the bar staff always happy and willing to let us enjoy the drinks.   We are already talking of going back again nexy year.

reviews.author: eze300
reviews.title: Slightly underachieving,  but worth a 2nd try
reviews.text: My wife and I visited the Reserve at Punta Cana last year.  At arrival,  the greeting is pleasant but drawn out as the staff incorporates timeshare presentation with check-in.  After a long day of travel,  just get the guests to their room.  Everyone was nice and the resort grounds are  clean  and beautiful.   When we arrived at our room we were dissatisfied.   The room was in disrepair in the bathroom and sitting area.   I called the front desk and spoke to Elvis about the condition of the room.  I expressed that the cost didn't match the room.  He came for a  personal inspection.   He agreed with my assessment and asked if I could give him an hour.  He returned in 40 mins and asked if I'd accompany him to inspect a different room.  This room was an upgrade which was more than satisfactory.   He made a call and had our bags brought to our room in 15 mins.  He apologized for the inconvenience and excused himself.  Over the next 5 days,  he appeared wherever we were and insured that we were happy.   He had champagne and fruit assortments delivered to our room on 2 occasions and had a rose petal bubble bath drawn in our room.  It was a nice bounce back from the initial underachieving.   The restaurants are very good,  especially the steakhouse. The beaches are nice and the drink service is great! Live entertainment takes place daily,  but isn't pushy or juvenile.   Resort is big,  but they have shuttle buses running frequently.   The Reserve is a resort within the resort and has a little more privacy and preferences.   I thought it worth the couple of hundred bucks.  Overall,  this is one of the better resorts in Punta Cana,  but remember that popularity creates high volume which creates wear and tear.   The staff makes up for the mgt underachieving.   We are going back in August 2016 to see if they have improved.

reviews.author: CANDLELADYPA
reviews.title: Will never go back
reviews.text: Food was horrible. I found myself eating lunch meat and cheese for breakfast and pizza for lunch and dinner. Even the fruit was tasteless. During my 4 day and 3 night stay, the electricity went out twice. There was no hot water in the shower. Staff was not friendly

reviews.author: Vanessa T
reviews.title: Bon complexe
reviews.text: Super bon complexe! Les chambres sont belles, les installations aussi! Très dommage car le complexe est loin de la plage (7 minutes a pied) le service à la plage, dan sa section réservé est très lent! Vous êtes mieux d'aller chercher vos drink vous même ! Même chose à la piscine, il devrait y avoir plus de serveur! La plage et la piscine, rien à dire sur les installations c'était parfait. La nourriture est bonne mais le matin le buffet c'est toujours la même chose. En gros c'est un bon complexe mais sans plus.

reviews.author: dtsleighton
reviews.title: Felt like Royals!
reviews.text: I want to thank or private butler,  Jose Salvador for his attention last week on our vacation.  He was friendly and warm.  He did not hover but provided just the right attention.  He was quick to respond to our calls and always helpful.

reviews.author: Torre de Pizza
reviews.title: Increible
reviews.text:
Trato excelente, buena comida y servicio, el resort es una maravilla, tranquilo, bien cuidado, silencioso, decorado como un paraíso oriental, lo recomiendo al 200%
La playa es muy bonita, Gabi beach perfecto para pasar el día en las tumbonas con buena música y tomando algún cocktail

reviews.author: Deanna S
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: I went there for my wedding and it was all I could hope for and more. The resort is top notch , the beach us beautiful, food is great with excellent presentation. Do not hesitate to book, luxurious resort. Would recommend doing the royal service, worth every penny (separate private beach, amazing restaurant, separate pool and access to hydrotherapy)

reviews.author: JORGINHO2009
reviews.title: El hotel ideal para disfrutar las vacaciones
reviews.text: Un hotel donde te tratan con una excelente atención y en especial Melvin Concepción de Actividades se encarga de poner la chispa con su entusiasmo y hace que los huéspedes se sientan augusto durante la estadía y en la Fiesta Latina José rules

reviews.author: bren0981
reviews.title: Latin Night!
reviews.text: This is a great vacation resort. Melvin, Luis, Naomi and staff are so nice and helpful! They made our stay that much more fun and relaxing all at the same time! The wine tasting event was great and Aqua, the Italian restaurant on the property is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sofia G
reviews.title: Paraíso en la tierra
reviews.text: Melvin Concepción el mejor en Actividades de Animación no sólo clases de Baile, Preparación de Velas y también Luis Florian en los bailes pegaditos de bachatas  y full música Latina con este par diversión asegurada durante toda tu estadía 👍🏻

reviews.author: Nicole D
reviews.title: First time 😊
reviews.text: This was our first visit to the Dominican Republic Punta Cana and we had the best service. The resort was awesome the restaurants were excellent. Our favorites were Vento and Fuego. The waiters at Fuego made both or lunch and dinner experience one to remember. Jesus Evangelista from Vento was an awesome waiter. Visit M-bar for the best bar and bartender. Starky from the M-bar makes the best Mojitos and is always there to serve you something new 🍹. This will not be our last visit here that is for sure. Thank you Everyone at Palma Real for making our visit memorable.

reviews.author: MissMeredith
reviews.title: Amazing Royal Service Team Members!
reviews.text: I would like to thank Martin Tineo and Jheuri (our butler) for providing excellent service and making our trip so relaxing and memorable! Everyday they saved us our favorite cabana - we had no worries that it wouldn't be available for us. They brought my friend "el flotador" to take out into the ocean and made sure it stayed with us and didn't disappear to another guest! And then Martin brought me a bottle of champagne for my birthday! Wow over the top!! Jheuri was so kind to share some of his experiences growing up in the Dominican and really showed us how much he loves his country. He surprised us every morning with where he had made dinner reservations for us that night and kept our room fully stocked of our beverage choices at all times. We can't wait to come back to this resort - it was an amazing experience from beginning to end!

reviews.author: Sean M
reviews.title: A nice resort.
reviews.text: The resort is a nice resort and a beautiful beach. Plenty of water sports and chairs available. The resort has a nice layout and entertainment at night is nice. You can hang near the beach at a nice lounge area or step it up and hit the dance club. The food is hit or miss. You need to be choosy at the buffet. Some choices are good and some are bad. The service at the resort can be a little more friendly. The staff is not as engaging especially in the restaurants. I would recommend upgrading to their reserve service if you are looking for a little more attention and pampering.

reviews.author: debra f
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.text:
Beautiful, very well maintained resort! Early, every morning workers were scrubbing the inside of every inch of the Reserve pool. The entire resort was immaculate and beautiful. 
The staff at the Reserve was very helpful, nice and accommodating!
Nicia, our concierge was so nice. Juan the Reseve bartender took excellent care of us. Jasson made checking out as easy as possible. Wonder kept us hydrated at the Reserve pool. 
The beach is beautiful with plenty of shady "huts" with comfortable lounge beds. There were also several accommodating bar areas and beach waiters. 
We hope to return again!

reviews.author: Monica P
reviews.title: Muito bom, mas pela fama tem muito a melhorar!!!
reviews.text:
O resort realmente é maravilhoso, passamos dias deliciosos em Bávaro!!
Resort  enorme com uma piscina gigantesca e restaurantes muito bons... Não gostei do Japonês onde nos serviram yakimeshi (arros com ovo), espetinho de camarão e isca de frango, muito decepcionante!!!! Os quartos estão precisando de reforma e modernização! Já a reserva é maravilhosa luxo e conforto!!! Porem fica muito longe da praia, os shows são fraquinhos. Tem muita insistência para aquisição do programa de férias, isso é péssimo!!! No mais é muito limpo, organizado, cheiroso e cheio de mimos com os hospedes...

reviews.author: dsmeli75
reviews.title: Excellent Resort and Vacation!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for 5 nights and upgraded to the Royal Service, highly recommend this upgrade.  Our Butler, Angelo was excellent, he was always very attentive and helpful throughout our stay.  The entire staff was very friendly and welcoming, I would like to give special thanks to our bar tenders, Leonardo and Angel at the private Royal Service bar.  Also Martin was great in always being sure we had whatever we needed while we were at the beach and pool.

reviews.author: RCasil
reviews.title: Great hotel, friendly  staff, but not well organized
reviews.text: Stayed 3 nights and 4 days in a golf vacation - beautiful  facilities and most of the staff were friendly. Rooms are nice but could use a remodel. Food was above average at the Buffett but not as good at the only restaurant that we could make reservations (Mediterranean). The main opportunity was the reservation process that they use for the restaurants. We have to insist about 3 or 4 times per day to be able to get reservation for 7 people. Also, several restaurants were closed for guests apparently for private events. I encourage all visitors to try to make their reservations the first day when they arrive, you will have a higher probability to eat at the best restaurants. I probably will be back, but I hope they organize the reservation process better.

reviews.author: Emma L
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: This is my first time at this resort and it is very nice. The people who worked at the hotel were all very nice and helpful. I loved Luis florian and Javiela Alvarado .maximo Vedanta.they are the best people around the hotel. I had a fantastic vacation.

reviews.author: Kristen K
reviews.title: Wonderful resort!
reviews.text: We had royal reserve and our butler Jeuri was amazing! He made our dinner reservations, massage appointments, answered all our questions and even left daily snacks/treats in our room. Also Marino P. At the hibachi bar was very helpful. We were sad to leave after getting such exceptional service.

reviews.author: sunworshipper
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text:
We used our RCI timeshare toward this 1-week stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We were very pleased with the accommodations and service. 

We upgraded to Family Concierge and we're glad we did it. Luis Amarante was our butler - he was awesome. My kids loved him - he spent lots of time teaching them Spanish and took care of all our needs. We hope to see you next year, Luis. Elizabeth Perez from Family Concierge helped arrange our schedule and worked with Luis to provide fun surprises for us all week. They are an awesome team. Thanks also to Mery Rosa at the front desk. 

Family concierge means getting a cell phone to call your butler anytime - we were picked up and shuttled around at a moment's notice. Reservations for dinner were made for us, we had access to the reserve beach area and cabanas were reserved for us at the pool or beach, our choice. I will say once or twice we changed plans - you lose your reserved cabana if you aren't there by 10am - but we always managed to find a place to sit at the pool or beach. 

The resort is huge, restaurants were good (some better than others. Didn't like the Italian place food wise though service was good.) We liked Mole for Mexican. Loved Bana - the kids enjoyed the hibachi. Gabi is the go-to for breakfasts and lunches when we used the pool - buffet. Overall lots of variety, we were happy. The fresh juice bar at Gabi is awesome. Special thanks to Sija Aquino and Mallelin Escarfulier(spelling?) at Gabi for awesome service and taking care of the kids!! 

We found the rooms comfortable and well-appointed. It can be damp - it's tropical, so to be expected. The grounds are immaculate. We saw other hotels when we went on excursions - were happy to be where we were. Many resorts seem to be more motel-like. This is high end, really a lovely place. 

Excursions can be easily planned by Otium by Gabi. Andres was our rep. He put together our dolphin excursion (awesome but $$$) and Caribbean Pirates cruise (amazing value, great show, must-do if you have kids).  

Fantastic first Dominican Republic experience. We can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Bjkjwickham
reviews.title: Loved every moment and everything
reviews.text: Stayed 7 nights at the Paradisus in Punta Cana   and it was fun, romantic, entertaining, and restful!! The food was great and the service at all the restaurants was attentive and engaging. The beaches were beautiful and The pool staff was awesome and engaging.  Thank you Argensis!!!

reviews.author: _afonso86
reviews.title: Fenomenal
reviews.text: Férias inesquecíveis neste belo resort. Um verdadeiro paraíso!!! Ótimas condições, excelentes espaço balnear com ótimas piscinas e uma localização mesmo em cima da areia. Se existe um lugar a repetir nesta vida... é o paradisus palma real.

reviews.author: Michelle R
reviews.title: Wedding weekend
reviews.text: We came here for a friends wedding and loved every minute! The accommodations, food, activities and staff were all amazing! Special thanks to Argenis de Lis Santos, Jensy Rijo, Santo Polanco, Juan Cruz, Luis Parra, and Andino Jimenez for their friendly service :)

reviews.author: Grace G
reviews.title: Great vacation thanks to the beach staff...
reviews.text:
The beach staff, particularly Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez and Santos Frias, Jose Reyes turned our stressed mood into the vacation we well deserved. Thanks guys it was a truly amazing week because of you! 

My fav restaurants Vento (thumbs up to the chef) and Bana/Teppanyaki delicious...

reviews.author: kzip2016
reviews.title: Wonderful family vacation!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for spring break.  We took our two children, ages 5 and 8, and overall thought that the experience was worth the expense.  

Sandra was our family concierge, and she was a delight.  She helped us with everything that we needed.  She moved our room after we were originally placed next door to a family with a baby who cried all night (poor mom and dad!).  She took care of all of our reservations for the pool and the beach, and we were always in a good spot.  She treated our children like royalty, surprising them with a balloon-filled bubble bath one night, putting lots of little gifts on their bed the first night, and delivering candy-scented pillows.  She also treated Mom and Dad to a couple bottles of wine and fruit.  Sandra was always accessible, very kind, and just made our experience that much better.

The pool at the Reserve was great - not very crowded compared to the pool at the main resort, and the palapas were a dream.  Unfortunately, spending the morning at the pool resulted in many, many  mosquito bites despite bug spray, which was not only concerning but also ultimately uncomfortable.  We preferred the beach, with its gorgeous palapas, big waves and soft sand.   The restrooms in the common areas were also clean and nice.

The reason we wouldn't give the resort 5 stars is because of the food.  The buffets were plentiful but mediocre.  We often had to put in special requests for food that the kids would eat, and while the staff was very accommodating, it took a long time and even then it was just OK.  The drinks at the pool and the beach were OK, although it was difficult to detect any alcohol in some of them and they were typically not frozen by the time they were delivered.  The restaurants were better, and we enjoyed the Mexican and Italian restaurants.  

Overall, we had a great time as a family and would consider returning if we want a similar experience in the future.

reviews.author: danaraeg
reviews.title: Service at Palazzo
reviews.text:
We have been extremely happy overall with our stay here, but last nights dinner was our most enjoyable meal yet! My boyfriend and I have been in the restaurant business for over 15 years, and we appreciate good food and good service. Last night we ate at Palazzo, a restaurant offered to Royal Service guests. We had been there a few nights before, and Richard had taken care of us. Last night, as we entered, he greeted us with a warm welcome, and went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction during our dinner. His service is excellent, and his personality is even better. He goes above and beyond to ensure all guests are satisfied. From the first course to last, he does not miss a beat. Richard from Palazzo gets an A+ in our book. 

Dana and Louis

reviews.author: Andrew R
reviews.title: Spectacular resort, excellent staff and service
reviews.text: This resort was truly a vacation paradise. Rooms were outstanding, beach was beautiful  and the staff was fantastic and were good with our kids especially Gasolina, spending time with our kids with water spinning, dance lessons and the dance party at night. Every night was a different theme and show which was fun especially the Micheal Jackson Show. Restraunts were 5 star but you must reserve times the day you arrive. I will definitely recommend to friends and family. Is definitely on my list of vacation resorts to return to.

reviews.author: annakY9152XB
reviews.title: Raj na ziemi
reviews.text: Gorąco polecam ten hotel. Dla osób lubiących wyśmienitą kuchnię, pięknie serwowane posiłki, dobre drinki. Można poczuć się jak w raju. Super obsługa, b.miła i pomocna szczególnie na plaży ;). Bardzo fajne wieczorne dyskoteki w barze na plaży - polecam!

reviews.author: Thomas L
reviews.title: Had a great time, could have been better
reviews.text: It was nice, had fun, but could have been better. The beaches are beautiful! Limited variety of alcohol choices but after a while it was fine. Food is very bland and tasted the same after a few days, Rooms were very nice, beds are great, room service was off and on. The pools are great, especially at the reserve. Service is outstanding at the reserve, not so much at the main resort. Entertainment so-so. You must go on some excursions other wise the resort gets to be old, beach, pool, bar and do it all over again. If you can upgrade to the royal service and stay at the reserve do so. Its not right on the beach, but its less crowed and much better service. May go again, unsure at this time

reviews.author: lorithorn
reviews.title: Paradise everyday
reviews.text: We were at the Reserve from March 29th to April 5th .  It was Paradise everyday.  From the moment we got there till the time we left.  Travel usually every year was the best resort we have been too.  Absolutely beautiful property, extremely friendly staff, the rooms are beautiful, room service was awesome, Angie, Anui and Hilario looked after us with whatever we needed in the room.  We needed water, they brought us a case not just a couple bottles.  Dined for breakfast and lunch at the Gabi Club, tried the other buffets but this one was the best.  Estefany, Janna, Yaritza, Antony, Celso, Paola all looked after everything we needed, didn't even have to ask always a very warm welcome.  Loved all the food in the buffet and was so nice having all the labels to know for sure what everything was.  Excellent quality food, no mystery meats. Ramon did an outstanding job at the lunch grill at the pool.  All the pool boys were amazing looking after everyone around the pool "drinky drinky" anytime.  Sugar Ray and Naomi Campbell did an excellent job with the activities.  Quite enjoyed wine tasting with Naomi and doing pool aerobics with Sugar Ray.  All the restaurants were delicious, we went to the grill twice it was so good.  Really enjoyed the lobby in the evening always lots of seating and excellent bartenders, quite enjoyable to talk to.  We would definitely return to "Paradise" again.

reviews.author: Jonatas R
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and stay
reviews.text: My wife and I have spent 4 days at Paradisus Palma Real. We select the royal service, which gives you a exclusive service "mordomo" during your stay. Besides this the service has a special pool, beach service, exclusive restaurant and lounge. The stay was one of my best in a beach resort.

reviews.author: Yessica L
reviews.title: Valió la pena cada centavo, muy buen servicio!!!
reviews.text: Estuvimos visitando este maravilloso resort a principio de abril por motivos de mi cumpleaños atrasados, mi novio y yo estuvimos en el Royalton services donde tuvimos un mayordomo que más que eso fue nuestro amigo, cada día nos sorprendía con algo diferente, fresas con chocolates,  plato de frutas o una decoración en el jacuzzi,definitivamente excedió nuestras expectativas y los chicos de la playa muy servicial, los restaurantes maravillosos,los que pude visitar,lo único que no nos gustó del hotel fue nuestro poco tiempo que duramos en él... Alvaro Fernández volveremos pronto por ti :) gracias por todo!!!

reviews.author: Madison L
reviews.title: beautiful paradise
reviews.text: Luis florian, Raynol Tamayo. Beautiful place, every one is very welcoming and there is lots to do during the day, lots of activities. would definitely recommend coming here and definitely want to come back, thanks to Raynol and Luis I had lots of fun!

reviews.author: Freedom570603
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Staying here now. Make sure you sign up for MELIA rewards if you stay here. They value their members very much. Signed up before hand and were taken to vip immediately. We requested a second floor and it was not met- the amazing service Agent kenia was so gracious and changed our room- even met us there to ensure everything was okay. She later upgraded us to the royal service restaurant for our birthday celebrations. 
The pool is beautiful and jensey rijo & santo Polanco provided us with the best service and drinks promptly all day! 
The language barrier is extremely hard but staff are eager to learn. Never try to call guest services they don't know anything and hung up on me three times as If they did not know the answers to my questions 

Would come again for sure! The beach is beautiful and so are the grounds

reviews.author: Ludhiana Paiva Tessarollo
reviews.title: Delicioso!
reviews.text: Eu e meu marido fomos em Lua de Mel, e tivemos uma experiencia incrível! O hotel é maravilhoso e até hoje nos lembramos do melhor risoto do mundo que comemos no Gabi Club!!! Era de cogumelos, e o detalhe é meu marido não gosta de nenhum cogumelo! Mas concorda que foi o melhor de todos!! Recomendamos a todos que conhecemos...

reviews.author: Dickson C
reviews.title: Paradisus é o paraíso.
reviews.text: O Paradisus Resort é sensacional. Para aqueles que desejam ir à Punta Cana e querem um local diferenciado, com serviços exclusivos, todas as suas vontades atendidas, ótima comida, instalações novas e o melhor do "all inclusive", este é o lugar. Ah, quem puder, contrate o serviço do mordomo. Ele vai fazer quase tudo por você: do check in às reservas de restaurantes e passeios, e há vários bons no Paradisus, enquanto você desfruta das bebidas na praia. O mordomo que nos atendeu foi o Eriberto: superatencioso e desenrolado. E no bar da praia, procurem pelo Jeremias, sempre solícito. Boa viagem!

reviews.author: lfdv2016
reviews.title: Welcoming staff, spectacular beach and relaxing resort!
reviews.text: Although rooms are dated they are spacious and inviting. Our king bed was wonderfully comfortable. Housekeeping was efficient and friendly. Room service was as expected and timely. We especially loved our breakfasts poolside with Wandy Castillo who greeted us every morning with hot coffee and a welcoming smile. He treated us with great hospitality and exceptional service! Fabulous pool and best of all, beautiful wide white sandy beach! A lovely relaxing getaway to paradise!

reviews.author: Nya N
reviews.title: Un reve eveillé
reviews.text: Sejour debut mars, l' hotel est a couper le souffle, aucun point negatif. Le buffet est de loin le meilleur que j'ai eu, vu sur la piscine. Il n'y avait pas grand monde pour notre plus grand bonheur. Je reve d'y retourner!

reviews.author: K3521JCjohnf
reviews.title: Punta Cana for family Spring Break
reviews.text:
Our overall experience was fantastic and we'd probably go back. The Paradisus resorts have a very cool vibe, from the lighting to the music to the decor, we feel it is definitely a step above and the brand tries a little harder then its competitors. We are actually vacation club members with a different brand and chose to forego staying there because we prefer the Paradisus experience. A special thanks goes out to Luis Diaz, the bartender at the swim-up bar.

If I'm being honest I have one comment and one critique. The comment is that the complex is huge when considered as part of the overall property that includes The Reserve. We have kids, 9 and 7, and they went to the Kid's Zone daily. The Kid's Zone is at The Reserve which is, but really isn't, walk-able so you have to grab one of the golf cart shuttles. The shuttles run constantly, but we made four round trips daily - drop off for morning activities, pick up to go swimming (the Kid's Zone pool is only 8 inches deep which is great for babies, but not our kids), drop off for afternoon/evening activities like rock climbing and trampoline, final pick up for dinner & the show. Each round trip takes at least 20 minutes and that's if you have the hang of it. It is what it is and The Kind's Zone is really spectacular, but an hour and a half of "commuting" detracted from the experience. Also, some rooms can be very far away from the center of the resort so when you check in you should look at your room location in relation to the beach/pool/restaurants. We didn't and our room was pretty far away. Again, the property is very large so getting your bearings early on is imperative to your enjoyment.

My critique is the lack of group athletic activities or maybe not the lack of activities, but the lack of the activity staff getting people involved. There are defiantly activities - dance lessons, cigar rolling, paddle board yoga, vollyball - but since the property seems to cater to weddings and other large groups that know each other, there didn't seem like there was much of an effort by the staff to get people involved. This is a very small critique.  

Overall, a spectacular property and a great experience.

reviews.author: Sherita14
reviews.title: BEST EXPERIENCE! Great Resort, Very Relaxing, Amazing Staff! Highly Recommended!
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience!! The beach was gorgeous! We did tons of excursions including the Floating Spa, Speed Boats, Snuba Diving, 90 min massage (best I've ever had) and more. As a Royal Service guest we had the luxury of receiving top notch service all around. Our butler, Samuel Rodriguez was extraordinary! He was extremely attentive, helpful, suggestive, kind, professional, and he set up our dinner reservations every evening. We were pretty low maintenance but his attentiveness was much appreciated. 

We ate breakfast most mornings at the Palazzo restaurant (best dinner spot) which was much better than the general buffet. The entire staff there was amazing but two people stood out the most. The hostess Zenovia made us smile every single day! We would literally chat it up and laugh with her for several minutes every morning before being seated. She has such a welcoming personality and is a pleasure to be around. Richard was our server for most days and although we always opted for the buffet, he still managed to make sure we were taken care of. I couldn't take more than two steps away from the buffet without him generously taking my plate from hand and dancing his way to my table to place it down...every time! Such a remarkable personality!

"Shaky, Shaky" is hilariously entertaining (you'll know what I mean when you go) and Carlos was extremely helpful. 

I could go on and on but I digress. My overall experience was fabulous! I would recommend this resort to anyone. My only issues were the lack of authentic food and the lack of variety pertaining to late night entertainment (i.e. bars, clubs, etc). But that wouldn't stop me from returning!

reviews.author: ROMUALDA R
reviews.title: Pleasant Vacation
reviews.text:
First and foremost, I booked my stay at the last minute, and did not know how segregated the resort was until we arrived. Be aware that guests who choose more expensive packages will not only have better rooms, but also different wrist bands, preferential treatment, and access to "exclusive" areas.

Overall, the vacation was satisfactory and I would recommend this resort to a friend. However, I will be focusing more on the negative aspects of the trip. 

 We were checked in quickly, and the hotel grounds were beautiful. Upon arriving to our room ( a junior garden-view suite), we were surprised at how spacious it was. However, the layout brought my family closer, in all the wrong ways. There was a window between the bathroom and main room, and the lack of privacy made taking a bath or changing an uncomfortable experience. This would not be an issue for couples, but for families it may be. On a more positive note, the room was cleaned twice a day- once in the morning, and then once in the evening.

The main buffet restaurant was very nice, and had a great mix of food. The pizza in particular exceeded my expectations, and my husband enjoyed having lobster in the evening.  Making reservations to the other restaurants was difficult, which seems to be the case in many Dominican resorts. I don't quite understand why this system is in place, as I have stayed in other tropical resorts where walk-ins were welcome and it never resulted in any issues. 

The pool and beach were well-maintained, no complaints there. I would always go to a yoga class in the morning on the beach, and it was situated in a very sunny/hot area, which made it less relaxing. The activities provided for guests were otherwise great, and all of the staff seemed genuinely invested in getting everyone to have a fun time. 

At night, they held evening shows for the guests. The best performance was definitely the acrobatic one. Just when you thought it could not get more extreme, they came back with more jaw-dropping moves.

There were a lot of small things that made the Paradisius experience great: passing the flamingos on your way to the gym, getting a coconut fresh from a palm tree, sipping margaritas under a straw umbrella, the small chocolates your maid would leave you before bedtime. I do not regret choosing this resort.

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Paradisus is real slice of Paradise
reviews.text: My wife and I spend five great days & nights at Paradisus Palma Real and enjoyed every aspect of this magnificent resort. The grounds were manicured ,the beach was spacious & exciting the variety of bars and cafes were great for a variety of drinking and dining experiences. Some special servers we enjoyed interacting with were Davidson , Horacio & Clairebell : all made the dining experience extraordinary. amazing service and attention to detail. We would highly recommend Paradisus to anyone. W

reviews.author: tom and julie m
reviews.title: Pure Paradise
reviews.text: Second time at resort; fabulous! We upgraded to Royal Service this year...great for couples. Shout out to beach/pool employees Pedro, Angel and Francisco. Always attentive and took care of our beach needs every day. Perfect weather, restaurants and their staff were exceptional. Felix and Franklin at Olio could not do enough for us...complete with hugs and kisses on arrival at breakfast and dinner. The hostess, Melania, at the Japanese restaurant helped us change our reservation time at that restaurant and at Rare steakhouse. She worked at Fuego during they day and made it a point to inform the night hostess to help seat us on our last night. Kathy at Fuego in the evening was exceptional as well. The quality of food, the drinks, the staff, the concern of all the employees is outstanding.

reviews.author: sps34dfs
reviews.title: Would go back tomorrow
reviews.text: The room was spacious with a good size patio with a garden view.  Service was quite good and very member of the staff was quite friendly.  The grounds are well maintained and our stay was very relaxing.  We highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Ladyfish76
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this resort. The grounds are beautiful tropical gardens throughout the whole resort. Also a great value many restaurants something for everyone's taste. The rooms are very nice. The pools are magnificent,The service is first class from the minute to check in the beaches are magnificent and water is blue as the sky that is where we spend our days relaxing. The service on the reserve beach is great thanks to Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez
Santos Friars & Benita Meraedez . They will do everything they can to make your experience at the beach special at the same time make you feel special. They work very hard getting you towels, drinks all your beach needs. We have been coming to this resort for 20 years and we keep returning because the great experience and people like I just mentioned. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: ritadeas
reviews.title: First time in DR want to go back!
reviews.text:
We were in the Royal Service area of this beautiful resort and our personal butler Miguel made our stay even more special.  His attention to details, help with reservations, and overall hospitality really represent the way everyone made us feel.  Highly recommend this property and definitely want to return with the whole family.

If you can swing for Passion, the only restaurant not part of the all-inclusive I would also encourage their tasting menu.  Food was delicious and service with Sergio and Marcos outstanding.

reviews.author: Angela G
reviews.title: Awesome Caribbean all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: Spectacular venue with fabulous and courteous service. Many choices for on- and off-site activities, casino, boutique, spa, lovely and comfortable rooms with nice resident buildng sutuated around a serene natural setting with water feature. Didn't feel like a hotel but rather a luxury apartment complex. Pools are numerous and there is a Reserve area for privacy. Beach accommodations include tiki canopies with table over beach lounge chairs and complimentary bar service. You can choose to be as active or restful as you wish. Room service good and timely. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Lack if understanding English made it difficult to make reservations.
reviews.text: We liked the the hotel and location the weather was great but they have an English barrier and it made us have issues a couple of times . We were there 5 nights, three out of the five nights our reservations not being done right. Due to someone in the process not knowing what we were asking for.my friend had a butler that came with their room which they really enjoyed , but he was the one that made all our reservations for dinner and like I said before three out of the five nights our reservations were not there when we went to the restaurant . I would have thought  he spoke their lanuage and how could it get messed up?? Well it still did. Very disappointing !!

reviews.author: clyde p
reviews.title: Food Poison
reviews.text: After traveling all day to get there, had to wait 3-hours for the room and also with an attitude at desk.Beautiful room and view. Second nite at Rare Rest. food poisoning.So very sick rest of trip.All together, foods were terrible. Odd looking meats and dark color. Cold soup.Never will go there again, unless I like being sick.Many other people also had food poisoning.

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: This trip was really great.   We traveled with a few more friends than usual and we all had a blast.   The new Naos restaurant is awesome.   Food from all restaurants was very good .  Everyone is always so friendly and helpful.   We met alot of nice people on this trip.   As always, the staff goes above and beyiond.   I would like to give a special shout out to some of the staff that really outdone themselves....Shaky Shaky,  you rock., Luis Peguero, Caramelo, Beyonce and at the pool bar, Luis Diaz and Leonardo Moto.   These people make your trip so much more fun.   Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Rudy P
reviews.title: Family Vacation With Baby
reviews.text:
I usually don't write a review after visiting a tropical destination;  however we're half way through our vacation and I'm compelled to mention how fantastic our stay has been.

We're travelling with our nine month old daughter and our concern was making sure we had enough shade at the beach.  Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez, Jose De Los Santos, Santos Frias made sure we had a shady palapa every day for our little one.  No need to get up to reserve - the Palapa was always waiting for us. Benita Mercedes  at the beach bar made sure we never went without a drink.

We will certainly come back here for our next vacation.

reviews.author: Lacy B
reviews.title: Enjoy
reviews.text: RAYNOLD Tamayo is a great host and really made sure we had an awesome time! The Melia Paradisis The Reserve was luxurious and peaceful! The best vacation ever! And entertainment guys they are very good thanks for all guys we come back guys ..,

reviews.author: marisolc975
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay, staff was super friendly. Headphones went missing from room and we did find an employee in our closet when he was supposed to be refilling drinks. Lost total sense of security and trust in staff.

reviews.author: sh02131
reviews.title: Loving the reserve!
reviews.text:
Luis is treating us so well! Thebeach is gorgeous and the huts are a nice way to enjoy the breeze. Coco locos are the best!!
Reinold has been a pleasure too. All the staff are friendly and helpful. I look forward to coming back next year. The breakfast buffet at The Reserve has everything you'd want.

reviews.author: Kik54
reviews.title: Le paradis à l'état pur
reviews.text: Séjour inoubliable dans un décor de rêve, tout est parfait : propreté de l'hôtel dans les moindres recoins, aussi bien intérieurs qu'extérieurs, qualité et quantité des services proposés, confort de la chambre et des matelas de plage, aménagement au top des bords de la piscine et du bord de mer, possibilité de diner chaque soir dans un restaurant à thème différent, animation pour ados et jeunes adultes, personnel très sympathique, très poli, très serviable et aux petits soins, en particulier Anthony Cid, l'un des serveur que l'on a rencontré au Gabi Club et au Vento, Jasson de la réception et notre concierge Melissa. En bref, tout est conçu pour passer un séjour extraordinaire. A recommander !

reviews.author: NorthStar640605
reviews.title: Great place!!!
reviews.text: Me and my family stayed a week here and absolutely loved it!! We had great service and a wonderful agent, Yessica she was so nice and caring. Thank you Yessica!! If you are planning to go here I absolutely recommend coming here!!! Thank you The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana !!

reviews.text:
Mal. Nada más entrar nos dieron una habitación usada después de 12 horas de viaje

reviews.author: Sequana J
reviews.title: Very Relaxing
reviews.text: I really enjoyed myself on this trip. Relaxing on the beach was all I needed. The staff at the Paradisus was exceptional. Everyone was very friendly and extremely accommodating. I have to give a huge shout out to Argenis Rijo, a server in the Naos Buffet. Oh my goodness, he made me want to stay at the resort forever. My friend and I sat in his section every time we ate breakfast and lunch. He always had our drink orders ready when we sat down and checked back in on us constantly. He always put pretty flowers on our table for us. Oh and Shaky Shaky (from entertainment) was extremely helpful as well. They both really seem to love their jobs. I really also loved the night entertainment. The Micheal Jackson and Lion King shows were fantastic! Oh my goodness and the casino. I won so much money using the free slot vouchers that the young lady kept giving out from playing bingo. It was great! The only negative I had (and why I didn't give 5 stars for service) is because of the housekeeper. For whatever reason our lady forgot to restock at least one item every single day (towel, wash cloth, hand towel). It was pretty insane. It got to be a little funny after awhile. Besides that everything was awesome!

reviews.author: MichelleMarc2102
reviews.title: Spectacular Wedding Experience!!
reviews.text:
We spent 10 nights and 11 amazing days at Paradisus Punta Cana.  6 nights at the main hotel and 4 nights at the The Reserve for our honeymoon.

I'll start by saying that planning a destination wedding is a stressful experience!  Picking the location is the most difficult part.  We spent months trying to determine what location would be the best fit for us.  It is not easy to find reviews just on the wedding services.  

After a lot of thought, we decided on Paradisus Punta Cana and could not be happier with our decision.  Although some things were not clear and some things were more money than we expected, the overall experience was well worth it.  We had a large group to make happy - many of them experienced travelers.  When we walked down the beach and saw the other hotels, we knew we picked the right one!  

I have to give a shout out to Annabel Gonzalez.  She was our on site wedding coordinator.  Another shout out to Allison who was also amazing!  She was our US contact.  She handled everything up until the final weeks.  Questions were answered in a timely manner and even though I asked the same questions over and over she was very patient with me.  

Once we arrived at the resort, Annabel had everything figured out and all the plans and details were laid out for us.  Upon arrival, we were upgraded to a nicer room.  We stayed at the main resort because we had a lot of family and 4 kids 18 and under.  We were given a butler who tended to our needs and concerns.  Annabel made reservations for us and for our group for every night we were there.  That was a HUGE relief.  After our family left, we were upgraded to the most beautiful suite at THE RESERVE.  We are preparing a separate review of the resort in general.  

Our photographer, Lala, was also on site.  She was great!  Wasted no time, and captured many beautiful memories.  I really enjoyed working with her and I loved the pictures!

The flowers were gorgeous!  Top notch - and very elegant.  Cake as well!  Gorgeous!

The spa on site did my hair and make up.  I wish I could remember who did them, but I was a nervous bride.  She was sweet and patient and very professional.  I was very happy with the result.  

As for the wedding  -- it was amazing and beautiful.  Everything went very smooth and the amazing weather certainly helped.  The ceremony was on the beach and the reception was at the Pool.  It exceeded our expectations.  We ordered a buffet and there was more food than we needed!  And the quality of the food was fabulous.  We are foodies, so that is a huge compliment.  From start to finish, I felt like a Princess and was treated very kindly and with patience and respect.  I could not recommend a better place for our wedding.  

Thank you Paradisus!  I will definitely recommend your resort.

reviews.author: willow73
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT! AMAZING PROPERTY!  AUTHENTIC FOOD AND EXCELLENT SERVICE!
reviews.text:
First time in Punta Cana and first time at Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  Room was clean and spacious.  Garden View 3rd Floor.  Not a bad walk from the main lobby and pool area.  No bugs in sight for the whole trip.  Clean towels, stocked fridge, great turn-down service.  

Pool and food/restaurant options were excellent!  We ate different food every day (and we really only ate at the "buffet"!).   Our server at breakfast and lunch was hard working and remembered our favorites even though he had hundreds of guests to manage I'm sure!  His name was Davidson Germain!  The food choices were fresh (particularly the fish).  The fruits and smoothies were delicious.

The beach was clean and the sand was white.  We really loved the free cabanas on the beach (and in the pool).  Bartenders were attentive and made some fun drinks.  I enjoyed the beer but by the end of the trip, it was getting somewhat bitter.  Great activities throughout the day and night.  Casino was very small.  Only a few tables and a few machines.  Look for workers giving out $10 match play coupons each day at the pool.

Wine bar, night clubs and music were all great.  We really enjoyed hanging around the fountain areas at night with the colored lights, music and great people.

Felt very safe the whole time but really had no need to venture away from this palace!  I heard the golf was incredible but a little pricey.

Finally, when checking out, the housekeeper started cleaning our room and the bellman took our luggage out before we actually checked out.  We had a few personal items (Apple Watch and charger) charging on the dresser before we were leaving for airport.  When I went back to the room, everything was gone.  I went down to front desk to inform them and I was told to go meet Carlos at Bell Desk.  He had everything in safekeeping for us and knew our exact room and everything!  What a great relief and a testament to their trustworthiness!

reviews.author: ChrisandMel1204
reviews.title: GREAT STAFF here at the Reserve!
reviews.text: What a great resort! The staff here is very friendly and ATTENTIVE TO EVERY NEED. Even our usually shy 11 year old son was speaking Spanish with the Gabi Reserve waiters and hostess! Yaritza Rodriguez is amazing! A real sweetheart in both languages always smiling and helpful😊. Sua Aquino  fixed my bad hair day and Luis Vasquez made sure we had the Mamajuauna Dominican drink to keep us going! The gardens are beautiful and rooms are comfortable and relaxing- sol Melia has thought of everything and put in paradise!

reviews.author: leonl733
reviews.title: Garden of Eden
reviews.text: When we left, we felt like Adam and Eve must have felt when they left Eden.  My only complaint was that the wifi was way too slow and. did not reach to all areas of the beach.  The room was good but not ultra luxurious. Except for these faults, I would have given the resort a 5.

reviews.author: hubertf722
reviews.title: Spring break
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The staff was very nice and always smiling. Our family concierge, Nikel, made our family vacation even better. He was so polite and attentive. He took care of all our reservations. This was our most relaxing vacation and my family can't wait to come back.

reviews.author: janetdL9227RG
reviews.title: My fourth time back to Paradesus Royal-Janet and Anthony DiBlasi
reviews.text: Excellent service, accommodations and food. Beautiful place, great food,experienced Butler service for the first time and Jose was wonderful!! This place is beautiful with all the accommodations you would want. We will be back and that will be my 5th time!

reviews.author: Meggie D
reviews.title: Great trip at a great resort!
reviews.text: Overall, an amazing trip!  Food was good, night life was fun (especially the casino!), and amenities were fantastic.  Booked a spa appointment and went back for a second one because it was that great.  Our Butler Samuel was wonderful, and most of the staff/service was friendly with the exception of some language barriers.

reviews.author: alex_r_00138
reviews.title: Great place!!
reviews.text: This resort has awesome beaches and restaurants, and the staff is awesome as well. The bartenders are great, especially Luis, Ramon, Santos, and Fria. There is so much to do for all ages, and everyone is so kind and helpful. Definitely recommend it!!!

reviews.author: davidwladue
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
This property as compared to other options for your travel dollars is average at best.  To be more specific;

*Avoid the Royal Service rooms.  No better than an upgrade at a typical Hilton Garden Inn.  Absolutely NOT worth the price.  Avoid, avoid, avoid...do NOT fall for this rip off. 

*Very average to poor food.  If a restaurant in the US served food like you find here it would be out of business quickly. 

*Customer service is average at best.  The employees seem to be "just doing there jobs" without any real interest in their customers.  Almost uninterested and unengaged...

In general, you can find many much better options for your travel dollars.

reviews.author: bamagirl2016
reviews.title: Alabama girl
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful and the service is excellent!! The staff is very friendly!! We hope to return on a couples get away in the next year! We are now spoiled to the all inclusive vacation! Hope to go on some of the outing/adventures next time around!!

reviews.author: 476caseys
reviews.title: Ecellent
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus for a Company Event and the staff was excellent. They were all very friendly and very engaged with the guests. I would highly recommend this resort. I would love to go back for a pleasure vacation.

reviews.author: Angel V
reviews.title: Un lugar encantador
reviews.text:
Somos socios de Club Melia y este ano conocimos este hoel
Las comdidades que nos otorgaron como socios del club excelentes
Comidas muy buenas y variadas.
El servicio de los camareros np es uniforme u en algunos casos no esta acorde al restl del hotel

reviews.author: Jenn D
reviews.title: Family loved it! 2nd visit
reviews.text:
This is our second visit and hopefully we will come again. We love this resort. The first time we came to the resort our son was 3.5. We returned this time with our son now 5 and another baby 8 months old. 
We stayed in the reserve family conceige suite. 
We put the crib in the bathroom suite with the large tub and had a door that slid between our bedroom and his room. Our 5 year old slept on the pullout in the living room and loved it.
I thought he would eventually get in our bed but never did. 
We can't say enough about this resort as just really enjoy ourselves. The only negative is that the family reserve area is not on the beach. However when the nighttime entertainment is loud and at the beach we were so thankful we are separate. I like quiet for the kids and us to sleep and this for sure allows this. We once stayed at a resort in Mexico and it was so loud my son would cry it was too loud.
We love getting room service in an so can take our time getting everyone dressed, sun screened and ready for beach. 
We would go to beach in am and love reserve beach area. Sandra was our concierge and she would take care of our reservations and assist.
We went to the gabi beach buffet for lunch but it is busy.
We love the reserve buffet. 
 Melvin at the beach grill is great. He made us a special lunch thanks to friends returning as well. He made us a seafood stir fry that was amazing.
If you are a family looking for a resort, highly recommend this!

reviews.author: H3881IErichardl
reviews.title: Great Vacation Spot
reviews.text: One of the best vacations spots ever. Beautiful and very well kept resort. I was told that the food in the Dominican was not that good, but the food here was excellent. Our Butler Johnfi Rivera took outstanding care of us and was a pleasure to work with, would defiantly request him again. Also Carlos Rosard  at the royal services sunset bar was outstanding very attentive and funny. Would defiantly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: HappyTravellers1954
reviews.title: Amazing all inclusive!!!
reviews.text: We visited the resort for a week at the beginning of April. We were blown away by the resort. Food was excellent in both the buffet and specialty restaurants. Staff was friendly and always helpful. Our waiter at Rare, Esteban, and our waiter at Naos, Nores were fantastic, couldn't do enough for us!! The beach is clean with lots of chairs and cabanas, we never had a problem finding a cabana and lounge chair. The grounds were spotless. We did not upgrade to concierge service as we felt it was an unnecessary expense and we didn't miss it. One thing they could add would be activities like bocce or darts something to get people mingling together. The nightly entertainment was incredible, the Michael Jackson show in particular was very well done. The wi-fi was good and we were able to get a signal on the beach. We will be back!!!!!

reviews.author: Hermes S C
reviews.title: Excelente. ..La Reserve. ..una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: Estuvimos en La Reserve por nuestra membresía del Club Melia.  Una experiencia inolvidable. Las habitaciones impecables y la comida excelente.  El personal,  con una atención que nos hace sentir a gusto.  Esperamos volver.

reviews.author: jvand0
reviews.title: Traveling with a group for a 3 night stay
reviews.text: The service was excellent.  The resort was very clean.  The buffets were fabulous.  The young man who helped organize the events, Shaky Shaky, was very entertaining and kind.  Ivan was also a very friendly waiter.  Would definitely return to the same resort.

reviews.author: NancyGreyStreet
reviews.title: Nancy Greystreet
reviews.text: Unfriendly staff.  I far prefer Jamaica or Cancun for an all-inclusive . Front desk Personnel are not very helpful .  8 Atlanta and the buffet so far  in both  we're not great . Below average food.  Beautiful setting. Nice enough rooms.

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: Gold Canyon Annual Achievers Trip
reviews.text: I was blessed to have earned an all-expense paid trip for my husband and I, to the Paradisus Palma Real, with my side little candle business, Gold Canyon.  This is an amazing resort, with gorgeous rooms, beautifully manicured grounds, and phenomenal beaches!  It was exceptionally clean, wonderful food, and incredible service. All of the employees were so friendly, helpful, and engaging, even though I spoke minimal Spanish, and they spoke little English. They always greeted us and made an effort to hold a conversation!  We especially loved Juan Peralta, our beach server, who took such fabulous care of our group, several days in a row.  He was kind, attentive, and has the absolute greatest smile! If you go, look for him on the beach! He is THE BEST! We cannot wait to go back to this beautiful island, and visit this PHENOMENAL resort again! Thanks Gold Canyon and Paradisus Palma Real for an a wonderfully memorable vacation!

reviews.author: Laura F
reviews.title: A+ Service, smiling faces, nice design and great drinks!

reviews.author: Arlene A
reviews.title: One of the best all inclusives I've stayed at!
reviews.text:
I traveled to Punta Cana for the third time this month and picked the perfect place. My travel dates were 3/30-4/5/2016. The weather was perfect. 85 and sunny every day. We stayed at a Paradisus in Playa del Carmen which is what made us decide to stay at one in Punta Cana. I would HIGHLY recommend upgrading to Royal Service. You get a private butler, private bar indoors with top shelf liquor, private pool with private outdoor bar (this area is adults only), private beach area with actual beds. Everyone that worked here far exceeded my expectations. The employees definitely made our entire trip very enjoyable. Our private butler was Luis Sanchez. We were given a cell phone to contact him any time we needed anything or needed him to make a dinner reservation. He always answered right away and took care of dinner for us every night. He even made a reservation for us on the first day (we arrived too late to make reservations). Every day he left surprises in our room (I don't want to spoil the surprises). 

The main pool had many families with young children (probably because it was spring break) so we spent a lot of time at the private pool. The bartender Leonardo Mota was the best! He greeted us every single morning on our way to breakfast. He made amazing drinks that we never waited long for. Ask him for a Mono Sucio! Francisco Cabrera waited on us every time we were at the pool and beach. He made sure we never had empty cups! He set up our beds poolside and beachside. We never had to look for him. He was there any time we needed anything.

There are many bars on the resort but our favorite was M Bar. Starky Valoy is the best bartender!!! He was super friendly and kept making us drinks. We went to M Bar just to see him. On my birthday he made me a special ice cream treat and surprised me with it! My favorite drink he made was a passion fruit mojito (made with fresh passion fruit he scooped out of the fruit in front of us). We really felt like we were the only people he was serving.

Most of the places to eat are restaurants where you order off the menu. The Gabbi beach buffet was very impressive (I usually don't like buffets). The other restaurants were pretty good but......you MUST make a reservation at Passion. It's not part of the all inclusive but is so worth it! I would highly recommend doing the sampler (I believe it was $70 for 7 or 8 courses). The chef has other restaurants and in total 7 Michelin stars. There were some things on the menu I have never tried and may not order on a menu but they were so delicious! (I'm somewhat of a picky eater too.) We were waited on by Julio Cesar and Thompson. I eat at many nicer restaurants and have never had better service. They were so attentive and courteous and made our experience there great!

We would definitely return to this resort. My one recommendation is to bring a lot of singles with you!!!! We received a letter at the start of our trip that says tipping is not required but we felt that everyone who waited on us deserved it! We always tipped (for drinks and meals). I noticed many people did not but the employees REALLY appreciated it. We had a hard time exchanged bigger bills for single and the ATM on the resort only gave pesos. Next time we'll make sure to bring a stack of singles only.

reviews.author: Carina T
reviews.title: Verwöhnurlaub! Traumhaftes Hotel, perfekter Service von tollem Personal!
reviews.text:
Das war unser schönster Urlaub seit langem. Von 08. bis 20. März haben wir eine traumhafte Zeit im Paradisus Palma Real verbracht. Die Gegend ist herrlich, der Sandstrand wie aus dem Katalog, das Hotel toll, sowohl Buffet als auch die Restaurants waren ausgezeichnet!

Sehr viel dazu beigetragen hat das Personal dort. Allesamt sehr freundlich, aber speziell zu erwähnen sind Wanda Covrea (den Nachnamen können wir leider nicht mehr lesen! - aber sie war die einzige Dame hinter der Bar), Pedro Ledano und Angel Frias, die uns an der Sunset Bar im Royal Service Bereich bestens versorgten. Ein Dankeschön auch an unseren Concierge Ariel Benzo, der noch zusätzlich für unser Wohlbefinden sorgte. Vielen Dank an euch!

Alles in allem: Ein rundum gelungener Urlaub. Uneingeschränkt weiter zu empfehlen!!!

reviews.author: Davis/Darnell
reviews.title: Service!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from Spring Break with several families.  We had kids ranging in age from 9 to 17.  After having stayed with another group of friends at another resort (the Royalton - see that review too), the difference here in service was dramatic.  While the property is lovely, the family concierge service far exceeded my expectations and that is what would bring me back.  (Again, contrast that with the "Diamond Club" butler service at the Royalton!)  Our concierge was Estephanie Ruiz.   She was nothing short of amazing!!   She met every need, and anticipated needs we didn't know we had.   When my daughter wanted to ride horses on the beach -- and a particular untouched beach that we had visited on a boat outing -- I asked Stephanie about it around 7 p.m. at dinner.   We wanted to go early the next morning!   We thought there would be no way she could pull this off, but she did.  She contacted me early in the morning and told us she would meet us in the lobby to go horseback riding!   Really over the top service.  She is a treasure for the Reserve.  Also, a great shout out to Jose, the bartender on the beach.  His amazing service and fun personality will never be forgotten.    

The only negatives I would note is that the food really doesn't stand up to the general quality of the resort, and the service at the restaurants was not good - sour attitudes, slow, unresponsive, etc.   Also, the portions are small, but you can order more of course.    Because we stayed at the Reserve, we had to take the shuttle to get to the beach and most restaurants.  That was a bit inconvenient.  Finally, this may be perceived as a negative or not, but the atmosphere at the resort is "quiet and laid back".  That suits most, but the teenagers in our group preferred the Royalton because of the lively atmosphere at the pool and beach with music, games, etc.

Overall, I would recommend this resort and would tell everyone to ask for Stephanie and Jose!

reviews.author: Travelbug2001_05
reviews.title: An Absolute Gem!!!
reviews.text:
I don't normally write reviews as I feel they are extremely subjective. My husband and I have been to a few places now and we have liked and disliked a number of things about each place. However, this resort deserves a review. 

I will start with the accommodations. What you see in the pictures on the website is what you get. We stayed in a One Bedroom Master Suite and it was the perfect size for a family of four (two adults and two kids). We came to celebrate our 15th wedding anniversary and we were able to enjoy the suite as a family and as a couple. 

The beach is amazing! The most beautiful beach by far of all of the islands we have been to. Having a section of the beach devoted to Reserve guests is wonderful. The service on the beach was excellent and the staff always looked out to make sure guests were content. And the water - the most perfect turquoise you will find!

The grounds are superb! The attention to detail of the landscaping and grounds is extremely evident. 

The restaurants are wonderful for an all inclusive. We managed to try each of the restaurants once and enjoyed them all however, Vento was by far our favourite. In addition, my husband and I went to Passion and it truly is a lifetime experience. If  you can swing the additional cost, we highly recommend it. Our waiter Gustavo and the rest of his team made it an experience to remember. 

Finally, I have to mention the staff. I have never been to a resort and made to feel that it is home. That is no longer the case. The staff from the restaurants to the beach are phenomenal across the entire resort. However, those at The Reserve won my heart. First, to Silvio Lantigua who went out of his way before we even arrived to ensure our stay was everything we hoped for, I cannot thank you enough. Second, to the staff in Building 40 who always greeted us with a smile and were willing to help with whatever we needed. We cannot thank you enough. And to our housekeeper, Adalgisa Zorrilla, whose attention to detail was superb and who always made sure our room was well stocked with everything we needed over the course of the week. She always greeted us with a smile. She was superb! And to Yaritza Rodriguez who is one of the hostesses at the Gabi Club who always greeted our family with a smile and learned all of our names and made us learn some Spanish - this place is better because of her. And finally to Johan Santiago at the Gabi Club who from the start made note of our names and drink preferences, it is because of you that my children felt as comfortable as they did. It meant more to us than any of you will ever know!

For the first time ever we have been to a resort where we are so sad to leave and already planning to return. This island and in particular, The Reserve, is a true gem! We cannot wait to return soon.

reviews.author: Eileen S
reviews.title: Romance
reviews.text:
I accidentally posted this review for the wrong resort in Punta Cana. THIS is the place 

As soon as we got here the staff worked tirelessly to make us happy. I had booked the vacation through RCI at the last possible minute. Jerandy checked us in and changed our room assignment so we would have a view; Jennifer (Yennifer) found an open florist that found roses for me at 6PM on a Sunday night and arranged to have the jacuzzi filled with bubble bath and rose petals strewn from the door on a path leading to the bed and jacuzzi, floating in and around the tub and on the bed. ❤️

Staff are all wonderful. Want to especially thank Naomi, Edmundo, Julio, Jose, Luis and I know I am leaving people out. I am terrible with names. 

Victoria at the YHI spa gave me a WONDERFUL massage. 

As others have said, I want you to know this is a real review. In terms of the food I have most enjoyed The Grill and the buffets were some of the best. If you like fish try the many grouper dishes. No other restaurants stand out. 

The grounds at the Reserve are beautifully kept and the rooms are lovely. The pool and thatched huts are great for the fair complexions. Lots of little nooks for privacy. Managed to get to the private beach using the convenient tram--just a few minute ride.

I would vacation at this resort again.

Stayed April 2016, traveled as a couple

reviews.author: Ritztravel
reviews.title: Will Take Effort on Your Part to Have an Enjoyable Resort Experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled to the Dominican Republic for the first time and stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana April 9 - 15.  This was a much-needed vacation, and I spent many hours researching and toiling over the decision where to stay.  I write to share our experience for anyone who may be in a similar situation, and debating whether an all-inclusive is the best option, and whether this particular resort is a good fit for you.  

To aid your decision-making process, I developed the following 10-question quiz.  I wish something like this had been available before we booked The Reserve at Paradisus.  Read through the questions and keep track of how many times you answer "yes" to each.

1.  Have you taken a cruise?
2.  Did you enjoy the cruise experience, and were you eager to book another one?
3.  When lying on the beach, would you prefer listening to Caribbean music blaring at the bar, rather than hearing the waves crash?
4.  If you need a drink while relaxing at the beach, would you rather say "drinky drinky" to the server, than raise a flag, for example?
5.  While on vacation, do you like to consume an alcoholic beverage every hour from sunrise to sunset?
6.  Will you be traveling with children, preferably toddlers?
7.  Are you an extrovert?
8.  When at the beach, do you enjoy having neighbors in front of you, behind you, and directly to your left and right?
9.  Do you speak Spanish?
10. Do you value a "friendly" staff over a "service-oriented" staff?

If you answered "yes" to the majority of these questions, I am fairly confident that you will enjoy your stay at The Reserve at Paradisus and will love the all-inclusive experience.  If you answered "no" to a majority of questions, but based on all the positive reviews you have read thus far, still think this could be a good fit for you, please continue to read about our experience.

Let's begin with a clarification that I am reviewing THE RESERVE AT PARADISUS PUNTA CANA, not the Paradisus Punta Cana, not the Paradisus Palma Real, not The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real.  I am reviewing what is described repeatedly as the  "boutique" resort within the Paradisus and the "newly-created oasis of tropical escapism"   with an "all-new, all-luxury collection of suites."  More on those later.

Let me also say that this review is not particularly directed at the staff at The Reserve; it is directed at the management.  The Reserve has an adequate number of staff (I might even go so far as to say The Reserve has too many staff members toiling around).  And for the most part, all staff members are very friendly.  The problem is the staff have not been properly trained for this "exclusive, private, and ultra luxurious" experience, and there are serious service failures.

Check-In at The Reserve:  Disappointing
After deciding to book The Reserve, I tried my absolute best to negate any hiccups that had been experienced by resort guests in the past that I had read about - issues with arrival, dinner reservations, and cabanas by the pool and beach, for example.  I read every word on every page of the resort's website, and I even contacted the resort via email to inquire about what information I could provide in advance to make our stay a "memorable one" and to make sure "everything runs smoothly" so that we would "enjoy an experience that goes beyond mere accommodations."
