After emailing back and forth with Silvio Lantigua, the Reserve's Guest Services Manager, I was sent a Pre-Arrival Form to complete.  I answered every question on the form and emailed it back to Silvio, noting details about our arrival time, flight number, airline, reason for our visit, gastronomy, preference for when we like to eat dinner, leisure activities, etc. The Reserve had everything at their disposal, in advance, to prepare for our arrival and deliver on their promise.

When we were dropped off at the front, and stepped out of the OTIUM van, the chaos began.  Who are you?  How long will you be staying with us?  Where are you from?  We need you to complete a Pre-Arrival Form - here is a pen.  Come sit down in our small, hot, check-in area reserved just for guests staying at The Reserve, and enjoy the assortment of snacks remaining on that table over there.  

There was no warm greeting.  There was no indication that anyone was expecting us.  There was no cool towel.  No bottle of water was handed to us.  There was no organization whatsoever.  And clearly the pre-arrival form that I completed and sent to Silvio seven days earlier never left his inbox.  What a waste of my time.  The Reserve "welcome" was not a good indication of things to come.  We were now ready to see our "Paradisus Suite."  

Paradisus Suite:  Disappointing
This was the absolute worst part of our experience.  When we walked into our Paradisus Suite, we saw nothing that looked "all new."  Our room was dirty - there was a big wad of hair on the bathroom floor.  There was a smear of blood on the bathroom wall.  The furniture was old, broken, and stained.  The jacuzzi tub was absolutely disgusting.  I wouldn't even want to soak my feet in the tub.  Our "mini bar" was an old beat-up mini fridge.  I wanted to be anywhere other than our room.  I could not imagine ordering room service in this place.  Where would I sit?  I didn't want to touch anything.  I was utterly disappointed as our Paradisus Suite looked NOTHING like the beautiful photos online.  If you choose to reserve this resort and you are given Room 2373, run!  I wondered if all the Paradisus Suites were in this condition.  I wondered how anyone staying in a Paradisus Suite could have a smile on their face?  These questions ran through our minds the first day.  And we seriously considered all options.  Could we move to another resort - perhaps Eden Roc?  Should we ask to move to another Paradisus Suite?  Do we risk forfeiting our non-refundable pay-up-front reservation to go somewhere else?  It was all too much for our first night, and we decided to go with the flow and see if things could improve.

Making Reservations - Concierge Service:  Disappointing
On that first day as we were escorted to our Paradisus Suite, we met a team of concierge that were assigned to the building where we were staying.  From what we understood, these were the staff who were responsible for booking your dinner reservations, etc.  And remember - I completed a pre-arrival form.  This form was never given to our concierge team.  No reservations had been made for us.  These people didn't know where we wanted to eat or what time.  We started from scratch.  And this group disappointed.  Not one time during our 5-night stay did we show up for a dinner reservation made by our concierge that comported with the time the restaurant had us down for a reservation.  Our concierge would tell us we had a 7:00 PM dinner reservation at Mole tonight.  We would show up at 7:00, only to find our reservation was for 9:00 PM.  What on earth is going on here?

On the second day of our stay, we had not heard from our concierge about dinner reservations for that evening.  At 6:50 PM, I asked my husband to go check with the concierge to see when we were supposed to eat and where.  You see, the concierge never printed a schedule for us and let us know where we were eating each night.  It was a day-by-day thing.  When my husband asked the concierge about our reservation at 6:50 PM, the concierge looked our name up and informed us that we had a reservation at 7:00 PM at Fuego!  What?!  Here we are in our bathing suits.  No one ever left a message on our phone.  No one ever knocked on our door, or called us, or slipped a note
in our room - what were we supposed to do - read their mind? This was the straw that broke the camel's back.  Our Paradisus Suite was abysmal, and now yet another service failure.  We called the front desk to move.

Paradisus One-Bedroom Master Suite:  A Welcome Change
On day two after a series of missteps, and after we missed our 7:00 PM dinner reservation, we called twice to request to be moved to a One Bedroom Master Suite or to get a refund and go somewhere else.  Initially, the front desk wanted us to pay an additional $100 per night to be upgraded to the one bedroom master suite.  After a second phone call and fully comprehending our disappointment with our room and the service, they offered to let us move without charge to a one-bedroom master suite.  

WHAT A DIFFERENCE.  If you decide to book The Reserve at Paradisus, you must book a one-bedroom master suite, NOT a Paradisus Suite.  The one-bedroom master suite was new.  It actually looked like the photos online.  The furniture was not broken.  There were not stains on the furniture.  The tub was clean.  We had a dining room table that we could eat at.  We had instructions for the televisions and the picture quality was much improved.  We had instructions for the shower.  Our mini-bar was a real-deal new, high-quality mini-fridge.  This must be why people were smiling at the resort - they are staying in a one-bedroom master suite!  We wondered if the Paradisus suites were intentionally bad so guests would pay to upgrade - surely not.

Dining:  Some Good, Some Very Bad
To keep it short and sweet - our advice would be to never eat at a buffet on the Paradisus property.  Repeat - stay away from the buffets.  After trial and error, we figured out that for breakfast, our best bet was to order room service - two boxes of cereal and an order of pancakes.  At least the pancakes would be warm.  We could eat that.  For lunch, we figured out that you should order room service, or go to an a la carte restaurant and order from a menu.  Stay away from the buffets.  If you follow this advice, you can make it through breakfast and lunch, and count on a pretty good dinner.  Our dinners at Mole, Vento, and Aqua were great.  We did not like Fuego, but I'm vegetarian and my husband doesn't like seafood.  Remember the title of our review - it will take effort on your part to have an enjoyable vacation.  

The Beach Setup - Frustrating
Clearly The Reserve at Paradisus was an afterthought imagined after opening the Paradisus and wanting to create a smaller "boutique" within the Paradisus.  This means The Reserve is further from the beach, and the square footage of beach access is small in comparison.  For illustration, if Bavaro Beach was 100 feet long, the Paradisus guests had 80 feet of beachfront, and The Reserve guests had 20 feet of beachfront.  It was a compressed space.  Yes - The Reserve had its own little bar with service on the beach.  Yes - The Reserve had its own restrooms on the beach.  But unless you were a Royal Service guest, or were traveling with a family, you had ZERO chance of having a front-row or even second-row cabana on the beach.  No matter how early you wake up, the Royal Service guests have the front two rows.  Period.  The best my husband and I could do was the third row of cabanas.  We always had people in front of us, next to us, and behind us.  For two days, we even had a topless woman next to us on the beach at The Reserve.  How lucky were we?  Yes - at the Reserve Beach - a family friendly resort, there was a guest who took her bikini top off the laid in the sun with everything hanging out all afternoon.  And this particular couple also thought it would be nice to bring their own boombox and play loud music for everyone on the beach to enjoy.  Thank you.

Despite the loud music emanating from the bar or from our friends two cabanas over, and despite the fact that the servers would yell "drinky drinky" or "let's get drunk" repeatedly throughout the day, we must acknowledge that Bavaro Beach itself was beautiful.  I would have rather experienced it front row, or with more space between the cabanas, but it was a beach!  

Lest you say - well why didn't you just go down to the Paradisus and get a cabana on their side of the beach?  We tried!  There were simply not enough chairs/cabanas to go around for every guest staying at the Paradisus.  No matter what time of day (except after 4:00 pm), we could not find chairs on the beach that were not already reserved or occupied.  

The Reserve Pool - An Experience
Let me start off by saying that if you want to relax at the pool, you will need to set up at the kids' splash pool.  This will be the quietest space for you to relax and enjoy a book or swim or lay out.  Why?  Because ALL the kids are in the main swimming pool - and they congregate around and play "Marco Polo" by the swim-up bar and by the "water ritual" feature.  Let me also warn you that there is no rhyme or reason or instructions or pointers from your concierge about reserving a cabana.  And no one will explain which cabana you can use, or set you up with towels.  This is your responsibility.  Even though three staff members sit behind a desk at the pool, it will be your responsibility to scope out and hunt down a cabana that is not already reserved by some ghost in the night, to grab the appropriate number of towels, and to set yourself up at a pool cabana that you find.  

YHI Spa - A Complete and Utter Fraud
Hoping that things could turn around, we decided to ask our concierge to book massages for us at the spa - 80 minute massages!  I was just giddy that morning - I couldn't wait to experience "a seductive oasis of luxury" and utilize the "thermal circuit" with the Turkish Bath, cold pools, and hydromassage and "discover a new concept of wellbeing."  Oh my - was I in for a rude awakening.  The women's changing area was tiny.  There was one bathroom, two showers, a steam room, a sauna, and a co-ed whirlpool.  I have no idea where the thermal circuit was.  I never saw a Turkish bath or a plunge pool, or a hydromassage area.  And your were given one towel.  That's it.  I had to utilize my one towel in the underwhelming sauna, in the dirty steam room, and dry off with it after taking a shower before my massage.  The showers were never cleaned after a prior guest used one.  Eeww.  After changing into my robe and dingy flip flops (no telling when they were used or cleaned last), there was no relaxation room to wait in.  You were instructed to wait in the tiny women's locker room on a bench and your therapist would pick you up there.  On the flip side for my husband, at any moment a woman therapist could open the door to the men's locker room and changing area to pick him up for his massage.

When I met my therapist, she led me outside to a cabana-type room.  Not exactly what I was hoping for.  I would really have preferred a treatment room inside the spa.  She didn't ask.  I guess you do not have a choice.  Let me describe the ambiance.  The room is not dimly lit.  There are no candles.  There is no music.  There is no heated bed.  Instead, you have an air conditioner blowing on you.  The room is brightly lit from the sun.  And you hear mopeds, service vehicles, fellow guests, and staff communicating on walkie talkies during the entire massage.  When the massage began, the first thought I had was "why did I schedule an 80-minute massage instead of a 50-minute massage?"  I firmly believe that if I had given my husband $180 cash and asked him to give me a massage, he could have done a comparable job, if not better.  

Gym:  It's a Jungle in There
We visited the gym twice to workout.  It's a decent facility, but it's very hot.  I can't understand why they do not keep it cooler in there.  And in keeping with the theme, the equipment is not cleaned after use.  There was always a staff person in the gym, but he never cleaned the equipment.  He just opened the door to the gym, and handed you a water bottle.  After we used the cardio equipment, we would have been happy to disinfect  it for the next guest, but there was nothing to use.

Overall:
The grounds are beautiful and well maintained.  It was a joy to walk from our room to the beach.  If you can get over the fact that the staff is not well trained on how to deliver exceptional service in this "luxury" environment, and you are okay taking charge of making your vacation work for you, it can be a good value.  This resort absolutely caters to families with children.  We would not recommend this resort to couples looking for a relaxing, romantic getaway.  Nor would we recommend this resort for the discriminating traveler.  If the management could get organized and train its staff, this could be a very, very nice all-inclusive property.

reviews.author: Beachhopper
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We spent 9 days at Paradisus and could have spent another 9!  Needless to say I was crying when we left because it was paradise.  The beach, water, people, food and resort.  Where to even begin?

We had Deybi Garcia to thank upon arrival and for the next week (even when he was off for two days) for making reservations, helping with rooms, giving us the lay of the resort.  Anything we needed he made happen.

But, our time there was made even better by the resident activity director Shaky Shaky.  His team was the life of the party.  Daily Yudy and Popeye led yoga, dance classes, any activity you could think of.  Pamela I saw every morning for towels and was always helpful (like when I needed a new book.)

Shaky Shaky....may everyone have on their vacation.  In fact we will be returning to Paradisus for another week in the next year because our trip was just that good and he gets credit for a lot of it.  Our kids say they can't wait to see Shaky Shaky again.  My children were willing to do anything he suggested.  Our son was nicknamed "Little Giant" by Shaky Shaky and has been living up to his name since.  Each night there is a show (which they were all amazing each night.  The Michael Jackson show is a must see!) Our kids were like groupies after a week when they saw SS on stage in Lion King.  

The pool was our favorite.  Which is terrible since you are at the beach.  But, it was too easy to watch the kids in the pool and have drinks made to order by Leonardo Mota.  Leonardo was so great.  He would make sure the kids had drinks if they got the nerve to walk up to the bar.  If you go, find him!  He was perhaps the reason why we liked the pool even more than the beach.

Juan, Nelson, VictorMonteo....all!  So nice and really made our stay that much better.

We found there to be plenty of activities at our resort for us.  We just went to relax and unplug.  Our youngest is 5 so we held off on booking a lot of excursions.  We did walk the beach each day and there was plenty of spots to swim and see fish.

We were in building 39 and found the walk great.  I know some people have complained in other reviews.  We love it.  There are golf carts that run by.  But, it was quicker for us to walk. 

We enjoyed all the restaurants.  My least favorite was Rare.  I think they have a lot of kinks to work out with the staff in that restaurant.  We had a reservation one night only to be told it was hours later.  We went back later that week and honestly I would have been happier at the buffet.

If you have a peanut allergy...or nut.  I have to say you may want to be more careful.  There were a few things I noticed where cross contamination could happen.  Like on the breakfast bar peanut butter would be in a bowl to the back of two other jams, or such.  I would say you would definitely want to be fluent in Spanish to be able to stress any food allergy.  GF is much easier I am sure to deal with.  

I don't think we can really complain about one single thing.  We had a keycard stop working.  But, I think that was b/c it maybe touched our cell phones.

I would recommend learning some Spanish. 

We took a taxi from the airport to the resort for $30.00  It was worth it since we got there faster and we could see the area.  Most buses have curtains we noticed.  I'm sure you can open them.  But, the taxi driver was fun to talk to and learn more about Punta Cana from.

Our kids did the kids club two nights.  They enjoyed it.  We loved it b/c we went to the casino.  It's not a very big casino.  But, there was one craps table so we were happy.  Rubin was there both nights and we loved seeing him.  I wish I could remember all the guys on the table with him.....but they were all fun and patient when a few people would forget to back up their chips.  It's a fun spot to visit.

reviews.author: Carol D
reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: Start to finish perfection. Prime beach location in the middle of two other resorts, and ours was by far the best. The buffets were almost always open and the food was a delicious mix of American favorites, gourmet options, and Dominican favorites. The dancing with hotel staff was both entertaining and so much fun, our favorite staffer was dubbed "Shaky Shaky" and was so accommodating with everything we needed. Beach had ample wait staff for drinks and every surface was spotless. I have never seen a hotel so well staffed and prepared, they had everything!

reviews.author: Anthony V
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and the best service!
reviews.text: My wife and I visited The Reserve in 2014 for our honeymoon and were highly impressed. We stayed again this past week and we were again very pleased!! The service is exceptional. As we laid by the pool each day we looked forward to Emilio passing by saying "drinky drinky", his service is wonderful! We also loved the daily activities from paddle boarding to in water cycling brought to us by Luis and Raybold! And the towel service and entertainment by Naomi was remarkable! We will be back again!

reviews.author: schererw
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort With Special Attention To Children
reviews.text: Stayed in the Reserve section of this resort from April 6-11, 2016. My wife and I were here with our son, his wife, and their young children ages 1 and 3. Beach, pools, sun, junior suites, and food were very good. Special mention for Elizabeth and Sofia who both offered our families excellent assistance throughout our stay. Also very impressed with Jason Munoz who offered me assistance in the registration area. A special thanks to Yurandy who called Amstar when the ground transportation to the airport was late on our last day. This place rocks for both families and couples. You will have a great time!

reviews.author: Brian T
reviews.title: Just what my family needed!!
reviews.text: I can't say enough about this place.  We came needing a break from the stresses of everyday life and boy did this place do the trick.  Especially relaxing was the beach for the Reserve where Santos, Ramon, Luis, and Jose took great care of us.  They were great with my three kids and helped me with "improving" my Spanish.  I am ready to get home but look forward to a return visit next year!!!

reviews.author: João R
reviews.title: Top, Lugar Maravilhoso!!!
reviews.text:
Achei um lugar muito bom! O Resort é muito bonito, eles mudam a decoração diariamente, organizado e limpo.
A comida é muito boa, tanto nos restaurante principal quanto nos restaurantes temáticos.
A Equipe é muito simpática e agradável.

reviews.author: Ilona T
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: It was a great experience, the waiters and staff are great, they bring drinks promptly and are very friendly. They play wonderful music on the beach and it provides a beautiful atmosphere for your holiday. I totally loved it and will definitely come back! Benita is great at making cocktails and Ramon is a very friendly guy. Luis and Santos are always there for you and Jairo Minier always work hard for all the customers.

reviews.author: Eileen S
reviews.title: The best service I have ever experienced
reviews.text:
As soon as we got here the staff worked tirelessly to make us happy. I had booked the vacation through RCI at the last possible minute. Jerandy checked us in and changed our room assignment so we would have a view; Jennifer found a florist that found roses for me at 6PM on a Sunday night and arranged to have the jacuzzi filled with bubble bath and rose petals strewn from the door on a path leading to the bed and jacuzzi, floating in and around the tub and on the bed. 🌹❤️

Staff are all wonderful. Want to especially thank Naomi, Edmundo Julio, Jose, Luis and I know I am leaving people out. I am terrible with names. 

Victoria at the YHI spa gave me a WONDERFUL massage. 

As others have said, I want you to know this is a real review. In terms of the food I have most enjoyed The Grill and the buffets were some of the best. If you like fish try the many grouper dishes. No other restaurants stand out. 

The grounds are beautifully kept and the rooms are lovely. The pool and thatched huts are great for the fair complexions. Lots of little nooks for privacy. 

I would vacation at this resort again.

reviews.author: t2104
reviews.title: Spring Break 2016
reviews.text: The employees make the resort. They go above and beyond. Kids and family friendly. We booked the Reserve during spring break, and never felt crowded. Mole and Vento restaurants are a must. The Grill was a disappointment. I have to say I am a restaurant Manager/Owner and have high expectations. Jose and Emilio at the pool are people I wish I hire. I still can here Emilio saying "drink drinky" My feel broke his arm on the last day, and Doctor Gabi made the experience more bearable. Will return next year.

reviews.author: Ari B
reviews.title: Amazing wedding at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We held our wedding at Paradisus Palma Real in April 2016.  From the beginning stages of planning we were well attended to and felt comfortable planning the wedding from the United States despite having never been to the resort before.  All planning was done through email with Jinayda who was based out of Miami.  They offered many packages and options but also customized everything to meet our needs.  About a month before the wedding, we starting working with Natalia and Claribel, our wedding planners.  We felt like we were in great hands immediately.  Natalia and Claribel were available to answer every question and smooth out every detail through multiple emails a day.  

Upon arrival to the resort, we were greeted by Natalia and Claribel and our butler Luis.  They had upgraded us to Royal Service which ended up being fantastic.  Every day and night at the resort started and ended with great food, service, and atmosphere.  The beach was full of clean white sand with many cabanas and chairs so that we never felt on top of other guests, even though the hotel was at capacity.  The most important part of the royal service was the comfortable beach beds and cabanas that were available every day on a private section of the beach.  Each night day when we returned to our room, we had a snack or gift waiting of us from our butler, Luis.  The grounds are very well kept and absolutely beautiful.  There are many restaurants and bars to make every guest happy.  Every detail of not only our wedding but our stay at the resort and our wedding parties accommodations (we had 100 guests) was perfect.

Natalia and Claribel saw to it that every detail of our wedding weekend was perfect. They accommodated all of our requests with a smile.  They set up a beach volleyball tournament for all of our guests on a private volleyball court and a table full of ice cold bottled water.  Even though it rained the night we were supposed to have our beach BBQ, they seamlessly moved our party into a banquet room where everybody had a great time.  We held our wedding ceremony in the garden, a beautiful setting for our special occasion.  Our cocktail hour and reception followed at Fuego restaurant, a perfect open air venue located right on the beach. Every detail of the ceremony and reception was looked over by Natalia and executed perfectly.  Natalia was there at every moment to make sure we were relaxed, having a good time, and enjoying time with friends and family.  We have been in the service industry for over 20 years and we can honestly say the staff did an incredible job from top to bottom.  We could go on and on talking about how incredible our wedding experience was at Paradisus.  Our family and friends were so incredibly happy to be there and had the best time celebrating with us.  A HUGE thank you to Natalia, Claribel, Luis, and Martin for making our dream wedding come true.  We will remember it for the rest of our lives.

reviews.author: alexa d
reviews.title: El cumpleaños de mi esposa
reviews.text: Esta ha sido mis primera ves en la República Dominicana ya que he visitado todos los paradisus y es genial su personal en especial es muy simpático y agradable y muy serviciales. Los chicos del equipo d entretenimiento excelente en especial naomi(germanía José) José Luis delos santo, Emilio Valdés, máximo Cedeño, Wannsee roa , Luis glorían, rainol tamayo, todo son muy eso, bonito equipo tienen usted en su complejo deben de cuidarlo por qué son muy bello y buenos.

reviews.author: Minerva C
reviews.title: Mi cumpleaños
reviews.text: Es mi primera visita a punta cana y asido una experiencia inolvidable. El personal es muy amables y gentiles. Los chicos del equipo de entretenimiento son genial germania jose. También el equipo de pool concierge excelente y muy amable José Luis de los santo. Emilio valdes.  Wander  José reinos o.  Todos muy bellos.

reviews.author: George F
reviews.title: Grounds and service personnel were excellent
reviews.text: This resort is pricey in its beverage and drinks package. The overall quality and selection of food was very good. The drinks were good, but unless you could enjoy an unusual amount of alcohol the cost does not ad up. Unfortunately there is no option of just a food package. For this reason I would not choose to re-visit this property

reviews.author: Chandafromchhicagp
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: This is a review from 2012. Paradisus is the beautiful resort I've ever visited. Rooms, pool, beaches, restaurants, lobby, and lounge spaces were all immaculate and tasteful. Food wasn't amazing but it wasn't bad. Great options for excursions.

reviews.author: mariaalebarba
reviews.title: Un paraíso!!!
reviews.text: Estamos en the reserve punta cana, el hotel es cinco estrellas es muy hermoso, habitaciones muy cómodas y muy amplias todo muy cerca los restaurantes y desayunos y piscina a unos pasos de la habitación y tiene una playa exclusiva para los the reserve, quiero agradecer la atención a los chicos de la Playa, Santos Frías, Ramón Ramírez, Luis Santana, Benita Mercedes , José Luis de los Santos, José reyes ,Jairo Menier. Por todo esto es que volvemos siempre.

reviews.author: Alejandro E
reviews.title: Buen servicio en comedores y restaurantes
reviews.text: Lo mejor de este lugar es el buen servicio en comedores y restaurantes. Destacamos, mi familia y yo, especialmente a camareros José Rivera y Jesús Evangelista de comedor NAOS y a Lady Jiro de servicio de bar.

reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort AWESOME
reviews.text: Although the cost of this vacation was pretty pricey, we had an overall great time.  Aside from the beautiful resort.  My favorite memory is the staff.  They were awesome and always helpful. This was our first "All Inclusive" vacation and first Melia property.  We are already planning our next trip.

reviews.author: JSC79
reviews.title: The friendliest and most helpful staff!
reviews.text:
We cannot say enough about the staff at The Paradisus. Every single employee, whether front desk, waiter/waitress, gardener, tram driver, maid... I didn't matter, we were greeted and helped with a smile every single time. 

Our room was clean and beautiful. It was updated and felt very comfortable, which hasn't always been the case with other all-inclusive resorts in the Caribbean. Every building has its own concierge right in the lobby providing help with reservations or information at a moments notice. 

The grounds are remarkable! They have done an incredible job of creating so many different experiences as you travel around the the walking paths and buildings. Beautiful vegetation, mangroves, flowers everywhere, meticulously manicured lawns and landscaping. We LOVED the porch swings lining the walkway in the main building, it was so relaxing the sit and swing with the breeze blowing and the pond right underneath you. 

The food was much, much better than any other all-inclusive we've been to. We were very impressed with the the selections and the freshness of buffets. But the regular restaurants had delicious meals as well, especially Aqua. I didn't expect that quality of dishes to be included. Again, the service could not be beat.

The pools are immense! We never felt crowded even when there were a lot of people in the water. Tons of room to spread out, loungers in the water, sunning shelves, volleyball, swim up bars. Nothing was run down, it was apparent the property is very well cared for. The beach is perfection! The way they have it set up with a 2 person padded lounger along side 2 regular chairs, all under a shaded hut, make it the ideal set up for getting some rest & sun without having the switch spots. The beach staff was so much fun, always making people laugh or sitting down for a few minutes to chat about whatever. 

My mom and I had the best girls trip. This place far exceeded my expectations. Having traveled extensively and stayed at quite a few Four Seasons and Ritz Carletons, service is a big deal to me and can make or break the stay. This place is top notch. Thank you for a fantastic vacation! We will be back!

reviews.author: Nancy J
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
A group of 8 high school seniors and their moms (and two dads!) enjoyed Spring Break.  I'm not sure if kids or adults had more fun!  Lobby, pool, beach are incredible!  All activities staff was fun, energetic.  Special kudos to Didi and Popeye.  Luis,,,,happiest bartender out there!
Probably the most comfortable beds and pillows I've had in a hotel.  Grounds are lush and extremely well-kept.  Food was not "out of this world," but variety and quality definitely above what we expected for an all-inclusive.

reviews.author: johncS9734YL
reviews.title: Great Place to stay
reviews.text: What a great place to stay, had a wonderful time.  Would go back again.  Did the whole thing through Delta Vacations it made everything very easy.  Weather was great beach was clean, sunny, hot, nice sand.

reviews.author: Isabel S
reviews.title: Amazing Time
reviews.text:
This was my first time in DR and I had an amazing time.The hotel is simply beautiful. 

The service was definitely what will bring me back to this hotel. The service was phenomenal and the smiles incredible. Thank you to your staff and a special thanks to the following staff members; Stevlis Bayu, Juan Polanco, Jose Rivera, and Roberto Velasquez!! On our trip the staff members were so friendly and truly gave exceptional service. See you all soon!!

reviews.author: iambigbill73
reviews.title: awesome vacation
reviews.text: our room was centrally located to our private pool and beach area, the restaurants were also located nearby.there were many choices for breakfast lunch and dinner.the bar was fully stocked with premium liquor and the bartenders were able to make all drink requests,the room was spacious and very clean the maids were very thorough.The staff was helpful all in all a great experience.

reviews.author: Leonard R
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: We had a great trip to Palma Real. The food was excellent & the staff was very friendly. We would definitely recommend this resort to anyone. We stayed in April 2016 and loved every minute of it. The beach was amazing!

reviews.author: SteveDeb31
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text: We had an excellent room enjoyed the hotel thoroughly..The only thing that could've made this place better would be if it was adults only. Go to M Bar and see Starky and Hutch  Best mai tais ever also the  food was off the chain in all the restaurants

reviews.author: Murphy O
reviews.title: Best workers!
reviews.text: I was just recently at the Paradisus in Punta Cana and had the best time! The workers really went above and beyond to make my stay as memorable, relaxing and fun as possible!! My by far favorite was Ravel at the Swim Up Bar!!! He taught me how to speak Spanish and was always making the best piña coladas for us!!! The entire Swim Up Bar was overall amazing and super friendly... I spent a majority of my time at the Swim up bar talking to these great guys! Super Mario we love you! Luis Castillo, Nelson, Edwin, Wander, Anthony and Sandy! Zumba was another really fun activity run by the one and only Shaky Shaky, it's hard not to love him! "Shaky shaky no nappy nappy!!" Thanks for always bringing a smile to our faces Shaky Shaky. Also Yudy your our girl and we love you 2!!! Caramelo thanks for teaching me how to dance!!! Another great bar that is kind of hidden is the Bargarita... Carlos Pie is our man, always there for us with his killer drinks, endless story's and always teaching us more español. We miss you Carlos!!! Red Lounge is also a party every night!!! Juan Suarez, Lilian Aquino and Junior Marte are also great bartenders. They always brought the party to Avenue (great bar, great people, great drinks!) These amazing people touched our hearts and helped make our experience at the Paradisus 10x better! We will be back to visit you all!!! Shout out again to RAVEL for being the best of the best. We miss you and your discooooo stories. Love you all and thanks for a great week in paradise.

reviews.author: Anita M
reviews.title: Excellent vacation!
reviews.text:
This is the second year in a row that we visited this resort. We went back because we were so impressed with the quality of the hotel (e.g.cleanliness, amenities), the helpfulness of the staff and the selection of restaurants and great food.
We have three children, ages 10, 7, and 4. We were able to find a nice balance between couple time and family time as their Kid's Club held enough appeal for all three of them.
There is plenty to do between the pool and the beach, and the evening shows kept the children entertained.
In particular we would like to thank Jindrich Stipek, Juan de Dios, and Yuderka Peralta who took care of of food arrangements. My daughter has Celiac's disease, and all three children have nut allergies. They came to see us each day to go over the menu with my daughter, and prepared her meals separately so we knew it was prepared safely. This gave us great peace of mind as if she gets ill it spoils the whole vacation.  They were friendly, courteous, and went out of their way to ensure we all had a good time. They even prepared gluten free pancakes and brownies for her!
Overall, we were very impressed, and will definitely be returning again.

reviews.author: Marsha L
reviews.title: Met Expectations
reviews.text: It's been about five years since we last traveled to DR and we were pleasantly surprised. Upon arrival, we were impressed with airport update. The hotel itself is a nice property. For an all inclusive the food is fairly good. We did go during peak time right after Spring break/ and during Easter break but found the hotel to be staffed adequately and to our surprise not too over crowed (sufficient chairs etc.) Earlier dining hours were difficult to come by (if traveling with younger kids) entertainment was sufficient and catered towards all ages. Staff was really polite, seek out "Argenis" Rijo Santana he was based out of one of the main buffets super friendly and courteous guy will really go out of his way for you! Be conscious of the inclusive package you book, some allow you access to its neighbor resort for dinner "The Reserve" not really necessary but an option. Had upgraded room, wasn't too costly to do which allowed for larger sq. footage for family. Overall would return, good value for cost. Did not seek excursions outside of resort, beach was great.

reviews.author: johnmE9341CT
reviews.title: Spring break 2016
reviews.text: First trip to Dominican Republic and Paridisus Palma. The weather was wonderful. The hotel, beach and grounds were beautiful. The restaurants were also very good and fun. Our butler, Ariel Benzo, was delightful and very helpful. He made dinner reservations, surprised us with drawn bubble baths, helped with beach accommodations, chocolate covered strawberries and wine and cocktails waiting for us in the room after a hard day at the beach! All in all, very relaxing and enjoyable vacation.   We will be sure to return!

reviews.author: Anjali A
reviews.title: Lovely Staff and Great Family Activities
reviews.text: The hotel is perfect for families that like to stay centralized and on-property. The best asset are the people of the DR who were by far, some of the most wonderful people I've experienced when traveling in the Caribbean. A special shout-out to our family concierges Sandra and Estanfania; as well as to Estefamy Hurtado Santos and Yaritza Rodriguez.  Everyone by the pools, the beaches and at all the restaurants went out of their way to make sure we were happy.

reviews.author: MMM522015
reviews.title: Family celebration
reviews.text:
A wonderful week. Beautiful facility. Great staff that fulfilled all our wants and needs.
The rooms were well appointed and always clean and comfortable.
The only negative was the inefficient, always wrong dinner reservation system.

reviews.author: fascor
reviews.title: Quick Trip, Beautiful Resort, Great Weather!
reviews.text: Went there on a company convention. Beautiful place, as everybody was great to us. I want to thank my girl Kenia at the Gabi Bar for making us feel at home! Rooms & Grounds were clean and neat. Food was good as most of the daytime food was a buffet. Would definitely go back...for a longer stay!

reviews.author: Andrea E
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
My husband and I were able to go for business and extended our stay. It was the nicest resort we have been to (we've been to several nice resorts in the Caribbean, 2 Sandals included). We did not do the upgrade and never felt like we were missing out on anything. A LOT of the reviews I read before hand had me a bit nervous that our stay was going to be horrible since we knew, going in, that we would not upgrade. The food was great! I did quite a few of the daily activities and exercise classes offered-all awesome! My favorites were the paddle board classes (yoga and a general workout) plus they put the paddle boards back in the water later in the day and let you use them! I also took painting and candle making-fun and it made me feel productive ;) 
We had no issues finding somewhere to sit, both around the pool and on the ocean, we got there anywhere between 9-10 and had plenty of options. 
While checking out the man next to me was a grouch saying it was horrible and never coming back bc the water pressure in his room was bad.... You will never be able to please everyone, ours wasn't the best but we didn't care, we didn't go there for a nice shower ;)
My only complaint is that the coffee place doesn't open until 11am, but you can get all of that at the Buffett, so not a huge deal!

reviews.author: BethFromCanada
reviews.title: Our trip to PPR
reviews.text: My husband and I have been to PPR a number of times and always look forward to our next visit. We can always count on great weather, wonderful people/staff and an overall relaxing holiday. I wanted to especially thank one of the restaurant Managers, Juan de Aza who we've known all the years we've been going to PPR. We met him when he was Manager at the then Gabi Beach restaurant (now known as Fuego), the Palazzo restaurant and currently he manages Rare (the steak restaurant).He demonstrates the epitome of customer service and professionalism. Thank you!

reviews.author: Brigittte2016
reviews.title: HOTEL 10/10 PLUS !!!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Acabamos de regresar a nuestra casa de Valencia, Venezuela, después de disfrutar de 7 fabulosos días (31 Marzo al 7 de Abril) en ese maravilloso Resort y queremos por este medio hacer llegar a todo el personal del Hotel, que tuvo a bien atendernos, nuestras mas sinceras felicitaciones y reconocimiento por la manera como nos "mimaron" durante nuestra estadía.

Aparte de las modernas, impecables y muy bien dotadas y mantenidas instalaciones y servicios del Hotel, no hay duda de que su activo mas importante es el personal que trabaja allí y que con su eficiencia, deseo de atender y complacer, bonhomía y carisma, nos hizo disfrutar de unos días inolvidables, haciendo muy apropiada la definición del Royal Service, donde estuvimos.

Mención especial merece nuestro Mayordomo, Sr. José Minier, quien mas que un mayordomo fue un amigo y se esmeró hasta la saciedad para satisfacer en forma efectiva y oportuna nuestros mas mínimos antojos y requerimientos.  También es necesario resaltar la eficiencia y amabilidad de todo el personal del Restaurant Palazzo, empezando por la carismática y muy simpática anfitriona Zenovia y Oscar, Richard, Félix, Miguel, Jhoneidy, Yunior, Osvaldo, Marino, quienes sin duda alguna se esmeraron por hacer que las veces que fuimos a comer a ese Restaurant fueran verdaderamente placenteras.  A todos ellos una condecoración y nuestros aplausos.

Desde los deliciosos y abundantes desayunos del Restaurant Palazzo hasta la cena de degustación, altamente gourmet del Passion, todos los restaurantes, cada uno en su especialidad, fueron espectaculates.

El mantenimiento de todas las áreas del hotel y limpieza y servicio en las habitaciones fueron estupendas.  No podemos dejar pasar por alto nuestro reconocimiento al personal de atención en el área de la piscina y de la playa.  En fin, si hay que calificar a este Resort, la nuestra es 10/10 PLUS !!   Esperamos sinceramente que este personal esté en el hotel en Septiembre cuando pensamos regresar.

Cordiales saludos,  Brigitte y Gustavo Cosson

reviews.author: jayjay821
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: I travelled here in August 2015 for my honeymoon and the resort is beautiful. They keep it up very well and even the scent sticks around the resort were a nice touch. We had an ocean view suite and it was worth every penny to wake up and look right out at the ocean every morning! A couple of my complaints were that when we were there, a few of the restaurants were closed for remodeling, but I never saw this mentioned ahead of time and one of them was the Italian restaurant and Italian is my favorite food, so I was bummed. Also, I felt like the room service cleaned too much - I know that sounds stupid, but they came in our room 2-3 times a day. One suggestion was that I wish we had the choice to have a butler or not - we knew we wanted the ocean view suite, but we really hardly used our butler, but still felt we needed to tip him at the end - I'm sure if given the choice though, most people wouldn't choose a butler so it would probably hurt their business. We had Enrique as our butler and he was great and funny - he kind of felt like our friend by the end of the trip. One night we had a dinner with other couples on their honeymoon which was very nice and when we came back he set up candles and rose pedals in our room (soo romantic). My last complaint (really from my husband) was that the pools closed at 6 or 7 so there wasn't much to do at the resort in the evenings. Also, I commend the resort because when we travelled there was when there was a big seaweed outbreak in the Caribbean so we were really disappointed with the beach, but the resort was working to resolve the issue and had a tractor out there each morning to clean it up, so I appreciate the effort! Overall though, this is a beautiful resort and well kept. I would definitely recommend it :)

reviews.author: daveF4962TD
reviews.title: Enjoyable but some room for improvents
reviews.text: Great resort.  Very beautiful setting and fantastic beach!  Food was good for punta Cana but overall just average. Rooms seemed a little dated and worn. We tipped frequently and service was adequate but not enthusiastic. Was here mostly for business but stayed a few extra days for ourselves.

reviews.author: christinertunney
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation!!
reviews.text:
Wow, we had an amazing time. The food, the service, the cleanliness, the beaches, 
everything!! We will be back!! Nicia Cortorreal, our concierge, was so helpful! She would send special treats for the kids up to our room, she took care of all our dinner reservations. Such a nice person too as were all the staff. Julio Reyes & Anthony Paola in Gabby Beach were super! Always so helpful. And of course, we can't forget Carlos Aguilera!!!
Thank you so much for a very memorable vacation!! Mr. & Mrs. OF:)

reviews.author: ronalddrummond
reviews.title: Family Vacation at The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We've returned from an excellent 8-day vacation at The Reserve.  So many great things to say about the resort, that I think I will start with items that could be improved upon:

- Club Melia:  A small percentage of the staff were looking to get us to sit down to listen to the timeshare.  More of an annoyance than anything.  
- Reservations:  Get on these early or get a family concierge to help out.  Times book up fast at the sit-down restaurants.

To the good things:

Our family of four (kids 5 and 7) were in a one-bedroom master suite in Building 41, on the third floor overlooking the main pool.  The room was spacious, modern, clean, and well stocked.  The beds were very comfortable - lots of pillow selection.  The pullout sofa was surprisingly comfortable for a pullout.

The Reserve section is a 5-10 minute walk from the beach.  The resort has a number of shuttles running to and from the beach, and bicycles, if walking isn't your thing.  The beach is fantastic - great sand, waves, and staff.  We found that cabanas were always available at the beach and service staff down there (Jose Luis, Jose, and Ramon) eager to help you find a good spot and keep things light.  Drinks at the beach bar were excellent.  We would highly recommend borrowing a boogie board from the sport shop down there and spending lots of time in the waves - certainly the highlight of the vacation for us.

The main pool is stunning - super clean, good for anyone that can swim and full of life.  The staff there knew us by name (or had nicknames for us) by the end of the trip and made sure the whole family was taken care of.  Emilio and Wander were great with the drinks, Luis made sure to keep us updated with daily events (finger painting sounds lame, but is actually pretty great), Naomi always had a smile and a story, and Sugar Rey (Raynold) had a contagious energy while leading whatever pool fun for kids or adults.

The food is what you would expect from a resort.  Nothing blew us away, but nothing was awful.  I particularly enjoyed The Grill and Vento.  The breakfast buffet at The Reserve lounge was a touch better than the buffets down at the beach.

Administrative staff of note include Melissa, the concierge in Building 39, who worked super hard to find us a new room; Jasson at the front desk - my brother from another mother - made checkout a breeze; Sofia - who made sure our transit back to the airport was confirmed; and, most of all, to Yarol - the family concierge, who's efforts and smile made every day go according to plan.

reviews.author: Mark F
reviews.title: Visited for a company payoff and really enjoyed it.
reviews.text:
It was our first trip to the DR and when we first landed and entered the airport to go through customs I was very
Impressed already with how clean and nice it was. Everyone you come in contact with are super nice and not just because they trying to extract money from you, they seemed honestly interested in you enjoying your  vacation experience. After a 20 minute bus ride to the resort we checked in "quickly" and walked to our room which was spacious. Only check complaint was the told us our bags would be right behind us with the bellmen but after about an hour I called to inquire and they arrived shortly after. Also everyone we were there with had issues with the showers, no hot water and pressure problems. Those were our only issues, the property, beach and employees were unbelievable. The beach was beautiful! It was huge with plenty of palapas and lounge chairs and the sand was the finest I've seen like powder. The ocean was warm with very little seaweed and no shells (kind of strange)
But easy on the feet. The other thing I liked was no beach sales people aside for the para sailing people that was it!
Bartenders were awesome everywhere, very friendly and seemed happy to be there. My wife and I only ate at one of the restaurants "Bana" which offers Sushi and it was really good, the rest of the time we ate at the buffet "Naos"
Which had a very nice selection of food. All in all a great place that I would come back to and recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: 880sunfun
reviews.title: A REAL PARADISE
reviews.text: Our trip was all inclusive with Royal Service Suites, all meals and beverages,  The suite had a in room Jacuzzi and bed turn down service and our own butler.  Our butler, Ariel Benzo, made sure our stay was most memorable.  He was attentive and provided all that things  we needed. There were nightly shows that were entertaining.   The food at the restaurants we tried was all very good.   The landscaping at this resort is a real eye feast.

reviews.author: Randy N
reviews.title: Pretty Good, but lots of flaws
reviews.text:
The good--The staff was pretty good all around from check in to check out, the food was pretty good for an all inclusive. The Resort is pretty and have nice views of water,beach access etc.Wifi worked pretty well.

The flaws--  First thing we were told is to not drink the water out of sink,nor brush your teeth with it. The second thing we were told was not to be on beach after dark--not safe.

Lots of little things.. shower is difficult to operate, some days very little hot water,dinner  reservations are tough without a butler.Casino is TINY,TINY. room keys were always not working--despite not being near cell phone etc. Happened 5 times in 7 days

Bottom line is we enjoyed our week, the employees of the hotel work hard--but off the resort felt sketchy---  even during day you walk the beach there are tons of guys approaching you about buying things--some illegal. Not all that unusual I guess but seemed like a lot more here.

I would not go back to Dom Republic again --

reviews.author: Dori F
reviews.title: All inclusive at its best
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived until the moment we departed, our stay was nothing short of perfect.   Our family hostess Claury Careta again went far above and beyond to ensure that our every need was met.   Although I'm sure she had other guests to attend to, she always made us feel like our pleasure and enjoyment was her only goal.    She was very attentive to detail and followed up with us regularly to be sure we were receiving superior service from everyone at the resort.   This was our second visit...we were fortunate enough to return with more family this year and everyone was in awe of the amenities....the restaurants, golf, spa, gym, and daytime pool-side activities were extremely 
enjoyable and the evening shows were spectacular.    I would also be remiss if I didn't mention your employee Popeye'.   His interaction with ALL the guests was amazing.   He is an asset to the resort.    My most sincere thanks to all - most especially Claury and Popeye for making this a vacation we will all remember.   We're already looking forward to a return trip!

reviews.author: ericmJ1448KM
reviews.title: Great property but a lot needs to be worked out.
reviews.text:
Great place and good food.  Make sure everything they promise is in writing or it never happened. 
Make your dinner reservations beginning of the week or you will never get in.  Dinner at the buffet everynight can get stale.  All staff are very nice until you actually need something.  Then it can get frusterating.   We called 6 times for additional towels and got nada until we walked to the front desk.

reviews.author: MANUEL ARTURO R
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia en este Hotel
reviews.text: Excelente hotel y el personal de la piscina (Ronald), bar, playa (Ramon) y demas que ahora mismo olvido el nombre realizaron excelente trabajo permitiendo que pueda sentirme a gusto junto a mi familia, el Room Services impresionante y con gusto volveria a este hotel.

reviews.author: gkm110
reviews.title: 1st Visit to Punta Cana
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, very nicely maintained, beautiful grounds.  Rooms were spacious in the resort (we did not stay at the reserve).  Stayed in 3700 building, close to pool area and easy walk to the beach.  No problem getting chars every day, not too crowded either.  The food at all locations was okay, just different with a strange variety of items.  It was a really nice vacation and the whole family enjoyed the resort.  Not much English speaking, we had to wing it every once and awhile.  But overall, nice place.

reviews.author: Patricia G
reviews.title: Wonderful Relaxing Birthday Vacation
reviews.text:
Our vacation started with a private care ride from the airport to the resort. We knew we were in heaven the minute we went through the gate of the resort. My husband and I were welcomed immediately, told our luggage would be waiting in our suite and then we were taken to the Royal Service Suite where we checked in and were familiarized with their services. We then met our wonderful, friendly butler Angelo. After inquiring if we wanted to go to our room or on a tour of the resort, we decided on the tour. He was very knowledgeable about all the amenities. He introduced us to our pool concierge Martin Tineo at the adult pool. an then took us to our room and asked if it was to our liking (we had a hotel ocean view room). He informed us of all amenities in the room, gave us info about the spa, 24 hour room service and provided us with a cell phone to contact him whenever we had questions or needed him. He offered to unpack for us which we declined.

If you are able, Royal Service is the way to go which other reviewers have also said. They go out of their way to make everything special for you. The restaurants, pool and beach areas for Royal Service guests were wonderful. The only negative was at the pool which is not very big, there was a large group who brought their own music which they played very loud even though their was music also playing at the resort, were drinking a lot and became very loud and sometimes offensive. No staff at the resort spoke to them so we changed to the cabana at the beach for the rest of our stay.

Since it was a long day for us...weather delayed our flight, we decided to eat at Naos for their buffet. We didn't know where to look first, what a choice of food and every bite was better than the last. We ate breakfast and lunch their almost every day and really enjoyed the freshly made food, fruits, bread, eggs to our liking, etc. The staff greeted us at every meal and always had a smile for us. The staff were there to refill our water, provide coffee, cappuccinos, juice, soda, alcoholic beverages, etc.

Our butler Angelo made reservations at the restaurants for us. We gave him free reign on which restaurants to go to except for the last night were I wanted to eat at Passions for our birthdays...more about the later. We asked him to provide information on some excursions which he readily did. Anything we asked he answered with a huge smile. 

Our days were pretty much days of relaxation at the adult beach for Royal Service guests. Our wonderful, caring pool/beach concierge Martin Tinoe always had our cabana ready, provided us with towels, a smile and always "Hola, Buenos dias, Como esta?. Throughout the day he came by to ask if we were okay and needed anything including drinks...water, soda, alcoholic drinks. I can't say enough about Martin. He made our stay very special. He made us feel like we were the only guests he was taking care of. Our last day was my birthday. He put a Happy Birthday sign on the cabana, affixed balloons and made a towel heat. He was such a sweet man.

Angelo made reservations for us at Palazzo the italian restaurant for Royal Service guests only, Vento....International/Mediterranean, Fuego...Peruvian, Blue Agave.....Mexican, Rare....Steakhouse and Passions. The food was delicious at Palazzo (we paid extra for a bottle of wine), Vento, Rare and Passions ($$$$). We'd never eaten Peruvian and didn't find it a favorite. The Mexican was okay, but the food was dry. While we liked Palazzo it was not a favorite either. We loved Vento, Rare and were ore than happy to pay the additional money for Passions. Would highly recommend these and Naos which I mentioned before.

We decided we wanted to try our hand at parasailing. There were a number of companies providing this right on our beach. Angelo made a reservations for us as well and "off we went" literally. This was a blast. The company he set us up with did not give us a long ride as some others did and what was a real disappointment to us was were agreed to purchase pictures and CD which we never received. Angelo tried several times to contact them, but they did not return his telephone call. Thankfully I had a waterproof camera with me so I did get some pictures.

The last day was by far the best, of course it was my birthday which started out with the decorated cabana. In the afternoon, without my knowledge, Angelo decorated our hotel room with a happy birthday signs, balloons and a bubble bath spa with candles, flower petals and HBD in flower petals in the middle of the bubbles. What a special treat! Our dinner at Passions was spectacular. No wonder Martin Berasategui has 7 Michelin stars!

I can't say enough about all the staff we came in contact with. Even the staff who cleaned the pool had a smile and Hola for all the guests. By far Angelo and Martin were the best!!!!!! The resort is beautiful. I would dare anyone to say they could not relax here. Everything you could want is at your fingertips....including cigars! We will definitely return to the resort again.

reviews.author: 314grettab
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PARADISUS PALMA
reviews.text: Upon arriving, the check in was effortless, welcoming and warm. the open air lobby, bar and view to the sea, past towering fountains an polls, the architecture was stunning. The white sand beach, had plenty of tikis  for shade, (zero litter), lots of chairs and cabanas at pool too. Great beach service of cold Presidente and Miami Vice drinks! Beautiful room and public areas, very well kept. The buffet area had multiple choice of food styles and preparations, again very very clean. Our room was comfortable , quiet and beautiful. I would go back to this resort as the staff so friendly and the property very well maintained.

reviews.author: Patrick P
reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: This place was awsome! The all inclusive had tons of stuff to do, the people where all very friendly and helpful! I highly recommend. The beaches are great and there is stuff to do at night like dancing and hanging out, it's a fun place to just walk around if that's what you like to do and it's also a great experience.

reviews.author: enzoandres
reviews.title: Servicio de Habitaciones
reviews.text: Quiero agradecer el esmero que nos dan en la villa 38 the reserve punta cana las stas. Cleybi, Desirse y Gina para que no nos falte nada y que el cuarto este siempre listo e impecable, siempre con un saludo cordial.  por estas simples cosas hacen que volvamos siempre. Gracias a todas ellas.

reviews.author: amargoli
reviews.title: Two Thumbs Up!
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Paradisus Palma Real and it won't be our last.  We vacationed with our close friends and took the Royal Service package with a Garden Room.  This was arguably the best vacation we have been on, and we are all-inclusive vacationer's and have been all around the Caribbean over the past 30 years.  My wife is a tough critic and a New Yorker, if something goes a little sideways she is calling it out.  She loved this place, enough said.

She is a beach fanatic, and I am a golfer who likes to play early and be on the beach around noon.  This place hit the nail on the head for both of us.  The beach was a 9.5 (I'm leaving it shy of a 10 only because there was a little seaweed but very minimal so no big deal, and the ocean wasn't that swimming pool calm, but also no big deal as the water was gorgeous).  Huts galore on the beach if you wanted some shade, awesome lounge chairs on the beach (like full size beds).  Unbelievable powder white sand and Martin from the bar kept us happy with drinks and super nice disposition.  I pride myself in making awesome margaritas and Leonardo the bartender at the adult pool gets 2 thumbs up for the best margaritas I've had at any resort.  He'll squeeze you fresh limes if you ask him instead of that sour mixer garbage you get at almost any bar.

Our butlers Alvaro and Sam were nicer than nice, and that goes for everyone who works at this resort.  Everyone was happy, smiling all time, and made you feel welcome and were happy to help in any way.

Overall, the food was very good.  At Pallazzo it was outstanding and the chef made the 4 of us a special dinner on 2 nights because we weren't too happy at one of the other restaurants because of the service (we left without even ordering, so for all I know the food might have been very good).  The food was very good everywhere we ate with one exception and that was the steakhouse.  Since our food was all-inclusive we elected to not order the steaks from the prime meat section of the menu because it was an extra cost.  We went with the ribs and a bunch of side dishes...not good, we'll skip that place next time.  But all the other restaurants we ate at were very good (although we didn't eat at all of them).

The golf at Cocotal is 27 holes, very nice, and 4 minutes down the road from the resort.  There are alternative beautiful $300/round courses in the area, and I am spoiled with nice golf courses where I live. But Cocotal was just fine and I think any reasonably spoiled golfer would appreciate playing there.

We will be back.

reviews.author: dori821
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Having recently returned from a day short of a week at the Resort I can't stop reminiscing about the wonderful time had and the staff that went over and above to make sure we left feeling the way we do.  We checked into the Royal Service and felt exactly like royalty from the getgo.  From our buttler Samuel, to our outside at the ocean buttler Manuel to our awesme outdoor bartender Lorenzo.   The staff at the private italiain dining room Palazzo could not have been better. From the moment we were greated by Zenovia with her warm smile and fabulous personality. WE had a special meal prepared for us by chef Rafael.  Our waiter Felix Garcia and Oscar were so attentive and made sure everything was perfect.  It was like being at a five star dining experience..oh, it is.  The food at the buffet is wonderful.  If you can't find something there..than..yeah, it's you.  They have everything!!  Kid friendly, adult sophisticated, vegan, glutten free, fat free, fattening, delicious, beautiful presentation.  Now although there are kids at this facility, being in the Royal Service you would never know this.  I only know this as when you walk on the beach you might see them, or you might see them in there designated area with the kid staff coaxing them to participate in games and group activities.  The pool area also has adult friendly group activities like paddleboard yoga, spin class in the water with stationary bikes, yoga classes.  You must check a print out they give you upon arrival.  OK.. this is one of my suggestions:  the daily activity sheet should be left on the bed during the bed turn down in the evening so you can check the schedule for the next day that evening.  If you don't have bed turn down (if you are not in the Royal Service) then it should be left after the room is cleaned during the day.  I'm not sure if they have bed turn down in the other buildings in the evening.  My other suggestion is much more important and really needs to be addressed:  (yeah everything was great .. except this..)  YOU NEED TO GET INTO GOING GREENER!!  The amount of PLASTIC soda bottles used is ridiculous.  Why do you not have soda out of a fountain????  So there you have it..my biggest, worst criticism!!  I kinda get the paper cups for the drinks, I think there should be a recycle garbage for plastic and paper as well.  
So, besides the "green" issue, which is pretty easy to change this place is awesome!!!
The spa garden is worth a walk thru to continue to keep you in the zen zone.  The overal rating is outstanding!!  Thank you for a great week 
And only because this next statement is my husbands field of work..the premisis is accessible to all.  There are ramps for wheelchairs, hand rails, the pool had a ramp to get into..not that I saw anyone using it..but it is a very friendly place.

reviews.author: crys4848
reviews.title: Best vacation ever..Here's some tips
reviews.text: First off, before you arrive, bring 100 singles for tips. Give only $1.00 dollar tips because even 1 dollar is huge in Dominican Republic. So this hotel is about a 20 minute car ride from the airport. The hotel is absolutely stunning and is the best in the area. We had a wonderful 6 day stay and I can't say enough good things about it. Find a bar in the hotel that you will most frequent. We chose the swim up bar for obvious reasons. The first day I gave the bartender a $20.00 and told him I'd be here all week. Being that your drinks are free, he made them extra strong and as soon as he saw us coming he'd start making them. Guestavo and Luis are excellent bartenders! If I could change one thing, I'd give the bartender $5.00 a day because sometimes, you won't see that bartender again. The buffet was excellent and was very good with plenty of options to eat for all meals. The servers are very good with getting your drinks. Davidson and Argentis were very sweet and eager to please. Everytime we ate, we left a dollar on the table. The nightlife at the hotel was wonderful. Gabbi beach bar puts on great entertainment which usually starts at 8:30pm until 11:00pm. The staff dances and is very engaging with the guests. The pool was very clean and we made several friends from all over which we saw all week long. We only did one excursion, "Isle Saona." Its an island off the coast and you take a party boat to the island. They feed you lunch (Which was the best and most authentic food) and beer and you stop and see starfish on the way back home. As you will be wet, bring a change of clothes for the bus ride back to the hotel.  There are local guys on the beach that try and sell you excursions, stay away from them and they are a bit annoying. The hotel security does an excellent job keeping them off the property.  Also, don't go to the shopping center down the beach, Its about a 10 minute walk to your left. Everyone tries to get you to come into their store and when they see your Paradisus hotel bracelet that you must wear on your wrist, they press you hard because they think you have lots of money since Paradisus is such a fancy hotel. This was told to me by a local guy who we became friendly with. They have a club in the hotel called "Red lounge." It opens everyday at 11pm. We had lots of fun dancing the night away almost every night. Our room was spacious and comfortable. Housekeeping comes twice a day and they leave pieces of chocolate on the bed at night. Theres a snack bar open between 11am-6pm. They have nachos, burgers and small snacks.  Theres also a coffee/gelato bar. Everything is included in your stay. We always tipped a dollar. We didn't get the royal service. I didn't see the need. I wanted a massage and the spa is a bit expensive. The cheapest massage was $150.00. So the next day, I saw the staff from the spa by the pool and they were giving 30 minute massages on the beach for $60.00. We did that and it was the most amazing massage. My masseuse's name was Daury. She is wonderful. Overall, this vacation was nothing short of amazing and we are planning to come back in September!!!!

reviews.author: danielrodis
reviews.title: YOU MUST GO TO THE RESERVE!!!!
reviews.text:
Friends, My family just came back from 5 days at the Paradisus Reserve, and it was FANTAAAAAAASTIC!  Our Family Concierge is named Yarol, and he attended to our needs and anticipated what we would want even before we did.  When you go, ask for him to take care of you!!!!

My wife misplaced her phone, just as we were going to one of the great restaurants, and let Yarol know, just in case anyone put it in the lost and found.  20 minutes later, it was delivered to her at the restaurant.  They didn't want her to worry through a meal and give it to her later.

The daughter in the family we traveled with had a birthday while we were there.  Yarol went out of his way to make it a special day, with a decorated room, and offered us a special dinner outside by the pool, just the eight of us, with any food we would like to eat!

Martini, the bartender at the Italian restaurant was awesome.  Not only a great mixologist, but one of the funniest and kindest people around!

Lastly, I am sorry I didn't get the fellows name, but we all called him DrinkyDrinky.  He was the attendant at the Reserve pool, and regularly asked us if we wanted any drinkydrinky.  By the middle of our first day, DrinkyDrinky knew our preferences and brought them even before we asked.

The customer service is top notch, the food is great the pools and the beach are inspiring.  It was a wonderful trip!

Another great team, but I can't remember the names, were the two ladies who attended to our hotel room.  My family and I are quite messy on vacation, and our room was completely restored and refreshed every day, IMMACULATE would be the word I use.  Additionally, the complimentary 'fridge would be restocked of our favorite cookies and juice and such!

We also went to Dolphin Discovery and our director is Gabriel and the dolphin is Nefty...both amazing.  It was a great experience, and he really knew how to guide and instruct us!

reviews.author: attoto25
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Palma
reviews.text: My family went the week of Easter , the beach and the rooms were beautiful. Very accomodating staff - wandy castillo in the main buffet area was very helpful , and Francisco Cabrera got our chairs and drinks every day at the pool and beach for us. Both great guys. The air conditioning in the rooms were very noisy especially when it cycled on.

reviews.author: Daniel N
reviews.title: Paradies in Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Das war eins der schönsten Urlaube, die wir hatten.
Wir waren 2 Wochen vom 25.3.-8.4.2016 im Royal Service.
Einfach traumhaft. Mit eigenen Butler Jose und Francisco. Diese beiden haben uns alles sehr schön vorbereitet. Der Geburtstag meiner Frau war wunderschön. Wir wurden immer mit schön hergerichtetem Jacuzzi im Zimmer überrascht. Vielen Dank!
Die Bar im Royal Service wurde wunderbar.
Hier vielen Dank an Leonardo Mota !!! Einfach super !
Danke an Faustino Mejia- hat uns alle Getränkewünsche erfüllt.
In den Restaurants vielen, vielen Dank zuerst an Juan de Dios Gomez!
Schläft dieser Mann mal ?? Er war überall und fast zu gleichen Zeit ! Er erkundigte sich ständig nach unseren Wohlbefinden. Noch nie sowas erlebt! Vielen Dank!
Auch an die anderen sehr,  sehr netten Mitarbeiter des Paradisus - Danke ! Wunderbar alles und nicht zu toppen:
Junior - Oscar - Marino - THoreidy - Richard - Felix - Miquel - Zenovia - Julio Cesar - Thompson.
Wir waren im Royal Service mit den 2100er Räumen mit OceanView. Traumhaft und sehr, sehr ruhig.
Vielen Dank an alle für diesen unvergesslichen Urlaub.
Sehen uns in September wieder !!!

reviews.author: Leanne
reviews.title: 2 weeks in paradise!
reviews.text: We just spend 2 weeks at Palma Real Paradisus and had a wonderful holiday.  Everyone was extremely welcoming and always friendly.  The resort is clean and well maintained.  Our maids were wonderful. Only had a few issues with our room but they were taken care of right away.  We had 2 wonderful waiters at the pool and beach that did a wonderful job of taking care of us.  Francisco Estrella and Georges Alriche were excellent.  This was my second trip here at the same resort in 3 years and I was impressed with all the improvements and changes that have happened.  Room service was great, having teenage boys with us we used this service a great deal.  Would love to see some more activities for teens though, like ping pong tables.  For us the food was ok, was a little disappointed this time around.  But by no means did we starve. The Japanese restaurants were our favorite.  This is a beautiful resort

reviews.author: A3543WCdeniseb
reviews.title: Paradisus palma real
reviews.text: All inclusive fees are way too much for the quality of food.  Need more Dominican restaurants on site as well.  I know these resorts depend on reviews but this is my opinion.  I don't see how I'm going to eat and drink $1600 worth of food and drink in 6 days.  The presentation of food is nice to make you think it is expensive but the taste, not so much.

reviews.author: The Brautigan A
reviews.title: Wish I was there longer
reviews.text: Great food very nice rooms. I loved the room service I loved the pools  and I loved the beaches.Will go back again. Very !friendly staff. The weather was outstanding. The dining and the spa where great. I would like to thank Carlos and from the spa Jenny and Ruth for being so nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Violeta G
reviews.title: Calidad excelente
reviews.text: El hotel nos encantó. La ubicación, las habitaciones, el resort, la comida, y sobre todo el trato del personal. Me gustaría sobre todo destacar la profesionalidad y amabilidad de Caramelo, Judy, Agripina, Luis y Angel. Todo en general excelente, lo que nos hizo disfrutar de unos días inolvidables.

reviews.author: eley864
reviews.title: Palazzo restaurant is the Bomb!
reviews.text: The staff at restaurant Palazzo was awesome.  Thank you Oscar,Felix,Richard,Miguel,Yunior,Jhoniedy, Marino and Zenovia for making our dining experience suburb.  Special shout out to our butler Yohelvi who took great care of us for 5 days. He checked on us everyday. Surprised us with fruit platters in the room after a long day out. Came back to a warm bath with roses in the shape of a heart. He even took the initiative to book our dinner reservations. WHAT A STAR!!!! OVERALL A WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE.

reviews.author: Jorge B
reviews.title: Family concierge butler was excellent!!!
reviews.text:
This is our 3rd visit to a Club Melia resort. Our first time in DR. Our butler, Junior Segura really went out of his way to ensure our vacation was special. He always made sure we had a little something extra in our room everyday, From a bottle of chilled wine to having a cake ready for our daughter on her birthday. He even prepped a bubble bath for our kids!!
The team at the kids zone was also excellent. Our kids didn't want to leave! They had special activities planned every day. 
The beach at this resort is amazing, very clean and plenty of loungers with shade.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: ESI Circle of Excellence
reviews.text: Eduard Meinda was our butler and provided top notch service throughout our 5-day stay! Always smiling and going above and beyond. He took care of all of our needs and wants!! We will ask for him personally when we return to the Paradisus Palma Real resort. Fransisco was also always smiling and going above and beyond!! These 2 guys were awesome!!

reviews.author: twinboymommy
reviews.title: Luis Sanchez - Made our trip!
reviews.text:
This trip was part of my company's President's Club award. Our trip included the Royal Service treatment where we had Luis as our butler during our stay.
The rooms, beaches, pools, and restaurants that are reserved for the Royal Service guests are amazing. Palazzo had wonderful food, the pools where relaxing and the beach area was spacious. Luis ensured we had great reservations each evening, drinks in hand on the beach, and great spaces on the beach.

The hotel was clean and all the staff worked hard to ensure we had everything we needed during our stay.

The wireless was very reliable, and we were able to use FaceTime to save on the international calling charges.

The only feature I was not entirely in love with was the bathroom design. The plantation shutters instead of a wall were the only oddity in the elegant room. 

Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our time here, and I would recommend staying here under the Royal Service - ask for Luis - you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Caco297
reviews.title: Ferias
reviews.text: Férias com a família, ficamos no The Reserve, conceito de hotel dentro do hotel, 100% família. Quarto térreo com piscina na saída da varanda, as crianças adoraram. Muito amplo um aspartame to com 2 suites, hidromassagem privativa na varanda. Ótimo atendimentos à beira da piscina, leve dólares para "comprar" melhor atendimento, não gosto desta parte mas não funciona sem....todo dia $5 no mínimo. Os restaurante do hotel mãe Paradisus não gostamos muito comparados a variedade e qualidade dos disponíveis no melia Caribe ao lado

reviews.author: F2657BWrafaelr
reviews.title: Entorno magnifico
reviews.text: Necesita mejora en el mantenimiento de algunas habitaciones sobre todo en los cierres de las terrazas y grifería se ve que no tienen mucho mantenimiento el personal del hotel genial intentan solucionar cualquier problema

reviews.author: Merrill M
reviews.title: A wonderful resort
reviews.text:
The resort was a fantastic location for our family gathering. The pools, restaurants, beach and activities were great. The only downside is the restaurant reservation process is frustrating, inefficient, confusing for their staff as well at the customers. I do not think they could make it more difficult if they tried. Our group of 40+ had a group of reservations at each restaurant that were supposed to be held open for us until 1PM - at 9AM there was virtually nothing available other than 2 seats at 9:30 at a restaurant that we did not wish to eat at. When you did get into a restaurant, more often than not, they were 1/2 empty. Two guesses - either they expected a tip to get a reservation or they wanted to persuade the vast majority of guests into the buffet.  
Other than that, the resort was spectacular. Our garden suite was larger than we could ever need but it was reaching a point where renovations were about due.

reviews.author: S6770DKleew
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive ever
