reviews.text: Be sure to get the Royal Sevice package if possible. We almost didn't and it's worth the extra. Food was excellent. Service was outstanding. Avoid the Japanese restaurant and go to Palazzo often. We were surprised by the shows each night, not expecting that. Fun.

reviews.author: Ro S
reviews.title: Beyond Bad - a 2/3 star experience at 5 star prices
reviews.text:
The pictures and reviews of this place are soooo misleading. The disappointment occurs as you pull into the Reserve. The lobby and reception area are really tired. It is 100 notches below a Four Seasons or Ritz Carlton. And this is only the beginning of the disapointment. During Spring Break, it is basically  Four Seasons prices for a Courtyard Marriott experiences.

Why is it like a Courtyard Marriott like experience?

The beds - the sheets are cheap as well as the mattresses and pillows. There is nothing comfortable about the beds. When I say cheap, the sheets have no thread count and the pillows are really thin. The towels are really cheap and thin too.

The Food - Beyond Bad. You feel like you are on a cheap cruise line - Carnival or Royal Carribean. Bring your Immodium as everyone in our group had an upset stomach on the trip even though the hotel claims to abide by international standards. They make a big deal about reservations but even the supposedly higher end restaurants feel like strip mall restaurants. The Hibachi place is like Bennihana and Rare is no better than an Outback Steakhouse. 

The Service - from the moment you arrive, someone is trying to sell you a time share and the level of service is determined by if they think you are a sucker who will buy the timeshare. I think Melia should concentrate on making the experience better - otherwise who on earth would want to buy a timeshare. This was my FIRST and LAST time at a Melia hotel. Service here is basically non existent. You are lucky if they clean your room before dinner.

Returned to NYC and we are so embarrassed to tell anyone we stayed at this hotel.

reviews.author: Nicole McGeehan
reviews.title: Most amazing vacation ever!!!
reviews.text: From the minute we stepped off the plane until we left Punta Cana, our experience was unbelievable! This resort is top notch and we will definitely return!! The food was excellent, beach was beautiful, and the entertainment was incredible!! The shows each night were worth so much more than we paid! These men and women have amazing talent!! Impressed beyond belief!! We will be back!! Thanks so much for the great memories!! Luis Florian, Jose Fernandez and Yordan Rosario were especially awesome!!!

reviews.author: LCNJ2016
reviews.title: Remarkable family vacation
reviews.text:
Palma Real was absolutely beautiful! We stayed in a one bedroom master suite. It was so spacious. The grounds were very clean.  The weather was fabulous.  We had a beach and pool cabana each day. Although there was 100% occupancy, we never felt the resort was crowded.  There was plenty of room in the pools and beach.  

We had reservations each night for dinner and had no problems changing if we needed to.  The buffet we ate each day for breakfast and lunch.  There is something for everyone!

What most impressed me was how helpful, friendly, and happy the resort employees were. We made sure to be seated at Davidson's section for breakfast and lunch.  Our family loved him. Gabriel made sure our suite was stocked and that all was fine. Harrison saw to all our needs as well. They are such hard-working and dedicated young men. The resort is lucky to have them.

Each night there was entertainment and our family enjoyed the shows. Throughout the day "Shaky, Shaky" informed us of the various activities provided for families. We also saw him throughout the day working very long hours.  He was great!

Overall, one of the best family vacations I have had.  I highly recommend. No complaints.

reviews.author: Christina E
reviews.title: Awesome Trip 😝👍🏾🍾🌊😎
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and my family and I absolutely loved our trip! One of the nicest beaches we have been to with manicured white sand and fabulous turquoise waves! We stayed in the family concierge area and really enjoyed the private pool and kids activities everyday. Our family concierge, Yaro, made sure our trip was perfect, complete with our favourite drinks, food and activities. At the pool Emelio kept the drinks most delicious drinks coming and had a lot of fun with the family. But it was Naomi that really made the trip, she got us dancing in the evening and did wine tasting with us, she was my absolute favourite! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦🕶🐠🏊

reviews.author: CharlSal
reviews.title: Another amazing vacation
reviews.text:
We had another perfect vacation at Palma Real for our group of nine. This was our third time.   The accommodations, food, service and beach could not be better.  Even the weather was perfect.
Our lunch waiter, Wisly Fortune made our time extra special.  He treated us to special lunches and gave us friendly, outstanding service.  
Just wish we could have stayed longer!

reviews.author: 525cheryll
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: We went for one week.  This is the third different property we have stayed at in Punta Cana.  This resort had the nicest rooms and best food we found.  The entertainment staff was amazing.  They go above and beyond.  The ambiance of the lounge, courtyard and restaurants was beautiful and upscale.  Although this was the most expensive resort we have stayed at in the dominican, we wouldn't hesitate to go back.  We enjoyed it that much.

reviews.author: C1402OIkarenr
reviews.title: Excellent Family Vacation
reviews.text: The Reserve was a perfect blend of pool and beach access for our family.  We had adjoining rooms with plenty of space (2 parents, 2 adult children 2 teenagers).  Between Sofia and Silvio our dinners were planned and fabulous.  Despite one parent being sick (prior to trip - sinus infection) we were able to regroup and connect; only negative was the trip wasn't a bit longer - had only 3 full days without travel.  Will definitely be back!  Thanks to to Elaidy and Ysabel for a smooth check out!

reviews.author: lena59
reviews.title: Beautiful Ocean Powder Sand Beach
reviews.text:
We went from March 30 - April 6th. Weather was wonderful. The day we left it poured rain but up until then great. The resort itself was gorgeous. Set on one of the best beaches I've been to. The sand was so powdery. The floor of the ocean was better then some that we have been to. You weren't sinking all the time and the sand wasn't course. Nice. The area wasn't over crowded. My only complaint was that I couldn't enjoy the pool as much as I would have liked to. Being short in height. The pool was 4'.7 " deep. I lingered a lot on the steps - on the water beds and in the jetted area. The ocean was my favourite. As for the food. We only ate at the buffet. Being on holidays for only a week we didn't want to take away from our time. No planning - no clock watching. Lots of choices. Food mediocre. Steak was great. Salad bar wonderful. Servers were friendly and courteous. Loved, loved our room. Room # 3024 in the Sapphire block. Comfortable bed and room size perfect. Our maid - I regret that I don't know her name. She was always singing and smiling. Very accommodating. Service was great. Rooms were kept tidy and clean. 
One thing I couldn't help but notice about this resort was that who ever engineered it knew what they were doing. Air flow throughout the building thumbs up ! Building Structure, furniture and decor aesthetically pleasing to the eye. Built solid. 
Negatives - I did notice lack of understanding english language. 

To Paradises Palma Real People. Thank you for the relaxing wonderful stay. Special thanks to Franklin who made sure we knew all that was entitled to our stay.

reviews.author: Pedro Pablo Rioja
reviews.title: Vacaciones de ensueño
reviews.text:
Estuvimos dos semanas maravillosas en Punta Cana. Excelente tiempo todos los días, soleado con solo un poco de lluvia en las noches. El mar espectacular, de los mejores!
Pasamos todos los días -y todo el dia- en la playa donde quiero destacar la excelente atención y cordialidad de Ramon Ramirez y Jose Luis de los Santos quienes ademas nos hacian reir con las invitaciones a "Drinki Drinki, don't be shy nobody know you, time to get drunk"!!!
Destacar tambien a Luis Florian que tuvo una excelente disposición (y paciencia) para enseñarnos a bailar Bachata y  Merengue, ya que "nos falta todavía para salsa". Y recordar tambien a la Sra Benita Mercedes quien nos atendió muy bien cuando la visitamos en el bar de la playa.

reviews.author: stephendO4823UO
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Best ever and won't to go back asap. Enjoy every thing about this resort. The advantage this resort has it all. Night life shopping great beach and a wonderful staff form the front desk to the butler stuff to the bartenders.

reviews.author: francislucie2016
reviews.title: Un endroit super pour des vacances de reve      Lucie et Frank
reviews.text: Nous revenons de cet hotel,tres bon service et un merci particulier a nos serveur du resto Vento,Wonder Despero et Arcenidas qui ont été d une extreme gentillesse.Notre chambre était tres propre avec le wifi dans la chambre sans frais suppl,une belle plage et tres belle piscine et aussi tres bonne nourriture.Il y avait beaucoup de chaises et de  serviettes disponible a toute heure de la journée.Si vous y aller en suite junior,vous n aurez pas de coussins sur les chaises a la plage,c est peut etre ce que j ai aimé le moins,pas tres confortable.Je vous conseille d y aller vous ne serez pas decu.

reviews.author: Petrbez1
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text:
The whole resort is well kept and maintained. Staff is polite and helpful and you feel safe any time. The beach was clean, seaweed was cleaned every day and the water was warm. Pools were clean, we did not have problems getting beach chairs in the morning. 
Our room was clean and did not have musty smell, we kept AC on the whole day. Bar was restocked every day without calling the front desk. 
We did not upgrade since we had children with us. We still felt we were getting very good service. 
Overall impression was very good, better then similar resorts on other Carribean Islands.
The best surprise was food. We usually do not care too much about food but this resort is really fantastic. Even food buffet is excellent, especially ceviches. 
We will return back next year.

reviews.author: lavi-tom
reviews.title: A Peaceful Escape.
reviews.text:
3 adults and 18 month old visited 2/21-2/27
We stayed in a one bedroom suite - spacious living area, big bedroom with whirlpool tub along with a full-size fridge, plenty of counter space and cabinets (be creative).The bedroom and living room each have their own doors to bathroom, although only the one bathroom, nice to have this privacy. Summed up - great room (ROOM SERVICE TOO)!
 Incredible grounds - pool and beach perfect, along with the service which is non-stop and courteous! 
We ate all our meals in the buffet (18 month old) which was phenomenal! The Best part of the buffet was our server Marta - truly a great person whom our son fell in love with! Food was delicious, more than enough variety, honestly best food we ever ate in an AI.
Look forward to going back someday - well worth it!!

reviews.author: julya1971
reviews.title: super belle vacance !!!
reviews.text:
wow nous sommes aller a ce resort en novembre 2015   7 jours 
moi et mon mari on adorer la plage juste wow ,la bouffe es super bonne et de qualiter,la boisson es de qualiter ,services impecable services par tous picines plage ect les shows le soir etais super  bon nous planifion retourner en 2016 garantie :)

reviews.author: EhJayEl
reviews.title: Great spot for our family vacation
reviews.text:
My wife, myself and our 16 month old daughter spent a week at the Reserve and loved every minute of it.  This was our first experience at an all inclusive resort.  While we missed the chance to experience more of the Dominican Republic's culture, I would not have changed a thing.  The entire staff at the Reserve was absolutely delightful and did whatever they could to make our stay pleasurable.  The pools were perfect and the beach was just a quick golf cart ride away.  Our family concierge was Elaine, and she was very helpful during our stay.  We had a blast with the pool guys and Hector Santana at Gabi Beach made our morning meals a delight.

We often at breakfast at one of the buffets and there were plenty of options to choose from.  Each night we tried a new place for dinner and the food was great, especially the Hibachi grill.  We also liked the Mexican and Italian spots.  I would have loved to have tried Passion, but we didn't want to ditch the little one at night.  We're not big meat eaters so we skipped the steak place.  

Overall this is probably the best service I've experienced.  I would recommend this spot without hesitation and I'm sure that we'll be back again next year.

reviews.author: MARCE-ARG
reviews.title: Comodidad extrema en el paraíso
reviews.text:
The Reserve es un sector más boutique dentro del complejo Paradisus. Todos los servicios y amenities apuntan a una atención más personalizada, no masiva como se vive en el resto del complejo. Estuve alojado durante 10 días con mi esposa e hija de 3 años y la experiencia fue excelente. La habitación es muy amplia y con todo lo que uno  puede esperar de un servicio de excelencia. Destaco: Cama muy amplia y cómoda, yacuzzi muy grande, terraza exterior, sector de living muy amplio con mini cocina. Me sorprendió la limpieza, ya que se hace una limpieza fuerte por la mañana pero luego el personal pasa 2 veces más para reforzarla o preguntando por nuestras necesidades. Tiene un sistema de family concierge para que la atención sea más personalizada. 
Todo el complejo es paradisíaco, muy cuidado en detalles de todo tipo: jardinería, piletas, decoración de lugares comunes, restaurantes, sector de playa.
El wifi es veloz en todo el complejo! 
Las comidas del all inclusive son de mucha calidad y variedad. Hay tragos a todo momento y en todos los sectores! 
Hay un kids club para los niños con actividades muy atractivas para ellos.
Solo elogios para todo el personal, siempre simpáticos y muy cordiales, siempre predispuestos a ayudar para que la estadía sea excelente. 
Especial mención a Rosmery, Cheila, Nicia, Erica y Trinidad. Gracias por todo!! Esperamos volver pronto

reviews.author: marcpaul31
reviews.title: Esprit zen
reviews.text: Cet avis concerne le superbe spa . Situé dans le splendide parc de l ´  hôtel , les abords sont très soignés .   Esprit japonais avec chemin en bois jusqu ´ à  ´ l  entrée , bonsaïs et chemins  en gravillons , petit  bouda ,  lanternes allumées dés la nuit tombée . L ´accueil est classique , vestiaires hommes et femmes séparés ,  avec casiers à clés  pas souvent préparés correctement : il manque soit les chaussons , les sandales , la serviette , la bouteille d  eau ! Passé 18 heures le hammam est éteint et le sauna pas assez chaud . A l  extérieur , 2 bains chauds japonais , bien à l'  abris des regards et du bruit . De l ´autre côté , joli piscine extérieure , et petites cabanes extérieures pour les massages .le luxe absolu : le calme . Massages de qualité moyenne pour le prix , surtout que ce n ´est pas un spa de marque ( clarins  , Guerlain  ,  nuxe  ) .mais belle ambiance japonisante et de très bonnes odeurs , bougies et encens .

reviews.author: Kelly H
reviews.title: Fantastic Family Vacation!
reviews.text:
First off, our Family Concierge Sofia was AMAZING.  Such a sweetheart, took great care of us the entire trip.  Always had beach chairs or poolside chairs reserved for us (based on which one we chose for the day), had all dinner reservations made at the perfect time of night, kept us informed of any and all entertainment, went above and beyond to take care of the kids and meet our every need.  Each night there was a special treat left for us, either backpacks for the kids, goodies to snack on, a bottle of wine or even a bubble bath for the girls!

Overall the resort was great, fantastic service food was good and the grounds were impeccable.  We did the family concierge two bedroom master suite- that room is huge!  As big as a condominium and plenty of space for each of our three kids and for my husband and myself.  It's basically two huge hotel suites connected together by a door that you can close or keep open.  Loved it.  

The resort is huge, the Reserve section is not on the beach, it is set back on the property so if you are someone who has to be able to walk out to the beach from your room maybe book the Paradisus.  We didn't mind taking the little cart to the beach each day.  The Reserve has it's own pool and restaurants but you can use everything that the big resort has to offer.   The Reserve portion has higher end alcohol, and the family concierge allows you to use a section of the beach that is just for the concierge guests - which is perfect because you'll have waiters wait on you for drinks and take really good care of you, plus you'll get these incredibly lush beach chairs!  Perfection!

If you are deciding between the Punta Cana and the Palma Real here are the major differences that I noted (we went over the the Palma Real to visit friends that were staying there and walked around a bit).  The Punta Cana (Paradisus Portion) is a bit smaller with a bit of a smaller pool that the Palma Real Paradisus portion, the Palma Real has a better pool to beach set up - meaning their main huge pool is closer to the beach you can literally just walk back and forth.  The Punta Cana has a bit more separation, not a big deal but a different set up.  Also, the Palma Real has much calmer water, almost no waves at all.  The Punta Cana has some surf that you can boogie board on.  My kids were torn between which one they liked better - both have the typical stunning white sand beaches and breathtaking water!  The Reserve section is almost identical in both hotels, both were set far back on the property and not near the water.  Again, not a problem in our opinion but others may feel differently.

Overall, I would book this hotel again in a heartbeat.  We enjoyed it tremendously.  This was our third time to Bavaro Beach in Punta Cana and I can say that when we return to the DR again we will be staying at one of the two Paradisus hotels there.  It was great!

Oh, by the way, Wifi was free for us for the entire stay and was incredible, fast everywhere- even on the beach!!!!

reviews.author: Sarah-Jane R
reviews.title: Good food, GREAT people, Wonderful holiday
reviews.text:
I don't know where to start with this review. I could describe the wonderful food, atmosphere and beaches, but for me, the people made our holiday complete.
Sofia at the Family Concierge, Alexandra in the VIP, Adalgisa, our housekeeper, Jean at Reception, to name a few. Always on hand with a smile and willing to help. From the Hostesses to the Kids Zone, I mean everyone! The resort itself is stunning, and the atmosphere is friendly and open. Lots of choices with the food. Some tips - make your dinner reservations when you arrive since it can get busy! :)
Sam says hi to everyone!! :)

reviews.author: F1287BEmarianar
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: La estructura  de primera,  la atención  ambiente de primera,  las habitaciones  inmensas,  cómodas,  todo de lujo.  La única Nora. Negativa fue la ducha,  un poco difícil de entender pero en verdad estoy super contenta  y satisfecha de la atención,  la comida,  los que trabajan ahí gente super educada y gentiles . Si me preguntarán que hotel podrá aconsejar en Punta Cana de seguro diría Paradisus  Palma Real.  Gracias

reviews.author: bibianneh
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Hermoso staff el equipo de animacion son excelentes Yokaina es la mejor tambien Noël,Francis,Jordan,Josias,José y Pedro. Es un hermoso resort,hermosas empleados,hermosa playa,arena blanca,hermosa piscina. Es un pais asombroso. Regresaremos otra vez. Nos han tratado genial. We love republica dominicana

reviews.author: Andres G
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text:
Si buscas el paraíso, mucho romanticismo y servicio 5 estrellas este es el lugar indicado. Desde la llegada hasta la salida calidad en atención. El lugar simplemente es mágico. Playas paradisiacas mezclado con modernos medios de transporte locales y habitaciones de lujo. La calidad del personal de servicio de mayordomo personal (Hilario, Luis) y servicio de playa (José Luis de los Santos, Benita Mercedes, Santos Frías) es excelente.
"Its a magical place"

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: First All inclusive trip
reviews.text:
Traveled with family who said this property was a much better experience than other all inclusive resorts. The property is very nicely maintained, the food at the buffet was good, well presented and lots of options.
The restaurants were kind of a pain in the butt- no reservations or very late reservations only. Food at the various restaurants was just OK. It was frustrating trying to get a table every night. I'm not sure if you can book in advance but I would do this if you can to get a good time.
The beach is gorgeous and there are tons of umbrellas and chairs.
The pool was also very nice. Bar service was good, drinks were good, not great...kind of as expected at all inclusive.
Jesus Evangelista at Vento was an excellent server as was Juan Suarez every morning at breakfast and every day at lunch. Both were terrific!

reviews.author: olgagisellea
reviews.title: Calidad y excelente servicio
reviews.text: Me encanto este hotel. Ya es la cuarta vez que lo visito. Me encanta su personal. Domingo beltre es lo maximo, antonio en el area del bar decla piscina es otra joya de persona. Cada visita que hago me sorprenden mas y mas pues en general todos me hacen sentir como en casa pero ellos dos , definitivamente son los maximos!

reviews.author: aritchey
reviews.title: Best time
reviews.text: Thank (Raynold Tamayo) and entertainment at the reserve! This was an amazing vacation. Best all inclusive I have been to yet. Beautiful beaches, great food, and great staff! Thanks again Raynold Tamayo, Luis De Leon, and Jose Perez! And..

reviews.author: Mearl R
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Luis Florian and Pedro Mota, Raynold Tamayo were great!!! They really helped my family. And every time I seen them they had a smile on their faces. It shows that they really love their job! I looked forward to seeing them every day it helped us have a great vacation!!!

reviews.author: 846janez
reviews.title: The Reserve!!  Second time
reviews.text: We just got home last weekend.  We had a blast.  We were there last year and liked it so much we went back.  Food was great again.  The resort was clean .The guys at the beach were awesome Santos Friaz ,Jairo Menier , Ramon Ramirez, Jose de los Santos  All did a great job making sure we were happy.  The pool Guys Jose Xan,  Emilro Valdez, Juan Diego,  Jose Reinoso  made sure we had everything we needed.  Our Family concierge was Stephanie and our concierge from last year was Sondra. She remembered us and also helped us out. Everyone was so friendly and made sure we were happy. I would recommened this resort to friends to join us next time.  Thanks

reviews.author: CarlaChriste
reviews.title: Incrível!!!
reviews.text: Resort completo com todas as regalias e com um serviço de primeira, todos os restaurantes no complexo são incríveis, o atendimento é sensacional. A suíte é um arraso, as noites são super animadas e temos a opção de irmos para o outro complexo da rede que tem cassino e mais atrações, inúmeras formas de divertimento, apenas deve-se prestar atenção aos passeios oferecidos por agências dentro do resort, saber mais detalhes para não ficar o dia todo fora! O Restaurante Mizu é muito divertido! Amei!

reviews.author: X7386KPtinac
reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: The hotel and employees were overall very nice... Some of the restaurants lacked some service quality but overall they meant well... They could use more top shelf liquors at the outside bars... Entertainment needed to have more variety mostly dancing which didn't relate to kids and husbands..

reviews.author: E.G. F
reviews.title: A good experience
reviews.text:
Raul Jiminez helped me and my family at the resort the entire song. The service was excellent and they didn't disappoint once. The team and staff here is excellent. Heel always asked if I was okay, and was always checking up to see if we needed anything. His service was much appreciated. 

As well as Felipe Morla who was at my attendance at any moment that I needed help. The two were phenomenal & I'm super grateful for their service.

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: Nice hotel overall and great beach.  OK selection of restaurants.  Golf courses on site and nearby.  But  very crowded.  Not much service.  Room has moldy smell.  Bath shower leaked badly to the hallway.  Slippery and dangerous!

reviews.author: Enzo C
reviews.title: Los chicks de la playa Los mejores
reviews.text: La atención recibida  es excelente, ya vinimos 4 veces y Cada Vez nos sorprenden más con su buena atención y amabilidad y buena predisposición, en especial a José Luis de los santos, Ramón Ramírez, bendita mercedes, santos frías, Jairo menier, marcelo Sanchez Tineo, Luis Santana..

reviews.author: ina322016
reviews.title: Traumferien!
reviews.text:
Das Hotel war wunderschön. Wir buchten den Royal-Service, was wir nur empfehlen können. Dazu gehören ein separates Restaurant, einen separaten Pool und einen separaten Strandabschnitt. Die riesengrossen Liegen am Stand laden wirklich zum Entspannen ein.
Der Royal Service ist um einiges ruhiger, als der "normale" Bereich. Dort hat es viel mehr Gäste, welche gerne den ganzen Tag Party machen. 
Unser Buttler Emilio war sehr zuvorkommend und reservierte uns sämtliche Restaurants im Voraus. Er erkundigte sich immer nach seinen Gästen und schaute, dass es uns an nichts fehlte. Er machte wirklich einen sehr guten Job!

reviews.author: Glenn F
reviews.title: Overcharged by $1,000  and ignored when trying to resolve
reviews.text: We paid the full balance of our stay at checkin on 2 credit cards.  The morning of checkout, we received a bill under our door, we went to checkout and were told we owed $1,000 because the 2nd card was declined.  We weren't allowed to leave without paying $1,000 more but had to to catch our flight.  When we arrived home we noticed all 3 charges did go through, and we have now overpaid by $1,000. I've been trying to resolve this issue for 3 weeks now and the only contact info I have for the hotel is Josephina the front desk manager and she just ignores me, the only response I received was 2 weeks ago saying they only charged me $1,900.  I paid $2,900. I have shown them proof by sending them all 3 statements and never heard back.  I have no luck calling and getting someone else to help.  At this point I'd say the hotel is trying to scam me out of $1,000

reviews.author: kochen24
reviews.title: If you are a Family looking for a place in Punta Cana...Stop now and Book here
reviews.text:
AMAZING!!  Some can be very picky as I was hesitant upon our departure to this hotel after reading a few reviews here.  However, all of those worries were well behind us the second we arrived to check in at our hotel.  My family has been to numerous countries and stayed at many different hotels and this is the best all inclusive hotel for a family with children by a long shot!   

My family of four just returned from our 7 night stay at the Reserve in the Family Concierge section.  If you don't mind spending the extra money it is well worth it to have someone book your restaurant reservation and cabana reservations.  Elizabeth took care of us and made sure our stay along with our boys stay was extra special.  The boys loved coming home at night to a special treat.  She kept them smiling all week long.  They also provide you with a cell phone to reach you, which comes in handy if you plan on leaving your kids at kids zone.   We have a 4 year old and an 8 year old that we love spending time with and were not so sure about kids club. We went on the first day to check out the kids club and whispered back to my wife I couldn't believe parents would just drop their kids off and leave.  However, after seeing the interaction with the staff and my boys they didn't want to leave.  They loved it so much that they asked to go back each day for a little bit to play.   One night they even had a pirate party for the children on the beach from 8-11 at night :)  Again, we dropped them off and weren't too sure about wondering off but we did and had a great date night.  The kids loved it again and the girls at the kids club were all smiles even after a 15 hour day!!  We made sure to tip them as it was better than some of the babysitting we have at home.  

On to the food choices.  Our kids favorite was actually when they ate lunch at kids club and had noodles :)  My wife and I have ate at some of the best restaurants in the world.  Please keep in mind that this in an all inclusive resort and if you are expecting to have that type of dinner every night, you should probably book "Passion" and pay to eat there every night as it will be more on par with a fancy restaurant back home.  However, we were very happy with the service and the food at each and every restaurant we ate at.  The only exception maybe was Mole, where the food was ok, but the bugs were the worst.  For the buffet spots there were many choices and the food was always fresh!  

Next the pools.  The kids pool was amazing!! Our youngest is 4 and could stand around the entire pool.  Allowing him to go down the slides on his own and play.   The bigger pools always had spots to just lounge around and swim as they are HUGE!!!  

The beach. We had a reserved section of the beach and is the best beach area by far. We walked all the way down both ends of the beach and no other hotel can match the beach front property of this location.  The cabanas were nice when you needed shade and the beds out front were great for lounging in the sun.  The service was amazing and I never felt like I had to wait long for a drink :)   Sand is perfect and the water crystal clear.   

Overall, we usually don't go back to the same place but for another family trip this will be hard to leave out.   The grounds are absolutely breath taking and the rooms are very clean!! Once again I could go on and on, but if you are traveling as a family, stop right here.  I promise you won't find a better family resort to enjoy your vacation.  

One last thing I forgot!! WIFI!!  Our 4 year old was able to relax in the shade and watch Netflix for his rest time in the shade.   No need to upgrade your phone plan as you can just turn on airplane mode and text on wifi all week.

reviews.author: bethr599
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: If you go make sure you are part of Royal Service or on The Reserve otherwise it's a waste of money and very expensive for no reason.  Grounds are beautiful but staff was less than helpful, reservations for dinner were a mess and overcrowded.  Food and drink was average of all inclusive.  Wait staff was not very engaging and got impression most didn't speak English.  If you are part of RCI timeshare exchange definitely don't go here...room was terrible and charged enormous all inclusive fees on top of your points. Have a feeling if didn't go part of RCI it might have been better?

reviews.author: kenandjaneMichigan
reviews.title: Beach concierges Superb
reviews.text:
Having vacationed at several resorts, we have been served by a variety of people. I have to say that Jose (De Los Santos), Ramone ( Ramierz) and Luis (Santana )  and Santos (Frias) form a team that is both fun,polite.extremely complete and definitely 5 Star. They make every day an adventure and full of laughs! The beach concierges are the best!!They are fine examples of why the Paridisus Punta Cana is a great place. 
  PS The guest services ladies-Erika Trinidad and Yenifer Valdez were always there to assist in any and all ways possible.

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: A Slice of Paradise - Treated Royally
reviews.text: This was my second visit to the Paradisius Palma Rea, I had been 6 years ago with my Mom and sister. This time l came back with my husband to celebrate our 25th Wedding Anniversary  The first time I was so impressed but the second time I felt like we were royal guests. We did add the Royal service and from the moment we met our "butler" Eduard Mendez - it was like we had an instant host. Eduard was wonderful - request him when you book - his attention to all the little things - afternoon hor doerves , wine, chocolate covered strawberries, champagne on ICE - there was a surprise in our room every afternoon. He catered to every request and anticipated whims we never even thought of. Angel Frias was our pool/beach host and never failed to fix our reserved Bali bed wherever we desired and then attend to our thirst always with a smile! Leonardo Mota was our bartender and he welcomed us everyday - like we were coming home. Home is exactly how we felt for seven days - the food, grounds, room were all the best! We booked a couples massage but due to a sunburn my husband had the day before we thought we would have to cancel - The spa staff fixed a special service for him to tend to his burn and still provide a great experience! We were so happy to be there - sad to go and can't wait to GO BACK!! Thanks to the Staff you were fabulous and Made our Anniversary very memorable! Robin and Jim Humphreys

reviews.author: Armando M
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: El trato en general fue excelente. Sin embargo, la atención brindada por: Lenny Reyes, Anny González, Raúl Jimenez, Francisco Estrella y el Señor Diego, Barman del restaurante el fuego fue excepcional, por lo cual quedamos muy complacidos.

reviews.author: Jen A
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Raul, Raul, Raul Jiminez!!! From the moment we arrived, he got us set up on the beach and took care of us all week!!! Second time here, and we LOVE this place!!!  I will write more when we get home, but I just really wanted to say Raul has gone way above and beyond!!!

reviews.author: Parivash B
reviews.title: Spring Break trip
reviews.text: Place was beautiful did not like that we had to make a reservation for every night and on the first night making all reservations we couldn't get seated until 9:00pm at every place which is late.  Otherwise nice

reviews.author: adamia88
reviews.title: Paradisus experience
reviews.text: The property, beach, water, weather and designs are beautiful. But quality of the service does not match the price of the stay. The food could be of better quality, the fresh juices were mixed with too much water. Some food for breakfast  you just get if you come earlier, like farmer cheese and some smoothies, otherwise they say - no more.  Unfortunately, my phone charger to say softly, disappeared from my night stand. i complained, but nobody bothered to compensate me. Entertainment was disorganized and boring. The only good memories are the beautiful weather, beach, sun and good company. Honestly, i would not consider to come back to this resort. Thank you.

reviews.author: mercedesnperez
reviews.title: Amazing Trip after getting through Check-In
reviews.text:
Our family of 11 stayed for 5 nights. We definitely had a wonderful time. Everyone treated us very well and we felt like we were in paradisus. The grounds, facilities, restaurants and pool were absolutely beautiful, very well maintained, I seen workers everyday working outside and I must say they do an amazing job to keep the grounds breathtaking. 

We got to know several of the waiters that would bring us drinks on the beach. As grand and beautiful as this facility was, the best part was the amazing staff. Jesús Pereyra was wonderful to us, always going the extra mile to serve my family of 11. 

Service impeccable, variety of food and quality is excellent. 7 different restaurants, and the Buffett is high quality, large variety. If you see something you don't like just ask and they will provide! Loved the fresh fruits, juices, and variety of cultural offerings. 

Never did we feel that the pool areas or beaches were overcrowded. The resort is so spacious and there is so much to do! We definitely will be back again for my wedding.

I must give a huge thank you to our housekeeper Johanna Calderon. She was wonderful and very helpful. I never had any complaints about my room. She is amazing. Thank you Johanna for taking good care of my room with my twins I know everything was all over the place. 

Only two complaints I have are check-in and the fact that I was never allowed to enjoy the canopy seats near the pool because guest leave their belongs there at night to hold their spot and I really do not think that is fair to everyone that is staying that the resort. I think at night everyone should be told to take their belongs with them and it should be on a first come, first serve basis. As for Check-in, It took forever to get our rooms ready and with two babies after a long flight I was ready to get to my room.  After about two hours of waiting we finally make it to our room only to have to turn around because our room keys were not activated. 

Definitely one of our best family vacations!

reviews.author: 734donald
reviews.title: satisfaction
reviews.text:
satisfied
nice people 
caring 
happy staff
you should put mosquito screens in royal service  rooms save on energy enjoy breeze of island 
make sure all vegetables are well cleaned with disinfectant repeatedly avoid gastric problems

reviews.author: Kasey O
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I visited in October, we had such a fun time! This resort is huge which is great because it never feels crowded. The restaurants are great. Men need long pants for the Greek restaurant, which in my opinion was the best one. The steak house was great too. Lots of couples and honeymooners, but family friendly as well. The nightlife was a lot of fun, the lounge down by the pool is really popular at night and then when that shuts down the upstairs nightclub opens up which is a lot of fun - both have DJs and plenty of complimentary mamajuana! The bartender in the lobby is a mixologist, he makes really cool drinks. Also the swim up bar they have a guy that comes around and cuts coconuts to drink out of, the bar tender at the swim up bar is awesome and made these drinks called cocoloco, which used the fresh coconut water which was like a tasty pina colada - incredible! The only negative experience we had, actually had nothing to do with the resort - they allow independent vendors to set up at night outside selling different items like art, jewelry, liquor, etc. One of the booths that was selling premium mamajuana asked if we wanted sample shots - we took them and they were delicious. I was so excited, I bought about $100 worth of bottles to bring back to the US only to find out when we got home it was a scam, I swear it tasted nothing like the kind we tried it almost tasted like a mixture of Listerine mouthwash and Dayquil, I even got sick from drinking it. Other than that, we have no complaints and look forward to visiting the resort again!

reviews.author: 807kimberlyj
reviews.title: Fun in the sun!
reviews.text: Buffet was okay so I prefer the restaurants food because they were delicious.  Also, not enough nightly entertainment for adults and I didn't appreciate having to attend a 90 minute presentation without my knowledge at booking. Other than that this hotel has it together.

reviews.author: rmgupta
reviews.title: Had a great Spring break
reviews.text:
Overall v satisfied. Enjoyed our Spring break. Beach was one of the best. Excellent service. Would have liked a better room for the price we paid. Snorkeling trip is must. 
Did not like the food in the restaurants. Would have liked a fire pit for chilli evenings.

reviews.author: Cheyer
reviews.title: Great family vacation!
reviews.text: Just returned from a week's stay at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.  It was a beautiful place, the service was good and we had a really great family vacation.  Those I must mention include Luis Florian (he was the highlight of our vacation!  Joked and talked with us, danced with our kids, etc), Rino, Jean L, Ramon and Jose/ Mikey Mike (very friendly beach staff) and Benita (our beach bartender) and Carmen (our nightly cocktail waitress).  They went far beyond normal expectations for service. We also had a family concierge, Yarol, who was wonderful.  Very friendly, booked and changed our dinner reservations for us, provided extra surprises for our kids and was very accessible. As with most all-inclusives, you may wait a few minutes for your table or for a cup of coffee but it's vacation and the pace is slower in the Caribbean so relax! The food was good, not great, as is the case with most AI's. The only "negative" for us was the fact that the beach was so far away from The Reserve and from the main lobby of the Paradisus.  It was only a 7 minute walk or a quick tram ride to the beach but it would have been nice to have a view of the ocean from our room. Other things to mention: the beach is beautiful, we had a blast riding the waves on the boogie boards the resort provides, you can also take out ocean kayaks and hobie cat sailboats. They do have some top shelf liquor but you need to ask for it or they will use the cheaper stuff. The prices at the gift shop are very expensive. Bring plenty of sun block, aloe, etc from home!  We had teenage kids so went on some excursions they would enjoy.  The parasailing, snorkeling, hooka diving, party boat excursion was fun but the other people on the excursion crossed the line a bit and my kids were introduced to "girls gone wild". Others I know who did this excursion thought it was great.  One excursion we LOVED was the Macao Surf camp.  I can't recommend this one enough.  All 4 members of my family were surf novices and we all got us many times! We will definitely consider returning to Paradisus and other Melia resorts!

reviews.author: Kippermangirl
reviews.title: Perfect Once again
reviews.text:
Once again a terrific vacation at a beautiful resort. Love it there wish we were there now! 
Friendly lovely service from the bottom up. 
Beautiful grounds, great pools. We've been twice now. First trip we stayed at the reserve building and this time beachfront. Both are great but I will say the reserve is a little walk to the beach but I think I prefer it. Bigger rooms.  And The concierge at the Reserve, her name is Christina, makes your stay even more perfect. She is amazing we missed having her around this time being we were in the beachfront suites. Overall it's a great family (or adults) resort and not your typical all inclusive! This is the only one we'll go to.
Enjoy!

reviews.author: Vanessa D
reviews.title: excellent experience!
reviews.text: Liked this place a lot -  We previously stayed at the location in Mexico (riviera maya)and it was so amazing - this place ran second to that. Very clean - which is so important - service was very good and location was breathtaking.  There was a few things that would keep me from giving it a perfect rating - 1) there was NO water pressure - seriously none.  We stayed in an upgraded master suite and for the amount of money it cost I truly would have expected a beautiful shower - this was the biggest let down for me (not a huge deal in the grand scheme of things) 2) I felt like the poolside service was lacking- it was hours before we would see someone walk by to take a drink order and when we went to the swim up bar the bartender was almost annoyed that he had to come down - just an observation that surprised me a little bit because the riviera maya property was not like this at all.  Again, not huge issues but its enough to  make me want to try somewhere else next time we are in the Dominican for the price we paid. Overall very good but management needs to know these things - quick fixes to make it a 5 star and comparable to their other properties!

reviews.author: Hrodward
reviews.title: Awesome hotel and people, but some problems
reviews.text:
The hotel's facilities themselves are astounding. It is huge, right in front of the beach, it has a lot of available activities, and service is always available and happy to help.

The people working there were, for the most part, a delight. Very polite, and ready to help with anything. 

Our butler, Johnfi Rivera, was always ready to help and an overall joy of a person, as were his colleague Martín Tineo, who served us daily while at the beach, and the very great waiters at the "Palazzo" restaurant, Jhoneidy Charles, Miguel Jimenez and Bayú. (This restaurant is worth the extra price, let me tell you that) 

However, there is one issue. The hotel tries to diversify its food options too much, and not always succeeds. The buffet is excluded from this, as it is something that almost always works, and the size and variety helps.

There is, as I was saying, a very huge disparity between some of the restaurants. While we LOVED Martin Berasategui's restaurant (A must) and "Fuego" we were disappointed at the hotel's "Blue Agave" (mexican) and "Rare" (Meat) restaurants; not because of the food, which was acceptable, but because of the service (ranging from plain rude to just painfully slow) and the plates themselves, which in some cases seemed to be made just by throwing the ingredients into a plate without any care.

But that was the only issue with the hotel, and the best thing is it is a manageable one.
Maybe we were just unlucky.

One last thing, I recommend the "Japanese garden" for a great, quiet reading spot.

Also, be ready to be asked constantly in the beach if you want to go parasailing (or be offered some drugs), but not just in front of the hotel, but all along the beach.

Stayed March 2016

reviews.author: Linda beachwalker
reviews.title: After check in - Paradise!
reviews.text:
This was to be an easy trip from NY,a great family relaxing vacation.  Well, check in was a nightmare waiting over 4 hrs. even though I did the online check-in. After my husband called the GM because they could not get our reservation done, and continually were getting the run around, finally ,it was rectified.  I can only say after that it was pure indulgence.  Staff fantastic, most well trained, food - far superior than our last visit. Fresh seafood and fish and great selection. And the property - beautiful!.  The kids zone - well run - my grandchildren loved it!
one of the reasons I booked this resort is because it is a short trip from NY, you can be on the beach in the afternoon if things run well.
Thanks goes out to Yesyi, our concierge ,  who bent over backwards  with special treats for my family.
I would recommend booking restaurants before time, especially during Easter or February break.  Some I would not suggest for young children even though they permit them.

reviews.author: lieve001
reviews.title: Love vacation
reviews.text:
Raynold Tamayo 

Really fun time!!!

Raynold is a very good dancer and entertainer! Really enjoyed myself while staying at the resort.
I learned some bachata and Meringue! 

Would come back again :) we love this place we love Dominican and reserve

reviews.author: LISETTE B
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
Prior to arrival, I read reviews about this resort so my expectations were really high.  Upon my late evening arrival, initially I was somewhat disappointed with my ground level one bedroom solely because of its location, but I made a quick call to the Front Desk and without hesitation Victor Benitez, the bell man, came to my room, helped me gather our belongings and we were moved to a 3rd level one bedroom that faced the garden.  The room was lovely and from that point on, the vacation got even better.

The food was excellent so upon arrival, make sure you make your dinner reservations because they tend to get booked rather quickly.  However, if you can't get into one of the restaurants, the buffet will not disappoint.  I personally am not a buffet person, however, for breakfast and dinner the food was always made fresh, there are endless food stations and there is something for everyone from pizza to mussels.  It stays pretty packed, but there is plenty of seating both indoor and outside and the waiters/waitresses were always happy to help you get what you need.  The other dinner restaurants like Fuego, Blue Agave and Rare had excellent food.  The Japanese restaurant was fun.

The evening entertainment seemed to start promptly at 8:30p (at least when I was there) and ended around 9:00p.  There is plenty of seating but the venue is pretty big so get there early to get a seat up front.  All of the acts were great but my only wish was that it would last a little longer!

The grounds are super clean and their are golf carts that are always buzzing by to give you a ride if you're having a lazy day and don't feel like walking.  I would encourage walking the grounds though to enjoy the beauty of the resort to see things like the flamingos as well as the beach at night when it's all lit up.  Also, the  hotel photographer is worth taking advantage of because we have some amazing shots and our photo shoot only took about 30 minutes,  

Overall the staff was pretty amazing.  Leonardo Mota was amazingly accommodating at the pool bar.  He makes excellent drinks, is very professional, and makes sure all the guests are taking care of. The poolside entertainment staff was a lot of fun and did their best to keep the guests engaged.  Popeye is a great dance instructor!

The only complaint I had was that it seemed close to impossible to get towels and wash clothes for the room so make sure you get a few extras to keep on reserve.

Overall, I was so impressed with the resort.  My 10 yr old daughter did not want to leave and  I am already planning  another next trip back before the year ends!

reviews.author: loubar2016
reviews.title: El personal del hotel pasó a ser mi familia durante mi estancia.
reviews.text: Mi familia y yo pasamos las vacaciones de Semana Santa en Paradisus Palma Real Resort y he de admitir que es muy, pero que muy poco probable que vuelva a pisar un hotel que se acerque al nivel tal alto de Paradisus Palma Real Resort. Me quedo corta cuando digo que me sentí en casa, es más, me hice amiga de muchos de los trabajadores allí. El día que llegamos al hotel nos estaba esperando la directora Belén Sanmartín, la cual estuvo pendiente de nosotras en todo momento. No pasaba un día en el que se acercara y nos preguntara si habíamos disfrutado de las actividades de la mañana, del restaurante del mediodía o de la cena. También he de mencionar a la maravillosa Claury Carela, a la cual ya consideramos como parte de la familia. Siempre estuvo a nuestra disposición para cualquier necesidad o duda que tuviéramos, reservas de restaurantes, actividades, tumbonas, horarios, etc. Incluso vino a despedirnos el día que nos fuimos y nos dio un abrazo a todos. No miento si digo que hubo lágrimas en esa despedida y una invitación para que venga a visitarnos a España. Una gran profesional y persona. Por otro lado, el servicio en los desayunos fue totalmente inmejorable. De hecho, solíamos sentarnos en la misma mesa todos los días para que nos tocara el camarero de siempre, el cual cuidaba el más mínimo detalle. Todos los días ayudaba a mi abuela a sentarse y a levantarse de la silla con una sonrisa en la cara y dirigiéndose a ella como "jefa". Un comentario que nos hizo mucha gracia y que nos hizo sentir como en casa. Por último, me gustaría mencionar a Juan de Dios y a Gerardo, dos grandes profesionales que también nos trataron como "reinas" y de los cuales me llevo un recuerdo muy tierno. De todos los hoteles en los que me he hospedado en mi vida, no exagero si digo que este está en otro nivel. Sin duda alguna, es el mejor en el que he estado y en el que he creado recuerdos que durarán para toda la vida. Gracias, gracias y gracias. Espero volver ir.

reviews.author: jwaid2016
reviews.title: The Royal Service was Amazing!!!
reviews.text:
We had the time of our lives at this resort... It was very clean, the staff was incredible, especially in the Royal Service area... Special thanks to our butler Miguel Abreu who showed us all the club had to offer, he went above and beyond with his job duties and we will make sure to request him next time were there... 

Also we cant forget to make mention of Angel Frips, who made our stay on the beach and the private Royal Service an experience we will never forget! The second a thought popped in our heads in terms or drinks/requests, he was there with a BIG smile on his face!!!

Thank you Paradisus for a memorable experience and we're counting the days until we can come visit you again!!!

Joe & Samantha

reviews.author: Aammpp111
reviews.title: Another week in paradise!
reviews.text: My family spent the last seven nights in at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, almost exactly one year since our last stay at this resort. Everything that we loved and remembered from our first stay was still here - newly renovated and beautiful rooms, immaculate grounds, the best all-inclusive food we've ever had, and most importantly - unmatched service. What makes this resort truly in a league of its own are the people who work so hard day in and day out to make every guest feel special. This review wouldn't be complete without giving recognition to those individuals who went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Ray Tamayo and Pedro Mota at the Reserve pool were truly fantastic - always smiling, always a ton of energy, always providing superior service to the guests. Noel Vasquez at the main pool also went out of his way on a daily basis to make us feel at home - we consider him a true friend after spending much time together both last year and during this trip. And we can't forget our two favorite bartenders - Jensy and Emilio - both of whom kept our drinks full and our smiles bright each and every day. Thank you all for another wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: beth265
reviews.title: Beautiful but poor food.
reviews.text:
Absolutely lovely grounds, pools and rooms. Very relaxing atmosphere. I used both the The Reserve as well as the Palma Real (had an Oceanfront Reserve room).
The Reserve area had nicer pools and food. Overall, the food was the main disappointment. Went to Vento based on reviews but atmosphere, service, and food quality was truly terrible. Had a much nicer experience at Rare. The buffet at Gabi Club in the Reserve section is much better than at Naos in the Palma Real section.
Beautiful oceanfront reserve room but annoying and loud music can be heard in those rooms until @11pm. Very friendly staff. Avoid Casino. First experience at an all-inclusive; had I booked a less expensive room I may have been more forgiving of the food but the room I booked was VERY expensive and I guess I expected higher quality food. It also didn't help that I got traveler's diarrhea either. Also, for the price I would have expected more beer selections at the Palma Real section (for the beer drinkers that we traveled with). Only the local Presidente was served.

reviews.author: Marian Beatriz M
reviews.title: Nuestra primera vez en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Somos miembros del Club Melia y es la primera vez que estamos haciendo uso del mismo desde que nos hicimos socios con la familia, no vinimos con la familia grande que solemos viajar pero sí con mi esposo e hija de 3 añitos. Lo que puedo decir es que la experiencia es más de lo que yo había esperado, cuando uno compra la membresía no tenemos la real idea de lo que será, uno hasta llega a pensar y dudar si ha sido en verdad una buena inversión, pero resulta que si lo es por varias razones, como por ejemplo el costo beneficio (realmente conviene económicamente), el servicio, la infraestructura, uno paga por algo que realmente vale la pena, el único inconveniente que tuve o lo que me pareció que se le pasó por alto al encargado de limpiar el apartamento es no haber chequeado que en el baño hay que recargar shampoo y acondicionador todos los días, no fue algo grave pero se podría mejorar ese detalle, los funcionarios son de más amables, muy predispuestos y amorosos en especial Yaritza Rodríguez y Janna Ortiz, un saludo chicas ha sido un placer conocerlas...Punta Cana es un lugar maravilloso, Dios les dio un lugar con una belleza y encanto extraordinarios!!!
The Reserve es más que excelente, supero ampliamente cualquier expectativa...Felicitaciones a todo el equipo que hace posible mantener un servicio de calidad de punta para que personas de distintos países del mundo puedan tener vacaciones inolvidables....muchas gracias!!!

reviews.author: Jorge O
reviews.title: Buen servicio
reviews.text:
Excelente comida y muy buen servicio en piscina (Raúl Jiménez). Los niños lo pasan genial en el kids zone. Linda habitación     
Realmente una excelente opción para venir en familia. Todo un equipo para hacer un tiempo agradable para nuestra familia

reviews.author: CanadaSunlover
reviews.title: Overall very good
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve for a week during our March Break. Overall it was a lovely vacation. What we loved:
The grounds are beautiful
The staff was friendly
Excellent wifi. Never been to a resort that it was so good, even on the beach!
The beach was gorgeous, although a bit windy the first few days we were there
Service at the beach in the Reserve section was fantastic. They found us chairs, brought us towels, and were great at bringing us drinks regularly. The little bar there had top shelf alcohol that they gave us without asking and a drink list.
Service at the pool was overall very good too.
We found the shuttle very regular and accessible. Others have mentioned they had to wait—we never did and always had room. 
Rooms are spacious and clean, bathroom was lovely.
Food was decent to good.
Lots of room around the pool and on the beach. Very comfy chairs.
What we didn’t love:
While very friendly, there was a big language barrier for some of the workers. They try hard, but many times waiters and other workers stared blankly and had no idea what we were saying.  Big difference from Mexico, we found.
No drink menu at any of the other lobby bars or pool bars besides the beach.
We traveled with our 16 year old daughter and friends. If you don’t want to see a lot of young children /hear a lot of kids in your hotel and pool, this is not the place for you. We didn’t mind it at the pool, but hearing babies cry at all hours in our hotel room wasn’t great. Thank goodness for noise apps.
Restaurant reservations were a pain. I hate eating dinner at buffets, so having a la carte reservations was important to me. It seemed very inconsistent and like each concierge had a different story about obtaining the reservations. Having said that, with MUCH persistence we were able to get reservations for all nights but one.
Food at the reserve Gabi Buffet for lunch was very good. One day they had prime rib and it was to die for. Some of the food was a bit ‘fancy’ for our 16 year old. Breakfast was good if you had a made to order omelet.  Sometimes the pancakes and other foods were not as fresh as they could be. But overall pretty good.
We liked the Vento restaurant for the food and the Italian for the ambience. The Mexican restaurant was excellent for lunch. The Japanese teppanyaki food was decent but service was terrible. We were rushed in and out and waiter didn’t even take drink orders until we finally asked 20 minutes after arriving.
Overall I would recommend this hotel and the Reserve is worth the extra. They try very hard, and we enjoyed the service and company of many of the workers there, from shuttle drivers to waiters.

reviews.author: Josh Q
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation!
reviews.text: Unreal.  This was one of the best family vacations that we have ever taken.  The Reserve is beautiful.  You never feel crowded because everything is so plentiful and spacious.  Our family concierge Alicia took care of us and all of our needs.  She was absolutely fantastic.  Our man who stocked the mini bar everyday was also wonderful.  He always left something different for the kids to eat and drink. The food was great at all the restaurants, and we ate at a different restaurant every night thanks to Alicia who made all of our reservations.  The golf cart transportation was always there within a couple of minutes.  I cannot say enough about this place and how wonderful it is.  We will definitely go back.  My kids are 11 and 8.  They had a great time with the activities and things that were offered for the kids as well.

reviews.author: Mary ann S
reviews.title: Good family vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed over Easter/Spring Break week in a one bedroom family concierge suite, 2 adults and 2 kids ages 9 and 10.

A few items on the room/concierge service: The room was fine.  We liked having a separate bedroom, but the pull out couch for sleeping was not very comfortable.  This is a family suite, but not really family friendly.  I would go for the master one bedroom suite if available and select two double beds in the future.  

We were on the fence as to whether the family concierge was worth the expense (they made dinner reservations, golf reservations, and booked our cabana for the week.  And you really have to hunt down your concierge to get information.  We didn't get our phone until the third day, and we never knew where our dinner reservations were going to be, or what time, until around 5 in the afternoon which made planning for cleanup and getting to the restaurant a little hectic. I would suggest asking your concierge to give you the full week's reservations as soon as she can, all at once). Until our daughter got sick and we had to be taken to the hospital by ambulance.  Our family concierge Mery went with us and was invaluable to help translate for the ambulance driver and the doctors/nurses.  She stayed with us until 1 o'clock in the morning when we left.  For that alone the concierge was totally worth it.

Overall, I would say we were impressed with the resort.  It is huge, and you have to take trolley cars to get to different areas.  But the trolleys come frequently and were not a problem to get around.  It has one of the best beaches I have seen- and we've stayed on the DR 4 times. The kids loved playing on the beach, wave jumping and boogie boarding.  The buffet food was ok- nothing spectacular, but the dinners were pretty good.  Aqua was our favorite.  The kids adventure zone with the bungee jumping was a hit with our kids.  And even though we were there during a very busy time, the resort did not seem over crowded.  We could get chairs by the pool and at the beach no problem, and there weren't waits to get into the buffet areas or dinners.

reviews.author: LoliLoli2016
reviews.title: Gracias a todo el personal !!!
reviews.text:
Volvimos ayer y ya extrañamos el hotel y la gente del mismo! Volveremos pronto!!!

 Queremos agradecer a las personas que estuvieron con nosotros sobretodo, agradecer en particular Leo en la barra del Royal Service quien cambio nuestra estadía totalmente para mejor. Le puso siempre una sonrisa y la mejor actitud y siempre dándonos los mejores tragos. Hasta incluso a veces tardaba en cerrar por los pedidos que todos le hacíamos. Hizo que se generara un buen grupo en el royal y varias veces nos quedamos en el bar largas horas conversando con el y los demás que estaban en ella. Se creo asi un ambiente único =)!!!

 También quiero agradecer  a  Martin  especialmente también en royal Service que siempre muy atento nos ayudó a tener las toallas y reposeras lista

Gracias a Jose Lugo mayordomo del royal quien estuvo atento a todas nuestras necesidades

También quiero dar un muy especial agradecimiento a todos los que trabajan en Palazzo quienes mañana tarde y noche nos recibieron con la mejor sonrisa desde Zenovia en la recepción del restaunrate hasta todos los chicos adentro: Oscar, Feliz, Richard, Yunior, Jhoneidy. Osvaldo y Mariano

 Muchas gracias todos por hacer nuestra estadia la mejor!

 Volveremos y recomendamos este hotel sobre todo por la gente que trabaja en el ¡

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We experienced numerous issues with our room including no hot water in the sinks, loud music outside our room every night until after 11 pm, the ceiling fan in the bedroom not working.  We complained about these items 4 times during our stay and nothing was done about any of them!  Also, the golf is advertised as "free".  If you call having to rent a cart for $150.00 free!  Every year our family tries to experience a new "beach vacation" and unfortunately this one ranked as our least favorite.

reviews.author: Leah C
reviews.title: Worth it!
reviews.text:
Amazing Food, beach, alcohol, entertainment, staff, etc!! 
my boyfriend and I went for the first time to celebrate our 5 years anniversary... & yes he popped the big question. 😀 we both had an excellent time. all inclusive is the way to go. shout out to our fave bartenders Jan, Lucia, & Larry.. 
we had standard luxury room & it was huge! comfortable bed. our shower pressure could've been better & have blackout curtains in the bedroom but we managed. 
we will come back & for sure recommend to our friends and family

reviews.author: Claudia
reviews.title: Incredible experience
reviews.text:
My wife and I just came back from spending 8 days and 7 nights at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort. We paid for the Royal Service and it was a great experience! We had a great butler, Alvaro Fernandez, who made sure we had everything taken care of. From reserving a Bali bed by the exclusive pool, to dinner reservations every night, to recommending great outside excursions, to even specially preparing our bath tub at night.
Every morning we were greeted by Angel Frias, one of the pool and beach attendants for the Royal Service customers. Angel always made sure we got a great Bali bed at the beach and made sure we got the drinks that we wanted and did it in a very friendly way!
We had breakfast and lunch at the Palazzo restaurant every day. This restaurant was exclusive for the Royal Service guests. The Palazzo staff was incredible. The friendliest group of people I have ever been served by! They greeted us like if we very their very best friends and they had known us forever. Miguel Jimenez one of the waiters even made special arrangements for the chef Alexis Francisco to cook us a very special plate that was not on the regular menu. We were blown away by the gesture.
We dinned at the many different specialty restaurants the hotel offers, we had a chance to try them all and we were very satisfied with the quality of the service and the friendliness of the staff.
The quality of the food was great and they had abundant healthy options. We never got sick during our stay.
I have traveled to many places around the world, I have to say that Dominicans are some of my favorite people. They are always happy and go out of their way to be friendly to their guests.
We loved our experience so much that we want to return next year to the same hotel, next time we are also bringing our young adult and teenage children with us!

reviews.author: Jenny G
reviews.title: Great but disappointed...
reviews.text: We went to Melia Punta Cana to celebrate our "honey moon". Reservation for a king size bed was made last year between October and November. When we got there for spring break we received the news that we are getting two single bed room. Great started for a newly couple!! Well, staff tryed to find a solution but at the end, we still in the room and both beds were putting together. 😏  We had good service during our trip, thanks to junior, Hilario ... At the bar 21 in the main lobby we had a great bartenders, Juan Gomez and Olga. Always ready to make our nights! Thanks guys. At the beach, Ramon, Benita, Jose, Jairo and the coconuts.. At the restaurants, Lupe, Marilin, Juan, Eliezer, and others... All of the server was amazing! NOTE:The hotel has a tour guide with the otium company. We booked a tour with them. They gave us a cost of the trip but when they charged the amount to the bank, it wasn't the same amount in us$ that the tour originally cost. They charged $10 extra for the trip plus the cost of the money exchange(almost $9us). So be careful when you book a trip, check what they charge to you. They can take advantage of the situation because you are not in your country and is difficult to track the bank transactions when you don't have access to your bank account. In overal it wasn't a bad trip, just few things that would have been better.

reviews.author: CMJJ63
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text: We just returned from a 7 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel. We were celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary and upgraded to the Royal Service and couldn't be happier with our choice. Our butler, Jeuri, was excellent.  He was very helpful, making our dinner and golf reservations, and left us surprises in our room, including an anniversary cake.  At the beach, Angel made sure we had shade every day and was very attentive seeing if we needed beverages throughout the day. We thought the restaurants were excellent, especially Palazzo. The pool and beach were lovely.  We played tennis and golf and used the work out facility. It was our first visit to Punta Cana and we plan on returning to this hotel again. We loved our stay there.

reviews.author: dianegggg
reviews.title: great teen family trip
reviews.text: went with 4 families w teenagers 14-16 yrs old,  there were 24 in our group. lots of activities for kids and adults.  food was very consistent and good.  beach was beautiful.  Shaky was an amazing social coordinator. Dinner reservations were very cumbersome- like checking 2 or 3 times before they were solid.  No complimentary coffee service.  It would be nice if they put one in the lobby in the morning so you could get it to go.  As it is right now,  you go into a restaurant and ask for a "to go" cup.

reviews.author: Susan C
reviews.title: Great Stay at Paradisus Punta Cana, The Reserve March 9 - 15, 2016
reviews.text:
I'm going to write my review as I honestly as I can and I am going to rate things as I go. 
Check-in was 2 out of 5. We arrived and we were the only ones there and we were told that our room would be ready shortly.  We waited later than anticipated and noticed that four other families that came after us got their room before us.
Room was 4 out of 5. A nice clean room. Conveniently located. 
Family Concierge was 5 out of 5. Diosmery Francisco was wonderful!!! She took care of all our needs promptly. She is very nice and goes out of her way to make your stay a pleasant one. She made my son very happy. She was so very nice to him. We feel she's an asset to the resort. If you can, request her. You will not be disappointed. 
The beach 5 out of 5 because my husband and son love the waves. The beach staff were very nice and always came around.  The sea weed wasn't an issue at all. 
The food - Vento 5/5. Food and service were great. 
Aqua and the Grill 4.5/5. We liked the food and the service was good. 
Mole 4/5. We ate there for lunch and dinner and liked it all. 
Fuego 3/5. Food was just okay and the service was okay too.
Bana 2/5. We didn't like Bana. Food and service were just okay. 
Gabi Club and Gabi Beach 4/5. Both Buffets but the food was good. 
All and all we had a great time. Our major complaint would be their shuttle service to the beach and to the restaurants. They don't have enough and they don't run enough creating line-ups and rude guests who would push and shove to try to get on.
Oh and lastly, the Melia Club. They ask a lot and we found it very annoying.

reviews.author: lupalmer99
reviews.title: " Una experiencia maravillosa e irrepetible "
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado la Semana Santa 2016 en familia en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real Resort en Punta Cana. Ha sido una experiencia maravillosa, espectacular e irrepetible. 
Nos recibió la directora del hotel Belén Sanmartín que fue nuestra gran anfitriona, una gran profesional y hotelera española que va dejando la marca España allí a donde va. 
Debo decir que la atención fue exquisita, muy detallista y cordial. La limpieza del hotel tanto de las habitaciones como de todas las areas del resort me llamó especialmente la atencion y máxime teniendo en cuenta el nivel de ocupación del hotel en esas fechas. Todo ello se debe a Grimilda , el ama de llaves, una excelente persona y grandísima profesional, inigualable. Tambien tuvimos un trato exquisito con Claury Carela, que estuvo pendiente de nosotros con las reservas de los restaurantes, reserva de tumbonas en la playa y de cualquier actividad prevista. Además acudió a despedirse de nosotros el día en que nos ibamos del hotel. Muy dulce, cordial y gran profesional. 
En cuanto al servicio quiero destacar que la atención en los desayunos, comidas y cenas fue inmejorable, cuidando el más mínimo detalle con una delicadeza y atención exquisita y con especial esmero con los niños y personas de edad. Quiero mencionar a Juan de Dios y a Gerardo que nos trataron como "reinas" y mejor imposible, grandes profesionales también. 
Por todo ello y más, recomiendo este hotel para pasar unas vacaciones inolvidables ya sea en familia o en pareja, la experiencia merece la pena. 
Doy las gracias a todo el personal del hotel en general por su profesionalidad y por su trato excelente.

reviews.author: Circusride
reviews.title: Beautiful facilities and grounds with a wonderful staff
reviews.text: Our family of 6 stayed for 8 nights under the family conceirge package.  We had beautiful suite that joined two rooms to a center living area including a kitchenette.  We were assigned a family conceirge (Rienna) who was very friendly.  Unfortunately she had two days off early in the week and we weren't reassigned another staff member during her absence.  The grounds, facilities, restaurants and pool were absolutely beautiful.  The beach is full of thatch roofed umbrellas that are perfect for staying at the beach all day.  We got to know several of the waiters that would bring us drinks on the beach.  We took advantage of the included paddleboards and kayaks and also enjoyed snorkeling, scuba, and parasailing.  As grand and beautiful as this facility was, the best part was the amazing staff.  Jesús Pereyra made an extra effort to be friendly and helpful in the morning keeping my coffee full and hot.  Gregario was our favorite waiter for dinner at the Blue Agave.  You can't go to Paradisus without falling in love with the activities staff.  Caridad, Johanna, Pachi, Beyonce, and Angel were always happy and dancing.  The two staff that our family will miss the most, though, are Popeye and ShakyShaky.  They were always full of positive energy and smiling.  They tried to include everyone, young and old, in daily activities.  Definitely one of our best family vacations!

reviews.author: Wherecar54
reviews.title: Overall good visit but...
reviews.text:
We stayed here 5 days. This was an all inclusive resort. The rooms were good, the buildings are well kept, however there is no real appropriate bathroom privacy. It's a strange layout. They have a huge whirlpool tub that takes half the bathroom, I never I I I found the help and checking in not adequate. They gave me a sub-par room with a King bed and I am with my daughter, after I repeatably asked and booked double beds. If you complain properly they listen, but just like all third world nations you have to strongly let them know and that is at times exhausting. The leadership running the place need to be better about this, and may I add attentive.  

The room:

The toilet was wore out and you had to lift the handle to stop the water from running. The shower stall was good but the lighting was not good hard to see in the bathroom. They had a huge whirlpool in the room that took a lot of space never used it but the bathroom basics were tight, poor design. 

We were on the third level in the Reserve we had a nice balcony very private and pleasant to sit out there. 

Beds were good, mini bar was excellent for this resort. 

I found language to be a noticeable problem at times. Majority of tourists are English speaking, but the staff was not good at it. Look I understand that it's the native language but the visitors and the money are English speaking. This was aggravating. 
 
 The Beach was very windy but weather was good most of the stay the ocean was rough this time of year my complaint is the Ocean and the seaweed was annoying and low visibility in the water. Not a very good ocean area to swim or snorkel in. Lots of garbage in the water buried in the beach area. Bottles, beer cans, and general trash.  Especially in water out by the safety buoys. Not much marine life except the turtles coming in to feed later in the afternoon, and that's wonderful to see. 

The positive the water was warm for his time of year. 

Now onto the food.

One thing I can say for sure, they had plenty  of restaurants, and buffet restaurant is outstanding!

Most of the restaurants if you can get in are goodnever show up, then others who want eat there can't. This is a serious problem that needs to addressed. 

For an island, and resort the food is fantastic. You can't beat that aspect of the resort. Could I see myself coming back...yes for the money...but would I it depends. I really like beach and the water but this is limited. 

If you want sun and a beach and food nice place overall come here. 

4 stars based on the food.

reviews.author: ythind
reviews.title: An excellent facility that is lacking in service
reviews.text:
We were very excited to be staying at this property based on its star rating and the facilities provided.  We had planned a 1 week family trip for late November and had paid extra to get into the "Reserve" section of the resort.  The property is gorgeous and the rooms are very well appointed and spacious.  The pool and beach facilities are also good and there are numerous restaurants on the resort.  The service, however is very inconsistent and sometimes non-existent.  The beach was a good walk from our room and there were times that golf cart drivers refused to stop for pick-up even though we had two small children with us.  The food variety was good but it lacked flavor and taste.  It is definitely quantity over quality.  Our worst experience was their vacation program sale session, which we got duped into attending.  Some of this was our fault as our concierge - Ada - asked us to show up to this session for 10 minutes so that she could get credit. We obliged to help out but ended up burning through half a day listening to a lecture when we had no intentions of purchasing anything.

Bottom line, a well kept property with lots of activities with so-so food and sub-par service.  Skip the reserve if you must stay here.  Not worth the extra money for what you get in return.

reviews.author: lrbfamily
reviews.title: Spring Break Visit - not for teens, activities listed on website not up-to-date
reviews.text:
Last minute Spring Break trip with 15 yr old. Here's what you need to know:
