1.  Hotel - beautiful facilities, high-end furnishings

2.  Very limited teen program - this is a hotel for those with children 12 & under or over 18yr. Our 15 yr. old was disappointed.  Activities that are listed are for those under 12yr.  We tried to come up with some alternatives - frisbee?  board games?  but were told no to frisbee, board games limited and only available during the day.  Of course, the beach and pool are wonderful daytime activities, but nothing at night except nightly show which ends by 9:30-10:00 and that's it. May not be of interest to that age group eg. Michael Jackson show.

After that, there is a DJ in the Gabi Bar which was fun when the hotel staff were dancing and encouraging those to participate, but the last night we were there, they didn't show up until late after being in the show (I imagine) and were only there for a short time.  This ends by 11pm.

How about teen club?  karaoke?  Pool table?  DJ & dancing?  Ping Pong that could be used outside kids zone under 12yr club?  

3.  Activities listed on website are not all correct and we selected this hotel because snorkeling was supposed to be included and it no longer is.  Neither is scuba, etc.  Our travel agent did not know this.  

4.  Service - uneven, some staff friendly, others not so much.  Most have limited English so it is helpful to speak Spanish.  We were assigned a concierge, AC, who helped us with initial dinner reservations, but after we declined the VIP lunch (really a sales pitch to join Club Melia), never saw him again.  Dining staff are a bit overwhelmed in Buffet area so it can take awhile to get drinks, clean tables, etc.

5.  Food - wide choice of food in buffet which we thought was quite good - particulary made-to-order omelets, also lovely presentation.  Dined at Mizu (hibachi) & Fuego (Peruvian) - underwhelmed by food at those restaurants.

6.  Dining Reservation System - poor.  Only available at guest services between 9-4:00.  Many complain they are unable to get reservations or only at late times.  This was not an issue for us as we were not traveling with small children and prefer to eat late & our concierge made the reservations.  You are selecting restaurants without the benefit of menus.

7.  Orientation - this hotel could do a better job of orienting its guests both on arrival and in the room, even online info. for reference & food services would be helpful.  This would save a lot of time and help guests use the services right away.  

8.  Off site excursions - would not recommend Marinarium - quite expensive for what you get.  We booked the middle of the road trip for around $100 per person which included snorkeling, swimming with sharks & rays, dancing on board boat, snacks, stop at natural pool where boats are docked and drinks are served in the water.  

The snorkeling was not good, very limited - really you are just led from one side of the boat to the other and into the roped off area where the nurse sharks & rays are located.  Then you travel to a sandbar where you stand in the water & drink.  There was very limited dancing on our boat, so that fun, festive atmosphere was missing.

Also, do not expect to travel far, these trips hug the coastline and don't travel very far so you are not getting the experience of seeing much of the island.  

We signed up because my son was interested in snorkeling, but we heard from a number of guests on the trip and at the hotel that the DR is not know for its snorkeling and we should have saved our money for the excursion.

9.  Casino - we did not use, but it is quite small.

10.  Late night dancing at nightclub on premises - hardly anyone in there - opens at 11pm, I believe.

11.  Wifi not that good all over resort, including rooms, beach, pools

reviews.author: Shelly A
reviews.title: Very Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Reserve for 5 days traveling with my family that included 2 toddlers. The service was great. Managers took interest in ensuring our stay was going great! One Manager in particular provided exceptional service, Julio Reyes. Throughout my trip he made sure my family was satisfied and even went above and beyond to ensure my kids were happy, I was traveling with two toddlers that were very picky eaters and a problem to eat anything other than their normal, and he made sure that they were able to have what they wanted, even going to another restaurant to get them something to eat, when the restaurant we had reservations for did not have anything they would try, That meant SOO much!! 
The hotel is very big and always has activities for the kids and adults. I liked that there was always supervised activities for the kids so adults could enjoy late night parties and shows. The rooms were beautiful. And the resort grounds were stunning with lush gardening and picturesque surroundings. Felt very safe on resort. Resort also had golf cart shuttles that took you to beach and all over the resort, very convenient. There were plenty of food choices 11 restaurants, and room service included for free 24 hours, I did not have to use room service. 
All the employees were very friendly and warm, offering a pleasant hello and a smile. Service was great: A few employees that stick out to me and made my stay that much better are: Julio Reyes, Catalino, Joel, Yessica, Anthony, Estefamy Hortado.

reviews.author: Alumita21
reviews.title: Para volver siempre!!!
reviews.text: Fuí con mis dos hijos y pasamos una semana perfecta !!! Atención increible. Opciones de comidaa excelente. Todo el personal muy proactivo, amable, atento. Juan, del sector Conciergerie un genio al igual que sus compañeros. Lo mismo Juan del sector playa. Muchas opiones de enntretenimimiento. Un lugar de lujo donde ir a desconectarse del mundo.!!

reviews.author: Mary Anne G
reviews.title: Another fabulous week in Paradise
reviews.text:
Just returned from our 14th stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Our visits are obviously always memorable because we keep returning...and this time was no exception. Our friends, Maria Ester & Leida, make beach massages a MUST. In fact, we had 3 this week. This is an experience that stays with you long after you return home. (I miss you already, Maria!)

The pros that take care of us on the beach are THE BEST!  Ramon Ramirez, Jose Luis de los Santos, Maiker Ramirez, Benita Mercedes, Santos Frias, Jairo Minier, & Luis Santana make a great team to see that each person is set up with towels, drinks & a good atmosphere to enjoy the best beach in the world. The piña coladas have been upgraded & are the best!  There is a new tiki bar in The Reserve beach area where things are very festive & lively with some informal dance lessons & 2 very nice bathrooms.  Also the wifi works better on the beach than it used to. 

Upon checkout, Yorandy was extremely courteous & printed our boarding passes for us. Eddy Wilson went over & beyond for us when our shuttle didn't show up on time. He made several calls until a private coach arrived & we made our flight with some time to spare. Thanks again, Eddy. 

Besides our favorites mentioned here, everyone is very polite & professional at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We can't wait to go back to our see our "other family" again soon.

reviews.author: JTO_10
reviews.title: Great family holiday
reviews.text:
As a family of 8, we enjoyed our stay at the Reserve during the second week of February 2016.  We had a fairly typical master+lock off "time share" type of room.  Two adults and two young children used the master suite (kitchenette, dining area, living room with pull out couch, one bedroom, bathtub room, and another washroom with a shower, sink and toilette) while another 2 couples used the lock off (living area with small kitchenette and pullout couch, bathroom, and bedroom.)  The rooms were nicely appointed but starting to get old.  Similar to other Melia places in Mexico, they do not do a good job of making repairs when things break or start to show a lot of age.  
We were in building 34 which was located right next to the main entrance to The Reserve section of the resort.  The resort is essentially split into The Reserve and the main resort.  The Reserve has its own pools (a main pool and a children's pool right next to the kids zone) and buffet.  One of the resort restaurants is also located there.  Because we were in the Club Melia section of The Reserve we also had access to self-serve laundry.  This was a real benefit having 2 young children (both of whom got sick.)
When we arrived we were assigned a butler who was supposed to be available to help arrange anything we needed.  However, we didn't really need his services; nor was he really available by phone one the few occasions we did.  The general staff was more than friendly and helpful in arranging our reservations at restaurants (which you must do well in advance if you stand a chance at getting a seat) and calling for the rides from The Reserve to the rest of the resort.  It's not that you couldn't easily walk to the other area, but sometimes it was helpful to get a ride.
The food was pretty good.  Not as good as we expected compared to other Paradisus resorts in Mexico  .. but the choices were plenty.  They had all the usual restaurants found at the Paradisus chain.  We did have some challenges with one of our dinner reservations (for Tepanyaki.)  We had been told our reservation was for 9:45pm, but when we got there, we were told our reservation was actually made for 6pm.  They refused to seat us.  Only after I said we would not leave the restaurant until they found us a place to eat (since everything was closing) did they agree to seat us at the Asian fusion section.  Good thing too because the food (thai-chinese) was surprisingly delicious.  At the same time, I was not impressed by the staff's complete lack of concern for the mistake they made in giving us the wrong reservation time and the inconvenient situation we were put in.
The kid's section was wonderful and they have a full drop off service that keeps kids entertained throughout the day if that's what you want to do.  The kid's pool was perfect for 1 and up.  There was a deeper section with slide and a shallower section with a platform that made it perfect for our under2.  The baby pool was also great for, well, babies.
There were a lot of activities.  Tennis lessons were offered each day, and since we were the only ones who showed up, we ended up with private/semi-private lessons every day.  The gym was well-equipped and we enjoyed the yoga classes at the beach.  Bikes were available throughout the resort.

The resort uses "Otium Tours" to arrange transfers between the resort and the hotel.  We had reserved a private transfer so we could get a toddler seat.  Otium and the resort confirmed this was possible and arranged, but when we were led to our car, the Otium staff was essentially clueless about baby/toddler seats.  They said the company didn't even own any!  They offered our money back but were helpless in terms of getting us a transfer to the hotel that included an appropriate seat for our toddler.  Only after I went up to the taxi stand and had about 10 drivers trying to offer us rides with a baby seat did we find a suitable transfer.  I would not recommend Otium Tours unless you have very simple or easy needs that they can fulfill.  And, if you are a few people, you can just get a taxi for less than the private transfer.

All in all it was a great week and we would return, knowing some issues to avoid, and with a few lower expectations.

If you haven't travelled to the Punta Cana before, it is important to keep in mind that the airport involve a lot of long waits (to enter and leave through customs).

reviews.author: mngrl08
reviews.title: Inconsistent service but nice property overall
reviews.text:
We have never been to a Melia property, so here's our take on this all-inclusive brand's  Punta Cana property.  We stayed at the Family Concierge side of the Reserve since we have 2 small children and had heard that it's worth the extra $$.

Kids' Club - 5 stars.  Great staff, lots of activities, lots of themed events outside and inside.  Nice play structure.  No complaints here.  The serve lunch and dinner at the club, so you don't need to order food for them if they are there to play.

Pool - the Reserve and kids' pool are 5 stars.  Very clean and safe.  Pool toys are available for use.  Pool service for drinks are very inconsistent( 3 stars), depends on your server.  One day we had a server that was constantly attentive while other days not so much.

Restaurants - Food is definitely 5 stars.  We did La Palapa and Passion, 2 adults only places that requires extra $$.  Both had great foods.  For how much Passion was touted as the best place to eat, we found the service at La Palapa better.  We also ate at Fuego and Vento, both were decent.  Buffets at Gabi for breakfast and lunch were decent with lots of choices.  We had no complaints.  For some reason, the other restaurants did not have very good desserts for dinner.  We always ended up going back to Gabi for desserts after dinner.  Why not?  All inclusive, right?  Our biggest complaint, which is the reason this property got 3 stars, is the inconsistent service and sometimes inattentive services.  Even at Passion, with an upcharge of $55 per person, we were seated and ignored for 5-10 minutes minimum.  Then our supposed server came by to ask if we were ready to order, no asking about drinks and whether we had questions about the menu.  This is not the type of service you run at a restaurant you advertised as Michelin level.  Same thing happened at Vento.  We had a great server at Fuego, who was wonderful with our kids.  Since tips are part of the all-inclusive rate, we often wondered whether this played into the inconsistencies that we witnessed.

Family concierge - 3 stars.  Is it worth the extra $$?  Depends on your concierge.  We met people who had great concierge and made it worth their while.  Ours was absent most of the time.  In fact, I did not even meet her until the third day we were there.  My husband briefly met her at the pool on the end of our second day there, just long enough for him to tell her to make dinner reservations for us.  We were supposed to have a phone to call her directly, which we didn't get until day 3, and we were only there for 2 more day.  She kept saying she couldn't find us, but how come other concierges did not seem to have any trouble finding their families?  We never left the property and had the same pool cabana the entire time, so I really don't buy that excuse.  She also claimed she left voice messages, which never showed up.  It seemed like, after talking to several other families there, that the concierge was helpful for getting off property excursions and if you traveled with a baby or toddler.  IF we had to do it again, I would not pay the extra $$ for what I considered a wasted expense for our family.

Drink - 2 stars.  I put this in a separate category because even though we are not big drinkers, we do enjoy good drinks on our vacations.  Part of the all-inclusive lure was that we didn't have to worry about stuff like this.  What's included is very limited, Stoli vodka, El Presidente beers.  At La Palapa, the vodka gets upgraded to Skyy.  No Bombay Sapphire though.  The upcharge on different brands are different, and there is no list to tell you what the costs are. Our Delta flight down had way better alcohol selection than the resort.  Unless you are into what I call beach drinks, ie pina coladas/fruity margaritas/daiquiris, you're out of luck.  We had mojitos a few time, but the quality of the drinks depend on the bartenders.  Again, inconsistencies.

Room - 4 stars.  Nice and clean.  Good size.  But as always, service is not there.  We were supposed to have nightly turn down service.  We only got it 2 nights.  No one came by the other 3 nights.

Overall, at the final cost of over $800 per day for our family, we did not feel the cost justified what we received.  That is why the 3 star rating.  We have spent that same amount of $ at other luxury resorts and completely feel pampered.  There were many bright spots, such as the pool, nice beach, kids club, but when you are constantly trying to get good service or even just any service, it wears you out.  A vacation no longer feels like a vacation, and no matter how much good food one gets, it just doesn't make it worth while.  This property bills itself as a luxury resort, but I think it has a long ways to go on the service aspect.

reviews.author: Cris C
reviews.title: Excellent service, food and amenities.
reviews.text: We booked our vacation through Costco travel and could not be happier with our decision! We are still marveling at the excellent accommodations, great guest services, food and amenities. We upgraded our stay to receive the royal service. Our butler, Samuel Rodriguez was wonderful. He booked all our nightly dinner reservations, golf and treated us to some amazing surprises each afternoon when we returned to our room. With the Royal service, we received a cell phone upon arrival for 24-hour service. Additionally, we had our own beach/pool attendant. Francisco Cabrera treated us with great care. He ensured our beach beds were reserved each morning and brought ice cold water, snacks, towels and drinks. Always with humor and a smile. The resort was gorgeous, and had such wonderful, attentive staff. Dancing every night at Gabi beach--- with a special staff member named "Shakey Shakey" who encouraged with great enthusiasm and skill guests to dance and have a great time! We highly recommend this resort. While tipping at this all-inclusive wasn't necessary, we found ourselves wanting to leave tips for our butler, beach attendant, food servers, and maid.

reviews.author: miriam0412
reviews.title: Jose Salvador the best!
reviews.text: This hotel was amazing my husband and I we're here on our honeymoon we decided to take the Royal service, you get your private pool and own section on the beach where you are served drinks. We also had a butler  name Jose Salvador who was wonderful very helpful,  and always there when needed through out our entire time. He made our stay extra special..On our arrival he gave us a tour of the hotel it is beautiful. We will be returning in November no doughty! I recommend this to all couples and family's with kids. Everyone will enjoy 100%.

reviews.author: Nisha M
reviews.title: Amazing Trip!
reviews.text: My family and I stayed in royal service for seven days which was amazing. Jeuri was our awesome butler who made our dinner reservations every night and was always helpful. The food was delicious, especially the buffet, and catered to an international spectrum. The beach was very nice and well kept, as well as the rooms. All of the staff was incredible! The entertainment at night was always fun as well as during the days with the activities guys, Luis, Caramelo, and Shaky Shaky, giving us dance lessons. Carlos on the royal service because was always friendly and set up the chairs every morning. Jorge at the fruit bar was amazing and always made delicious smoothies. Overall the trip was fantastic and we cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Elizabeth J
reviews.title: Simply paradise....
reviews.text:
Just spent a wonderful week at Paradisus Palma Real. From the moment we drove up we felt the warm welcome. The staff goes out of their way to make sure you are having a great time. Our party and activity host nick named Popeye and Sheky Sheky were awesome! Best personalities, went above and beyond to make sure you know what's going on, when, where and once your there they interact with all. Love that with so many people they remember names and your likes. 

Service impeccable, variety of food and quality is excellent. 7 different restaurants, and the Buffett is high quality, large variety. If you see something you don't like just ask and they will provide! Loved the fresh fruits, juices, and variety of cultural offerings. 

Never did we feel that the pool areas or beaches were overcrowded. The resort is so spacious and there is so much to do! We definitely will be back again.

reviews.author: Beachgirl044
reviews.title: Best Resort Ever!
reviews.text:
We stayed from March 2 to March 9, 2016 in the Royal Suites.  This is the best way to go when staying here because you truly feel pampered and get access to everything at the resort.  You also get your own butler.  Ours was Luis Sanchez.  Let me tell you, when we stay again we will ask for him.  He was always there when we needed him.  Was quick to fulfill our requests and was the nicest young man.  Helped us get into one of the restaurants when it was already "full."  Honestly, every staff member was always smiling and ready to help if you needed them.

Hotel is beautiful.  Marble, travertine tile, granite.  Beautifully landscaped.  We took a long walk along the coast and the Paradisus was by far the most beautifully kept beach.  Lots of umbrellas and chairs on the beach.  Beautiful turquoise waters.  They have several bars for the tastiest smoothies.  Mixed drinks available, too.  Food was excellent.  One of the restaurants has a buffet (breakfast, lunch, dinner) that goes and goes.  Fresh fruits, veggies, meats.  Several ethnic foods prepared.  Chefs on hand to cook your food how you like it.  Has a great view of the beach.  Was fearful of drinking the water before we arrived in Dominican Republic.  No problems at the Paradisus.  Drank water from the tap with no worries.  They have several water bottles in your room at all times and serve from large bottled water at the restaurants.  Truly nothing to worry about here.  We were with a large convention and none us had anything to worry about.

Hotel has a private pool with a bar for royal service.  But the property has a huge wrap around pool that is so clean and relaxing to be in.  They also have a pool that is geared towards small children.  Lots of outdoor bars to keep refreshed.   Property is one of the cleanest I've been to.  Rooms were always cleaned each day and the beds are wonderful.

I'm sure it's hard to believe this place is as good as what I've written, but it's true.  We have been to many resorts on many different islands.  If you want money well spent, relaxing environment, cleanest hotel, you need to stay here.  I know we will be back.

reviews.author: Irania
reviews.title: Shaky Shaky
reviews.text:
Shaky Shaky is the best entertainer! He always has a smile on his face, is very fun and we  loved him!!! Our 3 year old had so much fun dancing with him!! Great time here!!!
The hotel is awesome. It s our 3 rd time here and we are still in love! The beach is paradise, the service is great and we highly recommend this to everybody! You ll make long lasting memories and have a wonderful time in paradise!

reviews.author: Jacmalex90
reviews.title: A wonderful week
reviews.text:
What a great week we had.  Hosted a group at this wonderful resort, Francisco Cabrera always had chairs, towels, and drinks for the group.  Great job Francisco, you made our stay great.

The golf here was good, the food was also very good.  Get the Royal Service well worth it.

reviews.author: aleoliv1003
reviews.title: Hotel excepcional, com tudo incluso.
reviews.text: Atendimento fantástico. Comida de primeira. Piscina excelente. O único ponto a melhorar são os drinks, feitos à moda americana (com xaropes ao invés de frutas). Mas como eu pedi pina colada com frutas de verdade, eles fizeram.

reviews.author: Kurt M
reviews.title: Relaxing Beach Vacation
reviews.text: Our two adjoining rooms were very spacious and well appointed. We enjoyed relaxing on the quiet balcony in the evening after dinner. A three minute walk brought us from our rooms to the resort dining area, bars, pool and beach. Service in all areas was friendly and quick. An important amenity at the beach were the thatched sun shades which provided good protection and a quiet spot for the family to relax. The beach front itself is quite busy in this area, with hawkers of cigars, parasailing, banana boating, shopping ("lookee lookee"), etc. Very good food at the buffet and OK at the various restaurants. Not much of a program for teens.

reviews.author: BS13
reviews.title: Nice place with some faults and not quite "all" inclusive
reviews.text: To begin, this is a very nice property, beautiful beach, nice swimming pool and pleasant, large structures. Rooms are a little dated, but good size, clean and overall comfortable. All meals daily are provided at their huge buffet, lots of selections, problem is the food leaves something to be desired, not really that good, but plentiful with lots of variety. If quality of food isn't a big deal then you are set with eating. There are the additional theme restaurants around 6 available for dinner, we went to 2 out of our 6 nights, nice to be able to sit and be served and some improvement on preparation of dishes, definitely nice that your meal won't be cool from standing on lines in multiple areas before you can get it to the table at the buffet. We were hoping to get to at least 4 restaurant nights, but they require reservations which can only be made after checking in and except for our 2 times we could not get more reservations, all booked. By the way the best restaurant Passion with a Michelin chef, is Not included, $70 per person dinner and expensive wine available to buy if you can get a reservation. Other all-inclusive resorts have more individual restaurants. As to service at the tables when at buffet for drinks and incidentals, when busy it can be hard to get your wine, drink or coffee served timely, but once you have the attention of a server they are very nice and attend to your needs. Overall we were pleased with the service staff. Drinks are available at bars, poolside bar makes ok drinks, and the main bars do have premium labels, such as Stoli, Tanqueray, Johnny Walker Black, Remy Martin. If you don't specify you'll get lower shelf. Look at the shelf or ask what they have if you want better. However they also display some "super" premiums like Hennesy XO or Macallen, but when you ask for these there is an extra charge. Not a good way to do it at the "all-inclusive". Only one brand of wine is served at buffet, restaurants and bars, it is a decent Chilean with choice of Merlot, Cab. Sauv, Sauv blanc or Chardonnay, nothing memorable. Further, unlike all-inclusives such as Sandals or Beaches, no water activities are included here. No snorkeling, no boating wind or motor, no water-skiing, etc. They can be purchased at fairly high prices especially if you have family. They claim golf is included but you have to pay for a golf cart. Does that make it included? I'm not sure. Evening entertainment is nice if short followed by dancing at the main bar. Overall a nice resort, we had a good time and great weather the week we were there. Only want to say it could be better and should live up to All-inclusive as advertised.

reviews.author: James W
reviews.title: Great Spring Break Trip
reviews.text: The Reserve at Paradisus was a first rate spring break trip.  We enjoyed the pools, beach, activities and the variety of restaurants.  Had lots of fun in the small casino too!  Our family concierge Yarol Rijo was fantastic and was always available for any request.  He took care of all our reservations and added some special treats.  The entire staff was great - bartenders, pool & beach staff, and servers at the restaurants. Lots of laughs & smiles.  We enjoyed the Passion restaurant as a treat - the food was very good. I would highly recommend this resort; kids 18+ will have a blast!    The only suggestions: improve the gym equipment quality and have more music by the pools.

reviews.author: lsocash
reviews.title: Service and restaurant reservations
reviews.text:
Just got back.  Family of 4 stayed in the a junior suite with garden view.  
Positives.  Gorgeous resort and nice beaches. Some food was great others just ok.  Lots of staff willing to help, but at times seems like 3 or more are helping you and you lose track of who is actually helping you. 
Negatives: Everyone is very happy and willing to help.  (Heads up many do not really understand much english so they will look like they understand and smile and say "my pleasure"…but your left thinking did they actually understand what I asked for.)

Biggest Frustration for us was the run around you get when making rsvps for the restaurants.  Highly recommend making rsvps before your arrival.  While we were there, we were told all restaurants were full, then last min. we got a reservation and then when we went to the restaurants they were not full??  We heard this over and over "were full", but if your persistent you can get a rsvp and the rest. will not look full.

As far as restaurants:  Bana- the Hibachi / Teppanyaki rest. was disappointing.  Food and show just ok.  Not at all the level you would find in an american Hibachi.  Best restaurants were Acqua, Rare and Vento.  However the shrimp cocktail at Rare was worst we've ever had.  I'm not sure how you can mess up shrimp cocktail.   The Buffet was good…so many options…just gets old after awhile.  We only ate 1 dinner, but had multiple lunches and all breakfast meals.

Now for the room.  Overall it looks very nice, however, there is no privacy b/w the bathroom and room.  There are shutters and columns from bathroom looking into bedroom.  Not best scenario with teenage girls. We also had problems getting hot water the first 2 days.  They did fix it.  You also have to stay on the staff about clean towels for the room.  Sometimes they don't come until late in the day.  

Also if you have a food allergy, you need to ask concierge on arrival to make you a card that you can hand to the restaurant & buffet staff.  I didn't know they had this option until 4 days into our 6 day vacation.

We did the Marianium excursion - they will negotiate prices…one person said $70 for child under 12 and other gave us $50 price.  (It was $103 ea for 12 and over)
This was fun trip, mainly because we met some fun people and the music and drinks were good.  The snorkeling is not great…very choppy waters into a fenced off area in the ocean…you see many of the same fish, they have you hold one sting ray so that you can get a picture that they charge $15 for, your supposed to be "snorkeling among nurse sharks" which was 2 nurse sharks at the bottom in a corner of the fenced in area…. thats it.  They sold this as the best snorkeling excursion in Punta Cana.  No way,  If you want good snorkeling don't spend this ridiculous amount of money.

reviews.author: CameronQuilling
reviews.title: Excellent Vacations!
reviews.text: The beach was incredible, even better than the ones in Mexico! The ocean was so blue and uncrowded! There was always plenty of room! The real highlight of the trip were the great workers - Ramón Ramirez, Santos Frías, Jairo Minier, Benita Mercedes, Jose Reyes, Junior (Club Melia), Luis (Club Melia).

reviews.author: Kristal W
reviews.title: Excellente!
reviews.text:
Overall a great all inclusive. Awesome weather, friendly staff, GREAT food, and excursions galore. GREAT WIFI even on the beach. I would recommend booking excursions prior to arriving and immediately getting your dinner reservations made by your personal butler. Our butler, Juan Cedeno, got us the times we preferred for the nights we wanted. It helps break up the "always eating at a buffet" feeling. It felt like a cruise but no floating. The activities director, Popeye, made the afternoon Zumba/salsa dance lessons so much fun. He was very good with the tween aged travelers in the evening dance parties. I felt save to allow my 15 year old to go on her own. Roberto taught paddleboard yoga and as a middle aged, out of shape woman he made me feel confident to participate. I loved it!
 I would return but have my days somewhat planned so I didn't get shut out of the excursions I wanted to do. I did get the tour and information on purchasing into the vacation club, Club Melia, but choose not to buy in. Be ready for this option. Paola was my appointed agent and she explained everything very well. Many guest were members but it wasn't for us. 
The swim up pool bar manned by Leonardo was very refreshing. He made sure we had a great time. One of the resturants, there were 7 (2 you had to pay extra for), "Rare" a steak house was amazing, Jhonny, our waiter, was wonderful. Harol, also provided top notch service.You got to know the staff on a first name basis. They knew what you liked to drink and where you would typically sit. There were  nightly shows and a few nights they had tables with vendors selling you the local souvenirs.

reviews.author: lisadV8240WG
reviews.title: Satisfied Spring Break 2016
reviews.text:
Overall, the resort and staff were lovely.  They need to improve the food somewhat.   Our rooms connected and were large and clean.   We tried to get a better room with a closer view of beach but didn't have much luck.  They did give us a room closer to the main beach area though.  Recommend Family Concierge - worth making the dinner reservations and getting nice beach spot.  They seem to cater mostly to the Melia Club level guests though.  Had hot water issues but maintenance did come when called.

Augustine and Primo were great!

reviews.author: Reena A
reviews.title: Great services.....
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous. Full service facility provides any guest the opportunity to keep busy or simply relax at the beach or pool. Food options for breakfast, lunch or dinner were accessible at one of two buffets or if you prefer a quieter dining experience you could schedule a time to dine at one of the many restaurants on the property.

reviews.author: Claribel T
reviews.title: Acogedor, hermoso, eficiente.
reviews.text: Su diseño en general es hermoso, su personal eficiente, sus instalaciones en sentido general, sus playas, las opciones para bodas en referidas área, las opciones de restaurantes cuenta con un Excelente servicio del personal que nos atendió,  su menú variado y exclusivo.

reviews.author: Janet H
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
We just got back from a 5 day stays and are already looking forward to going back. The staff was great - especially Francisco Cabrera and Leonardo Mota at the poolside bar on the royal service side. They made the best drinks and always had a smile on their face.  
Our butler was Nicolas who took great care of us. He went out of his way to make my husband's birthday so special. Everyone at the resort was just so friendly. The weather was perfect,  the food was great, the service was fabulous and the drinks were cold. 
We had the royal service so we didn't have to worry about booking dinner reservations or reserving a cabana pool side or a bed on the beach. Nicolas took care of the details - this was really a big plus.

reviews.author: Norzamp
reviews.title: fantastico
reviews.text: Fuimos en abril 2015, con amigos, sumamente bello, no ibamos desde el 2010, realmente sorprendidos con la renovacion que ha tenido en estos años, atendidos de maravillas en el NAOS por el camarero Frank Sanchez, super simpatico y servicial , psamos una semana maravillosa, relax total, disfrutamos de la pileta, la playa y todas las instalaciones de ese excelente hotel

reviews.author: sae89599
reviews.title: Muy bueno!
reviews.text:
Nos hospedamos tanto en el royal service como en la reserva, en general nos gusto mucho todo, lo unico que cambiaria serian las duchas de los baños de la reserva, de resto todo muy bien!

Gracias a todos por el excelente servicio, Agradecimiento especial a:
- Equipo de la piscina del royal service, Santo eres lo maximo, Definitivamente el mejor de todos ! 
- Equipo reserva: Mike Mike muy atento y entretenido, juan carlos santos muy bueno
- Conductor: jose hizo de los paseos en carrito algo inolvidable, es el tipo de persona que siempre quieres que te reciba y te transporte.
- la palapa: increible la comida de la noche, agradecimiento a Quintina, Ruth, Tony, Gustavo, Isidro, Billis, Bryan, Algenis y a Jairo.

Saludos/Regards
Sergio

reviews.author: MollanaD
reviews.title: Wedding at Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We were at the Paradisus Palma Real for our wedding two weeks ago. We stayed 10 days. We had 60 guests – they all stayed 4-7 days. Overall, I would recommend this resort without hesitation for a family vacation and definitely for a wedding. We could not have had a better experience! 

Prior to Wedding: The Romance Team was very organized and accommodating. Prior to arriving they always emailed me back within a day or two and answered all my questions. We did not visit the resort prior to our wedding. Once there, we met with the wedding coordinator (Raquel) the second day (before our guests arrived). The Romance team, decorator (Caribbean Celebrations) and DJ (assigned by the resort) reviewed everything with us. We were able to discuss the flow of the reception (when we wanted food to be served, when the dance starts, if we want an open mic for people to talk or only specify who can give speeches, etc.). Another wedding coordinator met our group the day before the wedding and we did a quick rehearsal - this was nice to get a general idea of the flow of things. 

Wedding Ceremony: The ceremony itself was beautiful and went as planned - they had everything set up correctly and the location was what I pictured/expected. The only thing I didn't love (but expected) was that there were a lot of people watching at the resort - the resort/wedding staff kept them at a distance, but the beach location is by no means "private". In the moment though, the other resort guests are far enough away that I didn’t even notice them. I think the Garden location is more private, but it would have been so hot back there without the breeze of the ocean - so I still would pick the beach over any other location. 

Wedding Reception on Olympus Terrace: Awesome!! It was set up as planned and it fit our size group very well - made it feel intimate, but not crowded. They blocked either side of the terrace, so it felt very private. The buffet was excellent - plenty of food, it was fresh and hot and people went back for seconds without a problem. There were more than enough servers there - if a glass of wine was even half empty, they were there filling it up! Two wedding coordinators were also there throughout most of the reception to make sure things were going well. The DJ was awesome- he listened to our suggestions and played off the crowd - if he started a song that people didn't seem into, he quickly faded it out and got everyone going again – it also helped that our wedding group loves to dance and came ready to party!

The Resort: It was beautiful - just like the pictures! All of our guests commented throughout the week how much they liked the resort itself. They had a private check-in set up when everyone arrived for our wedding group - that was nice. They didn't have a few rooms ready right away when people checked in, but they gave the guests a wrist band and they were able to go eat and have a drink while they waited – since most people had just come from a long flight, they were starving and food was their priority over the room anyway. Getting around the resort was easy - it was big enough that you could get away from the group if desired, but not so big that you couldn't track people down if you wanted/needed to. It was very clean. The only grounds issue was that the beach did have quite a bit of seaweed - no one seemed to complain about that and it seemed to be common for many beaches that time of year. 

Food/Restaurants: We tried most of the restaurants and they were all good. And actually the buffet was just as good as any of the restaurants – which was great for the kids if they didn't want to wait for a dinner reservation. There was some confusion on a couple different occasions about reservations, but nothing major. For example, the first 3 nights we were there we went to the restaurant where our reservation was and they didn't have the reservation written down, but then they still sat us down within a few minutes of getting there - that was odd to me, but no big deal. 

About a third of our group had stomach issues for one of the days while there - most were not stay-in-bed type of sick, just not feeling great (e.g. they didn’t drink all day and night at the pool!) But they were still able to sit by the pool and enjoy themselves. Whether the stomach issues were from food, ice, alcohol, or a combination of these, we might never know - but we did expect a few issues like that and we were happy there weren’t any major illnesses. We had a few people who brought antiobiotics with them, and these probably saved the 2-3 people who got a little sick from being really ill. 

Royal Service: They upgraded us to a very nice room with an ocean view. Our butler called every day (sometimes a bit too early!), but when we tried to contact him (which was only a couple of times), he often did not answer his phone. We liked being able to go to the Royal Service restaurant for some quiet/privacy and have our butler make us dinner reservations - those were the biggest perks. We didn't utilize the Royal Service pool as much since most of our guests were in the other pool. Overall, I don’t know that I would bother with Royal Service again unless you want the room upgrade to ocean view and you don't want to mess with making your dinner reservations. 

Oh, and the beds were very comfortable and they offered different pillows if you didn't like yours. That was a big deal - I've been at hotels with rock-hard beds, so getting a good night's sleep was key!

The other service around the resort was great. Sometimes you had to push for something (e.g. I asked for saltine crackers and they said they did not have any – I knew they had some somewhere because there were always tons out at breakfast – but when I stated that, they quickly found some!). But overall, they were very friendly and accommodating throughout the week. 

We booked our own excursion privately through Hispaniola Aquatic Adventures. I did a lot of research on this because when I was in the DR with my family a few years ago (stayed at Majestic Elegance), the resort booked us a catamaran trip that was terrible. The one we took with Aquatic Adventures was awesome - definitely a highlight of the trip! The crew was fun and friendly. The snorkeling was fun. They had plenty of drinks and food - chicken and fish skewers and lots of lobster - everyone was impressed. I would definitely recommend an excursion with them.

Overall, great trip and awesome wedding experience. All of our guests gushed over how great everything was. Wish we could repeat our wedding there every year!

reviews.author: BrookeWhitty

reviews.author: Gabriella Oviedo
reviews.title: Serviço excelente
reviews.text: Além do hotel ser um paraíso na terra, o serviço dos profissionais é um ponto de destaque com uma simpatia e alegria em nos servir que impressiona. Especialmente nossos amigos Raul do serviço da piscina e Rodny do Restaurante La Passion

reviews.author: Jon K
reviews.title: Mal desde el principio / Wrong from the beginning!
reviews.text:
Algunas recomendaciones suenan espectaculares para este hotel, sin embargo debí haber escuchado a mis instintos. En el Meliá Caribe una situación con las toallas me dejó ver cómo los trabajadores hablan de los clientes a sus espaldas. Falta de profesionalismo que lo vi porque hablo español. Igual en Mx, tabajadores que hacen lo que quieren y no tratan al cliente como se merece… Si no se les da propina! 
En esta ocasión, reservamos para el Reserva Punta Cana. Dos íbamos desde USA y otra desde otro país. 4 días antes, nos cambiaron la reserva. Una Sra Sánches dijo que habían ocupado el hotel de más, así que  nos daban un 'upgrade' al Palma Real (no el Reserve!). Le solicitamos que NO nos cambiaran la reserva, que nos respetaran la reserva inicial. Habíamos buscado lo que era mejor para mi familia que incluía un niño y una sra de edad. NUNCA nos dio ninguna respuesta. Sólo decía que estaba esperando a que los gerentes decidieran. Hicimos la reserva en enero, y en abril nos la cambiaron a última hora! Totalmente insultante y más cuando lo presentaban como un 'upgrade' cuando realmente no lo era.
En miras de disfrutar las vacaciones, decidimos seguir con nuestros planes. Mi esposo quería reservar en otro hotel, pero are muy encima. Llegamos al hotel y a mi mamá le iban  cobrar más- 40 minutos para solucionar eso.  Luego cada día teníamos que esperar 20 minutos para poder reservar para un restaurante cada noche (situación que se puede evitar si se tiene un concierge, como hubiera pasado con mi reserva inicial); la habitación súper lejos de la piscina (como no lo era en el Reserve - reserva inicial). Minibar con solo sodas y cerveza.
En Mexico nos preparaban la tina con burbujas, balloons, etc. Acá no nos dejaban los saludos.
Definitivamente, pésimo! Falta de coordinación, de organización! Es el primer sitio en el que veo que cuando venden más habitaciones los que pagan son los clientes. Hasta que encontré el por qué! Los que reservan a última hora pagan más! Asi que los que pagamos antes, con meses en anticipación, nos mandan a las habitaciones de tarifas más bajas! 
Tengo snapshots para demostrar que cuando nos dijeron que el hotel estaba 'overbooked' (ya habiendo reservado), todavía había habitaciones disponibles. Nunca Mas!

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: This was my best vacation ever, from the time I arrived the RCI rep Luis Munoz was excellent. The waitress staff Martha Santana provided excellent service always  greeted you with a smile. The entertainment staff Bigmac, Rey-Rey and Mini Mini was off the chain job well done guys....can't wait to go back!!!!!!!

reviews.author: peacelilly811
reviews.title: Prob won't return
reviews.text:
our room in the Royal Service area was spacious for the 2 of us, excellent comfortable bed, housekeeping did great job, resort grounds are beautiful and well maintained, the beach panaplas were comfortable, beach area was clean. The seaweed is a problem in the water, but not the fault of the resort.  We ate mostly at the Gabi buffet. Daniel was the best! The first couple of days we loved the food, then it became the same overall, just cooked different ways, and we couldn't wait to get home to eat healthier. My stomach is still queasy after 4 days now home. The papaya though was excellent! Loved the woman who made the delicious omelettes in the mornings. 

In no special order: Big Mac and his crew are excellent entertainers. Dancing music could be better though. The painting class was fun, but the fingerprinting class we did not enjoy bc the teacher criticized the people and was quite sarcastic most of the 40 min. Was not enjoyable at all.

our 'butler' was AWOL for a day or two, the pager didn't work, the bathroom sink had a foul odor most mornings, the water pressure in the shower most evenings was very low. Took me several times to figure out the shower knobs. Much water leaked on the floor. One night there was a knock at the door and it was a housekeeper mentioning that she'd be on holiday the next day, apparently wanting her tip to which we didn't give her! 

Our 'butler' could have done a better job. I think we sought him out more than he sought us out. Although he was very nice, with always a smile when he did show up. The beach butler also did not come around much. I did a lot of seeking him out as well. I had no problems with the transportation to and from the resort. The dinner meal at the Reserve was just okay. I enjoyed a massage by Silvery, very relaxing. Spa area quite beautiful.

I don't think I'd return to this resort, but just wanted a short beach vacation out of the States. I prefer small, quieter resort's, with healthier food/organic choices.

reviews.author: evycitas
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text:
Fuimos de vacaciones con mi esposo, el clima nos tocó de maravillas. En cuanto a la Infraestructura, servicios, amplias habitaciones, servicios en la playa, muchas reposeras, playa muy buena, el personal muy bien atendidos, estan muy bien entrenados especialmente nuestras Felicitaciones en Lobby a JUAN CARLOS SANTOS excepcional sus atenciones. En  Gaby Club especialmente a CELSO PERALTA Y JANNA CRUZ , excelente sus atenciones, muchas gracias por tenerlos.
En cuanto al Buffet muy poca variedad en Comida, en Bahia Principe Punta Cana hay una variedad enorme para todos los paladares, al ser mas exclusivo este Resort deberia mejorar en este aspecto tan importante como es la Gastronomia.
Lo recomendamos un Hermoso Resort.

Saludos Cordiales,

reviews.author: cal_dude7
reviews.title: Wish we didn't have to leave!
reviews.text:
My wife and I went to the Paradisus Palma Real for four nights last week, and all I can say is I wish we were there longer. From the second we arrived we were blown away by the property. The grounds were immaculate, and the service was above and beyond.

We decided to pay for a room upgrade at check in. They were able to find us a room in the family concierge section. At first I wasn't sure it was a good idea, as usually if anything we look to get away from kids when on vacation, not stay in sections that cater to them. My concerns went away the second we arrived, saw our amazing room, and were introduced to our concierge, Luis. I never saw the necessity in concierge or butler services at resorts, as I am more than capable of getting my own drinks and finding places to relax, but Luis went above and beyond each day to the point I know I will now have a hard time going to a resort without one. Within moments of being introduced, he learned the times we like to have dinner, and where and when we wanted to be out in the sun each day. Before we headed out to the beach when we arrived, he had already reserved us chairs by the beach, and had made reservations at what he felt were the best restaurants based on our preferences for the entire duration of our stay, and advised us of the many discounts we were entitled to with our room type. Literally within the first hour of being there our vacation was all set up, and all we had to do was relax and enjoy!

Definitely go to the Paradisus Palma Real if you can, and if you manage a concierge room, even better, especially if you end up with Luis!

reviews.author: rgmotta
reviews.title: Perfeito para descanso com familia
reviews.text:
Hotel muito bem organizado e confortável.
Diversas atividades de lazer e ótimos restaurantes e atendimento impecável.
Entre Paradisus Punta Cana e Paradisus Palma Real, eu prefiro o Punta Cana por ser mais aconchegante. Palma Real é tudo muito amplo e mais impessoal.

reviews.author: MIGUEL M
reviews.title: bellisimo hotel
reviews.text: espectacular hotel me gusto el trato  la comida el servicio para mi no habia visitado un paraiso tropical, eh visitado muchos hoteles en el caribe, pero paradisus palma real supero todas mis expectativas, mi esposo quedo satisfecho con el servicio  pero lo que mas nos gusto fue el servicio que nos brindaron el departamento de room service en especial a FERNANDO GERONIMO que hermosas playas waoo que amabilidad recibinos del personal de este hermoso sueño......

reviews.author: sishab
reviews.title: This could not be more beautiful!
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana in April 2015. Our room was family with concierge. I am not sure if all rooms are the same but ours was amazing. 

Room:
Large, clean, plenty of closet space, kitchenette, dining room, mini bar, balcony with chairs and table, Jacuzzi + shower + four sinks (1 kitchen + 3 bathrooms) + bath robes, nice towels, high-end toiletries + comfortable beds + super clean beddings and sheets: Basically everything you need and want in a hotel room (5 Stars to rooms)

Staff:
Mostly very friendly and nice, however most of them didn't understand much English,  sometimes it would get so cumbersome ordering things because they would mess it up brining you something you didn't ask for - It also seemed to me that they were not properly trained for the job! At one of the bars, a bartender and 3 other clients, I asked for a drink and it took him 25 minutes to make it! (3 stars to staff)

Environment:
Amazing decorations and settings, just beautiful, clean pools, Wifi in many locations (5 stars)

Food:
Gabi in the Reserve: Excellent (5 stars)
A la Carte restaurants (We tried 5 of them) I was not impressed with the food nor the service at any of them, just average (2 stars)

Suggestions to the hotel:

1. There is so much going on in this mega resort but they do not provide much information nor they give you a legible/informative map. You basically have to figure things out on your own meaning you are going to lose much time just finding out where things are and what kinds of service are offered.

2. There are 4 Paradisus in Punta Cana ( We stayed At The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana) meaning that we had access to Paradisus Punta Cana as well. This naming is SO confusing! people get totally lost as where they are! Couldn't they be named four different names?!

reviews.author: amber p
reviews.title: Great services
reviews.text:
I've had the best time At the Palma real resort .... Especially with having the royal service upgrade -it has been an amazing experience!!!  I cannot tell you how much the servers made my vacation better and what an unbelievable time we have had!!!!
Francisco Cabrera, Leonardo Mota
and Nelson Cedano were our daily bartenders and they did not miss a beat we were here on a company trip and not only did they help us but they helped everybody in our group with amazing services and the quality of our drinks were fresh with fresh ingredients everything was clean and unique !!!
Angelo Mercedez  was our personal butler and you will never experience a better butler service then with Angelo -he was always there for us and help us make all the reservations and gave a special gifts and our room each night he was so attentive and very sweet and professional!!!
 This resort was a five star because of the service and the bartenders not because of the hotel !!!!   If you go to this hotel you must ask for these gentlemen may make your experience so much better !!!!
 We love this resort but only because of them !!!!!

reviews.author: dmtiern
reviews.title: The DRINKING LADIES miss you already MIGUEL!!!
reviews.text:
I was fortunate enough to be my sister guest on her Circle of Excellence Award Trip that she earned with her company Temper-Sealy. (Way to go Dawn!!!) I had never been to an "all-inclusive" and had never been to DR, so really did not know what to expect. I don’t speak Spanish, but that was OK, nearly everyone we encountered spoke English & for that I was grateful. Upon arrival we were each handed a paper fan & a lovely cool cocktail – Great start!! The property was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!! Really stunning views!
Her company upgraded us to include Royal Service, which came with our own Butler (!!) as well as in-room mini-bar! We were introduced to MIGUEL & that’s where the vacation really began. What a lovely, professional, friendly & funny guy! He was nothing but AWESOME! Miguel gave us a tour, took us to our room 1047 with a beautiful Garden View & gave us a cell phone & told us if there was anything at all needed, just call him. 
We started with a lovely company reception buffet on the beach which ended with drinks & dancing – the beach is a most beautiful & spectacular place with a lovely breeze…it is truly Paradise! The next morning we found our way down to the buffet at NAOS… great food & plenty plenty plenty of choices!
We phoned MIGUEL & asked for ice for the room, a bottle of Merlot & asked if he could get us reservations for dinner at one of the restaurants. He did all of the above & more – in fact one day we came back to our room to find MIGUEL had filled the huge Jacuzzi tub with sudsy warm water & even floated beautiful red hibiscus flowers (It was very romantic but we are sisters, remember!) – we both got a big laugh out of that but I decided to take advantage so I hopped in with my bathing suit, ahhhhh!! Another evening MIGUEL brought us a surprise of fresh fruit & yet another night surprised us with a lovely cheese tray….(WE MISS YOU MIGUEL!!)
MIGUEL also suggested we try the restaurant AQUA at the adjoining hotel The Reserve at Palma Royale. He got us reservations & we hopped on a shuttle which took us there (it’s just a few minutes away.) WOW!! Did he ever know what he was talking about!? We loved it!! Such a cool vibe there, we felt like everyone else was missing out on this hidden gem, after a wonderful meal with wonderful service, we made our way to the Reserve pool bar where we were treated to LIVE saxophone music played by a most talented young man & an awesome show from the LION KING cast!!
Each day I asked for a (small) LOL bottle of rum & red wine for our room & Miguel and also Hegel kept us stocked! We knick-named ourselves the Drinking Sisters because we had such a good time sampling Mimosas & Bloody Marys for breakfast, Banana Daiquiri’s, Dirty Monkey’s & of course Ultimate Pina Colada’s, woo hoo!! MIGUEL doesn’t drink & would shake his head at us just like a worried parent
I can’t say enough, Miguel really was the cream of the crop! He really did add to the pleasure & joy of such a wonderful & amazing trip! If you are planning a trip there, I’d suggest you ask for MIGUEL – you will not be sorry

reviews.author: nyctraveler05
reviews.title: Great place, some flaws...
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just got back from The Reserve at Punta Cana. We are in our late 20's and have NO children. It was just the two of us. Like many of you, I researched EXTENSIVELY. I finally settled with The Reserve at Punta Cana since it seems to be #1 and super exclusive.The place was beautiful and well-maintained. The staff is extremely courteous and hands-on. The food was absolutely delicious! That being said I have to touch upon the negatives. I don't want to sound negative but this place is very expensive so you should know what you are investing in....

When booking I was most drawn to the beautiful beach setting with the light-up chairs at night and gorgeous decor. My first issue was that this part of the beach was for EVERYONE at the resort. Not just the "Reserve" section. We didn't have our own private section actually. If it was meant to be only for "Reserve" members, then this was definitely not at all reinforced. Not that I mind, but for all the extra money we paid I expected some exclusivity. Had I known this prior, I would've just booked at refular Paradisus. If I could go back I would just purchase ROYAL SERVICE package at PARADISUS. This is very exclusive and for ADULTS ONLY right on the beach.

Basically, only go to THE RESERVE at PUNTA CANA if you have children and need the extra space. It's very expensive and you are really only paying for the extra space, and an extra 2 restaurants that you are NOT guranteed reservations for! They were booked for many restaurants and we had to settle for what they had. We only got to eat at VENTO at THE RESERVE PARADISUS the night before we left but the rest of the nights we ate at the regular PARADISUS (Aqua and The Grill). Also, it becomes annoying that you are pretty far from the beach. It becomes a hassle after a while. NOT WORTH THE EXTRA MONEY. We were also unclear as to what restaurants were open for late lunch. Many places shut down to prepare for dinner. We ended up eating at MOLE one afternoon. The food was tasty but it took 1 hour to get the food.

My recommendations for dinner:

VENTO (The Reserve) - Delish!
Aqua (Paradisus) 

Last but not least, our biggest pet peeve was how watered down the drinks were. I'm almost positive they water down the bottles. You can have 10 mojitos and not feel any kind of buzz. Stick to the white wine and beer for any sort of buzz. I dont know about you but if I order a cocktail at a 5-star resort I expect an excellent cocktail. Not watered down cheap liquor and ice. On my thirs day I began to just order the liquor i wanted on the rocks and even this did not make me buzzed and I'm a lightweight!

******FYI****

TOP SHELF is not included! Even "Kettle One" is considered top shelf! So you are getting watered down cheap alcohol. You have to pay extra for "top shelf".

I just wanted to touch upon some of the negatives so you are not surprised when you get here. However, we had a great time and I would stay here again but definitely ROYAL SERVICE instead. The extra money was not worth it at The Reserve since I have no children. 

To end this on a positive note, the food was absolutely amazing EVERYWHERE. Even for breakfast. Huge variety and selection of different types of cuisine. You definitely will not be eating the same thing everyday. Best food I've ever had at a resort. The service was excellent, grounds were well-kept, ambiance was relaxed. They play great music at the beach/pool area. Also, check out the nightclub at night by the main lobby/casino. We danced a ton. The Michael Jackson show on Sunday blew me away. That guy should win an Oscar for that performance. They look identical!! Overall, you will not be disappointed if you choose this resort. Just keep in mind what I said and maybe stick to Royal Service instead if you are a couple.

reviews.author: Robert F

reviews.author: Craig Waggaman
reviews.title: A Nice Beach Experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana to attend a wedding. This was our first trip to the DR and my first trip to an all-inclusive resort.
Strengths: Great Beach and pool, large, lovely grounds, nice room and generally good service.

The food was good, but not great.  the service was good, but I still felt like I were was a "vacation factory."  But to be truthful, an all-inclusive beach resort is not my idea of heaven as it is for so many people.  

In summary, I would not hesitate to go back here for a relaxing week in the sun and looking at the reviews, I believe this is one of the best places to go in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: eilyn_rs

reviews.text:

Recomendado 100%

reviews.author: Helenahus81
reviews.title: Another amazing vacation
reviews.text: The resort has really done some major improvements.  It has always been beautiful, but every year there is some kind of update to keep the grounds pristine.  I was there the year prior, the dining area in the main buffet was somewhat outdated and they did a really great job matching it to the rest of the resort. The grounds are beautiful, the beach is the highlight of the resort.  The amount of space in terms of lounger to person is key, no one is sitting on top of each other, plenty of room around you.  The option to sit under the covered loungers, or on the mainly empty beach that is available to you(unlike the other resorts where people are sitting on top of one another).  The pool areas also have a ton of space, surrounding the beautiful pools.  That to me is the best part of the resort, the amount of space available.  The staff are wonderful, my family and I have been coming to the resort for the last 10 years and the service is wonderful and constantly improving.  Make sure to make reservations for dinner as you arrive the first day, especially if you like the earlier time slot.  Passion, is the only restaurant( I believe that you have to pay for) but i really don't recommend it, just because its the same quality of food, but that's just me. I mostly was at the Gabi beach pool and bar, the service is awesome.  I want  to thank Francisco Estrella for incredible service, and helping out with any issues that we had.  Felipe Morla is another kind, and extremely helpful dude, along with Raul Jimenez.  These guys are the best, and literally you end up spending a ton of time with everyone, so make friends.  Willqui Morra is at the lunch and breakfast bar and is amazing, and really makes lunch a special occasion.  Overall the resort is beautiful, just like the pictures.  I absolutely recommend the resort, for families and couples.

reviews.author: Exploration79835
reviews.title: 5 estrellas en instalaciones y servicios.
reviews.text:
Excelente atención del personal con los huespedes, muy buenas instalaciones, inmejorable comida. Las actividades nocturnas que ofrecen son super amenas.
Deben mejorar el servicio Wi-Fi en la habitación. Lo recomiendo 100 %.

reviews.author: wizardofoz28
reviews.title: Great Beach,Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: This resort is stunning. Staff is extremely helpful and nice. Especially Anna, She went above and beyond for us. Food was good. Entertainment was great. Beach is very nice and clean. Had a nice time. Grounds are well kept. Service was quick. Wifi was not an issue

reviews.author: Audrey V
reviews.title: A recommander
reviews.text: Séjour all inclusive : Hôtel grandiose, chambre spacieuse et très propre. La plage est la plus belle de ce côté la. Personnel toujours souriant et agréable . Buffets TRÈS variés et bon, avons essayé ce jour le restaurant : RARE une catastrophe nous sommes partis avant la fin du repas. Petit bémol nous sommes logés au 3ème étage et depuis 2 jours travaux au 2ème (étage non fini ) avec perceuse et burin et poussière ++ . Impossible de rester en chambre l après midi dommage pour un 5 étoiles. Nous recommandons cet hôtel.

reviews.author: micheleinma
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Just returned from our annual Caribbean vacation (Husband/Wife/7 year old son).  This year we chose DR (we normally go to Cancun or Turks & Caicos) and I'm glad we made the decision for this resort in the DR (thanks to our amazing travel agent).  As a family, we all enjoyed the resort and all that it had to offer even though it was much larger than some of the other resorts we've recently visited..  beautiful grounds, beaches/pools, people (both hotel staff and other travelers/families) were wonderful, always able to find lounge chairs at the beach or any of the pools (no getting up at 6am to secure a spot every day), our one bedroom master suite in the Reserve section was spacious and beautiful.  We also loved being in the Reserve section which even though was a shuttle ride away from the main hotel/beach it was a much quieter section of the property.  We loved our personal concierge Sulenny Gil for she was truly wonderful...  she really took care of us and really connected with our son..  We also loved seeing Luisa Recio every morning at breakfast-- so bright and cheery every day..  Both Sulenny and Luisa have beautiful souls and made our time there very special...  Our son (7) really enjoyed the Kids Club, making new friends as well as doing some of the activities the Kids Club had to offer (there was a treasure hunt one day and baking cookies another day).  We (Husband and Wife) loved the Spa, gym, and daily yoga/Pilates classes.  The yoga/Pilates instructors were both really great and we really enjoyed the classes.  The restaurants were all fantastic with amazing food.  We were never disappointed in any of the restaurants/buffets.  Overall a great experience.  A huge thank you to the people who work so hard in all the areas of the resort to provide such a wonderful vacation experience.  Hats off to all of you!

reviews.author: SkiFlyDoc
reviews.title: Luxury and Pampering!
reviews.text:
Ok, I’m writing this review from the standpoint of a busy professional who has limited vacation time and wants to make the most of each.  My wife has a somewhat different vantage point: you can check out the many resorts she has reviewed (under the name of jointfixer).

Overall, this is simply the best all-inclusive to which we have traveled (and we have been to many, including other Paradissus resorts). The property is amazingly beautiful, the weather warm but not unyieldingly hot, and the staff is friendly and generally very accommodating.

Our family of four stayed in a one-bedroom swim-up suite, complete with a Jacuzzi tub inside and a second hot-tub on the deck.  A small patio is accompanied by a private area to sunbathe with lounge chairs and a private cabana hut, leading to a semi-private pool shared with the other swim-up suites.  The grounds are lush and well-manicured, and the property itself is well thought-out.

The beach at the main hotel is gorgeous: the sand is white and sugary, the water is warm and the color of jade, and there are plenty of thatched-roof umbrellas for all.  The resort has taken pains to ensure that the pan-handlers that plague the other resorts on the island may display their wares but not pester, and plenty of staff are around to offer drinks. Importantly, unlike other resorts (including other Paradissus properties) where you almost have to set an alarm to get up to put out personal belongings to secure a desirable spot at the pool or beach, there are plenty of lounge chairs to go around almost any time of day, allowing you the luxury of sleeping in, having a lazy breakfast, then making your way to the beach or pool for a day of sun.

The restaurants are excellent and far better than most all-inclusives; even the buffet serves restaurant-quality of food instead of the typical fried-food swill that fills the troughs of most buffets.

Most important to me is that the staff are extremely accommodating and ready to meet your needs without their hands out, generally with a smile and the ever-present “It is my pleasure.”

So now…

The Good: My family has several food allergies that require particular attention to ingredients.  At each meal, the staff took special care in ensuring that these were accommodated, and for the first time, my wife was not sick from her very severe lactose allergy (not intolerance). In addition to the above, certain individuals very much stand out in our recent stay and deserve mention. Our waiter, nickname “Toro,” at Blue Agave was fantastic. Randolf van de Lisle at the Melia Club was very gracious in explaining Club benefits in a very non-aggressive manner, leaving us very much wanting to upgrade our Club membership. Angela Mercedes at Aqua remembered us from our stay 3 years ago and was able to get us a table despite the restaurant being booked.

The Bad: Housekeeping in general was good, but they inconsistently refilled our bath products and left the door open each morning while cleaning, thus replenishing our supply of mosquitoes and ensuring we had plenty to hunt down each evening. The shows are great, but many, including the Lion King, start too late for younger audiences. Having more vegetarian and vegan options would have been great. Also, some “family” activities, like Fingerpainting, did not allow children to participate (really? Fingerpainting? Hmm…).

The Ugly: Some staff, most notably at the Avenue Bar, are ruder and more opportunistic than a Manhattan bartender on New Year’s Eve. In particular, Juan Suarez and Eddie Mercedes paid more attention to the size of one’s brassiere than customer service, and were blatant about their vain attempts to secure the attention of young, nubile females.

In summary, the resort is outstanding, and with few exceptions, the staff are welcoming and gracious.  This has become my favorite resort of the great many at which we have stayed.

reviews.author: Rose Marie Z
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: Went to celebrate for our 50th Anniversary with children and grandchildren.  We were truly treated like royalty.  There is something to do everyday and entertainment at night. Fermin in Royal Service searched us everyday to see if there was anything he could do for us.  Juan & Santa at NAOS were wonderful, Alexander at Palazzo, Rosa at Olio Lounge, Edward Chocolata at the pool, Sossa at Mizu. Maria and Andrea in Royal Lounge were also wonderful.  Definitely would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Dalemandy
reviews.title: Vacations w Friends
reviews.text: 2nd visit to the reserve! Best beaches, pools and staff. Meet Mike Ramirez when we arrived. Friendly face from last year! Great service on beach w Luis Santana and Ramon Ramirez best beach runners. Did everything w 100%. Would highly recommend the stay here. Best place in to go in Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: BillDugan
reviews.title: Great Vacation!!!!
reviews.text: Great time at the beach with. Luis Santana and Raymond Ramirez.  Great service.....awesome!   They took great care of us every day!!!!  The beach was great.....weather was fantastical and the services in the Reserve were top notch!

reviews.author: Bartb33
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: Great trip. Coming back again. Beach staff is wonderful. Luis Santana ,Ramon Ramirez , santos frias, Jose Luis , Emilio Valdez ,silvio lantigua, Oneida zorilla. Rooms are excellent, many fine dining establishments, entertainment nightly. Don't hesitate to book today.

reviews.author: Kristie M
reviews.title: The most relaxing place to be!
reviews.text:
My husband and I took this trip to celebrate our 10th anniversary. A few of my husband's co-workers have been and had suggested we looked in to it - we couldn't have been happier. We arrived on Sunday and were immediately taken in to the private Royal Service lounge.  We were met by a hostess that provided us with drinks and then  showed us how to hook in to wifi and use our butler phone. We then met our Butler Evian - he was great. He took us on a tour of the property and then brought us to our suite. The rooms are beautiful - a beautiful suite with canopy bed, sitting area and patio overlooking the beautiful gardens. The bathroom had a huge jacuzzi tub and stand-up stall shower. the only complaint about the bathroom was it is totally open, so you have no privacy when using the toilet! Each night they offered turn down service and sprayed our pillows with lavender, it was heavenly!
The resort its self was clean and the ocean was breath-taking. The weather could not have been any more perfect! We would start each day with breakfast and then hit the gym. The gym was staffed and had quite a bit of equipment. It even smelled like a spa!!. After our workout we would head to the pool and sit and relax for the entire day. There was always some sort of water aerobics, pool party or drinking to be done. We also took some nice walks on the beach to see what the other properties looked like. There is a lot of water sports to try and some shops down the beach that you can barter on goods (never fall for their high prices, always get them down :) !!)
Each evening our butler set up reservations at the restaurants for us.  We never had a bad meal. Our favorites were Fuego and Rare, the steakhouse. We had excellent service and meals at both. Evenings brought more entertainment and drinking. Lots of places to just sit back and relax and enjoy your company. We would typically sit at Gabi Beach and enjoy the giant beds to relax and take in the view.
Our last evening was quite special - our butler, Evian, set up our jacuzzi with flower petals and got us a cake to celebrate our anniversary. It was a nice final touch. 
The one tip we can give everyone, make sure you bring plenty of sunscreen.  You will need it and if you run out, the cheapest bottle on the resort and surrounding shops was $28!!

reviews.author: Shakinta J
reviews.title: Really enjoyed the experience and awesome staff
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently returned from an 8 day/7 night anniversary trip to this resort to celebrate our wedding anniversary.   This was our second time visiting Punta Cana and our first visiting this particular resort. The resort truly is a paradise.  It has a few minor flaws, but the staff more than make up for those.  Here’s our review.  Sorry, it’s a long one.

Airport Transportation.  My husband and I booked this trip through RCI and arranged transportation through the hotel concierge about two weeks prior to our arrival date.  We confirmed a week out.  My husband confirmed day before.  We were given confirmation that transportation had been locked on and provided a map of how to get to the transportation area after arriving at the airport and retrieving our luggage.  We followed that to the letter.  Here’s where things got…odd.  After my husband and I retrieved our luggage, a baggage handler asked if we’d locked on transport to the hotel.  We told him we had and he asked us with which company.  We told him the company name and he said “Yep. Okay, go see that guy over there”.  We asked if he was with our company and he said again, “Yep, that guy over there”.  Now we’re in the transport part of the airport and go over to the guy in the booth who greeted us as if we were his fare and started talking to us.  We made a rookie mistake and should have verified that he was in fact our transport.  He wasn’t.  It turned out “that guy” was from a different company trying to sell us a timeshare presentation and excursion.  The thing is he never said he wasn’t the company we weren’t using for transport.  We actually thought it was the excursion spiel the transport company was giving us.  Only after we listened and had locked something on did we find out our driver was by another desk and was furious that we’d purchased through this guy.  Apparently there is some gentlemen’s rule that companies are not supposed to sale to other company’s customers.  He even wanted to give us a new spiel for another excursion.  We didn’t know “that guy” WASN’T our hotel arranged transportation and missed our original driver.  This has nothing to do with the hotel resort only to say be careful of whom you are directed or just look for yourselves.  We didn’t mind purchasing the excursion as it was lower than the hotel, but we could have been in a crazy situation trying to find a cab if secondary transport had not been provided.  Fortunately, the airport transportation to and from the airport was uneventful and we highly recommend Optium.   They are a great company.  

Check-In.  Like other reviewers, we arrived before check-in time on Saturday and were informed our room was not yet ready.  We were asked to enjoy lunch and return after 3.  We did so and after waiting an additional 20 minutes, our room was ready for us.  We were provided with transport to our room.

Room.  I was worried that our room wasn’t going to be as nice as pictured on the hotel site after reading reviews, but needn’t have.  The room was perfect.  The bed was comfortable and a nice size.  There were flat panel televisions in the bedroom and living rooms.  The bathroom was tastefully appointed and I didn’t mind the tub being in its location.  I don’t know if the location is similar in the Reserve side with children, but it didn’t bother us.  How many times do people take baths on vacations (unless they have their little people with them) and if they do, does it really matter that someone can’t be in the bed napping while the bath is happening?  The kitchen was a nice partial with a fridge that was stocked daily with soft drinks, water, and Presidente beer, of which we didn’t indulge.  No complaints with the room itself at all.

Food.  The food here was pretty good.  Honestly, my husband and I enjoyed the buffet at Naos just as much as the other foods available.  Breakfast was always a joy with the made to order omelets and the fried queso in panko, (which is amazing with syrup by the way).  Lunch had me enjoying the seafood paella and the Asian fusion and pasta stations.  Of the restaurants, the food at Bana was my favorite.
