It was a delightful hibachi show for just my husband and I when the remaining reservation group of 8 did not show.  We enjoyed it very much.  Our next favorite was Blue Agave for the shrimp burritos.  We wish the portion size had been larger, but understand they went for presentation as well as gastronomy.  (Please note most of the restaurants are big on the small portion presentations of the more upscale restaurants).  We didn’t enjoy Rare as much as other reviewers.  The staff was wonderful, but we just weren’t great fans of the entrees we received.

Staff.  Amazing.  Huge shout outs to Big Mac and his assistants, to Kirsty and Franklin with Guest Services, Esteban at Naos and several of our restaurant visits, and Omar Hernandez at Business Services where we were able to get some important news about a family emergency.  Big Mac kept the party going and got my husband and I involved in SO much!  He had us doing beach games, cocktail making classes, water aerobics, dance lessons.  You name it, he could convince us to do it.  You see his name in the reviews often for a reason.  He really is that great!  Kirsty and Franklin were always a joy helping us with reservations and excursion info, locking on spa dates, or just plain keeping us on their mind with a smile and a handshake.  We hated to leave them.  Esteban truly was one of the kindest people we met.  He went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of when we dined, even if only to come over and ensure we were having a good evening.  We appreciated that he remembered us and that he was patient of my hobbling Spanish.  I understand well, but it’s been a while since I’ve spoken fluently, so I struggled a bit. He was patient and kind.  Most of the staff from front door to concierge to transport was amazing.  We had one slight issue where we’d tipped a driver earlier in the day, were running late for a reservation, he saw us and volunteered to take us to the restaurant later that same evening.  Because we left in a hurry, we’d neglected (accidentally) to bring enough money to tip him again.  We got out of the cart and we thanked him and rushed in.  He yelled in Spanish (livid) “so I get Nothing?!”  Along with that was another not nice phrase.  That made me quite upset as I consider gratuity just that, an appreciation for exceptional services rendered.  Not a requirement.  We tip 99% of the time simply because we appreciate the services rendered and know what it is like to need the additional funds.  It is an extension of appreciation, not a requirement.  For my husband and I not to tip is an extreme rarity.  Had he simply waited, we would have made sure to ride back with him again that evening or the next day and tipped him extra.  Because of that exchange and the vehemence in his voice, when we needed transportation (which was rare as we enjoyed walking), we purposely chose another driver.  This was our only negative experience with staff.

Resort.  Beautiful.  As you walk into the lobby you catch an amazing view of the pool, the beach, and the ocean.  It is breathtaking and you see the attention placed in the details.  The layout is not confusing.  We were able to get everywhere we needed within a 5-10 minute walk.  You constantly see landscapers working to cultivate their craft and they do a wonderful job.  There are plenty of included activities that give you an opportunity to join in the hustle and bustle or just lounge around if you prefer a slower pace.  The beach is beautiful and while there are some areas of seaweed, it isn’t overkill and certainly doesn’t take away from the beauty of the island.
Shows.  Delightful.  We so enjoyed the Michael Jackson show.  Joaquin, the impersonator, did a very good job, as did the accompanying dancers.  From Thriller to Bad to Heal the World, they nailed it.  The choreography, the scenes all took me back to some great childhood and adult memories.  Equally as delightful was the Lion King show.  We’ve been blessed to see the musical and this adaptation was very good.  The dancers did an excellent job in an abbreviated amount of time.  There were some intoxicated hecklers that threatened to take some of the fun out of it for us, but the dancers were so good we soon forgot about them.

Spa.  So relaxing.  We arranged for a 30 minute couples massage in the Yhi Spa.  We arrived early to enjoy some of their hydrotherapy rituals and enjoyed the process.  Our masseuses did such a wonderful job.  My neck and shoulders tend to bunch with tension and it was relieved perfectly.  My husband carries his in his shoulders as well and complimented on how this massage didn’t hurt as previous ones in other resorts had.  I cannot remember their names, sadly.  But they were very kind and very calming.  Highly recommend.

Now a few items of note.

Mosquitoes.  Ugh!  As I said, my husband and I have visited Punta Cana before and in our last stay and resort had not so much as an ant.  So, based on that experience, we neglected to bring mosquito repellent.  Horrible idea.  We were besieged by these demon mosquitoes.  No exaggeration to say 10-12 a day were present!  I am allergic to them and was left with HUGE marks on my arms and ankles.  They were so bad we had to call the front desk to fumigate the room.  The first time they did not come.  So, we called again.  This made the bugs slower so we were able to kill them and we saw the number reduced to about 5-7 a day, but they made sleeping not that great.  We finally figured out turning the bathroom light on and closing that door caused them to congregate in their mostly.  That reduced the night bumps a lot.  Bring bug repellent!

Details.  Not really a con, just a notice to make sure you confirm the details.  Prior to arriving at the resort, I’d arranged a special surprise for my husband for our wedding anniversary.  There was to be rose petals in the tub, champagne in the ice bucket, and chocolate covered strawberries awaiting us after our anniversary dinner.  I was very excited and had confirmed everything with our concierge the morning of.  However, when we arrived after dinner, there was nothing at all.  I was very disappointed as I had prepaid for the delivery of those petals.  I contacted the concierge and he was surprised as he’d received pictures of the room and the surprise.  You guessed it.  They went to the wrong room.  Someone got a huge surprise.  My husband and I laughed about that later, but I was still disappointed.  This was to be one of the highlights of our anniversary and it didn’t happen.  The concierge arranged for it to be done over, only this time they would not bring the rose petals I’d paid for originally, nor was I reimbursed the funds for those rose petals.  The champagne and chocolate arrangement was beautiful, but it lacked luster without the roses.   Even though the money spent wasn’t much, I was disappointed that it wasn’t returned.  While I understand the delivery man wouldn’t return to deliver roses without pay when he’d done the job, albeit the wrong room, I would have expected the resort to eat that one as the improper room number was not our snafu.   I will say, however, the representative was incredibly apologetic and I appreciate the communication I had with him.  I refrain from using his name only because I don’t want it to personally reflect poorly on him.  I only want it to be useful information to double check all details in the event of personal surprise plans.

Reservations.  Again, not really a con, just an annoyance.  The first day we were unable to make reservations due to a miscommunication in knowing to go to guest services for that purpose.  We just went to the buffet which was fine.  The next day we went to make reservations and could only make them for that evening.  We had to come back the next day to make the remaining reservations which took a bit of time.  Unlike several reviewers, I understood the reservation system as there were several groups that were in most of the restaurants we attended in the later hours.  However, earlier reservations had plenty of room.  I did notice that the nights of crowded reservations had some of the staff seeming harried and with not enough time between reservations to properly reset.  One of the restaurants in which we dined still had bread and crayons on the floor from the party who’d left directly in front of us.  Another still had a shard of glass from a broken wine glass.  In our previous Punta Cana stay, we didn’t need reservations and always had a seat and the time and location we desired.  Just an observation.

Overall, my husband and I had a wonderful vacation and were truly sad to go.  We met some wonderful people and had some amazing experiences (GO ZIPLINING!).  I certainly would recommend this resort to anyone and have already done so to a couple of friends planning to make their trip to DR soon.  Just remember your bug repellent and you should be fine.

reviews.author: Travel_purposely
reviews.title: Great stay in a little slice of Paradise
reviews.text: Received Royal treatment at the resort. Restaurants were top notch, Spa was heavenly, beach pristine, and our butler, Gabriel Dalusma, did an unbelievable job catering to our every need and want, even personally going to pick our tickets in town. 5 stars!

reviews.author: 54CKY
reviews.title: Better Than Expected
reviews.text:
I came here with low expectations after looking at previous reviews- especially of the food.  Came with several other couples and we all thought the food wasn't all that bad.  Decent variety and you just have to use common sense if something doesn't look good - don't eat it.  Specialty restaurants were good and good variety as well, even those with the fixed menu.  We all had Deluxe rooms towards back of resort.  Rooms were nice, good size.  The only thing is they are by the main service entrance, so noise could wake you up at night and early morning.  

Staff was nice and bar tenders very attentive.  Other than the noise the only thing you should know is the liquor is terrible and beer sometimes had a sulfur smell at times, and drinks were very sweet.  I know it defeats the all inclusive you pay for, but suggest you buy alcohol at airport duty free before coming to resort if you want a better cocktail.

Beach was wonderful and probably the best attribute of the resort.

reviews.author: Nst2015
reviews.title: Great family trip- very relaxing
reviews.text:
This was our first all-inclusive trip with our kids and they absolutely loved it. Said it was the "best vacation ever". And it was a great family vacation... We stayed at the Reserve which is smaller and more manageable than the larger resort. I'd recommend it. The food was better than I expected. The beach is a 2 min golf cart ride away or a 10 min walk- gorgeous blue water and tall palm trees. The pools are great and they wind around the area. I especially loved the shady cabanas that were huge and easy to find- provided nice shade coverage so the kids could still be outside to color or read, but out of the sun. The gym was small but clean and nice and there were machines available- not too crowded. The room was a garden room so we had access to the outside. You could also get a poolside one- those looked nice. Very big and clean rooms- they were great.

The big negatives were the hard sell on the Club Melia day one. You would think they'd wait a bit to let us get a feel for the place, but our "concierge" wanted us all to meet for some 45 min. breakfast one morning and wouldn't do it without both of us being there. There is no way our kids would want to sit through that (or us for that matter)... and once we said no we didn't see our concierge again. He was helpful before but then just disappeared once it was clear we weren't interested. The dinner reservation thing is a joke too. Just make reservations your first night there- for the nights you want to not eat at the buffet- so you can try different spots, but they like to tell you reservations are hard to get, etc... and make you talk to a concierge or the main desk- it's chaotic- but it usually ends up working out. Just not a great system...

We were also given all these coupons (for My Time) which ended up being totally useless. We tried to use one for a bottle of wine and it caused so much drama. Not worth it. Ignore them if you get them.

Anyway, overall it was a really nice and relaxing getaway. The kids loved it all (5 & 7 years old)... our room was really big and nice and clean. Nathanial, Luisa Recio and Aosi who waited on us were all very nice. Luisa and Nathanial were both especially kind, friendly and always smiling. Thank you for your great service!

reviews.author: marcela14061932
reviews.title: comentarios
reviews.text: He visitado muchos resorts en el caribe, pero Paradisus Palma Real, superó todas mis expectativas, es realmente un paraíso y la atención del personal es EXCELENTE, yo estaba en Royal Service y todo el mundo resultó ser muy amable, siempre dispuestos y con una simpatía única para ayudarte en lo que fuera, para mi, el mejor resort de la vida!!

reviews.author: Jason R
reviews.title: This hotel does it right, from management to the outstanding service staff
reviews.text:
Anyone who has a negative review for this hotel will not be happy anywhere. Yes the staff is great, the hotel is 5 star all the way but I think we forget why the service is so good.... the management! The hotel manager BELEN SANMARTIN is a true Professional and I wanted to say how much my wife and I appreciated her looking after us. More important is how clear it is to us that her attitude and her attenttion to detail is why this hotel is so outstanding. Yes there are fantastic employees who really care and want to make sure you have a great vacation. But I believe that the training and the wanting to please their customers comes from the manager and her incredibly dedicated team. There is no way the staff can be this good without a top notch leader. 
We were greated. treated and taken care of like family. We are not VIP'S, we are average customers who have been converted to Paradisus fans because of Belen and her team. Thank you so much, we will be back!
One quick word for those who take the Royal Service, ask for SAMUEL RODRIGUEZ. We cannot describe how hard this guy tries to make sure you enjoy your stay. Samuel is not the typical employee, he is far beyond what you would expect. Quick story, my wife needed to go to the hospital (nothing to do with the hotel at all) Samuel organized the whole and came with us and waited. He stayed and helped us the whole time while his wife waited for him at home... we felt so bad but he insisted. He went far beyond what we expected and we are greatfull to him since he really made our vacation!
If you are not sure about this place you need to try it. You will not find a better run hotel, they are Worth every penny. They really go out of their way to give you an exceptional experience.
Paradisus is a new vacation home for us because of Belen, Samuel and the rest of the staff!
Marie-Pierre and Jason thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Bruna D
reviews.title: Verry good place!
reviews.text:
It is an excellent hotel, but has positive and negative points, those last ones specially about the bathroom. 

Positive
Instalations: poll, beach.. everything is beautiful and you have to be there early to get a chair!
Staff: very good ppl. Always smiling and very helpful
Room: great bath for 2 and a great  and confortable bed
Food: lots of variety and great quality. Make sure to have dinner in Ventos

Negative
Bathroom: too dark. no windows. Shower has a weak power, so it takes a looong time to wash long hair. One day I found a cockroach there! it was disgusting! Thankfull my fiancee was near me and he was able to kill it. 
Restaurants: it's hard to get a reservation in some restaurants... But I tried my lucky to have dinner without a reservation and I succeeded  

Besides all, I would go there again, no doubt. But probably in another room category.

reviews.author: dkrapose
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, excellent service!
reviews.text: We selected this hotel based on other Tripadvisor reviews and it definitely lived up to the positive reviews. We loved the fact that we never crowded, whether be at the pool, restaurant, beach, golf course. There are plenty of lounge chairs by the pool, plenty of huts at the beach and never had trouble getting a perfect spot. The food at the buffets was probably the best buffet food we've had at similar resorts. They have a huge variety. The staff was great, very friendly and service was much better at this resort than at other DR -Punta Cana resorts we've stayed at. We must mention a few employees by name because of their outstanding service to our entire family - Onardo Marino, our waiter beachside and poolside, super friendly and always right there to bring cold drinks. Big Mac, who coordinated poolside/beachside activities, was great at getting people involved, even our children who enjoyed a beach volleyball game with him and other guests. Antonio Ramirez who was a bartender at the swim up bar, again, super friendly and always had a smile on his face, got to know us by name, he was great the whole week. Lastly, Dionis (not quite sure of spelling), who worked at the morning buffet, always a pleasure to see in the morning, gave excellent service and does his job well. All of these people made our week very memorable and it is service like this that will keep people coming back to your resort.

reviews.author: vacaylover2015
reviews.title: Enjoyable, relaxing and happening place for the whole family. We loved it!
reviews.text:
We travel a lot, but never to an all-inclusive resort.  We like to "rough it" with a vacation rental instead because we do not like crowds.  But when our friends decided to get married there, we booked this trip.  To our delightful surprise, we actually very much loved this resort! The food was good with all kinds of varieties.  I am a fish and seafood lover and I could not get enough of the varieties they had to offer.  My husband and son also satisfied their cravings (perhaps a little too much at times). :-) If you want to try their restaurants for dinner, you should book all your dinners before you travel to DR because the restaurants do "sell out" at dinner time (meaning that you won't get in because they are booked to capacity each night, especially the weekends). Our favorite swim-up bar drink was coco-loco (spiked or virgin - your choice) - delish!  Mumbo is good too. The bartenders are funny and entertaining.  In short, we have no complaints about food or drink choices.  

The resort seems full but it does not feel crowded (which is what we were afraid of when we booked it, since we normally prefer to do our own thing with a vacation rental option, rather than an all-inclusive resort, when we travel).  The beach is nice and quiet, with lots of covered shady areas and beach chairs for you to relax.  If you feel like "action," the pool is a happening place.  The staff members (I would call them the "cast members") are happy and go out of their way to entertain you.  When you check in, do pay attention to their schedule of events if you want some activities.  I enjoyed finger painting class. My husband went to a cocktail making class.  My 12-year-old son who loves sushi came with me to a sushi making class. We did candle making; I was doing Zumba, water cycling, water aerobics, and various Latin dance classes every single day. My mornings started with a bit of stretching. Dancing usually followed.  Our special "thank you" goes to the four "cast members" whom we loved the most. We do not have their actual names (although each employee does wear a name tag), but these guys go by "Big Mac" and "Mini Me."  We also loved Angel and Ray-Ray.  I don't know how these guys can always be (or act very well to seem to be) so happy, cheerful, funny as can be and just entertaining.  They seem to be working (or "hanging out" to entertain the guests) all the time, from the morning 10 am stretching class to a 9:30 pm show where they are also members of some performance.  Great job!  Our trip would not have been the same without these employees! 

Take the time to see the Michael Jackson show on Saturday. It is well worth it.  The actor does an amazing job imitating Michael. And his supporting dancers are great as well; we have not seen break dancing in years. These guys are amazing.

We also liked the Lion King show a lot.

Each night they have some local dancing and the "cast members" will dance with you and make it really fun.  Again, Big Mac, Mini Me, Angel and RayRay, to name our favorite guys are there and they are dancing (after a long day of working already, mind you).  

If you are planning a wedding there, it will be beautiful.  My friend who was a bride there advises to read the "fine print" of the contract though, so that you understand what is and is not included in the base package price.  Reading carefully may help avoid any unpleasant surprises.  But for us, the guests at the wedding, I must say that it was a very beautiful and well-organized celebration. They do two weddings a day on average, so they got the logistics down to science, which helps the happy couple relax and just enjoy their special day instead of stressing about it. 

The beach is very clean at the Melia resorts (they have a couple neighboring properties).  They manicure the beach every single morning. The other areas of the island are not so clean, with seaweed everywhere.  The beach is nice and spacious, not too close to the water to the point where all chairs must be crammed together; plenty of space to play in the sand.  The water is nice and warm. We did some snorkeling. If snorkeling is what you love, this is not the beach for that.  But we did see a turtle, a spotted stingray, some star fish, a puffer fish, and lots of tropical fish. But again, this is not the place for a snorkeling-only vacation; the sea life we saw was a nice bonus, in our view, to the overall experience at this resort.
The shopkeepers and all kinds of vendors on the beach can get a bit annoying (trying to sell you their stuff or make you come see their store), but at our beach the security (which patrols the beach all the time, by the way) is trying to keep those local vendors away from the guests - another nice bonus from this Melia resort.
If this helps, we booked a private round-trip transportation through Expedia; just added this option when we booked the trip.  It was $114 round trip for a private van.  Very nice and adequate. if you do this, be sure to come see the Expedia rep in the hotel's lobby the next day or to so that your return transportation time is confirmed. We did this the day before our departure and they had a bit of trouble locating our booking. It all worked out fine though, so no complaints there either.
The room was average, but we did not book anything extravagant and we hardly spent any time in the room, so that was the least of our concerns. The room was sufficiently spacious (for our needs), the beds were comfy, and the Jacuzzi in the room was nice.
I really cannot think of anything negative to say about this place! We will be back; my son already wants me to book the next trip there, and we met one couple there who has been coming to this particular resort for the past 9 years. They said that they love this place above all others where they stayed.
Wifi works surprisingly great all over the property, including the beach. This allowed us to stay connected with work emails, which was important to us.

reviews.author: Patrick . H
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The staff is very friendly and we enjoyed the beach. It is very peaceful, quiet and relaxing. The food was delicious, the rooms are beautiful, the beds comfortable. Wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Beautynewyork
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Wasn't ready to leave our trip from a wonderful and relaxing resort . This  was my family and I first time staying at Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana. Everything was perfect from the variety of foods, room service, the room and the  entertainment. The resort was beautiful and the staff was very  friendly. I wanted to give special shout out to ALFREDO at the Blue Agave Restaurant.  He was very attentive to my family every time we came to eat at the restaurant. My family and I will definitely be back to visit.

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good stay.  Estefania was a good family concierge.  Beach was nice.  Pools were very large.  Bars were everywhere.  Lots of food options.  Resort was very lush and pretty.  Staff was friendly.  Check in and Check out was easy. ........................................................................................................................

reviews.author: Gaurikay
reviews.title: Was a very good holiday
reviews.text: Our luxury family holiday was fantastic. The weather was superb. The hotel was spotless and the staff were so friendly wished we could have brought one home with us. The food served was scrumptious couldn't fault a thing. Can't wait to book again. All in all a thumbs up from us

reviews.author: ConneryIreland
reviews.title: very good resort with room to improve
reviews.text: Just back from vacation and really enjoyed our time here. To arrive at 11.00pm and look down at what must be the most jaw droppingly beautiful hotel lobby, with Roman style impluvium lined with columns on 3 sides, including several water features, leads one to think one has chosen the coolest of  holiday venues....but our excitement took a knock when we went to our room. It smelled damp, it was not clean, the bin was full, dirty glasses were half filled with green liquid, no clean towels. I pointed this out to the bellboy who beat a hasty retreat. The bed had a damp feel to it but after 24 hrs travel we slept soundly. All was reported first thing in the am and most were acted upon but no new towels were delivered till we recomplained that afternoon. The tv was repaired twice. One has to queue to book restaurants which are invariably half full at night. Those are the cons. Everything else was excellent and delivered with a broad smile from most staff.We were a wedding party of 70 and the wedding itself was lovely. I would definitely return and I recommend this hotel with the above reservations.

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text: My trip was amazing and highly recommended the paradisus Palma real but our room. Service attendant Fernando Geeonino made our trip extra special. Fernanndos attention to detail and personal service makes everything extra special!

reviews.author: Melina C
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Fernando geronimo made our stay a pleasure. He was so happy and cheerful. We were so lucky to have him for our room server. He was very special, he made the whole experience pleasurable.  Make sure you request him as your server, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: swilky
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text: Had an amazing time. Samuel our butler was very helpful and so polite. We would recommend this resort to anyone. All the cleaning staff were exceptional and all the staff work so hard to keep paradisus  so beautiful.

reviews.author: dodotte63
reviews.title: Superbe séjour
reviews.text: Magnifique séjour ! Hotel grandiose, propre et très bien entretenu. Le personnel est vraiment très serviable et souriant. La nourriture est excellente et variée .. Les cocktails frais ! Une dédicasse à Georges, serveur du bar de la piscine qui est vraiment très sympathique.

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.title: Wonderful Time !!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time in the Royal Service part of this resort. The food was great and the drinks tasted wonderul. Our butler Luis Hernadez was great. Omar in the business center was so polite and shared some of his coffee with us ( which was delicious !). This was a great vacation and we cannot wait for the next time !

reviews.author: Boston_MANana
reviews.title: Best Relaxing Family Vacation Yet!
reviews.text:
I am not going to go into a ton of detail, but I will say this was one of our family's best vacations.

This is our third time in the DR, and this was my favorite resort.  The grounds are gorgeous and clean.  We stayed in the Reserve in the Family Concierge area.  Our concierge Sofia was excellent, adorable and so helpful.  

The gym was great, I went to a spinning class three times, David, the spin instructor was fantastic.

All of the help was excellent.  I love the quietness of the Reserve pool and restaurant.  The beach was gorgeous and the restaurants/food were all very good.  The shows at night were very entertaining. 

Our pool server Emilio was awesome.

Wifi at the pool was excellent, a bit spotty in the room.

If you are not traveling with kids, the Royal Service would be the plan to get.  Adults only, pool, restaurant and beach area.

My son is 13, I am not sure we would do the family concierge again, but we will definitely be back and will stay at the Reserve.

I gave the sleep quality 4 stars because I am not a great sleeper, but the bed and room were very comfortable.

reviews.author: Wolfhabel80
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This place was amazing. The staff was great and we had a great time. The royal service really helps you take advantage of everything. The Palazzo in the royal service area is one of the best meals we had on our trip.

reviews.author: Clabilli
reviews.title: Hotel maravilloso!
reviews.text: Me hospede en el hotel en el mes de abril con mi esposo. Todo hmaravilloso. Playa excelente servicios calidad superior. 100% recomendable. Especialmente la atención recibida en el Business Center por parte de Omar Hernandez!!!!! Gracias Omar por tu asistencia!

reviews.author: Phil S
reviews.title: First infant vacation
reviews.text:
We just returned from a lovely vacation in DR. We chose The Reserve for it's "family friendly" reputation and were not disappointed. This was our first real vacation with our 16 month old son.  

Pros:
-Well maintained and beautiful property.
-Staff are very friendly and accommodating, especially with our son. Two in particular, Jazmin and Kenny were just amazing with him.  They went out of their way to make sure he was having fun and taken care of.  Very sweet, especially Jazmin, who affectionately called him her "little cowboy".
-Excellent beach and pools
-For an all inclusive, found drinks to be good quality and very easy to order

Cons:
- Dining reservations are a nightmare. Read ahead on Tripadvisor and booked all of our reservations the first day. Still had issues, wrong restaurants and wrong times. The system is seriously flawed. Countless mistakes. 
- Food quality is at best a 6/10.
- The hard Club Melia sell is annoying

reviews.author: Diana G
reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: Stayed here last week with my husband and daughter. The property is breathtaking! The pool area is magnificent with many thatched-roof areas for sun protection- same for the gorgeous beach with soft sand and warm water.The staff was attentive and always aimed to please. Sweet Carolina helped us to get a table in two restaurants when reservations were difficult to get. The activities staff was wonderful - BIg Mac, Mini Mi, Angel and RayRay made poolside Zumba and dance lessons fun along with aqua aerobics and aqua spin. These activities definitely helped counteract the calories I consumed in the delicious food and tropical drinks.The room was beautiful although they could use some new high-quality pillows instead of the ones in the room. Also it would be better if the two beds were queen-sized rather than full. Check-in was a little frustrating as they did not have the room prepared with two beds which I requested 4 months earlier - instead we were originally given one king-sized bed. It was also disconcerting that they take photo copies of your passport upon check-in without telling you the reason why. The restaurants were lovely and the food was delicious. The buffet was wonderful with two separate grills where you could get the fish or meat of your choice grilled while you wait. It was a truly wonderful vacation and I would definitely go back!

reviews.author: johnny r
reviews.title: todo perfecto
reviews.text:
primero lo que mas me gusto fue el gran servicio de room service FERNANDO GERONIMO  se encargo de que todo fuera perfecto a la hora de ordenar a mi habitacion la calidad de servicio de fernando sobre paso mis expectativas..
  
segundo el servicio en los restaurantes me encanto muy amables todos los chicos en los diferentes restaurantes que visitamos y muy bune preparados todos en general todo perfecto..

reviews.author: tony r
reviews.title: no tengo quejas
reviews.text:
el servicio fue lo que mas me encanto, aqui el personal te da un trato como si tu estubieras en un paraiso, tambien la comida es de primera donde quiera que ivas cualquier restaurantes la comida se ponia mas buena o mas ric.

otro servicio que fue de mis preferidos fue el de room service  FERNANDO  GERONIMO muy buen chico cuando venia a nuestra habitacion nos daba un servicio fenomenal siempre atento con una llamada de cortesia para retirarnos los platos este chico fue de lo mejor muchas gracias por tan buen servicio te lo agradecemos..

reviews.author: BrigitteV737
reviews.title: First time at Paradisus resorts
reviews.text: We booked the Royal Service and right from our first day we got great service with our butler Omar Mota and our beach concierge Francisco Cabrera. Your beach beds are reserved, towels, water etc. Etc. Omar even finds us on the beach every day to book our reservations for Dinner or to see if we need or have any requests. Muchas gracias ;)

reviews.author: Andronal
reviews.title: Vacances de rêve
reviews.text:
Nous sommes arrivés depuis trois jours et jusqu'à date tous est parfait. 

Nous voulons soulignons le service extraordinaire de notre concierge de plage Francisco Cabrera et de notre buttler Omar Mota qui ont  à tous nos désirs et besoins. Ils  sont prévoyants et très attentifs, ce qui rend notre séjour encore plus merveilleux.

reviews.author: ECUPirate
reviews.title: Great stay...
reviews.text:
My wife and I were down in Apr. 2015 with my company.  So all of our arrangements were pre-arranged for us.   The check-in was super easy.  We had the Royal Service package, which came with a butler.   Sandy gave us a quick tour of the grounds and escorted us to our room.  I honestly believe within about 30 minutes of our arrival we had our toes in the sand.

The rooms/ grounds were clean and the staff was super friendly.  We spent most of our time relaxing on the white sand beach enjoying the crystal blue water.   The cabana/ beach waiters, Franscisco, Marty and Lenonardo, were fabulous.  They really hustle and took great care of my wife and I.

Again, being a company event a few of our meals were pre-arranged so we didn't make it to all of the restaurants.  But I can say that I was not disappointed with any of our meals.   

Our overall experience was great...

reviews.author: dagwood1574
reviews.title: Awesome place!
reviews.text: My girlfriend's parents took us all to Punta Cana for her 40th birthday!  They arrived the day before us and upgraded our room.  The room was incredible! There was a private seating area and private access to the swimming pools.  The service was incredible!  My main guys at the pool bar were Felix and Henry.  They made sure that our drinks kept flowing.  Also many times they made us fresh cocktails instead of the usual machine mixes.  Many of these guys usually do not get tipped.  So I made sure I took care of them and they were extremely happy!  I think our people that helped us at breakfast every day was Carlo and Kenny? Carla?  Sorry.  The grounds of Paradisus are absolutely incredible.  I am usually the budget traveler so this was a different surprise.  There are so many options for food and I did not have a bad meal anywhere.  I splurged for the romantic package at the spa.  That was absolutely awesome and highly recommend even though it was expensive.  The only problem we had was I guess the rates reduced because on Sunday and Monday there were a ton of screaming children running around the breakfast areas and pools.  Sometimes the kids made it to the private access areas for swimming.  All in all a great family birthday weekend!!!

reviews.author: Jose Mari G
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Quizás la arquitectura exterior del hotel, no refleja bien lo que puede ser El Caribe. Creo que se podría mejorar. Por ejemplo, el hotel Barceló de Playa Bávaro, me parece que tiene mejor apariencia "exterior" que el Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: minamikaze
reviews.title: A wonderful stay
reviews.text:
My husband and I and our 12-year-old daughter stayed at the Reserve side of the resort during the April school break.  This is a very well run resort, albeit huge,  with a stunning white sand beach.  During our stay the weather was consistently sunny with temperautre in the 80s.  And the water was the color of azure blue with no seaweed at all !  We enjoyed walking on the long smooth white sandy beach and my daughter loved surfing on the boogie board and play with the waves !    Some families found the waves a tad strong for their little ones, but for us it was very nice ! 

Food :  this is the first all inclusive resort I have ever been to  ( other than club med a long time a go) and was a bit dubious about the food offering, as food is very important for me in terms of make or break the trip, but was blown away by the quality of food, and junk food wasn't even an option !  

For buffets, there are three buffet restaurants offering breakfast, lunch and sometimes dinner, and my favorite one is Nao which offers international buffet, quality food, lots of fresh fruits and salads and vegetables.  No junk food, not repetitive, all real food cook to perfection !  

As for the restaurants, I highly recommend Vento, just avoid the Japanese restaurant which was disappointing. The restaurants could be hard to book if you don't have the concierge or royal services to do the bookings for you ! Make sure you make the reservation as early as possible !  

Room:  We stayed at a one-bed room with concierge service on the reserve side of the resort.  The travelers pictures here are quite true to life, so I don't need to say more!  We had Sofia as our concierge who is a very delightful person and provided all the help we need to navigate the huge resort !  The only thing I would add is that the room could become very cramped and lack of seating area if the sofa bed is extended !  We had a tour of the master suite and found it is really nice and spacious.  if you can, go for it ! 

Service: Overall service was very good as mentioned by other reviewers .  Staff  were very pleasant and helpful ! 

The only thing affected my stay at the end was that the buggy service between the reserve side and the beach area had became very inconsistent - and if to walk, would take about 15, 20 minutes to the beach area and could become unpleasant in the hot sun if you have beach bags to carry !  Also, make sure you have bug sprays and ointment for mosquito bites !  My daughter and I got terribly bitten by mosquitos ( or could be bugs) !

reviews.author: Patrick M
reviews.title: FAntastic Experience
reviews.text:
This was my first all inclusive and was a wonderful experience. The staff was processional and friendly, from the grounds crew to the butler service. Food was better than I expected for an all inclusive. Nothing I ate was amazing, but everything was of great quality and I did not worry about getting sick at all. 
I would highly suggest the royal service; having the private beach away from the crowds and kids really made the trip for my fiancé and I. It is worth the money for the butler and private areas. 

Wonderful stay, and If I ever return to the Dominican Republic I would not go to another hotel.

reviews.author: Winslow Y
reviews.title: Perfection in every way
reviews.text:
Just came back from Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana. I loved, loved, loved the resort and service. If I go back to Punta Cana, I would stay here again, and again, and again.

Our RCI rep and concierge was Luis Munoz, he was Awesome. He speaks perfect English, and was super nice. He came looking for us around the resort on a daily basis. He planned all of our dinners at there 6 restaurants. Luis Munoz provides A plus service and is a great person. We welcomed Luis into our family, because he treated us like family. 

Martha Santana the waitress at Naos buffet, is very hardworking. She always has a smile on her face.She made sure we had everything we needed. She was definitely the nicest waitress, and she had a sense of urgency. She was always busy taking care of the guests. I never saw her stop to take a break. Martha Santana should get a raise. If ever at Naos, sit in Martha's section. 

Big Mac and his crew provided great entertainment. Big Mac is high energy, fun, talented, friendly and loves what he does. Most importantly, he actually remembers everyone's name. Hundreds of people he meets, but he walks up to you and greets you by name. The entertainment which Big Mac and his crew provides is family oriented but still has a club vibe. No need to leave the resort to Party when you have Big Mac.

reviews.author: John Richer
reviews.title: Tropical Island Paradise
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the DR, and as a vacation destination it was incredible.  As to the resort property where we stayed, I will review it based upon 1) Grounds / Facilities; 2) Food and Service; 3) Room; and 4) Misc. / Overall Experience.  

As to the grounds and facilities, we stayed at the Reserve but spent equal time there and at the main Paradisius resort on the beach, which is a 10 minute walk.  Those staying at the Reserve can eat at the resort restaurants, swim in its pool and spend time at the beach.  Those at the main resort, however, cannot access the Reserve or its amenities.   The Reserve is a newer addition geared towards families with a Kids Club, which is why we picked it, having two children aged 7 and 4.  Regardless of whether you are at the Reserve or the main property, it feels like one single resort, and it is immaculate.  You truly feel like you are in a tropical island paradise with a resort feel.  The property is beautiful, it is clean, luxurious throughout and it is well-maintained.  You can tell that management makes this aspect a priority, and it makes a HUGE difference in your overall beach resort experience.  The beach is also great and what you would expect for the Caribbean.

As to food and service, we had a family concierge, who made all of our dinner reservations for the entire trip on the first night.  Those with concierge service are given a preference on dinner reservations, and we had no problem getting what we wanted.  We had dinner at Ibana, Vento, Aqua, Fuego, and the Grill.     I have seen some some critical reviews of the food on TA, and I honestly do not know what these people are talking about.  The quality and variety of the food at these restaurants was outstanding.  It is the best food at an all-inclusive resort I have ever had.  It is delicious, very fresh (fruit and fish especially) and well prepared.  Our son had food allergies, and each restaurant had no problem making an appropriate dish for him that he liked.  The food was the highlight of our trip, and we loved each meal.  As to breakfast, it is your typical resort buffet, and it was very good.  Again, you will notice how fresh the food is, the selection and variety.  You will love and look forward to breakfast in the morning.  The coffee is exquisite.  As to lunch, we ate at Mole twice, and it was very good.  Otherwise, we had a buffet lunch, and these were as good as the breakfasts.  The food at both properties was a treat.  As to service at the restaurants, it varied.  A few of the restaurants (Aqua and Mole), the service is slow, and after your initial order is taken, you will have to flag your server down if you need something else.  This can be improved, and a technique to overcome it is to place your entire order (appetizer, dinner, desert) at the same time.  The service at Fuego and the Grill was much better, and at Vento it was outstanding.  The waitstaff there is extremely responsive and will pamper you and make sure your every need is met.  Given the disparity, one must wonder why the service at the other restaurants cannot be like Vento?

As to our room, as noted we had a concierge, and stayed in a family concierge suite.   The room was very clean, the beds were comfortable and the A/C worked great.  The room was luxurious and spacious.   Every night our beds were turned down, and the kids were given treats.  Our personal concierge, Nikel, took excellent care of us.  We were given a personal cell phone, and anytime you needed anything, Nikel was a call away and took care of it.  This included the dinner reservations discussed above, along with reservations for the spa, private cabanas at the beach and the pool and wine each night for the room, scented pillows for the kids and a fun bubble bath.  The only critique we had with the concierge service is that this was the first time we ever had it, and we were unsure what services were available and what to expect.  We would have appreciated it if the hotel could have given us more information about these services when we first arrived.   It was only towards the end of the trip when we fully understood the benefit that the concierge could provide, and once we did we were very pleased.  Nikel was competent, responsive, and we grew fond of him and were glad we paid extra for this service.

Finally, as to miscellaneous thoughts and the overall experience, the staff is friendly and charming, they are great with children, and you will appreciate that you will rarely walk by a staff member without them saying "Hola," or "Buenos Dias" as they go by.  The staff is also flattered when you try to speak Spanish with them, and this was fun part of our trip.  It is these small things that add up to a nice experience.

The Reserve is geared towards families, and we have to give a major shout out to the staff at the Reserve Kids Zone.  For couples with small children, a resort with a kids club is a major selling point, as the adults would like a bit of quiet time and relaxation.  As to the one at the Reserve, it was outstanding, and we would like to mention by name the excellent service provided by Ilbia, Yeika, Jonathan, Berlis, Martina, Virginia, Meika, Yafreisi and Katiuska.  You could tell from day one they were competent, fun and loved children.  We felt completely at ease leaving our kids there.   By the second day they knew the names of our kids and their particulars (no food for our son with allergies, no sun for both fair skinned children).  Our kids loved going to the Kids Zone and appreciated the activities provided.    

As to negatives, there are a few, but I want to emphasize they exist at the margins and were overwhelmed by the positive aspects of this resort.  One area of improvement is the shuttle service between the main property and the Reserve.  You can walk it in 10 minutes or so, but with small children we needed the service.  The problem was is that it was inconsistent, and at times we had to wait longer than I felt was appropriate.  Adding more shuttles, especially in the morning, would be a significant and appreciated improvement.    Another improvement would be adding more staff for beverage services, both at the bars and with respect to the pool boys, ie, the guys who bring you drinks while you are kicking back at the pool or beach.  There were many times where you could tell these guys were overwhelmed, meaning the service was slow, frustrating at times, but easily cured if staff were simply added.   The wi-fi was also spotty and inconsistent.  It was consistent in the room and at the Reserve, but very inconsistent at the beach and the main property.  

Last but not least, on the first day a very charming young man met us and said he would be taking us to breakfast the first day and giving us a tour of the resort.  In all frankness, this is a trap for the unwary.  What is really going on is you are being steered toward "Club Melia," which is the vacation rewards / point system run by the corporate owner of the property and Paradisius chain.  Once it became clear what our guide's true role was, we did not have the heart to tell him we did not want to hear a sales presentation on our first day of vacation.  But he was persistent, and it was very hard to tell him no, especially since he was on "probation," and he told us that getting guests to commit to hear the sales pitch would help him become a permanent employee.  Regardless of whether true or not, we did not appreciate spending our first morning at the resort having to hear a high pressure sales presentation that felt at times like you were buying a car, which for many is about as fun as going to the dentist to get a root canal.  Even if we had some interest, there is no way we would make such a commitment without first trying out the resort and gaining some experience, which calls into question the wisdom of selling guests as they start their vacation.  Regardless, the last thing we wanted to do on the first day of may vacation was spend it in a sales office (we had not even been to the pool or beach yet).  This left a bad taste with me, and there is a better way to lure those who might truly be interested in "Club Melia" other than deception and subterfuge.  Perhaps offering a free massage or significant room upgrade for spending the 90 minutes.  

At the end of the day, what counts when considering where to spend you hard earned money at a Caribbean beach resort is were you able to relax and rejuvenate or were you stressed about getting a reservation for dinner or a cabana at the beach or pool?  Was the food good?  How were the drinks?   Good or watered down?  Did the kids have fun?   The Reserve exceeded our expectations on all of these points.  We had a great time, were sad to leave, would certainly come back and will recommend it to our friends.

reviews.author: Beachgurl2015
reviews.title: THE GREATEST ANIMATION
reviews.text:
I have been to many hotels in Punta Cana but I must say that this hotel is the greatest. Our stay was perfect thanks to the Animation, more specifically Rony!! He is an awesome animator, always smiling, encouraging everyone to participate. He was great with our kids, they absolutely loved him. We were able to relax while they were participating in activities because we knew they were in great hands!! From zumba, water aerobics, dance lesson you name it Rony was full of energy and always always smiling. He is definitely a reason why we would go back to this hotel!!!
The grounds were well kept and very clean. The food was great too.
Will definitely be back with my family. Thanks paradisus family and thank you Rony!!!! See you soon :)

reviews.author: Dana H
reviews.title: Best Vacation to Date!!
reviews.text: So happy with this vacation.  Great food, great people, so fun for my husband and I and our two children (11 & 12).  Beautiful beach and pool - nothing to complain about.  Would go back in a heartbeat.  BigMac and MinniMe will keep you smiling all vacation!!!    Franklin at Fuego is the waiter you want!!!  He is the best!!

reviews.author: Chadandteri
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed here for 5 days and loved it. The beach and pools were gorgeous. We were worried about the food being good with it being an all-inclusive resort, but they offered lots of options and everything tasted great. One mexican restaurant especially was amazing!! Some of the best Mexican food I've ever eaten. The staff were all helpful and made sure you were having an excellent stay. Would definitely go again!

reviews.author: Ronald K
reviews.title: Paradise for sure
reviews.text:
Would recommend this hotel for sure. 
              Do not sleep with your sliding doors open and make sure you have Benadryl for bug bites if you do. Other than that great place, very nice people.
Loved the beach, the pool, the food. The resort is so big that even though there are a lot of people it never seems crowded. This would be a place I would go back to if there wasn't so many other places to see in the world.

reviews.author: Paola H
reviews.title: Vacaciones Familiares
reviews.text: Es un autentico paraíso para los niños y para los mayores permite desconectar con un servicio muy bueno, especialmente en el Family Concierge. Ha sido un viaje de 15 personas y todos lo hemos pasado genial y hemos descansado muchísimo.

reviews.author: michele g
reviews.title: My return to Paradise..
reviews.text:
One year ago today I got married at the Paradisus Palma Real and now I am back for my anniversary. Just like alway everything is awesome and a beautiful.. There are a few new restaurants and changes that were made and they are absolutely breath taking. 
The service is once again phenomenal. I stayed on Royal Service again and it is an absolute must do. The service the staff provides is excellent. The afternoons at the Sunset Bar and Royal Beach are packed full of fun. The staff here is amazing, and want nothing but to make sure you have a great time. They are my 3 amigos, Francisco Cabrera, Leonardo, and Nicolas.. You want to have a great day visit these guys.. My main man on the beach is Pedro, he is just so happy and puts an instant smile on your face. They are all a staple to this resort and such an awesome group of guys. They make the trip that much better.
Also I couldn't stay in Royal Service without having my butler Johelvi. He is so attentive and anything I needed or wanted he was there to get me. If you are going the Royal service route, you must ask for him. 
It was nice to see my wedding coordinator from last year Claribel, she is a sweetheart and from watching the weddings taking place this year, she continues to  work with sheer excellence. 
This is just a great place to visit and this being my third year in a row here I will continue to come back year after year. All the workers and staff just make you feel like you are family..

reviews.author: Pam Z
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time. This is my 3rd year in a row in Royal Service. My favorite amigos are Francisco Cabrera, Leonardo Mota, Nicolas Maracallo and Pedro. They make the best drinks and service at the Sunset Bar. They are an asset to your company. Thanks again for a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Olya M
reviews.title: Do not forget anything there. You will never see it again.
reviews.text:
Overall a good resort with good food, plenty of shade to hide from a sun and people if you want to. If you like company and swim in the ocean it is better not to stay at a Reserve. It is a good 10 min walk or need to take gulf cart.
Did not have good experience connecting to any of their representatives on a phone or email. They just do not answer any emails and with a phone bounce you around to different people. My first experience trying to book a shuttle to get from the airport to the hotel ended with just getting my own taxi.
Unfortunately. I forgot several pieces of clothes in my room and the same day reached out to the resort. Several emails later, phone calls, sending my friends who stayed behind to speak to the Managers did not produce any response. The same happened to 2 of my friends and they had identical experience so make sure do not forget anything and book  your own transportation.

reviews.author: noblehalogen
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, beach, and bars.
reviews.text: There was only one negative thing to say about this hotel and is the inconsistency of housekeeping and room service. One day housekeeping took all our dirty/wet towels but did not put any new ones. And even if the minibar says it will be refilled every 24hrs, they only refilled it once during our 4 night stay. Also, if we needed something in the room we had to ask more than once to get it resolved. Aside from that everything else was perfect. The bartenders at the pool bar and the main lobby are great and quick (Luis and Juan for example). The concierges at the Family Concierges suites will make all your restaurant reservations, and help to plan your day. The servers at the beach are always friendly and they keep the drinks coming. Food is good, better in some places and worse in others but I guess it all depends on your culinary preferences. Buffets always looked clean and food was kept at the right temperatures. We were able to relax at the beach and the pool during the day (if you want a bed go early - before 9:30AM),  and during the night it was nice to go to the main lobby to listen to live music. Rooms were quiet, and I did not had any problem sleeping. Beautiful grounds, and good choice for our honeymoon.

reviews.author: BklynYank
reviews.title: Good time, Good Food, Overall Very Good
reviews.text: Great overall experiece. First impression and view of beach from lobby is first class. Kudos to a great activities staff, Big Mac and Mini Me, for keeping us entertained. Also see Georges at the beach for ordering your drinks, he'll deliver to your location under your umbrella. Buffet selection and food were great for an all-inclusive. Challenges were room-related, including mosquitoes that entered room with you when you opened your front door, we had issues with not enough towels, and water drainage from shower left small puddles in bathroom. However, resort itself was beautiful, picturesque, great beach, nice pools. Last, bring tip money, the staff works very hard. Despite a good experience, we will probably stay at another location next time since there are so many other beautiful properties on the island.

reviews.author: Eptitom
reviews.title: 5th time here and it just gets better
reviews.text: This is our 11 trip to the Dominican Republic and our 5th time at the Paradisus Palma Real. As usual service has been exceptional especially at the Palazzo. The wait staff including Jose, Jhoneidy and chef Carlos are amazing truly 5 star service. Chef Carlos never seizes to amaze us with his culinary skills.  We visited the spa this time and truly enjoyed wonderful massages from Rosa, Juana and Keshia in a tranquil spa environment. We will be back next year!

reviews.author: Jen F
reviews.title: GREAT SERVICE
reviews.text:
We had a great time. The service was great. Francisco Cabrera by the Royal Service pool was excellent. 
Nicolas was our butler and he was good too.
We enjoyed the food it was good. The place is clean. Weather was great too.

reviews.author: Cudbwrs
reviews.title: On the Verge of Excellent (needs more value for the money)
reviews.text:
This was our first all-inclusive experience.  And I'm not pleased with the value of the experience.  While the food was good, the resort beautiful, I'm displeased with the total price paid for the experience. 

The food was good, but portions were small.  We did have some waiters ask if we wanted to share an additional entree, which worked out well in the cases where we did it.  We opted for the Royal Service, an extra $70 per person per day which provided us the Butler service.  I assumed this would provide us more complimentary wine service, but I was wrong.  Only 2 house reds available every night.  A bottle of Sangiovese that would run us $15 at the local Sam's club, cost $75 at dinner.  That was disappointing.  

The service at the pool and the beach was phenomenal!  Those gentlemen worked extra hard to ensure we were taken care of every day, from nice bali bed choices to drink service to fresh fruit served at our bali bed.  

Most of the waiters were really good, although we did have 1 or 2 that seemed apathetic and unresponsive.  

Our butler (coupled with the beach service guys) was the best part of our experience.  Our butler's name was Thomas, and he was perfect.  He made our dinner reservations every night, a feat that some of the non-Royal Service guests weren't able to accomplish.  He gave us a 1 1/2 hour tour of the facility, showing us all that it had to offer and helping us setup our excursions.  Every day he left a little surprise in our room for us (wine, champagne, personalized cake, chocolate dipped strawberries, ...).  And most nights, he even showed up at our room and walked us to dinner.  Thomas was absolutely terrific!

One thing I wish I had known before leaving, tipping is appropriate.  I read before our trip that the all-inclusive included tipping.  But that was not the case.  My advice would be to take lots of $1's, and to tip your bell-boys, your beach bartenders, your beach chair service guys, and at the end of dinners where you have reservations, tip a little more generously.  We gave each good waiter $20-40 at the end of the meal.  Important note, no way to leave a tip on a credit card, cash is required.  Also, at the end of the week we gave $170 to our butler as a tip.  I'm curious to know from anyone else who's been - did you tip, and what did you tip?  We never could get any feedback on what was appropriate, so we guessed.

If you love spas, and you have the Royal Service - make sure you go to the Spa at the sister facility "The Reserve".  It was a phenomenal setting.  We had massages there one day, which in itself was awesome.  And we returned another day to enjoy the aquatic wellness area of the spa.  Both the Paradisus and the Reserve have similar facilities, but the atmosphere at the Reserve was so much more tranquil and relaxing.  Koi ponds surrounding you, bali beds in a garden, outdoor showers, just amazing.

We spent 6 nights and 7 days in mid-April.  The weather was good this time of year, I don't think we could've handled the heat any later in the spring/summer season.

reviews.author: ricardo s
reviews.title: rooom service
reviews.text:
quiero desir que me encanto el gran servicio de room service, un servicio de primera, la comida sumamente deliciosa , un servicio de lo mejor desde que llamas y te toman la orden quedas satisfecho, el gran servicio tambien de FERNANDO GERONIMO te deja soprendido y con ganas de volver a ordenar para recibir la misma atencion que ya habias recibido..
tambien en el telefono a billy el operador un chico muy amable siempre con sus llamadas de cortesia nos dejaba satisfecho muchas gracias por todo...

reviews.author: SFSWC
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: We had the most amazing wedding here . The romance team was perfect , they gave us our dream wedding . The resort is stunning. The food was great , the drinks were delicious . Royal Service is the way to go we were blessed to have OMAR take care of us who was wonderful , Omar made life so easy and relaxing for our vacation , he's the best . Can't wait to return for our anniversary

reviews.author: mikey48
reviews.title: Near Perfect All-inclusive
reviews.text:
We spent 10 days with our son, daughter in law and 4 grandsons aged 8-16. It was a near perfect vacation. Direct non stop from JFK on Jet Blue, easy customs and immigration on arrival and prompt transfer via third party service to the hotel, included in our package. We opted for their regular junior suite, no private butler,  not on The Reserve and no Family Concierge. In retrospect that was the right decision for us. Whatever service the extra charge might have provided was really not needed.

The hotel is one of the best laid out, most physically beautiful resorts we have ever visited. That's something considering that we are sophisticated, experienced high end travelers. Everywhere you turned was another beautiful vista, interesting architecture, beautiful grounds.  There is a very Zen feeling with music piped in along the paths that lead to the outlying buildings that house the guest rooms.

Our rooms were a pleasant 5 minute stroll from the main building and beach, under cover in the event of rail. The room was nicely appointed with plenty of space, comfortable and a marble bathroom. The in room Wi-Fi was sketchy at best but if connectivity is important there is a business center and other facilities you can access.

The restaurant situation is a little challenging making this the only area a private butler may be helpful. Reservations are required in all but the buffet. Some restaurants, especially Rare, the steakhouse, are in demand. Bottom line, we made reservations at I opportune times but we're always able to adjust late in the day or at the venue. The reservation system could stand some improvement.

There are a wide variety of dining choices. The buffet is international with a huge range of freshly made choices for all three meals....and their wears alway seating. There are several venues for lunch proximate to the pool and beach and the specialty restaurants for dinner. All very good but none, other than the Michelin Star restaurant, up to a New York standard.

The resort was full but never felt crowded. The pool covers acres, beautifully designed into the overall site plan. The beach is world class, in fact one of the most beautiful I have ever been on with a wide expanse of sand and thatched palapas. Never a problem getting chairs for the entire family. There is staff everywhere, very friendly,and extremely well trained. The Spa at The Reserve was special and a wonderful way to spend a few late afternoon hours.

Bottom line, we asked ourselves if we would come back. The answer is a resounding "yes".

One minor negative...they do try (with some persistence) to sell their Club Paradisus type of time share membership with an offer of discounted activities to sit through their presentation. After a few polite "no thank you'd" they do back off.

reviews.author: Albertomiami
reviews.title: Great bartender, excellent hotel
reviews.text: I had an absolutely WONDERFUL experience at Paradesis Palma Real Resort.  The staff was so very friendly, and the hotel was clean with very spacious rooms.  I could not write this review without mentioning Luis the bantender, he is something else. He did an excellent job preparing drinks, he is really an Expert. Luis keep up the good work. I would recommend this hotel to all. Families, Couples, friends, even a wonderful place for a destination wedding.  I will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: William K
reviews.title: Excellent property for vacation, but beware on site excursion services.
reviews.text:
The facility, location, beach, food, rooms, etc. warrant a 5 star rating.  

We made the mistake of booking an excursion through a vendor at the hotel lobby.  Payment was made at the time of booking with a credit card.  The scam started later that day when we received a call that we were overcharged.  The credit card was again requested to process a refund.  Surprisingly, the electronic hand-held card reader didn't work so a carbon copy was made.
Two days later, a nearly $500 charge from a coffee shop with Western Union shows up on my bill.  Luckily, my credit card company shut the card down to minimize the damage.

DO NOT let your credit card leave your site.
NEVER let a carbon copy be made.  Walk away from the transaction if the electronic card reader does not work.

The hotel needs to do a better job checking the integrity of vendors on site.

reviews.author: Donnapcdr
reviews.title: Shocking Disappointment...
reviews.text: We have always wanted to stay at a Paradisus over the last 15 years of going to Punta Cana and have stayed at many properties there. I had heard their reputation was to be one of the best hotels there. This is not what we experienced. We had a very stressful and aggravating week due to many intolerable problems. Botched reservation on their part having no Royal Service available as was told to us, broken furniture so bad it had to be replaced, blown power in the room, no wifi was working, hours spent calling around to try to find someone to make reservations as our concierge was no where to be found, amenities through the MY Time package were never delivered, mosquitoes so bad we had to move to another room on the third floor with no elevator, $700.00 extra spent to get Royal Service "access" to amenities only to have all of our requests ignored to get the items they advertise and are not even aware of. Also minibar was only stocked twice the whole week unless we called and requested.  Perhaps this was a fluke in comparison to the other reviews but it was absolutely awful from a customer service perspective. I do not expect a 5 star hotel, especially at such a high pricepoint, to blame their reservation mistakes on my travel agent and basically say "hey, this is a business" so basically deal with it, as Marco had told me, unreal !  They were not willing to accept any responsibility for ignoring any and all requests prior to getting there.They were absolutely not interested in offering any concessions whatsoever in light of all of this. Most luxury hotels would at least offer an upgrade or something. I was pretty shocked. We are waiting to hear from the hotel and hoping that they will be reasonable and offer us a fair settlement on our stay. So far we have received a very unfair one.  I will review further when we hear something more without going into detail but just to say whether they dealt with us fairly. I will say that the grounds are very beautiful, as most bavarro hotels are, and the food is quite good, although very tightly rationed. We have stayed at Bavarro hotels with fewer stars for less money who showed much, much, more concern for their customers. So now let us see if this is true.

reviews.author: AS1205
reviews.title: Teacher
reviews.text:
This resort was beautiful!!!!! The staff and the entertainment staff were so friendly, entertaining and accommodating.  Jose was our server for breakfast and lunch at the a buffet. Antonio was the best bartender near the pool and truly the most comical and entertaining person on the resort was little Big Mac, he was able to get everyone involved no matter the activity. I was very impressed with the food and the number of choices.  The only restaurant we did not like was Fuego, the seafood was very over cooked and the lobster was much different than what we are used to in RI.  

Overall, very satisfied, weather was great, room was clean and spacious.. A great experience!!! We will be back!

reviews.author: CallumRocks
reviews.title: The quality of a resort is the quality of the people assisting you during your stay
reviews.text:
I last visited the Paradisus Real in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic eight years ago, so returned with interest about the great memories of the first visit to this resort. 
The Reserve had been added to offer additional features and resources, including upgraded rooms, restaurants and leisure areas. One other very important upgrade; the people.
Special mentions to Victor, our waiter at Hydro Grill and Mizu, Marlene who was funny, personable and very helpful at reception and dinner reservations and our friend Ewing who was our initial guide, room inspector and general guide to all good and helpful things. The stay was wonderful from the perfect weather, great room, fantastic food (try the grilled shrimp and lobster at the Hydro Grill) and beach, but Victor, Marlene and Ewing were the icing on the cake.
Search them out, they will make a great stay even better with their professionalism, extra mile help and fun and exhuberant personalities.

reviews.author: Gwen S
reviews.title: Best food, best service (Samuel), and best beach
reviews.text: A gorgeous property with personalized service.   The butler (Samuel) was awesome, friendly, attentitive.  The beach had the softest sand and plenty of chairs and covered spaces to tan and lounge.  There were more restaurants than we could try in our stay.  The meals were delicious.   My time at the spa was perfect.  Have been in many spas all over and this was the nicest I have had the pleasure of experiencing.

reviews.author: Maritza
reviews.title: Un fin de semana inolvidable
reviews.text:
Encantada con con el paisaje, la gente y su bonita amabilidad y cálida sonrisa y sus atenciones personalizadas, la comida para elegir, pude compartir unos momentos especiales al lado de mi familia los cuales los volvería a repetir en el mismo lugar The reserve at paradisus punta Cana.
Buenas atenciones de:  Eddy Wilson que nos ayudo con el equipaje, Daniela Castillo del Club Meliá con su excelente servicio en la recepción, Antony Cid del gaby club muy servicial, Janna Ortiz, todos hicieron de mis mini vacaciones una maravilla!!!

reviews.author: Flori Wegher
reviews.title: Excepcional foi a nossa estadia
reviews.text: Desde a nossa chegada, minha esposa e eu que fomos recebidos pela Natália e depois pela Luíza, passamos a ter efetivamente um tratamento de rei. A Royal Suite com a sua beleza e conforto teve a administração impecável do nosso Mayordomo Gabriel Dalusma que ao final já era muito mais um amigo, que um funcionário do Hotel. A piscina e praia particulares da Royal Suite, também impecáveis. Os garçons que atendiam a praia e a piscina, não deixavam faltar absolutamente nada com uma eficiência extraordinária. Nosso muito obrigado ao Martin e ao Angel e também ao barmam do sunset bar, Leonardo Mota e todos os funcionários.Os restaurantes de categoria internacional disponibilizados  Honestamente da Royal Suite, lindíssimos e eficientes. O restaurente Buffet, quase 24 hs servindo maravilhas. Devo confessar que foi o melhor hotel em que já me hospedei, incluindo alguns da Europa onde ja tive a oportunidade de estar. A paisagem é absolutamente maravilhosa. Acho que é um pedaço do paraíso. Formidável. A única imperfeição foi o transfer de volta, que nos levou ao aeroporto. Primeiro, tratava-se de um micro-ônibus com uma carreta reboque onde se colavam as malas,  umas sobre as outras e por isso, alguns objetos se quebraram dentro da mala. Por segundo, o motorista além da velocidade exagerada, não respeitava sinalização na rodovia, passando em faixa dupla..etc.

reviews.author: Renee M
reviews.title: Great Vibe - Perfect Relaxation
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful and memorable week. Met folks parasailing from a different resort who said we were the first folks they met who spoke English. Mostly Americans here! Staff speaks English, Spanish and French. 
ACCOMODATIONS: Gorgeous. Immaculately kept, inside and out, by beautiful, attentive and capable people. The design and placement of architect Alvaro Sans Canada's buildings to the beach could not be better - there is a constant breeze cutting the humidity and all buildings have an atrium open to the sky. The variety of food is very satisfying and the fruit is better than we get in the States.  Other adjoining Paradisus resorts are lovely, perhaps more intimate, but this one seems to be everyone's favorite! Pools are amazing - no chlorine odor - immaculate. STAFF: The hospitality rivals Disney. Shared the first half of our week with 3 older family members who managed to flood their bathroom, spill a whole bottle of water on the bed and lose their room keys - they were taken care of each time quickly and kindly. Our concierge Deybi Garcia struck that perfect balance of professionalism and brotherly kindness, finding and watching out for our best interest. 
ACTIVITIES: Activity directors "Big Mac" and "Ray-Ray" are the best of the Caribbean (see our video)!  We were taught tango by professionals Leo, Jaz and Angel - all gracious and patient - The resident dance troupe, musicians and DJs put on a wonderful variety of shows each night - and the size of the resort provided for all our moods, fast or slow, loud or quiet.  Joachim Reyes, Rachel and her dance partner are not to be missed. The night life here is intoxicating even before you hit the bars (see our pics) but the best part is the variety of ways to enjoy the ocean - both in and out of the water.  
EXPERIENCE: By the second day we were so relaxed we never took advantage of the free 30-minute massage for which we qualified. Parasailed, 2-hour snorkel excursion, took free transport to a lovely, classy mall, all directed through the resort.  The only other outside vendor we encountered was a man with fresh coconuts walking the beach who would cut them open for you and give you a straw - but it was free (maybe that's why he's the only one allowed to walk past the resort).  Safe, relaxing, happy place, adult fun. So glad to have met so many others from the States, and the Dominicans we met are all beautiful people. Great vibe. We will be back every year. 
CONS: None related to the resort - the photographers on our excursions - no obligation to buy the pictures they take, but if you decide to buy, get them before you leave the excursion because the photographer won't be allowed into the resort to deliver them!  And yes, you can haggle for a better price.

reviews.author: R0ckSalt
reviews.title: Awesome Facility. Awesome Food. Awesome beach
reviews.text:
There are a lot of reviews on this hotel, so I don't necessarily need to repeat everything.  We stayed at the Reserve section, which is sort of for families and has the advantage of offering "Famiy Concierge" service. The concierge service was useful in getting dinner reservations, etc.  It's a trek down to the beach, and the golf cart trollies are somewhat sporadic, but if you don't mind the walk then it's not bad really.  It's more just the issue of having to carry your stuff for a day at the beach.

We thought the Vento restaurant was the best, although others have preferred the Grill and Bana.  Personally I thought the food at Bana was mediocre.  However, overall the quality of the food in all of the restaurants was outstanding. Well above my expectations for what you can get in an an all-inclusive deal. The buffets were of excellent quality and don't require reservations.  I really give the food a 10 out of 10, even if you never go to one of the places that needs a reservation.  And all the bars are free as well, and they don't just pour the cheap stuff.  I was really quite amazed. 

I handed out a generous amount of tips in $2,  $3, $5, $10 and $20 increments.  If you are inclined to do so, I'd bring about a hundred bucks in $1s with you because other wise you are constantly having to go t the front desk to ask for change.  Personally I thought the service was almost unilaterally outstanding, and while nobody is fishing for tips, they certainly welcome them and you can tell that that is part of the system.  I have to say that I was very pleased to hand out so many tips to so many people that looked after us.

The facilities are incredible. The beach is incredible. The weather is incredible. The water is incredible (some days more surf than others.  Never dangerous for an adult. For kids under 10, I'd stay close to them if the surf is heavy in case they get bowled over.) The food was awesome. The service was excellent.

We had one incident which was a slight negative. My daughter stepped on something in the pool and cut her foot. I took her out of the pool and she was bleeding enough that you needed a towel to apply pressure to stop the bleeding.  We went to the clinic (doctor on duty 24h) and they sanitized the cut. Did not require stitches, thank God.  Bandaged her up and she was fine.
