Theoretically I was supposed to have to pay for it but the doctor insisted thatthe hotel pay for it since in her view it was caused by thehotel.

I attempted to show three different staff where in the pool she had been when she got cut so that someone could go in and figure out what was down there to prevent further injury.  That's where I was slightly frustrated because I wasnt getting hte sense that anyone was that worried about finding the source.  By the time we had sorted out bandaging etc it was close to our dinner reservation, otherwise I would have gone back to the pool with my goggles to figure it out. As it was, I tried to find the issue while we were waiting for the staff to come to take us to the clinic, but I didn't find the offending item in the time I had.  Could have been a sharp rock?  Maybe glass, although as you would expect, there is no glass in use anywhere near any of the pools, for this very reason.  In the end, it was not a major issue, and thankfully it happened on the last day so it didn't keep my daughter out of the water.  Anyway, it happened, but I'd still go back in a nanosecond, and I would still say that the place is extraordinarily well maintained, safe, fun, and awesome.

I would definitely go again and would send my friends there as well.  

When they tried (twice) to sell me their time-share concept, I shut it down instantly since I was not interested.  It's part of their business model - and they are going to try, but you don't have to subject yourself to it if you don't want to.

reviews.author: Allgold S
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text:
This was just the vacation we needed! Pure relaxation for our seven night stay. Our personal concierge Juan de Leon met and surpassed all our needs. He was quick to assist in any and every need as they arose. He was a critical part of our enjoyment or our vacation. Not having to worry about booking the restaurants was a huge plus as well as his knowledge of the area and advise about amenities. 

Leonardo Mota and Fransico Cabrera at the royal service bar were always quick to greet us with a smile and served us our drinks promptly. Martin Tineo was also a great asset in terms of assisting in booking a cabana on the beach. 

Great trip all around. The beach was stunning and the resort was top notch.

reviews.author: awildarandy
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Estas vacaciones son muy espectacular sobre todo por las atenciones de los chicos: Rosmery de jesus .club melia, Daniela Castillo del Club Melia , Eddy Wilson ,Hazael Reyes , Ambioris Mesa con estos chicos estodo una amabilidad muchas gracias por todo

reviews.author: Nancy P
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation from start to finish!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palm Real, Bavaro Beach, was a wonderful experience for my husband and me, our teenage daughter, and her friend! We booked the hotel as a jetBlue package and found the entire trip to be a smooth and relaxing week. From the original e-mail contacts with the hotel customer service (Mr. Gil) to arrange airport transfers, to the recommended OTIUM airport transfers company, to our champagne greeting and insightful no-charge upgrade, to every staff member with whom we interacted, we found the Paradisus Palma Real to be outstanding. The resort's cleanliness, food and restaurant service, beach and pool experiences, beautiful grounds, sense of safety, and overall entertainment were excellent. The entertainment staff work tirelessly to create fun classes, lead exercise opportunities, and present unique evening entertainment--thank you, Big Mac. We sailed each day, went snorkeling, learned some bar-tending and dancing skills, took Zumba and water spinning, and our girls got to parasail. There was also plenty of beach reading and sun soaking.
We would especially like to thank our concierge, Kenia Lina, for her pleasant attentiveness to every detail of our stay!! She made our dinner reservations each day at our requested time and restaurant, made sure we had front-row beach lounges in both sun and shade every day, surprised us with daily treats in our rooms, treated our girls with afternoon tea, brought my daughter by golf cart to the medical clinic when she stepped on a small piece of glass in the ocean, confirmed our return airport transfers, found us a few times each day to see if we needed anything, and always greeted us with a warm and bubbly smile! She was an available and subtle presence from our first day right through check-out and saying good-bye. We will certainly ask for Kenia to assist us when we return! Thank you to the entire Palma Real team for your hard work that produces a fantastic vacation spot.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.title: Quite simply the best
reviews.text:
The best all inclusive holiday resort I have ever stayed at - by far.  I was with my wife plus our son, his wife and two little ones - a boy of 2 and a half and a girl of only 7 months.  Everything was absolutely top quality with the resort itself being maintained to the highest possible standards.
The service both in the Reserve and in the main resort was impeccable with a special mention going to a waitress in the Gabi buffet restaurant by the name of Louisa Rucci.  She was always happy and happy to serve and has a wonderful way with the children - really somebody quite special.

reviews.author: Sharon_510
reviews.title: Babymoon
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Reserve from April 19-23rd and it was a lovely stay.
We booked our trip from Travelocity and we had the one bedroom Master Suite.
From reading the reviews, I was aware that there are no elevators around the building so I called few days ahead to request for 1st floor room since I'm Pregnant and it will be challenge for me to carry my luggage. They accommodated it and was given room 1438.

The resort is ginormous since it shares it with The Paradisus resort. The Reserve is the front side of the resort so You will need to take a trolley to go to the beach or any other restaurants by the beach. There is no problem with the trolley as it comes every 10 mins or less. We decided to rent a bike (free!) for 3 days and bike around early in the morning. No bikes by 7pm since it's dark by then.

The service is impeccable! We got our own concierge, Mindy. She booked our restaurant reservation for our Anniversary and had our room set up for the night. She was attentive but not too pushy . Everything when we see her, she ask if we need anything. Almost all of the employees are super helpful!

We ate at the Gabi Beach for dinner and lunch . Dinner they served grill lobster . Eat all you can! It's so good and fresh. We also ate at Naos which is located next to Gabi beach. Take the Trolley and just tell the driver to drop you off to either restaurant. Love all the food.  We ate at one sit down dinner. Vento and we loved the food! So full!  I have one minor complain on the Gabi beach , there was one night that I was picking on the lobster that is well done because I'm PREGNANT and cannot eat raw food. I think the cook felt offended and threw the one lobster I didn't take. I wasn't being picky, just my situation . He seem displeased. I don't think he heard or understand when I said "sorry I'm pregnant and need a well done lobster".  I should have asked our server to get it for me so she could have told him about my situation. Oh well.
You can ask for to go box if you like to bring some food to the beach. 
Just ask the Ladies at the front of the restaurants .

Bring $20 cash for deposit if you want to rent boogie board . It will be returned to you after 2 hours of rental.
There is a special beach area for The reserve area but gets full pretty fast so try to reserve early.

There was  a beach party and was fun on a Tuesday night and some vendors by the Gabi beach restaurant Wednesday night. They have shows almost every night.

There is also a gym area and I took a spinning class. The workout room is big. 

Airport visa fee is $10. Bring cash!

Love our stay and my husband was so pleased that we are planning to return back.

reviews.author: lincoln m
reviews.title: perfect
reviews.text: This hotel is very nice , all very well kept, the food delicious, the service very good , I liked the pool and restaurants especially the buffet .. also I loved the room service , very friendly FERNANDO GERONIMO...

reviews.author: Terry H
reviews.title: Zifenriching Activities
reviews.text: Best vacation ever!...With the help of Big Macdonna - Rey Rey & Minmi. The room, food, buffet, service was great! People were so friendly and helpful. Would definitely go back again. The resort is absolutely beautiful the pool and the beach.

reviews.author: elkhan73
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
My room was huge and superb
I had enormous balcony and jacuzzi and my own cabana for sun tan...................................
I enjoyed my time and will definitely be back to this resort again no doubt

reviews.author: Victor C
reviews.title: Ótimas férias

reviews.author: BoookwormBob
reviews.title: Entertainers
reviews.text: Big Mac brings the party everyday. Lots of charisma, whether it's playing volleyball or teaching Zumba. Minimi is an awesome dancer and is always looking to entertain and flirt with the French girls. Rey Rey and Angel are really fun too.

reviews.author: keri2579
reviews.title: Amazing Convention!
reviews.text: The Paradisus is the perfect name for this resort!  It was absolute paradise!  Just walking into the resort takes your breath away.  The nightlife was fun, the food was amazing and the staff were outstanding.  Big-Mac, Mini-Me & Rey-Rey were always engaging and fun!  They made our experience a memorable one!  We are sure to visit again in the future!!

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: AWESEOME RESORT TO STAY AT WHEN IN PUNTA CANA
reviews.text: By far the best & classiest resort we have ever stayed out. The food was great, the grounds were immaculate, the entire staff were courteous & attentive! BIG thanks to Oscar Palanco & Rudelania Rincon

reviews.author: rosario m
reviews.title: un paraiso
reviews.text: me encanto la comida, las playas, las piscina, todos los restaurantes son hermosisimo principalmente su marabilloso buffet que te dan un servicio de marabilla, la gran atencion que te dan en general todo muy bonito.. me encanto el servicio de room service siempre despues de la piscina ordenabanos a la habitacion y todo llegaba super rapido FERNANDO GERONIMO se encargaba de que todo llegara perfecto.

reviews.author: jon s
reviews.title: Great Property Great Staff
reviews.text: My wife and I spent seven wonderful days in the luxury of Royal Service in your resort. A rating of overall experience would be excellent, great rooms, pristine beaches, better food than expected for all inclusive, good bars and bartenders and super staff especially Angel at the Blue Agave.  But the Star of the show is without a doubt Nicolas, our butler. Your management should be aware of his value and any future guest that might read this should request his services!!!

reviews.author: Gmb0311
reviews.title: Go here.
reviews.text: Booked through RCI. Excellent staff. Excellent facilities. Stayed for a full week, loved every minute. Plenty of activities everyday from Aqua spinning to wine tasting. Food is great too, book dinner reservations for the whole week! Make sure to say hi to Big Mac, Angel, Minime, RayRay, Jazz, the best pool bartenders - Luis and Antonio! Can't wait to come back next year.

reviews.author: Sara O
reviews.title: Lua-de-mel perfeita!!
reviews.text:
Meu marido e eu escolhemos Punta Cana para passar nossa lua-de-mel e não temos nenhum arrependimento na escolha do hotel.
O hotel é simplesmente perfeito. Tudo muito limpo, organizado, espaçoso e luxuoso.
Todos os funcionários são excelentes, solícitos, sorridentes e educados.
Os restaurantes também são ótimos, tudo muito bem servido e uma comida muito boa. É claro que cada um tem sua preferência, mas para nós, os dois melhores foram o jantar no asiático em que comemos um Teppan, e sem sombra de dúvidas o Palazzo (exclusivo do Royal Service). O Gabi Beach também é ótimo!

Outra vantagem do hotel é o shopping que fica aos fundos. O próprio hotel nos leva e nos busca no shopping com um carrinho tipo de golf. Também há um supermercado ao lado.

Para aqueles que estão em dúvida quanto ao Royal Service, eu posso dizer o seguinte: se você optar por não pagar por ele, a sua estadia continuará sendo ótima e inesquecível. Porém, no Royal Service nós temos certas exclusividades, como por exemplo: piscina privativa, área privativa na praia, com cadeiras extremamente confortáveis, um mordomo à disposição (não é essencial, mas é uma delícia. - o nosso foi o Fermin), mas acredito que o essencial são os check in e out diferenciados, no qual não perdemos tempo algum e o restaurante Palazzo, que sem sombra de dúvidas é o melhor de todos.
Enfim...  principalmente para uma lua-de-mel, eu acredito que valha a pena o investimento.

reviews.author: Neetu T
reviews.title: Paradisus is truly paradise
reviews.text: we had an amazing vacation with another family.  Our kids loved the pool, kid zone activities, and endless eating options.  By far, Fuego's was amazing.  Juan (head of food services) went out of his way to ensure we were Happy!  Franklin De la rosa, Johnathan were especially helpful and service oriented.  The resort is spectacular.  The oriental garden spa felt like I was taken away to bliss.  It was so calming and refreshing.  We loved our vacation and would recommend this place to those wanting a top notch experience.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: Great Service Beautiful property
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 5 days and 4 nights at the resort in mid-April.  We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel.  We had a great overall experience.  The property is stunning and the service outstanding.

The quality of the food was a real surprise. I expected average food considering it is an all-inclusive but the food was excellent.  I recommend the buffet which was very good each time we ate there.

The service across the board was excellent.  We received truly exceptional service from Marino Payans, bartender at the Palazzo bar.  Each night we tried a different restaurant but we would stop by the Palazzo bar to talk with Marino. He was very personable and went out of his way to focus on us while we were at the bar.  

Our butler Alvaro was also very helpful. He made our dinner reservations each evening and put special items in our room each night.

I recommend that you skip the sales presentation that they will try to make. Just say no before is starts.  

Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Wendy232014
reviews.title: Loving the Royal service treatment.
reviews.text: Great resort.  Well laid out and not too big and sprawling (we had heard the HardRock was too open and spread out), with tons of staff ready to help.  We have gone to the DR in the past (the Excellence) and thought this resort was better plus the Paradisus' location is a closer ride from the airport and the beach is way nicer.  We got the Royal Service.  If you can swing it, I would say it's worth the extra cost.  Your own private pool, beach, restaurant, upgraded lounges, and bar.  You also get your own Butler.  Ours was Nicolas and if you can request one I would say he is a great choice.  He spent several years in the US and his english is excellent, which of course makes things easier if you don't speak Spanish. He attends to your every need.  Our beach attendant Francisco Cabrera is also a good guy to get to know as he can reserve you lounges and brings drinks all day long!.  The food in the Royal service restaurant is definitely better than the buffet restaurant, but it's was nice to have a choice.  I'd say the best place to eat that we tried was the Fuego.  If you do get the Royal Service then ask Nelson the bartender at the private outdoor bar to make you a "special".  Very tasty.  He also makes a mean Caipirinha.

reviews.author: Mayra M
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text:
The Reserve is considered the exclusive section to Paradisus Punta Cana. Studios & one bedroom suites. It's own pool area, w/ swim up bar. You have access to all the restaurants in Paradisus resort, but not everyone has access to the restaurants inside the Reserve. Great buffett style restaurant Gabi, Hydro grill by the pool is great to catch a quick something by the pool. Great pizzas, hamburgers & fries. Vento, is super delish for a fancier dinner. 
One & only downside is the location, it is the furthest from the beach. Trolleys are always running thru the resort & it is 5-10 minutes to get to & from beach front. Fun live or DJ'd music in the main lobby everynight, with a bar open for drinks. You will find lovely little cabanas beds under shady chiqui huts. Ask before you lay in one, to have it smoked out for mosquitos & bugs.
We had a one night adults only, so we requested an on site babysitter. She was great w/ our 4 yrs old who was giving us a lil hard time leaving. She colored & played board games w/ them. Was very well worth it, as she was able to stay til 1 am & give us amble time out. 
The hibachi style restaurant books up really quick, so make sure to make reservations as soon as you arrive.
All in all it is a great place & great value for you're $.

reviews.author: Carla S
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus Palma Real for my daughter's wedding. Beautiful resort, large nice rooms, very clean property and beaches and the service and friendliness of the staff was wonderful. Nicolas was the very best butler we have ever had anywhere.  He made our stay stress free, relaxing and everything easy.  We enjoyed visiting with him and could not have ask for any better service.  Nicolas was amazing!

reviews.author: Jjjjjjjtttttttttt
reviews.title: Mrs was
reviews.text:
Great service. Very clean. Martin Hineo treated us so well. He saved us a spot on the beach everyday, brought us extra towels & always had drinks for us. He was a very kind & friendly man. Thanks Martin. 

Our butler, Niclaus was excellent. He helped us with everything we needed. He had nice surprises in our room every night. He went above & beyond to make our trip great & relaxing. 

I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: RON B
reviews.title: PERFECT!!!
reviews.text: Far and away the best vacation ever!!!! Rosa, Alex, Luis were absolutely phenomenal!!!!! I will be back every year! Very peaceful and beautiful all the way around. Hated to leave!! Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Daniele P
reviews.title: PERFEITO
reviews.text: Tudo perfeito!!! limpeza, atendimento, alimentação, diversão, bebidas!!! As piscinas são perfeitas, os bares oferecem bebidas de ótima qualidade, nada comparado com os resorts all inclusive do Brasil!!! Espero voltar em breve!!!

reviews.author: biamarti91
reviews.title: Perfect stay!
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was simply perfect. The location is wonderful and the beach/pools are even better. The staff is super helpful, always with a smile on their faces. 

The hotel offers a structure with a lot of activities and you can be active all day. The entertaining crew is an atraction itself. Minimi, Big Mac and Jazz are a high point at the stay, always trying to keep you distracted. There are dance classes everyday and I fully recomend the acqua spinning as well. Thank you, Paradisus and entertaining crew, for making us feel at home.

Queremos volver lo mas rapido posible!

reviews.author: airtrack
reviews.title: Good, not great.. 3.5 circles really
reviews.text:
We visited as family of 4, kids aged 11 and 7 for 11 nights during April (Easter) and stayed in a 1 bed master suite with family concierge.

checkin was more long winded than it needed to be and, disappointingly they tried to get us to sign up to attend the time share (holiday club) presentation at that point. after a 9 hour flight when we are tired etc , DONT do this.. it spoils the start of the holiday and the start of the holiday is the wrong time to do it as we haven't even seen the place! We refused and the demeanor of the guy checking us in changed immediately... shame but i guess they are targeted/commissioned on signing people up?

The first night our kids slept on the double sofa bed which was wholly unsuitable for any kids over the age of 7. We asked 3 times the following day for an extra bed which we were promised but it didnt arrive until 8.30pm after numerous phone calls to chase it up. We then, having been asleep for some time were telephoned at 11.15pm asking if we had received the extra bed!!!!  If that wasnt bad enough we were then telephoned at 8.15 am by the "Hotelbeds" rep to who the transfers were booked with via the Melia website asking why we hadn't come to see them the day before to sort the return transfer. When I said we were not advised to do this but I could do it on the phone now, they refused as they only wanted to sell us excursions.
I complained to the head concierge Mildred about this and she was helpful in sorting transfers with a different company for us. The point being though is they are aware this goes on and its not good so they shouldnt be promoting this company! Our transfers were free of charge as they were included when we booked but to be honest i wish i'd paid the $35 and taken a taxi so save the hassle

Not the best start to the holiday...

anyway..

The 1 bed master suite is large and comfortable except the sofa bed but disappointingly has an adjoining internal door to the room next door which isn't well soundproofed so if you have noisy neighbours beware!

Also, there is no lock on the door so with a keycard you can just get in even if you have twisted the latch on the inside and staff sometimes came in without even knocking. We also has a keycard that stopped working so went to reception for a replacement and they only asked our room number, not our name or any I.D meaning we could have got a card for any room! We ended up putting a chair against the door handle at night to stop anyone just walking in..... Beware!

Room servicing was hit and miss as to whether you got enough towels or face cloths etc and our patio wasn't swept once in 11 days..

The vast majority of the food was very good indeed with the Italian restaurant the only one we classed as average. The Grill restaurant was our favourite with great food and Juan P was such a nice cheerful waiter who made our visit!

The kids club had lovely staff and a great facility but neither of our kids really liked it as it was geared towards small children and the activities didnt suit our kids ages (11&7).

We paid extra for the family concierge but apart from reserving our restaurants and cabana, Im not sure what else we really got. We never received the mobile phone advertised for contacting the concierge either? 
My personal recommendation would be to save the money and do without the family concierge as its an expensive option that didn't get us much.

The hotel itself is set in lovely grounds and the buildings and grounds are very nice and well maintained. Yes its a 5-10 min walk to the beach but its a pleasant one.

The gym is good and the staff there are nice and helpful with some enjoyable classes. They do need to get a lot of their spin class bikes fixed though.

All in all we had a good holiday but it wasn't as relaxing as we had hoped. The hotel doesn't have the Caribbean feel you get in say Barbados or Antigua for instance and they let themselves down with dodgy sales practices with the timeshare and the affiliation with companies ringing and hassling you. Had this been a lower class of hotel at a cheaper price then fair enough but it isnt and therefore they need to look at these issues. Reading the reviews the manager only responds to those that give 5 circles and great reviews which is the wrong thing to do. They need accept the points raised by previous reviewers and sort them out as there is a common theme. Its free feedback..be thankful for it.

reviews.author: Terry C
reviews.title: GREAT PEOPLE
reviews.text: beautiful water ,excellent resort and plenty of activities to keep every one busy. you have to take a bus to go zip lining in the mountains it's a blast. and take a cultural tour through the country side.  you will love seeing how the people live.great food and plenty of rum for all.

reviews.author: SKLTW
reviews.title: Five star grounds and lodging -- but overrated food, staff and service
reviews.text:
Overall, this was a nice place to stay. Many people have already pointed out the high points of staying here -- private beach, spacious/updated/modern rooms, stunning well-maintained grounds, proximity to airport. There are many nice touches. Our first day we were greeted with sparkling wine and chocolates (yum). Also, rooms are very clean and well-stocked with towels/bathrobes/slippers. That said, we will point out a few of downsides just so that travelers can come prepared.

First, staff is a little pushy about their agenda to recruit "Club Melia" members. At first, we were flattered by what appeared to be attentive staff (asking about where we were from, our interests, joking freely), however, within minutes the conversation turned to highlights of joining Club Melia. Staff even asked to join our lunch table to discuss this in detail -- awkward! Our repeated attempts to end these conversations politely were unsuccessful. Unfortunately a direct approach worked best. Avoid eye contact with staff members wearing white outfits with blue sashes around the waist -- those are the recruiters!

The beach was beautiful with ample cabanas/huts, but don't expect a front and center ocean-view unless you pay for the "Family Concierge" upgrade. The first three rows of cabanas/huts are reserved for those guests and Club Melia members to claim until 10am. After 10 am they open these seats to other Reserve guests, but an opening in these sections is rare. This was unfortunate because we had already paid extra for the "perks" of staying in the Reserve suites with private beach access. If you do not plan to join Club Melia or pay for the Family Concierge service, consider staying at the main part of the resort or just using their portion of the beach -- seating there is first come/first serve!

Staff also dropped the ball with our dinner reservations. Restaurants other than buffets require reservations. Concierge staff asks that you provide a list of preferred dinner restaurants/dining times and then leaves confirmed reservations under your room door the following afternoon. We put in our requests right away, but did not receive confirmation the following day. We asked three times (separate staff members) about this and were ultimately assured that reservations were made and provided "confirmation." Upon arriving at two of the three restaurants, there was no confirmation and we were kept waiting/almost turned away. This was disappointing.

Regarding dining options, the buffets had a wide variety of food -- you can probably find something you will enjoy. The food was a little bland, but that may be intentional to satisfy mass consumption preferences. Most restaurants (Mole, The Grill, Vento) served food very similar to food available at the buffet. That said, the ambience at all restaurants was impressive. Staff there was courteous and attentive. The best food was at El Fuego -- unique and of higher quality. Overall the food wasn't bad for a busy, high-volume, all-inclusive resort.

One minor annoyance is that there is no dedicated foot path connecting the Reserve suites to the beach. You must walk along the road dodging service vehicles. A little scary at times.

Overall this resort has so much potential -- amazing scenery, excellent location, beautiful rooms. Maybe with a few changes this could be a five-star resort.

reviews.author: Mariana V
reviews.title: Falta de comunicação
reviews.text: Havíamos reservado o hotel do dia 17 a 21/04, no entanto chegaríamos apenas no dia 18 às 7hs da manhã. Entramos em contato com antecedência com o Hotel para avisar do late check in e pagamos a diária do dia 17. Ao chegarmos ao hotel, haviam dado NO SHOW e não havia quarto disponível! Ficamos até as 15hs aguardando um quarto disponibilizar. Então sabendo que chegaríamos tarde e que já havíamos pago a diária do quarto, passaram para outros hospedes. Na verdade nós perdemos uma diária por essa falta de cuidado e comunicação entre os funcionários que não cumpriram o que haviam acordado via email conosco. Além disso, nesse período de espera de quarto não nos deram as pulseiras de acesso e fomos destratados pelos funcionários que não tinham como saber que eramos hóspedes. Considerando que ficamos apenas 3 noites, isso estragou 1/3 da nossa viagem. O Hotel é excelente, instalações e alimentação. Mas esse descuido é inaceitável pelo preço que pagamos em cada diária.

reviews.author: Estelle S
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Vacation
reviews.text: Went to this resort for a friend's wedding.  Beautiful resort, nice rooms.  Had a great time.  The service at the hotel is great.  I forgot an item after i checked out and guest services did a great job finding the item for me and making sure I could get it back.  I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: altheaw2015
reviews.title: Quiet Surprise
reviews.text: After taking the trip of a lifetime to Seychelles to celebrate our 20th Wedding anniversary in February 2015, my husband and I decided to go to the Dominican Republic April 11 -18th as we had time off.  We had previously been to the Dominican before and it was not memorable.  Upon checking into the hotel on April 11th by Ana Almonte we received excellent service, as our room was not ready she recommended Fuego for lunch we were greeted by the friendly hostess Ana Domingo, we enjoyed our meal immensely. After lunch we stopped by Gabi beach bar for a drink where we were given a warm Dominican welcome from our bartender Jeimy Reyes Cabrera who made us a special welcome drink which was very enjoyable. This was our introduction to the excellent service we were about to receive from the Palma Real for the rest of the week. Everywhere we dined or had a drink the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. Rosa Abreu & Starky at the lounge had us laughing and sharing stories as if we had known them for years, they were extremely engaging. Also Kimberley & Alexis the Chef  at Olio Restaurant treated us to a culinary delight.  As for Gabi Club the food was fantastic as well the service from Angella .  My husband had not eaten fried rice in 30 years, however the chef at Mizu has converted him.  We will be returning very soon with our 3 grandkids to enjoy the wonderful service and amenities.  Last but not least thanks to Juana and Claury at family concierge who gave us an excellent tour of the suites.

reviews.author: Alayna790
reviews.title: Highly recommend!!
reviews.text: Amazing time at the paradisus palma real in punta cana! Hughly recommend staying at the main hotel vs reserve which is further from beach, and upgrading to family concierge which was a huge help with dinner reservations etc! Both Kenya and Luis Sanchez (royal service) were extremely friendly and helpful! Kenya had the best energy about her and Luis was very attentive. Loved the activities the resort had going on especially the shows, zumba, and pool party! BIG MAC was one of the highlights of the trip and the resort! He was so entertaining in each role he plays at the paradisus from water spin class, zumba, etc. His fun spirit was contagious and brought everyones mood up around him! The last major thing I would say about this resort was the food! I ate from the buffet often and we all loved it! Every dinner we went to was VERY good! Especially Rare steak house and Fuego latin fusion...the hibachi was great too! Noone in our party of 6 ever got sick which I know is often a concern for people travleing and being nervous about what they eat/drink. Great trip and look forward to booking paradisus palma real in playa del carmen this fall!!!

reviews.author: 2013kdg
reviews.title: Fantastic service (except for the check-in)
reviews.text:
I would rate Paradisus Palma Real five stars, except we had a truly miserable experience when we checked in.  We had paid for Royal Service and were promised an oceanfront room.  When we checked in, the front desk clerk Johan Fabian, informed us that the Royal Service rooms were full, that we had not paid for the upgrade for Royal Service, that no one ever promised us an oceanfront room, and basically that we would have to just take whatever he gave us.  

What made this particularly upsetting and stressful was Johan's complete arrogance and indifference towards our situation.  Never once did he apologize or even pretend that he cared one bit.  When we asked to speak to his manager, he said it wouldn't help, the manager would tell us the same thing, and he intimated that we were just making up everything we told him.

After finally going to the business center and printing out several emails, I was able to prove that we had indeed been promised an oceanfront room and that our credit card had been charged for the Royal Service upgrade.  Only then did his attitude and tone change just slightly, and he begrudgingly involved his manager.  The manager came out and apologized and put us in an absolutely spectacular, oceanfront room, although it wasn't in the Royal Service area. 

Johan's contemptuous attitude is evidently legendary because we talked to other people in the resort about him ~ they had had similar unpleasant experiences with him.  When we checked out a week later and were waiting in the lobby for our luggage, we saw him mistreat several other people who walked away from the counter, shaking their heads and calling him names under their breath.  I can't imagine why he is still allowed to work there ~ must have a relative in high places.

Other than that truly awful beginning (really, it ranked right up there with the worst customer experience we've ever had), we had a fabulous time.  Our butler Nicolas Maracallo was fantastic.  He made dinner reservations for us every day, reserved a palapa bed and sun bed by the Royal Service pool every day, left us special treats in our room every day (cheese or fruit platters, special wine, the Jacuzzi on the balcony filled with bubbles and sweet messages spelled out in flower petals.)  He was charming and helpful, and we will ask for him again next time we visit.

We also want to thank Carlos Rosario for his kind attention to us throughout our stay.  He made sure we were comfortable by the pool and on the beach, and delivered a steady stream of great drinks that he made himself at the bar.  

We ate several times at the Palazzo Restaurant which is for Royal Service guests only and had great service from one of the waiters, Felipe.

The food was great at all the different restaurants, the nightly entertainment was fun, the beach is soft, clean white sand, and the resort is stunningly beautiful and clean.  

Other than an awful beginning, it was a perfect, restful vacation, and I would recommend the resort to anyone.  Just don't let Johan check you in :)

reviews.author: FedericoPellicer
reviews.title: Atencion de Lujo
reviews.text: Muy buen resort en Punta Cana. Recomendado el Royal Service. Muy buena gastronimia. Un muy buen destino para descanzar en el caribe. Servicio de playa muy completo. All inclusive de nivel. El centro de la ciudad no tiene mucho para hacer. Solo vida de Hotel

reviews.author: Siebby
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here to celebrate my 30th Birthday and it was awesome! The people were so friendly and welcoming... The room was beautiful and clean... Our concierge Sofia made sure she met all of our needs and extras!! She always had a lil surprise for us when we returned to our room! I've been on plenty vacations but this one has been the best so far.. It was always something to do on the resort, I enjoyed the shows and entertainment as well.. The food was delicious... I would definitely recommend this resort and I will be back!!!

reviews.author: Aimee L
reviews.title: Great experience but underwhelmed by Kid Concierge
reviews.text: Our family of 4 stayed at the resort for Spring Break.  I used trip advisor to select the resort; it received amazing reviews, which are mostly well deserved.  We got off to a rough start at the airport, as the hotel rep there could not find our reservation.  This continued when we arrived at the resort; again they could not find the reservation.  Each time I was shown a list of people coming in that day; everyone on the list booked through a travel agent, whereas we booked through melia.com.  Lesson learned.  They finally found the reservation after I forwarded my confirmation email from my smartphone to one of the reservation agents.  At the time of booking I chose not to select the Kid Concierge, but after reading all of the reviews here I changed my mind.  So when they asked if I wanted an upgrade I enthusiastically said yes.  We spent $100 per day, but received only about half of the amenities.  Our concierge was friendly but unreliable and difficult to find.  In all I would say the Kid Concierge was not worth it (although my girls did love the kid-size hotel slippers, I wouldn't say they were worth $700!).   Aside from those annoyances, the food and service were as fantastic as promised.  Our room was great.

reviews.author: Irene L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - loved our butler
reviews.text: As soon as I walked into the hotel, it took my breath away.  The view was truly spectacular.  The grounds, hotel and pool were immaculate.  We had the Royal Service and our butler, Faustino, was amazing.  He made us feel very important and took fantastic care of us.  Not sure how he did it but he found us several times a day, no matter where we were, and checked on us.  With a resort of this caliber, I feel the only slight negative was the food, and the bathroom set up lacked some privacy.  Steak house could use more and better options.  I was there for 7 days and would come back in a second.  If you are thinking about going here, do it you will not be sorry

reviews.author: Melissa K
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, amazing food, and great service!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a week starting April 9.  The hotel is breathtakingly beautiful, and the rooms were very nice.  We did not opt for the Royal Service option, and still felt that the service was outstanding.  The staff is very friendly, many try to speak english, and even if they don't - they always have a friendly "Hola" to greet you.

We prefer a more casual dining experience, so ate at the Naos buffet for every meal.  The food was truly incredible, there was always something new to try and plenty of healthy and fresh choices.  The choices for dessert were also incredible.  There was one staff member in a chef's hat who seemed to be manning the dessert station every night at dinner service (unfortunately we didn't get his name) and he seemed quite proud of what he was serving - rightfully so.  The little chocolates, pastries, and baked goods were outstanding.  The dining room staff, particularily at the dinner service, was exceptional for this type of restaurant.  I would like to mention Frank Sanchez, Felix, and Dionis - all three of them recognized us from day to day and made sure that we were taken care of.

The drinks were very good, especially the Ultimate Pina Colada at the lobby bar.  Made with real ingredients, not sugary bar mix - it was incredible!  The bar staff was always friendly as well.

There always seemed to be plenty of space at the beach with shade for us fair northerners.  There was drink service at the beach as well, which is nice, and Wifi throughout.  The activities team was regularily walking the beach letting everyone know about upcoming events, "Big Mac" worked tirelessly and enthusiastically to make these events a success.  I joined Jazz's stretching class on the beach a few mornings. She did a lovely job leading it and it was a relaxing start to the day!

The only downside of our visit...  There are some travellers who, as a nation, have a reputation of being loud and obnoxious travellers.  Sadly there were several groups who were showing the world why they are known as loud...  It was very disruptive to an otherwise peaceful day at the beach on several occasions.  This is, of course, no reflection on the resort, but perhaps might be a reminder to be more considerate??

Overall a fantastic vacation, great value for the money, and just as wonderful as the other reviews say!

reviews.author: VRBG
reviews.title: Amazing 4 Day Bachelorette Trip
reviews.text:
My 4 girlfriends and I had the most incredible time here. The resort grounds were amazing -- well maintained, clean, lush and beautiful with greenery. The beach area was serene -- from beach chairs to cabanas to hammocks. The pool/swim up bar was large enough so that it felt exclusive to everyone who was in it -- never overcrowded. The restaurants/buffet were comparable to NYC dining (make your dinner reservations early). The rooms were clean and modern with round the clock housekeeping (we had a 2 bedroom suite). And the Yhi spa at the reserve felt like you were transported to a zen garden -- insanely calm and relaxing. 

But the best part about the entire resort was the friendly, helpful service and staff. Everyone was attentive to our needs, and always had a smile on their face. There was never a time that we didn't feel like we were in good/safe hands.

In regards to nightlife -- it's literally a non-stop party. It starts at 9pm on Gabi Beach, with music and dancing, then moves to the Avenue Bar, then to the casino, then ends at the Jewel Nightclub at 4am.

I have to give a special shoutout to Big Mac, Johan + friends -- aka the hype crew. If you want to party, these are the guys to be around. The bachelorette trip wouldn't have been the same without them!!!

Overall, a 5 star staff in a 5 star resort. The best all-inclusive resort I've ever been to.

P.s. The wifi here is BOMB. We never had a problem finding reception.

reviews.author: Yoger P
reviews.title: Excelente estadia en su hotel
reviews.text: mis vacaciones junto a mi familia no pudieron haber sido mejores, fue una excelente estadia, mi hijos las pasaron excelente, gozaron mucho comieron mucho se divirtieron mucho, ha sido la mejor de lo mejor

reviews.author: Carol M
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
The Royal Treatment is an understatement.  Our butler Luis Sanchez made our stay amazing!  It is just a beautiful resort and the most relaxing vacation we have ever had.  We were with a large company group and they handled the movement and activities for all of us easily.  The restaurants are all very good, so even if you don't have or miss a reservation it's okay!
Thank you Luis!

reviews.author: Luis F. A
reviews.title: n-a
reviews.text: very very good good good...  Excelent services, value, location Quality... It was perfect vacation....   i hope to return soon.  very very good good good...  Excelent services, value, location Quality... It was perfect vacation....   i hope to return soon

reviews.author: BackPacker55898
reviews.title: Wonderful experience !
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort!  Can't wait to return!  Grounds and beach are lovely!  
 Employees are there to please and made our stay absolutely lovely. 
Waiters and waitresses could not do enough to please!  
              Beautiful! Lovely! Excellent!

reviews.author: Alicia F
reviews.title: Our butler Johnfi Rivera
reviews.text: He truly made our stay very welcoming and was nothing but professional and truly was everything I could of asked for.  I will be returning to the hotel with my family in February of 2016 and plan on only wanting Johnfi as our butler again.

reviews.author: thomas k
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: The personnel at the hotel were tremendous, especially our pool attendant Pedro, and bartender Leonardo. The hotel is beautiful and the room was luxurious, however the food was just okay.  Overall, if I go back to Punta Cana, I would stay at the Paradisus Palma Real again.

reviews.author: Alfredo AH
reviews.title: Insuperable... Lo único malo es tener que irse!!!
reviews.text:
Sorprendente alternativa en Punta Cana. No sólo se trata de un hotel muy lujoso sino que difícilmente se puede conseguir un servicio más atento, hay que decirlo, de toda la oferta del hotel, el personal, atento y amigable, es sin dudas lo mejor del hotel.  Todo el personal y las instalaciones son de un nivel optimo. Siempre hay algo que hacer, y la comida, toda, sea en los restaurantes a la carta o en los bufet, es de un alto nivel de calidad. Personalmente he visitado otros hoteles en Punta Cana, pero sin lugar a dudas es el mejor sitio al cual llegar, pues comparativamente tiene una oferta difícilmente superable. Nuestro viaje fue en familia, 11 personas incluyendo a una niña de 4 años, y todo fue perfecto, cada miembro de la familia siempre consiguió alguna actividad o ambiente en el que podía hacer lo que le gustara, y estando juntos no falto donde comer o beber todos. Las piscinas y la playa son sorprendentemente cómodas. Entiendo que es un hotel de lujo, y precisamente ese detalle fue el que más nos agradó, pues viajando con niños hay veces en que esa alternativa de lujo queda excluida porque el ambiente resultara un poco forzado para los niños pequeños, pero en el The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, se consigue un ambiente de muchísimo confort y muy muy amigable, que indudablemente ayuda a relajarse. Diseñado con unas hermosas instalaciones, es una oferta que vale la pena pagar, pues se aprovecha al máximo. El número de restaurantes a la carta y los bufet en los que hay que reservar obliga a tomar una difícil desviación, pues son estupendos todos, personalmente recomiendo el Fuego! El restaurante de comida japonesa y La Palapa.
Lo malo del hotel es tener que irse... Lo recomiendo ampliamente, para comer, beber, descansar, divertirse, y pasar un tiempo tranquilo en un ambiente lujoso y confortable, de alto nivel de atención, si se va en familia aún mejor. Para ir de vacaciones, no lo duden,  The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, es una de las mejores ofertas que ofrece Punta Cana, bello hotel excelente servicio.

reviews.author: Renee T
reviews.title: Fabulous service!
reviews.text: We just returned from 5 days in Punta Cana at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  If I had to pick only one thing to rave about, it would be the amazing Royal Service we experienced.  Our Butler, Faustino Ramos, provided us with every possible amenity and a smile at every turn.  We couldn't have asked for more - he even planned ahead and booked us a private cabana each day without us even asking him to do it!  I also experienced water aerobics with " Big Mac" and "Mini Me" at the pool and marveled at their energy and humor.  They made it fun and got everyone to join in.  The food was out of this world and the bartenders were responsive and personable when mixing up those wonderful frozen concoctions.  We would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: This was our 2nd trip to Punta Cana. Paradisus Palma Real was a great resort. The room was clean and roomy, shower was a little complicated, but everything else was really nice. Food was pretty good, I've found that the food is about the same at all the resorts. The staff was great. I would like to give a special compliment to George Alriche, he is a waiter that works around the pool area, he gave outstanding service!

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: Five Star resort with Five Star Service!
reviews.text:
This place is paradise. We traveled in a large group (18 total) for 9 days to celebrate a friend's birthday. The majority of the group were Royal Service which I highly recommend given all the amazing amenities that come with it. Upon check-in you are taken to the Royal Service lounge for VIP service while they walk you through everything then give you a private tour of the resort. We were exhausted from traveling all day so the check-in process was a bit extensive although a nice perk. 

Across our entire group we had two butlers who went above and beyond every single day to make us feel special and well taken care of. Our trip wouldn't have been the same without Nicholas and Omar, our butlers who did everything from checking in on us multiple times a day at the beach to making dinner reservations for 18 each night. Every day we'd return from the beach or pool to find a special treat in all our rooms personally delivered by our butlers. For our friend's birthday, Nicholas coordinated a private catamaran for our entire group equipped with food, beverages and a crew who took great care of us. Nicholas and Omar took the time to get to know us all and truly understand how to make the experience the best it could be.

Every day at the beach we were treated like kings and queens all thanks to Francisco Gil, our waiter. He had our "spot" prepared for us each day with beds and chairs and made sure we were never without beverages. We were in awe by the impeccable service he provided and also incredibly grateful. 

Each evening our group met for cocktails at Gabi Beach Bar before dinner. A beautiful ocean view with live music on most nights. We had outstanding service from Rosa, who became a friend to all of us. 

I can't recommend this resort more. Five star service surrounded by five star views. We will definitely be back (soon I hope). Nicholas and Omar definitely made sure our friend's birthday was one she will never forget!

reviews.author: Tee J
reviews.title: NO DOMINICAN FOOD?!?!
reviews.text:
Traveled for birthday celebration April 2015
AIRPORT 
1- no signage or direction and a Spanish speaking country
2- you have to pay $10 when entering airport for "tourist card"! No ID required and you only get a receipt...no card...I guess that's the government hustle.
3- "helpers" are swarming luggage area to help you get to transportation area...which is just around the corner...another hustle
THE RESORT 
1- beautiful property. Opt for VIP service with butler. I am sure it's great bu I never called him..LOL!
2- I assumed the staff was African American, like me, carrying on a full conversation and realized they mostly speak Spanish..LMAO! Hey...my bad! The staff was amazing, greeting you throughout the day.
3-  I stayed inThe Reserve #40. It's near main lobby, but far from beach. Had to take ride from shuttle, which can take 30 mins...boooooo!
4- none of the restaurant serve Dominican food...which is strange!!! Mole is a Mexican restaurant that is not great., very commercial...small portion ... A tablespoon of beans and the same fried rice you get at the buffet. Guacamole is watery, chips are red/ green...no Bueno. The buffets were just OK, served the same food 4 days...desserts were not great. Fresh juice and fruit good.
5- bars were good, no la king of liquor. The Mamajuana drink shots can really get you going..
6- there are no inclusive water sports, so you have to pay at the place on the beach
7- to me it seems there would be Dominican music going, but no!. They play remixed versions of American classics and a few Spanish tunes...disappointed me greatly 
8- not much night life on the resort, one club and they seem to only have Pit Bull and Rihanna on rotation. 
9- there are kids who may get whiny, so get ready for that
10- nice resort, quiet and relaxed...wifi can be sketchy 
11- get the Outback tour excursion to see the locals, get some Dominican food and goods
12- the mall is like any other in US..avoid if you want local items
13- for local shopping go to beach and walk to your left and you will find about 3 cool shops with gifts, art, hair braiding, t-shirts and great sundresses. It is next to a black and white beachouse abou a 1/2 mile nice walk!!

reviews.author: T L
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: Our overall experience at Paradisus was a very pleasant one. The property and grounds were really nice and clean.  The staff was exceptionally friendly, especially our butler Luis.  Nice pool and beach areas.  Nightlife and activities were also good!  The food at the resort seemed to be hit or miss (mostly miss unfortunately).  We did have issues with our toilet breaking twice, but maintenance was quick to come and fix it. The wifi was exceptionally reliable.

reviews.author: Jalinna
reviews.title: Great Sister Trip Destination!
reviews.text: I just returned from a 5-day get-away with my two sisters. This resort was a perfect destination for us, because we really just wanted to chill on the beach during the day, eat good food, and play and disco at night. Let me just preface this by saying that we are 3 very opinionated chicks from Texas and we like things the way we like things. This resort did not disappoint, primarily because of the beautiful setting, and expert staff.  Whatever you do, pay a little more for the ROYAL SERVICE. Our butler, Nicolas, was amazing. We had lots of requests that most people would find annoying or difficult, but Nicolas was completely accommodating and charming. From dinner reservations, to getting more towels and toiletries, to leaving us great snacks and cute decorations in our room, he made our stay perfect.  Francisco, our waiter at the private Royal Service beach, was extra wonderful as well.  We loved Franklin and Fatima at the delicious (Royal Service Exclusive) restaurant The Palazzo, Juan at the Avenue Bar, and Francisco, Ronald, Kelvin, and Lydia in the casino. I have been to several all-inclusive resorts and this is one of my favorites. I do think the spa area could be updated, and they need a snack bar on the beach so you can grab some nachos or a burger. A martini bar would be great! The rooms were a little more simple than in other resorts I have stayed at, but overall we had everything we needed. Also, the Royal Service lounge was a little blah. It needed a real bartender, and better snacks, and just a more lively vibe. The beaches are gorgeous, and the pools are as well. The lady from Chicago who wrote the last review was next to us on the beach each day. She and her group were SO FUN and we loved meeting them all. I would definitely go back to this resort again, and really would not change a thing. Paradise at the Paradisius Palma Real, for sure!

reviews.author: Justine H
reviews.title: Amazing and unforgettable experience!
reviews.text:
I have traveled to many destinations around the world and I have to say that this hotel and the experience as a whole was one of my top 3. I went down to Punta Cana to celebrate my 40th birthday with no less then 18 friends (not a quiet and timid group either).  A few of us had the Royal Service and others had one of the different levels of service offered.  We all experienced amazing service from the staff and no one felt treated any worse for not having the Royal Service. 

The grounds of the hotel are gorgeous, the beach is ridiculously clean with even a daily early morning clean up of the seaweed that collects on the shore, the staff is beyond friendly and goes out of their way to make sure you are having a great time, the restaurant selection was nicely varied (although some were better then others), surprisingly, the buffet was excellent, and Avenue Bar, Gabi Beach Bar, the lobby bar and the mini discotheque were fun late night venues for those who aren't ready for bed just yet. The rooms are all very spacious, clean and updated and even if you do not have an ocean front room like I did (amazing view) the other room views my friends had were all really scenic (facing the gardens) and each had their own balconies which are a necessity.  

I have to really commend and applaud Francisco Gil who was our go-to-guy at the Royal Service beach area for the 9 days we were there. He not only had our designated ocean front beach area saved for all of us daily before we even awoke (not easy to do with 18 people) but he always knew when we needed cervesas, pina coladas and even bottles of wine and champagne. He was always in a good mood, smiling and encouraging us to keep having fun. His service was impeccable and one of the main reasons our days spent on the beach were so relaxing, fun and memorable. I knew I never had to worry about whether or not we would have a place to sit on the beach and if everyone would be able to be together. Again, not an easy thing to organize with 18 people. Thank you Francisco! 

The second person who made our trip amazing was our butler Nicolas Maracallo. Dealing with a pretty demanding birthday girl and her "ready to party" friends could not have been easy but he went above and beyond to make sure I worried about nothing. He even sowed my beach hat back together when it broke the first day we arrived. He made all our dinner reservations (again for 18 people) and organized an awesome boat day. On my birthday he surprised me with flowers, a personalized cake, a breakfast champagne toast with a few singing staff members, a hot tub with "Happy Birthday" and my name spelled out in roses and even decorated my door with balloons. Everyone should be able to celebrate their birthday like this! Muchas gracias Nicolas!

Lastly, a thank you to the gorgeous and sweet Rosa at Gabi Beach who took great care of us on multiple nights. You are the best!

The resort and staff exceeded my expectations and I know my friends feel the same way. We are all already planning our next trip back.

The only two complaints we had were that check in took longer then necessary....give us our room already we want to go to the beach!!!!! And that periodically our room keys would not work and we would have to go to the lobby to get new ones. This process was fairly quick but there is nothing more annoying then coming home late at night and not having a key that works and having to trek to the lobby for a new one.  Minor issues but worth mentioning.

Can't wait to go back next year! Thank you for an amazing time.

reviews.author: Jax
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay.  Resort was clean and beautiful.  Staff was extremely friendly and went out of there way to make sure you were enjoying your vacation. Juan and Hector at the beach provided outstanding service as well as Juan Castillo our concierge

reviews.author: John N
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
Just returned from Paradisus Palma Real. Top-notch service and a beautiful location. We had a Royal Service Suite. Adults only, private area of the beach and a pool. Highly recommend the upgrade. Gets you into all of the restaurants and a butler to personally help with reservations and any special requests. We were probably "easy" on our butler, Luis Suarez. We made all of our dinner reservations upon arrival. And only had a couple requests, which were handled right away. Luis would track us down each day to make sure everything was OK. You get a cell phone to keep in contact with him, but we left it in the room too often. Keep it with you!! The Royal Service beach is wonderful. Francisco G. had our beach area set up each morning. Would deliver waters right away and drinks all day. His service is impeccable, and he's always smiling. Francisco alone is reason enough to get the Royal Service upgrade!!. Also want to mention Carolina Franco at the Naos breakfast buffet each morning. The sweetest girl you'll ever meet!! Always smiling and greeted us each morning. She'd check on how dinner was the previous evening and how our stay was going. A pleasure each day. Make sure you keep her!!
Just one small negative. There's a bit of a language barrier in some of the restaurants. The waiters should speak better English in that position. However, this was a very minor issue. The food is wonderful. Highly recommend Fuego, Palazzo (Royal Service only), and Vento. The drinks are awesome, all top-shelf liquor, including in your room. Secret, if the beach bar is crowded, walk up to the Lobby Bar. Never crowded, top-notch drinks. A little warm up there in the evening, but still worth it. Overall, we loved our visit and can't wait to return.

reviews.author: mark2try
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Me encanto el gran servicio que me dieron en room service todo de maravilla incluyendo el personal que me dio servicio..me encanto el servicio de fernando geronimo sobrepaso mis expectativas en cálidad y amabilidad muchas gracias por tu gran servicio..!!

reviews.author: Monica M
reviews.title: Lower your expectations and you will only be slightly disappointed
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is a nice looking resort with a beautiful beach, but has very poor service and mostly mediocre food and experiences.  We went with a group of 11 (3 families with children 11-14)

Before you go:  Don’t bother calling as they will most likely hang up on you or leave you on hold for a long time (this was not only our experience but I spoke to others at the resort).  Making reservations ahead of time does not work as we sent them a month before and none of them were made.  The only thing that was complete ahead of time was an airport pick up as that was done online.  Also, don’t bother trying to get rooms next to each other ahead of time, as that will also not happen.  Needless to say, the check in took two hours because none of the above was complete ahead of time and we were unable to get a reservation at any of the restaurants on our first night, which of course was one of our friend’s birthdays.

Service:  The worst part about the trip and the resort was the service.  When you go to many islands, the staff is happy to have you there, tries to solve problems and is friendly in general.  I would say that this resort had none of those traits.  From a horrible check in that took two hours for all of the wrong reasons, to the many issues that arose because all of the requests up front weren’t honored to just many bad interactions, this is an all time low service experience. Service people were not trained well for a higher end resort as most do not make eye contact and with the exemption of one concierge, no one attempts to solve problems.   We paid extra for the concierge (Elvis) and the only thing we really had him do was make reservations for the week, which as I said before were already submitted but not honored.  He confirmed reservations for Sunday-Wednesday as Saturday ended up being the below mediocre buffet, but couldn’t confirm Thursday and Friday for some weird reason.  We asked everyday about those days and got- “working on it” all the way up to Thursday at 6:15 when he wasn’t around.  I called and found out it was at 7 when requested for 8:30 and we wouldn’t be ready.  So, I had to call around attempted to talk with management, who was in a meeting and another concierge ended up getting us food at that restaurant, but never a call back or check in from the management about the issue.  In the meantime, I had to make my own reservation for Friday because I couldn’t trust Elvis.  Other things were no towels available after 6PM at the pool and rude answers as to why, the pool closes at 7PM, the swim up bar is the worst set up as one person covers up and down and is never available…and it closes at 5.  Our friends had issues with their sink and toilet on day one and it was never fixed, although asked about several times.    We asked for blankets, never got them- more towels- never came- more water- only came once at 2AM.  

The rooms and grounds:  The rooms are ok- but asked for a king and got two full beds. We would've switched, but we spent 2 hours trying to get all of our groups rooms together and didn't want to ruin that. The tile floors combined with wood chairs made for early mornings as our upstairs neighbors dragged them at 7am everyday and it sounded like a bad trombone player waking you every morning.  There are some drinks in the fridge but it's limited and there are only 4 waters in the room for the day- so bring some back from a bar.  The pull out worked fine for one of our children.  The grounds are very nice, but many people talked about how far away the beach is which was inconvenient but great exercise.  The activities for the kids were very good as there was a rock climbing wall and trampoline that was well supervised.  Parents just needed to sign the kids up and then could leave the kids to it.  The Paradisus main hotel I thought was a lot nicer looking than the Reserve and I didn’t think anything was worth the extra for the Reserve.  Also, most of the restaurants and nightly activities were at the main hotel.  The gym was small with old equipment, but did offer classes, which I thought was a nice touch.  Wifi coverage of the grounds is really bad.  It is either slow or non-existent in most areas. Towels- only 4 per room and as many times as we called for more, no one ever comes. It's cold and we asked for blankets several nights, but alas none came. It actually became a joke by the end as I called at 8am the day we left for towels as we had only 1 and we left the room at 9 and of course, they are consistent as no one came!  

The Pools: The pool area was very good at all locations with plenty of beds, covered and open, tile loungers in the pool and the water temp was refreshing.  The only problem was that the pool closes at 7PM and there are no towels available after 6- and when you ask, you are ignored or told no towels.  Also, the swim up bar at the Reserve was a more like a bartender stair master as the same guy was covering upstairs and down so was rarely there. 

Golf:  Free golf was ok but carts were $65 per person, which is crazy.

Nightlife:  Nightlife is non-existent. Beach party on Saturday and Tuesday is fun, but It ends at 11pm. Nightclub and live music did not have a lot of people in them and they play 80% Latin music.   In fairness, we did not attend any of the shows as my group likes to dance and have a good time and stay out late.

The Food: All of the buffets are not very good- very small and not a big selection. They did a good job with a lot of fruit and there were grill options, but most of the prepared options were over salted or sauced.  Breakfast buffet was ok- but if you can get a warm fried doughnut, go for it as it is delicious. If you do go, order items from the grill.  Fish was good on the grill- you can get a whitefish and tuna in edition to beef and chicken.  Breakfast closes at 11am and lunch doesn't start until 12:30. The biggest hunger gap is between 3:30 when lunch ends  and 6:30 when dinner begins. Eat at Mole for lunch as its good sit down Mexican. The Grill was not very good steakhouse- poor cuts and they seem to overcook everything.  Aqua was ok. The appetizers were good, but the entrees were not great; don't get the cod- very hard and overlooked. Vento was very good italian; good seafood (tuna was excellent) good pasta. Bana was a standard habachi place- good, but not great. Fuego was our favorite- tuna appetizers were awesome, service was outstanding as they were very attentive and for dessert they just brought everything out. One call out is that coffee at the resort dinners was outstanding; dark and delicious and most of the desserts were pretty good. 

The beach:  The sand was amazing, the water fantastic, but the vendors along beach are annoying.  Same ones come by a lot and take a while to go away. It's bad cigars, bags and sunglasses and some other random ones. 
Service at the beach on the Reserve beach was poor. If only the waiters came by as often as the vendors!  We tipped $20 to keep them coming and that did nothing. We even tried consistent $5 tips and that did nothing. We ended up going to the bar shack to order most of our drinks. 
The Ocean: Sea life is relatively non-existent. Along the shore there is absolutely none as there are a fair amount of waves, which was cool for body surfing. When we went on an excursion, there were very limited fish along the coral and even when we went deeper with snuba. 

Checkout: was weird as they don't automatically charge your card as it's not on file and they don't automatically give you the voucher for the airport shuttle- as per everything else, you need to get it yourself. Then the shuttle is not directly to the airport, as you need to stop at other hotels first. 

Best parts of the vacation were the weather which was the best I've ever had- low 80s ad sunny with 20 minutes of rain the whole time. The breeze at night was amazing as it carried away any frustration from the day's poor service. The beach was beautiful sand, loungers, beds, straw umbrellas and great water and waves. The resort itself is beautiful, although I find the main hotel much more impressive than the Reserve.

reviews.author: KAPA0129
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Phenomenal Service at Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort & Spa!
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 9-day vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort and Spa with a large group of friends to celebrate a friend's birthday.  The resort itself is beautiful and only a 15-20 minute drive from the airport.  The grounds are well maintained and I felt very secure with the amount of security and staff on-site.  For the most part, the restaurants were very good.  My favorite was Palazzo and least favorite was Vento.  Thee buffet was good also.  Gabi Beach Bar was my favorite place for a pre-dinner cocktail (we loved Rosa, who was our server most nights).  Most of us had Royal Sevice and I would highly recommend it - it gives you access to additional areas and restaurants within the resort and also sets  you up with a butler.  

Nicolas was our butler and coordinated dinners for our group every night (which included 18 people on several nights).  He also did so much for us throughout the week including daily snacks and treats.  On my friend's birthday, he coordinated a fun breakfast (complete with the singing of happy birthday by several staff members), he decorated the room, ordered not one but two cakes for her, gave her flowers and coordinated a boat excursion for our group which included decorations and cake!  He exeeded all expectations we had and we could not have asked for more.  I would request Nicolas as our butler when we return!

Omar served as the Butler for several of our friends and was also very helpful a and very friendly.  Francisco coordinated our daily beach area and served us cocktails and water throughout the day.  Francico was always kind and friendly.  He was great to us and truly helped out so much throughout the week.  

The experience was a great one.  I was a little leary of the all-inclusive aspect (my first time) but it served our group really well.  Some things to note: if you can afford the Royal Service option, do it, without question.  Be forewarned, check in takes longer than average, which was a bit frustrating, but had I expected it, I might not have been as frustrated.  Also, if you leave valuables out and/or your safe unlocked and housekeeping comes, it is my understanding that they have to call security, put items in the safe, and reset the safe. You will need to call to have them open the safe and let you reset the code for the safe.

reviews.author: Julia C
reviews.title: Mordomo Luis Sanchez
reviews.text:
Passei minha Lua de Mel no Resort Paradisus Palma Real no serviço Royal Service e, com certeza, recomendamos.
Na nossa chegada fomos recepcionados pelo senhor Luis Sanchez, que fez com que nossas estadias fossem ainda mais especiais do primeiro dia até a nossa volta. Sempre muito atencioso! Ele quem fazia as reservas nos melhores restaurantes do resort, e não tivemos que nos preocupar com nada! Além disso, todos os dias tínhamos uma surpresa quando chegávamos no quarto no fim da tarde, e o mais especial foi a banheira linda que ele preparou com pétalas, frutas e champagne!
Todos os dias, quando chegávamos na praia, já tínhamos um bangalô reservado por ele, ou quando pedíamos, ele reservava um lugar especial na piscina do resort.
Obrigada Luis Sanchez! Esperamos voltar um dia! Grande abraço!
Julia e Flávio

reviews.author: Dan O
reviews.title: The butler is the best part!
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience.  Enjoyed everything especially our butler, Faustino.  Didn't know what we would use a butler for but Faustino took care of our every need.  Made the experience even more relaxing.  If you stay here and get the Royal Service, ask for Faustino to be your butler!  You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: David H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Very elegant, excellent service, but last year the Melia Caribe was better in terms of ambiance but not in terms of dining.  WiFi was very slow!  Estelle at Customer Service was great, and Indira Gonzales at travel service was fantastic!

reviews.author: Deb2q
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and service!
reviews.text: Onardo Marino is fantastic! The best service - wonderful English, Russian, French and of course Spanish. The best personality and person and he made our vacation extremely special! A wonderful experience. We highly recommend him and the resort! He is the reason we chose this place for our vacation in the Domincan Republic! -Deb

reviews.author: Rich K
reviews.title: Dad's Rejuvenating Spring Break
reviews.text:
Third time down to this great place. As always Luis at the main pool bar is a superstar with his ever present smile. He pours em like no one else, but unfortunately had a few days off coming so we only caught him a few days. Carolina Franco as hostess at the Morning buffet spoke with us at length regarding her career ambitions. Nice to see a pleasant and friendly young lady with a plan. She will be good for the company! Francisco Estrella who choreographs the chairs, towels and beverages down on the beach and poolside for the Club Melia members took fantastic care of my wife and I for the entire duration.. He wouldn't even let me move a chair with out his help, kept me "hydrated" and always had us where we wanted to be. Last but not least Ms. Jennika Ortega in member services went that extra mile when it came to making my golf and our spa and  dinner reservations and following up with any in room requests. Her last words always said with a smile were  "My Pleasure".

One disappointment was the steakhouse "Rare", menu wasn't impressive and  the cut of beef was subpar compared to the other dining options offered at Palma Real. But hey no one is perfect.

Starting to plan for the next trip already......

reviews.author: DorothyRivers
reviews.title: Exceptional Vacation Getaway
reviews.text:
This was my second time visiting this resort and it is fabulous. The service and staff are wonderful, alert to your needs, always willing to assist with any request or concerns. My stay both times was just exceptional compared to all the places I have visited. I have to give a shout out to certain staff member who went above & beyond to make sure our stay was over the top.
Pool Attendee Jose D. Los Santos; Club Member Services Anvvi, Clarabell & Sandra; At LaPLayaDeBavaro Restaurant, fantastic staff: Quintina Santana, Mayra Ruiz & Tony Guerrero; Life Activities exceptional activities & staff: Marionell Ramirez & Luis Florian (Super Sexy :-)) & Javiela (Gaby); Also, Jose Luis, Jose Reinose & Emilio Valdez, Miki D. Leon, Sandra Cedeno. I'm hopeful that I'll see them again same time next year. I cannot say enough to applaud the resort & staff

reviews.author: lepont
reviews.title: Wonderful family holiday
reviews.text:
We returned last weekend from a super holiday at this lovely resort.Three generations  with eight people in our party including two children and everyone had a great time.The children loved the Kids club and the staff there are really really good with the children.
The accommodation was excellent with lots of room -we had three one bedroom suites.Well maintained and kept super clean by the house keeping team of Desiree ,Cleybi and Gina.
The food is very good even in the Buffets and the staff in all the Restaurants are friendly and efficient.It was lovely to be greeted in the mornings by Anthony Cid and his buddies at the Gabby club who remembered what we wanted to drink and where we liked to sit.I should have made note of all their names but they are a real asset to the Resort and should be rewarded.
The Pool is great and the service there is excellent
The Beach was beautiful although the waves a little boisterous.The children enjoyed the para gliding ,sailing and snorkeling -so much to do !!
We have been to most of the Islands in the Caribbean and were a little hesitant to go to D.R.but I would rate it and this Resort particularly as one of the best especially for families.

reviews.author: aimeetravels6
reviews.title: 18 friends had one spectacular time
reviews.text:
The hotel is very lovely.  The gardens are lush and well kept and the rooms are also nice and well maintained.  The food is good, it is an all inclusive resort so I don't expect it to be michelin star quality.  Certainly plenty of options. 
Service was impeccable from our incredible pool/beach server Francisco to the staff that went to my room to help me find my passport.  Every person who works here cares that you are well taken care of and enjoy your stay. 
I would recommend getting Royal Service.  I did not, but my friends did so it did not matter but I would have been missing out without it.  
This is a really lovely resort with an amazing staff, a beautiful beach and grounds/pools.  I have no complaints and would go back.

reviews.author: Ferbcaroli
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Viajei com a minha família e namorado, sem dúvidas foi uma viagem maravilhosa! Fomos atendidos maravilhosamente bem, todos os funcionários são simpáticos, atenciosos e profissionais. Os dormitórios são grandes e sempre limpos e arrumados. Grande variedade de restaurantes.
Assim que chegamos no hotel foi direcionado uma pessoa para cuidar de nossas reservas em restaurantes, nossos passeios fora do hotel, enfim toda a ajuda necessária, o funcionário que nos atendeu foi o Jorge, gente muito boa, sempre presente e cuidadoso. Na praia tivemos atendimento "vip", Angel foi nosso braço direito, até escolhia nossas bebidas (acertou sempre). Foi tudo inesquecível...

reviews.author: Shay R
reviews.title: Shay C. "Service Above and Beyond"
reviews.text: Our arrival was breathtaking, walking in to such a beautiful view of the ocean and the openness of the whole Resort was lovely.  We were greeted by a guide that escorted us to the Royal Service.  Once we walked in the lounge I thought I was in heaven.  The décor was gorgeous the staff was so friendly and not to mention the wonderful dishes and cocktails they had waiting for us.  I thought they would just give us our room key and then we would be on our way.  However, it was a process...but it was very professional and caring and made us feel like royalty. We were then introduced to our Butler Juan De Leon.  He walked us to our room and then provided us with our personal cell phone to contact him when needed.  I have to tell you this was something I had never experienced.   Juan  would call us in the morning to see what our daily activities would be and set everything up for us.  Before he got off work for the night he would contact us to see if there was anything we needed before he left.
