Everyday was so carefree we didn't have to worry about doing anything but relaxing, whether it was just hanging out on the beach or dining in the amazing restaurants... Unfortunately about the fourth day of our vacation I got really sick and had to go to the hospital.  Juan was already off work by this time.  He called us to find out what hospital I was going to and he came there and stayed until I was released.  This was by far not in his job description and service above and beyond.  We were so appreciative to him for this.  Juan, our bartender Leonardo, and our beach server Fransisco checked on me constantly to make sure I was comfortable and feeling better.  I did recover and was able to enjoy the remainder of the trip.  I recommend Paradisus Palma Real to anyone traveling to the DR. The professionalism, care, and service was something I will never forget and beyond what I ever experienced!  My boyfriend and I will be visiting again soon!

reviews.author: Ryan Y
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: I just returned from my fourth time staying at the Paradisus Palma Real-Punta Cana.  I am never disappointed.  This time I was with 18 close friends for a birthday milestone.  There are two Paradisus resorts in Punta Cana.  Be sure and stay at the Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort.  It is the largest and nicest of the two.  I have always done the Royal Service all-inclusive package and highly recommend it-it is definitely the way to go.  The Royal Service comes with butler service which is truly a an appreciated luxury.  Our butlers on this recent trip were Omar and Nicholas.  They were both amazing!  From making sure our favorite spot on the beach was reserved and we were never with out cocktail in hand, to making sure our group always had a dinner reservation at our desired restaurant, to booking a fabulous catamaran excursion, our butlers never disappointed and truly made our trip a memorable one!

reviews.author: stipa99
reviews.title: Best resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel.Had Royal service,well worse the money.Loved Palazzo restaurant,best service,,best food.Special thanks to Samuel and Francisco,they made our stay even more enjoable.will definitly go back.
The only negative point I would like to make.This is a boutique resort,perfect for couples and families.At some poin a huge group of people arrived(Volvo company),drunk,loud,obnoxious crowd. Spoiled the very special atmosphere of the resort.
I think the administration should not allow this in future.
So again thank you Samuel(at Royal service),Francisco(at the beach) and Alexander(at Palazzo restaurant).See you next year.

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text: My friend and I were at the beach everyday. Our bartender Onardo Marino made our trip that much more enjoyable. He was very personable, spoke English and always wanted to make sure that we were taken care of and happy. He had great drink suggestions and wanted us to get the whole island feel, it was wonderful. Even though all of the people that work here were very friendly and helpful, Onardo was definitely our favorite, I highly suggest looking for him on your trip!

reviews.author: Rachel S
reviews.title: People
reviews.text: Onardo Marino was the best bartender we had on the trip. He was friendly and even served us at the beach. He spoke very good English, too. His service was accurate, fast, and he came just when we needed a new one. Onardo was very easy to get along with.

reviews.author: Brooks R
reviews.title: Best Family vacation in the best location!
reviews.text: We had never traveled to the Dominican Republic before, so we didn't know what to expect.  Our experience at the Paradisus was better than we ever imagined.  Our family concierge, Estafania Rodriguez was perfection!  She was kind, thoughtful and very attentive to our daily schedule and reservations.  We wouldn't have had the comprehensive visit we had without her daily smile and check in.  We can't say enough good things about her attention to detail and professionalism.  Our housekeeper, Soran and Angela were sweet and kept our room perfectly.  Denis Silverio greeted us every morning with a fresh pot of cafe con leche, juice and a big smile!  Pool attendants: Santo Polanco, Wendy Nunez, Jensy Rijo and Natanael Perez cared for us daily at our cabana.  Amazing beachside massage by Wendy Yokata.  We miss our vacation already and our counting the days until we get back to the DR again!  Employees Jazmin, Jose Bana and Rosemary were on it!  The staff is all polite and greeted us with smiles and offered to help in any way they could to make our stay as perfect as possible.

reviews.author: Lauren R
reviews.title: Mini mi, Big Mac and angel were amazing
reviews.text: Mini mi and Big Mac where the activities workers they were so fun and energetic and always happy! I loved the way they engaged people and "made" them do it. Angel was also fabulous, but he had his 3 day break but he was so fun and his dance classes were very fun! They had so many cool things to do like Zumba, yoga, candle making, and painting. It was such a fun experience! And I wish I could go back next week! I have been to 4 all-inclusive resorts and this was by far the BEST!

reviews.author: joistori
reviews.title: Overall very nice experience, I just booked the wrong room and service
reviews.text:
I spent 2 weeks at the Reserve this Easter and very soon realized that I had made a mistake. I should have booked the Royal Service since my wife and I were not vacationing with any kids. The Reserve has the biggest rooms and are definitely the choice if you’re having a family break. The pool and service most of the time very good, sometimes a bit hit-and-miss when it comes to the house keeping, i.e. sometimes you would get enough towels, sometimes you would need to call and ask for them… so don’t expect the finer attention to all details you would expect from a five star hotel. However, this is not the place to wear a stiff upper lip, this is the place to relax and enjoy the whole package. 
We upgraded our service package to the adult only Royal Service during the second week and even though it was a bit steep on the price, we both agree it was the right thing to do. The Reserve is furthest away from the beach of all accommodation at this massive resort but the Royal Service is basically on the beach. It has its own pool and pool bar and the atmosphere is very relaxed. You also get the a la carte breakfast at the LaPalaba which included some of my favorite breakfast bites, namely Eggs Benedict which were perfect every morning. 
Since it was a rejuvenating vacation…I used the gym every day. It was a decent one with most of what you would expect in a good hotel gym. The gym staff was very helpful and positive. One of the gym machines, the ecliptic cross walk (or whatever its called) needs serious maintenance, they should look into that ASAP before it falls apart. 
It was quite obvious that the staff wanted us to review the place and service on Tripadvisor, which was kind ‘a funny. I assume that the management uses personal reviews as part of the staff performance appraisals. 
We tried all the restaurants and they were all good. The least one was the Asian stir fry adjacent to the teppanyaki… would skip that if you need to skip one. The Passion was very good but I felt it was too pricy for my preference. We met the general manager who was checking out people’s experiences and we had a short discussion in the Sky bar. I like it when the management shows themselves and make an effort to meet their guests. One star extra for that effort.

I don’t usually revisit places I’ve been to, but I liked Paradisus very much and will come back if I get the chance.

reviews.author: JSeaton
reviews.title: Great all inclusive Hotel.
reviews.text: The entire resort was very clean, everything was wonderful. Beautiful landscaping everywhere!Attention was paid to the details. The Royal service was excellent. The staff went out of their way the entire trip. Excellent food and drinks were always available and were regularly brought with out asking. I was very impressed by the entire staff. Everyone was very welcoming and genuinely wanted to help. I will go back!

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: The Three Amigos
reviews.text:
First let me say that this is our first time staying at an all inclusive resort. The experience was wonderful. What a blessing to not have to carry money with you and constantly be tipping everyone that talks to you. 

No one here expects a tip and was extremely kind and helpful. People here go out of their way to help you and make your stay the most pleasant one you could possibly have. 

I would definitely come here again. 

The three guys in the picture ( ray-ray, Big Mac, and mini mi) were by far the best for hospitality. They teach many different classes throughout the day. You owe it to yourself to at least do one of their classes. It's a total blast, and you might learn something! 

They have dancing, yoga, and other classes. Check them out when you get here! You won't regret it.

reviews.author: Zoltán O
reviews.title: dream come true
reviews.text:
We spent here our beautiful Honeymoon. Perfect place to relax and enjoy time together.
Beautiful beach, comfortable sunbeds, delicious cocktails.
There was a lot of fantastic programs like Jazz concert, Bounce show, Dominican show, dance party. Amazing dancers!! Special thanks to Carida and Luis for the real dominican bachata dance lesson! We loved it! We learned a lot of musicality and movements!
Our butler, Faustino performed all our wishes. He was kind and very friendly. We got a lot of surprises... fruits, strawberries with choccolate, bath with flowers! He made our honeymonn more romantic!
Our favourite restaurants were the Palazzo and the 7 Michelin stars Passion! Great food and perfect service.
We loved the animator programs also. Big Mac and his team were really funny and friendly. He always smile! :)
We would like to thank all the hotel member! We are looking forward to see you again!

reviews.author: Jordan S
reviews.title: Amazing Staff, amazing service, delicious food!
reviews.text: From the start i knew this would be a great trip. I was there with a large group staying in the main Paradisus resort, but since I'm in a power chair and the best rooms for me to access were in the Reserve we were placed there. From Ambiorix the bellboy and Santiago who is also a bellboy who drove me around on their wheelchair golf cart the whole week, to Eddy Wilson in the Reserve lobby who always looked out for me the staff was excellent and went above and beyond each day. Elvis Lopez our concierge was great at taking care of all our dinner reservations and reserving pool cabanas, and Jennifer in the Gabi Club waited on me hand and foot.

reviews.author: merimesas
reviews.title: El hotel mejora año tras año.
reviews.text:
Nuestro segundo viaje este año y siempre excelente. Las instalaciones van mejorando año tras año. Hay restaurantes nuevos y las cartas mas variadas. Incluso mejor organizado. Los buffets también. La carne del restaurante Rare más que excelente.
Y el servicio inmejorable!
Cabe citar a Yafreisy en la recepción de La Reseve: muy agradable e hipereficaz. En la playa del Servicio Real: ambos Franciscos y Martín escogen las mejores tumbonas para ti, y siempre tienen a punto tu bebida preferida a la hora justa.
Moisés en el nuevo y muy buen restaurante Olio, ha sido nuestro descubrimiento de este último viaje, un encanto.
Todo sobresaliente!

reviews.author: Valery B
reviews.title: Simply amazing
reviews.text:
Resort is amazing. Food is delicious, beach is perfect. Our butler Francisco Estrella made our stay extra special by taking extra special care of us, by having our chairs ready, bringing us water after our walks, special drinks all day, and mostly by being very friendly.
Thank you Francisco! :)

reviews.author: milton n
reviews.title: servicio de habitacion fenomenal
reviews.text: me encanto el servicio ami habitacion siempre todo lo que ordenaba me llegaba rapido y con calidad FERNANDO GERONIMO y sotero castillo nos hicieron sentir como en casa un saludo cordial a ellos y a cesar la fle en el telefono muchas gracias por tan buena atencion se los agradesco...

reviews.author: ercili p
reviews.title: fenomenal
reviews.text: fenomenal fue el gran servicio que vi aqui en el poco tiempo que dure solo vine para una boda pero lamente no haberme quedado mas tiempo, en la boda nos atendieronn de marabilla un gran servicio las chicas de romance especialmente CLARIBEL muchos abrazos y afecto para ti..tambien me encanto el gran servicio de room service comida rapida y de calidad un fuerte abrazo al chico que nos atendio en el poco tiempo que duramos aqui FERNANDO GERONIMO muchas gracias por ser tan amable...

reviews.author: carmeng552015
reviews.title: An excellent vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I are very happy with this hotel. The facilities are just gorgeous! The pool is big and so beautiful. The food is amazing...we loved everything that we tried. Plenty of seafood everyday...mmm We had the junior suite and it was absolutely amazing, jacuzzi included. Special thanks to Big Mac...awesome guy! always involving the guests and bringing a smile to our faces everyday...The spa facilities...out of this world...excellent massage that we received. Just want to mention a few things...it would be nice to have more tropical music in the resort. When you arrive the music in the lobby and other common areas doesn't make you feel that you are in the Caribbean and I think that this is the purpose of many of the guests that make this vacation..feel the flavor of this beautiful tropical island. In the same line would be nice to have more Dominican nights...instead of just Monday night...we missed it because we went from Tuesday to Monday :-( Local merengue and bachata bands will be awesome. Also, our room had a musty smell, I know it might be because the weather is mostly humid most of the year, but it was a little annoying...Other than this little issues, overall, this is a great place to have a vacation...

reviews.author: vivek_dhir
reviews.title: Incredible!
reviews.text: So first thing - we have stayed at multiple Paradisus's - Cancun, Playa and had an excellent experience each time. That's why when planning our first trip to DR, we chose this place - but even we weren't ready for this incredible experience- perhaps the best vacation we have ever had. The hotel is gorgeous. I have stayed at the Ritz and many superb resorts, but this was something else. We checked in in a private lounge.  The room was not ready but we got a room to change - and off the pools which are superb. The beach has the best sand ever. Yes, there is seaweed but there are people out cleaning it and it didn't bother us. We got our room around 3pm - and what a room - view of the sea and the pool in the family concierge section to which they were nice enough to upgrade us, given that we were celebrating our 15th anniversary. We also got reservations in all the restaurants we wanted. Palazzo and Fuego were outstanding, the others good - we ate in a different place every night. The entertainment- the Lion King and the Michael Jackson show were superb. The other shows were ok. Our kids loved the kids club.  But most of all it was the individuals who made it an incredible experience for us - shout outs to Juan de Dios  and Geraldo for the most superb dining experiences, Jonathan at the concierge pool for taking care of us, Oscar the main bar for the best cocktails, and Vicente Rubianes and Domingo Beltre for making this the experience of a life time. We recommend this place to all and will be back.

reviews.author: Cristiano C
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Tudo perfeito, otimas opções de restaurantes inclusive um estrelado pelo guia Michelin (Passion), para todos os gostos. Área de lazer excelente com piscinas enormes e bares completos. O quarto nem se fala, amplo e superconfortável.

reviews.author: Leanimal_14
reviews.title: The Learning Experience
reviews.text: Very great service and customer service. The experience was unforgettable and I cannot wait to go back. Jazz, Big Mac, Rey Rey, Mini Me were all amazing. The sun, beach and food was very good. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: TLEconvention2015
reviews.title: If you're looking for a vacation, look no further... This is your spot!
reviews.text: One word... UNFORGETTABLE! The Life Enrichment staff especially Mini Mi, Big Mac, Jazz, Rey Rey and Angel made us feel like we were at a home away from home. The beach yoga, poolside Zumba classes, salsa dancing, water aerobics and more was so much fun! The food was delicious with a ton of variety of choices and the restaurant service was impecable. The room service was always prompt and the views with the turquoise waters, white sands, palm trees and the sun was always shining was a picturesque way to wake up in the morning! A great big thank you to Immanuel as well for helping me in my time of distress. So many great things to name except for if you are looking for an all inclusive resort, DON'T LOOK ANY FURTHER! This is your spot!

reviews.author: ESmith-Theis
reviews.title: Wedding greatness!
reviews.text:
First, I need to thank you all for such an amazing and unforgettable experience! It is rare to find a resort that excels on so many levels, from room quality, staff, service, and more. This hotel truly exceeded all expectations across all areas. We had 30 guests attend our wedding and several said this was by far the best resort they had been to. Many intend to return.
A special thank you to Raquel Vega, Caribel De Los Santos, and Natalia Cantor. Their service was exceptional and extremely professional. Each made sure that our wedding went smoothly and I am convinced without their dedicated level of service, things would not have gone as smoothly. We had only a small group but their level of attention to us felt as if we had a much larger wedding.
Even though almost all the planning was done by email, it went well. The organization was a bit difficult for us but in the end, it did not detract from the overall excellent experience they provided.
I want to thank you for a truly amazing and unforgettable experience we will remember for a lifetime. We fully intend to return again for a future celebration.

Kind regards,
Langston & Liz

reviews.author: packman b
reviews.title: verdadero paraiso
reviews.text: su nombre lo dise todo esto es un verdadero paraiso disfrute desde que llegamos hasta que nos fuimos. desde que llegas a la recepcion te dan un trato impecable, un hotel muy lindo en instalaciones, las piscinas muy buen cuidadas y el nuevo restaurante fenomenal , el restaurante pasion que no es incluido pero vale la pena pagar su costo adicional fue asombroso...quiero tambien darle un saludo al chef carlos del restaurante palazzo muy buen chef gracias por esos excelentes platos que nos deleito ami y ami esposa. y por ultimo y no menos importante el grandioso servicio de  room service un chico de este departamente me encanto FERNANDO GERONIMO siempre llamandonos para ver como ivanos siempre con una excelente sorpresa nos dejaba en la habitacion buen vino, excelente quesos muchas gracias fernando por todo no te olvidaderos esperamos volver a verte.. en general todo perfecto gracias paradisus palma real por tu confort y atenciones...

reviews.author: manuel e
reviews.title: muito bom feriado
reviews.text: Eu amei o ótimo serviço deste grande hotel, os quartos muito agradáveis ​​, restaurantes com bom serviço e instalações fantásticas serviço de quarto também FERNANDO GERONIMO perfeito grande muito obrigado por tudo .

reviews.author: isabel p
reviews.title: fabuloso
reviews.text: me encanto el gran servicio que ofrecen aqui, las habitaciones muy bonitas y muy bien cuidadas las piscinas son de marabillas las playas hermosisimas y los restaurantes principalmente el vento nos encanto.. el servicio de room service espectacular comida muy deliciosa y rica nos hicieron sentir como en el paraiso especialmente fernando geronimo muy excelente chico...

reviews.author: TeaKandTie
reviews.title: Vacation Club is fantastic
reviews.text: We purchased a vacation club membership here a few years ago and visit twice each year. We look forward to the great weather, amenities, and food at Palma Real. However, more than anything,  we appreciate the excellent poolside service provided by Francisco Estrella. He actively looks after our interests making sure we're comfortable and sharing laughs. Thank you for such heartwarming service!

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation at Palma Real
reviews.text:
Last minute decision to go to the resort during the March Break,  We were not able to get a room at The Reserve, but were able to get one at Palma Real.  This was our 15th visit to the resort, and it didn't disappoint!  The friendly, hard working staff at the resort bring us back at least once each year.  As usual, Francisco Estrella at the Vacation Club pool went way beyond exceptional with the level of his service,  Also thanks to Wendy Gyal at the Fitness Centre at The Reserve for keeping us motivated during our vacation.  Thanks also to the Vacation Club employees who are always so accomdating and pleasant.
The resort has done a reallhy nice job with the new buffet.  We also enjoyed the new/changed restaurants.  The new steak restaurant Rare was very good, but they need a steak on the menu that is less than 10 ounces!  We were able to eat at the new restaurant Olio, which is for Family Concierge guests.  It was the only restaurant that was close to empty.  It would nice if this was an option for Vacation Club members all the time - just a thought.  The nightly entertainment around the new bar next to the Buffet was really good.  It was very busy every night, and the variety was great.  We'll be back for our 16th visit in no time!

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!!
reviews.text: This is the most amazing all inclusive I've been to. The resort is unbelievable, beyond words really. Beach is beautiful, food fantastic, rooms are beyond expectation. Fabulous all around well worth every penny. Special mention to the great staff especially "Big Mac", Yazmerlyn Fernin and to Ornado Marino for all the great drinks and daily Spanish lesson! Would go back in a heartbeat!💓

reviews.author: 72Peter_G
reviews.title: Fantastic Family Experience
reviews.text:
We chose this hotel because of the great reviews on Trip Advisor and I can honestly say that we had a fantastic experience. We decided to get the Family Concierge option and I am glad we did as our concierge - Jarol - was awesome.

After finding out what foods we enjoyed and the dining experiences we were looking for - he made all of our dinner reservations - within 3 hours of our arrival !!! 

He came to our room as we were unpacking and provided us with all of our reservation cards and asked if we wanted to book a cabana by the pool or beach for the next day as well as provide us with a hotel-issued cell phone we could use to contact him at any time.

With Jarol's help - there was no "typical resort headache" of rushing to book restaurant reservations before all the spots are taken or rushing out the door every morning in order to find a decent spot by the pool or beach. This made our trip that much more satisfying. Jarol also set up an awesome Jacuzzi bubble-bath for the kids - which they loved after a "long day"(;-) by the pool.

All of our dining experiences were great and there were many options so you will definitely find what you're looking for. 

The beach was beautiful and the private area for the Reserve guests was an added bonus as it was very peaceful and relaxing. The pool was also very nice and with the private cabanas - you get out of the sun whenever you wanted which was also a nice thing to have when travelling with kids.

The grounds were absolutely immaculate as well as beautiful and all the staff were very friendly.

If we choose Punta Cana for a future vacation - there is no doubt that we will be booking The Reserve once again,,,,with the Family Concierge option.

Thanks again Jarol for making our trip a great one !!!

The Gismondi Family

Some other quick points if you're travelling with kids :

1. The beach is a 10-minute walk away but you can also take a shuttle bus which comes around often.
2. If you're debating between The Paradisus and the The Reserve at Paradisus ---- trust me ,, go for the Reserve. The Paradisus is not as family friendly. More smoking, more drinking, not as many families.

reviews.author: Lucia C
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO DESTINO
reviews.text:
Es uno de los mejores destinos que hemos visitado.

Mi esposo y yo fuimos de luna de miel y para ser sinceres nos hubiese gustado permanecer mas tiempo.

Las atenciones del personal fueron excelentes, en especial la de la asistente de guess service Cristy Coste.

En cuanto a las instalaciones, 10% recomendadas, los restaurantes, piscinas, playas,etc..., todo nos encanto.

Definitivamente pronto volveremos.

reviews.author: Ros A
reviews.title: They of the best!
reviews.text: I went there in October with my husband and son, as a young couple we enjoyed everything there! My kid loves the kid zone, the best I think in the bavaro area, the girls there are beautiful and they take care very well of the kids!! All the ppl that works there are very friendly, they boys at the gabby club gave us an ecellent service! Our driver Andrew I think that was his name, was available for us all the time the same Jose! This was the kind of attention I was willing for all us since my husband traveled more than 8,000 miles all the way from Afghanistan! The hotel is beautiful, clean, good food, good service, everythng, I was willing to go back this past week, but was full so I had to go to other melia resort! Only think I didn't like and I will try to everybody not to do it is the club melia membershit don't join there they picture it as it will a good deal but at the end it's not, you have to pay for the all inclusive after to arrive to the resort for the days you gonna be there, and they NEVER SAY ABOUT THAT even in the page to know about it, you have to look in every stuff to realize you have to depend of the hotel you going to be... And the contract, of course has more than 10 pages and maybe they say it in the last page! -_- that was my only bad experience, and yes I would like to yall let it know to AMANDA AND MIKE! Yes we got a lawyer! Other that that the resort was excellent!

reviews.author: Julius A
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel and Service
reviews.text:
This was our second time to the resort in two years and we noticed many upgrades. First of all the airport in Punta Cana was easier to get through customs and also for departure. I would have to say if we had the same experience we had at this airport, would have reduced the overall rating as it added some stress to our trip.

This time around we had the royal service which included a butler and access to a Private Pool area, restaurant and wasn't as crowded as the other section. You can reserve a bali bed and a cabana where you can read, sleep under shade which was very relaxing by the pool.  With the top shelf bar available until 9 PM in the VIP lounge and bar in the room, didn't have to worry about alcoholic beverage access.  

I recommend this hotel and especially the service our butler, Alvaro Fernandez, provided who was attentive to our needs. I know it is pricey and was fortunate enough to enjoy this experience as a company Incentive Trip, but it made a major difference in my overall experience of this resort with the royal service package.  It was considered the best Incentive Trip our company has held!

reviews.author: OrthoPouet
reviews.title: Séjour top!
reviews.text:
Nous sommes partisan couple, du 16 mars au 1 avril, soit 17 jours sur place.  A peine arrivés, des rafraîchissements nous sont proposés le temps de régler l'administratif. Une fois les bracelets noués au poignet, direction la chambre au premier étage! 
Elle est spacieuse, coquette, dotée d'un jacuzzi, d'un lit immense et d'une terrasse avec vue sur un jardin… Malgré cela, la chambre est très mal située (le couloir donne sur un générateur électrique bruyant et qui fleure le diesel!). Nous demandons à changer deux jours après notre arrivée et sommes installés l'après-midi même dans une chambre au rez-de-chaussée. Non seulement elle est tout aussi belle mais nous sommes enfin au calme et bien plus proches de la piscine et de la plage. Nous n'avons eu recours au room service que quelques fois mais le personnel a été irréprochable systématiquement.

La plage est agréable et propre, le personnel se remue pour que les lieux restent propres tout au long de la journée et que des serviettes soient dispo quelle que soient l'heure à laquelle vous vous installez. Pour les places, nous avons toujours trouver des transats à l'ombre, que ce soit à la plage ou autour de la piscine. Des serveurs passent régulièrement vous proposer à boire. Petit clin d'oeil d'ailleurs à Davidson Germain et Georges Alriche pour leur gentillesse et leurs mojitos! Une pensée et un grand bravo au manager de la plage, Jonathan Goldschmidt, pour sa disponibilité, sa prévenance et sa gentillesse. ^^ 
La piscine est grande et baignée de soleil, un peu bruyante notamment lorsque le cours d'aquagym démarre. Point très appréciable: il y a une partie du bar qui donne dans la piscine: vous pouvez siroter un verre tout en barbotant.

Le buffet principal auquel vous pouvez prendre vos trois repas (ou plus!.. ou moins! c'est vous qui voyez!) est varié et bon. Les restaurants sont assez diversifiés: viandes, japonais Teppanyaki, cuisine méditerranéenne sont ceux que nous avons testés. Verdict: Rien à redire pour aucun! La seule chose: penser à réserver le matin et si c'est complet… et bien tentez tout de même votre chance à l'heure du dîner! Nous avons pu diner au Vento (cuisine méditerranéenne) sans avoir réservé!

Bref! Situation géographique idéale, temps magnifique, lieux superbes et personnel aux petits soins… A refaire!

Merci à tous!

reviews.author: tmc2979
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: This was my first all-inclusive that actually impressed me. The food was 5 star quality, the service was excellent, the staff was pleasant, friendly, and always offering to help. The resort was super clean all the time!

reviews.author: Danimaljenkins
reviews.title: Excellent Honeymoon! Excellent Service!
reviews.text:
This place is practically perfect! The food and drinks are fantastic and all included. The beach looks just as good if not better than the pictures. 

The pool server Santo Polanco was a huge help to us and deserves majors recognition. 

All in all I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone.

reviews.author: jvanegmond
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: We came for a wedding and had a wonderful time.  Buffet, Resturants and Room Service were excellent and afternoon and evening activities and shows were great! All the staff were very welcoming and engaging. In particular Wilkin, Yazz and Big Mac made our trip extra special with all of their special touches and fun personalities.  We look forward to coming back again!

reviews.author: Karla Andrea G
reviews.title: Espectacular!!!
reviews.text: Me encanto todo.  El servicio (todos muy amables y serviciales), la comida, el ambiente, las actividades del hotel, los show de noche,  el hotel en general es perfecto!!!  Lo recomiendo!!!  Unas de las experiencias más lindas!!

reviews.author: Yi J
reviews.title: Good experience staying at this hotel
reviews.text: Booked this hotel mainly for playing golf. Had a good experience staying there. Food and services were good. I wanted to thank a room service guy who was very honest. He found that we forgot to lock the safe box and we were not in the room. He didn't leave till we were back and confirmed everything was safe. Facilities in the room were a little old.

reviews.author: Aammpp111
reviews.title: True paradise
reviews.text:
After having just returned from a blissful 8 night stay at the Reserve, I can honestly say I have never felt so blessed. Over the last 15 years, my family has ventured all over the Caribbean and has stayed at our fair share of very nice resorts. The Reserve puts them all to shame. 

The rooms…the service…the food…the grounds – I can’t even begin to express in words what a truly magnificent experience we had. I have vowed to return to The Reserve on at least an annual basis for many years to come. It truly can’t be beat. 

Of all of the amazing selling points of the resort, what truly made our stay spectacular were the people: 

--Out of all of the points of contact we made, our most memorable and touching bond was the one we formed with Noel Vasquez (a member of the entertainment team). As I mentioned previously, we have stayed at quite a few all-inclusive resorts of the past 15 years. Noel is by far the most attentive, entertaining, genuine individual we have ever had the pleasure to meet. He treated us like family throughout the duration of our stay, and he is one of the main reasons we will return to the hotel in the future. 

--Every morning at the Gabi Club buffet, we were greeted by the warm smile of Antony Cid. His enthusiasm was so incredibly genuine, and it was always such a fantastic start to our day.  His attention to detail was superb, and the service was far better than anything we are accustomed to at home. 

--Every evening after a long day at the beach, we sat down for our free chair massages with Roselina. She is not only an incredible masseuse, but she also took the time every night to get to know my family. We loved her massages, but we loved her personality even more! 

--All of the bartenders were magnificent, but our favorite was Diego Guzman. His drinks were delicious, and his kindness was unmatched.  

Do yourself a favor and spend at least a week at this resort. You’ll never want to venture out anywhere else.

reviews.author: Eloir S
reviews.title: relax y calidad total
reviews.text: Me hospede en los dos hoteles y llene esta encuesta pensando sobre los dos. aclaro, el Palma Real no tiene pero alguno, todo estuvo excelente. La comida es increíble y me encanta el ambiente de la noche. El servicio de primer nivel. Amo Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: ReginaCNeri
reviews.title: Excelente Resort
reviews.text:
Excelente Resort!
A suite é bem espaçosa, e arejada.
As refeições em todas as opções de restaurantes são muito bem  apresentadas e com vários opções.
O ponto alto da área externa do Hotel não é a praia e sim os maravilhosos jardins, super bem cuidados e panejados. Nota 10 para o paisagista que os planejou!
O atendimento é de primeira e os funcionários são muito simpáticos e bem preparados.
Agradeço ao Tripadvisor porque graças aos relatos que havia lido sobre este Hotel, nos livramos de uma prática adotada nesses Resorts que é extremamente negativa e deixa o hóspede numa verdadeira enrascada.
Ao fazer o check in, alguém muuuiiiiito simpático se apresenta e se oferece para, na manhã seguinte, lhe mostrar todas as dependências do hotel. Ao saber que eramos brasileiros a figura disse que se chamava Neymar (risos), mas é óbvio que é um nome fictício, escolhido de acordo com a nacionalidade do hóspede. Agradecemos a oferta mas não aceitamos o convite de tomar o café da manhã com ele, porque já sabíamos que essa reunião tem por objetivo vender pacotes desta rede hoteleira. Mesmo tendo declinado ao convite, ele telefonou para nossa suíte na manhã seguinte logo cedo e mais uma vez recusamos a oferta, o que o deixou contrariado de uma forma até um tanto agressiva.
Portanto, NÃO aceite esses amáveis convites, a menos que queira negociar algum pacote com a rede de hotéis.
É uma pena que um Hotel tão bonito, com tudo feito para agradar todos os sentidos do hóspede adote esse tipo de abordagem de venda tão infame. Nota zero para quem idealizou essa estratégia de venda!

reviews.author: Kay H
reviews.title: Family Concierge
reviews.text:
This our 3rd vacation at this fabulous resort.   This year we brought our son, daughter in law, and 2 grandchildren, ages 3 and 20 months.  
The service we received from Sofia, as our personal  concierge was unbelievable.  Upon our arrival,  she gave us a cell phone so we were able to keep in contact with her at all times.  Our grandchildren were treated like royalty.   Sofia ran a warm bubble bath with a tub full of balloons, 
brought the kids warm milk and cookies at night,  and did so many special things for them.   The kids pool, and the Kids Zone was so much fun.   
The food in all of the restaurants and room service was excellent.  
Our rooms were always cleaned to perfection by our wonderful sweet ladies, Adalgiza  and Zorrilla. 
Mildred has done a great job with her awesome staff.
We will definitely be back next year.

reviews.author: Vacation542949
reviews.title: Best Part Was the Spa
reviews.text: YHI Spa was amazing for a massage. I tried the Indian Abyhanga massage for 180 minutes; worth every penny. The food was less than apetizing. Too many buffets and too many people literally picking over the food items.

reviews.author: Peter K
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time.  There isn't one bad thing that I could say about this resort.  Food was excellent, Room Service was excellent and we had a personal Butler.  His name was Johnfi Rivera and he was so welcoming and wonderful.  He made our trip extra special with all of his special touches.  We look forward to having him again as our Butler when we return in November.

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Overall great experience!
reviews.text:
Overall experience was wonderful. Beautiful property and beach. Weather was wonderful. Restaurants were very good...above average for an all inclusive. We did have one problem with a black worm in our buffet lunch salad that got an apology from the manager and little else.
Guest services and relations need major improvement. Beach drink service by Santos was the best. Overall, a great family vacation.

reviews.author: SSSS611
reviews.title: Second Time Back, Still Amazing!
reviews.text:
First, let me say that Juan and Jose behind the bar at Avenue are excellent hosts and stewards for Paradisus.  Second, Big Mac (and the addition of Ray Ray, who is also great) did a fantastic job getting us to exercise this year. Third, Bruny made us feel right at home--great host. 

As usual, Paradisus has only gotten better over time.  This year, it appears as though they had a tragic fire, so they renovated the whole place.  The beds are more comfortable and the new bars are great. Also, the buffet area is totally re-made into a much brighter more comfortable space. Each of the branded restaurants was better than last year!  

Two things to improve: (1) we could not check into our room on time, this was a little bothersome as we could not check in until after 5 PM; (2) Bring back the Thursday night unlimited lobster night!

reviews.author: Noel B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Great Staff
reviews.text: We have been visiting Punta Cana for over 10 years for our annual golf trip and Paradisus is our favorite resort by far.  They have a beautiful resort with easy access to the pool and beach.  Good food and a great staff.  From the time you check in to the that last sad day that you have to head out the staff is friendly and always looking to be helpful.  Luz Franco checked us in and got us into the vacation mode and was there to check us and make sure that our stay went as planned.  She with the rest of staff made sure we had a great stay.

reviews.author: 222Carlinn
reviews.title: Amazing spot for our honeymoon
reviews.text: Came here with my wife for our honeymoon. We couldn't have asked for a more amazing experience. Luis Santana Ramon Ramirez santos frias these guys made a wonderful experience on the beach. Me and my wife came to their side of the beach everyday. Kind, friendly,and very helpful. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: abourgeois2
reviews.title: Wonderful and amazing honeymoon!
reviews.text:
Me and my husband came here for our honeymoon and it was absolutely the most amazing experience. Not only is the grounds beautiful with tropical plants but so is the beach with white sand and crystal clear water. Plus the individuals who work here cater to your every need. Especially the following guys on the beach 
Luis santana Santos frias Ramon ramirez and Silvio lantigua

reviews.author: Arthur Y
reviews.title: Soaked our bed
reviews.text: Staff soaked our bed because, we can only assume that they thought they got a poor review over our Club Melia experience.  We were told that the presentation would only take 90 minutes over breakfast.  We were very disappointed that we wasted 2 hours and 30 minutes of our vacation away from our children.  Then they called us caustic because we told them we were not interest and that it didn't make financial sense.  We were never even shown a brochure.  Nothing but numbers written on a white sheet of paper.  Very unprofessional.

reviews.author: Jacquie N
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: The resort is very kid and adult friendly. The food is good with multiple restaurants to choose from. However, the system for reservations at the various restaurants needs to be improved. The rooms are clean and comfortable. The king bed in our was very comfortable, but the hide-a-bed for our kids was terrible. We put the mattress on the floor each night so they could rest better.

reviews.author: Antonio-Anne
reviews.title: A good resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: The resort is good, however, they should speed up the from desk arrivals, we arrive around 4pm and the rooms were not ready, they seem unable to handle more than five people at the same time!!! The water sport section sucks.

reviews.author: Rachel A
reviews.title: Best resort I have EVER stayed at!
reviews.text: The staff at the Paradisus Palma Real are top-notch. Franklin De La Cruz (our concierge) was a delight (very empathetic and kind). Carolina (hostess) was also so kind and told us which restaurants to dine at. Neither my husband nor I had ever been to the Dominican Republic, and we were so impressed not only with the country, but this particular resort.

reviews.author: LawMatta
reviews.title: Awsome vacation!!! Loved the people
reviews.text: Best vacation ever. Excellent food and service. Yasmerlyn, Big Mac and all the crew did a stupendous job making us feel comfortable. They became our friends. I will certainly return this year. Thank you for everything.

reviews.author: riverajeanette18
reviews.title: personal experience
reviews.text: I never a manage that such a beautiful place exist . It felt like a dream. I recommend this resort to everyone. We had a family wedding there and it was beautiful. Everything was perfect. I wish time could have been stopped so the days would be longer. This experience will be unforgettable to our family.

reviews.author: David James C
reviews.title: Service is extremely poor and rare
reviews.text: The I was the worst service I have ever seen. The tips don't seem to motivate the staff. If you don' t mind going and getting your drinks you might like it. The food is average. Two good restaurants. The resort is beautiful and large. Watch out for the outside activities bate and switch on what you get.

reviews.author: Katherine B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort...   loved the "Royal Service"
reviews.text: Stayed here in March 2015 for a 3 night trip (too short!).  This was my second visit to an all inclusive in Punta Cana (the first being the Riu resort further north) and this one blew away my expectations.  We had an upgraded room on the Royal Service side, which included an exclusive restaurant, upgraded drinks and a shared "butler service".  The butler is assigned to you during check-in and is there to help  you with just about anything.  They give you a cell phone to call them whenever you need help with dinner reservations, something in the room, questions about the excursions nearby (we literally called him and said "tell me about this pirate ship I see passing by" and he knew everything about it, probably a common inquiry, but still impressive).  Our butler was Nicolas and he was fantastic, surprising us with a romantic bubble bath before dinner one of the evenings and ensuring we had dinner reservations at the restaurants we wanted.   The food in the exclusive restaurant was delicious and the food at the other restaurants and the buffet was very good as well.   Great drinks, the bartenders were super friendly and attentive, especially at the "Sunset Bar" by the pool.  The drinks in the lobby bar were a surprising highlight, the bartenders there making "hand crafted" cocktails, classic recipes and intriguing original recipes (a cocktail made with ginger and passion fruit was an amazing weird combo).  All together a wonderful trip, I would definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: vacationguy
reviews.title: Great, relaxing vacation......our seventh to the D.R.
reviews.text:
Another wonderful trip to the Dominican and again, the people make the difference.  
This boutique hotel within the Paradisus PC was a great vacation experience for my wife, daughter and myself.  
With so many friendly and accommodating staff, it seems unfair to name a few but feel it important to recognize those that made a good vacation even better.  
Our service staff around the pool, including Jose Reinoso, Jose D'Los Santos and Emilio Valdez were truly, special friends.  
Our concierge Yeuri, who worked his magic to ensure our dinner times were accommodated, and Aronis at the Gabi restaurant who would greet us each time we saw him with a friendly hola Louisa and Christopher. 
Special mention to the entertainment staff and especially the pool aerobic instructor.  Although we never got his name, he was extremely polite, friendly and a great salsa dancer!  
Food was above average at most restaurants, Agua and the Grill our favourites, and upgrading to Reserve was well worth it as the beach buffet although beautiful, needed some rethinking in layout.  
Needed more top-shelf included alcohol, but ultimately, a great ten day stay!!

reviews.author: Christopher Doo... J
reviews.title: Relaxing in Paradise!
reviews.text: We stayed in the Reserve at the property, which was a short and delightful walk from the beach.  Our room was magnificent!  Restaurants were delicious, staff was friendly and accommodating.  We thought we'd like this vacation and would try the Dominican for the first time.  We'll be back to Paradisus Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Jeffrey J
reviews.title: DR for families
reviews.text: Good bang for the buck. Concierge service was excellent. Very good food options. Great place for a family with children. There were children's activities all day and excellent staff to watch them. Kids could opt in or out.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Stayed here instead of booked hotel
reviews.text: Our original hotel could not take us so they swapped us to this hotel. On checking in we were supposed to given $100/p compensation for the booked hotel failing to honour a guaranteed booking, this didn't happen. The rooms are large, large double bath, separate shower and toilet cubicles, large seating area, large comfortable bed, yes I think the word is large!!! There are good facilities in the room and fridge. The staff are generally very good, although they didn't sort out the compensation issue. The grounds are very smart and well kept. We only used the buffet restaurant, this being very good, varied choice and quite often freshly made in front of you (steaks, chicken, etc). The one issue we had with the place was that some areas, including the beach, were split into sections for the different types of booking. On the first day on the beach there was no sunbed available in the ordinary section, in the Royal section, barely any of them used, similar in the other area (can't remember the name of this section), we weren't aloud to use these, disappointing. This was the same with the sunbeds around the pool. We only used the hobbycat sailing boat but other facilities are available. I would recommend this hotels to others, just sort out the sunbed issue.

reviews.author: Austin H
reviews.title: Fantastic experiences
reviews.text: Luis Santana was probably the best person on the whole resort you can see him at the reserve beach drinks were always great his service was excellentand we could not be happier* if you stop by the reserve and stay by the beach ask for Luis santAna and Ramon Ramirez Also Jennifer in the concierge was more than helpful getting our reservations for dinner and attending to any of our needs we will return simply from the service we received from these three people everything else was splendid Silvio laantigua and Santos fria and Jose Luis de Los santos all provided services for my girlfriend and I to a level of professionalism never experienced in a all inclusive resorts we have been to

reviews.author: Ted K
reviews.title: Returned for the 3rd Time
reviews.text:
My wife and I returned to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for the 3rd time in 3 years.  We vacationed with friends of ours that have been coming here for many years.  The staff took care of our every need.  Anuvy our concierge, Luis our butler and Mikey Mike who looks like he has made a nice transition from the beach were all polite and helpful and accommodating.  I also want to call out Emilio out at the pool and Santos at the beach for their excellent service.  Saving the best for last.  One of the reasons I keep coming back is Ramon and Luis out at the beach.  It is so refreshing to be greeted on our first day with Welcome Back My Fam-I-Ly. I know we will always have a nice refreshing drink on hand with refills of ice whenever needed.  They all work so hard to make sure everyone is taken care of.

The resort is beautiful.  We spend most of our time at the beach and then come back to the Reserve pool afterwards.  The restaurants are mostly very good.  I recommend the tasting and wine pairing at Passion.  There is a charge over the All-Inclusive but its worth it.  Love The Grill as well.  

All in all a great vacation.  Looking forward to seeing everyone again next year (unless we go back in august!)

reviews.author: Natan C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We visit the hotel to eat and see the night life and was great there for young people all day activities and the beach just near it was great location excellent transport between our hotel to this one next time I will go to this one coz is more alive

reviews.text: Estuvimos aqui mi esposa y yo y la pasamos de maravilla gracias al gran servicio de fernando geronimo de room service mas que un camarero alguien muy especial para nosotros porque gracias a el nuestros dias fueron fabulosos gracias fernando por todo te mandamos besos desde venezuela...

reviews.author: Peggy Ann C
reviews.title: Disappointed and frustrated
reviews.text: Rerserve rooms were too far from the beach very inconvenient. For the price they should be on the beach. We did not have the Family concierge so we could not get any beach or pool cabanas. We had to wait until 10 and by then they were all taken. Personal concierge said she would check on a cabana for us each day and did not get back to us. They asked our dinner choices first day of checkin for the entire stay. I don't know why because dinner reservations can only be made day of and then we could not get the times we wanted even though we were requesting first thing each morning. Shuttles for dinner took a very long time to get. Waited over 30 minutes during "rush" hour. When paying over $850/nt would expect a little more attention to details and customer expectations. .My son wanted to play basketball. The full size court is on the far end of the property near the tennis courts but they don't have a basketball there, you have to go to the beach which is about a 25 min walk from there. There is a nice hoop on the beach but the basketballs are in the worst condition, threads, seams pulled apart, lumpy. Seriously, this property can't invest in a couple of $20 basketballs???  Would not return to this property.

reviews.author: Perry L
reviews.title: Exceptional

reviews.author: gentilhom
reviews.title: Fabuleux: voilà le mot juste
reviews.text:
Encore une fois, notre séjour fut magnifique; j'écris encore parce que nous avons adopté l'endroit depuis quelques années quand nous allons à Punta Cana. Et je pourrais facilement écrire la phrase à l'envers parce que l'équipe, autant celle de la Réserve que du Paradisus, nous a manifestement adoptés elle aussi!

Nous y avons donc séjourné pour Pâques, un beau deux semaines, du 28 mars au 11 avril. Ce qui me donne, au final, pas moins de dix semaines au Paradisus ou à La Réserve; je crois donc savoir ce dont je parle. Et encore une fois, ce fut magique, merci en  cela à notre géniale amie Christelle, promue directrice générale de l'hôtel, une promotion amplement méritée après qu'elle ait fait de la Réserve le NUMÉRO UN de tous les établissements répertoriés sur Tripadvisor. Rien de moins. Si vous pensez que ca pourrait être difficile pour The Reserve de conserver la pôle, c'est parce que vous ne connaissez pas notre autre bon ami, Carlos, son successeur et donc nouveau chef de la Réserve, un homme né pour briller dans le secteur hôtelier et qui nous a même dit, au moment de quitter, que ce serait encore meilleur la prochaine fois! Oufffff, on n'en demande pas tant! Nous devons autant à lui qu'à Christelle de sincères remerciements pour les gâteries qu'ils nous ont si gentiment offertes... Merci également à celui que j'appelle "The Ray of Sun", Angel, le sommelier dont je n'avais pas le prénom quand j'ai écrit mon dernier résumé mais qui nous a encore lui aussi généreusement gâtés, mon épouse et moi dans ce qui représente les petites touches qui font d'un établissement un "vrai" cinq étoiles... pour ne pas dire un CINQ PLUS.

Au risque de me répéter en relation avec ce que j'ai déjà écrit dans de précédents résumés que vous pouvez lire sur mon profil, je recommande fortement le Paradisus, notre hôtel numéro UN en République Dominicaine... et nous en avons pourtant visité de très bons et beaux ailleurs dont les Bahias et le Majestic ainsi que le Paradisus Palma Real. Le Paradisus Punta Cana demeure bon premier pour nous, en particulier The Reserve. Parlant du Paradisus Palma Real, nous sommes allés y passer quelques heures, avec la bénédiction du nouveau chef, Miguel Rideiro, jusqu'alors chef de la Réserve au Paradisus Punta Cana, qui nous a recus comme si nous étions le Roi et la Reine... merci Miguel pour ce délicieux repas que nous avons dégusté en ton agréable compagnie! Parlant de nourriture, on a encore très très bien mangé pendant notre séjour, et bien que je fasse beaucoup de sports, j'ai quand même pris un ou deux kilos pendant le voyage, ca vous donne une idée des festins qu'on s'est offert... La Palapa, le Vento, le Aqua et le Grill, ainsi que le Bana ont surtout été appréciés, sans oublier le buffet du Naos, qui nous a semblé avoir de meilleurs choix que le Gabi Beach, cette fois-ci.

Un autre superbe séjour, donc, et vous me laisserez saluer les services offerts par des employés ou patrons dont les noms méritent d'être mentionnés ici: notre merveilleuse équipe de concierges à la plage (Ramon, Luis, Wander et Santos), notre meilleur concierge dans l'édifice 39 ou nous étions, Monsieur Beltre, Cesar, le gérant du Vento, qui nous accueille comme si nous faisions partie de sa propre famille, nos super serveurs Janinin et Luis, comme toujours, du Gabi Club, et Celsio du Vento, l'équipe des femmes de chambre, dont la superviseure est la dynamique Cleybi, mes amis du tennis, Ambi et Domingo (malheureusement, mon meilleur partenaire parmi ceux-ci, Jose était absent au moment de notre séjour...), les sympathiques Josef et Emilio de la piscine de la Réserve, Monsieur Wilson, le très efficace chauffeur en chef pour les navettes entre la Réserve et la plage... et combien d'autres que je ne peux pas tous et toutes nommer! Je tiens à ce que tous ces gens sachent que c'est un grand privilège que la Vie nous fait, celui de pouvoir passer ces moments en votre si précieuse compagnie, Nous vous reverrons bientôt :)

reviews.author: Seekerle
reviews.title: Vacation club review
reviews.text: we have come for at least 4 or 5 years. Missed last year. The overall experience has been great. Food at Naos seems to be elevated. Francisco Estrella at our club pool and beach is hustling as ever. Am always amazed at how well this place is taken care of. "Mac" from activities keeps us going as well. This is a great place for a family vacation. Time seems to melt away.

reviews.author: Harry T
reviews.title: Would go with 4 1/2 if I could
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve for 5 nights & traveled with 2 other families.   Estefania was our family concierge & she was great.  Made all of our dinner reservations (tip:  if travelling with a big group, break up the party into smaller groups if you want to get later dinner reservations - most of our reservations were for 6:00, though we usually didn't get there until 6:15 or so & it wasn't a problem)  She also reserved cabanas at the pools and beach.  She was great with the kids, as well.

The food was pretty good overall.  We were very impressed with the buffets for breakfast - large selection & made to order omelettes.  Lots of different fruit juices & the fresh fruit was incredible.  We weren't thrilled with Fuego, the Latin Fusion restaurant.  Our favorite was Ventu, the Mediterranean restaurant.  The Grill (Argentinian Steakhouse) was just not good for lunch, but we heard it's much better for dinner.  Had lunch at Mole (Mexican) several times - excellent!  Jose at Bana made our last dinner at Bana (Japanese steakhouse) entertaining!

The pools are awesome.  Drink service at the beach & pools is not fast, but Ramon & Santos were great guys & always had a smile!!  They were working hard - just a lot of people to take care of.  If the resort is crowded, don't expect really speedy service, even if you tip. (The employees don't "expect" tips, but certainly appreciate it)

The grounds were beautiful & the weather was great.  The surf was pretty heavy & brought LOTS of seaweed a couple of the days, but that didn't deter us from boogie boarding & body surfing!!  Our boys enjoyed the bungee jumping/trampolines.  Shows are nothing to write home over (though we did particularly enjoy the jazz band Friday night!)

The bars are plentiful.  Upcharges for premium liquors.  Only serve Presidente Beer (which is pretty good as long as it's cold!!)

The Spa was very nice.  Ana was an excellent masseuse.  Kind of small.  NIce private pool, but it only had 2 chairs.

Overall, we would definitely return here if we ever make it back to the DR!!

reviews.author: Raydioman61
reviews.title: Glad it was free!
reviews.text:
Annually, we go on a  reward trip, given to the top salespeople at my wife's company.  We've gone to places like Costa Rica, Cabo, Florida, etc, usually at a golf oriented resort.  The five day trip to Paradisus Palma Real happened in early April, 2015.

First of all, my review is based on my previous resort experience.. Some people will have different opinions than mine, different people have different tastes.

I'll say right off, that if you are looking for a private, romantic get-a-way with your spouse, spending quiet, relaxing time on the beach, listening to the waves lapping up to the beach and the wind ruffling through the palm trees, this probably isn't the spot for you.. I say this, because this is very family friendly, and you will have lots of kids screaming at the pool and at the beach.  That is one strike against already for me, because I like it peaceful.
Secondly, the rooms look fancy when you walk in, but as you look closer, there are lots of flaws and lack of attention to detail.  We had an upgraded room, which had a kitchen, as well as a dining area and living room.  The bathroom had a leak near the commode, which had obviously been there for quite awhile, since you could see the repair attempts, and also the floor drain in the little commode 'nook'.  Also, ceiling fans didn't work in the living room area.

This is an "all inclusive" resort, meaning that most of the restaurants are free.. There are a couple that are extra, most are included.  I didn't enjoy the food at any meal, the coffee wasn't good (they didn't even know how to make a latte, or other coffee drinks.. That's disappointing, since they are supposed to have excellent coffee in this country.

One really positive thing about the beach here.. the sand is white and soft, you don't need any kind of shoes to walk in it.  It's very nice.. However, during my time at the beach, there was loud, thumpin' music being played, both on the beach, and on party boats just off the beach.. There was no place, during the day, at least, where you could find a peaceful, romantic spot, if that's what you are looking for.

Room service started good, but went downhill the longer we stayed.  Most of the employees understand English, but few speak it well.  We had several days where clean towels weren't put in the bathroom, and coffee packets/stocked refrigerator items weren't replaced.  Wifi is terrible here.. I know, you're at a resort, you should be out enjoying it, not logged in to your computer.. but, it would be nice to check online for area events or information.. I thought maybe it was just our room, but almost everyone in our very large group had the same issues with the internet.

Here are some tips.. a cab ride to the Hard Rock Casino Resort is $30 BOTH WAYS.. taxi cabs are expensive here.  All the roads have speed bumps, and motorbike/scooter taxis crowd the road.  We went to see the Don Lucas cigar makers, and I did enjoy that.. However, the guard there, walked around with a shotgun, and that made me alittle nervous.  In face, every resort or business in that area, has a gated guard shack, and the guards are all packin' the heat, which says something about the country.

The small mall is just down the street from the resort, you probably could walk there, but the resort does have a free wagon ride down to it and back every fifteen minutes.. We bought our Larimar stuff there, at the jewelry shop.. Most of the stores are American type stores, like Addidas, Dior, etc.. they even have a Hard Rock Cafe, and Outback Steakhouse.

I love palm trees and peaceful beaches.. This place has the palm trees, but it's not peaceful to me.. Others will have a different opinion, as I said before, everybody has their own opinions.  I don't see any reason why I need to go back here, I can get pretty much the same stuff in south Florida.

reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
We stayed in a Royal Service room and had a wonderful experience. Most beautiful beach we have been to (yet).  Each morning we would go to the Royal Service Lounge for coffee.  Fernando Gonzales makes the most incredible coffee.  Then we headed to the beach and the palapa and Bali bed that Francisco reserved for us. Such a hard working guy. Guided us to the right restaurants. He even assisted us with some of our family members who were not staying in Royal Service.  We at one point mentioned it was our wedding anniversary that week. Definitely recommend the Fuego restaurant.  The Blue Agave restaurant was also good - and Gregory was a joy.  The other restaurants were good, though not remarkable.

The rooms were clean and a good size.  Furniture could use an update.

Overall, a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: JeremAnais
reviews.title: Super
reviews.text:
Séjour d'une semaine en novembre 2014, vacances qui ont été super.
Commencons juste par les points négatifs : aucun personnel qui parle francais, heureusement nous nous sommes débrouillés avec notre anglais et espagnol.  
2eme point négatif : la lumière du balcon ne marchait pas, dès le premier jour nous l'avons signalé, et ce après plusieurs fois mais sans succès. Dommage car pas très  sympa pour rester un peu dehors le soir. 
3eme et dernier point négatif : la plage rempli d'algues  (plages et dans mer). Mais au bout d'une  semaine ca en faisait presque des montagnes. Dommage qu'il n'y est pas eu de ramassage.
A part cela, nous avons quand même noté cette hôtel excellent car nous nous sommes régalés.  Formule family concierge  (à  l'achat il ne restait plus que ça ) et all inclusive, nous avons été  chouchouté  et ce grâce à  estafania (désolé de l'orthographe si c'est  pas bien écrit ). Le buffet était  juste excellent, limite meilleur que les restaurants. Chambre relativement propre sauf la douche (trace jaune au sol). Animations tous les soirs ce qui permettais aucun ennui.grande piscine et agréable mais difficile pour trouver un transat malgré  le nombre important. 
Encore merci estafania toujours avec le sourire un bonheur. Merci également à  roselina, luis, et ramon (beach).
Nous songeons à  y retourner fin d'année.

reviews.author: sunny4966
reviews.title: Very Good - A few flaws
reviews.text:
Took family of 4 in April 2015. Best friend and his family also came as well. 

The Pros
The weather, beaches and hotel rooms were great. Very clean, felt safe everywhere we went. Plenty of shade, plenty of room on beach. If you got a very late start there would have been some challenges in getting room at the reserve pool.

The Cons
Service. We did NOT get the royal service ($500+) as we figured it cost enough for a family of 4. This made getting reservations at the restaurants more difficult. I know we went during a busy week, but it was hard getting times we wanted for 7 people. But, even with that, drink service was surprisingly slow everywhere. I tipped at least $5 to start each round and mostly never saw the same server again. When we went to the Melia Caribe a few years ago, we tipped early and got great service all week. They knew our names quickly.

Dinner
While breakfast and lunch choices were pretty good, the dinners were below average. The Italian place called Aqua was the worse, just bad food and limited choices. The other places were just "OK". I was expecting much better food for what I paid and what I have received from other all inclusive resorts *Warning*, there are 2 restaurants that have an upcharge and one of them does not allow any kids.  

Entertainment
Not many shows going on at night for those who like them. We did see one on Sunday night and it was quite good. But overall, there was not a lot of things going on. The bars looked active and fun at night, but because we were with younger kids, we did not hang out there.

Other
We had an AC problem the first night and they did not fix until the next day. It was not a big deal as we had 2 units and 1 was working, but it could have been a problem for those rooms with one unit. Room cleaning was excellent.

If money is not a problem, get the special concierge service. This will make things easier and also gets you first dibs on the pool huts and dinner reservations. If not, you will need to work the phones harder to get your reservations. Get up by 8am to reserve your spot by the pool or beaches. We took a cab for $10 per person to hotel from airport, Much quicker than waiting on the transfers. Give yourself 2.5+ hours time at the airport on the way home, you will need every minute of it.

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Beautiful & Relaxing: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We enjoyed a relaxing 7 days at Paradisus Punta Cana, staying at the Reserve and Royal Service. The Atlantic is 80 degrees: delicious and exciting. The weather in mid-March was beautiful each day. The folks who work there are truly hospitable and helpful.
First we (3 of us) would like to thank staff for their kindness and hospitality: 
At La Palopa: Samuel, Maira, Quintina, and Billy, their smiles and daily courtesy brought smiles to our faces, and they were so gentle and magnificent. 
On the beach, Matiel Reyes made sure we were well accommodated each and every day. 
And at the Reserve, Vianka Vasques and Anuvi Aquino professionally addressed our concerns with small issues in our rooms as well as helping us to understand how to check out. They were consummate professionals and well able to reassure us that our questions would all be completely addressed. 
Last, in Membership, Alicia and Katie helped to address our desire to increase our membership benefits and to them, we are completely thankful. 
We look forward to our next visit in October/November 2015...Linda, David & Randy

reviews.author: Philippe Andre G
reviews.title: Once again, a vacation of a lifetime.
reviews.text:
We had a excellent stay at The Reserve. Truly a vacation of a lifetime. This Resort exceeds our expectations with every passing year (3rd time back).

We highly recommend this Resort! A guaranteed amazing holiday.
