reviews.author: Joanne S
reviews.title: 14th Repeat visit… a wonderful time once again
reviews.text:
This was our 14th visit to the hotel and we once again enjoyed every minute of our two week stay. We have made so many good friends at the hotel and meet up with them each year as many guests repeat their experience year after year at the hotel. This year the new General Manager, Mr. Rodrigo Silveyra and his Assistant General Manager, Christelle, kindly invited us to a special cocktail and dinner with other repeat clients and it was both fun and fascinating to spend a pleasant evening getting to know other like-minded people from around the world and listening to the reason they also enjoy going back every year.
The gardens and mangrove swamps are absolutely stunning and are beautifully maintained. I love walking from the Reserve down to the beach, enjoying the natural beauty and design of the gardens and saying good morning to the friendly gardeners and other staff working hard in maintenance and housekeeping, etc. 
The beach is stunning and has the best beach furniture compared to all other hotels and the luxury of friendly waiters passing by and serving your favourite drinks and fruit directly to your sunbed. 

After so many years we have our favourite places where we hang out and wonderful staff who take care of our every need. It is impossible to name everyone as they are all so kind and helpful, however, we are especially grateful to the boys at the tennis and padel courts (Ambiorii & Domingo), Juan Cruz, Juan Bautista, Pablo & Julio at the pool bar next to the beach, Emilio and his colleague at the Reserve pool, Jorge in the main lobby bar, Socrates and Juan Castillo for their help wherever we are!!, Valentin the Executive Chef who works miracles everyday, Leidy (aka Elisabeth) our Personal Concierge who also helps us every year with anything and everything and works miracles to make dinner reservations for our group of 14 at a time when the hotel is completely full. We are also well known now and very well taken care of in the different restaurants and in particular by Marlen and her colleague who cooks the fesh pasta at lunchtime in the Naos, Santana, Jessica and Adalberto in the Gaby, Daniel in the Fuego, Lilian in the Acqua, etc. etc. A special thanks also to Carolina Sacristan, Executive Assistant, who we have known for years and who always goes out of her way to help us.

Our only disappointment this year was the lack of local music (bachata, merengue, etc.) in the pool bar at the beach and at the bar in the main lobby. The chill out areas of the Reserve and the Gaby Beach are wonderful, however the hotel loses its soul and authenticity when there is no local music to be heard anywhere. Many guests noticed this and a particular family who also repeat every year but whom we hadn't met before, took the initiative to write a polite letter to the management asking for them to re-introduce the beautiful and fun local music - at least for a few hours a day. Many other guests signed the letter and we also happily agreed. They then handed the letter to the manager who very kindly listened and then re-introduced the music for a few hours the very next day. Thank you Mr. Silveyra!

People frequently ask us why we go back every year and we reply "Why not?". The hotel is so special, elegant, authentic and fun. There are 11.5 months of the year left to travel to other places (which we do) and so why should we stop going to a hotel that we absolutely love and where we have made so many very special friends and enjoy every single minute of our stay??? Our children have practically grown up there and although now in their teens, they would be so upset if we ever said we weren't going back. It's a win/win for both parents and children and we will all be back again next year! Thank you to everyone at the Reserve and the Paradisus Punta Cana for the hundreds of little details that make our annual stay so enjoyable and memorable!!

reviews.author: 865Ing
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text:
From the first glimpse of the breathtaking lobby view of the ocean front pools and beaches to the gracious hospitality staff, Palma Real Paradisus felt like home during our week's vacation.  Tomas Newton, Louisanda and the Royal Service staff took special care in arranging all of our dinner reservations.  Pedro our beachfront concierge greeted us each day with a smile as he set up the perfect chicki!  Passions staff especially Sergio and Raymond made our last night extra special with their attentive service. Beachfront buffet has improved dramatically since our last stay in 2007!  Waiters--Francisco and Manuel made us feel welcome at the buffet.  
The room was clean and housekeeping kept us stocked with clean towels and plenty of bottled water. They kept our room stocked with top shelf liquor and Nespreso pods.  Each afternoon, when we returned from the beach, we found a cheese plate waiting for us.  Each evening our beds were turned down and a small piece of chocolate was left on our pillow.
One morning we had a wonderful exchange with a landscaper, who opened a coconut for us so we could try the island delicacy of fresh coconut water!!
Of course, there is room for improvement. Ibana, the Japanese Restaurant, was a major disappointment.  The food was bland. The atmosphere was loud, and the waitstaff was inattentive.  This was surprising because the sushi in the buffet was much tastier and fresher than the fair at Ibana's! That same evening, management scheduled dueling live music events on the beach.  Paradisus, for that brief time, was quite unnerving!!!  I was a bit frustrated with the unresponsive front desk, who promised to have the management contact me regarding my concerns.  I never heard back!!
Nonetheless, we enjoyed an incredible 7-day vacation in DR thanks to the staff at Paradisus!!

reviews.author: Karon G
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Estubimos yo y mi familia en este excelente hotel y nos encanto el gran servicio que nos dio room service Muy buena comida excelentes atenciones especialmente de nuestro deliveri. Favorito fernando Geronimo May cortez y professional muchas gracias a el por todo..!!

reviews.author: Sandy L
reviews.title: Perfect Wedding in Paradise
reviews.text:
I was extremely impressed how beautiful and well kept this resort was. This review is extremely late but there was so many good things to say about Paradisus. I LOVED IT. My wedding was flawless everyone was very helpful and my wedding was exactly as I planned it. 1 week wasn't enough to enjoy everything this resort had to offer. 

The check in was quick and easy they gave us a tour of the place along with the glass of champagne. This resort was very big and is split into two parts the reserve and the normal side. And they give you bracelets so they know which side you're suppose to be. The reserve was huge and had more private pools and their own swim up bars. Most of my family and friends were on the normal side so we didn't really get to use the reserve side. 

The bedroom was well kept and we got more towels as needed. The shower however was a little off you really had to play with the handle to get it to warm. Otherwise no complaints about our room. We got a room close by the main pool and the bar was right outside of our sliding door. I didn't find it to be too noisy so it was a good spot for us as it was close to the buffet and beach. So if you don't like the walk i would suggest getting a room closer to the beach as again its a huge resort. We used the train lots while we were here other wise its a 30min walk to the main lobby, club and casino. 

The food was awesome lots of variety and the A la cartes were really good too i really enjoyed the Japanese restaurant the food was excellent. Make sure you book your a la carts as soon as you get there and also check the board at the main lobby it will tell you what entertainments they will be having all week. 

The beaches were spectacular, it was clean and there were guards out so none of the people would approach you to sell you trinkets. 

BE SURE TO BRING BUG SPRAY I was fine because i wore it ALL THE TIME but sand fleas and mosquito's were super bad for some of us, that goes for everywhere else too.

Check out the club in the lobby we had a blast and they had really good beats. 

We had Vladimir as our Butler and he was the nicest person I've met he really went beyond my expectations. He drove us everywhere and was super helpful the day of the wedding. Every time we called him he was available. He really made our stay wonderful even when i was stressing out about our wedding he insured everything would be perfect and he was right. Jennifer and Miguelina helped me with  my wedding. Jennifer arranged an appointment to go over final details with me a couple days before the wedding. I thank you for how smooth everything went during out stay :) If you are renting the bridal suite i would recommend the bigger suite by the beach there was so much room for me and my bridesmaids to get ready in. And the room was beautiful and luxurious. Oh and thank you for the staff who got me super glue as one of my gel nails broke !! life savers !! thank  you

Again my wedding was perfect if you're looking to book a destination wedding in Punta Cana I would recommend The Reserve at Paradisus. 

Thank you so much for the wonderful trip I will be returning for sure.

Sandy

reviews.author: Denzle_Boy
reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text:
We have recently returned from a trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. It was a special trip and one that took around 4 months to research, plan and book. 

I don't usually write reviews but I wanted to quash some of the criticism I'd read before our trip AND put down in writing my gratitude to those who went above and beyond to make our special 2 week holiday unforgettable. 

To say I researched the trip before we booked is an understatement. In total, I think I must have spent 24hours+ looking at hotels, reviews on T-A and playing different booking sites off each other to get the best rate. I must admit to being a little apprehensive about going to the hotel because of a few reviews citing "overly aggressive marketing - flogging timeshare" and "rude staff" etc. However, in the 2 weeks we spent in the hotel I saw plenty of smartly dressed (what I can only assume to be) marketing staff, but we were never approached about time shares specifically, only by people asking how we were and were we having a good time. We also didn't experience any rude staff, on the contrary - almost without exception, the customer service was excellent.

A few of the staff went "above and beyond" our expectations though and I wanted to say thanks.

Firstly, Melvin Brizon (chef) and Frank Mertinez (waiter) who work the "Grill" area were AMAZING. Melvin made sure we have everything we wanted and even cooked us special food that wasn't on the menu when I asked. Frank made sure our table was just how we liked it, even arranging ice buckets and playing with my daughter when she was irritable.

The drinks guys were hilarious and great fun, especially Jose Reinoso, Jose Luis & Santos Fria. All can whip up a mean Pina Colada and ALL will serve you like a king / queen.

I would have absolutely no doubt in recommending this hotel. If you're a family, upgrade to the Concierge service. Well worth it.

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: ACE......Amazing, inCrediable, Exceptional!!!!!!!!
reviews.text:
What a place..........my husband and I and our 5 year old daughter have just returned from the most spectacular holiday at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  The stunning landscape, luxury accommodation and tranquil pool and beach settings were matched by the ACE staff!!!!  The staff can truly not do enough for you and enable you to relax and enjoy your holiday creating tremendous memories.

We decided to go for the 'Family Concierge', our Concierge was called Diosmery Francisco, she was absolutely amazing, caring and really made our daughter feel like a 'princess'.  It was our daughters 5th birthday whilst we were there and Diosmery arranged some magical surprises for her, again just building spectacular memories. Diosmery......if you are reading this thank you again, you were fantastic and Evalina says 'hi' xxx

A truly wonderful holiday filled with luxury and relaxation.  I would highly recommend the Family Concierge for a well planned and hassle free holiday.

reviews.author: SunshineFamily
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with mediocre food and service.
reviews.text: The hotel facility is spectacular and the scenery is wonderful. The foundation is set, but there is a whole lot of education that needs to go in with the staff on what top level service is. They are all incredibly friendly, but there is a language barrier and miscommunication, mediocre service at the main restaurant, and the food (other than 1 or 2 of the restaurants) could use a whole overhaul. Truthfully they need to bring in a top chef to set the menus and recipes and recreate the entire offering.

reviews.author: mugsyOntario
reviews.title: Truly Paradise!
reviews.text: unbelievably excellent! The food is the best we have ever had at an all inclusive. The room is gorgeous. Comfortable bed, full size fridge, beautiful balcony. The grounds are impeccable and the service outstanding. Francisco Estralla is the best! Attention to detail and so friendly!!! We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Marta L
reviews.title: Piscina Family Concierge
reviews.text: Nuestra estadía está siendo más que placentera gracias a la amable y permanente atención de Francisco Estrella. Es muy atento y permanentemente se preocupa por saber de nuestras necesidades. Me prepara unos licuados de frutas exquisitos junto a todo el equipo del Sunrise Bar. Es muy atento y respetuoso además siempre está alegre y sonriente. Excelente!!

reviews.author: stuka_1939
reviews.title: Piscina family concierge
reviews.text: Por este medio quiero agradecer sobremanera la hospitalidad, recibimiento,  cordialidad, profesionalismo y siempre predispuesto a evacuar cualquier duda de los clientes del hotel al señor FRANCISCO ESTRELLA. Es la segunda oportunidad que visitamos este lugar y realmente nos sentimos muy a gusto. A pesar que hacía dos años que no veníamos se acordaba perfectamente de nosotros y eso es muy importante para los miembros del club ya que nos sentimos más a gusto.  Gracias

reviews.title: amazing family vacation
reviews.text: service, food , rooms , pools really as oustanding, this is our second time iin this hotel and we can not think to change for another, they treat us as vip, in special to carlos san jose, he solve all our douts and he was there when we need him, my kids really love this place

reviews.author: ironfist2015
reviews.title: Second time as great as the first!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to Paradisus in the Dominican. My family fell in love with this resort the first time we visited The Reserve at Palma Real.  The Reserve at Punta Cana is just as outstanding. We felt like we were visiting old friends from the moment we returned. The staff and property are wonderful.  Thank you to Rodrigo Silveyra for taking the time to visit us during our visit.  Put Paradisus on your list of must visit resorts!

reviews.author: Enrique P
reviews.title: Fun Vacation
reviews.text: The service was great, our Mayordomo Elvis Hidalgo was excellent and at the pool Francisco Cabrera and Leonarbo Mota they were excellent and gives you a lot of attention . The service of the worker in the restaurant were excellent, also the beach and pools. But the Wi-Fi wasn't that great, it was very slow.

reviews.author: mirenvicente
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text:
Great hotel for family vacations. Kids enjoyed all the activities. Restaurants for dinner are excellent but with high demand which requires family flexibility to adapt to availability. All personal in the hotel were very helpful but Mr. Vladimir Rodriguez (assistant manager) and Mr. Juan Suarez (Naos restaurant) were absolutely outstanding.
Highly recommended if you are looking for a family vacation

reviews.author: zfahr
reviews.title: Top Notch Resort / Food / Beach / Service
reviews.text:
I had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  I had the opportunity to check out each of the Paradisus Properties as well as the Melia Tropical Carbe, they are all simply incredible.  I have never had food at an all inclusive resort that was as incredible as Palma Real.  Each dinner would easily be $100 + per couple if you received the same quality, service, and ambiance at a normal restaurant. 

Throw out any idea of any resort you have ever stayed at because this one stands alone.  We will be back and are greatly looking forward to it..

reviews.author: Rick L
reviews.title: High School Seniors Group Trip - Just Perfect
reviews.text: A group of parents traveled with their kids (all were high school seniors) and couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the time we woke up each day and enjoyed the elaborate breakfast buffet until we called it a night after dropping a few $$$ in the casino it was a perfect vacation. The rooms were just fine. If you're worried about certain luxuries missing then you're spending too much time in the room. If you're in a large group arrange to have someone like George Alriche set your lounge chairs up before you arrive and then the drinks will keep coming non stop. Trust me - look for George. He was well worth the extra we paid him. Food at the restaurants far exceeded the typical fare at all inclusives. Fresh fish, beef and fruits. Never left any one in our group hungry. Stayed 4 nights and that was ideal. Oh and the kids loved it all too.

reviews.author: Lucia A
reviews.title: Amazing, as always
reviews.text: My family and I have been visiting this resort almost every holy week for 7 years. Every time we go we have a great time and are never disappointed. We receive the best service and treatment. We are specially grateful to Carlos San Jose who is a great friend and always helps us so we can have the best family vacation possible.

reviews.author: CK-Mich
reviews.title: Great Stay - Wonderful Service
reviews.text:
We had the best service - paid extra for the Royal Service. Everyone worked so hard to make sure that our stay was relaxing - especially Padro Cedano and Leonardo Mota. Padri always made sure that we had a great spot by the pool or on the beach. Leonardo made the greatest drinks - you'll know its him, he looks like a young Mohammed Ali.  They never stopped looking out for us. 

Beautiful rooms and good good food. We would visit again.

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, everyone was very friendly,always smiling and most helpful. Our private butler Jeuri Ferreira was the greatest. He was there for us whenever we needed him and he was always very pleasant and you can tell he loves what he does. It shows in the way he treats you.
A must try.

reviews.author: amy z
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: This resort was great, I was very skeptical coming here since I had only done reviews online and never knew anyone who has stayed here but THIS PLACE WAS GREAT! We had a 2 bedroom family concierge suite and the service was excellent Elaine was our hotel concierge and she was awesome..Valentin henriquez who worked for club melia was FABULOUS! He helped to arrange a lot of beach activities and both encourage us to join melia for all the added benefits and they are worth it with all the added services. Leo our sales rep was also excellent to work with. Would HIGHLY recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: 0_Lucio_0
reviews.title: Um sonho
reviews.text: Estivemos em lua de mel na ala do Royal Service e não poderia ser melhor. Hotel maravilhoso, instalações bem cuidadas, restaurantes excelentes, wi-fi pega até na praia.. Todos os funcionários amorosos, alegres e prestativos, principalmente o Francisco Cabrera que nos auxiliava sempre com muita alegria na praia e na piscina com seus deliciosos drinks, e ao nosso querido mordomo Elvis, que foi sensacional e muito gentil, nos preparando surpresas maravilhosas, perfeito! Só temos elogios a tudo e a todos! Esperamos poder voltar logo!

reviews.author: Danielle A
reviews.title: GRACIS!
reviews.text:
The staff was so friendly and attentive, especially Big Mac, Angel, Ray Ray. They were easy to talk with and their activities such as Zumba and involvement with the Michael Jackson show were so fun!  They were constantly making me laugh and got me involved in activities I wouldn't normally do. The trip wouldn't have been the same without them!!! GRACIS! GRACIS! GRACIS!

The blondes - Danielle, Jamie, and Patti (mommi)

reviews.author: Nancy M
reviews.title: The resort exceeded my expectations!
reviews.text:
In general, I am a very hard person to please and have high expectations. I was obsessed with reading reviews for months before we actually went on our spring break vacation and was nervous about some of the issues people had with the resort.  I actually found none.  From the moment we got to the resort, throughout the entire stay, it was a wonderful experience for our family, my husband, me, and 3 kids ages 12, 9, and 7. We stayed in the reserve, and had Diosmery as our concierge.  She explained everything we needed to know, made all of our reservations for the pool, beach and dinners and answered the phone every time we had a question.  The kids loved her!  We didn't have to worry about anything which made the vacation that much more relaxing.  She actually wanted to upgrade us the Villa, which was incredible!  Your own house on the beach, private pool, cabana, etc. but we just didn't have enough room for all 5 of us to sleep...such a shame, it really was incredible! The two rooms in the reserve had a large amount of space, 2 bathrooms so we could get ready that much quicker. 
So many people complained about the 7-8 minute walk to the beach, but I got excited doing it everyday..the grounds are beautiful, clean and constantly kept up.  Not only did we get exercise, but enjoyed the views, the music, the friendly people and the beautiful weather.  I loved staying in the reserve because it was hardly crowded, no lines and fast service.
All of the restaurants had very good food, I have stayed in other all inclusives and was completely bored by the options by the third day, but each day was  a different cuisine and tasty as well.  Make sure you have dinner on the beach...the view is amazing.  
The service here is spectacular, you actually never feel a need to tip but we did just because.  We listened to other people, they had a hard time getting change, so we brought a lot of tip money just in case...it certainly went a long way but generally was not necessary.  
This resort thinks of everything to make your stay completely pleasurable.  I was also nervous about everyone talking about the hard sell for the club Melia...we just said from the beginning no thanks, and it was never a problem again.  Free wifi is EVERYWHERE!  What a plus!
We all were sad to leave after a week stay, we will surely return!

reviews.author: Jordan C
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We stayed for four days for my brother's wedding and were very dissatisfied with the whole experience. Had three issues with management that were handled poorly: they double charged us for the room; did not fix our running toilet; and locked our phones and purse in the room safe without notifying us (scared me half to death).

reviews.author: Hearts100
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Lovely Easter break. Great hotel. Thank you to everyone, especially Sandra our concierge who organised our time here so brilliantly. Would recommend to families and couples alike. 💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜

reviews.author: Tomás Ibañez
reviews.title: Paraiso para la Familia
reviews.text:
Somos una familia de 5 integrantes (los padres y niños de 7, 5 y 3 años). Fuimos muy bien recibidos y todos tuvimos una excelente vacación, incluyendo los padres!!!!!!! El servicio de Family Concierge es excelente y recomendable (aprovecho de agradecer a Leidie Elizabeth, excepcional), y también el equipo de Kid's Zone, amigable y profesional. A los niños les encantaba ir a las actividades.
Otro tema destacable es la calidad de la comida, pienso que es un "all inclusive" sin parecer un all inclusive, ya que la calidad es muy superior al estándar.
También recomiendo el restaurante "Passion", para una noche en pareja. No exagero en decir que es clase mundial con la calidez humana de los dominicanos.
En fin, realmente disfrutamos de la estadía, el personal está muy bien entrenado en servicio, lo cual es un agrado. Muchas gracias y esperamos volver.
Nuestros agradecimientos específicos a Leidie Elizabeth, Hilario Vásquez, Luis (de la playa), equipo de Kid's Zone y a Christel Lucchini por hacernos sentir tan en casa.

reviews.author: Yanaemaxim
reviews.title: Un giardino botanico
reviews.text: Struttura alberghiera eccellente , le piscine bellissime, Vegetazione eccellente,settimana  piena di eventi di animazione ,colazioni da sogno ,7 ristoranti a tema .Organizzazione perfetta. Per il Guest Sevice  affidatevi a Marlenis Vi aiuterà' per qualsiasi problema.  Segnaliamo per il tennis , Domingo , un istruttore disponibile è sempre  sorridente.      Per quanto riguarda l'animazione il cuore pulsante e senza alcun dubbio sono Oscar e Laissa veri insegnanti di balli latini , veri coreografi di spettacoli , degni  rappresentanti di un paese pieno di passione..  Grazie a tutti Voi

reviews.author: emily2205
reviews.title: Excelencia Meliá
reviews.text:
Excelentes instalaciones pero lo mas importante es la calidad de su gente. RTendríamos que hacer una lista muy grande pero nombraré a todos aquellos que hicieron posible esta experiencia de 7 días 
Empezando por Carlos San José y Julio de Club Meliá, ayuda indispensable para disfrutar al máximo de nuestra membresía
Francisco Gil, Aurora Portorreal y Francisco Cabrera la cara mas amable y eficiente de Royal Service que bien nos atendieron GRACIAS extraño los jugos de melón y las margaritas
También Martin Tineo, Pedro Cedan, Leonardo Mota, Carlos Rosario
Mención especial a Juán de Dios, supervisor de restaurantes no hubo un día ni una hora que no hiciera acto de presencia en los restaurantes con su sonrisa y buen hacer, guía a todo ese excelente personal 
Y el cuidado y atención de la gente del YHI SPA en especial Aracelis y la linda y simpática Angelyn GRACIAS
Esta vez disfrutamos de la experiencia en Passion Restaurant excelente y por supuesto la experiencia no podia ser sin el trato estupendo de Jorge Tirado, José y Zoris
No tengo los nombres de la gente que nos atendión en los otros restaurantes pero todos se merecen 5 estrellas 
Un recuerdo muy especial para Jorge nuestro mayordomo del año pasado en The Reserve que alegría verlo y mas alegría que nos reconociera entre tanta gente GRACIAS
Un reconocmimiento especial al grupo que dirige y realiza las amenidades que buenos son el show de Michael Jackson y todas las fiestas en Gabi Beach buenisimas felicitaciones
En cuanto a las instalaciones muy bien mantenidas y el nuevo área de Family Concierge en una de sus suites nos hospedamos modernas y muy bellas, deben mejorar un poco la atención en las habitaciones hubo varias noches que no hicieron la ronda correspondiente y faltó lenecería nuev, también sugerimos la colocación de colgadores en el baño para colocar toallas y batas.
El equipo de Scuba que presta el servicio de deportes acuaticos es excelente en especail Carlos que siempre nos atendió cuando ibamos a navegar Gracias
Este Hotel es excelente y lo recomendamos si quieren asegurarse unas vacaiones sin percances y disfrutar al máximo

reviews.author: Jamie H
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: I was awarded a trip to the Paradisus Palma Real for work and it was a very relaxing time. We had amazing accommodations in the Royal Service Suites where our butler, Jose Salvador was very helpful and thoughtful throughout our 4 day stay.

reviews.author: justaguy755
reviews.title: Great time and better service
reviews.text: Stayed for a week with my lady. We spent the extra money for royal service and it was worth the cost. Started most mornings with coffee made by Fernando Gonzalez in the Royal Service lounge. Angel was extremely helpful in making sure we had a cabana by the beach or pool every day. Leonardo the bartender recommended great  Dominican rum. Nickolas, our butler, was fantastic. If we return we will definitely request his service. Palazzo is the best restaurant and Alexander G. is the best server.

reviews.author: Andres2803
reviews.title: Los mejor de lo mejor
reviews.text: El lugar perfecto para nuestra luna de miel, un lugar espectacular y el servicio ni para que, especialmente nuestro mayordomo Francisco Santos y el servicio en la playa de Francisco Cabrera y Angel Frías, que hicieron que nuestras vacaciones fueran realmente inolvidables y nos sintiéramos en el paraíso! Mucha gracias por una experiencia que no olvidaremos jamás!

reviews.author: Michela V
reviews.title: El mejor servicio
reviews.text:
Francisco Cabrera y Ángel Frías han hecho que esta luna de miel sea la mejor!
Excelente servicio y un trato de reyes!! Recomendadisimo!!! Fransisco Santos el mayordomo más especial, dulce y atento que se pueda tener!! La mejor experiencia de mi vida!!

reviews.author: Aline Z
reviews.title: Bom serviço
reviews.text: Francisco Cabrera, atendimento 5 estrelas. Leonardo Motta, ótimos drinks! Francisco Santos nos atendeu perfeitamente, melhor mordomo do hotel! Muita variedade de restaurantes e comida maravilhosa em todos eles! fomos muito bem atendidos em todos os lugares. A praia é linda e a estrutura do hotel muito boa!

reviews.author: WagnerEscalao
reviews.title: Bom serviço
reviews.text: Francisco Cabrera and Leonardo motta são os melhores! Francisco Santos é o melhor mordomo do hotel! O atendimento nos restaurantes são muito bons e a comida maravilhosa! Com certeza voltaremos em breve!

reviews.author: Irania
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
This is our second time at this resort and we love it!! So happy we chose to come back! Amazing resort, the beach and the entire property are outstanding!!! Paradise!! Our 2 year old is having a blast and so are we!! Ray Ray and Big Mac are very entertaining and the danse lessons were so much fun!! Ray Ray has always a smile on his face and  ready to do everything to make your day!! 
The check in procces could have been better: faster and accurate ( we did not get in the right type of room from the 1st time); Hard to wait with a 2 year old.... And the reception did not seem to care a lot about their mistake and for the late check in.
..But overall we are having the time of our lives!!!
We'll definitely recommend this resort to our ftiends!!!

reviews.author: Andrew K
reviews.title: Very nice visit to Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our first visit to Punta Cana. The Reserve is a beautiful hotel with incredible grounds. I understood the benefits of the Reserve before we came ....very large rooms, less crowds, some exclusive restaurants and pool, but it not on the beach and by most other restaurants.  I enjoyed walking to the beach but others in our party took the trams that run constantly. The trams are fine. We tried a different restaurant every night which was nice. The restaurants are all fine...everyone has different menu and restaurant choice favorite but again all fine.  We are not picky eaters or drinkers.

We had a concierge for multiple rooms and she, Elaine, made a huge effort to keep us happy.  She did get us all the reservations we wanted for each night and if we showed any disappointment for anything she made it right.  Elaine did many special things for us that were nice touches and did also arrange a birthday cake with balloons for one of our party. Elaine arranged for special covered spots and either the beach or pool and this was important.  

I hear concierges are even a bigger benefit with kids. But it was nice to know there were some things not to worry about.  We also liked a guy who had a great attitude Mikey Mike. The servers and helpers at the pool and beach all had great attitudes.  

Overall a nice family visit to a great hotel for our party of 3 generations
Andy K. New Jersey

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Ask for Claury Carela
reviews.text: My husband and I have been lucky enough to travel all over the world because of his business. For our family spring break trip we took six family members  to the Dominican  Republic. Never, in all our years of globe trotting, have we received the service provided to us by the Paradisus Palma Real, and specifically by their incredible family concierge, Claury Carela.  When I say Claury went above and beyond all expectations, it's a major understatement. Her motto is: "anything is possible!" She foresaw our every need and added so many special touches throughout our stay. She gave us a special cell phone and told us to ring her at any hour, and she would make sure we were taken care of. Before we left for our trip, we weren't  sure if we would rebook for next year. Not only are we rebooked, my husband and I are going back in two months with another couple. We can't wait to see the newest member of our family again...Claury Corela!

reviews.author: Hola_Kimi
reviews.title: Concierge. Amenities. Atmosphere.
reviews.text: The sweet girls that concierged for Family Suite 24, rooms 2401, 2403 & 3401 specifically = the DOLAN & LUX families = were so gracious & helpful. They gave me a card with all of their names listed but I lost it in transit back home to cold New Jersey. Sorry girls but you were all so wonderful. Gracias! Highly recommended. Room service was great! All inclusive restaurants and buffets were great! Rooms were comfy & great! The people were so friendly & great! The mixed drinks at pool bars were typically awful but all other bars were great! Presidente beers are awesome too.

reviews.author: Lucas C
reviews.title: Inolvidable
reviews.text: es un verdadero paraíso , la gente esta todo el tiempo de buen humor , los servicios son muy buenos, con sus excelentes empleados , fue un gusto compartir con mi familia en este maravilloso hotel una semana de vacaciones .

reviews.author: Steve K
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful - clean, huge, well-kept up. The rooms are large, the beaches are pristine, the pool provides cabanas and lounge chairs. The weather was perfect.

Our concierge Elaine was attentive and helped to secure dinner reservations each night at the variety of restaurants. (We also liked Mikey Mike).

reviews.author: Fernando R
reviews.title: Wonderful experience at the Caribbean
reviews.text:
The Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real could be the best experience we had since many years (18) going to the Caribbean; nice, cozy and very comfortable room, very well decorated and clean hotel facilities, one of the best beaches in the world, nice and kind people to make us feel pampered: our greatest recognition to Miguel Santana (restaurants supervisor), Nicolás Maracallo and Fermin Mota (buttlers), Francisco Gil (bar and beach service), and specially Vicente Rubianes (Food & Beverages Director).

Fernando y Solange

reviews.author: Nikkkkkkki
reviews.title: Awesome time!!!
reviews.text: Everyone was so accommodating and friendly ! The bartenders at the pool bar, Antonio and Wellington were awesome! They always had our drinks ready for us and were so fun and personable! Big Mac and Jazz put on a great show and knew how to get the audience hyped! Our mini bar attendant, Angelo was so welcoming and happy to help us! Loved everything about the resort and can't wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Mary H
reviews.title: Culture
reviews.text: This place was great! Staff was so helpful! Very Clean. The only thing We were disappointed in was there was no Dominican food on the entire resort.  The service was outstanding, will be going back next year!

reviews.author: Arlene L
reviews.title: Second stay even better than the first!
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus Palma Real. Second stay there on a group trip with friends and our high school senior kids. Property is amazing! Rooms are luxurious and immaculate. Gorgeous beach, pool. The layout never makes it feel crowded. Food was excellent for an all-inclusive. Breakfast/lunch area was a major improvement from last trip...completely renovated. Dinners were mostly good. Didn't like food at Vento (Italian) as much. AQUA restaurant was excellent. This review wouldn't be complete without praising one employee... Georges Alriche. Although the entire staff was extremely courteous, George, as we called him went above and beyond to have beach chairs set up for our group, brought us drinks all day, and was just so pleasant and professional! Would definitely recommend this property for vacation!

reviews.author: Vinson L
reviews.title: Could the 2nd trip back to Paradisus Palma Real surpass the 1st Incredible one...
reviews.text: And the answer is YES! They say the second time around is better than the first and in the case I would have to agree 100%. Paradisus Palm Real you have out done ourselves!  It was great to see all of the staff who served us so graciously on our first trip to remember us when we returned. Just like old friends! OMG Linny Silverio (concierge) words cannot express our gratitude and love for the excellent care and thoughtfulness you provided to my wife and I. She made us feel like celebrities the entire time.  Thank you Linny!. Special thanks to Bruny (RCI) for his attention to detail and caring spirit. BIG SHOUT OUT to the activities staff; Mac (Macdona)...you the Man! Make sure you check out Mac and Angel in there acitivities they keep you moving! Francisco congratulations on your new postion you will be missed. Luis Martinez...the Mixologist! keep the Sangria's coming and we will take the credit for introducing the Sangria to the resort. Lol. All the shows were wonderful but The Lion King...Wow! it was incredible...great job Omar and dance company. Also the loved the new outside restaurant...great addition to an already awesome resort.  The food was Magnificent! All the restaurants staff deserve a 10 for their pleasantness and giving spirits. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn W
reviews.title: Perfect Vacation
reviews.text: My stay at the Reserve at the Paradisus was amazing and it wouldn't have been nearly as enjoyable if Ramon, Santos, Jose, Luis, and Yarol hadn't been so accommodating. They catered to my families every need and were so incredibly nice. They are such hard workers and I've never been taken better care of at any other resort. Yarol was our family concierge and he made sure every aspect of our stay was perfect. He made sure everything was taken care of from dinner reservations to reserving us a cabana. Ramon was at the reserve beach every day and he made sure my family and I were always happy and had everything we needed. Everyone of the workers worked so hard. Out of all the places I've stayed at, the workers at the Paradisus, especially the ones listed above, were the most hard-working and wonderful people ever.

reviews.author: 379ginad
reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: We just got back and really enjoyed our stay. Everything from our room to the grounds and the service, everything was perfection. Our favorite restaurants were the steak restaurant and the tempura restaurant. The only small thing was we would have enjoyed better desserts.

reviews.author: Nathan P
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Stay
reviews.text:
Went there for my honeymoon with my wife. Beautiful property. Easy to relax. I definitely recommend the Royal Service. Access to their restaurant is key. The food and service is far better than the public cafe to eat. You're going to want good food and great service so it's worth it.

Everyone is very friendly and accommodating. Just ask and they'll take care of you. There's some nice activities to do so explore and try some of them. 

Tip: Get a cabana bed right away in the morning or else they'll be taken. You'll want to just relax in there sometimes after the pool and drinks. If you have a butler like we did, he can reserve it for you :)

If you haven't done this before just ask questions. You will feel much better if you are informed. The staff is very helpful.

reviews.author: kellyyy7
reviews.title: The best time!!
reviews.text:
This was my first time staying at an all-inclusive resort. It was fantastic. The staff was friendly. The entertainment was great. It felt really safe. 

The food so tasting good , the restaurants awesome baron justo at vento restaurant was our favorite employee  he was so attentive and cute...

The beach so beautiful the weather was great all the days while we stayed there....

reviews.author: MKNJCO
reviews.title: Almost Perfection
reviews.text:
We were pleasantly surprised with the entire experience, starting with sailing through the new airport’s entry process into the awaiting airport transfer – it was seamless.   Our driver enjoyed updating us on the DR and filling us in on Punta Cana with his quaint English and brilliant smile.

At the property we were warmly greeted at the front door and escorted to the Royal Service lounge for check-in, all very nice and comfortable, enhanced by a cool tropical drink and refreshing chilled towels.  

The only blemish the entire trip was the hard-sell on Club Melia before we were allowed to go to our room.  I feel for the poor sales girl, Natalia Green, who was set up for making the sale, but launching into such a pitch, right off the plane and without us realizing what she was doing was very off-putting and frankly rude.  We passed on the  "spa coupon", the "free gourmet breakfast" and "tour" only to be softly reprimanded by her the following morning for not taking the tour – ouch!   Not the best first impression, so much so that we consciously sought to avoid her the remainder of the trip.

Off to the room … which was splendid and enhanced by our butler, Ariel.   Ariel booked all of our dinner reservations (best food was in the Royal Service restaurant, Palacio, followed by Fuego, a Latin fusion concept) and a massage, which was the best one my wife said she has ever had (Roxanne did her massage).  

The coup-d-grace was the beach area.  Having enjoyed the Royal Service set up, I would never do anything else.  Our beach attendant, Martin Tineo, was magnificent, anticipating our every need and ensuring a prime sun/shade spot each day.   He even re-located some overly-noisy neighbors to a spot where their rum-fueled debates could be extinguished by the ocean breezes.

We experienced very few wrinkles.  Yes, the bellman failed to show up to collect our bags upon departure, but that is why god gave me strong arms, and the 7:00pm dining time we initially selected was way too early to avoid the cacophony of crying babies and “happy-happy-birthday” carolers (we moved dinners to 8:00pm and enjoyed them).  Fresh fruit delivered daily, a most-satisfying bottle of Chilean red, and the Champaign and dipped-strawberries hot-tub were extraordinarily pleasant surprises in our room. 

The return to the airport was just as pleasant as the arrival, with a cheery/chatty driver from Santiago who loved regaling us with DR history.  We were met curbside by an equally pleasant greeter who accompanied us through check-in to the custom’s area.  Our United flight left on time and arrived early in Newark.

I would certainly return and would without hesitation recommend the destination and property to anyone considering a very relaxing beach vacation.

reviews.author: Bkugeler
reviews.title: Best trip ever!!!!!
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Punta Cana, and we could not have picked a better resort. The grounds are huge but immaculately maintained; it is impressive. The food was better than we imagined it would be, for an all-inclusive resort--we were pleasantly surprised. The buffets could have been a bit better, though. Our favorite, though, was spending our days at the reserve beach. The staff down at the beach were fun and attentive, particularly Wander Roa and Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana, Benita, and Santos, as well as all the others, who made us and our 2 girls smile all day long. The boogie boarding was awesome. I hope we can come back next year!

reviews.author: KerryJW
reviews.title: Perfect Place!
reviews.text: Stayed @ The Reserve Paradisus. Ramon, Santos, Jose & Luis were the BEST waiters on the beach. Every need we had was met immediately and with smiles. Felt like royalty! Highly recommend if you want to feel pampered. Concierge Yarol provided all we needed with reservations and room assistance. Made the kids feel so special with in room delivery of fruit, cupcakes, milk & cookies, even filled jacuzzi with balloons. Best vacation ever!

reviews.author: nieves
reviews.title: maravillosas vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Fantástico hotel con zona específica para familias con niños pequeños. Buenos restaurantes, magnífico trato (especial gracias a Desirée Rodriguez y R. Cleybi), buen ambiente, mucho descanso y mucha diversión.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana- Excelente!!!!
reviews.text: It exceeded all my expectations. As the facilities and the service are excellent. Perfect place for a couple to enjoy honeymoon, as was my case, or simply to enjoy with friends and family. The service is exceptional. In this sense, Candida and Super Billy employees stood out during our stay. Recomedo !!! I intend to return

reviews.author: SONIA M
reviews.title: Inmejorable
reviews.text:
Hemos estado en este hotel durante una semana en familia con mi hijs. Una semana realmente especial.
Instalaciones, personal, habitación, servicios de limpieza, es decir TODO!
Solo tengo palabras de agradecimiento para todos los que componen el equipo de Family, hacen que te sientas como en casa pero con todas las comodidades que alguien pueda desear.
La atención es impresionante, el trato no puede ser mejor, lo que solicites lo tienes.
en resumen volvería con los ojos cerrados, totalmente recomandable. Si tuviera que poner nota sería 10 en todos los aspectos.
Gracias por hacernos pasar una semana inolvidable.

reviews.author: Niki D
reviews.title: Once in a lifetime trip
reviews.text:
This has to be one of the most beautiful, out of this world resorts I have ever seen, let alone stayed at. We were treated like rock stars from the moment we arrived. Our family concierge, Estephanie, was amazing and deserves a raise for going above and beyond. She was like a family friend, so much so, we invited her to our wedding ceremony. She really helped make our special, once in a lifetime trip memorable.  The wedding coordinator, Anabel was extremely helpful and thorough. She made it so easy and stress free. 
The Family Reserve is worth every penny! They make all your restaurant reservations, organized and helped with our tours, reserved our beach and pool beds. Made sure our room cleaning was done at a time that was convenient, stocked our room with a case is bottle water, left us snacks every night, made sure my daughter was fully satisfied every day and checked up on us most nights at our restaurant of choice. Your missing out if you skip this option!
The food on the resort is nothing less then spectacular! Not sure why anyone would negatively rate it, they must have a diet of McDonalds and Taco Bell. Passion was the place to go. You have to have the tasting menu. This was by far some of the best food I've ever eaten, and I've been to some of the top restaurants in North America. The service was impeccable. Food was perfect. I would pay double what they upcharged to go, completely worth it. 
Every single other restaurant on the resort, including the buffet,was outstanding. You will have no trouble finding food you like. He service is over the top great! You could not find 1 employee who was not smiling and asking how they could help you. The bar in the main lobby always had great service and even better drinks. 
Outstanding location! The beach is stunning! White, soft sand. Bright blue water. 
The activities on and off the resort are fantastic. Be sure to take a tour with Punta Cana Mike for a true picture of the DR. They will take you places you would never see on your own. And the Canopy Tours experience was a blast! Patrick, our guide, was informative and hilarious. It was overly safe and unbelievably fun!
The only thing stopping this resort from being a true 5 star resort is the Salon. Although the staff, Juana, was very sweet, I would have gotten a better mani/ pedi from my daughter. The equipment was outdated, no dryers or even true pedicure chairs and location tiny. 
Overall, stay here if you want to be treated like royalty.  You will not regret it! We are trying to figure out how to go back. 
Thank you Paradisus, for making our wedding trip amazing!

reviews.author: Sherrie C
reviews.title: Very Good Vacation Spot
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our stay at Palm Real.  The staff was very friendly. The room was clean and comfortable. The buffet food was very good as were the restaurants with the exception of Rare which had very poor quality beef.  We though the wines included in our all inclusive were not up to our liking so we just purchased a good bottle of wine with dinner and otherwise drank specialty drinks or beer at the beach.

reviews.author: Kevin L
reviews.title: Kevin L
reviews.text:
HOTEL AND ROOMS:
The hotel is beautiful.  My family of 5 was there for 4 nights and 5 days over the Easter weekend.  We booked the two-Bedroom Garden-View Master Suite that consisted of an adjoining "Luxury Junior Suite and a "1 Bedroom Master Suite". 

RESTURANTS:
It's all inclusive, but we were locked out of the family concierge restaurants (OLIO & MIX) and the Royal Service restaurant (PALAZZO) and Passion was adults only for $70 per person. The Grab & Go was supposedly open all day, but I only saw sandwiches there during lunch.  Thanks to Daniel, both the food and service at FEUGO were excellent. Daniel even taught us some Spanish.  FEUGO was supposedly an additional charge, but we did not need to pay any extra.  BANA was also very good, Perdo the cook put on an entertaining show and Nelson Tibu provided excellent service.  Stay away from RARE, all the steaks we had were tough and chewy, and the chicken was so salty that you could not taste any but salt, even the desserts were terrible and the service was horrendous, the server passed my drink to me over the partition and we had to ask for our drinks multiple times. NAOS provided a good variety for breakfast lunch and dinner.  BLUEAGAVE was good for lunch (didn't try it for dinner).

ENTERTAINMENT:
Excellent live shows.  We saw a Michael Jackson impersonation, the Lion King show and attended a Dance Party on the beach.  We also played volleyball on the beach, but the ball is tough to come by, seems like they only have 2 for the entire hotel.  Special thanks to Rey Rey, he got us a volleyball and when the court was being hogged by some rude families, Rey Rey got an extra net and setup a make shift court so we and others could play.  He was the friendliest and most helpful person we encountered at the hotel.  My boys loved the scuba diving, kayaking (included) and para sailing ($45 extra/person). If you want to snokel, book once you get there, we tried on our second day, but snorkeling was booked for the next 4 days.

PROS:
- Friendly staff (Rey Rey, Daniel, Nelson Tibu and Pedro)
- Good resturants. Fuego, Bana and Naos
- Beautiful and spacious hotel and beach.

CONS:
- Do NOT do the 90 minute tour they offer you at the hotel.  It is just a sales pitch for the Club Melia vacation club.  $73,000 for 50 years, plus $1,500 yearly maintenance and you still need to pay to stay at the hotels and buy your own airfare.
- Almost everyone here is trying to make a buck.  Almost everywhere you turn (airport, hotel, beach, etc.), people want to sell you a tour, future trips, water sports, etc.
- Confusing "All Inclusive" restrictions.  There are 11 restaurants, but we could only choose from 7 restaurants (actually 5 because RARE is so bad, I wouldn't include it as a restaurant and GRAB & GO only had sandwiches during lunch)

reviews.author: LuVenia W
reviews.title: Felt like princess!
reviews.text:
This resort makes you feel like you are so special. I was given a butler when i arrived. He was super amazing. I know he gets paid to make my stay easy and pleasurable, but he went over and beyond to make my stay one to remember. He checked on us every day. made all of our reservations to restaurants and various activities. He even helped me learn a little bit of Spanish while I was there. He was awesome! Go Francisco! 
I also enjoyed the entertainment. They were very professional and energetic. I loved the activities that were available. The staff was very lively. I loved Yas, Angel, Rony, and Rey Rey. They were super good dancers and so friendly.

reviews.author: MIGUELMARIA2015
reviews.title: EXCELENCIA
reviews.text:
A LA GENTE DEL CLUB MELIA
Señores de tripadvisor, con mi esposa es común que vayamos dos o más veces de vacaciones al año y a diversos lugares del mundo, por este motivo y no habiendo escrito nunca sobre cómo nos fue, en esta oportunidad no dudamos en hacerlo. Nos alojamos en el Paradisus Punta Cana Resort. entre el 26/3 y el 2/4/15, es decir 7 días, ese periodo que fue cortísimo lo hemos puesto al tope de nuestra preferencia por la excelente atención que recibimos por parte del personal que nos atendió tanto en el Club Melia, como en el Royal Service pudiendo destacar a las siguientes personas. Yahaira, Alfonsina, Leidi, Yuri, Rissi, Yenifer, y nos apenas olvidarnos al alguna mas.
Todas y cada una de ellas pusieron el esmero, cuidado y dedicación en nuestras personas, por lo que reiteramos miles de gracias y ojala siempre pudiéramos encontrar gente con esa dedicación dispuesta hacia los demás.

PARA LA GENTE DEL BAR SUNSET, Y PLAYA
Comenzando por Rodolfo y Jeremias, que los destacamos como dos excelentes seres humanos en lo que hace la atención y dedicación hacia los huéspedes del Paradisus Punta Cana Resort, donde estuvimos alojados con mi esposa durante 7 dias en el mes de marzo, y su compañeros: Jose Reyes, Matiel, Benita, Santo Faña y Pedro Amparo, debemos destacar que su atención fue en lo que hace a su tarea estar en el orden de los 10 puntos, no solemos repetir lugares turísticos, pero la calidez y atención nos ha predispuesto a que por lo menos una vez al año, volvamos a ese lugar donde no importa tanto la estructura, pero si el grupo humano. Por lo tanto a todo ellos miles de gracias y nuestro deseo más profundo de volver a compartir nuestras horas con Uds.

PARA LA GENTE DE LAPALAPA
Este año habíamos decidido cambiar de cadena de hoteles pese a ser habitúes de otra importante cadena, pero al final del periodo nos arrepentimos de no haber tomado esta decisión mucho antes, ya que fue una de lao mejores vacaciones que hemos tomado en mucho tiempo, pues es de primer nivel el personal, la infraestructura, la variedad de actividades y servicios, al punto que ya hemos reservado para dentro de pocos meses volver a pasar un tiempo en ese hotel con mayúsculas PARADISUS PUNTA CANA RESORT. Ya que nos falto tiempo para disfrutar todo lo que ese complejo brinda y en especial los equipos de trabajo, del que rescatamos algunos nombre a los que nos interesaría que supieran lo bien que nos sentimos y son Meritxell. Beckys, Manuel, Pablo Isidro, Gustavo, Daniel, y ojala que no nos olvidemos de ninguno hasta muy pronto Lapalapa y equipo y muchas gracias   

MARIA SARAGO Y  MIGUEL RODRIGUEZ
 
Buenos Aires. ARGENTINA

reviews.author: Argentina007
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL, FOOD AND SERVICE
reviews.text:
On March of 2015, after searching for a place to expend some quality and relaxing time together, my husband and I choose the Paradisus Palma Real in Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana in the Dominican Republic. We returned home sooo impressed with the service, the food quality and the location, that we decided to make it one of our yearly winter destination. So we are booking our next year's vacation!
The spot is absolutely magical, with white sands, miles of beaches, lush vegetation, beautifully landscaped grounds, many restaurants to choose from, numerous pools, many bars and disco, a theather just to name a few. The staff could not be more helpful, caring and knowledgeable! We especially like to take the opportunity to thank MARLENIA BELLIARD for being such a wonderful host. The food is the best I ever had from and all inclusive vacation spot...you can have CAVIAR for breakfast and LOBSTER for dinner or lunch no to mention prime ribs....etc. 
Our last night was marvelous..after spending the night eating, attending a show and dancing, when we went back to our suite, we were amazingly surprised with a bottle of iced champagned, a trail of rose's petals and candles and a nice, warmed, petal filled hot tub waiting for us..and WHAT more can we ask to the end of a perfect couple vacation !!!

reviews.author: Romina D
reviews.title: excelente!!!
reviews.text: Excelente atención, en especial de Leonaldo Mota, Francisco Cabrera y nuestro mayordomo Francisco Santos. Una experiencia maravillosa, un lujo todo y muy serviciales!!! la comida exquisita, hermosos shows y la mejor playa!!!

reviews.author: Chad F
reviews.title: Great services
reviews.text: Our trip is absolutely amazing.  Francisco Cabrera and Leonardo Moto took special care of all our needs throughout the day and made sure we had everything we needed!!  Royal Servive is the best!!  Our butler Gabriel Delusma made our stay personal and unbelievable amazing!  This place is truly paradise you will not find anything better anywhere on any island.  We will be coming back here to visit our second family every year!

reviews.author: Nsejkorova
reviews.title: The best service
reviews.text:
This resort is magnificent! Our trip was excellent! Our experience with Francisco Cabrera on the beach and Leonardo Mota as our royal service bartender was the most unbelievable experience! They took care of our drinks, beach beds and pool beds, anything we needed. Everything was made special just for my husband and I! Our butler Gabriel Dalusma was perfect from reservations for dinner, to making baths, and making the trip personal for my husband and I! They make you feel like you are family!Request them all when you book at this resort, especially royal service. We will return here for years to come to deal with the professionally amazing people. So impressed!! Thank you to the whole staff! (Ps, the testaurants and casino were perfect!) 
If you are looking for a true paradise getaway this is it! 
See you next year!
Chad and Nikola Sejkorova

reviews.author: evonhaam
reviews.title: Royal Service is fantastic!
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd visit to Paradisus Palma Real - we had been here 3 years ago, and quite a bit has changed - some of the restaurants, the new spa area in Royal Service, the new RS lounge, the disco, etc. However, the most important thing didn't change - the friendliness of the staff. Everyone we encountered was fantastic to deal with.

A few special thanks go to:
Jeuri - our butler was awesome - he knew we were there to relax, and he took care of dinner reservations and helped us with a few other things, but knew his main task was to make sure we were not stressed. Very friendly, great personality - and he even is learning how to speak Russian!

RS pool bartenders - Nelson and Leonardo. We spent A LOT of time getting drinks at the bar, not because we had to wait, but because Nelson and Leonardo were so much fun to talk to.

Francisco and Angel - pool and beach areas. These guys would hook us up with Bali beds and palapas every day - very friendly and always willing to go the extra yard.

Alexander - waiter at Palazzo. He was our waiter the first night, and remembered us all week, whether we saw him at breakfast, lunch or if he was bartending at another restaurant.

Quick reviews of the restaurants we tried:
Palazzo - breakfast is excellent (especially loved the crepes!); dinner was very good
Bana (teppanyaki) - OK, but compared to the Japanese steakhouse we can go to at home, the show and the food were a little weak
Rare (steakhouse) - surprisingly good
Vento (Mediterranean) - very good
Fuego (Peruvian) - good, but the menu could use more non-seafood items

Last shout-out is to the Lobby Bar - it was NEVER crowded, and the bartenders make great drinks - my wife says the Watermelon Crush there is one of the best cocktails she's ever had.

reviews.author: G29Pena
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
Amazing!!!
 We had and amazing time at the Paradisus Real Palma. When we arrived we were amazed by the view. We had the Royal Service, it's the best private check-in and check-out. Private lounges and restaurants. We want to thank Elvis Hidalgo for all the special things he did for us; checking on us at the beach and pool, making reservations to great restaurants. In addition, for the surprises on our anniversary dinner with a delicious cake, champagne and chocolate. And for answering our phone calls,  all our questions and requires. 

THANK YOU ELVIS FOR MAKING US FEEL LIKE QUEEN & KING

reviews.author: Manuel H
reviews.title: Cada año mejor
reviews.text: Por segunda Semana Santa consecutiva viajamos en familia a Punta Cana y tengo que decir que nuestra experiencia de este año en el Paradisus Palma Real ha superado ampliamente las expectativas previas. El alojamiento en Family Concierge, con atención permanente a nuestras necesidades, la variada oferta de entretenimiento infantil y el notable nivel de calidad en los distintos locales de restauración han contribuído especialmente a hacernos pasar una semana fantástica. La guinda de la satisfacción la ha puesto el equipo del Club Meliá, con un recuerdo especial a Carlos San José y Julio Moreno, que nos han hecho vivir la agradable sensación de disfrutar de atenciones exclusivas.

reviews.author: Luis S
reviews.title: Excelente Resort all inclusive para familias con excelente atención
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real es un maravilloso lugar para descansar y vacacionar en familia. Las acomodaciones, los servicios, actividades y la comida del hotel son excelentes. Desde el recibimiento por parte de la señorita Lenny (de trato estupendo y excelente ayuda para la familia en su estadia) y el mayordomo Henderson nos hicieron sentir como en casa. La playa del hotel es espectacular y el servicio que se ofrece en ella es MEJOR IMPOSIBLE, en especial el señor Francisco Estrella y el señor Wilken Paris quienes nos complacieron en todo lo que pedimos durante nuestra estadia, el servicio de estas personas es inigualable sin duda alguna.  Por otra parte la comida del buffet NAOS es de muy buena calidad, en este lugar la atencion de la señorita Bekerly por las mañanas fue inigualable, siempre pendiente de nosotros. En la parte de recreacion Big Mac alegra las noches en el hotel con sus bailes y su contagiosa simpatia. La comida en el hotel es muy buena menos los postres, recomendacion mejorarlos ya que no estan al nivel del resto de la comida. 

Sin duda alguna, el mejor hotel todo incluido que he ido con mi familia.

reviews.author: Linda F
reviews.title: Nice but would upgrade on a return
reviews.text: We attended an all expense pain business retreat here - just the basic all inclusive package. The scenery and beaches were beautiful - but the food got boring unless you spent extra in one of the restaurants. The room was spacious enough but the bed and pillow were very uncomfortable and worn out - once again - no upgrading to feather allowed unless you had the 'royal' package - even at our own expense. Would possibly o back but definitely would upgrade ahead of time

reviews.author: KBrill
reviews.title: Great place to relax...without being so quiet it's boring!
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to the Paradisus.  We liked it enough to repeat....which I never do... which says a lot about how much I like this place.

 Last year we took our whole family (kids, boyfriend, fiancee).  This year, since it was only my husband and me, we decided to stay in Royal Service. With Royal Service you get a butler to help with dinner reservations, which is nice to not have to deal with yourself.  

The greatest thing about this hotel is the amount of land/beach that it has.  It never feels crowded.  It is always fairly easy to get chairs/palapas/umbrellas more or less where you like.  With Royal Service it is even better.  Our butler, Nicholas, worked with one of the beach attendants to secure us a front row spot on the beach for our entire visit.  The width and depth of the beach in front is great.  There has been some seaweed/seagrass in the water both years we visited....but I think that is simply a time of year issue.  I walked up and down the beach quite some distance and really no other hotels have as much beach space....which allows you to be pretty far away from neighboring lounge chairs.  

The restaurant variety is good.  Our favorite was Blue Agave.  Also liked the steakhouse quite a bit.  By staying in Royal Service you gain access to a couple of additional restaurants which is a nice feature.  Overall, we find the food to be quite good for an all inclusive.  The buffet restaurant had been rebuilt since our trip last year and is now much larger.  Another new feature this year was an outdoor bar (Gabi Beach) which is a nice addition to the property.

The rooms at this point could stand a little updating....but they're still nice enough.  The rooms in The Reserve are very, very nice...but I dislike the proximity of many of The Reserve rooms to the beach.  Royal Service rooms put you in a good location to everything, so I would do Royal Service again just for the location if nothing else.

Our butler did a lot of nice things for us throughout the week including sending champagne, a cake for my birthday, snacks, etc.  And he was great about checking in with us to see what we needed.  

Really find the people working here to be very accommodating and pleasant to be around.  Not ruling out another trip to the Paradisus in the future!

reviews.author: campamy
reviews.title: Delightful getaway
reviews.text: We had a great vacation!!  It started off a bit rough - the travel agent had difficulty reaching the resort for advance plans, arrangements made through the resort were not as we thought, our room looked out over a garden and maintenance path and there was construction at 7:30am.  We had paid for Royal Service and were very frustrated.  I walked into the Royal Service reception area exhausted and frustrated and was greeted with smiles and with real help.  Apolinar listened, truly listened, and fixed the problem.  It was my honeymoon and we were moved to an ocean front room that was guaranteed quiet and the service from then on was fantastic.  Jose Slavador (our butler) cared for us so well, we felt like family - creating special experiences for all of us.  He was attentive without being intrusive and learned our favorite places, foods & drinks quickly.  He was great!  He introduced us to Francisco Gil at the bar who was also great - keeping us hydrated with cold water, greeting us with a friendly smile each day and getting us anything we needed.  The staff was great - the trip made a 180 turn and was marvelous.  The food was mediocre, but the weather was perfect.

reviews.author: juliero2015
reviews.title: GREAT WEEK!
reviews.text: Just back in the states after a terrific week at Paradisus Palma Real.  Actually this is the third time we've stayed at this resort.  Once at the Reserve and twice at the main property.  We loved our week.  The staff is very friendly, happy and courteous.  The management seems interested...and the recent renovations to the dining areas have really ADDED a lot to the guest experience.  In particular I would love to mention that "Juana" in the main dining area was just a "delight"...she was chatty and friendly and we looked forward to seeing her at meals!  Actually most of the staff was exactly that way!  If you have just a little bit of spanish it's a great chance to practice!  And if you don't, you're fine too!

reviews.author: sarav906
reviews.title: AMAZING SERVICE! BEST RESORT!! ROYAL SERVICE

He took care of all of our reservations bother dinner and entertainment. After a day of golf upon entering our room we had flower pedals scattered on floor leading to a jacuzzi bubble bath fresh fruit and champagne. He made sure our every need was taken care of. He planned a private dinner on the beach to see the sunset. Palma real has breath taking beauty. The spas are amazing, we indulged in couples massage on beach. Cocatol golf is next door so remember your clubs if you golf. Thank you Argenis for the exceptional service

reviews.author: Danilo C
reviews.title: Paradiso di nome e di fatto
reviews.text: Trascorsi  7 gg in pieno relax una struttura fantastica per spazi e servizi ... reviews.author: DBSJF
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation!
reviews.text: We spent the Feb break at the Reserve and made memories that will last a lifetime. The beaches were beautiful, rooms brand new and spacious, and people extremely friendly. Our private concierge Diosmary Fransisco made our time there one to remember. She was helpful in every way possible. She booked outings for us, checked in and answered questions and even left fun surprises for the kids in our room. If you go to this resort and can make a request make sure to ask for Diosmary. reviews.author: Jaime P
reviews.title: Mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Me encanto todo del hotel en especial el servicio y la amabilidad de los empleados,resaltar la animación con RONNY y BIG MAC grandísimas personas y muy atentas.buenas actividades al aire libre y buen acceso a la playa,una experiencia única,merece la pena

reviews.author: mariamartinez0
reviews.title: Vacaciones

reviews.author: Peggy D
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation!
reviews.text: Highly recommend Royal Service!  Our butler Gabriel Dalusma was excellent!  Anything we needed or any questions we had were answered immediately!  His expert knowledge and special attention to detail made our vacation one of our best ever.  On the beach we had wonderful and friendly service from Angel Joel Frias that was exceptional !

reviews.author: AnDMuk
reviews.title: Great Resort! I highly recommend this place!!
reviews.text:
We just got back from an amazing vacation as the Reserve as Paradisus in Punta Cana.  I’m breaking down the review in several sections:

Resort and Amenities:

The resort is stunning with absolutely beautiful (and very well-maintained grounds) and great amenities.  The buffet restaurants (NAOS, Gabi Club, Gabi Beach) were great with a bunch of different food options.  The non-buffet restaurants are amazing.  We tried the Acqua (Italian), Mole (Mexican), Vento (Mediterranean fusion),  Bano (Asian) and Fuego (Latin fusion).  Acqua was okay, Mole was quite good, but the other three were outstanding.  Great food, fabulous decor (especially Fuego) and great service!  There were a couple of other good ones too, but they don’t allow kids so we didn’t go.  They also have a beautiful gym and a nice theater where they have shows. 

The beach was great! The water was more weedy than I like, but still quite good.  On the beach there are separate sections reserved for the Royal club members and one for guests who have the family concierge.  We had our concierge reserve a cabana on the beach every day.  You have to get there before 10 to keep the reservation (but get there closer to 8 am if you want a cabana closer to water).  Ramon Ramirez and Luis Santana at the beach were very helpful.  

Location of the Reserve Building

So if you are in the Reserve with the family concierge service, your building is the farthest away from the beach.  It’s about 7-8 minute walk.  I was initially very disappointed to learn this.  However, not being right at the beach didn’t end up being a big issue.  They have golf carts going to and from the beach every few minutes.  We never had to wait for one more than 3-4 minutes.  

Family Concierge 

We chose the family concierge option only because after trying various combinations (of booking directly from Melia, getting flight tickets from the airlines, etc) buying it as a package from expedia was the cheapest option and expedia only offered the family concierge option.  The family concierge service, however, came in quite handy.  Our concierge was Yarol, who was very nice, but made a few goof-ups (which he did end up correcting).

The concierge does some nice things for kids that they love, like preparing bubble bath for them when you’re away at the beach, leaving cupcakes/cookies for the kids, etc. which is all nice.  The most important thing is that they help make all your restaurant reservations and they also reserve a cabana by the beach and/or the pool for you at your request.  Yarol was super friendly.  However, he made all the reservations for us before even talking to us.  That was disappointing because he made a reservation at the Grill and I’m vegetarian so I didn’t want to go there.  We asked him to change it to the Asian restaurant instead on the very first day.  The following day, we called and asked him if he change the reservation and he said he had not done it and that the restaurant was closed so he would do it the following day (the day of the dinner).  He not only made the reservation but he personally came to the restaurant to make sure we got seated.  We also realized that he hadn’t booked us anywhere on our last night.  So we had to call him again to request a reservation, which he promptly made.  We found that we ended up calling him once or twice every day regarding the glitches in the reservation.  But he was very helpful in addressing our concerns and did his best to fix it.  I wish he would first meet the guests when they arrive, ask for their preferences and write everything down.  That may help avoid such minor glitches.  Other than this, he was great and very friendly and courteous.  When he was off duty, another concierge Sofia also helped us out.  

Kids Zone

This was great.  Kids have two separate pools (a toddler pool and a regular kids pool – 3 or 4 ft deep).  There’s also an indoor kids area where they basically provide child-care.  We didn’t use it, but we did tour it and the staff seemed friendly and warm toward the kids and they have a bunch of different activities (i.e., finger painting, easter egg hunt, pool party, etc.) there. They also had a decent outdoor play area for kids.  

Aggressive Marketing for Club Melia Membership

This was the most annoying part.  They have sales staff who aggressively market the membership.  I understand that the resorts like to sell their loyalty programs, but I found these sales people almost like car salesmen.  Always hovering around and continuously asking people to join.  Three of them approached us at the beach, two at the restaurant.  I know they want to sell it, but I don’t want to be continuously bothered at the beach.  It’s one thing to ask us if we would like to go see the presentation when we’re checking in.  But being constantly approached by various sales staff when you’re relaxing at the beach or eating a meal was a bit much. 

All in all, a great vacation and a fantastic resort.  I highly recommend this resort.

La idea del Family Concierge me parece brillante y nos ha hecho la vida tan agradable ,que no tengo palabras ,especialmente la Srta. Dahiana . La playa es increible y todo el servicio es amabilisimo. Gran variedad de restaurantes muy buenos y unas atracciones infantiles estupendas.tambien el Spa es magnifico. Me ha parecido un viaje  que no olvidaremos. Enhorabuena a todos.

reviews.author: naneantunes

Temos um mordono, Juan de Leon, que duarante as 24 horas está a nossa disposição. Os mimos são constantes e encantadores, não dá a menor vontade de voltar para casa. reviews.author: André B
reviews.title: Excelente hotel, paradisíaco !!
reviews.text:
Reservamos um quarto no The Reserve e quando chegamos para o check-in nos ofereram um upgrade para o Royal Service (uma área privativa de frente para a praia, somente adultos). Tem uma área exclusiva com piscina e restaurante que somente os clientes Royal Service podem acessar, muito bom. E sem contar com o serviço de mordomo que quando vc chega lhe deixam um celular para fazer contato com ele a qualquer hora do dia. O Juan de Leon foi muito atencioso e nos atendeu durante este período. 
O atendimento na piscina é expetacular, principalmente dos amigos Francisco Cabrera e Leonardo Mota que são muito gentis e nos atenderam muito bem com ótimos drinks a beira da piscina.
Vale muito a pena o hotel e principalmente a área de Royal Service.

reviews.author: Susan N
reviews.title: The Place to Relax
reviews.text:
We just got back from a few days at The Reserve and loved it.  It is impossible not to relax there.  The pool and beach areas were beautiful, as was the entire resort.  It is clear that tremendous resources are devoted to keeping the entire resort groomed and cleaned, giving a sense of peace and calm where ever you are.

The service at this resort was also excellent.  Of particular note, was the superb service given by Jose D Los Santos at the pool, and Antony Cid, Janna Ortiz and Cesar Areche at the Gabi Club and Vento.  We were greeted by each of them with a big smile everyday, and they knocked themselves out to make sure we were well cared for.

We found the food to be better than expected, although thought the lunch options could be improved upon.  Specifically, the items to put in a salad and dressing options could be expanded.  The food at Vento and Mole was particularly good.

I am not sure how the concierge system works, as we did not find our concierge particularly helpful.  They were very nice, but we did not feel we could rely on them.  This was one of only two negatives (and was really not a big deal).  The other negative was that check in took an impossibly long time, I think because they are trying to sell you a time share at the same time.  At the cost of this resort, the guest should not be pestered at that time, or any time, to buy a time share.  After we made it clear that we were not interested, the representative finally left us alone.  

We would love to go back to this resort.  I have been to a number of islands and different resorts, and this is by far my favorite.

reviews.author: Noiseanddkisses
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: I was legitimately happy with every second of my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. If you can opt for Royal Service, do just that! Alvaro made sure all of our reservations were made and questions were answered. Spending each day at the pool with guys like Francisco Cabrera to set up your sun beds and take care of everything you need and Leonardo Mota to mix delicious drinks made every day truly paradise! These guys are the best! I am already looking forward to coming back for another visit to his beautiful resort!

reviews.author: Juliana Santin
