Ficamos no Royal Service e fomos atendidos pelo Luis Sanchezi - que nos ajudou em todos os momentos e sempre muito prestativo! Vale a pena reservar o Royal Service, tem alguns benefícios. Fomos no Carnaval e ficamos 3 dias. Dividimos a estadia entre o Paradisus e o Hard Rock. O hotel estava quase cheio, mas é muito tranqüilo. Bons restaurantes. A praia é muito bonita, apesar de muitos ambulantes e barulhos de barcos com música alta e esportes aquáticos que são oferecidos. Foi uma ótima escolha!

reviews.author: Angela D
reviews.title: great property

reviews.author: CStruckman

reviews.text: We had an amazing time in Punta Cana. We did the family concierge service and it was wonderful. We had Nikel as our family concierge and he made sure all of our plans were set - beaches, dinners. Our girls loved him.

reviews.author: Brittany B

reviews.text: I had a great time on vacation at Paradisus Palma Real! Everything about this resort is beautiful, and there are lots of activities to participate in everyday. The activity directors BigMac, Yass, Mini-me, Angel, Rey Rey, Reyne and Pamela are all super friendly and welcoming. They made my trip loads of fun and I would love to come back again.

reviews.author: LissaR
reviews.title: Life enrichment. Jazz
reviews.text: Yazz was great during our vacation.  She was always bubbly and smiley.  Full of energy and ready to please each guest and accommodate their needs.   What a great employee to have on your staff.  Keep up the great work.

reviews.author: JenniferTUSA
reviews.title: Amazing entertainment
reviews.text: By the pool is so fun and enjoyable because of the amazing entertainment here!! I need to thank ReyRey, Yas, and Angel for bringing their authentic Domenican talent to the Paradisus every day! It makes my vacation the best one that I have ever had!! I will miss them when I go home! They are great dancers and a whole lot of fun! They always put a smile on my face!

reviews.author: carebearPittsburgh
reviews.title: What more can we say?  Excelente!!!
reviews.text:
We could duplicate the comments of so many other reviewers and talk about the lovely beach, the pools, the buffet, the ambiance, etc., etc., etc.  Everything the five-star reviewers say is true.  I would like to concentrate on two factors -- the Family Concierge facility (which I think is fairly new) and the lovely, gracious people who work at Palma Real.

We booked this trip at the last minute after a very hectic February.  We thought we had booked Royal Service through an on-line provider, but discovered when we arrived -- based on our own computer print-out -- that we had booked a standard Junior Suite.  This was NOT a problem of the resort, only ourselves.  Jonathan at the front desk spent almost an hour getting us an upgrade to a suite in the Family Concierge area -- including a walk through several options -- and it was wonderful!  There don't seem to be a lot of photos on the website of this facility, but our room had a walk-in closet, full bath with a double shower and soaking tub (more about that later), a separate toilet and sink, a little relaxation space with table, TV, storage, coffee maker and fully stocked refrigerator.  The bedroom had a king bed and a walk-out balcony with rocking chairs overlooking the beautiful beach, palm trees and Caribbean.  Nothing was missing from our suite.

I do not know how the Family Concierge services and costs compare to Royal Service but this would be a very good option if you have small children who are able to sleep on the pull out sofa in the "living room."  It is closer to the beach than the Reserve and has its own pool and beach area.

Now for the staff.  We had the best concierge possible, Claury C.  From the moment we met, she was gracious, welcoming, always willing to go the extra mile to make our stay enjoyable.  She brought us a bottle of wine one day, provided large coffee cups (because we preferred those to the espresso cups provided in the room), made every dinner reservation for 9 consecutive nights, arranged our snorkeling trip, and provided everything else we wanted.  The highlight of our last day was to come back from the beach to find a trail of red rose petals from the door to the bathtub, filled with warm water and more rose petals, then the trail continued into the bedroom where our bed was decorated with a rose petal heart.  Claury is a true darling.  If you choose Family Concierge, there is no one finer.

Some other staff deserve mention as well.  Our beach concierge was Hector who seemed to appear just when we needed a fresh drink.   We don't know who was responsible -- Claury or Hector -- for being sure that every day there was a sign on one of the palapas reserving the space for us, but it was certainly a welcome treat.  At the Naos buffet where we ate breakfast and too many lunches, all the waiters were great, especially the tall handsome young man whose name we have unfortunately forgotten (it's his fault -- he poured the wine too generously at lunch!)

As I said above, Claury made dinner reservations for us each evening and there was never any problem with getting the time and place we wanted.  If we were to return, we would pass on Rare, the steakhouse -- it was hectic and service was confused, although our waiter was great.  Ditto Fuego where the service was rushed and the food nothing to write home about.  Our favorites were Aqua at the Reserve -- which is included if you are staying in the Family Concierge area -- Vento and Olio.  The Italian food at Olio is not what you would find in Sorrento, but almost as good.  The chef, Alexis, provides excellent appetizers, pastas, and fish.  After two evenings there, having praised his cooking, he made a special four course meal for us that was as good as we have had in many New York restaurants.  Carolina, the Olio hostess, Kimberly, the manager and Luis, our waiter most evenings, were all outstanding.  Rosa in the Mix Bar adjacent to Olio pours a very generous Remy VSOP and gives free Spanish lessons at the same time.  In short, I don't really understand the reviews that give the staff less than stellar marks -- everyone we interacted with spoke more than adequate English and tolerated our mediocre Spanish very well. Every service was provided with a smile.

In the interest of full disclosure, there were a few negative points as well.  Yes, the wi-fi is spotty, but you are on vacation, people.  Put your iphone and ipad down and walk away down the beautiful white sand beach!  A little point -- the toiletries in the bathroom were not truly five star, so bring your own if you are fussy.  We took only one excursion (having been to the DR before) -- a snorkeling trip.  The reef is not in good shape -- mostly dead where we were taken -- and there are only a few varieties of fish.  We didn't see turtles, starfish or any other fauna.  The worst part was that the snorkeling area was too shallow so that if you came upright, it was almost inevitable that you touched the coral with your swimfins.  However, the boat trip to and from the dive area was fun, especially if you like beer and rum.  There are a lot more excursions that can be arranged through your concierge or the service desk on the ground floor.

We would return to Paradisus Palma Real before going back to several other resorts we have visited in the DR, Mexico and other points in the Caribbean.  My husband and I have traveled all over the world for more than 30 years and found this one of the most  relaxing vacations we have ever experienced.  Go and enjoy!

reviews.author: Soriyat
reviews.title: A Week In Paradise
reviews.text:
My fiancee and I traveled for the first time to Dominican Republic and we absolutely loved it!!!  Let me start off by saying that the resort is absolutely gorgeous and the resort staff were all very friendly and welcoming.  My fiancee and I stayed there for a week in the adults only, royal service area.  The price is a bit expensive but well worth it.  The royal service staff really makes an effort to make your trip enjoyable.  The royal service lounge offers premium liquor where other places on the resort does not.  If you are like me and my fiancee who enjoys premium liquor than it is well worth the money.  The royal service lounge also provides the best cup of coffee on the resort.  Please ask for Fernando Gonzalez, the best royal service server.  

When we arrived to the resort our check-in process was quick and we were introduced to our butler Nicholas Maracallo. A big thanks to Nicholas for making this trip memorable for us.  He made sure our dinner reservations were made for the whole week upon on our arrival.  He would leave us fruit and cheese plates every night, drawn up bath with fruits and champagne.  On the last night his colleague Alvaro filled in for him and made our last night very romantic and memorable.  I can't thank the two enough for making this a very romantic trip.

The food at the resort was amazing.  I am a big foodie and the restaurant Passions by far is exceptional in service and quality.  This restaurant is possibly one of the best places I have ever eaten.  The restaurant manager (I can't recall his name) and his staff were very professional and made sure everything was completely satisfactory.  My fiancee and I also really enjoyed Palazzo.  We dined there several times for breakfast lunch, and dinner.  A big thanks to Team Palazzo.  We love Alexander Guzman, he was our server the first and last night, such a funny guy. Thank you Alexander for introducing us to Dominican Power, we love that drink.  

Thank you to the royal service bar staff namely Leonardo Mota (best bartender at the resort) and Angel Frias.  Angel, we can not thank you enough for always helping to set up a place for us to lounge at whether it be the pool area or the beach and always making sure we had something to drink. You always had another drink for us before we can even ask for one.  Thank you for making this trip such memorable and enjoyable time. I will definitely be making a trip back at a later time.

reviews.author: 2014_MariadeF
reviews.title: Estupenda experiencia !!
reviews.text: Estupendo para descansar y disfrutar de la playa. Los empleados muy amables, la comida muy rica y lo mejor las actividades... las clases de baile y laZUmBA Geniales !! Especialmente Big Mac que es súper súper divertido, y baila fenomenal, también Minime, Rey, Reina, la chicasa de zumba, el equipo de bailarines y el coreógrafo Ali. Echo de menos mas música Dominicana

reviews.author: PolynationalDad
reviews.title: Oceanfront Family Concierge is Outstanding
reviews.text:
This is a wonderful all inclusive resort - particularly if on one of the premium tracks - either Royal Service (no kids) or Family Concierge (with kids). The older Family Concierge at The Reserve is far from the beach, which means hotter, less breeze and at least the odd winged insect. The new Oceanfront Family Concierge has ocean views, large rooms and is right by the beach. The resort had ample great restaurants and we sampled a different one each evening for variety. The buffet and beach restaurants are good enough with lots of variety. There was a clear effort to have a sampling of traditional island food alongside all manner of international and fast food fare. The concierge beach areas were great and reserved cabana each day was wonderful. 

The highlight was the staff - they have absolutely wonderful people working here!! Our family concierge, Kenia,was just lovely and took care of us at every step - milk for the baby, snacks, balloons, reservations etc. The buffet and restaurant staff were almost universally amazing. All the staff love kids and knew our kids names and made them feel so special.  

Minor negatives - wifi is slow. Sofa bed in the 1 bedroom suite was small and not very comfortable - fine for a 7 year old but maybe not a large/heavy child or adult.

Advice - tipping is not expected or required but a few dollar bills here and there really ensure an extra level of VIP service at bars/restaurants/beach.

We would repeat here!

reviews.author: 67CindyF
reviews.title: stunning resort
reviews.text: We split our 8-day spring break trip in the DR between two Melia properties:  Paradisus Palma Real & the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  The "Reserve" at both properties is tucked into lush gardens & lovely landscaped grounds, &is a bit of a walk to the beach.  The Reserve is for those who want quiet, luxury & privacy.  We preferred the Paradisus Palma Real because it's newer, bigger, more fun.   We loved the massive beautiful beach & giant pool. At the Reserve, we had upgraded to the "Family Concierge Service." Sandra did a great job getting us dinner reservations each night, despite the hotel being at full capacity.  At the Palma Real, however, we did not have our own concierge, &found it extremely difficult to get dinner reservations.  Tipping helped sometimes.  All restaurants require reservations(except the buffets.)  So I highly recommend upgrading to the "Family Concierge Service" or the "Royal Service"(adults only) &get all reservations made on your check-in day for your entire stay.   Be aware that your concierge will ask you to attend the Melia membership presentation at breakfast or lunch with them.  We said a firm "no thank you" because we'd read reviews on Trip Advisor that it takes HOURS out of your precious vacation day,  &is a high pressure time share sales pitch. The restaurants are all good(try them all!)  Try to eat dinner early enough to catch the shows at night.  Get a room on the upper level to get a better view of the property.   Our teens loved the beach volleyball.  Must haves:  diarrhea med, sunscreen & bug spray!   The property has gorgeous ponds all over that house those nearly invisible biting insects.   There are beers/water/sodas in the fridge, but we had wine(bottle/glasses/corkscrew) delivered to our room each day by leaving a request/note in the room for our mini bar re-stocker.  Our 2 bedroom family suite was HUGE!  1400 sq ft.!  More than enough room for us: 2 adults & 2 teens.  Because they were sold out, we had to go out early in the morning& put our stuff on a few beach chairs or pool chairs to reserve some for the day. Lots of seaweed washed up on shore each day, but it didn't bother us.  I loved the absence of beach vendors(unlike in Mexico.)  The house wine from Chili (Santa Carolina) they serve is good, but the California wine (Tisdale) is watery.   You can pay extra for top shelf booze like Patron (about $8 for a top shelf rita), but the poolside bartenders make ok ritas with the house tequila & fresh squeezed limes. Passion(adults only) is gorgeous fine dining & perfect for a romantic date night.  But if you're not a die-hard "foodie," then save your $60 pp.  The staff speaks decent English & are very friendly.  But if you know some Spanish, it is indeed helpful.  Big Tip: Go on line (dgii.gov) & purchase your Dominican Republic "tourist card" ($10 pp). It will expedite your entry &you'll avoid the very long lines when you arrive at the airport.  Take a taxi cab from the airport.  It's about $30 USD, & takes about 20 minutes to get to the Palma Real.

reviews.author: cassie3375
reviews.title: Fantastic visit to Punta Cana, exceeded expectations!
reviews.text:
This was my family's first all-inclusive resort experience and it definitely exceeded our expectations!  We have travelled to many islands and I can say that the people who work at this resort are by far the friendliest and most committed to customer service (almost every request is immediately granted with a smile and "my pleasure").  Our family concierge, Yarol, went above and beyond to ensure that we were happy and comfortable at all times, frequently leaving little surprises for us (champagne upon arrival, a balloon bubble bath for the kids, cupcakes and cookies before bed, and much more).  Personally, we felt that the extra cost of having a family concierge was well worth it and made for a memorable vacation, especially for my kids who thought Yarol was the best!

Housekeeping was good, but not always consistent.  For some reason, things weren't always replenished (coffee cups were sporadically provided, we would get 1 face towel and 3 bath towels for a family for 4), and once our room was still not clean when we got back to the room at 5:30.  But all and all, we were satisfied with the cleanliness and amenities of the room (Family Concierge Master Suite).

The Reserve pool was huge and wonderful, not overcrowded as stated by other posters this week.  

We enjoyed the beach cabanas in the family reserve area, but I felt somewhat pressured to get there by 10:00 or else another family could "take" our reserved spot.  I started going at 9:00 to claim our cabana, then returning with my family after breakfast (the beach staff says that we have an hour to get back, but it was never a problem if we took a little longer).  Luis and the beach staff were great and always made sure we had a premium spot!

The food was not stellar, but much better than we expected from an all-inclusive resort.  We tried all of the a la carte restaurants for dinner and would say that Vento and The Grill were our favorites.  Room service for breakfast was extremely convenient and always delicious.

Make sure to bring cash with you (especially small bills for tips).  I had to get American dollars from the exchange and ended up paying a hefty fee for doing so.  It was really difficult to get change from the resort, I wish I had known that before coming. 

Long story short, it was a fantastic visit and we will be back!

reviews.author: Samantha V
reviews.title: Surpassed our expectations, can't wait to go back!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Palma Real with two friends in March 2015. We shared a Royal Service Garden View Suite. In short, everything surpassed our expectations and the low point of the trip was having to go home at the end! Some highlights:
Royal Service: absolutely worth it if you're looking for an adults-only experience. Our butler, Yohalvi (Jo), was the best. He made sure all of our reservations at the pool and for meals were taken care of, and he gave us great advice on activities and things to do during our trip. The Royal Service pool tended to get a bit crowded at times, so we spent our time on the Royal Service side of the main pool--this gave us access to the swim up bar, so we were very happy! Angel, the pool concierge, was very attentive and made sure all our needs were taken care of promptly. We ate at the Royal Service restaurant, Palazzo, on a daily basis. The food there was great regardless of whether you ate off the menu or chose the buffet. The service was especially skilled, and we are very grateful to Alexander and Lorraine (server and host, respectively) for always making us feel like the only patrons in the place. Overall, the Royal Service adults-only experience wasn't excessively couple-y or romantic, so my group felt comfortable, though I could tell that the couples there were satisfied too. We hope to go back to Paradisus next year, and we'll definitely use the Royal Service again!
Passion: We went to Passion the last night of our trip. We chose the seven-course tasting menu with the wine pairings. I'm a foodie, so it's a big deal when I truly feel that I've had a memorable meal. This one absolutely nailed it and ranks among my top ten meals of all time. I'm so glad we went, and I can't recommend it highly enough. Special thanks to Julio Cesar, Hector, and Zoris for taking such good care of us!
Blue Agave: We had lunch and dinner at Blue Agave on separate days, and I'd say this is the one restaurant to skip. The lunch selection is limited and the dinner quality is nothing remarkable--the staff is great, but you'd be better off eating next door at Naos if you're looking for something more casual.
Booking: I recommend booking the hotel online through the Melia website. If you register for the (free) Melia rewards program, you automatically get access to better nightly rates. Our booking even came with free airport transfers. You can also save ~$20 per person on the tasting menu at Passion by pre-purchasing it during your booking.

reviews.title: Inmejorable
reviews.text:
Es el mejor hotel en el que he estado. Es de primera categoría. El personal muy amigable, la comida y el servicio de 5 estrellas. Las instalaciones del Paradisus están recién reformadas y eso le da un aire más moderno y actual. 
Todo está pensando: por la mañana playa, piscina y actividades recreativas y por la noche suelen haber espectáculos. 
En The Reserve el trato es un poco más exclusivo y personalizado y quien se hospeda ahí tiene derecho a todo en el Paradisus.
El trato de Julio Moreno fue espectacular, un directivo de la cadena... nos hizo sentir en casa.
Es imposible arrepentirse! Agradecerán haberse decidido por este hotel.

reviews.author: Tuttlefamily753
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text:
I just stayed 12 nights at the "reserve" Paradisus in Punta Cana. What an incredible and wonderful experience.

For starters, The huge two bedroom connecting rooms made the living accommodations quite comfortable. I consider myself an experienced traveler to the Caribbean and know when resorts exaggerate. The Reserve has it all...Great location on Bavaro beach, excellent restaurants, friendly staff, strong wifi in hotel room and even air conditioning that will make you pull your covers up at night.

I highly recommend the concierge service. My concierge, Yarol Rijo did an excellent job taking care of me and my entire family...love you Yarol!! Yes, I will be back for your wedding!! Haha

The beach staff of Louis Santana and his co-workers Ramon, Santos and Wander know how to make a person feel special and will treat you like a king.  Thanks guys for spoiling me and the kids!

Also, make sure you eat at the Bana Japanese style restaurant at night and ask for Eliezer Rodriguez. He will take good care of you and the food their was voted best by our family.  

Wow, really can't think of much negatives to say except coffee is somewhat difficult to get in the morning at the Gabi club. They only seem to have one pot made at a time for the whole place. I know, sounds trivial but hey, nothing is perfect in life.

All in all this place is a well kept secret when it comes to impeccable service, beautiful beaches and excellent room accommodations! I highly recommend you give the Paradisius in Punta Cana a look when booking your next vacation!

 The Tuttle Family

reviews.author: 962arelys
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: Excelente el royal service.. El sunset bar espectacular el mejor trato de Leonardo Mota, Martín Tineo y Fransisco Cabrera.. Los mayordomos muy atentos Angelo Mercedes y Gabriel Dalusma.. Las habitaciones muy comodas y limpias.

reviews.author: Arelys V
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy bonito.. Muy bueno para descansar.. Las comidas espectaculares.. El royal service tremendo.. Excelente la limpieza.. El personal muy buena gente.. Las actividades excelentes en especial Reina De Paula.

reviews.author: Gonzaga A.
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Pasamos una semana celebrando las bodas de oro de mis padres, toda la familia, un grupo de 18 y la experiencia fue espectacular. Las instalaciones del hotel son estupendas, los restaurantes muy buenos, las habitaciones amplias y comodas pero si algo destaca es el personal. El trato es cercano, alegre y buscando siempre hacerle a uno sentir como en casa. Ibamos con ninhos desde los 8 anhos hasta los 14 y siempre estuvimos perfectamente atendidos. Mildre se ocupo de los pequenhos y siempre estuvo muy pendiente de ellos, presentandoles a todo el personal y se lo pasaron fenomenal. El personal del GABI, buffet para desayunos y comidas, era realmente impresionante. Destacar'iamos en particular, por que son los que m'as tratamos, a Luisa, Felix Santos, Virginia Alvarez y en el bar a Gustavo. Sencillamente especataculares!! En la playa, Onardo Marino nos atendio siempre muy bien y estuvo muy pendiente de nosotros para todo lo que necesit'abamos. Pero si alguien merece una menci'on especial es Glennys Martinez, que estuvo pendiente de toda la familia desde el primer al ultimo dia, sin escaparsele un solo detallle. Preparando sorpresas para los ninhos, detalles para los adultos, insuperable!!... Enhorabuena por todo el equipo y muchas gracias por una maravillosa estancia.

reviews.author: Ohjodi
reviews.title: One more day...
reviews.text: Just one more day pleeeeeease! This was my second visit (first was five years ago) and second time at an all inclusive. You have to understand that I am not someone that sits still well, so a vacation like this is good for the soul. You are forced to sit back and relax. Just relax... This property is gorgeous! Perfectly manicured and constantly maintained. I do have to admit that check in was less than wonderful. Our request for joining rooms was not fulfilled and we were put in separate buildings. We could have let that ruin our experience, however we were on vacation in Punta Cana...don't sweat the small stuff! The staff in the resort definitely make the experience. (I do have to point out that we properly tipped through the entire trip. They deserve it!) We had such a great time at the beach with Santos, Luis, and the rest of the guys. Talk about hard working...sweltering heat and they are still laughing, smiling, and making sure that you are enjoying yourself! The pool staff was equally wonderful (I learned too many names to mention)! Elvis was our go to guy for reservations and Gorge and Edward made sure we had our favorite drinks! Tip: you need to get to the pool or beach early to get your seat, even earlier to first reserve it. We reserved a seat at the beach and lost it b/c it was busy and we didn't get there until almost 10. No need to stress, the guys helped us figure out another option!  Overall... the food is okay- you will figure out the places you like the best, the staff is kind and they want you to have a great time, and this trip will be what you make of it. Brush up on your Spanish, you are visiting another country and you can't expect that everyone here is going to speak fluent English. Don't be uptight, you are on an Island... Enjoy yourself!!

reviews.author: LeonelSimoes
reviews.title: Princely vacations in a paradise
reviews.text:
This year I and my wife decided to spend our two week beach vacations in this resort, and it was really an excellent choice.
We like very much staying at the beach for a good part of the day, sometimes doing just nothing but enjoying the view, others doing some activity like swimming, canoeing, and my best, diving. Diving is really a must in this resort, you take 5 minutes in a boat and you reach more than a dozen spots. Huts at the beach were wonderful, keeping a comfortable distance from neighbours, providing good shadow and very nice deck beds. The personnel at the beach are very helpful, with the accommodation and also with drinks. We really enjoyed everything at the beach.
This time we were looking more for quietness and being with ourselves, so we didn't experienced much group activities at the beach neither the huge pool nor any of the pools, although they look very attractive.
Foods and drinks are really superb here. Diversity of types and of environments makes a choice difficult when it comes to eating, which is excellent when you are spending two weeks at the same place. Food quality meets high standards. The best way to go with all inclusive is to have as much all inclusive as you can, so you can feel freedom the most, it feels really very nice to go wherever you want without restrictions.
Restaurants, you should try them all. We tried twice almost all of them. The same goes for bars, all different all very good. Parties, shows, events at the end of the day were all funny, interesting or simply beautiful, you should coordinate dinners and shows so you can enjoy them all.
We enjoyed every piece of our master suite room, with garden view, which is the best after spending a day at the beach, to have some balance. One of the best things is to have a light snack and drink at the balcony just admiring the garden after a day at the beach.
We experienced Yhi SPA, a couple massage, just divine.
Personnel makes you feel like princes, cordial but attentive, serviceable and yet not intrusive, really excellent treatment.

reviews.author: oliviaviolet15
reviews.title: Best resort!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Paradisus has the best service! Anything you order comes immediately and all of the staff are so welcoming, friendly, energetic, and passionate! Normally i would be too shy to try any dancing but Ronny and Bigmac are very convincing and i ended up having one of best nights of my life! I would seriously recommend this resort to anyone considering traveling to the Dominican Republic, and i will definitely be visiting again. Glad to know that when i come back i will already have some friends here!

reviews.author: Jenni H
reviews.title: Great staff and resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real toward the end of March, 2015. It was a wonderful experience, mostly because the staff were all exceptional, very friendly and attentive. Our butler, Johelvi, took care of our reservations, private taxi to airport, and left kind touches in our room for us for when we returned from the beach each day. Pedro found us a cabana on the beach each day and always made us laugh. 
The housekeeping came a few times a day and someone always restocked our minibar. We ordered room service everyday early in the morning for coffee and tea, and the restaurants and waiters were all great. We noticed before the restaurants opened (we had early reservation times), the waiters met together. And then when meeting us and bringing our food, they seemed to really enjoy their work.
People cleaned the seaweed from the beach every morning and the ocean was very warm (about 80 deg F). There were some waves and a little seaweed, but the ocean was easy to swim in. The swimming pools were a little cooler, but nice. 
We didn't experience very many mosquitoes, and the room was in good condition and always clean.
Our only complaint was that we had to leave to go back home. We miss Johelvi and all the nice people that work at the resort. We have traveled a lot before, but this was our best vacation so far because of the people.

reviews.author: VVASIMON
reviews.title: Georges is the best beach service man
reviews.text: We had a great time in Paradisus Palma Real and it was great because of people like Georges Alriche. The best services ever. Great Guy with the a wonderful smile all the time and providing the best in class beach service. Really happy with him.

reviews.author: Alessadip
reviews.title: Best service we have ever experienced!
reviews.text:
This was one of the best vacations we have ever had!! We stayed in the Royal Service area and were treated so wonderfully. We had a private butler, Jorge Rosado, who helped us with everything and anything we needed. He reserved dinner with us everyday, made recommendations on what to eat for lunch, and made sure we always had what we needed. He prepared two jacuzzis for us with flowers and chocolate covered strawberries. He was there for us the moment we got there until the moment we got on the bus to the airport. 

The pool service was also phenomenal. Francisco Cabrera, Nelson, and Leonardo always prepared a cabana for us everyday and always provided us with a drink in hand. Fernando in the royal service lobby always prepared the best espresso as well! 

I have never been to a hotel where everyone was so happy to work there and was so nice. We did not have one bad experience. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone. It was a great week.

reviews.author: Shaun M
reviews.title: EXtremely fun and caring staff !
reviews.text:
This is my second time at Paradisus Punta Cana. And this is the first time I have gone to a resort twice in my life. The first time I was here it was about 1 and half years ago and I had a fabulous time. This time the things I noticed was the wonderful variety of delicious food and drinks, I thoroughly enjoyed that. The attentiveness of the staff was extraordinary. My 7 year old son had an even better time at the Kid's Zone than the first. He loved the caretakers and enjoyed making new friends fro around the world. The beach was clean and beautiful. Some staff that I have to mention- from the Gaby Club- Antony Cid and Celso Peralta. Also Gino Vilorio.  
The cleaning staff- Cleybi Rosario and Desiree Rodriguez.
Only 2 caveats, I am a light sleeper and the shades are not blockout so when the light comes in the morning, I was awake too early. Also the wifi in my room refused to work although the staff tried to fix it for me.

reviews.author: anne922013
reviews.title: le paradis, ou presque
reviews.text:
Tout est parfait à la Réserve : cadre magnifique, service top et à l'écoute, appartement spacieux et confortable, très bons restaurants variés. Bref, un séjour merveilleux durant lequel nous nous sommes sentis chouchoutés. Et heureusement, il n'y a pas d'animation sur la plage - on peut se détendre en toute quiétude
Un grand merci en particulier à Silvio Lantigua à la réception (j'espère que je n'écorche pas son nom de famille) , au chef du restaurant Gabi Club, à  Sandra Cedeno à la résidence , et à Ramon  sur la plage, et bien d'autres

reviews.author: Dee S
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time!!!
reviews.text: This was the first time going to an all-inclusive and was skeptical if it was going to be worth it.  Well, it definitely was.  Not having to worry about where to eat, what to drink or do, or carry money was a relief.  We had a WONDERFUL family concierge - Sophia - she took care of our every need and made our first stay very comfortable.  She continually checked in with us to make sure things were going as anticipated.  She was great!!!!  The resort is beautiful and very big.  Our room overlooked one of the pools.  The Reserve is on the farther end of the resort, away from the beach.  Getting a tram to the beach was difficult in the morning.  Most of the time we walked.  The beach area was very beautiful and the staff there were very friendly.  They made sure we had what we needed while there.  The food was very good.  The restaurant selection was also very good.  I found the Casino disappointing and saved me some money.  The circus show on the beach Monday nights is not to be missed.  All the staff was very friendly and helpful.  Will definitely return, but stay closer to the beach next time.

reviews.author: drymartini3
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: This was our 8th trip to Punta Cana (we missed the last two years).  Each time we have stayed at a different hotel (some very nice, some ok).  We love Punta Cana - it's a bit of heaven.  Our thing is to be on the beach, enjoy the sunshine and food.  The hotel is beautiful, the grounds are beautiful.  Usually my wife and I are along, but this year we were with our daughter, son-in-law and two grandsons.  The service was rather hit or miss, but generally good, although I was a little disappointed to be honest.  The food was good, but compared to other hotels, again I was a little disappointed.  However, I have always said that there is always something at the buffet that should please everyone's palate.  Our grandsons ate most chicken nuggets and fries, which was happily supplied upon request.  We enjoyed several specialty restaurants on a few nights.  Our beach area was not crowded, whereas the Reserve appeared to be more crowded.  Our rooms were comfortable and close to the lobby and beach.  All in all, you should enjoy your stay here.

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Amazing entertainment
reviews.text: The resort was esthetically pleasing and we throughly enjoyed the  entertainment especially Big Mac, yass, angel,Ronny, reyna, Rey rey, Pamela. They had lots for everyone to do, many activities for all ages. The food could be improved on. Overall, it was a fantastic trip with experiences and views that can not rivaled.

reviews.author: Maryclairebassett
reviews.title: The best entertainment of my life!
reviews.text: I had a great time at this resort. There were parties everynight that involved every age which is perfect for families. There were also specific events tailored to certain age groups, kids, teens, young adults, and adults. The entertainment crew was especially outstanding as they were extremely personable and went out of their way to make sure every guest was comfortable and having a good time.  I have no doubt that I have met each employee of the entertainment deparetment (Yass, Big Mac, Pamela, Angel, Mini Me, Reyna, Ray-Ray, Rachel, Sandy, ChoCho, Caridad, Luis) and that they have met each guest. Overall, the best part of this trip was the parties/activities and the staff. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Cwang22
reviews.title: Ótimo hotel
reviews.text: Minha primeira experiência num All-Inclusive foi muito boa. Passei sete dias neste resort em maio. Na ocasião, o hotel parecia um tanto vazio, o que achei ótimo. O quarto em que ficamos era um standard com vista pro jardim. Mesmo sendo quarto básico, era realmente muito bom: limpo, confortável e bem decorado. A comida do resort era acima da média. Muito boa, com bebidas de qualidade, mas não tão boa quanto bons restaurantes a la carte de São Paulo. Os funcionários são muito atenciosos. O único ponto negativo foi a insistência deles em vender o clube meliá e também o sistema de "hierarquia" do hotel: fazer o hóspede pagar mais para ter "status vip" para acessar cadeiras melhores, prioridade na reserva de restaurantes, etc. Enfim, o hotel é muito bom e acho que esses "upgrades" são desnecessários. Vá e aproveite a praia e o hotel. Dica legal: os esportes aquaticos e mergulhos eram livres, fiz 3 mergulhos de cilindro sem desembolsar um tostão a mais.

reviews.author: jenann1112
reviews.title: Am I staying at the same resort as the rest of these people??
reviews.text:
I am curretly staying at the hotel and I am looking forward to going home.  This place is terrible!!  It is run on the a scarcity model and with some customers as being "special."  Here are the pros:
1. The nature is beautiful.  Lovely beach, nice landscaping, perfect weather.
2. Food is fine.  Nothing special but enough variety to please most people.
3. The pool is also fine. It may be worth staying on this side of the resort if you don't have kids.  It's almost empty which is nice.  You don't feel like you are swimming on top of peope

And the cons:
1. When we arrived, they did not have the room we requested/paid for in our package (2 queen beds) so they showed me 2 different rooms.  Both with kings.  Both on the third floor with no elevator.  We chose to be upgraded so they put us in  the family conceirge section but we did not get family conceirge.  And they made me pay $500 in cash (weird... I'm sure that wentright into somebody's pocket) for the room.  Now my son has slept on a sofa bed all week and is having back pains.  
2. So now we are in the family conceirge section but not family conceirge guests.  Well that must have been a personal attack on all of them because they treat us like lepers.  They won't even say hello/hola.  One of them did whistle at me one morning which was super inappropriate and had my 11 year old asking me if that really just happened.  
3. The resort is very large.  They say that they have trams that circle every 5 minutes but it's more like every half hour and then good luck getting a seat. 
4. You can rent bikes but good luck getting there early enough to get one. 
5. There is almost nothing for kids to do at the Reserve pool.  You need to go to the other pool.  
6. The staff is rude. 
7. The staff does not speak English.  At all.  I speak Spanish and found myself interpreting half the day.  I am not one to say that all should learn English but please do not ask me to interprete.  
8. We had to call for the last two days to get our minibar restocked.  We got home from an excursion today at 8pm and had no water to drink.  I'm so tired of asking for stuff I have paid a lot for.
9. I am basically harrassed everyday by the Melia Club people to join their time share thing.  It's ridiculous.  Last time I checked, no meant no.....

Basically, save yourself the trouble (and some money) and go to the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, Mexico.  You won't regret it.

reviews.author: donnaw666
reviews.title: Royal Service is truly Royal!
reviews.text: We had the most adorable Room Service guy and his name was Hegel Zabalo! He made sure we had a fully stocked bar every night even leaving us a little extra of what we requested.  Our last night there he brought us the most awesome bottle of champagne and chocolates. I can't wait to visit this resort again and I hope I have this guy treating me like royal again!

reviews.author: Hector T
reviews.title: Bonitas Comida, debe Mejorar Limpieza
reviews.text:
Llegue a las 12:00pm al Hotel. La habitación fué entregada a las 4:10, la misma no era cama King, solicitamos el cambio y a las 4:30 nos entregan la habitación 2009 con cama matrimonial, el polvo y la humedad que tenía era increíble. Nos acercamos a recepción y  nuevamente nos pusieron a esperar. A las 5:20pm nos asignaron una habitación similar a la reservada. La Encargada de Host Adriana manejó el caso. Estoy muy inconforme con el trato recibido. El hotel no está preparado para estas fechas de mucho tránsito de huésped. No obstante la comida hasta el momento ha sido excepcional. 

Para una persona mínimamente asmática no recomiendo la higiene del hotel. Mi pareja que no lo es no lo soportaba. Los servicios de Salud son muy caros por esta zona y si viene de vacaciones es algo que debe de sopesar.

reviews.author: Esra K
reviews.title: "Fabulous - Perfect Service- Great entertainment team"
reviews.text:
This was our second time in this resort. Again, we had a wonderful week. The place is gorgeous. The garden areas, walkways, seating and lounge spaces, pool area, and beach are all stunning. This year they had renovated the NAOS Restaurant and what a change. We were amazed of the outstanding new look. The rooms were very nice. Fridge was stocked daily with juices, lots of bottle water and beer. Wi-Fi was also included with the room which was great. They have lots of chairs on the beach. The restaurants were okay but alcohol beverages were weak. In our stay last year our favorite was the drinks. They were fresh, delicious, nothing like the other resorts. Unfortunately, we couldn't find the same flavor this year. However, the waitstaff is extremely friendly and always remembers your favorite drink. The water activities were really fun. Nightly entertainment was also fun and interesting. The shows were usually at 8:30 or 9. Each day there was water aerobics, some type of dance lesson and other things like painting, etc. Our 3 year old had a great time at all of the dance activities. It was great. Each night you could find dancing available and the dancers were always there to dance with you and get everyone involved. 

Entertainment: BIG MAC WAS THE BEST! He is a huge value to this hotel and makes everything a lot of fun. The dancers would dance with you each night. Whether at the pool, on the beach (volleyball) any activity you would find Big Mac making it fun for everyone around. His continuous effort to make sure you are enjoying your stay, and putting himself 100 percent to what he was doing was exceptional.  Unluckily, he was taking a time of while we were there and somehow hotel become monotonous and empty. Especially parties at night were short and quite in his absence. In addition to Big Mac-we really enjoyed Yass, Ronny, Rey Rey and Reyna. What a great group! They are so friendly and everyone would enjoy their company. They would always make sure everyone is feeling welcomed and fitted in. No matter how old the person is. They are always smiling, and treating you like you are their best friend. They made the vacation super fun and memorable. The place was beautiful, and had many activities for people different ages, and tastes. But once again the activity guys were unbelievably amazing!!

reviews.author: Amber0806
reviews.title: The best life enrichment in my life
reviews.text: The staff was really fun and friendly.. And the dancing was amazing.. Here you can learn how to paint, make cocktails, sushi and much more, there was also shows and parties every night, my favorite was the white party I just want to say thank you to Yass, minime, Big Mac, Angel, Rey Rey, pamela and Reyna making my vacation the best of my life

reviews.author: Justo G
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text:
I'm here at Paradisus Palma Real, this is a great hotel, I recommend Royal Service for adults, food is great, property is clean and we'll kept, staff is very friendly  and willing to accommodate all your needs, special mention to the team at Sunset Bar ( Leonardo Mota. Francisco Cabrera, Martin Tineo) also my buttler Eduard. 
I strongly recommend  this hotel, planning to come back for the summer

reviews.author: Rajiv S
reviews.title: Johnfi Rivera is the best Butler!
reviews.text: We greatly enjoyed our time at the Paradisus Palma Real. Johnfi ensured we got everything we need promptly and made our stay enjoyable.  Thank you Johnfi! The resort is amazing. The food is excellent and beach accommodations are awesome! Royal Service is the way to go here.

reviews.author: LillyRn2015
reviews.title: Great Place for Children...Treated like Royalty!
reviews.text: Elaine, our family concierge, did an amazing job taking care of all of our needs.  She went out of her way to make sure the kids had a daily surprise in our room...the highlight of every evening.  Her attention to details and amazing service really set the bar high for future travel. In addition, the hotel is safe, quiet, and clean!  Thank you Elaine! See you again soon!!!

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Best Vacation in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
The property is spectacular.  We will come back again.  The food and the variety of restauraunts were outstanding.  The service and hospitality at the property was unmatched to our past experiences.   Specifically our Royal Service Butler, Luis Martinez made our stay extra special and relaxing.  His attention to detail and his frequent checking in at the pool was perfect.  His extra touch in the evenings with fruit, cheese and wine was just right.  We would highly recommend the property and Luis.

Luis Martinez Royal Butler Service

reviews.author: Kristen J
reviews.title: Amazing Anniversarymoon
reviews.text: This is an amazing place to stay.  From the time we arrived, we felt taken care of.  My husband and I didn´t take a full honeymoon when we got married last year, so this trip was a combination of our honeymoon and first anniversary.  We upgraded to the Royal Service and felt like royalty all week.  Our butler, Angelo, did everything we asked asked and more, from making reservations for dinner each night, to booking our excursion to having a bubble bath and bottle of wine waiting for us.  He made sure we had everything we needed and wanted and was happy to see us everytime we saw him throughout each day.  Francisco Cabrerra took care of us each day at the private Royal Service pool and beach area and had everything ready for us each day without us asking.  Nelson and Leonardo were top notch bar tenders and always had smiles on their faces.  We visited Rosa each night at the lobby bar before dinner, and she was always so friendly and happy to see us.  Pasquel took amazing care of us at Palazzo, which is probably the best restaurant at the resort, but only available to Royal Service guests.  Overall, the food was very good and you must try Mama Juana.  We could not have been more pleased with our experience and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Scott S
reviews.title: Incredible Place
reviews.text: My Paradisus Punta Cana vacation was absolutly AMAZING!  All of the staff were friendly and eager to please.The food was outstsanding!!! Be sure to visit Teurys. Manuel Reynos,  Chef Silverio and Chef Charles in The Gabi Club for excellent service and Delicious Food. I highly recommend this place. There are many people that stand out and deserve a special Thank You Daian Martinez, Daryelin Pena, Ramon Simbert,  Posficio Casado, Masia Valdez, Tuerys Feliz, Jose Reinos, Enilio Valdes, Jose Luis and Deivy Lugo.These are just a few names of the incredible people that went above and beyond. Thank you for making our vacation wonderful!

reviews.author: paquirrin2015
reviews.title: ESPECTACULAR¡¡¡¡¡¡
reviews.text:
Durante una semana hemos disfrutado mi familia y yo de este espectacular hotel, hemos estado hospedados en las nuevas habitaciones de Family Concierge, la habitación muy grande y con todo lo necesario. La atención es inmejorable hasta el punto de llamarte a la habitación por si necesitas algo.
El servicio no puede ser mejor, te hacen la habitación por la mañana y por la tarde te la revisan para abrirte la cama, dejarte bombones etc....
Jamás te dicen que no a nada y la amabilidad de sus empleados es de admirar.
Volvería mañana con los ojos cerrados.

reviews.author: weissdj
reviews.title: "Perfect Stay"
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, Great service, great hospitality, staff very helpful and courteous. Our butler, Johnfi Rivera, was very attentive to details, made us feel at home and personally took care of arrangements at the restaurant to make a "perfect" birthday surprise for one of my friends. Very enjoyable, cant wait to return next year. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this hotel to everyone !!!!!!!  And ask for JohnFi !!

reviews.author: Kathleen D
reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text:
Every moment of our week was perfect.  Our beautiful, clean, well-appointed and serviced room was comfortable and quiet.  We did not spend much time there as the beach was perfect.  The king beach "beds" were the best place to relax outdoors.  We understood that the resort was fully booked, yet we never felt as if we were in a crowd, and, in fact, often felt like we had the beach, spa, bar, etc. all to ourselves! See the photos.
The restaurants all had their own personalities and different menus. All delicious with great service.  We especially enjoyed Fuego - because it was open to the beach, and Palazzo - because it was fabulous and we were able to sit outside.  Juan de Dios is an amazing person and fantastic manager of all the restaurants.  Thank you for all your help Sr. de Dios!  Also, a special thank you to Carolina who greeted us each morning at the buffet with a beautiful smile and a generous heart. 
Don't miss the amazing YHI spa at the Reserve; hop on the shuttle to get there. 
The grounds were idyllic and magically perfect every morning.
Do take advantage of the activities!  Daily dance lessons on the terrace were great even with my two left feet.  Jessica & Luis were patient and entertaining instructors, as well as beautiful dancers. Stretch/yoga on the beach in the morning was a wonderful way to start the day.  I tried water aerobics in the pool right by the swim up bar.  What fun!  Yas, you were a super activities person - full of energy and enthusiasm.  Thank you to Rayna and Big Mac, too. 
The evening was full of action in the main courtyard - music, dancing, entertainment.  Delightful!
You can get a ride to anywhere, but for shopping, the market comes to you two evenings a week!  The prices are as good or better as "outside".
OK, apparently wifi was slow, but who cares?  I left my phone and laptop home! All you need is a hat, sunscreen, and dinner reservations. 
We will be back to heavenly Palma Real very soon!

reviews.author: Julie R
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We had an amazing honeymoon. Royal Servce is definitely the way to go. Breathtaking beautiful resort. Our butter, Fermi Moto was fantastic. He had a bottle of champagne in our room and a delicious plate of desserts once we told him it wa our honeymoon. He also had a bath ran for us with candles and rose petals. Eve very night we had something in our too fro Fermin. He was available eveytime we needed him, yet he did not smoother us. It was as the perfect balance. Leonardo Moto was our bartender at th bar we visited most, he's the best. He remembers EVERYONES drinks, faces and names. Can't wait to go back!!!!

reviews.author: Barbara P
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week on our first visit to Punta Cana and it won't be our last.  What a gorgeous place this is.  The resort's website does not do this place justice so please check out the visitors photos also.  The entrance is a feast for the eyes and it just gets better and better from there.  We stayed in the Royal Service suites and the garden view rooms were peaceful and quiet.  The beds were excellent.  Not too hard or soft.  Great pillows and a super sized jacuzzi bath.  We do recommend the "Royal Service" upgrade which gives that added reassurance that everything that is already wonderful will be perfect.  Our butler Sandy was wonderful.  He got us dinner reservations at our desired restaurant at our desired (or close to) time.  The food selections and quality were very good.  The best we've had at a large resort.  If the food was not prepared to your liking it was immediately redone or substituted as requested.  Sandy made all our golf reservations and made sure we made our tee times.  We missed the scheduled group transfer once and he arranged a private transfer.  Around the Royal service pool area  the reserved palapas were always a wonderful retreat from the sun.  The pool bar area is a favorite spot and don't forget to try the "Mamawanna"  Even when Sandy became ill the day before our departure he made sure we had the same superior service with another excellent butler, Johnfi.  Both are highly recommended.  It did not take us long to decide when we returned home that we would be coming back.  We just booked another week at the end of May.  See you soon!

reviews.author: Hector L
reviews.title: Un hotel de primera
reviews.text: Estuve un fin de semana con mi familia, y las atenciones, comidas, servicios, habitaciones, todo fue de primera. El servicio en habitaciones, restaurantes, bares y piscinas es excelente. El diseño del entorno de la piscina es majestuoso, y la clase de huéspedes es muy selecta.

reviews.author: gillac
reviews.title: Best vacations ever Tome 3
reviews.text: We were back again, for the third time, at the Paradisius Palma Real and once again, we were more then satisfied! We invited a couple of friends to join us and they could not beleive how great the facilites and the services were. The Royal Service, despite it is expensive, is worth the expenses. Our butler Gabriel Dalusma was absolutely incredible. He helped us to résolve a little problem at our arrival and thanks for his generosity, his availability and his always smile! We were also happy to see again Pedro and Francisco Cabrera at the beach. They are always smiling and ready to serve you above standards . The Palazzo restaurant was our best place for breakfast and we had our first and last dinner there. We missed Stephania but enjoyed again the Chef: Rafael Nunes and Richard Otis. Always smilling and ready to make your meal expérience unique. This year, they had renovated the NAOS Restaurant and what a change. We were amazed of the outstanding new look and the many and varied counters for incredible choices of meals for everybody's wishes. They proved us how good they are to maintain and upgrade the facilites and always offer more. We have appreciated the smile and care from all the personnel and their réal désire to make your expérience unique. Really, we cannot find any negatives from our third stay at the Paradisius. Chances are they will see us again next year. Many thanks to all for providing such outsatnding services. Best regards to all!

reviews.author: Paul B
reviews.title: The presidential suite is awesome.
reviews.text: The staff is excellent. This was my 15th time and am already looking forward to my 16th. We take friends with us each year and they are always in awe of the premises and the hospitality. I have grown to know many of the staff over the years.

reviews.author: Andrea H
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: That is what an all inclusive experience should always be. Everything was absolute perfect. The staff was amazing, they go far and beyond the normal service. Thank you Julio Reyes, Nurkia Benitez,Diversi Herrera, Medelin Sanchez, Yesica Lilian, Rosanna, Edwal Arturo, Eusebio Alesander, Joel and so many others that make of their work a blessing to every person that vacations there.

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.text:
For those that want total relaxation with all the worries taken care of, look no further than Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real. 

From the moment we arrived to the minute upon departure all our cares were looked after. Service is first rate - special thanks to our Butler, Jose and to our private beach attendant, Francisco. Every little detail was attended to with the thoughtfulness and proactive nature that one would find at a 5 star New York boutique hotel. 

The food was fantastic and the service was always with a smile - special nod to the employees of Palazzo Restaurant. 

Resort staff seem to really like their job and are happy to go that extra mile. 

My wife and I would highly recommend this resort and hope to be back soon. The bar has definitely been raised for all other resorts in this category. 

Great job!!!!

reviews.author: Cati-TP
reviews.title: Días de relax
reviews.text: Un lugar fantástico para disfrutar de unos días de relax. Todo estuvo muy bien, desde la habitación hasta la comida, piscina y demás instalaciones. La atención al público muy buena, destaca especialmente la labor del grupo de animadores, siempre pendientes de informar de las actividades disponibles. Todos son un encanto, especialmente las monitoras Queen y Jazz.

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.title: Exeptional Service
reviews.text:
Let me first state that the grounds keeping and gardens of this resort are magnificent!
I wish to mention the names of several staff that served us during our stay that made this the most memorable vacation we have had. Linny Silverio was very attentive to our needs during our visits to several of the restaurants. At the Olio restaurant Kimberley and Anthony took exceptional care of us. Baron and Emilio served us many times during breakfast, lunch and some dinners.  Felipe Morla was a pleasure to meet and kept us comfortable and "hydrated" on the beach. Denis Concepcion was a delight in serving us at the bar. These staff members touched our hearts with their service and kindness, be sure to look them up if you are planning your trip to Paradisus Palma Real, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: ashishdoc1973
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text:
Horrible experience
Especially front desk
They messed up our rooms gave us smaller rooms than we had booked and made us move in between our stay to other rooms even when our son was sick
Did not have any of the dinner reservations that we had made
Overall 1 star service at 5 star price
Never recommend it

reviews.author: ozcan yuksel
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Paradisus Punta Cana is one of the best hotels that I see all-inclusive concept other than Turkish resorts. All kind of food and drinks are tasty. Beach is lovely, however this is ocean at the end of the day. Don't expect lots of fishes in the sea. The resort is beautiful and there are lots of tropic trees. Rooms are in new fashion and clear.

reviews.author: Josef F
reviews.title: Very good service
reviews.text: If I would compare this property to all others in the area, I'd say that this is one of the better ones.  Service and food were up to my expectation. Outside the property activities are a big no-no. Fishing trip turned into a third world country disaster.  All activities within the proper are fine. The tennis courts are very well maintained, and the pro's are fine.

reviews.author: Sebastian C
reviews.title: agradecida
reviews.text: buenas tardes,en nombre de dolly cardona: estoy muy agradecida por el buena atención recibida en especial del señor jose torres del restaurante gabi , personas como el es que necesitamos para que el servicio se a excelente.

reviews.author: cgens
reviews.title: By Far THE Best Bartenders
reviews.text: I stayed in the Paradisus for 4 nights along with my family for our cousins wedding. Ramon down at the swim up bar in the main pool was amazing! Never let any of us (and we were a large and rowdy group) stand, sit or sleep without bringing us another beverage via his head or 12 glasses on his arms! Dude was sick! I highly recommend this hotel and especially Ramon at the swim up bar to anyone who is looking to get a way for a few days!

reviews.author: sw33tTravels
reviews.title: Lovely Getaway
reviews.text:
We returned from The Reserve 2 days ago. You know you are having a great time, when 2 days before you return flight, you are looking for deals to return during winter.

The beach is gorgeous, beautiful green water and pink sand. Well kept and well maintained pool and gardens. Our room was facing the main pool and the kids zone pool. Everyday, I saw the maintainace crew very early in the morning thoroughly cleaning the pools, even scrubbing the tiles. I never saw sand in the pool.

Its a Beautiful resort with an excellent staff. Our concierge Sofia Paternina made our stay so smooth and relaxing. She had atleast one surprise for us everyday. We travelled with our boys, 5 and 1. After a day full of sun and play, when we returned to our room, we always had a surprise waiting for the kids...and after dinner, she would leave something nice for us...something small that would just make us smile. She was very helpful. Whenever she wanted to confirm something and if I didn't answer the phone, she would come looking for us. At such a huge resort, I dont know how she found us everytime, at the restaurants during breakfast and lunch or the beach or the pool. My family was so lucky to have her as our concierge.

Ramon Ramirez was our star at the beach bar. He was very cheerful and pleasant to take to. He made sure that we always had what we wanted, be it drinks or towels or useful information. Maiker, Anaida and Luis were great too.

Robert at Vento was remarkable too.

Staff at the restaurants definitely needs English lessons. It was impossible to communicate with them if you dont know Spanish.

The buffets didn't have a lot of options if you are not a meat eater. They need more seafood and vegetarian options.

The pools were very beautiful and always had nice music. We were with kids and my 5 YO felt very very comfortable at the kids pool, so we couldnt even once go to the adult pools...which is alright, since kids had an awesome time at the kids zone.

If you can, get the concierge service. Its worth the extra money.

BEST part about this resort is: if you don't like something, just let them know and they will actually fix it.

Thank you Sofia, Ramone & Robert for making us feel so speical and  for making our stay an exceptional one. We can't wait to go back =)

reviews.author: Jorge J
reviews.title: Best Place to Relax - Amazing Staff that Make all Difference!!!
reviews.text: The place is amazing and beautiful. But the biggest difference at Paradisus Palma Real is the service! All  employees are so respectful, happy, helpful, considerate and polite. They make the moment so special and unique that you don't want to go back to your home. Alvaro (our amazing butler at the Royal Service), all the staff at Palazzo Restaurant are the best (special Smerlyn Olea and the barman Jorge Azevedo), the staff at Passion Restaurant, barmen at Bana, the staff at Bana, Martin at the Royal Service private beach is amazing too, at Gabi Beach Jose Mateo is amazing, Leornardo (the barman at Royal Service pool). Additionally, nothing compares with the guys responsible for the activities, dances and to make all the parties happier: Big Mac, Angel and Wilfredo are amazing, fantastic and deserve all the credits to make the day wonderful from the beginning through the end of the night (it really seems they don't sleep but keep happy anyway, motivating and transmitting all the satisfaction to people staying at Paradisus Palma Real).

reviews.author: Carmelo Padilla
reviews.title: Excelente propiedad, servicio y atenciones
reviews.text:
Es un excelente hotel Tranquilo y Familiar, muy buena comida y bebida, grandes áreas comunes y muy buena ubicación. 
Mejorar un poco el servicio de camareros en los restaurantes ya sea por agotamiento o alta ocupación se tardaban mucho en atender.

reviews.author: NatalieMysz
reviews.title: Excellent luxurious holidays
reviews.text:
We had really good time here :) everything was okay. 
Alexander is perfect at pool activities, José is very kind, our concierge Yeuri was helpful and gave us useful informacion.
Generally great team!
Food was also delicious, original drinks, clean rooms.
We will come here again for sure!!! :)

reviews.author: Rafa H
reviews.title: alexader lopez the best
reviews.text:
El hotel es para disfrutar. Magnificas instalaciones y sobre todo un personal amable y siempre dispuesto a agradar. La comida es buena o muy buena. Las piscinas, playa, etc. 
Gracias a Carlos el chofer del club de vacaciones, un profesional y muy buena gente. Gracias a Alexander con su animacion en la reserva y en general a todos los que trabajan aqui. Volveremos pronto!

reviews.author: GiGiAtlanta
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: we just stayed at this lovely property.  I loved using the wellness center at the Reserve.  We had lunch every day at the Gabi Beach restaurant and had fabulous service thanks to Genivel Mauricio.  I loved the Royal Service treatment and the beach side service.

reviews.author: Daniel P
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel
reviews.text:
Acabamos de terminar unas lindas vacaciones de 10 días en the reserve paradisus punta cana. Un hotel con muy buenas instalaciones. Grande pero con un toque personal. El servicio es muy bueno. La calidad de las habitaciones en The reserve es bueno. Habitaciones grande y muy cómodas. La comida es muy buena, salvo la excepción de The Grill y Aqua.  Esto dependerá de los gustos, sin embargo nos gusto mucho Vento y Fuego. Dos restaurantes muy buenos. El bufet de The Reserve, Gabi Club, excelente. Buena calidad de comida y muy buen servicio. Los mas especial de los restaurantes es el servicio. Les mandamos saludos y agradecemos la hospitalidad de Wandy, Juanlin Figueroa y Candida Pacheco en el Gabi Club. Los cocineros del Gabi club, Cesar Suarez y Narciso Quezada. Muchas gracias por los saludos y la excelente comida. También saludos a todo el personal que nos servia tragos en las piscinas de The reserve. Emilio y compania. Gracias. 
Una de las cosas que mas nos gusto a nosotros como padres de dos niñas pequeñas, fue el Kids Zone. Las cuidadoras, muy amables y cariñosas con nuestras niñas. Gracias a Yahira, Kiwi y a Arne.  El Kids zone esta muy bien en términos de instalaciones. Grande y con cosas para todas las edades. Habria que hacer un poco mas de publicidad entre los huéspedes para involucrar mas a los padres y que traigan a los niños a las actividades. 
Rosmery de jesus y las otras concierges, muy simpáticas. Nos ayudaron en todo momento.
Nos dejaron hacer late check out sin coste alguno, lo cual fue un gesto muy bonito del hotel. La verdad es que no tenemos quejas. Sigan así y nos veremos pronto.

reviews.author: Jodi M
reviews.title: Wonderful time at The Reserve!
reviews.text:
We returned from The Reserve last week after a 5 night amazing stay. I traveled with my 15 year old daughter and twin 9 year old sons. I highly recommend The Reserve and we will be going back! As a single woman, I felt very safe at this property;everything was easily accessible. The beach was beautiful, the pool was amazing, and most importantly the staff was stellar! I'd like to recognize our concierge, Estefania Ruiz who reserved our cabana by the pool, made all our dining reservations, checked on us almost daily, and surprised my sons with a balloon bubble bath one day after the pool. She was sweet, friendly and attentive. I'd also like to mention the wonderful job of Fabio V and Alexander Lopez by the pool. They were very entertaining and encouraged all of us to join in all the fun by the pool.   Antony Cid was wonderful in the Gabi Club.
Kids Club- Appropriate for ages up to 7; my 9 year old sons were bored and lasted about 45 minutes there.
Restaurants-we ate at Fuego (very good), The Grill (excellent), Vento (excellent), Aqua (very good), and Mole (excellent). Lunch was either at the Aqua Grill by the Reserve Pool (good) or at the Gabi Club (good). Breakfast every day at Gabi Club; food was average with expected breakfast fare.
Room- we stayed in a Reserve Family One Bedroom Suite. It was exceptionally clean, well maintained, excellent air conditioning which is a must for me, and enormous! Plenty of dressers to unpack into, large closets, mini fridge, coffee maker. Beautiful marble floors, comfy beds. We were in building #41 which was right next to the Reserve pool and walking distance to the main lobby at Paradisus, restaurants, and shopping.
Getting around- We used the trolley/golf cart transportation. Very reliable and the desired way to get down to the beach, restaurants.As a side note, one of my sons lost his iPod one night traveling on the trolley. We alerted Estefania and within 2.5 hours, he had his iPod returned. Amazing because this was at 10:30 at night! 
Check in/out- Its worth the extra money for concierge level because check in and out was effortless and pleasurable!
My ONLY negative, and it's a minor one, was that we were not informed of the bike rental option. After 2 days at The Reserve, we noticed people riding bikes and when I inquired about them, I was told they had to be reserved 24 hours in advance. Needless to say, we were unable to reserve bikes and it would have been nice to use as transportation around the property. It should be mentioned at check in which it wasn't.

reviews.author: Brownmo14
reviews.title: Still on my honeymoon and counting the days until I get out of here
reviews.text:
Still here and writing a review...
Day one
Our reservation was at the reserve, or so we thought. The shuttle driver dropped us off at the paradisus Palma real. Went to check in and they didn't have our reservation and directed is back to the reserve. Get driven on a golf cart to the reserve, where they tell us that our reservation is at the paradisus Palma real. We finally get to the right desk at the paradisus Palma real, when the woman asks for a credit card to pay for the all inclusive fees. I showed her the email (that I printed out before I left- thank god!) and she informs me that I should not have prepaid and the hotel doesn't do that. She was not sure why I was emailed to get prepayment. Anyway, a whole 4 hours after landing we make it to our room. Loosing an entire day because the people at this  hotel DO NOT have a clue of commonsense. They may be very nice, but will NOT go out if their way to help. We tried to get a late lunch/ early dinner only to find that you need reservations for dinner and only one of the two lunch places were open. So we grabbed some quick food at the one place that was open and went back to the check in desk to make reservations. We ended up making reservations at a hibachi place for that evening and the rest of the week. The hibachi food/ menu was good and typical hibachi. The guys working the grill were charming and funny. We didn't feel like joining
In the dancing festivities so late, plus we were Exhausted so we just went to bed by 10pm. 

Day two
Started the day early at the pool. Bartenders were accommodating and cheerful. Moved to the beach early afternoon where there were still open cabanas. Tried to go to lunch, but yet again, only one of the two lunch spots was open. Same old resort buffet (ignore the flys) and it is only day two.  We went back to the room And thought we could salvage lunch by ordering room Service. Boy were we wrong! It's not that it wasn't edible. It was just I've never had food like that. The calzone was more like an empanadas, which are premade, so no customizing for food allergies. The pizza was made on a tortilla shell, that want too bad, a little salty tho. The only thing that I recognized was the Fruit platter of watermelon, cantaloupe and pineapple. Went back down to the beach and had a great rest of the afternoon. Came in from a long day of sunbathing to realize we didn't get our dinner reservation tickets for the week still! Go to the front desk and to talk with Heidwi and Patricia to find not all of my reservations have been made. What the heck, can something please go right? For dinner we had reservations for the Market grill. Our Server extremely friendly and the salad course was timely and rather Delish. But then we waited an hour ten for over cooked steak and undercooked lobster. Since I am pregnant and CANNOT eat raw or undercooked meat this was especially disturbing. We Left food not eaten on table, searched for another restaurant. We could not find another restaurant that could Accommodate and or we were underdressed. So hear we are night two on our honeymoon ordering room service and watching in room movies with subtitles.

Day three 
Started off with no running water. Called to alert he front desk where the woman that answered the phone, Patricia, hung up on me. Ordered room service breakfast and there were two small flies in the eggs. Absolutely disgusting. The only edible thing was the toast. Go to the pool and find our reserved cabana and lay our towels out. Decided then to head to the ocean for an hour or so. When we returned to the pool the cabana that had our name on it, to reserve it, no had someone else laying in it with someone else's name on it. None of the staff would help correct the issue and or find us a new cabana. After basically having a nervous breakdown because my honeymoon couldn't get any worse they found us a "new" cabana. Basically I am in a foreign country, no one can speak English and when there is a problem there is no one to help. Have 5 days left in hell. Definitely wouldn't tell my worst enemy to come here.

reviews.author: amyillapetrs
reviews.title: Good time, a little slow, not a lot of english.
reviews.text: Alexandro Lopez was a lot of fun to do activities with in the pool. There werr a few nights we had early donner reservations, but they opened VERY late... 6:40 when our reservation was for 6. Beautiful place, well maintained. Inconsistent with drink preperation, room cleaning. Quality of food was very good, best dessert was the chocolate soufle at vento. Mole was best restaurant overall. Overall, we had a great eight days.

reviews.author: Bocke6
reviews.title: The best resort ever!! We have been to many and this has been the very best!!
reviews.text:
The rooms were beautiful !  Everyone was so helpful. Annabella Gonzalaz and Yeuei Beltre were the best - very helpful!!!!!!the beaches were beautiful. Huts at the beach were great. Enjoyed all the different resteraunts. We were so pleased that we are bringing our whole family. 
The Grill Resteraunts was the best. 
Pool was very clean and refreshing!
Staff all very friendly and helpful

reviews.author: truehabsfan
reviews.title: Much better than what I was expecting !!
reviews.text:
We just returned yesterday from the Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana, we were there for 10 nights.  We were with another family and there were 8 of us all together (for adults and four children – two girls aged 14 and two boys aged 16).   Both families have been all around the Caribbean many times and for us, this was our third trip to the DR, but our first at this resort.
We arrived a little later than we were supposed to, as our driver from Dominican Air Transfers took us to the Grand Palladium first, then the Reserve at the Paradisus Palma Real, and finally he figured out where we were supposed to be!  No worries, we were all in a pretty good mood at that point so made no big deal out of it.
Once we arrived, we went through a painless check in session at the reserve lobby, and were led to the Gabi club for lunch as our room was not ready.  Once we had a bite to eat, we changed into our swim gear (which we always pack in our carry on for this reason) and spent a bit of time in the wonderful refreshing pool.  At around 3:30 we headed back to the lobby and met our family concierge Leidy Guerrero who we all fell in love with immediately!  She gave us our cell phones to contact her (and the other family with us), and made all our dinner reservations for the next 5 nights (at 7:00 pm as requested).  She then brought us to our rooms where we were immediately stunned by the size and modern feel of them.  We honestly had too much space but didn’t complain.  We were in a two bedroom Family Suite, where there were two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, two Jacuzzi tubs, and a common living room with dining set.  The two mini bars were stocked with pop, water, and beer.  Leidy then reserved a cabana for us at the pool, each day, and would do the same at the beach if we changed our minds.  We ended up staying at the pool most of the time and the beach was very windy and not enjoyable for lying out (it was also very crowded).  The beach was great for morning walks however.  From the reserve pool to the reserve beach it is exactly a 7 minute walk at a normal pace.  I almost laughed out loud when I thought of some reviews that complained about the long walk LOL.  If it really is too much for you to walk those 7 minutes however there are trolleys that pass by every 5 minutes or so.
Reading reviews before we left, I had prepared myself for time share sales pitches throughout the week.  I was rather surprised then, when not once was there a call or a hint at any kind of presentation.
We ate at all the restaurants and enjoyed every meal.  We paid the extra for the Passion restaurant ($50 per person).  It was an experience we were glad we tried, but would not do it again.  I don’t like to go into many details regarding food when doing a review because I know it is a subjective thing, but I will say that all eight of us found something to eat at every restaurant that we liked.  Our son is a vegetarian and he had no problems at all.  
We did not attend many of the shows, except for the Lion King one night which was quite nice.  It was all lip syncing and a bit cheesy but still a nice show worth seeing.  The beach party on Saturday night is fun but we found it a little tacky that they rent out the sun beds and chairs during the event
The grounds at this resort are simply beautiful – well groomed, always being taken care of and cleaned.  There is a walking path that is “green” and no vehicles are allowed on it.  There is also a small garden by the main lobby where they grow their own herbs and spices.
Here are the main things I liked about the resort:
The Reserve – very calm and peaceful around the pool.  Lots of chairs available any time of day.  Pool not crowded at all.  Rooms are very large and modern
There are no towel cards or exchanges – take as many as you want and no worries about returning the same amount.
