There are bins around the pools to put them in, or the pool guys come around often and clean them off the chairs.  A little tip – when we had our cabanas reserved, we were told we had to get them by 10:00 , after that they are up for grabs.  If you want a cabana and they are all gone, wait around until after 10:00 and take one that does not have any belongings on it.
Drink service at the pool was simply amazing.  Emilio Valdez and Santo Polanco were two great guys that became friends very fast.
This is the first resort we have been at that tips were not expected all the time.  We did leave some after the meals and at the bars but they were not standing over you all the time with their hands out, like we experienced in Cuba a couple of years ago.  The airport, well that’s another story lol
Here are a couple of things that were not so perfect:
We seemed to be the only Canadians there, and there were maybe 20% Americans.  Not a big problem but we like to socialize around the pool and we hardly heard any English at all.  The resort advertises heavily in Europe so there are many Spanish and Italians around.  As I have learned over the years they are quite rude and this tended to be the case again this year.  On top of that they love to smoke around the pool, and a few times we had to change chairs to get away from it.
There was a large language barrier in most of the restaurants.  Many times we received the wrong drink order because of this.  Not a big deal but it was disappointing in the Japanese Grill where the chef put on a nice show but couldn’t engage the guests because he spoke no English at all.  
It did not happen to us, but our friends had money and an iphone stolen from their room.  The items were not in the safe but they were stashed away very well, and in a carry on bag so their items were gone through.  We put all our stuff in the safe as we have learned our lesson well.  I did have money stolen on an excursion but this had nothing to do with the hotel – see my review on the adventure boogey tour.
In summary we had a great stay at this resort.  We will not likely go back to the DR again as we have been there 3 times now and would like to visit other islands, or go back to our favourite (Jamaica).  Should we do decide to visit again, we would certainly go back to the Reserve, but without the family concierge as we found we are not demanding enough to justify that extra expense !

reviews.author: C M
reviews.title: Spring Getaway 2014
reviews.text: It was the little touches that made this such a wonderful visit.  There were a number of nice and friendly people from Bell Boy Hazeal Reyes, Concierge Ada when we arrived, Evan Martinez for Room Service and Elaidy M. when we left. There were so many others, I wished I had written down everyone's name.  The rooms were nicely done, the decor was very relaxing, loved the fact that at any turn there was a place to lounge on a couch, always a zen feel to the place.  I traveled with my boyfriend and his teenage daughter,  there was something for all of us and plenty of food choices even for a picky eater.  An additional nice touch at the Reserve is the available concierge at each of the unit, it made you feel that there was always someone available in easy close proximity that could provide assistance. The young lady that was there during our stay April 23-26 was so lovely, patient and helpful, from confirming reservations to questions about the resort. The grounds are lovely, we wished we actually could have been there longer. We took advantage of the evening "entertainment" at the Nova theater, it is a nice touch, not a major show, however it was nice. We used dollars the entire trip no need to exchange for RD Pesos, and tended to use more small bills. Boyfriend and I were able to take advantage of the pool side spa service, they happen to be running a discount for that afternoon, so within 15 minutes we were relaxing with a 50 minute massage, extremely relaxing and convenient, it was also toward the end of the day still rather peaceful and the general noise from the pool was quickly tuned out.

reviews.author: Kamal P
reviews.title: Once again, terrific
reviews.text:
This is our fifth year in a row to the Paradisus, and it continues to maintain, and in fact exceed, its quality. For example, this year they have a bike share program (you have to make a reservation for the bikes, though once you get them they are a ton of fun to ride around).

The upkeep of the grounds and facilities is meticulous, the service is gracious, and the staff is very hospitable. The beach staff led by Maiker makes the stay 5-star (along with Ramon, Luis, and Oneida at the bar). 

We will be back next year again!

reviews.author: Claudia A
reviews.title: 5th time at hotel and disappointed!
reviews.text: I'd like to start out by saying that it's a shame that Naos burned down - it was such a wonderful place to have breakfast and lunch.  The Market Grill was horrible - we ate there twice and had RAW meat - very disgusting!  We were also disappointed to find that one of our favorite pool bartenders (Ramon "FUEGO") was no longer at the pool bar, but at the Sky bar - which is a little bar on the side of the Market Grill.  The pool bar wasn't the same.  We upgraded to VIP, but didn't get treated that way.  We made dinner reservations at the beginning of our stay for all 4 nights - so we thought.  We were told that we had dinner reservations our first night at the Gabi Beach club, but then when we went back to check the time, they didn't have the reservation, so we made a reservation for Bana for 8:15 that same evening.  Guess what, Bana did not have our reservation, but they called someone and found out that we had reservations a - you got it - Gabi Beach club.  When we got to the Gabi Beach club, they said that they were going to TRY to accommodate us.  Are you kidding me!  This happened day after day.  Very disappointed!  Don't think I'm going to go back next year - will try another all-inclusive Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Martha C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, Never Again
reviews.text:
This resort has its cons and pros. Last year we stood at Melia, which was amazing! We ended up buying a timeshare so this year we decided to stay at the Paradisus since it's supposed to be an upgrade.

The resort itself is beautiful and well maintained. The food and drinks are good as well. We are Melia Club Members and didn't feel that we received any special treatment at Paradisus Palma Real as we did last year at Melia. We had a couple problems throughout our stay. 

First thing is that as club members we are guaranteed a bed by the pool. We were told we would have it the next day. When we arrived to the pool, of course we didn't have one. It took them a while to figure it out. The following day, we had the same problem. Second thing is that our concierge made our dinner reservations for the remainder of our stay. On the second to last night we were there, we went to the restaurant and they didn’t have us on their list. Luckily, there were a few tables empty so they were able to fit us. On our last night we didn’t end up having dinner until 10 pm because again, they didn’t have us on their list. We went to guest services and they couldn’t figure it out. When they tried looking me up by my room number, my name wasn’t even on their system. They had another family with a party of 6 in their system for our room. Another problem was room service. Every time we ordered room service, they screwed up the order. They never gave us our entire order. One of the times we were finished with room service, I called them so they could pick up the plates. After two hours of waiting, I decided to put the plates outside the room since it was late and we wanted to sleep. The next morning the plates were still there with a horrible smell since there was ceviche. We were also told that the servers were supposed to constantly come up to us by the pool to see if we wanted any drinks, we had to complain multiple times to get this type of service. It seemed that they only came around when we started tipping larger amounts and when they would come around they didn’t have our complete orders. We also thought that the hotel’s nightly entertainment was pretty boring. On our last day we bumped into our concierge and told him about all the problems, he looked like he could care less about anything. During checkout I also informed the receptionist and she didn’t seem to care either.

As I stated before, the resort is beautiful and the food and drinks are great. But I feel that for it being the Paradisus Palma Real, the service is horrible. Being a Melia Club Member, I expected better treatment was greatly disappointed. We will not be returning to the Paradisus Palma Real. Hands down, Melia gives you the treatment and service you deserve.

reviews.author: nancy l
reviews.title: beware
reviews.text:
the good news is this resort has a great location. the grounds are on a 1 to 10 a solid 10.  the buildings are also a 10 in design and eye appeal. the resort is very clean.  the ocean is usable.  the rooms are clean and set up nicely.  NOW the bad news.  beware of the price promised and the actual charges. we over paid $700.00.  No help from the management.  The concierge desk has only one person and what they confirm and tell you is only true maybe 40% of the time.  we had restaurants, dates, and times changed several times. the beach has no drink service.  the resort is very restrictive if you are not a member.  management has no authority to solve issues. not enough towels in the rooms.  some equipment in rooms do not work and it takes most of your vacation to get repairs. if you do not swim or if you are short the pool is to deep for a lot of the guest to use. the sound for the night shows (lion king) was so bad we left the entertainment early.  the restaurants service was lacking...we received our drinks after we had eaten our meal almost 75% of the time.  the resort was just a little off the standard in most cases.  things to note:  you need to pay for a visa before you go...otherwise you will stand in a long line at the airport.  make your taxi arrangements to the property before you go.  the resort charge is twice as high.  the water for brushing your teeth or drinking in your room MUST be bottled water only.  day trips and excursions are great to set up and have handled by the resort desk however do not have any of the excursions people handle the photos or DVDs we paid $45 and received about 10 minutes on the DVD for an entire days adventure.
The property is beautiful and can with some management overview be great. it advertises and charges it self as a 5 star but is only maybe a 3 star experience at a 5 star price.  we will not return.

reviews.author: JR J
reviews.title: Attractive Resort, if a Little too Low Key. Great Beach Staff!
reviews.text:
Two things immediately stood out as we arrived at The Reserve. The first is just how beautifully landscaped the property is. Not surprising, as it appeared that landscapers were tending to the resort's lush greenery in what appeared to be a 24x7 cycle. Great job guys! The second realization was just how spread out the property is. Be prepared to walk fairly long distances to get to certain restaurants and facilities, or to wait for one of the "golf cart trains" that continuously circled the resort carrying guests looking for a faster alternative to walking.

The Reserve boasts a number of specialty restaurants, which in our opinion were OK, certainly nothing spectacular.  But what made our stay at The Reserve extra special was the beach staff 
of Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana and Oneida Zarrila. They worked non stop. They tended to our every need, making sure we had ample towels. We had the privilege of having Ramon help us on most days.  He knew where we preferred to sit and gave us valuable advice about the best time to arrive at the beach to be assured a shaded area for the day. He always remembered our favorite drinks and made sure we were never thirsty. Ramon - thanks for introducing me to the Ron Barcelona rum and for making our days at beach especially stress free and relaxing.

reviews.author: MsLyn901
reviews.title: Excellent - would love to return
reviews.text:
Anabel was our concierge - building 39. She helped us make our travel arrangements. We also had an issue with the  screen on our balcony door. We called Anabel, and the door was fixed within 20 minutes. 

We also had a great time at the pool. The entertainment staff was wonderful!! Jose, Emilio (drinks), Rafael, and Marionelli were fabulous! We always had drinks, activities, sunscreen, towels, etc.  They also helped us make dinner reservations when we were having so much fun by the pool that we forgot to make them. 

I would definitely stay here again. Housekeeping was wonderful too. We had turndown service, and our minibar was restocked multiple times a day.

reviews.author: DRSUGARMAN
reviews.title: Great for Families but not Foodies
reviews.text:
My Family spent a week at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana from March 17th to the 22nd.  We wanted a very quiet and relaxing trip and that’s definitely what we experienced.  We did not use a Family Concierge as our Girls are 12 and 14 and didn’t need babysitting.  That being said Sandra Cedeno was excellent – she was attentive and helped us make dinner reservations every night.  She was an absolute delight and always had a happy smile on her face when we saw her.  She even shared some homemade coconut candy which was so delicious we’d go back to see if she’d give us some more!  Our room was in the back (not overlooking the pool) and this meant it was especially quiet which we liked.  Room was comfortable and clean.  We did have some issues with the WiFi which took a while to overcome – but hey it’s the DR and you are on vacation…
 
I’d like to give a big shout out to Valentin Caminero and Santo Polanco at The Hydro Grill they were super waiters – they knew that we liked the local grouper and remembered our drink orders and were always so cheerful.  We spent a LOT of time by the pool because it was so nice and because Emilio Valdez and Jose Luis kept us in drinks all day – I loved hearing “Drinkey drinkey”.  Too bad they don’t do that at the office…
 
I was disappointed that the gym was so small and the equipment was pretty old – I went once the first day and subsequently discovered they do poolside exercise classes! Noel was fun and full of energy and I just LOVED aqua aerobics and spinning in the pool.  Noel more than made up for the gym being a bit sad.  We didn’t use the spa as I thought the prices were way too high (and we live in Manhattan).
 
I also have to compliment the groundskeepers on how immaculate the resort is – it’s truly beautiful and we had an extra treat of one of the coconuts from the palms they were trimming.  The beach is also nice and being at The Reserve area means it’s a bit less crowded.  There was a lot of spring break drinking and craziness further along in the main section.
 
My only real complaint is the food – I wish that there was more local fresh fish and produce on the menu.  When we travel we’d rather eat simple local cuisine and feel like we are in the country we are visiting rather than go to Italian, Japanese etc. restaurants.   I didn’t see a single empanada and not much rice and beans anywhere (when I look up DR Cuisine online there’s a long list of interesting sounding dishes with influences from Spain and Africa we would have loved to have tried).  I guess they think that Americans want to eat “American” food.
 
Gabi Club – breakfasts were good loved the fresh pineapple, plantains and omelet station
Hydro Grill – the Grouper ceviche and the fried grouper were excellent
Vento – revolting; the tuna we had was not fresh
Mole – decent tortilla soup
Passion – very pretty and some of the dishes were excellent 
Fuego – only place where the service was not friendly or attentive.  Food was overall so-so, but the shrimp were very fresh and delicious
Aqua – Good octopus and pizza, but I didn’t enjoy the risotto at all and they noticed that I didn’t eat it.  The Chef came out (I didn’t ask him to) and seemed quite annoyed with me and lectured me on risotto – in my opinion it was swimming with fat (I thought it was butter, he said it was cream) and I got dressed down as if I was an idiot and had never eaten risotto before.  Sir – I have spent extended periods of time in Italy; whatever you had done to that risotto was not right, period.
Bana – this was actually quite fun even though the sushi wasn’t great.  We ate here twice because watching the chefs cook was very entertaining.
The Grill – miss.  Very production line type of food. 
 
Overall we very much enjoyed our stay, which was made more fun by all the fabulous people working there.

reviews.author: Brandy R
reviews.title: If you have an IQ higher than your resting heart rate you should really read this!!!!!
reviews.text:
Okay, so I don't really know where to start with this. I have never written a review on here before, but because my experience was so mind-blowingly awful, I felt the need to share it with whoever wants to listen. Honestly, I could write a small novel about why not to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, DR, but I am not going to waste too much time because I have a lot to do today. I always keep a notebook or journal wherever I travel and I write down almost everything so I have documentation and so I avoid forgetting my experiences. While staying here, I accumulated a total of 86 negative experiences and 13 positive ones. Here is a short, but very important, top ten list of reasons why not to stay at this resort:

1. Excessive waste of money on so many levels: I hate spending money and not getting what I want. This place is so expensive that it makes me want to throw up. It is completely unnecessary and disgusting to spend over 6000 USD in one week and walk away unhappy, broke, and mentally exhausted.

2. This resort is really not ALL INCLUSIVE. It is a perfect example of corporate exploitation and greed. What is included is pretty much any amount of booze that you can keep down so that hopefully you will remain drunk enough not to notice or care what is happening around you. I watched a guy have 29 drinks in about 4 hours and then the next day I checked on him and he was in the bath tub passed out and covered in vomit. Where was his butler at this moment with the gatorade, cheeseburger, and Ibuprofen???

3. The rooms are not nice by any means. After leaving the resort I stayed in a hotel for 23 USD per day and was happier there than the Paradisus  (around 400 USD per day).

4. Almost all of the food is disgusting with the two exceptions being the offerings at The Palazzo and the Royal Services Club. If you like frozen food or food that will make you sick, then by any means, eat up my friend. My mom got sick twice from the food, her friend only got sick once. I only ate at the resort a few times so I was safe other than a couple of explosive diarrhea experiences. No big deal right???

5. Just because you have a "Butler" in no way guarantees that you will get what you want. They give you what you think you need or what they are allowed to do based on a ridiculous set of rules and regulations.

6. Background music that sounds exactly like the soundtrack for a soft-core porn movie is playing everywhere and never stops.

7. A lot of NASTY people work here. By nasty I mean excessively bad attitudes. There are a number of fabulous, accommodating, and caring employees, but unfortunately for me the bad managed to outweigh the good due to the extremity of my interactions with terrible people that should burn in hell for all eternity.

8. It takes FOREVER to get anything here. It's almost like they go as slow as they want because they know there is nothing you can do about it, even if you are locked out of your room and need your inhaler so that you won't stop breathing. Death obviously isn't on there list of concerns.

9. Constant lies and over exaggerations about places off the grounds. Punta Cana and the surrounding areas are truly amazing. Wonderful everything: Bars, restaurants, shopping, beaches, people, music, food, and I could go on and on. I liked it so much that I am probably going to buy property here and live here for half of the year. Note: I plan on putting this place out of business or at least hopefully forcing them to get new management so that they can't continue to monetarily rape people on a daily basis. 

10. Do you really need a number 10??? I am getting worked up so I need to stop before I ruin my day and have to spend it doing yoga so I can emotionally reset. Just kidding. Kind of. Anyways, I hope this helps a little. If you need any more information regarding my experience here or you want to know where to stay, eat, drink, dance, swim, drive, shop, get your nails done, or anything else for a fraction of what you will spend in this hell hole, feel free to contact me at raraavis120@gmail.com and I would be more than happy to help you as much I can.

Thanks for reading, and remember, it is okay to use your brain to make sound decisions on a daily basis. It's good for you and makes you live much longer so that you will have years and years and years of good vacations!!!

reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.title: Great all inclusive
reviews.text: I have never been to an all inclusive and had my concerns before going. This is a high end all inclusive.  All drinks, including alcohol were included -- apparently this isn't always the case.  Golf course was great and not crowded. Beach and facilities were very, very clean, maintained and beautiful...

reviews.author: thereserve
reviews.title: Spring 2014
reviews.text:
Very nice resort. Concierge Annabel Gonzalez Yeuri Beltre is professional & very nice!
Geremis P. Ramirez also provided fantastic service. 
All employees very friendly and helpful. Lots of activities/entertainment too. Food is good. Reservations for specialty dining can be difficult but concierge did good job. 
Had a great vacation. We will come back.did catamaran/snorkeling which was so much fun!!!!!
Love love love DR. We'll be back.

reviews.author: JulioPrados
reviews.title: Un lugar al que volver
reviews.text: Pasamos 11 dias increibles en este mes de Abril del 11 al 22 exactamente, sin duda volveremos. A pesar de que el hotel haya bajado su calidad en algunos aspectos con respecto al pasado año, este año nos faltó Naos y se notava sobre todo en que el resto de restaurantes estaba mas concurrido, tampoco habia el tan apreciado "Churrasco" a la hora de la comida en el restaurante Gabi beach y tampoco en Gabi Club en The Reserve. En cambio el servicio en la mayoría de los casos a ido a mejor, sobre todo en el caso de los bares de las piscinas, con especial mención a Michelet Loase que tuvo un comportamiento fantástico. Victor Feliz de Gabi beach y uno de los camareros que se llama Jose y no recordamos el apellido. En la playa Felipe nos hizo sentir en el paraiso, con sus atenciones desinteresadas. Cristian Santana de The Reserve también  fue muy amable. Luis Amauty nos preparo los mejores cocteles de todo el resort, con una gran dosis de paciencia. En Sky Bar en el turno de noche también nos trataron de maravilla. También añadir con especial cariño por parte de nuestros pequeñajos a todo el staff del Kids Zone, con especial mencion a Angel, Edward, Nicaurys, Jennifer y Carlos, fueron los mejores cuidadores que pudieran tener Nicole y Maxim. El chef Salvador y Juan de Dios fueron de verdad unos fantasticos anfitriones en todo lo que pudiesemos desear. Las cenas de Passion y Aqua fueron una verdadera delicia, inolvidables. Gracias por todo, esperamos volvernos a ver. Un saludo, Familia Borràs.

reviews.author: JenniferM77
reviews.title: Surprisingly quiet and relaxing for a family resort
reviews.text:
We have spent a wonderful week at this resort. The Reserve is part of a larger resort, whereby the main resort is busy, lively and lots going on. The couples only (Royal Service) is small and then there is the Reserve, which is newer and in my opinion far nicer. Whilst it is pitched for families, there is much more of a calmness to the place and the kids pool is separate to the large main pool. 

The only downside is that it is only families that can reserve cabana's round the pool and beach. So, if you're looking for some shade you need to be up early to get up early to grab one of the non-reserved for the day. Didn't bother me so much as at nearly 28 weeks pregnant I'm up at 6am, but definitely needed the shade in order to sit out. 

The staff are extremely proud to work at the Reserve and all seem to really enjoy working there. Everyone was very attentive. Special mentions should go to Iris (our concierge) who made sure everything was perfect for the day, including restaurant reservations. Also to Santo and Emilio who ensured we never were without a drink by the pool. They were both always walking around with a smile and remembered preferred drink orders from previous days too. 

Staying at the reserve you have access to all the restaurants and if staying for a week you never need to go back to dinner at the same place twice. Definitely try the red snapper at Fuegos and Ventos is
also very good. We were lucky enough to win a romantic meal for two on the beach - a reason in itself to get involved with the daily activities. This was superb and Edward (our waiter for the evening) was very attentive. 

Would definitely recommend this resort to anyone looking to get away to relax and have the option to get involved with a more lively resort if they want.

reviews.author: P0lfam
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week long vacation at The Reserve.  We brought 8 adults and 5 kids with us.  What sets this place apart is the family concierge.  Ovidio Pavilis was our concierge.  He did an outstanding job.  We got to know him and he got to know us.  He took care of every possible detail of the day for us and made each transition throughout the day smooth.  We can't say enough good things about him.

Another employee that stood out was Berlis at the Kids Club.  She had tremendous energy and our kids could not wait to give her a big hug every time they saw her.  The kids club is truly a great ammenity that allows adults time to themselves throughout the day or dinner time.  The whole staff at the kids club was great but Berlis set herself apart.

reviews.author: HAD232
reviews.title: The Royal Service is Special
reviews.text:
This is the second all-inclusive resort my wife and I have been to, and it was probably one of the best trips to a beach getaway that we have had.  What made it superior was the Royal Service that some friends told us about just before we booked the trip. This service level is worth it primarily for the reserved beach hut, the Palazzo Restaurant and the private lounge upstairs from the restaurant.  We were greeted by our pleasant young butler, Jeuri, who was very accommodating and helpful.  With Royal Service, your assigned butler handles just about anything you might need done on the property.  After a few days, we felt that none of the other restaurants come close to Palazzo, so we stuck with that even though the menu does not change;  there are enough items to have a different meal at every visit.  We also learned that the absolute best coffee is served in the lounge, and though I did not get his name, kudos to the butler who handles the service there.  We found that dinner at Vento, an Italian restaurant, to be mediocre and the service was quite unprofessional.  Dinner at Gabi Beach was just ok, and lunch at the Market Grill was dreadful.  We arrived the day after the largest buffet, Naos, burned down on April 5, 2014 due to a careless use of pyrotechnics.  Mole, an adjacent Mexican restaurant, also closed as a result, eliminating two restaurants.  Fortunately, this was not a major issue for us, since I don't feature spending this kind of money to go to a buffet, although Naso evidently had a good reputation. Bana, the hibachi restaurant (it also serves sushi and Asian-fusion dishes in separate areas) was fun, but the food was well below average for this kind of cuisine; very salty and overcooked, possibly as a result of the cook getting carried away with his grilling antics.  Go for the show and the camaradarie, but have dinner elsewhere.

I had just completed several very stressful months of work, and wanted to just veg out on a beach.  This was just what I needed.  The beach is spectacular. Very relaxing, with bar service (Ramon took very good care of us there) and whatever else you may want from your butler who is available by cell phone that he gives you on arrival.  Butlers work 11 days and then get three days off.  After four days, Jeuri was replaced by Juan de Leon, and the handoff from one to the other was nicely done.  I could pick a few nits, but the overall experience so overshadows these, I don't think it is worth mentioning them.  

We probably will return to this resort. It is the only beach resort I have ever been to where I don't need to get up at 7 am to go down to the beach to reserve a lounge.  To me this was huge as I could sleep in and not be concerned about wandering out to the beach after a fine breakfast at Palazzo.  I would be remiss in not mentioning Stephania, the hostess at Palazzo who greets you daily with her magnificent smile and pleasant manner. The staff is very good, particularly the butlers, and the facility is first rate.  We had a garden view room overlooking the Yhi Spa garden, which is absolutely beautiful.  The entire facility is very meticulously maintained.  If you are considering this resort, which caters to adults, I highly recommend the Royal Service, which has its own buildings close to the beach.  Thanks again Jeuri and Juan.  We hope to see you again.

reviews.author: viajador
reviews.title: Anabel is the best
reviews.text: Es un sueño.El servicio es excelente; todos en el resort se esmeran en hacerte sentir especial. Me divertí mucho con las actividades, la comida es muy buena. Anabel es nuestra concierge y es muy profesional y atenta.

reviews.author: dahi2r
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones!!!
reviews.text: Me parece que las atenciones que tienen con los turistas son excelentes, la comida muy buena, los shows nocturnos son padrisimos la fam. Vargas agradecemos la atencion en especial a Ruben Dario y Benjy Bourjolly, personas amables, atentas, respetuosas, simpaticas y  muy bailadores. ... Muchas graciasss por hacernos sentir como partr de su familia! Sin dudarlo volveremos!!!

reviews.author: Mindy M
reviews.title: Wish we were still there.....
reviews.text:
We returned late last evening after a 4 night, 5 day stay at the Paradisius Punta Cana. We stayed in a suite with concierge service, well worth the extra money! Our concierge Sophia Paternina rocked! She made sure that our first footsteps onto the resort where comfortable and throughout our entire stay was always available for questions. She sent us coconuts,cookies, chocolate covered strawberries even made a bubble bath in our jacuzzi tub with gorgeous flowers throughout the bubbles. She was such a sweetheart when we return we will be requesting Sophia for our concierge again, she made our trip so much easier for us!
The service and friendliness of the staff didn't stop with Sophia, we met many workers on our stay at the resort and everyone was friendly. The first day we where there we ate at the Hydro Grill, we met Jose , Melvin & Valentine very nice and professional gentlemen. Valentine made sure that we where being taken care of and didn't need anything more! The food was very good there and Jose was very prompt with his serving. Melvin however is the man! He went above and beyond what he needed to.While we were chatting with him he asked us if we would want to eat there the next day and we said yes so he invited us back for a "special" meal. He made us an amazing shrimp,chicken & beef platter to die for, with a side of plantains! I have never eaten food so good. Melvin you are awesome! We also met Ramon Simbert at Hydro he is also super nice and a great cook as well.
Everyday we would eat at the buffet on the Reserve side with great service, food and friendly conversation with Luis Vasquez & Celso Peralta. We also had Celso as our waiter when we ate at Vento which was a very good restaurant. Def my favorite!
During our stay we also ate at The Grill which was probably my least favorite but it was still good. Bana which is Japenese was a great show and really good food. Aqua which is in a really neat part of the resort,also had very good food.
The beach is unbeatable, I never had to worry about needing a drink. Mikey Mike, Ramon Ramirez,& Louis Santana kept us well hydrated and taken care of. They where so nice to deal with and chit chat with. The resort itself makes it an enjoyable experience having gorgeous amenities, but the staff such as the people that I mentioned above make it truly enjoyable. Every single one of these people did their best to make us feel special and taken care of! For this reason I would choose to go back to this resort again! Thank you to everyone, you make the resort unforgettable!
The only thing I would be skeptical or apprehensive about is going to the Melia Club meeting. We met Jean Louizaire on the beach and he invited us to go to a 90 min promotional meeting which lunch to hear about their program. He did explain everything well and was very nice to deal with. However once lunch was over we met with a gentlemen I cannot remember his name but he was shifty and a woman I believe her name was Marisela a "supervisor". We heard about the club and if you travel a lot and have the money to put down right then and there then it may be something worth while for you. We ended up wasting 4 hours of our vacation being pressured to buy into this club. At one point we asked to have a minute to talk it over amongst myself and my boyfriend and the "supervisor" said NO what is there to talk about? I'm sorry but that is not how you do business. So unless you plan to travel a lot and have cash  on you to spend don't waste your time!
I would absolutely return to this resort for another vacation, and would recommend to my own family and friends and to travel to!

reviews.author: mtill2
reviews.title: Best Vacation by Far
reviews.text:
Me and my girlfriend just returned home last evening from a wonderful vacation at The Reserve at Paradisius Punta Cana.Our stay was a 4 night 5 day in the concierge suite.I myself have visited Punta Cana 3 other times and this resort was by far the nicest.The Reserve concierge part of the beach was excellent.The water was very clean and the sand was also very well taken care of.Other resorts I have visited were not raked on a regular basis.The beach never seemed crowded which was great seeing that we decided to go on peak season.The Reserve pool was also very clean and well maintained and also was never overly crowded.Our 1 bedroom Concierge suite was great.Its was very spacious for 2 people and the hot tub was definetly a treat.The restaurants that we attended were as follows:Vento (Mediterranean),The Grill (Steak House),Bana (Japanese),and Aqua (Mediterranean/Italian).My favorite was definitely Vento with Bana a close second but all 4 were very good and exceeded my expectations.

Now onto the staff.First let me start with Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana and Mikey Mike from the Family Concierge bar on the beach.All 3 were extremely friendly and welcomed us the first morning on the beach.We never waited very long for drinks as the bring them right to you.Now to the staff at the Hydro Grill at the Reserve pool.Celso,Valentin,Melvin,Jose,Luis Vasquez and Ramon Simbert all get 2 thumbs up from me.They were all extremely friendly and helpful.They all welcomed us with open arms from the beginning.A special shout out to Melvin at the grill.He was always laughing and smiling throughout the day and made our pool trips great.He even cooked us a special lunch on our third day which was better then any of the buffets.The little things that the staff does here really go a long way.

Last but definitely not least our Reserve Concierge Sofia more the exceeded our expectations.From day one she welcomed us and made us feel right at home.From reserving our spots either by the pool or the beach every morning to making our dinner reservations for every night it really was comforting knowing that every thing was taken care of.She also had special treats in our room every evening and even had a bubble bath drawn for us after a long hot day in the sun.She was very pleasant to deal with and had no problem with taking care of our every needs.

My only negative comment would be the Melia Club presentation.We were approached at the the beach to sit through a 90 minute presentation..which turned out to be a 3.5 hour high pressure sales pitch.We were told no obligation to buy today which was false and one of managers Marisela became very rude toward the end.I even asked if my girlfriend and i could speak privately about the matter (we were interested at that point) and she responded with a NO.She even lied about the time of day it was when we asked her.The last thing we wanted was to spend that amount of time sitting through a presentation.

All in all we had a wonderful time and would definitely recommend this resort to friends and family.The staff really goes above and beyond the meet your every need.Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sid P
reviews.title: Lively, Fun Resort
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at the Paradisus Palma Real and highly recommend it. It's beautiful with classic and modern style combined - lots of beautiful lighting and statues. We had a fantastic room with an ocean view on the club side. We had a very nice private butler too, who was mostly able to help us with reservations and cobanas at the fantastic club pool. Leonardo Moto is an awesome bartender and will take great care of you there. The main pool is massive and also worth visiting with a great swim-up bar. At night the place really comes to life centered around the incredible central courtyard. All the food was great, including the Western Grill where we particularly liked the amazingly fresh salmon at lunch, and all the dinners provided for our group by the hotel. We thought the food at Passion was also good, but not totally worth the extra cost above the all-inclusive rate. One thing we noticed was that the internet only worked about half the time, but, we worked around it, for example, you forget about that quickly watching the incredible fire dancing, having drinks & apps at the club bar before heading out for dinner, or just lying around in your own private beach bed... We hope to return next year.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel, muy buen servicio y atención, Me encanto la habitación y en general todas las instalaciones. Hermosa la playa y piscinas. Cordialidad de todo el personal de servicios. Excelente servicios de alimentación.

reviews.author: Steve20W
reviews.title: Warning:  The buffet (Naos) burned down and is being rebuilt
reviews.text:
I just spent a week in Paradisus with my family, days after the buffet Naos burned to the ground due to a fireworks accident.  We had a good time, and this is not a negative review, but I picked this resort for its buffet and I found its complete absence, which the hotel did not even acknowledge, to be a shock.   
1.	I would like Managing Director Rafael Torres to speak up on Trip Advisor concerning the loss of Naos.  I would like to hear that the staff is now trained in fire safety and that everything possible is being done to ensure customer satisfaction during this outage.  Accidents happen, but sweeping this issue under the rug with no explanation is not acceptable to me.  When areas of a hotel are closed for construction and there is lots of construction noise, huge signs apologizing for the inconvenience are a MUST, so please put those up!  Your guests will probably forgive you.  At this point I am having trouble forgiving you because you have not apologized.  
2.	Guests figure out the buffet is gone the hard way.  The buffet is served in the theater for breakfast and lunch and on the beach for dinner, which I consider to be a weak substitute.  Naos is now just sealed off, but from the map and walking around it I would guess Naos comprised about half the indoor public space in the resort.  I chose Paradisus mostly on the strength of the buffet because I knew we would mostly be eating there.  It is a huge effort for the staff to relocate the buffet 3 times a day, esp to the beach, and the experience is still good, EXCEPT for not apologizing about not having Naos, which guests paid for and have a right to expect to exist.  The food quality in the relocated buffet is very good for a buffet of this scale, so we were pleased with that.  I have eaten at countless buffets, and while not great it was fine and had a better supply of fresh fruit than any other buffet I have ever been to.
3.	The other restaurants were mostly booked up from the day we got there, so we did have to eat on the beach several times.  I knew going in that this would happen as reviews mention it, so I was not surprised, but I found it odd that these restaurants have many empty tables... more than half it seemed.
4.	A good variety of food is available at odd hours at Market Grill, which really came in handy.
5.	The staff was excellent and really cares.  We found they all spoke enough English to get by, so I don’t know why people complain about this.
6.	Early in the week getting beach chairs was a real problem (for regular guests, not royal service or reserve), but as the week went on the problem eased (though I still think they need more chairs).  Perhaps the fire created the issue.  More thatched beach umbrellas were constructed (maybe some burned down) and one was completed the very second we needed it on our last day, which was nice. 
7.	The rooms and public areas are absolutely top notch and very clean, it was the highest caliber I have seen anywhere overall.  You can read about things like that from all the other reviewers.  I did not feel in the slightest put out to be a regular guest even though there is a royal service area and a reserve area; all the areas for guests work well together.  
8.     We all used the Yhi Spa, and it was very nice.
9.	I had higher expectations for activities and entertainment.  I was under the impression that the resort would rival cruise ships in this department, but it was no different than any other resort.  They have a huge theater, but they did no shows in it (just buffets).

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real during our Easter break this year. This was by far the best family vacation to date.
From our personal concierge AC, to Luis Diaz and the entire swim up bar staff who spoiled my little guys despite their young ages, this was a trip to remember. 
If you truly want to get away, enjoy your family and actually relax, this is the place to go.
Thank you to all the staff at the kids camp and and on the beach daily rounding up volleyball games and keeping it lively. 
We cannot wait to come back for another visit and see all of you again.
The only part of our trip that was unpleasant was leaving.
Thank you to everyone who made it so special.

reviews.author: Casey H
reviews.title: Kids Zone Rocks
reviews.text: Thanks to the great fun provided by the counselors at Kids Zone (Kiwi, Berlis and Alvie in particular), our girls (5 and 7) wanted nothing to do with us on vacation! They do a great job. Only wished they gave the kids more time in the pool. The drop in and out is super easy and they really get to know the kids personally. Thanks to all for a great time.

reviews.author: Elena C
reviews.title: Un viaje increible
reviews.text: Paradisus palma real ha sido el mejor hotel al que he ido. Nos lo hemos pasado yo y mi familia súper bien relajándonos en la playa cercana, piscina enorme y cuarto moderno y claro mucho mas. Nos han recibido con unas personas muy amables como uno que se llamaba Franklin que al final del viaje se convirtió en otro de nuestros amigos jaja. Se aseguro de todo y le doy un 10/10, pero no solo el sino muchas mas personas preguntándonos si lo pasamos bien y si queríamos algo, era perfecto. Recomiendo que todas las personas que vengan a punta cana vayan a este hotel no os disgustara :)

reviews.author: Stephanie Ann S
reviews.title: My Vacation
reviews.text: There are areas of the resort that need to be improvement such as lighting at night, room service and check-out service, and not running out of face clothes and towels.  Overall they really have a great resort but with these changes they can be even greater.

reviews.author: Carmen C
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: We have just arrived from Palma Real.The resort is great in everything specially the food in all restaurants. We enjoyed most the Palazzo and Gabi.I recommend to stay at Royal Service because you have more options of restaurants and you have a private space at the beach so you need not to worry to find a place for you early in the morning.Juan De Leon was our butler and made our vacation very special.Very friendly not being invasive.Also we need to say good things about the beach butler Martin Tineo.He really works hard and has always a smile in his face.So, Palma Real was a great surprise for us because we live in Brasil where we have beautiful beaches and very nice resorts but the service, the staff, and above all the very blue sea made our vacation unforgettable.

reviews.author: Lyne P
reviews.title: Royal Service stay was excellent, as always!
reviews.text:
My partner and I spent a week in Royal Service April 6-13/14. Our first butler Jose was very attentive to our needs and even ensured that the couple of days he'd be away for his wife's childbirth that we would be attended to by his replacement, Sandy Gil. He too ensured that our every need was met and went beyond to even help other couples we met in Royal Service. Angelo Mercedes, another butler was also a big help our last day. We also spoke to the new Royal Service manager Ruben who asked us daily how we were enjoying ourselves and whether we could offer suggestions for improvement. Pedro and Fransisco were outstanding around the pool at keeping us refreshed with new drinks and always cracking a joke or two! Pedro's smile is simply infectious!

We will definitely be back to the Royal Service at the Paradisus Palma Real, as we have several times prior. It feels like heaven, every time.

reviews.author: Heather B
reviews.title: great family vacation
reviews.text: This is a beautiful property.  The rooms are very nice.  The pool at the Reserve is fantastic, but oddly, closed at 6pm.  The beach is beautiful, but know that it has waves, not tranquil water so snorkeling is not an option although other water activities are available.  The food is very mediocre.  The nicer restaurants allegedly book early, so we had to accept early reservation times (although they looked half empty when we left an hour or more later).  Their two nicer restaurants require you to pay extra on top of the all-inclusive price.  I would say that the service, generally, was mediocre.  It was often not with a smile.  Every breakfast we had to ask for utensils and flag someone down for coffee refills.  We had to order every drink ourselves from the bar and not once got served at the pool or beach.  Even though you pay for all inclusive, the waiters appear to focus on the people who are willing to tip handsomely.  They literally walk right by you and pay no attention to you at all.  There are very nice cabanas around the pool, but they fill early by people willing to pay extra to reserve them.  The Reserve is the second property back from the beach, so it is either a long walk or you wait for a shuttle.  The sales staff there relentlessly hunt you down to make a sales pitch, which was very annoying.  Each building has a concierge, and I will say ours - Anabel Gonzalez - was great.  Our son celebrated a birthday on the trip and she decorated the suite and left cupcakes.  That was awesome.

reviews.author: Rebecca M
reviews.title: Great vacaction!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in March with another couple.  We had the royal service, which I highly recommend. The royal service lounge was really good, with drinks and fresh snacks all day long. I found the free wifi in there didn't always work for me (but that certainly could of been user error!) Our personal concierge was Juan Castille and he was very good, made sure we had everything we needed, but occasionaly we had to seek him out if there was something we wanted.  He made our dinner reservations for the week the first day we were there, went over them with us, and we only made a few changes, but I appreciated that he made them for us in the first place.  The only "mistake" was that we tried to book a snorkeling trip two days in advance, but I believe he waited until the next day to book it and it was full. We probably could've walked on to the snorkeling boat (because people who reserve don't always show up) but we wound up being too late. Not a huge deal, we took an outdoor painting class instead.  Franscisco at the pool was great and reserved beach chairs for us everyday.  The food was better than average for an all inclusive.  I found some of the service was slow, but you're in the caribbean, so it's not that unusual.  There were some inconsistencies, for example, they pretty much only served Presidente beer, but one night at the casino I ordered a Corona and got one, but the next day (and the rest of the trip) they were out of it.  Rooms were beautiful but I wouldn't recommend rooming with someone if you're not completely comfortable with them, as the bathrooms are sort of open.  Overall this was a great and much needed vacation.

reviews.author: Sarah C
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The hotel is gorgeous and relaxing. Johnfi was great and very helpful. Our family came down for 9 days and enjoyed every moment without even leaving the hotel. The beach was also stunning and very well kept. When we have stayed at all inclusives before, the food can sometimes get very old, very quickly but here there was a great array of cuisine, my favourite being the Palazzo and Market Grill. We will be back for sure!

reviews.author: Paulaemiliaabrate
reviews.title: UN PARAISO!!!!!
reviews.text:
Fuimos en Abril de 2014,NOS ENCANTÓ TODO,SIN DESPERDICIO!!!
Excelente la atención en el Lobby de Claribel y Sandra. Juan,que fue nuestro guía el día de la llegada. Somos un matrimonio con un hijo de 8 años y la experiencia fue bárbara!!!! TODO GENIAL: la comida muy variada,todos los dias tenes de todo. Los mejores restó el NAOS,GABY CLUB Y GABY BEACH Y VENTO. Las piletas bellas todas!!! Mas tranqui la The Reserve que la del Beach,donde hay mas joda!! los espectáculos a la noche muy buenos,las barras del Lobby,los baños del lobby principal parecian Museos!!! Genial todo.EL MAR,LA ARENA, TODOS LOS DIAS CALOR, dos dias se largó una lluvia tranqui que paró a los 15min. LA VEGETACION DE LOS JARDINES,LAS FUENTES Y LAGUNAS. tenes bicis para recorrer todo el lugar,fuimos al gimnasio que está buenísimo!!! Usamos las canchas de tenis ue están en excelente estado,también tenes de Padel. Hicimos rapel,tiro al blanco,tenis de mesa,acuagym,spinning en el agua. Fuimos a tres show nocturnos con los chicos de recracion. LA MUSICA  adecuada tanto en los jardines como en los distintos ambientes (piletas,lobbys) lA VAJILLA,EL MOBILIARIO,TANTO EN LA PLAYA COMO EN LOS ESTABLECIMIENTOS DEL HOTEL. La habitacion muy buena!!! NINGUNA QUEJA,TODO EXCELENTE!!!! VOLVEREMOS CUANDO PODAMOS PORQUE NOS CAUTIVO TODO!!!

reviews.author: Dana1980159
reviews.title: Awful food
reviews.text: They had many restaurants but they were already booked before you arrived. So your options were a ten o'clock dinner or the Buffett every night that had the same food night after night. The staff making the reservations could care less if you ate or not. They barley spoke English and would lie to you just to make you think they were going to take care of any requests you had. They only carried one beer and much of the food tasted old or bland.

reviews.author: Linda S
reviews.title: 7th trip to Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text:
We have been coming to this resort for 7 years in March every year for approx. 8-9 days. The food is top notch and the service starting with Pedro and Francisco at the Royal Service pool and the butlers especially Carlos, the head of the butlers who always goes out of his way to be gracious and charming and the rest of the staff including the housekeepers, the servers in the restaurants and the people at the Royal Service desk are all exceptional and can't do enough for us. We are happily looking forward to our next trip back to Palma Real Royal Service next year.
This resort is truly romantic for couples who are in love.

reviews.author: Rob T
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: The service by our butler, Juan De Leon, was awesome! The upgrade to royal service is totally worth it. Property was well kept and beautiful. Beach was awesome, drinks and food were awesome. Gabi was the best restaurant by far, for lunch and dinner. Will be back, with friends!

reviews.author: Leandro D
reviews.title: Recomendo
reviews.text:
Hotel muito bom, ficamos no Royal Service atendimento dos funcionário excelente. Principalmente pessoa da piscina, praia, seguranças, camareiras e restaurante Palazzo.
Duas coisa que nos deixou um pouco constrangido:
1°) Nosso 1° quarto no andar terreo de frente pra piscina tinha cheiro de barata, notificamos o mordomo que disse que seria resolvido. No dia seguinte fui tomar banho e uma barata dentro do Box do banheiro. Reclamamos e em 2 horas trocaram o nosso quarto para o 3° andar com vista parcial pra praia. Quarto excelente com todo o conforto e sem cheiro de barata.
2°) Na noite do dia 07/04 houve um incêndio gigantesco dentro do Hotel em cima dos restaurantes NAOS e Mexicano, fuigmos para praia, ninguém se feriu mas nenhum funcionário veio orientar os hospedes e no dia seguinte quando perguntei se algo seria feito, todos os funcionários desconversavam sobre o assunto. Estava em Lua de Mel e devida ao tamanho do incêndio minha esposa ficou em choque 2 dias querendo ir embora, tive que acalma-la. Alias no dia seguinte do incêndio parecia que nada tinha acontecido visualmente também pois os decoradores fizeram um serviço muito bom tampando tudo.
Mas acredito que foi acidente, o Hotel em si é Espetacular e seus maiores diferenciais na minha opinião são: Tratamentos dos funcionários, comida muito boa e estrutura de lazer.

reviews.author: Jeffrey K
reviews.title: Thank You!
reviews.text:
Special Thanks to our butler --- Luis
Special Thanks to "Big Mac"
 Both were exceptional!!     
 The resort was outstanding, clean and the service was excellent!
Thank you for your wonderful service and for a great and memorable vacation!

reviews.author: Mark W
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: My family of 4 stayed in a 2br Family Concierge Suite.  Having only been to one other all inclusive (that was significantly more expensive), we didn't expect this to be any better per se.  We were wrong.  Great room, fantastic food, beautiful grounds.  Service was exceptional.  Ovidio was our concierge rep and could not have been better.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: jessica p
reviews.title: Easter Week
reviews.text:
The best thing about our stay at The Reserve at The Paradisus was absolutely our family consierge ESTEFANIA!!! She facilitated our dinner reservations, cabanas, anything we asked of her with true happiness and professionalism.  She enjoys her job and it shows.  She was never unavailable and went above and beyond our expectations.  We have stayed at Beaches Turks and Caicos with butler service. She surpassed the service we received there.  Because of Estefania's dedication to us, our week was smooth. A true vacation! Thank you Estefania!! We miss you!! 
One thing that was misleading or that we would complain about was that there are many many things that require cash payment.  The only thing that we were able to pay for on our stored credit card was our spa treatments, which were wonderful.  I would stress the importance of bringing lots of extra cash in order to pay for added excursions such as zip lining and/or para sailing.

reviews.author: Thiago R
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text: Hotel sensacional de excelente infra- estrutura e atendimento perfeito aos hóspedes! Piscinas relaxantes e comida deliciosa e muito variada entre os seus vários restaurantes! Recomendo! Sistema all inclusive que proporciona todo o acesso as preferências de cada um! Spa relaxante além de uma bela praia na frente fo resort que seduz qualquer bom apreciador de um lugar maravilhoso como este! 😃

reviews.author: myronnee
reviews.title: One Of Our Best Vacations
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We traveled as a family of 4 (adult children ages 18 and 23) and were thrilled that we stayed at the Reserve and had a family concierge. The Reserve is set off from the rest of the resort and has its own pool, restaurants, and place on the beach. The walk to the beach (approximately 7 minutes) was not bad at all. While the trolleys were running all day, we walked more often than not through the beautiful grounds. 
The rooms at the Reserve were spacious and modern. Beaches were white sand and pristine, with just enough wave to allow for some boogie boarding fun. 

The best part of this resort, however, is the staff. From the groundskeepers, to the housekeepers, to the bartenders, waiters and concierges, everyone went out of their way to smile, say hello and help you have a great experience. I wish I could name all of the wonderful people that made our week special, but would like to give special thanks to Ovidio Pavilis our family concierge who was amazing!!!   He made all our dinner and cabana reservations each day. One day there was even a bath drawn with flowers, champagne, and cheese and on another day we arrived to a beautiful plate of fruits. All Ovidio’s doing! If we even ran into the slightest problem (getting 4 bikes) Ovidio was there to intervene. Excellent service was also received by Lady and Annabelle our building #38 concierge, 
We ate in a different restaurant each night and loved them all. Vento was great and Mole and Aqua were really good. The Grill at the Reserve pool was excellent and my husband and son had a 4:00 hamburger and fries every day. The wait staff was excellent there as well. Housekeeping did a wonderful job of keeping our room clean and restocked. 
I also have to give a shout out to Leonardo from Club Melia who spent the afternoon with us and did a fabulous job of showing us around and explaining everything to us and introducing us to our newest friend Alicia Lois. Alicia is amazing at her job and we immediately felt a bond. 
We normally do not like to go to the same place twice as we look forward to trying out new places and resorts. However, I am sure that you can NOT beat the level of service that the staff at the Reserve/Paradisus provides and therefore we would not hesitate to come back again. 
We highly recommend this lovely property.

reviews.author: MRBzzzz
reviews.title: Perfect 10
reviews.text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful. The staff was beyond kind, attentive, and respectful. Four people gave exceptional service. José Rienoso made sure we made our flight by bringing out our food quickly with a very kind attitude. Emilio Melvin Brizon brought my family drinks everyday with a smile on his face and was extremely enthusiastic all day long. Rafael Diaz and Marcos Alejandro taught us how to make sushi and we had such a great time.

reviews.author: Carlos T
reviews.title: Excelente hotel, Excelente personal!!
reviews.text: Un hotel muy lujoso en una de las mejores playas de Republica Dominicana, lo mejor del hotel es su gente muy amables y atentos, lo malo es que hay que caminar o esperar un carrito para ir a la playa..

reviews.author: LuvTraveling158
reviews.title: Fantastic service!
reviews.text: Our stay at The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana has been wonderful! My husband has needed a very relaxing and carefree vacation for a long time, and this is the perfect place.  Great food, terrific accommodations and attention to detail.  The entire staff has been so friendly and welcoming, especially our family concierge, Luisa Villafana.  She does a superb job of looking after our family!  She's always available, has taken care of all our reservations, questions, anything we need, and always with a smile!  We can highly recommend this resort to everyone, and will definitely return in the future.   Kristen P.

reviews.author: Gary L
reviews.title: Gabi Beach - Juan Medrano is the Best
reviews.text: We just got back on 19 April 2014. It was me, my wife, my 16 year old daughter and 2 of her best friends. We had an awesome vacation. The vacation got off to a little rocky start, but then we met Juan Medrano at Gabi Beach. Juan was the beach server at Gabi Beach and he was simply the best. We travel all over the Caribbean and I've never had anyone take better care of my family then Juan. He brought us lunch on the beach, made sure we were all set up with our chairs by the ocean, when it rained (downpour for 20 minutes) he replaced all our towels and kept the Mojitos, Malibu Bay Breeze and Pina Coladas coming. He checked on us constantly to ensure everything was "muy bueno". Getting dinner reservations is a pain if you're not a "Member" (aka timeshare owner) but that frustration was overcome by Juan's outstanding service. Initially I felt that I'd never go back because if you're not a timeshare owner you are treated like a 2nd class citizen and dinner reservations are very difficult to get, but all of us want to return just so we can visit with Juan!!!

reviews.author: kidsandcats
reviews.title: Beautiful but a little boring
reviews.text:
I just got back 4 days ago from the Paradisus, I went with my husband and 17 year old boy-girl twins. The hotel was beautiful, very clean, very plush, the rooms were well maintained and pretty. I really like a clean, "new" room and this fit the bill. The only problem was that there was a shutter and posts between the bedroom and bathroom so it made for very little privacy, or sound proofing while you were using the bathroom. The toilet and shower have separate rooms from the sink and bath tub but the both have a partially frosted door so you can still see and hear everything. I used a flashlight in the middle of the night to use the toilet so that the light wouldn't wake up my husband. My kids had their own room and it was embarassing for them that you could see into the bathroom. 
The meals were mostly good, the buffet had lots of choices but some of the food was bland. The desserts were good and it helped that the Market Grill was open most of the time so you could catch a bite if you were hungry when the buffet was changing over to a new meal time. The restaurants had better food especially Bana, the hibachi/tepanyaki was very good.
The pools were large, clean and fun and the beach was very nice but it was hard to get lounge chairs because you couldn't be sure if people were done sitting because they didn't take their towels with them when they left. We finally just took chairs if we didn't see any personal items on them even though they had towels on them. It would be helpful if people were asked to remove their towels when they were done.
The shows at night were good but brief and the entertainment in front of the Avenue bar was interesting. I think the hotel needs to plan more activities at night for kids and teenagers. There were a considerable amount of teenagers while we were there but nothing for them to do. Maybe games or karaoke, perhaps something interactive they can do on their phones to keep them busy and have some fun. 
My husband and kids booked a parasail ride in the hotel lobby and my plan was to take pictures from the beach at the hotel. When they were leaving, my husband got worried that maybe I wouldn't be able to see them from our beach (even though I tried to reassure him that I could) so we asked the guy that was driving them to the boat if I would be able to see them from our beach, he said just come along and I could take pictures from the beach where the boat is. I asked a few more times will I really be able to see them from the other beach and he said yes, and that I could even go on the boat for $10. I said no I want to take pictures from the beach. When we got there it turned out to be a local souvenir shopping area where your supposed to haggle and be hassled by the vendors. Quickly they hustled my family on a boat that turned out to be a tender that brought them to the real boat. It became clear to me really fast that my plan of taking pictures was not going to happen, they were not going to to be anywhere close to me on the beach. They completely LIED TO ME! They kept asking me to go shopping while I was waiting but I refused. I've been to the islands before and I know how badly they want your money. I would have been happy to shop there if they hadn't lied but as it was I just stood there until they took me out on the tender boat to meet up with my family and go back to the hotel. This really put  a damper on that day.
All in all it was a relaxing trip, which is what we needed, but we left feeling as though we needed a little more to do.

reviews.author: MichaelKohler
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.   We traveled with my parents and two children (8 and 7 years old) and were happy that we spent the extra money to stay at the Reserve and have a family concierge.   The Reserve is set off from the rest of the resort and has its own pool, restaurants, and place on the beach.   With kids, it was nice to have a place where other families were staying and the walk to the beach (approximately 7 minutes) was not bad at all.   While the trolleys were running all day, we walked more often than not through the beautiful grounds.   However, if you want to be right on the beach, the Reserve is not the location for you.

The rooms at the Reserve were spacious and modern.   The restaurants throughout the resort were above average for resort food with a lot of choices on the buffets.   The Passion tasting menu was worth the extra cost for dinner and service was tremendous.   Beaches were white sand and pristine, although the waves could be rough at times (which was appreciated by the kids for boogie boarding).   Nightly shows were just OK, but were appreciated by the kids.

The best part of this resort, however, is the staff.  From the groundskeepers, to the housekeepers, to the bartenders, waiters and concierges, everyone went out of their way to smile, say hello and help you have a great experience.   I have never been to a resort where 95% of the staff smiled and said hello whenever I walked by.   I wish I could name all of the wonderful people that made our week special, but would like to give special thanks to Nikel Lendor our family concierge who attended to us like we were his own family.   Excellent service was also received by Angelo in Passion, Noel with water aerobics, Ramon at the beach (drinkie-drinkie) and the housekeeping team lead by Mahaira Reys who kept our room spotless throughout the trip.

We normally do not like to go to the same place twice and look forward to trying out new places and resorts.   However, I am not sure you can beat the level of service that the staff at the Reserve/Paradisus provides.   We would not hesitate to come back again.

reviews.author: FEOHIO
reviews.title: Moved here from other hotel... Ended up being a good trip!
reviews.text:
This was a good hotel and based on my experience (just pre arrival) with the hotel I booked The Reserve Palma Real wasn't expecting much... Especially since this hotel was ranked lower than the other one on TA.

This hotel was fine however it really needed a facelift...  In two of the pools I  found  a  light in each that was  floating out of its  socket  only connected  by a wire.

The  key people on staff that made this  trip better for us were:
Nickel our Concierge was a great help throughout our stay! 
Ramone took care of us at the beach every day and made sure the ladies in the group had prime beach lounges and a bed!!
George Clooney was our Bar Tender at the main hotel lobby bar and really treated us very well! 

Thanks  guys.... Unfortunately it will be a while  before  we go  back to Punta  Canna again.

reviews.author: Russell C
reviews.title: Wonderful visit even after a year to reflect
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Palma Real in June of 2013 and let me just say it was absolutely great. I am a very low maintenance individual and even traveling alone everyone was extremely friendly.  Absolutely get the Royal Service as just getting into restaurants is worth it, but Tony my butler was great despite having to wait on several groups other than myself.  I eat all over the world and the food is better than any all inclusive I have been to so don't be scared away by any negative comments.  Berenice America and Alexander Guzman were there every day at Palazzo taking caring of me, learning my name, and exactly my favorites.  And the dinner at Passion is so well worth the up charge.  Great selection of food and the service was managed perfectly.  Laura Castillo and Luis Rubio really took care to give me a in depth view of the dishes as well as some of the details that made the meal exceptional.  Some people weren't happy because cable wasn't working perfectly in their room... You are on a beautiful resort, the Royal lounge has great WIFI and TV, and those bothered were usually with someone else so just keep that in mind.  I enjoyed my stay so much that I am bringing my now fiancé to get married at the resort in a couple of months.  They earned my trust and look forward to a wonderful second trip!  My only request would be that the Royal guests get the pre trip email to coordinate the reservations and requests ahead of time...look forward to seeing the staff with my future bride!

reviews.author: flyginger18
reviews.title: Fabulous all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: Our butler Fermin Angelo was spectacular and booked all of our dinner reservations and fun for the week.  They have a dive shop there, where they arranged for us to tour Catalina Island and do 2 dives.  Definitely would do it again.  We upgraded to Royal Service instead of our room, and still had a large room with separate dining area.  We signed up for an extra dinner at Passion which was really good food with multiple courses.

reviews.author: gstarke
reviews.title: Amazing vacation for friends getaway!
reviews.text:
The Palma Real was selected by my friends and I as this year's vacation destination.  When traveling, I love to enjoy the local cuisine and take in all the sights.  All-inclusive resorts were not my first option, so I was tentative about this location.  My mind has changed.

The property and accommodations are amazing, and beautiful.  There are plenty of areas to enjoy coffee in the morning, and afternoon book, and drinks in the evening.  The rooms are comfortable, and well taken care of by the staff.  My room was cleaned daily, and prepared for my weary body when I decided to go to bed.  I could go on about the property, but the photos really do it justice.

If you are selective about what you eat, you might have a difficult time with the food.  I live in Chicago, a foodie mecca, so I found the dining options challenging.  The food is fine, and abundant.  I was tired of the menu towards the end, but satisfied with the options.

If you regularly drink craft beers, wines from Wine Enthusiast, and buy tickets to your next dinner, then you're going to have a difficult time with the libation options.  I'm lucky to have a native Spanish speaker, and I make every attempt at speaking Spanish, so ordering from the bar is significantly easier (this is true for food too).  The lobby bar offers a few extra beers, and some well crafted drinks by the an award winning bartender (Mario???).  The other bars offer drinks based on the venue, so don't expect to order a Tiki Tiki at the cocktail bar.  They have all the basic options, so do your homework and make sure you know what to order.  I think using good judgement when ordering like you were at a wedding is good advice.

I have some special shout outs for some of the staff -

Ramón - he's the poolside bartender, and definitely one of the best bartenders on staff.  He's got game both behind the bar and around the pool with fantastic drink balancing routines.  The hotel should take notice of his skills, and make it part of the training program.

"Big Mac" - he's one of the entertainment staff, and comparing him to the energizer bunny would not do him justice.  This guy goes a mile-a-minute, and delivers customer service without blinking an eye.  You can't miss him, and shouldn't before you leave the hotel.

The hotel will push their vacation club during your visit, and it's up to you if and when you attend their informational meeting.  We turned it down right away, which may have affected our reservations for some of the restaurants during our visit.  We recommend the hotel staff gauging the customer and giving them the choice of if and when to learn more about the vacation club.  Hard selling is never going to fly when someone has just arrived from the airport.

Overall, my friends and I had a great time at this hotel, and given the option would return here for our next visit to Punta Cana.  I appreciate all the people that work here, and wish them all the best.

Thanks!

reviews.author: Patti L
reviews.title: Lovely vacation
reviews.text: Silvio was the best and I wish he was still taking care of us now that we are back in Chicago.....  He did everything he could to be sure that our vacation was wonderful and accomdated our requests.  If things went wrong, (minor inconveniences like with a dinner reservation or spa appointment) they did everything they could to remedy the situation and mitigate the inconvenience.  It is a beautiful hotel and we found the people working their to be quite nice...."Lady" and Annabelle were terrific and Lady even rode along with our group one night to be sure that our reservation was correct and that we were satisfied with the table we received.  The beach is lovely and the service is attentive and the employees truly try to  make you feel at home.  Highly recommend this lovely property.

reviews.author: Gesse73
reviews.title: Férias marcante
reviews.text: Fui a Punta Cana por recomendação de uma amigo e realmente o clima, a hospitalidade e o hotel são maravilhosos. Fomos muito bem recebidos na recepção e sempre muito bem atendidos em todos os setores que usufruimos! O hotel bem tranquilo para viagem em família principalmente a gente que tinhamos um bebê de 05 meses! Foi tudo perfeito, o serviço de quarto excelente com lençois e toalhas sempre novos e com arrumação também a noite e sempre com uma barrinha de chocolate deixada em cima de cada cama! quero ressaltar o excelente atendimento prestado por Canaenia Garcia e Julito Olivo garçons do restaurante NAOS, que proporcionaram nossa estadia ainda mais aprazível! recomendo a todos e em breve retornaremos

reviews.author: Colleen_Z235
reviews.title: Bait and Switch?
reviews.text:
The pictures of the rooms on the website don't exactly match with what you get. The rooms were adequate. The tv was antiquated. They also push the buffets on  you after bragging about the wonderful restaurants on the premises. They also have up charges at 2 of the restaurants which you don't know about until you are ready to book a reservation. Be persistent about getting a dinner reservation otherwise you will be on the buffet lines each night. The kicker is, the restaurants are not even busy.  Once you get in one, you will have a fairly good meal.

The beach, pool and common areas are very beautiful. The weather is fantastic.  The service at breakfast was excellent--all others, including the bars are S L O W--they call it Dominican Time.  They are not in a hurry and  you will wait.

reviews.author: Ilovetravel555
reviews.title: Outdated rooms
reviews.text: Was there in February place was 100% booked. Overcrowded . Always had place to eat though . Concierge service was great help but wasn't smooth. Hard to find place on beach even it should be reserved, people don't care . Shuttle bus wasn't great help too. Sometimes it was much faster to walk 15 min than to wait for bus. Buffet food was average. Great kids club. Room was old and not so clean . Sofa in room was unbearable , I don't know how they count it for a bed . Place is really big a lot of stuff to do . Won't be back for sure . Can get better vacation for the same money .

reviews.author: Angel Rodriguez
reviews.title: Una experiencia
reviews.text:
Puedo decir que de todos los países que conozco y son muchos (mas de 58 ) y de todos los hoteles en los que me he alojado, en ninguno nos hemos sentido tan queridos como el Paradisus Palma Real Royal Servis .de Punta Cana República Dominicana.
Desde la llegada la atención que se nos presto fue absoluta, Primero  por Rubén Ligero mas tarde por Jorge Mora, fue un trato que podemos calificar  de amabilidad, cercanía, y amistad. Se aprecia que son unos grandes profesionales y conocen bien el sector en el que trabajan. Nos demostraron que saben resolver cualquier dificultad o contratiempo que pueda surgir.  
Los dos  mayordomos que tuvimos , tanto Johnfi Rivera como Jeuri Ferreira fueron de una profesionalidad total, tuvimos largas charlas , donde demostraron el nivel cultural que poseen, (no es pequeño) y las ganas que tienen por saber mas. También agradecer a Carlos  jefe de mayordomos todas las atenciones que nos presto. 
Que decir de nuestros dos amigos  Martin y Pedro nuestros camareros de la playa, siempre preocupados por que no nos faltara de nada, cualquier capricho que teníamos ellos estaban dispuestos a darnos . Siempre todo listo todo preparado para cuando llegábamos a la playa estuviera en su sitio. 
No tengo nada mas que palabras de elogio y agradecimiento hacia todos y cada uno de ellos, forman un equipo compacto y bien organizado. 
Regresare lo antes posible.

reviews.author: Patricia S
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: Our trip March 2014 to the Paradisus Palma Real was great!  The people were  pleasant and helpful. Best in a long time.  Two critisisms:  The power kept going out in our room and not being able to make reservations in restaurants.

reviews.author: Edie B
reviews.title: 50th Wedding Anniversary with our family.
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Reserve could not have been better. Thanks to Asia Mateo for an excellent job making & arranging, for our family of 10, restaurant reservations, rearranging rooms to meet our needs, and making arrangements for our daughter's birthday which was special.
