Emilo Valdez "drinky okey" was always smiling and taking that extra step to bring drinks along with Jose Reinose and Ramon Simbect.  Thanks to Tina Vilo Rio and and guys at the outside Hydro Grill Melvin Byison.  There are so many other names I can't remember, I can only say that the staff was wonderful. Our 17 year old grandson was so delighted that he could call room service and have food brought up at 11:00 p.m or 12 midnight.  He was happy happy.   He watched the little ones for us while we had 2 adult dinners.  While you had to pay extra for La Palapa the food and  service was less then exceptional and not as the other restaurants.  Our children treated us to Passion which cost $100 a couple and did not include any wine.  However the  food at Passions was the best ever.  Gabi Club at the Reserve was outstanding buffets for breakfast and lunches.  The staff there made all the presentations look so beautiful.  Vento was  great and the Mole were really good.  The Grill was excellent and a must go to while you are there.  The wait staff was excellent there as well. The staff were always so happy to help and make your night enjoyable. Housekeeping did an excellent job of keeping our room clean and restocked. 

One thing that I must point out that our travel agent, we believe just went through Delta travel agent to make reservations but I know now that it would have been better to call Asia at the "Reserve" to make sure our room arrangements are correct.  We made reservations 6 months in advance and some of us did not get the rooms that we wanted because our Travel arranger kept telling us they do not assign rooms until the week of.  Not true. I feel that calling the hotel direct we would not had any hassle getting our rooms right.  We were very fortunate to have second floor, pool side.  We had asked for a king bed as we were celebrating our 50th anniversary but there were none left with a king pool side and second level. But we were happy to have two full size beds.  Only wish is they were Queen size.  Our daughter got a king first floor and the room was exactly like ours but with a road view.  But they had NO problem with it and found it quiet.  We all loved the place and the kids were very sad to leave.  They loved the kids pool which was right next to the big pool.  Their is another bigger pool down by the beach which was very pretty as well.  We saw many weddings and made my husband and I think back 50 years what has happened to us over the years.  My grandson said he was going to have his wedding there.

reviews.author: Sarah R
reviews.title: Best vacation of my life!!!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed here for the first time for her birthday. We opted to pay for the Royal Service which included our own private butler. Upon arrival, we were escorted to the Royal Service lounge and served mimosas to start our stay. The lounge had a full bar of premium alcohol and served snacks all day long. It also had daily periodicals and 8 computers with full internet access. We met our Butler, Yohelvi Aracena AKA "Yoel", we were given our Royal Service bracelets and cell phone to contact Yoel and then given a tour of the property. Royal Service included a private beach, pool, pool bar, restaurant, the lounge, our butler and of course "Royal Service" wherever we were on the property. It was worth every penny!
 
Every morning, Martin Tineo  would have our chair ready on the beach in our favorite spot in the sun, prepared with towels complete with a table for our drinks. After settling in, he would check on us frequently and bring us water, drinks, buckets of ice, anything we needed. Midday, he would turn the chair for us towards the sun. After lunch we generally visited the pool bar where Billy Levons and Leonardo would mix us up some drinks and back to the beautiful beach we went. All the alcohol was top shelf. There wasn't a "mystery" alcohol" that we didn't recognize. Billy would also bring us drinks on the beach and when Martin wasn't available, Francisco Cabrera took care of us. We were always attended to and wanted for nothing. We were completely pampered. 

Our room-the bed- was top notch. Scotch, Vodka, Rum, wine and beer was in the room when we arrived. Every night Yoel would deliver scented pillows to our room-lavender, chamomile, green apple. He drew me a bath complete with burning incense and rose petals. He left us chocolates and sweets at night. Even on the days his shift started later in the day, he made sure we were taken care of and had our dinner reservations made days in advance. Upon check in, we were given a cell phone to contact him and he answered every call no matter what time of the day. He even chatted with us and hung out at the bar with us while Leonardo made us delicious fruity drinks. 

The water was beautiful, clean, not even a sea shell. The breeze from the beach made the hot Dominican sun enjoyable. The white sand was lovely between our toes, even at night when the dinner buffet was served on the beach. And no matter where we ate-buffet, restaurants, outside, inside-the food was exquisite. Lobster was frequently served, even at the buffet.

The hotel, the accommodations, the people, the service-it was the best vacation of my life. I have been to Costa Rica, other parts of the Dominican Republic, Barbados and this by far was the best. I don't know if I will ever be able to take a vacation without the Royal Service. The pampering was exactly what a vacation should be. I will be back as much as possible.

reviews.author: Leticia G
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente resort, la atención insuperable, había leído muchas opiniones positivas pero la realidad superó mis expectativas. La oferta gastronómica destacable. Ideal el servicio real para quienes busquen días de descanso y tranquilidad sin preocuparse de nada. Agradezco a Yohel por su amable atención y en la zona de playa a Pedro quien desborda simpatía para todos.

reviews.author: Eva B
reviews.title: Un très bon séjour
reviews.text:
Nous venons de passer une super semaine à la Réserve du Paradisus Punta Cana. Tout est fait pour que votre séjour se passe à merveille ! Le lieu et les jardins sont magnifiques, et les prestations de qualité. 
Nous tenons à remercier plus particulierement Ramon, Luis et Aneida qui nous ont choyés sur la plage de la Reserve. Un grand merci à Fabio V et à toute l'équipe d'animation pour leur bonne humeur.

reviews.author: Lucas V
reviews.title: Excelente atención ! Excelentes habitaciones y excelente comida
reviews.text:
Mejor imposible !!!el trato!!ll la comida!! La infra estructura, todo excele !!! El desayuno en la habitación. Los paséis el parasailing, Lo recomiendo en un 100% ninguna queja de nuestra parte.

Tiene, nevera , lavadora, mesa de planchar,microondas.

reviews.author: DLKandCJK
reviews.title: Truly Paradise!
reviews.text: This was an amazing vacation.  The grounds are beautiful and spacious.  Nikel was always available to make reservations  and answer any questions. Very friendly but professional. We loved coming back to our room as Maria left flowers as well as attention to small details.   Food was well prepared and good variety.   Ramon set us up at our beach cabana every day and kept the drinks coming .  Who could ask for more from a vacation?  Would definitely plan a return trip!

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: WOW A GREAT TRIP
reviews.text: I stayed in the royal area, The butler "ALONZO" was fantastic, seeing to our every need. He really works hard. The beach, pools and bars were all fantastic. The food was OK not fantastic. I would stay there again

reviews.author: Plsau
reviews.title: This resort is truely all inclusive and the service from all staff was exceptional.
reviews.text:
Room was cleanest I've experienced anywhere. Room service from Jonathon was excellent!!! He went beyond our requests for just coffee daily.  
We had royal service and Fermin was our butler. He made our reservations to meet our time requests and also supplied a pillow menu and extra food treats as a surprise. We met the head butler, Carlos and he was very concerned that we were satisfied and taken care of. He is a definite plus to this resort. 
We most loved the service at The Pallazzos restaurant. Especially Richard and Alexander as waiters.  They provided quality service for all meals. The food was superb at this restaurant.
Thanks to Ruben at Royal Service for helping us out when we took someone else's luggage from the airport and made all arrangements to help us find ours and get it to the hotel. 
Royal service pool staff at the bar and waiters were very accommodating and friendly.  
We will definitely return!! Thank you Fermin, Carlos, Jonathan, Alexander, Ruben And Richard for going above standards to 
make our stay incredible!!!

reviews.author: Holly K
reviews.title: Pedro Cedano - Beach Butler extraordinaire!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a business conference that my husband attended and had a fabulous time!  We stayed on the Royal Service side of the hotel and my favorite hotel employee was Pedro Cedano on the beach.  He is happy, obviously loves serving the guests and is ready to help you in any way possible.  There is a lovely fruit stand on that side of the hotel and you can get fresh fruit smoothies all day - served with a smile by Diego. This is a lovely hotel and the all-inclusive is very convenient and top notch quality.  My husband and I enjoyed the delicious paella at the Market Grill at lunch everyday.  

On the Royal Service side you are supposed to receive the services of a butler during your stay.  Although our personal butler was not attentive to us, there were other couples in our group that had wonderful personal attention by their butlers - most notably, Luis - small, but powerful!  He actually took over the duties for our butler to complete our stay.  

The resort is clean and activities are numerous to choose from both day and night.  We also took an off-site excursion with ZipLine Adventures and it was terrific!  Although they indicated it would be a 3 hour outing and it actually turned out to be 6 hours, but wouldn't trade the experience - it was excellent.

reviews.author: Keith R
reviews.title: The Beach & Pool Service Saved the Trip
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, the rooms are very nice, The Royal Service area was great...much more private.  The food was average.  The communication challenge was surprising.  I speak english and very few of the staff sould communicate with me effectively.  The butler service was disappointing.  Only asked for something a times but they didn't get done.  I would have been very disappoined withthe entire stay had it not been for Super Billy Leo.  They are the pool butler and bartender.  They were very attentive and made up for quite a few problems we experienced elsewhwere.  Thanks Leo and Super Billy for saving the trip!

reviews.author: Isabelle C
reviews.title: Fuego! Fuego! Fuego!
reviews.text: The staff at the pool bar is amazing! Gracias Ramon Fuego, Luiz and Gustabo! Excellent mojito, pina colada and dirty monkey. They are fast and always smiling. I highly recomand this place. It's clean and very nice.

reviews.author: jissi10
reviews.title: Siempre volvemos por el excelente trato
reviews.text: Siempre venimos por el lujo y el servicio que recibimos. Los colaboradores son excelentes. Tenemos 3 años viniendo y no  vamos a cambiar. Agradezo a Eddy Wilson, Vicky del vip lounge, Dhoralix en la recepción y Saima de Calidad.

reviews.author: CarolWS
reviews.title: First Trip to Punta Cana- won't be our last!
reviews.text: We had a great stay here. The service was great everywhere- esp Luis Martinez our butler. Carlos in royal service lounge was wonderful with our coffee service each morning. Pedro's service to our beach hut was wonderful too. Definitely upgrade to royal service. It is worth the extra money.

reviews.author: Thomas S
reviews.title: 2 for 2: Another AWESOME vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful and pristine.  The staff is absolutely outstanding; service oriented to the extreme and I mean EVERYONE.  The food is EXCELLENT and I just couldn't ask for anything more!

reviews.author: ColoHiwayBuilder
reviews.title: WOW!!! Royal Service was Awesome!!!!!!
reviews.text:
We recently spent 5 days at the Paradisus Palma Real in the Royal Service side of the resort and the experience was excellent. Our butler (Fermin Moto) made our stay absolutely perfect. He was on top of his game and tended to every request that we had, from making dinner reservations to handling tee times and spa appointments. He went above and beyond the normal call of duty to ensure that our stay was absolutely "First Class". If we were not around our phone, he would find us on the beach to make sure that we did not need anything, and to find out what else he could do to make our stay more enjoyable. 

 There are two other individuals who also went above and beyond to make sure our stay was first rate; Leonardo Mota (Royal Service Pool Bartender) and Pedro (beach and pool waiter). Leonardo was always very friendly and willing to mix up any type of cocktail that you would request, including his "Leonardo's Special". He was very engaging and made everyone feel right at home while doing an excellent job of manning the bar. Pedro also went out of his way to ensure that we were well taken care of during our lazy days on the beach. After our first day, he knew our preferences and was waiting for my wife the following day with our beach towels and chairs already set up. He was a true pleasure to be around and was always  friendly and smiling. These three individuals made our trip truly memorable.

Although this was probably the nicest resort property that we have ever had the pleasure of staying at, there were some items that could be done better to make this a truly "one of a kind" resort. The main issue was the food was merely average. I realize that this is typically the case at all inclusives, but with such a nice resort, I guess our expectations were somewhat higher. Although the food was not terrible, there were often times that the meals were not hot when they arrived, and the choices were limited. 
The property itself was in great shape and the rooms were very nice and well appointed. It appeared that the maintenance on the property was well taken care of, as we saw many people tending to the grounds, as well as performing other functions around the resort to ensure that the property maintained such a high quality.
I would not hesitate to recommend this resort to anyone who is thinking about Punta Cana for their next vacation.

reviews.author: Jennifer285
reviews.title: Huge Fire - No evacuation plan - stay away
reviews.text:
The best part of this vacation was the masseuse on the beach !!! 
Mold in shower , poor management , making reservations for dinner was so difficult .. They would say there' was no availability yet the resturants would be empty .. Basically , they wanted you to eat at the buffet ... Huge language barrier , they had one English speaking guy named Victor - who was very nice and helpful , however , he was always busy ... 
The ladies that work in the reservation section look at you like you have ten heads when all your doing is trying to book a dinner reservation ..
Worst part of all - a HUGE fire happened due to irresponsible managers allowing fireworks to be set off which caused  a massive fire .. All we got the next day was a letter stating we can use another restaurant - really ?? I hope so , since two of yours burned down .. We expressed our concerns to management and they wanted nothing to do with it !! I would never take my family here EVER .... If I had children I'd leave and stay somewhere else , which many people did , since I felt unsafe as 32 years old .. 
Nothing was compensated or followed up when my husband and I complained , they did not care at all for our safety , which to me is scary especially being 30 min from a hospital . Nobody told us that we would be able to return to our room , I had to call from another hotel twice .. It was awful - never again ..
Advice - talk your way into the resturants , don't leave items left in your room unless you don't care about them..
Pros : pool , beach , wine selection

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Muchas oportunidades
reviews.text:
Nos hemos quedado en varios Melia ya que somos socios y sin duda alguna este es uno de los que tiene más oportunidades especialmente a nivel de servicio. 

Se supone que cuando estas en el club no tienes problemas con reservar sitio en la playa...pues todo lo contrario, hemos ido y no han tenido lugar para nosotros.. y hemos visto como solo le reservan a familias que les dan una "buena propina" por adelantado. 

En otros melia nos han asignado a una persona que se ocupe de hacer todas estas cosas... en este nos asignaron a un tal Frankelin que lo que ha hecho es tratar vendernos paquetes de excursiones que no queremos.... 

Muy lamentable esta situación ya que estamos pagando las anualidades de "los privilegios" del club Melia. 

Todavia seguimos aqui, esperemos que mejore.

reviews.author: Ana T
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: 3 of us couples traveled to this amazing resort.  The food was great, the service by our concierge -Byron- was bar none.  We have never been treated like such royalty.  The rooms were comfortable and luxurious.  Room at the adult pool was plenty.  Everyone was very welcoming and made our stay very relaxing.  The hydrotherapy was an adventure.  Also, the gym was fully equipped with our crossfit needs.  We cannot say enough!!

reviews.author: A272014
reviews.title: Very enjoyable
reviews.text:
Wonderful place for families to relax and enjoy! Attention to detail was very apparent. 
Family concierge service was well worth the extra money. Estefania, our concierge, was amazing! She took every effort to make our trip enjoyable. Not only did she check in with our family multiple times a day, but she made sure that everything was to our satisfaction. She went above and beyond for our family.

reviews.author: Anna  S
reviews.title: The reserve at paradisus punta Cana
reviews.text: We had a great time. The staff was extremely help, especially our family concierge, Estephania Ruiz. She made all our dinner and cabana reservations for us each day.  Each day our room was stocked with food and beverages of our choice.  One day there was even a bath drawn with roses, champagne, and strawberries. The food and drinks were good. The atmosphere is wonderful.  The beach is great with lots of seats, but not too crowded. The pools are also great and they offer water aerobics which can be fun to participate in or just as an onlooker. Overall it was an excellent experience and we would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Disappointed Pl... D
reviews.title: DO NOT VACATION HERE - Absolutely Horrible Experience
reviews.text: To say that I had a bad experience would be an understatement. While the hotel grounds were lovely, my room smelled musty and had flies, mosquitos and visible mold spots on the walls. We were there for a corporate event and Camilo Pache was out hotel liaison. ABSOLUTELY AWFUL SERVICE!!! There was clearly a language barrier and instead of trying to understand what we needed, he would just say "yes" and our requests were never fulfilled. Due to his negligence and poor communication we never received our boxes with gifts for our attendees. There was also a massive fire that burned down the main restaurant area of the resort during our stay. The fire was caused by fireworks that were set off on the beach way too close to the restaurant buildings. I personally witnessed a piece of the fireworks land on one of the thatched roofs of Naos Buffet and start the fire. We were beyond disappointed with our experience at Paradisus and would NEVER return. In fact, we will NEVER return to the Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: Rosedaisy14
reviews.title: Absolutely an amazing resort for a holiday.
reviews.text: The hotel itself was always very clean , such nice staff and great value for money. There was activities for every age from volley ball to finger painting. The rooms were absolutely fantastic. Dinning was also at amazing standard in the resort! Also the activities at night such as discos were very we'll done. I couldn't of ask for a better stay, waking up with the beach on your doorstep over all it was paradise. And I'd love to thank you all the members of staff especially Eduardo and Fransico for making my holiday amazing!

reviews.author: Shannon W
reviews.title: Incredible Family Vacation!
reviews.text:
My family and I had an incredible vacation at The Reserve at Paradisus in Punta Cana.  We traveled with two small children (ages 1 and 4), as well as grandparents, and found amenities and activities for all.

The Reserve – The Reserve is a newer part of the resort that was built away from the beach and the rest of the resort.  My wife and I looked at a room in the main portion of the resort, which was very nice.  However, the rooms at the Reserve are slightly better (bigger, more amenities).  The main advantage of the Reserve seemed to be the lack of crowds.  There were always chairs and cabanas by the pool, the restaurant was never busy, and the staff was always available and helpful.   We did not have a family concierge and quite frankly don’t see the need for one.  Nicia Cortorreal was the concierge for our portion of the Reserve.  She was amazing!  She always greeted us with a smile, allowed me to practice my Spanish even though her English was better, gave balloons to the girls whenever she saw them, had bubble baths ready for the girls when we got back from the beach, left wine in our room for us, and even went with me and my young daughter to the doctor when my daughter got an ear infection.  She, as with a lot of the staff, went above and beyond.  We found the food at the Reserve to either meet or exceed our expectations.  And again, the staff was truly wonderful.  Antony Cid at the Gaby Club always knew exactly what we wanted and would get it for us before we could think to ask for it.  The cooks (especially Senon) were wonderful and would go out of their way to make special dishes and always did so with a warm smile.   The other restaurants were good, but with two small children a buffet is sometimes easier than sit down meals.  Johnnie (aka Johnnie B. Good) at Fuego was extremely friendly and funny.  He made sure our meal was special and relaxing.  Emilio, a waiter at Aqua, was truly wonderful bringing bug spray, getting food early for the kids, and generally being very attentive but in no way intrusive.  

The beach – the beach is beautiful.  White sand and nice water for swimming.  There is an area set aside for Reserve guests.  The cabanas in the front are usually reserved by the family concierges, but there are plenty in the back that are open most of the day.  The staff make great drinks and come by frequently to see if you would like anything.  Jose (at The Reserve beach and The Reserve pool) was especially wonderful and would always make us smile with his “drinky drinky” offers.  The only down side of The Reserve beach is the lack of restroom nearby (there is one located on the main part of the beach, but it takes a couple of minutes to walk there and when a 4 year old has to go you need a bathroom easily accessible and nearby).  Also, it is about a 10 minute walk from The Reserve to the beach, but there are shuttles that come by frequently if you don't want to walk.
Overall, we thought this resort was incredible and would strongly recommend it.  It has great rooms, pools and beaches, but what truly sets it apart is the staff.

reviews.author: Calunoldin
reviews.title: Serviço excepcional!!!
reviews.text: Um resort acima de nossas expectativas...nota máxima para o atendimento, de todos os funcionários em geral. Nossa concierge Rosemery foi muito atenciosa e sempre atendia prontamente a todas as nossas solicitações. E o Hazael Reyes nós encantou com seu atendimento excepcional!! O atendimento do bar da piscina também foi excelente por todos! A comida e a bebida sao de alta qualidade, porém algumas bebidas mais requisitas não estão inclusa no pacote e precisa pagar a parte. Quanto aos restaurantes as opções são inúmeros, 11 no total com todos os tipos de cozinha internacional. O Passion é o único que não está incluído, porém não se paga pelo preço x serviço. Há opções muito melhores inclusas no complexo. Recomendamos com toda certeza e voltaremos para este hotel em nossa próxima vinda a Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Maritza
reviews.title: El mejor lugar para pasarla bien
reviews.text: A la llegada fuimos escoltados a la recpcion pox Daniel quien tiene una sonrisa fenomenal. Todo el staff es maravilloso. Agradecimiento especial a Rosmery, Anabel, Yeuri, Adalgiza, Eddy Wilson, Melvin, Emilio, Elaidy. Wao simplifico...TODOS en La Reserva son iguales de bueno.

reviews.author: Jan R
reviews.title: Paradise is the only name for this resort!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from 4 days in the Royal Service suites at Paradisus. His company awarded select employees with this lovely trip. It took all of the first day to get it through my head that what I was looking at was real! The property is arranged so that wherever you are you have a breathtaking view of something. The resort is large, but after wandering around you get the lay of the land and all the shops, pools, and beach entries were very easy to get to. 
Our butler (!) gave us a tour as soon as we arrived and made sure we knew to contact him for ANYthing we needed. Juan de Leon was lovely and served us well right up til the last minute we got on the bus to the airport. 
Our room was spotless, and everything was in perfect working order, stocked daily with water and snacks. Anything you forget - beach bag, beach towel, slippers, robes, etc. is in the room. We felt secure leaving our passports and valuables in the electronic safe daily. We never encountered any bugs, as you might expect in the tropics, but of course off the property is likely a different story.
We had food at a catered event the first night and lunch in the buffet; both were less than impressive and left us wanting for something. Room service was also less than tasty, though presented well and delivered timely and courteously. The restaurants, however are outstanding and well worth calling your butler to make a reservation. 
The beach and ocean were so enchanting that we avoided the pools altogether. If you want peace and quiet and experience in nature, stay on the beach/in the ocean. Though there were always a few couples near us, we felt we still had significant privacy on the Royal Services beach. The pool area seemed to be more of a social hangout - drinking at the swim up bar, a bit more crowded and noisy. Depends on your preferences. 
The smoothie bar on the beach was awesome! The butler brought us towels, smoothies, etc. and made dinner reservations for us so we never had to leave our beach beds! We also left our beach bags/items on our beach beds while in the ocean and no one ever disturbed them.
Go out at sunrise, stay all day if you can. There are plenty of shaded lounging options. Between 5pm and 7pm, people start leaving the beach, which makes it a good time to get some pics and walk on the shore.
We never saw beach or pool "hours" posted, but it seemed there was never anyone in the pools or at the beach after dark. Not sure what the rules were. 
There was one glitch the day we left - electricity and water suddenly went out at 6am, but were restored within the hour. Perhaps a reminder that we were staying in the DR. There was also a minor fire in one of the rooms due to an electrical short in the circuit box, but that also was dealt with quickly. 
All the staff were extremely friendly and cheerful. We felt fully welcomed and at home. We hope to return again and enjoy the pristine aqua waters and white sand on Bavaro Beach!

reviews.author: Prasad M
reviews.title: Wonderful relaxing Dominican vacation
reviews.text:
Stayed at Paradisus Palma Real from 4/12/14 to 4/16/14.  Overall, a great experience. The hospitality was what stood out.  Genuinely caring and attentive staff. You do have to deal with sales pitches for excursions etc regularly but easy to either say yes or no. 

Food overall very good. Buffet above average. Ala a carte restaurants mostly very good. Hibachi dinner was tasty and entertaining. Room service was slow in the mornings but of good quality. Lots of bars. Good quality liquor. 

Resort grounds beautiful. Lobby is exquisite. Everything is high end. The rooms are very nice. We stayed in a connected two bedroom master suite which was quite spacious for 2 families of 3. Nice patios. Overall quiet. No major disturbances other than occasional kiddos shouting in the morning!

Bavaro beach is as advertised - beautiful. Nice covered seating on beach though you do have to get up early to reserve an area. Nice large pool - very clean. Great service in the pool area. Free non-mechanized water sports - kayaks, catamarans,etc. 

Vladimir in guest services was very helpful throughout our stay. He was able to get us a reservation at a very popular restaurant on the last night. In general, the guest services staff was very helpful. 

Overall, a very, very nice stay with few hiccups.

reviews.author: Vladimir D
reviews.title: Personnel in the Hotel
reviews.text: We were there at the second time and definitely will come back again!!! Everything was excellent! Personnel is very well trained and professional!!!!!!! Special Huge Thanks to Mr. Lenin and Ms. Pamella in the Reserves Bar!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Drako23
reviews.title: wonderful vacation
reviews.text: This is an extraordinarily friendly and comfortable resort~rated 4th best for the entire island.  The restaurants offer variety and excellent cuisine, the staff are uniformly pleasant and helpful.  The pool at The Reserve is large, clean, and delightfully not heavily chlorinated.  The beach is gorgeous.  And the room/suite we had was impeccable and very comfortable.

reviews.author: RDfromNC
reviews.title: Beautiful & Relaxing Vacation in Paradise!
reviews.text:
My wife & I just returned from an incredible "babymoon" in Punta Cana at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was everything we had been hoping for and more!  The entire resort is absolutely beautiful... gorgeous gardens, stylish rooms, and spectacular beach. Truly a top-notch resort that is impressive at first sight and stays that way throughout.

We decided to go with the Royal Service which provides access to an exclusive pool & bar, beach area, restaurant, and lounge that are all adult-only spots. Royal Service also means you have a butler that it at your service during your entire stay.  

Our butler, Luis Martinez, was excellent!  He was so friendly, helpful, and went out of his way to make our stay special and relaxing.  Luis provided a tour of the whole property when we arrived so we would have a lay of the land and he also made reservations for dinner at the different resort restaurants each night and even helped prepare the staff at every place to accommodate my wife's gluten allergy. He talked with us for a bit each day to see what he could do to make our experience the best possible and he found a great excursion for us to go snorkeling. Luis was awesome!

We loved spending time on the amazing beach and I got to enjoy lots of great tropical drinks made by Leonardo at the Royal Service Pool Bar.  Leonardo was really friendly and also made great non-alcoholic beverages for my wife since she couldn't enjoy the real stuff with our kid on the way.

Overall, the service throughout the resort was extremely attentive, friendly, and professional. They staff seems to really care about the experience you're having.  We did decide to tip fairly frequently because we felt the level of care provided deserved it.  There are lots of dining options and the food is good but not exceptional.  If you are looking for a beautiful, relaxing, and service-oriented place for a tropical vacation, then you will love it here!

reviews.author: Amy T
reviews.title: Paradisus palm real resort
reviews.text: Overall good experience at the resort. Would like to mention excellent customer service received by Aneuris Santana and Juan Cedeno they were both really helpful and welcoming.We complained regarding the AC not working but sadly issue was not resolved.

reviews.author: David J
reviews.title: Vacation that could last a lifetime.
reviews.text: The beach and pool were fantastic.  Bartenders Luis, Gustavo, Pedro, and Ramon were always ready to serve.  I would like to thank Big Mac and Yube for the personal attention from the Activities staff.  What a difference these two make.  Needless to say we had a phenomenal time.  Seven days of pure tee relaxation.

reviews.author: JillMarie5
reviews.title: Destination Wedding & Honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I got married at this resort on 2/16/14. (Once we got back home, the real world kicked in, so pardon the delay posting). I can't say enough wonderful things about the resort, the service, and all the wedding festivities. We knew we were in for a treat because we chose to do the Love at First Site visit to check out the resort prior to the wedding. Yessica was very helpful during our tasting and even sought us out when we returned for the wedding. Highly recommend the LAFS visit because we were able to see all the locations in person and changed our mind after seeing them. There is a Miami based office so we were able to easy plan from the NY. Bianca was my Romance Planner in the US and Cecilia assisted us with room reservations. They were both very helpful. We chose the Tailor-Made package and had 32 guests. The whole wedding was so perfect that it really feels like a dream. I can't believe how wonderful the service was. Claribel was our on-site wedding coordinator; she was very sweet, helpful, and attentive to details. For our welcome beach BBQ, it looked like it might rain, so she sought us out to show us the alternative location if the weather didn't improve. Luckily, the weather improved and it was an amazing festivity, gorgeous all under a full moon. I highly, recommend having a welcome event to see everyone ahead of time and introduce guests who don't know each other. The food was phenomenal- lobster tails, steak, really everything you could ask for. Claribel was very prepared and organized, she was helpful to family, friends, and us. We felt lucky to have such an incredible planner for both the BBQ and wedding. We choose to get married on the beach and have the reception on the beach terrace. It was all so beautiful and romantic! We were very laid back with decor, etc.. We had Caribbean Celebrations do our decor (on-site decor company and most of it was included in our specific package) Our photographer and videographer did an incredible job- we had TropicOne Studio (the on-site photographers). Hernán Btesh was our photographer- he was fantastic, I was pleasantly surprised with our photos and we got lots of compliments from friends and family. Our videographer was Louis and we were very happy with the footage. We can't thank Francisco Cabrera, Richard (Palazzo) and Stephania Auguste enough for making our honeymoon in the Royal Service areas phenomenal. They remembered us from last summer and went out of their way to congratulate us, assist us, etc... We will miss them! Our friends and family loved the resort. :) 

Unfortunately, my dad slipped on the bathroom floor one night, hurt his knee badly and had to go to the hospital. The resort sent a doctor to the room and called for an ambulance immediately. They went out of their way to make sure he was okay the rest of his stay, constantly had ice etc... They had a wheelchair waiting for him upon his arrival from the hospital and I was very impressed with how they took charge during a crisis (my dad is doing fine). Two flights in our group were cancelled from the US due to the snow storm and the resort had their stay's extended a day without an issue.  
My only complaints are that we spent a lot of money to get married here in addition to bringing so many family members that we were expecting a room upgrade and were not able to get one. To be honest, our room for our wedding/honeymoon was not as nice as the room we had for our LAFS visit or the rooms some of our guests got. They were pretty booked solid (being a teacher, I had to travel when schools were off for Presidents Day so the resort was more crowded) so they were not able to accommodate us. Our other complaint, was we were not pleased with our butler. We were over whelmed checking in with so many friends and family that we made the mistake of not requesting our butler from last time- Juan de Leon. He is an incredible butler and should be in charge of training butlers to make sure they know what to do. We were so sad when we entered our room the night of the wedding (which was at the resort!!) and did not find anything special in the room. With Juan de Leon, we never entered an empty room. We were able to switch halfway through our stay to get Juan again- what a difference!  He surprised us with rose petals, candles, champagne, etc.. We just wish we had that treat on our wedding night because our butler really didn't do anything and was very disorganized! :( If you travel here, request Juan De Leon- he's the absolute best! 
We loved being able to go to this resort twice and have our dream beach wedding here. I highly suggest this resort for a destination wedding- the resort takes care of everything! Thank you for the amazing memories!

reviews.author: Abby A
reviews.title: Avoid the annoying salesmen
reviews.text:
This place is unbelievably stunning. The service was outstanding, the resort was the cleanest I've ever seen. Everyone was working the whole time to ensure that the property was in perfect shape and that all guests were happy. And the beach is WOW! I spent 2 days just laying under the palapa enjoying the sound of the ocean.
On the negative side, the management needs to reconsider their sales strategy for their "Melia Membership". When you are at the hotel, you will run into many staff who are always eager to help. However, you will undoubtedly come in contact with the "bait and switch" salesman. My boyfriend and I were on our way to eat breakfast and we were stopped by a nice gentleman who was asking us about our trip and if we were enjoying ourselves. As the conversation went on, he offered to give us some additional information about the hotel over breakfast the next day. My boyfriend immediately told him that we weren't interested in any club or timeshare. The gentleman denied that this had anything to do with a timeshare. He reassured us that all he wanted to do was "give us information about the hotel". The next morning, we were escorted into another area of the hotel specifically for Melia Members. At this point, we sat through an hour and a half of a sales pitch on becoming a member of Melia. This is how they phrase this. They never call it a timeshare. At the end of the presentation, they offered us a "membership" for $20,000 upfront. We felt like we were lied to the entire time just to be sold on a timeshare which we clearly stated we had no interest in. This is the last thing a guest wants to do when they are on vacation. The management needs to be honest with their guests and stop trying to be sneaky with their terminology and sales strategy. It's a waste of time for guests who probably can't afford to charge $20,000 on a credit card and don't want to be lied to.

reviews.author: Santiago Y
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, maravilloso en todas sus instalaciones y comodidades. Los restaurantes muy buenos, tanto los buffet como el Gabi Beach. Todo el personal de Club Meliá ejerce una labor espectacular, siempre atendiéndote de buena manera y con una sonrisa, haciendo tu estancia más placentera, al igual que el personal de ServiExpress. Destacamos por sobre todas las cosas, la labor de José Luis Martínez, por su trato de maravilla con nosotros en todo momento, siempre dispuesto a ayudarnos en lo que necesitaramos, las 24 horas del día. Excelente persona y excelente también en su trabajo como funcionario del hotel.

reviews.author: laurenbork
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, wonderful staff
reviews.text: We were lucky, after a slight mishap with our room, we had the Royal Service at this gorgeous resort. What a beautiful hotel, the beaches pools and restaurants are well maintained and the staff couldn't be nicer. Juan Castillo is the most fantastic butler, we were so lucky to have him as our "family" for the week -- definitely ask for him if you can. The food (in all 7 restaurants) was excellent, and we would absolutely go back. Great for couples and families -- more than enough room for everyone to coexist.

reviews.author: PONTU007
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de Playa Bavaro en Punta Cana
reviews.text: No hay mejor opción en todo Punta Cana. Su precio no es barato, pero si te gusta la buena comida con excelente bebida, y la playa, casi diría que el paraíso esta por unos días, y si le sumas la excelente atención, ya deja de ser caro. He venido en varias oportunidades y sigue manteniendo la mejor calidad.

reviews.author: Jeanne B
reviews.title: Patrick and Jeanne WOW......
reviews.text:
My husband and I was celebrating our 30th Anniversary and this was our first time going to the Dominican Republic and staying at the Paradisus Punta Cana resort what a time we had! Everyone at the resort was so nice, they made us fill like royalty. Inside as well as outside the resort was very clean, every time you pass an area someone cleaning, and that made me feel good because for me to enjoy anything that I do my environment has to be clean.

What can I say about the food! (Excelente). Everyone from the cook to the waiters and waitress that served us did it in style. Our first night we ate at Gabi Club (buffet)  and the second night at  Fuego, and other times at Vento, Passion,and Mole, these are restaurants and required reservation and that was done for us by our concierge Ada and Anabel Gonzales. I am a very picky person and for me to say this about this resort it has to be good. I am the kind of person that carries her Lysol, pillowcase and sheets when I go to resorts or hotels but being at this resort I see I would not need all that, just the Lysol though because I carry it to any hotel I go to.  

I would like to give special thanks to Ada. my husband and I went to the beach and when we got back to our room, a bubble bath was prepared for us with flower petals and a note from Ada wishing us a happy anniversary. Ada you are doing a great job, you have a beautiful spirit keep up the good work, we love you and you now have friends in Maryland, the resort should feel blessed to have everyone of you because you help them in accomplishing their goals.  This just tells you how caring and considerate the staffs are. we also want to thank Anabel Gonzales who was very kind and helpful and always smiling you too help made our stay enjoyable and memorable.

And what can we say about the housekeeping team Cleyhi Rosario you are the best, Jino Vilorio, and Desire our room was always clean, fresh towels twice a day, they even come at night to turn down our sheets to get us ready for bed with chocolate at both ends. We've been to some nice resorts and hotels in the pass, however, In our 30 years of vacationing, I can truly say this has been by far one of the best resort we've stayed in and the best service we've had. You guys spoil us and we will be coming back soon God's will and we will recommend this resort to all our friends and family that are planing to vacation in this area.   

 My husband said everyone at least once in their lifetime should have a vacation like this, but it only can be at Paradisus Punta Cana. If anyone is thinking of vacationing at DR I highly recommend this resort. They have class and I would not of settle for any thing less. Also a shout out to Yardi you are a great guy with a beautiful family keep leaving for them they need you and you are doing a great job for the resort, God bless you and Marecela thank you for everything, in spite of the job you do, I know it is not always easy but you are doing a great job.  God bless all of you and keep up the good work.

reviews.author: SaeedRizvi
reviews.title: Absolutely breathtaking and phenomenal!!
reviews.text: Our service was great and very courteous staff! We were helped constantly with 2 kids, even without asking for any. Ask for Franklin De Lacruz, who went out of his way every single day to help us out. Many congrats to a great team they've built and to the owner especially.

reviews.author: milton m
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever !!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: My wife and I recently returned from the Dominican for a well over due vacation. We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real with the royal service. I will say we were more than pleased with our experience. I have never seen a well managed resort with a staff that has a smile at all times. From the moment we walked on the resort we were taken care of with open arms. My wife and I were very pleased with great service. The resort was very clean and just beautiful to be apart of. Our butler Bayron was Amazing!!!!! I can't even imagine our trip with out him being apart of it all. Not only did his service hit the top but personality was out of this world. Whom ever decides this resort should be blessed to have Bayron as a butler. Also our bartenders Billy and Leonardo they are the best. Billy you are the best I really enjoyed your company and looked forward to seeing you everyday. Keep doing what you are doing. I can't even say enough about this resort the people i crossed paths with. If you want your trip to Punta Cana to be an experience then you will choose Paradisus Palma Real. I can't for get Nathalie you are wonderful ! Your smile alone from the greeting was the best thank you as well for everything you have done. Last but not least julian AKA frenchy you are the best and believe me when I say we will be seeing you soon and it will be worth the time we spent.

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.title: The Roof is on FIRE!
reviews.text: Ok so the resort is hands down one of the most beautiful ones I've been too. I was here for just the weekend for a friends wedding. The service was really good for the most part. We did have a few bad experiences with rude employees in the restaurants though. Also the "Market Grill" and a two other building caught on fire while we were there after the wedding... The entire wedding party watched it burn from the beach down to the ground... very scary! Other than the fire and the few (VERY FEW) rude staff members it a great place they keep the drinks coming and the food is good for the money! I would go back! Also the room are real nice too!

reviews.author: Lorrey S
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!  Even better the second time!
reviews.text:
Just came home from our second stay at Palma Real.  It is hard to believe, but it was even better this time.  The resort is beautiful with 9 restaurants and royal service.  I highly recommend the royal service, you will not be disappointed. 

The Royal service staff is fabulous!  Our butler, Narciso Green, made sure that we had a great time.  We were not able to upgrade when we got there as the front desk said that the Royal Service was full, but he was able to get us a room in that area!!  He was always around and we never had to ask for anything.  He made our dinner reservations, prepared our bubble baths with strawberries and champagne and made it a truly special vacation.

The butler we had last year, Luis Martinez, was off when we arrived, but he came to find us when he found out we were there.  He also checked in every day to make sure that there was nothing that he could do for us.  We were not even his guests, but he cared that we were satisfied!

The pool concierge staff is out of this world.  Being our second time there, they all remembered us from last July and welcomed us "home".  Francisco Cabrera, Pedro, Ramon, Billy and Martin go out of their way for every guest and are truly happy to be of assistance every day.  We never even had to place a towel on a chair or anything.  They are truly full service!  

The rest of the resort staff is great.  The Royal Service bartender Leonardo had the bar full all the time, but you never saw he sweat with all of the drinks he had to make.  Every one was made with a smile!  The restaurant staff, the Royal Service lounge staff and even the groundskeepers always greet you with a smile and will do anything to make sure that you are enjoying your vacation.

I cannot wait to go back next year, if I can wait that long!!!

reviews.author: Kathy C
reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
This was the most Top Resort that I have ever stayed in.  The grounds were beautiful and the service was excellent!  Ramon Fuego Luis at the swim up bar was the best bar tender ever and would take care of us every day!  He would even save seats or a cabbanna for us every morning.  I loved that guy and he always had a smile on his face and served us with drinks on his head.  Starky Valoy at the 24-hour bar was also a fantastic bartender and very friendly.  Fernano Geronimo was the most repsonsive Room Service provider there was and Juan at the Naos Restaurant was most accommodating.  The service there was impeccable and we tipped them a bit every day and always had the best of service!  This was a phenomenal Resort and the beach was beautiful.  The pool was beautiful as well.

We took one excursion to do snorkeling and the crew really accommodated us and we had fun.

Bear in mind that the resort does loose power from time to time and the water will go out for a period of time when the power goes out.  (approximatelly 15 minutes)  This was a tad to get used to when taking a shower.

Make sure you read the all-inclusive fee prior to arriving.  I didn't necessarily read the fine print and got hit with a $2K bill when I arrived, however in the end it was all worth it.  If you had to take taxi's and go out to restaurant's on the island we would have probably spent the same amount of money.

The Water activities were wonderful during the middle of the day.  If you are a workout nut, the water spinning classes were phenomenal!  Lots of activities to do onsite, so you don't feel like you are bored.

Food was a tad bland at the buffets, but the food at the other restaurants were pretty good.  Fresh fruit and fresh fish.....what more could you ask for???

Overall, great stay and great resort.  Would recommend this place to all!

reviews.author: Bill M
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation for spring break
reviews.text:
We booked our trip to the Reserve shortly after Christmas after reading the great reviews on Tripadvisor.  We then suffered through +60" of snow and sub zero temps and counted the days until April 5 finally arrived...

The trip from the airport was a snap.  $35.00 taxi ride with plenty of available options at the airport.  We received a huge hello when we stepped out of the taxi, and it never stopped from there until we left!

It is difficult to imagine a better family-oriented hotel.  Maria De Paula (housekeeping) made balloon bubble baths for my 5 year old every day.  Valentin  Caminero brought us lunch (and drinks!) poolside and made sure we had a great time.  Our waiters at the Gabi club, where we ate breakfast and lunch every day, were fantastic.  Juanilin, Francis, Johairo, and all the others served us with a perpetual smile.

The rooms at the hotel were first-rate.  Beautiful and spacious.  Myself, my wife and my 2 sons stayed in a 1 bedroom family concierge suite on the second floor with plenty of room to spread out for the week.  The pull out couch could have been more comfortable for sleeping, but it was perfectly manageable.  The main bed was outstanding.  Great whirlpool bath and shower.  3 sinks.  Plenty of space for your cloths and a spacious sitting area.  Wifi was good and the signal was strong in the room, but better by the pool.

I've read the complaints about the food, but we found it to be very good and varied.  In the morning we ate a healthy breakfast with fresh fruit, lots of juice, cereals, and coffee.  There was also a grill for eggs, oatmeal and other tasty things.  Lunch could be eaten at the grill poolside or at the buffet a couple of steps from the pool.  We never opted for a sit-down menu lunch, but it was available as well at many of the restaurants.  A couple of times we ordered room service and it came quickly with the correct order.

Dinners were always good.  Reservations were required, but our concierge made them for us (see below).  We just had to show up.  The highlight of the week for me was the octopus carpaccio at Aqua.  Not to be missed!  Each meal had something for my wife as well as myself and my kids.  

The family concierge service was well worth the expense.  Estefania Ruiz, our concierge, is now officially a part of our extended family!  She took care of everything for us.  Restaurant reservations.  Shopping trips.  Snorkeling.  She was perfect in every way.  I speak no spanish but it didn't matter.  Her english was fluent and we had no difficulty communicating.  My boys miss her already.

The pools and beach were beautiful and never felt crowded.  We alternated each day and could always find a comfortable place to camp out and play in the water.

The Reserve is part of the Paradisus campus, so you get to use all the facilities at the Paradisus while enjoying the relative seclusion of the Reserve.  It's all within walking distance, and there are also golf cart shuttles to take you around if you don't want to walk.  We rented bikes for the week (free) and rode everywhere.  Fun!  The beach is an extremely easy 5 minute walk from the Reserve.

Great health club (we used it) and spa (did not) and lots of other fitness programs (did not) are there if you want them.  We just wanted to relax, which is very easy to do at the Reserve.

Although this hotel has many, many things that make it special, it's the staff that really stand out.  They are all proud of their hotel and the quality of service they provide.  It's important to them that you feel welcome and are taken care of each day.  Everyone was friendly and helpful 100% of the time.  It was a real joy being with them for the week.

Just book your trip here!  You won't be disappointed.

The Morgans from Indiana

reviews.author: MaryLiam
reviews.title: Perfect Beach Getaway
reviews.text: This was my first solo vacation and my goal was to enjoy a beautiful beach in a quiet and relaxing setting. Paradisus Palma Real's Royal Service was perfect for this goal. I had an ocean view room that was beautifully and tastefully decorated. The room was kept fresh and clean daily by the maid service. Since the room faced the private beach, my porch was a quiet refuge - no children running around and no loud partiers, just the fantastic view of the palm trees, white sand and blue-green water. The butler service provided by Jeziel Alvarez was excellent. Jeziel was always responsive, reliable and personable. He made sure I had a cheeseplate in my room in the afternoon and had a relaxing bath ready for me when I returned from dinner. The personalized service on the beach was also amazing. I don't recall the gentleman's name, but every morning when I stepped on the sand, the same friendly face greeted me and walked me to my private Bali bed. And within 5 minutes of my arrival on the beach each day, he brought me an ice bucket with bottled water. The entire staff was great. Everyone I passed gave me a friendly smile and said hello. I pre-arranged transportation to and from the airport to the hotel with Olympus. They also provided outstanding service and the driver, Yamarco, was very courteous and friendly. My new goal is to return here and enjoy the Royal Service with my family!

reviews.author: Joan P
reviews.title: Perfect Wedding and Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We got married on the beach at the Paradisus Punta Cana our reception was at the Nova Terrace.  We had a small group of people.  However,  I would do it all over again.  We got a free upgradto the Reserve (highly recommended).  The food was really good and we did not get sick from drinking water or ice from the bars or resturants.  Use bottle water in the rooms.  

Wedding:  Set up was great and I received so much positive feedback from our friends and family who came to our wedding.   The cake was soooooooo good my husband (who doesnt eat cake) had two slices and the wedding coordinator was great and listened to our specific wants/needs.  

Staff:  The staff was so nice and the shows are also very good (not broadway).

reviews.author: Susan P
reviews.title: Sad to leave
reviews.text:
OMG - what a stunning resort!!  The grounds were beautiful and always being maintained.  We stayed at The Reserve section.  

Thank you so much to Nikel - he was assigned to our family for the week and was just wonderful to me and my family.  All questions answered and all requested made - always with a smile!!  He made our trip even more relaxing as he took care of all of our needs and booking of reservations. 

By the end of the week, the pool bartenders knew what drinks we liked and were so friendly.  

We ate at 4 of the restaurants (my favourite was Vento) and then did buffets too.  All were great.  There was never a lack of tasty food - something to meet everyone's taste buds.  All buffets were clean and constantly being replenished.

The pools wonderful, the beach stunning.  Did some of the activities, though spend most time relaxing.  The list of activities you could do went on and on. 

Rooms were very spacious and always well stocked.  All staff throughout the resort are friendly and willing to help wherever they can.

Would highly recommend to couples and families with children.

reviews.author: Ron O
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real ...Loved It!
reviews.text: This is our second stay at a Gran Melia resort in as many years and the Paradisus Palma Real was by far our favorite. Our Member Services Host Yafreisy C. was extremely helpful from the moment we arrived to the moment we checked-out. Great room with our private hot tub on our private balcony. Great resort from the main to The Reserve where we stayed. Easy to get around with the always available shuttle service. Among our most favorite, polite, helpful, engaging and friendly drivers were the following (and in no particular order) - Jose Lugo, Juan Jose Rosa, Ricardo Luis and Jonathan Mejia Maletero! We abolutely loved this resort, Gabi Beach, the pools and restaurants around the pools, etc., and above all else, The People of Paradisus Palma Real! We will be back.

reviews.author: TLC121212
reviews.title: a great get away, relaxing with pristine views of the beach
reviews.text: We were fortunate to enjoy this trip as part of an awards program through my husband's company.  We haven't been to the caribbean together, but will say we look forward to going back.  The Reserve was wonderful.  We loved Steeve Phillipe our Butler.  He had a great personality, was very accommodating, and addressed our needs.  We really enjoyed the Reserve only restaurant for breakfast and lunch.  The breakfast offerings were healthy with the green juice and loved the mango gazpacho - yum!! The opportunity to find lounge chairs on the beach and have wonderful servers come out frequently was such an indulgence. The whole trip was really an indulgence.  Well worth it!!  We loved the Reserve lounge as well, a great spot to do some work if needed, get a snack or drink, and to hang out out of the sun.  Only critique would be that the rooms are a bit worn, they could use some updating - e.g. we had to hip check the door open, but hey we are in Caribbean paradise so we'll take it.  Wonderful location for a relaxing get away.

reviews.author: SpaceCoastDave
reviews.title: Geat group property
reviews.text:
I am a meeting planner, and just had the pleasure of staying for 3 weeks with 2 different corporate groups.  The staff was amazing, and the food was great.  My butler, Juan de Leon was so great the first time, I requested him for me and some of the executives.  He was always there helping us out with everything, and was awesome.
I will be coming back with my wife to enjoy this property for our personal vacation.

reviews.author: Smithfield13
reviews.title: Fabulous and we want to come back
reviews.text:
We came on an RCI exchange and have had mixed experiences at other resorts in the past.  However, this place was by far the best we've ever stayed at.  We originally were booked at the Reserve but moved to the Royal Service at the main resort (they offered it to us upon checkin).

Everything the entire week was fabulous.  Food at all the restaurants, especially Palazzo, was great and much better than I had expected.  Our butler Javier helped us with anything we needed.  We liked staying at the main resort because the walk to the beach and activities was so close - at Reserve it is a long walk or a shuttle ride from the beach.  We found many times that somebody had to go back to the room during the day and it was just 50 yards.

The resort was gorgeous and the staff were literally like family.  Lots of activities all day and night.  Shout outs to Lorenzo and Roberto at the Avenue bar, Ramon at the pool bar , and Leonardo at the Royal Service bar on the beach.

We'd love to come back and are already talking about it.  It has fully earned Gold Crown status.

reviews.author: Matt R
reviews.title: BIG MAC
reviews.text: This was a great stay!!!! Great service and wonderful efforts from everyone. From the moment I stepped onto the resort everyone worked as hard as possible to make me feel like a king. Big Mac made each day at the beach rock. Thanks B- Mac for all your fun. Gregorio! Thanks for the Yep!!! And the miso soup was great.

reviews.author: Mark W
reviews.title: relaxation
reviews.text: We would recommend the Royal Service program. We had a garden view room and found it very private. The Royal Service experience was excellent. The private dining restaurant was amazing. Our butler Luiz was wonderful and made our vacation a memorable one. We would definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: Erik R
reviews.title: Great resort choice
reviews.text: The staff of this resort was exceptional. The bartenders at the main pool Ramon and Luis were great!  Bartender Juan at Gabi beach was just as good. Wife and I also had a great meal at Passion. It was amazing!

reviews.author: fduncan3452
reviews.title: Vacation in Punta Cana Dominican Republic
reviews.text: Just got a back from a fabulous vacation in Punta Cana. We were there 5 years ago and went back for my 60th birthday present to the same resort. I just can't say enough about how great and relaxing it was. We had a concierge name Franklin De La Cuiz and he was the greatest. He handled everything for us. Got reservations for our evening meals, got the person I needed to set up excursions and checked with us daily to see if we needed anything. Service from people like Franklin is the reason I would go back and recommend the Paradisus Palma Real to anyone that asked me about the Dominican Republic. Beautiful ,relaxing and all the staff is there to please and serve you. We had a fire that destroyed our favorite restaurant the first evening we were there. That did not damper all the employees at all or at least you never saw it. They always have a smile.

reviews.author: Erwan B
reviews.title: La grande classe!
reviews.text:
Notre séjour de 10 jours aurait pu très mal commencer: en arrivant au Paradisus Palma Real on nous annonce que notre chambre n'est pas disponible et qu'on va être transféré à l'autre Paradisus de Punta Cana. Après les heures passées sur Trip Advisor pour choisir et l'effort financier consenti pour le Palma Real, nous refusons catégoriquement de repartir, d'autant plus que ma femme est enceinte et que la journée de voyage a été longue.
Nous sommes alors relogés au The Reserve pour la première nuit (magnifique) et pour compenser la gêne occasionnée nous sommes upgradés dans une suite Royal Service pour la suite de notre séjour.
Un majordome est à notre disposition, avec une téléphone pour pouvoir le joindre quand bon nous semble. Le notre s'appelle Fermin, il a été d'une gentillesse incroyable et a ponctué nos vacances de nombreuses petites attentions (programme pour la semaine, préparation de la suite, petites surprises, etc...).
L'hôtel est somptueux, très grand, et entretenu à la perfection jour et nuit par une véritable armée d'agents et de jardiniers.
Les infrastructures sont superbes, les chambres très grandes et très belles et le choix de restaurants (une dizaine) avec service à la carte le soir est incroyable. Je voudrais particulièrement l'équipe du "Palazzio" avec Stephania et Richard qui nous ont accueilli chaque jour avec le sourire, un petit mot gentil et surtout un très grand professionnalisme. Un grand merci à eux d'avoir rendu nos vacances encore plus belles. Merci aussi à Richardson du "Market Grill" pour sa gentillesse.
La plage est très belle, le sable blanc est très fin, et elle est nettoyée chaque matin (ramassage des algues déposées par les vagues). Pour la partie de la plage réservée au Royal Service, un bar, un bar à jus de fruits et une équipe est à votre disposition pour vous installer sur de grands transats king size face à la mer, génial!

Ma femme et moi ne sommes pas trop friands de séjours en "hôtel-club" mais difficile de trouver quelque chose à redire sur le Paradisus tant la qualité des lieux, des prestations et du service est élevée, nous avons passé des vacances parfaites!

Petits défauts de l'hôtel :
 - Les animations dans la piscine (aquagym, aquabiking, etc...) sont prévues tous les jours à midi pile (en plein Soleil, brûlures assurées),
 - La qualité du réseau wifi dans les chambres fluctue, 
 - Des événements privés (business ou mariage) peuvent ponctuellement bloquer l'accès à une partie de l'hôtel,
 - lorsqu'on est pas client en Royal Service, un certains nombres de lieux ne sont pas accessibles (piscine privée, restaurant privé, plage privée), mais il reste largement de quoi faire,
 - la nourriture offre un choix immense et souvent de grande qualité mais les amateurs de pain, viennoiseries et pâtisseries seront frustrés par leur côté un peu trop anglo-saxon.

Petits défauts de la plage (vrais pour tous les hôtels à Bavaro) :
 - pas mal de vent certains jours,
 - côté levé de Soleil (il se couche derrière les hôtels),
 - pas mal d'algues, nettoyées uniquement devant les beaux hôtels,
 - zone de baignade réduite à cause des nombreuses activités motorisées (bruyantes) ou non: parachute ascensionnel, bouées, bateaux d'excursions, pédalo, voiliers, etc...
 - rien à voir sous l'eau (à part la pollution des touristes),
 - rabatteurs des boutiques des boutiques de souvenirs, gentils mais nombreux,

reviews.author: Hornes6405
reviews.title: My Birthday Week In Paradise
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed in Paradisus from April 7th to April 11th with the Royal Service. The staff and service was simply amazing. The food was delicious and the drinks were made to perfection. The resort was clean and well maintained. The beach and the pool were so relaxing, we felt as if we were the only couple there. I also did a spa treatment which was well worth the money. The spa took place inside of a bungalow over a small pond. We hated that our vacation came to an end but happy we found a little peace of Heaven on Earth. I would like to thank Eduard Mendez; our butler, Francisco Cabrera; our beach attendant and Natalia(from Royal Service) for making our experience unforgettable. We will be back!

reviews.author: Bill S
reviews.title: Courteous Employees
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Luis Diaz and Omar Hernandez at the resort last weekend. Luis made great drinks and Omar was very helpful in the Business Center. The facilities were excellent. Thank you.

reviews.author: Andrew T
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort, with wonderful food and Staff
reviews.text: We booked a destination wedding at Paradisus Punta Cana and could not have been any happier with our decision.  Not only was the resort among the nicest we had ever seen the staff were amazing, and incredibly helpful.  I would especially like to note the help of Beatriz Rosa, our wedding coordinator who bent over backwards to ensure that our wedding was everything we could have hoped for it to be.  The hotel provided us a wedding gift of a room upgrade to the Reserve which was a wonderful plus.  The food (both buffets and ala carte restaurants) was amazing, not a single dish that we did not like.  We would highly recommend this resort and all it has to offer to anyone looking to vacation in Punta Cana, or anywhere else that Paradisus resorts exist for that matter.  100% satisfied and then some!.

reviews.author: Paulo N
reviews.title: Quase perfeito
reviews.text: O hotel é realmente maravilhoso. A praia é exuberante, a infraestrutura funciona muito bem e os quartos são bastante espaçosos. A comida também é excelente, exceto pelo restaurante argentino, onde a carne não estava muito saborosa. Com relação ao atendimento por parte dos funcionários, existem aqueles que fazem de tudo para você se sentir bem (como os concierges das villas), mas também tive algumas decepções: no bar da piscina, fui claramente colocado em segundo plano enquanto funcionários atendiam clientes europeus: pedi o mesmo snack que outro hóspede, ao mesmo momento (um pacote de batatas fritas), mas a a garçonete entregou 5 pacotes ao outro hóspede e disse para mim que havia acabado. Quando insinuei que estava tendo um tratamento inferior e iria reclamar, ela apareceu com os mesmos pacotes para mim. No geral, vale a estadia pelo quarto, pela comida e pela praia!

reviews.author: kprice84
reviews.title: Simply the Best!!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here  March 16-21,2014.  It was absolutely fabulous!!  We purchased the Royal package and truly were treated as royalty.  Elvis, our butler, went above and beyond to make out stay completely effortless from making our dinner reservations to shining my husbands shoes.  If he wasn't availabke , someone was and they did the same.  Carlos, the head butler, was great.  Always making rounds to check on guests and so easy to talk to.  All of the staff were amazingly polite and courteous and eager to please.  The drinks were amazing!!!  I recommend the Bananamama all day long!!!  Our rooms were cleaned everyday and beds turned down each night.  Scented pillows and comfortable beds made for great nights. The food was plentiful, and for the most part, delicious.  We did not get to eat at all of the restaurants but Naos was one that visited every morning for the buffet breakfast.  Yum!!!  The beach staff were amazing and so hard working.  We never had to find our own spot and drinks were brought to us. Thank you Maurice!!! Entertainment was never ending.  Big Mac was incredible from his dancing to his water bicycle exercise classes.  His energy level was through the roof!!  The resort was absolutely gorgeous and I hope that we are able to return sooner rather than later.

reviews.author: Sheila3322
reviews.title: Gorgeous beach and spa like room
reviews.text:
Had a great time!  Beach was absolutely beautiful, room was very peaceful and almost like a spa.  We stayed in Royal Sevice junior suite that had jacuzzi and private balcony.  Only downside was no view of beach and had to look onto street between two resorts.  The grounds were very well maintained and again the garden view was quite peaceful ( just usually like to view ocean from balcony or terrace).
Leonardo at pool bar was excellent and I loved how he always had a smile!  
Our butler was decent, meaning some days he seemed to do really nice things and other days he seemed to forget we were there?  Hearing from other couples who joined us and had different butlers, they all seemed to offer different levels of service.
I would have to agree that the restaurants were high quality, but the buffet or market grille needed some improvement!  I also feel that having some sort of lunch menu near the Royal Service beach/pool area would be an excellent addition.
I also questioned a few times whether the drinks really had any alcohol in them as it didn't seem there was much!?  (Top shelf, and definitely alcohol located in Royal Service lounge).
Overall, it was very relaxing, clean, and a great getaway.  Definitely a must if you are a beach person!!

reviews.author: Maryale68
reviews.title: Un sueño hecho realidad! La boda más bella del mundo!
reviews.text: Siempre soñamos encontrar el lugar perfecto para celebrar nuestra boda y que la playa de Punta cana fuera testigo de nuestro amor donde nos conocimos! Decidimos darle la confianza al equipo Romance de Paradisus Punta Cana para celebrar nuestro gran día y sólo puedemos decir Gracias! espectacular! único! una atención personalizada siempre acompañada de guía, tratando de complacer cualquier petición, dulce, al cuidado de todo detalle casi que como sí fuera la novia ese fue el servicio que recibimos de Beatriz Rosa  siempre coN una sonrisa y una paciencia la verdad doy gracias que tuvimos la suerte de contar con su ayuda! Apoyada por Miguelina que hasta coco compartió con la novia antojada jeje, nos ayudo mucho con algunas aprobaciones :) todas dando guía y consejos ante tantas preguntas de novios que viven fuera de ese lugar mágico Nunca olvidare el día en que entendí que nos casábamos cuando puso la canción con la cual entraríamos a esa bella playa me puse a llorar y José nervioso pero felices de tan espectacular música y mejor la de la salida! Agradecemos también a Jennifer por su supervisión consejos y paciencia! La verdad que la planificación organización atención durante el evento y cierre del mismo fue único superando nuestra expectativas y haciendo del día más importante de nuestras vidas y de nuestras familias algo mágico único inolvidable y lleno de cariño y buena vibra! Y estuvieron hasta el final... Mil gracias por las atenciones el apoyo ante la indecisión  ante la premura del tiempo y ante cualquier situación que impactó lo planeado! Extiendo el agradecimiento al hotel principalmente en el servicio The Reserve por tan alta distinción todo el mundo nos conocía en el hotel 5 días espectaculares donde José y yo y nuestros amigos y familias disfrutaron hasta el mínimo detalle! increíble .el apoyo de Beatriz en la reserva de los restaurantes, flexibilidad en todo! Miles gracias y también al equipo de reservas de The reserve que nos ayudaron mucho en solicitudes varias que hicimos sin lugar a duda lo recomendaríamos y volveremos a visitarlos pronto! Muchísimas gracias se despiden Maria Alejandra José y Paula Valentina :) ah y excelente el evento en la playa de fuego y música moderna que nos permitieron seguir celebrando luego de la recepción y hasta cumplir el último sueño bañarnos en la playa vestidos de novios lo máximo! Gracias besos miles! Se me olvidó agradecer a quien me consintió esa mañana en el spa servicios de manicura pedicura maquillaje y peinados únicos mil gracias

reviews.author: Karen A
reviews.title: Wonderful resort!
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort with amazing beach (white sands and turquoise water) as well as pools.  The rooms were lovely as well.  Juan de Leon was our butler for the time we were there and he did an exceptional job -- he was very responsive to our requests and attentive to what we might need. The spa was so serene and beautiful, with all the amenities -- had a great massage and spa pedicure. We had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: TomTimbrook
reviews.title: Best service!
reviews.text: Bertilo was the best drink maker!  We had so much fun! Everyone was so nice and took care of us!  We went on the Xtreme Buggy ride and it was amazing!  Don't be afraid to walk into town and buy from the locals, they are all so nice.  The only non friendly people we talked to worked in the main lobby gift shop.

reviews.author: Mary S
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: We had 23 members of our family in The Reserve.  With 23 people to coordinate, the family concierge concept was very valuable to us.  Jeuri was our family concierge and he was wonderful.  This is our second visit to this beautiful resort, and i expect that we will go back.

reviews.author: Ahart123
reviews.title: Beautiful and great service
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Punta Cana is just the right spot for those who are looking for a beautiful place to relax and to receive great service.   The privacy of the Reserve allowed us to relax without a huge crowd around.  The various concierge services were well done and professionally friendly.  The Reserve is set back away from the ocean but it was only a 7 minute walk to the private beach and there are plenty of golf carts running back and forth.   It is also well populated with umbrellas and cabanas to allow you to sit at the beach but escape the mid day sun.   
The choice of restaurants is nice and we found something we liked in each one.   You are able to eat at the beach or further away from the shore depending on your preference.   
Although they allow smoking in open areas around the entire resort, you are able to move away pretty easily. 
We are adults in our fifties and we travelled with two teenage girls who also enjoyed themselves.  There were plenty of people of all ages at the main resort as well as at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Joanne C
reviews.title: Yearly Travelers
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort 3/22-3/29/2014.  The resort is awesome!  I was so impressed as to how they were constantly cleaning everywhere.  Especially with clorox!  Wanted to send a special thanks to Ronny Frazor and Jonathan (last name??) for breakfast room service everyday!  When asked for coffee wih Baileys they always performed for us.  Thanks again!  Any one reading this should seriously consider this resort.  I did hear, however, that down the road from this resort is a bit more top notch from another traveler that we met.  I just can't recall the name of it.  But it was just down the road south of this resort.  You might want to look into it.

reviews.author: Sygraham
reviews.title: Friends 50th Birthday
reviews.text:
This was a great vacation and birthday celebration.  The resort amazing, the rooms were extra large. The service was great, our concierge was Mr. A.C. he was great.  Also, Omar Hernandez assisted me int he business center very help. 

I would highly recommend this resort and yes, I will be going back.

reviews.author: Gigi V
reviews.title: Best vacation spot!
reviews.text: My husband and I went to this resort with our 16 and 8 year old. It was so clean and the staff went above and beyond. I would definitely recommend this resort. The day care in the resort were so great with the children. The food was fabulous. The entertainment was exciting.

reviews.author: Sherryann S
reviews.title: Business visit and i did not know until i got there not good
