reviews.text: We had the opportunity of visiting this resort was good the food was good we were invited to see the hotel we thought that was cool so we went only to find out they were trying to get us to buy shares that was not cool I wasted half of my first day hearing about shares when I could have spent it relaxing my problem was them not telling me the truth don't lie don't go around the bush let me choose because if I knew this was about shares I would not have gone.

reviews.author: Caroline M
reviews.title: Outstanding on all levels!
reviews.text:
My husband and I visited The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana from February 1st - February 8th 2014.  This was our first experience of an all inclusive resort, and it certainly won't be our last, we will absolutely return to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana!  
The service we experienced was second to none, there are a few names I would like to mention - Luis Amparo, Candida Pacheco, Santos, Señor Ramon & Melvin at the Grill, our concierge Jennifer (Yennifer :-)), Alvin Martinez & Juan at the pool bar, the guys at the tennis courts (sorry for not remembering names!) - to name but a few!  Everyone we encountered was courteous, friendly and extremely helpful!
Not only was the service exemplary, but the gardens, beaches, pool & all common areas were stunningly beautiful, spotlessly clean and there was always somewhere comfortable to sit, lie down or chill out and enjoy a tasty beverage!  Having worked many years in the Food & Beverage industry I was extremely impressed at the selection and quality of the food and drinks - you will not go hungry or thirsty!!
All in all our trip was amazing and we cannot wait to go back and revisit the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and all it has to offer...

reviews.author: dan p
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
the trip was everything and more that we expected.  `We appreciate the service that Angelo Mercedes gave to us,  `he went over and above the call to make sure our trip was excellent.
RS ~Bar Leo the bartender was most enjoyable and friendly.

reviews.author: Liam_Neeson2014
reviews.title: Very Impressive
reviews.text:
My family stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus. We were impressed by the great food, service, incredible beach and general atmosphere of the place.

The people there made us all feel very welcome, happy, safe and went above and beyond to make the vacation the best.

All of the staff were truly brilliant, and special mention must go to:

Hazael Reyez for his very welcoming attitude, and making us all laugh!

Antony Cid ( Gabi Club) great service and for remembering every morning how we took our cappuccinos :)

We would definitely return on our next vacation!

reviews.author: alyssa6138
reviews.title: Best weekend!
reviews.text: The rooms were amazing and the hotel is absolutely beautiful! The friends I made on my trip and all the friendly employees made it a weekend I'll never forget. Francisco, Angel, and especially Eduardo were truly among the best people I met all weekend. They each are so fun and full of energy. I was heartbroken when I had to leave and I still think about being back, even to this day. Can't wait until the day I can visit again!!

reviews.author: Isaac C
reviews.title: Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: The service is excellent at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana, everyone is friendly and tries to help with anything you might need. My concierge Anabel Gonzalez was very helpful from the first day I came, she was able to make reservations and point out activities I would like. She was always ready to help with any requests. Also housekeeping is excellent they come several times a day to clean the room and check that everything is nice. The entertainment staff is also friendly and helpful and the bartenders are always happy to make drinks. The Reserve is nicer than the Paradisus Punta Cana because it is quieter and there is less competition for the pool areas and beach.

reviews.author: A H
reviews.title: Wonderful Place, Great Service, relaxing atmosphere
reviews.text:
This is a great resort for families. Multiple swim choices with nice beaches and great swimming pools. You enjoy their food and drinks. Do not miss going to the Gabi Restaurant and try a special drink, Paradiso Del Sol, from the bartender Victor Feliz. One of the best beach drinks from a great bartender and his colleague Juan Carlo.
The place is great, especially for families. Restaurant and buffet options are all first class. Service is very nice, with most people greeting you with a smile. Certainly a place to go back....

reviews.author: Adrical
reviews.title: Excelente Reveillon!!!
reviews.text:
Hotel muito confortável, comida excelente com varias opções de restaurantes o que faz toda a diferença na estadia de uma semana. O Hotel e pê na areia o mar super calmo e com uma linda cor verde azulado. O Atendimento dos garçons na praia e piscina e muito bom o que torna suas ferias ainda melhor. Na entrada do hotel fica o Shopping com alguns itens interessante, porem muito caro.
Passei o Reveillon com minha família nesse lindo resort e amamos, foi sensacional!!!

reviews.author: javeria s
reviews.title: Paper thin walls!!!
reviews.text:
Hi 
This is out first time to the reserve at Paradisus. The resort itself is very beautiful and has lot to offer. 
I am here with my 19 month old who can not sleep due to constant noise from ouside.I can hear my neighbours talking and even moving around. Yes its that bad!. This is not fun. Despite all the luxury the noise level is too high to relax. 
I complained about this at the front desk and the girl just said oh im sorry. Thi is getting unbearable as my toddler is cranky all the time because she cant sleep properly. 
Please keep this thing in mind when booking this resort. Beside this we have no complains

reviews.author: NICHOLE R
reviews.title: Romantic Getaway
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay - we had the royal service - with Alvaro Fernandez - the most amazing time.  Everyone we encountered was so welcoming from the moment we arrived Ricardo Canela assisted us with our bags to the room and made a great first impression of the resort.  My husband and I were treated like royalty the entire stay from the help down by the beach with Super Billy and Francisco Gil and service we received at the pool everything was top notch.  We are planning a return next year for sure.

reviews.author: PCMarkieRI
reviews.title: Another Awesome Stay at Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve
reviews.text:
This is our 4th visit to the Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve.  The beach is amazing and the service is excellent.  Maiker Ramirez at the Reserve Beach always takes great care of us.  His service supersedes all of the service received there.  Great attitude, hard worker and he is a tremendous asset to the Paradisus.  Thanks Mikey!!!
Tori & Mark

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: En la linea de Paradisus, con algun pero...
reviews.text:
Actualmente estamos en Paradisus Palma Real, y como todos los Paradisus, la calidad de comida, bebidas y demas, excelente. Aunque el Sabado cuando llegamos se declaro un incendio que desgraciadamente acabo con el NAOS y con el MOLE, el hotel ha hecho un esfuerzo grande, y su ausencia no se esta notando demasiado.

No obstante, tras haber estado previamente en Paradisus Varadero, y sobre todo Paradisus La Perla, en este hotel de la misma linea, algunas cosillas andan mas flojas. No las escribire aqui, ya que son detalles, y no quiero que nada ensombrezca el pedazo de hotel que es, y la atencion esquisita de gente como Franklin (nuestro conciernge), o Ramon Fuego (en el swim bar).

Nos quedan 4 dias aqui, y espero que los detallitos se vayan arreglando paulativamente, aunque como digo, si tuviera que volver a Punta Cana, seguiria eligiendo este hotel.

David C.

reviews.author: Ken W
reviews.title: Outstanding in all dimensions
reviews.text:
Our family (8 of us, ranging in age from 20 months to 68 years) stayed at the Reserve March 1-8, 2014. We have enjoyed many all-inclusives throughout the Caribbean. None has come close to the Reserve in so many dimensions. 

That starts with the beach, the most perfect one I have experienced. Gorgeous white sand both on the beach and in the water, for miles in both directions. We never saw any shells or rocks! The waves were terrific and we were fortunate not to experience any serious undertoe. And the service on the beach was exceptional. At other all-inclusives, you're lucky if a staff member roaming the beach stops to ask if you want a drink once or twice a day. At Paradisus Punta Cana, we rarely waited for long (and we could simply go up to the many bars to request drinks). Jose, who worked on the Reserve's beach area as well as at the pool, was especially fun and friendly. He's got a personality that will take him far. PS - The drinks did not seem to be watered-down as we have encountered elsewhere (or at least not as much). I should note, as well, that the Reserve's beach area and its pool area were never crowded. Unlikely virtually all other resorts we've gone to, you didn't need to get up at 7 a.m. to go claim chaise lounges with books and towels. Nice chaises, with cabanas providing shade, weren't hard to find.

The facilities are outstanding. The reserve is somewhat newer than the main complex and is designed with families with children in mind (although we met several couples w/o kids there). The Reserve has its own very nice pool, but also has a great kids pool that our 2 granddaughters loved. The Kids Club is fabulous - great activities that our 4 year-old enjoyed with great staff (which, as I will note below, was true throughout). The suites have an apartment feel to them - nice-sized living room with kitchenette; very spacious balcony; bedroom (not much larger than the king bed but with a nice feel to it); walk-through room with large tub for 2 (or more) on one side, closets on the other; bathroom with 2 sinks and nice shower. However, the one negative about our experience concerned the tight squeezes between parts of the suite, with doors opening in seemingly odd directions, and doors set up in a manner that was dangerous for our 2 grandkids; too easy for them to get fingers and toes caught in doors, as happened twice. Still, all-in-all, very comfortable accommodations. (The management needs to do something about the incredibly loud slamming doors to the rooms!)

Perhaps the most unique and best part of the accommodations experience was the concierges. We did not sign up for the personal concierges, but given the service we received from the concierges in our building, we felt like we had one. They were off-the-charts terrific, doing all kinds of fun things for our grandkids (filling the room with balloons, making balloon animals for them, bringing them treats, etc., etc.).While they were all great, Nicia Cortorreal stood out as especially attentive and friendly. She exemplified the warm, thoughtful, conscientious service that we encountered throughout the Reserve. She seemed to "take" to our family, perhaps enchanted with our 2 girls (and they with her), and her kindnesses - and her smiles - added immeasurably to a fantastic trip.

The resort offers many restaurants, with the Reserve having its own very nice, very spacious (rarely full) buffet restaurant. We ate dinner at 3 (4?) of the other restaurants and particularly enjoyed Aqua, in part for its excellent Italian cuisine and also very much for its structure: we had a "room" to ourselves, walking over some water to a covered outdoor area with a large table that accommodated just our family. It was perfect given that we had two young children in tow. Mostly, though, we preferred our own (Reserve) restaurant for the convenience of the (incredibly ample) buffet. On occasion we were wowed by the quality of the food. At most other times it was just what one would expect from such a resort.

If you like to gamble a bit, as I do, you'll find a small casino at the resort. It wasn't much - and it was a bit seedy, inconsistent with the rest of the place - but I had fun playing poker there several nights (at the one poker table at which perhaps half of the dealers understood their job). We didn't utilize other facilities and activities much, such as the shows at night.

The one aspect of the resort that we didn't like before arriving, but got used to while there, was tipping. It's not included in the package. We tipped waiters each night, as we did maids each day; we gave the staff at the pool or on the beach an occasional tip (a few each day); we gave our concierge a nice tip at the end of the trip. Its certainly possible that our tipping increased the quality (and frequency) of the service we received. But I'm not convinced of that. Nicia, for example, had no idea whether she'd receive a tip from us until the very end of the trip. Yet her smiles, her extra efforts, her genuine warmth greeted us several times a day. 

Having experienced a dozen or more similar resorts over the years, I have never seen such consistently friendly and solicitous staff. Management must be doing something right. Either that or, perhaps, Dominicans are an especially friendly people. Either way, they contributed a lot to a great trip.

reviews.author: gmmccool56
reviews.title: Awesome vacation and resort
reviews.text:
Everything was top of notch.  Beautiful resort, accommodations and service!!  It actually met or exceeded everything I read in reviews.

Gloria and Luis at the swim up bar were unreliable. Friendly and very attentive. Nector ( Vector?) at the sky bar was wonderful also.  There was another mail bartender there, also great. Just never caught his name.
We made friends with other quests and met with them a few evenings..
the only issue was making reservations to eat at the ala carte restaurants.  We tried several times to call the reservation number and never were able to get through.  Went to Front desk and they also tried, no luck.

My husband went to the Mole restaurant and made reservations in person. When we went the next evening, they had no record of our reservation and would not accommodate us.

So we just ate where we all the other nights, the buffet. And it was Lobster night, so not a huge loss.

I loved the quality of the food and the chefs, all the fresh grilled vegetables. No matter what your tastes, diet, vegetarian, etc, there was something for everyone. Outstanding cuisine.

Hope to go back again in 2 years and bring my adult children..

I can not say enough about how the staff aimed to  please.

Also enjoyed the aqua exercise classes everyday and the Zumba
Must go there!!

reviews.author: patmom14
reviews.title: beautiful resort
reviews.text: everywhere you look there is something lovely to see.  Fountains, statues, flowers, paintings. The evening lighting was exceptionally beautiful. The service, especially the room service was excellent.  The pools and spa were wonderful. Entertainment and music was great.  The room was lovely.  Only one problem.  Sea grass on the white beach and in the water.

reviews.author: Teambibi
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: This was my first visit to an all inclusive resort. Upon arrival, we found our room smelled of cigarettes and the front desk staff immediately changed our room. Was pleased to see that our luggage had been transferred and it was a very nice room. The grounds, pool area and beach were beautiful; however, the food was not so great.  What made my stay memorable was the staff. Everyone went out of their way to be accommodating and were very friendly. Ramon Fuego at the pool bar was very entertaining and made the best drinks.   On our last night, after a company banquet, there was a fire in one of the restaurants, caused by fireworks from a wedding. Although there was no alarm, the staff tried to get everyone off the property as quickly and safely as possible. Our rooms were not affected by the fire; however some of our friends had to have their rooms moved due to smoke damage.  Next day, it was business as usual.

reviews.author: Catherine A
reviews.title: amazing!!!
reviews.text: Best trip I've ever been on. Not only was the resort beautiful but the staff made it worthwhile. So genuinely nice and made you feel like royalty. They made the trip amazing! Shout out to victor, Andy, and wily. Highly highly recommend. Miss it and can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: paradisesxm
reviews.title: BEWARE! THEY'RE MONEY HUNGRY!!
reviews.text: This experience was surprisingly disappointing considering the money spent. As soon as we got there, they wanted to be paid immediately and pushed for it (i was told we could pay on the last day). On top of paying thousands in cash, we got charged 575 on our credit card without being advised of it when we were made to provide it for incidentals, so I demanded to be refunded. It took a week to get the money back. This all happened first day, 2nd day, we were told to go to a breakfast buffet at Gaby's Place and was taken there when later to find we were going to be pitched a presentation. We were "told" what to check off on the questionnaire and sat down before eating breakfast when we were starving. The presentation was supposed to be 90 mins, turned into FOUR hours, and we had our two yr old with us who never spent time with anyone but his parents. All of us were held hostage for 4 grewling hours when later to find out the Mgr of "MELIA" only cares about how much money you have, NOT your needs. Our concierge Luisa was wonderful but she scheduled many activities in advance and didn't tell us until the day of which was a slight inconvenience so we had to cancel many reservations. Do not get your nails done, the polish will chip off the next day, the food was terrible, i got food poisoning on the first night, don't eat at the dominican buffet. The best thing was the massage on the beach! We will not return again, this was a waste of 4500.00 for 5 days!

reviews.author: JenniferGigi
reviews.title: Our first family vacation was great!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just took our 22 month old son to The Reserve for a 5 day stay. I agree with most of the previous reviews- the property is beautiful, the staff is very attentive and friendly, the food was great for an all-inclusive, and the beaches are gorgeous.  The only problems I had were with the front desk staff and our room.Upon arriving, we had to wait quite a while for someone to come and check us in. The front desk staff was not very welcoming and friendly. The other problem we had with that staff was they were constantly stopping us or calling our room to meet with them for "a presentation"- wanting to sell a timeshare. We just kept declining them.
Our room was right next to the pool/lobby and the first night we were there, a man playing the electric guitar was so loud, it felt like he was in the room with us.  After that ended around 10PM, the Gabi Club restaurant/bar started playing loud music that ended somewhere around 2AM. I didn't sleep very well that night! However, the next nights the music was not as loud so, with ear plugs, I couldn't hear it as much. Also, all of the doors in the hotel slam very loudly and it echoes, so you can hear people coming and going all day/night. Bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper like me. My son's crib was metal and too small, so he ended up not using it and slept with us in the bed. 

The Reserve section is pretty far from the beach, especially when we have a young son and was too hot to walk back and forth with him. Luckily, the shuttles come by often enough to take us there. 

Those were minor annoyances. The best part of the trip was the treatment from the staff. They always smiled, said hello, and got whatever was needed. Our son loved The Kids Zone- shout out to Kiwy- my son enjoyed playing with her! Our family concierge, Luisa, was the best! She was always available to us and reserved our beach chairs, restaurant times, even booked our transfer for our trip back to the airport! Each night, she came by with champagne, wine, sushi, etc. We were treated like royalty!  I also want to thank Antony Cid who served us at Gabi Club. He made us smile and was always in a good mood. The servers who work at the Reserve Beach were awesome as well. Overall, we had a great stay and would return.

reviews.author: lindas l
reviews.title: Lo mejor!
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, la mejor atención. Definitivamente es lo mejor que he visitado de Punta Cana y del caribe. Viaje con 10 personas, en familia y la pase excelente es la segunda vez que voy. Volveré pronto. la comida es divina, la gente es súper amable se preocupan por hacerte pasar unos días de diversión y relax maravillosos. Visitenlos porque no se arrepentiran

reviews.author: LaineyB10
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
After a ropey start, we had a fabulous vacation.  We booked through Delta Vacations.  We arrived at the Palma Real on a Sunday evening and were told we had private check in and were taken to the Reserve.  The Reserve had no knowledge of our booking and after a number of phone calls suggested we were booked into the Punta Cana resort 5 miles away.  However they did not have any booking for us either and we were then sent back to the Palma Real.  Our travel documents confirmed our reservation at the Palma Real but the reception staff said they could not accept these documents and would need to contact Delta Vacations in the morning.  After an hour and a half, they offered us temporary accommodation which we had to pay for and were told it would be refunded in the morning once they had confirmed our reservation.  We were told the rooms were one room apart - instead they were two blocks apart.  It was now 11.30 pm at night and we decided to take the rooms.  When we returned to reception in the morning, they had no notes of our discussions the night before and we started all over again.  They told us to come back after breakfast.  This we did and there was still no resolution in sight.  At the stage one of the concierges - Garnier - stepped in and helped us.  They had found our reservation and we would be moved to the right accommodation that afternoon and our temporary accommodation would be refunded - we are still awaiting that refund but I understand it can take 4-6 weeks!!!!  This was supposed to be a relaxing short break and we feel we lost the first day of our break. The reception staff and other staff we spoke to were not at all sympathetic to our situation - it appeared to be our fault for booking  through a travel agent and not directly with the hotel - they just shrugged their shoulders and told us this happens all the time.  Be warned!!

Garnier became our concierge for the week and did a brilliant job and did his best to make up for the awful start to our vacation.  He dealt with all our restaurant reservations.  The food was great - we particularly enjoyed the Market Grill and Vento.

The resort is beautiful and well kept and has one of the largest swimming pools.  Most staff are extremely helpful.  Special shout outs to some of the bar staff who go above and beyond - Ramon at the Pool Bar did a brilliant job at making everyone feel special  -  Robert and Lorenzo at the Avenue Bar - who are entertainment in themselves as they mix cocktails - Freddie at the Sky Bar who always made it a special end to an evening.  Nelson at Club Melia was also brilliant.

We will definitely return but this time will book directly with the hotel.

reviews.author: SabaOnAnIsland
reviews.title: Best All-Inclusive - Luxury!
reviews.text:
I have been to many all-inclusive resorts and visited most of the islands in the Caribbean. I consider myself a foodie and definitely have high standards for decor, beaches, and food. So, I was very pleasantly surprised by this hotel. We chose the family concierge program and it was awesome. We stayed at the Reserve section of the Punta Cana resort.

My husband, myself and my 2.5 year old son stayed in a junior suite. The suite was large and very tastefully decorated. There were 2 separate rooms and a large bathroom with a separate room for the toilet, the tub and the shower.  The balcony faced the pool. The room was clean and comfortable. There was free wifi in the rooms and main areas. The signal in the rooms was not so consistent, but it was great in the lobby and by the pool.

The family concierge program was a huge plus. We were assigned a concierge to help us with all of our reservations and questions. Our concierge, Leidy, we super sweet and on top of her job. My son absolutely loved her. She helped us arrange child care, dinner and activity reservations. She arranged a cabana for us at the beach or pool.  They provide you with a free cell phone which is a huge plus, especially if you are a nervous parent and want to make sure you can always be reached when you leave your child with a babysitter. We had the same babysitter come for 3 nights so we could enjoy a nice dinner alone after our son went to bed. Our babysitter was named Diosmary and was also very very kind and gentle. I would 100% request both Leidy and Diosmary if we ever visited again. Overall, the hotel was very family friendly. I think about 50% of the guests had kids with them at the reserve. There were more young couples and singles at the main part of the resort.

The food. The food was amazing! Like I said, I am a bit of a food snob. At the reserve, the food was better than at the main section of the hotel. At the buffet, they had things like fresh grilled calamari, steaks, ceviches, shrimp, pork mignon, you name it. The salads, fruits, and desserts were all fresh and delicious. My least favorite meal was probably at the Mediterranean restaurant. It wasn't very mediterranean first of all. The presentation of the food was great but not too tasty. I also thought the Japanese restaurant was just OK. It was a Japanese Hibachi style place where they cook in front of you. The buffets for breakfast were the highlight of the trip food-wise. It was great because everyone, including my 2 year old, could find plenty of options. They even had 6-7 different fresh fruit smoothies every morning. There was also a poolside grill that offered personal pizzas, burgers, salads and fish. It is simple food but pretty good. I loved that they also had a "green" smoothie that you could have all day at the hotel, between your pina colada's and Brugal (to feel a bit healthier :)).

Activities. There was a selection of activities at the hotel, but I must admit that we didn't participate. We basically went to the beach, went to the pool, and ate. We were only there for 3 nights so the time was short. But they did have snorkeling, pool aerobics, dance and spinning (in the water!). I also saw rock climbing and a mini bungee jumping area. You could rent bikes and go all around the resort. There was a tram to take you around that came about every 10 minutes. We saw a show one night that was mostly dancing or something like Stomp. The massage that I had at the spa was one of the best I have ever had! Also, there was a nice steam room, mini pool and sauna at the spa. The casino was the weakest point of the hotel. You cannot really call it a casino. It was a small room with a few slots and tables. One night I went and there was only one other person playing blackjack. The tables are $10 minimum.

The beach- There are different sections of the beach for different parts of the hotel. At the reserve's section, they had free sunscreen, tan lotion and bug spray. There was a bunch of buckets and kids toys for the kids to borrow. There were flotation devices for the kids too. A waiter came by every so often for drink orders. You could not order food on the beach. We really loved the location of the beach and the service, chairs and cabanas. The waves at the beach were extremely rough! I am a good swimmer but I would not venture out too far because of the strong current and random huge waves. This was not a rocky beach. You could go barefoot and not step on any sharp rocks. Many of the caribbean islands have extremely rocky beaches and you need to wear foot protection so that was nice.

All in all, between the gorgeous sandy beach, the beautiful pool, great service and wonderful food, I give this hotel a strong 5 stars. Normally I never want to go to the same place twice, but I would actually want to go back here again.

reviews.author: Maria Conchita A
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text:
I loves staying here, the service was amazing and it was a very positive experience.
      I loves staying here, the service was amazing and it was a very positive experience. Would highly recommend it to all.

reviews.author: jlrvs
reviews.title: Amazing place, beautiful beach, helpful/friendly staff-such a fun trip!!
reviews.text:
This was our first time to Punta Cana, and I didn't really do much research.  Found a great deal at Paradisus and we went for it.  SO GLAD - Paradisus was the best resort we saw down there!  Very classy looking, the beaches and pools were gorgeous and the staff could not have been nicer!  It might have been the best 5 days we've had together…just so relaxing and easy!
So I'll ry to keep this short, but SO much to say.  
First, we upgraded to the "Royal Service" package a few days before.  SUCH a great package.  You get better rooms, (closer to beach) a butler for your stay, private pool with private bar (top shelf liquor) and the prettiest beach on the resort.  Private indoor lounge with wine, liquor, newspapers, and Macs.  You even get to eat at more private locations for breakfast and lunch…which is nice!  It is only about $30-40 more per night and SO SO worth it!  
Let me explain the "butler" - we had Johnfi.  He was amazing - so helpful, so smart (speaks several languages) and really took care of us.  He showed us around the resort, made all of our dinner reservations, and even drove my husband to a local store to buy camera equipment!  But the best part was when we came back from a boat trip to find our tub filled with bubbles, with our initials in rose petals, and champagne and candles!  (he thought we would need to "relax" after snorkeling!)  It was so cool and thoughtful!  
Bottom line - the butler service is great b/c they handle a lot for you and there really is a language barrier sometimes!  Aside from the fact that you are in the quieter pool with "Bali beds" on the beach - great for shade or sun.  
The actual resort is gorgeous - very clean, beautiful and amazing.  The pools are huge, the staff is just so friendly and there is SO much space!  There are 8 or more restaurants, and they are all different (Asian, Mexican, Italian, etc.)  Some are casual and some are dressier, which is fine.  Every night there was something fun going on in the main courtyard - live music, live shows, local art shows, etc.  We were never bored!  One night we even slept out at the pool under the stars - they brought us pillows and blankets and it was amazing!
If I had to complain, I will tell you this:  while the Royal Service has all upgraded liquors (Absolut, Johnnie Walker, etc) the wine selection is truly awful.  So if you order wine by the glass or bottle, the only one that is "included" is just not drinkable.  (and I am not a wine snob).  So at dinner, we would "upgrade" and pay for something we chose.  But I just feel that for a resort of this caliber, the wine should be better.
My only other complaint is that the food was good, sometimes even great, but just not memorable.  So there are plenty of choices, it all looked fresh and well-presented, but something was just lacking.  I think I am spoiled b/c I know a lot of chefs?  But really, the food was good and there was SO much to choose from.  The buffets were always neatly presented and freshly prepared, so that was fine.  There is even a "take-away" stand where you can just grab something quick and take it to the beach.  Room Service was a great breakfast option too.
We walked up and down the beaches and clearly this resort has the largest and nicest beach.  It is fairly quiet (no local salespeople bother you) and very very clean.  (Some other resorts were cramped, lots of loud music/people, etc.)
I highly recommend this resort, and if we go back, I would do Royal Service again and beg for Johnfi.  What a great guy!  The only reason it doesn't get a 5 from me is the wine and food issues.  But to be honest - I got over it really quickly b/c the weather and resort was so amazing!!!

reviews.author: Aleksandra
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
We just returns from 7 days trip to Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.  Amazon location on the one of the most beautiful beaches I have seen. Lots of palms and trees. At the beach you will have great chairs/beds available if you are staying at The Reserve. Really nice to walk to the beach, especially taking walk on Eco since they have musi coming out from hidden speakers and great landscaping. There is a lot of activities even spinning bikes in the pool. They also had shou every night and some kids entertainment.  
Rooms are nice but beds were not 5 stars for sure. I think they should invest more in pillows. Well if you get neck pain, you can visit Yhi spa which is great and they have specials every day. I had package with massage, facial and exfoliation and everything was great with Aribinda. Price was ok too.  
Food is decent for all inclusive resort. Not everything was perfect but there were so many choices. We got reservations from our concierge and went to a different restaurant every night. I liked Aqua the best. We did not go to those two restaurants that you have to pay extra. I liked magazines and books on the pool/beach area. Staff really nice except for couple guys at the bar.
We had problem with water in the room, there were no cold water and it was difficult to shower or brush teeth with hot water.  We complained 3 times before they came and changed the whole shower.  Water was little cooler in shower and sink but was still super hot in the toilet which is really odd.  Anyway, we got used to it an we really did not spent much time in room since we came from cold Chicago. Overall, my family enjoyed vacation and hotel and would probably go there again.

reviews.author: J27smith
reviews.title: The Reserve lo mejor
reviews.text: Es la primera vez que utilizamos nuestra membresia y la verdad que ya tenemos deseos de volver. Atenciones de primera y una voluntad única de servir. Diosmery, Asia, Anuvis, Dhoralix, Emilio, Santo, Ramón, José Luis, Maiker, Melvin, José, Lenin y por supuesto Silvio quien se encargó de la bonita sorpresa de cumpleaños de mi hija. Todos son excelente.

reviews.author: gillac
reviews.title: Best vacations ever!
reviews.text: For our second experience at the Paradisius Palma Real, two years in a row, we were once again, very very satisfied! From our butler, Luis Martinez that we highly recommend, also Stephania Auguste, the exceptional receptionist at the Palazzo (the restaurant is not the same when she is not there, including Richard Otis and the chef Rafael Nunes who made a difference. And our two friends from the beach Francisco Cabrera and Pedro. Facilities very well maintained, Personnel always eager to serve you well and make your stay as best as possible, food is absolutely over average and everybody  wants to satisfy your desires. Definitely the best place for your vacations and we will be back again next year. Ask for the personnel mentioned above, It is well worth it! Enjoy your own vacation as much as we did!

reviews.author: Dave P
reviews.title: We'll be back someday, Katherine and Dave
reviews.text:
This being our second consectitive trip to Paridisus, My girlfriend and i stayed at the reserve this year. Being here before, we had met people(who work there) that we had added to facebook the previous year. So we knew our greeting would be plesent. We arrived early and are room was not availible at that point. So we went to the reserve bar for drinks, and immediately ran into a friendly face from last year Lenin. He, along with Rodorfo, would be are bar tenders at the reserve all week, mostly during the day time. Yael and danny were our evening bar tenders and all were extremely pleasent and easy to understand. Plus they make some great drinks ( We suggest the strawberry mango daquirys) We brought large plastic travellers cups so we could enjoy a drink for an extended period of time by/in the pool without having to go back frequently to get another drink. When are room was ready, we were pleased with room, even though there where lots of doors that were a little confusing the first couple nights. ( prob because I had quite a few drinks the first couple nights LOL). After we were settled in, I went to down the beach to meet with Chinel, who is the man responsible of setting up some the great excursions you can enjoy. I was excited to see him, as his english is good, and we have been friends on facebook since last year. At that time, I recived information for the Catermeran, and we made plans to go for drinks with him later that evening. I also stopped by to say hi to Yves at the main lobby, he was our concierge from last year a big part of why we returned to paridisus. As for food, I was easy to please with an omelette bar and bacon, great service and good coffee. The buffet's were also good and was extremely happy with the hydo grill. The food was excellent and the service was top notch. Thanks again to valetin and Jose and the cook( can't remeber his name but really could cook!) I ate at the hydro grill every afternoon! We had a la carte 5 evenings, at 5 seperate restaurants, and even though i am a picky eater, i ate well and again the service was great. Occasionally, i would stop for some grey goose shots with carmen, thanks again. One evening, we even asked about getting our jacuzzi tub in our room done for a romantic evening, and one melia's own Yenifer, and back from being off the night set up champagne, rose peddles and candles. Get get much better than that! Our maid Anus would often leave us very pretty towel designs with flowers, and left our room spotless everday. We went for the sea aquarium catamaren, after some confusion, made it to the boat and really good time.At the front door Enrique was very helpful. Thanx to everyone that made our trip as wonderful as it was. I am sure a missed a few( Blanka was super polite all week) but we will be back some day.

Thanks again Dave 

Stayed April 2014

reviews.author: ArielTarantino
reviews.title: Best all inclusive resort we've stayed at so far
reviews.text: This is a beautiful property.  It is very clean and well-maintained.  I am not a fan of all-inclusive resorts but this ranks the best of the ones we have been to in the past.  We were traveling with three teenagers on spring break.  This was not a senior class spring break nor would it be a good choice for one as it is more couples or family friendly and from experience would not cater to or tolerate what goes on with a senior class group.  There was a moderate amount of young children and handful of other teens.  Our boys met some nice girls from a top ranked prep school with names such as Dahlia and Claire who plan to attend colleges such as Princeton and Yale.  We didn't opt for the Royal Service nor did we stay in the Reserve for first go-around here.  I don't feel like we missed out really but would have chosen such option if my husband and I were on a couples only trip.  However, the boys ended up in the Reserve and had a blast with the ivy league girls so they faired even better than we did.  The staff was so nice to our kids.  They had a blast.  I think what I've figured out with all-inclusives no matter where we go is that you just carry around wads of cash and spread it around all day long.  Make sure to hand $$ to the people who clean your room whenever you see them.  You just have to or they will stop doing the things they do on the first two days.  The main gardener of the property seemed to absolutely love his job.  He was at the top of a palm tree right outside our balcony trimming it and he took a coconut and cut off the top and stuck a straw in it and gave it to us.  Give him $$ too if this happens to you.  Every time I saw him he had a smile on his face.  If you hang at the pool bar during the day give them $5s & $10s to start the afternoon and then taper down here and there with single dollar bills.  It's necessary to keep them happy and you happy.  I ate a lot of healthy food.  It's not a gluttony fest.  Which is right up my alley.  The salad bar is not your typical salad bar.  I ate more beets that week that ever.  Beets, hearts of palm, mini bundles of greens wrapped with a carrot shaving...fresh fish grilled in front of you, eggs cooked whichever way you like, assortment of cheeses and breads, fresh salsa.  Be sure to go to the hibachi grill in the Reserve and try some of the more upscale restaurants.  Reservations are confusing.  You make them but they look at you like you don't have a reservation.  There was some confusion there but it wasn't too major of a deal.  We did get approached on the first day to have breakfast with one of the reps of the resort who checked us in upon arrival.  He asked so nicely so I agreed assuming there was possibly some catch but wanted to believe that he just wanted to give us more details of what to do during the week.  But it was about purchasing vacation club rights.  This was tempting and intriguing but we don't have time for that many weeks a year with other vacation ownership so we opted out.  I feel that this breakfast and tour and all that wasted about 3 hours total of our time during the week and caused a few members of the staff to hover and it was annoying.  Don't do it.  That kind of stuff makes me angry in the long run because that's not what you're there for.  If you like to drink alcohol, research it before you go.  There are top shelf liquors available if you book the right level.  We were booked in an upper tier but I felt like I was drinking watered down liquor all week.  I think I had less to drink here than any vacation because it tasted like empty calories of sugar and water.  I love the little Illy coffee kiosk past the Market Grille.  They make the best espresso, cappucino, iced coffee.  Truly the highlight of my day.  Beautiful beach.  The seaweed is not that bad.  I mean it's there but they maintain the beach so nice.  Lots and lots of major events go on at this resort from weddings to conventions and it doesn't seem to hinder the experience for the family vacationer.  It may even enhance it a bit.  The casino is not impressive.  I would avoid it.  Slot machines are a bother the way they are set up.  And if you are into the casino thing you would want to be at Hard Rock anyway which is 21 minutes away.  I used the fitness center a lot and I love how the lighting is in there and it is very cool, comfortable temperature with good music and media.  The equipment is sufficient and well-maintained.  The weather when we went was absolutely perfect.  Even days it said rain, it was for like 5 minutes and you'd probably miss it.  So if you go, bring lots of singles, 5s, 10s and use them every day to make your experience better.  Not really what you think you're signing up for but after experiencing a number of all-inclusives, it's the only thing that gets you through the week without frustration.  If you don't continue to take care of the staff, you will not be taken care of in a consistent manner.  They don't seem to want to be tipped when you are being transported back and forth to areas of the resort by golf cart.  Punta Cana is a lovely island.  It was our first time to the Dominican and I'm glad we chose Paradisus Palma Real.  Oh, and be sure to book private shuttle to and from airport.  Don't get on a bus.  Just speaking from experience.

reviews.author: CAD
reviews.title: Great Time!
reviews.text: A group of 29 were there last week for a wedding and the holiday was wonderful.  The resort was much larger that most that i've been to, but there was a shuttle running back and forth to the lobby, room and beach.  The service was quite good, especially Orlando Diaz (room services) at the Reserve.  He was very professional, well spoken and friendly.

reviews.author: Hector g
reviews.title: atencion

reviews.author: Brett B
reviews.title: Expensive but worth it
reviews.text: This is one of the best resorts we've ever stayed at. Great beaches, pools and doesn't seem that crowded due to the size of the resort. Food is above average. Rooms are very good. Will definitely come back here.

reviews.author: Torimcnally
reviews.title: Always a great stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve
reviews.text: This is our 4th stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve.  The room is alway very nice.  The beach is amazing and the staff always takes great care of us.  We love it and the staff always remembers us. Ramon Ramirez, Luis Sanrana & Oneida Zorrilla took such great care of us at the beach as they usually do with a friendly smile. A big thank you goes out to each one of them and they are huge assets to the Paradisus organization. Santos Frias was a great waiter up at Gabbi Reserve and at Vento.  He always made our morning.  We also really enjoyed Aqua for lunch and dinner and the Aqua staff was awesome. Thank you to all at the Paradisus for another great stay in our home away from home.

reviews.author: michael f
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego is fantastic
reviews.text: Great weather, incredible service by poolside bartender/entertainer Ramon Fuego.  Great place to relax.  Rooms were comfortable and fridge always stocked with water/coke/beer.  The only knock is the quality of food was not to our tastes, but it might just be us.  Other than that an excellent relaxing experience.

reviews.author: Jedinight37
reviews.title: Mind changed
reviews.text: All inclusive? DR? Resort? What does that actually mean? "Tourist trap" is the first thing that comes to mind.  Not at Palma real resort. Hospitality is only out done by the surroundings. Even on a half sunny/rainy day, plenty to do. Food is exceptional. Special mention to the pool side bar, bartenders!! Andy, Luis, gustabo, padu, florentine, and Ramon Diego, know how to help you enjoy you stay. Feeling welcome is an understatement, I watched Ramon head deliver a drink to a waiting lady. Good times. My wife and I will be back, as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Margaret W
reviews.title: mixed review
reviews.text: The property is lovely, and well-kept.  And the staff were extremely friendly.  But when we needed assistance with dinner reservations or other issues we were extremely frustrated with their ability to assist.

reviews.author: minnesotamom333
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana -- Family Concierge
reviews.text:
We just returned from our vacation to the Reserve.  We were there for 7 days and came back relaxed and rested.  We traveled with our 9 year old daughter and we all had a marvelous time.  Huge thanks to Ovidio in the Family Concierge for pulling out all the stops and making our experience amazing.  Wine and cheese delivered to our room, chocolate covered strawberries, cupcakes, and for my husband's upcoming birthday -- a cake and a bottle of champagne with the room decorated so nicely with balloons and a banner.  He took care of all of our dinner reservations and checked in with us frequently to make sure we were happy.  I would definitely recommend the Family Concierge upgrade to any family who wants a little something extra with their stay.  

Maria, our cleaning lady, made sure our room was very clean and did cute towel sculptures for our daughter.

Miky and Luis at the Family Concierge beach area were wonderful and always remembered our drink orders!  Thanks guys!

Melvin and Antony at the Gabi Club were wonderful servers and were always ready with a smile and a cup of coffee in the mornings.  

PROS:
*Beautiful room
*Gorgeous beach and water
*Nice pool
*The food was great (seriously).  We tried all the restaurants except Passion.  We never had a meal we were disappointed with.  We ate at Gabi in the mornings and Gabi beach for lunch.  The variety of the food and the freshness was better than expected.  My daughter never wanted to order off the kids menu, opting for the cod, sea bass, shrimp, and other delicious options.  For an all-inclusive I would say the food was better than expected.
*Everyone has a smile (except for the service at Mole restaurant was off -- they all seemed to be in a bad mood)
*The kids club staff was really nice (Kiwy!).  Unfortunately there weren't a ton of kids so my daughter was a bit disappointed by the lack of attendance at the events.  
*The Family Concierge beach palapas are phenomenal.  We were recovering from bronchitis and for the first couple days all we did was lie around and read.  It was heaven.
*The water is great for boogie boarding.  A little choppy but not too bad.  The water is the most beautiful clear turquoise.
* The grounds are absolutely stunning.  Water features, beautiful palms, manicured everything.  The resort is HUGE and we chose to walk a lot of the time because it's good exercise and so beautiful.  However, the trams area always running.
*The employees try really hard to accommodate everything, and their English is great.  We were laughing at the folks who complain that the workers should know better English.  It's a European company operating in a Spanish speaking country.  How about instead of complaining that they don't speak 100% fluently every language in the world, you learn a few Spanish phrases?  I loved being able to practice my high school spanish and found no issues with communication whatsoever.  

CONS (minor, really hard to complain):
*The walls are paper thin.  You can hear every noise, from inside and out.  There were lots of nights we could hear the entertainment from across the resort when we were trying to sleep.  If that doesn't suit you, bring earplugs or download a white noise app onto your device.
*The Euro Bungy broke and wasn't repaired quickly so the Adventure Park experience the last few days were kind of a bummer for our 9 year old.
*My husband got a minor case of stomach upset from something he ate or drank one night (I won't go into details).  My daughter and I took Pepto and a probiotic every day as a preventative measure (as recommended by our doctor) and we didn't have any trouble.  Husband opted not to.  We did the same in Mexico and I would highly recommend trying it.
*The vacation club people can be really persistent.  You just have to say no.

Overall, a fabulous vacation and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone!

reviews.author: Stefano Di Nardo
reviews.title: Un struttura come dice il nome  paradisiaca!!
reviews.text: Una vacanza lavoro stupenda !! 10 giorni trascorsi veramente stupendo!! Animazione - cucina- bar !! Tutto al top ! Simpatia !!! Amore per il proprio lavoro !! Questo fa del personale delle persone stupende !!!!  In particolare all'acqua bar ed i suoi barman il signore Ramon Fuego la signora Gloria Rodriguez veramente bravissimi!!! Voglio ringraziare il direttore Rafael Torres ! Per aver scelto questi lavoratori veramente speciali!! Grazie a loro ho dimenticato l'Italia ed i suoi problemi!!! Immensamente grazie a tutti dj Stefano di nardo !!

reviews.author: Ed D D
reviews.title: Awesome Punta Cana Vacation
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus Palma Real somewhat wary as we had never stayed in an all-inclusive resort before. The trip was a wonderful surprise in so many ways. The food/dining was exceptional! Every meal was excellent and the staff was friendly and attentive. Our personal concierge, Alvaro Castilllo(AC), was very helpful making sure that we had reservations for the dining of our choice, golf tee times and any help we needed to make the day more fun.
The beach was clean with lots of choices for lounges and staff was available to arrange snorkeling , kayaking,trips...you name it(and get you a drink!). Loved this trip!

reviews.author: Margaret L
reviews.title: Excellent time!
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this resort.  Everything was perfect and we had the best time.  The staff were so helpful and friendly.  Dany Romero, Lenin Moga, Oneida Lorilla, Angentica Reynoso, Jose Luis, De Los Santos, Miki Rafael, Popfirioashoo, Fabio Star, Ramon Ramirez, Roroif de Pena, Maria Valdez, Melvin Brizom, Ramon Simbert, Valentin Caminero, and Jose Reinoso all treated us like rock stars.  We can't wait to go back there.

reviews.author: ruts04
reviews.title: Amazing trip - thank you Bayron and Francisco Gil!
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently returned from our week long trip at Paradisus Palma Real. The hotel is absolutely gorgeous. We had such an amazing time and cannot wait to return! We exchanged our timeshare through RCI and upgraded to Royal Service which I would strongly recommend! 

Bayron and Francisco Gil made our trip and were both fantastic! Bayron helped to take care of all of our restaurant reservations, water sport activities and always managed to surprise us with something each day - fruit and cheese tray, etc. 

Francisco Gil always greeted us with a smile and made sure that we had the best cabana every morning. He was one of the hardest working and happiest employees at the resort. 

We will definitely be back! Thank you again Bayron and Francisco for making our trip perfect!

reviews.author: GuiltyPleasures08
reviews.title: Another Great stay
reviews.text: Great place, great staff, great beach. Not my first time to this resort but I really had a great time with their staff, shout out to Michelet and Estrella at the bar and my man GENIVEL! at the Gabi. I'd love to point out I lost my beautiful hat after a night of too much drinking and much to my surprise the honest staff safeguarded it for me personally and gave it back 3 days after when I finally remembered the small bar I ended up at. It's the personal small things/tips and insight (which ill keep t myself =p) that the staff went out of their way for me that made this particular trip more memorable.

reviews.author: Ali M
reviews.title: Was nice
reviews.text: Great staff. Couldnt have asked for a better staff. The reserve is definitely nicer than anywhere else and most accomodating. My girlfriend and i repeatedly were called by our first names and really felt like home.

reviews.author: Ellen K
reviews.title: I'm speechless .... well, maybe not!
reviews.text:
My high expectations were exceeded from the minute the Royal Service lounge bartender brought me a refreshing wash cloth and mimosas (yes, plural) during our private check-in.  We got a cloth envelope that had our paperwork and a cell phone to make it convenient ot get in touch with our Butler, Johnfi Rivera.  Our check-in person was Andrea.  She got our experience started off on the right foot.  I asked her to give us the best butler..... I'm fairly sure she did!

Johnfi took us on a tour and made us feel like family.  Each time he saw us, his face lit up and he referred to us as "Mi Familia"!  He somehow figured out what we would like, even if it was beyond our dreams.  One night, we were welcomed by a jacuzzi bubble bath with rose petals, floating candles, champagne in an ice bucket, and incense.  Niether of us requested that.  We wouldn't even dream of that.  So special.  Johnfi was our ambassador the whole time.  Any reservation we wanted was no problem for him.  He even negotiated a discount for us on our excursion.  He's friends with lots of people and leverages his relationships to make his "familia" feel like the most important guests in the resort.  Thank you Johnfi.  We can't wait to see you again.

Leo and Super Billy at the Royal Service pool bar created a relaxed party atmosphere every single time I walked near them.  I'm laughing just remembering them and how much they LOVE making drinks, even when you are just walking by.  Thank you Leo and Super Billy.

Just so you understand the level of service, I'll share just one quick story, but know that there are many stories like this from Paradisus Palma Real.  I was lounging/sleeping/reading in a Bali bed near one of the pools.  A gardener named Ceasar showed up with a coconut and a huge knife.  He started whacking on the coconut to level off the bottom and put an opening in the top.  Then, he ran off in all directions (RAN!) to get me a straw.  He handed me the coconut and straw and told me that coconut is good for the body and soul.  He shared that we all have the essence of love in us.  Yes, we sure do, Caesar.  He waved every time I saw him after that.  So sweet.  Oh, by the way, the coconut milk was delicious, warm from the sun, good for my soul.  Of course, I went to show off my "love coconut" to Leo at the pool bar.  He took that coconut and filled it with whatever happened to be in his blender at the moment.... also good for my soul!

Paradisus Palma Real was truly the experience of a lifetime.  The resort is breathtaking, but it's the people that are the heart of this destination.  I will never forget them.

reviews.author: Brian W
reviews.title: Best all inclusive in DR!
reviews.text:
2 employees stood out, but all were very friendly and helpful. Our concierge, AC was simply the best!
Big Mac was very entertaining at the pool and beach. Great host.
Better experience than all inclusives in Mexico. By far.

reviews.author: rmergent
reviews.title: Excellent Service from Starky, but most of the rest was just "O.K."
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort last week.  Starky Valoy was a bar tender, and I want to write an excellent review for him.  He was kind, responsive, and always looking to serve.  We don't drink alcohol and he was always so creative in making delicious drinks for us.  We appreciate his service.  He was excellent!

My other experiences were not as good though.  We were not able to have the Royal Service or stay on the reserve due to capacity constraints, so my review may be lower than others because of that.  Also, we had to ask for this and it was not even mentioned at check in--maybe because they were very full when we were there.  Our room was below expectations.  It was smaller and not as nice as the last all inclusive we stayed at in Tulum, Mexico.  The food was below my expectations, though there was a large variety of things.  Also, the service, aside from Starky, was sub par in part because we were not staying in the nicer parts of the resort.  Many times I felt like I was not able to communicate with the hotel workers due to the language barrier.  Further, we were blocked from even crossing parts of the hotel to get where we wanted.  This was annoying.  We weren't even trying to stay in the "Royal Service" places.  The main parts of the hotel were amazing though.  Also, the location is the best.  The beach is beautiful.  I guess I just expected to be treated better and to have better overall service (aside from Starky) given that I paid $3,600 to stay there.

reviews.author: Corey M
reviews.title: Not that good
reviews.text: The pool and the beach views were great.  The food was ok.  Service wasn't very good unless they talk you into buying one of their "time-shares".  I wouldn't recommend staying here unless you only want to hang out at the pool or beach.  The food and drinks were not very good.  We had to change rooms 3 times, the first time the room just wasn't ready although they told us it was, the 2nd time, there was a leak from the floor above.  The 3rd room was ok, but our king size bed was actually two full size beds pushed together.  For the price it isn't worth it.

reviews.author: Ronald H
reviews.title: Disappointing vacation
reviews.text: Room was in very poor condition--looked like in middle of remodel. TV never worked in master suite after having maintenance there 4-5 times. No hot water to shower one night. Dinner reservations hard to get.

reviews.author: Yoanna P
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia un lugar maravilloso con un un equipo de personas muy preparadas y preocupadas en nuestra estadia el lugar es perfecto cuenta con todo lo necesario para tener unos diaa de relax y esparcimiento

reviews.author: Rafael  S
reviews.title: No me gustan los all Inclusive, pero quize tratar
reviews.text: Fui con esposa y dos hijos de 8 y 6, al decir la verdad, nunca me gustaron los hoteles todo incluido, pero este me pparecia que podia hacer la diferencia. LAs habitacione no son gran cosa, son bastante Standard, el servicio tambien Standard, el unico restaurante que valia la pena es el Gabi Club, comida bien realizada, pero nada especial, carta de vinos pequena y mas de la mitad de los vinos de la carta no estaban disponibles. Los ninos la pasaron muy bien, la playa muy buena y las piscinas tambien. Mi review es subjetiva, dado que no me gustan estos planes. probablemente a otros les encante.

reviews.author: MNtraveler55118
reviews.title: Awesome Spring Break!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana for Spring Break March 22-29, 2014.  The resort was great and far exceeded my expectations.  I was a bit nervous to try the whole all-inclusive thing but this resort was top notch.
I am VERY glad we did the family concierge program.  Nikel was extremely helpful and professional.  All of the concierge folks in our building were just great but kudos to Nikel.  My daughter's birthday was over break and they did a fabulous job decorating for her and getting a cake to dinner that night.  She was over the moon with the balloons in the jacuzzi!
The food was very good.  Some of the restaurants were awesome!!  We especially liked Agua and The Grill.  If you need an adult night out, try Passions.  There is an extra charge but it is well worth it!  There are separate reviews for Passions.  The concierge made the reservation process smooth and easy!
Someone mentioned that there was not a lot for there 9 and 11 year old to do--I think because the kids club is "younger" but my 9 and 11 year old LOVED everything and participated in the "teen" club down by the beach a few afternoons.  They wanted to go down and hang out with the other kids their ages and "Carlos"  entertained them with basketball, soccer, volleyball and trips to the Adventure Park.  They would not let me pick them up early!
The rooms were really clean, especially considering the amount of sand on our feet.  Thank you Gladys!  
I love gardens and the grounds to the entire resort were gorgeous and well maintained.  There was hardly a leaf out of place.  Because of the beautiful grounds I did not mind all of the walking.  It is a HUGE place and we walked a lot.  There are shuttles but I am usually too impatient to wait and needed the exercise with all of those desserts!
The Reserve Beach area and Palapas were great.  Like a big bed!  There were plenty of chairs on the beach and around the pool even without a reserved spot.   
My complaints are minor.  I requested a King Bed on our pre-arrival intake form and we got 2 doubles (in realty probably slept better haha), we had a couple of minor repair issues in our room that were addressed promptly.  I wish the evening shows started a little earlier as I was too pooped to party, but that is my own fault!  I can't remember the others so obviously they were not that important.
Our transportation to and from thru Sunny-C was perfect (recommended thru the hotel prior to arrival) as well as our excursions.  
Great staff throughout the property- thanks!!

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.title: Syracuse Travelers
reviews.text:
This resort & beach are very beautiful, very clean, the rooms are very nice & modern  and the staff is very helpful.We upgraded to the Royal service which was great because we had separate check in/out, separate facilities/ beach and we had our own butler Eduard Mendez to take care of setting up dinners,scheduling excursions getting our fridge stocked basically almost anything we asked for (Now Eduard asked us to mention him in this review but if he didn't we would have mentioned him and the bartender at the Sunset bar Leonardo because they both are outstanding young guys who really help you out and genuinely seem to enjoy what their doing also make sure you order the Leonardo special drink every day). The beach beds & huts were awesome, the food & liquor is very good (which was one of our major concerns), there's a good variety and the breakfast buffet for the royal service was outstanding. We Golfed at Cocotal which was very nice but not outstanding and Scuba Dove with the onsite outfit which was also ok but not outstanding.
The only things about the resort that we would criticize are the following The Drink service on the beach was slow and you can't order food on the beach you have to go to one of the restaurants and get it yourself. There aren't many staff members speak fluent English which was interesting to say the least sometimes when we were trying to ask for certain things (but we really need to learn Spanish as we are the visitors in their country). 

People on the beach were mesmerized by the leaning tree in front of the beach hut that we occupied daily and some of the foreign (Russian , French etc..) travelers took some interesting shots of themselves on that tree which was daily comic relief. (We may have been drinking a little too much at that point!!!)

We have been to many places in the Caribbean and Mexico , we were very skeptical about traveling to the D.R.  but were very pleasantly surprised and the Resort was absolutely top notch.

reviews.author: albertodao
reviews.title: Un paraiso
reviews.text: El hotel es grande,bonito y bastante bien cuidado,las habitaciones comodas,grandes ,les falta un poco de retoque,ya acusan el paso del tiempo, en la reserve es espectacular todo y el bar de la piscina los barman son de lujo, y especiales ,siempre para complacer, si por algun motivo tienes una queja,la resuelven de inmediato,sin dilacion, la gerente general del hotel es la persona mas eficiente y diligente que conozco, la comida debe mejorar en los restaurantes del hotel principal, es un hotel para volver mil veces

reviews.author: gigi22r
reviews.title: Didn't want to come home
reviews.text: I just got back from my friends wedding there!  I had an amazing time.  We were a group of 60 . The hotel was beautiful!  Beach was to die for !  (i am feeling depressed to be back home)  The food was delicious  We were in RS and our butler Johnfi Rivera was so nice!!! He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed for an amazing vacation.  To tell you the truth the whole staff was very accommodating!  But a must see is Ramon Fuego, Luis Fuegito and Gloria they are by the main pool at the bar, OMG they def mad our trip that much more fun!!  Amazing , great drinks and fun company are cups were never empty!

reviews.author: Mary T
reviews.title: Relax and
reviews.text:
We had a very relaxing stay at the Paradisus.  Our trip was made especially memorable by Stephanie Bellido from Guest Services who went out of her way to secure reservations for us in each of the restaurants.  The food was spectacular.  definitely the best I have had at any All Inclusive resort.
Thank you Stephanie.  Also the beds were fabulous.  Very comfortable. 
The beach could have used a few more thatched roof coverings, but it was beautiful and clean. 
I would recommend this resort very highly.

reviews.author: Kurt K
reviews.title: Palma Real excellent; Royal Service not-so-much
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous stay at Paradisus Palma Real this March.  We took a friend and we all had a great beach, spa, and dining experience.  We are members of Club Melia and it just gets better and better.

We did stay one night in Royal Service which was terrible.  No hot water, broken lights, coffee maker didn't work, no space at the "private" pool.  Butler and lounge staff were sympathetic but not helpful.  I would never spend the money on this again.

reviews.author: Mboj
reviews.title: Great Vacation - We will be back
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights with 4 other couples and had a wonderful time.  We went with the royal service and from our private check in drinking mimosas to our check out we had a lovely time.  The room was large and very nice and the bed was super comfy. My only complaint about the room was it was a bit far from the beach. Over all the food was very good and a lot to choose from.  I would like to give a shout out to Francisco at the pool/beach  he was great!  The one problem I had with the trip was the golf.  It is fine that a cart fee is charged but I don't think it should be advertised that golf is included when actually you end up paying $75 a person.  Either charge $20 for the cart or just charge a green fee and don't say it is included.  I felt it was a little misleading.  Overall we had a great time and I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
The facilities were awesome top rate.  You do pay for it but you do feel pampered. Good is awesome and gourmet. Internet went in and out and was unstable. It was hard to understand what the daily activities were. It would have been nice to get a letter in your room of what the activities were and where foe the day. Perhaps on the in room television.  But they were well built with thick walls and very quiet. 

The rooms are awesome - but the toilet did not give very much privacy.  The staff were all beautiful and friendly.

reviews.author: Aline C
reviews.title: Lugar melhor, não existe!
reviews.text:
Estivemos em uma segunda lua de mel no Paradisus, antes já havíamos nos hospedado em outros resorts do tipo all inclusive no Caribe. E não consegui concluir se foi o Resort, os Dominicanos e Haitianos ou Punta Cana que nos deixaram encantados.
O Hotel possui um serviço 5 estrelas diamante, o que o diferencia dos outros da região. Visitamos outras bandeiras renomeadas em Punta Cana e vimos a diferença das instalações, do cuidado com o Resort e com os Hospedes.
A comida era simplesmente maravilhosa, lagosta no almoço, restaurantes exóticos e maravilhosos, só estando lá para descrever. Voltaremos com certeza.

reviews.author: anacspc
reviews.title: Fantástico!
reviews.text: Fomos para o resort em agosto de 2013, contratamos royal service. Desde a chegada fomos tratados com muita cortesia. O quarto é maravilhoso, o ar condicionado funciona muito bem, a limpeza é impecável. De fato, o único "defeito" é que o banheiro peca um pouco na privacidade. Mas não chega a alterar a qualdiade de todo o resto. A comida e a bebida foram nota dez, não têm nada daquele "bastantão" que se imagina nos resorts. recomendo muito a estadia, sem qualquer ressalva!

reviews.author: Ann N
reviews.title: Great vacation, we will return
reviews.text: We just recently returned from Paradisus Palma and had a wonderful time. The resort is beautiful, the rooms are very comfortable and the service was exceptional. All of the staff are super friendly and accommodating. We upgraded to Royal Service on arrival and it was well worth it. Francisco took great care of us at the beach everyday and Bayron (our butler) made sure we had everything else we needed off the beach! We will definitely return again next year. My biggest complaint would be spotty internet service, but hey you're on vacation do you really need to be connected 24x7?

reviews.author: naz e
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This is one of the best resorts in Dominican, food, people, service, super clean. The pool was beautiful and the selection of drinks and food was awesome. I highly recommend this place to anyone that wants to go to Dominican.

reviews.author: Sean S
reviews.title: Royal Service is Royal Service!
reviews.text: We wanted a quick 4-night getaway to celebrate a landmark birthday.  After significant research into Mexico and Dominican Republic locations, we chose this resort based on TripAdvisor, word of mouth and other reviews.  We are glad we did!  We upgraded to the Royal Service option because we really wanted to relax and have everything done for us (reservations, excursions, etc.).  The private pool and beach section for Royal Service was fantastic!  On our first day, our Butler, Faustino introduced us to Billie, the beach attendant, who from that day on attended to our every need.  Each day our cabana, that we chose on day 1, was reserved and prepared with towels.  The location provided for sun when you wanted it and shade when you didn't.  Billie was very friendly, always smiling and very pro-active in making sure we were comfortable and wanted for nothing.  We never felt the need to walk to the bar for a cocktail as Billie could always sense when we needed something - he really added to our relaxation.  As a part of Royal Service, we were provide a Butler to make our trip worry free.  Faustino made all of our dinner reservations, researched excursions with us, made recommendations and just took care of everything including scheduling our airport transportation to and from the resort.  Faustino was always available and within 24-hours had a really good sense of what we liked to do and how we wanted to spend our time.  Requests to Faustino were typically fulfilled within minutes.  Faustino surprised us with a wonderful birthday treat that we will remember for some time.  We will go back and we will request Faustino!  The food and drink quality was very good although I would recommend dishes that did not include red meat (except for lamb) as it was always either undercooked or too well done (we request medium rare).  The seafood dishes were wonderful and highly recommended.  We really enjoyed our experience and highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real.  We'll be back with a group of friends!

reviews.author: jaime m
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: loved everything. stayed in the reserve one bedroom master suite with 2 friends. the room was perfect for us with plenty of space.4 days was not enough time to try all the restaurants but the buffet was great for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Dont eat the pizza though lol. Bartender Bertilio Tellerias was a great guy and gave us the run down on best things to do. Not far from other resorts you can check out. my biggest complaint was how ridiculously tiny the casino was.would like to come back with my wife to fully enjoy the relaxing and romantic side of the resort. Take the atv tour and bring cash(small bills)

reviews.author: polancomariel
reviews.title: Beautiful property with over the top service
reviews.text:
This hotel is just beautiful! the white sand beaches and crital clear water obviously helps it, but the pool is also just awesome :) what I first noticed was the 5 star service, starting at the security gate. Everyone is so curteous and seems genuin which makes it even better. 
Everyone seems always eagered to help and make the best of your stay. The rooms are wonderfull, nothing wrng with it. I satyed at a double room with 2 beds, but the beds were big and comfortable. I was not a fan of the pillow since they were a bit hard for my liking.

The food did not impress me. the buffet has lots of choices but nothing really blew my mind even though they had flavor. The grilled meat was hard and lacked flavor and the ice cream quality could improve. This was the only think that could really use improvement but thats just me being picky because of the category the hotel has. I did not get a chance to visit the well known martin aristegy restaurant, Passion but hopefully i get the change in the future.

Overall the hotel is beautiful and the service will make the best of your stay guaranteed, Although i went for business, it´s great for families and couples as well.

reviews.author: Mari S
reviews.title: Spring break vacation
reviews.text: Had a great time with my friend carlos.  I recommend this place to any one or family. This is the second time I've come love  this place .a special thanks to miky and friends. Thank you too the staff at paradisus Punta cana.

reviews.author: BreZee09
reviews.title: Wonderful anniversary trip
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a wonderful trip at Palma Real for our anniversary.  Admittedly, I was a bit nervous what type of room we were going to have as it was very unclear where we were going to be.  We obtained our reservation through RCI using Platinum points, however I know we wanted to upgrade from just a standard room.  I had heard so much about Royal Service so I assumed we had the option of regular room or Royal Service or the Reserve.  A difficulty and probably the biggest complaint we had was we could not get a hold of someone that could give me an answer to what kind of reservation we had.  I emailed the resort 3 months before we arrived and was told don't worry, wait until cloesr to your trip.  I still persisted every month and sometimes would not get an answer back at all.  I tried calling once and no one spoke English and I was hung up on.  I tried to speak some Spanish but regretfully it was limited.  Had we still wanted to upgrade from a "regular" room to Royal Service, we would have been screwed because that section was sold out when we were checking in.  I finally emailed and spoke with Lenny who was a wonderful help and got us straight!
With our RCI reservation, we actually ended up being in the Club Melia side which was very comparable to Royal Service in terms of what you get.  There might have been a couple perks or extra restaurants but nothing that was a deal breaker.  We were in the building closest to the ocean on that side and were very excited thinking we could just watch the beach out our patio, but not so much.  Gabi Beach was located between us and the ocean and 6am ON THE DOT, workers would start to prepare for their day.  They are just doing their job, but admittedly that was probably our biggest compliant.
As far as food goes, I would certainly upgrade so your dining options are not just the buffet.  That got real boring, real quick.  We went there for breakfast as that was the one typically only open and it was more of the same.  We went to the Dominican theme night which allowed us to try some local food-definitely recommend that.  Gabi Beach was BY FAR the best restaurant there.  We went there 4 times during out stay for either lunch or dinner.  Their lobster was the BEST and they had an excellent mahi.  We had a steak at the Market Grill and the waiter was so accomodating.  I could not decide between a steak or the fish of the day so he brought both!  I was not at all impressed with any beef dishes at the resort and likely that's a factor of what's available (being from the midwest we are used to some good beef).  Stick with the seafood-it's fresh and wonderfully prepared.  The sushi place though limited was pretty good.  Vento was supposed to be one of the better restaurants, but meh-I was not terribly impressed.  We did a couple of room service breakfasts and that was great. It was kind of annoying to have to schedule dinners at the beginning of the trip.  You certainly can change it up, especially if you discover a favorite, and I get it that it helps to have an idea of how many people might be coming so you can prepare accordingly but still.  We did not attend many theme nights (I heard the Michael Jackson one was good) and what was advertised as 80's night was actually 60-70's night.  Perhaps lost in translation and again, not a big deal but do not go expecting Vegas-like nightly entertainment.
