Overall it was a beautiful vacation, and we would go back to this resort.  I've seen compliants about the seaweed and the resort does a great job keeping up on it.  You have to consider that geographically, the trade winds are beating that part of the island and bringing seaweed and such with it.  While walking up and down the beach we noticed other resorts had it worse.  It was a little annoying how much helicopter and airplane traffic over us but again, this is not a quiet, secluded beach.  We would recommend the trip!

reviews.author: Erica W
reviews.title: Wonderful honeymoon!
reviews.text: We booked the Paradisus Punta Cana for our honeymoon and it was absolutely amazing! We stayed at The Reserve and the room was great! Large suite with a balcony overlooking the grounds which were upkept very well.  We especially enjoyed the hydromassage tub in our bathroom! The food wasn't five star but it was good.  Making reservations at the restaurants for dinner was a breeze Thanks to concierge Sandra Cedeno! Big shout out to bartender Lorenzo (lil Mike Tyson) at Gabi! This was an amazing vacation and one we won't soon forget! We would love to come back!

reviews.author: unocic
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful! The staff are extremely friendly and extend themselves to meet your needs. Our hotel room at The Reserve was gorgeous.. It was always cleaned and services there were great! They have entertainment that is of top quality and many restaurants to choose from. We will definitely be coming here again.

reviews.author: Maggie M
reviews.title: An unforgettable vacation
reviews.text:
beautiful beach with white sand,  best sea food I ever tasted, unforgettable people and culture.  
Will recommend this destination to my family and friends.
I spend a week and I really wanted to stay longer, it's truly an place to relax and to get away from the fast and hefty NYC life.

reviews.author: GoBucks03
reviews.title: Nice place that needs a few changes
reviews.text:
My husband and I are in our mid 30's and have done a fair amount of travelling. We took this trip together just to get away from work and relax for a week. We had a regular, non-royal service room. 

We arrived on a Saturday around 2:30pm and our room wasnt ready until 4pm. This was a little irritating after travellig all day, but we are in PC and we are just happy to be there! We check into our room which was in the Pearl building, #3835. This building was the second from the last building on the property so we had about a 8-10 minute walk from the lobby to our room. No biggie, we are young, we can handle it. We check in and the room is nice - king size bed in its own bedroom, HUGE jacuzzi tub, nice bathroom, living room and small kitchenette area and balcony overlooking the Melia next door and the gardens. Not bad!

A few notes to mention about the room.........there was a stereo in the living room. This thing was so old it had a cassette player.........yes I said it, a CASSETTE player........and no way to hook up an ipod. It literally had rabbit ears on the top. For such a nice resort, charging top dollar to stay here, you would think they could splurge on a $19 alarm clock radio that had ipod capabilities. So that was disappointing. Something else - our bedroom had an old school tube television in it that was so blurry/snowy you couldnt even watch it. Another thing that just makes you scratch your head in wonder.

The food - it was OK. We tried every restaurant except Mole, and that was b/c I heard it was terrible and I wasnt in the mood for Mexican anyway. Vento - good food, but dont get the "creme brule". It literally looked like a plate of nacho cheese. Disgusting. But the dinner was decent. The Japanese hibachi grill was just OK - the rice was hard as a rock, the cook was obviously new, and the chicken was so dry you needed a bottle of soy sauce. My shrimp and salmon were great though. Market grill was pretty good and the asian restaurant was OK. We ate at the buffet every day for breakfast and lunch. Breakfast was always great - there is always someone making fresh omelettes and eggs which was great. I really struggled with lunch. It just seemed to be the same stuff every day and I found myself filling up on desserts b/c I couldnt find any substance worth eating. 

I do need to point out Passions restaurant. This is a fine dining restaurant on the property that you can pay $50 per person to check out. In our opinion, it was well worth it. The food, the service, the wine (also extra), the atmosphere, it was all FANTASTIC!! It is truly a must see while you are here. This was one of the highlights of our trip. 

We ordered room service for breakfast 3 of the days we were there. If you do this, be prepared to wait about an hour and 15 minutes no matter what they tell you (we were usually told 35-45 minutes). 2 of the 3 days, the food was barely warm. But it was nice to eat on the balcony in peace and quiet. 

This resort requires reservations at all restaurants except buffet. That was a pain in the butt. Our concierge told us that they would only take reservations 2 nights at a time so we would have to keep calling back to make reservations for the week. He made them for the first 2 nights. I found out the next day that is not true - they can be made for the entire week. I spend the better part of 45 mintues trying to get this accomplished at the concierge desk on our second day. For some reason, they cant check reservation information in the computer, so they have to call all of the restaurants to check and see if times are available. If you are a non royal service guest, they will always tell you 6pm and 9:30pm are the only openings. But if you keep trying, you will eventually get a better time (we ate at 8pm every night and the restaurants always had open tables). In my opinion, the whole reservation thing was a big irritant. And just as an FYI - guests staying at the Palma Real can eat at the restaurants at The Reserve. We did that one night and checked out Agua. Food was OK, service was terrible. 

We checked out the spa one day at The Reserve - it was AAHHHHHMAZING!!! I highly recommend going here. This was the other major highlight of our trip. We got to do the steam room, hydropool, jacuzzi, sauna, etc. Really worth the extra $$$. 

The entertainment at this hotel was so-so. The activities during the day were fun - they had aerobics on the beach, dance lessons, finger painting, volleyball, etc. But the shows at night werent that great. The Michael Jackson show was good, and we loved the nights that they had live music in the lobby bar, but other than that, dont waste your time. 

Drinks - we were very impressed with the bartenders at this resort. They are ACTUAL bartenders. Professionals. The lobby bar was our favorite - those guys really know how to mix up drinks right. And they dont cut corners, they take the time to do everything just right. Luis at the pool remembers you and what you like to drink and will start it up before you ask for it. 

One major issue I need to point out about the drinks is their wine. I am a wine drinker so this was a major issue for me. The hotel did not have the same wines offered at all of the bars. For instance, you could get Chardonnay anywhere, but I dont care for it. Savignon Blanc was sometimes available for lunch in the buffet but other days they didnt have it. Sometimes they would have it in the lobby bar and other days it was Chardonnay only. I just cannot understand why they wouldnt keep all of the bars across the resort stocked with the same wines so that customers would know that they could get what they like no matter what time of day or what bar they went to. This issue should be addressed. 

Another bummer - they were constantly running out of drink supplies. In the mornings, my hubby likes to have a Bloody Mary. They were out of tomato juice at 9am on 3 different days. I like Mojitos and if I tried to get one after 1pm, they were always out of mint. Another issue that should be addressed. 

The pool at this resort is amazing. Its absolutely huge and you will never feel crowded. We loved the chairs that are built into the pool with the palpalas. Also loved the swim up bar. 

The stretch of beach that this resort is located on is just stunning. We loved that it was never an issue getting a chair and you dont feel like the chairs are packed in too close. There were always people out first thing in the morning cleaning up the beach which was a nice gesture.

Service - No complaints. Everyone was friendly and we never felt like we went without. I also never felt as though we were missing out on anything by not getting royal service. 

Just a pointer - they assign a concierge to you as soon as you check in. He will want you to attend a VIP breakfast the following day. This is actually a sales pitch for Club Melia. They will offer you spa and dinner discounts and vouchers. If you are into that stuff, go for it. But for us, vacation time is precious and we didnt want to spend it listening to a sales pitch that we knew we had no interst in. However, if you choose to attend, your concierge gets $100 per couple. I am sure that is why we never saw our guy the rest of the week - if we had helped him earn his $$ I am sure he would have been more helpful to us. 

Overall, we really liked this resort. Very nice, big, well kept, and beautiful. However, if we find ourselves in PC again, for the money we spent, we would check out a different resort.

reviews.author: ndelaluz11
reviews.title: We had an amazing visit with an extremely relaxing environment
reviews.text: The people were the difference during our stay. Ramon at the pool bar and Steulis made our dinning experience very entertaining. We enjoyed a few of the night shows but the highlight was definitely dancing with Dariana and Rachel. I would definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: mhwmom
reviews.title: Fabulous Girls Trip--Bucket List Spa Experience
reviews.text:
Just returned from a five day/four night trip with three best friends that was incredible.  I have very high expectations about accommodations/service/experience and for the most part the resort exceeded all of them. The resort is not Caribbean (no calypso music and loud “island” decorations) very classic and European with everyone speaking Spanish, which was a pleasant surprise.   Be aware that the resort has a variety of “levels of service” Royal, VIP, Reserve, etc. so know what you are getting and paying for because some parts of the resort are off limits based on your experience.  

Resort was easy to get to from airport; took a cab, $32, to resort, clean, easy to get and 25 minute drive.  Check-in was most disappointing part of experience.  We arrived and waited 20 minutes at counter then told we needed to go VIP room down hall.  That process took another 30 minutes, then told us room wasn’t ready, come back in 30 minutes (which is fine we ate), but then another 30 minutes after 3 p.m. (when rooms are ready) to finally get room and they gave us key and moved on.  Rooms were suppose to be adjoining with friends (but in person they said it was extra, not on phone).No one walked us to room or took us on tour of resort, when we saw others getting that service.  

I was starting to question if this was a five star resort, but luckily we quickly moved from the lackluster start.  Room was clean, beautiful and spacious.  We stayed in a garden view on Gabbi Beach side and loved the location to beach. Cleaning staff was noisy in mornings EARLY—6 a.m., but otherwise no room complaints.

The food was great!  Hard to find quality at all-inclusive so the food exceeded my expectations. The buffet was good, but the restaurants have great options and the staff is more than willing to accommodate your requests . Get reservations for your stay the first night you arrive.  I thought Vinto was best meal and loved Thai (Bana) and Steakhouse (MarketGrill) (want to have fun server, find Anthoni!!.  Would skip Gabbi for dinner, but they had great lunch.  Didn’t get to Mole, but I am sure it was great.  We didn’t pay additional $50 for Michelin star restaurant.  I would save money for spa.  Special call out to Jendy who took the extra time and effort to make my 40th party dinner special.  He is FABULOUS and can train everyone on true customer service!!

We are use to gulf coast beaches, so we are spoiled with our soft white sand, but these beaches were great, clean, deep and the water –well is isn’t possible to do it justice in words. It was REALLY windy a few days during our visit, so not sure if it was seasonal (sand blowing in your face when you laying out, burying chairs windy) so you might want to do some research.  JUAN made our trip special.  He was a server at Gabbi who took care of us.  Find Juan!!!

The SPA—This is what sets this resort apart from many great all inclusive I have stayed at around the world.  Don’t waste your time at the smaller Royal Service, go to the main spa and get any treatment (I had three and they were all great!) , but go two hours early to get the complimentary water treatment, it will change your life!

Think this resort is best suited for couple or groups of friends.  Not too many families and babies (left my kiddos at home and sure didn’t want to hang out with other peoples) Also loved it wasn’t a lot of singles.

reviews.author: YvettaLady
reviews.title: Never disappointed!
reviews.text:
Edison did a great job when we attended the local gym, did yoga and Pilate's!  He made sure we were comfortable with the movements and it helps us.
Yaihaara at YHI spa was FANTABULOUS! Manta, Yaira and Alex helped create a beautuful painting.  Thanks for the dance also!  Love this place!
At Melia members office, I must say that Patricia and Jennika went above and beyond the call of duty!

reviews.author: Jill B
reviews.title: Great Vacation!! 4th time at this resort
reviews.text: I just returned from another weeks vacation at this resort and it was excellent!  My husband and I have been going to DR for the past 6 years and stayed at Paradiscus Palma Real 4 times.  We wanted to try a few other places but Paradiscus Palma Real is far superior to the other resorts we went to.  The minute you enter the foyer and see the sea in the distance it just takes your breath away.  We happen to enjoy the buffet and find there are selections for everyone.  If you want you rfood hot, order from the grill selections as these are cooked for you.  Many of the dishes in the buffet are luke warm at best.  We sat in the same section for lunch and breakfats nad received great service from Juan Suarez.  He made sure we had our cafe con leche as soon as we sat down.  Leaving a few dollars tip helps.  If you like a relaxing vacation with not a lot to do and want otbe pampered-this is the place to go.  I wish I was still there!.  The rooms are excellent, too.  They have the MOST comfortable beds wehave ever slept on.  Maid service is good,  Drinks are good but ask for mucho rum or they are too sweet.

reviews.author: ProfesorX
reviews.title: Muy buen resort para familias excelente atencion
reviews.text:
Pasamos 7 noches con familia, nino de 20 meses en Paradisuis. Tomamos opcion familly concierge. Recivimos muy buena atencion de los consirge Ovidio y Sandra.
Entregan un celular para comunicarse a todo momento con su concierge.
El club para ninos es muy bueno y las chicas que cuidan a los ninos son realmente super sin exepcion..ojala mentienen en el futuro este nivel de servicio, puede cambiar los ninos dar tete, mientras los papas se pueden dedicar a otras actividades.
Estuvimos en la reserve al numero 40, (1402), cerca del kid zone lo que fue ventajoso para nosotros. El apartamente esta muy bien equipado, limpio,..limpieza perfecta todo los dias, mini bar perfecto y adaptado a nuestros requerimientos.  Llevavan toda las tardes leche y gelleta para nuetrso nino.
Lado actividades : buenas y variadas. 
Yo presto atencion al gym esta bueno pero le hace falta unas machinas (pesas).
Punto negativo : el transporte hacia a la playa es a veces problematico..pasa el train full a noche o fin de la tarde. Cuando uno se vuelve socio el cuento es distincto ya que se puede pedir carito de golf privado.
Comida : de muy buen muy nivel por un resort. hay comida saludable abundante y fresca cualquier sea el sitio que uno escoge..Gaby beach, Gabi CLub, mediteraneo...
cada dia cenamos en un restaurante distincto, el unico un poco regular nos parecio el italiano que se llama Vento.
Regresariamos sin problema, por lo meno 2 semanas.
actividad de playa buena.. son un poco conservador con los hobby cat y uno no puede navegar cuando sopla a mas de 15 nudos..precisamente cuando puede agara velocidad..pero bueno son reglas de capitania.
Picinas limpias, muy buenos cocktailes..realmente buena atencion a todo nivel.
Muy buen resort al nivel de lo que se espera en Melia. De echo decidomos de hacernos Socios  del Melia.
Un gran abrazo a Isidra y a Juan (ejecutivos socios), y a Sandra y Ovidio como family concierge.
Probamos el SPA..muy bueno pero un poco mas costoso que otros de nivel similar. Igual excellente.

reviews.author: Claudia A
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort!  Ramon "Fuego" and Luis Felguito are the BEST pool bartenders ever!  They were very accommodating and always attentive to our needs.  The rooms were beautiful and always clean!  This is our 4th time at this resort and we can't say enough good things about it!  Everyone goes above and beyond to make sure we are completely happy with everything!  We can't wait to come back again next year!  LOVE IT HERE - truly paradise!

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Average experience mars beautiful property
reviews.text:
So for a quick version before the extended review I'll sum up how I view this property.  If you're looking for an average hotel with a great beach to visit, this is the place!

My initial impression of this hotel was very good!  Driving up you're greeted with a lush tropical landscape thats obviously very well groomed and maintained.  The hotel itself is quite large and open with modern appointments.

Upon arrival we went to the front desk to arrange for our check in.  There is a definite language barrier here as Spanish is the main spoken language but most employees speak some degree of English.  While we were checking in I inquired about several of the activities, most specifically the scuba diving. (The website is pretty much a joke when it comes to describing the activities).  At first the employee didnt seem to know what I was asking, and then told me scuba diving was not included.  I responsded that I had called prior and was assured that it was.  She then asked several other employees each one echoing a different sentiment.  Finally the Scuba Aquatics center was called and it was clarified.  In case anyone is interested Tuesdays and Thursdays are single tank dives and are included.  Mon-Wed-Fri are 2 tank dives and require an additional 50 dollars.

My biggest gripe with the check in process was that there was no orientation.  My friend and I had no idea what was and wasnt included.  You are handed an envelope that goes over most of the basic things, but questions can take a long time to answer.

Once check in was complete the employee suggested we go to guest services to book a reservation for dinner and then eat lunch.  When we went to the guest services area I told them we'd like to make a dinner reservation.  Without a word they picked up the phone, dialed a number and handed it to me.  I have no problem making my own reservation, but why tell me to go to guest services if I was supposed to do it myself?  Talking to the person on the other end of the phone was also frustrating.  They asked where I would like to eat and I asked for a recommendation.  They said "I Dont know what kind of food you like."  Ok, I thought, well what kind of restaurants do you have?  "Um, an asian place, sushi, greek.."  The lack of knowledge from a person that was supposed to help you make your reservation was dissapointing to say the least.

Now lets talk about the food.  Breakfast and lunch are average at best.  Breakfast basically consists of a buffet with typical breakfast foods.  If I were to grade it I'd give it a solid C.  Nothing spectacular nothing terrible.  The service is definitely inconsistent though.  Every morning I'd usually order an ice tea.  A couple days I was told they dont have ice tea and often times it would take quite a while to receive drink orders.  The lunch buffet I'd rate a little worse than the breakfast buffet although they do offer another option "Market Grille" that serves pretty decent burgers.

Dinner on the other hand is usually pretty good.  I'd rate most restaurants B-B+.  We ate at the Sushi Place (the only dissapointment I'd give it a C-), Teppanyaki (B+) Asian Fusion (B+), Vento (B+) Market Grille (A) Gabi Beach (not included you have to pay A).  24 hour room service is also available and actually comes in quite handy..

Alcohol is also included in your all inclusive package.  For the most part the drinks were quite good and usually decent alcohol was used.  However your mileage can vary wildly based on the bartender.

Now lets move on to activities.  Paradisus offers a WIDE variety of activities that are definitely a selling point.  I didnt get a chance to experience many, so I'll only comment on thsoe that I did.

I signed up for a tennis lesson the 2nd day there and was the only one that showed up so I basically got a free tennis lesson.  The instructor was very knowledgeable and friendly and took the time to help correct my mistakes.  I enjoyed my time doing this and would recommend it.

Snorkeling. The resort offers snorkeling once a day at 3 pm.  I'm not sure why they offer a popular activity like this only once a day.  The boat literally takes you on a 3 minute ride within sight of the hotel to a reef. If you would like to do this I suggest you book it early.  We tried to book 24 hours in advance and were told a group had filled it for the next day.  Seriously?  If you take a boat that close why not offer it several times a day?  Its obviously a very popular activity.  When we finally got to snorkel it was well worth it.  There is a pretty decent variety of marine life and if you're lucky you might see some bigger critters.  I got to swim with a small barracuda which was very cool.  If you can arrange it I would recommend giving this a shot.

I also had the opportunity to dive.  Diving is arranged through Scuba Aquatics which is located on the resorts 'Gabi Beach' section.  They ask you to show up around 850 to get sized and go over a few things.  Domingo the dive master was awesome and very knowledgeable.  We did the Astron (sp?) wreck which was quite fun as I'd never had the opportunity to dive around a wreck before.  The only bad thing about the experience was the boat.  You're on a small skiff style boat maybe 15-17ft in length.  There were 6 divers, the driver, and a passenger.  The boat is VERY crowded and it makes it a pain to get in and out of your equipment.  Still the overall experience was good and I would recommend it.

One of my biggest problems with the activities was the lack of 'local' type activities.  When I was in belize we could kayak through the forest, explore caves, go on nature hikes etc.  This resort offers only 'resort' type activies.  I was really hoping they would offer different activities.

There is also a shuttle to a shopping mall... This isnt a local shopping mall.  This is a mall that has Gucci, Diesel, etc.  If you want to go out and experience a local market or cuisine you'll have to have them call a taxi for you.

As far as overall service there is definitely an 'island casual' or very relaxed regard to service.  When going to guest services they are almost always on the hotel phone or looking down into the desk drawer on to their personal phones.  When you walk up they usually greet you uninterestedly and seem to not really want to help you.  I'm not sure if thats just part of the relaxed atmosphere or what.  

There's also a pass the buck attitude. We were walking looking for the spa and asked an employee to guide us in the right direction.  He literally grabbed another employee and told him to do it.  This second employee grabbed a third and told HIM to do it.  We were very fortunate this third employee led us where we needed to go.  We felt bad as he was off work and on his way home to study (he was carrying his school books)

I know the overall tone of this review is negative and thats not my intention.  I didnt have a bad time at this resort, nor did I have an amazing time.  I had a very average stay that could be improved upon with a few small tips.

Some suggestions I would offer:

I do not expect to be catered to in English.  However a couple of strategically placed employees that are fluent at the front desk and guest services would stream line the process immensely.  Also a brief 3-5 minute orientation of what is and is not included would help quite a bit.

Offer more times for the more popular activities.  Offer a larger variety of activities that might allow a deeper view into local culture.

Engage your employees to be more friendly and helpful!  

We stayed at the Palma Real portion of the resort.  There are other areas such as the reserve that include more amenities.  This review is based on the Palma real.

Again if you're looking for a resort with a nice beach and average service, this might just fit the ticket.  (Althought if you want to travel somwhere with a nice beach and decent service why pay the premium to fly here when you can save money and go somewhere closer?)

reviews.author: Giselle J
reviews.title: Truly Royal Service
reviews.text: I went for Spring Break with three generations of my family.  We all had a fantastic experience, but for the two of us in Royal Service, it was absolutely luxurious (I felt as though I was walking around a sprawling ancient Roman estate), while still being true to the island sensibility.  The food options were varied and and delicious, and the service across the board was attentive and personal.   I miss lounging on my reserved palapas, which were immediately beachfront and pool side (Thanks to the gracious, Pedro!), and the perfectly blended velvety drinks by their skilled mixologists.  Our favorite Palazzo waiters, Richard Ramirez and Alexander Guzman always remembered us by name and made us feel at home, as did the hostesses.  At night, entertainment staff member, Joangel, was engaging and helped us get our "dance on" when we were feeling timid.  Standout:  Our butler Ramon, who's genuine, affable sophistication and ability to anticipate every need truly makes him the BEST!!!  Gracias, Palma Real, for a well-needed rest and pampering.

reviews.author: Brian K
reviews.title: Our Honeymoon at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Overall, the resort had all the comforts and conveniences i.e. closeness to beach, clean hotel room/linens, various restaurant selections albeit after a few days, the food seemed more of the same types of things. 

Important note - best experience would be to upgrade to Royal Service, as the rooms, amenities are improved drastically. Our first room was a standard junior suite, which was subpar and was not comfortable. The rooms in Royal Service were of a higher quality and closer in location to the beach, restaurants, etc.

Our butler, Yohelvi was awesome, he made sure that all our needs were met and beyond. When he found out we were on our honeymoon, he made sure to prepare special surprises i.e. bubble baths w/ champagne, chocolate covered strawberries, and more! He truly made our stay at Palma Real more enjoyable and memorable. We would highly recommend that you request him as your butler, if you stay at Royal Service.

As a side note, wifi hasn't been working at the hotel consistently, but they are in the process of fixing it. Bring closed toed dress shoes as they are required for some of the restaurants.

reviews.author: Renate J
reviews.title: Spitzen-Hotel
reviews.text:
Der Royal Service des Paradisus Palma Real lässt einen Traumurlaub noch traumhafter werden. Die Vorzüge daraus kann man in vollen Zügen geniessen. Ganz besonders war für uns der Butler-Service und das haben wir vor allen Dingen auch unserer Butlerin zu verdanken, die sich außerordentlich bemüht hat und wirklich die Dinge auch sehr unkompliziert und toll umgesetzt hat.
Unser Aufenthalt war vom 04.04. - 18.04.2013. Daher gilt unser besonderer Dank Karollysh.
Auch hat uns besonders gut das "Palazzo" gefallen. Das begann schon morgens beim Frühstück, ebenso beim Mittagessen und weiter am Abend. Das gesamte Team war immer sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und sehr zu vorkommend. Dort war es einfach nur toll. Aber auch in der gesamten Anlage sind wir durchweg sehr viel Freundlichkeit und Aufgeschlossenheit begegnet. Die gesamte Anlage hat einen super gepflegten Eindruck gemacht. Die Parkanlage - einfach nur toll.

Auch war unser Zimmer perfekt, Größe, Ausstattung und Aussicht haben gepasst.
Wir kommen ganz bestimmt wieder!

Herbert und Renate

reviews.author: dawerbeltre
reviews.title: My best vacation
reviews.text: Royal palm Estavamos past us and WE RECEIVE a vacasiones eselentes the best Wake of the person in punta cana, first boss babi good servisio francisco beach and crashing on the beach and super attention of pedro reyas in room service was fantastic all hope volber

reviews.author: Noelle S
reviews.title: Super excellente
reviews.text: Muis muis bien, most beautiful resort I have ever been to, I highly recommend upgrading to the Royal Service it is totally worth the extra $35 American dollars per day to have a personal butler and access to the extra restaurants that are not buffets! I suggest you recommend Yohelvi aracena, he was the most excellent and genuine helper I could have ever asked for . Enjoyed meeting him and hearing about his familia and made the whole experience more genuine. He had the most excellent recommendations for excursions including golf, day trips and even helping me with medicine I needed. Will definitely return to the resort and highly recommend to all!

reviews.author: guillermoruiz
reviews.title: es un señor hotel........
reviews.text:
el hotel cubrio todas las espectativas a cabalidad frente a sus ..... instalaciones ,comodidad, descanso, confort, alimentacion e una insuperable atencion personalizada.
recomiendo el hotel para disfrutar de unas excelentes y verdaderas vacaciones.

reviews.author: Mirela Guarreschi
reviews.title: Valeu!!!
reviews.text: Eu e meu marido passamos 07 dias no Palma Real em Abril/2013. O clima estava ótimo, muito sol, o hotel é maravilhoso! Os funcionários muito simpáticos e prestativos, a comida deliciosa e de boa qualidade, o quarto delicioso!! Nossa única ressalva é quanto as bebidas. É imcompatível um hotel de alto nível como esse servir um "champangne" (pelo menos eles acham que é) que no rótulo está escrito "coquetel de frutas", ou seja, aqui no Brasil seria uma "cidra". Os vinhos também são bem simples; o que não condiz com o resto do complexo. Minha "pulserinha" era VIP, então acho que a qualidade das bebidas poderia ser melhor; e olha que não sou exigente, apenas sei que no mercado, hoje, há muitas opções boas e baratas.

reviews.author: nicole m
reviews.title: Best Time!
reviews.text: We were there for a wedding with about 20 other people and had such a great time! The resort was beautiful and we have to give a HUGE thank you to Maiker Ramirez! He took care of us and the group the whole time we were on the beach. Our trip wouldnt have been the same without him there!

reviews.author: Beth C
reviews.title: On the top of the list!🌞
reviews.text: We just arrived home 3 days ago from one of the most relaxing great vacation at the Palma Real.  As you enter the beautiful property you are greeted with the upmost courteous staff. The entrance into the lobby is breathtaking with the ocean as the background. This property is updated trendy and extremely clean and well maintained. Our room was beautiful bed comfy no complaints. We asked for our room to be cleaned daily by 12-1pm and our request was granted with no problem. We were in Building 3200 garden view suite room. Our maid Dominga was so kind and helpful. She's the best😄. The staff was wonderful. Kudos needs to be given to so many of the staff members. Domingo and his wonderful staff at the Club Melia were great!  If we needed anything they were always right there. The food at the resort was very good.  My favorite restaurant was Aqua at the Reserve we loved the food atmosphere and staff there so much we went two nights. The chef is amazing you most try the mushroom risotto the best I have ever tasted. We also loved dining at Gabi Beach great food and view. We ate  lunch there daily. My favorite Bartenders are also at the Gabi Beach Bar ! Orni and Hector and the gang were very good to us🍹I miss my Zombie and Rum runners! You guys are the best and thank you so much for making our birthdays and anniversary so very special. I have to mention my very favorite waiter on the Gabi Beach Juan you are the best and I can't wait to return soon and chat some more on the beach🌞. You will not be sorry if you order room service in. The service was excellent. We called every morning and received prompt courteous service from Felix Garcia, Pedro Reyes, Fred and Nicolas De la Rosa. Everyone was great. There was nightly entertainment provided to us which was a lot of fun. Take advantage of the daily excursions they offer. We had a great time on the catamaran half day excursion. This property is on the top of our list. We travel a lot so that is a great compliment. We will be back someday soon😄you will not be disappointed!🌴

reviews.author: traveller090
reviews.title: Amazing gardens, beach and resort
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely stunning resort on the a perfect, white sand, palm studded beach in Punta Cana.  The gardens are meticulous as is the entire resort.  It is absolutely beautiful throughout and the staff is attentive, friendly and know how to take good care of their guests.
I had some problems with the wifi but they were able to set up a router in my room that made my access to the internet perfect.

reviews.author: Mikki78
reviews.title: Royal Service is a scam
reviews.text:
I do not know where to begin. We paid an extra $950 for "Royal Service"  to get the Internet in the room and butler service. Well the Internet in the room does not work. We stayed at the resort for 5 nights. Every day they said they would write up a ticket and it would be fixed. Well that never happened. Also we asked our butler Doward for serveral items which never got done. We asked him to reserve us lounges  at the Royal service pool with the bar..,that never happened. We rarely saw him. He stopped by yesterday and asked what time we would be leaving we told him and he assured us a bellman would be at our door at 11a....We were mot surprised that never happened either.  He was a nice enough person, but clearly needs better training and follow through. We never got and special treatment with Royal service. 

We also were never told when we checked in that the Plazzo restaurant had a dress code for men. They need to wear long pants.  Communication and training is an issue with this property.

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Destination Wedding Review
reviews.text:
This is our second trip to the Paradisus Palma Real and it was for our wedding (April, 12th).  I first want to give a HUGE shout out to Massiel and Rosa at the Romance Department.  They put together the most amazing wedding anyone could have wished for.  They were both so easy to work with and really made sure everything was perfect.  We had as large wedding (80 guests) and there was not a single complaint about the wedding from anyone.  They were all telling us that this was the best wedding they have been to.  If you are thinking about having a destination wedding, please use Rosa and Massiel.  They will make this even more memorable than you ever would have thought.  Splurge and have your wedding at Gabi Beach.  It was so nice having the ceremony, cocktail hour and reception in one place.  And the pictures turned out AMAZING at the Gabi.  If you are considering using any photographer other than Arrecife DON'T.  They are located on Site and know the resort better than any other company.  Marisol was so helpful in getting everything set up and making sure we were getting exactly what we envisioned.  Rodrigo was our photographer and did an amazing job.  He was easy to work with and had so many creative ideas.  Please request him if possible.. he was awesome! After the wedding i sat there and thought about what i would have changed and there is absolutely nothing I could think of.  Weddings are always stressful leading up tot he BIG day but they really make sure you are not dealing with anything the day of the wedding.  I want them to all know how much i appreciated everything and hope they get the recognition they deserve.  A few other high notes from our trip were the room service, bartenders and servers.  Fred Martes gave TOP ROOM SERVICE!  He was there every morning on time with our breakfast.  He would check in during the day to see what we would need and at what time.  When you check in i would call room service and ask for Fred.  Let him know what you like, what time you eat breakfast and any other room service requests.  He will have notes of everything and make your trip so enjoyable.  Fred was so friendly and just a genuine person. As for restaurants we LOVE Palazzo!  Try the spaghetti with garlic sauce...yum!  We try to go there as much as possible and would always have Miguel Lopez Gil as our server.  He would have a bottle of our favorite wine ready for us when we sat down.   He would remember everything we talked with him about and really made us feel like "regulars".  And I cant forget Gloria at the Pool Bar.  She was so much fun and had so much fun with our group.  She was so good that we requested her for the wedding and she was able to work it.  It is great when all of your guests are getting the best possible service at the wedding and you keep hearing how great everything was.  I really want to thank Massiel, Rosa, Rodrigo, Gloria, Fred and Miguel Lopez.  You made this wedding the most amazing event I could have ever imagined.  You know these people are great because you want to go back and see them again.

Thx
J & K

reviews.author: patmarbar
reviews.title: This way to Paradise !!!
reviews.text:
This was our (Hubby and I 's )  second trip to the Dominican Republic and to be honest, I will only refer to this resort when recommending a vacation in the  DR (I am sure there are many other beautiful Resorts around, but it stops here for us ) . Staying at the Paradisus Palma Royal with Royal Service was one of the most luxuious vacations  my husband and I have ever experienced.  As many have stated on Trip Advisor, there was indeed a  nice mix of people - couples, Conference Groups, etc.....WE highly recommend the Royal Service -- adults only, excellent service, exclusive restaurants (along with 24 hour room service if you want to take it slow and enjoy a nice breakfast on your balcony ), butler service, beautiful rooms,  Roomy, comfy beach beds, private beach and pool -- definitely worth the splurge!! The beach and ocean were simply picturesque ! Our very friendly and always "available " beach waiter, Francisco Cabrera, pampered us daily reserving our favorite beds and towels  and keeping our thirst quenched with cold drinks! ...everytime my husband turned around to look for him, there he was walking towards us with 2 cold drinks......unreal !!! Also, Alexander Guzmanfria , our favorite waiter at Palazzo restaurant, was extremely obliging , and genuinely kind....I am a picky eater (Alexander, you remember me ? healthy omelett but add in the Amerian Cheese and Artichoke ? ) . The food (at all A la Cartes) , even the buffets, was top notch. .... We highly recommend  Palazzo, (for Breakfast & Dinner)..... Gabi Beach restaurant is Picture Post -Card Beautiful!!! (All meals at Gabi beach Resto are included in Royal Service). One thing I would change is: Given that we pay quite a substantial amount to get Royal service, it would have been nice if our butler would have listed off our perks rather than us having to do all the homework on what these perks are then having to solicit them ...( meaning, rather than me saying " I heard we are entitled to this...or that " ...it would have felt really special to hear " With your Royal Service, we are offering you this and that " after all, I am on vacation...I dont want to feel I missed out on something because I did not ask for it....Royal Service to me means : "never having to ask" because they already know :) 
Maria and Pat from Montreal

reviews.author: Brandy S
reviews.title: The Reserve is worth a little extra money!
reviews.text: First I want to start by saying that the Reserve was wonderful!  If you choose to stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana, be sure to stay at the Reserve.  I stayed at the regular part of the hotel for 4 nights for work, then switched to the Reserve for 5 more nights.  It was well worth the extra money!  The pool is less crowded and more quiet and the food at the Gabi club is so much better.  The personal concierge service is such a nice touch!  We stayed in building 39 and Fernando and Asia were absolutely magnificent!  They made our dinner reservations for us every evening and Asia even prepared a jacuzzi bath in our room for us.  The rooms are so much nicer as well.  The Reserve is only 6 years old, where as the rest of the resort is 17 years old.  We definitely felt pampered.  A couple of minor suggestions would be to have change machines for the guests, more trams (or more trams specifically for the Reserve), and to update the spa.  It is on the small side.  Overall, we had a great stay, and we are very particular!

reviews.author: Lori W
reviews.title: Beyond all expectations
reviews.text: When you book a trip, you never can be sure what to really expect when you get there. Paradisus Palma Real surpassed all our expectations. Luxurious resort, extremely friendly staff, delicious culinary. Beach is very clean. Just fabulous! The club house staff Angel & Yira did an amazing job of coordinating events and keeping the beach fun happening.  Also thanks to Apolinan at the check-in desk for his stellar service.  Highly recommend, especially for families.

reviews.author: Hkitb
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Fres Martes at room service was amazing and such a help. He brought me milk every night for my toddler and was always warm and accommodating. I highly recommend the resort the service and I want fres to get promoted ASAP ! Also the babysitting service was wonderful.

reviews.author: Krystal D D
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Excellent Service
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and we thoroughly enjoyed our experience at the Paradisus Palma Royal with Royal Service. We are two single female friends in our 40's and did not feel out of place, as we would in some resorts surrounded by all romantic couples or all families. There was a nice mix of people - couples, business groups and families. I highly recommend the Royal Service -- adults only, excellent service, exclusive restaurants, butler service, beautiful rooms, oh-so comfy beach beds, private beach and pool -- definitely worth the splurge!! The beach and ocean were simply gorgeous! Our very friendly and always smiling beach waiter, Francisco Cabrera, pampered us daily reserving our favorite palapa and keeping us happy with yummy drinks! Also, Alexander, our favorite waiter at Palazzo restaurant, was consistently very attentive and sweet. The food at every restaurant was excellent -- even the buffets. I cannot say the same about other all-inclusives I have visited. We highly recommend especially Palazzo, Vento and Gabi Beach restaurants, which were included in Royal Service. There were only a couple things in which we were disappointed. First, the check-in service for Royal Service took a ridiculous amount of time - approx. 2 hours in which we were sequestered in a room without open air while waiting for our check in process to be completed and have our butler arrive. We heard from other guests the same complaint. Secondly, we were recommended to Sunny C travel company (representatives at the excursion desk at our resort daily) for our Snorkeling and Dune Buggy excursions. The Marinarium Snorkeling excursion was to include stops at a coral reef, as well as swimming with sharks and stingrays. We were never taken to a coral reef to snorkel - very disappointing. And upon return, checking my Amex bill noticed we were charged $100 over what we were told for the 2 excursions!! Amex is disputing, so we'll see. Don't bother with this excursion - just take the short snorkel trip off the resort coast that's included in Royal Service at the resort dive center. It was short, but good. We also enjoyed our own excursion to the Indigenous Eyes Ecological Reserve. It was all nature -- not a tourist trap. Very beautiful lagoons and very peaceful. Royal Service included a free ride to the park. Word to the wise: bring small bills -- $1.00 and $5.00 for tipping -- change for big bills is really hard to come by!! You cannot get cash at the main desk -- only at the ATM, which only dispurses Dominican dollars, or the Exchange desk, which charges a large fee. All in all our trip to the Dominican was wonderful!

reviews.author: pepitocucurucho c
reviews.title: el mejor hotel que he disfrutado con diferencia
reviews.text: la verdad, es insuperable, nunca he visto nada igual en el caribe, la atención, el lujo, todo todo, pero por poner una pega fui con mi hija y mi mujer y la verdad, los niños se aburren un poco, creo que es mas de parejas.

reviews.author: Jorge-Geog
reviews.title: Muy buen resort, a pesar de estar algo masificado
reviews.text:
El mejor servicio, sin duda, lo recibimos de ciertas personas de la Recepción. Primeramente de la Gerente de Recepción Sra. Adriana Guzmán, quién tuvo la profesionalidad de contestar rápidamente a una petición que por correo le formulamos, antes de la llegada y sobre todo de la Srta. Josefina, quién nos atendió muy eficazmente al surgir un problema con una reserva para los dias siguientes en el Meliá Caribe Tropical, que si bien, el problema podía ser responsabilidad de la cadena Meliá ó Paradisus, és lo mismo, ello no quita mérito al buen hacer de dicha recepcionista.
En cuanto a mencionar algunos de los servicios utilizados, el Bufet bastante bueno, el restaurante Japonés muy bien, aunque tuvimos que esperar bastante tiempo sobre la hora reservada. Falta de espacio a la sombra en la playa, debido a la saturación de público y un buen Gym. Las actividades nocturnas, los pocos dias que las atendimos, muy buenas.
Aunque no estuvimos en el Servicio Real, su personal de recepción, especialmente un chico que no recordamos su nombre, nos ayudó eficazmente ante un problema surgido con nuestra empresa y precisábamos escanear y firmar unos documentos.

reviews.author: ChefBea
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation!
reviews.text: we thoroughly enjoyed this resort. A big shout out to our family concierge Ovidio as he took great care of us!! The resort is large but very walkable although there are shuttles. The food was fabulous and the drinks great as well. If you can swing it, book in the Reserve...it's worth it.

reviews.author: Jo E
reviews.title: Lovely Resort and Friendly Staff
reviews.text:
This was my first all inclusive resort visit.  A fantastic choice - we were greeted by cold towels and native drinks upon arrival.  The view from the lobby to the ocean was awesome.  We enjoyed the attentiveness of the staff, especially the room service provided by Espiritu.  Special efforts were made to make our trip memorable.  Thank you Espiritu !

Yes, I would definitely recommend this resort.  It is huge with varied meal choices on the property.  Our room was huge and clean.  Just be prepared to speak slowly, as English is not easily understood by all staff.  However, everyone's aim was to please the customer.  A traveler can not ask more than that from a resort.   Loved it!

reviews.author: TracyG455
reviews.title: Service ....it really makes a trip!!
reviews.text:
Earlier this month, I had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus Punta Cana where I was impressed with the customer service. Knowing 2 weeks later, I would staying at the Palma Real, I was not sure that this sister resort could live up to the high standard set at the Punta Cana Paradisus.  Well, pleasantly surprised, it did!!

The rooms were beautliful and clean...and it was lovely to be wrapped up in nice soft sheets.

The food never dissappointed. It was fresh with alot of variety!

The beach was lovely and we were always able to find chairs with sun or shade at any time of the day.

The only thing I think can be fixed was the WiFi access points....though not really the point of being on vacation and checking work emails.... :)  It did make we relax.

Due to some techincal issues, our Royal Service cell phone never worked unfortunately but it did not impact my vacation in any way....

I would return for sure...but tough to decide whether its to the Punta Cana site or the Pamla Real....

reviews.title: Excelente Resort
reviews.text: Pace un fin de semana con mi familia y la pasamos de maravilla fue una esperiencia inolvidable el servicio es muy bueno, la comida exquisita berdaderamente fue impresionante. Las habitaciones comodas, los baños lindicimo, las picinas deliosas fuimos a descansar de lo agotado del trabajo y balio la pena porque bolvimos a casa renovados. Mando una felicitacion general a pedro luis reyez por el excelente servicio que nos ofrecio ami y a mi familia muchas gracias.Les deseo que Dios bendiga al dueño y a los que trabajan en este hotel que sigan prosperando para que sigan ofreciendoles a los viajeros el excelente servicio que ofrecen. Dios los bendiga.

reviews.author: pedro luis r
reviews.title: Excelente Room service...el mejor de todo punta cana
reviews.text: Lo único que diré es que llame a probar Room service para ver si todos lo que dicen en esta pagina es verdad y créanme es poco lo que se dice aquí comparado con lo que ellos verdaderamente te hacen sentir...créanme si vas a parAdisus palma real y no llamas a Room service no has tenido unas completas vacaciones; desde Bertoldo y Sergio, hasta Nicolás y Pedro son todos profesionales incluyendo a Cristian, la fle,Jonathan y todos los demás volveré solo por ellos.....goob Job guys

reviews.author: Christine D
reviews.title: "Outstanding resort with fantastic service"
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a lovely resort! The rooms are lovely, the grounds and landscaping are breathtaking and of course the view of the surrounding ocean is spectacular. Above all is the excellence in service coupled with the sweet hospitality of the Dominican people. We would return to the Paradisus again and again so that we could enjoy the kind services of Tiburcio De Pena 
(our personal butler),  Pedro Reyes, who brought us our coffee every morning, Billy Levons and Francisco who assisted us continually by the beach and pool with drinks, towels, chairs etc. These young men are gifted in their gifts of hospitality and service and are assets to this outstanding resort. Bravo for selecting these men to contribute to the success of this establishment. We hope to return and we will specifically ask for them by name next time.

reviews.author: CarlosdeSouzaSilva
reviews.title: Férias em família!
reviews.text:
Estive em abril 2013, indicação da RCI. Excelente hotel, meus filhos aproveitaram bastante a semana que por lá estivemos. O pessoal é super simpático e atencioso. Os nossos concierges, Malvis, Alberto Ruiz. No bar da piscina o sempre atencioso De Greccia.
Desde o café da manhã nossa família foi tratada como Reis e Princípes. 
A suíte maravilhosa com tudo que tinhamos direito e ainda mais um pouco. Os restaurantes no jantar, cada um mais saboroso que o outro, curtimos comida mexicana, caribenha, frutos do mar  que delícia de lagosta no Gabi Beach, parabenizo ao mestre da cozinha. Não posso esquecer do Vento. Todos com cardápio para as crianças.
Foi tão bom que estou fazendo parte da famìlia Meliá e já agendei um retorno para janeiro/2015.
Agradeço a atenção de todos os funcionarios do hotel, sempre com sorriso na face e quando falavamos que somos brasileiros a alegria aumentava. 
Agradeço a atençao do Jorge e do Angelo, do Club Meliá. E em especial ao Alberto, já citado acima. Detalhe, só falo o portugues e isto não foi empecilho em me comunicar com todos.

reviews.author: Antonio S
reviews.title: R.D vacation
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience, the staff is excellent. Special thanks to Mr. Wander Martinez, restaurant manager @ the Reserve restaurants. Also special thanks to Lorenzo, main bartender @ Gabi bar. 
The only problem the hotel has , the resort area is so large that you need to be transported and the trams they have are not the best in the world, the equipment is not very good, you fell that is like transporting cattle and sometimes you have to wait a long time for the tram to arrive. Too bad they do not address this problem which leaves you with a bad taste in your memory.

reviews.author: Amaia C
reviews.title: Sólo una persona de todo el staff nos prestó atención
reviews.text:
Sábado 8 de septiembre. Llegamos a The Reserve Punta Cana donde habíamos reservado y ¡CERRADO!. 
El hotel nos ofrece un Servicio Real en el Paradisus Punta Cana que queda lejos de nuestras expectativas y lo contratado. Pasados tres días después de varias quejas a distintos empleados del hotel dimos con un señor llamado Silvio Lantigua que solucionó eficiententemente el problema apenas 30 minutos después. 
The Reserve es un concepto totalmente diferente al hotel normal, es incluso mucho mejor que un Royal Service en un Paradisus. Lo digo porque hemos estado alojados en los dos regímenes y la diferencia es de tener en cuenta. 
Gracias a la ayuda de este señor, que gestionó rápidamente nuestra reubicación en The Reserve Palma Real tuvimos unas de las mejores vacaciones de nuestras vidas. 
Agradecidos por su interés quisimos darle una propina que rechazó diciendo que si la aceptaba se perdía la esencia de su trabajo. Muchos profesionales deberían aprender de él. 
Desde aquí mi más sincero agradecimiento.

reviews.author: maradel2117
reviews.title: Like walking into Paradise
reviews.text: After enduring a long, cold winter in Cleveland, OH, stepping onto the grounds of Paradisus Palma Real, on April 12th,  was a dream come true.  Elegance, beauty, great service and sun. Pictures on the internet do not do this place justice. Can only describe it as a "palace".  Royal service is so wonderful.  Many thanks to our butler, Nicolas who helped make this vacation so special.  His professionalism and kindness is much appreciated.  Also, Luiz and Gloria at the poolside bar were fantastic!  Our ocean view from room 2117 was spectacular.  Many thanks to all the staff for making this vacation so wonderful!

reviews.author: dbnewyork_13
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - but don't go for the food
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve with concierge service.  Grounds are very well kept and the concierge service is attentive and helpful.  Our concierge was Yeuri and he was helpful but not overly intrusive.  Made a wonderful bubble bath for the kids and also provided other special in room amenities each night.
Warning:  if you have airport transfers included in your package, make sure not to get guided by the taxi drivers at the airport aware from the check in desk.  They will try to convince you they provide the service and then make you pay [and say you can get reimbursed when you get to the hotel]
Food:  The food at Paradisus is just average.  Vento [Reserve only] is likely the best.  The buffets have a good variety, but not enough of the proteins/entrees are grilled on an open grill - they are all doused in oil on a traditional grill top. Don't expect much and you won't be disappointed.  Reservations are not difficult to get if you use your concierge and are flexible with times.  
The trams around the campus are a difficult at times to get but nothing is more than a 10-15min walk.  And you do need to confirm activities with your concierge or the activities/entertainment team b/c otherwise things will not start on time [or start at all].  Make sure to reserve snorkeling at least 24 hours in advance.  It does book up.  Best activity of the week?  Finger Painting!  Its really a landscape acrylic painting exercise and the teacher is hilarious.
Spa:  Disappointing.  The dressing room/showers are very small . . . and you have to walk through the lobby to get to the treatment rooms.  Normally this is not a big deal . . .but I was not very comfortable walking through in my robe one day when the lobby was filled with men/women from a large bridal party.   If you get an outdoor treatment room, beware of street noise and trucks using the service road.  This is something they really need to remedy.
Entertainment:  Fun shows nightly  . . . . its not Vegas . . . but for families it is great --- though they do not start until 10pm.  If you time your dinners around 7:45-8:15pm it can work out perfectly.
Pool and Beach chairs do take some planning.  Your concierge can reserve them for you --- our if you are out by 8am you will not have an issue.  If you see a chair with just a towel [no personal item on it] for 30 min -take it [or ask staff to help]
Agree on other postings that the walls are paper thin.  However, I found our building to be very quiet after 10pm.  But pre-dinner, felt like I was in our neighbors room the TV was so loud.  
One other note . .  it can be loud with music at the beach and at dinner, depending on location.  If you want it quiet, you may need to seek out the more low key locations.

reviews.author: Alvarovilla
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en una convención de la compañía donde trabajo. La experiencia fue espectacular. Las instalaciones, el personal, la alimentación y sus playas...espectaculares.
El personal fue amable en todo momento. La alimentación a la altura de este hotel

reviews.author: Cristina A
reviews.title: Beyond an EXCELLENT adult getaway
reviews.text: This was just a dream come true. We booked the royal service and it was more than what we ever expected. Our butler Juere (Jerry) was extremely helpful and professional the entire time. He made the experience so wonderful, surprising us with decor and treats in our room each day, booking dinner reservations for us, and handling any minor aspect, question and concern. In addition all staff memebers were very pleased to help and serve us. The food was great and having such private access to the pool and beach made this even better. Def would return!

reviews.author: K4BAMA
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, definitely recommend the Royal Service as this added so much to our experience. Agustin Nunez was our butler and he far exceeded our expectations. He set up all our dining reservations, drew 2 romantic whirlpool baths, surprising us each time, made our golf and scuba reservations, had our bali bed at the pool set up each day, and was always ready to assist and serve us and make our vacation special. Richard Ortiz in Palazzo, Laura, and Symartin (spelling?) were a pleasure and always took great care of us again trying to make our vacation as nice as possible. At the Royal Service Sunset Bar, Wilkin Mejia the bartender was outstanding, always remembering what we liked as was Billy at the pool. Even though the restaurant Passion was extra, it was well worth the money. Also enjoyed Vento and breakfast and lunch at Palazzo. The nightly entertainment is wonderful, especially the Cirque de Soleil. All in all a wonderful time!

reviews.author: Bill W
reviews.title: We Will Be Back Every Year
reviews.text:
Jean and I spent 3 months in a condo in the Bavaro area.  As a "treat", we decided to go to the Paradisus Palma Real (PPR) for 3 nights in April.  We have stayed at 3 other resorts over the last 5 years in the area.  Of them all, including the Reserve at Paradisus PR, this was by far our favorite.  There were things that could have made our stay a 5 star one of course and I will mention those as I write the review along with the things that will have us returning again and again.

I need hip surgery now that I am home, so while we were there, a wheelchair was needed to be able to get around this expansive resort.  One of the young men at Guest Services made that happen.  All of the chairs at PPR were taken, but he went out of his way and called a friend at another resort and managed to get him to lend us a chair for our stay!  Without it, I would have been in a real bind.  I only wish we had written his name down since he was off the rest of the time we were there.

The front desk staff made sure we had a very nice room close to the buffet and beach.  The room was great with an excellent bed, TV, safe, and plenty of room to spread out and a patio with a beautiful garden view.  The downsides to the room were the wrought-iron chair backs on the patio (super hard and uncomfortable) and the fact that the mini-bar was stocked with 2 beers only.

The beach is outstanding as everyone mentions.  And in my case, it was accessible because the PPR took the effort to build a boardwalk on the beach that led to a large deck for handicapped folks with 4 lounge chairs under a huge palapa.  Without that I don't see how I would have gotten that far down onto the sand.

The pool is huge and a happening place.  At the pool bar, one of the bartenders, Gloria, made our visits the best they could be.  She was right on top of your order and makes a seriously great coco loco according to Jean.  My cerveza was always ready as soon as she saw me wheeling up to the bar.

As for activities, the staff were seemingly all over the place getting folks involved in volleyball and dance lessons, etc.  It was our pleasure to meet Rudolpho.  He went out of his way to talk to everyone!  He took special notice of us and we spent a great deal of time talking to him about many topics.  His English was perfect, but more on that later.  If you go, make sure you look him up (though you may not have to look too hard) and I guarantee you will not regret it if you are looking for things to do at the resort.

Another staff member who was invaluable to us was Hugo.  Hugo is one of the folks who makes sure your stay is the best and assists you in anyway possible.  Part of his job is to schedule folks for the presentation on the time shares through the Melia guest services.  That consists of a 90 minute tour of the resort and then details on buying into the deal.  But it also comes with a day pass to the private beach (Gabi) for the folks at the Reserve and a free dinner reservation at one of the specialty restaurants that are exclusive to the Reserve.

Hugo went out of his way to help Jean get antibiotics delivered from a local pharmacy.  He set us up with reservations, made sure that our mini-bar was stocked with more than the 2 beers, and spent time with us talking about the DR and answering questions we had about different areas of the country and other issues.  He was a truly great person to meet.

Now to the food.  The buffet was better than any we've been to.  The food was all labeled which is not the norm.  While it is nearly impossible to keep the trays hot, the food was always above warm and the choices were many.  Each night spotlighted a different special selection.  One night it was roast turkey which was excellent; another NY strip.  We ate at the Italian restaurant, Ventu ( I think), one night and I prefer the buffet actually.  I ordered the chicken in tomato sauce with mashed potatoes.  The chicken and sauce were totally dried out to the point that it was more a tomato paste than a sauce.  And the mashed potatoes, while good, were warm at best and the serving size was about 1 1/2 tablespoons.  There were no vegetables with the entree.  I left very hungry.  Jean ordered the fish and was a bit happier but agreed there was no need to return.

Then there is the "casino" if you can call it that.  2 years ago, we came to the Reserve and went to the PPR casino.  In fact friends of ours that own a condo in Bavaro often came to the casino as it is open to the public. Easily 1/2 the machines (and there are not that many) were out of service.  Getting a drink took patience and actually standing up and flagging one of the 2 waitresses down.  If you win or want to simply move to a different machine you have to flag down one of the attendants since the machines do not dispense money or vouchers despite indicating that they do.  So you call the guy over, sign a form and then he takes it to the cashier and brings you back your money. Then you start all over at another machine if you can deal with the hassle.  I personally met 3 people who were playing that took their money and left saying the place was a joke.

Because it is very unusual in our experiences over the years, I have to mention that the vast majority of staff who work in the resort, other than the cleaning and garden staff, spoke fair to great English.  Never seen that anywhere else.  It is their country and we try our best to speak Spanish as much as we can given our limited vocabulary, so it was an enormous help to us and we sincerely appreciated the effort they took to learn English.  (It is our understanding that the Melia, which Paradisus is a part of) offers free language classes to their staff !!!!).

So after a long review, I close by saying we had a wonderful experience all in all and that it was especially enhanced by the staff and specifically, Hugo, Rudolpho and Gloria.  We hope to see them again next year.

reviews.author: Paulo F
reviews.title: Decepção Total
reviews.text:
Algo estranho acontece no hotel: a maioria dos funcionários faz questão de ser desagradável, com bem vindas exceções, padrão que não se aplica a nenhum dos outros 3 hotéis que nos hospedamos em Punta Cana, durante o mês de abril / 2013.
        Além disso, é muito desagradável a segregação imposta pelo tal do club Meliá e Royal Service. A maioria dos lugares na praia, os melhores restaurantes e até algumas piscinas são exclusivas aos hóspedes dos dois programas. Para quem não entendeu, nós, hópedes comuns, temos que nos digladiar para conseguir um lugar na sombra, já que se você aparecer na praia ou piscina às 7 da manhã em busca de uma cadeira, perceberá um fato curioso: 90% das cadeiras estão reservadas pela quantidade ilimitada de toalhas distribuídas aos hóspedes. Fontes me confirmaram que alguns funcionários da área da piscina, em troca de algo como 10 dólares,  fazem o trabalho de reservar cadeiras e principalmente as famosas cabanas familiares. Em 7 noites lá não consegui aproveitar nenhuma....
        Desde o momento do check in, um “concierge” cuida de suas reservas nos restaurantes. Na verdade, tudo é desculpa pra lhe empurrarem uma reunião na empresa Club Melia. Pra ajudar o simpático moço, você se compromete a ceder pelo menos 90 minutos de seu tempo (US$ 56,25, se considerarmos que paguei  US$ 400,00 por noite). Achei a proposta ABSURDA, mas que cada um forme sua própria opinião. Detalhe: para entendermos bem o que estavam nos oferecendo, levamos pelo mais de 2 horas – confirmamos mais tarde que a maioria das pessoas não entende bem o que lhes é oferecido, principalmente porque nem todos os vendedores falam bem o português. 
        A comida é boa para o que nós, brasileiros, estamos acostumados nos resorts brasileiros, mas MUITO abaixo do padrão de Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Sara H
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had the Royal Service package, worth all the money. Amazing grounds, beautiful beach and the locals are super friendly.
From the minute we arrived we felt like VIP's:) Food was great, service even better.
Special shout out to HAMLET ROSA, he was our waiter at Aqua restaurant, he was one of the nicest guys and made our dinner a true experience.
We travel a lot, but this resort is by far one of the best places to go to and we are thinking of going back this year!
Thanks Paradisus for an amazing vacation!!!!!

reviews.author: Maria D
reviews.title: Super schönen Urlaub gehabt!
reviews.text:
Ich war rundum zufrieden mit allem! 

Deshalb mache ich es kurz, denn alles einzeln zu erwähnen, was ich toll fand, würde zu viel Zeit in Anspruch nehmen...

Das Personal war spitze - die Service Kräfte im Naos waren immer super (v.a.Oscar Polanco) und auch die Animateure/innen waren toll (v.a. Angel)! 

Aber am allerliebsten war mir Luis, der Barkeeper von der Poolbar - sehr liebenswerter Mensch!

Kann einen Aufenthalt im Paradisus Palma Real nur wärmstens empfehlen!

Und unbedingt an den kostenlosen Yoga- und Pilateskursen bei Edison teilnehmen!
War mit das Beste am ganzen Urlaub!

reviews.author: Cris0308
reviews.title: Mucho más de lo esperado!
reviews.text:
Debo reconocerme como una persona muy exigente y con gran agrado me he visto sorprendida gratamente durante nuestra estadía en Abril.
Más allá del hotel en sí que es muy lindo, lo que debo destacar y resaltar es la calidez humana con que nos han tratado.
Mi hijo más pequeño es celíaco (alérgico al gluten) y Mikel Rodeiro (Cheff Ejecutivo de The Reserve) se convirtió en su cheff personal. Cada día lo sorprendían con algo especial (galletitas, helados, papas fritas). Fue increíble su atención, su calidez, su profesionalismo y su servicio abocado al pequeño, como así también de las personas que lo acompañaban: Ambioris, Wander y Silverio. La verdad, no tengo más de AGRADECIMIENTOS porque nos hemos sentido de maravillas! Infinitas GRACIAS!
Debo destacar también la calidez, la sonrisa y el profesionalismo de Dhoralix (recepción de The Reserve), quien personalmente nos hizo las reservas de toda nuestra estadía en todos los restaurantes. Muy profesional! da gusto encontrarse con gente así.
Los niños estaban encantados con el servicio de playa y adoraban escuchar el ¨drinking-drinking) de Ramón y Maiker, como también los licuados de María, que según mi hija… hace los mejores licuados del mundo!!!
Respecto del hotel: amplias habitaciones, muy lindas y confortables. Si me permiten un consejo de mejora: prestaría más atención a los detalles de mantenimiento y limpieza. Si bien estaban muy ordenadas y limpias, había pequeños detalles que se podían mejorar.
Los mejores restaurantes: Vento y Gabi Club.
Realmente vale la pena pagar la diferencia y alojarse en The Reserve. Los beneficios: ambiente exclusivo, atención personalizada, comida más selecta que en los demás restaurantes de Paradisus, ambiente familiar e increíble piscina, además de tener un lugar exclusivo en la playa.
Gracias por todo! 
Gracias y reconocimientos especiales para Mikel y Dhoralix)

reviews.author: Barb B
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: I had just gotten back from Paradisus Palma Real.  We had a wonderful week.  Great weather and beautiful beaches and pools.  I have a few people who performed exceptional service during our stay.  Fred Martes was a wonderful room service employee.  He was very attentive and went way beyond our expectations!  We will miss him. Nicoles in Room Service also was great.  I also want to recognize Vitaly at the spa.  I had a wonderful massage.  Gloria at the poolside bar was very sweet and friendly and took special care of my group.  Fabio and Roberto made our experience so much fun.  They were great at teaching salsa dancing and the other activities that were offered,  The room was beautiful and clean as was the beautiful resort.  I would love to come back.

reviews.author: GreatG77
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Looks just like the pictures
reviews.text:
The Palma Real is paradise when you arrive.  Key is when you arrive, the whole airport, customers, tourist card, etc. is controlled chaos at it's best.  Once you arrive you will quickly forget about it all though and your worries will subside for the most part.  This depends on where your room is located.  Be prepared to walk a LOT depending on the room location.  We were in the Royal Service so had an excellent location, minutes from the dining options, pool, and beach.  That was room 3003, nice ocean view and view of the pool.
We were here for a friends destination wedding.  Many others had far walks back to the hotel, beach, food, etc. a solid 15 minute walk each time.  
The drinks were good, bartenders and service was excellent.  The drinks do seem watered down, but you can avoid that by drinking wine, beer, or giving good tips.  Everyone has mentioned all the good employees, Ramon, Fabio, etc. 
The biggest negative was the food 8 out of 12 people in our small sub group got sick at some point during the trip and we were only there for 4 days.  The food was very bland, dull, tasteless, unappetizing.  Typically with buffets, free endless food and drinks you would think you would gain a lot of weight, well I lost 5 pounds and I'm average weight by all means.
There are good activities through out the day, aerobics, volleyball, painting, exercises, etc. Plenty of cabana's, beach chairs, and hammocks to go around.  It is nice not having to rush to the beach or pool out of fear for not getting a spot to sit, the hotel was completely booked and we never had an issue getting a spot where we wanted.
The kids zone is fun and of course great for the kids, however, you will either walk 25 minutes or just take a quick shuttle (golf cart) ride.  
The casino is the smallest one I have ever been in but gets the job done.  About 6 tables and 20 slot machines, and most in our party that played did fairly well so can't complain.  
We did do snorkeling and that was a great experience more so due to our guide the extra activities.  Hopped in a small boat that he let us drive, took us to a natural pool/lagoon/party area and hung out there for awhile then hopped back in and drove near the coral reef.  The actual fish and snorkeling was not that great, nothing compared to other places, particularly Mexico, but it was still fun and definitely worth the $35. 
Can't really say had a favorite restaurant, since they were all mediocre at best.  The hibachi was decent, Vento was decent, Mole was horrible, Naos and Market Grill were consistently mediocre.  Room service breakfast was one of the better meals.  Besides the lobster tails that we had for the wedding the next best meal was Wendy's at Punta Cana airport.
The nightlife is decent, mostly have two options, the lobby bar and a small lounge/club Red Room.
Overall it was fun, not as relaxing as I would've liked, but that was in part due to our large group and always having to do something, along with travelling with a 3 year old.  
Not sure if I would return, for the money there are a lot of other options.  Please feel free to reach out to me with any questions.

reviews.author: bessy a
reviews.title: not sure what you are looking for
reviews.text:
enjoyed every thing during my vacation, service laked. It was not so bad for me personally, with the exception of a minor item that they couldnt get right until the day before going home, I did get an apology from Pedro Reyes, followed by a cheese try, wine and chocolate covered strowberry, it was nice of him, however, there was no shortage of food and drinks provided in our trip. but I did appreciate his effort.
I have no complains about the maintenance of my room, with the exception of shortage in wash and hand towels. but that was corrected most of the time.
Other people in our group had very bad experience in maintenance of their rooms, there was time when the room was not clean, beds were not made for 3 days.

reviews.author: Silvia S
reviews.title: LINDAS VACACIONES
reviews.text:
Quería agradecer la atención brindada por la concierge SUGELIS, una excelente persona que se encargo que nuestra estadía fuera estupenda, nos realizo la reserva en los Restaurantes del hotel, en el horario solicitado y todo lo que le pedimos lo cumplió a la perfección.
También quería destacar la excelente calidez que recibimos por parte del Sr. RAMON FUEGO, la Sra.GLORIA RODRIGUEZ en el bar de la pileta son excepcionales tanto ellos como todos los chicos que los acompañan. 
Muy buena la comida de todos los restaurantes y de las personas que atienden en los mismos, todos muy amables y atentos a las necesidades de sus clientes.
En el Restaurant PASSION quería destacar la atención de la Srta.LAURA CASTLLLO y del chico que nos atendió del cual no recuerdo el nombre ya que no es muy común, pero los dos se desvivieron en en la atención y en hacernos sentir especiales.
Fueron unas vacaciones inolvidables,

reviews.author: Bruce R
reviews.title: Great Vacation Spot and especially great staff
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed from April 7th to the 14th and had truely great vacation thanks to Massiel Molina the Concerge of Villa 38. She insured we had a great time. In fact all the staff, location and facilities were first rate. We would return again.

reviews.author: lotsalove123
reviews.title: Good time in Royal Service
reviews.text:
Had a great time March 29th to April 4th at Paradisus Palma Real.
I think the upgrade to Royal Service made the vacation. My wife and I got into a nice routine circulating between our ocean view room, to the reserved pool area, onto the private beach area, into the concierge area, into the Royal Service restaurant- (Palazo) -Spa right there, Gym nearby....
etc, etc... I could have been happy just in that area.  It was nice to have the rest of hotel to hit restaurants, bar and explore, but needed it less and less as trip went on! 
The staff overall in areas was great, but especially good in my areas. 
My Butler Nicholas was great.... (the wife and I liked the bath set-up a couple of nights!

Also of note, whole staff at Palazo was great- ( Richard Ortis, Yeuris, Laura...) 
Billy Levons by the pool was great help and gave outstanding service....
Cristian Ortiz Pacheco did nice job..

Loved the staff at conciege area- helping to grab drinks, snacks, etc...

Would redo carpet in there, getting a little old.
Was not a fan of the guys walking around trying to get time share meetings set up.
The free wine was pretty good- but not as good as I usually drink - especiallt the redwine, as soem were undrinkable..   So I had to buy a few bottles while out dining.  Next time I would bring a few of my favorites.   ( no I not a wine snob- i just like decent wine) 
The resturant where you pay 50.00 each person to eat ( forget the name):  well, the  staff was great!  The food was too "gourmet" - very small portions and some odd things! 

Overall- great time- very nice place...

reviews.author: kpalms
reviews.title: Pretty perfect Paradisus
reviews.text:
Just got back from PPR, a lovely place. My review is colored by the fact that I have leg pain. The property is not handicapped-friendly. Only a few buildings have elevators and, although there are golf carts, many are used to ferry guests back and forth from the Reserve, which is far from the beach, or Royal Service guests.
