That said, we did get rides a few times and could have moved to a closer building. I decided not to since our building looked out on a palm-filled garden area that faced Secrets Royal Beach. Loved looking at the palm fronds every day. We were in a RCI timeshare in Bld. 38. If I go back and still have leg pain, I'll pay $70. more a night for Royal Service, which probably would have gotten me more rides!
The rest is good!! The condo was beautiful. Kitchen, LR with sleep sofa, on one side, bedroom and bath on other. Bedroom looked out onto lanai with patio table and chairs. King bed next to wall with wood louver blinds separating the bed from the two person jacuzzi. Two sinks next to tub, and separate bathroom with shower, sink, and toilet. Lots of marble. Immaculate condo. The kitchen had a full refrigerator, a sink, cabinets, but no microvave or silverware or plates. We just put leftovers and silverware in frig and maid didn't touch them.  8-10 bottles water, cokes, sprites, Presidente beers, left in frig daily. Called RS once when maid forgot waters. Room service is free so we ordered RS almost every day. Breakfast would be omlettes, rolls, plate of bacon, sliced fruit plate, etc. We had both red merlot and white chardonnay sent up for appetizers with a cheese plate and rolls. Watched very funny French comedies on TV. Only a few English channels, but you're not there to watch TV, are you? Maid service plus turndown service included. We were RCI members, so had use of all restaurants except Gabi Beach and Passion and Palazzo. Went to timeshare presentation, so were given a Gabi Beach dinner. Ordered lobster, which was served at Naos seafood buffet the next night. Sadly overcooked at both Gabi and buffet. They grill the lobsters, then regrill to warm up. Would suggest boiling for a very short time, 3 min, then grilling to order. Order the Gabi Beach chocolate mousse cake, best dessert we had. Food and waiters and hostesses at Naos buffet, all great. Had the cerviche bar most lunches, ate lobster cerviche 4 times: WONDERFUL! Octopus, conch, and fish cerviche delicious. Full salad bar, huge wheels of parmesan, grilled fish or meat. Desserts from chocolate cake to flan to ice cream. Did not eat at  Passion restaurant. Had Thai at Bana one night: appetizers and salads great, curry chicken OK. If you order the hot spicy dishes, be prepared for the habinero peppers. Vento had tender beef filets, but veal shank just OK, tasted like pot roast. Aqua best food: nice tender steak and grilled salmon. Was told Mexican fair, so did not eat there. Mizu Teppanyaki had average Japanese, tons of food, nice show by chefs. About the dress code: women can wear dresses or capris, flip flops. Men have to wear long pants and closed shoes to go to Passion, Vento, Palazzo (royal service only) and Aqua. Dress shorts OK at Gabi Beach, Naos buffet, Bana, Mole, and can't remember about Mizu. Think shorts OK. You can eat all day long if you want to! If ordering pina coladas, which tasted like no alcohol in them at all, ask for a shot of Brugal dark rum. About towels and beach chairs: The palappas vary in height so sometimes there is a thatch roof only 3 feet from your head so you are totally covered, others are taller, like a regular beach umbrella. We didn't get out till noon everyday, but found lots of chairs available under palappas or palm trees. Lots of towels available, no cards required. Pool bar had drinks, also waiters come around to beach chairs. Tipped $1/per visit to bar and to waiters. Tipped $3 to lunch waiters, $5-8 to dinner waiters, $5 to maids daily plus more on last day, $10 to masseuse, plus tips to porters, cab drivers, etc. Spent about $40 each way for cab, $50 maids, about $20-25/day waiters and bartenders, about $250. total. The employees depend on tips to live on. If you are spending 2000, what is another 200 more? Please tip generously. ATM's in lobby, $3 service charge per transaction. Also, in airport arrivals, need $10/per person for tourist card. Timeshares are in points. Need 38K for PPR wk/high season/ go every other year/50 years. Cost is  about $1/point, so $40K plus $1100/ year SERVICE fee plus $115/per person AI fee, if go to AI resort. We thought this was too much. The timeshare market is depressed now. We paid $145/per person/ per night plus our RCI exchange, which costs us about $500/yr. Met some people who got packages and paid about 175/night. If you add the 38K plus 1100/yr for 25 weeks, plus interest, you are paying about 4000/wk. Twice what we paid. Do not buy!!!!! Sign up for a Melia Rewards membership before you go so that your AI money will get points. You can use points for nights at Melia hotels all over the world. Bring your number and make sure it is credited. Find the VIP lounge or call from your room.
About reservations: If you are given a seating at 6 and you want one at 8, call back after 3:30 and you'll get it. Dinner reservations 9-5 only. Had a great massage. Had $15 coupon, ask at reception or VIP for one, so got 50 min for $115. Went into large hot and small cold pools after very relaxing massage. Husband went on zip line: 7:20 am to 12:30 pm, said was very safe, bring lunch, got panninis from snack bar the day before. Bring: dozen lg. zip bags for frig, suntan lotion: at least half bottle/day/2 people, hats, flipflops, books, passports, alarm clock or cell ( many power outs, called operator to get time at least twice/day), insulated mugs with tops for drinks, $150 in $1 and $5's, $100 in $10's for tips and cab and tourist cards. Pack lotions and shampoo in zip lock bags for flight. Plan on bathing suits and coverups for day, so don't need lots of clothes. Have fun!!!! GO!!!

reviews.author: rjrodriguezds
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: We visited in August to test-run the resort for our wedding (which is this week!). Other than some initial hiccups with our reservation and room (front desk gave us the wrong room), service and food was superb. The personal attention from Bolivar, Massiel, and Ramón helped make this an unforgettable stay! Even the executive team (Laura and Mr. Torres) were very hands on and treated us like kings! We are really excited to be returning!

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.title: A wonderful vacation
reviews.text: We just returned from five lovely days at the Paradisus in Punta Cana.  The beach is spectacular, the three pools are warm and there is plenty of space to lounge.  The food was very good, as was the service.  We were disappointed by two things:  one, the Wifi service and two, the music.  It was very difficult to get online at the Paradisus.  I had to keep wandering around with my device, trying to pick up a signal.  At times, it would connect, only to disappear almost immediately.  Very frustrating.  Secondly, the music was an irritant.  At this hotel, speakers in the shape of rocks are scattered everywhere--Gabi beach, the paths to and from the rooms, etc.  The music is a type of lyricless house music that NEVER ends.  Actually, they turn it off at 11:00 p.m. and start it up at 8:00 a.m.  On the second morning of our stay, I just wanted to sleep in, but was unable to due to the very loud music that was being played directly below our balcony.  On the Sunday, a DJ played at Gabi beach ALL day long.  It was impossible to get away from it.  We just couldn't understand why they thought this would be relaxing.  I am all for having some zones where music is played (but it's time for them to get a new selection--it's not 2002 anymore...), but there should be some quiet zones where people can simply enjoy the sounds of the waves, or silence.

reviews.author: 760DanielleS
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely amazing!! I honestly do not have one complaint.  The people were all extremely nice and helpful and the food was GREAT (which is always a concern of mine at an all-inclusive place).  Our butler Nicholas was also great went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we could possibly want.  Everything at the resort was always clean and well kept!! The ladies in the Royal Service lounge just to mention a few Diana, Kathia, and Rosy were also AMAZING!!! They truly went above and beyond to help me when I made a error with my reservation, but some how they fixed it!!!! We are soo excited to go back there in Sept. to have our wedding at this resort because it was that GOOD!!!! I would definitely recommend this resort to my friends and family, and cant wait to come back with them all in Sept!!

reviews.author: Jamie P
reviews.title: The best vacation ever
reviews.text: Tia was the best vacation we have ever had.  Pedro Reyes was an excellent server and took care of our needs.  He went out of his way to make us feel very special. I strongly recommend royal service. It is the best experience we have ever had.  It was simply awesome.

reviews.author: Ulises M
reviews.title: Cuidado al realizar pagos con tarjeta de credito
reviews.text:
Estuve en Paradisus Punta Cana The Reserve el pasado mes de Diciembre, durante mi estancia realice una reserva para una cena romantica frente a la playa para el día viernes, pagando por adelantado con tarjeta dicho servicio, los ineptos la programaron para el jueves, el dia viernes al preguntar porque no me habían mandado la carta de confirmación me dicen que ya perdi la reserva pues era para un día antes, es decir el jueves, revisaron y contactaron al personal involucrado y se concluyo que fue un error del personal, me piden disculpas y me dicen que el cargo no se realizará a mi tarjeta.
Al finalizar mi estancia efectivamente esta restada esa cantidad de mi cuenta total, sin embargo días posteriores me hacen el cargo, TRAMPOSAMENTE ya que estoy fuera del país de regreso en mi lugar de origen. 
Levanto la aclaración ante la institución bancaria y durante la investigación el Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana envía un voucher firmado por la cantidad y un texto donde argumenta que es un cargo por "cena Romantica" el cual es un Servicio queme brindaron. Lo cual es Totalmente FALSO!. 
Despues de 3 meses en los queel Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana insiste en su mentira, envié correo al area de calidad y de esta manera ahora me explican que en realidad fue un cargo que se les paso cobrarme, que no corresponde a la cena sino a varios cargos que por ERROR nuevamente de ellos no me cobraron y que se les hizo facil ingresar el cobro del servicio que no me brindaron.

CUIDADO!! ES GENTE QUE ACTUA DE MALA FE Y JUSTIFICA SU INEPTITUD AFECTANDO A LOS CLIENTES.

ademas de que durante su estancia LOS HOSTIGARAN PARA QUE ADQUIERAN UNA DICHOSA MEMBRESIA. cON LO QUE SEGURAMENTE OBTENDRAN DATOS BANCARIOS Y HARAN MAS COBROS INDEBIDOS.

reviews.author: susan K
reviews.title: Gloria was awesome!
reviews.text:
I was recently at the Paradisus Palma Real for my son's wedding. The resort was beautiful and sprawling, the food excellent and the wedding was the best wedding I've ever attended; however, all was not perfect in paradise.  The service was lackluster with too many communication (or lack thereof) problems to mention.  The resort is run in an elitist fashion whereby the more you pay (the better the bracelet) the better the service.  Those relegated to the white bracelets can't make a dinner reservation or order a Corona!!  The management allows excursion vendors to hawk their services regardless of the quality, safety and frequent bait and switch practices.  Members of our group were subjected to a dangerous fishing excursion (at $650,00! no less) in rough seas, on a rickety boat where to operate the toilet unconnected wires had to be reconnected.  When several people got sick (including the groom who spent much of the remainder of the eve of his wedding sick in his room) the charter refused, initially, to turn the boat around and return to shore until my brother in law adamently insisted that they do.  Other members of our group were subjected to a bait and switch of 4 wheel vehicles for which they paid the higher price to ensure  a more quality vehicle and were subjected to the lower priced, malfunctioning vehicles.  I would think that a resort of this caliber would monitor the excursion vendors and not permit questionable ones to work on their property.

Accordingly, I would recommend avoiding excursions and, instead, enjoying that which is offered on resort which is extensive and, if you're lucky enough to encounter Gloria, the pool bar bartender extraordinnaire!!!!, you're trip will be all the more enhanced.  Order one of her "specials"; I am missing them sorely as they became a staple of my Punta Cana diet!!!  We even requested her to work the wedding and, despite being poolside at 7:00 a.m. that day, she worked the event until after midnight. Miss you Gloria!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Armando P
reviews.title: Equilibrio
reviews.text: Siendo un gran resort la diferencia ha sido notable a diferencia de cualquier otro de sus caracteristicas. EQUILIBRIO es la palabra que lo define incluso la calidad de su comida, el servicio esquisito y acogedor...

reviews.author: MarioB
reviews.title: Trop cher payé pour un hôtel 5 étoiles
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné du 2 avril au 9 avril 2013 à l'hôtel Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana. Semaine. Bien que nous ayons passé une très belle semaine, nous avons tout même été déçu car nous estimons ne pas avoir bénéficié de la qualité de services auxquels  on est en droit de s'attendre normalement dans un hôtel 5 étoiles.

Les points positifs
Le site est propre et offre de magnifiques jardins. Les déjeuners sont ok. Pour les soupers, nous avons beaucoup apprécié les restaurants Vento et Passion.  Les chambres sont propres et et les lits confortables. La plage est bordée de grands palmiers et le sable est fin et blanc . La mer est turquoise et son fond est dépourvu de roches. La piscine est grande, munie d'un bar et de lits nautiques.  On peut se procurer des serviettes à volonté. Le personnel est gentil et souriant.

Les points négatifs 

Les réservations de restaurants étaient ardues. Il fallait être très patient et dès notre 1e journée, nous n'avons pas été en mesure de réserver des restaurants pour 3 journées consécutives car ils n'y avait plus de places de disponibles dans les restaurants sur le site. On nous suggérait d'aller au buffet ou d'opter pour un restaurant se trouvant sur la Réserve à quelques kilomètres.  Étant donné que nous ne voulions pas manger au buffet ou nous déplacer, nous avons demandé pour une réservation au restaurant Gabi Beach et pour lequel il fallait payer un surplus car ce était exclusif aux gens du Service Royal et de la Conciergerie.. On nous a dit que les prix étaient inscrits en US sur le menu. Ce qu'on nous a pas dit, c'est qu'une taxe de 26% y était ajoutée pour les taxes et le pourboire. La bouffe est assez ordinaire et par ce fait, nous nous sommes sentis exploités en comparaison à tout ce que nous avons obtenu pour le menu dégustation au restaurant Passion.  Le midi, les restaurants Naos et Market Grill n'offraient pas une grande variété de choix .Sur le site il y avait un resto italien mais tout comme le Gabi Beach, ce dernier était réservé que pour les gens logeant au Service Royale ou à  la Conciergerie.

Contrairement aux plages réservées au Service Royal et à la Conciergerie, à la plage principale, il n'y avait pas assez de huttes pour tout le monde. Ce qui nous obligeait à se lever très tôt le matin afin d'aller se réserver une hutte. Les chaises longues de la plage principale n'étaient pas munies d'un coussin. Pour obtenir des rafraîchissements et des boissons, nous devions nous déplacer jusqu'au bar de la piscine car les serveurs se faisaient rare.  La mer était de couleur turquoise mais toute la semaine il y a eu beaucoup d'algues qui flottaient à la surface. Il nous a été impossible d'obtenir des Bloody Cesar car il n'y avait pas de Clamato. Contrairement au Service Royal, les heures d'accès à la salle des ordinateurs était limités et  2 jours ils ont été hors d'usage. Pour notre dernière journée, nous devions quitter la chambre pour midi alors que notre départ pour l'aéroport n'était qu'à 16h30.  Nous avons dû débourser $60 pour conserver notre chambre 2 heures de plus et pouvoir ainsi bénéficier un peu plus de la plage à notre dernière journée. 

Conclusion

Tous ces petits inconvénients deviennent rapidement agaçants et on ne se sent pas comme des clients privilégiés d'un hôtel 5 étoiles.  C'est un bel endroit,  mais si vous n'êtes pas dans les sections du Service Royal ou de la Conciergerie, vous avez l'impression de séjourner dans un 4 étoiles alors que vous avez payé pour un 5 étoiles.  L'année dernière au Paradisus La Esméralda du Mexique nous ne ressentions pas autant de différence de qualité de service entre nous et le Service Royal ou la Conciergerie et de plus, nous avions obtenu gratuitement un late check out pour notre dernière journée. 

Heureusement, il a fait beau toute la semaine et nous estimons  avoir tout de même passé une très belle semaine  même si nous croyons avoir payer trop cher pour ce 5 étoiles.

reviews.author: josemunoz63
reviews.title: EXCELENTE RESORT
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado 12 días fantásticos. Todo ha funcionado a la perfección. Calidad en la comida, en las habitaciones, gente amable, servicio exquisito,.... han demostrado todos un nivel dificilmente superable. El servicio real fantástico, the reserve también increíble. 

Especial mención al restaurante Palazzo de Royal Service, a su chef Carlos Seuno por la exquisitez y calidad de su cocina, la elegancia y educación de su esmerado servicio, y felicitaciones a todo su equipo de camareros, asistentes, cocineros..., realmente sobresaliente.

Mi enhorabuena también al chef del Passion de Martín Berasategui....

En the Reserve y Club Melia, todo perfecto, gracias a todos, en las habitaciones, en el buffet, en la playa, son tantos y tan buena gente que no me quiero olvidar y mando una feclicitación general.

Quiero también felicitar a Carlos San Jose de Club Melia, por su eficacísima gestión

reviews.author: Pat and Kim
reviews.title: Resort was great!
reviews.text: The wife and I decided to return to Punta Cana after 3 years and we wanted to do it real big.  Paradisus Palma Real was the place for it.  The royal service was phenomenal and especially Gabi beach and Palaozzo restaurants were the best that we've ever had.  Our butler Ramon was excellent and he did he's best to keep us satisfied.  One of my best lunch spots was the Market Grill.  Our server Wisly was superb and he was so nice to us which we appreciated.  Another person that stuck out for us was Kimberley.  She made sure we had great seating at the Vento restaurant.  Overall we had a great time and had lots of fun golfing with my wife.  The room WIFI's certainly need some improvement.  Having a 8 months old baby home we weren't so successful at using the WIFI unless we were standing in our balcony which took away the privacy.  The WIFI pole was directly facing my room and still couldn't get any service in the room although online the resort says in room WIFI.  We told the concierge but no luck...

reviews.author: jacques l
reviews.title: pas vraiment dans mes attentes
reviews.text: On prévoyait des belles vacances en groupe mais à notre arrivée cela à été très pénible d'avoir notre chambre  17hrs  ensuite c'étais le défi de réserver un restaurant pour le soir des fois à trois reprises dans la même journée et le buffet très ordinaire, heureusement on a réussi à  avoir accès aux restaurants de la Réserve donc  enfin du service. Pour le personnel rien à dire  que ce soit Ramon Fulgo,Luiz Fulgnito ou Paulino au bar de la piscine,  Miriam et Guillermo Avila au buffet et surtout Marcelino Munoz et Malcom Nunez du Restaurant Mizu lors de mon anniversaire c'étais super !! Bref je ne  crois pas y retourné et surtout que les commentaires sur trip advisor mentionnait exactement les problème que nous avons vécu, donc j'espère qu'un jour on va apporter les correctifs

reviews.author: lenny w
reviews.title: Beautiful place and nice people
reviews.text: My family just got back from the paradisus palma real golf & spa resort in punta Cana . The place is beautiful . When you walk into the lobby you can see the beach straight ahead . Very nice pools and the help is so nice and accommodating . Watch out for the concierge guys who try to be so helpful and nice but there is a motive . They want you to go to a 90 minute meeting and try to get you to invest a lot of money to book your next trips with melia vacations . Don't do it . There is a swim up bar in the pool and Gloria and Luis the bartenders are awesome . They are so nice , fun and helpful . Very well liked people . At Gabi beach restaurant there is a waiter named Juan who is really nice and goes out of his way for you . The food was good but dinners at the restaurants aren't so kid friendly on their menu . We ended up going to the shopping center by the resort and ate at the hard rock for dinner twice . Wasn't planning on that but it made my son happy . Really good food and big selection at Naos . There is a young man named Estaben who works at Naos and bana restaurants who always ha a smile on his face and is really nice . They have flamingos there which make it feel so tropical . There is shopping on the beach as they call it ""Walmart "" . You can bargain and get good tee shirts and souviners to bring home but don't pay regular price . My son & husband played golf and said the course is very nice . We meet the most wonderful family there which made our trip extra special .

reviews.author: Patrick L
reviews.title: Fantastico!!
reviews.text: I've been to quite a few places and must admit that my visit to Paradisus Palma Real has thusly been the greatest visit of them all. The housing was tremendous, the food was great, and the service was excellent. My butlerae, Kharollys Siri, went far and above the call of duty to see to it that I was satisfied. I would reccommend this place as a definite vacation site to anyone. Kudos to the entire staff.

reviews.author: juanluisamoroso
reviews.title: impecable
reviews.text: bello hotel en una bella playa ; bellos jardines; en NAOS la comida es muy variada y muy buena. vale la pena pagar extra por el  restaurant PASSION ; el risotto  de calamares fué exquisito; a mi pareja le encantó el foie-gras. VENTO es muy bueno también ; el risotto de trufas es muy bueno. Igual el oriental: a mi pareja le encantó el pollo en salsa verde , y a mí ,el ceviche de pescado blanco. Muchas actividades para adultos y niños. El Spa en el Reserve es fabuloso. pero lo major fué el staff, especialmente : Yuder Javier , mesera en VENTO y Naos; Elizabeth Ramon , hostess en NAOS ; Sergio Calderon [mesero] y Laura Castillo [hostess] en PASSION;  Yeisy Felix, concierge. ; y las dos chicas que nos dieron los masajes en el Spa del Reserve. El único problema que tuvimos es que la tarjeta de la habitación se demagnetiza muy fácil y había que cambiarla varias veces al día. Y no había staff en la piscina para servir bebidas , ayudar con las sillas, etc.

reviews.author: Krista C
reviews.title: Best Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: I've only been to Punta Cana twice. I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for Christmas 2008 the first time I went so I didn't appreciate how wonderful it was until my second time when I stayed at another resort on the island.  Paradisus is far superior! On my recent trip I stayed at a huge resort that I didn't like. I ended up touring the Paradisus for a time share presentation on that trip for a free gift and it's still just as wonderful. The food was excellent; the beach was beautiful with lots of shade from the palm trees; the staff was friendly and helpful the entire time. The rooms were wonderful! They smelled like flowers everyday and had a huge, square tub in the bathrooms. I could go swimming in them. I stayed in the adults only section of the resort. This is a perfect honeymoon resort where everything really is included!

reviews.author: Barry N
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: We just returned from 10 days at the paradisus Palma real.  We had the Royal Service which was great. Our butler Jose Martinez was exceptional. He went above and beyond to make our stay really special. We were celebrating our wedding anniversary and he surprised us by meeting us at dinner and had a beautiful cake for us. When we got back to our room he had candles and bubbly to make our evening very romantic.  We enjoy the beach and Francisco Cabrera was so wonderful. He had the same beautiful spot on the beach for us every day. We've been to a lot of resorts and we have never experienced someone who worked as hard as Francisco to ensure that your day on the beach was perfect.  Service is really important to us and everyone who worked there provided exceptional service. Daniel Rodriguez the management asst was so helpful even before we arrived and even checked on us while we were there.  The food was very good. We like specific drinks and when we first arrived we weren't happy with the drinks but once we found someone who made them perfectly she told us we really needed to tell the bartenders, once we did everything was great. So be sure to speak up and let them know what you want.  Everyone is very accommodating.

reviews.author: Karin H
reviews.title: relax and enjoy
reviews.text:
Here is a non-royal service review...

Food:  Food was good here compared to other all-inclusives we've been to.  The breakfast buffet was good, had an omelette and cooked to order egg station along with meats, fruits, yogurt, breads, and a juice bar.  Lunch at the Naos buffet was not great in our opinion, we always opted to eat lunch at the Market Grill where there were hamburgers, hotdogs, nachos, salads, desserts.  We were able to eat at an a la carte restaurant every night and making reservations was very easy to do on your own...just call the number given to you and go from there!  We did not try the Passions restaurant, which you have to pay extra for, as the menu just didn't appeal to us.  The teppanyaki side of Bana and Vento were our favorites.  

Rooms:  Our room was huge with more than enough room for the two of us.  Housekeeping was not really consistent.  Some days we would come back from the beach at 5:30 and we would not have clean towels, but the bed would be made or vice versa.  However, they did keep our fridge stocked with soda, water, oj, and a presidente or two.

Beach:  We never had a problem finding a beach chair on the main beach...most days we were even able to find an empty palapa.  The beach that this property lies on really is the best one we saw.  We walked quite a ways in each direction along the beach and many of the other properties we saw had much smaller beaches.  We did not use the pool at all....just not our scene, but it always seemed busy when we walked by.

Service:  Check-in and check-out were both quick and painless...no complaints.  The servers at all of the restaurants and bars always seemed to have a smile on their faces.  One waiter stood out to us as being exceptional...Wily Mercado, from the Market Grill.  We saw Wily every day and he always had a smile on his face and he seemed to genuinely care and take pride in his job!  Keep up the great work, Wily!

Club Melia:  It is no secret that this resort is trying to sell time-shares.  The "concierge" you meet upon check-in is a club melia rep who tries to get you to a presentation on time shares.  We politely declined every day when we saw our concierge.  Please know that you DO NOT need this concierge to make restaurant reservations or tours, you can do this easily on your own!  Just call the restaurant reservation phone # given to you to make reservations and the resort has a full array of tour reps where you can make your own tour reservations as well.

All in all we had a very relaxing stay at the Palma Real and would have no qualms recommending it to others!

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Not a 5 star! Eduardo listen up.
reviews.text:
Oh where do I start. 
Firstly let me start by saying that I have vacationed pretty well across the globe and currently take 3 vacation a year with my husband and 3 year old twins. 

I wrote to the hotel 1 wk before arriving to request certain accommodations, my first email wAs answered by Carolina the assistant Manager, she forward my email to Noemi the Reception Manager who responded partially. When I returned the email to get further information I never heard back. I later forwarded my email to Carolina and Eduardo the General Manager but sadly no response from either. So much for customer service. 

About my stay, we are in the "reserve area".  Only advantage.is that it's close to the kids club and the kids pool aside from that the room are far from everything! Oh and the walls are paper thin, doors start slamming at 6 am. Don't expect to sleep in. 

The resort is so big and that u have to take a trolley to almost l everywhere, beach, restaurants, spa, lobby etc. problem is the trolley only come by very 10 minutes, tonight we waited 17 minutes and we ended up being late for our dinner reaevations. 

Restaurants: buffets, probably the worst I have seen. Selection very poor, small and repetitive. Most all inclusive buffets offeri much more of a selection. 
A la carte, u have to beg and plead to get a reservation. Funny enough when u show up the restaurants are almost empty, go figure. 
Vento, fair. 
Gabi Beach, don't bother. Lobster was tough, definitely not cooked to order  and shrimp were obviously heated in the microwave. Disgusting. 
Mole, good. Worth a try
The grill, good .  

The resort says it caters to families but  the shows only start at 10!  
Some other hotels that I have been to have a kids show that atarts earlier. Sadly not here!

Service lacks at every corner. U have to ask several time to refill coffee. Drinks show ip acter tour meal  god fornid if u need a fork, that can take several minutes.  English is week. Very little interaction. Bartenders are unfriendly. 

One Person taking and serving drinks for the whole pool area..

This was our first time in Dominican, we will not be returning. 

FYI, we were in Jamaica last year and stayed at the Rose Hall Suite Iberoatar which is a 41/2 star. That place rocks hands down over this place. No way In hell Paradisus is a 5 star.

reviews.author: GreekCuban
reviews.title: Paradise indeed!
reviews.text: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was an absolute delight.  The resort had all of the beauty and amenities that we could have ever hoped for.  Anything and everything that we needed was at our fingertips.  We stayed in the "Reserve" portion of the resort, which offered great exclusivity and personalized service.  Our personal concierge, Massiel Molina, was wonderful.  She took care of making our dinner reservations, helping us with transportation, and with any activities that we wanted to partake in.  Further, she added great personal touches that made our stay that much more memorable (e.g., running a bubble bath with chocolate covered strawberries after a long day).  Another example of the magnificent service was when our rental car experienced a flat tire.  The resort had their in-house mechanics come and patch our tire, which was done in less than 30 minutes.  This type of service is rare!  We would certainly return to this resort and would highly recommend it to anyone considering a trip to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Mark S
reviews.title: Beautiful, world class resort.
reviews.text:
I attended a company awards trip to this resort and was pleasantly surprised how beautiful this hotel is.  The beach is awesome, the pools are great, They have thatched covered beach huts for 2 people that are the best.  We stayed at the Reserve portion of the resort, but I would suggest staying in the main building, because the main pools and beach are closer.

The spa is awesome, one of the best massages I have ever had.

The food is okay, just not great great.  But everything else is wonderful including the swim up bars.

I was there for 5 days and never left the compound.  Maybe I missed something in town, but I never had a reason to leave.

reviews.author: augustoy2k
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: the families Nuñez want to thanks to all services employee who did a great job to satisfy ours requests, in special to Juan Martinez, Felix , Nicolas, Juan Jose, hugo and more. Thank you all. The food were great, and the drink too, but they need to supply it more frequently. The rooms were clean and nice.

reviews.author: SpoiledRottenMom
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, very relaxing week -- would definitely return....but.....
reviews.text:
I have such a love/hate relationship with trip advisor; I drive myself crazy every year planning our spring break trip!  The reviews are all over the place -- I can usually weed through and figure out what I need to know.  That said, our original reservation was at a resort about an hour from the airport, but the reviews were almost all bad, so Amex Travel was able to change us at the last minute.  I'm going to try to be specific because I couldn't find the answers I was looking for when I looked up this resort.  Our visit was March 31-April 6, 2013.

The Reserve is a separate section of a much larger resort, the Paradisus.  There is a very large pool and a baby pool, but the beach is NOT CLOSE.  It's not far, but we've gotten used to walking from our room and being on the beach in a few steps.  We walked every day instead of waiting for the tram and it was about 10 minutes from room to beach.  If you're traveling with any older family members, I'd stay at the Paradisus.  

We checked in on Sunday about 3:00 and there were no problems.  Very nice concierge area.  Our reservation was for a 2Br suite and it was still being cleaned, so we changed and grabbed a late lunch.  The room was really two adjoining rooms, one king and two queens.  Both had living area with sofa and tv, but the queen room was huge!  Large dining room and living area as well as large bathroom.  Unfortunately, my teenage boys had this room and my husband and I were in an equally beautiful king room with a weird layout.  The bedroom and bathroom were both very cramped.  My husband and I are average size and we really had a hard time moving around.  Beware of the marble floors and stairways throughout -- especially after rain.  

We eat out a lot at home, so we're not looking for gourmet meals when we travel.  All-inclusives are notorious for buffets and there was a lot of repetition.  I'm very picky and most days I had fruit and bread!  There's lot of fish and salads.  If you're adventurous, the food is fine.  Thank goodness there was a grill that served burgers and pizza every day, but even the pizza was just fair.  The majority of the specialty restaurants (dinner only, I believe) are at the Paradisus, so you will travel back and forth a lot, but realize you need reservations at many of them and you should make the reservations at check-in or as soon as possible.  We were only able to get into three of the restaurants and had buffets for the rest of our dinners.  We were very happy at the Italian restaurant and Aqua, which is at the Reserve.  Skip Melo (mexican)!

The Reserve guests have a special area at the beach and there is a guard watching the area.  It is next to the area for Royal Service, which is adults only, so you should be prepared for topless bathing.  We didn't get the Family Concierge package, but my husband is an early riser and goes down to the beach early to get our chairs.  Unfortunately, many people will put their things out at the pool and beach and you never see them use them.  We stayed at the beach most of the trip and had no trouble finding a spot if we got there by 9.  The first two rows are reserved for the Family Concierge guests, but if no one shows up by 10:30ish, the beach staff will let you move into their spot.  The set up is beautiful with the straw hut umbrella and double lounge beds.  

By mid-week, after walking back and forth to the beach, I announced I wouldn't have chosen the Reserve if I had known it wasn't beachfront.  That changed when we decided to have lunch at one of the Paradisus buffets.  It was packed.  At all the buffets there is a chef making some things to order, but there were so many people rushing to get to the food we left.  This alone was enough to change my mind about the Reserve.  You pay a little more, but it is a quieter, less crowded experience.  

My kids usually disappear on vacation and we have to make them check in, but they were bored here.  There doesn't seem to be an "activities organizer" or maybe we just didn't see one at the Reserve.  Even on the days we spent at the beach and ventured away from the Reserve's private area, we didn't see any activities so the kids were never able to meet anyone.  Other resorts we've visited have had someone at the pool area getting kids involved and planning teen activities (boat cruises, games, etc.), but we didn't see anything like this.  

A sales pitch was mentioned to us early in the week!  It was going to be 90 minutes.  My husband even told them we weren't buying anything, no matter what, and they said their pay was based on the pitch, but we were able to avoid it!

Few more things.  Drinking age is 18.  Loud, obnoxious teens (with parents!) with free alcohol spoiled one evening at casino.  In the evening, the Reserve is dead.  Paradisus has shows, entertainment, etc.  Casino (small-15 slots, 6 blackjack tables, roulette) stays open until 3 am.  One bar is 24 hours.  We did one excursion, the dune buggys/ATVs.  Lots of fun.  VERY MUDDY.  Husband golfed twice.  He's played all over, including Ireland.  Played at La Cana.  He is still raving about it.  Service was fine.  Bartenders were all very nice.  Beach waiters were great.  We were a little surprised that quite a few staff members didn't understand or speak English, but it wasn't a big deal.  

We've been to just about every island that offers all-inclusive properties.  Beaches Turks was our favorite, but this is a close second.  Beach was beautiful and property is very nice.  Just wish it was closer to the beach!!!  I know I've left something out -- just send me an email!

reviews.author: Reuben-advisor
reviews.title: Terrible servicio de transporte de los carritos, quita las ganas de estar acá.
reviews.text:
Estoy actualmente en el Reserve, el hotel en general es bueno, tiene detalles modernos y el servicio es acogedor.

La comida al igual que comentarios anteriores, tiene una rotación casi nula, todos los días lo mismo.

Ambiente, playa, piscinas y personal son todos de buen nivel. No quiero que mi comentario reste lo positivo de estos puntos.

Mi comentario central es acerca de los carritos de transporte (hay solo 3 para 600-700 habitaciones). Me estoy quedando en la primera villa y la playa es bstante lejos, por lo que nos movemos en estos trencitos. Es inaceptable la demora que tienen, casi 40 minutos en promedio ysiendo que es una zona "exclusiva". Lamentablemente se piede unas 2 horas al día en "espera de carritos".

Hemos alegado al desk de reserve y el general, hace dos días nos responden que no es la primera queja y que vendrán más.. estamos 72hrs. Después y la misma cantidad de carros con la misma demora.

Realmente es decepcionante tener que perder tiempo de las lindas atracciones del hotel por esto,  se pierde tiempo y llega el stress. Adicionalmente comp pasa tanto tiempo, se juntan 30-40 personas en los stops, cuando llega el primer carro hay peleas y es un desagrado.

Como si eso fuera todo, hay carritos pequeños de otras funciones en el hotel dando vueltas, cuando le pedí a uno de esos (25min esperando carro) si me puede acercar me responde que "no está autorizado y debo seguir esperando al carro de pasajeros",  la politica de hospitalidad llegó hasta ahí nada más.

Me queda  tres días de mis vacaciones y he optado por caminar 10-15 minutos a la playa todas las mañanas para no seguir perdiendo el tiempo y empezar el día reclamando.

reviews.author: Ats1717
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real was Great
reviews.text:
This is my first review, but I researched everywhere before we went and found the reviews helpful so I thought I would reciprocate.  Here is readers digest version.

Resort:  Very nice, well kept, very clean.
Service:  Not overly friendly like other islands, but helpful.  Hugo Boss was our concierge for the week and he is AWESOME.  Ask for him if you can.  He made all of our reservations and handled all of our requests in a very professional timely manner.
Wifi:  only worked in lobby.  Needs improvement.  This was important to me.
Food:  Better than most resort foods.  Always available but reservations are a must.  Make them as soon as you get there to enjoy the trip.  
Entertainment:  Something every night, but not a night life hotel.
Casino: Small but suitable.  Dealers need a little customer service help to keep people playing.
Excursions:  Had fun, but all were long bus rides from hotel.
Taxis:  All very clean and comfortable.
Tipping:  If you tip, you get more attention.  Same as any other place.
Spa:  Top notch.
Chair availability:  You can always find a spot.  The hotel was sold out and we never had a problem.  Use your concierge to help you get the spot you want.
Launguage Barrier:  Never had a problem communicating.  They will find someone to help you.
Room Service:  Did not use much, but attentive.

Overall great experience and would recommend to anyone.  We will be back.

Only bad experience was a guy, Julian, with the vacation club was very rude to my wife and others in the vacation club lounge.  But we did not let him ruin our trip.

Go enjoy this beautiful resort and definitly ask for Hugo Boss. (The concierge, not the Cologne)

reviews.author: Lucklibralady25
reviews.title: Cant wait to return
reviews.text: We stayer in the reserve and was automatically upgraded due to MyTime.. It is a very big property with alot to do. The beach was beautiful and it was always some place to lay out in he sun. The room service was my favorite and also free. The staff was excellent even though most dont speak english. I receied a massage by the pool on the reserve and i fell asleep. I would definently recommend his location to anyone travelin to Punta Cana.. Thans Paradisus

reviews.author: Gabrielemy
reviews.title: 20th aniversary
reviews.text:
A pesar de ser socios del Club Meliá En Puerto Rico, no se nos asignó un concierge, así que conocimos las facilidades por cuenta propia igual que nuestras reservaciones en los restaurantes. El segundo día hubo un apagón que nos mantuvo sin agua ni luz por varias horas.
 
Por qué doy calificación sobre el promedio? Pues porque la calidad de la gente que nos atendió fue espectacular. Meseros, Bartenders y el resto del personal compensan por mucho. Quiero mencionar en especial a Carlos San Jose del área de ventas de Meliá Internacional quien nos ayudó mucho con algunas dudas sobre nuestra membresía y se ha mentenido en contacto cercano.

reviews.author: jmcosta2
reviews.title: Que semana magnifica...
reviews.text: Vou começar pelos momentos excelentes passados no bar da piscina. A equipa que trabalha no bar é de primeira qualidade, animam até um morto... Ramon Fuego ou Fueeeeeeego com o seu "espectacular" show no balcão, assim como Gloria Candelas com a sua simpatia para toods principalmente com os meus filhos pequenos, e o resto da equipa Luis Hielo e Paulino que na ausência de Ramon estiveram tb muito bem. A animação também esteve bem,Rodolfo-Angel muito esforçado e com a sua simpatia levou-nos a participar em várias actividades, dança, jogos ,os workshop,e na noite dos anos 80 Rodolfo e um magrinho, que não me lembro do nome (desculpa por isso), deram um espectaculo a dançar com os clientes. Enfim foram uns dias bem passados. Quanto a comidas, era de boa qualidade e no serviço notava-se um esforço dos empregados de mesa para que o cliente ficasse satisfeito. Fiquei numa suite que embora espaçosa tinha uma decoração algo antiquada Toda a envolvência do Resort está muito interessante, com muitos espaços verdes e pequenos lagos muito bem enquadrados no resto do ambiente, a praia é pegada ao hotel e podemos fazer umas boas caminhadas pele praia. Atenção á reservas das camas da piscina e da praia, "estranhamente" ficavam bastante cedo reservadas pelo nos levou a reclamar, depois a coisa melhorou.Em conclusão foi uma semana bem passada.Com certeza voltaria a este Resort em férias.

reviews.author: TATANANIE
reviews.title: Upgraded to Paradisus
reviews.text: A few days before our trip to Melia Caribe, Punta Cana, we were notified that we had been upgraded to Paradisus Palma Real. We had the advantage that we knew the Paradisus was next door to Melia, and that the most important thing was that golf was included. This resort is not huge, so all amenities are literally next to each other. The staff are excellent, if you request something in your room, for example, another facecloth, it magically appears within moments.This is a quiet resort , so if you are looking for total relaxtion, it fits the bill.Food is excellent, lots of variety. No problem getting a lounger on the beach.Once again a fantastic vacation. Thank you to all at Paradisus Palma Real. Just to add, the beds are super comfortable.

reviews.author: ivang247
reviews.title: Volverás
reviews.text:
Para nosotros es un placer poder escribir estas palabras, puesto que todo lo que podamos decir es poco, siendo la cuarta vez que hemos estado y andamos preparando la quinta. Estuvimos en The Reserve del 11 al 25 de marzo del 2013, siendo alojados en la misma habitación que en años anteriores para que no nos sintiéramos extraños, impecable, como si no nos hubiéramos ido nunca de allí, siempre al más mínimo detalle. Los restaurantes una maravilla, la comida muy variada y de muy buena calidad, y un trato exquisito en cualquiera de ellos. ¿Y qué decir del encanto del lugar?, eso no se puede expresar con palabras, puesto que por mucho que lo intentes es imposible, la sensación al estar allí es de un auténtico paraíso, pero lo que más nos maravilla y con lo que mejor nos hemos sentido trayéndonos un recuerdo inolvidable, ha sido con el trato recibido de todo el equipo humano que forman tan maravillosas personas, sin querer dejarnos a nadie quisiéramos mencionar y dar mil gracias a Melvin Brisor, José Reinoso y Luis Hernández de Hydro Grill, Santiago (showman) de Ilbana, ambas Sras. Liliana y Sr. Richard (veteranos profesionales y encantadoras personas) de los restaurantes Naos, Aqua, Palazzo, Ilbana, entre otros, y en especial con mucho cariño a Maiker Ramírez, Marcelo Sánchez  Tineo, Ramón Ramírez, José Luis de los Santos y Pacheco, que dan un magnífico servicio tanto en la playa como en el bar de Naos, piscina y playa. También queremos agradecer la gran labor social que realizan Silvio Lantigua, Yelissa Benítez y Doralys dirigidos por Crhistelle Luchini.
Con un afectuoso saludo desde España.
Familia González.

reviews.author: Ladybug5602
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL WEDDING - EXCELLENT STAFF
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for a family wedding from March 22nd to March 27th.  The grounds were beautiful and the pool was huge.  The staff was excellent.  Our room was large and comfortable, however as far as the mini bar in the room went, well just juice, soda and beer. They would bring wine and ice to your room if requested, room service was excellent.  We had a ground floor garden view and was probably the farthest building away from everything, I don't mind the walk but we were traveling with other family member's that were older and the desistance was a problem to get to the ocean, pool and even the restaurants.  It was very difficult to get reservations at the specialty restaurants perhaps because we were a large party, the 2 that we did get were after 9:00 which meant we missed the shows for those nights. Most of our meals were spent at the buffet.  It wasn't bad they had a large assortment of different foods just not the same as a nice sit down restaurant.  There was a lot of grass in the ocean however the resort does try to keep the beach clean and they don't have any control over what comes in with the tide.  Entertainment was lacking and we were not able to make any of the shows. The bar in the main building 2nd floor was great - good drinks and they did have some music going on in that area occasionally. I would certainly recommend this resort to anyone who wants to relax or just have quiet time.  The only down side that did bother us was the areas where we were not allowed because we could not afford the "Royal Service "upgrade. We paid a lot on money, but felt degraded since RS had their own beach area, pool area, restaurants & lounge.  I could not find a hot tub and the staff wasn't sure what I was asking for, but our rooms had a huge Jacuzzi tub so maybe that was it. To end I would say we are glad we went and we enjoyed ourselves so that makes for a good trip!

reviews.author: ACNVM
reviews.title: Choosing the best place for a perfect romantic stay !!!
reviews.text:
This was my third time in Punta Cana .... the last two after a big and extensive research I decided for Paradisus Palma Real , and was not  disappointed  again. 
This time we decided for the Royal Service ... And I have to say that it is really worth !!!!! The Palazzo was the exclusive restaurant with gourmet breakfast and lunch ... just wonderful! Special thanks to our butler , Luis , who made our stay a perfect dream making our dinner reservations and attending all our wishes !!!!
For a romantic holiday definitely it is the right place ...decide for the Royal Service, . Ask for a room in the first pavilion .... Near the pool ...  Ask for Luis to be your butler and just rest and enjoy your time !

reviews.author: Loum613
reviews.title: The "Place" to stay in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently enjoyed a great return trip to Paradisus Palma Real in Febraury 2013. As always (we have been coming to Palma Real since its opening in 2006) this hotel lived up to our expectations. The employees always treat us with a big welcome smile and the utmost courtesy.
The grounds and facilities are just spectacular and very well maintained.
Guest suites are clean and spacious, ask for an upper floor and you will have beautiful views of the gardens or possibly the beach. The beach will amaze you, one of the prettiest sand beaches you will see, yes there is seaweed when storms come thru but that is cleaned daily. Activities on the beach, include hobbie cats, scuba diving to the reef (one free per day), snorkel boat to the reef (included), beach volley ball and dance classes.
Off the beach there are included cigar making classes, candle making and flower arranging, etc. Always something to do or like us, just relax if you wish. I do, scuba dive and this is an excellent area to learn, our children were certified here. The reef helps protect the area and therefore not many strong currents when diving. The resort aquatics center provides a free intro class to scuba diving at no cost and includes a shallow dive (approx 20-30 feet). At extra cost they also can get you certified.
There are two gyms one in the main hotel (recently remodeled)  and one in the Reserve which is very nice but you will need to either walk a bit or take a cart.
We enjoy all the restaurants at this resort, but our favorites are Palazzo, Passion, Vento and Gabi Beach. We would like to recognize the various employees that provided us with above and beyond service.
At Gabi Beach, Juan D'Aza always makes sure we have a phenomenal meal. 
Palazzo we are treated with incredible service from Smerlyn, Hoose, Richard, Jose and Americo. Bienvenido working the grill and Pablo will make you great meals there .
At Vento, which is mediterranean they have a new menu including our favorite dish of osso bucco. Wander and Luis "Luigi" always make sure we are well cared for here.
We had a spectacular meal at the Passion restaurant. Try the multi course tasting menu with the wine flights to match. This restaurant has an extra cost but is well worth it for the quality of food and service.  Very romantic and not to be missed. 
In the Royal Service area,  which is adults only, you have a dedicated pool and beach area and generally is the quieter area of the resort. Pedro, Francisquito, Francisco G and Martin take exceptional care to be sure you are pampered both in the pool area and beach.Bringing you drinks, preparing your beds on the beach/pool or a palapa (sun hut) and just making sure you are enjoying your day. Winkin in the Royal Service bar makes the best drinks (and no they are not watered down, so be careful) he does his job with a constant smile. I think it is because he enjoys what he is doing to you ;-). 
If you are traveling with adults only, Royal Service is definately worth the extra cost.
Do not miss the show put on by Ramon "Fuego" in the main pool bar and his sidekick Luis "Fueguito", they are just great. This is the swim up bar area. 
There is a small casino but we do not gamble but do enjoy the bar service from Antonio. In the Lobby bar David, Orny and Altagracia do a great job to keep everyone happy and thank you also to Julio Cesar, evening bars manager. If there is high occupancy this area can get very busy and a great area for people watching. There is also live music from 10pm.
The new Red Lounge next to the lobby bar gets busy after midnight and is pretty much the only late night entertainment on the resort. 
If you are traveling with children you might want to consider the "Reserve" area, there is a children's play area and pool. Also you also get a dedicated beach area, but you do have to take a cart to the beach, otherwise a 15 minute walk.
The airport is a short 20 minute ride to the resort and we usually take a taxi (the guys wearing the pink shirts at the airport) the cost is $30 for up to six people one way. There are shared shuttle buses that cost approx $7 per person each way, but depending on luck you might make multiple stops which will make for a longer trip timewise. We prefer to get there quicker and start enjoying. 
We have traveled the world and can tell you that this is a great resort and well worth it. Understand that you are on island time and therefore at times you might have to wait a bit, but remember why you are visiting. Just relax and enjoy. They work very hard at pleasing you and a simple "gracias" goes a long way.

We would like to send a very special thank you to Vicente Rubianes and Miguel Rovira for their very kind hospitality. 

We are already planning a return trip with our family.

Select Paradisus Palma Real as your resort in Punta Cana and you will not go wrong.

reviews.author: LimeyNJ
reviews.title: Ok, not outstanding!, the good the bad and the ugly.
reviews.text:
I am still here on vacation and wanted to write a review immediately!
Ok the good....   the staff are wondrful, always polite and informative.  They will always greet you with a smile and once they have learned your name will not forget it, truly the best part of this vacation. The grounds are really well maintained, there is always staff making sure that everything is pristine.  The rooms (we are staying in reserve section), since we have children (9-10) with us we are not permitted to stay in royal service, which sounds like from other reviews not a bad choice, as our room is great!!!!  The kids stay on a pull out sofa while my husband and I have a king size bed, not king size room, but that's ok.  The room is clean and has nice furnishings.
The bad....  that would be the food, hands down.... Not good.  I am a foodie so a bit of a snob when it comes to food.  I find the steak and chicken at the buffets ineddable.  Oh, that brings me to the point of the a la carte restaurants, you HAVE to book and that took us an hour one morning, very annoying!  Last night we went to Feugo.... OMG I seriously almost cried because the food there was amazing but you have to pay a $40 up charge per person, well worth it in my opinion but not worth it for the kids, we might go back and leave the kids at kids club or something.  I will update the food status after I have been to some of the other restaurants that are a la carte and don't have an up charge.  The grounds are absolutely huge, lots of walking since the "trains" run very irregular and you could be stuck on one for quite some time if new people want to get on and then detour to get off.  They really should make specific schedules that run regularly on a designated route.
The ugly....  And it's ugly... You have to be out by about 7am to get a chair at the pool, if you are late forget it for the rest of the day.  Not sure what time you have to get to the beach we got lucky twice, but the second time I think it was only because the chair we got was broken and very uncomfortable.  People put their towels down and then return for hours and I mean hours.  So when in Rome, I do it to but it drives me crazy.  If everyone would just not do that there would be chairs everywhere.  I went to a different resort and they had a 30 min rule, if you hadn't been there for 30 mins you were booted, excellent idea, they should really try that here, because there are always chairs when and where you want to go.  Today I got to the pool at 6am, yes the sun was not even up... but I was.  I'm already worrying about going to the beach and it's only 7am!!!!
Would I come back... Hmmm the jury is still out on that, I will have to wait to try the other restaurants.  I also think they would have to change the chair rule for me to consider coming back, it's really stressful, not what you want on vacation.

reviews.author: marier278
reviews.title: awesome vacation!
reviews.text: i just return from my vacation march30 to april 6 I was truly impressed by the service the staff and the facility as whole it lived it up to its name a paridise I want to give praise to two of your staff in particular Cesar Lafle room service he goes above and beyond to get us what we needed and Mercedes form housekeeping service she is very professional those two staffs take pride in your organization they didnt expect tip they want you to know how good the service was its show a lots of passion for they works in facts everybody was very polite friendly and professional I will recommend this hotel to my friends and families in a heart beat Kudo

reviews.author: Dasa84
reviews.title: vacaciones paradisiacas
reviews.text:
Acabo de volver de punta cana. Hemos estado en el hotel paradisus punta cana, en la parte The Reserve, y del paradisus palma real. Los 2 hoteles son muy similares, diseñadores por el mismo arquitecto. Hasta los restaurantes son muy parecidos, algunos con los mismos nombres. El Spa de palma real es algo mejor ya que tienes la opción de hacer un ritual (jacuzzis, baño de contrastes, pediluvio...) gratuito si estás alojado en The Reserve o si tienes ocntratado un masaje. Recomiendo reflexología. Me gustó un poco más el paradisus punta cana si te alojas en The Reserve aunque se notaba que el palma real era un poco más premium en algunos detalles. Por ejemplo las cocacolas del punta cana eran con manguera y las de palma real siempre de botella. También el servicio era mejor y el buffet de mejor calidad.
Muy buena la atención de Belén y de Isabel (directora del The Reserve palma real). Nos sentimos como en casa. Hemos visitado el hotel paradisus punta cana en varias ocasiones, y esta semana santa no había casi españoles comparado con otros años, muchísimos argentinos y mejicanos. Seguro que volveremos a paradisus pronto, ya sea punta cana, palma real o al nuevo hotel que van a inaugurar en Costa Rica!

reviews.author: Vanterpool
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text:
My husband and I and his cousin and wife stayed at The Reserve at Pardisus Punta Cana Resort  March 25-29 2013 Building #37. We had an awesome time even though getting there was a bit of a headache thanks to American Airlines/Eagle. We arrived very late and was more than accommodated. Our room was fabulous, spacious and very comfortable. I am a foodie....so it was important to me that the food was on point and it was! Breakfast was divine especially the omelette and the choices of bread. The fruit, freshly made drinks-watermelon, orange, pineapple...to die for. I especially enjoyed dining at the Gabi Beach. Glienly, the night waiter at Naos Restaurant was fabulous and took very good care of me. Infact, the night we arrived my stomach was acting up and I asked him for a yoghurt and he went across the resort to another restaurant to get me one only to find out later on that yoghurt is only available at breakfast....thanks Glienly! Our concierge Sandra Cedeno was amazing! I truly appreciated her warmth every day. Diosmary at the Front Office, Marvin at the bar Grill, Raphael Bautista and Alicia Lois of Melia were so nice to us. Thanks guys for the great service. 

The only problem we had was the length of time it took for the trolleys to come around at nights. That they definately need to improve on and we made sure to mention it. The shows and the dancing in the club were fun-filled and enjoyable! We went to relax, and have a great time and indeed we did! We came as guests and left as owners! Already we are planning our return trip with the children for August 2013.

reviews.author: Beth117R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
Mike (my husband) & I visited the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for our dear friend's   daughters wedding. Eddie & Niki. We arrived on the 13th of March 2013 & left on the 20th, begrudgingly...We had a wonderful time at your resort. The service was grand. The food was great. The rooms were spectacular & the turn down service was a special treat. I just wish that casino was bigger : ) !

We loved both the beach & the pool. The grounds of the resort were really beautiful. The shopping was pretty sweet too ! The buffet was good as well as the restaurants. There is  something for everyone's tastes.
We will surely recommend this resort to our family & friends.

reviews.author: SherriU_13
reviews.title: Relaxing and Fun Vacation for Families!!!
reviews.text: What a wonderful vacation!!  All of our needs were taken care of which made for a relaxing vacation with our children.  Traveled with our 3 and 6 year old and always had options for fun at the Kids Zone.  Yahaira, Nataly, Kilvaria and Berlis were wonderful with our kids, always greeting us with smiles when we entered the Kids Zone. Our kids truly enjoy the daily crafts/activities offered. Our concierge, Sandra Cedeno, was always professional and went out of her way to make sure all our needs were met.  Tremendously helpful with booking our dinner reservations and answering any questions we had about the resort. We will not hesitate to book our family vacation at The Reserve again!

reviews.author: Maria_Falcao
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Minha irmã e eu estivemos hospedadas no Paradisus Palma Real por uma semana em março de 2013 e nossa viagem foi maravilhosa. O hotel possui uma excelente estrutura, a praia é linda e o atendimento é impecável!! Todos sempre sorridentes e muito simpáticos. Não tive problema nenhum com o inglês, quase todos falavam a língua. Faço referência especial ao Andrés que nos recebeu e cuidou de tudo para nós, à Eliza e Liliana do Gabi Beach, ao José da recepção, ao Fabio e todos do concierge. Os restaurantes são excelentes, com ótima comida, especialmente no jantar. O único ponto negativo foi a grande demora no check in, pois tivemos que esperar muito tempo para que o nosso quarto ficasse pronto. Como forma de se desculpar o hotel nos ofereceu um upgrade na pulseira, o que foi bem legal. Com certeza um lugar para voltar! Recomendo para viagens de casais (Royal Service), família (The Reserve) e amigos!

reviews.author: BP369
reviews.title: Would not recommend this resort
reviews.text:
We choose The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for our family vacation.  We were a group of 25 people and three of the families choose to book a family concierge for a stress free vacation with kids.  Before going on with the negatives, I would like to start off on a positive note appreciating the service provided by Ovido our Family Concierge, Sergio the manager at Vento, Melvin the grill chief.  These guys went above and beyond trying to make the best of our vacation. Especially helping with providing meals when needed for our children and us.
Overall the resort was very disappointing.  The variety and quality of the food in the buffets was not up to standard.  It seemed as though you were eating basically the same food for all 7 days we were there for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  We have been to other all inclusive resorts and we would never run out of choices in the 7 days were there in the buffet, but his was not the case at the Paradisus.  
The rooms are nice but the walls are paper thin.  You hear everything in the halls and the room next to you.  The guest in the room next to you would be having a conversation in a normal tone and you would hear the conversation because the walls are so thin.  The doors to the rooms don’t align so to open and close them you have to slam them so this disturbs your neighbors and everyone else in the building.  
To add to our frustration during our stay, to get to anywhere on the property you needed to walk or wait for the shuttle.  The wait for the shuttle would be about 15minutes.  While waiting you would see all the Club Melia cars driving around empty but since you were not a member you could not use them but there were tons of them around but not enough of the shuttles for the non members.  This really was frustrating to see empty carts go by and you were not able to use them. 
Moving onto the Family Concierge concept we paid extra for was a waste of money.  Each family who had the Family Concierge was supposed to get a cell phone; in our case 3 families had the service so we should have had 3 phones.  However my husband and I arrived first so we got our phone the day we arrived, but our sister and brother did not.  They were told they did not have enough phones on that day so if we can share the phone for the time being and they would get it the next day.  So my sister got her phone but they still did not have another one for my brother who then just said forget it.  This should not have occurred we should not have had to share phones just because we were one large family.  The hotel knew beforehand how many Family Concierge groups there were and they should have had all the items ready based on individual numbers.  
Then the next incident occurred with reserving the cabanas at the beach.  The concierge is supposed to reserve a cabana for each individual family either at the pool or the beach.  Well on Monday we requested to have 3 cabanas (one for each family) reserved at the beach for Tuesday.  We were told he would not be able to book 3 cabanas for us at the beach.  We would only be able to book 1 at the beach and 2 at the pool.  How is that possible?  If we were three separate families then we would have been able to have 3 separate cabanas at the beach but since out last names were the same and we were together we needed to share again.  Where is the value of paying extra for a service we are not really getting?
The Family Concierge also offers turndown service, well not once in the entire time we stayed there were we able to use this service.  They would always come knocking after 9PM or sometimes even 10PM for the turndown service by then our children would already be fast asleep.  If you know there are kids in this area they should come earlier to provide the service.  Most kids would be in bed before 9, only older kids would be up that late.  So yet again we are not getting what we paid for.  
The Paradisus Punta Cana – The Reserve was chosen since it seemed to be kid friendly however our experience makes us question the kid friendly aspect of the hotel.  Our four children ranged from 18 months to 24 months.   They are young and their meal times are early since they go to bed early, however the hotel does not accommodate for this.  It is an all inclusive resort therefore food available 24 hours but you can’t keep giving them the same food every meal for the 7 days we were there.  Our children are not old enough yet to understand they need to wait an hour before the restaurants open.  Breakfast time was fine but the restaurants don’t open for lunch till 12:30 and the kids eat at 11AM so if we order from room service we have to order them breakfast food, which they already had at breakfast plus you are stuck in the room till your order comes since they can’t bring it anywhere but your room.  Then dinner doesn’t start till 6:30 but the kids eat at 5 so yet again you are ordering room service but now the lunch menu, plus you are confined to your room once again.  So the kids miss out on eat anything off the dinner menu.  We spoke to our concierge about this and early in the week he said he would not be able to do anything about it because that is how the hotel policy is but then towards the middle of week he would try to go in the back and request the chiefs to make us some food early for the kids.  I know he was given a hard time each meal by the staff for not following the policy.   This was very stressful for the parents because when lunch and dinner time came around we would have to preorder the food to ensure we would have it on time for the kids.  Half of the day went in us stressing out of what to do for meals, this should not have been the case in an all inclusive resort.  Older children would be able to wait until the restaurant open for meal times but how do you expect young kids to wait that long?  
Over all we were very disappointed with our stay at The Paradisus Punta Cana The Reserve, especially with the whole Family concierge concept.  I regret to say this but we would not recommend this resort to anyone, especially families with children.  We really feel the money and effort we spent for a nice family vacation was wasted and regret booking with this resort.  In an all inclusive vacation the resort makes the vacation memorable and in our case it made a bad memory of a vacation.

reviews.author: JUSTINF890
reviews.title: nicolas de room service es lo meor que tiene este complejo
reviews.text: estub hospedado en este hotel y puedo decir que sialgo me sorprendio fue el trato obtenido por el departamento de room service,en especial por el joven nicolas,siempre un paso delante de nuestras espectativas...racias a su supervisor bertoldo y su ayudante feliz creo sin temor a equivocarme que volveria slo por ese exelente trato

reviews.author: NevioSavieto
reviews.title: RESORT 5 ESTRELAS SÓ NO NOME
reviews.text:
Serviço de limpeza de quarto péssimo, todo dia era preciso implorar para limpeza.
Restaurantes a la carte deixaram muito a desejar
Nos acessos externos ao quarto, as fossas liberavam cheiro de esgoto o dia todo, até na área do Royal Service
Falta de informações, no primeiro dia, o jantar foi alterado de lugar e ninguém nos comunicou.
Ar condicionado no quarto precário, internet precária

reviews.author: MaggieH545
reviews.title: Palazo & Richard Ortiz
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real over February 25 - 27 as a site visit for a group. We dined at Palazo for lunch on February 27 and Richard Ortiz waited on us. He was wonderful! He went way above and beyond the call of duty and really treated us like "royalty". In fact, when my friend requested another glass of wine and he knew we were headed upstairs to the Royal Service Lounge he put the wine in a different glass and carried it upstairs for her. Terrific service! 

We had terrific service all over the property but Richard Ortize in Palazo really stole the show!

reviews.author: pron6miller
reviews.title: Facilities great, service needs an upgrade
reviews.text:
The grounds, the rooms, the pool area and the ocean were all beautiful.  The food was OK - not horrible, but didn't have any meals that I truly enjoyed, except maybe at the Japanese restaurant.  The service was lackluster - at breakfast you could finish your entire meal before receiving your first cup of tea.  I had given up on finding a well-made cocktail in the entire resort until I found the M bar.  This is located inside between Fresco and the surcharge restaurant - go there.

Also - the spa is fantastic and the prices are suprisingly reasonable.  Highly recommend the reflexology treatment.  

If I had it to do over again, I would probably stay at a less expensive resort.

reviews.author: Mary S
reviews.title: enjoyed  the stay
reviews.text: The check  in was so easy with help of Santos, the bellman,and all who welcomed  our party of four.   we got to our rooms they showed us the pool, the Gabi restaurant and the beach bar. We made resivations  at six different  restaurants  all the meals were excellent. The upscale  restaurants and waitstaff were so pleasant  and could not do enough for us. The crew at Gabi beach bar was so helpful with our Spanish  lessons  and drinks thanks to Jose David, Dani Romdro andWilson Vallo. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The beach is outstanding  great for walks or just relaxing.  We are planning to return soon but not soon enough.

reviews.author: patyr508
reviews.title: Mi familia fu humillada y maltratada en este hotel!!!!
reviews.text:
Quiero expresar por este medio nuestra insatisfacción e indignación debido a la humillación y el mal trato recibido por parte de ustedes el día 28 de Marzo durante el proceso de registro en este Hotel.
Nos presentamos un grupo de 21 personas, incluyendo 4 Bebes, los cuales nos trasladamos desde Santo Domingo, y  4 de ellos vinieron de Texas, para pasar el fin de Semana Santa en familia. 
Lamentablemente no pudimos hacerlo debido a que la reservación nos fue cancelada el mismo día 28 en la mañana, no obstante habernos confirmado la noche anterior la reservación que habíamos hecho incluyendo reservaciones en los restaurantes Asian Fusion, Steak & Grill y Ventos.
En adición a lo expresado, fuimos maltratados por la Señora Belen Santamarina, no solo de palabras si no que también amenazo con sacarnos a la fuerza del Hotel llamando a los agentes de seguridad.
En fin, perdimos el fin de semana y todo el dinero que habíamos invertido en los arreglos, viajes, traslados, etc.
Entendemos que ustedes representan una empresa de gran prestigio, por tanto tienen la obligacion de asumir su responsabilidad ante los hechos ocurridos e indemnizarnos por los gastos y maltratos recibidos.

reviews.author: 204MikeM204
reviews.title: 4 Stars!!!
reviews.text: I was concerned after checking into our room which I noticed immediately smelled very musty. After 12 hours of traveling we were totally exhausted and got put in an adjoining room next too a crying new born baby. I remembered having the option of upgrading to Royal Service during check-in but opted not to at the time. My girlfriend took a shower and the water wasn't draining either. Then noticed in the closet a cover missing and a lot of loose wires which didn't look too safe. I called the front desk to talk to someone about changing rooms and there was no answer, so hung up and called again. One more time, no answer. So we walked to the lobby and I upgraded to "Royal Service" for about an extra $550 for 8 days. Best money I could have spent! This is when the vacation started! We were taken to the Royal Service lounge to check in(also a faster check-out when leaving.) We were put in a much newer, cleaner, and better smelling room with a butler(more later), a cell phone to call the butler, private beach, private pool & private restaurant. Royal Service is the difference between a 3 star and 5 star resort! Ok, about our Butler...he only did an average job. I noticed other Butlers greeting people in the morning and helping them get setup on the beach. But we didn't see him until we called repeatedly and then he finally would show up. He did make restaurant reservations in all 6 or 7 places, but he never asked what we liked to eat. We ended up making some changes ourselves. He also prepared a bubble bath jacuzzi one night, with rode pedals and all. It was awesome...but I had to ask for it a couple times. It would have been cool had I been able to surprise my girlfriend, but he just didn't seem to get it. Everyone doesn't speak the best english and that's OK, if you try to speak a little spanish and are patient, it works out. I gotta say, one of the real highlights of our trip was Pedro Reyes who delivered room service to us everyday. He is one bright 20 year old young man. He called us every morning(he didn't wake for us) and made sure we had everything we needed. One day after sharing that we wanted tacos(not on the menu) he jumped on the phone and found a cook who made them for us special, along with a huge bowl of guacamole and pico de gallo....all of which was not on the room service menu!! He was great, teaching us Spanish while we helped him with English. He told us all about the Dominican Republic...stuff we never would have known. He just went the extra mile and did it with a huge smile. I hope the management knows what a gem they have on their hands. We wish he had been our Butler! He made our vacation special and we will never forget him. We ended up having a terrific vacation and enjoyed this resort. But I don't believe we would have without the upgrade. Go with the Royal Service!!

reviews.author: JRTX77
reviews.title: NOT A HOTEL FOR A BIG FAMILY!!! THEY OVERBOOK!!!
reviews.text:
CONFIRM!! CONFIRM!!! CONFIRM!!!  Your reservation. 
I traveled from Texas with my wife and daughter to meet with my parents and relatives in Punta Cana to expend Easter from Thursday to Sunday with them. In total we were like 20. We confirm our reservation and also we made reservations in a couple of the restaurants of the hotel the night before arrival. (Restaurants Asian fusion, Steak & Grill). When we arrived Thursday morning they said our reservation was cancelled. Nobody knew how? Or Why?  The reservation was cancelled. We had the confirmation number with us but that didn’t help at all.  They offered us to look in another hotel because they didn’t have any rooms available at that moment. (They found a hotel that didn’t accept kids. WHAT?????  They knew we were traveling with 4 babies). Anyway we never got a concrete answer of what happened neither an alternative solution to the situation.  After 2 hours there, a lady named Belen Santamarina, called the security of the hotel kicking us out of the hotel. I don’t know if this hotel tends to overbook rooms on a busy season and latter on randomly cancel your reservation without letting you know in advance. 
My advised is to be paranoid about your reservation confirmation!!
Avoid going on a big group. 
Avoid going on a busy season.

reviews.author: Mathma43054
reviews.title: Paridisus punta Cana
reviews.text:
I will try to be short and to the point:
Overall facilities:  wonderful!  The gardens, the beach, facilities.  Beautiful.  Fun to explore!  Takes a day to get the lay of the grounds, but once acclimated, easy to facilitate.
Rooms:  dated, dark, poor storage areas.  But viewing the pool and ocean add greatly to the pleasure.  Not that you will spend much time in your room other than sleep and horizontal boogie
 woogie!
Dining:  above average overall.  Vento the best!  Ambience and service excellent.  Gabby B
