each very nice. Service spotty at lunch but wonderful during evening dining.  Alessandro great server, hard worker.  Palazzo, very nice.

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Excellent way to get away!
reviews.text: My wife and I recently visited the Paradisus Palma Real and stayed in the Royal Service Garden View Whirlpool room and had a GREAT time.  We had recently gotten married and needed to get away from the New York City crazy for a few days.  I have to say that Paradisus served that purpose perfectly.  We paid the extra money for the Royal Service and that was definitely worth it.  Our butler, Nicolas Maracallo, was amazing.  He took care of everything we asked for (arranging massages, making dinner reservations, prep-ing the jacuzzi in our room, bringing special pillows for my wife, and even bringing sunscreen down to the beach for us when we forgot ours).  Nicolas and the rest of the staff at Paradisus kept us from having to think about anything other than relaxing.  Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: 622BillM
reviews.title: Fond Memories and Much Gratitude
reviews.text:
My wife and I have just returned from a 14-day (March 9-23) trip to paradise!

The Paradisus Palma Real is strikingly elegant with its Spanish Colonial architecture, pools, ponds, pathways, gardens and even Flamingos.  It cannot be overstated how this resort excels in personable and professional service.  From the first telephone conversation with Martina Gabriel (Manager of Reservations), to the valets, reception desk staff (Rafael Mendez), to the many restaurant greeters and waiters, cleaning staff and security personnel, everyone was friendly and professional.

Guest rooms are spacious, classy and comfortable.

The food options offer both high quality and variety at the beautiful buffet restaurant (Naos) along with several theme restaurants.  Special thanks go to Miguel, the wine steward in Vento (Mediterranean cuisine) for his insightful recommendations.  By the way, Dominican Night is not to be missed as the buffet in Naos highlights Dominican cuisine.  Be sure to try the thick soup called San Cocho – it’s delicious! 

For those who want to do more than just chill, there is a full schedule of activities to choose from.  There are dance lessons, art, cigar making, volleyball, yoga, Pilates, flower arranging, etc.  We would most sincerely like to thank the team in the Club House for their friendship and enthusiastic instruction over the course of our holiday.  Our thanks go to Rodolfo, Angel, and Fabio who treated us like family.  

I’d also like to mention that unfortunately, while on holiday, I needed to be hospitalized for two days due to a heart condition.   While the situation was scary, I received immediate, thorough and professional care.  

Lastly, I would like to acknowledge and thank the Paradisus Palma Real management, and especially Domingo Beltre, Manager Guest Relations, for his personal care, compassion and support for both myself and my wife during these challenging circumstances.  I am truly grateful.

With fond memories and much gratitude.

Bill and Margaret
Ottawa, Canada

reviews.author: rafael_canabay
reviews.title: Excellent experience at Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Absolutely a great place for holidays with your family. The whole place is a beautiful garden, excellent installations, good restaurants and the best of all, the hotel staff. Everybody works hard there to make your stay really enjoyable. I want to make a special note on the top management of the hotel, Mr. Eduardo Perera and Mr. Pablo Cogolludo. They really showed a real interest in making every stay at the hotel something special, a really high level of commitment in delivering highest standards for a really top notch luxury hotel. Congratulations for the good work!!

reviews.author: urikn
reviews.title: Great family vacation
reviews.text: I spend a week with my whole family , wife, mother in law, three daughters, husbands and 5 grandsons. The accomodations were fantastic we had 2 bedroom lockup suits on the ground floor as requested which were very helful to the old and young in the group. The members club specially Patricia was of great assistance to us in obtaining reservations for restaurants with such a large group. Fres Martes of room service was friendly, always available, and happy to serve. Mr. Dionisio Rodriguez made sure we got adjoining rooms whcih made our stay so much easier for us all. We hope that next time the WIFI in the rooms will work, seems that a change of vendors left us in a no reception zone. other than that all was excellent.

reviews.author: Patrice R
reviews.title: Amazing service, facilities and food
reviews.text:
We arrived at The Paradisus Palma Real on March 26, 2013 and stayed for 7 days. We left the reort on April 2nd  I've provided a review for each section of our stay below.

Royal Service - because of other reviews I read prior to our departure we decided to upgrade to the royal service once we arrived. We payed an extra $425 for a garden view royal suite. The Royal Service is worth the extra!  With the Royal Service you receive a cell phone which is used to keep in contact with your butler. Our butler was Justo De Aza...and he was absolutely amazing. He contacted us daily to ensure our needs were met. He booked our reservations for all the restaurants. He assisted in booking our excursions. He set heavenly bubble baths for us and provided champaign, wine, fruit, cheese and chocolate in our room every night. He also provided us with scented pillows. 
Room - this is the only aspect of our trip that I will have to provide a somewhat negative report on. When we arrived the room we were given was visually appealing however it didn't take long for us to realize that there were other occupants in the room...cock roaches. The good thing is as soon as we notified the royal service personnel they offered to move us to another room, we were upgraded to an ocean view suite on the 3rd floor. This room was even more beautiful than the first and the view was breathtaking.  Most importantly, it was critter free. 
Food - the food was spectacular!  All the restaurants are delicious!  And the service is absolutely amazing. We went to the Palazo every day for breakfast....the food is fantastic and the service is unmatchable.  Richard Ortiz was our main waiter at this restaurant and he was impeccable. Infact all the waiters and hostesses were great!  I do have to agree with another review that stated that drink orders can take a bit longer than expected, I found this at all restaurants but Palozo was definitely the quickest. 
Facility- the facilities are absolutely gorgeous. The landscaping is well manicured. And the grounds are immaculate. The ground keepers are out early every morning and late nights ensuring the pools and other areas are clean. They quietly move thoughout the property making sure every inch is well kept. 
Spa- with the royal service you are also permitted access to the spa's hot tubs, steam rooms, hot stone path and hydro baths. And let me tell you, it is glorious. On one of the rainy days, my husband and i spent the day at the spa and although we did not pay for any extra spa services (massages, facials, etc) we enjoyed our time at the spa immensely. 
Overall Sevice - other than the great service we received from the royal service staff we also found that all staff members (from the front desk reception staff to the grounds keeper) were welcoming, friendly, helpful and pleasant. 
Entertainment - very entertaining. 
Excursions - all our excursions, although booked at the hotel, were off site. We did the helicopter ride, para gliding, horse back riding on the beach and zip lining. All of which I would recommend for the adventurous types. But if you're going for a more relaxing vacation this resort caters to that as well. There are adult only pools which offers a quieter option for those not wanting to hear children playing in the background while trying to relax by the pool. 
Beach -  the beach this resort rests on is Magnificent. It appears to be endless, and there is enough room on the beach for all at the resort. Royal service patrons have a private, sectioned off area of the beach. The beach waiters are awsome and swift with the order taking. 
Overall experience - I would definitely recommend this resort. It is by far the best resort my husband and I have stayed in so far!

reviews.author: BettyMF
reviews.title: What a Magical Experience !!!
reviews.text:
I don't typically write reviews but I felt very compelled to write one this time. I have been to all inclusive resorts in Cancun, Turks and Caicos, and other Punta Cana resorts and this is the first review I write. I just returned from the most fabulous and magical place and the weather was not even on our side. I went with a friend of mine and we upgraded to the Royal Services. It was truly a "Royal Service". I could not have asked for better service, better food and drink, better pool, better beach, etc. 

We arrived at this magical paradise to a staff that was superb and a resort that was gorgeous. Since we upgraded to Royal Service, we soon met our butler, Yohelvi Arecena. His smile alone said a million. What ever we could dream of he was there to provide us from the daily fruit platters, cheese platters, alcohol of choice, bubble bath, personalized cake for our last dinner, and a message for safe travels created in rose petals on the night before we left. You name it, Yohelvi provided. Our favorite place was the private beach and private pool for Royal Service members. One of the things that made these places special was our wonderful, fantastic, always at your service, friendly, etc pool and beach concierge, Billy Lerons. Billy took such good care of us that I wanted to pack him in my suitcase and bring him to America. Before we were even at the beach, Billy had set aside our beach chairs (2 in the shade, 2 in the sun). Each chair had plenty of towels to accommodate us. As soon as we got to the beach, he was ready with our favorite drink. We asked him for a drink in a coconut. There were not coconuts so he went to a tree and knocked down 2 coconuts for us. He also made drinks in pineapples for us. He also had our chairs ready by the pool for our afternoon lounging. Billy sure knew how to spoil us. While at the beach, we were guarded by a wonderful Security Guard, Hilario Santana Reyes. Of course, who can forget food? The food was excellent and service was magnificent. Some of the wonderful staff that catered to us in the restaurants were Richard Ortiz at the Palazzo, restaurant for Royal Service members only so we saw him every day. He knew our names by the second day. Rosa from Gabi Beach, Wilson from Mole' and Naos, and Yuderqui Javier from Vento. Every single one of these people (and so many others) when out of there way to be friendly, courteous, accommodating, and provide spectacular service. 

Paradisus Palma Real was by far the best (out of about 10 visited) All Inclusive resort I have visited. I plan to go back very soon and (of course) see in all these "friends". I highly recommend this resort. Everything about it was just great!

reviews.author: amorosotoo
reviews.title: Impecable service
reviews.text:
The grounds are lovely , [including the fountains, live flamingoes, Japanese bridge, low scale of attractive buildings , art & sculptures, etc.]  . The food exquisite, abundant  plus very varied. But what really stands out are the people : from the front desk to the maids . Some stood out for us : [1] Yeisy Felix , the concierge who got us reservations at all the restaurants
 [2] Laura Castillo , hostess, and Sergio Calderon, waiter, at PASSION ; the food itself was unforgettable , especially the calamari risotto ;my spouse loved the foie grass. It was worth it to pay $50 per person to eat at PASSION.
 [3] Elizabeth Ramón , hostess at NAOS ; friendly, professional 
 [4] Yuderhui Javier , waitress at VENTO [ the food was excellent, especially the truffle risotto ,]and NAOS . In the Asian restaurant I enjoyed the white fish ceviche the most; my spouse > the chicken in green curry.
 The only recommendations we  have are [1] our room keys demagnetized constantly ; so we had to go back to the front desk to get new ones  several times a day [2] very little help at the pool : we had to get our own towels , move the chairs ourselves, find empty chairs , get our own drinks at the bar , etc.
It is perfect for a family, singles or couples since there are many acitivities for every age and taste : from art classes to dance classes , etc.

reviews.author: margregoR
reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: Para ser un hotel de semejane precio,mi experiencia no fue muy agradable,la habitacion con holor a humedad,y deteriorada, la cafetera mal,el mayordomo asignado prometio y no cumplio nadaaaaaaaaaaade  de mis solicitudes ,como fue  por ejemplo el cambio de la maquina del cafe.los cocteles ofrecidos de mala calidad,solo tengo un comentario de una empleada,  Rosa Abreu, quien simpre tenia una sonrisa al atendernos.

reviews.author: veronica b
reviews.title: Impecable!
reviews.text:
es hermoso! la habitación es grande, cómoda, muy bonita!
el hotel en general es precioso, muy grande, muy bien cuidado, muy prolijo.
los restaurantes son muy lindos y la comida es exquisita.
los concerges todos los días nos preguntaban cómo iba todo, si teníamos algún problema con algo.la verdad una atención estupenda. la atención de los mozos es excelente. los chicos del parador de la playa unos genios!! todos, absolutamente todos muy serviciales.
negativamente es poco lo que puedo decir: tal vez estar un poco más atentos en detalles como, el sistema de elevación de la cortina se rompió y no sube. la puerta se falseo la bisagra y se abre, la luz del balcón se quemo y no enciende, y los carros que van dentro del hotel llevando servicio a las distintas partes del hotel son muy viejos y no están acorde con el hotel. si bien son detalles menores, creo que son detalles que pueden hacer mejorar al hotel.

reviews.author: 759LauraS759
reviews.title: watch out for the concierge scam
reviews.text: The property is very pretty, and unlike most Caribbean all-inclusives, the food is excellent, but avoid the "concierge" that meets you at the door like the plague: a total waste of your time, scheming for a way to get you to the time-share/upcharge meeting.  They do not have any ability to affect restaurant reservations (which you should make from your room, the reservations open Monday and Thursday), whatever they say, and the tour they give of the property to emphasize what is NOT included in your stay is once again a total waste of time.  It's too bad, because there are many nice staff there: Rodolfo in particular is a sweetie, and his shows for the hotel are excellent...

reviews.author: Stephen R
reviews.title: Paradise in the D.R.
reviews.text: I just returned from a wonderful week with my spouse and 2 kids (ages 10 and 4). We met my wife's family (mother, father and two sisters)  who flew in from Toronto and L.A.  The setting was paradise, the food was incredible and the service was exceptional. Everyone was helpful but I would like to give special thanks to Ramon who was the butler for my wife's sisters in the royal service and made things go effortlessly.  Pedro was extremely helpful  in providing pool and beach services, always with a smile. Joangel in entertainment was an excellent ambassador for the hotel and made sure our kids and each member of the family had a wonderful experience. This was such a fantastic trip that my family will return again and I will recommend this resort to our friends.

reviews.author: Cara H
reviews.title: Family Spring Break at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real has some wonderful employees, dedicated to an exceptional, fun experience.  We would specifically like to thank and let the following restaurant employees know how much we appreciated them:  Wilson at Mole; Rosa at Gabi Beach; Nelson, our Royal Service bartender; Francisco who took care of our drinks on the beach; Jendi Traviaso at Bana, and Juan Jose "JJ" at Bana.   Awesome time!

reviews.author: EduNav719
reviews.title: Excelente estadia
reviews.text: El complejo completo es excelente, piscinas limpias, baños muy modernos y siempre en buen estado, el servicio es su mayor fortaleza, siempre están atentos a lo que el cliente necesita y quiero hacer mención especial al restaurante gabi beach, excelente servicio en especial de Juan de Aza y su equipo.

reviews.author: Scooter79
reviews.title: Once we figured things out, excellent!
reviews.text:
3/23/13 - 3/30/13
We started out at The Reserve - big mistake (unless you bring children), but my review for that resort is posted as well.  To summarize our experience there, we had a great Customer Service rep named Gabriel that took care of our questions, concerns and helped us upgrade to Royal Service.

We chose to upgrade to Royal Service due to the adult only nature of this portion of the resort.  This was really what we were looking for anyway - so it was our mistake for booking The Reserve in the first place.  We were greeted by friendly receptionists and offered drinks and cold towels - definitely a nice comfortable atmosphere in the Royal Service lounge.

Once checked in we were given our cell phone to contact our fantastic butler, Ramon Justo De Aza.  He brought us to our room, showing us everything along the way, explained the room, mini-bar,  the restaurants and dinner reservations.  We told him a couple of places and he took care of the rest.  Justo (as his name tag read) was always available and took care of everything we needed. 

Royal Service: highly recommended - simply for the fact that you get your own butler, private section of the beach and a pool with bar for Royal Service guests only, access to all restaurants and peace and quiet if you want it.

The Beach!: Royal Service has a private section of the beach where there are plenty of beach beds and chairs to be had.  The sand was great, the water beautiful and the drinks plentiful.  Everyday we had Francesco and Billy to take care of us.  They prepared the beds with towels and brought our drinks - this is where we chose to spend the majority of our time.  Drink service did dwindle a bit after 3pm, but by then we  usually had enough anyway - but I would recommend that the beach staff still go out to check.

The pool: Royal service, again has its own pool, but the beds around that go quickly (non-issue for us, as we paid for the Caribbean Sea, we swam in it - we have pools at home).  The water is warm and the bar is close - that's all I can say about it.  I'd recommend the ocean.
The main pool looked nice, it was never crowded, everyone looked like they were having a good time.

Restaurants: we only have one other All-Inclusive resort in the Riviera Maya to compare to, but hands down, the food quality here is MUCH better.  We only ate at a few of the restaurants available, but here's the breakdown: 
NAOS - the buffet, food was okay, a good assortment - but definitely better for breakfast than anything else.  Service was hit or miss, one time it we had no issues getting drinks and refills, 2 times we had trouble getting anyone to come over.  Their idea of washing tables seems to be using a napkin to wipe away the crumbs of other guests...

Palazzo (Italian for Royal Service only):  This turned out to be our restaurant of choice - we ate breakfast and lunch here the majority of the time (after the experience at NAOS).  We were greeted everyday by the friendly hostess (and I'm sorry I didn't get her name!!), and brought drinks by Richard Ortiz who was devastated to learn that he brought us our last drinks on Saturday.  He was always friendly and prompt - he definitely made our dining experience a great one.  Both chefs behind the grill did a fantastic job on everything they cooked up for us, and the lunch and breakfast buffet always had something different to choose from.

Passion: We paid for the experience - the extra $$ per person seemed worth it for the type of food promised - and it was good.  We ended up eating too much bread though, so be careful.  Our waiter was Yeuris Sanches, assisted by Julio Cesar - a great team that was very professional and ran liked a well oiled machine.  Yeuris explained the process (we ordered the tasting menu), every dish and what to expect and when.  

Vento (Mediterranean): This restaurant was just ok.  I wasn't impressed, it was probably the most busy of them all, I heard of mistakes in reservations for others, people not being told about changes in their times.  The food was average, nothing worth remembering.

Bana (Sushi): Just terrible, poor service, the Maki was ok, but nothing special, the Sashimi was terrible, the tuna was not fresh, the salmon was just chunked and not really of the best quality.  There weren't that many people in this section of the restaurant, there was one server, and one person doing drinks along with what appeared to be 2 other people (one manager and I'm not sure who the other person was).  We ordered our drinks that eventually got there, then our food, of which we ordered a little at first, and planned to order something else afterwards if we wanted to try more.  After finishing the first serving of food, we weren't really impressed, but wanted to try some of the other items, but no one came for probably 30 minutes - so we asked for desert menus and drink refills.  No drinks ever came, after about 15 minutes someone asked us about the deserts and we told him what we wanted - he never relayed it to the waiter.  The waiter came back by after another 10 minutes and asked us what we wanted, so we said nothing and left.  I spoke to the manager about the experience and explained to him that the fault should not be completely on the waiter, because this is what I saw: the one waiter was doing EVERYTHING, while 2 or 3 people stood around with their arms crossed, the drink waitress was nowhere to be seen.  Instead of taking our order and attending to guests, the waiter was busy clearing off other tables, even though they didn't really have anyone waiting to sit at them.  Either way, if you are from the US, the sushi you get here is much better, don't bother with this section.

Bana (Teppanyaki): basically hibachi - we were promised a show with dinner - the chef we had could flip a spatula and fork - that was the show.  He proceeded with cooking the rice and then the other foods as we had ordered.  The food was good, the service was good (much better than the sushi), but then again, we are right there at the grill, so it's not too hard.  We ended up with the same drink waitress we had at the sushi section, but she performed much better this time.  So, food was good, show was basically non-existent.

Market Grill: We walked over to this to check it out at lunch, all I saw were hamburgers, we decided against it, so I can't really say anything about it.

Gabi Beach: didn't make it to this one, regrettable - wish we had tried it.

Mole (Mexican): We were actually surprised by this one.  There was no discernible entrance to this, you have to walk through NAOS to get to a nondescript entrance (I think adding a host podium would help).  Once we figured it out, the hostess was great and took care of us.  Our waiter Wilson Otanez was excellent!  Definitely one of the best we had during our stay.  The food was actually really good - better than the Mexican food we had at the AI resort in Mexico!

Other things of note: 
Shopping - they have their own shopping plaza right in front of the resort - and after going to a small local plaza, we determined it was better to just shop at the resort.  The quality of the goods and prices were better (although varied slightly from shop to shop for Rum, Cigars, coffee, gifts).  Specialty shops were expensive, many we have here in the US, so stick to the local stuff.  The gift shop in the resort was very expensive for everything, so take a golf cart shuttle to the plaza.

Rum: bring back some Ron Barcelo Imperial rum - it can be found for $20 US at the plaza in the cigar shop (or $50 in the gift shop).  It is just good, I don't think I've had better rum (although I'm not an aficionado...).  Small bottles of Brugal Extra Veijo can be found for $7-$9 dollars, big ones for under $20, I think I saw one for $13.

I didn't buy anything, but the Duty Free Americas shop at the Punta Cana airport actually had some really good prices on alcohol and tobacco products (all items you can buy here, but for the price difference, if you are going and want to buy it, buy it there before you head out to your resort if you don't have a direct flight home).

If you plan on bringing back liquor, bring an extra bag, and some padding, since you have to check everything.  

Travel to and from the airport, we used dominicanairporttransfers - I can recommend them - our experience was pleasant, from the airport, they knew our flight arrived late, and I called from Atlanta just to make sure, and the gentleman on the line simply stated, "Relax, you're on vacation - we'll take care of it!"  And they did.  Leaving the resort, they were slightly early (which is the only way to be on time), we had a private car both ways, and cost only slightly more than a Taxi.

reviews.author: PatriciaA948
reviews.title: Magnifico!
reviews.text: Hola, viajamos mi hija y yo en diciembre 2012, y pasamos las fiestas de fin de año, hasta enero de 2013, a este maravilloso lugar : Punta Cana! Nos alojamos en The Reserve, Paradisus Punta Cana. El hotel es sencilla y literalmente maravilloso!. La habitación superó mis expectativas, realmente era un departamento de lujo: amplio, confortable, luminoso. La atención: excelente! Les cuento un poco: este hotel que tiene no sé cuantas hectáreas de de jardines, es realmente para no volver a casa. Nuestra habitaciñon estaba casi pegada el Restaurant Gaby y en frente de la piscina.Genial! La limpieza de las habitaciones, como la atención desde la primera a la última persona: son muy buenas.El servicio, tanto como en las habitaciones, Restaurantes, piscina, playa es esmeradisima! La comida? Un restaurante mejor que el otro : Gaby, Gaby Beach, Vento, Fuego.. se come realmente muy bien! Comida variada, desde frutos del mar, quesos, comidas calientes de pollo, pescado, cerdo, vaca.Frutas y verduras de las que te imagines y de las que no! Los tragos: super! No duden en preguntarme, porque seria muy extenso contarles brevemente lo maravilloso que es este lugar. Volvería SIN DUDAS!! Lo recomiendo? SIN DUDAS! Saludos a todos : Hihwan, Myki, el mozo de la playa con su siempre muy buen humor y predispoción. Saludos a todos! Se hacen extrañar!

reviews.author: Lori O
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text: We just returned from our trip to a destination wedding.  The resort was beautiful and the service was excellent.  Every day started out great thanks to Nicoles and Peter from Room Service.  They provided excellent service throughout our whole stay.  The weather was perfect all six days we were there and the beaches were not crowded and relaxing.

reviews.author: Fechavo
reviews.title: One of the Best Hotels in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Very nice place, magnificent entrance, lobby and ocean view from front desk. It's an upscale facility. Restaurants a la carte wonderful (try the Asian food at the Bana complex),  buffet at main restaurant average. Beach service very good with a waitress serving drinks. Nice chairs, towels and setting at the beach. Royal service (pay extra) is better but not sure worth the extra cost.
SPA experience a must with ecological cabanas over a small lake where you receive the massage, single or couples and the water treatment at the SPA ( included in your massage) is a wonderful experience.
Will return.

reviews.author: Jailes
reviews.title: Opinion sobre el hotel
reviews.text:
Bueno, primeramente es un hotel bien bonito y acogedor y lo puedo recopmnedar a cualquier persona que busque un hotel tranquilo y que quiera descanzar, especifcamente en la parte de la 
(LA Reserva)  The Reserve. ya que es una area, bien tranquila y acogedora. no es un hotel de mucho movimiento y el publico yo diria que es un publico adulto maduro. espero que mi opinion le sirva de alguna guia. 

Att. Jayles Hedz
Tour Guide. 
Santo Domingo DR. 
1.809.902.5615

reviews.author: Marta C
reviews.title: Genial si reservas en Servicio Real
reviews.text:
He estado alojada en este hotel en el mes de Enero, y mi experiencia ha sido fantastica. Tuve un cambio de habitacion el primer dia porque no cumplia las expectativas, y no correspondia con lo reservado, pero pasado el primer disgusto, no resuelto por el personal de recepcion, que no resolvio nada y me facilito hoja de reclamaciones como unica opcion, pero el personal de RRPP Martha fue maravillosa, recuerdo una frase suya como maravillosa me dijo "esta usted en Republica Dominicana y aqui no hay problemas hay situaciones y las situaciones fluyen", y asi fue en toda mi estancia, al estar en el Servicio Real todo fue de 10, el mayordomo personal fue fantastico, la habitacion estupenda con unas vistas deliciosas al mar, con detalles especiales cada dia en la habitacion, y atenciones especiales durante todo el dia.
Pero lo mejor era la playa, y en la zona de Servicio real sus camitas maravillosas. 
Todo fantastico, restaurante muy buenos sobre todo el show cooking, muy divertido yo repeti en este. Mojitos y baile para acabar el dia. Paraiso en la tierra.
Unica critica el personal de recepcion sobre todo a dos de sus miembros, pero la experiencia posterior fue tan buena que ya lo he olvidado.

reviews.author: Jorge M
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text: Acabo de llegar de Punta Cana y pasè unos dìas maravillosos en este hotel. El servicio y las habitaciones son fantàsticas, La playa muy buena. Un menciòn especial para el barman de la piscina Ramòn Fuego verdaderamente ESPECTACULAR quien con su alegrìa y tragos fantàsticos hizo muy amena nuestra estadìa.

reviews.author: namneuville
reviews.title: Un vrai 5 étoiles
reviews.text:
Ca fait plusieurs fois que nous allons à Punta Cana dans des 5 étoiles, on peut donc facilement comparer. L'accueil à l'arrivée a été excellent. Déception pour l'emplacement de notre chambre. Nous sommes donc retourné à la réception et ils ont fait des pieds et des mains pour nous satisfaire. Toutes les chambres sont des suites avec une immense salle de bain un lit énorme très confo, une terrasse pour chaque chambre.
Le soir, avant d'aller souper, il y avait un petit bar avec musique et drink tout à fait à la hauteur, le martini olive excellent, je le recommande. 
Contrairement à ce qu'on avait lu des autres commentaires, ce fût très facile de réserver les restaurants. Le buffet était aussi excellent et le vin inclus raisonnable.
Les seuls petits hic, trop de services et options différentes, tous devraient avoir droit à un service 5 étoiles...
Pas assez de vue mer, le complexe est construit pour garder la fraicheur et le calme, donc presque tous des vues jardin!

reviews.author: Daniel A
reviews.title: Mis mejores vacaciones!!!!
reviews.text: Cuando decidimos con mi esposa ir nueve días a Punta Cana al Paradisus Palma Real , después de comprar el paquete turístico , pensaba ¿qué voy hacer tantos días en un solo lugar ? , te cuento , nueve días nos parecieron poco , vamos a volver , con más tiempo de estadía. Al llegar al aeropuerto , nos estaba esperando un auto que nos llevó directo al hotel , nos recibieron en la recepción y nos presentaron a Pedro , que sería nuestro guía (anfitrión) . la habitación , un lujo , enorme y con todo el confort que te puedas imaginar , Juana Ramos (mucama camarista) una mujer excelente , era la encargada de mantener 10 puntos la misma . hay 6 restaurantes , uno más lindo que otro , Pedro se encargaba de las reservas para ir a cenar , pero nos gustaba ir al rest. NAOS , es lo máximo , en calidad de los desayunos y en la variedad de comidas , de la atención ni hablar , única , la mejor , te cuento: los camareros Glenny Rodriguez - Pablo Perez - Kelvin Feliciano - Frandy Santana - Fiordaliza Marte - y el cocinero de cena  Miguel Angel Sotovilorio - ( Miguel te cocinaba al toque , lo que le pidieras , un fenómeno) , toda esta gente nos atendió tan bién , nos mimaron tanto , que se me hace muy difícil explicarlo . los encargados del rest. NAOS , Juan de Dios asistente A y B , y el encargado Mario , dos tipos de primera . El espectáculo estaba  en el bar de la pileta , el bantender ; Ramón Fuego , haciendo equilibrio con una botella en la cabeza , corriendo sobre la barra , gritando fuego - fuego , te servia los mejores tragos que te puedas imaginar ( este muchacho , todo un SHOWMAN ) , en este mismo bar está Bianca Marta , camarera de la playa , increible como te atendía , le pedía y a los cinco minutos tenías tu trago , un amor de persona. En actividades , lo mejor , Maria Cecilia Arias , la coreógrafa ( un encanto de mujer con un toque caribeño , que lleva la salsa en la sangre ) , junto con , Ebelise - José - Leo Y Gabriel , te hacían gozar todas las noches de diferentes espectáculos , y terminaban bailando , salsa , merengue , bachata ......donde hacían participar a todos los presentes ( era hermoso terminar la noche bailando y tomando una copa ó un café en alguna de las tantas barras que hay por todo el hotel) . Difinitivamente vamos a volver el próximo año , y lo recomiendo , el Paradisus Palma Real , es una hermosa alternativa , para unas relajadas vacaciones.

reviews.author: DeeDeeNH
reviews.title: Had a Great time!
reviews.text:
Once we moved from The Reserve to the Royal service area of the resort!  We wanted to be nearer the beach.  At the Reserve section you need to take a golf cart to the beach-it's a haul.
Had a great "butler" who took care of everyting for us from dinner reservations to finding super glue to fix my husbands's Tevas!!  His name is Carlos A. de la Cruz.  He was terrific! Ask to be assigned to him! All the restaurants (except buffets) required advance reservations-a couple are casual, some are a little dressier, which I found a little annoying-not that I'd go as a slob, but you don't always feel like dressing up on vacation. There were a couple of occasions at the buffets where we were seated, but then it took awhile to be acknowledged by a waiter and brought drinks before we hit the buffet. It took a little work to get a vegetarian meal put together from the offerings at a couple of the a la carte restaraunts, but fortunately my husband is fluent in spanish and helped work our way through it. The few times that we needed maintence help they were there within 15 minutes, took care of the problem and even got a follow up phone call to check on their service.  Wilkins at the Sunset bar was a standout!  Very attentive.     Went Zip lining with Canopy Tours-it was an excellent!  I was pretty nervous, and their attention to safety and making sure we all knew what we were doing put me at ease.  It was a LONG drive up into the mountains to get to the lines, though.  They said 45 minutes-I say double that!  The roads into the mts. were awful!  But once there-safe fun!  I had a very good massage at the Spa onsite.
  
Don't know what the naysayers are talking about, but I will say that we saw a lot of very rude folks who were snapping their fingers, shouting at the workers, rolling their eyes, etc.  A few 'por favors, gracias-s", and smiles go a long way to getting good service!!

reviews.author: AKA_Hiram_Abif
reviews.title: A hit and miss
reviews.text: My wife and I are members of the Melia Vacation Club and this is the 3rd time we've been to Palma Real since we like it better than the other two which we also visited a few years back, they treat you well in general when at restaurants, etc but like the other reviews I've read, there's a gap when it comes to service and you don't speak spanish. I'm at the Reserve this time around, without going into the prices, I think it's a pretty great place for couples. The misses so far on the first day: 1. I asked for a time and place for mass from reception and they said they'd call back... I guess maybe I'll get an answer on Monday when Sunday is over. 2. I'm here with my wife, they get us a room with 2 beds which were single/flat beds, when asked if they had rooms with a King or Queen bed which my wife asked, they said they don't have "single bed" rooms at the Reserve, really? So we were expected to stay at a really expensive place and end up falling off the bed because the bed is too small because instead of a nice big one we get two small ones? To fix it, they joined the two, so now there's a hard section in the middle, yes that really helps guys... 3. We got an email a few days ago asking what they can do for us, we replied back asking for a reservation for a particular popular restaurant since we already know from experience that the first day, you always miss reservations to popular restaurants especially if you arrive after 12PM. Got here and guess what? No reservation and the person who asked "if there's anything we can do for you?" wasn't around, so our reply email was probably not even read, but if it were read then there's a much bigger issue here. If you cannot commit, don't ask, OK? Again, a great place for couples, try to hit all the restaurants, don't expect too much on service, just do your own thing if you can. Make reservations for each night clear, this is from past experience. There's still a lot of days left on this trip, I still think it's the best resort at Punta Cana, but as a member and price anyone who is not pays, I expect more, we'll see if things improve. Till the next review.

reviews.author: bsoba2000
reviews.title: No se dejen engañar
reviews.text: Al llegar a Punta Cana, para ir al Hard Rock Hotel, el maletero me llevó directamente a un representante del Paradisus Palma Real. Nos dijo que por ser huéspedes del Hard Rock nos invitarían a un evento VIP, como parte del aniversario del hotel, para ver las instalaciones y probar el servicio. Que todo sería gratis y todo el día. Que no aceptara ir a la reunión de ventas del paquete vacacional de mi hotel, pues debería disfrutar mis vacaciones y que lo que él nos ofrecía era la mejor forma para hacerlo. Al llegar al Paradisus Palma Real, nos percatamos que se trataba, precisamente, de una tomada de pelo y que nos dirigíamos a los famosos 90 minutos de orientación para la venta del plan vacacional. Ya que estábamos allí, aceptamos. Nos invitaron a desayunar -nada del otro mundo. En ese restaurante me quemé la mano, ya que el cocinero que estaba confeccionando los omelettes dejó el plato cerca del fuego. El representante de ventas, ni su gerente hicieron algo para ayudarme. Únicamente las empleadas de mantenimiento me ofrecieron cebolla y salsa de tomate para mi mano. Al culminar la presentación, que nos dicen los precios "altísimos" del paquete vacacional, la gerente, de nombre Laura, nos trató de manera ruda, burda y muy grosera. Le expliqué que estuvimos allí por engaño y que no pretendíamos comprar nada y ella se alteró. La experiencia fue horrorosa.

reviews.author: BKJ28
reviews.title: Perfect Resort In Punta Cana
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful.  It is large and you will do a lot of walking.  The room was very nice and stocked with beer and non-alcoholic beverages daily.  The pool was very large and beautiful.  The beach had plenty of lounge chairs and huts to get out of the sun and great to walk or run on to catch the sunrise.  There are a variety of restaurants available, including the buffet (which had a pretty good selection of foods at all meals).  There are also 3 Asian, 1 Mediteranean, and a steakhouse, all included in your resort cost.  There are a variety of non-motorized "toys" available on site as well as tennis and golf.  There are also excursions available offsite.  Our personal concierge, Alvaro Costillo, was available daily and really helped us find our way around and maximize everything the resort had to offer, including making our dinner, golf & tennis reservations as well as referring us to an excursion expert that was contracted with the resort.  We enjoyed it all and would go back again.

reviews.author: jerry l
reviews.title: JUST GORGEOUS
reviews.text: I just came back from a week of relaxing time with verynice wheather, the resort is nice and super clean, pool is spectacular, the beach is great( clear water ), the staff is very helpful and friendly especially RAMON FUEGO,VICTOR and GLORIA at the pool.......this guys are incredible!...........Another person is IRIS at the coffe station. They make your stay like no place on earth.

reviews.author: VCrook
reviews.title: Edgar Gonzalas made our trip grand!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for 10 days in mid March 2012.  Our personal concierge, Edgar Gonzalas, met us daily to see what we might need to make our trip enjoyable. He made all of our daily dinner reservations so that we were able to make the most of the dining options at the resort.  He was there to address our every need. Not much to do outside of the resort, but that was just fine for us, we wanted to relax and that's exactly what we did. The resort is very nice and clean.  All of the staff were very pleasant and went the extra mile.  The buffet manager, Mario, was also very accomodating and wanted to make sure we were satisfied with all of our meals.  Ramon at the pool made us laugh everyday. Would go back today if I could.

reviews.author: nanyBuenosAires
reviews.title: inigualable experiencia en el Paradisus Palma Real Resort !!!!!
reviews.text: Hemos pasado mi esposo y yo los mejores 9 dias de vacaciones !!!!! El servicio es de excelencia. Queremos agradecer especialmente la cordialidad de sus empleados : Actividades, a la hermosa coreografa Maria Cecilia Arias y sus parteneires, Ibelice, Jose, Leo , Gabriel y demas por la calidez y cariño que nos demostraron. Los mimos y atenciones de las/los camareros;Fiordaliza Marte, Pablo Perez del Naos, al cocinero de noche que nos preparaba todo lo que pediamos Miguel Angel Sotovilorio y los servicios de playa de camarera Bianca Marta y el inigualable show de "Fuego Fuego" Ramon Fuego de Bartender. Hemos disfrutado cada momento mientras duro nuestra estadia. Lo SUPER recomedamos . Esperamos volver la proxima temporada. Mil gracias por tanta cordialidad y buen servicio!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: cesevilla
reviews.title: Calidad de Servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel esta muy bien mantenido, lo más importante es que el personal se ve muy motivado a prestar un Excelente servicio. Nuestra habitación (# 3405) presentó algunos detalles apenas llegamos (cañería tapada en la regadera - no servía el control remoto de la TV - la caja fuerte no funcionaba) pero todo fue resuelto en cuestión de minutos. 
Durante nuestra estancia observamos cierta irregularidad en cuanto a los horarios del transporte interno y por casualidad fui atendido el Sr. Rafael Torres quien de inmediato tomo nota de la novedad que fue subsanada ese misma día, igualmente le agradezco al Sr. Rafael Alcalde por su amable atención durante el seguimiento del caso.
De lo restaurantes solamente conocimos : Bana - Gabi Beach - Gabi Club - Vento - Naos y Mizu pero solamente nos gustaron  : Gabi Club - Vento - Naos y Mizu ya que en los otros no hay nada que destacar.
Fuimos muy bien atendidos en el Club Melia por la la Sra. Patricia Coste, en el YHI Spa (Reserve) por el Sr. Wander Trinidad, por todas las jovenes que laboran en el Kid Zone, por la la Sra María Cecilia del Grupo de Animación y por la Sra María del Servicio de Habitaciones (destacada al Edificio # 34).
Con gusto recomendaría este hotel y esperamos volver a repetir esta agradable experiencia en Paradius Palma Real.

reviews.author: Jesus D
reviews.title: Pool
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful ,staff is very friendly . There is one guy at the main pool that makes your day more enjoyable his name is Ramon "Fuego" .

reviews.author: OzVetea
reviews.title: Be carefull!!!
reviews.text: Be very, very patient about personal belongings. Do not leave money unattended!!! Me and my family had very bad experience about that. I mean IN THE ROOM, NOT OUTSIDE!!

reviews.author: NYCJaneE723
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: The resort is immaculately maintained, the beach is beautiful, rooms were spacious and clean. I can't say enough good things about this resort. We absolutely loved our stay and were sad to leave! We stayed in the Sol Melia owners area and the staff was extremely accommodating, especially Freddy, at the bar! He had our cabana/day bed ready for us every morning and made sure our newly made friends that we met at the resort were next to us! We ate nearly every few hours - totally gluttonous but we were paying for the all-inclusive so we indulged ourselves! The pool & the beach were always clean. We would love to go back soon!

reviews.author: Manny C
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: I recently took my boys to the Paradisus Palma Real.  The room was great.  Nicely detailed.  Comfy beds.  Granite everywhere.  a fully stocked mini bar.  The resort was fantastic.  Absolutely beautiful.  The staff was more than accomodating.  The food excellent.  Two of the staff.  Hamlet and Nathaniel were unbelievable.  They made everything happen that we needed too.  We used the VIP for transport to and from the resort.  We did the the dolphin explorer trip which was amazing.  I have stayed at beaches several times and found this place better.  The beach was absolutely gorgeous.  I would put this on your travel plans.  For the price a great trip.

reviews.author: Kim S
reviews.title: Perfect holiday experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I went to the Paradisus on our own (first time on holiday without taking children).  Everything about our vacation experience at the Paradisus was perfect!  We did a "Royal Service" package and I highly recommend the upgrade, since it allows you to enjoy a special Royal Service restaurant and, most of all, the services of a butler who will make your dinner reservations, ensure that you have a bana bed by the pool, bring wine and snacks to your room each evening while you prepare for dinner, and even prepare a jacuzzi for you, complete with bubbles and rose petals!  The staff here are fantastic - uber-professional, friendly and helpful.  And the food is amazing.  We ate at a different restaurant each night and never had a single appetizer, main course or dessert that was not 5 star quality.  Even the nightly entertainment was specatcular (cirque performance is awesome).  

We have been on all-inclusive holidays before and have enjoyed them, but this experience was really in a category of its own.  Again... I believe that the "Royal Service" package played a significant role in making this such an outstanding holiday because it completely removed even the possibility of having anything go wrong by providing us with an assigned staff member to take care of everything.

reviews.author: Marty Brescia
reviews.title: good time
reviews.text:
settimana fantastica alla resort, per chi e' interessato le attivita' non sono male, e i ragazzi sono simpatici.

La Bre

reviews.author: Veronica S
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation!
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently stayed a week at this resort celebrating our 5th wedding anniversary.  We could not be happier with our stay!  The room, the grounds, and pretty much everything about the resort were top notch.  Throughout the whole week we could not stop saying, "Wow!".  We booked through RCI and had a concierge, Bruny, approach us on day one and he was there throughout our stay making sure everything was easy and relaxing.  Bruny made all of our dinner reservations, booked our excursions, etc.  He was fabulous and certainly deserves some recognition and a bonus or reward.  He made our stay phenomenal!  We have never stayed at an All-Inclusive resort before so we were curious if it was worth the value....and it was.  The food was very good, the drinks (and alcohol) were top notch, name brand, and it all of it was available 24 hours.  I would also recommend booking a few excursions to see the beautiful island.  We went on a buggy tour (watch out you get dirty) which was so much fun and then we booked a full day excursion to Saona which was well worth the money.  Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our vacation and will have an experience we can treasure forever.  Thank you again to Bruny and to the whole staff, you were wonderful!

Best regards
Joseph and Veronica (Family Hermans)

reviews.author: Tat3115
reviews.title: T. S. Toronto, Canada
reviews.text:
I just returned from a one week stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. I enjoyed it very much. It is upscale resort.  All the staff was very friendly. Almost every one was fluent in English and some spoke other languages as well.
Food was excellent and service was great. The front desk manager Rafael Torres spent a great deal of time to help choose the best room and plan suitable for me. Josefina Abrey -front desk receptionist made me extremely happy finding me the ocean front room and helping to choose the royal service with many priveleges inluding an exclusive beach area for the fraction of money. She helped make my trip so pleasant. The room was huge and very clean. The bed was very comfortable and linens were changed daily. At night it was very quiet in the hotel. It is a 500 rooms hotel and it was almost completely booked but I never felt crowded on the beach or in the pool and restaurantes. 
The Gabi restorante is one of the best but you pay for the meal if you are a standard  service member. I recommend to upgrade your service from standard but after your arrival.
The pools area was beautiful with a lot of vegetation and very comfortable sunbeds. The hotel has a very wide and long white sandy beach with many palapes. 
One very negative thing with this hotel is  Ilike to swim in the ocean and the sea weed was growing all over in the water. It was very unpleasant.

reviews.author: jean a
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful!  The entire staff was friendly and helpful.  Everyone went above and beyond to make our stay great.  Our favorite time to spend the afternoons was at the Pool Bar.  Ramon "Fuego" Bonilla, Louis, and Bianca are EXCELLENT!!!!  They consistently treated us like royalty!  We will definetly come back - to see the resort as well as spend time with Ramon, Louis, and Bianca!!!

reviews.author: dan m
reviews.title: Paradisius Palma Real Punta Cana - very nice
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 5 day stay at the Paradisius Palma Real in Punta Cana.  After reading reviews on tripadvisor, we were curious to see how the resort stood up to the good, the bad, and the ugly reviews.  In summary, we were very pleased and will return.  

Staff and Service:
We enjoyed the staff very much.  There were some negative reviews on staff, but in my opinion, you get what you ask for.  We treated the staff very well, interacted with them, and in exchange, they embraced us.  We witnessed some vacationers that were rude and the staff remained professional.  Some people always find a reason to complain, so would dismiss their complaints, unless you are just high maintenance.  We also had no issues with service.
-We would like to recognize Orny Guzman, bartender at the Gabi Bar.  This guy is spectacular, one of the nicest people you will ever meet.

Rooms:
-Majority of rooms are not oceanfront, but have great privacy and garden views.  Rooms are well appointed and in good shape.

Beaches:
The beaches are super nice.  The great thing is, they put security at each end of the beach to keep the locals off and away from hassling you.  Security is on one end of the Paradisius and at the far end of the Melia, therefore, providing a really nice stretch of beach without hassle.  There were plenty of open chairs and cabanas for us.
-Caution:  If you walk beyond security, you will be approached by locals selling anything and everything, so unless you are used to dealing with this, stay within the boundaries.

Amenities:
-The resort has everything you and your family will need to enjoy your vacation.  Depending on the time of year, golf is included in the all inclusive and there are three 9 hole courses.  Scuba is included, which was a nice perk.  Scuba was average as much of the coral is dead, so not a whole lot of sea life.  However, its scuba, so very cool regardless.  The scuba instructors/masters were very nice and did a great job.
-All non motorized sports were included as well - kayaks, sailing, etc

Food:
-The food was decent.  We did not experience any food that was bad and the selection was adequate.
-Victor from "Vento" restaurant was an outstanding waiter and had a great sense of humor.

Club Melia:
-They will most likely ask you to join their 90 minute Club Melia tour.  It is an interesting concept, similar to timeshare, so will leave it at that.  Not something for us, so we cut the tour off early and 90 minutes is some precious time while on a quick vacation.

Room levels:
This is all a little confusing as they have differing levels of service.  Standard = standard, VIP, Royal Service, The Reserve, Club Melia.  Make sure you clarify which is which prior to booking your reservation.  

Dan

reviews.author: Flag-OnYour-Knapsack
reviews.title: Outstanding Service from Luis (Activities Group)
reviews.text: After hearing a couple of hours of great Dominican music on the beach, I asked Luis from the Activities Group where I could buy a cd to take home.  He ended up taking his personal memory stick over to the DJs and asked them save all the songs they were playing on to his device.  He then gave me his memory stick to take home.  There must be over 100 songs saved.  This is a nice example of going the extra mile for a hotel guest.  Jose and Gabriel from the same Activities Group also stood out a great hotel ambassadors.

reviews.author: Manuelmen
reviews.title: Lo mejor en punta cana
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, excelente atencion, excelentes instalaciones de verdad todo un espectaculo!!! Ramon Fuego el mejor de todos!!!! Fuegoooooooo

reviews.author: DanniEspinha
reviews.title: Punta Cana no Paraíso Palma Real
reviews.text: Ao escolher esse Resort, fiquei maravilhada primeiramente pelas fotos na net e depois constatamos a exuberância do lugar!! Os funcionários são de altíssimo nível e com um treinamento impecável no tratamento aos hóspedes: sempre sorridentes, gentis e educadíssimos em todo hotel. Os restaurantes são ótimos, sempre com seus menus diferenciados e mesmo o self, todos as refeiçoes fartas e variadas, para todos os gostos!! O hotel é um exemplo de que o Paraíso realmente existe, piscina fantástica, SPA divino e acomodações muito confortáveis, tudo perfeito e em sincronia com o Paraíso !! Tenho a plena convicção de que voltarei várias vezes!!!

reviews.author: endya1
reviews.title: Excellence at its best!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Paradisus for our anniversary and we could not have been more pleased. Everything about this resort if for your relaxation. The rooms are incredible, the staff is wonderful, and the food is delicious. My favorite part is the open-air courtyard where you can relax to live jazz music as the evening breeze comes in. I highly recommend this property and would go back again and again.

reviews.author: mjhanley34
reviews.title: Nice time...
reviews.text:
Check out the Pool Bar and ask the bartender by the name of Ramion Fuego to make you a Coco Loco! It's great! Especially if you find a real coconut from the beach for him to pour it into!

Place was very nice, service was great, food only average but it was an all inclusive so that's to be expected.

My wife and I went and had a good time, but it's probably a better place for a family trip.

reviews.author: oliverMichigan
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego Saved The Trip !!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that It is not a 5 star hotel in my opinion. The food was average, Not even the Special restaurants weren't anything more that average, and the service was not anything special. I was having a 3 star hotel experience until we met Ramon Fuego at the Pool Bar, Ramon, Luis, Victor and Bianca made this hotel a better place, wtih Ramon Jumping around with Drinks on his head and making people Drink Fuegooo!! He's the only reason to come to this hotel!!! 

Bottom line this hotel is overpriced, But if you have the Money Ramon is well worth it !!!!!!!

reviews.author: Shepsys
reviews.title: Unforgettable trip. I love this country and people
reviews.text: Hello, i am from Ukraine, my name Anastasiya)  We came for couple weeks for usual AL relaxing vacation and it was our first visit to DR. Have choose hotel because of advices of our friends. It was just enough for me to be on Atlantic oceans beaches and i did not expected anythings else except  amazing nature. BUT the hotel was gifted us most amazing impressions of our trip!!!!!  its was just sooooo much fun there!!! A lot of different handmade lessons, crazy and passionate lessons of their local dances, gym, yoga, pilates etc...If i would visit them all every day i won't have free minutre to just lay and relax and i was crazily close to it)) My best wishes and just positive impressions of our Animation Exelenteee)) guys! They rocks! and made me fall in love with their guys))) Want to advice next guys for girls who love to dance salsa, bachata, samba and other dances : Eliezer Sealin, then tall guy Gabriel (sorry, don't know his surname but you will recognize him coz he looks like Adriano Chelentano, but just a little darker:)))  Also great guys who entertained me and my friend - Jose Pikacho, Luis Bailario, Angel Alcantare  and Jose Gonzales!!! reviews.author: Marina B
reviews.title: Animacion Excelente!
reviews.text:
Первый раз не хотелось возвращаться домой после двухнедельного отдыха. Огромное спасибо ребятам, которые не давали нам скучать ни минуты. Анимация просто превосходная, Спасибо Jose, Angel, Leo, Gabriel, Lois, Maria, Eliezen, Pikacho! Вы сделали наш отдых незабываемым!

Еда с утра до ночи разнообразная и вкусная, вино, каждый день особенный коктейль, вечером развлекательная программа, танцы. 
Всем рекомендую.
Обязательно вернусь сюда еще!

reviews.author: Cami_Nogueira
reviews.title: Lua de Mel Perfeita
reviews.text: Ficamos no Paradisus Palma Real em Março/Abril 2012 e fomos muito bem atendidos. Por termos usado o Royal Service, nos foi designado um concierge que nos contataria após as 15hrs (horário de check-in, que foi tranquilamente antecipado para 12hrs visto termos chegado mais cedo). Fomos aproveitar o resort e descobrimos mais tarde que nosso concierge seria outro, Carlos. Ele nos ajudou muito com as reservas nos restaurantes (indicamos pagar a taxa extra de U$40 por pessoa e conhecer o Passion), envio de champagne e vinho ao nosso quarto. Sempre que nos encontrava pela piscina Royal Service se colocava à disposição para qualquer assunto que precisássemos. O Royal Service realmente faz a diferença...piscina e parte da praia privativos e tranquilos. Ótima comida, ótimos restaurantes...valeu a pena, a viagem foi perfeita!

reviews.author: rmendell7244
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Beautiful Beach, Sweet Staff
reviews.text: I really wanted to give this place 4 stars but I just couldn't.  First lets start off with the pros.  The beach, pools, hotel, restaurants are ALL beautiful!  Looks like a 4-5 star resort when you drive up.  The thing that makes it drop down to 3 stars is the food.  I consider myself a foodie and when I go on vacation that's the one thing I look forward and I can't say that any of it was good.  NOW if you want to pay the $40 extra and go to Passion every night you'll be fine.  We went to Passion on our last night and the food was delicious and the service was excellent.  If we ever go back I will eat at Passion every night.  The rooms are clean and I would give them 3.5 stars.  I know they are doing a lot of renovations.  The liquor drinks are NOT watered down and they have great house champagne.  If your not into food and want to enjoy cocktails by the beach or pool then this is the place for you.  Spend the extra $40 a day and eat at Passion.  Hope this helps.  I've done a full post on my blog about this place... www.ryanspearl.blogspot.com

reviews.author: Tinta30
reviews.title: Las instalaciones son de primera, quiero volver
reviews.text: Ramon Fuego fue quien hizo grata nuestra estancia, la atención lo máximo y su carisma incomparable... Gracias a él vuelvo a venir

reviews.author: LucyCanada_Toronto_
reviews.title: 11 days of pure bliss.
reviews.text:
We, my husband and I, are trying to make it a tradition, to celebrate our wedding anniversary at the beach. This was our second time in the resort, we stayed at the Royal Service part of it, and decided, that yes, it's not cheap, but totally worth the money. Everything worked out beautifully, and we had a grand time. Special thanks to our buttler, Ramon Avila, he made our stay extremely pleasurable. The first words, we've heard, were: "Wellcome home." And it felt like it, just better, because everything was taken care of. Again, thanks to Ramon, our beach buttlers : Francisco, Pedro and Franciscito. We'll try really hard, to come next year.
Lucy and Igor.

Muy buena estancia, el hotel está muy bien, como gran hotel, encuanto a dimensiones y posibilidades. Nada que envidiar a establecimeintos de cadenas hoteleras similares.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Great trip again
reviews.text: Another great trip to Palma Real!  We love the property and the staff make us feel at home.  Thanks to Francisco Estrella and Freddy at the vacation club pool.  They take such good care of us every time we are there.

reviews.author: joseph b
reviews.title: my best vacation ever with Angel, Jose, gabriella, and Ellessa
reviews.text: I was on a family trip and i had sooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo much fun at the end of every night. i cant wait to come here again. please come to this hotel. you will have the time of your life and if you dont then they will get fired and no one wants them to be fired. their the best in the buisness. please make me happy by coming thanks and they are never slow everyone who has negative comments just egnore them all. they are not telling the truth.

reviews.author: KonstantinR
reviews.title: Great Vacation-Good Hotel!!!
reviews.text:
Well, I am going to be short to the point.
Tips for the fellow travellers go first: 
1. Request/demand a print out of all hotel activities/schedule on arrival - this will save you a bunch of hassle. (kids club has its own schedule)
2. Kids club located in the reserve is free for all the guests (it has its own acvtivites program including free horse back riding trip and dolphin swimming adventure).
3. Have enough small bills if you want to tip. Even the currency exchange place on premises didn't have enough small bills.
4. Usually you can get to the restaurant you want to visit by just getting there in the evening and asking politely to seat you.
5. All non-motorized watersport activites are available at no charge (included). The booth is located on the far right side of the hotel's beach (if you are facing the ocean). Sometimes you have to book.

Pros:
-Very nicely maintained property and the beach.
-Great food quality and selection.
-Great kid's club.
-Great housekeeping service.
-Super friendly and fun staff
-Nice entertainment and activities programs.
-Tastefull decorations everywhere.
-Roomy and clean suites.
-more.... 

Cons:
Nothing really to mention other than ask the hotel to please print and hand out entertainment/activities schedules on guests' arrival.

Special thank you's to the guys that made out trip and stay pleasant:
-Kid's club staff - Wanda, Evelyn, Ines, Sundra, Luisa and the rest of the team.
-Pool bar/Beach staff - Victor, Ramon, Bianca, Louis and the rest of the great people.
-Room service/house keeping.
-Entertainment team.
-and last but not the least our buffey waiters - Victor Urena and Rosa Rosario.

Muchissima gracias guys!

reviews.author: Dina R
reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text:
Hotel property was beautiful with great pools. The beach was gorgeous, but could be cleaned from seaweed better. Rooms are nice overall, some items were broken but housekeeping was very prompt to replace them. Food variety and quality at the buffet was excellent. The restaurants (sushi, grill, Italian) were mediocre –slow service, unremarkable meals. It was not easy to get a reservation, and was not worth our time after all. 
Staff is very good overall. Our waiters Rose and Victor and buffet supervisor Freddy were very attentive. Our daughter enjoyed the Kids Club – girls there (Wanda, Evelyn, Ines, Sandra and Luisa) were excellent. 
Concierge service was puzzlingly poor. The hotel has many recreational activities (yoga, water sports, art workshops, tennis...), but “our concierge” Violetta was completely unaware of such events, tried to deny us service with her strong confidence and was remarkably unprofessional. Once she started to avoid us, our vacation significantly improved. Ask about activities at the beach club they know much more then useless concierge service. 

Overall the hotel is very good for a family with children.

reviews.title: Bar piscina
reviews.text: El mejor ambiente está en el bar de la piscina con Ramón Fuego y sus tragos !!!

reviews.text:
Yes the location is lovely, the room and all inclusive program makes things very relaxed, but I didn't feel like I was in the swing of the Caribbean unt we met 4
Ramon Fuego-- this guy makes "entertaining" a boring word! He will consult with you, making you a new unique concoction right before you realize you are ready for another drink and dont know what to request! He is a sweet yet amazing talented Mixologist--- try his Fuego shots! And 
Watch him deliver drinks off his head or pick up your beverage after he pushes up for you! He's the best and makes Paradisus Palma Real special.

reviews.title: great deal

Merengue night was excellent, David at the lobby bar is great. Friendly and all smiles! Not much for shops. But it is literally next door to the Mall,where you can catch the hockey game in Tony Roma's or party at the Hard Rock. The Spa is top notch and worth the $$. Only complaint was check out, guys at the desk didnt speak english well and didnt resolve the issue. Overall though, great stay

reviews.author: galina p
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text:
I recently came here with my  22-year-old daughter and 74-year-old mother and we all fell in love.  The hotel has something for everyone and we all agreed the service was by far the best from any all-inclusive we have previously stayed at.  Upon arrival, we were greeted by a super friendly and attentive staff.  Raquel helped check us in and was extremely friendly, accommodating and beyond helpful throughout our stay!  Whenever we needed something or had a question she always went above and beyond to help us. The food was was also better than any all-inclusive we've been to - the buffet was delicious and better than most of the restaurants on premises.  The room was extremely spacious for the 3 of us and ALWAYS spotless.  During the day the activities staff did a wonderful job and getting everyone involved and during the evenings the hotel had great performances. -GP, NY

Beautiful property with awful service. Incompetence rules.   Called housekeeping 3 times still no t
Response.   Food poor unless you pay upgrade of 40 per person for upscale restaurant.  Front desk totally unresponsive.   Thankful the beach is nice because hotel service is awful

reviews.author: Pamela W
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real from 3/23/12-3/30/12.  Overall, it was a great vacation!  The resort has a few areas of opportunities but nothing to stop you from attending. The restaurants were pretty good especially for an all-inclusive resort.  The buffets were great with many healthy choices.  The Bana restaurant for Sushi and the Teppanyaki grills were the best.  Gabi Beach is an a la carte restaurant that has a fee but it was excellent.  Passion was not worth the $40.00 per person.  It was a very romantic restaurant for adults but I did not find the food options very good.  Market Grill was an excellent steakhouse that is included in the all-inclusive package.
The staff at the resort was hit or miss.  Some of the staff such as Ramon at the Aqua Bar and Wendy in the fitness center were excellent and provided 1st class service!  However, other staff members such as the front desk staff were rude at times.  Overall, most of the staff tried to be helpful.  Tipping is very common at this resort so we always tipped for great service.
The beach, pool and the grounds were beautiful.  You never had an issue finding a chair, umbrella, pool towels, etc. The spa on the reserve side was amazing.  I had 4 spa services and they were all excellent.
The areas of opportunities for this resort is in the area of entertainment and consistent communication.  The entertainment was not very good at all.  They also would have signs posted with the times but when you show up the time was completely different.  We really wanted to see the Michael Jackson show and they advertised the show at 9 and 11.  We showed up at 10:45 only to find out that they show was at 9:45 only.  During the rest of the week, we would get different show time from different employees.
Another thing that the resort can improve in was the consistency in the room cleaning.  The minibar was not always stocked.  It took us 3 days to even get more water in our room.  
Overall, the resort was great except for a few minor things that I mentioned but I would come back as it was very beautiful.

reviews.author: MsDsMMs
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation--Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text:
My family just got back from a week stay at the Palma Real.  I traveled with my wife and two sons age 3 and 5.  The welcoming right off the bus was amazing, the bellhop's were right there to assist with bags, walking into the lobby area was like walking into paradise.  The resort in all is breathtaking,  they did not skip a beat in anything.  The check in process was very smooth, our room was not ready yet but they have an area to change and enjoy all facilities until the room was ready.  We were immediately greeted by our personal concierge (Alvaro).  Try to upgrade to VIP, it has some extra fun perks.

Rooms-  The rooms were beautiful, clean, spacious.  The jacuzzi was large enough for four people,  The stand up shower was great with all the extra jets.   The only Con I had with the room was getting towels after the rooms were cleaned.  There were never enough towels, we always had to mind the cleaning service and ask for our towels.( not really a big deal)

Service-  The service was fantastic,  it didn't matter where you were.  If you needed anything anywhere, just ask and they are all over you.  

Restaurants-  The restaurants were top notch,  the buffet was good , always a large selection.  
The quality of the food in the restaurants were excellent with amazing presentation.  The waiters were all trained with high standards.  
CON-  I felt that the whole reservation thing was a bit annoying,  the concierge picks the restaurants for you.  We ate the buffet the first night because we were told the restaurants are booked.  The second night our concierge, Alvaro, gave us reservations at The RESERVE,  when we get there we find out that its actually the buffet for The Reserve.  We were the only table in there that night, you really don't even need reservations there.  DO NOT FALL INTO THAT TRAP.  I made it clear to the concierge the next day, "NO MORE BUFFET's", I paid for the restaurants.  If you request a restaurant they always say that its booked.  Meanwhile when you walk by, there are plenty of empty tables.   I was very satisfied with the restaurants that we ate in.  It seems like they try to spread out all the guests.  Please don't mis-understand this CON comment,  the restaurants are amazing and the buffet is good,  you just have to be one step ahead of them in their game.

Pool-  one word " Spectacular"...  The pools were very comfortable, plenty of lounge chairs and pool beds.  We never had a problem.  The pool bar was amazing,  you must see RAMON and Luiz.  These guys were awesome, always with a smile and making the best drinks.  My kids are still taking about Ramon and Luiz, with all the virgin drinks they made.

Spa- My wife did the spa, she said its the best experience she's ever had...

Overall it was a great vacation, the location is great, close to the airport.  Everything is walking distance, you do not need golfcarts to get around like some of the other resorts.
We will definately go back.
Hopefully this helps some people making decisions.

reviews.author: Christopher S
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Took a family vacation here, we plan on coming back. The resort staff are all friendly and accommodating, especially the waiters in the buffet. Ricardo Canela, among many others, always welcomed us with a warm smile at the buffet and tried to get us whatever we wanted, he became a friendly face that we looked forward to seeing and talking to everyday. The food is amazing, they have a large selection that varies day to day while accenting food from many cultures including their own. The night time activities are always exciting. There are live performances every night including dancers and musicians ranging from a Dominican themed night to a Circus theme. Afterwards there are always live performances on Gabi beach and in the bar near the lobby. There is always something to do. Whether it be snorkeling, windsurfing, merengue lessons, painting, or just hanging out by the pool or the gorgeous beach. Overall an amazing experience with a multitude of activities at your finger tips and delectable food that is too good to be true.

reviews.author: Lisbeth C
reviews.title: Unas vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bello, el SR. Edgar Gonzales(nuestro guia) nos atendio con mucho cariño y respeto, las piscinas fabulosas, las habitaciones bellisimas, la animacion espectacular, los restaurantes tienen excelente atencion y tenemos muchas ganas de regresar muy pronto, pasar unos dias espectaculares en este hermoso lugar.

reviews.author: maririos
reviews.title: LO MEJOR!
reviews.text:
Tuve la oportunidad de hospedarme ahi hace unas semanas y solo puedo decir que este hotel es espectacular! Desde el personal en el check in, restaurantes, mayordomos, Servicio Real y las habitaciones con una vista espectacular.
Sara en Servicio Real, Carlos nuestro mayordomo, Pedro en la piscina de SR hicieron que nuestra estancia fuera tal y como la esperabamos... de descanso total!  Ah.. y no puedo olvidar a Manuel, quien se encargaba de la estacion de jugos en la playa de SR y todos los dias nos hizo regresar con el para tomar un refrescante jugo!!
La comida de todos los Restaurantes es de lo Mejor, desde Passion by Martin Berasategui, Vento, y el mejjor de todos, NAMI, que hizo que repitieramos ir a cenar ahi en un par de ocasiones.
Esperamos regresar pronto, estoy segura que sera igual que estas vacaciones o aun mejor!!

reviews.author: moppiesue
reviews.title: awesome vacation!
reviews.text: We went on a business trip, we had a fabulous time.  You need to look past the small things in order to have a good time.  Diving wasn't so good but the  equipment was very safe. Excursions were very touristy but all in all they were alright. The boats for deep sea fishing were a little decrepit and worn but we caught a ton of large fish, whoo and ma I ma I. The food was very plentiful but you had to spend 2 hours for dinner. Are most enjoyable moments were at thebar outside with fuego.  I would personally suggest the spa the massage was amazing and probably the best I've ever had.  I would go back but change my room to an upper floor.  We also had a wonderful time crashing other peoples parties and weddings:-) have fun.. watch out for the glitter people the stuff doesn't come off for about 2 weeks.

reviews.author: criticadeverdad
reviews.title: Para el precio... no creo que califique
reviews.text:
Mi critica es basada a que he estado en el GRand iberostar, el cual tiene el mismo precio que el
palma real, y al comparar obviamente me baso en lo siguiente.

Servicio
Los empleados andan confundidos en el area del buffet restauran Naos. La comida es normal, pero nada especial para un hotel de mas de 500 dolares las noche.

El restaurante Vento, fue bueno y el servicio excellente, pero la comida no califica para un hotel de esta magnitud.

Las habitaciones
Lo mejor del hotel, buenas camas, limpieza optima, internet incluido, buena decoracion y baños

La recepcion

Buen servicio, no hay quejas 

Los maleteros y Valet parking, excelentes.

los bares buenos , la playa preciosa, servicio de toallas, spa y piscina muy buenos/

el Show, aburrido.

Espero que mejoren el tema de la comida por que es un hotel muy bello, pero no vale su precio.

reviews.author: karla383
reviews.title: Es un verdadero Paraiso

reviews.author: Ana G
reviews.title: ESTUPENDAS VACACIONES
reviews.text:
Es la tercera vez que elegimos este hotel para nuestra estancia en República Dominicana es estupendo y está situado en un entorno paradisiaco.Las habitaciones son dignas de un cinco estrellas y el servicio muy bueno.La animación es excelente, son todos muy agradables, especialmente Angel,Jose y Gabriel.

reviews.author: Rich K
reviews.title: Family Fun in Punta Cana
reviews.text:

If Ramon Fuego,Luiz or Gloria couldn't make you smile there is no hope for you to ever be happy. Mucho appreciado!!!  It's lunchtime back home and wish I was sitting in the swimming pool bar stool. Kudos also to Rainieri Del Rosario who became our "go to guy" for getting stuff done like reservations and general help issues.

Gorgeous pool and a wonderful beach just steps away from the room and enough towels to absorb the pool water if needed.

reviews.author: Monica O
reviews.title: Great Experience !

If you are looking for few days to relax, enjoy the beach, and pamper your place.   This resort will be the best choice.

The SPA is excellent !!  all the staff was very kind and always ensuring you were pampered.  If you are thinking on getting a massage, Rosi is Fantastic !!  Apart from being very professional her kindness and positive spirit makes the difference.

This is the first time I have a one week holidays alone.  I was a bit worried at the beginning, but once I arrived at the Resort I felt safe, respected and the best of all pampered.  Exactly what I was looking for.  !!

I will go back again and will recommend this place to everyone looking for a week of peace !

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: Beautiful resort...very poor customer service
reviews.text: Beautiful and enormous resort with a breathtaking beachfront.  The problem with such a big resort is that it needs more people to maintain it.  Check-in was at 3pm and at 4pm, our rooms were still not ready.  This happened to several people at the counter checking in around the same time.  For half my stay, my room was not cleaned until 6pm.  Also the dining options were very limited.
