Unless you signed up for the Royal Service, it was impossible to get a dinner reservation since the reservation line was busy from 9am-5pm.  Dinner at one of the restaurants was almost impossible without a reservation.  After complaining several times, we finally got a dinner reservation at Aqua at The Reserve, only for them to not have our reservation on their list when we arrived.  To be honest, after all the hassle at the restaurants, the food at the buffet was better.  If customer service and dining out are your thing, I would be cautious to stay here.  If you don't care about having buffet for all your meals and want to enjoy the pool and beach at a beautiful resort, then this is the place for you.

reviews.author: alex m
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: My family and i took a vacation to Paradisus Palma Real and had an amazing time! One thing that made the vacation even better was the friendly staff working there. Two of my favorite people were Angel and Jose with their fun attitudes and amazing personalitys!

reviews.author: JCRiol
reviews.title: BUENAS VACACIONES
reviews.text: Execlente hotel en Playa Bavaro ( Republica Dominicana ) . Perfecto para pasar unas vacaciones en familia . Con buen tiempo asegurado . Playa paradisaca . Muchas actividades, y muy buen servicio por parte del personal del hotel. Destaca la simpatia y el buen humor que puedes encontrar en el bar de la piscina con la inmejorable atencion de Ramon Fuego .....   Arriba Ramon y un saludo desde España !!!.

reviews.author: Just S
reviews.title: Beautiful place with deffinite pros and cons
reviews.text:
We were here the first week of April 2012 with friends and it was truly a luxurious hotel with great amenities, but some downsides.  
Pros – Beautiful grounds and pools.  Many bars and restaurant choices, as well as decent buffets.  Service was generally very good with some exceptions both ways.  On the upside, if you end up with Elvin as your waiter at the buffet or grill, count yourself very fortunate.  He is professional courteous and respectful.  The bartenders were great.  There were a couple of standouts there as well; from the acrobatic guy at the swim up pool bar who hopped around the counter with a bottle balanced on his head before pouring a special concoction directly in your mouth (well mostly in your mouth, but it was a pool bar), to Carlos at the Gabi Bar who was not only an incredible juggler, but an attentive, personable and excellent bartender as well.  Brands of liquor were top shelf.  The “well scotch” was Johnny Walker Black.
Cons – The biggest con was the beach.  The sand was perfect, but the constant flotillas of seaweed made it difficult to enjoy the water.  I don’t mean a bit of seaweed; on one of our walks we had to turn back because the washed up stuff was over a foot high, 3-4 yards wide and around a hundred yards long!  You can imagine what the water looked like.  This was probably after a front passed, but from reading other reviews it’s not rare.  Getting reservations at the restaurants was often challenging.  Our rep was of little help and kept saying that they were very busy and need more than a few days notice.  We courteously pointed out that giving a week’s notice is not practical for most vacationers.  But do make as many reservations as possible as soon as you can.  Our transportation guy behind the counter just gave us the phone number of his office so that we can arrange for pick up to return to the airport.  Why he could not do it was beyond me.  There were many examples of these minor glitches in service, but the annoying part was that they could be addressed very easily.  On one occasion, our special concierge made an effort to be extra nice and drew a bubble bath in the Jacuzzi, complete with towels folded to look like swans, flower petals around the tub, etc.  Unfortunately, he did not let us in on this, and by the time we got back to the room, it was only room temperature.  Again, an excellent gesture, but with notice we would have really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Maria Jose H
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisiaco pero no un 5 estrellas superior
reviews.text:
El entorno del hotel es paradisiaco, las playas, las habitaciones son amplias y tienen jacuzzi y terraza todas ellas. Los jardines del interior son preciosos y la piscina espectacular. El servicio del hotel es inmejorable y el conserge que nos atendió (Alberto Solutions) nos hizo pasar una fantastica estancia facilitandonos todo lo necesario.
El primer fallo del hotel es que al llegar te intentan vender un paquete Royal Service de uso exclusivo que no nos informaron en la reserva de su coste adicional. Como no lo quisimos, ya no teniamos acceso a ciertas partes del hotel asi como a algunos restaurantes. Dado que la variedad de restaurantes es escasa para ser un 5 estrellas de lujo nos quedaban pocas opciones. La carta de los restaurantes (solamente 3, market grill, hidrogrill y oriental (que te dicen son tres por la variedad de sushi, tepamyaki y asiatico)) a los que podiamos acudir era muy pobre con apenas dos o tres opciones de plato. Acudimos a uno (de pago) que si fue bastante bueno, pero ya no entraba dentro del paquete vacacional (Gabi Beach). 
Otro gran fallo del hotel son las tumbonas y camas de la piscina y playa. La gente "reservaba" las tumbonas con una toalla o un libro o una revista, cualquier cosa y se iban a desayunar, excursiones o cualquier quehacer por lo que llegando a la playa mas tarde de las 7.45 de la mañana ya no habia sitio donde sentarse. Como ibamos con un bebe retirabamos estas "reservas" para poder tener sombra, donde algunas de ellas no aparecian en todo el dia. Esto era vergonzoso, ya que pareciamos domingueros de alguna playa de la costa blanca que tiene que clavar la sombrilla para tener sitio con sombra en la playa. Pusimos una reclamacion al hotel aunque no se si serviria de algo.
Lo que tambien nos molestó bastante es que nos tuvieran dos horas intentando convecernos en comprar una multipropiedad del grupo Meliá, aunque nos regalaron una entrada a un restaurante de pago adicional que resulto ser el mejor de todos.
Mencionar el spa, algo caro pero merece la pena. Si contaratais algun tratamiento, podeis ir una hora antes de la cita y te dejan realizar todo el circuito de agua. Lo unico, es que no se encuentra dentro del hotel (como algunos restaurantes) y tienes que ir en un carrito (tipo golf) a otro edificio. Te llevan y te traen sin problemas.
Recomiendo el hotel por la habitación, el servicio, que es inmejorable, y su entorno, pero presenta grandes fallos que no deberia cometer un 5 estrellas superior a los precios que te cobran la estancia.

reviews.author: Pepe450
reviews.title: Mis mejores experiencias!!!!!
reviews.text:
Ramon "Fuego" es el mejor bartender del mundo!!!!
El y sus compadres logran que todos disfruten su estadia!!!!
Una experiencia inolvidable!!!!

reviews.author: ctaylor0226
reviews.title: Second Christmas Vaccation and wonderful time
reviews.text:
We went for second year in the row to the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana and had a wonderful time.
we always have great service and the people are just wonderful,.
We met some great people that work that and helped us a lot and made our experience amazing.
People like Pablo serving us at the breakfast buffet, Ornie and Fernando at the piano bar making great drinks, yuberky gomez serving drinks at the Cassino, Francisco Tchello serving drinks at the members only poll.  These are among great works that make our vacation even better at the Palma Real and thats why we decided to go back and bring more family members to enjoy this amazing place.

reviews.author: Nick D
reviews.title: First Rate Honeymoon!
reviews.text: My wife and I chose the Palma Real for our honeymoon after getting positive reviews from a few friends and family, and we were not disappointed. There were beautiful beaches with private cabanas for shade, lots of great activities, and our room was beyond expectations. Our concierge, Alberto Mercedes, went above and beyond to make our stay perfect - he took care of everything we needed including dinner reservations and any special requests we had. We tried every restaurant they had and loved them all. The pool bar was a frequent haunt for us, where Victor and Ramon "Fuego" made sure we had a great time. We would (and probably will) visit again, and we would recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and relaxing vacation spot!

reviews.author: Revlon C
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation
reviews.text:
I just returned from staying at Paradisus Palma Real and I have nothing but great things to say. I was there on a girls trip & we did the Royal Service. I've read some of the other reviews & I'd have to agree that Royal Service is definitely the way to go.  Our butler, Carlos & concierge-Alvaro (AC) made sure we were taken care of every step of the way.  Overall the food was good...of course, some restaurants were better than others.  Loved Gabi Restaurant the most...the food, ambiance as well as the music. Also, loved the bartender, Samuel, at the new restaurant, Palazzo.  No matter where we had our dinner reservation, we would always get the "Samuel Special" before heading to dinner.  They also had a good chocolate soufflee at Palazzo!

We mostly stayed in the private beach & pool area.  We had a reserved bali bed & palapa every day at the beach.  There was a slight issue w/our palapa reservation by the pool but it was resolved quickly.  All of our reservations were taken care of by our butler & concierge and whenever we needed anything at all, we had a cell phone (given to us by the resort) that allowed us to call our butler any time.  It was a nice touch!

The spa at the Reserve was wonderful...we literally did not want to leave that place.  My massage therapist, Milly, was great.  And the warm pool & jacuzzi didn't hurt either. 

Admittedly, reading some of the negative reviews was very shocking to me because our experience was so exceptional!  However, with any resort, there will always be someone that may have a negative experience because no place is perfect. So I can only speak about our experience as a Royal Service guest and they met & in many cases, exceeded our expectations. We would definitely recommend staying here & we plan to be back again next year.

reviews.author: Eliza2012_12
reviews.title: Going Back Next Year!!
reviews.text:
In March 2011 my parents stayed at Paradisus Palma Real and had a GREAT experience, so my husband & I went and stayed at the same place a few weeks later. We had such an amazing time that we became members and went back again in March 2012!!! The resort is AMAZING, the money they spent on decor and the views are just breath taking!!! The employees are WONDERFUL and VERY attentive!!! I never had a problem with any of the employee’s being rude or un-attentive?! Especially when you tip the employees who wait on you, they remember and get you what you want before you even ask for it! A tip goes a long way!!! My husband and I noticed a lot of people don't tip the people who serviced them?! Inclusive or not, you ALWAYS tip the people who serve you drinks and food!!! 
My husband and I had such a wonderful time last year that we brought back Tiger Woods hats to the bar tender, Freddy Lora, and the cabana guy, Francisco Estrella, who served us last year. Both employees were so attentive, they knew what drinks to give us and they had our cabana set up in the spot closest to the bar. Freddy knew I LOVED the “Miami Vices”, so he would save this larger glass for me and use that instead of the paper cup. Then, Freddy would make decorative items out of towels and put them in our cabana. Last year when we were leaving to go home, my husband said “We’ll see you next year and we’ll bring you each a Tiger Woods hat” (They both LOVED my husband’s hat). So, this year when we went, we brought the hats, but before they saw the hats, they knew who we were!! Now, if that’s not wonderful service, I don’t know what is?!
Once again, this year we had an AMAZING experience!!! We had the same cabana guy, Francisco Estrella, who took GREAT care of us!!! We had a new bartender, Freddy Ramos, who take such good care of us!!! Both guys would bring us drinks and did whatever it took to make sure we were taken care of!!! Of course we saw our bartender from last year, Freddy Lora, who would make us drinks and take good care of us. 
After that great dinners we’d eat (Gabi Beach is the BEST restaurant), we’d get a cappuccino and then watch whatever show was on that night. I’m a cappuccino drinker and I LOVED that they had a cart!! Maria Ortiz, the Espresso cart lady, was so wonderful!! When I would walk up to the cart, she would say “1 cappuccino and 1 espresso”. I LOVED that she knew exactly what we wanted!! 
The only bad thing I have to say about the resort is the ocean water. There is so much seaweed that you don't want to go into the water. I feel like they need to get a huge skimmer or something to reduce the amount of seaweed. I know they have a huge John Deer that rakes up the seaweed, but by the end of the day, there is so much built up on the beach. The sand is so white and BEAUTIFUL!!!
I CAN’T WAIT to go back next year!!!

reviews.author: Ann M
reviews.title: RECOMENDADO
reviews.text: Totalmente recomendable ya que tanto su politica de servicio como su politica de calidad es totalmente inigualable , mis respetos para el excelente servicio que me estan brindando asi como la limpieza que existe en sus intalaciones gracias Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: Lucio P
reviews.title: Buenisimo, de lo mejor!!
reviews.text:
Es de los mejores hoteles de playa que he visitado, desde la recepción la cual fue muy cálida, después la habitación tan bonita y sobretodo limpia que encontré, nos topamos con un excelente servicio al cliente.
Regresaria ahi sin pensarlo.

reviews.author: Emil H
reviews.title: Hotel Ovesold. Reservation not guarantee
reviews.text:
I had not a pleasant experience in Punta Cana Palma Real yesterday 4/5/12. Hotel was oversold and did not guarantee the reservation. This previously happened 2 years ago in Paradisus Punta Cana. Seem to be a trend on high season. I booked my stay on 3/18 and prepaid full. Got my booking confirmation 120337098. During check in yesterday afternoon, the Hotel was oversold and after 3+ hour of delay and notice that " we are working in your case" finally the Manager show up and we settle in what was suppose to be a good deal: relocate into nearby Hotel and credit to stay in the Hotel a different date. The offered Hotel was for adult only. I had my daughter with me, so we have no option than to drive back and upset ask for a refund and demanded a free night in a nearby place, since it was around 10 pm. Finally settle on this. 
What was supposed to be a relaxed Easter Weekend started with a very disappointing event. To the Administration and Reservation Manager thanks for your dis- service. 
Definitely do not recommend to stay in Punta Cana Paradisus or Palma Real.

reviews.author: Raul Alberto O
reviews.title: SU MAJESTAD, EL HUESPED
reviews.text: Como en todos mis viajes, elegí este hotel - resort por consejo de mi agente de viajes.  Nos alojamos entre el 22 y el 29 de marzo. Hace honor a su nombre y es de una categoría superior. Nos dieron una habitación con vista al mar y a los increibles jardines, que el solo verlos y caminar por ellos ya es un deleite. Los restaurantes son dificiles de calificar, pues son uno mejor que el otro. Destaco el MIZU y el AQUA pero no desmerecen a los otros, donde los camareros compiten en la mejor atención. Los espectáculos teatrales y musicales, de primer nivel. Todo está pensado en el confort y el disfrute del huésped. El personal, de ese maravilloso pueblo dominicano, lo hacen sentir a uno  en todo momento como si uno fuera el único huésped del hotel. No acostumbro a mencionar al personal de un hotel por su nombre por el riesgo de pasar por alto a alguno, pero quiero destacar a tres y en la persona de ellos felicitar a todo el staff: Maria, sirviendo deliciosos cafés en su puesto al lado del teatro, con una sonrisa y un buen humor que te alegran el día; Gloria, incansable alcanzando a la playa los maravillosos tragos del bar de la piscina, siempre atenta, sonriente y con esa chispa dominicana y por último detaco a Emmanuel, del Guest Service, UN VERDADERO SOL.  Ciertamente para recomendar. Dos críticas, que de manera alguna pretenden empañar nuestra hermosa experiencia: 1) baja o nula señal de internet en la habitación del Royal service, reclamado en por lo menos tres oportunidades. 2) No es agradable, ni este ni en otros resort de la región, la insistencia del hotel por venderte tiempos compartidos o clubes vacacionales: pagamos para disfrutar nuestra estadía y no para emplear nuestro tiempo en charlas de venta.

reviews.author: cheerdoc
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
I just returned from Punta Cana on April 1, 2012.  We were there from March 28- April 1.  I went with a group of my girlfriends and we had a blast!!!  This is not the typical all-girls trip hotel but we made the best out of it!  We did the royal service and our Butlers (Jose and Carl) were very attentive and helpful.  Jose set up all of dinner reservation on our first night and he was even able to get us one for that first night despite the fact that we arrived later in the day.  Vento had the best food.  The hibachi restaurant was good too. So over all the food was A+.  Having paid for the royal service we had more options than the baseline rooms which I really appreciated.  Plus the day we left they opened the new royal lounge and restaurant, which was very nice.  Enough about food...

The room was very clean.  I enjoyed the iPod radio in the room.  We used it whenever we were in the room getting ready!!  I read about the power outages.  I happened to be in the room for one and it only lasted a few seconds.  But otherwise I didn't notice any issues with this.  Since we had royal service we had chocolate covered strawberries, fruit plate, cheese tray etc delivered to our room daily...it was a nice touch while we were preparing fro dinner and a night out!! 

THE STAFF!!!  Well were to begin??  Everyone was very pleasant and helpful.  I want to really mention the activities staff...Jose', Angel, Gabriel, Jimmy and Eliejer.. This group of guys made our trip unbelievable.  they were very friendly and attentive.  We participated in all the classes/activities: dance classes, wine tasting, painting classes and many others. Words cant express how much fun we had with them and what they added to our trip.  Thanks guys!!! 

Well just to let you know we had a such a great time we WILL be returning very soon!!! And doing everything the same way...royal service included.

reviews.author: Samantha L
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying that sadly, this is the first time I have written a bad review on TripAdvisor. My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real from March 29-April 3 expecting a nice all inclusive getaway. We ended up leaving frustrated and annoyed, it was the first time that we were excited to leave a vacation!! It was a complete shock considering the positive reviews that I read on here! 

The Negatives: Other then Edgar, our concierge, the entire staff was rude. We would wait roughly 15-20 minutes for water and napkins at the buffet and the market grille. We learned very quickly that we had to bring a bottle of water from the room refrigerator with us to breakfast, and grab drinks from the pool bar to bring with us to lunch-I have honestly never encountered such a thing in all of my travels. Secondly, there is absolutely zero poolside service...in 5 days we had a waitress come up to us ONCE and ask us if we wanted drinks...we tipped her exceptionally hoping she would come back, but no. The food...don't even get me started. The buffet was pretty inedible. Market Grille was functional, Vento (which we had high hopes for) was disappointing and we both ended up with sour stomachs afterwards. Our two good meals were at Gabi Beach (which is an additional cost) and at the hibachi side of BANA. Other frustrations on our trip were the amount of rude guests...the stories are endless. I lost count of how many times I had conversations with other americans regarding the blatant rudeness of other travelers and the staff. We also scheduled beachside massages, showed up at the beach massage space 5 minutes before out massage was to start. 20 minutes later our massage therapists come casually walking up and have us wait additional time to put fresh linens on...no apologies for being 15 minutes late. During the massage, the therapists spoke in spanish to each other (so much for relaxing) and hardly touched a knot in my back, so needless to say, it was a complete waste of money. Lastly, do not believe the advertisements for wifi...it is non-exsistant everywhere but the lobby, and scattered here and there by the pool. 

The few positives-Edgar our concierge was AMAZING. If it weren't for him, our vacation would have been a nightmare. He was so lovely and helpful and understanding of our frustrations. Another positive was that the grounds, pool and beach are amazing. The rooms are decent, with a jacuzzi bathtub and nice decor....but zero bathroom privacy, a shower that never got hot, and sheer curtains that had us awake at 6:30AM.  

The hotel came at the recommendation of our close friends who have been to stay at the Reserve part of the hotel, which is apparently completely different then the hotel itself...they rave about it, and were shocked at our poor experience.

Bottom line, I would never recommend staying at the Palma Real. :(

reviews.author: ParksloperBrooklyn
reviews.title: Best meal of my life
reviews.text: The hotel houses a 5-star reataurant entitled Passion that provides a tasting menu for an addiitonal $40 fee over the all-inclusive rate and it is well worth it. It was the best meal I ever had.

reviews.author: travelerwith4
reviews.title: Beautiful, Friendly
reviews.text:
The people were so friendly!  Especially Ramon bartender, AC our personal concierge and ALL the activites guys!  Grounds were gorgeous.  Lobby was amazing.  Pool very pretty but a little cold.  Beach was fabulous, great sand and easy to play in surf, lots of chairs and shade if you wanted it.  My favorite though were the cabana/beds, spent a lot of time there!

Not so great stuff: not much to do for kids 5-13 unless you drop them off at the kids club.  Game room kind of sad.  If you wander just a bit off the hotel beach, you get accosted by interesting salesmen. No bathroom privacy :)

Disclaimer:  Employee's will ask you to name them on this site as they receive a bonus for this.  Still, felt they were genuinely friendly and it is a pleasure to do this.

reviews.author: Linda L
reviews.title: Amelioration souhaitable
reviews.text: Nous sommes actuellement en vacances d'une semaine et repartons vendredi pour Montreal. Nius en sommes a notre 3 ieme sejour en Republique Dominicaine dans differents hotel. Le Paradisus Palma Real est tres confortable et le erpsonnel dans les restaurants est vraiment sympathique, cependant je ne peux en dire autant pour ce qui est du service general...nous n'avons pas pris le "update" offert et nous avons senti que la qualite du service a alors diminue: les reservations dans les restaurants a la carte pratiquement impossible et ce meme si j' etait au bureau a 9:00 le matin, apres une panne d'informatique ma reservation n a pas ete enregistre donc pas de resto disponible, etc. De plus je dois etre presente pour rappeler a la femme de chambre de faire le refill de breuvage et d'eau dans le frigo...et n'essayez pas d'avoir des debarbouillette, elle refuse de vous en donner...bref, sur certain points j'apprecie le confort sur d'autre je suis decu du service offert....

reviews.author: Sean B
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Spot for Families
reviews.text: There is a great deal to like about this resort. The 1-bedroom suite was plenty of room for my wife and I as well as our 10-month old and 3-year old. The room consisted of a kitchen, living room, master bedroom, jacuzzi/ vanity room and bathroom. The food was better than average as compared to other resorts we have visited with a nice selection of restaurants to choose from. What placed this a notch above was the staff , who was wonderful, particularly the pool bartender, Ramon "Fuego". The time he took to make my family as comfortable as possible by the pool (and entertained) was greatly appreciated. My older child loved watching him deliver drinks on his head while riding a Segway. Great resort, great people, and very good food.

reviews.author: Jack E
reviews.title: A great hotel and really great people
reviews.text: i thought that the resort was so beautiful from swimming in the gorgeous pool to hour walks on the smooth sand beach. the faculty was so nice the chefs waiters and basically everybody. i especially  had a lot of fun with Angel Alcantara who was super nice and funny.

reviews.author: tony k
reviews.title: A mixed bag
reviews.text:
Okay! I read all the reviews before I chose this place, and I felt it my obligation to write one for others that are thinking about it.  Here it is:

1- Definitely go with the at least the "Reserve" or Royal Club.  Otherwise you will be very disappointed and angry most of the time.  These two levels get to swim in different pools, different buffet, different chairs, different part of the beach, and different level of service.  This is happening in the same common area.  I took a look at the buffet for the regular guests staying in the main area....dog food.  The restaurants are open to everyone for reservations, but some are good and some not.  The good thing about Reserve or Royal Club is your concierge will make all the reservations for you.  Trust me, we paid an extra 700 US for 5 nights, which is peanuts considering the extra amenities you get.  Otherwise get ready to be treated as a second class citizen.

2- Everything here is a switch and bait. You're talking about a third world country and most of the staff are locals ie politically correct hustlers.  I'll give you an example. We reserved to eat at the "Vento" restaurant.  I was Italian dining and in the entrance was a big wine rack.  We were presented with a wine menu.  I asked the waiter to bring me a glass of pino noir I choose from the menu.  Pretty simple no? No.  The menu they showed me was if I wanted to pay for and order wine on top of what I was supposed to get.  What kind of wine do I get?  Merlot, Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonay...choose which one you want, not the brand.  Get it?

3- Watch out for the people walking around selling you trips and excursions.  These guys are local hustlers and will tell you what you want to hear just to get the deal.  Pay attention and ask the exact details.  What kind of boat?  How long until we get to the bay?  What wil the lunch be?  Keep in mind once you leave the hotel, it's a very rough country.  And I mean very.  No traffic lights, the beggars are very aggressive.  Especially the kids.  This kid jumped on our car throwing water and started cleaning the windshield.  When the driver refused to give him anything, he wouldn't let go of the car until he gave him one of the bottled wates inside.  At the bay the local kids attack you in groups.  They'll start pouring water at your feet or anything to get your attention.  If you tip one they'll swarm you, even asking for your hat.  At the ATM there was an old lady holding a medicine bottle with her "neice" asking for money.  The driver told me this was all BS and a business.  Moral of the story: Make sure you're being escorted by someone at all times, even on the boat, if you plan on leaving the resort.  

3- Overall, The rooms at the resort were pretty good and the service responsive.  The Dominican Republic has a problem with electricity.  Actually two evenings the lights in the major parts of the hotel (walkways, etc.) were out for one hour from 8:30 to 9:30. What was annoying was the "thing" with the light bulbs.  It was like musical chairs in your room.  One night you come to your room to change and certain bulbs aren't working, the next night you come in and realize that the ones that were out before are working now, but others are out.  I think they switch the working light bulbs around.  I brought a multi-outlet electrical outlet from home to charge the various electronic items that our family comes with, laptops, iphones, computers, kindles, walky talky's, etc.  Almost every afternoon when I came back in, the red fuse was popped on the main outlet.  It was obviously intentional because all the electronics I had were in in the safe.

To me the beach is what makes the Dominican what it is.  White sand, aqua clear water.  Wow.  Loved trip to Saona Island where we got to play with the giant star fish in the natural open water pools.  Amazing experience you won't get anywhere.  The Hotel itself is nice and kept well, the pools are clean, and staff pretty attentive, but slow (think Dominican time).  If you're looking for true five star service this is not the place.  But look at what you're paying also.  The food could be a little better.  Expect a few situations where you will be controling yourself from getting really angry.  It's not the Hotel, it's the people.  There where Americans yelling at the airline reps at the airport.  It's the people, and the culture. We expec instant gratification and service, and even the Dominican president doesn't get this.  Will we come back again?  Maybe, but without Reserve or Royal Club, I wouldn't set foot here.  It's class warfare.  Even as a Reserve I felt uncomfortable, people looking over at our Gabi pool area and the food and buffet we got.

reviews.author: Martine c
reviews.title: " Excellent séjour "
reviews.text:
De retour après 2 semaines au Paradisus. C' est notre  3e séjour en Rep Dom et toujours dans la chaîne Mélia. L' hôtel est superbe, le complexe magnifique et le service royal, bien que plus onéreux, un réel plus pour le séjour. Il nous permet un majordome, joignable par portable, qui se charge, à l' avance, de toutes les réservations dîners,  jusqu' à notre confirmation vol retour et nos besoins. On le voit 1 fois/jour mais il n' y a pas d' omni présence. Ce service facilite l' accès aux plages privées (avec lits de plages confortables) et totalités des restaurants.
Une mention TB à Francisco, sur la plage Service Royal, toujours agréable, très dévoué et drôle... Je demande à la direction : une promotion très méritée pour Manuel TORRES, sur cette plage, qui tient la cabane à jus de fruits frais ! Il est EXCEPTIONNEL !! Nous avons apprécié et admiré la politesse, l' empressement, l' envie de toujours bien faire et le Français PARFAIT de cet employé qui mériterait une autre place, aux vues de ses capacités ! Bon nombre des majordomes pourraient prendre des leçons de français avec lui car ils ne sont, hélas, pas tous à la hauteur de leur qualification ! Nous en avons changé en milieu de séjour et le second (Juan "le petit") s' est trouvé plus performant dans ses attentions et dans son désir de parler français que le 1er. J' ai une mention TTB ou AAAAA à donner à Zulinas PENA SOMEZ, serveuse au Naos (international) merveilleuse de compétence, de gentillesse, prévoyante, excellente; car même s' il y a eu pourboire, elle s' est conduite ainsi dès notre arrivée. Nous avons aussi apprécié Sylvain HOSSE, à L' Aqua,de la RESERVE.
 Nous recommandons sincèrement cet Hôtel pour ses chambres spacieuse, l' entretien constant du complexe, le personnel qui a parfois quelques lenteurs, mais vite rattrapées par leur bonne volonté, la plage, les restos en grande majorité excellents... Nos seuls petits reproches seraient pour le manque d' interface français, nous nous sentons un peu mis de côté car peu font l' effort... Et les américains, très exhubérants, seuls au monde mais vous les trouverez PARTOUT en Rep Dom !!! Aussi, vaut il mieux aller dans un hôtel étoilé comme le Paradisus, ils sont, peut être, ainsi, mieux élévés !!! PARADISUS PALMA REAL : à recommander, sans modération, car la gentillesse Dominicaine, n' est plus à démontrer...et c' est VRAIMENT un superbe complexe !!!!

reviews.author: clau1975
reviews.title: Excelente atención de Ramon Fuego!
reviews.text:
Acabo de llegar de Punta Cana, soy de Argentina, me aloje en la habitación 1019.-
Excelente la atención en el bar de la psicina de Ramon Fuego el creador del trago "Adelita", el mejor trago!! 
Excelente el hotel, las habitaciones, verdaderamente un paraiso!

reviews.author: MacarenaGutierrez
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de Punta Cana!!
reviews.text:
Queria tomarme el tiempo de escribir aca y recomendar al 100% este hotel 5 estrellas. Pase una semana increible con toda mi familia, no quiero dejar de mencionar a Ramon Fuego, Victor Feliz y Bianca Ortiz del bar de la piscina que nos hicieron pasar muchos momentos inolvidables. Si quieren tomar los mejores mojitos del hotel tienen que ir al bar del  restaurante Bana y preguntar por Francisco. Por otro lado te hacen pasar unos momentos super divertidos, todos son muy buena gentes y siempre estan dispuestos a ayudarte, en el puesto de las toallas podras encontrar a Jimmy que te hara divertirte en la playa con su juego de las bochas en la playa, tambien esta Angel Alcantara que es muy buen bailarin que te hara divertirte en los shows de las noches y muy gracioso, vale la pena bailar con el.
La unica recomendacion que les doy es que deberian tener mas formas de entretenimiento en la noche para los adolescentes, por todo lo demas recomiendo al 100% este hotel, no se van a querer ir de ahi, espero poder volver algun dia y que se encuentren todos los que me atendieron.
Gracias por todo, desde Peru!
Macarena G.

reviews.author: Ndoumet
reviews.title: An experience not to miss!
reviews.text: There will be many reviews informing you about this beautiful resort- and they are all very true. The beach, the service, the pools, the drinks- but perhaps one of te best, dining at Vento! Our Maitre D', Wander, made our experience at this restaurant very special! He knew his menu very well and advised us on the selection! We all very much enjoyed our experience here!

reviews.author: maricarmengg
reviews.title: Vacaciones Increibles!!
reviews.text: Quiero recomendar este hotel, fueron unos días increibles, la gente es super amable,las instalaciones te brindan toda la comodidad de un hotel 5 estrellas!! la atención en el bar de Ramón Fuego; Victor Feliz y Bianca Ortiz, te hacen sentir como si estuvieras en tu casa!! gracias por hacernos pasar a mi y a mi familia una semana maravillosa.  Desde Peru les mandamos alos tres un fuerte abrazo!!

reviews.author: Luis G
reviews.title: El encanto de su gente
reviews.text:
Acabamos de regresar de Paradisus Palma Real en Punta Cana y hemos pasado seis dias extraordinarios.  Lo mejor de todo: su gente.  En particular, nos causo muy grata impresion la atención en el bar de la piscina a cargo de Ramon, mas conocido como FUEGO, y su equipo integrado por Bianca y Victor (Fueguito).  No solo preparan excelentes tragos (prueben el Banana Mama), sino que además transmiten mucha cordialidad y calidez con mucha educación, respeto y buen trato.

Para vacaciones familiares con hijos adolescentes, el hotel es ideal.

reviews.author: Jorge G
reviews.title: Vacaciones Excelentes en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
El hotel excelente, la atención de todas las personas que trabajan ahí es genial, en especial el barman de la piscina Ramón Fuego...genial y muy gracioso y prepara tragos extraordinarios!, Bianca del mismo bar, muy atenta y amable y por último a Francisco que está por las noches en el bar del restaurante Bana (dentro del hotel) y que prepara los mejores tragos!
Los cuartos muy buenos y la playa que pertenece al hotel fue la mejor que pude conocer comparándolas con las otras que vi cuando caminaba.
Lo único que faltó fue un poco más de vida nocturna, a pesar que tienen muy buenos espectáculos todas las noches, terminan a las 11pm y después ya no hay nada más para hacer.
Pero en general increíble lugar!

reviews.author: Verinagra
reviews.title: Comfortable, Spacious, Friendly
reviews.text: We were part of a conference group of about 60 people. Group check in was fast and smooth. All facilities provided were good. It was high season and I think, the resort was full, yet no facility was over crowded. Plenty of space and privacy in the pools. Lots of comfortable and shady gazebos. The rooms, restaurants etc are air conditioned. The lobbies are well designed to catch lots of breeze and have thatched roof, so are a very good green initiative (as is the Punta Cana airport). Kudos to the people of Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Coati52
reviews.title: Bien mais pas francophone
reviews.text:
Bel établissement mais pas adapté aux français, aucune carte exceptée celle du vento n'est traduite en français. Même les soins du spa ne sont pas traduis. Le personnel est aux petits soins mais ne parle pas ou peu le français.
Prestations hotelières de bonne qualité. Petit bémol, soirée sur le thème du cirque le mercredi. Le buffet NAOS est fermé, vous devez vous rendre dans la salle de spectacle mais comme rien n'est traduit vous le découvrez à la dernière minute et là un buffet vous attend mais très bruyant et mal organisé. Si vous choisissez cet hôtel, reservez un restaurant le mercredi soir sauf si vous aimez manger dans le bruit.
A déconseiller formellement, la boutique de l'hôtel. Elle vous vend des articles casés et ne veut pas les échanger car il y a une pancarte ( non traduite en français) "article non repris". Personnel de la boutique peu commercial est très désagréable.

reviews.author: Tamatha F
reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: I just arrived back home last night from march26th until the 31st.My husband,my 7yr.old son and myself.When we first arrived and were standing in the lobby it looked so nice.then it was all down hill from there.The food taste so awful.And I mean everything.The coffe is gross with god knows what kind of milk.We just had to find something that you could handle and stick to it.I basically ate fruit and salad with balsamic vinegar.The dressing was not good.The drinks were also terrible cheap booze and sugar mixers no fresh fruit in any cocktails.The service was discraceful.Especially at the golf course.It is not included its $30 for the cart and no food on the cart at all.nothing...I hate to be so negative but We meet so many others vacationing there as well and said the same.I'm not sure if they'll take the time to write a review.The room we paid extra for ocean view was not ocean view at all.It was trees and if you lend over your balcony and stretch your neck over you could see a glimps of water through the trees.I know mother nature is in charge of the weather.But it was sun in and out all the time.Humid.And poured rain all day and night 2 of the days.And that leaves you with nothing to do at this place.Well live and learn.I would never go back to this Island or recommend it.Others at the airport said the most decent place is the hard rock and thats not saying much..Spend your money else were and enjoy..This place looks beautiful on the computer, and is nice in the lobby.But the rest of the experience is the pitts..

reviews.author: Hhhyjuki
reviews.title: Vacaciones familiares en punta Cana
reviews.text: El hotel ya lo conocía, pero ha mejorado bastante el Barman de la piscina . Espectacular Ramon Fueeeeeego, te ameniza la estancia con sus chistes y sus bebidas. Actualmente estoy en el hotel todavia, y lo único a mejorar son los restaurantes a la carta. Espero repetir y allí encontrarme al crack Ramon Fuego. La playa tambien se debe destacar .

reviews.author: James J
reviews.title: Leap Year Birthday
reviews.text: This was one of the best birthday ever.  The restaurant staff had a wonderful surprise for me, a cake, and they sang for me in many different birthday tunes, traditional, and local birthday song..  I was also offered a Irish coffee drink, awesome.  Might be back next year.

reviews.author: irishrugger68
reviews.title: Trip of a Life Time
reviews.text: I write this review only to mock the snooty people who review this place poorly. It is one of the most beautiful places I have ever been in my life. The food was very good and the service I had was outstanding. The rooms are also very clean and room service was not bad either. Perhaps there are some isolated incidents where someone may not be happy but if that is the case no one I met there were one of them. Being that nit picky most be a terrible way to go through life. I had a trip of a lifetime and will definately be going back. Winkin, if your read this, your the man.

reviews.author: JoyK
reviews.title: Far from Paradise...Pretty resort with no clue what customer service means
reviews.text:
I've never written one of these before, but having just come back from my trip to Paradisus Palma Real, I felt compelled to share my experience so I could warn other travelers.  It was the talk of the hotel, at least for Non Reserve guests, that service was very poor and there were many disgruntled guests.

When we got there, our concierge Alberto told us that we could not secure ANY reservations for a restaurant for at least 3 days because they were "way overbooked."  I told him that we had already paid our money, so didn't understand how that could be the case.  He had no answers for me and appeared completely dumbfounded as to why I would be upset that I couldn't get my 2 young children into a restaurant.  After wasting about 30 minutes with him and another concierge,I demanded to speak to manager, who was finally able to help us out the next day.  Even when we showed up for that first reservation, the staff said they had no record of our reservation and gave us a hard time until I again had to demand to speak to the restaurant concierge who had worked with the manager I had spoken to.  A lot of unnecessary stress for a vacation to get into restaurants with pretty average food.

Once our meal situation was solved, we had to deal with getting seats at the pool or beach.  After not being able to find any seat for our family of 5, we were told quickly by other hotel guests that the trick was coming out and getting seats by 6 am.  And again, despite it being a vacation, my husband or I were out there every day between 5:30 - 6 am securing pool side chairs.  I've stayed at beautiful resorts in Anguilla, Turks & Caicos, Hawaii, etc. and have never had to do something so ridiculous.

Other areas of service are spotty.  The on-site tour company that handled our transfers tried to swindle my mother-in-law into paying $90/person for a snorkeling trip until I told her it was free at the hotel.  While the people at the pool told us we had booked a snorkeling trip for one day at 11 am, I found out the next day when I went to the aquatics area that the reservation was actually made for 3 pm and that we were only "waitlisted."  Once I told them that was not what we were originally told, they said they could accomodate us, which was nice.  While there were some hiccups in getting this booked, I'm glad we did make this trip, as my kids loved it and the staff was good.

I had heard from people we met at The Reserve that they had a better experience.  Honestly, I would recommend that you just skip this "paradise"  and do yourself a favor and stay at a Four Seasons, Ritz Carlton or mid size boutique hotel that understand what it means to please and satisfy customers.  This is a pretty place, with spacious rooms and nice grounds.  However, there are many other nice resorts to go to where you can just relax and not constantly have to talk to manager or your travel agent to make sure you get what you paid for.

reviews.author: Kennytwins
reviews.title: Overall, we were very disappointed with this resort! Not worth the money.
reviews.text: This resort is very nice to look at and the rooms and suites are well appointed. The photos on-line reflect what  you see when you are there. The pools and beach are beautiful but thats wher my complements end. The problem with this resort is the lack of service. The whole place needs new management. The staff are pathetic. They did not have our 2 BR suite available when we checked in so we had to go to two separate rooms for two days. There was no apology, no explanation, no attempt to make us happy. The check-in staff wer not sympathetic in any way and had no problem telling us that our room category would not be available till later in the week. Most other hotels, would give you some spa creidts or something to makeup for this inconvenience but not here. It also seems like they bend over backward for vacation club owners. There are separate restaurants, separate pool area, separate beach area with cushioned chairs. If you are not an owner, you are not treated well. We had to get up at 7 am just to get a chair at the beach while the vacation club area was empty. There was a definite feeling that if you were not an owner, you were a second class citizen. It was also very very difficult to get reservations for dinner. Many nights, we had to eat tthe mediocre buffet because the restaurants were all booked. The entire week was just very frustrating an dot t all what I expected or paid for. All in all, I would never go back to this resort!

reviews.author: cooldude3919
reviews.title: Amazing, palatial resort! Wonderful stay !
reviews.text: Just spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real; in a word: AMAZING! i was blown away by how big and roomy it was! our concierge Pedro was wonderful and took us on a private tour of the hotel upon our arrival and took care of our dinner reservations throughout the week. it could get a little busy at times, but nothing that would make you feel overly crowded. the room was very clean, and housekeeping was always finished before noon! there were a choice of 7 à la carte restaurants, all elegant with great food! the beach was very sandy, lots of tall palm trees make for an charming setting, but quite a bitof seaweed in the water. my only complaint: it was hard to reserve chairs at the beach and the pool! i would be up at 6am and would barely be able to find a free spot! you really need the ''huts'' to relax in the shade sometimes. the service was excellent, all the locals made an effort to speak english to the guests. the pool was magnificent and the bars have anything you want! will definitely return in the near future

reviews.author: KSTiger
reviews.title: Not perfect, but darn good
reviews.text:
Paradisus Punta Cana – A review (long)
This is our 5th stay at an all-inclusive resort, but first to the DR.  After making this trip, I would definitely go back, both to the DR, and to this resort.   Is it perfect? No.  Is it really, really, really nice?  Yes. 

First, facilities.   The beach is just like it looks in the photos…gorgeous acres of white sand, blue-green water, etc.  They seem to actually have plenty of chairs and shade, the resort was well spread out and you never felt crowded even though we went during a fairly busy week.  The common areas of the resort are nice, well maintained, and beautiful.  Honestly, the whole place is gorgeous.  Best we’ve stayed at so far for facilities/beach.   It can be pretty windy on the beach, especially at night,  you might want to bring a light windbreaker.   There is some seaweed but this stretch of the beach is good, some of the neighboring resorts we walked by had a LOT more seaweed.   Honestly, it’s the ocean.   

Rooms.  We were in the “Turquoise” area which is one of the farther areas away from the beach.   Our 1 bedroom Master Suite was very nice and roomy.  Hot tub pretty good.  Bed was a little firm and squeaky but tolerable.   Very nice shower and bathroom area.  So/so view of the garden but we weren’t expecting much here.   Overall very happy with this.  Have heard rooms at Reserve are nicer but it wasn’t worth the tradeoff for us in being farther away from the beach.  We didn’t spend a lot of time in the room anyway.  

Activities were very good for an all-inclusive resort.  One thing this place throws in which most don’t is free (introductory level) scuba diving, after an instructional video and ½ hr in the pool we took an afternoon trip to a nearby reef and dove down around 25’.  I had such a good time they invited me to show up again for the same trip the next afternoon, and it was tremendous.   Very good time.  Other watersports (kayaking/paddleboating/snorkeling/windsurfing) were also included and I did some of them, which was fun.  Night-time entertainment was a little “hit-and-miss,” but they tried hard, and we had fun.  I played a ton of beach volleyball, and met a lot of cool people. 

Food.  Breakfast and Lunch are buffet style, you could always find something good, just be prepared to try different things, and if you don’t like it, get something else.  Food quality at breakfast/lunch= on the order of a typical buffet at a Ryan’s or Golden Corral.  Lots of fresh fruits and vegetables – which we ate in spades, violating every major rule of dining for international travel, and never got sick.  We met people on the plane on the way back who stayed elsewhere and got sick.   Dinners were hit and miss, some plates were good, some were mediocre, and some were flat out bad.   Definitely not as good food as the last place we stayed (El Dorado Seaside Suites in Mayan Riviera).  Nutshell version – you won’t starve, you’ll find a lot of food you like, but you’ll find some stuff you really don’t.  Don’t be afraid to order a different dish or duplicates of something you really like.  My wife and I have a rule about the dinners – we always get different dishes, appetizers and salads, and share – which I would recommend as well.  You can always get more if you like it, right?  Room service is free and 24/7, which we took advantage of a couple times.   In general the best thing we found was the seafood, which was quite tasty….if you like seafood you won’t be disappointed here.   One major gripe is the weird reservation system for dinner, our concierge did not do well for us and we had a lot of late night (9:00+) dinner reservations.  If you showed up at a restaurant early they would try to fit you in but often you would have to wait half an hour plus, even if there were numerous visible empty tables.  Also be prepared, 3 of the better restaurants require long sleeves/pants/close toe shoes, and the ladies dress up – this wasn’t well advertised in their literature and the only close toe shoes I brought were sneakers.  They still let you in, but you feel a little underdressed. 

Drinks.  Pretty good, lots of selection of mid-range alcohols.   JD and Jim Beam for whiskey, pretty good rum selection, some high-end gin and vodka selections, Jimadora Tequila, JW-Red and black + Dewars.   One local beer (Presidente), which I didn’t care much for.   Pours were a little inconsistent from bartender to bartender.  If you ask for a “stiff” drink be prepared to have them knock your socks off.    We were quite successful in keeping a good buzz going from around 1:00->bedtime, without “going over,” which is just how we like it. 

Service.  Generally service was pretty good, we had one bad experience at the Hibachi place with glacial service, but in general we were pretty happy.   There was no expectation of a tip, although we went around on the last day we were there and took care of the bartenders and wait staff who we thought did the best jobs.   The place could definitely benefit from having one more beach waitress for drinks, I got up a lot and got my own, the one girl they had on the right side of the beach was working very hard all day, but was a little overwhelmed by demand.   There are bars everywhere no matter where you are at this place.   Minibar was stocked daily and our beds were turned down both at noon and also around 8:00 at night.  

Other random comments:
-The main pool was gorgeous and enormous but a bit chilly in March despite it being 80 degrees outside, heating it up another couple degrees would have been awesome.
-Facilities were very “kid-friendly” without catering exclusively to families.  I would have had a hard time finding dinners my picky kids would eat, though…..I was glad we were solo.   Maybe provide a kids menu? 
-Not sure I like the “Reserve” concept, I wouldn’t pay more for it, too far away from the beach for my taste. 
-Spa is hugely overpriced -- $140 for a 50 minute massage?  Really?  Most expensive I have ever seen at an all inclusive resort before, especially considering the labor rate in the Dominican.  
-Ditto on the gift shop - $20 for a tiny tube of sunscreen.  Bring your own AND BRING EXTRA, we thought we had enough but we ran out on our second-to-last day there. 
-Tours – I hear very good things about the ziplining, scuba was excellent, horseback riding was fun but do the 1 hr trip and not the 2 hr trip.   Not sure I’d do the dune buggy thing based on what we heard from others who had tried it.  
-Punta Cana airport is an experience in and of itself.  If you can possibly avoid it, avoid flying back on a Saturday.   Apparently Saturdays are their worst days, we spent 2.5 hrs just clearing security at the airport due to massive lines in checkin and at security, fortunately they held the plane for us, but it was a nightmare.

reviews.author: Irisagat
reviews.title: perfection
reviews.text: just got back last night from the most amazing vacation I've ever had!!!! I travel a lot but was never as impressed as I was with this resort. we were not the "royal members" and I think there is just no need for it. the hotel is amazingly clean and beautiful, the entertainment team is awesome (especially Santa and Juse), the restaurant are good (Mizu was our favorite) and the ocean is just perfect. the food was good, selection was excellent - TOP SHELF ANYTHING YOU WANT DRINKS all day everyday. everyone works really hard to make you feel good (so please tip them). they come to clean the room TWICE a day and leave little surprises. This was a perfect vacation in a perfect hotel (20 min from the airport $30 for 2 ppl taxi each way) and will recommend to anyone who likes to be pampered and be sun-kissed.

reviews.author: Richieharv
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text: Having read some scary reviews before going to this hotel I was very worried. We travelled with our family which included our  two young grand children. We found the accommodation  to be very good, the concierge service at the Reserve was excellent and the wide variety of restaurants served very good food. The kids pool and club were excellent and we enjoyed alternating between the pool and the beach day by day. We enjoyed the entertainment a couple of evenings and found the staff generally good fun and helpful. Waited at times for transport back tot he Reserve from the main area but nothing to get uptight about. Would recommend to families, especially our experience at the Reserve with the family concierge service. Phew, what a relief, we had a great time!

reviews.author: HJR2011
reviews.title: Just What We Needed
reviews.text:
We visited in April with our two children-an infant and active little boy-and had a wonderful stay. The resort is immaculate, and they work hard to keep it that way. Everyone is pleasant, especially if you greet them all with an 'hola' and not treat their staff like wallpaper. They are the nicest people and treated our boys like little princes! We loved our room, and even though we were right around the corner from the casino, bars and restaurants we still felt like we were in a quiet hideaway. 

The beauty of this resort is that, even though you are there with a lot of guests, it does not feel crowded at all! Other reviewers complain here that they were turned away from restaurants even when there were empty tables-this is due to the fact that they don't cram people in like they do at Olive Garden. Remember people, this isn't the US where you are in and out of a restaurant in 45 mins! This is a more european style resort, where that table is yours for as long as you like. So if you're arriving at 7:30, they will NOT seat people at that table at 6:30. They spread their guests around at the restaurants so you don't feel like one of the herd. Moo.

We had a wonderful time-this place has something for anyone. If you want to rest and be left alone, or party it up it seemed like they accommodated all types. Our concierge took our cues and left us alone-every few days he slipped a note under our door to let us know where he booked our reservations for us (Thank you so much!) If the kids weren't up to it, we just went to the buffet for dinner which had SO much to pick from it was incredible! If you weren't interested in what they had laid out, they also had three or four choices of fish & meat that they would grill for you upon request. Maybe the previously posters who complained about the buffet didn't notice that....

No one bothered us about the timeshares. The beach and pool are BOTH gorgeous. My husband would get up before dawn to reserve a spot for us haha, but we've done that at every resort we've ever been to-sorry!

One last note-if you are there with your kids, take the time to book a sitting with their photographers. Its quick and easy and the pictures came out beautifully-thank you so much Nadia! The memories will last a lifetime and now we have photos to share with our family as well. You made us look gorgeous too!

Any questions you may have about traveling with kids to this resort, feel free to email me. We heard a lot of people left their babies at home, and seemed regretful when they saw what a great time we were having with ours. Its completely do-able and perfectly safe.

reviews.author: eirpr
reviews.title: Spectacular Beach, Food and Guests Services
reviews.text: Everything was better than we expected. Great accommodations Large Villas with Plasmas TVs/ Whirlpool/etc. Outstanding 24hrs food/drinks(buffets-A la carte, 7+ restaurants(variety)). , All inclusive convenience. Golf Tennis, Water Sports, Great Massages, Amenities, Activities Day & Night, etc etc. Like the hospitality/service.

reviews.author: murrala
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: In the week that my wife and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort, it was the best vacation I have had so far.  We were on our honeymoon and it could not have been more perfect.  We stayed in the Royal Service section on the Resort and I recommend that section if you are on your honeymoon or want to be exclusive and private.  Only adults are allowed in the Royal Service section.  This section also has its own private pool and part of the beach with a wait staff and bartenders who were exceptionally attentive. They helped you get the best spot on the beach in the morning and made sure you were happy, sun-blocked and hydrated all day!  Staying in the Royal Section you also get your own private butler!!  We had a gentlemen named Mercelovichy Paul or Merselo as he told us it was pronounced.  He was an outstanding butler and I highly recommend you request him before your stay. Marcelo went out of his way to make sure our honeymoon was romantic and rememerable. The restuarants and night life were amazing and I suggest you choose this resort!

reviews.author: Vickie J
reviews.title: Most Relaxing Vacation Ever
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real

Arrival: The hotel is really beautiful. Marble and sweeping archways throughout, tremendous main pool and a truly white powder sand beach dotted with gorgeous palm trees. Paradise.  From the airport we chose the transfer option and it was quite easy and not expensive ($35 roundtrip). Only took 30 mins to hotel in a nice air-conditioned van. After they dropped us off, they had a few more folks, but was only a 12-15 seater van so they can't take too many. After arrival at the airport where you pass thru customs (you need $10 each by the way) and after baggage claim, look to the right for dozens of operator booths. Just look for name of your transfer company or ask anyone to locate. Keep your baggage with you until you locate your transfer company. That way you just tip one guy. Note the best advice we got was to bring a lot of ones,then you can tip easily and they are quite pleased. You will never feel "bummed" for tips on property, but you will be very glad to have them. One guy told us the avg salary in the DR is $250-300 in USD per month. 

Internet:  Free wifi in Lobby only. Works fine. Room supposedly has 
pay cable- bring your own or rent it. 

Concierge: we had a nice guy who made all of our dinner reservations for us. You do a few nights in advance and come back for more each few days. You cannot get into the ala carte ones without the reservation paper each night. The concierge's main job is to get you to attend a vacation club presentation. They are nice and helpful with everything, but that is their priority. The presentation is actually low pressure and interesting. We did not mind at all. 

Restaurants: we have mixed reviews. We actually liked the main buffet restaurant as they prepare many things fresh for you. Steaks pork burgers tuna salmon lamb etc etc. Omelets are good and fresh. It is certainly above cruise food.  The Sushi Bar in Bana is quite awful. We could not eat the rolls so we left and went to the buffet. The sushi rolls were pre-made and mushy. The restaurant Passions was like a chain restaurant. Food was not so great.  We got into the Mizu at the Reserve and it was very good-hibachi style japaneese -  better than back home. The beef and shrimp were quite good.  Restaurant Aqua was nice atmosphere and better than Passions for sure.  For attending the vacation club presentation we got into Gabi Beach.- it was the best food we ate. We had the grilled lobster and it was quite good.   Room service is great and free all the time. Ordered a cheese and fruit platter with some wine several nights before dinner- very reliable  Your mini bar is stocked sparsely, but just ask your maid or main desk for more of whatever you want. They all say dont drink the water or brush your teeth with it.   

Room & Royal Service: we had the Garden View Room and were very pleased-5 star quality. Had a small living room with separate bath and living room.  A slight mildew smell but it is very warm and moist here. We cannot recommend the Royal Service since we did not choose, but have to say we didn't miss anything! Service was great and would not pay extra for a Royal Service. The room safe is easy to use and we always used it when we left.  Electricity outlets here same as in US.  Since we didnt have Royal Service we did get up early to reserve a chair with our towels as they get gone quickly.  Postcards were mailed free for us from the front desk. 

Activities: down on the beach at the resort's green watersports shack, we checked out both the paddle boat and kayaks (included) and had a really nice time. We also did the snorkel trip (also free) which was a short 5 min ride via boat. Pool is very nice and the nice folks at the pool bar will insure you keep a cold frozen drink in hand and have a great time! Tips again are appreciated. English here is spotty but we had no problems. Also even though we came during spring break and they said it was at max capacity we did not feel it was crowded at all. Large expansive property.  The Spa was wonderful. There are two on property with same offers and prices. The Reserve one seemed a little more peaceful due to it's location. If you can, show up an hour early and enjoy the spa.  Make sure to ask for Damaris and get the full hydrotherapy treatment prior to your paid service. Excellent spa. We had a massage and pedicure- both great.   

Shopping: minimal choices. Hotel has a large gift shop and it seems each Monday around dinner they invite in vendors for Domican Night. Or you walk to the mall at the entrance to the resort. Nice but expensive and not many Artisan shops. Or if you walk out of the hotel onto the beach -a few hundred yards to the right and left you will find a couple of local flea markets just off the beach. Very touristy stuff but if you want a small souvenir it will do. They negotiate and are slightly cheaper. 

Overall wonderful experience. We will definitely come back. The only thing they could improve is the food quality.  We travel a lot and while you may read a few disgruntled reviews, you will be very very happy you chose here! It is truly like paradise. Several who travel here to Punta Cana  a lot told us the Paradisus had one of the best beaches and good service.  Several folks did like the Dreams resort also but we have not tried.

reviews.author: Cswolfe
reviews.title: Welcome to the caste system
reviews.text:
Review of Paradisus Palma Real

Date of trip: April 19 to 23

I went to Dominican Republic with my two younger children, ages 11 and 15 to get some warmth and fun for a few days.  PPR came highly recommended so we decided to give it a try. While the facility is relatively new, rooms are clean, the beach is beautiful, and the pool is lovely, there exists at the PPR an underlying class system that will thwart any intention of someone going there from having a great time.

So unnerved were we and many other families that we met by this experience, that it ruined the experience that a resort of this nature should have left us with.

First off, when you check in, they give you a colored bracelet. Mine was white while my children's were red.  Along the way, I saw purple, brown, light blue, and a myriad of other color bracelets.  It's a subtle way of letting you know that you are part of the plebeians without actually stating that fact at check in.  Here's how the bracelet system works from what I can tell. If you are part of the low class race that I was in (and mind you I did pay a small fortune to stay there), it is nearly impossible to get a reservation at one of the many restaurants the resort offers and a seat at the beach.  

We arrived on a Tuesday and were lucky to get access to the sushi bar for dinner on Wednesday night.   However, much to my dismay, we noticed that Bana, the restaurant that offers a teppanyaki menu, an Asian fusion menu as well as a sushi menu, was mostly empty while they claimed it was booked.  They utilize only 20% of the restaurant space at any given time.  The sushi bar where we ate would ONLY serve sushi to us, even though there was Asian fusion food offered at the table next to us.  Also, the sushi menu was very limited, maybe 10 items in all, too much rice and they couldn't make anything off the menu.

Wednesday at 4 is the time when you can book for Thursday and beyond. I got on the line w the concierge at 4 and by the time I arrived EVERYTHING was booked at ALL restaurants.  The alternative is a buffet dinner which looks like regurgitated food from breakfast and lunch w some steak offered.  People were livid and were made to feel like second class citizens.

Okay, so on with the beach access and pool. About 2/3s of the beach is available only for reserve and royal patrons.  Not sure what the ratio of plebeians to the upper class is, but the end result is that 2/3s of the roped off beach is empty while the plebeians are are waking up at 5:30 am to get a shaded spot at the beach.  When you try to venture over to the other side, there are guards with batons that look like machine guns that kick you out and really make you feel good about your choice of staying there.  People also leave stuff on the chairs from the night before.  The hotel really should be on top of this as we witnessed two world wars while there. Same situation at the pool and especially the coveted shaded beds they have around.  I was less concerned w the pool as I'm a beach person.  I did manage to get a nice spot on the beach for two days by waking up at 6:30.  On our last full day, nothing was free so I piggybacked on someone's space, who was gracious enough to share their shade. They claimed their space the night before!

The water sports desk, run by scuba quatics, is inadequate to handle the needs of the resort.  For a resort that large,(I think there are 2,000 people there?), they have only two hobie cats, one windsurf (adults only size) and a few kayaks and one paddle boat.  It took us two days to book a reservation for a hobie cat and even then we had to wait an hour for it.  People I spoke to were very frustrated with the wait time to get access to water sports and gave up.

I'm not sure the owners of this resort understand that it isn't just looks and a nice beach that will keep the hotels reputation up to snuff.  People going on a vacation want to sit at the beach, partake in whatever water sports or amenities are available, they want to relax, and at the end of the day, they just want to sit down and have a nice meal and be served.  I personally felt very slighted by my experience there.  I have been to many beautiful resorts and have never been so overtly made to feel like part of the underclass.

Going forward, I would not recommend this hotel and I, for one, will only go to a resort where all men and women are treated equally!

reviews.author: LB021
reviews.title: Carlos Alex Garcia is the greatest bartender!
reviews.text: The hotel/resort was great, weather was perfect, but one of the highlights of the trip was our bartender, Carlos.  If you want to see a drink made like Tom Cruise did in the movie Cocktail, you should check him out (find him at the bar in BANA).  He also does a fire show on the bar.  Very friendly and very entertaining.  We kept going back to him for drinks even if we were eating at a different restaurant.  Also, a short walk down the beach is a restaurant called Jellyfish (not part of the resort) it was some of the best food I've ever had.  Worth venturing off the property and spending a little cash.

reviews.author: lucyandigor
reviews.title: unforgetable vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I recently returned from our vacation in Paradisus. It is an absolutely perfect location for people, who need to unwind and just do nothing, except relax, listen to the waves, and get lazy. We went there to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary and upgraded to royal service,that when we experienced the Paradise. We would like to send special thanks to our butler Ramon Avila, who made us feel like kings, to the beach butlers Francisco and Pedro, who took care of us at the beach and the pool and Maybeline, who was the mmost gracious host ever. The Hotel grounds as beautiful as the name of the Hotel, the food is excellent, everything is perfect, every wish does become true there, thanks to the people who work really hard to make it possible.

reviews.author: StPaulCountry_Girl
reviews.title: Best Week Ever!!!
reviews.text: We went to the resort for a week for a work function. There were 90 of us that went coming from all over Canada. The resort was seamless for checkin. We arrived at 10am and had a room ready which was great since check in was 3pm. Our room was so nice and even had bathrobes and slippers. Bar fridge fully stocked was kept full all week. The grounds are breathtaking and spotless. The staff work very hard to pick up everything including cigarette butts. We had a private beach BBQ arranged and it was beautiful and excellent food. I have been to many places and this was the best food I have had hands down. So much variety and it actually tasted really good. Even the desserts!! Drinks were delicious. Top shelf liquor. One of the beach bar waitress's Bianca made us up her special "Dirty Banana" drink that was so yummy.  They even bring you bags of Lays potato chips/Doritos! The bali beds were the only thing we didnt get to enjoy as there were towels on them all very early. I hate the towel game however it is at any resort I have ever been at. You could always find a spot though. We had such a great week here and were impressed constantly throughout the week with the staff and services available. I really wonder about the people putting negative reviews if they just have nothing better to do with their time than complain. You are on vacation.... relax and dont sweat the small stuff!!! :-)

reviews.author: eramalho221067
reviews.title: Espetacular!!!Todos deveriam ter a oportunidade de conhecer, um dia!
reviews.text:
Fizemos nossa viagem de lua de mel, após 20 anos de casados e não poderíamos ter escolhido lugar e hotel, melhores. O lugar é maravilhoso, o hotel além de oferecer inúmeras opções de lazer, o faz com muita classe e qualidade. Foi deixado à nossa disposição um  personal consierge chamado "Genaro" que se mostrou um excelente anfitrião e amigo. Nos dedicou uma interminável atenção e ainda nos fez um linda surpresa na data do aniversário de casamento.
Indicamos esse Resort a todos que quiserem ir e temos a intenção de retornar em breve.

reviews.author: ZoeChloe827
reviews.title: Relaxed and rejuvenated!
reviews.text:
This resort is immaculate, and considering it is an all-inclusive (with service folks not expecting tips), the service was spectacular.  People were REALLY friendly and full of hospitality.  It was a fun, international clientele - many Canadians (from all over), Brits, Italians, French, Dutch, German - lots of languages.  Add a star if you speak Spanish, but even if you don't, you'll get along just fine.  

Highly recommend the Spa at the Reserve ( a golf cart ride away) - it's beautiful.  We had good services at both Spas, including the hydrotherapy.  The rooms were comfortable and spacious and the beds were completely comfortable.  The Jacuzzi bubble bath was FUN!
Many dining options (including a really good buffet).  The food is good - not great - but there is a nice variety.  There are many activities (if you want), gorgeous beach, plenty of shade options at the beach and by the (many) swimming pools.
Off-site, we went on a horseback ride at a nearby beach (scheduled at the activities desk at Paradisus) - El Pat Ranch - and loved it.  The horses were gentle and the guides were great.  Then we went to "Dolphin Explorer" and had a lifetime memorable experience - exceeded our expectations (how often does that happen?!)  Got amazing photos.
Evening activities were fun too.
Kind of like a cruise, only WAY better.  Very glad we went here, we really came back ready to face the real world again (and we arrived there kind of blotto!)

reviews.author: Qflyer
reviews.title: Nice location but overall poor quality
reviews.text:
Just spent 4 days with my wife at the resort.  First time in an all-inclusive, so was very curious to see if it's something i would pay for (I didn't pay for this trip).  The resort itself is not bad - nice beach, decent pool, spread-out.  The food was VERY disappointing - all the restaurants have more-or-less the same food and it's not food that i would pay for in a restaurant.  Nice to be able to get all the drinks and stuff you want, but would have been 100x better if the food was good.  Service was spotty - from housekeeping and on.  One thing that bugged my wife and I was housekeeping just knocked and came in - don't even wait to hear if someone is in the room.  Our A/C was broken when we first checked in, but that was taken care of after I called and talked to someone who could speak English.
Would I pay for this resort myself? Definitely not.  Would I consider staying at a another all-inclusive? Yes, I liked the concept and hope it can be executed better elsewhere.

reviews.author: jc1941
reviews.title: muy bueno, pero con ciertas falencias
reviews.text:
Las instalaciones y hotel lindísimas, todo excelente, buenas piezas, variadas comidas y buenas y lindos restaurantes. El bar de la piscina estupendo gracias a la atención y presencia de una persona , que si no estuvieses no creo que iría tanta gente y el grita, canta FUEEEGOOOOO, FUEEEEGOOOO.
atiense muy bién y es muy simpático, merece mención aparte y creemos que es el alma de ese bar.Felicitaciones especiales. pues tiene carisma y simpatía
El personal no saluda como es habitual en otros hoteles 5 estrellas como The royal Playa del Carmen y Paradisus en Varedero o en Jamaica. Todos los que pasan al lado de uno debe de ser un 10% que saluda por lo que los pasajeros o turistas lo hacemos. En The Royal les enseñan o está dentro de su trabajo el saludar a todos y es muy agradable.
La atención del personal o mejor el hotel no es buena pues en la habitación colocan toallas de menos, jabones a veces no ponen etc. A veces dejan la cama abierta para que uno se acueste y otras no. En otros hoteles en la camas hacen figuras con toallas y pétalos de rosas.y acá nada.
Se enviaron de Chile para informaran como era una boda en la playa 4 mails y nada; se reclamó allá
para hablar con el Gerente y no atendió. Además se solicitó una torta pequeña pues eramos 8 para un yerno mío que estaba de cumpleaños y nada, tuve que habler con un jefe pues por otro lado no hubo caso, se complicaron mucho. El personal  del buffet y restaurantes estupendos para atender
Ahora si me preguntan si volvería a ese hotel y la respuesta es siiiiiiiiiii pero me gustaría que las cosas malas la solucionen

reviews.author: mjfunk
reviews.title: Service ranges from spotty to rude
reviews.text: I just returned from this resort and was quite dissappointed at the overall experience.  First of all the food was bad.  Not ok, bad.  The breakfast buffet was ok, but it took 10 min to flag somebody down for coffee.  The dinner choices were ok, but the results were not.  And the service, especially the hostess at Venta, was very poor.  At the casino, drunk gamblers were abusive to the staff and other guests w/o any consequence.  The resort itself is tired.  Rooms are ok, but just beneath the surface you see signs of age.  Very few on staff seem incented to help anybody.  Perhaps its the all-inclusive nature of the resort that dis-incents its employees to try harder, who knows.

reviews.author: tmanettas
reviews.title: spring break 2011-one of the best!
reviews.text: We booked this trip for our annual Caribbean vacay with two other families. Originally booked for the Paradisus Punta Cana, we were moved to the Palma Real due to some overbooking, which may cause some stress, but it was the first day of vacation and we weren't about to let something like this set it off.  They moved and upgraded us as an apology.  The Palma Real appeared to be nicer than the Paradisus Punta Cana, so it was fine.  The resort grounds are meticulously maintained, the rooms are tended to beautifully.  The staff are wonderful and extremely attentive.  Yes, the majority do speak spanish, and being far from fluent, I had no troubles communicating my needs.  If you just speak slowly and clearly, they will know what you want.  You're wishes won't be the first they've heard.  The family concierge was a Godsend, he planned everything for us; all dinner reservations, parasailing, snorkeling, etc.  We once tried to tip him and he refused saying 'No, this is my job.  After your stay, if I have done a good job, THEN you can tip me.'  If we had a language barrier, Guzman, our concierge would assist us.  If I had an issue to resolve or any question whatsoever, he was the man.  We made friends with one of the golf cart drivers who quickly became a favorite with the kids, he would pick us up at a predetermined time and take us to dinner, giving the kids extra rides through the resort.
