He didn't speak english whatsoever, so he would give us his phone to type in the time we wanted him to collect us. The kids actually cried saying goodbye to him!  The Kids Zone in the Reserve is wonderful.  The staff overlooking the kids are meticulous in their care of the children.  My kids, 9 and 11 had a great time.  The pools remain spotless throughout the day.  The bar staff will guarantee a great time for kids and adults!  (Don't be afraid to try the local drink!)  This isn't a resort to be concerned with the water/ice issue making you ill.  I have a horrific stomach and didn't have a single issue.  The ice is pre-bagged and safe to have in your drinks, the water is all bottled and the fruit was fine also.  The restaurants/food were great.  BUT I will make a disclaimer here:  If you're coming from the US/Canada, you may have a complaint about waitstaff.  Waitstaff isn't created equal outside of the States. Its not bad per se, its just different.  They may serve the kids first, which is great in theory, except then your kids are running amuck while you're trying to eat.  They may forget to bring you your wine, or fail to mention that the potato soup has seafood in it.  We've traveled the world and its the same everywhere but the States.  Just understand this, and be patient.  ALSO-this was a bit of a drag, the resort DOES NOT OFFER FREE WIFI THROUGHOUT, only in the lobby.  I was a bit gobsmacked by this, but ultimately it was a true vacation to have to disconnect and not be connected to the world.  The spa was out of the world and the prices are awesome.  We booked through Bookit.com and were given 100 credit to the spa and a round of golf.  We would absolutely go back, and the next time we are looking to stay All Inclusive we will make sure to book with the same hotel family.  It was a great trip!

reviews.author: Nancy R
reviews.title: I do not  recommend this resort
reviews.text:
We booked a week at the Reserve however upon arrival they did not have our reservation, therefor we were put up at the Paradisus Palma Real.  Although the resort, and beach was beautiful, friendly and helpful staff, the food was horrible and the liquor watered down.  I understand this is a 4+star resort (not sure who's doing the rating).  I would not recommend this vacation spot, and feel they have turned me off to all inclusive' vacationing.
Nancy
NYC

reviews.author: Ali35805
reviews.title: Don't go to this hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel made our vacation stressful before we even left.  We booked the hotel 3 months before the trip and a week before we were to leave they called us to let us know that they overbooked and they have to relocate us from the Reserve portion of the hotel.  The only reason that we booked this hotel was because of the Reserve.  Don't go there, they will make your vacation miserable before you even leave!

reviews.author: Willolot
reviews.title: Nice place, shame about the service
reviews.text: Attended our annual sales conference here. Great location on the beach, nice rooms, lovely pool etc. However, they need ti wake up and understand what good service is.Maybe the language barrier is the problem. OK, so I don't speak Spanish, but for such a major hotel catering to the US market the lack of good quality English amongst many of the staff caused real problems. On arrival my wife wanted to take a bath. The plug did not fit properly, so she rang reception to ask for it to be fixed, so that the water would stay in the bath. The sent a man to fix the toilet! We were supposed to have wired internet in the rooms. There were at least 4 RJ45 ports on the wall. None of them worked. I reported this at least 3 times to reception and nothing was done about it. The restaurants on site were good, bit if you did not book before 4pm you were not allowed in, even if they were empty (which they usually were). We arrived at 5pm on our first day and had to eat in the buffet.  We ended up with so many of us at our conference booking tables of 8 in restaurants and then deciding where we would go, but what a pain. It would be so much easier to just turn up. I was working all day and my wife wanted to relax, so why did we have to plan so much each day where we would eat. It all seemed to petty.

reviews.author: kevinmarshall
reviews.title: best vacation ever
reviews.text: I had the Royal Service and my room was ajacent to the beach. Never had to worry about a spot on the beach  there were always available loungers and palapas. My personal concerge Miguel was fantastic and made all my dinner reservations at the time i requested and checked in with me several times a day to see if everything was  satisfactory and made sure all my requests were taken care of. The al a cart resteraunts were great esp Vento and Gabi Beach and my reservations were always at the time i requested and made be Miguel. The week there was amazing and i cant wait to return to this beautifull resort who made me feel welcome as a single traveller and took such good care of me. special thank you to Juan and Daisy who checked me in and took me on the tour of the property. You are all my freinds now and cant wait to see you again soon

reviews.author: Kimber95
reviews.title: Not one Complaint
reviews.text:
I like everyone else was skeptical after reading reviews for this resort...We arrived on March 30th and have not one bad thing to report.  From the service of our concierge Edgar right down to the housekeeping, the resort was incredible.  Edgar  went above and beyond, as for the "time share" speel...it is not a timeshare, its all on a points system and if myself and my husband were older we would not of even thought twice about purchasing, we did the tour early in the morning and quite frankly I am happy we did, it wasnt that bad.  The reserve is beautiful but so are the main grounds, we ate at the reserve section and the Gabi Beach, food was excellent, the Gabi restaurant not so much, We stayed in a deluxe garden view suite, not even a 5 min walk to the pool or beach it was awesome and the food in the regular area was delicious...how could you complain about everything you could imagine for breakfast from, fresh omelets, waffles, fresh fruit and everything inbetween, the market grill was a great spot for a quick late lunch, burgers, chicken, fries etc...again awesome, we did a lot of the a al cartes for a late dinner, all of which were excellent as well, if you do not like it the buffet is opened until 10..and there is room service all night....that was never the case but we knew we could fall back on that.
The pool is fantastic much, much bigger than the one on the reserve..actually after reading all of the reviews I have realized that alot of the complaints do come from the reserve, its way back from the main area.  We thoroughly enjoyed being in the main part of the resort, close to everything.
If you are looking for a little shopping there is a mall just down the road from the hotel, if you head to the beach and go towards the right, past a huge blow up slide down the beach you will find some great markets, I do not speak spanish but one is called bebeaqua...totally mispelled I am sure...lol..it is about 15 mins down the beach, there is a bar and a restaurant as you approach, there is a smaller market just before this one and its not as good as bebeaqua..I happen to like the whole bartering etc, so if you do not like this, it may not be for you.  You can dicker alot on prices, because usually what they start out at is outrageous.
I will wrap it up I could go on forever we had such a wonderful time,  we travelled with one other couple and were treated like royalty from the moment we stepped into the lobby.  If you choose the Palma Real regular area I am certain you will not be dissapointed.

reviews.author: Luv2Travel5551970
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
My significant other and I stayed March 29th-April 5th 2011. Let me start off by giving my points of reference: Sandals Royal Bahamian, Sandals Grande St.Lucia, Riviera Princess, The Royal Playa del Carmen, Royal Caribbean Navigator & Explorer cruise ships, Aventura Palace. That being said, I believe that 5 star Caribbean resorts never quite measure up to 5 star NorthAmerican/European standards.
We stayed in an Oceanfront suite (#2115) in the Royal Section.
I am going to attempt to state all the things that I was searching for in TripAdvisor before our trip.

Checkin: Royal Service has its own Lounge for this. No one was in front of us, so checkin was seamless. We were assigned to #1118 which was on the ground floor (king bed) however we were paying for an OF room, and wanted to actually see the ocean. The only other room available had 2 double beds, so after about an hour, housekeeping was able to move the beds together, put a mattress pad on top so there wasn't a crack. It was great.

Butler: We were assigned Carmen. When we checked in, we were given a cell phone to contact her. The number we were given always connected to the RS Lounge, so whomever answered was the person who ended up looking after our request. The Butler will unpack/pack your luggage, draw a bath w/ candles & roses petals etc, however we never requested any of this. The Butler is also supposed to reserve your Bali beds around the pool and on the beach. Carmen did it the first day, however she said the Pool/Beach Concierge would do that for us, so we just arranged it with them. I still think she should have, but we never pressed it. Maybe we should have been more demanding to keep her on her toes. We made some dinner reservations through her, and some through the RS Lounge. One evening we showed up for dinner and they did not have the reservation that Carmen was supposed to make, but another restaurant fit us in.

Rooms: We would have preferred the jacuzzi to be on the balcony. The bathrooms were a somewhat small, and the jacuzzi took up alot of space. We are used to double sinks, so sharing was a challange. We had to organize getting ready a little better! We overheard some people complaining about the semi-open concept of the bathroom & toilet to the room. There is a frosted glass door that is not floor to ceiling where the toilet is. And there are only louvered shutters that separate the entire bathroom to the bedroom area. This was not an issue for us, however if you prefer complete privacy, one should consider this. The hairdryer is a very basic Sunbeam 1500watt wall mounted dryer. There is a coffee machine in the room, however not an espresso machine as www.paradisus.com states.

Food: Vento is the restaurant that is dedicated to RS and Reserve guests. We went twice and did not enjoy the food at all. The Asian fusion section of Bana was somewhat OK. The food wasn't terrible, but it was cold. Passion was great our first night, however the food was satisfactory on our second visit. Naos is the buffet. We only went for 2 breakfasts. There is a huge variety, but its still a buffet. And perhaps we did not go at the best time as it was really busy and resembled "cattle at a trough"

Beverages: Alot of top shelf liquors, JW Black & Red, Tanqueray, Chivas, Bombay Sapphire, Absolut Vanilla/Mandarin/Raspberry/Peppar, Benedictine....although we never really saw them open a new bottle of anything and suspected some were watered down. 
Bottled water is available everywhere, anytime.

Time Share: We were approached once on our first day. The gentleman was not aggresive and we politely declined. That was it. End of story. I suspect if one stays in the main part of the hotel/resort they are more suseptible to the Time Share reps.

I highly recommend the Royal Service. The extra perks were nice and the private pool, bar area, and beach area were oogled by everyone else that was not RS. 
Also, for any fellow Canadians, I recommened using Transat Vacations. This resort is considered part of their Prestige Collection and offers extras like private transfer to/from airport, seat selection, priority checkin at airport, bottle of champagne per person on the flight. We found those little things contribuated to our wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: GinaV28
reviews.title: JUAN CARLOS MEDRANO...your are the best!!!!!! YOU made our trip GREAT!
reviews.text: My husband and I along with our friends arrived at the Paradisus Palma Real on March 31. we were very impressed with the facility.  Very clean and nice. Our rooms were "ok" we didn't care for the layout of the Junior Suite, but they were clean. Our beach experience was the best! We had JUAN CARLOS MEDRANO as our beach attendant.  He was awesome. took care of us as if we were ROYALTY! He didn't miss a beat!  He is truly the shining diamond (and smile) of the resort!  Also we had Jesus, who was also very nice. We thought the evening entertainment was also very good.  The dancers really did a nice job, very talented! The food could of been better, the lunches are the worst out of the three. Breakfast "ok" and the dinners were somewhat good. I think they should have less of a variety and better quality for the lunch and dinners. However, It wouldn't stop me from going back. I thought the service was good, language barrier a problem at times. Also, I would like to compliment Denise Ortiz, she was extremely nice and helpful at checkout,  and was very professional and knowledgeable. I would definitely go back to this resort.

reviews.author: jsn13
reviews.title: The Place is AMAZING but the FOOD...
reviews.text:
We traveled to The Paradisus Palma Real RESERVE as a family of 9.  When we initially arrived we had some problems with the 5 rooms we had paid for.  For some reason, although we had received confirmation before our arrival, all of our rooms were not in the same building as we had requested.  Instead of trying to help us out, Marina initially was rude and not helpful.  She said there was nothing she could do and let us sit around the lobby (while we contacted our travel agent) with 3 young children until FINALLY miraculously, she was able to find 5 rooms in the same building.  Give me a break...they were available all the time.

Once, that was rectified our rooms were beautiful and very clean.  We met our family concierge Samira.  She was wonderful.  She helped in making dinner reservations, para-sailing escapades etc...

There are 2 NEGATIVES to this resort.
1.  The Food.  It was horrible.  Finally, 2 days before we were heading home, we had reservations at the main part of the hotel and the food seemed to be much better. However, the food was really AWFUL everywhere else!  From the pizza to Misu restaurant to Aqua and Gabi Beach.... just terrible!  The only restaurants that we found to be edible were Passion and Bana.  That really makes for a negative when your young children are telling you that they will ONLY eat PASTA.

2.  The language barrier:  The only person who truly spoke English and seemed to want to help was our family concierge Samira.  Otherwise, very few people understood English which made it difficult to communicate.  I don't think this would stop me from returning however, you need to be prepared.

Overall, it was a beautiful resort.  The pool, the beach, and the overall facility was gorgeous.  The kids loved the Kids Zone and all of the activities that they offered.  The other guests were very friendly and felt the same way as we did.  If they could get some people to bring the quality of food up I think it would be a top notch vacation.

reviews.author: kunruh
reviews.title: A dream vacation!
reviews.text: This review is for all you out there who are like me...very fussy about cleanliness and good quality!  I was nervous about going to Dominican after all the stories I had heard of how poor a place it can be...I was very excited and impressed when we got to this resort!  It was new, modern and beautiful!  We stayed in the Deluxe Gardenview Suite.  The room was big, modern, CLEAN and the service was great!  Housekeeping did a great job and they were always cheerful and friendly.  If you are an impatient person you will have to remember you're on "Island Time" and just take a deep relaxing breath and enjoy!  The restaurants are high class and the food delicious!  Just remember to book your evening meals when you first get there as they often are reserved already the day before.  Your concierge can help you with that...if you want a wonderful concierge ask for Edgar!  He is a nice, helpful man!  The beach here was clean! Much cleaner than others we saw when we walked down the beach!!  The pool was also great and huge!  So if you decide to pick this resort you will not be disappointed!  Oh and don't forget to tip...its important!

reviews.author: mikkiroo
reviews.title: Memorable stay with incredibly service
reviews.text:
In spite of all the negative reviews, this place looked like the best match for us and our friends, another couple our age. So we went ahead and booked and weren't disappointed! The negative reviews are almost solely from people who stayed on the Reserve. To be honest, I wouldn't have picked the Reserve even if we could have afforded it, because it was further back from the beach, the pool wasn't nearly as nice and the service we got from the rest of the resort could hardly be improved on! 

This was our first visit to the Caribbean and our first visit to a 5 star resort. We found the people to be friendly and helpful. As someone pointed out, respect the Dominicans and they'll respect you. Several of our party witnessed some irate clients placing blame on hotel staff for situations out of their control. IF that is how you roll, I'm not sure if you'll be satisfied anywhere! 

The buffet was bountiful and delicious, plus they had several fresh stations at every meal where you could get an omelet, steak, etc made to order and that food was stellar. The restaurants were second to none; we had our concierge book several days in advance for dinners and otherwise we just hit the buffet.

The pool was superb, the grounds were well-kept, and the beach was clean and groomed. I got up early most mornings (6 am) and witnessed a lot of groundskeepers at work already. It is worth it to get up and reserve a cabana as most are taken by 8 am. And by reserve, I mean just place your towels on or stay their yourself so it doesn't get taken.

If you go, definitely ask for concierge Edgar Gonzalez. He was our angel!

reviews.author: csilvass
reviews.title: Un lugar fascinante con gente linda. Unas vacaciones maravillosas.
reviews.text: Los días en Punta Cana fueron maravillosos, la playa es una belleza, al igual que las instalaciones del hotel, todo está muy bien diseñado pensando en el huésped, también mención aparte las cenas en los distintos restaurantes temáticos, que a decir verdad, nosotros como peruanos sabemos comer bien pero nuestras felicitaciones por la comida...la langosta en el Gaby Beach espectacular, porque la hemos comido en otra parte del Caribe pero ésta estuvo deliciosa. La atención del personal del hotel muy buena sobre todo del barman de la discoteca, gracias por toda la amabilidad. Lo recomendamos y claro que regresaremos....

reviews.author: goyagirll
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort but Annoying Issues
reviews.text:
We had our destination wedding/honeymoon at Paradisus Palma Real.  When we first entered the lobby, it was magnificent - beautiful set up for the lounge and bar, nice front desk.  They had our names in the system and they knew we were getting married there.  But as I've heard in other reviews, our room was not ready until 3pm.  So be prepared for that.  But they recommended that we have lunch at their Naos buffet Restuarant.

I was really impressed with the food there at the buffet.  They provided both american food (lasagna, burgers, salad) and alot of seafood dishes.  90% of my stay there, I always had the seafood - mussels were always fresh, the shrimp was spotty (some were fresh, some weren't and they do not deshell/devine them) and calamari.  

Our room was everything as expected from the pictures of the website.  4 sections to the room, Bathroom, Bedroom, Livingroom and terrace/balcony.  Everything in our room was clean even though my husband noticed the unkept maintenance of the room (peeling celiing paint, broken molding).  Everyday, there were about 2 power outages that lasted about a minute, lights, AC and fan would turn off and then turn back on again.  For me, it wasn't a huge concern since I spent the entire day at the beach/pool and the outages only lasted 1 minute.  We had hot water (I heard another vacationer complain that there was no hot water in their room) and great AC.  Please note that when you open up the doors to the terrace, it triggers the AC to turn off.  So you can't have both the AC on and the balcony doors open at the same time.  

The beach at Paradisus Palma Real was clean and soft for the most part.  You will see left over cups and cigarette butts left on the beach by midday by the other vacationers.  And the resort cleans up the seaweed every morning and at 5pm, you will see somebody straightening out the chairs.  

One of the annoying issue that I noticed is that the resort has about 5 restaurants that are portrayed as exceptionally fancy.  You will need to make reservations for these restaurants about a day or less in advance.  However, if you are staying in the non-Reserve room (Ocean view or Garden view), they will give you a 9:45pm or 6pm reservation.  They will hoard the in between times for the Reserve patrons even though they may not reserve any seats.  And you will see that the restaurant(s) are extremely empty.  

During our stay, we did eat at Passions Restaurant.  We had a 6pm reservation and of course, the place was 30% full.  The food there was mediocre, nothing to write home about.  I also made a 22 seat welcome dinner at Bana Restaurant for our wedding guests.  When we arrived, they were 6 seats shy from 22 and had to add more tables and chairs.  The food at the restaurant was again, mediocre, I noticed that the same formula for food was used throughout the entire resort - if you ordered a seafood dish, you will get the same items (Mussels, calamari and shrimp) prepared in a different sauce.  I've also noticed that a bug was crawling on the walls to the restaurant.  Thankfully it was towards the end of the night.  

During our initial stay, we were mobbed by the resorts concierge about their time shares, even though they do not state that they are trying to sell you a time share.  They will ask if you have been shown around or have made an appointment to see something (i truly turned them off once I felt the car salemen pitch).  They will promise you Gabi Beach reservations if you swing by their breakfast buffet to hear the time share proposals.  We said yes but we didn't show up.

Another weird thing that happened was that almost everybody in our party became sick all on different days.  My matron of honor got sick on the first 3 days of the vacation, my husband got sick on the 3 - 4th days, and I got sick on the last 2 days of our vacation.  We do not know if it is the food, maybe the ice in the drinks.  But we were all sick from diarrhea and still suffering.  My theory is that maybe they are recycling the grease to cook the food.  I dont know, just odd.  

One of the great things about the resort is that every night, the resort provides a different form of entertainment, from circus theme to folklore dancing.  

So we would definitely come back but not in the near future.  It's a great resort in that it's not a kiddie-college theme resort, it's meant for couples and families that want to enjoy the beach. The resort is extremely quiet by 11pm.

reviews.author: mgonzalez275
reviews.title: The most amazing vacation ever! Don't let the bad reviews change your mind!
reviews.text:
First I have to say that my boyfriend and I were very skeptical of this resort after reading some negative reviews.  But let me tell you first hand, that this was in fact our most amazing and perfect vacation ever.  Without a doubt, hands down.  Do not heistate to book your trip here, we are already planning on our next trip.
First and foremost, I can not fathom how any person could have experienced bad service here.  Amazing client service was the most attractive feature of this resort.  I have never been treated so wonderfully in my life at any vacation destination.  The staff were the nicest group of people I have ever encountered.  Every request was answered with an "at your service"...  and all requests were done accurately, efficiently and with a smile.
We did upgrade to Royal Service, and it was so worth it I couldnt imagine it any other way.  The grounds were beatiful, the rooms were immaculate, the beaches clean and eveything was comfortable.  I did not see a single bug inside any room at the resort.  The maids cleaned the room about 3-4 times a day!  Every time we went in, the beds were made and everything was clean and replenished. One day we came back from dinner to a  surprise... the jacuzzi filled with bubbles and rose petals, chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of champagne - what a life!  At the RS poolside and Royal Service beach the boys Francisco and Francisco were so very warm and helpful.  Getting us drinks nonstop, making sure were were comfortable, setting up our lounge areas before we got there... it was great.  Pure pampered luxury.  Wilkin at the Royal Service bar was so friendly and makes the best drinks ever.  All top shelf liquor.  There is a really nice man who climbs the trees for you and will chop down a coconut. Give it to Wilkin for the best Coco Loco drink in the universe.  
The food was pretty good.  We did not eat at the buffet at all though.  It didnt look too appetizing.  Gabi Beach had excellent food, the surf and turf - scallops and filet were suberb, as well as the lobster tail.  Vento was pretty good, and we had breakfast there everyday.  The "Dominican breakfast" is so delicious.  Tepanyaki was good, you defintely have to try the Salmon - very fresh and flavorful.  At Passion, I recommend the Sea Bass.  So very good!!  I would definitely not describe the food at this resort 'bad' at all.  The presentation was immaculate.  As far as the meats being overcooked and a couple of other bad review topics...  I think some people writing these reviews are not very cultured and adaptable.  You need to ask questions and open your mind.  You are in a different country, things are going to be done differently and for good reason most of the time.  Meats are cooked longer for a good reason.  This is a tropical island, meats do not stay fresh as long in any warm climate.  It is healthier for the meats to be cooked longer, it is a way of the culture there - and in any warm tropical place.  It doesnt mean the meats are bad, but these people are accustomed to doing this because it is the healthiest option.  I suggest you be open minded and not eat a rare steak in any very hot tropical place.  
As far as the coffee criticism... the coffee they serve is pure Dominican coffee.  You are in fact in Dominican Republic, and that is the coffee they drink.  It is a bit thicker, but to me it is delicious with warm milk.  Be open minded, your not going to get Starbucks.   Also you shoudnt get sick here.  They cook only with filtered water, they only serve bottled water, even the ice is made with filtered water.  And not to mention there is bottled water at the sink for you to brush your teeth.  Sometimes new foods might make your stomach upset.  Bring some pepto, you will be fine.
There were complaints about waits, not getting into restaurants, needing to reserve a spot on the beach the day before, arriving to the beach at 6am.... blah blah blah... This is just common sense.  If you travel during a busy season, well yes you will experience these kinds of things, that would be the case ANYWHERE.  I did not travel during busy travel times and did not wait for a single thing, ever.  Again, common sense... if you dont want to experience waits and crowds, call the resort and ask when would be an ideal travel time for you.  You cannot blame these things on the resort not having good service.  Just use common sense.
Some people stated it being annoying to get stopped on the beach by many individuals trying to sell.  This is not something to get annoyed about.  This is the way of life for some people, it is how they make their living.  It is not fair for anyone to truly be annoyed at a man trying to make a simple living.  All you have to do is say 'no thank you' and smile.  None of these people hassled us beyond that.  And honestly, it wouldnt be a bad thing to take a moment and listen.  Not only did we run into a couple of really nice people and got to learn a little of the culture, but we found some AMAZING deals.  We purchased some activities... the same ones the hotel provides, for HALF the price.  No joke.  I have the name and number of a man who helped up set up many activities and we payed hundreds of dollars less than what the activites were priced with the resort.  I can provide this info if anyone needs it.  

All in all this was a great place.  The best vacation we have been on.  Go with an open mind.  Remembering your in another country and some things will be different, and appreciate the culture.  It was beautiful, and the people there were even more beautiful.  I highly recommend this resort.  Go and Have Fun!!!!

reviews.author: ggmcgui
reviews.title: The Review you will want to read if you have small children.
reviews.text:
As a parent, I wished and yet I am grateful for all the parents out there that I didn’t read this kind of review.  We stayed at The Reserve on the week after Easter holiday.   I have also written Paradisus a more detailed letter about this hotel.  Although in my heart,  I don’t think that it will change the general attitude of the staff at this hotel which I will get into later.  Our 4 year old was bitten by an insect during the night;  on day two the nickel sized welt was from wrist to elbow approximately.  Don’t get me wrong here either, our child is a vibrant and cheerful child….her arm was merely an inconvenience to her at this point.  However, we knew that she would require medical attention as she was also developing a rash on other parts of her body.  Now, we contacted our Vacation Concierge and the Reception Desk at the Reserve.  I have to say that it was a challenge to find out where exactly we were to go.  Finally, they told us we needed to go to the Main Hotel. At Main Hotel, we went to the Vacation Concierge to be told  to go to the Reception Desk who told us to go back to the Vacation Concierge Desk again.  Not ONE PERSON at the Main Hotel was concerned that we were asking for Medical Attention or KNEW where it was that we needed to go.  It was readily conveyed to us in a variety of ways that it was a Serious Inconvenience for them to help us.  I cannot tell you how frustrating and infuriating that was for us.  Finally, our vacation concierge randomly walked into the lobby was shocked to still see us and somehow managed to arrange for us to be transported to the neighboring Melia Compound where they have a small medical clinic two hours later!  Our daughter ended up needing to go to the Hospital where she was treated for having an allergic reaction and cellulitis.  To add insult to injury, we received a call the following day questioning on the condition of our child and asking us if there was anything they could do for us.  All I could think was that it was a little too late to be concerned.   In my opinion, a resort cannot fail any worse than this resort did in that respect.  I am only grateful that this was not a truly life threatening ordeal.   The TOTAL LACK of concern on the resorts staff was shocking and shameful from a Leading Hotel of World.  
Clearly, I would not recommend this resort to a person with a medical condition or children.  But, I wouldn’t recommend this resort to anyone based on our experiences outside of the above mentioned.  However, in fairness there are many positive things to point out, too.
The Pro’s:
*Check –in was a breeze.  We were upgraded to a private garden room which was nice and a definite bonus.  Our room was clean, cool and fresh.  The rooms are Huge and nicely decorated.  Though they are showing some wear and tear, but I look at it as they were just coming out of the busiest season, it happens.  
*Food was much better than I was expecting, lots of fresh fruit, seafood and so many different food choices.  Reading some of the review made me very nervous about the food.  
*LOVED the ladies(and gentleman) at the KidsZone!  They are this Resorts shining stars!  
*Beautiful Beaches, there is some seaweed but they take care of it.  
*This resort is beautiful, expansive and impressive.  The grounds are well cared for and the grounds staff is again this resorts shining star.  If they saw a bird, frog or anything interesting they would point it out to our daughter language barrier and all (though we speak/understand some Spanish, I found the accent difficult to sort through).   
*The Spa…a little piece of quite expensive but, oh so well, well, worth it heaven.  
*Housekeeping staff….were so sweet and always made sure we have everything that we needed in our room including extra chocolates for our little one and a nice supply of CocoRico!
	

The Con’s:
*I don’t how to explain this any better than to say plainly-about 80% of the service staff there had a horrible attitude.   The service was BAD to Shockingly BAD overall.  Though, I want to give credit where credit is due.   I wanted the cheerful and friendly Gardeners who always had a smile and a “Buenos Dias” to be our waiter.  Tipping is a waste of money for the most part and thinking back now I wished we had tipped the Gardeners rather than the waiters it would have been more appreciated!
*The Reserve is a distance from the Main Hotel and there are suppose to be golf carts that ferry you between the two Hotels.   I can tell you that we walked more than 50% of time to the main hotel including the above mentioned day.   Yes, that day.  
*Somewhat confusing and difficult to get reservations. 

Restaurants:
*Gabbi Beach:  Wonderful Food and Staff.  	 
*HydroGrill and Bar:  Loved the Staff and Cook at this place.  They are busy and a little slow, but 	they try very hard and they made our daytime at the pool wonderful!  
*Passions:   Wonderful Food and Staff.	
*Market Grill:  Food was very good, but our reservation was at 9:15 and staff seemed ready for us to leave and service was pretty bad. 
*Aqua:  Our worst food experience.  Reservations at 8:15, starters arrived at 10pm.  Our daughter fell asleep on two pulled together chairs her food did not arrive until 10:30, she ordered plain pasta.  
Gabbi Club and Bar:  Service is horrible!  Go to the Main Hotel Buffet for Breakfast and Lunch, the service is better and you have more choices.  
H2o Bar:  What a nice Bartender!
I would not recommend this hotel, but we were very lucky in that we got an incredible deal for our week there, but that was before our unfortunate experience.   Unforgivably Horrible Service is when your hotel is neglectful with the Health of Your Costumers.  There is NO excuse for not having a protocol for ill/injuried costumers and with the number of Staff members we had contact that is absolutely negligent on Paradisus Palma Real’s part.  
If you have any questions please feel free to message me.

reviews.author: twosunbums
reviews.title: Great Vacation...Stay at The Reserve....
reviews.text:
All I can say is....Go...Go...Go.
Do not let the negative reviews drive you away.
Let me start by saying that we are a very well traveled couple and have stayed at many all inclusives throughout the Caribbean and Western Mexico. 
I only recommend staying at The Reserve side of the Paradisus Palma Real. 
It is quiet, clean and the pools are amazing!
A big plus is The Reserve private beach area at Gabi beach...slip Jorge or Jesus a few Washingtons and you will be guaranteed a prime palappa with drink service.
Everyone is wonderful, we could not complain about the service, rooms, food or property.
The staff is warm and friendly and go out of their way for you..tipping helps a bit.
Overall, we enjoyed our weeks stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real and would recommend it highly.

reviews.author: Jennyfer74
reviews.title: Perfect place
reviews.text:
I have to say, I was a little hesitant about staying here after reading some of the reviews on this site. I am very picky and have a little tolerance for bad service. But thankfully my fears were completely unfounded. High standard and good value.
Every request made to the front desk or our group manager was met with a big smile and an "no problemo, ahora mismo" response. I called for various minor things , never had to wait more than 10 minute for "problem" solution.
The rooms were clean and big, with very nice view. I had a view on little pool with flamingo's walking around ,really nice to see.
Use their business center for checking emails instead of the in-room internet service which is cumbersome to use and much more expensive since you have to pay a flat rate for 24 hours vs the business center PC use - you only pay for the time you are on the computer, tickets with minutes that can be used over few days. Telephone rent deal is good, too, cheaper than any deal from hotel and roaming adventures wit overpriced bills.
The pool area is very nice, I had a swim every morning. Hotel has some lovely features , amazing fountains, incredible beautiful beach, with live dj show at the weekend, directly on the beach, ...I didn't even want to leave the hotel at night because of its great restaurants and bars, and Gabi Beach Lounge area is excellent.
didn't speak much Spanish, and there was always someone to help me in English, very nice people and staff. Food was good, breakfast just how I like -  a lot of fruit yogurt, fresh fruit plates, croissants, cereal, honey,etc.
I would definitely stay there again. Slightly priced but compared to other places I think it was worth it.

reviews.author: archiphile
reviews.title: I'm not going to sue but
reviews.text:
We had a below average break at this resort.  We found the food in the buffets average at best.  The restaurants require a reservation an they messed ours up so I'm not that happy with that aspect.

We also intended on Kayaking, and sailing however the red flag (wind) was up for the four days of our trip and we were not allowed out on the water.

The guy at the pool yelling fire water really put the icing on the cake for us, I mean do I really want a shot pool side at 10am?  if so do I really need a guy to scream at me to do it?  and then to imitate as though it is him urinating in my mouth with the bottle?  
The place is a little confused between new age relaxation and DR frat boys gone wild.

reviews.author: Frelys
reviews.title: Dommage
reviews.text:
Nous sommes actuellent au Paradisius " la Reserve " service conciergerie jusqu'au 23 Avril avec ma famma et mon fils
le cadre et les chambres sont magnifiques avec une balneo et un jacuzzi dans notre jardin privé.le service conciergerie presque parfait et sommes tres bien servis. Rien à redire sur l'hotelerie.
Le gros bémol vient de la restauration qui est vraiement indigne d'un hotel de cet categorie.Tres peu de choix dans les plats,à la limite de la fraicheur,carte jamais renouvelée...Les restaurants à themes sont d'une sinistroce....
De plus une tres mauvaise organisation dans les navettes,avons atttendus souvent 15m pour aller à la plage ou pour rentrer de l'hotel à la reserve.Mais le comble est si vous voulez allez à l'entrée de l'hotel pour aller au centre commercial ou à l'autre hotel qui appartient au meme groupe,vous devez prendre un taxi....nul
Le deuxieme jour ,nous avond deposé notre fil de 7 ans au kids club, en le recuperant vers 17h ,il nous a dit etre rester toute la journée devant la tv et les jeux video et qu"il avait vomi,le responsable nous avait maintenu que tout c'etait bien passé.Le soir vers 20h il a était de nouveau malade....Depuis il n'est jamais retouné.

En résumé : un hotel superbe mais dommage pas à la hauteur coté restauration
la direction de l hotel à deja répondu à un internaute sur ce sujet, mais helas n'a fait aucun effort malgré ses dires....   dommage cela pourrait etre un complexe fantastique

reviews.author: Saintsfan777
reviews.title: One of the best vacations ever!
reviews.text:
Let me just say, when I read all the negative reviews on here before I got to the resort, I was really worried! After staying there, I couldn’t figure out what all these people were talking about. This place was AMAZING! We have traveled quite a bit in the Caribbean and this resort has to be my all-time favorite!

Check-In: We had booked a 1 Bedroom Suite in the Reserve section. When we arrived, we were told that we were going to be upgraded to Royal Service due to all of the families in the Reserve section. They wanted to move the couples to a more secluded and private location in the resort away from the families. 

Room: We were upgraded to the Royal Service Garden View room and it was beautiful! These rooms were also extremely close to the private Royal Service beach and pool. All first-class!

Service: Our butler Jefferson was always on top of things. We got to our room at about 4 p.m. and he had already reserved the restaurants for our stay. He would always come by our pool multiple times a day to check and see if we needed anything. It is so nice to make a tee-time for the golf course while still in the pool with your cocktail! The staff at the Royal Service pool and Royal Service beach were out of this world! Francisco #1, Francisco #2, and Wilkin, thank you so much! We were never left with an empty drink.

Food: Overall, we thought the food was very good at  the ala-carte restaurants and the buffet. The only issue that we had was with the steaks. Even if you ordered medium rare, they would still come out medium well. The teppanyaki restaurant did things differently than in the states. They would wait until everything was cooked before they served you your food instead of stages like we see in the states. This meant that our medium rare filet would sit on the grill the entire time everything else was cooked. We loved the Gabi Beach Club restaurant. The HUGE and I mean HUGE lobster tail was delicious! Buffets always had something to our liking and tasted really good.

Golf: The golf course was really nice! Very good condition and had a really good time playing it.

Overall, we had such a good time that we are already booking another trip for August. Would definitely book Royal Service again. We were in our own little paradise and it was fantastic. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: mizzledizzle
reviews.title: Most beautiful trip I've ever experienced in my entire life
reviews.text: GO! There are no doubts, theres sooo many activities. it is true paradise. The Reserve rooms are incredible and better than most 5 stars hotels I've been in. Absolutely gorgeous, I'm going back asap

reviews.author: EyedocNewJersey
reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.text: Our family spent Easter week at Paradisus Palma Real.. The hotel is beautiful, the suite was spacious.  The beach was great for walking but the sea was filled with seaweed making it impossible to swim.  Because the hotel was full, we had problems getting lounges at the beach and pool.  Reluctantly, we set our alarm to get up at 6:30 am to secure a spot for the day.  Reservations for dinner were difficult to get since we could only make the reservation one day in advance.  No matter when I called, 9:00 was the earliest time many nights.  The buffet was our only other choice and the food was mediocre at best.  Activities were very expensive.  Fortunately, the weather was great.  Next vacation we will go back to Aruba.

reviews.author: mandssa
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
This place is gorgeous. The longer you stay the more beautiful details you notice throughout the resort.
Pros: The one bedroom master suite was very spacious. We upgraded as we have two young children and it was well worth the upgrade cost.
The service was fantastic everywhere. Every employee was helpful and friendly.
The grounds are beautiful. We were a 3 min walk to the Reserve (which is where the kids zone is located) and a 3 min walk to the beach. The landscaping was so pretty - each time we walked we would notice a different kind of exotic plant or bird. 
The food: It was mostly good with a large selection. Being American you notice that some of the food is different than at home - which my kids and I loved but my husband was a little more tentative about trying. There were always many options for him though.
The drinks: All top shelf and plentiful. The complementary wines were mostly South American which we enjoyed
The kids club: Our kids loved it and the workers there were fabulous
No mosquitos - well not in the first week of April.
The chairs: I know this sounds nuts but there is a really fun variety of beach/pool chairs - beds with their own palapas, pumkin shaped wicker chairs, swings. There were also lots of built in chairs in the pools and plenty of shaded areas too.
The pools: Were all gorgeous and the water temp was perfectly warm. We have stayed in other caribbean resorts where the pool water was too cold and it was unpleasant to swim.
Distance from airport: It's a quick 20 min cab ride
Cons:
Smoking is allowed. That being said eventhough we did see people smoking we never smelled it as most areas are open air there.
Check in is lengthy and they will try upsell you
There is some seaweed on the beach which they remove every morning. It does tend to come back by later in the afternoon but it didn't bother us and the ocean was still fantastic for swimming.

Tips: There is a b'bque on the beach on Thursday nights which is a must. Bring lots of small bills with you for tipping. It's not expected or necessary to tip but the staff are so nice you will want to. There is nowhere you can get small bills on the resort.

Overall it is an upscale, aesthetically pleasing resort with great service and good food. We would definitely recommend it and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Redstorm54
reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be
reviews.text: Last year my husband and stepdaughter stayed at the Reserve in February 2009.  The resort was amazing.  This year we visited for Easter break and I don't believe the hotel staff was prepared for a very busy week.  We arrived to be told the Reserve room we booked was not available since the hotel was overbooked.  After spending over an hour talking with the front desk a room miracleously opened up.  The waits at the front desk this week for even change were unbearable.  They had a problem with their key system so we were given i kid you know at least  6 keys that did not work within a one day span.  The grounds and facility are still stunning but the service went downhill.  It takes hours before someone comes by the beach or pool to ask if you want a drink.  The service was very disappointing.  Not sure I will be back.

reviews.author: cheenay
reviews.title: 5 Start Hotel but 2 Star Service
reviews.text: When I first checked into the Paradisus Palma Real, I was very excited to stay there.  The grounds were amazing and clean.  After the first night, my bf and I were approached by the security guards and escorted to the front desk like criminals.  It turns out that the front desk did not give us our all-inclusive bracelets.  I assumed that their establishment did not require guests to wear bracelets.  After that embarrassment, they front desk did and said very little to apologize for their mistake.  In the room, the lights had a mind of their own.  Not sure why, but the lights in the room would not turn on/off when we click the switches.  Most times we would have to brush our teeth or go to the bathroom in the dark.  Also there are 5 great restaurants in the place, neither of which we were able to make reservations for because the reservation area did not pick up the phone.  I had to go down the front desk and concierge, hoping they would help me.  No one would.  My bf and I just ended up eating at the same greasy buffet everyday, breakfast, lunch and dinner.  For the amount of money paid at this resort, I expected the service and amenities to be excellent, but it was not.  I would stay here again, but only because i was told it was the best one in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: tffCalgary
reviews.title: Exactly what we were looking for!!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for 7 days in April 2009.  It was without a doubt the best trip we have ever taken.  I highly recommend the "Royal Service" as it made our stay that much more enjoyable.  We had no problem making reservations for dinner and we were able to eat breakfast and lunch in a couple restaurants instead of the buffet everyday.  Buffet food was good but the restaurants (7 in total) were fantastic.  The butler service (ours was Jose) that was part of our package was excellent, not to mention the bar and serving staff in the Royal Service area...Francisco, Galven and Pablo...amazing!  We spent our days by the pool or on the beach and our nights at the Monte Cristo (at the shopping mall on resort property but accessible to those off the resort as well).  The atmosphere was perfect.  Be prepared to bring a partner!  If you are lucky enough to find someone to dance with, as we did, great!  But the locals tend to come with a partner of some sort!  The music alone wasn't enough, you really have to dance!  We got exactly what we were looking for in the Paradisus, a girls week of relaxation and nightlife.  Beach was beautiful...white powder and very clean.  The shows the resort put on at night were excellent.  Completely different than the ones I've seen at resorts in Mexico, well worth seeing.  Fantastic experience.

reviews.author: dal01
reviews.title: Exceeded all expectations - would love to return
reviews.text:
After reading many of the views on Trip Advisor I did not want to build up my expectations too high for my holiday to the Paradisus Palma Real.  I expected poor service, problems at check in, with dinner reservations, average food, problems with the bathroom layout and no service at the pool or beach.  The good reviews on the hotel itself and the sumtuous surroundings convinced me to choose this hotel, but I kept my expectations capped, especially we did not book Royal Service.

Arrival / Check in

When arriving at the hotel we were greeted with a lovely cocktail and checked in without any issues at the main desk.  We had requested a Twin room as we were two friends travelling together, and they had allocated us a double room.  This was no problem to change and another room was made ready in 15 minutes.

In this time we were introduced to a member of the concierge who told us all about the hotel and made a reservation for us for dinner the following night.  It is true that you cannot book a restaurant for the first evening but this gave us chance to try the buffet which we only used this first night.

Room

The room was fantastic.  We booked the garden view room which was fine.  It overlooked the garden and had a view of the see but not a direct view.  It seems that the majority of the rooms overlook the garden and therefore I would go for a garden view room again in the future.  We had a top floor room (ie. starting with a 3) which was great as the ceiling height makes the room feel even larger.  The bathroom is open but with the shutters closed and a strategically placed towel we had no issues at all.  Remember we were 2 friends travelling together and not a couple and we found it fine.  The air conditioning does not go very cold but it was a very nice temperature when set to the lowest level.  The double jacuzzi bath and power shower were both excellent.  We also got a turn down service every night.  Some other reviews said this was hit and miss so perhaps we were just lucky.

Meals / restaurants

I found the food fantastic.  I ate Lobster 3 times during the stay at Passion restaurant twice and the market grill once.  We arranged the restaurants ourselves at the desk in reception and it took no more than 2-3 minutes each time.  You have to book a day in advance but it was very quick to do and you got a reservation slip.  Not once did we ever not get a booking and I would suggest if as other trallers have suggested the concierge made a fuss about getting these reservations for you or saying they are not available then just do it yourself it was really simple.  The restaurantes were better than the buffet for dinner in my opinion and would recomment them all.  The breakfast and lunch buffets were good and there was always something fresh to order if you took the time to wait for it to be cooked.  I always therefore had hot and fresh food so no complaints.  One lunch I had king tiger prawns freshly cooked to order steamed in white wine which were delicious.  In my view the food was way above the standard of normal all inclusive hotels.  

Drinks

These were one of the highlights of the holiday.  All premium drinks were serve in the bars.  My favourite is Aboslut Vodka and it was always available, along with cocktails, and very good wine on the all inclusive list.  Not a plastic cup to be seen the drinks were always served in very nice glasses.  We never felt the need to order a bottle of wine from the paid list.

Tipping

We read the reviews so expected to have to tip at every occassion but this was not the case.  Often the drinks had been serves and the staff would move onto the next person before getting a chance to tip.  Never once did I feel that the staff were lingering for tips quite the opposite.  We did tip but mainly in the evening for the drinks and for dinner but only a few dollars and it was much appreciated but never expected.

Beach

This was fantastic.  There was never a shortage of beds or towels.  You could just pick upt he towels by the Gabi Beach or from the club house which was great.  The beach has a lovely breeze which keeps you nice a cool and plenty of shade from from the sun if needed.

Royal Service

For the question of royal service many people have said that this is a must but in my opinion it is an option but not required to have a great holiday.  We preferred as mentioned to book our own restuarants, but we did have a concierge assigned who would have done this for us even though we were not a royal service.  The reserving of the beds we did not need as there were plenty to choose from that you did not have to reserve.  The Royal Service pool was fairly small and I preferred the larger pool and the beach.  The only things we could not use was the Royal Service lounge which had internet access free but we did not want to use it so was not an issue, and the GABI Beach restaurant.  You can use the bar and the beach but not the restuarant  There were many other restaurantes (too many for a 1 week stay) so this was also not a problem.  If I was to be lucky enough to return to the Palma Real I would have not hessitation in booking a standard garden view suite with no royal service.

Free activities

I can really recommend the horse back riding which was fantastic, and also the catamaran which was a real trhill to be able to try.  Both were free and no request for any money was made.

Other trips.

One of the trips I can highly recommend is the hiring of a speed boat.  You get to drive your own boat to along the coast and stop at a site in the middle of the ocean with a shallow reef and feed the fish and snorkel, and then drive back.  It cost us $80 for 2 people for 2 hours and was well worth the money.

Summary

The hotel was fantastic the architecture and design was jaw dropping, the service was always great the food was unbelievable and whole holiday was a joy from start to finish.

reviews.author: aligon
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text: El año pasado mi marido y yo estuvimos en este hotel durante una semana y nos pareció espectacular. Nos alojamos en el Royal Service y mereció totalmente la pena ya que gustaron mucho las zonas que tenia acondicionadas especialmente para el. Nos encantaron las camas que había en la zona reservada de la playa y alrededor de toda la piscina. La comida y el servicio del Hotel tambien es muy bueno, todavia recordamos a Pedro, el camarero de la playa que nos hizo pasar muy buenos momentos y sentirnos como en casa. En general el hotel es muy recomendable para parejas ya que no tiene mucho jaleo y hace que te puedas sentir muy comodo, ademas tiene algunos paquetes que no suele haber en otros hoteles para que la estancia pueda ser mas romantica como un masaje para parejas en la playa por la noche e incluso un paquete de habitacion romantica con la que puedes hacer que la estancia sea inolvidable. Definitivamente recomiendo este hotel para la gente que quiera pasar unos dias relajado y llevarse un muy buen recuerdo de Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Shareen18
reviews.title: Hammer Hotel
reviews.text:
Ich war mit meinem Cousin und seinen Eltern über Weihnachten da.
Es ist der absolute Hammer! Wenn ich im Lotto gewinne gehe ich nochmals dahin :P
Der einzige Nachteil war, ich war noch nicht 18 ( wäre es 2 wochen später geworden), durfte kein alkohol und konnte nicht in den internen "club", musste aber den selben Preis zahlen wie mein Onkel und meine Tante. Trotzdem ein: WOW!
Ich empfehle es für ein Paar, es ist herrlich romantisch. Bestes Hotel welches ich je war!  sauber, top lage, zimmer sind ein Traum, Service geht nicht besser, Preis: Man gönnt sich ja sonst nichts ;)

reviews.author: cshell25
reviews.title: Paradisdus is indeed "A Real Life Fantasy"
reviews.text:
After deciding on the destination of our April vacation, I spent weeks researching what Punta Cana had to offer in regards to its hotels and resorts.  I must admit that I became so confused after reading all of the reviews for Paradisus Palma Real that seemed to run the spectrum from 'abysmal experience' to 'sheer paradise'.  My husband and I decided, after much deliberation and research,  that we wanted our first all-inclusive vacation to be spent at the PPR.  We were not disappointed at all; the PPR is, as their slogan goes, "A Real Life Fantasy".  We absolutely loved our stay here, and would highly recommend this resort to our friends and family,

My husband and I are frequent travelers, and we have been to many different locations both within the US as well as outside of the US.  We must first share that nowhere have we met such friendly people as in the Dominican Republic.  Each and every employee of the PPR greeted us with a smile and an "Hola!" as we crossed paths, and we were treated like royalty in every restaurant and at every bar within the hotel.  We did not pay extra for The Reserve or for Royal Service.  We chose a "basic" Garden View Suite and, after enjoying our beautiful room for 5 nights, we were pleased that we didn't pay extra for any sort of upgrade in room and/or service.  It simply wasn't needed.  Our concierge greeted us upon check-in and made the first night's dinner reservation for us.  He asked us to come back the next day for the "presentation" discussion, but we did not return to his desk as we both knew that we didn't want to spend hours listening to the time share spiel.  (This was the only common "thread" that seemed to be shared by every single review of the PPR.  It IS true- skip the tour and instead tack on the three hours to your much-deserved vacation.)  Our concierge did not hound us about this.  As a matter of fact, after viewing the menus outside each respective restaurant, we decided to make the reservations ourselves from the phone in our room and didn't see the need to call on our concierge at all.  We just educated ourselves by walking around the hotel, asking questions when needed, and then making informed decisions as to where to eat and when.  We chose Passion and Vento and postively loved both restarurants.  Again, superb service...always with a smile and an eagerness to serve.  It is a benefit to know some basic Spanish, and a few of the waiters and bartenders even provided us with a few mini-lessons on how to speak the language.  We loved their sense of humor and patience!  We so enjoyed getting to know their culture and language.  We feel as if this lended itself to the whole experience of vacationing in the DR.  

I know that there are many poor reviews of the service, hospitality, food, and drinks, insect issues, and "bathroom setup", but we didn't find this at all to be the case.  It wouldn't even be adequate to simply state that we didn't experience these sorts of things at all.  It would be much more appropriate, and accurate, to instead share that Paradisus Palma Real exceeded all of our expectations.  PPR is not only a feast for the eyes, it captured and entertained all of our senses, and it left us yearning to return for more of the same.  Hats off the Palma Real for their top-notch service, attention to every sensory detail, and for the excellent service that always began with a smile.

reviews.author: jalousieNY
reviews.title: Thanks TripAdvisor
reviews.text: We stayed in April 2009.  Before going, I read all the reviews and I have to say, they were true, and helpful!  So I won't repeat things - just offer these tips:  Royal Service is a must.  And if you want an ocean view - be prepared that may be all you get - a view through some trees - if you can, specify ocean FRONT.  I highly recommend the tennis there - it may not be a tennis resort, but there are 5 courts there - all in excellent condition - and an excellent pro - Raymondo!  If you have no one to play with, he will just hit with you at no charge!  They have decent racquets there and are very accommodating.   Another great thing are the bali beds  on the beach - each day (thanks to the beach concierge in Royal Service I think) we had huge comfortable bali beds under a huge umbrella with a table.  All day everyday someone would come by and ask if we wanted more drinks.   And in the morning, they'll make a fresh cup of coffee at the RS pool that you can take with you and walk up and down the beautiful beach.  A real treat!  Other misc. things:  Don't expect real butler service in Royal Service - but you do get good attention simply by having the Royal Service bracelot - and also the cell phone they give you is great because you can call the RS desk and they will help with whatever you need even if you don't have a butler (or can't find them.)  The entertainment was not much - though we all enjoyed the cirque immensely.  Tips help (bring lots of singles).  As for the food, all the reviewers are right - nothing great, though if you eat simply, you will find something, and you won't get sick.  I was worried about the food and water, so I didn't take any risks so I was okay.  I think it's like Mexico - just be careful.  We avoided the tour for the timeshares by saying (thank to another reviewer), don't waste your time, we're not interested because we lost money in the stock market.  And don't expect much with the golf - I was given a set of clubs that was not just old and incomplete, but the "putter" was just a stick - literally!  The men seemed to get better/newer/more complete equipment.  And the course was dry - though parts were nice (interesting birds), but not very impressive.  Also, the snorkeling was disappointing - very few interesting fish and no colorful coral.  There's a sandbar, so maybe that's preventing not just big waves, but interesting fish?    Also, they were having computer problems the whole time we were there, so they kept saying that's why things weren't going smoothly (printing from the computers; reservations, etc.)  All in all, we had fun because we were on vacation with extended family, and it was very relaxing.  I would recommend this if you're set on the DR, but I've never been there before so I don't know how it compares to other places there.

reviews.author: jules11575
reviews.title: Beautiful location, terrible service, nightmare tour
reviews.text:
Our family recently returned from 6day/5night trip to PPR.  This was our third all-inclusive vacation, the others being Beaches Turks & Caicos, and Club Med, FL.  Our three boys are 4, 11, and 16.  We booked our vacation through a travel agent and we had a great vacation, but not because of the resort.  

Our trip started out great- flight was on time, transport was waiting at the airport for us and we had a quick 20 min. trip to the resort.  Upon arrival at the resort, we were amazed with the facilities and location.  The resort itself is very beautiful!  The entrance is one of the most impressive we've ever seen and we were excited to start our vacation.  This is when the service issues began.

We arrived at 2pm, and were told that our rooms were not ready yet, but to check back in an hour.  At 3, we were told it would be another 30 minutes, at 3:30, we met our "concierge" who told us it would only be 20 more minutes.  After 20 min, she said 15, after 15, she said 5, this continued until almost 6pm when we finally got our rooms.  The attendant at the front desk blamed the wait on the fact that we wanted rooms next to eachother, however the resort was only 50% full, and we had made the request two months earlier when we booked the trip!  We can appreciate "island time", but had we known it was going to be 4 hours before we got into our rooms, we would have taken our swimsuits out of our luggage and gone to the pool!  The front desk is NOT very helpful, and you are definitely at a disadvantage if you don't speak Spanish.  We found this throughout the resort.  Luckily, I remembered enough Spanish from High School, and my son knew enough that we were able to communicate our basic needs, but a LOT was lost in translation.

Once we got to our rooms, we were very happy with them.  They are absolutely beautiful and very spacious!  Our only complaint about the rooms is that the bathrooms are separated from the main room only by a set of slatted swinging doors, and the stalls for the shower and toilet have glass doors that are open at the top and bottom, so they might as well have put the toilet right next to the bed!  My husband got very sick one night, and noone got any sleep.  

Which brings us to the food.  The buffet is terrible, and the restaurants are just above that.  Breakfast is the best meal there.  If you're creative, you can survive with the buffet, but it is a lot worse than any all-inclusive we've ever been to.  In both the buffet and the restaurants, meat is left sitting out for long periods of time before it is cooked, and the "salads" are a joke!  This is probably why my husband was so sick.  Throughout our stay, we ended up eating a lot of fruit and eggs and the kids survived on carbs.  

Another point about the food- unless you are staying in the reserve or royal service areas, good luck getting a reservation at one of the restaurants.  You can only book 24 hours in advance, and the popular times are already taken.  Not that it's worth getting too upset over.  The menus never change, and the food is barely above the buffet- the greatest benefit is sitting at a table and getting quicker service.

Many people have mentioned the "tour" issue.   DO NOT TAKE THE TOUR!!!!!!!!!!  When you check in, you are assigned a "concierge".  We thought she was there to make dinner reservations for us and to help with any requests, but really they are just there to talk you into taking the tour of the resort and sitting through a sales presentation.  Our concierge was very persistent, to the point of harassing, and my husband eventually gave in.  We were told it would be 90 min, but it ended up being almost 4 hours!  Our three boys were shuffled from kids zone to computer room to game room while we toured, and our guide wouldn't listen to our concerns.  Initially we were interested in the program, but as the tour continued we grew evermore frustrated until finally we told them we were done and our guide took us back to the sales area.  We asked for a price, and our guide continued to give a sales pitch.  When we told him we were DONE and would get back to him, he brought in his sleazy manager who quoted us 20k less, but told us there were only two opportunities left and we had to decide right away.  We were not about to be pressured into buying, so we walked out.  It was the biggest waste of time, and the people in the sales dept. have no concern for your time or the fact that you are on vacation.  We asked several times during the tour for pricing because we wanted to get back to our vacation and our children, and they didn't listen.  Again, DO NOT TAKE THE TOUR!!!!!!!!

As for other service issues- 
     We were left stranded at the mall for 45min after being told there was a shuttle every 20 minutes.  
     We put our 4-yr-old in the kids program one afternoon, and were told by another mother staying at the resort that she saw the kid's club attendant put our son on a shuttle to the reserve BY HIMSELF because there wasn't enough room for both of them, and the attendant took the next shuttle.  
     There were power outages several times throughout our stay. 
     One of the restaurants required pants- my husband was wearing a nice shirt and khaki shorts, but had to change in order to eat there.  Apparently, they prefer jeans over khaki shorts!
     The chairs at the pool are taken by 7am every morning, and most days noone ends up sitting in the chairs- we ended up taking a lot of chairs that had towels on them after we saw that they were empty the entire morning.

Now, all of that being said, we did have a good vacation.  We spent most of our time in the pool which was great!  The bar there was great, and the weather was beautiful!  We also took a catamaran and peddle boat out a couple of days, played beach volleyball, and met some really nice people.  We played tennis almost every day- it was the best part of the resort!  The tennis faculty are great- just don't play between 11am and 5pm- the sun is brutal!

Overall, the resort was beautiful and we were able to make our own fun and have a great vacation.  I don't know that I'd return to this resort- the whole sales issue was VERY frustrating.  It is a great location, but would benefit from management by a different company that is more interested in customer service!

reviews.author: sarah987
reviews.title: beautiful, but unhappy staff and subpar food
reviews.text: the resort is stunning - incredible landscaping, great beaches, and lots of thought given to the rooms etc. however most staff you meet seem to just hate their jobs. few smile, most clealry don' want to be there, and with a few sentences they'll all start openly complaning about the resort. the food is decent in the reservation-requred restaurants ( system designed to be a touch cumbersome to prevent people from flocking there) and if you haven't thought through what you want to eat and when and planned it for the day it's not at all easy to just grab a sandwich somewhere, grab a coke, etc.

reviews.author: lolongan
reviews.title: Not valued for money
reviews.text:
Although I do not have many things to complain about this resort, at the end of the day I still find that I do not get value for money. While I do pay the same price here at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real as at other 4S or O&O resorts, the overall environmnent, amenities, quality of service and quality of foods are nowhere up to the standard I'm used to at 4S or O&O.
My room, a Family Concierge Suite at the Reserve, is fine and convenient. It has view over the pool area (be aware that The Reserve is an area about 10 to 15 minutes walk from the beach, so do not expect to have ocean view in this part of the resort). I did not know that before arriving and was a little bit disappointed. My room is on the 2nd floor and has a jacuzzi on the balcony, which is a nice thing. Rooms on the ground floor have a "private" garden and direct access to the landscape pool, which is also nice.
The advantage of the Reserve is that this area is less crowded than at the main hotel, so it is much more quiet, even if there are more children. But the disadvantage is that I have to go the main hotel every evening for dinner (while the main hotel has 6 restaurants, The Reserve only has 2 restaurants and they are all closed during my stay). The Kids Zone at The Reserve is quite large and well equiped, with a big splash pool and waterslides for children.
The food is mediocre, lots of unhealthy stuff like hot dogs, fat hamburgers, french fries. Even at the so called "gastronomic" restaurants, the foods are not that good. Mediterranean cuisine does not taste like real mediterranean cuisine, idem for japanese one. And the room service card is reduced to some mere snacks and sandwiches.
Finally, as for the service, it is simply inconsistent. I must say that the staff are all very nice and helpful. But they are difficult to find. During all my stay, I never succeeded to ring neither the reception nor the concierge from my room. No one answered to the phone ! Same at the pool, each time I need something I need to look around and wait for a while before finally finding someone. The "family concierge" formula is a joke. First the concierge is absent when I check-in. Then each time I asked for something, usually half of what I requested was "forgotten". To put it simple, to have or not have a "family concierge" does not make any difference. 
If my stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real had costed me two third of what it costed me, I would be happy. But for what I paid, I am rather disappointed.

reviews.author: brushgrl
reviews.title: Perfect Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Amazing resort,
This was the 4th all inclusive we have been to and we were very impressed.
My husband and I went for our honeymon and decided that we would try the royal service, it was great.
Our butler Carlos reserved Bali beds both on the beach and at the royal serivce pool everyday.  It was well worth spending the extra on rs.  We were told by others that did not purchase the upgrade that the restrictions were horrible.
We were told that the beach was very busy, the pools were noisy and hard to find a seat and that it was difficult to get reservations at passions, which is the best!!!!  restraunt in the resort,
I must say we had no issues, very clean beautiful and great serivce.  My husband was saying to me while doing our tour of the resort with our buttler that he would love a redbull to wake up from the flight, later that evening when we came back form dinner to our room to our surprise the butler had filled our fridge with redbull.
Amazing!!!!
I will go again.  
We are going to the Majestic Elegance in September and we are hoping that is is somewhat comparable to this great resort!

reviews.author: JSRNewYork
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text:
We go away every February with a large extended family group ranging from kids aged 5-12 to grandparents.  This resort was really great, from the beach to the pools and activities, and the many different top quality restaurants offered.  Very friendly and efficient service staff took care of us during our trip.   There were plenty of excursions and activities to take advantage of but other than a snorkeling trip we were very content just to hang out on the beach and relax there or in the pool.  The rooms were large and luxurious, although some may find the open bathroom style a bit unusual.  

You will be assigned a personal representative who will take care of restaurant reservations, etc. for you during your stay.  He will also try and get you interested in learning about the hotel's time share business.  Decline his offers to do so.

My only complaint, and it's not much of one, is that the food at the buffett restaurant was good but not great.  But it is hard to please everyone with a buffett.  

The hotel is so big that there was a large Canadian conference at the hotel (500+ people) and we really didn't feel at all bothered by them.  

Count on the ride to/from the airport taking at least 20-30 minutes, if not more, depending on traffic and whether stops are made at other resorts.

We would happily return to this resort.

reviews.author: ecw9877
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - Terrible Food & Service
reviews.text:
My wife and I took our 2.5 year old son to the PPR the week of April 4 – 11 and stayed in the Reserve section.  While our Family Concierge Master Suite was fantastic – (new, roomy, flat screen TVs, marble, etc.) and the resort grounds were gorgeous, there were several issues with our vacation that I want to make sure all prospective vacationers knew before getting to the DR.

First – the Reserve. About a week before we left for our trip, the PPR moved all “family concierge” people to the Reserve section.  If you plan to stay in the Reserve, know that it is a separate part of the resort, set back from the main pools and beach by a 7-8 minute walk or a 1-2 minute golf cart ride.  Not the biggest deal, but since the Reserve has only been open for 4 months, many people do not know this fact and the website does tell you this.  My son loved the pools and kids area at the Reserve – really meant for families.  Do not stay in the Reserve section if you are a single or traveling with your significant other without kids.  There is no reason to be there.  The spa is new and nice and the grounds are lovely.  The Reserve has one main restaurant – the Gabi – which serves breakfast and dinner and one pool restaurant.  The rooms are the best part of the Reserve. We had a Master Suite with a Jacuzzi on the balcony overlooking the pool.  Tons of room and everything was new and working.  The mini-bar could have used more food, etc., but overall, a great room for a family.  There is one king size bed and two fold-out couches for the kids.  The resort gave us a full size crib for my son which was great.

Second, the PPR is “all-inclusive” as you all know, but unlike other all-inclusives where the food is usually mediocre, the same is not true for PPR.  We ate in every restaurant possible, with the exception of the adults only restaurant, and thought that the food was terrible.  First, there hardly is any food.  You can’t get snacks during the day or get anything to take back to your chair.  Second, the food is just really bad.  Only vacation that I lost weight on.

Third, know your Spanish.  The resort caters to clientele from Spain – which is great, but no one and I mean no one speaks English or even tries to.  It is a bit difficult to even get towels.

Fourth, bring lots of cash.  Again, even though the PPR is all-inclusive, it is unlike other all-inclusive resorts.  Chairs, towels and even drinks are hard to come by without tipping people.  You need to bring lots of cash to use for tips.  Very annoying, but a necessity of staying at the resort.

Overall, I would not go back to the resort because of the issues mentioned above.  We had fantastic weather, a great time, and did not spend a fortune, but I would spend a bit more and go to a better resort.

reviews.author: HopeThisHelps2
reviews.title: Would have upgraded If we had Known
reviews.text:
First let me say that I use trip advisor for nearly all my trips and thank you to all who write these reviews.

All and All a very nice vacation.
