Booked the trip through orbits.com for 6 days 5 nights in a ocean view suite and with air fare and transfers for 2 adults the whole trip came to about $2600 US so I can't complain at all about the price.  After arrival at the airport we had no problem getting quickly though customs and immigration.  There is a $10 entrance fee per person, but this is pretty common for Caribbean travel. We met the tour operator (Coco tours) who we booked for transfers and were taken strait to the resort with no problem. We were actually both surprised at how conservative his driving was. Sometimes during past vacations it has been quite a white knuckle ride. We were told to meet our tour representative the next day for information about our pick-up but skipped this meeting knowing it was going to just be a push for us to sign up for excursions. Check-in was OK the front desk staff spoke english well however it was 3pm and our room was not ready. They did offer us a hospitality suite if we wanted to take a shower or change but we decided to get some lunch. After returning an hour later from lunch we were told it would still be another half hour so it was to the bar for drinks. Finally, around 4:30 we did receive our room and the bellman escorted us.

The room was very nice and looked exactly like the hotel pictured it. we reserved an ocean view, which meant we could easily see the ocean from the room but there was a good amount for landscaping between us and the beach. The room was clean and everything worked well. The only problem we had was shortly after moving in we found a gecko hanging out on the wall. for me this was not a problem, but my girlfriend wasn't too pleased. After a quick hunt on my part, he took a trip to the foliage below. We found the maid service to be excellent. We would leave for the pool or beach in the morning and when we returned in the afternoon everything was clean. Also, after returning from dinner each night the bed was turned down and room tidied up.

The food at the resort was OK. The sushi was good, although a limited selection. Hibachi was not very entertaining, mostly just watching someone cook. This may have been just our particular chef, but looking around nothing too much seemed to be going on at the other tables either. Also the food at hibachi was fairly poor quality. Our favorite restaurant was passion which had great presentation. The service here was lacking as both times we went one of our orders was wrong, but all and all the food here was the best we found. The buffet was not bad, but you do need to be a bit creative. It has everything to but together a good meal, but i found to make a nice salad i had to walk around a lot to find things. Also, if you don't want to wait until half way thought your meal for something to drink other than coffee water or wine, I suggest getting a drink yourself at the bar just outside of the buffet. Even ordering a beer seemed to take quite awhile. On the topic of drinks, this was the best part of their food and beverage service. If you asked for a top shelf liquor they had no problem pouring it for you. The wines were decent. Now if your looking for better wines, than just their house you will have to pay for them, but the house wines are pretty good for what they are. Espresso and other coffee drinks were pretty good. Best place for these we found to be the lobby bar. Again a little creativity on your part goes a long way, because the drink lists at the bars a fairly limited.  

Now on to my one complaint. Before our trip neither my girlfriend or I realized just how much this resort caters to their Reserve and Royal Service (RS) guests at the expense of the others. Dinner reservations are a pain because many of the times are saved for reserve and RS guests. This does have a lot to do with who you speak to, we found while one concierge would say no another would say yes. But don't expect to get the best times for dinner, and reserve early because otherwise they will tell you there is nothing available. Also, much of the beach is saved for these two groups along with much better seating with beach beds and padded chairs. We never had much of a problem with finding chairs on the beach, despite the rampant "chair saving" with towels. To all those who do this, at least use the chairs that you save, there were many chairs that sat empty all day with towels.  If we ever do decide to return to this resort we would definitely book in on of the categories. 

We did find that there was a slight language barrier. Many of the staff spoke limited English and I think much of my low rating on service was because of a lack of understanding. I definitely feel we would have enjoyed our trip more had one of us spoken more Spanish.  

Other amenities/activities were nice we made sushi and watched a painting class. Also there was nightly entertainment and often flea markets (haggling necessary unless you want to pay $100 for a $20-$30 item) Water sports were offered however at times difficult to get. The catamarans had to be reserved a day in advance and the daily snorkeling trip was booked three days out. Of course you could pay for a nicer one if you would like. The beach was nice and kept clean, however in the water there was quite a bit of trash and if you walked beyond the property the trash was washed up on the beach as well. We were not bothered by merchants on the beach, which is nice, however again if you go beyond the property, be prepared to deal with persistent peddlers. 

All together a decent resort, definitely would recommend a Royal Service or Reserve package, but then for the price you could probably find something nicer.

reviews.author: bitkr
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text:
Visually, it is just beautiful.  Would go back in a heart-beat. Great service overall; we stayed at the Reserve which we liked because of the quiet.  Toward the end of the trip, it got a little annoying to have to take a shuttle to the main area for activities or restaurants, but my teenagers didn't mind at all (in fact, when offered a switch to the Main area they didn't want it) and the staff were friendly and shuttles frequent, so it wasn't a big deal.  

Am not a foodie so won't comment on the food except to say my kids had no complaints!  If you want to try out the a la carte restaurants, make sure you do this pretty much asap, otherwise you may get very early (6:30 pm) or late reservations( 9 pm or later).  The pasta was way too al dente in one restaurant, to the point of being raw, but after a couple of days at the buffets or grills, it was definitely pleasant to eat in the restaurants and check out the extra varieties.

There were mosquitos in the bathroom so bring  your bug-spray. And yes, like somebody said earlier, sun-block was 25$ at the resort.

Evening shows were ok, some days better than others, but we didn't mind at all.  The lovely beach and hotel made for the perfect getaway. There are lots of free activities.

Punta Cana airport was too cute. The airport customs check your carry-ons very thoroughly for food etc. but service was efficient.

reviews.author: marquism
reviews.title: Skip the tour - spoil your trip
reviews.text:
We selected the resort on the recommendation of our travel agent, who knew we wanted a long getaway with sand and sea in a secluded all-inclusive package. What we got was a great food, bad vibes vacation, all because we did not take the 90-minute tour/demonstration of the vacation club. We were told our "concierge" would attend to our needs and would get points toward higher recognition if we rated him excellent, especially after a scheduled tour of the facility. When we learned the tour was a solicitation to buy a vacation club home, we were not interested in sitting through a 90-minute presentation and tour - period. 

After that, we hardly saw our "concierge." We were treated like pariahs from then on. We later learned that the staff earned their living off of tips, even though we were told not to tip because the resort was super-inclusive, and our refusal to sit through the presentation meant our concierge would not get paid at all.

The weather was milder than we anticipated, but the resort itself made up for the temperatures. The restaurants were excellent, especially the teppanyaki hibachi grill. The rooms were very generous and just as advertised. The grounds were OK and the overall facility was was we expected from a popular resort. What left us very unsatisfied was the way we were treated after refusing to do the tour. We won't be recommending this resort to our friends and family.

reviews.author: CMSCLS
reviews.title: Nice place, great weather, OK time
reviews.text:
Well...the trip began with a transfer (busride) from the airport.  This was fine and we were told we "had to come to the session the next morning at 10AM to find out about the return transfer to the airport."  We opted not to spend the first morning of our vacation "learning about transfers."  In actuality, we were told by other guests, it was a hard-sell of excursions on the island and that the information about the return transfer could not be obtained until the day before we left from the concierge!

Upon arriving at our hotel, we checked in easily and were then created by our "vacation concierge."  He told us that he was there to make all reservations for us-we just need to call him for anything we wanted.  Great concept!!  The problem began the next morning when he called us to tell us how he wanted to give us our "welcome gift."  When he told him ti bring it to our room he said we had to come down to get it.  We eventually crossed paths with him the next day and we told him we had ten minutes to sit down.  He said we needed much more time to "receive our welcome gift."  This turned out to be a major sell for timeshare or vacation "opportunities."  When we told him we were not interested, he brought over his supervisor who tried to convince us to come for the welcome gift!

Another issue was more interesting.  I opted to play tennis every day--I had the fortune of having a very pleasant and good tennis pro (Raymundo).  When the "vacation concierge" called and found out that I was out playing tennis he asked, a bit indignantly, "how did he get the reservation?"  My wife explained that I simply called!

We wound up changing rooms to The Reserve.  This was a bit more expensive but there was a much nicer, less hinky-tonk feel to it.  True, it was a shot gold cart ride from the beach, but that did not matter much to us.  The room was much nicer, cleaner, newer and better appointed than the room we had (which was nice in itself!)

One of the more irritating things had to do with dinner.  Reservations were required at most of the restaurants and a huge deal was made about getting them-??perhaps driving us to contact our vacation concierge who was looking for a tip for getting us the "impossible reservation" when the hotel was, at best, 50% capacity!  We were told that we could only get late reservations on some nights.  Whenever we walked into the restaurant, it was, at best, half empty!  Not certain if it was the capacity that they could not handle or if it was an image they wanted to create!

In terms of getting chairs, it was pretty easy...however, again, the hotel was only 50% full and I would imagine that this would be a problem if the hotel were busier--in a non-recession environment! :)

The quality of the food ranged--we were warned beforehand that the food was pretty mediocre so we had very low epectations.  For the most part, our expectations were met!  The sushi at Bana was pretty much all rice with touches of fish!  The pasta at Vento was pretty poor!  The lamb chops at Bali Club (not Bali Beach) were excellent and rivaled some really good NYC restaurants.  The salmon and veal chop at Passion were also excellent!  Again, our expectations were low so getting above that bar was easy.  I think that the food could be described as adequate and sometimes surprisingly good.

The drinks were awful!  My wife is in love with Pina Coladas by the pool in the late afternoon.  The Pina Coladas and Frozen Daiquiris was basically a tasteless slushy with some rum/tequilla poured in.  The fetch then from a slushy-type machine (premade) and add the liquor (no mixing done).  The wine was pretty undrinkable (as you might imagine at an all-inclusive.)  Understand, I am not even close to a wine conniseur (?sp?) but I know awful wine from decent wine--this was AWFUL!  We were able to purchase decent wine in restaurants by the bottle.

The service was below that of many other carribean hotels.  It was not easy to get a drink delivered at the pool--again, probably not surprising at an all-inclusive when the incentive is not there!  You could easily walk up to the outdoor bar and get what you want...it is just nice, sometimes, to have poolside service.

The waiters/waitresses in the restaurants were fine..not high level but certainly adequate and in line with the level of food being presented/served.  The presentation of the food at Passion was above that in the other restaurants.  

The maids offered turndwon service on, what seemed, a random basis.  Sometimes they would come, other times not.  Getting extra anything was a bit challenging and needed some persistence (actually LOTS of persistence--eg, washcloth or extra pillow) but the maids were pleasant, if not efficient.  

The electronics (music, internet access and TV) were all above average and are commendable.  Bring your own ethernet wire if you want to connect--no need to pay $12 to rent one there.

The YHI Spa at The Reserve was one of the nicest spas I have been in...ever.  It was beautifully appointed and had a great relaxing feel to it!  The staff was nice and very accommodating.

The air conditioning system in the room was great--especially in the heat of DomRep.  

The check-in staff at The Reserve (place we moved to) were very accommodating and pleasant.  They seemed to be at a different level than those at the main hotel.

All-in-all, a nice vacation.  Not suer I would come back here though.  I did not like the whole "hard sell" feel but I may have been adversely biased by two things early on.  It is a good value though--significantly less than nicer places such as Aruba, St Martin etc.

reviews.author: tsm143
reviews.title: PARADISUS PALMA REAL "THE RESERVE", LOVED IT
reviews.text:
Second visit to the Palma Real resort. Last summer had a fabolous time in the Royal Service of the main Hotel. This time as took our 16 & 17 year old kids with us stayed at "The Reserve", the all new resort with in the Pama real property.

From the moment you arrive you know this will be a great experience. Service is of high quality & everyone goes out of their way to make your stay as pleasent as possible.

We stayed in two swim up suits. The kids in a 1 bedroom suit & us in the 1 bedroom master suit, beinbg both rooms iternally communicated. The rooms are very well appointed, with all you need. Minibar "filled up daily with your choice of drinks", 2 flat screen tv´s with over 75 channels. jacuzzi both in the bathroom as in the terrace "Master suit", & in the terrace "suit". Both rooms had their own garden with two deckchairs & a giant palapa, best of all the garden gives directly onto the pool, small steps take directly into the water from your garden.

The hotel was 85% booked, but never gave the impresion of being crowded. In the pool area always plenty of deckchairs or palapas available "if you did not want to use your private ones.

At " The Reserve", you have a number of palces to eat, all the ones we tried good quality food & as a Reseve guest you have access to all the Palma Real facilities "except Royal service beach". Our choice of places to eat are: Daytime "Market grill down in Palma Real & the pool side snack grill in The Reserve. Night time. BANNA, VENTO, GABI BEACH, TEPANYAKI.

The beach is awesome, over 50km of white sand. The Gabi beach area has plenty of deckchairs & palapas available. From The Reserve to the beach is a short ride with the golf carts, ask the driver for the beach area as they take you right up to the Gabi pool area only meters away from the beach, if not they will take you to the main lobby of the palma real. Bar sevice in the beach is taken care of by a good aiter that will frecuently come & ask you if you want drinks. All water sports "non motorised" are free.

All in all a great experience. Having been to the two more exclusive areas of the Palma Real. I would recommend both without hesitation. If you are travelling with no kids under 18 & you are looking for a relaxed holiday & the bach is your top option, select the Royal Service "Pedro & Ahmed" down at the pool make you feel like Kings/Queens. Rooms not as good do. If you want modern posh facilities, have kids with you the The Reserve.

reviews.author: djkrown
reviews.title: Just Fantastic !!
reviews.text:
Was there March 28-April 4th...stayed at the Reserve, 3rd time in Punta cana and been to many other carribean islands....this Paradisus is truly Paradise !  From the moment you arrive everything is just fabulous, gorgeous rooms, exceptional staff, impeccable service, truly worth the price !  This was a quiet week, no problems of getting chairs anywhere at any time of the day, beach service was great, they aim to please !
The rooms at The Reserve are huge and beautiful, Luis [bell boy manager] , Gustave our concierge, Marguarita at the reception ,were all so pleasant to deal with...there smiles were so contagious!  The a la carte Restaurants, Passions, Vento, Aqua, Gabi Beach, all were above our expectations...the shows at night was so great, very professional and quite the variety !!
We never go to the same place twice, but our opinion has changed after this place !

reviews.author: Mr.L
reviews.title: Great Honeymoon
reviews.text: Was there from March 31 - April 7. This place is beautiful! I have been to many all-inclusive resorts and in my opinion this place was one of the best for food. All-inclusive food is hit or miss for me and i thought this place was good. Pool was very nice and staff was hard working and very polite. Our room was really nice with large 2 person jacuzzi tub. My wife and I are very comfortable with each other so wide open bathroom layout was not a problem at all! My only complaint would be that the place being very "upscale" made it seem a bit stuffy. We met some very cool people but the night life was a little dull. We have fun anywhere so cant complain too much.

reviews.author: jgms4
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - food needs improvement
reviews.text:
Punta Cana Airport - Very efficient and fast upon arrival. beautiful airport. very tropical. we were thru customs, with our luggage and in our taxi in around 20 minutes.

Ride to Resort - many people have mentioned the poverty seen along the ride.  i saw none.  i've seen much worse in other islands.  i was actually impressed with the new construction and clean looking corporations.

The Resort/lobby/checkin:  the first views of the resort are impressive. we were taken to the royal service lobby. Vincent checked us in..very charming and funny. We were given cold moist towels and mimosas. We were assigned what had to be one of the best rooms. ..directly ocean front on the top (third) floor.  we were introduced to our butler, Juan.  he gave us a short tour of the resort, introduced us to Francisco, the Royal Service Bartender and Pedro, who will help you with anything with a huge smile.

Our Room - very nice. high ceilings. clean fresh smell. beautiful view.flat screen TVs (with all major US networks),coffee machine,hair dryer, good toiletries.  There have been some mention of the "weird" setup of the bathroom - it's lack of privacy....well, there is NO problem.  You'd have to peep in thru 1 1/2" slats to peek in the bathroom.  I thought the set up was great because it kept the bathroom free of steam and kept the bathroom cool.  The linens were okay.  our bed was huge. The housekeeping was amazing and discreet - never ONCE did we "run into" them into our room.

The Royal Service - MAY not have been worth the extra money with the exception that it enabled us to get the best room, so to get that view, it's worth it to pay for the Royal Service.

The Pools - very cool and refreshing and numerous.

The Reserve - we visited the new section , the Reserve.  It is about a 1/2 mile up the entrance . it is very beautiful with natural wooden accents. we toured the Spa and it was FAR superior to the spa at the main resort.  very beautiful.  Although i found this section more aesthetically beautiful, i think i'd get tired of all the kids actiivities and going back and forth to the main resort.

Golf - very unorganized.  as mentioned , you MUST get a voucher from the hotel and bring it with you. Shuttles aren't very frequent. The checkin staff at the pro shop wasn't too friendly. there are 3 9 hole courses and the marshalls didn't really keep track of where they were sending people and when we went to one first hole, there were 6 carts waiting to tee off. our first round was almost 6 hours.  the second round we gave up after 5 hours. very frustrating.  nevertheless, the course was nice. 

Food - now to the worst part. this is a very nice resort but the food just does not measure up.  There was so much cheap frozen food, deep fried.  they aren't really big on appetizers.  Although we wouldn't order them, they would give us a plate of "wings"...not sure they were chicken.  Ribs had no meat on them.
the best meals we had were at the Market Grill - creamed corn soup, surf and turf.
Bana Bistro - was the worst. we noticed several people taking a couple bites of their meals and getting up and leaving.  
Room Service - Good pepperoni pizza.
Lunch at Market Grill - bad, only ate lunch once.  Hamburgers looked like hockey pucks.
                                (got ill that night)
Naos - breakfast - okay. suggest getting huge plates of fruit - papaya, mango, pineapple - delicious!

The drinks were excellent.  All top shelf liquors. Try the new Presidente Beer "The One"  - it's good, better than Corona.  Note - we saw NOT ONE Bubba keg.  maybe they are de rigeur at the other resorts but they are nonexistent at Paradisus Palma Real.  Leave them at home.

There were no bugs that we saw. I got no bites....until i got home...then i had a few welts all over my arms....odd.

The Domincan Republic is a very busy, hopping place.  There is alot going on. If that's what you like on vacation then you'll be very happy.  There is great people watching.
There were still alot of conventions going on, which surprised us. 

And finally, DO brush up on your spanish.  it's necessary....right from the start.  Learn some basic phrases that you know you'll need, put them on an index card and use them. The people are very friendly and will appreciate your effort.

reviews.author: Michelle L
reviews.title: Just Short of Excellent
reviews.text:
As my husband and I arrived at the resort after a short ride from the Punta Cana airport for a much needed getaway and wedding anniversary celebration, we were pleasantly surprised by how breath taking the ocean view was from the lobby. We were greeted by our concierge Alberto Ruiz, whose nickname is Alberto Solutions. We were immediately provided with beverages of our choice and were casually walked over to one of the couches to be informed, that our room was not yet available. Alberto was our saving grace. He had the foresight to make dinner resrvations for us, kept his sales pitch about the "reserve" vacation club short, walked us to lunch and afterwards, as our room was still not ready, he provided us with access to the hotels private bathrooms with a changing area. We changed and walked over to the beach for a short while. The hotel is beautifully decorated. It's sophisticated and aims high in terms of service, food and hospitality. However, like any large organization, it has some flaws to work out. 

Positives: 
1. Close to airport (Approx. 20 min.) 2. Restaurants, shows and activities are all very good. 3. Our concierge Alberto Ruiz was incredible. 4. Nestor at Aqua Restaurant at "the reserve"  is the model of service. An excellent waitor. 5. Favorite Restaurants: Passion, Aqua, Seafood at the buffet "Seafood Ceviche and the habachi restaurant. 

Negatives:
1. Our room was not ready upon arrival. Although we realize that check in is at 3pm, flights from NYC arrive in Punta Cana by noon, which means we arrive at the hotel by 12:30. We felt that the hotel should accommodate you upon arrival, specially when they were at less than 50% capacity 2. On our second day, it rained and there was a leak in our room, causing us to change rooms. (An inconvenince after we were all unpacked, but we moved.) The hotel didn't make this change in the system, causing reception to check another couple into our changed room, which caused them to wak right into our room as we were preparing to shower, very unpleasant. 3. The bracelets the hotel makes you wear upon check in should be a thing of the passed. It's annoying. 4. It's very difficult to make dinner reservations on your own and even more difficult to be accommodated should you have and miss your reservation. 5. Should you agree to participate in the vacation club presentation, be ware, it lasts longer than 90 minutes. 6. The spa is very good and treatments come with use of the water center which is great. 7. The disco is very nice!

reviews.author: cathym112
reviews.title: Not bad but could have been better
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 6 nights and 7 days.  The positive is the location and the beaches.  Just beautiful.  When we got to the hotel, we upgraded to the Royal Service which was not worth the extra money.  It completely depends on what Butler you get.  the "Sweet Caroline" couple ranted and raved about their Butler Maria and Francis.  We often saw Maria checking up on the couple and making sure her birthday was everything it should be.  However, we had a different experience.  Our Butler forgot to make dinner reservations for us, forgot to stock our minibar with our requested beverages and was pretty much nonexistant.  We ended up making our own dinner reservations, outside activities, and pool reservations.  The negative is the food.  Its terrible.

reviews.author: lsanche3
reviews.title: Would stay here again!
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from a 4 night stay at Paradisus Palma Real.  We both loved the time spent there and would go back.  From the minute we stepped foot on the resort to the minute we left everyone was very friendly, helpful, and courteous.  Our room was cleaned thoroughly everyday.  The resort itself is beautiful.  Only thing we were some what disappointed with was the food.  It wasn't awful but it could have been better for this type of resort.

reviews.author: newyorktravlr
reviews.title: Loved It!
reviews.text: My hubby and I visited for 5 nights from March 25-March 30.  We stayed in a  Royal Service oceanview room.  As soon as we got off the shuttle at the hotel, someone from Royal service met us to take us over to check-in and our butler Francis was standing by to take us over to our room.  Within minutes of sitting down to check in with the clerk across the desk, we were served mimosas (which were great).  Check in took less than 10 minutes.  Francis then walked us over to Royal Service giving us a tour of the grounds as we made our way there.  When we arrived at the Royal Service pool, Francis introduced us to probably the next most important person at the resort - the beach bartender Francisco, who immediately poured me a shot of "mama huana" and gave my hubby a corona.  Needless to say, the service was perfectly executed and actually things just got better from there.  The drinks were plentiful - Francisco was great -from his espresso and iced coffee with bailey and amaretto mixture in the mornings to the mixed drinks later on.  We did not have to ask for top shelf liquor at the Royal Service Bar.  Francisco mixed drinks with top shelf as a matter of course and when he learned that my husband liked Coronas he made sure to stock the bar with them everyday.  Maria, who was our butler in the evening literally attending to every detail.  The service was great.  Once we were locked out of our room and  we saw one of the maids actually running to our room to open the door for us.  The resort is truly more beautiful in person than it is in the pictures and we were very very pleased with everything.  We also met a number of other very friendly couples from the U.S. there - you know who you are "Randy and company" - and that just made our stay all the more better -the non-Americans didn't seem to really get "Sweet Caroline" during karaoke night. lol.  We were thoroughly pleased and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: RoadtoHappy
reviews.title: Want for Nothing just KNOW how to Ask!
reviews.text:
Ole!  This is the first time I have written a review with Trip Advisor, however, I felt that as I have read other's, it was only fair that I submit.  This resort lived up to its expectations and beyond!  I'll take in order of events:
CHECK-IN:  Was fairly quick...a bit of a mix-up as we requested 3 rooms in the same block (block is different than building).  Several blocks to a building.  Good to know.  However, they brought us champagne while we were sorting it out and they were pleasant and eager to please.  I think it helped that we spoke a few words in spanish and laughed at how awful we were...they seemed to find that charming!
ROOM:  Getting there was fun in the little carts, the porters were friendly and helpful..yes, we gave a small tip, but why wouldn't you?  We had a standard room, but truly it was beautiful and the view was breathtaking as we were in a corner style unit and had a view of the ocean and central gardens.  It was clean all the time, only had one day where they did not come until late in the day...and a few times they did not turn down the bed at night...was this a big deal...no..as Room SERVICE was quite excellent!  Had a sunburn day and decided to stay indoors, ordered room service and they brought within 20 to 25 minutes...only one day when it was 90 minutes and that is because it rained in the morning and everyone in the resort ordered room service at the same time...you sometimes have to be patient.
POOLSIDE:  The pool does indeed need its own zipcode it is so huge.  LOVED the beds in the water, sun and shade options.  A special hug and thanks to Bianca, Damien and Yani...for exceptional service around the pool...and yes,  during the conference busy times, you waited longer...relax, you are on vacation...if you are THAT thirsty, go up to the bar...if you go down and meet any of them, say Hi from Mindy, from the wedding party and the stainless steel insulated mugs...EVERYONE wanted one, suggest you take one...as keeps the drinks cold and icy...easy to pack.
BALI BEDS:  OK folks, its true!  These are the MOST coveted items on the resort...no question!  When you do get one, you WANT one ever after...the loungers are plentiful and everywhere, both sun and shade, but there is no doubt that I felt like the Queen in her castle observing her domaine, especially when Bianca came by to serve me my drink.  I managed to get a bali bed twice in the week...and that was because my husband got up to golf at 6:00 am wakeup, so I wandered out with my beach bag, towels (bring my own) and other 'stuff'...BUT, I spent the DAY in my bali bed, from pool to bed and had visitors all day long...I made TOTAL use of my time...I understand the frustration of others, who put down their 'stuff'...and don't show up all day until around 4:00 pm..that is definitely rude, but people are people and some are rude!
BEACH:  The beach is a lovely white sand, almost like flour on your feet...no question, that the Paradisius Palma Real has one of the BEST locations on the curve...and yes people, it has seaweed...after all, this is THE sea...please...if you don't like the feel on your feet...wear water shoes, or use a tube like we did...it wasn't horrible, it just took getting use to...I can tell EVERY DAY, they were bagging seaweed on the beach in the early morning..
FOOD:  Overall, very well done!  Here were our favourites...and again, it is a matter of preference, tastebuds and choices...there is definitely something for everyone.  First....BOOK your restaurants as many as you can as far in advance as you can...standard operating resort procedures...get over it...unless you do ROYAL SERVICE, and yes, some of my family members did it and LOVED it...said well worth the price, and their butler was fabulous!, YOU are responsible for booking the restaurants....VENTO's yummy italian...well done on presentation, services, had the duck...pretty good, beef, fantastic!  Soups, salads, and the trio of pasta...outstanding...standard red wines are just OK...Freixenet Champage...pretty darn good...order from the 'pay' side if you want good wine...martini bar is fabulous inbetween vento's and passions...OK...PASSIONS...not my thing...14 of us went and NONE of use liked the concept, the food choices...it may have 'looked pretty'...but it still tasted awful...except for the red pepper soup...we all loved, however, you only got 2 tablespoons..it has become the laugh of the trip, whenever we talk about food we don't like how it compared to Passions...Asian Fusion and the Tapanyaki Japanese was in a word EXCELLENT!  the food was cooked in front and tasted delicious..personal favourites...all agree...the scallops, shrimp and salmon...depending on the chef, beef came in a bit overdone...but, it happens...Market Grill (restaurant by the beach)...oh Gosh...Surf & Turf...to die for...melted in our mouths!  Service was quite good at every restaurant...OK...the main Buffet...I liked that although the tables were outside, the food items were inside an air-conditioned premise with sliding doors...again...something for everyone...this housed the breakfast (great omelettes & fresh squeezed OJ) until 11:00 am...shut down and re-opened at 12:30pm for lunch (homemade thincrust pizzas were delicious!)...dinner at 6:00 pm had a theme every day....only ate once, as I totally enjoyed the others...so, can't speak...oh yes, did a room service for dinner one night...simple...Soup and Chicken Ceasar salad...great salad, as they brought everything separate and you mixed it how you liked it yourself...
ENTERTAINMENT:  I would say this was Good...NOT great!...but getting better all the time from what I heard from some timeshare vacationers....they had a show EVERY night...it just depended on your tastes...we love live music and are used to trios bands coming around while you eat....this only happened once to us...however, I understand, they did so more frequent at the outdoor buffet area...we loved the 80's night...we loved the mexican live music night...they had a mid-week buffet with circ de solei type of deal...it was great...the disco is not!  Unless you are with a group...maybe you like it, but not our thing...we requested songs...but nothing ever came of it, so don't waste your time...the Casino is small but fun!  Some of us actually won money ($150) or thereabouts. 
DRINKS:  If this is important, no worries, you want Grand Marnier...you got it!  You want CC with coke, you got it!  You want single malt scotch..no worries...in the MAIN bars, you got the top notch..the only exception is the pool bars...I think this is to slow you down (smile!)....but, when I ordered room service, I told them what I wanted and they brought it...
TIPPING:  Your choice, but let me tell you a dollar here or a dollar there...and learning a couple of phrases like:  "No hable español, sólo unas palabras, Perdón"  meaning:  I don’t speak Spanish, just a few words, I’m sorry and then Usted tiene un país hermoso - or you have a beautiful country "...went a long way to endearing you to the Dominican people.  It's not hard to be friendly and yes, sometimes you may have a bit of a language barrier...relax...you ARE in THEIR country...expect some issues...
OK...One final thing...A vacation is what YOU make of it..if you are negative and picky...then geesh...you probably won't have as good a time!  Whereas if you relax, be open minded and friendly...well..you get the picture!...you just have to go and try it yourself...Adiós mis amigos (Goodbye my friends)

reviews.author: ALANSTRIPS
reviews.title: loved palma real
reviews.text: We just came back from the BEST vacation of our lives. We travel a lot and this was the very nicest vacation we have ever had. The service was amazing, the hotel and grounds the cleanest we have ever seen and with the exception of one meal the food was great. The Japanese restaurent was beautiful but the food was over salted and over cooked.  The rest of the meals were magnificent. The rooms were fine and the jacuzi tub a joy. Masage and game room great and the beach just spectacular. Can't say enough about how well we were treated. The "all inclusive" plan was perfect..the first time we have ever really seen it work as advertised. We will go back very soon,, just bring lots of dollar bills to spread around and you willl get everything you want.  Try the Gabi restaurent and ask for Fabian,, amazing waiter,Vento is also excellent. Breakfast was always good and the coffee super. Room Service should be avoided. make your reservations when you arrive and remmember to reserve a palapra right away for the stay..you will have to renew the request daily but a dollar takes care of it. Drink lots of water it is a thirsty place and the fish are very fresh.

reviews.author: angel73178
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 7 night stay, and let me just start off by saying this resort is even more beautiful than the pictures!
From the moment we arrived on Sunday evening we checked in and they offered us a welcome drink, check in took about 10mins and we were escorted to our room.  We also brought our 17month old and when we arrived in our room there was a crib allready there, the room was really nice with a huge jacuzzie and sitting area, we where in the tower next to royal service.  The first night we arrived we could not get a reservation for dinner so we went to the buffet.  The buffet is just OK, tons of food, something for just about anyone, our baby was very happy with everything there..lol
The pool is awesome very big and has a great swimup bar and the bartenders are so cool.  FYI if you want a bali bed by the pool you have to wake up very early!!  I didnt really learn till the third day when i woke up at 5:00am to reserve one!! (ITS WORTH WAKING UP TRUST ME)  oh and if you like the gym here is a tip the gym opens at 7am and is very crowded till 1100am, I wake up early anyways so i tried my room key at 6am and it had opened the gym door, so if you feel like going early and beating the crowd use your room key and turn the lights on and workout!
The ocean was filled with allot of seaweed they cleaned every day but i guess its that time of year?
OK THE FOOD....never had a problem getting a reservation!
BANA BISTRO good appertizers but thats it.
Japanese Grill AWESOME and allot of fun!! we went there twice
Market grill: Great steaks and great Lunch!!
Vento: very good food and Great service! (tip: we tipped very well and they told us we didnt need a reservation for the next evening!)
Tip...take the desserts from the buffet after dinner and walk over to the coffee bar and have a mocha!
Overall the food was great, it could be better but thats because we are used to eating the best in the states!  oh and forget the mall outside the resort its very expensive and not worth it trust me we wasted two hours of a sunny day there!  this resort was great!! If you have any questions email me!

reviews.author: newlywedinparadise
reviews.title: It was Paradise!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus for our honeymoon.  It was AMAZING!  We found a timeshare offer to stay here and we weren't sure what to expect.  The meeting didn't take a minute over 90 min (as promised)....they did pressure quite a bit, but that's to be expected.  Even my husband who was very scepticle about us having to go to the presentation said it was worth it.

We stayed 6 days, 5 nights and every day was another day in paradise.  They kept saying they were going to switch our rooms or do something special because it was our honeymoon and never did, but both my husband and I agreed that it didn't matter because even our regular room was beautiful.

Our Room:

*Flat screen TV 
*Nice view (you could see the water from the corner of our balcony, but it was not an ocean view room)
*Lounge area and Table
*Beautiful Draped Island Canopy style Bed
*Large Jacuzzi Tub (big enough for 2 with room to spare)
*Multi head shower

Restaurants: 

*Passion - this was our favorite because it was very intimate and romantic.  No children and exceptional service and food.

*Tampankayi - Fun, great food, good entertainment, and a good way to meet others.

*Sushi - Good Sushi

*Market Grill - Wonderful Steak and Lobster!!!  It was very good.

*Breakfast and Lunch Buffet - Very good food for a buffet, I couldn't have been happier.  There was an assortment of fruits, veggies, cheeses, salads, soups, appetizers, sides, steak, seafood, and much for ....and all for lunch.

Entertainment:
We watched a hispanic show and it was ok, but we didn't go to any other entertainment shows.

Sports:

We booked a sailing trip and it was very nice and worth the $35/person....very reasonable for 1.5 hrs. And we saw lots of neat fish.

we tried windsurfing but it was too windy, not possible.

Catamaran- very nice and peaceful out on the water, the only thing that wasn't nice was that they sent us with a spanish only speaking teacher for our instructional class.....we couldn't understand anything, and tried sign language...lol.. :) -we figured it out though.

IN ALL:

Our room was beautiful, nice, and romantic.  The drinks were very good and free!!  The beach was beautiful, and you only have to take a stroll down the beach to find a handfull of huts with souvenirs.  We never left the resort and didn't regret it!!!  Everyone treated us wonderfully and we could not have been happier!!!  It was a perfect honeymoon!  IT IS AS BEAUTIFUL AS THE WEBSITE SHOWS IT TO BE!!

Another add on:  The hotel has a team of professional photographers found downstairs at a desk across from the activites desk.  We booked a photo session.  He took us to about 10 different locations around the hotel and took about 250 photos.  There is no sitting fee and you just go back to the desk when they are ready, view them, pic your favorites, or all and they are $8/ picture...they even gave me a free CD of the ones I paid for so I could bring them home and make more copies.  It was wonderful because now we have beautiful, professional pictures to remember our honeymoon! :)

I would recommend this hotel to anyone.  If you aren't happier here ....then you are probably the type of person that would not be happier anywhere!!! 

Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions.  

Adrien

reviews.author: mlp2007
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 3 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  Like another reviewer, we did have some problems with our check in that took 3 HOURS to resolve.  That said, once we did get our room straightened out, we had a fabulous stay.  The resort is absolutely beautiful, the staff is very friendly and the beach is beautiful.  

The beach was full of seaweed right in front of our hotel, so we walked a little bit down the beach to a cleaner part and went swimming there.  The water was beautiful, just wish is was as seaweed free in front of the Paradisus.

The pool and swim up bar is great - the pool is absolutely huge and never felt crowded.  The hotel was full and we never noticed any part of the resort being full or crowded.  It is a very large resort and the garden areas are beautiful.

That said, a few negatives:

1.  They really push the vacation club sales and continue to pursue you all the way through your visit.  They aren't unfriendly about it, but they definitely are aggressive in their sales pitch.

2.  The "adults only" restaurant, Passion, is a definite must be missed.  The menu was limited and odd - we thought the Gabi Beach restaurant, only available to vacation club members and Royal Service Guests, was the best.

3.  The spa is expensive!!! The massages were great, we had them outdoors, but a pedicure for $78??? That's ridiculous.

All in all, a great trip.  We went kid free for a little R & R, but it definitely would be a great family or couple vacation spot.  We would go back.

reviews.author: daiz222
reviews.title: Nothing But Problems
reviews.text: My husband and I went with another couple in June 07. We had nothing but problems since the day we arrived. Our rooms were not ready when we got there. They tried to give us a room with double beds and offered to "push them together". Anyone who has ever slept like that knows how uncomfortable that is. With the amount of money we were paying for this trip it was totally unacceptable. They tried to tell us that they do not guarantee king beds. Ha! After endless fighting with management we got a room with a king bed. We opted for the royal service...what a SCAM! The "personal butler" that you are supposed to be assigned is NEVER around and your lucky if you get something that you request 2 days later! It was such a waste of money since all the things that he supposedly could provide are easier to get yourself! We travel to Mexico quite a bit and this was our first time in the DR. We found it highly lacking as far as service and hospitality goes. Most of the staff barely speaks English (or maybe they pretend not to when you have a request or complaint!) We are reasonable people, we just expect a certain calibur of service when paying so much for it. We tried to go parasailing and had to wait an hour on a boat for them to come and refuel. Then, after three days, they had us checking out even though we were booked for five days! I showed them the confirmation given to us by the travel agent but they still tried to get us to change rooms! The whole resort is very poorly run and very disorganized. The restaurants were above average... I have to give it that. We also loved Neftale, an amazing bartender. The casino was a good place to go at night since there is absolutely nothing else to do. It just seemed like everyone else that we met at the resort was from NY or NJ. I love my hometown but I went to the DR to get away from it for a week. The pool was overrun by loud drunk brooklynites during the day which is why we opted to stay in the private pool area most of the time that only Royal Service guests had access to. Next time we will just go back to Mexico where the service is outstanding and they aim to please.

reviews.author: Roccochomp
reviews.title: Very Good All Inclusive
reviews.text:
We just returned from 6 nights at the Paradisus Palma Real. Overall, they do a very nice job and I would recommend this hotel. We had a Family Concierge Suite with the corresponding service. Our concierge, Oliver, was world class and made our trip. He arranged everything for us - our daily reserved palapa, activities, meals, special turndown treatments in the room, gifts for the kids, jacuzzi for the kids - far and away outstanding. The entire Family Concierge concept and execution is very good.

The resort is beautiful. Beach area is nice, but lots of seaweed. Restaurants are okay. Vento was the best in our opinion. The sushi and teppanyaki are quite poor. Gabi Beach is terrific, and limited access - so book the FC or Royal Service and eat over there. By far, the best on property. Buffet quite good, as was market grill.

Staff is overwhelmingly friendly and go out of their way. We tipped at most every occasion, and it was evident in our service. Even a little goes a long way.

The only downsides to the trip were the A) Large Convention Groups, and B) The terrible Sol Melia Vacation Club salesmen everywhere.

The convention groups are loud, boisterous, and hold nothing back on the "all inclusive" concept. Hammered execs on company junket with unlimited booze - not pretty. Lots of strawberry daiquiris in the pool water by the swim up bar.

The Sol Melia Vacation Club staff should be sent away. They are rude, in your face, and downright harrassing. They position their desk as "vacation concierge" so you will stop by thinking they are the true "concierge", but all they want is 2 hours of your time and your money. 

Hey, I paid a lot of money for this vacation. I dont want these guys hammering me for a sales pitch. Sol Melia should be ashamed. They should take page from Ritz Carlton or Four Seasons Residence Clubs. People will come if they want to buy - quality sells itself. You dont need hard sell.

Watch the Haitians on the beach.....they're aggressive and hit you up at every chance they can.

Overall a very nice visit....we would go back. But only if Oliver is there!

reviews.author: majuValencia
reviews.title: El hotel...espectacular. Con Pedro al servicio del SR, INMEJORABLE!
reviews.text:
Hola lectores/as de esta página. Dedico un poco de mi tiempo, a trasmitiros mi gratificante experiencia en este hotel, el Paradisus Palma Real en RD. 

El hotel en sí, no puede ser mejor. Mejor en cuanto a calidad, belleza y trato. Es una pasada de hotel. Mi marido y yo, estubimos alli para celebrar nuestra luna de miel la primera semana de Agosto de 2007 y jamás nos arrepentiremos de haber elegido este hotel entre tantos y tantos otros. Tengo que decir, que nostrs estubimos en Servicio Real, pero aún así, la gente que no lo estaba, estaba igualmente bien, o al menos eso nos parecía. 

Supongo que podemos tener diferentes gustos, en cuanto a belleza del hotel, pero estoy segura, que coicidimos con el resto de huespedes, en el trato del servicio y como no, de las comidas!!. El mejor restaurante, el Gabi Beach i el mejor asistente , PEDRO. No tenemos palabras, es trabajador como nadie, bueno como nadie y honesto como nadie. No podiamos pasar por alto,el buen trato y el buen recuerdo que nos trajimos a España de Pedro.

Contratamos excursiones en el hotel, todo estupendamente. Comimos en casi todos los restaurantes, bares y buffets y todo buenisimooooo. La habitacion con un jacuzzi doble, una cama grande y comodisima, unos jardines, unas piscinas, etc. buff...me encanto.

En fin, no me enrrollo más. Solo animaros porque jamas os vais a arrepentir. ( y para los malpensados, no cobramos comision, pero moralmente, el hotel en general se lo merece y como no, en especial todos aquellos con los que tubimos trato, como es el caso de Pedro, en Servicio Real).

Pedro, no cambies nunca. Los señores cordero, desde España, te recuerdan.Besos.

reviews.author: Bob074
reviews.title: First and Last Time
reviews.text:
We travel to the Carribean almost yearly and chose this resort based upon our online research.  

Although the facility is beautiful, the food sligthly above average for an all-inclusive, and the stafff is very friendly, the resort is poorly run and not deserving of the 5 star rating.  Our experience was negatively impacted by the management's inability to address problems.  During our stay our ocean front room reservation had no view and was actually located in the farthest building from the ocean.   The beach was strewn with seaweed and any trip into the water necessitated a shower to rinse the seaweed off one's body.  The electricity didn't work in one of our our rooms and took 7 calls, two visits to the front desk and over 2 hours to have someone respond.   Some of the advertised restaurants were never opened during our entire stay.  Others had no available reservations the entire week.   Several other amenities advertised were no where to be found.  Management was very adept at pleasantly apologizing and sidestepping issues without any effective resolution.  Too expensive for one disappointment after another.  Certainly not worth a return visit based upon our experience.

Too many other great options for an island getaway to go through this aggravation again!

reviews.author: Danielle56
reviews.title: Excellent et magnifique hôtel
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé 2 semaines dans cet hôtel, et vraiment rien à redire : très bien entretenu, végétation luxuriante.
Le personnel est souriant et aimable et fait des efforts pour comprendre et parler  le français.
La nourriture est de qualité, abondante et variée.
La seule difficulté est de réserver les restaurants à une heure raisonnable, le Royal Service ayant priorité semble-t-il ...
C'est  un véritable "tout compris" y compris alcools internationaux.
La plage est agréable et propre, les algues sont ramassées tous les matins très tôt.
Par contre, difficulté de trouver des transats libres même à 9 h du matin !
Hôtel à très forte présence américaine.
Hôtel cher mais à conseiller pour sa beauté, sa tranquilité etc.....

reviews.author: gordochop30inch
reviews.title: The best vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
This place is top notch! At first I was a little skeptical because of the reviews but was I proved wrong upon arrival. I think if your mean and snotty then you will have a bad time! The staff was excellent and very friendly. The food was great for an all inclusive resort far above average. The restaurants Bana, Vento, Passion, and The Market Grill are fantastic! The reservation system is a little annoying but when your in the restaurant to see the volume of people you will understand why the reservation system is mandatory. Best advise is as soon as you get to the resort call reservations and reserve the restaurants ahead of time! I don't know what these people that had a horrible time were doing but it's very hard to make these people upset! Tipping is always a good thing! The bars are fun ( Look for Carlos @ the pool bar he makes awesome drinks for the females) Top shelf liquor is always available-Hieneken-El Presednte-No Captain Morgan! When we got there we checked in to our room and it wasn't ready yet-no biggie-we waited and then the front desk called and told us to come down to the front desk. We got to the front desk and they apologized deeply for something so small but then they upgraded us to a Master's Suite. This room was HUGE!! It had like 4 rooms in it and a full sized kitchen.The bed is a high quality memory foam very comfortable.  We had a little frog in our room the first night but I had left the door open but remember this place has alot of nature around it. The in room safe is very handy and gives peace of mind. Over all go with good intentions and you will have a great time. We also did the speedboats which were hella-fun!! It was $138 usd for 2 people for 2 hours which included snorkeling excellent excursion. Horseback riding is included but book as soon as you get there just like the restaurants. Breakfast buffet is the best in the world to much to list including 3 omlette stations, fresh fruit, and unlimited bacon and sausage. If you like to eat  you will have fun here! There are 2     
-32 inch lcd  wall mounted televisions with dish network. Room service was very responsive and good fast food. Did not get encountered by any body trying to sell me time shares. I have already made reservations to go back in 2008 and staying in a Master's Suite! Over all this resort exemplified my expectations and I was blown away from the courteous staff. Understand you are in a Spanish speaking country do no expect perfect english language but they try extremely hard to please and serve you. P.S. They tell you not to drink the water so don't but makes you wonder about the ice in the drinks? Well I consumed the cocktails with ice with no problems! The beach is powder soft sand with beautiful blue water. A little seaweed but hey thats nature people! They do a very good job a keeping it maintained as well as the grounds are impeccable! 110% satisfied!!

reviews.author: ChicaWoo
reviews.title: Property was beautiful but the service was AWFUL!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a 7 day stay at Palma Real (04/14-04/20) and were disappointed in our experience there.  When we arrived and saw the beautiful property we thought that we would have a wonderful relaxing time.  The place really is gorgeous BUT the service was terrible...  We purchased the Royal Service and had a very nice Ocean Front Jacuzzi suite.  Our first problem began when I had to contact the Royal Service lounge 3 different times during our stay because our room was NOT cleaned by the end of the day.  We were out of the room by 9 am each morning and when we returned at 3:30 - 4:00pm the room had not been touched.  
The restaurants and bars did not seem to have enough staff to accomodate the amount of people at the resort.  There was only one bartender at the outside beach/pool bars and it took forever to just get a bottle of water let alone a beer or frozen drink.  One waiter for the beach - IF they came over to ask if you wanted something it would be a long time before you would see them again.  I believe now that the reason for such short staff is there was at least one to two weddings per day and they pulled staff away to accomodate that.  If that's the case they should really think about how this will hurt their business in the future.  They need more people to keep up with the demand.
The food was "okay" - nothing spectacular.  The best dinner we had was at "Passions" - lobster.  I highly recommend it.  Lunch was hit or miss with the buffet selections and you were definitely "own your own if you needed a drink"... 
Unfortunately we will not be recommending Paradisus Palma Real to anyone due to our experience there.  We were very dissapointed and will not be going back.  Maybe we just went on a bad week (busy with weddings) because we met quite a few other travelers there and they were having similar issues.  We knew then we were NOT ALONE !!!

reviews.author: caroleColorado
reviews.title: great if you speak spanish and don't mind mediocre food
reviews.text:
We upgraded to the Royal Service which provides access to a private beach area and private pool, breakfast and lunch at a specific restaurant, a private lounge for check-in/check-out, 24 hours food and a "butler" to be available to help out. The upgrade cost a lot and I'm not so sure it was totally worth it. Our butler disappeared after the first few hours and wasn't totally helpful. The food, at all but one restaurant, was mediocre at best, and hardly anyone spoke or understood English very well even though they pretended to (they said yes to all requests and then never carried through!) now i know that we were in a foreign country, but this resort caters to americans and you would expect that their employees, especially the ones associated with the royal service, would speak english or at least let on when they didn't understand...
overall, the place is just beautiful and we had a wonderful time. Our room was wonderfully appointed, once we got the phone, closet door, safe and shower in working order (it took 2 days to get it all done)and everyone was friendly and helpful, but for the $$$$ I would have expected better food and more competent staff.

reviews.author: trip602
reviews.title: Loved it!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying here over Easter.  We have been to St. Lucia..Sandals all three, Aruba Wyndham all inclusive plan, Jamaica Grand Lido Negril and Grand Lida Braco, Riviera M. Mexica Aventuras Palace.  This resort is the best so far for service, food, room(we had a suite), drinks, entertainment( GREAT dinner on the beach and show) the pool is unbeatable!!!  Huge beach some seaweed, so what it's an Island!  There is plenty of shade on the beach, by the pool as well under huts.  The horseback riding was ok considering where you are at.  This is not Europe or the States, off the property it's very poor as every other all inclusive we've been to.  We like to relax, swim, eat drink Sun and enjoy good service, this place has all that.  I would go back in a heart beat, enjoy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: eeh3
reviews.title: disregard negative reviews
reviews.text:
i am a "cup half full" person...typical skeptic.   some of the reviews on this site had me very concerned about my pre-paid commitment to this resort.   all those concerns went out the window after the first day.   this resort is beautiful, well-kept and if you offer the least amount of courtesy to the staff your stay will be unsurpassed.   some advice i followed from other reviews that went well...bring some ones...enough to drop about $15 a day.   in the big scheme of things this is nothing...i know what you are thinking..."i am paying $500 a day!".   if you tip your waiters, especially in the main restaurant/buffet, your service will become amazing.   the people are very helpful, polite, kind and hard-working.   with a little appreciation you will be paid back in kind.   another point for parents bringing children...your kids are not that wonderful to the rest of us.   keep in mind we are paying $500 a day for our vacations please...we are here for relaxation and peace and quiet.   my mistake may have been going during spring break...i was surprised to learn that kids from other countries than the US were just as unruly and undisciplined than americans.   nonetheless, as unpleasant as some people's kids were, this experience was still wonderful.

don't worry about anything here...if you cannot have a pleasant time here..it may not be possible.

reviews.author: Toneup
reviews.title: Resort beautiful, Cocatal golf course needs to get a clue.
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, No complaints about the Palma Real. I would definatly go back. 

The Golf course is managed and run poorly.
We had tee times at 7:30 4 days last week. There is nothing worse than the 2 women working the front desk to be as rude and unfriendly as they were. The one needs to find a new job.
On yes I forgot to mention bring water from your resort or buy water from the caddies before you start playing. They only have 1 beverage cart for 27 holes and we saw him once per round. Totally unexcepable! Make sure you bring enough golf balls. Not that the course is tough but I bought 2 sleeves of balls for $40.00 and a bag of crappy tees for $5.00. 

The course is in great shape.

reviews.author: fleurdelune
reviews.title: Le vrai Paradis sur terre
reviews.text:
Nous revenons tout juste du Paradisus Palma Réal.C'est le paradis sur terre, la mer , la plage, le soleil, les 7 restos à la carte, sont disponible tous les soirs avec un décor et une ambiance hors du commun. Les employés de cette hotel sont tous très gentils et serviables.Le confort et le luxe des chambres ne sont pas à négliger . De luxueux jardins entourent l'hotel ainsi que des fontaines d'eaux et des flamants roses. Un endroit merveilleux à découvrir à Punta Cana.
P.S. J'ai de la difficulté à revenir sur terre............

reviews.author: TeresaTennessee
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Friendly people.
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Palma Real on Apr. 11-15, 2007.  This was
not the first all-inclusive we have visited but it was one of the best.
We did not pay for the Royal Service and everything was great.  
Our room was beautiful with a sitting room, king size bed, large 
bathroom with a huge jacuzzi tub, separate shower, flat screen 
TV, stereo, safe, ironing board & iron and a mini bar.  The mini
bar was always kept stocked with plenty of soft drinks, beer &
water.  There was water in the bathroom to use for brushing your
teeth (They tell you not to drink the tap water).  The bed was very comfortable.  The food was good with buffets for breakfast and lunch.  The other restaurants for dinner was great.  Passions was our favorite with the lobster being a great choice.  We did not
have time to eat at Bana, but other people we met said it was great.  The bars were all good.  Everyone was very friendly, the 
grounds were immaculate w/ lots of shade on the beach.  Not 
alot of shopping, some shops on the beach past the resorts 
where you can bargain for t-shirts, etc.   There is a new shopping
plaza at the main entrance to the resort but there were only  about
10 shops open so far.  They are building a Hard Rock Cafe there
and had already opened the gift shop.  We took 2 excursions:
Marinarium  (great crew but too many people trying to snorkle)
& Outback Safari (great trip, would do this again - bought great
coffee  & cocoa on this trip - cheap too).

reviews.author: sredish
reviews.title: Going home was sooo depressing!
reviews.text:
Just a background:  we have traveled quite a bit for being 29 and 30.  Hawaii, St. Lucia, an Alaskan cruise and to several other popular US destinations.  We know what we like, and know what we don't.

We had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus April 11 - 15th.  We were given the trip through a supplier of ours as a 'thank you', and they reserved us a Royal Service suite.  I know that we didn't actually pay for the RS upgrade, but I did find it well worth it.  I very much enjoyed the private pool and private beach - no kiddo's allowed.  We have two of our own, and as much as we adore them - we do enjoy our time without them!  

Note to men:  It doesn't matter if you have the hairless, sculpted swimmers body of Gary Hall, Jr. (which you don't), you just don't look good in a Speedo.  Not even the boxer brief style.  And while we're at it - stear clear of he-capri's, as well.

Note to women:  Not everyone wants to watch you prance around without your bikini top.  Especially if you're over 50.  Although it did give me all the reason I needed to look into getting the girls lifted when I get a little older.

We were checked in at the Royal Suite lounge with our entire group and it was very efficient.  We were shown our room and about 15 minutes later our bags followed.  We reserved a king bed and were mistakenly given two queens, which they pushed together for us as there were no kings available at that time.  They re-made up the sheets so you couldn't see or feel the joint.  No problem at all, we just had one GIANT bed!  I never sleep dead in the middle of our bed anyway, so it was no problem for us.  The beds were extremely comfortable, my husband remarked that he woke up without any back pain each morning.  That's a big thing for him, he's had a few injuries and he really notices a comfy mattress.  

The food was very good!  We read many reviews and stayed away from the buffet, but I really don't enjoy buffet's anyway.  It was nice to go sit down in Vento for an air conditioned, quiet breakfast.  We ate at Vento, Bana, and our favorite, Gabi Beach (which is free for Royal Service guests and a MUST).  Never had a bad meal, but Bana was my least favorite.  To give it credit, we ate with our entire group and the menu was a set family style, so I probably would not have chosen what was served to me had we been on our own.  The service is slow - especially compared to the service we are used to here at home.  But why hurry?  You are on vacation!!  We also enjoyed the nice little snacks and goodies that they set out all day long at the Royal Service lounge.  Very plush and quiet.  We came every evening around five to get out of the sun and have a little snack, as we were eating dinner around nine every evening.  We made reservations with our butler, Maria, every afternoon and we never had to wait for one single table.  I don't really understand why people complain about having to make a reservation - we do it all the time at home.  We used room service once for breakfast and it was delivered on time.

We found the beach beautiful, the pool water a perfect temperature, and the drinks fantastic.  We had the same bali bed reserved every morning for us and we did nothing but loung  and be waited on all day long by the beach waiters.  Order up a Miami Vice...yum!  

The casino was brutal - lost $70 in about four and a half minutes.  

The gift shop was EXPENSIVE!  $19 for a small bottle of Coppertone!!  Ouch!  Just walk out to the ocean, make a right, and you'll be at a great little beach marked with all kinds of local goodies, bobbles, and art in about ten minutes.  Much cheaper!  Of course, bargain your prices down!

The grounds were magnificent, the room was beautiful and very clean.  I can't really think of a single thing to complain about. Except having to come home.   (And the hairy Speedo men)

reviews.author: funvun
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus from 4/10-4/15.
Had a wonderful time. We had an oceanview suite with jacuzzi.
It really wasn't an ocean view,but it was closer to the pool and beach areas. I think only the Royal Service suites have real ocean views. The hotel is beautiful. Service was pretty good.
No problems.
Some tips before u go.
Food: For same day reservations, call before 2:00 pm.
           For next night reservations, call between 6-10.
           Vento was the best, then Passions,then Market Grill,then 
           Bana. Vento fills up real fast/so call early. Food was  
           surprisingly  good.
Lights are a little complicated. There is a main switch by the bed.
It took us a little while to figure it out.
Went horseback riding. Takes about 30-40 minutes to get to the ranch. The ride is very bumpy. So if u get car sick easily, ask to ride in the front with the driver. Be sure to tip though. The horses were half-dead. They had no spirit at all except for one that kept kicking whomever was too close to its backside. There were no instructions on controlling the horses.So for first time riders,beware. They also make u put on a helmet for safety reasons;it was kinda gross(pick out the helmet with the least amount of hair).
Also went kayaking. No instructions here either. They just put u on the kayak, and u are on your own.
Had fun though.
The sun is very strong. Be careful. Put on lots of sunblock.
Even with SPF 30, I still got a little burnt.
One small complaint: we ordered a water/Coke from the beach waitress. Never got it.
Casino: Very small. The dealers are not that friendly. Very businesslike. I think they train them to be that way.
Nightlife: one club that played American music. Very disappointing. Thought they would play Spanish music.
Got bitten a lot. However, did not see any mosquitoes. Probably sand flies. 
Water in back of the hotel is full of seaweed. However, if u walk a couple of meters either way, the water is beautiful. Very warm.
We took daily walks. We were bombarded with "salespeople".

Overall, had a great time. Still waiting for that Coke......

reviews.author: diciembre
reviews.title: Maravilloso Hotel
reviews.text:
He estado hace muy poco en este hotel, para ser mas exacta del 31 de Marzo al 9 de Abril de 2007, fuimos 2 parejas, lo que si puedo decir es que es un Hotel realmente maravilloso, tiene de todo y para todos los gustos. Nosotros estuvimos en el Servicio Royal (bastante tranquilo), pero tienes tu playa privada,y ademas bastante relajado con unas hamacas increibles de grandes y como no, unas palapas......que....que os voy a decir..mayordomo...servicio de bar...atencion de todas las personas que trabajan en ese hotel , como por ejemplo.....Miguel (nuestro mayordomo). Pedro, el que estaba en el chiringuito....encantador, todos los dias era un chiste y unas cuantas risas. Un beso para todos
Admas tiene una zona que es para familias con niños, muy bien pensado, tambien con su propia piscina y luego hay otra que es la piscina central.....enorrrme.
    L decoracion del hotel, preciosa, sobre todo ese olor a incienso.......los restaurantes, a parte del bufet, muy buenos, sobre todo el Pasion, el Vento y el Gabi. Nunca habia estado en Punta Cana pero para ser la 1ª vez, repetiria.  Un besazo a todas esas personas que nos hicieron pasar una semana a lo grande.

reviews.author: TravelBecky
reviews.title: Loved the Palma Real
reviews.text:
We just returned yesterda from nine days in Punta Cana at the Paradisius Palma Real.  I read many reviews prior to the trip, which were mixed, so I was anxious about seeing the resort myself.

We had a great trip.  The resort and property itself were drop dead gorgeous.  Everything was beautifully decorated and the whole thing was new, clean and filled with many outdoor rooms.  The gardens, which were all around, were gorgeous too.  We loved our room.  The weather was amazing every single day.  We were also amazed that the resort was sold out while we were there, but never seemed crowded!

If you're a pool person, you'll love it here.  There are three pools, and the main pool is huge and varied with different places to go.  We prefer the beach.  Both had alot of covered areas with the covered hut/cabanas.  We are divers though, and were disappointed to find out the reef on the beach was dead.  So the diving and snorkeling was not very interesting at all.  The seaweed was also prevalant and the waters stirred up.      

We found the service to be excellent and friendly 95% of the time.  All of the help is local and most knew little english, but we seemed to work around this.  The food was mixed, as many other reviews have said.  We found the breakfast and lunch  buffets to be great.  I would choose the freshly made things rather than buffet items (eg fajitas, stir fry, etc).  The dinners were mixed.  Passions is definately the best restaurant, but it is adults only (we went one night without our kids).  The other one we liked was the hibachi side of Bana (like a Benihanas).  Vento was alright.  We thought the dinners at the Market Grill and Gabi Beach were not good at all.

The only activity we did was to go deep sea fishing.  We caught a 6 foot marlin, which was the highlight of my 8 year old son's trip!  We heard mixed reviews on the other acitivities, and elected to relax at the beach or pool for the rest of the time.  There were also entertainment things going on every night at the resort, and I think many were good.  We had younger kids though so didin't make it to most.

We'd recommend this resort if you're looking for a relaxing vacation and a beautiful place and you're comfortable staying in your resort most of the trip.

reviews.author: misshawaiintropic
reviews.title: what are you complaining about????
reviews.text:
To begin, my fiance and I are 26 and 27 years old. I am a travel agent and get to take alot of trips to all-inclusive hotels.  I've been to about every Caribbean Island at least once, and have been to all of the tourist areas in Mexico as well.  Without a doubt, this was the BEST hotel I've ever seen!!

I just can't figure out what the complaints on this site are coming from.  

The property: breathtaking!  This place is amazing.  The second you set foot in the lobby you get a beautiful view of the ocean.  The decor of the place is ultra-modern.  Very cool, calm colors everywhere just make it so realaxing and comfortable feeling.  The rooms were emaculate along with everywhere else.  Room is huge with a large balcony, sitting area, and a jacuzzi you could really fit 4 people in if you wanted to.  There is a separate shower with jets spraying from all different directions.  The grounds are so lush and pretty, kept up really well.  There are little garden areas where you could walk around so peacefully, and there are even bali beds in little areas with ponds and flowers everywhere. 
Yes, the beach has seaweed on it.  Suprise!! It's a Beach, why wouldn't there be seaweed??? THey have very hard-working men scaling it daily removing it just to do it all over again in the morning.  

The service:  Okay so unless they've gotten an entirely new staff very recently, the comments about them not speaking English is just crazy.  I did not have one problem communicating with anyone.  My boyfriend had multiple conversations with multiple bartenders/servers about sports, etc.  They are fluent!  Check in was a breeze, took 5 minutes at the most, and the front desk staff were extremely friendly.  Another comment on the bartenders, they all went above and beyond on being helpful / friendly.  The recognized us from a mile away and greeted us by name daily.  Lobby bar~Hector and Jeffri are awesome, and really impressive bottle spinning!! All of the guys at the swim-up bar are the best too.  

The food:  Okay, I am the world's pickiest eater, and always pack tons of snacks when going to all-inclusives.  In my experience, I have had very, very few all-inclusive experiences where I enjoyed a meal.  The food here is gormet all the way.  We ate at Passions, Bana, and Vento... all of which were delicious, with great and fast service.  All of the restaurants are beautifully decorated, and the Bana experience is very fun with the show-cooking hibache grills. 

We golfed one day which was terrific.  The Cocotal Golf Course is beautiful and well taken care of.  The shuttle service to get there was on time and went as planned. 

The entertainment was good, not cheesy like most places.  The disco is really cool looking and has good music but never packed.

I won't run on forever, but like I said this is THE best place I've been to.  My fiance and I have thought long and hard to think of something that we could potentially be dissapointed about and there is nothing!  For those of you reading these bad reviews nervously don't worry.  Unless you are completely impossible to please, you will be happy you picked this place.  It is the nicest on the island.

reviews.author: lesliesusan
reviews.title: hotel is great, spa was not!
reviews.text: We were impressed by the beauty of the paradisius palma real. It was a beautiful resort and run very well. The food, for an all inclusive was good overall, with the exception of Bana. We had the royal service which i would definitely recommend; the staff was very friendly and helpful...we did tip them all week. the beach was beautiful and overall this was a lovely vacation. The one exception for me was the spa. There was a mix up in my reservation time which was ok with me. What was not ok was the poor way i was treated by the spa staff. They did not speak english very well which contributed to my problem..no smiles, no offer to reschedule. When i came back for a massage another day, i was taken to the relaxing room, then taken for my massage. The massage was fine, but there was no music playing in my room and i could hear all of the noises from the pool. it was not relaxing at all! Then, instead of being returned to the relaxing room i was shown to the stairs.The changing room and shower area was too small and the shower was not cleaned between. When i was there, there were 3 women all using the shower one after another, no cleaning. ick! I later found out there is a separate water area with jacuzzi, steam, etc. I was not shown this at all! The spa staff was clearly angry that i had complained about my earlier treatment and took it out on me. After my return home I wrote to solmelia to talk about my poor spa experience and after a short note back to me only addressing the mistake in my earlier reservation I realize they just don't get it..i thought they should have refunded the money i spent on the massage.So, the bottom line is...the resort is lovely, but my spa experience was terrible. Note: my friend had a facial and said it was very rough. The spa needs to be improved dramatically !!!!!

reviews.author: VWLTM
reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text:
